krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam /thog ma'i gleng slong ba'i mchid/der ya nga spyi lo dus rabs brgyad pa'i phyed phyi ma tsam tsha / gangs can sa la'i sman ljongs su nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sde'i thog ma bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug 'a ga khang gis mtshan pa'i bod brgyud nang dgon gyi dbu brnyes pa nas bzung ste/ bod yig ka ma da sum cur brten pa'i ma do rgyud gnyis dang bye brag thun mong rig gnas kyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus shing / de la de ma tshung‘ ga kyi 'grig bca' yig dang bcas pa yo ngas su rdzogs pa la brten nas bstan pa bla nas bla lhag tu 'phel/ bong khams kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar/ ma/ rig pa'i nu na pa dwangs/ de nas mi 'o stong phrag lhag gi lo rgyus kyi phreng thig tu/ bod brgyud nang ba'i bsta na pa la chags 'jig dang 'phel 'grib ma nga du byung na'ang /bsta na pa rang ngos kyi grub ma tha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dge ma/tshan gyis nyam sa pa dang rgud pa phar zad/ de la sa ldo ga ste ri rab las dpangs ma tho zhing rgya mtsho la sa kyang gting zab pas sa ngas rgyas bstan pa'i 'od snang gis phyogs ba'i ma tshams brgyad du gas la bar gyur/ de yang bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun la rag las pas skyes chen dam pa rabs dang rim pa mang pos dka' ba brgya phrag mang bo khyad du bsad pa'i bka' drin gyis bstan pa skyong ba'i dgon sde mang du spel/ bod mi yongs kyi dang ba chos la drangs pa ma zad/ rgya rmi rigs dang bcas pa'i so ga po/ yu gur/ 'jang / hor sogs mi rigs du ma dang yul gru chen por bstan pa'i nyi ma shar bar gyur/ mi lo sto nga phrag gcig gi ring la mdo dbus khams gsum ste bod chol kha gsum gyi ljo ngas dang so ga po'i yu/la gru khor mo lug dang rgya'i yul gru mi nyung bar bstan pa'i sde che phra khri phrag gi grangs las brgal ba btab pa'i bka' drin gyis/ dgon pa zhes pa chos lugs kyi sde gcig pu ma yin par/ rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud dang bcas pa'i thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang slob gso skyong ba'i sde'ang yin pas/ mi rigs sa khul gyi dpe mdzod gtsug lag gi sde'am/ rin po che'i dkor mdzod kyang yin pas/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dang rin thang bral ba'i 'bras bu 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa la nus pa gzhan gyis theg mi nus pa — 1 —

thog ma'i gleng slong ba'i mchid/mngon pa'i bka' drin gyis/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig pa'i lo rgyus kyi gser ri la nyi zer 'phros pa lta bu'i phyag rjes gling bzhi khyab pa thig bzhag go/ de'ang bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas babs la rtog dpyod dang nyar tshags phra zhib gnang rgyu ni deng dus kyi mkhas pa dag gi phrag tu bab pa'i 'khri ba 'bral du med pa 'ig tu sems la/ lo rgyus kyi ngos su grags pa dang phyag rjes che ba'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sder srung skyob dang bed spyod legs par btang na/ mi rigs sa khul gyi spyi tshogs zhi mthun dang 'dzugs skrun so/gas gang cir sman la/ mi rigs so so phan tshun bar gyi mdza' mthun dang rig gnas rjes res sogs la'ang de bas kyang sman pas don snying shin tu nas kyang che bar mngon no/ /tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi thugs skyong dang gzab skyor gyi bka' drin las/ dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba tsa na/ rlabs che ba'i rgyal gces ring lugs pa/ kun gzigs7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba chen po nas bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag cha tshang ba zhig sgrig thub byung na zhes pa'i gsung lung phebs pa la brten/ krung go bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gi zhib 'jug khang gis sne drangs thog bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ gan su'u/ yun nan te zhing ljongs lngar dkar chag rtsom 'bri u yon lhan khang btsugs te/ mkhas pa mi nyung ba rtsa 'dzugs byas shing dkar chag gi sa bon 'tshol sdud dang mnyam du bgyi ba chen po 'di nyid kyi dbu btsugs/ de la'ang rim pa khag gi tang u dang srid gzhung gi thugs khur dang rgyab skyor thob pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen du ma la brten nas bde blag gi ngang du 'grub pa'i snga ltas legs so/ /kun su 'u zhes bya ba'i yul gru chen po 'dir dus yun ring po'i lo rgyus mchis pa dang ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rig gnas dar khyab che la/ mi lo stong phrag ring po'i tshun chad du blo rig gsal zhing las la ha cang brtson pa'i mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams kyis phul byung gi rig gnas dang rang stobs rang gis spel ba'i gan su'u snying stobs bya ba 'di nyid gsar spel gnang byung bas/ 'dzam gling kun tu mtshan snyan grags shin tu che ba'i tun hong brag phug chen mo dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gling gis mtshon pa'i kun su'u rig gnas yongs kyi gtsug rgyan yin par gyur/ de bas rgyal khab phyi nang kun gyis gzengs bstod gang mang gnang ba thob/ de yang gan lho bod khul gyi tsho sde yod sar nang ba'i bstan pa'i dgon sde brgya phrag las brgal ba bzhugs yod pas mi rigs rig gnas kyi rgyan zhig tu gyur 'dug lo rgyus thog nas kun su'u yul gru chen po — 2 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'dir bod brgyud nang ba'i dgon sde stong phrag las brgal ba chags byung la thang rgyal skabs su tun hong brag phug tu bod kyi brag phug bcu phrag mang po bzhugs yod la/ mi nyag dus su kwa ju'i yul lung brag phug tu lha sku stong bzhengs pa dang / yon rgyal rabs 'go tsam du lang ju sde ba'i dang co ne dgon chen la sogs btab pa nas tā ming rgyal rabs dang chen rgyal rabs skabs su kun su'u yul gru chen por bod brgyud nang ba'i dgon sde ha cang mang po btab byung / khyad par du spyi lo1709lor bod brgyud nang ba'i dgon chen te bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gling chags pa nas nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyis 'gro ba thams cad bde bar bkod pa dang rgyal khams la gces spras mdzad pa'i dgongs pa mngon pa dang chab gcig tu/ mi rigs nang phyogs kyi mthun sgril dang mi rigs sa khul gyi bde 'jags/ rigs so so'i mi dmangs mang tshogs bar gyi mdza' mthun dang bcas par thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa bton pa'am phan thogs chen po gang mang bzhag 'dug lo rgyus las mched pa'i rin thang can gyi rig rdzas gang mang ni rin chen nor bu yin pas myur skyob dang srung skyong byed dgos pa ni lo rgyus kyis gnang ba'i 'gan 'khri gal chen zhig red/ de la 'dir nged cag bod brgyud nang ba'i dgon sde so sor bzhugs pa'i bka' bstan dang bcas pa'i dpe gzhung po ti khri 'bum las brgal pa/ thang ga dang lha sku sna tshogs grangs kyis mi long ba/ dgon pa'i 'dzugs skrun dag la zhib 'jug gi rin thang shin tu che/ 'di nyid ni lo rgyus kyis rjes rabs pa rnams la gnang ba'i rin po che yin pas/ cis kyang srung skyob spel bar byed pa gal che'o/ /skal ba bzang po ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su lo rgyus kyi gzhung gang mang rtsom sgrig byas te rjes rabs pa rnams la skul 'ded gtong ba ni krung hwa mi rigs kyi srol rgyun bzang po 'ig red/ 'ing chen yongs kyi bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i gdan rabs dkar chag zhib dpyod bgyis thog go rim thar chags su bsgrigs te glegs bam/ du spel rgyu ni lo rgyus kyi 'gan khur yin pa ma zad/ mi dmangs kyi re 'dun dang /sa gnas so so'i rig gnas bya ba'i 'khri ba'ang yin pas / tang dang rgyal khab kyi mi rigs srid jus dang rig gnas srid jus la'ang yongs su mthun no/ /krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam gyi rtsom 'bri'i cha la/ krung gung kun su'u 'ing chen u yon lhan khang dang zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rgyab skyor chen po thob/ rtsom 'bri'i 'go rtsom pa na zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig sgril pu'u yis las de gtsugs su bzung ste rtsom gyi sa bon 'tshol sdud kyi ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen yang sbyar/ rtsom 'bri u yon lhan tshogs kyis rtsom 'bri mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang sbyong brdar byas thog dkar chag rtsom 'bri'i rtsa gnad ltar — 3 —

thog ma'i gleng slong ba'i mchid/legs par bris / lo ngo bcu lhag gi ring du kun su'u mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa chen mo'i yon krang gzhon pa'am slob dpon chen mo kha gya'i klu tshang rdo rje rin chen nam yang na rdor phrug gtsos pa'i mgon po dbang rgyal/dpa' ris pa skal bzang don grub/ chos 'dzin bcas kyis rang 'ing sa gnas so so nas dgon che phra bzhi brgya drug cu re gsum la dri gtug dngos kyi sgo nas lo rgyus dang da babs kyi gnas tshul gang shes dang ci go yi se'i lam/ du spe' / rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis dkar chag gi rtsom 'bri'i cha nas tshan rig dang ma/thun zhes brjod rigs/ par sems la/ gong du drangs pa'i rtsom 'bri ba 'di bzhi ga dgon sde'i dkar chag 'ib 'jug byed pa la cha rgyus ha cang che 'ing chu tshad kyang nges can 'ig yod nges la/ rtsom gyi rgyu cha khungs btsun pa/brjod bya'i don gsal ba/ rjod byed tshig dag pa sogs kyi dge mtshan dang ldan pas/ lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan la zhib 'jug gi rin thang yod pa'i bod rig pa dang chos 'u gas rig pa'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom zhig tu nges/da ltar rtsom 'di'i mjug re zhig rdzogs shing dpar skrun gyi rim pa la nye ba'i skabs 'dir/ nged kyis kun gzigs chen po'i thugs bskyed dang re smon ma tha' klas pa las chu thigs tsam zhig 'grub pa'i 'dun pa re zhig rdzogs pa dang / skya ser mang tshogs kyi re ba tsam bskangs thub pa byung ba ni/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang dus rabs bzang bo'i bka' drin nyag cig la reg las pas/ nga tsho'i mes rgyal la stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas shing / 'bangs la bde skyid ldan la/ spyi tshogs zhi mthun yong ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar smon pa dang mnyam du/ nged rang glegs bam 'di'i gtso sgrig yin pa'i ngos nas rtsom 'bri ba tshang ma'i tshab byas te glegs bam 'di krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo ngo drug cu 'khor ba'i legs skyes su phul ba dge legs 'phel/ / / /zhes blo bzang lhun grub rdo rjes sbyi lo zla ches la/2 0 0kha kha 1 5

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/༄༄/ / kan lho bod rigs nang skyong khul/bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bla brang dgon pa dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling /bla brang dgon pa dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis kun nas 'khyil ba'i gling ngam dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu(zhwa ho)rdzong gi rdzong nub 'gram du chags/ bod yul nang bstan dge lugs pa'i chos sde chen po drug gi ya gyal rgyal yongs kyi gnad sa'i rig rdzas srung skyob sde khag ang gnyis pa'i skor yin no/ /le'u dang bo/ dgon pa ji ltar btab pa dang grub mtha' spel ba'i skor/1 dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad tshul/ spyir bkra shis 'khyil ba(a mdo bkra shis sgo mang yang zer)ma btab pa'i snga rol yul phyogs 'di/ rgya nag gi chin byang ma'i dus su bod kyi rus khongs su gtogs nub khrom('chang)gyi sa khongs yin pa dang / han rgyal rabs su cin khrin(gser grong / da lta'i lan ju)con las sa cha yin na'ang phyis su han phyi mas gser grong con dor nas lung nub con khongs su bsgyur/ rgyal khab gsum gyi dus su we phyogs brtsis pa dang cin nub ma'i skabs su leng kru'u sde bzhi'i khongs su bcos zer/ cin nub ma'i rjes su zhan phe'i 'a zha nub bskyod las ka jur(༈sto༅ h+phu han)dbang / de rjes cin shar ma'i dus shig slar brag dkar rdzong du gtogs bcug 'a zha'i rigs bskrad phyin ka ju'i khongs su 'du ba dang phyis su shar tsong kha rgyal bo'i mnga' dbang bsgyur mdzad/ rgyal rgyud de bsnubs phyin ka jur dbang ba dang mi nyag rgyal bos yun ring bzung mthar/ slar yon dus bod kyis yul gru bdag tu bzung zhing zhon we hri zir(zosmra//grotha)bsgyur gshis mnga' khongs sngar las rgya bskyed byung skad/ min dus ka ju srung khongs zhi yon zhin tu'o(yozoskorta.oṃ)bkod 'doms las khungs su gtogs skad/ (gong gsal lo rgyus rgya yig tu snang yang mu mthud zhib 'jug bya rin yod par bsams/)chin rgyal chan lung lo nyer bdun par ya rdzi rdzong ngam thin(༈ṣ+ṭha4shuṭha)tshugs shing kha gya tsho drug bcas par shog pa ni ya rdzi dang ka ju phyogs zung gis spel bar bsnyegs kyang / bkra shis 'khyil ba ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug tsam nas dar rgyas mgyogs shing chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs su 'gyur gshis bla sprul dang mkhas btsun mang bo'i 'bad 'bungs las dgon lag sogs 'brel zab brgya lhag brgal pa dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs khri phrag longs shing / yul de dag tu sku tshab dang 'go ba — 1 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/mngags srol btsugs/ chin rgyal gong ma'i sa gnas srid 'dzin las khungs nus nyams su btang / krung hwa mi ser rgyal khab tshugs phyin da dung srid 'dzin ya rdzi'i mnga' 'og bgyis kyang spyi lo1kha27lo ste rab byung bco lnga ba'i me yos la gan su'u zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs su bsgyur cing rab rgyal me yos lor bla brang rgyun skyong cus btsugs pa dang phyi lor zhwa ho (bsang chu)rdzong du bcos pa da lta'i bar rgyun 'khyongs mod/ 'on kyang mnga' khongs mi ser gyi chos dad kha phyogs gna' srol lta ra bod dbus gdan sa chen por 'khor zhing mchod yon gyi 'brel ba shin tu gting zab po/ /da ni brjod gzhi dngos mdo smad chos 'byung sogs su bkod pa mdo tsam gleng na/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang bo (1648da wa1721)dgung lo nga dgu'i steng ste me phag lo zur bzhugs kyis pha bong kha'i(bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos lha gdan gtsug lag khang phyag ma btab gong skyid chu'i klung thag gi nub byang dbus su gsar rgyag mdzad pa'i sgrub gnas shig)gdan sa pa mdzad/ dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa 'dul kyang 'di nas gnang / thugs bskyed dus bab dang dpon ju nang gis gdan 'dren mtshams sbyor bzhin sa glang la mdo smad du byon/ rtse gzhung lbang gi arge'i steng nas dgun bzhugs mdzad/ bu slob kha shas btang ste gnyan rje gong sngon(da lta'i a mchog zhang khongs)gyi ri zhol du bkra shis gso sbyong sa brtag bslangs shis brjod bcas gnang nas da co/na pa 'debs rgyu'i skar 'dzin mdzad/ dpon ju nang yum sras bcas lhan rgyas chibs bsgyur mdzad pa sa zlar bkra shis 'khyil du 'byor/ rkang tsha'i nang so dang kha gya'i be hu gnyis kyis dgon sa phul pa sa dpyad legs shing lung bstan gyi gnas su dgongs bzhin dgon pa 'debs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ rkang tsha ba rnams kyis grwa ba lnga phul pa la lnga sde btags/ dgon mthil du chu mig dang sbrul mang bo 'dug pa la klu gnas spo ba'i cho ga dang sa brtag bslangs/ bum gter sba ba sogs mdzad/ sa glang lo nas chos spyod ma chag pa mdzad cing rab 'byams pa grags pa la brtsi bzhag gtong bcug ste rten 'brel bsgrigs/lcags stag lor dpon ju nang dang rnam rgyal tshe brtan so so nas grwa ba brgya re/ mkhan po no mon han dang erge dā'i ching gnyis nas grwa rgyun kha shas phul pas grwa ba sum brgya lhag 'dus/ dka' bcu ba ngag dbang bkra shis(bse sku phreng dang bo)tshogs chen dge bshul dang / dpa' ris ngag dbang mkhas mchog tshogs chen dbu mdzad du bskos/ dpon tshang nas grwa tshogs brgyad brgya shong ba'i phying gur gru bzhi phul pa tshogs gur byas/tshogs chen gyi 'grig lam 'bras spungs dang chos grwa'i byed sgo sgo mang ltar bgyis shing / rten 'brel du dgongs nas dus ba'i'i chos grwa tshogs sa bzhi mdzad de re rer gter sbas/ lcags yos lo'i bdun pa rjes ma'i tshes bcu gsum la dgon pa gsar bzhengs grub pa'i rab gnas ngo mtshar ba gnang / rje nyid nas kyang gdan khri'i bdag mdzad pa na dgung lo don bzhi ba lcags glang(spyi lo1721lo)la gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa chos dbyings su gshegs/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi lugs bzang skyong ba'i rkang btsugs so/ /ju nang dpon pos kha gya tsho drug la shing cha 'dren bcug chos 'khor/ zam tsha/ rong tsho chen bco brgyad/ rong — 2 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/—bo yar nang mar nang / rdo sbis/ bis mdo/ rnga ba/ ra mdo/ tsha kho sogs nas u lag pa bsdus te 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu dri gtsang khang bcas pa bzhengs/ rtse dbal gyi gzhung nas sa cha 'ga' zhig ra mdo dud khag lnga brgya/ mkhan po no mon han nas zho 'phong dpyi/ erti ni tha'e jus mthe bo gza' ru sogs mchod gzhis su phul/ ma kha lha bzos shog ris chos rgyal sogs bzhengs/ de nas khong 'debs po'i rgyud smad pa grwa tshang tshugs/ sman pa'i 'du khang bzhengs kyang grwa btsun zhal nyi shu tsam las mi bzhugs pa na grwa tshang du ma 'phar/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i ring sman pa grwatshang grub pa dang bzhi ba'i ring kyai rdor grwa tshang dang lnga ba'i rgyud stod grwa tshang tshugs/ de bzhin rab rgyal me rta lo rig gnas gsar brje las 'gul zhes pa'i nang zing bar gsar 'dzugs dang rgya bskyed brgyud de dgon par grwa tshang drug po'i 'du khang che chung drug dang de bstun rung khang dang spyi khang bcu gnyis/ lha khang nyi shu rtsa grangs/ btsan khang gsum/ bla blang tshoms chen gtsos nang khag so so'i tshoms chen dang bde yangs sum cu rtsa grangs/ nang chen gtso bo bco brgyad dang nang khag drug cu re lnga/ grwa shag lnga brgya bcu bdun/ 'khor khang khang mig chig stong lhag la chos 'khor nyis stong lhagagung thang mchod rten mthong grol chen mo gtsos pa'i phyi nang mchod rten(li ma dang shing brkos sogs 'dus)brgya go bzhi las grub pa'i zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa las mi nyung ba rig gsaradu 'jig go/2 rten dang brten pa bzhengs tshul/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil lo ngo nyis brgya nga bdun(1709da wa1966)gyi ring la mdo smad kyi nang dgon gras su dar rgyas ches mgyogs shing mkhas chen mang bo 'tshar longs byung ba'i gnas khyad par can du gyur/ dgon pa dar sgang sa khyon smi lham po khri phrag477 000longs pa'i khor yug tu 'du khang lha khang btsan khang mchod rten rung khang mang du bzhengs pa smi lham po khri phrag40zin/da lta yod med gang rung grangs su 'khod tshe/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi tshogs chen 'du khang(grwa tshang drug po'i lhan 'dzams tshogs khang / 1711lor bzhengs pa phyis su rgya bskyed)dang / smad rgyud 'du khang ( 1622lor bzhengs)/ sman pa'i 'du khang ( 1724lor bzhengs)/ dus 'khor 'du khang(1662lor bzhengs)/ kyai rdor 'du khang (1879lor bzhengs)/ rgyud stod 'du khang (1928lor bzhengs)/ de dag re re'i rung khang dang spyi khang cha 'grig bcas pa/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gser khang chen mo lnga thog tshe dga' gling (1781lor bzhengs)/ snyan grags tshang 1907lor bzhengs pa'i jo khang ba'i thog can/ bsod grags tshang 1907lor bzhengs pa'i gdugs dkar lha khang sum thog can/ khri chen zam tsha gnyis pas 1809lor bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba seṅge nga ro'i lha khang bzhi thog can/ khri chen hor tshang bar ma'i zhabs brtan lha khang / sde khri'i sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang / dbal mang ba'i 192/lor bzhengs pa'i 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang sum thog can/ rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag dpon ju nang gi spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong lha khang / ngo mtshar lha khang / bka' gdams lha khang / gnas brtan lha — 3 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/khang / dge ldan lha khang / smad sog nor bus 1914lor bskyar bzhengs rje lha khang / rgya zhabs drung gi sgrol ljang lha khang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang / bsod grags gsum pa'i mtha' ba'i grub chen lha khang lnga thog can/ bsod grags tshang seng gdong ma'i lha khang / gling tshang lha khang / khri chen hor tshang drug pa'i 1940lor bzhengs pa'i sgrol dkar lha khang / dpe mdzod lha khang / rgya nag pa'i rje gzigs pa lnga ldan lha khang / cung gar tshang jo bo'i lha khang / mkhan po tshang ltu nga bshags lha khang / sgang kha tshang rta mgrin lha khang /ga'an par khang chen mo/ ston chos chen mo/ gnas chung btsan khang / tsi dmar btsan khang / dam can btsan khang / dgon dkyil dbyen zlum mchod rten/ byang du bdud 'dul mchod rten/ nub tu dbyen zlum mchod rten/ lho ru gung thang mchod rten/ da dung thub bstan pho brang / dbyar gnas spyi khang / smon lam spyi khang / kun mkhyen gzim shag mchod khang / tshoms chen bcas ra gong 'og zhol gsum/ bsod grags gsum pa'i rigs grwa thang gnyan gyi lha khang / khyad par du gtsug lag khang de dag las gser khang chen mo ni kun mkhyen gnyis pa rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bos gtsang gi rgyang rin chen rdzong gi byams khang ltar bod rab 'dod sa sprel te spyi lo 1788lor phyag 'debs mdzad/ sa sprel lor co ne tsa kun ho thog thu er ti ne paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma dkar bos sbyor 'jags rgya chen po gnang ste gser gyi rgya phibs bskrun cing glo 'bur dang rab gsal gnyis sgo gsum sge'u khung so brgyad steng du rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor ri dwags pho mo/ zur rgyan seṅge lnga thog khyams ra yod pa/ gtso sku li ma rje btsun byams pa mthong ba don ldan 'dom brgyad rdo rje skyil krung longs sku'i cha byad can ni thub bstan yun ring gnas pa'i rten 'brel du gser zangs las bzhengs pa la 'khor nye sras brgyad/ rje tsong kha ba'i gser sku mi tshad longs pa sogs mang bo dang / steng du gser bzhengs bka' 'gyur tsan dan glegs shing can gzungs gzhug rje mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pas bstsal pa ches rten 'gangs chen du brtsis so/ /bla brang nang jo'i khang zhes pa'ang rten ches byin mtshan can yin te/ kun mkhyen sku phreng dang bo rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog gis pha yul lhags skabs su bod dbus 'bum stod kyi khyim pa zhig gis phul pa spyan drangs pa na bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rten gyi thog ma yin/ lha khang ni lha sa'i jo'i khang chen mo'i dbyibs je chung tshul du bzhengs par gser gyi rgya phibs bstod pa'i sum thog phyi nang rim gnyis phye/rten gtso shākya'i rgyal bo jo bo mthong ba don ldan gyi sku brnyan khyad 'phags can ni gna' snga mor ston pa rang sku 'tsho ba'i dus su thugs dam rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs par grags pa'i gras kyi gcig 'dod pa mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos 'bum stod du bzhugs zer/ thugs sras bse ngag dbang bkra shis pas dbu rgyan dang phreng ba phul nas mdo smad du ri bo dge lugs pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam btab/ snyan grags sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang rgya mtshos gser zangs kyis jo sku mi tshad phyin pa mchog zung bcas pa bzhengs/ gzhan rtse gzhung byams pa dang kun mkhyen dang bo'i sku brnyan/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang kha sar pa ṇi/ phyag na rdo rje/bar khyams ma ṇi 'khor lo brgya lhag bzhugs su gsol/ 1907lo rab tshes me lug la kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i — 4 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bka' bsgos bzhin snyan grags sku phreng lnga bas gser gyi rgya phibs mda' yab bcas gsar skrun mdzad do/ /gong gsal 'du khang dang lha khang sogs su sku gsung thugs rten 'byams klas pa bzhugs su gsol ba las gtso rigs kha shas 'khod tshe/ ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dbus su bzhengs pa gdan drangs pa gtso sku dang / dbus kyi jo bo rnam gnyis/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho'i thugs dam rten 'bum stod jo bo/ rgya gar lho shar dang / bal bo/ sog po/ rgya nag bcas yul nas gdan drangs pa'i gser dang / dngul/byu ru/ ba so/ tsan dan/ zangs ma dmar ser/ sman phye/ sman 'dam sogs rgyu 'gang chen las bzhengs pa'i sku dpangs khru nyer lnga nas so bdun longs pa bcu drug bal bo'i yam bu rgyal bo dang khu dbon rgyal bo/ yi langs rgyal bo'i bzo bas bzhengs pa'i byams sku nyis thog ngo mtshar ba/ khri dang sbrags pa'i sku dpangs khru bcu nas nyer lnga longs tsam sum cu so gnyis/ sku'i dpangs mi tshad dam de las mi 'da' ba nyis brgya bcu bzhi/ sku'i dpangs khru gang ma sogs stong sku tshar bcu ste sku bsdoms pas chig khri brgyad stong drug brgya brgal pa ma zad/ da dung 'jim sku (sku 'bum ) bye ba du ma dang / rgyal ba u dra ya na la skyes lan du ston pa bris sku bskur pa nas bzhengs srol mched pa ltar dgon nyid du 'tshem drubs kyi gos sku 'dom brgyad cu can gtsos gos sku dgu/ thang sku khri phrag lhag dang / logs ris sogs gyan thang chig stong brgal/ cho ga rang rang gi gzhung bstan ltar gyi mkho don du rgyu zangs ma'am gser/ tsan dan gyis bzhengs pa'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi blos bslangs bcu gnyis sogs grangs brtsis tsam las de dag re re brjod ma nus so/ /gsung gi rten la'ang dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i phyag dpe ta la'i lo mar lañja'i gzugs su bris pa bu ༷ bā li ta dang / bla brang chen mo'i nang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ rje tsong kha ba yab sras kyi gsung 'bum bcas phyag dpe chig khri nyis stong lhag thos bsam gling ba'i dpe mdzod du pota nyis khri lhag gzhan bla sprul khag dang dge 'dun btsun pa'i mchod gsol gzhung gzigs su gser dngul/ g.yu byur/ dung bcas brdar btul bye mas bris pa'am/ tshem drubs/ mtshal snag dpar bcas nyung mtha' pota 'bum phrag gcig yan bzhugs pa'i gras su da snga zhib gsal du/ gser dngul byur mu tig rag dung g.yu sna drug gi rdul las bris pa'i rdo rje gcod pa/ gos chen nag po'i steng gos ser gyis drubs pa'i bzang spyod/ kun mkhyen dang bos gser chus phyag bris gnang ba'i bskal ba bzang bo zhes bya'i mdo/ byang chub lam rim dang 'phags pa brgyad sto nga ba gser bris/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar dang bka' 'gyur dkar chag dngul bris la sogs pota424bzhugs/ lam rim gtsos pa'i 'khor chen thog so brgal pa bcu dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dpangs khru lnga yas mas can gser tshon spras pa nyis stong lnga brgya lhag de bas chung gras nyis brgya nga bzhi bcas dgon pa'i mtha' skor yongs su gtams so/ /byang phyogs so bdun dang zung 'jug mtshon byed thugs kyi rten la'ang kun mkhyen sku na rim gsum gyi gdung hril nang bzhugs can bcas sku phreng gong ma rnam lnga'i gdung rten sogs drug bum gdan yan chad gser zangs kyis brgyan pa'i mchod rten mthong grol chen mo/— 5 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/yang dgon pa'i gong 'gab bar gsum du mchod rten che ba gsum/ 'du khang dang nang chen khag tu rgyu zangs gser dang / dngul/ ra gan/ tsan dan las bskrun cing be+eḍūr+ya/ rdo rje pha lam/ margad/ pad rag sogs rin chen sna tshogs pas phra brgyan pa'i mchod rten thog phyed dang gnyis mnyam pa nas chung khru tsam pa brgya go bzhi mchis lags te/ dgon pa skabs shig shin tu phyug cing spyi 'jog rten bzhugs grangs kyis ma 'dus pa med mod thal rags tsam zhus so/ /2 dge lugs grub mtha' spel tshul/ bkra shis 'khyil bas mdo sngags zung 'brel spel lugs tshugs pas/ mdo phyogs su grwa tshang ches che ba rmad byung thos bsam gling ste mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang / sngags phyogs grwa tshang gzhan pa lnga ste rgyud stod smad gnyis dang / skar rtsis rig par rgya rtsis gtso ba'i kyai rdor grwa tshang / bod rtsis gtso ba'i dus 'khor grwa tshang / bod kyi gso rig spel ba'i sman pa grwa tshang ste drug tshugs pa rang rang chos spyod 'chad nyan sgom sgrub lam lugs 'thus tshang srol rgyun du dar te/ rmad byung thos bsam gling ste mtshan nyid grwa tshang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang bos sa stag1710lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin la chos sde gsar 'debs kyi thog ma'i grwa tshang yin pas srol rgyun ches ring / gsar mas mdo sngags gnyis las mdo phyogs gtso bo byed pa ste rgya gzhung ngam gzhan las gnas pa dang thos pa las mkhyen pa ni thos pa dang / thos pa'i don de rang gis lung rigs pas tshul bzhin bsams te rang stobs kyis yid la nges par byed pa ni bsam pa dang / de ltar thos shing bsams pas nges pa las the tshom chod cing yang nas yang du 'dris par bgyis pa ni sgom pa'i don 'grub par bya ba yin/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i ring rgya bskyed pa dang kun mkhyen drug pa'i ring me 'jig thebs pa bskyar du bzhengs/ grwa tshang ches dar dus btsun pa sum stong 'dus skad/da lta dge 'dun pa chig stong lnga brgya lhag 'dzoms/ skyabs mchog 'jigs med dbang bos bca' yig mdzad cing rma chen srung mar bkur/ mtshan nyid kyi sgrig lam dang smon lam gyi tshogs sogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon spyi la rags mthun/ chos grwa'i sgrig lam dang 'dod cha sogs 'bras spungs sgo mang ji bzhin bgyis/'dzin sbyong thams cad bslab rim lnga brgyud de lo bcu gsum nas bco lnga'i nang gzod rdzogs thub/ dang bo bsdus grwa bse bsdus sbyong ba la lo lngar rim pa lnga 'phar dgos te/ lo dang bor kha dog dkar dmar/ lo gnyis par kha dog gong / lo gsum par bsdus 'bring / lo bzhi bar bsdus chen te 'di yan la bsdus grwa ba zer/ lo lnga bar rtags rigs te rtags rigs dang blo rigs sbyong ba la phyogs glang gi tshad ma btus pa/chos grags kyi rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ mkhas grub rje'i ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab rje'i rnam 'grel thar lam gsal bshad/ dge 'dun grub kyi tshad ma rig rgyan sogs sbyong zhor du dbu ma 'jug pa dang mngon rtogs rgyan thugs 'dzin bya/ gnyis pa phar phyin sbyong bar lo bzhi ste lo dang bor gzhung gsar zhol dang lo gnyis par gzhung gsar gong / lo gsum par phar phyin skabs dang bo nas gsum pa/ lo bzhi bar phar phyin skabs bzhi ba nas bdun pa ste thal phreng gi rtsod pa zhogs kha dang / dgong mo/ zur bkod kun mkhyen gyi — 6 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dge 'dun nyi shu dang rten 'brel/ grangs nges/ bsam ga'igs bzhi gung tshigs su rtsod/ skabs brgyad pa ni lo re'i srod chos la mdor bsdus nas byang chub par bya/ gtso bo mngon rtogs rgyan dang rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan/ 'grel ba don gsal/ legs bshad gser phreng / phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod sogs dang 'brel yod gsung 'bum klog ci thub bya/ gal te bla sprul yin tshe phar phyin dam bca' phul phyis dgon pa'i mkhas gral lam dge slong gi gral du tshud/ gsum pa dbu ma sbyong ba la lo gnyis te lo dang bor dbu ma gsar ba/ lo gnyis par dbu ma rnying ba ste stod cha dgong zhogs dang smad cha gung tshogs su rtsod/ dus gsum rnam bzhag dang tshad 'gog gnyis srod chos la snga phyi res mos rtsod pa'i lugs spel ba la dbu ma ba zer/bslab ga'i la rigs tshogs drug las rtsa ba shes rab dang / rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad/ dbu ma'i bsdus don legs bshad sogs mang / ba'i ba mngon pa mdzod sbyong ba lo ba'i ste lo dang bor skabs dang bo nas bzhi ba/lo gnyis par skabs rjes ma bzhi/ lo gsum pa dang bzhi bar mdzod spyi bshar bar bya ba la/ mdzod rtsa dang mngon pa rang 'grel/ mdzod sdom/ ma chims blo bzang grags pa'i mchims mdzod/ mchims 'jam dbyangs pa'i mchims mdzod/ mdzod ṭīka thar lam gsal bshad/ mdzod mtha' dpyod rtsa shes ṭīka chen/dbu ma lung rigs sgron me/ dbu ma rgyas pa sogs mang po/ dgun chos la thal phreng mtshan don 'gyur phyag sogs dang zur bkol gnas gsum/ dbyar chos la thal phreng khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye sogs dang zur bkod lha'i gnas bshad sogs/ rigs grwa'i dus su thal phreng rten bcas rten mtshungs kyi dbye ba dang zur bkol bskal ba'i rnam bzhag sogs/ dpyid chos la thal phreng gnas drug pa sogs dang zur bkol gnas brgyad pa sogs/ ston chos dang bo dang gnyis par bden pa mngon rtogs bcu drug sogs dang zur bkol ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba sogs/ ston chos gsum par thal phreng lam gyi khyad chos rigs bsdus sogs dang zur bkol zad pa bcu bcas rdzogs par bya ste 'di ba'in sbyangs/ pa la mdzod pa ba zer/ lnga ba 'dul ba sbyong ba la gtso bo gtan khel lo gnyis te lo dang bo'i dgun chos la gnas nges 'byung tshul khrims/ thal phreng lnga phrug bar nas dang gso sbyong zur bkol nas sman ga'i byed pa'i bar/ lo phyi mar thal phreng slong bzed skor nas ga'i stod kyi mjug gi bar rdzogs/ zur bkol las gzhi tshugs nas zur bkol gzhi smad bcas rdzogs/mdzod 'dul gnyi ga srod chos la dus tshigs dang spyir bstan gnyis lo res mos kyis gtod par bya/ gong ltar brtsis na lo bcu bdun zin kyang gzhung phan tshun mnol bas nang nur yod/ spyir 'dul ba sbyangs nas gzhung rgya chen po'i dbus 'jug tsam las rdzogs mtha' dben yang 'dul ba bsdoms dang 'dul ba'i mtha' dpyod/ bsdus rgyud 'grel chen/ 'dul ba lung sde ba'i sogs klog bzhin nyams len gtsigs su 'dzin dgos te/ sbyangs 'bras nges can thob phyin bka' rams pa'i dam bca' 'bul dgos/ bslab rim 'di dag brgyud pa la brtson 'grus lhod med sgos rtsod pa dang klog pa/ nyams len gang rung rig pa rtse gcig tu dmar dgos pa las don med du tshogs chos nyin gcig kyang chad mi chog mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa gtso bo ni — 7 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rang rang 'dzin grwa'am bslab rim nang rtsod pa dang bzhi ba'i tshogs chen bgro gleng / bdun pa'i tshogs langs gsum brgyud cing 'dzin grwa 'phar srol rigs gsum du phye ste/ thog mar rab 'byams pa'i dam bca' phul pa la bsdus grwa dang phar phyin byang chub nas lo re'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu bdun nas drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun bar dang / zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun bar rgyugs thengs gnyis phul nas 'phrod dgos/ de nas bka' rams pa'i dam bca' la mngon pa mdzod khong chud na gzod re 'dun zhus pa ltar dam bca'i rgyugs 'bul dgos/ mtha' mar rdo rams pa'i dam bca' la zhugs par 'dzin grwa'i dge slong brgya nyi shu'i gras su tshud cing rang blos dpag thub pa dang gzhan pas khas blangs pa'i sgo nas khri pas rgyugs pa la bdams tshe gzod kun mkhyen sku mdun bcar nas rgyugs 'bul dgos/ de bzhin lo re'i nang mi gnyis res dam bca' 'jog chog pa ltar zla dang bo'i tshes bcu bdun nas nyi shu bar thengs gcig dang zla bdun pa'i tshes dgu nas bcu gsum bar gzhung po ti lnga tshogs rgyugs su 'bul dgos shing / 'dzin grwa drug pa yan chad dang dge slob rnams la dam bca'i ston mo nyin lnga bya dgos/ dam bca' grub phyin bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag tu khri bar mngags/ mtshan btags dngos sam de'i rgyu rim la smon lam rab 'byams/ gling bsres rab 'byams/ /rdo bca' rab 'byams/ tshogs bsags rab 'byams yod/ bka' poṭa lnga ste sde snod gsum gyi sdom lta bu mdo rtsa ba 'dul ba'i sdom/ dbu tshad mdzod gsum mngon pa'i sdom/ phar phyin mdo sde'i sdom bcas dam chos gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jings brgal dka' bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po thob mkhan ni shin tu dkon par gyur/ de bzhin thos bsam gling ba gtsos pa'i tshogs chen gyi chos spyod gal chen la/ lugs rnying zla dang bo'i tshes dang po'i nyin kun mkhyen bla brang tshoms chen bzhugs gral spyan sngar chung khagaspyi gnyer/ nang khag so so/ grwa tshang drug gtsos pa'i tshogs 'du/ ser skya 'dus tshogs kyis legs skyes 'bul ba/ gar phrug 'cham zhing phyag dbang zhu/ nyi 'od gzim khang steng phog tshe skyabs mchog nyid bde yangs gong du phebs nas gdan sa'i bla sprul dgung lo brgyad cu yan zin pa rnams la mdun sder dang srung mdud gnang la 'al gsung lhug par bya/ bgres po dag gis tshe sgrub bum chu 'byal/ tshes gnyis par tshogs che lha tshes rgyas par kun mkhyen gyis grwa mang la lo sar gnang ba dang chos skyong la rab gnas bya/ tshes gsum la rdo bca' thang gi dge ldan dar mo che slar 'dzugs pa dang phyi dror smon lam chen mo'i yar tshogs cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa 'bul/ smon lam skabs su skyes rabs so bzhi/ byams chos/ spyod 'jug rje rnam thar sogs gsungs shing 'grel ba/ rnam 'grel/ dbu ma/ phar phyin/ mdzod/ 'dul ba rnams grwa skor dam bca' 'jog pa dar/ tshes brgyad nyin gling ra'i khrom chen du tshogs chen zhal ngos tshogs gtam gnang ba la dge g.yog brgyad dang rnam sras rta ba brgyad kyis gling phyi nang bsrung bar bya/ sems can la tshe thar gtong /ser phreng sgos rin po che thogs nas dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir khrus gsol bya/ mdun rir gos sku bshams la/ston chos su gar phrug 'chams/ khri chen gyis bstan 'bar ma gsungs nas me tog gtor bar bya/ tshes — 8 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsum nas bcu bdun bar smon lam chen mo'i zhogs tshogs dang / gsung chos/ gung tshigs tshogs/smon lam/ dgung ja'i tshogs/ dgung ja'i dam bca' bcas thun drug re 'tshogs/ bcu gsum la gos sku chen mor mchod pa bshams/ bcu bzhi la paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi byang sham bha la'i gzigs brnyan ltar kun mkhyen gnyis pas spel ba'i 'cham chen bkra shis lhun po'i srol can/ bco lngar zhal zas rgya mtsho ma dang me tog mchod mjal/ tshe dgu nas bco lnga'i bar bla ma ma ṇi bas skya ser gyi khrod la skor lam nas blo sbyo nga rnam thar dang ma ṇi bskul bar bya/ bcu drug nyin byams pa gling skor bcas/ zla gnyis pa'i tshogs la tshes bzhi nas brgyad par kun mkhyen dang bo'i gdung mchod/ nyer gnyis la kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i gdung mchod/nyer gsum la kun mkhyen lnga ba'i gdung mchod dang kun mkhyen bzhi bas smad sog nas bslabs pa gar phrug gi 'cham dang ser phreng bcas kyis nang rten gtso rigs rtsa chen gling skor spyan 'dren/ zla gsum pa'i bco lngar dkyil 'khor thad nas gar 'cham yod/ zla ba'i ba'i tshes bco lngar sa ga zla ba'i smyung gnas/ zla drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu nas bdun pa'i bco lnga bar gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me nas btsugs pa'i bdun pa'i rigs grwa ste rab 'byams pa'i bgro gleng chen po dang gling bsres/ mgon chos bskang gso/ tshogs langs la me tog gtor ba/ rje mi la'i shwa 'cham dang seng 'cham bcas bdun pa'i nang zla phyed ring rigs grwa 'tshogs par/tshogs thebs gnyi gar dge bshes gnyis res pota lnga'i gzhung brgal brtag tshogs gleng dang mang 'gyed zho ston sogs 'bras spungs ltar bya/ da dung rten mjal/ seng 'cham/ khyi rwa skor gsum gyi 'cham/ 'don pa la mngon rtogs rgyan/ yon tan dkyil 'khor ma sogs/ sngags kyi dam bca' bcas/ zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la kun mkhyen bzhi bas spel pa'i dbus gtsang bde ba'i dgu 'cham zhes pa/ nyer bdun la kun mkhyen gsum pa'i gdung mchod/ zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod tshes nyer lnga nas nyer bdun bar rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa rjes dran smon lam du 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang dbu ma 'jug pa/ dus bzang sogs dang /'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen chos rje gsol 'debs/ spong thogs kyi 'gyed/ bca' yig klog pa kun mkhyen gnyis pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bor gdung mchod 'bul ba ma zad dgon pa'i las sne thams cad bsko 'then bya'o/ /gsang chen chos kyi rol mtsho dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang / ri bo dge lugs pa'i bstan pa spel tshul mdo sngags gnyis las sngags phyogs gtsigs su 'dzin pa ste theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang skur dang lam gyi rnam bzhag sgrub thabs dang las tshogs sogs gtsigs su 'dzin la/ grwa tshang 'di bkra shis 'khyil btab phyin me sprel lo ste spyi lo1716lor 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis dgon gcig tu mdo sngags zung 'brel spel ched lha sa'i smad rgyud bzhin gsar du btsugs/ 'grel ba dang bskyed rdzogs kyi brtsi bzhag gnang zhing bca' yig mdzad/ sde 'di'i sngags rgyud gtsang ba shes rab seṅge las brgyud cing sgrig lam sogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs rgyud smad kyi dbyangs rnga chings tshugs lugs ltar spel/ rgyud — 9 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/sde'i 'chad nyan spel pa'i dpon slob rim par bskos / chu bya 'o/(172 2)la sde khri blo bzang don grub pas 'du khang ka ba nyi shu thog bzhi can bzhengs shing / sku'i rten du jo sku dang rje sku byin can/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi snang brnyan dang / rje shes rab seṅge'i sku brnyan/ gsung rten du bka' bstan/ mdo sde bskal bzang gser bris/ thugs rten la sde khri dang bo so gas/ lam rim bla rgyud dang bde gsang 'jigs gsu ma blos bslangs bcas byin can ma nga du bzhugs/ 'chad nyan nyams len du bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang mgon chos lnga bo gtso byed cing grwa rgyun ni thog ma nas grwa sa 'dir zhugs pa'i skor dang mang shos mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'grims phyin tshur 'o ga slob gnyer la rim/ pa sasum brgyud dgos te/ dang bo ni bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga cha tshang dang mgon chos lnga'i bskang gso/ da dung rtsa ba rgyud/ ṭīk+ka'i brtsi ba'agabade mchog dang gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs sogs slob pa'i zhor la thog ma gsum rgyugs 'bul bar bya/ 'dzin grwa bar ma nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug dang / sbyin sreg rgyud gzhung / 'jigs gsang sgrub ma/chod/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid/ gar thig dbyangs gsu ma/ rab gnas/gtor ma// 'khor lo sogs mang bo bklags mthar rdu' tshon 'debs pa dang / 'grel ba ba'i zi gas/chos spyod brgyad cu bcas thugs rgyugs 'bul bar bya/ 'dzin grwa gong ma 'i skabs su bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi dgongs pa bsgrub dgos shing / 'o re'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas nyer gcig bar gas nga sngags lugs ba'in rtsod pa brgyud de sngags rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog dgos/ srung ma dam can bkur cing / grwa btsun thun mong gis kyang rje tsong kha ba'i sngags rim chen mo ga'i bzhag sgos chos spyod 'di dag spel/lo re'i zla gsum pa'i tshes bco brgyad nas nyer ba'i bar bde mchog sgrub mchod dang / zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nas drug bar baje gsang 'jigs gsu ma gyi sgrub rim bzhin rab gnas chen mo 'tshogs/ zla dgu ba'i tshes bco brgyad nas zla bcu ba'i tshes gnyis bar gyi nyin du mar gsang 'dus dang 'jigs byed bdag 'jugamagon chos gnyi ga'i 'don rta dbyangs tshugs / da dung lo re'i dus chos skabs su sbyin sreg sogs sna mang spel/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i ya ra sngo na grwa grangs nyis brgya lhag dang da snga zhal brgya dang bcu phrag gsum 'dus pa'i skabs so/ /e waṃ chos 'khor gling ngam dus 'khor grwa tshang / chu lug ste spyi lo 1762lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi bka' bsgos dang gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi rgya khyon dang rtsig bzo ji ba'in phyag 'debs mdzad/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag thams cad phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus sbyor la 'brel bar bya/ rje nyid thog ma'i chos khrir 'khod cing dus 'khor gyi khrid dang 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi zhal 'u nga sogs gnang / kun mkhyen gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang bo'i sku brnyan/bka' 'gyur dngul bris/ zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs kyi sku gdung mchod rten sogs bzhugs su gsol/'chad nyan 'dzin skyong gi thog ma lho ba sngags rams pa blo bzang bkra shis zhes pa bskos te da bar de'i lugs — 10 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/brgyud/ de bzhin gsang sngags zab mo 'i theg pa las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rnam snang mngon byang / kun rig gsum gyi ṭīk+ka che chung dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gtsos pa'i 'jigs byed dang / mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras bcas tshogs 'don mchod bkur bla med bgyid/ de nas skar rtsis skor 'ib 'jug tu dus 'khor rtsa rgyud/ rigs ldan snying thig be+etūr+ya dkar bo/ rtsis gzhung nyin byed snang ba/phyag mdzod gsung rab kyi lo tho la so gas bslab ga'i byed pa dang / sdeb sbyo ra sum rtags/ snyan ngag yig rtsal/ rdul tshon/ 'don rta dbyangs/ gom bgros la sogs rang gi brtson 'grus dang rig pa phyogs tshul bstun nas bslab par bya/ 'dzin grwa 'phar rim gsum du phye ste/ dma' rim pas gtso bo 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang bla ma ma chod pa/ chos spyod/ ma gon chos lnga'i bskang gso/ kun rig bcas thugs rgyugs 'bul/ 'bring rim pas dus 'khor dang mngon byang / dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor/ kun rig gi dkyil 'khor/ mngon byang gi dkyil 'khor bslabs phyis thugs rgyugs 'bul/ mtho rim pas gong gsal rdzogs ma/thar rig gnas bcu bor 'jug cing lta sgom spyod gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsu ma gyi phyag las nyams len la 'bad pas chog grwa tshang gi rten gtso par+ṇa chen drug pa dpal ldan ye shes(1728da wa 178 0)kyi thugs dam rten dang 'jigs med dbang bo'i sku brnyan/ dngul gyi bka' 'gyur bris ma/ bla sprul du ma'i gdung rten bzhugs/ chos thog gal chen la zla gsum pa'i tshes drug la lha 'cham/ bcu bzhi nas nyer dru ga bar dus 'khor sgrub mchod/ bco lngar sangs rgyas kyis dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i nyin mor dus 'khor gyi 'cham/ srung ma byang blon/ lha mo gnyi ga bsten te dus gtor chag med gtong / rab rgyal sa khyi lo dge 'dun brgya bdun cu dang da lta brgya nyi shu tsam 'dzoms te 'chad nyan sgom sgrub gna' srol ltar bgyid do/ /gso rig ga'an phan gling ste sman pa grwa tshang / spyi 'o 17〈4lo ste shing 'brug la kun mkhyen gnyis pas lha sa'i lcags ri rig byed gling gi lam srol ji bzhin 'phel rgyas su btsugs shing bca' yig mdzad/ sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtshos grwa tshang rgya bskyed cing 'chad nyan gsar 'dzugs dang sgrig 'a ma so gas su spyan skyong gang legs gnang / grwa tshang nyid kyis sman bla dang mi 'khrugs pa/ rta mgrin/ sman dkar dbang gsum gyi sgrub mchod bla lhag tu 'dzin par bya ste/ sgrub sbyong du rim pa gsum phye ba la dang bo dma' rim pas skyabs 'gro dang / sgrol ljang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snying bo/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ sman chog che ba/ rtsa rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud (rgyud chen bzhi gtso bo)bcas blo thog nas rgyugs dbul/ sman gzhung gi sman sna dang nad rigs ngo 'phrod thub par bya/ gnyis pa 'bring rim pas bshad rgyud dang sman bla/ rta mgrin pad+ma dkar po/ chos spyod brgyad cu/ sman bla ring bo bcas klog 'don byang chub bgyis te ma na ngag rgyud thugs rgyugs 'bul dgos / gsum pa mtho rim du slebs tshe gso rig rgyud bzhi zhib 'jug lag len byed pa dang rje'i byang chub lam rim chen mo nyams su len/ de bzhin 'dzin grwa yongs kyis g.yu thog rnying ma'i gso rig rgyud bzhi gtsigs su khrid pa dang sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo/ shel — 11 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gong phreng la sogs bsten nas lus kyi chags tshul dang / nad yams 'byung lugs/ gso sman ngos 'dzin/sman sna sdeb sbyor/ nad mang brtag thabs/ phung 'khrug gso bcos bcas dpyis phyin pa bslabs phyin gzod lha rje mkhas grags su 'gyur/ grwa tshang rten gtsor sangs rgyas sman bla dang g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/kun mkhyen gyis gnang ba'i sgrol dkar gsung 'byon dang / mi 'khrugs pa gsung 'byon/ steng du sman bla'i pho brang / gzhan bka' bstan/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ bla kho rin po che'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten/ra skor du rgyud bzhi'i sdong 'grel dpe ris/ gso rig lus bkra'i thang ga bco brgyad / brgyad stong ba dang bskal bzang gser dngul las bris pa sogs bzhugs/ rje blo bzang 'jigs med dpon slob mdzad pa nas da ltar yang srol bzang 'khyongs / gso sman ngos 'dzin dang 'a ga len du lo re'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas bzhi ba'i bcu dgu bar dge rgan phul byung rnam pas dma' 'bring skor rtsa ba thugs rgyud kyi stod 'grel khrid cing / chu rtags/ me btsa' rtsa khab/ nad brtag lus grub/ sman sdeb/ gleng gzhi/bsdus stod sogs kyi 'grel bshad gsan sbyong gnang ba dang / yang zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas nyer ba'i'i bar sman bla'i bdag 'jug dang sbyi na sreg zla bzhi bar dpyid sman nyin gsum 'thu ba dang rtsi shing skyes tshul sogs bslab par bya/ drug pa'i zla stod du gza' 'khor gnyis ring dbyar sman 'thu ba dang sman sna mang bo bsdebs thog sman bla'i dbang dang ril sgrub sogs bya/ zla brgyad pa'i nyin gsum la ston sman 'thu ba dang tshes dgu nas bco lnga dang nyer dgu'i bar rta mgrin gyi bdag 'jug sbyin sreg zla dgu ba'i nang mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod bcas spel/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i dus su dge 'dun pa 'al brgya lnga bcu dang da lta brgya drug cu lhag 'dus so/ /gsang sngags rdo rje gling kyai rdor grwa tshang / rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo1789lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis dag ldan rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi rnam pa ji bzhin gsar du btsugs te bca' yig mdzad/ 1956lor me 'jig byung ba slar phyi lor bskyar bzhengs grub/ rten bzhugs gtso bo kyai rdo rje'i sku byin can dang kun mkhyen sku brnyan/ thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang byin can/ kun gzigs paṇa chen gyis gnang ba'i kye rdor/ 'khor chen/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'/ srung ma gnod sbyin tsi dmar/ dngul brdung mchod rten du ma sogs mang / grwa tshang gis dpal dgyes rdo rje dang / phyag rdor 'khor chen dang / rnal 'byor nam mkha' gsum ga'i sgrub thabs rtse gcig tu spel ba dang / rgyud brtag gnyi ga dang bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi khrid gsan par bya ste/ klog 'don la lo rim nges bcad med kyang bsla/ba rim gsum brgyud dgos/ dang bo dma' rim pas bla ma mchod pa/'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ 'jigs byed bcas dang / chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ mgon po bcas kyi bskang gso/ ga'an yang kye rdor gyi spyan 'dren dang / bdag bskyed/ bdag 'jug sbyin sregasmon lam bcas kyi cho ga cha tshang / 'khor chen dang rnal 'byor sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs 'dzin sbyong bgyis — 12 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/shing 'khor chen bskyed rdzogs blo rgyugs 'bul dgos / 'bring rim du 'phar rjes rgya rtsis dang sum rtags/yig rtsal/ de mo gling ba'i lugs kyi lha 'cham byang bar bshar ba ma zad/ kyai rdor bskyed rdzogs thugs rgyugs phul cing rtsis dkar nag khong du chud dgos/ de nas mtho rim du 'phar na so thar bsam gtan zag med gsu ma gyi sdom pa khyad du bsrungs nas lta sgom spyod gsum tshul mthun sgos gas nga sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len la bzhugs par bya'o/ /phyag las sam cho ga gtso bo'i rigs lo re'i sos ka nas ston mjug bar spyi ba nas kyai rdor 'grel chen zhal khrid gnang / zla bzhi ba'i tshes bdun nas nyer gcig bar sngags rams gcig res tshogs rgyugs 'bul ba dang / zla gsum pa'i nang rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bdag 'jug dbyar nyi ldo ga la gtor chen 'bul/ zla brgyad par kyai rdor bdag 'jug zla dgu bar kyai rdor bdag 'jug nyer dgu bgegs gtor dang thub bstan pho brang du kyai rdor lha 'cham kha bshad 'a dgun 'cham zer ba bcas kyi srol yod/chos sgo slar phyes phyin gung thang drug pas 'du khang la gser tshon byugs pa dang stag ring sku skyes bzhi bas nang rten gyan thang sogs kyi ma/thun rkyen sbyar/ sngon chad grwa btsun brgya lhag 'dus pa dang / da lta'ang brgya dang bcu lhag 'al 'dzoms nas 'chad nyan yar lda na du 'gro mus so/ /gsang chen rdo rje gling ste rgyud stod pa grwa tshang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1kha28lor ('du khang ni de rjes me glang lor bzhengs grub)kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bod dbus rgyud chen kun dga' don grub pas srol phye ba'i rgyud ltar phyag 'debs mdzad cing 'chad nyan thog mar spel/ dang thog legs bshad dga' tshal du 'tshogs/ me glang lor 'du khang ka ba nyer bzhi can bzhengs/ grwa tshang rten gtsor mgon po phyag drug pa'i nag thang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs byin can dang / byams sku thog tshad ma/gnas brtan bcu drug sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ bshags lha so lnga/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba dang rgyal bo in+t+ra bhu te'i rnam thar logs ris/ sgrol ma/ tshe dpag med/'brel ba bzhi sbrags/ rdor dril byin can/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i yab yum gdung rten/ 'chad nyan gyi 'gro phyogs ni mdo sngags zung 'brel las mdo phyogs cung shugs chen gyi tshul du bya ste bslab rim du phye ba la/ rim pa dang bo 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang / 'jigs byed/ mgon po/ lha mo/ nor rgyun ma/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog bcas sbyong ba ma zad/ 'dzin grwa 'phar bar rgyud sde ba'i thugs rgyugs 'bul dgos/rim pa gnyis par blo 'don du rtsa ba rgyud dang / gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs dang / dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sbyangs shing 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg rdul tshon thig 'debs byang chub dgos la/ rab gnas dang chos spyod brgyad cu thugs 'dzin gal che/ ma chod rten brgyad ga'i thig rtsa sogs lag len bya/ de nas 'dzin grwa gong rim pas bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang 'brel ba bzhi sbrags kyi srol ltar sgom sgrub nyams len bgyis te lo re'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar rtsod pa brgyud nas tshogs rgyugs phul mthar lo de'i sngags rams pa gcig 'byon ci thub bya dgos/ sngags rams pa'i — 13 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/mtshan rtags thob phyin slar 'og rim 'dzin grwa gnyi ga skyong ba'i 'os 'gan yod do/ /de bzhin grwa tshang chos thog gtso bo zla gnyis pa'i nang lcags mkhar/ gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas nyer bzhi la gsang 'dus bdag 'jug dang kun mkhyen lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer bdun nas nyer dgu bar kun rig dang tshe dpag med lha dgu'i mngon dkyil/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal bo/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags bstod skul spel/ drug pa'i tshes gsum nas tshes lnga bar rab gnas/brgyad pa'i bcu bdun nas nyer bzhi bar bde mchog bdag 'jug zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun nas nyer bzhi bar 'jigs byed bdag 'jug dang mgon po'i gtor chen/ zla bcu gnyis par lcags mkhar bcas tshugs/rab rgyal sa khyi lor dge 'dun pa zhal brgya bdun cu 'dus pa dang da skabs brgya phyin tsam 'chad nyan rgyun 'khyongs pa'i skabs so/ /4 chos grwar grwa mang 'dus tshul/ 1955lor bla grwa nyis stong lnga brgya lhag 'al 'dzoms/ cha rkyen de 'dra'i thabs chag ma yin te grwa mang gi tshogs bzhugs lo grangs de bod yul chos sde thams cad gcig mthun te lo bdun nas lo drug cu'i bar gyi sku khams bzang zhing rig lam gsal ba/ sdom khrims gtsang zhing sgrig lam bsrung ba thams cad rung la/ grwa rgyun gyi 'byung khungs kun lho khul ma zad/ zi khron/ mtsho sngon/ nang sog hu'o pe/ tung pe sogs nas tshogs bzhugs phebs pa'i gras su bod dang / sog po/ hor pa/yu gur/ cha'ang / rgya sogs mi rigs du ma'i dad ldan skyes bu 'dus/ dge 'dun pa grwa sa 'dir bzhugs pa'i ring du las sner sogs bya ba 'di dag bsgrub dgos te/ gcig tu grwa tshang gang 'dod du zhugs phyin 'don cha rdzogs rjes dpe gzigs pa zhig tu bya mi thub na/ lha khang dang / 'du khang / nang khag so so'i dkor gnyer dang grwa tshang so so'i las sne la 'dug dgos pa dang / gnyis su dgon pa'i spyi 'cham dang spyi ba gnyer ba / gling dpon bcas chos spyod/ rim gro sogs gnyer/ gsum du dgon pa spyi'i chos spyod dang /srid don/ sgrig khrims/ nor mdzod la sogs pa'i las sne bsko bar bya/ ba'i ru ched gnyer gyi yon tan nam khyad chos cung ldan pa ltar gso rig pa/ rtsis pa/ lha bzo/ par brko/ par rgyag tshem drubs la sogs su bzhugs dgos te/ gong gsal dag ni grwa ba mang shos(lo cung che ba dag)yin la phal cher brje spor mang yang las sne gang rung mi gnyer la lo bgres pa'i dus su rang rang grwa tshang gi rgyun ldan chos spyod thams cad la zhugs dgos/ lnga ru/ dpe gzigs pa'i skor te rang gi dmigs tshad dang grwa tshang gi sgrig khrims ltar/chos spyod thams cad chag med 'grims shing zhor du dge rgan mang bo bsten nas 'chad nyan sgom sgrub/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la dka' ba khyad bsad kyis mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi go 'phang mnga' brnyes pa la 'bungs dgos so/ /5 nang chen gtso shos dar tshul/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bla brang gtsos(bde yangs gong / thub bstan pho brang / bde yangs zhol te bzo bkod ches legs pa las gzhis sa 'khor tshogs dgon pa'i phyi rol — 14 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag la sa gan su 'u glegs bam/du yod)nang chen shin tu ma nga / dper na/ gser khri rnam pa bzhi ste/ dga' ldan gser khri lnga bcu ba gung thang rin po che dang / dga' lda na khri rabs nga gcig pa hor tshang rin po che/ dga' lda na khri chen nga lnga ba zam tsha rin po che/ kun ma/khyen sku gnyis pas gser khri bstsal pa'i sde khri rin po che/ bse ngag dbang bkra shis ('di ba'i sku gong ma ni dga' ldan khri rabs so brgyad pa bod rab drag chu lug ste spyi lo 164 2'o ra bzhugs pa'i dga' ldan byang rtse ba dogs po grong mda' ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam chos rgyal bkra shis ches bya ba/)rgyal mkhan po tshang / bla ma dkar bo sku phreng dang bo/ dbal ma/nga sku phreng ba'i ba/ da dung gtso bo mkhan po rnam pa brgyad du 'bod pa cung ma/nga la bshad tshul ya nga kha shas byung ste / rgyal tshang / sgo mang tshang / bde thang tshang / mkhan po no min han/ mkhan po ngag dbang dag legs bcas ni dngos su 'bras spu ngas sgo ma/nga mkhan por bzhugs myong / cung gar tshang / sta ga lung pā ta/ phyag mdzod mkhan po bcas dang / da dung dpa' ris pa dang / gling tshang / nyang tshang hu thog thu/ rgya nag pa/ dbal mang chung ba/ smad sog nor bu/ bsod grags tshang / nu gu tshang / dkon mchog seṅge sogs mang / de ri na mkhan po dang 'dra bar rtsis pa la 'gyang ro tshang / yo ngas 'dzin tshang / lab tshang / snyan grags tshang / rab brtan rgya ma tsho tshang /brag sgom pa tshang / hor tshang / rgya 'bas drung tshang / ma go rta tshang / blo bzang sbyin pa tshang ngag dbang bkra shis tshang / se ra tshang / gyo ra tshang / lha/ ram sa pa tshang / skyor dpon tshang / stag lung che ba tshang / thog ga tshang / stag ge tshang / dge 'dun dar rgyas tshang / rdo dkar mtshams pa ba tshang / stag ring tshang / bla kho tshang / 'al shu' tshang / mdzod dge stobs ldan tshang / bka' 'gyur ba tshang / lcang shar tshang / tsha kho tshang / mtsho kha ba tshang / a mchog mu to tshang / dme shul mu to tshang / gnyan thog gcod pa ba tshang / gong ba tshang / dpa' ris se mas nyid tshang / bla ma phun tshogs tshang / rgya mkhar tshang /sgyis dge tshang / khyom dge tshang sogs dang / da dung tshogs chen du gdong gral dang gral mtshams bcad pa'i bla sprul dang zhabs drung so gas kyi nang chen rigs la se li tshang dang / thur ma tshang / zam tsha'i dus 'khor tshang / 'dan tshang / han tshangang / ma go rta tshang / sgang khang tshang / rigs grwa tshang / khya dge tshang /yer ba tshang / rgya 'bas drung chu nga ba tshang / rtse dbus mtshams pa ba chang / 'bring ba tshang / tsa yus tshang /sum pa tshang / yig brgya tshang dgon li tshang / shis tshang 'bas drung tshang / sug thung tshang la sogs mang na'ang grwa dkyus las ma tsha na mtho zhing 'tsho ba'ang cung legs shas su gyur/ da dung chogs chen khri zur la yang srid blus pa dang ma blus pa thams cad mtshan snyan rgyas shing yongs 'beb legs pa dang tshogs chen du gral mtshams med pa'i zhabs drung ngam mkhan chung yang mang / gong gsal bla spru la kun gyis dgon sa spyi'i brgya cha zhe lnga longs tsam gyi ga'is ka bzung gshes dgon pa'i rtsig bzo byings dang nor longs spyod/ sku gsung thugs rten/ grwa mang bzhugs gnas bcas kyi cha lag chen por gyur/de ba'in du bla sprul gyi go gnas dang 'byor ba rgyas 'an gyi dbang gis kun spyod sgrig khrims kyang khyad par — 15 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/chen po yod de/ dper na dgon bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa mchog gi pho brang la sa tshon ser bo byugs pa dang phyi la chibs sgyur mdzad skabs su 'gyogs byams grwa ba brgyad kyis 'degs par bzhugs pa dang / gser khri dang / mkhan po'am ho thog thu'i gzim khang la sa tshon dmar po byug dgon pa'i phyi rol tu 'gyogs byams su bzhugs rung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa khong gi pho brang las ma brgal bar/ gser khri dang mkhan po/ ho thog thu'am mkhan gral la 'dra ba dag gis thog khang dbub chog pa dang spen phreng gis brgyan cing gzim khang sogs su gser tshon byug rung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i pho brang du sku 'khor zhabs zhu grwa ba lnga bcu lhag rgyun du bzhugs pa las/ gser khri rnam pas sku 'khor zhabs zhu ba dgon bzhugs bcu kha chog(mang shas gser khri'i dgon pa rang rang gi nang chen du yod) mkhan po dngos rigs kyi sku gam zhabs zhu brgyad dgu 'dug rung / mkhan por 'dra ba dag gi sku gam du zhabs zhu ba drug bdun re/ khri zur ram khri zur yang srid blus pa dag gis sku gam du zhabs phyi ba bzhi lnga re 'dug rung / grwa dkyus kyis thog khang dbub pa dang tshon byug mi rung / gal te dgon srol dang 'gal na khrims chad yod la/ mang 'gyed btang ba'i phogs thob ni bla sprul go sa'i mtho dman ltar gcig skal nas lnga skal bar dbye ba cung che'o/ /6 dgon lag skyong tshul/ spyir dgon lag dang mchod gzhis gcig gyur can gyi gras su sku tshab/ spyi ba / khri ba mngags par bya ba'i dgon pa nyer gcig yod de/ a mchog dgon pa/ 'bo ra dgon pa/mdzod dge sgar rnying / tsa yus dgon pa/ klu shod dgon/ rdo dkar dgon/ chos rdzong dgon/ shis tshang sgar sar/ yong gsum dgon/ gser bo dgon/ gtsang nyid dgon/ u pe dgon dang / han kyā zi(ka ju'i khongs)/ lo kyā ten zi (ka ju'i khongs)dang / sgo me dgon(mtsho sngon chi lan rdzong khongs)/stong 'khor dgon(dwang yon tsong kha rdzong khongs)/ dkyil 'khor dgon(rdo sbis khongs)/ se chang dgon(rdo sbis khongs)/ gsang sngags bde chen gling (gung ho rdzong khongs)bcas mtsho sngon khongs gtogs can/rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar/ tsha kho'i da tshang dgon pa bcas zi khron khongs gtogs rnams 'brel ba nye bar rtsi/chos mgo bkra shis 'khyil ba yin pa dang sku tshab bam khri ba/ bla ma sogs mngags chog pa'i rigs la chos sde sum cu rtsa grangs yod de/ tsag tsag dgon/ bkra shis dgon/ mu to dgon/ pad steng dgon/ dme shul dgon/ sgyis tshang dgon/ kho tshe dgon/ rgan bya'i brag dkar/ sman lung sgar/ rkang tsha dgon pa/hor gtsang sngags grwa mdzod dge sgar sar/ ri khrod gong ma/ spyozhu rgya ri khrod/ thar ba rtse'i ri khrod/ru stod ma'i dgon/ rgyal mo'i dgon/ klu shod rnga rgod sgar / shis tshang sgar sar(klu chu rdzong khongs)/dngul rwa dgon dang / be shing dgon/ chu kha ma'i dgon/ mtshan sgrogs dgon/ zhal shul dgon bcas rma chu rdzong gi khongs gtogs/ chas bu gshis dgon/ (tso ne rdzong khongs)/ gser thang dgon/ (the bo khongs)/ han stag lung dgon(ka ju'i khongs)/ dmu dge dgon dang kha shi dgon/ khams gam po'i gnas sgar bcas zi khron zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs/ thung rin rdzong shing li kha dgon/ mda' tshan dgon — 16 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bcas mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs yin pa sogs 'dus pa dang / thad gar du chos spyod phyogs do dam dbang cha mi spyod pa'i rigs la/ lha chab sgar/ kha gya'i sgar snying / rgya rje ri khrod/ gzhi dge ri khrod/or chung gdong dgon/ hor gtsang yi ge thang dgon/ rgan gya'i rtse dbus dgon/ gyi ling dgon/rta'i phur ri khrod/ khya tshang ri khrod/ bkra shis nang (klu shod) sgyi'u tshang nags ri dgon/ rwa lung ri khrod/bla brang jo mo'i sgar/ bas nga gi ser sde (da lta med)/ rmog ru sgar dang bla ri mgul dgon/ gdong gzigs mdo'i dgon/ nur ma'i ser sde dang / dbal ban ser sde bcas rma chu rdzong khongs gtogs pa dang /bde thang dgon dang yar thang dgon/ a 'khor brag dkar dgon bcas co ne rdzong gi khongs gtogs can/chas pa rgya mkhar dgon(bā tse rdzong khongs)/ bang tshang dgon(the bo rdzong khongs)bcas sa gnas khag tu khyab pa ma zad/ pā li zi dang yon cin r+pā tha(tsho1tho)bcas ka ju'i khongs gtogs/ da dung mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs su 'brel che ba'i dgon pa'ang dper na/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mgo log khang rgan dga' ldan chos 'khor gling dang / rong pad nag dgon/ gzhu shub dgon/ jog la dgon/ bar bzhi dgon/g.yag rwa'i ri khrod/ gdong rdzong ri khrod/ gar mar ri khrod/ ra ab ri khrod/ bya yul ri khrod/ mgo log bla ma'i ri khrod/ khang sar dpal yul dar thang dgon/ lung dkar dgon/ rdo khog g.yu thog dgon/shug chung dgon/ rdo grub chen dgon/ mdzo ska'i yi ge mdo dgon/ yul gzhi yar thang rgya bla'i dgon/paṇa chen dgon/ dpal yul rdi mda' dgon/ shing bza' dgon/ urge dgon/ mgo log rgyud mdo'i dgon/ sug chen ser sde/ sug chung ser sde/ khag sum ser sde/ tsho hor ser sde/ a ri ser sde/bkra shis chos rdzong gling / a skyid gro tshang dgon/ bo si'i ser sde/ thor kor ser sde/ dkar po gshong dgon/ rwa dge ri khrod/ ka mdo'i dgon pa/ rtsi bcings dgon pa/ lcang shar dgon pa la sogs dang /zi khron zhing chen khongs gtogs su khang dmar dgon pa/ mdzod dge gling ba'i stag tshang dgon pa/ mchod rten lcogs/ gnam lcags dgon/ bsu ba'i dgon/ sngo shul dgon/ gnyan rtse dgon sogs dang /pa ta ha lag dgon( ca༅nga7tsho)dang / cor ga chi dgon(loṭhatsho)/ ar rtsi tha'i dgon pa(loṭhacho)/ ku shri bskal bzang gi dgon pa('u7k+ṣi.o)/ smyung gnas dgon pa(—thuḥ 7pho)/ bla ma rin po che'i dgon pa(a4yoṣ+ṭhatsho)/ rgya nag pa'i dgon pa(a7tshoṣ+ṭhapho)/ tā yang ci'i dgon(༈tram̐tshotsho)bcas sog yul du gtogs pa dang / hran zhi zhing chen gyi ri bo rtse lnga'i bka' 'gyur dgon pa/he long cang zhing chen gyi zhi lin ko lo'i ta lan chos rje dgon dang / nyi 'od dgon pa/ na mo gu ru dgon pa la sogs nang ba'i gsar rnying chos sde'am ri khrod bcas brgya sum cu lhag gi grangs longs shing dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyang ha lam khri phrag gnyis dang brgyad brgya lhag tu zin mod kyang / da lta chos 'brel slar tshugs dang ma tshugs pa gang rung yin te kha shas sngon nas 'brel chad/ yang 'dir ma 'dus pa'i 'brel ba gsar du ste rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon kun mkhyen drug pa'i ring tshugs pa'ang mchis pas gang ltar bkra shis 'khyil bar dgon — 17 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ma lag brgya dang brgyad gleng ba bden don du gnas so/ /le'u gnyis pa/ kun mkhyen bla ma dang / gser khri mkhan po'i skor/chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gling phyag btab pa nas da lta'i bar gyi kun mkhyen sku 'phreng rim byon dang /gser khri rnam pa ba'i/ mkhan po rnam pa brgyad(don gyis de pas mang /)sogs skyes chen dam pa mi nyung ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus su dril te brjod pa la/dang po/ kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gsar 'debs mdzad mkhan 7rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi ste spyi lo1648pa'i hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad la da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong rgan gya zhang khongs rting ring lhas khra ding zer ba'i ru skor nas dbal shul dpon rgyud du ya/ba dpal 'bum rgyal dang yum thar mo byams gnyis kyi sras su sku blta mas/ ming sring bzhi yod pa'i thu bo'o/ /dgung lo bdun bzhes pa na yab kyi phu bo dge slong bsod nams lhun grub dge rgan du bsten nas yi ge bslabs shing 'bri klog dang lha ris 'bri ba thugs su chud/ bcu gsum pa'i tshe 'dul 'dzin chen po khyu mchog ye shes rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar rab tu byung bas ma/tshan la blo bzang rgyal mtshan gsol 'ing dge tshul gyi sdom pa'ang de las ma nos/ dgung lo bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar du dge sbyor gyi ched du sku chings bkrol nas mi gzim pa dang zhar la sngags kyi bklag thabs dang sman dpyad rtsis sogs bslabs pa ma zad/ rim gro dang sman dpyad/rtsis/ sa dpyad/ sngags dang mkhyud spyad sogs kyis skye bo mang po'i nye zho'i rgud pa khrol bar mdzad cing nyer gcig steng bod dbus su phebs nas thos bsam sgom gsum mthar ma phyin par phyir log na tshar chod cig ces 'phrin bcol mdzad pa la brten/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bkra shis sgo mang gi dpon slob klu 'bum blo gros rgya mtsho'i sku gam du bcar/ dgung lo nyer bzhi'i bar phar phyin 'dzin grwa'i ston mor phebs shing dbu ma sogs gzhung bka' pota lnga la sbyangs pa dang kun gzigs lnga ba chen po las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos pa ste rnal 'byor ba kho na mdzad/ dgung lo so gsum nas nga gsum bar ri bo dge 'phel du bzhugs te lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu brtson pa mkhas grub zung 'brel dang bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi 'bras bu smin par mdzad cing / dus de nas bzung dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi mkhan por dgung 'o drug cu bar du bzhugs/ pha bong kha'i gdan sa'i zhal bdag mdzad/rgyal dbang drug pa dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kun mkhyen dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes gzengs bstod mdzad/ dgung lo re gnyis par mtsho sngon sog po erti ni ju nang tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis spyan drangs shing sbyin bdag tu dam bcas pa thugs 'dzin sgos pha yul phyogs su chibs bsgyur cing / rab — 18 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa mo glang gi lo ste rje tsong kha pas 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas lo ngo sum brgya 'o na pa'i lor khel ba'i rten 'brel du rkang tsha'i nang so dang kha gya'i be hos dgon sa phul pa ltar dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi thig btab ste gnas ngos bzung zhing sa 'dul gnang nas skar 'dzin ma dzad/lcags sta ga lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga ni sto na pas dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang sher mdo gsungs pa'i dus yin pas ma 'ongs pa'i dgon par mtshan nyid 'dzugs par sta gon byas shing dgon pa rang dngos su btab pa la tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis sbyin bdag gi gtso 'gan bzhes/ grwa tshogs sum brgya lhag 'dus / phying gur tshogs pa brgyad brgya tshud pa tshogs gur byas/ shing rta 'o ra tshogs chen 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu can dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i pho brang bzhengs pa la bla brang zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ rje nyid kyis tshogs chen khri rabs dang po'i 'gan ba'es/ me sprel lor dpal ldan smad rgyud tshugs pas mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i chos sde zhig tu grub/ lcags yos hor zla bzhi bar rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos sgo mang iti ni no mon han zhes pa'i mtshan dang / dbu gdugs / tham ga sogs bstsal nas gzengs bstod gnang ba dang /ci gas byi lor khang zhi bde skyid rgyal po'i bstan pa 'dzin cing skyong bar byed pa'i paṇ+ḍita erti ni no mon han ches bsngags pa'i bka' lung thob/ rgyal dbang pad dkar 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho dang / mi dbang pho lha ba/thu'u bkwan sku phreng gnyis pa/ shar skal ldan rgya ma tsho/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge / hor tshang dang bo dpal ldan grags pa/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog lda na/ bse ngag dbang bkra shis/sde ba blo bzang don grub/ dgon lung mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ chab mdo'i 'phags pa lha/ la mo 'bas drung / khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho/ co ne'i grags pa bshad sgrub/ rdzong mkhar ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis so gas nyi zla ltar grags pa'i mkhas chen gyi bu slob drug cu lhag bskyangs par mdzad/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la gsung 'bum yang dpe tshan brgya dang zhe lnga bsdoms pas po ti bco lngar longs pa mdzad/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang la dasongs pa chos dbyings su gtad/ dngul srang stong dang rin chen phra rgyan gyi gdung rten byang chub mchod rten bzhengs so/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa nges don chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sprel lo ste spyi lo1728par mtsho sngon 'ing chen thong rin rdzong gi snang ra'i dpon tshang du/ yab ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang yum bsod nams skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/ sde khri blo bzang don grub kyis gtso mdzad de yang srid rtsad bcad cing dgung lo bcu drug pa chu phag lor 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul skur ngos bzung nas bkra shis 'khyil du gdan khrir bzhugs/ de snga dgung lo lnga'i steng slob dpon nor bu rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ khong gi a khu dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho las klog sbyangs shing bcu gsum par stong 'khor rin po che las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo bcu drug gi sngon nas ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i rig pa brdol bar gyur/ dgung lo nyer gnyis su lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje las — 19 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa khas blangs par mtshan la dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po ye shes brtson 'grus grags pa'i sde zhes gsol/ nyer lnga'i dus la yul dbus su phebs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs nas lo ngo brgyad la gzhung bka' pota lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi sbyangs mthar lha rams pa'i dge bshes kyi mtshan bzang thob/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes/ rje me tri'i 'bas/sa skya'i bdag chen kun dga' blo gros sogs bsam sbyor gnyi gas gtsug tu bsten/ dgung lo so gsum steng bod srid gzhung gis dge ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed paṇ+ḍi ta no mon tan zhes pa'i mtshan gsol pa dang / sku chas/ dbu gdugs/ rol cha/ chibs rta sogs gnang ba dang len sgos slar rang yul du log ste bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri rabs bcu gcig par bzhugs shing dus 'khor grwa tshang e waṃ chos 'khor gling / de rjes byang gi dgon lung dang sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khrir yang 'ar bzhugs mdzad/ zhe gsum dus nang sog gi ur tu'i si bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon btsan po no mon han dang dpal chos kyi bstan 'dzin 'phrin las bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas khong gdan 'dren zhus shing dngul srang dgu brgya phul stabs phyi lo sog po'i shar rgyud mda' tshan e dgur sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spel du phebs nas dbang lung bka' chos mang bo gnang /phyir lam pe cin brgyud de lcang skya rdo rje 'chang las rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung gsan pa dang mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen la dbang lung rjes gsum mang bo zhus/ dgu nga lo nga gcig pa nas phyir tshogs chen 'du khang ka ba brgya bcu can dge 'dun sum stong shong ba bskyar bzhengs dang dus 'khor lha khang / sman bla'i lha khang /bde yangs pho brang sogs bzhi bcu lhag gsar bzhengs la 'bad pa ma zad/ grwa rgyun yang stong khar 'phel/dgon pa'i khongs gtogs mi sde shog pa so sor dgon pa med pa gsar 'debs dang yod pa rnams rgya bskyed (dgon lag rnams rang rang skabs su 'chad par bya)pa dang bcas kyis dgon ma lag brgya dang brgyad du de dus nas grags/ yul dbus kyi gdan sa thams cad dang / mdo smad rong byams chen dpal 'khor chos kyi sde sogs la mchod sprin rgya chen bstsal/ spyi lo17rnga 4ba ste chan lung srid lo zhe dgu bar/ sman pa grwa tshang gso rig gzhan phan gling btab cing / ma dgon bkra shis 'khyil du mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi srol bzang sngar las je dam du tshugs pa dang / da dung gso rig dang / skar rtsis/ sgra rig pa/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag yig rtsal/ par rko/ par 'debs/ lha ris/ 'don rta dbyangs/ lha 'cham sogs zur sbyong gi las rigs sna tshogs dar du bcug thos bsam gling du lo rer btsun pa gnyis res rdo rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog pa (rdo bcal rams 'byams pa)bcas kyi 'dzin grwa 'phel rim bcu gsum du 'byed pa dang rgyud pa dang sman pa/ dus 'khor gsum la lo dgu'i nang 'dzin grwa gsum re 'phar ba sogs dbus gtsang gdan sa khag gi srol ltar rang dgon gyi grwa tshang so so'i bca' yig gtan la phab/ smon lam chen mo/ byams pa gling skor/ bdun pa'i shwa 'cham/ grwa tshang khag gi mdo bdar ba sogs gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgung lo nga brgyad steng yul dbus su phebs nas se 'bras dge gsum/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang sogs chos sde che chung — 20 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mang bor mang 'gyed rgya chen po btang ba dang phebs yul sa cha so so nas dpe dkon khri phrag longs pa blus shing phyag bris mdzad de rang dgon la gdan drangs shing byams khang sogs bzhengs/ tshogs chen 'du khang la ka 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan gya nom pa bsgrugs/ gcig pa'i smon lam dang bdun pa'i rigs grwa'ang btsugs/de phyis bya khyung dgon pa'i khri bar yang zhar du bzhugs pa bcas yul sde mi ser gyi dam chos re ba bskangs/ bu slob la mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / klong brdol grub dbang / rta tshag rje drung / sa skya'i bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' chos skyong / lo chen sprul sku/ brag yab che tshang chung tshang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ mnga' ris sprul sku/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma sogs mkhan chen mang bo byon/ gsung 'bum la'ang pota bcu gnyis bzhugs/ dgung lo re bzhi ba lcag phag ste spyi lo1791pa'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer bdun la bya khyung nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs lam ka mdo sa char sku gshegs/ dngul srang sum stong lhag rin po che'i phra dang bcas pa'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten bzhengs so/ /'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng gsum pa rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu byi ste spyi lo17kha2lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la mtsho sngon zhing chen thong rin rdzong gi gnyan thog tu yab dpon rigs klu 'bum rin chen rgya mtsho dang yum mkha' mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus thu'u bkwan rin ngo ches sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos bzung zhing rgyal dbang paṇa chen zung gis lha ldan gtsug lag khang nas thugs thag bcad/ dgung lo bdun pa'i dus su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs shing lo de'i zla gnyis pa'i nang thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma las rab tu byung zhing mtshan la blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtshor gsol/ lha rams pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin mchog dge rgan du bsten nas klog 'don sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu son rjes tshad ma sbyong mgo brtsams pa la rig pa'i bag chags brdol te gcig shes kun grol du gyur/ bcu gsum par gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me mchog las dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ bcu drug gi dus su dge 'dun gyi tshogs la lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang gnang / nye 'khor gyi chos sde dang mi sde'i ser skya mang tshogs la chos 'brel btsugs pa dang gnas chung btsan khang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ bco brgyad par yul dbus su phebs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs nas klu 'bum ngag dbang tshul khrims dang blo bzang chos 'dzin gnyis dge rgan du bsten cing gtsang na bzhugs pa'i paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gi zhabs la gtugs te bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa'i dam bca' phul phyin nyer gnyis steng btsan po no mon han dang mnyam du rang dgon du phebs nas chos mtshams la bzhugs/ de nas chos sde mang por byang chub lam rim chen mo dang drang nges rnam 'byed sogs 'al khrid gnang / dgung lo nyer gnyis steng bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri rabs nyer bdun par bzhugs shing 'dul khrims zhib tu byas/ de'i zhar du sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khrir yang bzhugs/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong du 'bas bsgyur mdzad/ yul dbus su phebs te gdan sa bzhi — 21 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/da wadang chos sde khag la mang 'gyed dang / jo shāka rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i rten gsum la mchod 'bul rgya che/gong sa rgyal dbang mchog gis dbu gdugs rta dar 'bol lcag sogs mkhan chas kyi gzengs dngos bstsal/sku tshod bgres skabs su 'jig rten pa'i nor longs spyod thams cad chog shes mdzad de sgom bzlas kyi las la brtson par bzhugs shing gser dngul gyi yo byad/ khri 'bol tshem drub can la sogs dngos su spa ngas te nyes dmigs mtha' dag bzlogs pa dang chos srid kyi bya ba thams cad phyag mdzod dang mkhan po la gnyer du gtad/gsung rtsom ngo ta gcig bzhugs/ dgung grangs re ba'i ba rab byung ba'i ba'i shing yos te spyi lo1〈55ba'i zla dgu ba'i tshes drug nyin sku gshegs/ dngul srang stong phrag du ma dang phra rgyan rmad du byung bas gdung rten byang chub mchod rten bzhengs so/ /'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng ba'i ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo ni/ rab byung bcu ba'i me 'brug ste spyi lo1856lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer lnga la khams kyi sde dge'i bkra shis lha lung zhes pa'i yul du yab bde legs 'byung gnas dang yum chos 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ sde ba tshang dang hor gtsang tshang rnam pa gnyis kyis kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa'i yang srid du ngos bzung / dgung lo lnga 'i steng bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan sar bkod/ sde khri rin po ches skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ces pa'i mtshan gsol/ lha rams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang shes rab rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo gnyis dge rgan du bsten nas dge tshu' gyi sdom pa bzhes la dpe gzigs gnang / dgung lo bcu gcig par mtshan nyid grwa tshang du zhugs pa la rig pa shin tu rno bas tshad ma'i gzhung dang 'bum pa sbyong brtson mdzad par 'bras bu myur du smin/nyi shu bar dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi blo bzang rnam rgyal ma/chog bsten cing paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang rgyal sras rin po che'i dbang lung rjes gsum mang du gsan la rje byams pa rin po che las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ slar rang dgon du phebs phyin mu mthud du dbu ma dang mdzod 'dul sogs la brtson pa rtag tu gnang ba dang 1879lor kyai rdor grwa tshang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling btsugs te khrir bzhugs/skabs der tsi dmar btsan khang bzhengs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa'i dus su rang gi gdan sa bskyangs pa'i zhar la sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khri 'gan bzhes/ mdor na rang dgon dang bcas pa'i chos srid lugs gnyis tshul bzhin du bskyangs pa'i bka' drin gyis rab rgyal yar sngon gyi rnam pa lta bur grub/ ('di'i skor skabs ga'an du 'chad par bya) de nas bzung chos srid kyi bgyi ba thams cad dbal ma nga tshang la gtad de rang nyid chos mtshams la bzhugs pa dang zhe gsum steng rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga dang pe cin du gnas mjal la phebs/gong ma kong zhur mjal bas ches cher skyob mdzad pa ma ti pak+shi zhes pa'i tham ga bstsal/ khams kyi dkar mdzes dang klu thang / chab mdo/ sde dge mtsho sngon gyi mgo log tu chibs bsgyur mdzad de skye 'gror chos kyi sbyin pa mang bo bstsal/ zhe lnga'i thog slar dbus gtsang gnyis su phebs/ gdan sa khag gsum dang bcas par mang 'gyed rgya chen bstabs shing sa skya dang tsa ri/ ding ri/ gangs te se/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho sogs — 22 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag la sa gan su 'u glegs bam /su gnas skor du phebs/ nga brgyad par rang dgon du byon/ re gcig pa me 'brug spyi lo1916lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gsum la sku gshegs/ gdung rten du dngul sra nga stong phrag ba'i la phra rgyan phun tshogs pas spud pa las byang chub mchod rten bzhengs so / /dam pa gang gi sku ring la/ spyi lo18rdo 2 pa'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lngar rje rin po che'i gdung ma chod dga' lda na lnga mchod tshugs pa dang tshogs rgyusas spro da pa'i sro la gtan la phab/ phar phyin dam bca' phu' mthar skar rtsis dang gso rig rig gnas sogs sbyo nga chog par byas pa dang / par khang du bris bzang ba/brkos bzang ba/ dpar bzang ba/ nyar tshags legs pa bcas kyi sgrig lam btsugs/ rje nyid kyis bde mchog dri' bu lha lnga 'i thang du bkra shis rab brtan zhes pa'i dga' tshal bzhengs/ sngar tshes bcu btsugs pa dang klu'i bum gter gyi rgyun bstsal/ bsgrub bya brgya phrag la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom/ pa gnang / bde 'jags dang gtsang sbra byed par gling dpon bskos pa dang shing slong 'gro srol dar du bcug gsu nga rtso ma pota gsu ma/ 'o/ngas pa bzhugs so/ /kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ye shes bsta na pa'i rgya' mtshan dpal bzang bo ni/rab byung bco lnga ba'i me 'brug ste spyi lo1 41(〈'o 'i zla gsu ma pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la/ kham sa spo bo sgang gi li thang grong tsho brgyad kyi nang tshan ma tshe ma grong du/ ya ba ma gon po don grub dang yu ma gu ru lha 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ 192 0lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba chos kyi nyi ma 'i phyag mo lta ra gung thang sku phreng lnga ba 7'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma dang sde ba sku phreng drug pas gtso 'gan bzhes pa 'a sa kun ma khyen sku phreng ba'i ba'i ya nga srid du thugs thag bcad de/ lo de'i zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la gdan sa ra bkod/ dgung lo bcu gsu ma par rgyud stod grwa tshang gsang chen rdo rje gling tshugs/'jam dbyangs ma khyen rab rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas rab byung gi sdom pa dang a lags bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin la sa rgya mtsho las dge tshul gyi sdom pa ba'es/ de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba bkra shis 'khyil du phebs par skya ser khri phrag bdun lhag la dbang bka' chos zhus/ maṇ+ḍil dang dung dkar g.ya sa 'khyil / dngul sgor/ na bza' cha tshang bcas phul te bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus / dgung lo nyer gnyis steng lha sar phebs pa la bod srid gzhung dang gdan sa khag gis bcib bsu dang thab bsu rgya chen bstar/ se 'bras dge gsum dang dgon chung mi ser khri/ phrag drug la mang 'gyed dang gnang sbyin mdzad pas yo5 ma/do 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa 'o ngas spyod rgyas 'dug ces grags / phyir rang dgon du phebs nas rgyud stod grwa tshang la sku gsu nga thugs rten mang po gnang ba dang lha sa ltar chos 'khor bzhings tshul sbyong du bcug chu khyi lor bkra shis rab brtan du bzhugs te thun drug gi rnal 'byor la gzhol cing me byi la par+ṇa chen bcu ba bzhugs spro zhus /srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar 'khrab srol btsugs/ nor 'dzin pho brang nas rnam rgya' gzungs ring 'bum phrag bsgrubs / me byi ( 19 26)lor par+ṇa chen bcu ba spyan drangs/ grwa mang la rgyan 'jug gi lung gnang /— 23 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rgyag brngan lha bsang dang chos rgyal rnam sras bskang gso mang du bsgrubs/ bla sprul kho nar bsten nas rgyal bstan skyong mi thub ste/ chos la dad cing srid dbang chen po thob pas na chos lugs yun ring du skyong thub ces thugs dgongs zab mo'i sgo nas yang yang gsungs/ lo der kho nyid gtso byas gcen blo bzang tshe dbang bas dbu bsdus pa'i bla brang dgon pa'i dgon ma lag brgya dang brgyad kyi sku tshab nyi shu lhag rtsa 'dzugs bgyis te 'jar 'gog dmag ru'i dpa' bo hrag rgod rnams la 'tshams zhur btang / gos dar dang bdog dngos kyi gtang rag mang du brdzangs/ spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya ba'i bcu tham pa lo ni 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug bslangs nas lo ngo gsum gyi bgrang bya 'das/ rang rgyal yul gru'i sa rgya chen po 'jar pan dmag
