gshed kyi sder 'og tu tshud/ skabs der cang ce hris rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gi kru'u 'i'i 'gan bzhes nas rgyal khams yul gru kun tu 'jar 'gog dmag 'gyed kyi zhal 'debs slong bzhin pa'i skabs dang bstun/ bla brang du rnyed bkur tshogs pa btsugs/ sku tshab bzhi bcu'am lnga bcu yas mas tsam zhig bsdus pa'i khrod du gcung bo dbal mang sprul ba'i sku dang / a lags nu gu tshang / 'jam dbyangs nag ril/ khang pan chen sogs lhan 'dzoms kyis khrung chin(skabs de'i rgyal sa)phyogs la gnam gru sum cu tham pa zhal 'debs su 'bul rgyu gros su mthun pa sogs rnam dkar gyi las mang du mdzad/ go min tang srid gzhung gi sog bod u yon lha khang gi u/ yon bya ba'i las sne'i 'gan bzhes/ bla brang bod 'bangs slob grwa chung ba dang bud med slob chung sogs btsugs/ kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba bla brang du phyag phebs gnang skabs su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ dgung lo so gnyis bzhes pa me phag spyi lo1947pa'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes bzhi la nor 'dzin pho brang nas gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa bsdus/rje 'di nyid sku tshe ring du ma bzhugs kyang / gsung rtsom pota gsum mchis la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che rgya cher spel ba dang 'brel bod kyi slob gso dang spyi tshogs bde 'jags/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas sogs gang cir sman pa la bod kyi rig gnas yar skul tshogs pa/ bla brang btsun pa'i slob ga skor bskyod zur khrid tshogs pa/ mtha' 'khor gsar 'gyur tshogs pa/ bla brang srid skyong las grwa sogs gsar 'dzugs gnang ba la bka' drin mchog tu nas kyang che'o/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa byi spyi lo1948pa'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes gcig la mtsho sngon zhing chen rkang tsha rdzong gi rkang tsha gong ma'i yab mdo sngags skyabs dang yum tshe ring sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ mtshan la 'brug 'bum thar zhes gsol/ dgung lo bzhi ba na/ kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba rin po ches thugs thag bcad cing blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma zhes mtshan gsol/ dgung lo lnga ba spyi lo1952pa'i zla gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la sku gong ma'i chos kyi khri 'phangs mthon po mnga' gsol bar ser skya khri 'bum gyi grangs las brgal pas bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du ma'i sgo nas khri ston rgya chen du spel/ nub byang — 24 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/cus dang kun su'u zhing chen gyi tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid pa/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsol dpon gzhon pa mkhan po bstan chos gzhan phan sogs phebs/ dkon mchog bsam grub mchog dge rgan du bsten te 'bri klog la sbyangs/ gling mchog sprul skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ spyi lo 1955ba'i zla gsum par rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi ba mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs gnang ba na/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs dbang lung rjes gsum mnos/ kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba rin po ches kyang lo der tshe dpag med kyi dbang sogs gnang / 1952nas1kha58lo'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur bar bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas slob gnyer bla lhag tu mdzad pas dam chos kyi gzhi tshugs/ 1962lo'i smon lam skabs su chos sgo bskyar phye dang mnyam du tshogs chen khri rabs gya dgu ba'i khur bzhes/rje 'di nyid rlabs che ba'i krung go grung khran tang gi bka' drin gyi skyed sring dang slob gso las rgyal nang yul gru so sor ljongs rgyu dang gzigs 'ib tu lan du mar phebs/ krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gi slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes / bkra shis 'khyil dgon ma lag dang bcas pas ma zad/ gan su'u zhing chen khong gtogs kyi nang ba'i dgon sde thams cad tang gi srid jus nyi ma'i 'od zer la brten te yar ldan du 'gro zhing / spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam pa'i dpal yon thad gzhogs 'degs gang legs byed bzhin yod/rje de nyid kyi phyag rjes bla na med si bgrang gis mi long na yang / de las mdor dril tsam zhig brjod na/paṇa chen bcu ba kun lhor phebs thengs dag la bsu skyel bla lhag bgyis pa dang khong gi sku gam nas lam khrid dang grub rgyal tshe dbang/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang lta gon khur bzhes shing sems bskyed mchod pa sogs gsan/ 1985lo'i zla ba'i ba'i tshes bdun la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo sreg za'i phung bor gyur pa na/ khong nyid dang gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs rnam gnyis kyis thugs khur bsam mi khyab pa gnang zhing bskyar bzhengs kyi 'khri ba chen po lhur bzhes/ gan lho bod khul nas gong rim zhing chen dang krung dbyang la yar zhu rim pa bzhin brgyud pa'i bka' drin gyis/ krung dbyang gis dmangs sgor sa ya brgyad dang / gan su'u zhing chen gyis sa ya bzhi gnang ba la brten/ lo ngo bzhi'i ring ste1990lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga la tshogs chen 'du khang rten dang brten pa bskyar bzhengs cha tshang ba legs grub byung / de la rab gnas chen mo dang 'brel ba'i grub ston rgya chen du bstar ba la/ pe cin/ nang sog hrang he sogs phyogs ba'i'i mgron tshogs lhan 'dzoms byung / tang dang rgyal khab kyi chos 'u gas srid jus dang kun gzigs par+ṇa chen tham sa cad mkhyen pa'i gsung bskul ltar/ mdo smad phyogs kyi bla sprul mi nyung tsam thugs thag bcad pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad 'phrin rgyas mus su'o/ /gnyis pa/ gser khri sku phreng rim byon/1 gung thang gser khri sku phreng rim byon/'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang sku phreng dang bo rje dge 'dun phun tshogs(1648da wa 172 4)ni/da 25 da

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/deng gi rma chu rdzong chu kha ma'i rus ldong gi yab 'bum phyug dang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sras su sku 'khrungs/dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa na 'ang bo skal bzang bkra shis kyi rjes 'brangs nas yul dbus 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du slob gnyer mdzad/ khyad par rje btsun dam pa 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang brtson 'grus bsten te mdo sngags zung gi zab chos du ma'i bdud rtsi 'dod tshim du bzhes/ sa yos spyi lo1699lor rgyud bla ma dbu mdzad dang phyis su mkhan khrir bskos/ 'bras spungs dge bshes zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ lha rams pa'i dam bca' ba'ag pa dang 'ang bo'i rjes su phyir rang yul du phebs rgyu zhus pa la/ kun mkhyen nas khyed rang re 'ig bzhugs te slo ba gnyer mdzod ces gsung skul phebs pa la brten/ dga' ldan byang rtse'i khrir bzhugs/rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yo ngas 'dzin mdzad pas rtse ngo ta lar yang re 'ig bzhugs/ shing lug lor 'brog ri bo che dga' lda na rnam pa/ra rgyal ba'i gling gi gser khri mnga' gsol mdzad pa khri rabs lnga bcu bar brtsi/(1712da wa1718) skabs der dpon ju nang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis sbyin bdag mdzad pa la brten/sngar yod dga' ldan dngul gdung chen cho/ de gser gdung du bsgyur/ dge 'dun pa lnga brgya rab tu byung /tshal gung thang gi dgon pa mang bo zhig gso mdzad/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ mkhan po dge 'dun lhun grub/ sgo mang dpon slob blo bzang dam chos/ rgyal sras ye shes grags pa/ bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ sde ba blo bzang don grub sogs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i slob ma mang du bskyangs so/ /gung thang sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan(1727da wa1759)ni/ yul dbus kyi dga' ldan nye 'dabs cha zhes pa'i lul du sku 'khrungs / dgung lo gsum bzhes pa na yum dang lhan cig tsha' gung thang du spyan drangs / lnga 'i steng rgyal sra sa ye shes grags pa 'a sa rab tu byung ba dang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwa 'grims/ tsha kho zangs dkar rab 'byams pa bsod nams dar rgyas dge rgan du bsten/ sgo mang dpon slob blo bzang dam chos las bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgu ba la rgyal mchog bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho ma gar thang nas dbus phebs skabs su mjal/ khri chen no mon han dang lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje la'ang mjal/ sku gong ma dang kun mkhyen sku phreng dang pos jo bo rin po che'i mdun sa ru mdo smad du bstan pa spel ba'i thugs smon gcig tu btab pa ltar/ sde khri rin po che dang ju nang dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma bcas kyi bskul ngor/ kun gzigs paṇa chen lnga ba'i bka' bgros dang thon phyag phon che ba gnang ba la brten/ urge brgyud bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ dgung lo bcu gcig nas nyi shu'i bar mdo sngags kyi gsan bsam rgya cher ma dzad/ rgyud pa'i khrir mdzad ring rim lnga'i dmar khrid chig dril du skyong ba'i srol btsugs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa 'brug nas chu sprel te lo lnga'i ring tshogs chen gyi khri mdzad pa gdan rabs lnga bar brtsi/ mgon po'i gtor chen gyi phyag srol btsugs/ rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos bstsal pa'i cho lo dang mkhan chas 'byor/ bar skabs rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon du bzhugs te smad — 26 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rgyud spel/ bkra shis 'khyil du yang bskyar khri mdzad pa gdan rabs brgyad par brtsi/ skabs der rgyab yol ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin 'du khang gzim khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ spyil bu 'ga' phub pa la grwa rgyun yang zhal grangs so gnyis su 'phel/ sa yos lor chan lung gong ma dang lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i bka' lung gtsigs su bkur te pe cin du chibs bsgyur mdzad/ gung thang hu thog thu ches pa'i cho lo gnang 'ing rdo rje'i slob dpon du bsten/ bde lda na byin chags gling (yong ho kung )du dus gsum sangs rgyas la rab gnas mdzad/ lo de'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsu ma la yams snyung drag por gso bcos kyis ma sman par gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa bsdus/ lo phyi ma ra ring bsrel bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos gdung rten la rab gnas ma dzad do/ /rje 'di la gsung rtsom yang thor bu du ma bzhugs snang ngo / /gung thang sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me(1762da wa182 2)dpal bzang bo ni/kun lho'i khongs mdzod dge dme bo'i lung skam gong ma/'i dga' rus yab the bo lcags byams dang yum/ bu chog gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga ba la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos gung thang sku phreng gnyis pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bdun pa la bkra shis 'khyil du spyan drangs/ blo bzang rin chen klog gi dge rgan du bsten/ lcags yos lor rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa rje 'jam dpal rgya mtshos sku gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin mkhan chas dang tham ga cho lo sogs spam mtho ba bstsal/ kun mkhyen dang sog po rab 'byams pa las dbang bka' chos mang du gsan/ bco lnga ba la gzhung gas ra dang dbu mar sbyangs pa rig pa dmar bas zhar du lha ris rgya yig sogs bsla bas/ sa khyi la yul dbus 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs te dpon slob skal bzang don grub yongs 'dzin du bsten/ dbu mdzod 'dul gsum legs par sbyangs/ phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sogs skabs der mdzad/ chu 'brug lor rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho las bsnyen par rdzogs/ lha rams pa'i mtshan btags thob/ nyer lnga ba 'a kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i bka' ba'in phyir bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ tshogs chen 'du khang steng gser gyi rgyal mtshan cha gsar 'jog dang grwa btsun rer dbu ni ma re'i 'gyed btang / 1790lor rgyal mo tsha ba rong stag tsha dgon nas dbang gnang / rnga ba'i sgo mang bde chen gling gsar du btab / chu byi nas sa rta'i bar bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gdan rabs nyer gcig par bzhugs/ dgon lung gi khrir bzhugs pa dang mnyam du mdzod dge dme bo'i dgon dga' ldan rab rgyas gling btab/ spyi lo180 2 2da wa1805 10bar gung thang mchod rten mthong grol chen mo bzhengs/ zhe lnga nas chu lug bar dgon nang dang ri khrod du bzhugs te ljags rtsom mang du mdzad/ bya khyung dang / sku 'bum/ gser khog chu bzang / dgon lung/ dmar gtsang / gro tshang / la'o kyā ton/ mchod rten dkar bo/ a 'gang byams pa 'bum gling sogs chos sde mi nyung bar phebs te dbang bka' mang du bstsal/ khyad par du sku 'bum dang bis mdo dgon du mi ṭa brgya rtsa'i — 27 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dbang gnang ba dang rgyal dbang dgu ba'i yongs 'dzin gyi bal/'a 'byor yang ma bzhes par/ dbang lung bka' chos dang ljags rtsom gyi bgyi ba lhur bzhes te sku tshe dang mnyam par mdzad/ bslab bya sogs pota bcu gsum longs pa mdzad do/ /rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu lugs lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gsum la dgongs pa chos dbyings su bstims so/ /gung thang sku phreng bzhi ba dkon mchog bsta na pa rgya ma tsho(1824da wa1859)ni/ shing sprel lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lngar tsa yus oṃ 'khyil du yab sgom pa yag ces pa'i rus ldong can tshang la sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtshos thugs thag bcad cing / de nyid las rab tu byung / sa glang lo'i zla dgu bar bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ rje gong ma'i drung yig dkon mchog kun dga' klog gi dge rgan dang hor tshang rdo rams pa ngag dbang rab brtan yongs 'dzin du bsten/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ lcags byi 1〈40lor sog po mda' tshan/ dngul rwa/ dbal shul stod smad/a mchog mtshan nyid dgon pa sogs la phebs/ phyi lor yul dbus su phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang du thos bsam rgya chen du mdzad/ rgyal dbang bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho khri bzhugs kyi dgyes ston du phebs/srid skyong tsha rdor no min han/ da tshag ju lang dpal ldan ye shes/ de mo hu thog thu sogs skyes chen du mar dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs/ chu yos lor rgyal rtse dang bkra shis lhun por chibs bsgyur/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i 'al snga nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ shing 'brug la lha rams pa'i mtshan btags brnyes/ de mur bkris lhun dang sa skya/ zha lu/ 'ol kha/ yar lung / bsam yas/ dga' ldan sogs su mjal skor du phebs/ phyi lor rang yul du phebs te gung thang tshoms chen ser bo bskrun/ grwa ba lnga brgya lhag la sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang bstsal pa dang / rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon gyi khrir yang bzhugs/ 1850lor ju nang bkra shis dbang rgyal gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin urge dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/ shing yos nas sa lug bar bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs zhe brgyad par bzhugs/ ri bo pad+ma can du phebs nas gnas ri'i lha khang bskyar bzhengs kyi rab gnas dang ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi srol phye/ phyir rang dgon du phebs te ma 'gyangs par gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /gung thang sku phreng lnga ba 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma(1860da wa1922)ni/ da lta'i bsang chu rdzong kho tshe zhang rtse dbus khri chen gong ma'i rgyud du lnga ba'i tshes bzhir yab bde chen dar rgyas dang yum bsod nams skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis gung thang sku phreng bzhi ba'i yang srid du thugs thag bcad/ shing byi lor gung thang bla brang du gdan khrir bkod/gnas brtan pa chen po rje shes rab rgya mtsho las rab byung / dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ rje dkon mchog seng ge las klog bslabs/ chu sprel lor rmad byung thos bsam gling la zhugs/ rdo rams pa don yod rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin la bsten/ bka' pota lnga'i tshig don la phud lhag ma lus par gsan sbyong dang chos thun ma chag — 28 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/par grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i 'gro stangs gnyom chung tshul mthun kho nas brtson 'grus mdzad pa bla grwa thun mong gi mig dpe lta bur gyur/ shing sprel hor zla lnga bar yul dbus su chibs bsgyur te tshe smon gling ba'i pho brang du bzhugs/de phyis tshal gung thang dang brag yer ba/ rin chen sgang / gangs rin po che/ chos 'khor rgyal/ lha mo bla mtsho/ zangs ri mkhar dmar/ gdan sa mthil/ bsam yas sogs su mjal skor du phebs/ phyi lor rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho khri bzhugs kyi dgyes ston du legs skyes spam mtho btegs pa dang lhan du 'dus pa rgya mtshor mang 'gyed btang / phyir mdo smad du phebs te kun mkhyen sku phreng ba'i ba'i mdun nas kyai rdor gyi dbang zhus/ ru stod ma dang shis tshang sgar sar/ rgan gya'i brag dkar gyi khrir bzhugs shing dad ldan skya ser la dbang lung rjes gsum mang du bstsal/ 1992chu 'brug la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i kyai rdor khri rabs dgu bar bzhugs/ shing rta lor sku 'bum brgyud sog po'i yul gru du ma dang / zhin cang gi mchod rten mkhar/ e lam chi sogs su chibs bsgyur nas chos sbyin mang du bstsal/ lcags glang la gung thang mchod rten chen por zhig gso mdzad/ phyi lor ko ru kha brgyud khra'o khrin(u ru si'i khongs)gyi rgyal sras la mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang / chu yos la kun mkhyen gyi zhal gdams ltar tshogs chen khri rabs re dgu ba lo gsum bzhugs/ me rta lor gung thang mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs su nye sras brgyad bzhengs/ pho brang dmar ser gnyi ga zhig gso bgyis/ lcags phab la stag tsha/ dka' chen/ kirti/ sgo mang sogs su phebs shing /dbal shul skya tshang chu kha ma'i nang gyod bsdums/ shing stag la sog yul du lan ba'i bar phebs te dgon pa sum cu lhag gi khri 'gan gyi mtshan bzhes/ me 'brug nas sa rta'i bar kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba dang dbal mang tshang snga phyir sku gshegs/ mā chi'i jag dmag gis bkra shis 'khyil la drag po'i sbyor ngan spel pa sogs kyi dbang gis/ chos srid kyi 'khri ba thams cad khur du bzhes/ shing byi lor paṇa chen dgu ba lang ju sde bzhir phebs pa'i mdun bsu mdzad/ shing glang hor zla dgu ba'i tshes brgyad la gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /gung thang sku phreng drug pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug( 1926cha 2 0 0 0 ) dpal bzang bo ni/rab byung bco lnga ba'i me stag hor zla dang bo'i tshes bcu gsum nyin/ zi khron zhing chen mdzod dge byams me dpon tshang gi dga' 'jigs med rdo rje dang bzhag sdom dpon tshang gi bza' pad dkar skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ lcags lug hor zla gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la gung thang sku phreng lnga ba'i yang srid du thugs thag bcad/ kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i yongs 'dzin bsang khog 'jigs med las dge tshul bzhes/dmu dge thub bstan rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten te klog bslabs/ dgung lo bcu ba la rmad byung thos bsam gling du zhugs/ 1926lor paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma sku 'bum nas rgan gya brgyud de bla brang du phebs pa las dus 'khor dbang chen gsan pa dang / a mchog rin po che nas bde mchog gi dbang mnos/ 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las dbang dang rjes gnang mang du gsan/ a mchog rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen — 29 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rab rgya mtsho'i gdung rdzogs su phebs/ zam tsha dang ba'ag sdom bar gyi rtswa sa rtsod gleng bsdums te thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / a mchog mtshan nyid dgon pa'ang skyong khur mdzad/ byams me dpon bla'i yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang ba sogs mdzad 'phrin mang du spel/ me khyi lor(1946)sog po khag gsum hur 'dus spyi'i nan zhus ltar gad dmar thang du dus 'khor dbang chen thengs dang bo gnang / lo de'i ston khar a ma chog dgon par 'al ngo dang rdo rams pa'i dam bca'i srol btsugs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba dang yongs 'dzin dam pa sogs dag 'ing du gshegs pa la dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin rgya chen bstar/ kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhal bkod ltar a mchog rin po che dang kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa blu 'gan bzhes te don rnams lhun gyis grub/ rgyal rong du spyan ras gzigs kyi sku mdun du 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gi sgrub mchod spel skabs spyan ras gzigs la bdud rtsi bab pa'i ltas bzang byung ba dang sum sgang chen po nor bu gling nas dus 'khor dbang chen thengs gnyis pa bstsal/ sa glang lor byams me nas dus 'khor dbang chen thengs gsum pa gnang /lo der sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho gdan khrir bkod/ 1949lor bcings 'grol dmag ka jur byon pa la mdzod dge phyogs kyi sku tshab 'tshams zhur mngags/ lcags yos lor rgyal yongs mi rigs bya ba'i rgya bskyed gros tshogs su phebs/ mi rigs 'dra ma nyam dang / sa gnas rang skyong / chos dad rang mos/dgon sde'i rigs gnas srung skyob skor gyi gsung bshad mang du gnang / skabs der rje klu 'bum shes rab rgya mtshor thog mar mjal/ 1kha51lor kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba rin po che mdo smad du phebs pa la mdun bsu rgya chen du bstar/ lo de'i zla bcu bar mdzod dge shog pa bcu gnyis kyi sku tshab mngags te rgyal khab gsar tshugs dang gung khran tang la bsnyen bkur zhus/ 1951da wa1kha52bar khron byang bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i rnga ba khul)mi dmangs zhib bsher u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa dang srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par bskos/ phyi lor zung chu dang bun khron sogs kyi 'go dpon dag la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi legs cha gsungs par/ 'bar khams nas then po(sangs rgyas ye shes kyang bya/)sogs kyi bsngags pa'ang thob/1955lor kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' phebs bzhin bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen gyi gdong lnga'i khri stegs su 'bas pad bstod cing bdun pa'i rigs grwa khyad par ba zhig 'tshogs par mdzad/ shing lug la skabs de'i rgyal yongs dmangs chen rgyun las u yon krang gzhon pa rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du phebs par bsu ma rgya chen du bstar/ 1956lor ser skya yongs la thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba rin po che phebs te 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang gnang / rman gya'i brag dkar gnas khang du phyag rjes bkod/ de'i phyi lo nas sa khyi bar sog po'i mda' tshan(da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho sog rdzong gi gser lung 'ang /)dang / co ne chas bu gshis su bla ma rab brtan rgya mtshos gdan zhus ltar phyag phebs mdzad/ bar skabs der dus 'khor dbang chen thengs ba'i ba/ lnga ba/ drug pa gnang /ska khog tu dngul sgor lnga 'bum gyis gung thang zhi bde'i 'o phye bzo grwa dang slob chung tshugs/ 1958lo'i — 30 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgun khar a ma chog mtshan nyid du bzhugs shing zla gsum pa'i bco lngar dbang lung rjes gsum mang du bstsal/sa khyi'i zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer gnyis(hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad)kyi dgong mo chu tshod bcu gnyis thog nag nyes ci yang med par btsan gyis btson du bcug cing nang chen gzhis ka thams cad gzhung bzhes byas/ rgya'i zlos gar ba'i 'khrab lwa bkyon du bcug gas ra brje ngo log pa ang nyer ba'i ba ches pa'i skyon bgrangs te lan ju mkhar nang dang / tā hra phen/ phen lang bcas su snga rting du lo grangs nyer gcig la brtson rar bzhugs/btson khang du lo ngo gcig gi ring rgya skad slob zhor rgya yig tshags par klog thub par gyur pa dang / rjes su ma'o tse tung gi 'gal ba'i rnam bshad dang lag len rnam bshad sogs ma ra le'i mtshan nyid rig pa bslabs pa dang zin tho'ang yig 'bru nyis 'bum lhag bris/ da dung lham gtsags dang / 'phrul 'khor bca' bzo/ par ris jus 'god sogs lag rtsal gyi rigs kyang byang bar gyur/ lhag par du 44krung dbyang rig gsar tshan chung 〉〉la ngal rtsol du gzhug rgyu'i re zhus kyi dgongs lan lta ra zhan dpar bsgrig pa la zhugs/ par yig dang tham ga thon rdzas tshong rtags sogs kyi brkos dang 'an tsha sogs kyi la'ang byang bar gyur/ 1979lo'i zla bzhi ba'i bcu gsum la btson bkrol thob/ shing phyi lor gan su'u 'ing chen srid gros kyi kru'u 'i gzhon par bskos/phyi lor bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang me skyon thebs pa bskya ra bzhengs nas legs grub kyi bar gtso 'gan bzhes/de rting yul dbus su phebs te 'bras sgo mang dang tshal gung thang sogs su mchod mjal gnang / dga' ldan du bka' chos dang kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu bar tshe dpag med kyi dbang gnang / 1986lo'i zla bcu bar krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon par bskos nas bal yul du 'dzam gling nang bstan pa'i mdza' 'brel tshogs 'du thengs bco lnga bar zhugs shing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khrungs gnas sogs la zhal mjal gnang / the go dang shang gang bcas rgyal khab dang sa khongs brgyud de chos tshogs mang bor 'al 'phrad gnang / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yo sa lor bod skyong thebs rtsa tshogs pa 'dzugs pa'i tshogs 'dur zhugs shing bkra shis 'khyil ba'i grwa mang dang ma dzod dge ru stod ma'i mang tshogs la dbang gnang / sa 'brug lor kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba'i rjes 'brangs nas lho kha'i rtsed thang bod rgyal thog ma/'i bang so/ pho brang yum bu bla sgang / bsam yas la sogs su mjal skor mang 'gyed rgya chen du bstar/ phyir phebs nas gang sar khams mdo nas drug pa'i bco lngar dus 'khor dbang chen gnang / 1kha89lor gtsang bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gling grub ston du zhugs pa dang de 'phral kun gzigs mchog dag zhing bzhes pa'i dgongs rdzogs su zhugs shing / yang srid blu ba'i don du krung dbyang la dgongs 'char dang re 'dun yang yang zhus/ phyi lor u ru si'i ma'o si khor mi'i rigs kyi khor yug gong 'phel 'dzam gling dpyad gtam spel ba'i gros tshogs kyis gdan zhus ltar zhugs shing dgongs 'char gsungs/ skabs de'i rgyal po'am tsong thung kor pa cho h+phu'i gsol ston du phebs/ phyir phebs pa dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs go gsum par zhugs/ dbyi ta lis su 'tshogs pa'i 'dzam gling chos lugs las rigs pa'i zhi bde srung skyob tshogs 'dur — 31 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhugs te pā li'i lha rigs slob grwa nas zhal gsung lhug po gnang / gsar 'god pa'i dris lan dag re re bzhin btab/ h+phan ti gang la gzigs zhib tu phebs/ lcags lug lor bkra shis 'khyil gyi sman pa grwa tshang du mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang bar theb rtse'i nang du me tog dkar po bzhad pa dang nam mkhar 'ja' tshon bkra/mtsho sngon sog po'i mda' tshan gyis nan zhus ltar zla lnga bar bzhugs khri'i thang nas rgya bod sog gsum la dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba ni dus dbang thengs brgyad pa lags/ brgyad pa'i bcu gnyis nas byams me'i skya ser yongs kyi bskul ngor ma mo thang nas dus 'khor dbang chen gsungs pa ni lan dgu ba'o/ /chu sprel lor gung thang mthong grol mchod rten chen mo(mchod rten thog ma ni gung thang sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi lor rten dang brten pa bzhengs grub cing kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho dang mnyam du rab gnas mdzad de byin rlabs kyi gter chen bsgrubs/ rab rgyal me rta lor dmar srung dmag ces pa'i rig gsar gyi chom pos rmeg med du bcom)bskyar bzhengs grub/ de'i rten gtso'i rigs la gung thang sku phreng dang bo nas lnga ba'i bar dang / bka' bstan gtsos pota 'bum gnyis kyi gras su rin po che'i phyag bris can glegs bam dgu brgya lhag mgon po klu sgrub kyi rdo rje phag mo klu 'jim ma/ 'od dpag med kyi thugs ga'i 'jigs byed/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i 'bas chags/ slob dpon pad+ma'i dbu skra/ khyad par du gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i sku gdung de snga tshogs chen 'du khang me 'jig skabs ma tshig pa mchod rten gyi rten gtsor spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa bcas rten 'gangs can mang du bzhugs/ chu bya lo'i zla drug par bsang khog rtswa thang du dus 'khor dbang chen thengs bcu ba gnang ba la dbang thob pa bod rgya sog mi grangs 'bum gsum lhag 'dus skad/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nas phyi lo'i gcig pa'i nyer brgyad bar a ri'i sangs rgyas bstan pa chos tshogs dang khong gi bu slob lo'u nyin dang li'u yo lin khyo shug le'u lin nā/ wang zho zhan bcas thun mong nas grong khyer la'o hran cir gdan drangs/ der yang mi rigs dang sha mdog mi gcig pa'i mi grangs bdun brgya lhag la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang skyabs 'gro'i lung gnang / mdor na gung thang gser khri 'di bas chos lugs gcig bu ma yin par rgyal khab dang mi rigs spyi'i don/ bye brag tu bod kyi rig gnas dang slob gso/ dpal 'byor sogs gang ci'i thad la'ang phyag rjes bla na ma mchis pa bzhag mthar chu 'brug lo'i lugs rnying zla1pa'i tshes 26nyin(spyi zla 2pa'i tshes1nyin)gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /2 zam tsha gser khri sku phreng rim byon/zam tsha sku phreng dang bo ngag dbang nam mkha' bzang bo(1690da wa 1750)ni da lta'i kun lho'i klu chu rdzong zam tsha 'ing gi rmog ri'i gdan thang du sku 'khrungs/ yab yum gyi mtshan la dkon mchog skyabs dang klu mo skyid zer/ de'u mgo'i dben gnas ri khrod pa 'phags ge bla mar bsten/ 'dul 'dzin pa nyang tsha tshang las rab tu byung / dgung lo bco lnga'i thog khri rgyal mtshan seṅge dang mnyam du yul dbus su phebs(1704)— 32 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/shing 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang dang lha sa'i rgyud kyi dben gnas du mar gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jings su brgal te mkhas grub chen por gyur/ kun mkhyen dang bo dang mkhas dbang dpal ldan grags pa sogs mang bo bsten/ 1726lor 'bras spungs rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags thob cing paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes las bsnyen par rdzogs/ snga rting du rgyud stod mkhan po dang dga' ldan shar rtse'i chos rjer bskos/ de nas me stag lo(1746 1750)la dga' ldan khri rabs nga lnga bar 'bas pad bkod kyang phyis bod du dus 'gyur mang ba(mnga' ris sgar dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan gyi gyod)sogs rkyen du gyur te khri btsan phab las sa sbrul dgung lo drug cu'i dus glo bur du sku 'das so/ /zam tsha gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang 'jigs med nam mkha'(1768da wa1821)ni/ mtsho sngon sog yul dpal gur chen thang du yab ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang yum ma ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/dgung lo dgu'i steng kun mkhyen gnyis pas ngos 'dzin mdzad de zam tsha'i gdan khrir bkod/ rjes su bsnyungs sel du bkra shis 'khyil bar gdan drangs shing 'gro song thams cad bla brang nang gis phul/ sum mthil rdo rams pa dkon mchog lhun grub dge rgan du bsten/ dgung lo bcu gsum dus chos grwar dngos su zhugs shing nyi shu'i thog kun mkhyen las dge tshul slong gi sdom pa mnos/ rma chu'i be shing dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi khur bzhes/ dmu dge'i 'khor lo dgon pa'i khri bar phebs/ pe cin yon ho kon nam bde ldan byin chags gling bdag skyong gi 'khri ba lhur bzhes/ pho brang du bar bgegs kun sel gyi sbyin sreg btang ba phan thogs/ gong mas hi thog thu'i cho lo bstsal cing kyā chin gong mas bla mar bsten/ sku phyi ma dag kyang pe cin du gdan 'dren pa'i srol btod/ 180khalor bkra shis 'khyil du rgyal ba seṅge nga ro smi bcu gnyis can bzhugs pa'i lha khang ngo mtshar che ba bzhengs/ rang yul rmog ri dgon dga' ldan byams 'phel gling btab/'jigs med dbang bo las bsnyen par rdzogs/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i drin gzo la gser dngul gyi bdog pa gya nom btegs so/ /zam tsha gser khri sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sbrul lo slar mtsho sngon sog por sku bltams/ gdan sar 'khor phyin ma 'gyangs par spyi lo1822ste chu 'brug dgung lo bcu gnyis su sku 'das so/ /zam tsha gser khri sku phreng ba'i ba 'jigs med bsam grub rgya mtsho(1rnga22da wa1)ni/ da lta'i gan lho'i bsang chu rdzong kho tshe zhing du yab bde legs dang yum mgon po 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi bar bkra shis 'khyil du spyan drangs shing sde khri gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma'i spyan snga nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ chu stag lor sde khri las zam tsha ba'i yang srid dus ngos bzung zhing kun mkhyen gsum pa las rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ chu byi lor gong ma'i bka' phebs bzhin pe cin du chibs bsgyur mdzad/ rgyal khab nang 'khrug zhi bar drag po'i sbyin sreg nyin bdun du bsgrubs pa phan thogs che bar snang — 33 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bas gong mas dngos 'gyed spam mtho bstsal cing phyag rgya'i bla ma zhes bkur bsti che ba mdzad/ sog po'i mda' tshan bar gyi gyod bsdums/ ri bo rtse lnga sogs gnas skor du phebs/ dpal rin pe tsir dus 'khor dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad/ sde khri rin po che dang kun mkhyen rin po cher rin po che gtos che ba dag drin gzor phul pa dang dgon par yang sbyor 'jags che/ shis tshang chos 'khor sgar sar gyi khri ba dang / shing glang lor bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs nga gsum pa mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bzhi'i steng sku gshegs so/ /zam tsha gser khri lnga ba skal bzang 'jigs med nam mkha' (1〈75da wa18kha9)ni/ lcags 'brug lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug pas ngos 'dzin mdzad cing bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ shing lug lor kun mkhyen las dge tshul slong gi sdom khrims mnos pa dang de rjes kyai rdor grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs/ 1895lor gong ma'i bka' bsgos dang len sgos pe cin du phebs/ sa phag lor pe cin du sku 'das so/ /zam tsha gser khri sku phreng drug pa skal bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho(1901da wa1kha55)ni/ da lta 'i kun lho'i rma chu rdzong gi dngul rwa'i 'brog khyim du sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas zam tsha sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos bzung / 1908sa sprel lor bkra shis 'khyil du gdan sar bkod cing kun mkhyen sku dngos kyis rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom khrims bstsal a mchog gsung rab dge rgan bsten/ gzhung bka' pota gsan sbyong mdzad do/ /zam tsha gser khri sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang rnam rgyal ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi lor(19〈2 4 19)mtsho sngon thun te rdzong du yab rnam rgyal dang yum rdo rje 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ 1992lor kun mkhyen drug pa dang gung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug sde khri brgyad pa/ lha mo'i gser khri bcas kyis thun mong du thugs thag bcad de/ lo de'i hor zla2pa'i tshes11nyin la bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan sar bkod cing / da lta slob gnyer la brtson 'grus bgyi bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /2 hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng rim byon/hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng dang bo ngag dbang dpal ldan grags pa(16〈2da 1729)ni/ da lta'i bsang chu rdzong gi hor gtsang go nyin yab dpon po mgon po seṅge dang yum skyid mo yag gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ba so rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma las rab tu byung / dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang dang lha sa'i rgyud smad grwa tshang 'grims shing kun mkhyen dang bo dang gung thang dang bo sogs skyes chen du mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung brgya bklags/ mkhas grub kyi grags snyan brnyes/ rgyud smad mkhan po dang dga' ldan shar rtse'i chos rje bzhes/ rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin du gdan drangs/brag yer ba'i rgyud stod lha khang bzhengs/ rab nye sa phag lor 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi khri rabs nga gcig par bzhugs(1719—1725)/ dgung lo lnga bcu'i skabs tsam du 'bar khams su sku — 31 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dal/ra chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gshegs/ rje nyid la dga' gdan gser khri thob pa'i bu slob ngag dbang chos ldan dang / khri/ rgyal mtshan seṅge / ngag dbang nam mkha' bzang bo/ tsha gan no min han ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs grags can mang ngo / /hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho(1721—1747)ni/ sku gong rma 'i khyim du slar 'khrungs/ yab chos skyong bkra shis dang / yum mtsho mo skyid du 'bod/ sde khri dang po blo bzang don grub pa las rab tu byung 'ing dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ bkra shis 'khyil du bzhugs pa dang dgung lo bcu bdun steng lha 'brum gyis sku gshegs so/ /hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rigs pa'i sedhe(1747da wa1815)ni/ hor gtsang 'bru 'dren gyi lung stod du khyu mchog rus su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bos ngos 'dzin mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bar grwa sar zhugs/ dgung lo brgyad par khri rgyal mtshan seṅges gtsos dgon par gdan drangs pa dang lcags 'brug la kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i zhal gsung bzhin bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ nyer bzhi bar dbus su phebs nas 'bras sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa bla mar bsten/ so gsum par phyir pha yul du phyag phebs gnang / dgung lo zhe gsum dus bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs nyi shu bar(1789—1792)bzhugs/ zhabs brtan lha khang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ phyis su rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs pa bcas bstan 'gro'i don mang du mdzad do/ /hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng bzhi ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma(1815—1〈75)ni/ da lta'i zi khron rnga ba'i dbal shul dpon po yab mkha' 'gro 'bum dang yum bsod nams skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen gsum pa dang gung thang gsum pas ngos 'dzin mdzad de dgung lo bzhi bar bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan sar bkod cing bcu gsum par tshogs chos 'grims/ nyer bzhi'i dus dbus su chibs bsgyur nas dbus gtsang gnas chen du mar mjal cing paṇa chen bdun pa'i sku mdun du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos pa dang tshe dbang thob/ de nas sgo mang sogs su rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos byings slob gnyer mdzad/shing sbrul cho 'phrul smon lam skabs su lha rams pa'i dam pa ang dang po thon/ lo der rang yul du phyag phebs/shing stag lor bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs zhe bdun pa bzhugs/ sog po'i pā rin che chung dang ne min/ar hor chin/ ca ron/ o nyog khor tan/ a pā ga ca zo nyi/ tsha gar sogs su chibs bsgyur te chos sbyin rgya cher bstsal nas lo bzhi 'gyangs/ kun mkhyen gsum pa thugs rtsis ha cang che/ sog mi mang bo bkra shis 'khyil gyi sbyin bdag mchod gzhis su gyur/ kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa gshegs pa dang bzhi ba khri bzhugs legs grub bar chos srid kyi 'gan gcig lcogs su bzhes shing yos lo nas lcags bya bar grwa zur du bzhugs myong ngo / /— 35 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng lnga ba skal bzang dpal ldan grags pa(1875 1912)ni/ da lta'i bsang chu rdzong mdzod dge shog par na to'u chu med du sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis hor gtsang lnga bar thugs thag bcad cing me khyi lor bkra shis 'khyil du khri bzhugs gnang /sa phag lor lha sar phebs/ phyir lhags te mtsho sngon sog yul dang hro ther ju nang ar khe'i dgon du khri bzhugs gnang ba dang kun mkhyen bka' lung bzhin rgyal dbang bcu gsum par dngos 'bul du phyag phebs te bla slob kyi 'brel ba je zab tu gyur to/ /hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho(1912—195rnga)ni/ da lta'i rma chu rdzong gi khro kho nur ma'i 'brog khyim du yab tshe rdor dang yum shis skyid kyi sras lu sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du gdan sar bkod/ rgan gya'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho dge rgan bsten/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ chos grwar lo bcu lhag bzhugs mthar dbus gtsang phyogs su dam chos lhur gzhol du grwa sa mang bo 'grims/ rma chu'i nur ma'i gsang sngags thar ba gling btab pa dang bkra shis 'khyil bar sgrol dkar lha khang bzhengs/ nur ma'i dgon dang shis tshang dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/bcings 'grol byas rjes rang yul du phebs nas srid gzhung la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi bya ba bsgrubs pa dang / ba kra shis 'khyil ba'i khri chen gya drug pa'i 'gan(1951—1952)bzhes so/ /hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng bdun pa 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho/ da lta'i bsang chu rdzong rgan gya ru19nga0lor sku 'khrungs/ 1kha91lor kun mkhyen dang gung thang tshang / sde khri rin po che bcas thun mong nas thugs thag bcad de hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan khrir bkod do/ /4 sde khri sku phreng rim byon/sku phreng dang bo sde ba blo bzang don grub(1672—1746)ni/ mdo smad khri kha'i sa cha lan kyo zhes bya ba'i yul du ltag ring gi rus las yab bla dwags dge bsnyen gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug par la mo bde chen dgon du khu bo rab 'byams pa'i mdun du klog slob mdzad/ bcu drug la 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho dang tā dbon pa kun dga' 'od zer las gzhung mang gsan/ gung thang khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs las bka' chos mang bo sbyangs/ khong gi bag chags sad cing rig pa shin tu dmar bas dgung lo nyer lnga bar lha ldan smon lam skabs rtsod rgyugs kyi mtshan snyan rgyas par gyur cing sgo mang grwa tshang gi sde bar bskos/ lcags 'brug la sgo mang mkhan sar kun mkhyen gyi bka' bzhin phyag mdzod kyi 'gan bzhes/ me rta lor dge bskos dang sa glang lor kun mkhyen gyi rjes 'brangs nas bkra shis 'khyil gsar 'debs su bzhud dgos par gyur/ thog mar rgyud smad khri bar bzhugs pa dang dgung lo re drug pa sa rta lor 'jam mgon bla ma sku gshegs rjes tshogs chen khrir bzhugs shing / btsun mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma'i sbyor 'jags la brten tshogs chen 'du khang gsar bzhengs dang rung khang / kun mkhyen bla brang / rgyud smad 'du khang — 36 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs legs grub mdzad/ kun mkhyen gyi yang srid gdan khrir bkod/ /sde khri sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med lung rigs rgya ma tsho(1748—1778)ni/ mtsho sngon rong bo dgon chen gyi khri rabs dgu ba rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tsha bor sku 'khrungs shing kun mkhyen gnyis pas thugs thag bcad pa dang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par tshogs chen du zhugs/bka' bcu dkon mchog rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ nyer gcig la dbus gtsang du phebs/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du slob gnyer dang lha sa'i smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad/ nyer brgyad la a mdo'i gdan 'dren pas nan zhus pa la mnal ltas mi legs gsungs kyang thabs zad ngang phyir chibs bsgyur mdzad cing bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs bcu drug par zhabs pad bkod kyang phyi lor sku gshegs so/ /rje 'di nyid lcang skya rin po ches er ti ni mergan shes rab hi thog thu zhes pa dang paṇa chen drug pas 'jam dpal no min han zhes pa/rgyal dbang brgyad pas er tina'i cho lo dang tham ga sogs bstsal to/ /sde khri sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma(177kha—1nga62)ni/ mdo smad rtse gzhung gi pe len nā rgan gyi yab yi bo phun tshogs sa ma ka 'bum sman pa ngag dbang phun tshogs dang yum lha mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga ba la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos sde ba snga ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang zhing / shing 'brug lor bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ dbang lung rjes gsum du ma mnos/bcu gcig par tshogs chen du zhugs/ bcu bzhi bar gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me las dge tshul slong gi sdom khrims bzhes/ nyer bdun skabs su be shing dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs pa dang zhe drug la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khrir zhabs pad 'khod/ rig pa lob skyen pas bod sog skad gnyis smra ba la thogs pa mi mnga'/ er khe dgon pa'i khrir gdan drangs/ mdo lung bu bla dgon/ bka' chen r+pā li dgon pa'i dus 'khor grwa tshang /shis tshang sgar sar bcas phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang / ri bo rtse lnga dang pe cin/ phyi sog sogs su thengs ba'ir phebs/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i bka' shog tham ga thob pa dang / khyad par du kun mkhyen bzhi ba khri 'god sogs la sbyor 'jags che/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas gser khri'i go gnas bstsal/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil bar gser khri rnam bzhir gyur/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang bzhengs/ ljags rtsom yang pota drug bzhugs pa ma zad/ rje bla ma khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma la gtso shos su lcang skya bzhi ba dang lnga ba/chu bzang ho thog thu/ thu'u bkwan ho thog thu blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ a kyā ho thog thu/ rwa kho ho thog thu/na ro ho thog thu/ stong skor ho thog thu/ sgom zhis mkhan po/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba/ gzhan dga' ldan khri chen rnam gsum/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol la sogs grangs kyis mi long ba yod do/ /sde khri sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang lung rigs nyi ma(1862—1rnga74)ni/ sngon co ne sa skyong gi khongs gtogs a 'khor rtig gu rngog pa sde ba'i yab nam mkha' don grub dang yum mkha' 'gro'i sras su sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen bzhi bas thugs thag bcad/ rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas rab byung dge tshul gyi — 37 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/khrims gtsang bzhes shing 'jam mgon pradzha'i mtshan can las bde gsang 'jigs gsum kyi rdor dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i zur bka'i dbang gang yod dang mi tra rdo phreng sogs spyi bka'i dbang / rin 'byung /brgya gram 'a sogs mang du gsan/ dgung lo dgu'i dus shis tshang sga sar du phebs te grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan dang sgrig lam/ rtsod pa/ 'don rta dbyangs sogs 'ib gzigs dang zhal bkod mdzad/ phyi lor ri bo rtse lngar chibs bsgyu ra/ gnas chen du mar dag snang mang bo byung ba dang / lcang skya rin po che mjal/ pā rin lbang dang a ru hor chen r+pā li/ mai tri ho thog thu sogs dad ldan gyi re ba bskangs/ do lon bu lag bcas su zhugs ma thar shing khyi lor sku gshegs so/ /sde khri sku phreng lnga ba 'jigs med thub bstan nyi ma ni/ yab yum gong ma dang gcig pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs / dgung lo drug par kun mkhyen ba'i bas sngar bzhin ngos 'dzin gnang zhing bkra shis 'khyil du sadan drangs nas khrir bkod/ rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs dam pa du ma bsten nas gzhung bka' sogs la tshul ba'in sbyong bar ga'ol/ smad sog rgya nag tu phebs/ sham bha la'i rig ldan nyer lnga'i 'jim sku bzhengs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'jam dbyangs lha khang zhig gso bgyis/ drang nges rnam 'byed zin bris bla ma'i thugs rje 'od stong gis phye ba'i legs bshad pad+ma dkar bo sogs dpe mtshan pota gcig bzhugs so/ /sde khri sku phreng drug pa skal bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho(189〈da wa 1kha2kha)ni/ mdo smad reb gong the bu nas yab tshe brtan dang yum yi dam skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas chu stag lor thugs thag bcad cing bkra shis 'khyil du khrir gsol/ rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes / bcu gcig steng rmad byung thos bsam gling du zhugs te blo bzang rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ gzhung lugs smra ba la ga'an dring mi 'jog pa'i klong brdol/ bcu dgu ba la phar phyin dam bca'i mtshan btags thob/ dngul rwa dang shis tshang sgar sar gyi khrir bzhugs/ a ru hor chen lbang gis gdan drangs/ ltar smad sog tu chos sbyin gtong bar phebs/ shing khyi nas lo gsum gyi ring bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs brgyad cu ba bzhugs/ me byi hor zla drug par kun mkhyen lnga ba dang lhan du paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi tshul khrims ba'es so/ /sde phri sku phreng bdun pa 'jam dbyangs bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan(1kha40ba1944)ni/ da lta'i gan lho'i klu chu'i shis tshang chos 'khor tsho ba bcu gnyis longs/ dpal sgur 'bum khang sgang gi yab lha mo don grub dang yum rta mgrin skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis ngos 'dzin gnang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi khrir 'khod cing rgya zhabs drung skal bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sku gam nas dge tshul gyi sdom khrims bzhes/ sku'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i skabs 'phral nad yams khur bzhes kyi tshul du dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /— 38 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sde phri sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ da lta'i zi khron zhing chen rnga ba rdzong gi snga ra gyi mdzod dge shog pa bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan byams me dpon skor du yab bsam gtan dang yum bsod nams skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ thu'u bkwan ho thog thu rje skal bzang dam chos nyi mas gser khri gong ma rnam gsu/ma bzhugs dbus zan sgyu ra thabs ngang ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan khrir 'khod cing rgya 'bas drung ska la bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar bslab khrims dkyus gcig tu mnos pa dang dge bshes blo bzang mtha' yas yo ngas 'dzin du bsten/ de nas shis tshang sgar sa ra du bzhud de gnam 'o gas ra tshes kyi dga' ston rol pa dang dad ldan pa'i bsnyen bkur zhus par mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon grung bo 'gro ba'i rgyud la btab/ chu sbrul lor bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor spyi tshogs dus 'gyur byung ba dang ( 1kha5981962) nub byang mi rigs slo ba grwa'i slob gso'i 'dzin grwar zhugs/ de rjes(1962—1968)kan lho khul gyi chab srid slob grwar slob sbyong mdzad/ de rjes bsang khog gi 'brog sder thon skyed ngal rtsol la zhugs nas yu na ring bzhugs pa dang 1979lor bsang chu rdzong gi srid gros rgyun ur bdamaca / lcags bya lor rdzong srid gros kru'u zhi ga'on par bskos shing shis tshang sgar sar sla/ ra gso'i skyong khur dang mthun rkyen sbyar/ yang rdzong dpon ga'on pa'i 'gan bzhes skabs gung thang drug pa rin po che dang bsdongs te ma nge 'ing dang a mchog nyi ma lung bar gyi rtswa sa rtsod gleng bsdums/ 1kha86lor pe cin krung go'i bod ba rgyud nang bstan slob gling du dam chos gzhung bka' mang bo zhig sbyangs/ de rjes rgya nang dang bod dbus gnas chen mang bor mjal gzigs su phebs/ paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhal ya/nga mjal 'a gang gi dgongs rdzogs sam yang srid myur gsal gyi don du smon 'dun shugs dwag ma dzad/ da dung bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzhengs dang de'i grub ston gyi bya ba mang bor thugs tshegs mdzad pa dang zam tsha dang hor tshang gser khri/ bla ma dkar po dang khya dge dpon slob bcas kyi yang srid thag gcod pa'i gros tshogs su zhugs nas zhal gsung gnad khel mang du gnang / 1992lor shis tshang chos 'khor tsho ba bcu gnyis kyi dad ldan skya ser khri phrag la thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang gnang ba dang shis tshang sgar sar/ co ne'i a 'khor brag dkar/ rmog ru dgon/ shis tshang sgar rnying bcas kyi grwa mang la mgon chos gnyi ga'i rjes gnang 'ib rgyas bstsal / 1988lor gan su'u zhing chen gyi gzhon nu 'brel tshogs kyi kru'u 'i gzhon pa dang / bkra shis 'khyil ba'i do dam kru'u rin bcas su bskos/ 2 0 06'o ra shis tshang sgar sar du dus 'khor dbang chen thengs dang bo gnang / da lta kun su'u cing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs gyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa dang kun su'u 'ing chen srid gros kyi kru'u 'i gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa'i skabs so/ /5 mkhan po rnam pa brgyad/bkra shis 'khyil bar mkhan po rnam pa brgyad ces thog mar grags can byon pa rnams las so so 'i sku phreng rim byon gyi mtshan tho tsam 'god par bya ba la/ spyir da lta mkhan ming bstsal pa de bas mang na'ang skabs — 39 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'dir bod yig dang rgya yig mngon mthong dag las mkhan sa dngos su thob pa lo rgyus yig rigs su bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/(1) rgyal mkhan po/ 'di ba'i sku phreng dang bo ni sgo mang bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje zer/ de'i yang srid rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan yin/ khong 'bo ra'i rgya sgar thang du1ra62lor sku 'khrungs/ 'bras sgo mang mkhan rtags thob phyir rang dgon bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen khrir mnga' gsol/ 18 27lor sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho tsha kho btsan lha'i a shen gyi rgyud du18 2〈lor sku 'khrungs/ de'i yang srid skal bzang grags pa rgya mtsho ste/ mdzod dge nyin ma'i 'brog sder sku 'khrungs/gdan sa'i khri rabs don ba'i bar bzhugs/ 'di'i sprul sku skal bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas 1kha2 4lor rma chu'i dngul rwa nas sku 'khrungs/ 195〈lor btson du bcug cing phyis su gdan sa nas sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng drug pa blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho 1984lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la a mchog nyi ma lung nas sku 'khrungs shing kun mkhyen drug pas ngos 'dzin ma/dzad de 1khakha2lo'i zla dgu bar gdan sar bkod do/ /( 2) sgo mang tshang / sgo mang sku phreng dang bo blo bzang chos dar ni 172 2lor mtsho sngon ka ring du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bdun dus 'bras sgo mang chos grwar 'grims shing mkhan ming thob/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs nyer gnyis pa mdzad mthar nga gcig par sku gshegs/gnyis pa skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho ni slar ka ring du 'khrungs shing gdan sa'i khri rabs so gsum par bzhugs/ de'i yang srid blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni190 1lor rma chu'i khro kho smad mar sku 'khrungs/gsung rtsom la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u dang bo'i bsdus don mchan 'grel/ le'u gnyis pa'i bsdus don cha tshang pota chen ba'i bzhugs so/ ba'i ba skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ dmu dge bar gzheng la sku 'khrungs/ gdan sar khri lo lnga dang dgon lag du ma'i khrir phebs/ khyad par du gso rig mkhyen rgya che bas mi ser gyi na tsha bkrol bar mdzad do/ de'i yang srid blo bzang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ni co ne rdzong a 'khor dgon chags sde bar1970lor sku 'khrungs/ 1kha94lor kun mkhyen drug pas sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad do/ /( 2) bde thang mkhan po/ bde thang sku phreng dang bo bsod nams bkra shis co ne bde thang ya rur sku 'khrungs shing dbus su bka' bcu'i mtshan btags thob/ ljags rtsom yang snang / 1641lor sku gshegs/sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni bsang chu rdzong gtsos kha yangs nas sku 'khrungs/ yul dbus rgyal me tog thang gi mkhan por bzhugs/ sog yul dang rang yul dgon pa mi nyung ba btab cing skyong khur mdzad/ rgyal dbang gis mkhan ming bstsal/ brtsams chos mang / 1718lor sku gshegs/gsum pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog nyi ma ni co ne'i ni'u mgo nas sku 'khrungs/ mkhan po btsan po ma zer/178 2lor sku gshegs/ de'i yang srid 'jam dbyangs phyogs las rnam rgyal ni co ne bde thang ya rur sa — 40 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bya1789lor sku 'khrungs/ sog yul du1808lor sku gshegs/ lnga ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni1810lor co ne'i bde thang stag pa lung nas sku 'khrungs/ smad sog sogs sa phyogs mang du chibs sgyur mdzad/ 1849lor sku gshegs/ de'i yang srid 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho sku gong ma'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ dgon sde mang bo dang bla brang khri chen la bzhugs/ 1nga94lor sku gshegs/ sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma ni1rnga95lor bsang chu rdzong bsang khog ri mang nas sku 'khrungs/ chas bu gshis dang 'bo ra/ bla brang rgyud smad sogs kyi khrir bzhugs/ bu slob mang bo bskyangs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor btson du lan kru'u ru sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang don grub rgya mtsho ni197khalor co ne'i brag khog lung 'ing du sku 'khrungs/ 1992lor kun mkhyen drug pas ngos bzung ltar gdan sar 'khod kyang / rab gnas lcags 'brug lor(spyi lo2000ba/)sku gshegs so/ /(4) mkhan po no min han/ (mkhan po rnam brgyad kyi gras yin) sku phreng rim byon bkra shis 'khyil du bzhugs pa nyung cing yul gzhan du phyag rjes che bar grags/ lo rgyus 'pho 'gyur gyi dbang gis da lta rnam thar rtsad ma chod par re zhig mtshan tsam 'god rgyu las ma byung ngo / /)(5) mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs ni/ gtsos 'brong lce'i dpon tshang rnam 'joms rgyal gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen dang bos bkra shis 'khyil ba gsar 'debs skabs su gtsos shog pa'i dpon tshang res grwa rgyun re phul pa'i gras su 'di ba byin/ dgung lo bcu drug bzhes tshe dbus su phebs/ de dus paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes mchog la zhal mjal tshe khong gis 'al rtsed nas 'di ba ni grub chen brgyad cu'i nang tshan gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor ba zhig gi skyes pa red ces lung du zin/ yang sgo mang mkhan slob zung gis kyang mgon po klu sgrub kyi skye bar zhal gyis bzhes skad/ dpon slob sangs rgyas sde'i dus lha rams pa'i mtshan btags thob cing 'bras sgo mang dge bskos dang rgyal sras ye shes grags pa bcas kyi zhabs la bsten/ yang rgyud smad du sngags sbyangs shing dam bca' bzhag rtse drung mkhan po dang rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad nas sgo mang mkhan por bzhugs/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i yig cha 'dzin chos rgyun chags dgos tshul gyi tshogs gtam dang bu slob mang bor bsdus grwa khrid skul sogs rgyal bstan bla lhag tu spel mthar shing lug1775lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin thugs dam ngang sku lus kyi bkod pa bsdus/ gsung rtsom pota 'ga' bzhugs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho(1776—1882)ni yul dbus 'phan po'i yul du rngog chos sku rdo rje'i gdung rgyud yab gsol tog dang yum dpal mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig me rta lor skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ba'in chabs gcig mdo smad du chibs bsgyur/ a rig gsung rab dang gtsos dkon gyi drung du gzhung brgya'i 'jings su 'jug rong bo bkra shis chos rdzong gi khri lo du ma bzhugs pa dang urger ching lbang gi bla mar mdzad cing smad sog sogs su phebs/ lcags yos lor gdan sa chen po'i tshogs khrir zhabs pad bkod do/ /— 41 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang thub bsta na rgya ma/tsho( 1〈 2(4——— —1rngarnga9)mdo smad rma chu'i lho rgyud sta ga 'u nga zhes par rus ldo nga nyang phan tshang yab mgon po don grub dang yum sgrol ma/ 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug gi steng kun mkhyen gsum pas ngos 'dzin mdzad cing rab byung dge tshu' ma nos te dge bshes bsam gtan rgya mtsho slob dpon du bsten/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon ma chog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas dbang lung khrid gsum mang du gas na cing thos bas ma gling gi tshogs chos legs par 'grims te gzhung pota lnga dpyis phyin par bslabs/ sa sbrul lor shis tshang sgang sar gyi khri la ma/nga' gsol pa ngang1879lor dbus gtsang gnas skor du phebs te gdan sa ma nga bor ma nga 'gyed phul cing skyes bu mang bor dbang lung rjes gsu ma bstsal/kun mkhyen gsum pa'i rnam thar〈〈 bshad sgrub bstan pa'i ma dzes rgyan〉 dang rnam thar/ gso la 'debs /bstod pa/ lam rim gyi skor sogs pota bdun mdzad do/ /sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho ma chog( 1〈91da 1kha2 2 )mdo smad rma yul mdzod dge nyin ma nas sku 'khrungs/ mdo dbus kyi grwa sa ma/nga bo'i skyes bu dam pa mang bo rtse gcig tu bsten cing 'chad nyan sgom sgrub lhur blangs pas ma khas pa chen por gyur/ ljags rtsom pota lnga bzhugs so/sku phreng lnga ba skal bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal ma/tshan/ rab rgyal sa yos1929lor co ne klu chu'i byang rgyud mtha' tshang a ma gon de'u grong du rngog tsho ba'i bla dpon skar ma zhes pa'i sku mched yab tshe dpag rdo rje dang yum ban de 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgya mtshan pas phyag mdud dang kha btags srid ring gnang zhing mtshan bstsal/ dgung lo lnga'i steng khong gis thugs thag bcad de mkhan khrir bkod/ rgya 'bas drung gi sku gam/ nas rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs/ dge bshes oṃ 'khyil ma/chog yongs 'dzin du bsten cing / dbang bka' chos khrid 'al lung bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ dgung lo bcu dgu'i steng rmad byung thos bsam gling du phar phyin dam bca' bzhag de rjes spyi tshogs 'gyur ldo ga gi rkyen 'a/sa skya chas bzhes te chab srid slob grwar phyi 'brel srid jus pa dang las byed du zhugs/ da lta zhing chen dmangs chen dang khul dmangs chen rgyun u/ bsang chu rdzong dmangs chen kru'u rin gzhon pa dang rdzong srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ khul srid gros kyi rgyun u'i 'gan bzhes te mi ser la phan bde'i legs tshogs kyi bya ba mi nyung ba sgrub bzhin no/ /ba cung gar mkhan po/ cung gar sprul sku dang bo cung gar blo bzang phun tshogs zhes pa yin/ (sku thog gnyis pa nas ba'i ba'i bar rtsad ma chod par lus) sku phreng lnga ba shis tshang sgar sar gyi grwa sa 'grims pa'i skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho yi na/ sku phreng drug pa shis tshang dgon dga' ldan gshad sgrub chos 'khor gling gi gdan rabs zhe gnyis pa cung gar mkhan po skal bzang ma khyen rab rgya mtsho zhes pa ste cung phug rab gsum gyi ya gyal yin/ kun mkhyen gyis sku na phra dus nas thugs thag bcad/ shis tshang khrir bzhugs skabs su grwa tshogs kyi 'chad nyan dar bar mdzad/ de nas co ne chas bu gshis dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/ skabs shig la — 42 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yu la 'khrug don rkyen las gdan sar bzhugs ma tshugs par dbus kyi grwa sa 'ga' 'grims/ 'di ba'i yang srid ni da lta ba cung gar bdun pa blo bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho lags te/ 1951lor da lta'i klu chu rdzong gi ma nge 'ang rtsa skor du sku 'khrungs/ yab yum gyi mtshan la tshul khrims dang rta mgrin skyid zer/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis cung gar spru skur ngos 'dzin gnang / phyis chab srid dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis gdan khrir ma 'byor bar ri grong kho nas lo sum cu lhag bzhugs dgos byung / da lta slar shis tshang sgar sar dang bkra shis 'khyil du gzim khang brgyab cing / 1992lo nas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i thos bsam gling du tshogs zhugs mdzad/ srid las phyogs su klu chu rdzong srid gros rgyun u dang khul srid gros rgyun u bcas kyi 'gan bzhes/ krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling 'grims pa dang dge bshes 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'al snga nas sdom khrims dkyus gcig tu mnos/7 phyag mdzod mkhan po/ 〈 stag lung mkhan po/ 'di rnam pa zung gi sku rim byon kyang gsal thag ma chod par re 'ig dus tshod kyi dbang gis ma lus rang 'u sa su gyur pas klog mkhan rnams kyis bzod par gsol lags/ /ga'an da dung mkhan ming thob pa la/ dpa' ris pa tshang / rgya nag pa/ nor bu tshang / dbal mang chung ba/ nying tshang / nu gu tshang / dkon mchog seṅge sogs mchis te mu mthud 'ib 'jug bya rgyu yod par snyam mo/ /le'u gsum pa/ skyes chen dam pa/ chos grwa'i do dam/ dad ldan sbyin bdag sogs kyi skor/1 skyes chen dam pa dag gi mtshan tsam rjes dran gyi tshul du bgrangs na/ kun mkhyen sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang po/ kun mkhyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon bla ma thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis/ hor tshang gsum pa 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge / gung thang gnyis pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan(tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rdo rje) gung thang gsum pa bstan pa'i sgron me/ sde khri gnyis pa 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho/ sde khri gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma/ dpa' ris pa dkon mchog bde chen/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍita dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dbal mang blo bzang don grub/rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ bde thang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ ma khan po ngag dbang dge legs/ dbal mang chung ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ sgo mang mkhan po blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ rgya zhabs drung rin po che/ ber stong blo bzang 'phrin las/ hor blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje blo bzang snyan grags/ dpa' ris dam chos/ rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ bsod grags dang bo bsod — 43 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/nams grags pa/ bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ bsod grags skal bzang bsod nams rgya mtsho/rtse gzhung shes rab rgya mtsho/ dus 'khor 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ gling dkon mchog rgyal ba'i blo gros/gling skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho sogs dang mtshan gyis ma zin pa ha cang mang po byon no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i gras kyi gsung rtsom can kha shas dper na/ khri bsod nams dbang rgyal/rje blo bzang chos dar/ khri blo bzang gnas brtan pa/ rigs grwa'i rigs pa'i ral gri(mtshan mi gsal) kha gya dge bshes dar rgyas/ mdzod dge'i bstan 'dzin/ dge bshes dkon mchog nyi ma/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchos chos 'phel/ gung thang blo gros/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin dngul ra'i grags pa/'ang ston bsta na pa rgya ma tsho/ 'ang ston pa thabs mkhas/ paṇa chen yongs 'dzin bsang khog 'jigs med/dge bshes lha mo tshul khrim/sa/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin dpa' ris rab gsal/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin skal bzang dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin dalon mchog bsam grub/ a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ sde khri brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin blo bzang mtha' yas/dus 'khor brtson 'grus/ bshes gnyen legs bshad rgya mtsho/ rdo sbis shes rab rgya mtsho/ lnga rig mkhas ma chog danu dge bsam gtan/ mdzod dge bstan pa rgya mtsho/ (bstan pa sna dmar) kyi rdor ba sa yus bsam grub rgya mtsho/ drung yig smon lam rgya mtsho/ da lta yongs su grags pa'i skyes chen dam pa la gzhung brgya smra ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ sman rams pa bsam grub/ skar rtsis pa bstan pa/ gzhan thu'u bkwan yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ hor gtsang yongs 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ a khyung dge bshes dpal ldan sogs mang du bzhugs so/ /de yang dpe mtshon gyi tshul du gsung 'bum gal chen gyi mtshan byang du ma bkod na/kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon sogs kyis mdzad pa ste tshad ma rnam 'grel/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi mtha' dpyod/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtha' dpyod/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i mtha' dpyod/mdzod kyi dgongs 'grel/ grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba/ bstan rtsis re'u mig 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i 'khrungs rabs kyi phreng ba/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi rnam thar/ gdan sa chen po sku 'bum 'byams pa gling gi gdan rabs/ phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod mdor bsdus/ rje blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i rtogs brjod/ gdan rabs gsang chen chos kyi nyi ma/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs bsdus grwa'i rtsom 'phro/ dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod kyi gsung bshad zin bris/ bsdus grwa'i dgag sgrub legs bshad/ nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/ legs bshad chu shing bstan bcos/ dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/ rgya bod hor sog gi lo rgyus nyung ngur brjod pa/ mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gdan rabs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i spyi don rnam par bzhag pa/ mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho/ grub mtha' legs bshad shel gyi — 44 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/me long / dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba sprin gyi gzhon pa'i rtogs brjod/ deb ther dkar po rtsom 'phro ma/ rdzogs rim gyi rnam bshad/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid yig tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo'i tshig don rnam bshad/ phar phyin bca' yig dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la sa brtsams pa'i bshad pa mdor bsdus gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzengs/ rje btsun blo bzang 'jam/ dbyangs ye shes bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam thar/ chos 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs don gsal bar byed pa / chos mngon rgya mtsho'i dgongs don brjed byang du bkod pa rin chen sgro na me/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel chung / sgron gsal gyi bsdus don/ tshad ma rnam 'grel bsdus don/ bslab bya blang dor gsal ba'i sgro na me sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos brjod kyis mi long ngo /2 chos sde'i do dam rtsa 'dzugs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyal bstan sgrig 'dzugs rgya che zhing zhib tshegs che ba yin te/ khyad par kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku ring du yig tshang dang phyag mdzod kyi lam lugs btsugs pas mgo bar mjug gsum tshad ldan rgyun 'khyongs su grub/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ gtsug tu bzhugs shing / bse ngag dbang bkra shis pas 'chad nyan do dam gyi 'gan dang sde ba blo bzang don grub pas spyi gnyer gyi 'gan/ dpa' ris pas kun mkhyen zhabs phyi'i skor bzhes pa bcas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bla brang zer ba thog mar tshugs/ grwa tshang tshugs pa la khri ba dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi ba/ dkor gnyer sogs las sne du ma bskos/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i dus su sngar gyi mi sna'i steng 'jam dbyangs bla brang dang tshogs chen tshogs 'du/ drung ja tshogs 'du zhes rtsa 'dzugs gong 'og gnyis btsugs/ kun mkhyen bla brang kun mkhyen sku rim byon gtsos pa'i yongs 'dzin dang / sku bcar mkhan po/ phyag mdzod/ nang mdzod bcas/ de'i mnga' 'og tu gsol dpon che gzhon gnyis/ gzim dpon che gzhon gnyis/ mchod dpon che gzhon gnyis/ drung yig chen po/ mgron gnyer chen mo/ kun mkhyen sku tshab/ pho brang sde ba/mchod khang sde ba/ sde chung ba/ nang mdzod gnyer ba dang drung yig la sogs kyis grub pa'o/ /tshogs chen tshogs 'du zhes pa ni kun ma khyen gtsos pa'i dgon skyong rtsa 'dzugs yin/ tshogs chen khri ba/tshogs chen 'al ngo / tshogs chen spyi ba/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ dkon gnyer chen mo/ dpon tshang gnyer ba/ tshogs chen rgan drug drung yig bcas kyi mnga' 'og tu/ grwa tshang so so'i 'dzin bdag la dper na/ thos bsam gling bar khri ba (tshogs chen khri 'gan gcig lcogs can) dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad spyi ba gnyis/ rgan pa drug bcas las sne bcu gcig kye rdor grwa tshang du khri ba dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi chen spyi chung bzhi/ rgan pa drug bcas las sna bcu bzhi/ rgyud smad grwa tshang la khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad gnyis/ spyi chen gnyis/ dngul gnyer/ rab gnas spyi ba/ smyung gnas spyi ba/ rgan pa drug bcas las sne bcu drug rgyud stod grwa tshang la khri ba dang /bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad gnyis/ spyi chen spyi chung bzhi/ rgan pa drug ste las sne bco lnga/— 45 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dus 'khor grwa tshang la khri ba dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi chen gnyis/ dngul gnyer/ mngon byang spyi ba/ rgan pa drug bcas bcu bzhi/ sman pa grwa tshang la khri ba dang / dge bskos/dbu mdzad/ spyi chen gnyis/ sngo sman spyi ba/ ma ṇi spyi ba/ rgan pa drug bcas bcu gsum bcas bskos so/ /bla brang drung ja'i tshogs 'du zhes pa ni kun mkhyen sku dngos kyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig ste/ der las sne gtso rigs la phyag mdzod chen po nyid dang sku bcar mkhan po/ gsol dpon che chung gnyis/ mchod dpon chen mo/ mgron gnyer chen mo/ pho brang sde ba/ sku tshab/ sde chung / 'gog pa/bla brang gnyer ba/ rdzig pa(khrims bdag)sogs bskos nas chos phyogs gtsigs 'dzin gyi zhor tu srid don yang skyong khur dang thag gcod byed/ tshogs 'dur bca' yig bkod pa dang dgon nang do dam 'dzugs skrun don gcod thams cad bsgrub dgos pa ma zad srid don 'brel yod ma lus bsgrub par bya dgos/ da dung dgon pa'am bla ma'i sku tshab(chos srid gnyi ka skyong )dang 'go ba(mi sde kho na skyong ) khri ba(dgon pa'i 'chad nyan bshad sgrub gnyer)sogs dgon lag chos sde'am lha sde mi sder sku tshab mngags te chos srid zung gi 'phrin las ma lus legs 'grub ci yong bgyid do/ /2 tshogs chen khri rabs mtshan tho/ bkra shis 'khyil btab nas lo sum brgya tsam 'das pa'i ring du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gtsos pa'i gser khri dang mkhan po rnams kyis skyong khur 'og dar rgyas rgya chen po byung / de bstun skyes chen dam pa mang bo thad kur tshogs khrir mnga' gsol te 'chad nyan sgrub sbyong sogs kyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ spyir btang khri yun lo gsum re dang khyad par ba'i skabs su lo du ma'am bskyar bzhugs kyang rung (dper na bse dang po lo sum cur bstud mar bzhugs myong )/ da ni khri rabs bzhugs pa rnam pa'i mtshan tho yang dag 'dus pa 'god par bya ba la/1 kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku thog dang po dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ 2'jam mgon bla ma sku phreng dang bo bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ 〈 sde khri dang po blo bzang don grub/ 4'gyang ro ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ 5 gung thang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 6 dbal mang blo bzang don grub/ 7 rje ngag dbang gnas brtan/ rnga gung thang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bskyar bzhugs/ 9dbal mang blo bzang don grub bskyar bzhugs/ 10 gling dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho/ 11 kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ 12 bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ 12 rje blo bzang snyan grags/ 14 gtsos rams ngag dbang 'phrin las/ 15rwa bsod nams dbang rgyal/ 16 sde khri gnyis pa lung rigs rgya mtsho/ 17 grub dbang bsod nams grags pa/ 18rje rab brtan rgya mtsho dang bo/ 19 dpa' ris dkon mchog bde chen/ 20hor tshang gsum pa 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge / 21 gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ 2 2 sgo mang blo bzang chos dar/ 2 2 rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan/— 46 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/24 dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 2 5 mkhas grub dkon mchog seṅge / 26 'gyang ro 'jigs med rgyal mtshan/ 27 kun mkhyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ 28 gling dkon mchog blo gros/ 29 dbal mang chung ba dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 2 0sde khri gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma/ 21 rje dkon mchog dbang phyug 2 2 stag lung che ba blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/2 2 sgo mang skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho/ 24 kang kyā zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs bskal ldan/25 su nyid dkon mchog nor bu/ 26 kho tshe dkon mchog bsod nams/ 27klu shod phun tshogs seṅge / 28 mdzod dge dpal ldan grags pa/ 29 gtsos dkon mchog bstan dar/ 40dpa' ris dkon mchog dam chos yar 'phel/ 41 rje dkon ma chog rgya ma/tsho/ 42 thog ga 'bas drung dkon mchog dge legs rgyal mtshan/ 42 su nyid dge 'dun dar rgyas/ 44 mgo log blo bzang dkon mchog 45 sbyor dpon dkon mchog nyi ma/ 46 thang dkar lha rams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin/ 47 tor gtsang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 48 gung thang ba'i ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgya mtsho/ 49 brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas/ 50 bla go'i bla sar 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ 51 mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ 5 2 chos rdzong dkon mchog bstan pa'i dpal bzang / 5 2 zam tsha 'jigs med bsam grub rgya ma tsho/ 54 dbyig gur dkon mchog seṅge / 55mgo tsha blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ 54 stag ge ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 57 nor bu 'jigs med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ 58 krang kyā 'bas drung blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ 59 phyag mdzod mkhan po blo bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho/ 60 kun mkhyen bache skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug61 dbal mang 'jam dbyangs bsta na 'dzin rgya mtsho/ 62 tsha gan hu'i zhabs drung byams pa rgya ma/tsho/62 mgo rta blo bzang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 64 rgya mkhar dge 'dun sangs rgyas rdo rje/ 65bde thang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ 66 gyo ra blo bzang don grub rgya mtsho/ 67 bsod grags 'jigs med bsod nams rgya mtsho / 68 dbal mang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bskyar bzhugs/ 69 gung thang lnga ba 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 70 rab brtan rgya mtsho'i yang srid dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ 71rgya nag pa blo bzang lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma/ 72brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtsho/ 72 dbal mang chung ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya ma tsho/74 rgyal mkhan po skal bzang grags pa rgya mtsho/ 75 mtsho kha ba skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/76 bla ma phun tshogs skal bzang byams pa rgya ma tsho/ 77 mgo rta 'jam/ dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtsho/78 dme shul mu to skal bzang sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ 79 dpa' ris skal bzang 'jigs med rgya 'bul ba sogs pota stong phrag gsum lhag dang / da dung po ti der dngul srang bco brgyad kyis phyag bris mdzad pa'am blus pa po ti chig khri'i grangs las brgal pa rang dgon du gdan drangs thog dpe mdzod lha khang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ bris ma mang bo par du brkos pa sogs par khang 'dzugs pa'i sngon 'gro'i mthun rkyen gang legs su mdzad/ de nas sku phreng gsum pa'i ring byams chen dang tshe dpag krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'gyed gang yod skabs ri khrod bzhi ma gtogs ham pa tsha bo can re gnyis kyis 'os min sngar med zhal ngo'i slong mo dang gdung mdun mar gso(gsol)lhag par len pa/ dge bskul(bskos)so so/ spyi gnyer che chung /'cham lcags mkhar/ shwa 'cham seng 'cham sogs kyi slong mo byed mi chog rung khang mar sgam dang / mar gzhong nang du'ang mar gso sogs las 'bras drang thig gis ga'al ba las/ ngan g.yo byed mi chog ko btsong('tshong)gor btsong ('tshong)sogs kyi lag nas zhal ngos nom pa zos te bud med tshong byed mkhan rnams rka chu'i phar kha las tshur ro' tu 'dug pa med/ ma nga tshogs nyung 'dus kyi skabs gang yin kyang skor lam tshong ra sogs nas du ba 'then pa/ 'os min gyi gtam sna tshogs smra mi chog gal te drag zhan bar ma su'i khrod nas na'ang yig rigs rnying bar byung ba slar rjes dran tshul 'god par bya/ /gung thang gser khri dang po/ zam tsha gser khri gsum pa/ bse rdo rje 'chang / hor tshang gser khri gnyis pa/ sde khri bzhi ba/ dbal mang tshang (sde srid bzhugs pas kun mkhyen lnga bas sde khri lnga ba'i dmigs bas la gnang )/ bla ma dkar bo (gral rim 'dir bkod kyang nang chen bco brgyad kyi gras min/ gong mas hi thog thu bstsal pa'i rkyen las dmigs bsal can du gyur) ngag dbang dge legs tshang / sgo mang tshang /cung gar tshang / bde thang tshang / hor tshang / dpa' ris pa tshang / phyag mdzod tshang / dbal mang chung ba tshang / rgya 'bas drung tshang / rgyal mkhan po tshang / bla ma phun tshogs tshang / mtsho kha ba tshang / rgya nag pa tshang / nyang ho thog thu(nang chen bco brgyad du 'dus med)/ zhes pa 'di dag ni kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dgung lo nyer gnyis pa'i dus te spyi lo1927lor bskal bzang tshe ring zhes bya bas 〈〈bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus〉zhes pa rgya yig gi rtsom du byung ba ltar yin te da lta'i 'dren tshul cung rnyog par snang bas 'der khyad du btus pa yin/ da dung skabs der gong gsal nang chen bco brgyad kyi gras su ma 'dus kyang nang chen gyi rgya khyon che zhing chos sde byings la snyan grags che ba bcu gnyis yod par gleng ste/— 53 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gling tshang / stag lung che ba tshang / dpa' ris stag lung tshang / khri dge 'dun dar rgyas tshang / bsod grags tshang / nor bu tshang / stag ring tshang / dkon mchog serge tshang / lha rams pa tshang yongs 'dzin tshang / rigs grwa tshang / tshogs 'du tshang bcas bkod par nor dogs kyis the tshom ma chod kyang /skyes chen dam pa tshar du dngar ba'i mdzad 'phrin ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa bla lhag tu bsngags pa'i snying ga'i pad+mo ba'ad par bya'o/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'dir yang chos sde chen po'i lo rgyus dngos la ches 'brel ba'i rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag chen po da lta'i mtsho sngon rma lho 'i sog po'i yul khams skyong mdzad dpon ju nang gi skor phran bu gleng bar bya ste/ dpon 'di ba gtsos pa'i mchod gzhis sbyin bdag dag gis bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyal bstan yun ring spel ba dang mi ser srid skyong du mdzad rjes bla na med pa ba'ag bod yul mdo dbus khams gsum dang sog po phyi nang / rgya yul gnas chen du shugs rkyen thebs pa'i snyan grags yongs su khyab par gyur/sog po'i sbyin bdag 'di ni mda' tshan nam dmag ru thog ma yin te/ mtsho sngon gyi ha'o hrog thu sog po zhes bya ba'i 'og rim mda' tshan 'ig tu nges la/ ha'o hrog thu sog po ni'ang e la'o the(nub sdod sog po'ang zer)shog pa gcig ste ha'o the shog pa dang / cung gar shog pa/ the cu bcas kyi gras yin par grags/ khong tsho'i rus la dang por ci ci the zer te yon rgyal rabs gong ma 'i khri chen por zhabs btegs pa khrin ci zi han rgyal bo'i sku gcung ha pu tho'o ha ser zhes pa'i rgyud du gtogs/ de bzhin dpon ju nang gi bar yin kha zo mor the cu/an dha'am a ta zhwa le gur chen zo the cu/ lha bla mo a khe tho/ pur khan zhwa cin nam sangs rgyas/ sa bha sher ma'am 'a pe zhi no min/ a khe zar kor ti'am a khe za ka le the nor yan(a lo then/ wi lo khe tha mor/ pu lo the pu ko po lo the thu mor/ to lon te po/ tho go sde/ sna go sde/ ze mo le ho/ kha'o hra'o/ r+pā pe/ hā nyi nor yan hon kor/ tho lo r+pā ho(ko hri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal)/ ye la to chi/ pa'o hrog khe tho ju nang (kun mkhyen gdan zhu thog ma ba)bcas su byon/ gong gsal las dpon rabs bco lnga ba bzhugs pa la kha'o hra'o zhes bya bar brgyud cing de'i phyi ma rnams e r+pā khe zer ba dang r+pā pe zhes pa gnyis su gyes pa la r+pā pe ni dpon rabs bcu drug par gyur/ yang dpon r+pā pe zhes bya ba'i rgyud pa de'i bu yā te ri sngon(gcen)dang gcung hā ni nor yan hon kor zhes par bgos pa'i tsho khag gnyis su grub pa la gcung bo'i dpon skor skabs der 'in cang khongs su 'tsho ba ste rim par mtsho sngon du chas pas mtsho sngon ju nang dpon rgyud thog mar gyur to/ /tā nyi nor yan bya bar bu drug byon pa'i bzhi ba tha'o lo r+pā ha'o ma ko hri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal(15〈 2da wa1654)ni dpa' rgod cing mtshon la skyen pa'i dpa' rtul du bsngags/ dar yon gyi dus su drag po'i stobs shugs che cher 'phar nas gnam ri'i byang rgyud nas lho rgyud du gzhis spos/ dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus dkyil du zhwa ser bstan pa dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' gsar du btod cing 'dzin skyong spel — 51 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su'u glegs bam/gsum ches mgyogs pa'i sgang du slebs mod/ nang ba'i grub mtha' ga'an dag ste khyad par du kurma bka' brgyud pa'i rin spungs pa dang gtsang ba sde ba/ sog po chos tho han sogs gtsos pas tshur rgo' dza drag thebs nas bod gangs can pa'i lo rgyus steng chos lugs grub mtha'i 'thab rtsod rgya chen po byung ba dang / man ju srid skyong stobs shugs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa ma mi rigs chos lugs las rigs pa grags chen sbrel ba'i skabs su / bod kyi grub mtha' gsar ba dang sog pa'i dpung stobs phan tshun 'brel btsugs te gcig phyogs gcig gi chos dang srid kyi rgyab rten bcol/ de'i rkyen mtsho sngon po'i g.yang gshong chen por thog mar ga'is tshugs pa'i sog po'i shog chen tho me the( ma༈nyi )'es pa'i rgyal bo yan tā han bar mdza' 'brel byung / rgyal dbang gsum pa bso da nams rgya mtsho(1542 da wa 15ra 〈)sog pos gdan zhus ba'in mtsho sngon phyogs su chibs bsgyu ra cing dge lugs grub mtha'i dbang lung rjes gsum skyes/ bu ma tho dman bar gsum ste rigs rus dbyer med du chos sbyin rgya cher bstsal nas bla ma'i sku bsod mtshan snyan rab tu 'bar 'ing mi ser gyi mthun 'grig nang 'cham/ la ma dzad rjes bla na ma mchis pa mngon/ rab byung bcu ba'i chu lug (15rnga2)lor rgyal bo yan tā tan sku 'das rjes bod sdod sog po'i ma/da' tshan so so'i bar dang bod mi sdod dmangs bcas su nang 'khrug 'khon gyod dus rabs gcig tsam gyi ring du byung 'ing sog po go ru kha pa chos thar han gyi dpung bod du lhags nas tho me the shog pa dang bcas pa 'joms par byas te sde srid gtsang pa dang kurma bka' brgyud par 'brel btsugs/de'i phyir yang dge lugs pas pho nya btang ste 'in cang gnam ri'i nye logs su sdod pa'i sngar gyi mchod gzhis so ga po we la the'i ha'o hro the la rgyab rogs bcol/ mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i gros mthun ba'in ha'o hro the'i shog pa'i mgo dpon ko hri han dang cung gar thog pa'i ma go dpon pā tho hung the cu zing gis dmigs pa bcangs shing 'char ga'i lda na pa'i sgo nas dpung gi sne khrid de mtsho sngon phyogs kyi dge lugs pa'i dgra zla thams cad tshar bcad pa ma zad mdo khams sgang drug de'i dbang du bsdus/ rab drag shing rta1654lor sog rgyal ko hri han tshe 'a sa 'das/ bod yul gyi sog stobs cung nyam sa shing rgyal dbang gis bod srid skyong ba'i gar stegs zhal du bzhes shing bu slob sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la bod kyi srid dbang skyong 'gan gyi bka' bsgos/ gnas tshul der bstun ri bo dge lugs pa'i dbu 'phang je mthor gyur pa ma zad chos srid zung ldan gyi rnam pa dar ba'i dbang gis bod mdo kham sa yul grur zhwa ser bsta na pa'i chos sde gas ra 'dzugs dang / mi ser gyis btsun pa byed pa/ bla chen tshos sbyin bdag btsal pa bcas spyi tshogs khor yug cig tu grub/rgyal bo ko hri han gyi mnga' khongs pa ho hro the so gas shog chen g.yas g.yon gnyis su gyes shing bu bcus bskyangs / 'di'i bu lnga ba'i mtshan la yu' lha rdo rje tshe ring(ṣāXmermyoshāzo g.yas ru mda' tshan dkyil ma'i dmag ru thog mar bskos)zer/ 'di la bu gnyis byung ba'i che ba mkho kha gar1 (༅oṃ)dang chung ba dar rgyas pa'o hre khe tho ju nang zhes pa mdo khams su g.yul las mang por zhugs pa dang gzhis mtsho sngon po'i logs su chags/ dmag jus la mkhas pas bod srid gzhung dang 'bar ma'i 'khon gyod bsdum du phebs/ de'i — 55 —

— — 4kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong si/ khongs/mdzad rjes la rgyal dbang lnga bas 44dga' ldan er ti ni pa'o hro khe tho ju nang zhes pa'i mtshan bstsal / dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus mjug tsam la dmag 'khrug mang zhing grub mtha'i rtsod gleng / mi ser nom gron che ba bcas kyi rkyen las mnga' 'bangs mi nyung ba thor/ skabs der ma tsho sngon gyi so ga po hro the shog pa bong mar kha phyogs pas rgyab skyor la go gnas dang tham ga sogs bstsal/ mtsho sngon yul du gtan sdod rkang tshugs par yar gong mar gus bkur dngos 'bul dang ma ra mi ser chos sde skyong ba'i dmigs chen bzhin pha yu'/ khya mdo ba bod dbus su dam chos sde snod gsum byang chub pa'i bshes gnyen chen po skyabs gcis myo/thong ba ngon lda na 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog shing byi lor thengs dang bor gdan zhur bzhud pa la kun mkhyen gyis 'al gyis bzhes kyang phyag ma phebs/ sa stag lor(1( 92)dar rgyas pa'o hro khe tho ju nang sku 'das/ bu gsum pa bde chen ho hro chi(༅nyolkoza) tsha gan (tshe dbang )bstan 'dzin gyis dpon sa bzung /btsun mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma bzhes/ skabs der dpon 'di'i dbang bsgyur pa'i mnga' khongs nyams nas da lta'i mtsho lho dang gan lho'i 'brog rkyang sa khul
