tsam du gyur pas shog pa skyong dgos pa'i 'gan lci yol thabs me da pa phrag tu bab cing yab kyi phugs 'dun 'grub ched/ lcags sbru la lor nang logs su chas te gong ma chan lung mjal bar to lo pe le(zotsho'iskya)zhes pa'i go gnas thob phyir sog phyogs dbang shed can du gyur/ khong gis sngar gyi bslab bya sna tshogs gzhigs nas/ gong ma ni bod dar nang bstan la thugs mnyes pa dang /rang rigs bod yul gtan sdod tshugs pa/ chos srid zung gi 'phrin las kyis sog bod mi ser 'dul 'ing dpon rgyun 'phel phyir/ chu lug lor slar ched du bod dbus su chibs kha bsgyur te/ kun mkhyen sku dngos la legs skyes(thengs rjes ma kho nar gser grub sga srab dang / rnga mong gsum/ rta ma chog bcu/ khal ma nyi shu/phrug dmar gyi gur bcas bdog pa)spam mtho btegs shing rang sar chos sde ngo mas 'debs re nan du zhus/'on kyang rje 'di ba tshig dam bzhin phyag ma 'byor gshis sa byi(1708)lor ston dgun snga phyir pho nya mngags nas yang yang gtsug tu bkur pa la skyabs rje kun mkhyen sku 'khor brgya nyer gnyis bcas sog yul du phyag phebs lo phyed ring bzhugs/ skabs de'i ring yul phyogs su lam rim sogs kyi dbang bka' chos gnang ba dgon gsar 'debs kyi sta gon du dpon ju nang gis da dung gser gyi maṇ+ḍil dang dngul gyi me tog so/gas yo byad 'gangs chen/ gos chen kha lnga brgya/ rta nor lnga brgya/ lug stong phrag bzhi bcas phul/ de ba'in sta gon gyi lo ni sa glang dang / gnas 'debs kyi lo lcags stag(bzhi ba'i tshes pa gsum khel/ bdun pa'i rigs grwa sogs su dge 'dun brgyad brgya shong ba'i gur chen du tshogs 'tshogs)/ lcags yos lo nas chos sde'i 'du khang dang btsan khang / kun mkhyen bla brang bcas bzhengs so/ /slar yang skabs der spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che ba tsam zhus na/ bod kyi chab srid ha cang mi brtan pa'i dus su khel 'dug ste/ rgyal bo lha bzang dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i bar 'khon 'gal 'chi gson gyi 'thab rtsod dza drag byung / phyis su sde srid sangs rgyam sku bkrongs shing sog po ha'o hro the lha bzang rgyal — 56 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/bor gyur/ sde srid kyis gtsos byas blus pa'i rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri nas spyugs mthar/pa'i be tham mo ha'o per han(rgyal dbang pad dkar 'dzin pa)zhes pa rgyal dbang drug pa yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gong mar zhuca/ pa sogs bgyi ba mang du mdzad na'ang mtsho sngon du gzhis chags pa'i the cu sogs dpon rigs dag gis khams klu thang du rgyal dbang drug pa'i sprul sku 'khrul med sku bltams pa thos rjes/ dbang shed che ba'i blo bzang bstan 'dzin(ha'o hrog thu bkra shis dpal dar gyi bu)dang tsha han bstan 'dzin gyis klu thang ba skal bzang rgya mtsho(1708—1757)ni ngo mas ha'o r+pā le han yin par dgongs nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing lug 'o ra pe cin du chibs bsgyur te chog mchan 'god pa'i thugs 'dun zhus/ 'on kyang rgyal bo lha bzang khros nas rgyal dbang klu thang ba sku bkrongs pa'i jus brnags/ tsha han tshe dbang bstan 'dzin dang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gtsos pa rnams rgyal bo lha bzang dang zhe log nas rgyal dbang 'phral skyob kyi zhal bgros dang thabs bkod de mtsho sngon po'i ri dmar chos sder spyan drangs te re zhig bskyabs/ phyis su chin gong ma'i bka' lung bzhin rtsod pa bsdums nas skal bzang rgya mtsho mchog sku 'bum byams pa gling du bzhugs bcug cing 1719lo sa phag la chin srid gzhung gis klu thang ba rgyal dbang dngos yin pa'i bka' rgya dkrol pa dang tsha han bstan 'dzin la ta'o lo con lbang zhes pa'i go sa bstsal/ tsha han bstan 'dzin gyis rgyal dbang drug pa'i 'phrin las la byas rjes che bas bod 'bangs spyi dang nang bstan dad ldan yongs kyi gras su grags pa'i ma tshan snya na ches mtho bar 'phar/ 172 0lor tsha han dang blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs the cu gtsos chen srid gzhung gi srung dmag bcas zi ling nas lha sar rgyal dbang bdun pa gdan bzhugs su chibs skyel rnam dag bgyis/ sog po jun gar gyi dpung rnams dbus nas bskrad/ 172 2lor blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang tsha han bstan 'dzin bar 'khon bslangs/ chen dmag gis tsha han la rgyab rogs byas mthar blo bzang bstan 'dzin sdod ma tshugs par zhin cang gi cung gar shog par mgo 'dogs su byol/ 1725lo ste rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing yos lor bkra shis 'khyil ba'i sbyin bdag chen po tsha han bstan 'dzin sku 'das/ khong la sras dang sras mo re byon kyang bu don grub dbang rgyal na tshod phra dus 'das pas rgyal rgyud phyi ma ni tsha han bstan 'dzin khong gi gcen po mo kin nor yan gyi tsha bu bstan 'dzin dbang phyug wang hro wo la 'dzin du bcug ste kho ni mor kin nor yan rang gi bu lha chen po mor gan bde chen(77oṃ)bu tha chung red/ 'di la sras gsum byon pa'i che ba tsha han rab brtan/ gnyis pa dbang phyug rab brtan/ gsum pa dpon bstan 'dzin dbang phyug kho rang yin/ de bzhin bstan dbang rang la sras bu gsum dang bu mo gnyis bcas pa'i bu che ba dga' ldan bsam grub/ 'bring ba blo bzang chos 'phel/ tha chung dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo(pha lam zer ba'ang snang )zer/ bstan dbang gis kun mkhyen gnyis pa gdan sar 'god rogs dang dam chos par khang btsugs shing lha sa'i sman rams pa gtsang sman ye shes bzang po gdan drangs/ phyis su sman pa grwa tshang 'dzugs par phyag rjes che/ de bzhin bkra shis 'khyil bas khyad par du dpon rabs dang bo yab dang yum— 57 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/(rnam rgyal sgrol ma)zung 'das par bsngo smon rgya chen spel ba dang sku gdung mchod rten spus legs ngo mtshar can bzhengs so/ /ju nang dpon rabs gsum pa dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo bskos/ sku na phra dus khong gi zhang bos chos srid skyong khur bgyis pa dang rang nyid gong ma chan lung mjal du phebs/ de rjes g.yu rtse'i mngon dge dpon tshang gi gzhis bsang chu'i ngogs brag mgon po'i zhol du bskyar bskrun/ 1770lor sku 'das/ sras ni ma byung /de nas kun mkhyen thugs dgyes pa'i dbang phyug rab brtan gyi sras ngag dbang dar rgyas zhes pa1786lor dpon sar gtang/ khong bod sog yig rigs la mkhas/ dbus nas tsong kha brgyad cu dang sde dge'i bka' bsta na blus/ yang smad nas dngul sras sum stong gis byams pa bzhengs nas spyan drangs/ sras gcig byung ba bkra shis 'byung gnas zer/ me yos lor yab 'das rjes dpon sar gtad de kyā chin gong ma mjal/1822lor bod 'khon byol ched hran kun spyi khyab lta skul pa nā yan khrin(smokhyaṣ+ṭha')gyi sog shog nyid da lta'i gung ho rdzong khongs su spo ra dgos pa'i bka' 'byor kyang / sngar gnas sdod yun ring bas bka' phyir bzlogs/dpon rabs drug pa1〈22lor yab 'das 'phral de'i bu bkra shis dbang rgyal zhes pa bskos/ 1rnga50lor sku 'das pas de'i bu khron cin(yum bka)zhes pas dpon rgyud bzung / 1887lor khong 'das shing /rang la bu med phyir de'i tsha bu dngos grub rab brtan(ga'an dpal 'byor rab brtan)zhes pa dpon rabs brgyad par bskos/ khong gis gshog pa g.yas pa'i mda' tshan dkyil ma do dam dang mda' tshan thog ma'i tras khe'i 'gan bzhes pa dang gong ma mjal du chibs bsgyur/ 1917lor khong sku 'das pas bu kun dga' dpal 'byor zhes pa dpon sar gtad/ khong bod rgya'i skad yig la mkhas/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i yang tsha bde skyid dpal sgron gnyen bsus kyang bu ma byon pas de'i gcung mo klu sman 'tsho lcam du bzhes par sras gsum byung / khong ni bod kyi zlos gar rol chas dang dge tshul gyi spyod par thugs mnyes shing 'phrengs drags pas phyis su grwa chas kyang mnabs/ 1940lor sku 'das/ bu med pas dpon rabs phyi ma ni sog srol ba'in khong gi sring mo bkra shis tshe ring(1920lor skyes)la dpon rgyud 'dzin pa'i 'gan bskyon/ mo lo nyer gcig steng chos srid 'phrin las bsgrub par zhugs shing a pa a blo'i(zo༅lo khong dgung lo go lnga ba ste1997 10 7'das/) bu ma gon po rnam rgyal(bsdus ming a mgon/) dang gnyen bsdebs/ a mgon gyis shog pa skyong grogs bgyis par mi ser gyis mgon po ju nang zhes 'bod/ dpon mo nyid pe cin gyi chab srid slob grwar zhugs pa dang 194rngalor go min tang gi rgyal 'bangs 'thus tshogs skabs dang por zhugs/ 1954lo'i zla bcu bar mtsho sngon rma lho sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gi kru'u zhir bdams pa dang phyi lor rdzong dpon du bskos/me rta lor sku 'das/ khyo bo mgon po rnam rgyal(a mgon)thog mar bsang chu(zhwa ho)rdzong gi zi lin gzhon pa dang phyis su mtsho sngon zhing chen phyugs las then krang gzhon par bskos/ 1957lor sku 'das/ khong la bu gsum dang bu mo gcig yod de/ bu che skal bzang da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gros u yon du bdams pa dang /— 58 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bu 'bring ba dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gan su'u zhing chen gyi dmangs chen du bya ba sgrub bzhin yod/ bu tha chung rdo rje zhes pas mtsho sngon rma lho sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gi nor srid cus su bya ba sgrub ba'in/ sras mo bsod nams stobs rgyal dbang mo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gi dmangs chen kru'u rin gzhon pa/ rgyal yongs dmangs chen 'thus tshab yin te/ 1kha90lor bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzhengs grub ston du mo rang gtsos pa'i rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag yongs kyis mang 'gyed rgya che ba bstar pas dad ldan kun gyi re 'dun bskangs shing 'gro drug sems can la tshogs gnyis kyi bsod nams rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lo rgyus snying bo can bsags par gyur/de bzhin bcings 'grol yar sngon du mtsho sngon gyi ja sag (ru dpon)zhes pa nyer dgu'i thog ma dpon rgyud ju nang ba nges te/ khong tsho'i mnga' zhabs su chab srid dang / dmag don/ nor srid bcas kyi sgrig 'dzugs 'thus tshang tshugs pa dang / dpon rogs brgya dpon sogs dmag spyi brgya lnga bcu dang de'i zhol du brda dpon drug sogs yul dpon che chung nyis brgya dang gnyis/ srung dmag nyis brgya/ g.yog rgyug gya bzhi yo da/ dpon tshang du tshogs 'du'i lam lugs bcas 'dzoms pas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyal bstan 'phel rgyas dang yul khams chos sde bde srung bcas la mdzad rjes mngon par che'o/ /le'u bzhi ba/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang de'i rkyen dbang gi skor/1 bkra shis 'khyil la spyi'i dpal 'byor dar tshul/ 1709lor rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog gis dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i dus su/ rtsa ba'i mchod gzhis sbyin bdag chen po dpon ju nang yab yu ma gyis kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul pa'i steng dgon pa gser 'debs la rta nor lnga brgya/ 'u ga stong phrag bzhi/ dar gos yug lnga brgya/ rin po che 'gangs can grangs kyis mi lang ba phul/ rgan gya'i dpon pos dgon sa phul pa dang bcas kha gya tsho drug gis shing cha drangs/ chos 'khor zam tsha/ rong bo sbis mdo/ rnga ba tsha kho sogs shog chen tsho khag mang bos sbyor 'jags dang las tshegs phud pa bcas tshogs chen 'du khang ka ring brgyad cu can gyi rtsig bkod yongs su grub/ rten bzhengs rin po che khyad du 'phags pas bltams pa dang / lha sde chos sde mi sde rgya cher 'phel cing dgon pa spyi'i 'dzugs skrun dang bla sprul gyi 'dzugs skrun yang ches cher dar/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i yar sngon dgon pa'i rnam pa ni/ tshogs chen 'du khang gtsos pa'i grwa tshang drug de bstun spyi khang rung khang / lha khang(sger bzhengs spyi spyod)sogs mang bo btsan khang / mchod rten/ tshoms chen grangs mang (nang chen nang khag ces pa drug cu rtsa grangs)phyi skor bka' 'gyur dang lam rim 'khor chen bcu phrag mtha' skor ma ṇi 'khor lo nyis stong lnga brgya lhag zangs sgam ma ṇi nyis brgya lhag grwa shag lnga brgya bcu bdun/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir ri khrod lnga dang sngags grwa gcig dge slong ma'i dben gnas gnyis sogs kyi rnam pas bod yul nang dgon che gas drug gi gral du tshud/— 59 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/da dung dgon pa'i khor yug tu 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod rdzas yo byad ma lus pa rin thang dpag tu med la grangs kyis kyang gzhal mi nus te/ de la dgon pa'i dpal 'byor 'byung khungs gtso gras sa ma de'i rnam pa tsam gleng na/ gcig tu de la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po dpon ju nang gtsos pa'i mtsho sngon gyi mda' tshan shog pa du ma dang / rma chu'i stod smad de dngul rwa lha sde/ rnga ba tsha rong / kha gya tsho drugarong bo sbis ma do la sogs gong gsal tsho ba shog pas rmang btings shing mu mthud 'phel rgyas kyi mthun rkyen sbyor 'jags mi dman pa mchis te/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon gzhung du dngul sgor drug khri brgyad stong dgu brgya/mar rgya ma stong phrag bdun/ nas dang phye rtsam rgya ma khri phrag gnyis lhag zung chu'i ja rigs rgya ma stong phrag brgyad/ 'bras dang gro ma sogs rgya ma stong phrag du ma mdzod du nyar tshags pa byas pa la brten nas gdan sa 'ig gso dang rgya skyed btang / dper na kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon gyi 'bul sdud las byung ba sa zhing mu'u bzhi stong lnga brgya(lo rer yong 'bab 'bru rigs rgya ma 'bum las brgal/ da lta'i rma chu dang bsang chu rdzong khongs su la lo nyis stong sum brgya/ gnag nor bdun brgya/ lug sum stong / khang ba mig brgyad brgya dgu bcu (lo gla dngul sgor brgyad brgya dgu bcu)/ rta dngul rdo tshad ma brgya phrag(dngul srang chig khri lnga stong ya na)/ dngul lnga bcu ma sum brgya lhag(srang chig khri lnga stong / dngul sgor 'bum phrag gsum/ thub bstan pho brang / nor 'dzin pho brang / tshoms chen 'dod dgu 'khyil ba/ gzim khang bsam grub gling / bkra shis rab brtan/ gnyis su lag nom/ 'khor rgyug ma dngul/ gser nag dngul chas/ rin chen sman sbyor/ ri dwags gcan gzan gyi pags rigs/ rgya mig 'ja' chen dar gos/ phebs bzhugs mkho chas rtsa chen la sogs zhib grangs lon ga la thub/ yang gser khri rnam ba'i las gung thang rin po cher mtshon na/gung thang mchod rten mthong grol chen mo/ thub bstan dga' tshal/ tshoms chen ser bo/ tshoms chen dkar bo/ dpe mdzod chos kyi dga' tshal/ par khang / 'o phye bzo grwa la sogs der bstun rten dang brten pa spyi rdzas sger nom brjod kyis mi long / gsum du tshong gnyer ba dang skyed lci'i bu lon brten pa ni yong sgo gtso shos yin te/ bla sprul mi nyung bas dgon pa spyi'i spyi 'jog gi ched du yul mdo dbus khams gsum ma zad/sog po phyi nang / rgya nang grong khag rgya gar bal bo sogs su tshong 'brel tshugs te nom stobs 'phel ba la brten dgon du lha khang mang bo bzhengs pa dang zhar du dgon lag du ma bskyangs mdzad/ dper na/ kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon/ gung thang sku rim byon/ bsod grags tshang / zam tsha tshang / hor gtsang tshang /dbal mang tshang / bla ma dkar bo/ rgya zhabs drung che chung / phyag mdzod mkhan po/ rgya nag pa tshang sogs kyis tshong gnyer ba dang dbang bka' chos kyi 'bul ba bsags te lha khang sogs rten dang brten pa mi nyung ba bzhengs nas sger dbang spyi spyod kyi rnam par grub/ da dung dgon pa spyis phyi la tshong gnyer gyi ma rtsa spogs dngul sgor chig 'bum nyis khri yan btang ba ma zad/ btsun pa phyug po spogs su dngul sgor 'bum gtong mkhan byung ste/ ma rtsa 'dis bal dang pags rigs/ sman rdzas dang g.yu byur/ ja dang ras cha/ zangs — 60 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/dngul yo byad sogs mi la gnyer du bcug bun skyed mang du blangs/ bzhi ru bod sog dad ldan gtsos pa'i spyi 'bangs kyis tshogs gsog mchod 'bul dang mang 'gyed btang ba'i yong 'bebs de rma klung dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin bskal ba ma stong gi bar mchis pa ni dgon pa spyi dang grwa mang 'tsho ba'i rma gzhir gyur/ lo re'i cho 'phrul smon lam dang bdun pa'i rigs grwa'i chos spyod ches cher spel ba'i skabs su shog pa'am tsho ba khag gis tshogs chen khri ba'i bka' bcol ltar mang 'gyed rgya che ba gtong ba'i 'gan lce 'khur bar bya ba dang / da dung dgon pa nyid kyi grwa tshang so sor mang ja dang zhag thebs/ bla sprul dag gi zhabs brtan bsngo smon/ khri ba dang spyi ba dang dam bca' ba la sogs kyis ston mo'am mang 'gyed/ grwa ja sogs/ shog pa'am tsho dpon khag gis mang ja dang 'das mchod zhus pa/ grwa ja dang gtong sgo sna tshogs kyis dgon pa spyi dang grwa ba 'byor 'an can la tshe hril dam chos kho na mdzad pa'i cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bskrun/ lnga ru dgon pa rang gi par khang dang / gla khang(mtha' bar khang mig brgya sum cu)/ rang 'thag sogs ni phal cher spyi phan gyi rnam pa can yin la der yong sgo'ang nges can re yod de dgon pa thun mong gzhung thog la legs skyes mtshams 'dri so gas 'gro sgo gang yod 'di nas gtong ngo / /2 gru tshang khag gi spyi rdzas tsam gleng na/ kha rgyun du/ stod na mdzod cig dngul rwa'i su rug smad na mdzod cig mda' smad 'khyil khug nang na mdzod cig rnam sras g.yang mdzod ces zer te/ grwa tshang spyi rdzas ni dgon pa spyi'i rgyu nom gyi grub cha gtso bo yin te re re'i thad kur sa zhing dang / nags tshal/ khang ba/ spyi gsog bcas grangs mi nyung ba gnyer yod pa dper na thos bsam gling ba la phug sde dang lung dkar thang /lcang ma'i nang / ri sder/ hor kha gya sogs su sa zhing mi nyung ba dbang la lo rer sa bogs 'bru rigs rgya ma(srang bcu drug can)chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya len pa dang / bsang khog sogs su rtswa sa'ang rgya che/ rgyud smad grwa tshang la hor kha gya dang / lcang ma'i nang / za yi nang / lam shar/ shong ma tshal sogs su'ang sa zhing mi nyung ba yod/ rgyud stod grwa tshang la za yi mdo kha dang sa dkar/ za yi nang sogs su sa zhing yod/ lo rer nas rgya ma lnga brgya bsdu ba dang spyi rdzas mang shas dngul rwa shog pas spyi 'jog byas/ dus 'khor grwa tshang la ya ring lung ba dang / sa dkar thang / 'ba' ru mdo kha sogs su sa zhing mi nyung ba yod/ kyai rdor grwa tshang la shong ma nang dang / mda' smad dge thang / dom lung / ser chung / phug sde/ 'gab sde/ za yi nang sogs su sa zhing mang bo yod/ sman pa grwa tshang la khyim pa rang gis gshin po'i dge rtsa'am bza' shul chad pas tsho ba'am shog pas lo tog gi rngo thogs 'bul ba yang gdong ba'i mdo dang / sran thang / g.yis khug phug sde/hor kha gya sogs su mang bas lo rer sa bogs lta bu'i tshul gyis 'bru rigs rgya ma stong phrag bzhi yas mas mchis/'bru rigs 'di dag gtso bo tshogs chen dang grwa tshang khag gi bsang rtsam dang / gzhung spyod/ grwa mang phogs gtong bcas la spyad pa dang phyi la btsongs pa'ang 'ga' re yod de sdud 'bul drang lugs gtan tshags dang 'khon 'dzing g.yo khram gyi spyod ngan rang byung ma myong / dper na sa dkar dang sman mkhar/ mtha' ba gong — 61 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'gab/ yig chung thang / glu rgyag lung dkar thang sogs kyi grong sde kho nas dgon par ma mtha' 'bru rigs rgya ma khri phrag bdun bskyel bar bya ste sa mu'u rer nas sam gro rgya ma so lnga byas na nye logs 'di dag tu ha lam sa 'ing mu'u nyis stong longs/ dgon pa spyi'i 'dzugs skrun la mkho che ba'i nags tshal mi nyung ba dgon pa'am grwa tshang khag gis gnyer yod de dgon nags la mi ser dkyus mas lag reg dbang gtan nas med/nags tshal gtso bo dag thos bsam gling la gnam kha'i lung ba dang / hor kha gya'i sa dkar/ gdong lung khogastag mo rdzong sogs su rgya chen po yod pa dang / rgyud smad pa grwa tshang la gdong lung khog dang / lo lung chos 'khor yan nas chu shar brag so'i man chad du nags tshal stug po spus legs mang bo/ rgyud stod grwa tshang la sha bo ri gseng / mda' smad bcas su nags tshal skor gsum/ kyai rdor grwa tshang la lcang ma'i lung du nags dbang phyed tsam yod/ sman pa grwa tshang la gdong ba'i mdo nas dgon par phul pa'i nags skal yod de/ 'di dag ni nags tshal 'dzugs skrun dang / bud shing / sdong tshong nyung shas bcas kyi phyogs spyod cing / sgrig khrims kyi sgo nas srung skyob bdag gnyer rgyun 'khyongs pa brten nags tshal je rgyas su gyur pas dgon pa'i mdzes rgyan dang sa cha'i gsos su gyur/ grwa tshang kha shas la gla khang 'ga' re yod de dper na mtshan nyid grwa tshang la mtha' ba gong mar gla khang khang mig brgya dang sum cu/ rgyud stod grwa tshang la za yi mdo khar khang ba ra bzhi dang sman mkhar sogs su khang mig so brgyad/ dus 'khor grwa tshang la yar ru lung bar khang ba ra bzhi/ kyai rdor grwa tshang la sman mkhar du khang ba ra gcig yod par gla blangs te grwa mang gi ja thebs su gtong / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag je mang dang je phyug tu song ba dang / dgon pa spyi gzhung dang grwa tshang so sor gzhung nom shin tu mang bo yod kyang spyi gnyer sus kyang grangs ka rags tsam las zhib phra shes pa cung dkon/ lo re'i zla ba ga ge mor spyi gsog gang phyogs dang gang gi dngul sgor ram shog sgor/ dung tse khron ci yod/ nyin ga ge mor gtong sgo ci song sogs grangs gsal zhig zin bris su btab pa dang / mi sger ram nang chen sus bskyis pa dang sbogs phar gtong gi bu lon tshur sdud sogs bris pa tsam las/ gzhung mdzod bsnan grangs mkhan ha lam med zer/ rgya rtsom zhig tu tshod dpag bkod pa ltar na/ thos bsam gling bar rgyun 'jog(nam yang mdzod du mnan pa)dngul sgor khri phrag nyis dang gzhan mar/ ja sogs/ rgyud smad grwa tshang la spyi gsog dngul sgor bdun stong nyis brgya/rgyud stod grwa tshang la spyi gsog dngul sgor drug stong sum brgya tsam/ kyai rdor grwa tshang la dngul sgor khri phrag gnyis/sman pa grwa tshang la dad ldan mang tshogs kyis tshogs bsags su phul pa sogs dngul sgor stong phrag brgyad lhag longs par bshad do/ /2 bla sprul khag gi sger nom ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyu nor longs spyod kyi phyogs chen zhig yin te dgon pa spyi la'ang phan rgya chen po thogs bzhin yod/ bla sprul gyi nom pa dgon par lha khang dang / rang gi bde yangs tshoms chen sogs 'dzugs skrun mang bo spel/ sger dbang dpal 'byor yin kyang dgon pa byings kyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs che shos su gyur/ dper na kun mkhyen bla brang khyad mtshar can dang / de bzhin du — 62 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gung thang tshang / hor gtsang tshang / zam tsha tshang / sde ba tshang / mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs / sgo mang / cung gar/ rgya nag pa/ bsod grags/ dbal mang / gling tshang / rgyal mkhan po/ smad sog nor bu/ snyan grags/ brag sgom pa/ yo ngas 'dzin tshang / rgya zhabs drung che ba/ bde thang / 'gyang ro/ dge 'dun dar rgyas/ dpa' ris pa/ mgon shul/ blo bzang sbyin pa/ bla ma dkar bo/ mgo rta/ phyag mdzod mkhan po/ nyang tshang / rab brtan rgya mtsho sogs la lha khang tshoms chen bde ya ngas gzim shag cha 'grig 'dzoms te ri grong gi dgon pa chung chung zhig gi yan du stobs 'byor 'phel pas/ bla ma rang nyid kyi zhabs brtan sogs rim gro thams cad bsgrub thub pa dang / sku phreng rim byon la 'brel zab pa'i gzhis byes bla sprul dang skyes chen dam pa gang phebs gtan bzhugs sam bsu skyel gyi cha rkyen yongs su ldan/bla ma rang nyid kyi gnyen nye dang sku 'khor zhabs phyi bcu phrag rgyun 'dug dang / rten bzhugs sam chibs sgyur mkho chas yongs su rdzogs pa mdzod du bsnon thub pa/ nyer mkho'i rta drel du ma gso snyor shong ba/ rgyun ldan du bla ma'i mchod gzhis shog pa'am mgron po gal chen byon pa 'dug khang dang zas bcud kyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba/khyad par du bla ma dang gnyer dbon por ngo cher zhus pa'i dge tshul slong 'byor zhan dang dpe klog pa mang bo rgyun bzhugs gnang bar khang gla chu rin sprod pa zer ba bla brang gling na med/ yang dper na mkhan po no min han dang / stag lung pā ta/ stag lung che ba/ stag ring / mtsho kha ba/ rdo dkar mtshams pa ba/ hor gtsang tshang / dkon mchog seṅge / han tshang / tsho 'du tshang / bla ma phun tshogs/ sgang kha tshang / thur ma tshang / ya rong tshang / se li tshang / rgya zhabs drung chung ba/ tan gan mkhan po/ chos rdzong tshang /skyor dpon tshang / stag ge tshang / tsa yus thog ga gyo ra tshang / lha rams pa / bla go tshang / a mchog mu to/ nu gu tshang / rgya mkhar tshang / mgo tsha tshang / tsa yus tshang / gser kha tshang / 'dan tshang /zam tsha'i dus 'khor/ dung sna ba/ khya dge tshang / kyai rdor ngag dbang bkra shis/ gung ru tshang sogs la nang chen phub yod kyang de 'dra rgya mi che ba dang bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs chos 'grims phyin rgyun bzhugs bya mi bya ci rigs yod de/ kha shas ni sku phreng rim byon gdan sa nyid du sku tshe hril bor 'tsho bzhugs bgyis pa yin pa dang / gong gsal dang bcas pa'i bla sprul che 'bring chung gsum phal cher la rang rang blus pa'i gdan sa dang /gsar btab chos sde/ skyong khur mdzad pa'i dgon pa gang rung du nang chen dang sa zhing / su rug nags tshal/ gzim shag chung shas sogs gang 'dzoms ci mkho mchis/ ga'an yang bla sprul kha shas te dper na mdzod dge stobs ldan tshang dang / dme shul mu to/ lcang shar tshang sogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i grwa tshang ga ge mo'i khrir 'khod myong yang sku dngos la nang chen lta zhog gzim spyil tsam yang med par lo kha shas ring yul phyogs dge 'dun pa'i grwa shag g.yar nas bzhugs/ da dung bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos grwa 'grims pa dang zur du dge rgan bsten par chos sde nyid du gzim shag med par bzhugs pa de bas mang la grwa sa 'dir grwa mang spyi dang mtshungs pa las khyad par gyi dmigs bsal dang mthong chung ci yang med do/ /— 63 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/4 ga mang sger gyi 'tsho ba rol tshul dang dgon par phan thogs tshul cung gleng na/ bod rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon la dgon par grwa shag lnga brgya lhag las med pas grwa shag rer cha snyom grwa ba drug re bzhugs dgos pa dang gzhan slob gnyer ba sogs mang bo bla sprul khag gi nang chen du snyeradug par bya/ grwa mang gi 'tsho rten gtso bo dgon pa'i mang ja/ zhag thebs/ 'gyed gtong sogs la brten pa'i khar rang rang khyim bdag nas rgyab skyor kha gas ba byas pa dang nye logs rim gro sogs la brten pa ches mang shos yin/ yang grwa ba chos zhan kha shas tshong rgyag pa dang / rgyu zog sems can bcol ma la brten pa/ yang la las rong du sa zhing gnyer nas 'bru sbogs mi nyung ba len par bya/ skor 'di rigs kyi gzim shag bzang zhing rten gsum/ rgyun mkho ca lag spus bzang rtsa chen mang bo bsgrugs/ dgon pa'i grwa shag ni khyim pa ga ge mo'am grwa ba zhig gis rgyu nom btang 'ing las tshegs phud de phub pa yin yang / rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang cha de dgon pa'i yig tshang la yod pa las grwa rkyang sger la med/ grwa ba gshegs na de'i nor longs spyod de sgor mo dang chos gos/ snam sbyar/ zla gam/ zhwa mo/rdor dril/ gzim mal/ thab cha/ phye rtsam thams cad las kha shas rang gi gnyen nye'am bu slob la gnang ba las/ lhag pa yod do cog btsongs te grwa tshang la bsngo smon zhu ba'i thebs su 'bul dgos pa dang / khang ba de shul bzhugs pa sur dgos na des nom pa btang nas rin gong cung stabs/ bde'i ngang nyo dgos pa las rang snang gang shar du 'dug dbang med/ khang ba'i rin dang ca lag gi rin pa yang na phyag nom cung mang na grwa tshang la mang ja bskol dgos/ sku gsung thugs rten ci yod dpe mdzod dang lha khang du 'bul dgos/ de bzhin gong gsal grwa mang rang gi rgyu rdzas thams cad tha mar dgon pa'i spyi gzhung la dbang bar gyur/ bla sprul yin kyang yang srid nyams na de ltar gyi sgrig srol bstun dgos so/ /5 dgon pa'i dpal 'byor ni rnam pa khyad par can zhig yin pas der 'gro gron gtong lugs dang bgo bsha' byed srol chos phyogs dang srid phyogs gnyis gar 'phrod thabs shig yod/ bkra shis 'khyil bar gong gsal lta bu'i yong 'bab khyab khongs che zhing rnam grangs shin tu mang ba'i rigs su gtogs te dad ldan bod rigs dang sog rigs/ rgya rigs sogs kyi khyim pa'i yong sgo mang shos dang rig rdzas (lha rten mchod gsum rtsa chen)sna ma nga dgon pa'i chos phyogs dang lha khang dag tu gtong bar 'gyur/ des na chos sde nyid kyi 'gro gron gtso rigs rags tsam gleng na phal cher phyogs bzhir 'dus par bsams so/ /gcig tu/ dgon pa spyi'i don du nom 'gro che ba ste/ bkra shis 'khyil bar 'du khang lha khang gi gras su bdun thog can gcig dang /drug thog can gcig bzhi thog can bzhi/ sum thog can brgyad/ gnyis thog can dgu/ gser gyi rgya phibs can bzhi/ rdza yam gyo thog can gnyis/ de min kun mkhyen bla brang dang lha khang / tshoms chen/bde yangs/ nang chen/ gzim shag grwa shag sogs sme lham po ba'i 'bum drug khri drug stong lhag gi gnas su rtsig bkod rgya khyon sme lham po bzhi 'bum bzhengs pa dang / de mtshungs kyi sku gsung thugs rten ma chod rdzas yo byad sogs kyi 'gro song grangs kyis gzhal mi nus te/ kun mkhyen sku phreng dang po'i gdung rten la dpon ju — 64 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nang yab yum gyis dngul srang chig stong lhag gis bzhengs pa dang / kun mkhyen gnyis pas dus 'khor dang sman pa grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa la dngul srang nyis khri lhag btang ste sngar gyi ka ba brgyad cu'i 'du khang de rgya bskyed de ka ba brgya dang bcu can grwa stong phrag gsum shong ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang bzhengs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i sku gdung mchod rten la dngul srang chig khri bzhi stong gser srang nyis brgya lnga bcu btang / gnyis su/dgon pa yongs kyi grwa mang la 'gro gron rgya che ste/ bod rab rgyal sa khyi lor gung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug rin po che khri bzhugs mdzad skabs su grwa sum stong brgyad brgya lhag zhal 'dzoms par bshad/ lo re'i cho 'phrul smon lam chen po'i skabs kyi 'tsho song shin tu che ba rab rgyal sa glang yar sngon gyi yig rigs shig tu bkod/skabs der nom stobs che ba ltar na/ nyin gcig gi ring la mchod me sogs la mar rgya ma lnga brgya/ thug mar rgya ma lnga brgya/ skams sha sbub gnyis/ 'bras rgya ma ba'i brgya/ rgun 'brum rgya ma brgya/ ja rgya ma bco lnga/bud shing sgor brgya/ gsol mar rgya ma stong phrag bzhi bcas de skabs rin gong du bkug na dngul sgor chig stong brgya drug cu'i gtong dgos te/ smon lam kho nar nyung rtsis la dngul sgor stong phrag bzhi lnga 'gro bar gleng (skabs legs kha shas la grwa mang rer dngul sgor bcu re them) de bzhin lo re'i chos thog gal chen gnyis pa'i tshogs mchod(tshes bzhi nas tshes brgyad bar)dang / gsum pa'i 'cham chen dang dus 'khor rdul tshon/bzhi ba'i bsnyung gnas sam ma ṇi ril sgrub sogs/ bdun pa'i rigs grwa nyin bco lnga bcas la gtong sgo shin tu che/ grwa mang rer nyung mthar dngul sgor bcu lhag dang gsol mar rgya ma lnga bcu 'dus pa sogs rags rtsis bgyis na'ang dngul sgor chig 'bum lnga khri lhag 'gro bar bshad/ da dung dgu ba'i lha 'cham/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs tshogs chen dang grwa tshang gang rung gi lo re'i 'gro gron zhib cha grangs kyis mi long / gsum du/dgon pa spyi dang grwa tshang khag gis rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs dang / mchod rdzas yo byad spyi 'jog bcas gang gi thad nom chen gtong dgos la/ dper na mar mchod rkyang ba ste gnyis pa'i tshogs mchod kyi skabs su stong mchod la mar rgya ma stong phrag ba'i lhag dgos dang / de ba'in lo hril bor mchod me dang bsang rtsam/ shug lo/ bud shing / ras yol la sogs su 'gro gron 'bor chen gtong bzhin yod/ bzhi ru dgon pa'i phyi phyogs 'brel ba'i thad 'gro song yang shin tu mang / kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon gyis mdo dbus khams gsum dang sog po phyi nang / rgya yul gnas chen du ma/ dgon le lag mang bo bcas la chos phyogs kyi mdza' 'brel dam zab tshugs pa dang / bla sprul mang bo thag bcad pa dang khri ba'am sku tshab dgon lag lha sder mngags pa bcas chos phyogs 'brel ba che ba'i dbang gis lo re bzhin 'tshams 'drir phebs pa dang 'tshams rtags skyel ba/ dbang bka' chos gnang ba/ gnas chen dang rgya nang / sog yul dag tu phyag mjal du phebs pa sogs la yang 'gro gron shin tu che/ kun mkhyen lnga ba spyi lo 1927lor lha ldan sogs chos sde gnas chen du mar mchod mjal dang slob gnyer mdzad pa gdan sa che chung mang bo dang mi ser khri phrag drug la dngul srang khri phrag bzhi lhag dang gser srang bcu phrag lhag gis 'gyed bstabs/ da dung yong 'bab — 65 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dang 'gro gron rang gnyer byed pa la nang chen bco brgyad ces gtsos pa'i skor yod de/ bcings 'grol yar sngon skal bzang tshe ring zhes pa zhig gi rtsom nang du zam tsha tshang / gung thang tshang / hor gtsang tshang / sde ba tshang / dbal mang che ba/ gter lung bse tshang / ngag dbang dge legs tshang / sgo mang tshang / cung gar tshang / bde thang tshang / hor tshang / dpa' ris tshang / phyag mdzod tshang / dbal mang chung ba/rgya zhabs drung / bla ma phun tshogs/ mtsho kha ba/ rgya lung ba bcas slar bzlos pa lta bu dang / der 'dra rigs yang yongs 'dzin tshang / mgo rta tshang / ya rung tshang / bse lung tshang / brag sgom pa/ rgya nag pa/ bsod grags tshang / snyan grags tshang / sgang khang tshang / rgya zhabs drung / dge 'dun dar rgyas/mgon shul tshang / rab brtan rgya mtsho/ snyi ga tshang / tshogs 'du tshang / han tshang la sogs so/ /6 zhar du slar yang lo re'i tshogs chen spyi ba'i 'gro gron dang phogs gtong gal chen skor rags tsam gleng na/ ( 1) lo re'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin la dgon yongs kyi grwa mang dang bogs len dud tshang re rer ko re g.yis btsos ster dgos/ thos bsam gling ba'i grwa ba rer dgu re dang grwa ba gzhan par lnga re/bogs khyim rer nyer brgyad/ bogs len khyim pa gsar bar lnga re/ glas drug sde ba'i bogs khyim(dpon ju nang gi bogs len pa)rer lnga re ster bar bya/ 2 zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin la tshogs chen gdung mdun du stong mchod tshar gcig dang zla bcu ba'i bco lngar stong mchod tshar gsum re 'bul bar bya/ 2 zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga dang / lnga ba'i bcu gsum/ bcu ba'i nyer lnga la tshogs chen gyi bla grwa yongs la tshogs thug dang lo re'i khang gla'i yong sgo'i phogs gtong dgos/ 4 zla lnga ba'i bco lnga'i nyin la dgon pa'i grwa mang 'dus sde yongs la nas phogs gtong dgos kyang skabs der 'bru rigs dkon pas sgor mo ster bar bya/ 5 nyin re bzhin rgyun chags su grub pa'i bsang dang drug bcu ba'i rtsam pa de spyi ba dang mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs gnyis gas 'dang bar bya dgos/ 6 tshogs chen du zhogs tshogs dang gung tshigs sogs sbyin bdag med nyin rgyun ja 'bul bar bya/ 7 lo re'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lngar bla sprul dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs la gsol rtsam du nas phogs rgya ma nyi shu lhag re stobs dgos te bsdoms pas nas skal stong phrag yin/ kun mkhyen tshang la skal drug cu dang / spyi bar skal lnga bcu/ gser khri rnam par skal bcu gsum re/ mkhan po rnam par skal brgyad re/ spyi zur rnam par skal bdun re/ khri zur rnam par skal gsum re/ lhan khang 'du khang dkor gnyer sogs la rang rang las 'gan tshegs che chung ltar ska la gnyis re gsum re can dang bdun re brgyad re can yang yod la/ grwa ba dkyus mar skal gcig re/ ra spyi ba bskos bzhugs pa'i ring du nges par dgon byes slob gnyer ba bzhugs pa'i sdod khang ra gnyis nas bzhi re phub pa 'grub dgos/ 9 dgon pa'i spyi rdzas la kha snon gsar skrun sogs su sbyor 'jags 'khyongs na ches legs par brtsi nges yin/ 10 spyi 'gan bzhes rjes rgan gya'i dpon po ni dgon pa'i sa bdag yin gshis lo rer rta mchog sga srab 'grig ma'i steng phrug lwa spus legs gnang nas drin gzo ba'i tshul 'bul dgos so/ /ga'an bla brang yul dpon chen po blo bzang tshe da 66 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dbang (hāng krin chin)mchog gi ljags rtsom〈dwang krin chen blo bzang tshe dbang dang kun mkhyen lnga ba chen po sku mched zung gi rnam par thar ba rjes su dran pa zag med ye shes kyi me long zhes bya ba〉las/ khong gis bla brang du chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs spel tshul kha nyung tshig gsal gsungs pa 'god par byas na 'di lta ste/chos srid zung 'brel zhes pa bla brang sa cha'i tshul ni 'di ltar/ man ju gong mas rgyal sa bzung ma thag tu kun su'u dang mtsho sngon/ rnga khul dang khams phyogs kyi yul gru phal mo cher dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' dar/yul gru de dag gi mgo ba'am dpon po dag gis dge ldan bstan pa'i sgrub sder rgyab skyor dang ngo dga' mchog tu byas te/ de ltar ma bgyis na rang nyid kyi dbang thang yang sra brtan gyi ldog phyogs su 'gyur 'gro bar dogs/man ju gong mas kyang bod dang sog po'i shog tshan la‘4chos lugs kyis blo kha bsgyur pa'i srid jus spel bar brten thog chos lugs kyi stobs shugs bed du spyad de yul gru de ga'i dbang bsgyur gyi byed las brtan brling du bsrungs/ man ju gong ma khang zhis ngo ma ni yon krin khri lo thog ma'i lo yin rgyal srid skyong mdzad kyi dus te spyi lo chig stong bdun brgya nyer gsum pa na/ sa cha de dag mnga' dbang du bsgyur po sog po'i sa skyong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis mtsho sngon gyi rtswa thang yongs su rdzogs pa dbang du bsgyur/ sku 'bum dang dgon lung / sgo mang bcas pa'i bla ma dang grwa rgan tshor sbrel nas man ju la ngo log pa'i sbyor ba brtsams/ skya ser nyis 'bum lhag 'ur du bslangs nas drag po'i yo lang spel/ de ltar bgyis mod kyang gdan sa chen po bla brang dgon pa'i sbyin bdag gi gzhi ma tsha han bstan 'dzin ni ngan sbyor der yi mi rang bas rbad kyis 'gog rgol mdzad/ zang zing dang yo lang la gzhug rgyu ni de bas ga la srid/ de nas yun ma ring ba na yo lang slong bo dag gi mgo bo bsnan cing man ju gong mas bka' nan phab ste yo lang du zhugs pa'i dgon sde bkag pa dang / bla brang dgon pa gtsigs su mthong bar mdzad de rgyab skyor yang mi dman pa gnang / dper na gtsug lag khang sogs rten dang brten pa mang du bzhengs la 'gro dngul gyi kha bsabs/ de bzhin btsun pa'ang mang du 'phel te mtshan snyan dang gdul bya je rgyas su phyin/ de nas chan lung gis rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i mjug tsam na/ khong gis chos srid kyi mnga' thang yang kun su'u dang zi khron/ mtsho sngon/ khams phyogs sogs kyi dgon sde du mar rgya bskyed cing dbang du bsdus/ kun mkhyen sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang bos chos kyi khri 'phang mnga' mdzad pa'i dus su chos lugs kyi kha lo nye bar bsgyur ba'i ched du tshogs chen tshogs 'du dang drung ja'i tshogs 'du ste tshogs 'du gnyis su phye ba'i tshogs 'du gong ma ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bla brang gi 'khor ram drung ja'i tshogs 'du ste/ phyag mdzod dang yongs 'dzin/ yab gzhis/ sku bcar mkhan po gtsos pa'i mnga' 'og tu gsol dpon chen mo dang / mchod dpon chen mo/ mtshan nyid zhabs phyi ba/ tā chos rje/ drung yig chen mo/ mgron gnyer chen mo/ sku tshab/ pho brang sde ba/ mchod khang sde ba sogs 'dzoms par tshugs/ de dag gis kun mkhyen rin po che'i sku don dang pho brang gi bya ba 'ba' zhig gnyer/ tshogs 'du 'ol ma ni tshogs chen tshogs 'du ste bla brang dgon pa'i gdan sa rang gi dbang cha mtho shos kyi las shag yin/— 67 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/de'ang kun mkhyen rin po che'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa las tshogs chen khri ba gtsos pa'i mnga' 'og tu tshogs chen dbu mdzad dang / dkor gnyer chen mo/ dpon tshang gnyer ba re re/ spyi ba dang sku tshab gnyis re ste/ de dag gis gnyer bya'i yul du bya ba la rmad byung thos bsam gling dang / kye rdor grwa tshang / smad rgyud grwa tshang / rgyud stod grwa tshang / dus 'khor grwa tshang / sman pa grwa tshang / khrims bstar khang bcas yin/kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku ring la rje khong nyid kyis bstan pa la sgrub pa kho na mdzad phyir 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad cung btang snyoms su bzhag mthar gdan sa rang gi dbang cha che shos phyag mdzod kyi phyag tu gtad/ nang chen khag gi bla sprul rnams kyi dbang thang yang je rgyas su phyin pa dang dgon pa'i sgrig lam bca' yig kyang mi srung ba byung ba'i rnam pa bud/ de'i phyir kun mkhyen ba'i ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gser gyi khri 'phangs dbang 'byor ba'i skabs nas slar gdan sa'i dbang cha gzhan du shor ba'i tshul ma yin pa 'thus tshang can du bsgyur cing drung ja'i tshogs 'du dag ther tshags bsher mdzad/ dgon par gtogs pa'i chos srid zung gi bya ba thams cad khong gis dag ther tshags bsher mdzad/dgon par gtogs pa'i chos srid zung gi bya ba thams cad sku nyid nas dam por gnyer ba dang / lha sde dang mi sde/ chos sde khag gi don dag ci mchis thag gcod pa'i cha ra chos srid kho na tsam ma yin par dmag don dang bcas pa rgya bskyed/ go gnas kyi char phyag mdzod las cung dma' ba'i sku bcar mkhan po gsar du bsna na pa dang zhabs phyi'i tshogs je rgyas su btang / de'ang zhabs phyi mi gang yin zhig mi rung bar nges par du phyug po'i khyim du skyes pas 'byor ba mod cing yid rton bya rung ba dag bdams rgyu thag bcad/ de gang zhe na/ 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa yul gzhan du chibs sgyur byung na gcig tu sku bcar mkhan po'i tshul du zhabs phyi gang legs zhu dgos/ gnyis su dgon lag dang lha sde shog tshan khag gi sku tshab dang mgo bar mngag dgos ched du red/de ltar lag len du bgyis pas sngar gyi srid dbang gcig ma nges phyogs su gyes pa'i rnam pa thams cad bsgyur te chos srid gnyis kyi dbang cha che shos dag kun mkhyen bla ma'i phyag sor gcig bu gsol pa la sman par dgongs/de'ang nang gses kyi phyogs res dang 'gal zla ste mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan dag bcos su med pa'i rang bzhin du grub pas/ skabs der mā chi yi lcags sder bsrengs pa'i 'byung rtsa'ang dgon pa'i nang gses kyi 'gal ba nyag gcig phyi la brdol par rag las pa'i rkyen sogs dgongs pas/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu tham pa'i bar dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slob gnyer gnang zhing chibs kha yul mdo smad kyi gdan sar bsgyur/ thugs kyi dgongs pa bsgyur bcos su mnyes te se 'bras dge gsum sogs gdan sa chen po dag gi phyag srol bzang bo ltar rang dgon du rtsa 'dzugs so so legs sgrig tu bstar/ kun mkhyen bla mas dbu mdzad phyag mdzod kyis gtso 'gan bzhes pa'i rtse yig tshang btsugs te/dgon ma lag dang 'brel lha sde shog pa khag gi chab srid dang chos lugs/ dmag don gyi dbang cha che shos thams cad mnga' dbang gcig tu bsgyur gshis chos srid zung 'brel zhes pa mngon sum du mtshon par nus pa — 68 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhig tu gyur/ de lta bas na tang(go min tang )srid kyi rtsa 'dzugs dang srid skyong las shag bsang chu rdzong (zhwa ho)srid gzhung / go min tang bsang chu rdzong gi tang don las shag gang la'ang skabs 'phral dbang cha ci yang ma zin pas/ kho tshos bka' nan ji ltar phab kyang mang tshogs kyi khrod du a lan tsam yang mi ster ba'i gnas su song ngo / zhes pas bar skabs lo du ma'i ring bod yul dgon sde che grags la srid 'byor rig gsum thad mi ser dbang bsgyur pa dang dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi brtan pa/ nang bstan bcas kyi rig gnas thams cad skul spel gtong ba'i nus pa'am phan 'bras kyang mi dman pa thebs pa mtshon thub pa 'di lags so/ /le'u lnga ba/ bstan pa slar gsos chun du ma nyams gong 'phel bgyid bzhin pa'i skor/1950lo ste rab rgyal lcags stag lo'i tha skar zla ba'i nag phyogs rdzogs pa'i gza' skar bkra shis legs tshogs kyi nyin mor paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po chos sde chen po 'di nyid du phebs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng drug pa thugs thag bcad cing chu 'brug lo'i dbo zla'i dkar phyogs dang bo'i dga' ba la gdan sa'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i gser gyi khri 'phang mnga' gsol/ me 'gog khra'o rogs su dngul sgor 'bum phrag bzhi lhag phul/ shing lug lo'i zla gsum pa'i nang rgyal dbang bcu ba'i ba phebs nas kun mkhyen drug par 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang paṇa chen bcu ba slar phebs nas tshe dpag med kyi dbang bstsal/ sngar me 'jig thebs pa'i kyai rdor 'du khang rten byin gyis bltams pa de slar bzhengs sogs yar ldan gyi bgyi ba mang du spel na'ang 195〈lo'i dus zing gis rkyen pas chos sgo brgyab/ 1961lor kun su'u 'ing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba ni zhing chen rim pa'i rig gnas dngos rdzas srung skyob sde khag gi gras su bkod pa khyab sgrog mdzad/ dgon pa'i dpe mdzod kyi skor dang dngos rdzas dkon po skor zhig gtor rlag ma thebs pa 'phral skyob thob/ phyi lor skabs de'i krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso 7yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rje rdo sbis shes rab rgya mtsho mchog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs te/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang yin pa dang skabs de'i krung dbyang gi mi rigs dang chos lugs srid jus ltar chos sde gal chen rnams rim par slar gso rung ba'i bka' snyan gsungs shing / zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u sogs 'brel yod sde khag gi chog mchan dang sbrags bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bstan pa'i sgo 'phar gyi tham ga dang lcags zwa'i rgya bkrol te bkra shis dge mtshan gyi 'o mtsho yongs su bltams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi dad ldan mi ser la slar stsol pa'i bskal ba re zhig ldan par gyur/ skabs der chab srid las 'gul mtshams byas pa dang srid jus nor 'dzol mi nyung ba yo bsrang bgyis stabs/ dad ldan mang bos gshin po'i dge rtsa dang gson po'i tshogs gnyis kyi ched du chos spyod ci 'dzoms rgyun ldan du spel/ dgon pa yongs su slar bla ma dang btsun pa zhal grangs chig stong lhag slar 'dzoms dang gsar zhugs pa brgya lhag 'dus/ gzhan grwa mang ni sngar gyi grwa rgyun yin pas thon — 69 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/skyed spel zhor chag 'jig kha shas zhig gso dang chos lugs rig gnas dngos rdzas shul lus thams cad legs sgrig dang mchod bkur mi dman pa byas/ khyad par du kun mkhyen drug pa tshogs chen khrir 'khod de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bskyar spel dang dad ldan par chos kyi sbyin pa rmad du byung ba bstsal/ de nas chu yos lor gong gi chos lugs sris jus lag bstar byas par btsun pa je nyung btang / shul du gling tshang gtsos pa rgan dar brgya lhag rgyun bzhugs thob cing rgyal mdzod nas 'bru skal bstsal cing mu mthud du thon skyed spel ba dang mnyam du chos spyod kyi bya ba bsgrubs so/ /'on kyang legs lam du sbyar ba'i khri gdugs srid jus bzang bo'i 'od stong de re zhig sprin gyi lcug mas bsgribs te gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur pa'i 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og gi rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i nang zing gi las 'gul chen po de krung go'i mnga' khongs mtha' dbus dbyer med du me ri'i zhun rdo 'phyur ba lta bur ches mgyogs shing ches dza drag can/ ches gting zab cing yun ring bo'i sgo nas spel mgo tshugs pa la/ chab srid las 'gul gyi 'thor rlung des krung go'i srol rgyun rig gnas ma lus pa rtsa snub btang / bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rten dang brten na byin rlabs che ba/ gnyer na rin thang che ba/mjal na yid dbang 'phrog pa'i bod yul spyi ma zad rgyal khab kyi'ang rig gnas bang mdzod cig yin pa 'di'i pargya cha bdun cu yan bsnubs/ 1966lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nang ya nga zhing gdug rtsub che ba'i‘cadamar srung dmag 〉 gi tshadapa' rgodami stong phrag dgon nang du lhags te gzhom gzhig sreg gsum gyi gshed spyod mgo btsugs/thog mar tshogs chen 'du khang bshig mgo brtsams pas na/ skabs de'i rdzong u hru'u ci su'u khe chin(tsho༅7)lags kyis mi chog pa'i bka' bstsal stabs brlag 'phro mtshams byas/ de nas bzung skabs de dang phyis su rim par bshigs pa dper na/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / sgrol ljang lha khang / mtha' ba'i thub chen lha khang / gung thang mchod rten/ sde ba tshang gis sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang / ltung bshags lha khang /cung gar jo'i khang / mtha' ba'i jo'i khang / rta mgrin lha khang / rje gzigs pa lnga ldan lha khang / rgya nag tshang stong sku'i lha khang / gling tshang byams khang / bde mchog lha khang / btsan khang gsum/ par khang chen mo/ nor 'dzin pho brang / bkra shis rab brtan/ rjes ma gnyis shul tsam re lus pa las gzhan pa thams cad sa sa mal dang rdo rdo mal du bsnubs mthar/ chos khri drug spyi khang brgyad/ mchod rten gnyis/ bla ma che khag gi bde yangs dang tshoms chen bcu drug dgon mtha'i 'khor khang che chung thams cad/ grwa shag yongs rdzogs bcas shing cha dang rdo tshang ma rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang thon skyed ru khag la bgos pa dang brkus brlags pa de srog chag grog ma'i tshang khyer ba ltar stong bar btang / shul du tshogs chen 'du khang dang lha khang sogs gong gsal dang snyan grags tshang bde yangs/ bsod grags tshang tshoms chen las gzhan bsnubs/ de bzhin dgon shul du bsang chu rdzong gi rgyal khab kyi las khungs mi nyung ba der gsar du btsugs pa dper na/rdzong go pags bzo grwa dang / zas rigs kung si/ rdzong bshan ra/ zhing las 'phrul chas bzo ga zhing — 70 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/las 'phrul chas kung si/ rdzong dngos rdzas cus/ rdzong gzan chas las snon bzo grwa 'bar rdzas kung si/sa bon kung si/ tang gi slob ga rtswa thang sa tshigs/ chu glog cus/ shing bzo ru khag bzo tshong cus/bla brang bzo tshong khang / 'ing las dang 'dzugs skrun dang mi dmangs gsum po'i dngul khang gi las khang gsum/ bod sman khang / rdzong zhib dpyod khang / rdzong 'khyag mdzod/ gzhan rig gnas dngos rdzas do dam u yon lha khang 1978btsugs pa dang 1985lo'i mjug gtor skabs der dgon pa'am rig rdzas do dam gyi dbang cha spyod ba'in yod de dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa srung skyob la byas rjes bzhag yod/ gong gsal las khungs 'di dag tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su/ yang dag pa'i srid jus rab dang rim pa dngos 'beb byas pa las/ da skabs nom stobs bcas kyi dbang gis re zhig spor ma thub pa ni rdzong bod sman khang dang ma gtogs gzhan pa thams cad gnas spar grub po/ /1 shul lus gtsug lag dang zhig gso bskyar bzhengs/1979lor krung go gung khran tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa pe cin du 'tshogs te/ lo bcu'i nang zing god chag chab srid las 'gul chen po mjug bsdus shing dngos thog bden 'tshol dang rnyog zing drang bcos kyi jus bzang bsgrags nas/ mi rigs gnad don dang chos lugs gnad don la 'brel ba'i byed phyogs dang srid jus dngos 'beb byas te/ 1980lor bla brang dgon pa'i rig gnas do dam u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs nas/ dgon pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob dang gtsug lag rnying ba bdag gnyer/ 'du khang lhag khang me 'gog ljongs rgyu mgron po bsu skyel/ mang tshogs kyi khrims mthun mchod bkur bkod sgrig la sogs dgon pa'i bstan don sna tshogs pa bsgrub mgo tshugs/ khyad du skabs de'i mthong rgya can dang kun slong bzang ba'i mgo 'dren pa dag gi 'bad brtson las dgon pa zhig gso'i ma dngul shog sgor 'bum lnga lhag thob thabs bgyis te nyen khog rtsig bzo mang bo zhig gso btang /skabs der nyams rgud thebs phyin lus pa'i gtsug lag la/ grwa tshang drug ga'i 'du khang dang / gser khang jo'i khang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang / gdugs dkar lha khang / seṅge nga ro'i lha khang / sgrol dkar lha khang / rje lha khang zhabs brtan lha khang bcas las gzhan/ snyan grags tshang dang / sgo mang tshang / gling tshang / bsod grags tshang bcas kyi bde yangs nang chen sogs cha shas lus pa tsam ste mang shos 'jig pa gong bshad ltar ro/ /chos lugs dad mos rang dbang zhes pa'i 'dod 'jo ba mo'i srid jus 'o bcud de bkres skom be'u'i srog skyob tu rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang mi rigs sa gnas rang skyong gi srol yig gtan phab longs su spyod pa'i ltas bzang mthong tsa na/ grwa shag gi thog ma de bod rab rgyal lcags sprel lo'i sos kha dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla brang khri rabs go lnga ba sog po dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs btsun bgres kha shas kyis brgyab ste bstan pa yar dar — 71 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs /gyi skya rengs bsus pa dang / lo de'i zla bcu bar krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba thams cad mkhyen pa dpal bzang bo bla brang dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis kun nas 'khyil pa'i gling du phyag phebs byon te/ tang dang srid gzhung gi bka' bsgos chog ma chan sgro ga bzhin thub bstan chos kyi sgo mo slar phye ba'i sku drin dngos su bskyangs te grwa mang phyir 'dus re la rje gung thang rin po che dang tsha kho rdo rje dpal bzang bcas kyis shog sgor sogs kyis mang 'gyed thog mar btang / skabs bstun gyi dad bskul de dang brten nas phyi lo'i lugs rnying zla gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba'i nyin mor lha khang thams cad kyi rten sgo rnam par 'byed pa'i yol ba bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang phye shing dgon pa 'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi dbu khrid pa kun mkhyen dang gung thang rnam pa zung gis gtso 'gan bzhes so/ /rab rgyal chu khyi lo'i zla gsum pa'i nang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bla brang dgon pa ni rgyal yongs gnad sa'i rig rdzas dngos po do dam sde khag skor gnyis pa'i gras su bkod stabs gzod mdo smad bstan pa'i chos sde chen po dngos gnas lo rgyus su gnas thub cing phyogs bcu'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'dod mos nam yang skong thub pa'i re ba byung / lo der kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog kun lho'i chos lugs dang mi rigs srid jus dngos 'beb la gzigs zhib tu phebs/ bod rigs dang bcas pa'i mi grangs khri phrag gsum lhag gis chos srid srol rgyun gyi gus lugs ltar bsu skyel rgya chen po spel/ de bzhin bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel mang du 'grig pa la/ rgya che ba'i dad ldan mang tshogs la rig gnas gsar rje chen po'i las 'gul nang 'tshe ba ches cher phog pa ma zad mi grangs mi nyung ba'i lus phung la rdung rdeg 'thab rtsod gdug rtsub che zhing ya nga ba thebs pa dang tha na kha shas lnga lam du bcug pa sogs kyi rkyen byung mod kyang / skabs der srid jus je lhod je 'jam dang chos lugs yang dar bskyar gso'i bskal ba bzang bo thon pa'i bka' drin gyis/ mang tshogs kyis dge rtsa mang 'gyed phogs gtong gi bgyi ba je dar du gyur/ dge 'dun pa shul lus sum brgya tsam ma bkug rang 'dus kyis rang rang so so'i grwa tshang du phyag 'byor/ dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi bla grwa rnams kyis mdun gyis rnyog 'dzing che ba'i dka' khag mang bo bsal nas dgon spyi'i rnam pa bsgyur cing chos spyod thams cad srol rgyun bca' yig ltar phyag bstar byed pa'i dbu btsugs/ lo du ma'i 'bad 'bungs lhur len la grub 'bras gzhan dring mi 'jog pa thob/ bla ma gling tshang gtsos pa'i thugs khur las gling dbus su dbyen zlum mchod rten bzhengs pas mtshon/ da snga bar dpe mdzod lha khang chen mo/ btsan khang gsum dang /thos bsam gling ba'i dpe mdzod lha khang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang (1987bsang khag gis bzhengs)/gdugs dkar lha khang gi phyi rtsig chos ra chen mo/ shar gyi bdud 'dul mchod rten chen mo(198 2lor tsha 'bum gyis bzhengs) nub kyi dbyin 'dum mchod rten (1989lor bsod nams dbang mos zhus pa ltar sger gzhung gnyi gas bzhengs) gung thang mthong grol mchod rten ( 1991—1992lor gung thang drug pa nyid kyis bzhengs) dgon pa'i mtha' skor du lnga cha gsum du 'khor chen 'khor chung khang mig mang bor chos 'khor — 72 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/—(dad ldan sde ba'am shog pa/ dud tshang nas bzhengs) sogs gang rgyas gang legs su grub pa dang / khyad par du1985lo'i zla4ba'i tshes7nyin bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang sku gsung thugs rten dang rgyu nom rtsa chen lhun gyis grub par bltams pa de me dgras brlags pa la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo kho na'i sku gdung cha tshang na bza' lhan gcig tu ma tshig pa'i ngo mtshar dngos su byung / zhing chen gyi hru'u ci gzhon pa la'o khe cen(bod) dang 'ing dpon gzhon pa nyan te 'ang sogs phebs nas me skyob la bkod 'doms mdzad pa dang tshes dgur zhing chen tang u dang srid gzhung gis bskyar bzheng gtan khel gnang / 'du khang bzheng skabs ma dngul la krung dbyang nor srid kyis shog sgor sa ya brgyad dang zhing chen gyis sa ya bzhi/ gser spyi rgya lnga bcu dang dngul spyi rgya drug brgya btang mthar/ 19kha0lor la yongs su bskyar bzheng grub cing lo de'i zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer lngar legs grub kyi dga' ston rgya chen po spel pa la/ mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ nang sogacang zhi/ hrang he la sogs kyi dgon pa mang bo'i sku tshab dang mi sna chig khri sum stong lhag 'dzoms/da dung slar gso'i tshun du bla sprul rnam pas tshoms chen dang lha khang / nang chen/ gzim shag bskyar du bzhengs pa la kun mkhyen rang dang / gung thang rin po che/ sde ba tshang / hor gtsang tshang zam tsha tshang /bde thang tshang / yongs 'dzin tshang bcas cung rgya che ba dang / rgya khyon 'bring rigs can la thu'u bkwan tshang /khya dge tshang / rgyal mkhan po tshang / bla ma dkar bo tshang / dga' bde tshang / stag ge tshang / 'bo ra'i mu to tshang / sgo mang tshang / rab brtan rgya mtsho/ a lags gdong tshang / khyom dge tshang / tsho 'du tshang /dus 'khor tshang / mdzod dge stobs ldan tshang bcas mchis te rab rgyal sa khyi'i sngon gyi rgya khyon sogs gang ci'i thad bsdur thabs zad kyang da lta legs shos su brtsi/ grwa shag lta bu can la dpa' ris pa tshang / dbal mang che ba tshang / dbal mang chung ba tshang / gur yag tshang / khams la ga sprul sku phyag mdzod mkhan po tshang / mtsho kha ba tshang / gling tshang / li thang bka' 'gyur ba tshang / dme shul mu to tshang / 'bo ra'i mu to tshang / a mchog mu to tshang / bsod grags tshang / nyang tshang / a rong tshang / tā dbon pa tshang /lcang shar tshang / tsa yus thog ga tshang / rdo sbis yongs 'dzin tshang / bde thang zhabs drung tshang / ya rong tshang/ dkon mchog seṅge tshang / dpa' ris stag lung tshang / stag ge tshang / tsho 'du tshang / bang tshang 'bas drung / 'gyang rgan 'gyang phrug tan tshang / rigs grwa tshang / rgya zhabs drung / rtse dbus mtshams pa ba tshang sogs mchis pa ma zad/ da dung dgos nges kyi dbang gis gzim khang gsar du brgyab pa'ang mi nyung ba bla sprul gsar ba bzhugs yod de/ dper na zhal shul tshang / lab tshang / gnyan thog gcod pa ba tshang / yig brgya tshang / sum pa tshang / dpa' ris stag lung tshang / shis tshang zhabs drung tshang / dgon mi tshang / yer ba tshang / sgyis dge tshang / sum mthil tshang / 'bring ba tshang / reb tsha'i bka' 'gyur ba tshang / dpa' ris sems nyid tshang la sogs mu mthud je mang phub bzhin pa'i skabs te/gzhan grwa shag lnga brgya bcu gcig phub pa bcas pa bkra shis 'khyil ba'i de snga'i rgya khyon slar grub cing / nang — 73 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bstan slob gling bcas kyi bzo bkod gsar ba dag gis phyi'i rnam pa lta na sdug pa dang nang rten thams cad bskyar bzheng grub pas mi ser gyi dad pa'i spu long kun nas g.yo bar bya'o/ /2 chos spyod slar gso dang dam chos dpar skrun/lugs rnying zla dang bo'i nang sngar srol bzhin smon lam chen mo 'tshogs pa dang gos sku bshams pa me tog mchod mjal (grangs nyung la spus cung zhan) byams pa gling skor/ 'cham chen ('cham lwa sngar las legs shing rgyan che) zla gnyis par tshogs mchod skabs kun mkhyen sku phreng du ma'i gdung mchod dang gar 'cham/ rten 'gangs chen gling skor sogs/ zla gsum par dkyil 'khor thad kyi gar 'cham dang zla bzhi ba'i smyung gnas/zla drug pa'i nang rab 'byams pa'i bgro gleng / mi la'i shwa 'cham dang seng 'cham/ dbyar gnas dang shing slong / zla dgu ba dang bcu bar dbus gtsang bde ma'i dgu 'cham/ lnga mchod chen mo/ bla ma sku drin can du ma 'i gdung mchod sogs/ da dung rgyud pa'i sngags kyi dam bca' dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ kun rig dang tshe dpag med kyi dngon dkyil/ mgon chos lnga'i bskang gso sogs/ dus 'khor du dus 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'cham/ sman pas sman bla'i bdag 'jug dang sbyin sreg rta mgrin dang mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod/ lhag par du dbyar sman dang ston sman dus tshigs ltar grwa mang rnams sman rams pa dag gis khrid de dngos sbyong phebs par bya/ kyai rdor bas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bdag 'jug kyai rdor bdag 'jug nyi ldog gtor chen/ kyai rdor lha 'cham la sogs pa mi nyams rgyud 'dzin dang phyogs gang ci'i legs bcos sgrig ldan du spel phyir/ chos kyi sde chen po'i ne'u gseng gi 'dab brgya lham mer bzhad pa'i dbus su rkang drug sprin phung g.yo ba lta bu ma skul rang shugs su 'dus pa'i slob gnyer ba brgya phrag du ma 'gro 'ong gi rgyun ma chad pa dang / dad ldan gang zag mang bo yid gdung gis bskul te rang rang tshogs gsog zhal 'debs su byon pa de bas kyang brjod mi nus so/ /gna' snga mo nas bod mdo dbus khams gsum du dam chos dpar khang che ba du ma dang nyung shos chos sde che 'bring dag tu brko srol dar/ rang re'i kun su'u zhing chen la mtshon na/ dpa' ris mchod rten thang dang /co ne dgon chen/ the bo'i bang tshang dgon/ 'brug chu'i ong gsum dgon/ klu chu'i stag tshang lha mo gser khri'i dgon/ klu chu'i shis tshang sgar sar/ bā tse'i khongs tsha rdor dgon/ bsang chu'i a mchog dgon la sogs las ches dar mgyogs shing grangs mang 'dus pa ni bkra shis 'khyil pa rang lags te/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul gyi skabs dang de snga sa phag lo la dam chos sogs rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'dus pa'i par shing khri lhag phrag me 'jig phog kyang / rab rgyal lcags bya lo nas lhag 'phro'i chad grangs gsab brko dang thabs chag can gyi lcags par khang gsar du tshugs/ skabs der rig gsar gtor rlog las dpe rgyun dkon pa dang mdo smad chos grwa mang bo slar gsos pas/ shing dpar dang lcags dpar gang gis kyang bstan pa yang dar la phan pa rgya chen po thogs/ da skabs kha gsab cing nyer tshags bzang ba'i rigs kyi — 74 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/par shing la / rje tsong kha ba'i gsung 'bum pong bco brgyad/ mkhas grub rje'i gsung 'bum pod bcu/rgyal tsha ba rje'i gsung 'bum pod brgyad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus dpal bzang bo'i gsung 'bum pod bcu bzhi/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gsung 'bum pod bcu gnyis/kun mkhyen gsum pa'i gsung 'bum pod gcig kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i gsung 'bum pod lnga/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i gsung 'bum pod gcig bse ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i bsdus gru gung thang bstan sgron pa'i gsung 'bum pod bcu gnyis/ sde khri gsum pa thub bstan nyi ma'i gsung 'bum pod drug mkhan chen tshang gsung 'bum pod drug 'ang thabs mkhas pa'i gsung 'bum pod bzhi/ khri rgya nag pa'i gsung 'bum pod gnyis/khyad par du bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bka' dang paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung rab kyang 'phags pa brgyad stong ba/ bskal bzang / ting 'dzin/ gzungs 'dus/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba/ sa lam sde lnga/ mtsho ṭikartogs 'bar/ lam mchan/ mgur 'bum la sogs glegs bam4928 2mchis pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ mkhas grub dam pa mang bo'i gsung thor bu brjod kyis mi longs te/ par shing kho na 'bum phrag lnga lhag tshags su dam par gleng / chu khyi lor lcags dpar gyi srol phyes pa nas da lta rigs gsum mgon po dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ ma ṇi yi ge drug ma la sogs pa'i shog 'bum bcu phrag du ma/chos kyi 'khor lor gzungs 'dus la sogs 'bum phrag rgyun mkho'i chos spyod rab gsal gyi skor du ma dang /zab gter gsang sngags skor mi nyung ba bcas mchis te deng dus lcags dpar spyod pa dang glog klad bsgrug pa'i phyogs su sta gon byed bzhin no/ /nye char bkra shis 'khyil du dpe mdzod chen po lha khang gnyis yod de/ che shos ni bla brang dpe mdzod chen mo zhes pa rig gsar las 'gul gyi phyis su gsar bzheng mdzad/ dpe mdzod 'di'i nang du dgon pa nyid lo du ma'i chab srid las 'gul brgyud ring bka' drin can dag gis srung skyob mdzad pa'i dpe rnying mang bo phyogs gcig tu bsdus te nyar tshags thub pa sha stag yin pas (le'u gsum par bkod pa'i nang don dang gcigadape mdzod gsar bar spo dus dpe tshan phal cher dag sgrig byas pa da lta dngos su nyar tshags bgyis pa'i grangs — de bas mang /)bsdoms tho zhib gsal ltar na/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur pod14040sngags phyogs pota240 2 1 ting 'phags bskal gsum pod2011 lam rim pota2 019 bka' rgya ma be bum chos 'khor skor2 25 min dpe po152 1 sgra snyan ngag sum rtags skor pod262 mngon brjod bzo rig skor pod7rnga rtsis dkar nag dbyangs 'char sogs275 rnam thar lo rgyus chos 'byung deb ther pota2529rnying phyogs pota167gser bris dngul bris can sogs rtsa chen pota424 bzhugs shing /ga'an yang thos bsam gling ba'i dpe mdzod du gtso bo grwa mang gi shul bzhag bstan bcos thor bu nyer gsog dang dgon pa skyes bu dag gis dad dbang du phul pa'am gnang ba'i bka' gsung bzhug par bya ste/ da snga dpe mdzod du dngos su bzhugs pa la bka' 'gyur pota nyis brgya dang / bstan 'gyur pota nyis brgya nyer lnga/— 75 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/yum chen mo pota so drug gsung thor bu pota110 2dang dag sgrig ma byas pa bcas bsdoms pas pota2767bzhugs so/ /da dung dper na rgyal ba seṅgeng ro'i lha khang du rje yab sras dang / kun mkhyen yab sras/ gung thang bstan sgron/ dbal mang / sde ba/ ta rā nā thā/ bu ston/ bla brang a khu che chung sogs skyes chen dam pa gser gyi ka ba dag gi bstan gzhung dang sgra tshad/ bod khungs se 'bras dge gsum gyi yig cha ma nga bo bcas pota 2750bzhugs pa dang / gser khang chen mor gser bris bka' 'gyur pota brgya/dus 'khor/ rgyud stod smad/ sman pa/ kyai rdor sogs kyi 'du khang du bka' 'gyur dang brgyad stong /gzungs 'dus/ bskal bzang sogs gser bris dngul bris du ma bcas/ da skabs bkra shis 'khyil bar bla grwa sger gyi phyag dpe ma 'dus kyang spyi gzhung kho nar glegs bam 'bum phrag bzhugs par 'dod do/ /gzhan yang dgon chen gyi phyi sgor lcags ri'i mtha' 'khor khang dang chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bco brgyad dang 'bring chung chig stong drug brgya lhag bzhugs so/ /2 rang gso'i thon skyed dang mang ja phogs 'gyed/dgon pas rang gso'i thon skyed spel pa ni gna' srol slar spel gyi gnad don zhig yin te/ rgya nang dang grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gang dag tu rnam pa mi 'dra ba'am bya thabs mi gcig pa'i sgo nas thon skyed 'bas phyi'i las rigs spel nas dgon pa'am lha khang ngam sgrub gnas de'i 'dzugs skrun la byas rjes 'jogabod yul gyi grub mtha' khag gi chos sde la rang rang chags gzhis kyi yul bab bstun nas thon skyed spel/'brog rkyang khul du dgon pa spyi dang bla sprul nang chen gyis rta nor lug gsum gyi su rug skyong ba la rtswa thang nges can bdag dam byas pa dang / rong ma 'brog tu sa zhing dang sgo phyugs gnyi ga gnyer ba/ nags rong sa khul du nags tshal cung rgya chen po dang sa 'ing du ma gnyer ba/ rong rkyang du sa zhing kho na gnyer ba la sogs kyi rang gso'i srol dar/ dgon pas thon skyed gnyer dgos don dang de'i khyad chos la ga'igs na gartsa bo gsum ldan te/ gcig tu khyad dbang gi khyad chos yod de/ dgon pa'i sa zhing dang rtswa thang / nags tshal tshong las sogs kyi thon skyed rgyu cha ni mang che ba dgon pas btsan gyis mi ser gyi lag nas 'phrog pa ma yin par chos sde gsar 'dzugs skabs sam de rjes bla ma grwa tshang la mchod gzhis shog pa tsho ba tha na khyim pa sger gyis bstan don tshogs gsog tu phul pa la/ slar mi ser gyi 'a ga tu sprad de thon skyed go rim yongs su gla bcol lam 'os 'gan zung 'brel ngang grub mthar dgon par gan rgya ltar thon rdzas yar 'bul bya dgos pa'i lam lugs shig yin/der brten dgon pas bdag tu bzung ba'i rtswa sa dang nags tshal/ sa zhing sogs la yul de'i mi sems su mchog tu gyur pa dang 'os 'gan dang len sgos dgon pa grwa tshang gi bstan don yar ldan du bsgrub dgos la/de ni tshogs gsog dge sbyong gi don chen yin par snyam nas/ mi'i klad pa'i nang rang shugs su khyad dbang mngon par grub pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i thon khungs bed spyod khag theg yong ched yul dpon dang rgan sems bcas kyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs khur srung skyob dang rogs ram je rgyas su btang gshis 'phrog rtsod — 76 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gtor brlag gi gnas tshul mi 'byung / gnyis su bed spyod kyi khyad chos ldan te/ dgon pa'i chags 'jig gam nyams gso rgya skyed bcas la thad kur rag las/ bod yul spyi khyab thon skyed rjes su lus shing mi ser mang shos 'tsho ba dbul bas dgon pa'i rtsig las dang rig stobs nang 'dren dang bzheng gal 'os 'gan dang len byed pa'i nus pa chung / des na chos sde'i 'dzugs skrun 'gro gron gtso bo ni dgon pa dang bla mas gnyer ba'i rang gso'i thon skyed la brten pa ma zad/ ma rtsa mi nyung ba ni yul phyogs mang bor rgyu ba'i bsod snyoms dang zhal 'debs bsdus nas rten dang brten pa thams cad bzhengs pa dang / dgon pa phyi nang gi 'brel ba dang bla sprul gsar blu/ skyes mchog dam par dbang lung bka' chos zhu ba/ dgon pa'i rgyun ldan chos spyod thad bcas su phan pa rgya chen thogs/ da dung der bstun bla ma dang grwa mang sger gyis kyang bzhon ma dang sa zhing nyung nyung gnyer ba'am/ slob gnyer gyi zhar du tshong las spel pa sogs kyi rnam pas rang kha rang gso dang dgon par sbyor 'jags gtong ba goms srol du dar/ de'i phyir dgon pas da skabs spyi tshogs gsar ba'i dgos mkho bzhin thon skyed phran tshegs spel nas yong 'beb blangs pa de lugs mthun yin pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs spyi'i 'phel phyogs kyang yin pas khrims mthun tshul ldan du bskyong bar rgyab skyor rogs ram thob na thub bstan yun du dar ba dang grwa mang 'tsho rten la phan nus chen po 'dod thub/ gsum du bde srung gi khyad chos mchis te/sngon chad dgon pas rang gso'i thon skyed spel ba la mchod yon 'brel ba dam zab dang bstan 'phrin 'phel rgyas kyi mkho don las/ dgon pa dang mi ser/ mi ser dang ru sde bar gyi mthun sgril 'brel 'dzugs la nus pa chen po thon/ bod yul du dus rgyun rtswa sa sogs sa mtshams chu mtshams/ nags srung shing gcod bcas kyi thad rtsod 'khrug byung ba la/ skabs rer rtsod gzhi 'dum ched rtsod sa'i yul gyi rtswa thang ngam nags tshal lam sa zhing de dgon par gnyer du bcug pa yod de/ yul gyi bkod pa srung skyong dang mi rigs nang khul mthun sgril la phan zhing dge ba'i don grub pa ma zad/ nags tshal la mtshon na btsan nags zhes pa'am bkag nags zhes bkas bcad kyis bsrungs te yul phyogs de'i sa chu srung 'dzin dang yul ljongs mdzes ldan la nus pa bton pas/ da snga bar kun lho yul gru'i nags tshal gyi rgya khyon che zhing shing rdzong stug po gdod ma'i nags tshal gyi rnam pa lus thub pa phyogs gtso bo der rag las pa dang / de bstun rtswa sman shing sman/ ri dwags gcan gzan 'gangs can 'tsho thub pas yul gyi khyad chos dang rnam pa ngo mtshar du grub pa yin no/ /bkra shis 'khyil bar mtshon na sngon chad rang gso'i thon skyed rgya che zhing spus legs pa/ 'byor ba rgyas shing bed spyod mkhas pa'i chos sde legs gras su grub la mdo smad dge lugs grub mtha' dar spel la mdzad rjes che bar mngon/ da skabs de 'dra'i phyi yul gyi rang gso'i cha rkyen mi ldan yang / dgon pa slar gsos tshun gong gi 'brel yod byed phyogs dang srid jus nang bzhin mu mthud du thabs brgya jus stong gis rang gso'i thon skyed cung rgya chen po spel nas grub 'bras dang nyams myong mi nyung ba thob/ dgon pas dgon pa gso ba la zhing las thon skyed dang / tshong las dpal 'byor/ las snon bzo las/ ljongs rgyu gnas mjal spyi phan zhabs — 77 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/phyi sogs kyi las gnyer btsugs/ sngon nas da bar gcig mtshungs su grub pa'i grwa ba'i 'tsho rten de gtso bo pha yul khyim pa dang gnyen nye la brten dgos te/ da lta'i grwa mang la rang rang pha yul du sa zhing dang sgo phyugs bgos pas khyim pa gshis drang dag gis lo re'i 'tsho rten zhal zas bskyal pa dang gcig dgon gzhung du tshong kha dang za khang / mgron khang / ljongs rgyu dran rten/ sil tshong khang bcas tshugs nas rgyal khrims dang khrom ra'i dpal 'byor la bstun pa'i sgo nas bskyangs dang skyong bzhin par yong 'bab kyang mi dman pa 'phar ba dang gnyis/ las snon bzo las kyi phyogs su rang dgon cha rkyen ltar mi dmangs la zhabs phyi dang mang tshogs stabs bde yong ba'i gla ldan thon skyed spel pa la/ shing dpar khang gcig dang / lcags dpar khang(1981lor tshugs) gcig grwa chas las snon/ gter sgrub 'khor bzo/ shing chas las snon/ bod spos sdeb sbyor sogs thun mong dbang ba'i thon skyed rnam pa dang gsum/ spyi phan zhabs phyi'i thad du chos spyod rgyun ldan spel ba'i 'phror phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dad ldan mang tshogs dang ljongs rgyu ltad mo ba'i 'du tshogs rgya che ba dang lha khang 'du khang gtso rigs rang mos mjal skor bgyis pa dang / ltad mo'i sgo shog 'tshong ba/ spro bsang gling kha tshugs pa/ rlangs 'khor skyel 'dren/ 'tshams 'dri mtshams sbyor byed pa sogs kyi byed sgor je legs su 'gro bzhin pa dang bzhi/ bya thabs 'di dag la brten pa'i rang gso'i yong 'bab nges can thob/ 1997lor dgon pa nyid kyis sprad pa'i bsdoms grangs ltar na/ — thon skyed dang zhabs phyi sna tshogs pa spel pa'i yongs 'bab(1996lo'i rtsis 'khod)shog sgor1 127 20 0longs pa la/ 'gro gron shog sgor1 12 2 70 0yin te/ lhag 'phro shog sgor chig khri sum stong drug brgya tsam las med par gsungs/des na lo du ma'i phyi bsgrags rtsis grangs la gzhigs tshe/ dgon pa'i thon skyed rgya skyed gtong ba dang las sgo gsar 'byed kyi phyogs 'gro song brgya cha lnga bcu yan zin pa dang / chos lugs byed sgo dang gtsug lag zhig gso/ rten gtso gsar bzhengs bcas su brgya cha nyi shu tsam gtong / de min mgron bsu dang spyi tshogs phan bde/ rgyun ldan gzhung las la sogs kyi thad du 'gro gron brgya cha nyi shu tsam yin par 'dod de/ da dung mu mthud legs bcos dang 'thus tshang gtong gal che ba dang / dad ldan dang ljongs rgyu ba sngar las lhag tu 'du bar zhabs phyi'i spus tshad dang nyams 'gyur/ ngo sprod dang gtsang spra/ bde srung dang do dam bcas kyi phyogs su thugs sems las tshegs thon dgos la/ gan lho ma zad bod yul kun la mig dpe rang bzhin mtshon pa'i gnad shin tu che/ dgon par da snga bla grwa rgyun bzhugs kyi grangs mang na'ang 'tsho ba khag theg yin te/ gtso bo ni gong du bshad pa'i rang khyim zhal zas 'dod sprod dang / de'i khar dgon pa spyi'i chos spyod kho na nyin brgya dang so bdun(rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon nyin2 0 5yin)yod de ha lam nyin gnyis re'i nang rgyun ldan chos spyod 'tshogs pa la/ lo rer shog sgor nyis stong gi 'tsho ba'i kha gsab dang / da dung rang rang grwa tshang du rgyun ldan ma yin pa'i phogs 'gyed dang zhag thebs sogs yod gshis/ gnas skabs dkon mchog gi sku drin dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyi mtshod bkur las bla grwa thun mong gi 'tsho ba ni yul gru gzhan las legs bcos byung ba — 78 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yin no/ /4 zur tshugs slob grwa dang de'i slob gnyer 'phel rgyas/kun su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa zhes pa ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dbus su btab ste gan su'u zhing chen gyi sa khul rim pa'i rgyal tshugs bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwa yin/ nang bstan slob grwa 'di tshugs pa'i lo ngo bcu phrag tsam gyi ring la kun lho khul gyi rdzong dang grong khyer dang su'u nan dang dpa' ris sogs kyi mdo sngags chos sde mang bor bu slob mi nyung ba skyed sring bgyis stabs/ dgon pa de dag gi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum la phan pa rgya cher thogs pa dang / dgon sde so so'i slob gnyer dang chos spyod/ do dam bcas kyi phyogs su mig dpe mang bo bzhag pas deng phyin bod brgyud nang bstan ji ltar gong du 'phel ba'i phyogs su nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa 'byung nges red/gcig 'debs tshul dang 'dzugs skrun/198 2lo'i zla bcu gcig lar krung gung gan su'u zhing chen tang us mchan 'god bka' lan gnang nas gan su'u zhing chen mang bstan slob grwa 'dzugs par mos mthun byung zhing zhing chen chos lugs las don cus kyis mgo khrid byed pa'i las don sgrig lugs su gtogs / shing byi lo'i zla lnga bar zhing chen tang u'i rgyun u gros tshogs thengs bcu gsum pa'i steng nas kun su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa ni sa khul rim pa'i slob gnyer las khungs su gtan la phab cing mgo khrid tshad khag bskos te las khungs mgo 'dren pa 'thus tshang du btang / de phyin rim bzhin zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u dang / chos lugs cus/ nor srid thin/ 'char gong u yon lhan khang / slob gso u yon lhan khang / 'phrod bsten thin/ mi don dang sgrig gzhi u yon lhan khang / zhing chen ched las go gnas sgyur bcos khang sogs 'brel yod sde khag dang / kun lho khul dang bsang chu rdzong gi tang srid 'go khrid rnam pa'i dbu khrid rgyab skyor gnang bar brten te/ slob grwa'i sgrig gzhi dang / mi sna/ gron nom/ dge rgan go ming / dge rgan bsko mngag rtsig las 'dzugs skrun sogs kyi bya ba hur thag tu spel bas yun thung nang slob gling gi sdod khang dang / sgrig chas/ dge slob bcas kyi rtsa ba'i rtsa 'dzugs grub shing glang lo'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin mor nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i bod brgyud bstan pa deng rabs slob grwa'i rnam pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gnas gcig tu rgyal khab kyis 'dzugs gnyer 'og spel ba'i gling mchog thog mar tshugs nas mdo sngags rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i 'jings su dam chos nor bu'i bang mdzod len pa'i skal ba bzang bo mchog tu rnyed do/ /phyi lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis te lugs rnying zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin 'phags mchog ston pa shākya thub pa bla med sangs rgyas nyid kyis bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo thog mar bskor bar mdzad pa'i nyin mo rjes su dran nas bstan pa'i slob gling gi slob gnyer mdzad sgo rgya chen po spel ba la/ slob gtso kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa blo bzang 'jigs — 79 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang / khri chen gung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug co ne mkhan po lwang don grub/ khro'u ron hwa/ sngo kho zur zhi tshang / bla ma rab bstan rgya mtsho bzhi ba/ nyang tshang bcas slob gtso dang spyi gnyer kru'u ren skal bzang shes rab sogs lhan 'dzoms dang / krung dbyang dang / kun lho khul gyi tang srid 'go khrid/ bod ljongs dang nang sog mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ sde dge la sogs 'brel yod sde khag gi mi sna dang sku tshab sum brgya lhag gdan zhus ji bzhin du phebs 'byor byung / slob grwa grub ston gyi mdzad sgo de sbrang char sil ma'i bdud rtsi 'jo ba'i ngang bkra shis bde legs kyi rtags mtshan du ma dang bcas grub par gyur/ lo bcu'i ring gi dka' spyad 'bad brtson la brten nas slob gling gi ga'is khyon rgya bskyed cing slob sgrub cha rkyen legs bcos su btang / dge rgan gyi dpung khag je bzang du tshugs pa dang sgrig gnyer lam lugs 'thus tshang / slob sbyong gi nang don dang slob ma'i 'tsho rten khag theg byung / slob grwa spyi'i bstan don 'phrin las bde blag thugs mnyes kyi ngang la 'phel/ da skabs dge rgan dang las bzo ba nyer brgyad yod 'di'i gras su mtho rim slob grwa'i yon tshad dge rgan bcu bzhi dang / 'bring rim yon tshad dge rgan gsum /srid 'dzin las byed pa bzhi/ bzo ba bzhi/ khyad par du bkra shis 'khyil sogs dgon sde nas dam chos byang chub cing slob khrid nyams myong ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu khyad du gdan drangs nas mtshan nyid dang lam rim sogs zab chos dang rig gnas kyi phyag las rlabs chen gnang bzhin yod de/ da lta'i slob ma brgya phrag gcig 'dzin grwa bzhi la bgos te dam chos bdud rtsis thugs tshim par mdzad ba'in mchis/ gong gsal dge rgan gyi gras su dus rgyun dpe khrid gnang mkhan la dam chos dge rgan bcu gnyis dang / rgya'i skad yigabod kyi skad yig chab srid sogs la dge rgan brgyad yod/ ched las go gnas su rgyal khab kyi dpyad 'dems lam lugs ltar thob pa dge rgan chen mo ba gnyis dang / dge rgan chen mo gzhon pa gsum/ shar khrid dge rgan bzhi/ gzhan dag kyang ched gnyer slob ma che ba'i rigs yin no/ /slob grwar bskyar bzhengs sam legs bcos byas pa'i rtsig bkod kyi rigs la lha khang gnyis thog can dang /dpe mdzod khang / 'du khang / tshogs khang (bsod grags tshang tshoms chen)/ sbyang 'bras bsham ston khang bcas dang / gsar du bzhengs pa la slob khang bzhi/ slob ma'i sdod khang / dge rgan phyag las khang /srid 'dzin gzhung las khang / tshogs 'du khang / mdzod khang / mgron khang / slob gtso rnam pa'i gzhung las khang / rung khang / dpe tshong khang / rlangs 'khor khang / las bzo ba'i bza' mi sdod khang / skyed tshal la sogs du mas gzhis khyon smi lham pa nyis khri lhag du grub pa las/ bkra shis 'khyil spyi'i gtsug lag 'dzugs skrun dang dgon pa'i rnam pa legs 'grub la mdzes sdug gsar ba bsnan pa ma zad/ lha khang gi rten bzhugs la sman 'dam las grub pa'i thub pa gtso 'khor gsum/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang ga sogs dang / dpe mdzod du shing dpar bka' bstan gtsos pota stong phrag lcags dpar rgya yig bka' 'gyur dang / gzhan rig gnas/ lo rgyus/ sa khams/ dngos khams/ spyi tshogs tshan rigs la sogs 'dus — 80 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa khri phrag bcu lhag 'dzoms/ dgon pa'i grwa mang gi slob gnyer dang sgrig lam/ kun spyod/ gtsang sbra bcas kyi phyogs la shugs rkyen gang bzang thebs bzhin pa dang / spyi gnyer mkho sgrub kyi bya ba'i do dam shugs bsnan cing gron chung sgos slob khrid dang dge slob la zhabs phyi sgrub pa dang / ma dngul mkho sprod/ slob ma'i zhal bzhes/ nor srid do dam bcas gal bo che gsum gtsigs su bzung / da skabs slob ma mi rer lo hril bor gron nom sgor bdun brgya gtan la phab kyang rkyen dbang gis dngos su 'gro gron sgor sum stong mkho ste chad grangs khri nyer gsum longs/ 'go khrid rnam pas gron chung dang thabs lam sna tshogs nas 'tsho ba'i kha snon thabs byas so/ /lhag par slob grwa nyid kyi slob deb bcos sgrig gi thad du 'phel rgyas byung ba ni/ 'dzin grwa so so'i mkho gal dang slob khrid kyi bkod sgrig ltar bkra shis 'khyil nas bstan gzhung dang de dag tu nyer mkho'i 'grel ba zur gzigs bcas mdo sngags gang ci'i dpe tshogs bsgrugs pa'i khar/ da dung zhal 'don phyogs bsgrigs dang / sdom gsum bsngo bgrang / lam sgron/ lo gyon ma'i sgo nas sman sdeb tshul/ thig rtsa/ bod yig dbu can dbu med kyi yi ge'i thig rtsa sogs bsgrigs nas bkrams pa dang / mi rigs srid jus dang mi rigs gnad don skor gyi rtsa ba'i shes bya/ chos lugs kyi do dam dang bca' khrims rgyun shes/ rgya'i skad yig deb dang po nas brgyad pa bar/ ljags rtsom 'bri tshul/ bod skad phreng rtsis man ngag krung gung tang gi lo rgyus/krung go'i gsar brje'i lo rgyus/ 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus sogs sgyur sgrig byas/ da dung chab srid bsam blo'i slob gso shugs snon par rang rgyal da snga bstar bzhin pa'i khrims lugs las chos lugs 'brel yod don tshan bdams bsgrigs/ nang bstan tshogs pa do dam byed pa'i sgrig srol lam lugs/ rang rgyal gyi chos lugs dang de'i srid jus kyi skor/ slob gso'am slob khrid la mkho ba'i dpe cha 'dang ba grub ste slob grwa'i dge rgan/ sdod khang / slob deb/ 'tsho rten bcas phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /gnyis/ slob gnyer dang grub 'bras/1987lo nas bzung slob gling gis dan su'u zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i gnas tshul dngos dang slob ma'i yong khungs la gzhigs nas/ slob grwa u yon lhan khang gi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i steng gros bsdur bgyis shing zhing chen chos lugs cus kyi 'thad pa byung ste slob yun lo drug de lo bzhir bsgyur/lo der〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob gling gi lo bzhi'i lam lugs kyi slob khrid 'char gzhi〉bskyar bcos byas shing / zhing chen chos lugs cus kyis chog mchan bkod de dngos su lag len byas/ 'char gzhi'i nang du slob ma'i chu tshad dang 'ing chen nang khul gyi bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dgos mkho ltar du lo rer mtshan nyid 'dzin grwa dang lo rer rgyud lugs 'dzin grwa res mos su bsdus shing / de la nges par du sbyong dgos pa'i slob tshan nang bstan dang / 'dem sbyong slob tshan gsum bcas bkod sgrig byas/ yang bye brag tu ched las dngos sbyong dang / rig gzhung 'chad khrid/ thon skyed ngal rtsol/ tshan rig zhib 'jug spyi tshogs — 81 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rtsad zhib bcas kyang slob khrid 'char gzhir brtsis te gnas tshul ngo mar mthun pa bkod sgrig byas stabs/chos lugs dang rig gnas/ chab srid gsum gyi slob thun gyi bsdur tshad ngos ni7 2 1 bcas yin/de bzhin slob gso dang slob khrid kyi bya ba'i phyogs su slob mgor 'char gzhi 'dzin pa dang / slob dkyil spus tshad 'dzin pa/ slob mjug dpyad zhib 'dzin pa bcas kyi bkod sgrig lag bstar mgo mjug bar gsum du rgyun 'khyongs te/ dge rgan so sor dpe khrid kyi las 'gan bzhag pa ltar dmigs 'ben dang / las 'gan/bya thabs bcas gtan la phab cing
