slob dpyod kyi bya sgo gang legs su spel/ de ni slob khrid kyi slob ston khru'u dang slob dpyad tshan chung / dge rgan dang 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin bcas las tshugs/ slob khrid bya thabs la dpe khrid dang rang sbyong / blo 'dzin/ rtsod pa dang dngos sbyong gtso bo bzung / khrid gzhi gtso bo ni mtshan nyid dang lam rim yin la/ des slob khrid dus tshod kyi brgya cha'i bdun cu zin 'dug rig gnas slob tshan ni gtso bo bod kyi skad yig dang rgya'i skad yig gnyis yin te/ slob khrid dus tshod kyi brgya cha'i nyi shu zin 'dugadaper na/ mtshan nyid 'dzin grwas lo bzhi bo'i ring rnam 'grel dang phar phyin/ dbu ma bcas skabs bstun rdzogs rgyu dang / lam rim 'dzin gas lam rim chen mo dang spyod 'jug sogs las da dung lo rgyus/ chab srid/ rig gnas sogs sna mang khrid bzhin yod de 'dzin grwa re res bslab gzhi nyer dgu dngos su bslabs dgos/dngos sbyong dang rtsod par grub 'bras bzang bo thob pas/ slob ma'i slob sbyong byed pa'i gshis spyod je bzang je bzang du gyur/ slob mas dus thun gyi dpe khrid 'char gzhi ltar nan tan gyis slob sbyong byas pa ma zad/ slob gseng du rang sbyong shugs bsnan te gza' nyi ma las khrom srang du mi 'gro bar blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis slob sbyong byed pa'i goms srol bzang bo chags/ dngos sbyong gi bya ba ni slob tshan gyi dngos sbyong dang mthar phyin gyi dngos sbyong gnyis su phye / slob tshan gyi dngos sbyong zhes pa ni slob ma rtsa 'dzugs byas nas dmigs ldan sgos bla brang dgon pa'i chos grwa dang chos kyi dus chen gyi byed sgor zhugs/ de ni slob ma tsho mtshan nyid gzhung rtsod par 'brel thabs la byang ba dang / gzhung lugs de chos kyi cho ga la 'brel ba/ bslabs zin pa'i gzhung lugs de lag len gyi nang du bkol pa'i nus pa je mthor gtong thabs yin/ dngos sbyong 'di rigs lo rer thengs brgyad bkod sgrig byas pa bsdoms na nyin grangs sum cu yas mas yod/ 1994lo nas bzung mthar phyin slob ma rnams bla brang dgon pa dang a mchog dgon pa shis tshang dgon pa la sogs kyi nang du phebs te rtsod pa sogs kyi dngos sbyong 'grims te mthar phyin ched rtsom 'bri bar brjod gzhi gal chen thon/ slob grwa nas thob pa'i yon tan dag lag len gyi nang du bkol thub/ yang lo re bzhin mthar phyin slob ma rtsa 'dzugs byas nas bod ljongs sogs su dngos sbyong lta skor du thengs gnyis rer 'gro ba rgyun 'khyongs pas/ paṇa chen sku phreng lnga ba nas dgu ba'i bar gyi sku gdung mchod rten dang pho brang po tā la bcu ba'i sku gdung mchod rten gyi lha khang / grong khyer lha sa'i rnam pa dang bzo grwa slob grwa sogs/ da dung rang zhing grong khyer lan kru'u bzo gter — 82 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khe las dang slob grwa chen mo sogs la lta skor bgyis pa la slob ma'i bsam blo la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste bsam pa'i 'char sgo je gsal dang / shes rgya dang mthong rgya je cher song lo bcu lhag gi ring la/ slob grwa nan gyis bskyangs pas grub 'bras phun sum tshogs pa thob/ da lta'i bar du zhing chen yongs kyi bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa gya brgyad kyi nang nas bsdoms pas slob ma 290bsdus/ slob dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i phar phyin rgyas pa bla ma'i gsung rgyun bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba dang / mthar phyin slob ma dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang skal bzang blo gsal sogs kyi ched rtsom dpar du bskrun/ thengs bdun la slob ma181mthar phyin te dgon pa nga drug tu byin/ mthar phyin slob ma brgya cha'i bcu ni dgon pa de dag gi dam chos srog shing dang / kha shas bla sprul 'ga'i dge rgan du bskos/ la las dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi las 'gan bzhes/ la las chos lugs dang rig gnas kyi dge rgan byas/ la la ni yang sprul du ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan khrir bkod/ yang slob grwa chags yul dang slob sgrub grub 'bras nyams myong gi dbang gis/ nye char rgyal khab dang sa gnas nyi shu lhag gam/ rgyal nang gi zhing chen dang grong khyer/ rang skyong ljongs nyer brgyad kyi mtshams 'dri/ rtog zhib/ brten mjal ba bcas mi sum stong lhag sne len byas dang byed bzhin mchis/ chos phyogs mkhas pa snyan grags can rgyal yongs srid gros kyi rgyun las u yo/na nam krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa chos dpon men dbyang dang / rgyal yongs srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon nam sku 'bum dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin akyā rin po che/ krung go bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi yon krang gzhon pa mchod gshis rin po che sogs gzigs rtog tu phebs nas slob ma rnams la rig gzhung dang sgrub sbyong / slob gnyer phyogs kyi bka' gsung gal chen gnang ba dang / slob ma rnams kyis rgyal gces chos gces dang sgrig brtsi khrims srung / 'dul khrims gtan 'khyong /slob sbyong hur brtson bcas kyi sgo nas bstan pa la phyag rjes 'jog pa'i blo sgo che cher phye/ dad ldan mi ser gyi nan zhus dang slob gling nyid kyi nye 'khor du slob glags bstun bzhin rim gro ci thub bsgrub par bya/ da dung gza' mjug dang dus chen/ gung gseng spyad nas rgyal gces kyi glog brnyan nas brnyan 'phrin bstan pa dang /phin phang spo lo/ bya sgro'i spo lo/ thag 'then sogs lus rtsal 'gran bsdur/ mi rigs dang chos lugs/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs shes bya'i 'gran bsdur bcas spel bas/ slob ma'i slob sbyong la yar skul thob cing slob grwa'i ra bar spro skyid khengs pa dang / mthun sgril/ yar thon/ 'bad 'bungs/ 'gran rtsod kyi 'du shes yar bskyed byung ba ma zad/ khong tsho'i gshis rgyud je 'jon du gyur to/ /gsum/ byed phyogs dang sgrig lam/krung dbyang gis〈rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs skabs kyi chos lugs gnad don skor gyi gzhi rtsa'i lta tshul dang srid jus〉zhes pa'i nang du chos lugs slob grwa bsgrub pa'i byed phyogs dang las 'gan bcas gtan 'khel gsal bo gnang / nang bstan slob grwa 'dzugs grabs byas pa'i nyin nas bzung / byed phyogs de'i khyab — 83 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/khongs las ma 'das par〈slob ma bsdu ba'i sgrig yiganyidang 〈slob khrid 'char gzhi〉gtan la phab/ slob ma bsdu len gyi sgrig yig tu rgyugs sprod mkhan slob ma ni nges par du‘ mes rgyal la dga' ba/ tang gi 'go khrid dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs brtsi srung / chos la dad mos che ba/ blo kha brtan pos bstan don skyong 'dod mkhan zhig yin dgos zhes pa'i byed phyogs bton/ de ba'in slob bsgrub byed phyogs dang /skyed sring dmigs 'ben bcas gang nus kyis dril sgrog byas nas/ zhing chen yongs kyi bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa so sos chos la dad pa brtan po yod cing spyod lam rnam par dag pa/ rgyal gces chos gces byed pa/skyed sring gi mdun lam yod pa'i grwa ba na chung mtshams sbyor byas shing / rgyugs sprod par mngag rgyu'i re ba bton pa ltar/ rgyugs len pa dang slob ma bsdu len byed skabs/ rgyugs sprod mkhan slob ma'i chab srid bsam blo'i 'gag sgo nan gyis bzung zhing / rgyugs 'phrod pa'i slob ma slob grwar ma zhugs gong nas mtshams sbyor bya mkhan dgon pa'i do dam khang dang 〈〈sgrig brtsi khrims srung dang / dgon gang nas phebs pa phyir rang dgon du phebs dgos〉zhes pa gros mthun gan rgya bkod/ slob ma slob grwar zhugs nyin nas slob thog slob gso dang / rgyun srol gyi do dam/ slob gso dang dpe khrid/ mthar phyin nam dngos sbyong sogs kyi bya ba thog mtha' bar gsum du dam 'dzin byas/ slob mar dge 'dun pa'i 'dul khrims ji bzhin bsrung dgos pa'i blang bya bstan pa dang mnyam du nyams myong phyogs sdom dang mu mthud du lam lugs sna tshogs pa bskyar bcos dang / 'thus tshang / tshad ldan du bsgyur la gtsigs su bzung nas snga phyis su/ 〈〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i gi dge rgan dang las bzo ba'i kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi〉don tshan lnga can dang / 〈〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i sgrig srol lam lugs sna kha bco lnga〉don tshan nga gnyis can/ 〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i btsun pa slob ma'i bya dga'am chad gcod kyi lam lugs〉don tshan bcu gsum can/〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i 'dzin grwa bdag skyong ba'i las 'gan〉don tshan dgu can/ 〈〈kan su'u zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i btsun pa slob ma'i dngos sbyong skabs kyi bsrung bya〉don tshan brgyad can sogs sgrig srol lugs gtan la phab pa ma zad/ da dung slob grwa'i las sgrub kyi tshan khag so so'ang rang rang gi bya ba'i khyab khongs ltar 'gan khur gtan la phab cing rim pa ltar bya ba'i dmigs 'ben gyi 'gan khur lam lugs lag bstar bgyis/ sgrig srol lam lugs 'di dag gtan la phab cing 'thus tshang btang bas do dam ni slob sbyong dang bya ba/ 'tsho ba sogs phyogs so so ma zin sa med pa byung 'ing bya ba sna tshogs bde blag dang go rim ldan pa'i ngang bgyi bar brten rung ba'i lam lugs gtan khel thub/ gtan la phab pa'i lam lugs sna tshogs dngos su lag len mthar phyin byed ched slob grwa'i 'go khrid pas dbu bzung nas rang dpe gzhan ston gyis dge rgan dang las bzo ba yongs la sgrig lam nan gyis brtsis nas slob mar mig dpe ston dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ dngos su bya ba sgrub pa'i go rim du 'go khrid kyis slob don khru'u bzung ba dang / slob don khru'u yis 'dzin grwa bdag skyong dang / 'dzin grwa bdag skyong bas slob ma bcas rim pas rim par dam 'dzin dang — 84 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bya ba dngos 'bab byas/ 'go khrid bcas gong 'og bar gsum tshang mas nan tan gyi sgo nas sgrig srol lam lugs sna tshogs lag bstar bgyis pas/ slob khrid kyi bya ba de rgyal khab kyi chos lugs slob grwa bsgrub pa'i kha phyogs ltar lam lugs can dang tshad ldan can/ tshan rig can gyi do dam gyi lam du zhugs thub pa'i re ba rlabs po che mchis so/ /zur lta'i yig rigs la/1 yul mdo smad kyi ljongs su thub bstan rin po che ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar brjod pa deb thar rgya mtsho/ 2 dpa' ris dam chos kyi bla brang dgon pa'i lo rgyus bsdus don(rgya yig)/ 2 la'o h+pha zhi sogs bzhis bsgrigs pa'i bla brang dgon pa'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus(rgya yig)/ 4 klu tshang rdor phrug gi bla brang dgon pa dang a blo tshang gi gdung rgyud(bod yig 'gyur ma/) 5 dbang rgyal gyi kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang khong gi bkra shis 'khyil pa'i lo rgyus mdo tsam gleng ba(bod yig)/ 6 bla brang dgon pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus(1989lor dgon pa rang gis bris pa)/ 7 'brug thar gyi kun su'u bod kyi shog pa'i spyi tshogs dang lo rgyus zhib 'jug(rgya yig)/ / smon lam rgya mtsho'i dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling (bod yig)/ 9 lbang con dbyin dang khrin pin hin gyis bsgrigs pa'i kun lho'i lo rgyus yig rigs dpe tshogs las bla brang skor(rgya yig)/ 10 bla brang dgon pa bcas pas bsgrig pa'i 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku phreng lnga'i rnam par thar ba mdor bsdus su bkod pa(bod rgya shan sbyar)sogs so/ /bla brang gnas chung btsan khang /bla brang gnas chung btsan khang zhes pa ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nub logs lha zhol bsang chu dal gyi 'bab pa'i nye 'gram du bzhengs pa la/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras sku phreng gis bka' bsgos gnyer du gtad pa'i chos skyong yin pa ma zad/ chos bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag la bu bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong chen po zhig yin/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen pos gnas chung dang tse'u dmar gnyis kyi gsar mchod mdzad/ der bstun spyi sger gyi 'phrin bcol gang dran mdzad de 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i mtshan ma ngoms/ lcags rta1920lor kun mkhyen lnga ba rje btsun blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gnas chung btsan khang du phebs te 'phrin bcol gzab rgyas mdzad/ be har lcog tu rnam dag smon lam ma dal bas tshar gsum mdzad cing sgron dar phul te thugs smon gang rgyas gnang / gling mchog sprul skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho sogs bla sprul mang bos 'gag med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs steng nas gnas chung la gzab gsol gtong bcug skyabs mgon sku phreng gis lo re bzhin gnam lo gsar tshes kyi lha tshes 'char can dang / hor zla dang po'i bcu bzhir gtor rgyag skabs su chos skyong 'phrin las spyan drangs — 85 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/nas 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel ba'i sdongs grogs tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' bsgos/ 195rngalo'i rjes su btsan khang 'jig rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu bya1992lor kun mkhyen drug pa rje blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma'i thugs bzhed ltar/ gnas chung btsan khang rten dang brten par bcas bskyar du bzhengs te gser khri mkhan sprul rgyud smad grwa tshang bcas nas rab gnas mdzad do/ /ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling /ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin ni da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi ho'u rgya zhang ste bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i g.yon gyi lung bar chags/ khri chen gung thang sprul ba'i sku rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing phag1755lor btab/ chu med par khron pa bton/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i lha grangs su bcad/ tshogs 'don du bde mchog bdag 'jug gsang 'jigs mi 'khrugs pa bcas kyi cho ga bde lam/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ gso sbyong la sdom pa gsum ma'i phyir bcos 'don rgyun tshugs/khong nyid kyang dgung lo so gsum gyi bar du thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i nyams bzhes lhur mdzad pa'i zhar la spong ba pa rnams las gtsos chos kyi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba la dbang lung rjes gnang sogs gang mos kyi chos 'khor rgya chen bskor bar mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes ri khrod kyi 'du khang nas bka' chos nyan mkhan mang bo la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs gnang / dge 'dun pa rnams la gsung bkod rim par bstsal te rang rang gi blor 'tshams pa'i zhal ta'i sgo nas nyams len thun bzhi'am drug bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bsnyen pa/ smyung gnas/ phyag mchod/ maṇ+ḍal sogs bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i dge sbyor dbyar gyi dpal la 'gran/ 'du khang gsar bzhengs dang rten bsgrugs/ bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhugs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bzhengs/ lung ston byams pa'i khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa grub/ rje nyid las/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bum phrag spro ba yi/ /byams mgon nyin byed dbang bo'i zhal mthong zhing / /legs gsung gser zhun 'od bzang khu ba'i rgyun/ /dad pa'i snyim pas rtag tu 'thung bar shog/ ces gsungs pa dang zhing mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin du skye ba'i smon lam gyi lung sogs bstsal/ mdun ri la skyed shing btsugs pa dang ri khrod du rta nor bcu dang mdzo mo bcu phrag bskyangs/sgrub shag so so'i zhig ral bcos shing sa dkar byug bca' yig yang dag sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba zur 'debs dang bcas pa bzhag ste sku phreng rim pas bskyangs/ phyis su bu slob dbal mang paṇ+ḍi tas gzim khang bskrun te ri khrod skyong khur gnang / 'jam dbyangs bla ma mtshan can gyis gdung mchod dang mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu ba'i gos sku mchod pa'i srol yang btsugs/ de yang mdo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i mang thos tshul ldan gyi drang srong spang ba ba'i bsti gnas mchog gi dbus su bla ma he ru ka dpal kun mkhyen bzhi ba — 86 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/stobs rgyas dbang bos sgrol ma'i ri rtse nas sgrol ma'i lha gsol rlung bskyed sogs bton/ gzim khang bsam grub rtse bskrun te srung ma tshangs pa bsten/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis 'du khang du tshe sgrub kyi bum pa rten bzhugs/kun mkhyen la phul/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi bdag 'jug blangs/ ri khrod pa rnams la dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i klog lung dang ser skya mang tsam la 'pho lung bstsal/ bsgrub la rtag gus brtson pa'i the bo'i zhabs drung ri khrod nas gshegs tshul ngo mtshar gleng / khyad par du 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje btsun bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang po lan du mar phebs te thugs rje bdag gir mdzad/ gnas brtan sbyin pa dag gis zhus te tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyis smon tshig mdzad pa'i nang du/ nam 'ig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/ /mgon khyod byin rlabs lcags kyus nyer drangs nas/ /lha brgya'i mdun sa yid dga' chos 'dzin du/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs su skye bar shog/ ces gsungs/ 'du khang dbus su bzhugs pa la byams pa bdud rtsi 'bebs pa/ gung thang gsum pa'i tsan dan 'dra sku/ dpal ldan a ti sha dang / tsong kha brgyad cu/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing sogs zhal thang byin can mang bo/ rje yab sras dang kun mkhyen yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum mang bo/ dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma'i lus rten mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku/ zhang ston pa'i gdung rten sogs lha rten chos gsum du ma/ bka' 'gyur ma ṇi bcas bzhugs so/ /chos spyod kyi rim pa la'ang smon lam rigs grwa dgon chen du phebs/ rgyud smad ltar gyi phyag len dngos gtsang tshugs pa'i bde 'jigs gnyis kyi sgrub chod/ gsang 'dus mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga ri khrod kyi srung ma srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i dus ston sogs dka' gdams pa'i srol rkang tshugs par mdzad/ kun mkhyen dang / gung thang tshang / dbal mang bcas pa'i gzim khang / grwa shag nyi shu dang grwa ba nyer gcig rab rgyal sa khyi lor yod cing / de'i rjes su chag 'jig byung / rgyab yol sde ba ni 'di'i mchod gzhis lha sde yin la/ rgyab yol brag dmar man chad/ glang chen sna zhags yan chad sde 'di'i sa nags yin ces bshad/deng skabs dge slong skal bzang bstan pa gtsos pa'i btsun bgres bzhi tsam bzhugs te spyi khang bskrun/ ri khrod kyi byin rten mkhar rnga rang grags dang / srung ma re ma ti'i rten thang / 'don chos skor gyi gsung thor bu 'ga' zhig lus/ me pho glang lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin skyabs rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku rin po che phyag phebs te ri khrod nyams gso ma/dzad rgyu'i thugs 'dun gnang ngo / /ri khrod bkra shis chos gling /ri khrod bkra shis chos gling zhes pa kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong spo'u rgya zhang gi khongs su gtogs la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nye logs nub phyogs brag zur gsum zhes pa mdzes shing mtho la nags tshal gyis rnam par spud pa'i gnas su chags/— 87 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/deb thar rgya mtsho ltar na/ sa dkar yar kha'i glas drug ngos nas 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i gdung zhu sbyong bgyis/ de'i shul du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku brnyan mang bo gzungs gzhug can gyi mchod rten bzhengs/dpon bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi sras dge ldan bsam grub kyi gdung yang der bzhug par de'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gnas der ri khrod 'di nyid btab/ dang thog sbyin pa rag cho zer ba bzhugs pas ma tshugs dgon du phebs nas chos grwar 'grims/ phyis su sde khri rin po ches spong ba ba re gnyis sdod pa'i ri khrod cig yod na bzang bar dgongs bzhin dpon bkra shis 'byung gnas las bslangs te ho'u rgyar gzim khang brgyab/ de nas grub pa dung sna can du grags pa lta ba sa skya ba'i grub mtha' phyogs mtshungs shing / spyod pa ngo ma tshar can de nyid kyis sgom khang bskrun te/ kun mkhyen dang sde khri sogs spyan drangs te byin rlabs mdzad/ grub dbang sde khri gsum pa dang gung ru dpal mo'i zhabs la gtugs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi las sna tshogs dang yid dam sgrub skor gsan pa rgya che/ grub pa'i rtags mtshan khyad par can bzhag pa'i lo rgyus bshad tshul mang /kha gya'i bla ma 'gyang ro chung ba 'jam dpal bstan pa'i sgron me mchog sprul ngos 'dzin pa'i bla ma mdzad/ khyad par du rgan gya'i brag dkar gyi 'brong ri rtse dang / gnas 'di nas sgrub khang bzung nas dge sbyong brtson pas nyams rtogs skyes/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar bde mchog gi sku bshams shing mchod pa phul te/ 'khor lo bde mchog pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo'i ngang nas chos dbyings su gshegs/ sku dmar gdung ho'u rgya'i sgom khang gi nang rten gtso bo byas/ der yang srid blus pa skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho mda' smad du yum rta mgrin skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ skyabs mgon mchog gis ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar 'khod/ ri khrod rang dang rwa rgas ri khrod du yid dam du ma'i bsnyen sgrub dang / sgo me dgon pa sogs kyi khri mdzad/ mthar 1921lor sku 'das/ de'i sprul sku skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho rgan gya'i gung ru tshang gi nye 'khor yab 'phags pa dang yum lha mo thar gyi sras su 'khrungs/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang phyin gdan sar 'khod/bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te snang ra'i rgya mtsho dge rgan bsten nas slob gnyer gnang / 1956lor khong 'ja' lus mkha' spyod du 'grim 'dod ces bsnyung med zhi bar 'phrin las bsdus so/ /gling sprul sku dkon mchog dgyes pa'i blo gros mchog gis gnas 'di nas sgom sgrub mdzad de gnas bdag gi zhal gzigs zer/ he ru ka dpal rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug phebs te grub dbang dung sna ba'i gdung mdun nas kyai rdor smon lam dang / yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ sham bha la'i smon lam gsungs/gnas 'di sngon sa gnyan gang ci'i slad gter dang yul khrus byas phyir yul lha dgyes pa'i rtags mtshan byung /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas zhes bsngags shing gnas bstod zhig brtsams skad/ bstan dang bstan 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs brtan du dmigs te 'di ga'i shing sdong mi gcod pa'i bka' khyab mdzad/ bde mchog lca i ba'i bdag 'jug dang / lha mo rig byed ma'i bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor bcas gnad du 'gro ba gsungs/ ri khrod srung ma zhing skyong bdud mgon seng zhal can bsten/ gzim khang gsar skrun bgyis/ kun mkhyen sku — 88 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/phreng snga phyi lan du mar phebs nas bzhugs/ sde khri sku phreng snga phyi dag gis ri khrod 'dzin bdag gnang ste 'du khang bskrun/ nang rten gtso bo bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi li sku che legs/ gnas brtan bcu drugaltung bshags lha so lnga sogs li sku mang bo bzhugs/ rgyud smad ltar gyi cho ga phyag len sgrub mchod sogs tshugs/'dul 'dzin pa chos bzang gnas brtan gtsos kun spang ba mi nyung ba bzhugs/ zla rer dus bzang nyin tshogs gsum re dang smon lam rigs grwa dgon chen du phebs/ ri khrod gnyer bas phyugs zog nags tshal don dam byas te 'tsho 'gan bzhes/ 1kha58lo'i rjes su 'du khang rten brten par chag 'jig shor/ rten gtso grub pa dung sna'i sku gdung dbu skra skyes pa skyon cung thebs kyang gling sprul bzhi pas nyams gso mdzad rjes bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang du bzhugs kyang / 'du khang me skyon thebs skabs 'jig pa dang / da lta mthong thos ltar na ri khrod slar gso bya ba'i sta gon bgyi bzhin par gleng ngo / /ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel gling /ri khrod gong ma bkra shis dge 'phel gling zhes pa ni da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bas nga chu rdzong gi chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i g.yas kyi lung ba'i yar zur du chags/gnas 'dir grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sgrub gnas yod la/ der skyabs mgon bar ma dgung lo so bzhi ba lcags sprul lor sgrub sde btab/ sgrig lam kun spyod 'gangs che ba dag ni rje tsong kha ba rin po ches mdzad pa'i byams pa gling gi bca' yig gzhir bzhag la dmigs gsal kha skong bcas pa'i bca' khrims bkod/mang thos 'dul 'dzin pa rin chen chos bzang gnas brtan du bskos/ ri khrod btsun pa gnas brtan bcu drug ltar grangs bcad/ rten 'brel du dgongs nas ri khrod pa so sor gnas re re'i ming btags mdzad/dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes ri khrod spyi zhus kyi ngor bde mchog lha lnga dang lus dkyil gyi dbang / sgrub mchog gsar du 'dzugs rgyur bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang sogs chos bka' du ma 'dod mos bzhin gnang / mkhan po sidha'i mtshan can gyis thig le bcu drug sgrub rgyun btsugs/ khyad par du kun mkhyen bzhi bas bkra shis dge 'phel ri bo'i rtser phyin cing gangs can 'gro mgon rgyal dbang yab sras kyi zhabs brtan dmigs te rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan jo dar bsgrengs pa sogs btsugs/ 'du khang nang rten gtso bo la 'jigs me dbang bo'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma dang / chos skyong beg tse lcam dral/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi bdag 'jug bdun sgrub gsar du btsugs/ mar me stong mchod dang / da dung kun mkhyen bzhi bas dngul srang lnga bcu sbyor 'jags bstsal/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad cing / mkha' spyod ma'i dbang brgya bskur rgyu'i gsung gnang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing bya lo1885la mkha' spyod ma dbang mo'i bdag 'jug gsar tshugs kyi tshogs 'khor bgyis/ bde chen gos dkar gyi sgrub rten mkha' spyod ma'i zhal thang bi re chi dkon mchog pa byin byung ri khrod du bzhag gsol — 89 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dpon mkhan po blo bzang bstan dar gyis dngul srang lnga bcu sbyor 'jags sgos lo ltar mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug chag med dar/ da dung kun mkhyen bzhi bas mkha' spyod ma'i bstod pa dang gnas bstod brtsams/sgom khang gong ma nas thugs rje chen po'i las rung btang / kun spong ri khrod pa dag la byang chub bde lam gyi khrid dang mi la'i mgur gyi lung gnang / dge 'phel ri khrod du sgom khang gsar bzo bgyis skabs sbyin bdag two zhin skal bzang dngos grub bkod khyab gnang nas gzhan phan gang 'gyur mdzad pa'i rnam thar rang rnam du snang / grub dbang sde khris gnas 'di nas mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad/ rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang / khong gi thugs zin pa'i slob ma sman lung dge bshes 'jam dbyangs/ skyabs mgon bar ma'i gsung rtsom zhu 'bri ma/khan sman lung smon lam gnyis bkra shis dge 'phel gyi mkha' spyod gur khang du thugs dam ngang sku gshegs/ khyad par du kun mkhyen lnga ba chen po dge 'phel sgrub gnas bde chen 'od gsal khang du phyin te thugs dam 'ba' zhig gnang zhing skyabs mgon sku phreng gis bskyangs/ myur mdzad grub pa'i dbang bo 'dul 'dzin pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa mang du mdzad/ ri khrod pa'i nang nas bcud len dka' spyad dang snying rus tshad du 'dzin pa mang du byung / ri khrod pa rnams la phyugs zog gnyer bas don dam byas pa dang / sa dkar grong du mchod gzhis mi khyim 'ga' yod/ grub gnas kyi brag ngos su grub chu zhes pa rgyun du bab cing rnam 'joms 'bas khrus de 'gro phan che/ dus bzang chos spyod sogs legs/ 1958lo'i rjes su gnas kyi 'du khang dang / gzim khang / sgom khang gong 'og bcas chag 'jig shor/ da lta mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen mtshams mang du song ba'i rdo sbis grags pa zhes pas kun mkhyen mchog la zhus te bka' thob pa bzhin sgom khang chung ngu bskrun/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs sngon gyi rgyun ma chag par spel ba dang / brlag 'phro byin rten 'ga' dang / mkha' spyod ma'i shing sku'i sku brnyan che legs can dag bzhugs/ sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma'i gnas bstod mgur ma las/ dpal bkra shis g.yas 'khyil chos grwa chen po'i/ /g.yas kyi bkra shis bogs chags ri bo chen po/ /dpal bkra shis dge 'phel ming du chags pa/ /don bkra shis bsam gtan 'phel ba'i gnas mchog/ ces gsungs so/ /thar ba rtse ri khrod/thar ba rtse ri khrod ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi spo'u rgya zhang khongs su chags/bla brang dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i rtse mo ni bde mchog rdo rje pho brang yin pa kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung rgyun las 'byung zhing / shing rta lo ste spyi lo 1774lor skyabs mgon bar mas thog mar phying gur phub bzhin gnas 'dir bzhugs te dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas gzim khang brgyab ste thar ba rtse btags/skabs du mar bcad rgya mdzad nas yi dam bde mchog gi zhal dngos su gzigs pa'i lo rgyus brag sgom chos — 90 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'byung du mthong / kun mkhyen gsang rnam du/ grub pa'i zhing mchog dben gnas thar ba rtse/ /zab gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas tshe/ he ru ka dpal rten dang brten pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i snang ba mngon sum gzigs/ /'is gsungs/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas su bsngags shing / mi ser gyis gna' nas da bar bde mchog klad du 'bod pa dang / kun mkhyen sku phreng gsu ma pas thebs ba'ag ste mngon par byang ba'i dus ston dang bstun zhal grangs brgyas smyung gnas chag med du bsrung ba'i rgyun btsugs/ yang kun mkhyen bzhi bas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas dngos grub kyi rdzas sbrang dkar la byas te rdzas bsgrubs/ bde mchog lha lnga'i bdag 'jug dang tshogs 'khor sogs bton pa ma zad/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'jigs mdzad dpa' bo gcig pa'i cho ga'i klog lung bstsal/byams pa'i stod mchod zhig kyang brtsams shing / ril sgrub gnang 'ing sku 'gyed kyang bstar/ 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan gtso rten du bzhugs pa'i lha khang bde chen dga' 'khyil la rten sogs la snyan shal phul te mchod mjal gnang tshul rang rnam du gsal/ da dung thar ba rtser bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bstad de dgra lha'i rlung rta sogs bton/ rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i ri khrod pa rnams la dbyar gnang zla ba gsum la bzhugs ba'i srol dar/ khyad par du kun mkhyen lnga ba rin po che phebs te bla mchod ba rtan bzhugs kyi mgon du mnga' gsol/ da dung thar ba rtse dang tshogs chen nas dmigs brtse ma dung phyur ngag sgrub kyi dge ldan ril bu nyin lnga bsgrub par bya ba'i srol btsugs/ 1928lor kā zi lin mā ka zhi hron zhes pa'i jag tshogs kyi ha'e dmag byon nas dben gnas mer bsnubs kyang sla ra zhig gso rgyas pa mdzad cing khong nyid lan du mar bzhugs/ ri khrod pa zhal grangs bcu tsam dus rgyun bzhugs nas thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i cho ga rgyun 'don dang / dus bzang chos spyod legs par spel/ ha sa badz+ra sku phreng gis 'dzin bdag skyong khur gnang / bod rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i rjes su ri khrod kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams chag gi dbang du song mod/ da lta'ang nye logs dad ldan rnams kyis khang mig gnyis tsam phub ste thugs rje chen po'i zhal thang sogs bzhengs so/ /bla brang gsang chen smin rgyal gling /bla brang gi gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgrub grwa gsang chen smin rgyas gling ni/ gan lho'i bsang chu rdzong bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi yar 'gram du chags/gos dkar lcang lo can gyi rigs sngags 'chang ba'i sde 'di khyab bdag he ru ka dpal rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bos bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags 'brug spyi lo1rnga80lor khong gis snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs phyogs brgyar spel bar gsar 'debs kyi thugs jus mdzad/ me phag lo'i sa zlar sgom thar rin po che zhabs brtan sgrub tu bcug cing rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la bkod khyab — 91 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gnang nas dge bskos dang dbu mdzad/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs las sne bskos pa dang / sngags 'chang ba rnam sa la gzan dkar ram gzan thebs bstsal pa ma zad/ sngags grwa spyi la rten skal rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku bzos grub can dang phyag phur/ gu ru drag po'i zhal thang / phyag sbub sogs gnang ba dang / nor 'dzin rdo rje pho brang nas thog mar tshogs 'tshogs thub/ rje khong nyid kyis sngags mang la bka' brgyad kyi sgrub pa btsugs/ sngags 'chang skyabs los bskul pa ltar slob dpon la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thig ngag rtsom mdzad/ sngags grwa'i rdor slob sogs la khyab 'jug gi bskang 'phrin sgrub tu bcug par sgrub gtor gyi rtse 'dar khri li li byed pa sogs srung ma 'khor ba'i rtags mtshan mang du byung / da dung rje 'di bas seng gdong ma dmar sngon shram ṇa rnams kyis rjes lung sngags mang bo bstsal/ de phyin bla brang rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung nas sngags pa gnyis nas rta mgrin dang seng gdong sgrub thabs kyi lung zhus pa dang /sngags 'chang don gnyer ba 'gas grub dbang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las pa'i mdun nas zhi khro sbrags sgrub sogs khrid skor gsan/ sgom thar rin po ches sngags grwar gu drag gi dbang yang gnang / kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog dwags gsal ri bo rtse lngar phebs skabs sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi sgo nas legs smon rten 'brel bsgrigs par/ kun mkhyen nyid nas deng nas bzung nga dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'bas brtan lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgrub mkhan dang / gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sde 'dir dar rgyas dbyar mtsho bzhin du rim gyis 'byung / gong ma'i spyi khral dang / sa cha'i 'u lag rtswa khral shing khral/dmag dang ra mda' sogs su gtan nas 'gro mi dgos/ sngags grwa'i spyi ba lha sde'i nang nas 'jog rgyu dang spyi ba la sngags pa ltar gyi dmigs bsal yod ces gsungs/ gtor sgrub dang gtor rtsam sogs lha sde shog pa bzhis ster dgos pa'i srol tshugs/ lcags byi1kha0 0lor skyabs mgon mchog nas sngags grwa'i bca' yig mu tig do shal bya ba brtsams/ de bzhin 'dzin grwa las sne rnams bla brang nas bsko ba dang grwa rgyun lha sde shog bzhi'i nang nas phebs chog pa bgyis/de nas rim bzhin rdo grub chen dgon pa'i bla ma 'jigs med mtha' grol gyi klong chen snying thig gi cho ga'i srol bzang bstar te dbyar chos la bka' brgyad dang / ston chos la rdo rje phur bu/ dgun chos la seng gdong / zla ba'i yar mar ngo'i tshes bcur chos thog kha shas tshugs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi lor kun mkhyen lnga ba rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar/sngags rnying grwa tshang gi 'du khang bla brang nas gsar bzhengs grub ste thog mar tshogs par bla brang rang nas mang ja nyin 'khyol dang da yan la rang re'i 'gyed btang thog 'dus tshogs pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin rje khong yang sngags grwa'i chos khrid zhabs sor 'khod cing / mtsho skyes bstan 'bar ma lan gsum gsungs/ khong gis dung dkar g.yas 'khyil cha/ rnga bo che/ rdor dril/ phyag sbub/ gsol dkar bcas bstsal pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i mtshan yang gsang chen smin rgyas gling zhes bstsal/ hrīḥ mnyam med 'dren mchog shākya'i — 92 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rgyal bo dang / rig 'dzin chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo yab sras sogs dngos brgyud bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bas mchod/ zhes bsngags pa dang / bla ma mgo rta tshang dang sman pa grwa tshang nas sngags grwa'i 'du khang gsar bzheng gi mthun rkyen sbyar/ da dung khong gi zhal dngos nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa tshang drug gi gong 'og nas khyed sngags pa grwa tshang bdun po'i 'gro sa 'dug sa gcig yin/ khri ba dang las sne thams cad 'dug sa sman pa grwa tshang dang las sne rnams kyi 'phros yin/ smon lam skabs kyi gtor rgyag dang gnam lo gsar ba'i tshes gnyis lha tshes la sman pa grwa tshang dgon 'dir phebs dgos zhes khong gis gdams shing gtan la phab/ bla ma kirti tshang sngags grwa'i khri thog mar bskos shing nang chen bzhengs su bcug sngags grwas stobs chen shugs bzlog dang / rma gnyan gyi bskang 'phrin sogs 'bas brtan phon cher bsgrubs/sngags grwa'i bstan pa'i dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i nang gras su 'dzin grwa gsum gyi 'phar rim byung yod de/'dzin grwa zhol mas 'don pa cha tshang dang cho ga chos spyod gtsor sbyor ba'i zhar la 'don rta dbyangs/ gtor ma bza' bzo/ yig gzugs sogs bslab dgos/ 'dzin grwa bar mas sum rtags dag yig dang snyan ngag sogs rig gnas gtsigs su bzung nas sbyang dgos/ 'dzin grwa gong mas dka' rams pas kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi gsung rgyun thugs 'dzin nyams len bya dgos/ snga sor sngags pa brgyad cu 'dus shing sngags 'chang ba 'brug skyabs dang rig 'dzin pa mgon po tshe brtan sogs grags che 'ga' byung / bod kyi zlos gar dri med kun ldan sogs kyi rnam thar 'khrab pa'i srol btod/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang / spyi rdzas yo byad gzhung bzhes dang / sngags 'chang ba nyung shos khrims la sbyar ba dang mang shos rang rang pha yul du phyir bskrad de thon skyed ngal rtsol du zhugs bcugalcags sprel1980lor gling sprul ba'i sku rje btsun skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtshos dbu bskul te sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang bskyar du bzhengs/ nang rten la snga srol ltar slob dpon chen po 'di nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar 'khrab ston byas/ sngags grwa'i sde 'bangs sogs kyis pad+ma saṃ bha lba dang /byams 'jam dbyangs/ lha drag phur bu sogs kyi sku brnyan 'ga' dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad dang / rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ zangs mdog dpal ris zhing bkod sogs kyi gyan thang dang 'al thang du ma bzhugs pa dang / ma gza' rdo gsum gyi btsan khang / kun mkhyen gzim chung phub/ mtsho kha ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / klu tshang skal bzang sde 'di'i khri la bzhugs/ da lta sngags pa lnga bcu nga gcig gis bstan pa spyi sger gyi zhabs brtan dang chos spyod sogs yar ldan du spel/ gang ltar khro bcu'i gtor bzlogaseng gdong gtor bzlog rta mgrin gtor bzlog lha drag phur bu'i gtor bzlog sogs 'don pa dang /zhar du lo re'i smon lam dus chen la rgyal bo khri srong sde btsan/ dri med kun ldan/ a stag lha mo sogs kyi rnam thar/ 'khrab ston spel bzhin mchis so/ /— 93 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/thub chen lha khang thub bstan bdud 'dul gling /thub chen lha khang thub bstan bdud 'dul gling zhes pa ni/ chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon byang shar phyogs kyi mtha' ba gong ma'i sde dbus su bla brang gser khang chen mo las lhag pa'i nyams brjid che ba'i lha khang 'ig bzhengs pa de nyid yin te/ 'di ni rje kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen po'i gsung gnang ltar khri chen bso da grags pa 'jigs med bsod nams rgya mtshos lha khang dang nang rten gser zangs las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo sogs lha rten chos gsu ma khyad mtshar can 'ig tu grub/ mtshan dngos skyabs mgon mchog la zhus te thub chen lha khang ngam thub bstan bdud 'dul gling zhes bstsal cing / rab gnas shis brjod sogs gnang ste bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i thugs smon nan tan mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma mngon du gyur/ rjes su bsod grags dbon po rgyal mtshan gyis kun mkhyen lnga ba mchog gdan drangs nas mchod 'bul rgya cher gnang / da dung mtha' ba'i jo bo mthong ba don ldan ma'i lha khang me 'u galor bzhengs yod de/ lha khang 'di nyid tsha kun bla ma mchog la gsung gnang ltar lha khang rten brten par bcachu/ pa bzhengs/ skyabs mgon mchog thugs mnyes te mtha' ba'i tsan+dan jo bo'i dkar chag bsod nams 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bcoms/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog mtha' ba gong 'gab nas gdan 'dren zhus te jo khang nang khrus gsol gnang / 1958lo'i rjes su lha khang shul med du bsnubs so/ /maṇ+ḍal bde chen klad ri khrod/maṇ+ḍal bde chen klad ri khrod ces pa de snga kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong ho'u rgya zhang khongs su chags/gnas 'dir thog mar dpa' ris sprul ba'i sku dkon mchog bde chen pa'i sgrub khang btsugs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa mo glang gi lo'i1〈8 2lnga ba'i tshes gsum nyin kun mkhyen bzhi ba maṇ+ḍal klad du phebs nas mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs sku phreng gnyis pa dang rnam gnyis kyis ri khrod gsar 'debs kyi bkod khyab gnang / kun gzigs mchog gis gnas stod gsar spel mdzad cing lha rten sogs gnang / kun mkhyen gzim spyil mkhan po'i gzim khang dang / 'du khang bcas gsar du bskrun te/ rten gtso la tsan dan jo bo dang / rje ril ral tshang gi dbu thod sogs bzhugs/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag 'jug tshugs/bde mchog bstod pa nam mkha'i mdangs 'dres ma btsugs shing kun mkhyen nyid nas dge 'dun rer dong tse sum brgya re'i sku 'gyed bstabs/ rigs grwa sde ba dang za yus nang sde bas ri khrod mchod bkur che/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas maṇ+ḍal klad ri khrod nas mgon po dang lha mo zung gi gtor chog rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i steng bskang gso dang bzlas pa ci nus bgyis tshul rang rnam las shes/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan po sku phreng gis bskyangs/ 1928lor kā zi lin ma ka zhi hron jag dmag gis ri khrod rdul du brlags/ rgyal — 94 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/mkhan chen lnga ba nyin der ri khrod du bzhugs pa lam kyog zhig tu byol bar sku nyen ma byung / ga'an yang thar ba rtse ri khrod/ smad sog nor bu tshang / dbal mang tshang / mkhan po'i nang chen bcas la gtor bshig chen po thebs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung thang blo gros gtsos mi nyung ba bkums/ gang ltar mā chi'i dmag dpung gis dgon 'dir snga phyir gtor bshig mang du btang / phyis su rgyal mkhan chen gyis ri khrod nyams gso byed rgyu'i shing cha mang du bsgrugs kyang rab rgyal sa khyi lor gzhung bzhes byas/ mkhan po tshang nas ri khrod bsten pa bag tse dang gnyan chen la lo gsar lha rtse nyin la lha dar bsang mchod ma nyams par rgyun 'khyongs kyang da lta gyang shul tsam du zad do/ /a myes gnyan chen lha khang /a myes gnyan chen lha khang zhes pa ni/ bsang chu rdzong ho'u gya zhang rigs grwa'i thang du bzhengs/ lha khang 'di nyid kun mkhyen skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog me rta1906lor bya lag rtse ste/ rigs grwa'i thang sogs nas bsang dang rlung rta bton/ gatshi bdag gi bsang ma chod cho ga gas ra rtsom dang gter 'bul ba gnang / 'brug sgra sgrog bzhin char zil ma babs/ skyabs mgon mchog shog bcu'i gnyan gyi ri rtser byon te bsang mchod rgya cher btang / dad ldan rnams kyi re 'dod ltar bla brang chen pos gnang rkyen la brten nas gnyan chen lha khang bzhengs/ 1928lor jag dmag gis maṇ+ḍal ri khrod rtsa med du gtor/ bla brang dgon pa nyams nyes mi 'byung ba'i phan grogs mtha' ba'i mi ser rnams/ kyis byas stabs/ yul dpon blo bzang tshe dbang dang / phyag mdzod mkhyen rab don grub gnyis kyis gnang spyin spam mtho ba bstsal cing / de rjes lha khang sogs rgya skyed bzhengs te sku brnyan mang du bzhugs/ 195〈lo'i rjes su lha khang gi rten brten par bcas pa gtor/ 19rnga〈'o ra bsang chu rdzong chos lugs cus nas shog sgor lnga stong lhag gnang ba dang /dad 'dus rnams kyis zhal 'debs sogs la brten nas sngon ltar lha khang bzhengs shing mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod kyang bzhugs/ lugs rnying zla lnga ba'i nyer gsum dang / drug pa'i nyer bzhi nyin dus mchod gtso bo byas te rgya bod kyi mjal ba mang bas mchod 'bul bsang mchod byed bzhin pa'i sgang lags so/ /dpon tshang jo dgon dge ldan bstan rgyas gling /dpon tshang jo mo'i dgon pa dge ldan bstan rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ bla brang dgon pa'i nub phyogs su bsang chu rdzong ho'u gya 'ang gi dpon tshang sde ba'i dbus su chags/kun lho'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus su bkod pa ltar na/ skyabs mgon lnga ba'i sku dus rje blo kho gnyis pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i smad dam spyi lo1925lor jun lbang dpon tshang gis sbyin bdag byas te btab ces bkod/ dpon tshang nas rgyu rkyen sbyar te 'du khang bzhengs/ nang rten ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo de 'jigs ser zhes pa zhig gis bzhengs pa dang /— 95 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dge bshes lha mo'i tshul khrims kyis bzhengs pa'i 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dang / mkhan po mtshan can zhig gis byams pa/ rje yab sras gsum bzhengs/ gnas brtan bcu drug mkha' spyod ma/ khros nag ma bcas kyi zhal thang / rgyal mchog bcu bzhi bas gnang ba'i spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba/ paṇa chen bcu bas gnang ba'i chos dung g.yas su 'khyil ba/ rdo rams pa lha mo'i tshul khrims kyis gnang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa sogs lha rten chos gsum mi nyung tsam bzhugs shing / dge lda na bstan pa'i bdag chen jun lbang / dpon mo klu kho dang bkra shis tshe ring bcas nas mchod bkur che/ khyad par du bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen sku phreng snga phyi nas gzigs skyong dang gnang sbyin bstsal/ rje bla kho rin po che khong nyid nas skyong skabs su dmigs brtse ma dang ma ṇi bzlas brjod kyi lung gnang / phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed mkhan dge btsun ma phal cher drug bcu lhag byung / 1kha5〈lor chag 'jig byung / chos sgo slar phye nas dge ma jo mo rgan pa 'ga' zhig gis sngar ltar chos spyod spel shing khyi 1994lor kun mkhyen drug pa rin po che gtsos rim pa gong gis gzigs skyong 'og bla brang jo mo'i dgon gyi don dam u yon lhan khang tshugs/ kru'u rin gung ri tshang dang dge ma mtsho mo bcas pas skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar jo mo'i 'du khang rgya bskyed de bzhengs/ bla brang dgon pa dang / sngags pa grwa tshang gi mi sna/ lha sde mi snas las khur byas/ dge btsun ma dag gis 'bad 'bungs ngang zhal 'debs bsdus/ rong ngar dam chos zhes pas sbyin bdag btsal pas shog sgor 'bum phrag gi mthun rkyen la brten nas 'du khang gser tshon byug pa bzhengs/ rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis gnang ba'i li sku rje tsong kha ba yab sras gtsos/ jo bo/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ thugs rje chen po/ gnas brtan bcu drug rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ kun mkhyen gong ma dang / rje bla kho tshang /sgrol ma/ ma cig lab sgron/ khros nag bcas kyi sman sku dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / ma cig mkha' spyod ma sogs kyi gyan thang dang / zhal thang du ma bzhengs/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / sher phyin 'bum/ lam rim sngags rims/ bskal 'phags ting gsum bcas lha rten chos gsum gsar ba mang bo bzhugs/ srung ma dam can bsten cing zangs ri'i btsan rgod yang bkur/ sa stag lo'i lha bab dus chen dang 'brel bar 'du khang legs par grub byung ba'i dga' ston la kun mkhyen mchog gis dgon mtshan bstsal pa dang rta mchog cig phul rgan gya nas 'khrungs pa'i khri stag lung tshang dang lo sprul dkon mchog mkhyen rab sogs dgon 'dir phebs te gter dang rten gsum 'ga' zhig gnang / dge ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag so so'i bla sprul khag dang / dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis dgon 'di la mchod sbyin yang yang byed ba'in yod/ dgon 'di'i 'chad nyan gtso bo la/ zla dang bo'i nang smon lam chos spyod kyi skor tshogs 'don dang / zla gsum pa'i nang zhi byed gcod kyi bdag 'jug zla bzhi ba'i nang thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag 'jug dang / smyung gnas/ zla brgyad par mkha' spyod bdag 'jug zla re tshes bcu la mkha' spyod ma dang /nyer lnga khros nag tshes bcur dkyus bzhin gsung sgrogs steng / dus rgyun ma ṇi tā re zhal 'don dang / phyag — 96 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bskor bzlos sgom sogs la brtson bzhin pa'i btsun ma drug cu lhag bzhugs shing / rang rang gi spyil khang nyi shu lhag bskrun nas dge sbyor la ci nus su 'bad bzhin pa'i sgang lags so/ /mtha' ba gong ma'i jo mo'i sgar/mtha' ba gong ma'i jo mo'i sgar ni gan lho khul gyi chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil byang shar phyogs te bla brang mtha' ba gong 'gab gi dbus su chags/dgon 'di ni kun lho'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus nang du bkod pa ltar na/ dge ldan pa'i jo mo'i dgon pa 'di ni ha lam rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags glang ste spyi lo1781lor btab ces bkod pa ltar bris/ mtha' ba zhol mas sbyin bdag byas te 'du khang chung ba zhig bskrun pa'i nang rten du/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo khong nyid kyis phyag bzo gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang rje tsong kha ba chen po'i sku brnyan/ sman 'dam gyis bzhengs pa'i mkha' spyod ma dang bcas snang brnyan che chung bcu phrag 'ga'/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med sogab / kyi thang ga sna tshogs/ chos spyod rab gsal gye skor dang gsung 'bum thor bu 'ga' 'ig bzhugs shing / snga sor btsun ma sum cu lhag nas chos spyod sogs spel/ 195ngalo'i rjes su jo sgar bshig 1980lo'i rjes nas bzung jo mo'i sgar rim pa gong gis gzigs skyong dang / mtha' ba'i sde ba gtsos dad ldan 'ga'i zhal 'debs bsdus te 'du khang chung ba zhig bskrun cing gtsor rten rje sku dang / mtha' ba'i tshe ring 'tsho nas sman 'dam gyi mkha' spyod ma'i snang brnyan dang sbyin bdag gzhan pas ma cig lab sgron sogs bzhengs/ gzhan 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mkha' spyod ma bcas sngar gyi thang sku che chung nyi shu lhag dang / rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa sogs li sku bcu phrag du ma bzhugs/ srung ma dpal ldan lha mo bsten/ dgon pa'i lo gcig gi chos thog gtso bo la zla gsum par khros nag bdag 'jug nyin bdun/ zla bzhi ba smyung gnas/ zla brgyad par mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug nyin bdun/ zla dgu ba smyung gnas/ dus rgyun yar ngo mkha' spyod ma dang mar ngo khros nag gi tshe bcu chag med 'don da lta btsun ma rig 'dzin zhes pa gtsos jo mo nyi shu lhag 'dus pa'i skabs so/ /za yus mdo'i jo dgon bslab gsum dar rgyas gling /za lus mdo'i jo mo'i dgon pa bslab gsum dar rgyas gling ni bla brang dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su za yus mdor chags yod cing da lta'i kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong ho'u gya zhang gi khongs su gtogs/dgon gnas 'dir snga 'gyur bstan pa'i yang snying btsan thabs 'chang rgya'i gdams pa dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i thugs dam nyams len mthil phyin mdzad pa'i sgrub rgyud 'dzin pa bzhugs pa'i gnas shig yin/kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba dang lnga ba dag snga phyir gnas bskor du phebs zhor gnas shis brjod kyi byin — 97 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rlabs phab myong / de snga gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i btsun ma bde chen bzang mo gtsos chos rdzong dgon pa'i jo mo 'ga' zhig bla brang dpon tshang jo mo'i dgon du yun ring bzhugs/ de nas chos rdzong ba'i 'go ba rnams nas kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog la dgon pa gcig la grwa tshang gnyis phye rgyu'i re 'dod zhus pa ltar yul dus dang bstun pa'i gsung lan gnang /bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me glang1997lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung za yus mdo ru 'du khang sogs bzheng rgyu'i 'go brtsam/sa/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma skal bzang dam chos sgrol mas do dam kru'u rin gyi 'gan bzhes/ rje thu'u bkwan brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho gdan drangs nas bkra shis gso sbyong dang / lto 'phye brtags pa sogs gnang / khyad par du kun mkhyen rin po che dang / rje gung thang tshang / dpa' ris a lags dor zhi sogs sprul sku khag dang / bla brang dgon pa sogs rim pa gong gi rgyab skyor dang gnang sbyin/ rong ngar dge slong dam chos gtsos zhal 'debs la brten nas 'du khang dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa dang / nang rten slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor dang /mkhan slob chos gsum/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al dang / byams pa/ rdor sems/ lha drag phur bu bcas pa 'bog sku che legs can gyi sku brnyan 'ga' bzhengs/ rgyal ba kun tu bzang / phyag lha so lnga/rje tsong kha ba/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ klong chen rab 'byams pa/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ rta mgrin/ dgon pa'i srung ma ma bza' rdor gsum gyi zhal thang grub/ sngags 'chang mgon po tshe brtan gyis skyong khur gnang zhing 'phags yul nas spyan drangs zer ba'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha lba dang / thugs rje chen po'i li sku byin can bzhugs so/ /dgon 'di'i lo hril bo'i chos spyod gtso bo ni/ gtsos chos rdzong ri khrod kyi phyag len ltar zla dang bo'i nang du smon lam chos spyod sogs zhal 'don dang / zla gnyis pa'i nang du zhi khro/ zla bzhi ba'i nang thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i cho ga smyung gnas/ zla drug par bcu gsum nyin dge rgan mgon po'i gdung mchod/dgu ba'i nang du thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi cho ga yar ngo'i rig 'dzin dang / yar ngo mkha' 'gro'i tshes bcur 'char can yod/de snga'i kru'u rin gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa'i dge btsun ma ye shes gtsos ha lam jo mo lnga bcu zhal 'dzoms/ dge btsun ma bde chen bzang mo ni/ bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing rta1904lor rdo sbis 'dam na nas 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung nas rdo sbis shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros dang / gung ru mkha' 'gro ma dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo/ kha bya'i gter ston/ rdzogs chen dpal sprul 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs gsar rnying gi bla ma mang bo bsten nas chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ lo kyā tun bde mchog rang byon dang / kha bya'i brag dmar dpal rdzong sogs nas yi dam mkha' spyod ma bsten nas sgom grub mdzad/ mkha' spyod bdag 'jug dang gcod kyi bdag 'jug rgyun 'dzin/— 98 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ma ṇi dung phyur/ sgrol ma 'bum tshar lhag lha du ma'i sngags bzla ba sogs dge sbyong 'bad pas yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa'i nyams snang mang / 1986lor rdo sbis mchod rten gnas su sku zhi bar gshegs so/dgon du kun mkhyen gzim chung / spyi khang / grwa shag sum bcu tsam nye zhing / mchod gzhis la za yus dang lam shar bcas kyi khyim tshang bdun cu yod/ de'i slob ma dbang mo dang a mchog sangs rgyas dag gis dgon 'di nas rnam dkar las la 'bad bzhin mchis so/ /brag dkar dgon gsang sngags smin rgyas gling /gsang chen bdud rtsi'i char ba 'bebs pa'i kha sbyor rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang shar gnya' gong brag dkar dgon gsang sngags smin rgyas gling zhes pa ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi bkra shis 'khyil ba 'dzin ma dkar bo'i byang phyogs rgan gya zhang du chags/dge mtshan 'bar ba'i chos sde 'di ni ha lam bod rab byung bcu gcig ba'i shing bya ste spyi lo 1644lo tsam na kha gya'i khams bsang gis grwa tsha'i dam pa ag byar mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar te/ sde snod gsum la mkhas pa'i rgan gya'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhes bya bas phyag 'debs mdzad/ mchod yon zung du 'brel ba'i srol rgyun da lta'i bar du ma nyams par mchod bkur che/ kun mkhyen gong mas bkra shis 'khyil phyag 'debs mdzad skabs rgan gya'i paṇ+ḍi tas gdan drangs te/ dad stobs ldan pa'i rgan gya stod smad kyi skya ser thun mong gis dad pas kun nas bslangs te gser dngul sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul te dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin zhus/ da dung paṇ+ḍi tas rje nyid la mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'dzugs grabs zhus kyang / mtshan nyid rgyas po mi yong bde mchog gi pho brang bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gnas su snang bas rgyud grwa tshugs na legs gsungs kyang re zhig lus/phyis su paṇ+ḍi ta'i thugs 'dun ltar mkhas dbang dbyig gya tshang la mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'dzugs su bcug de nas dbyig gya gong ma na rim ltar stag ring khri rgan rgya shul dpon slob sogs kyis bskyangs/ 'on kyang mtshan nyid cher ma 'phar ba'i rkyen gyis la kha tā le hu thog thu gtsos gung thang tshang sras dgyes pa'i rdo rje mchog gdan drangs nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi smad rgyud ltar rgyud grwa gsar du btsugs shing lo gsum gyi bar du skyong khur mdzad pas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang / ṭīk+ka bskyed rdzogs kyi 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa rgya cher spel pa yar rgyas byung / gung ru mkha' 'gro mas khong gi bla brang nas bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ brag dkar gnas khang zhib mjal mdzad cing tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i bsngo smon gang rgyas kyi mtshams sbyar nas rim byon gyi 'chad nyan sogs la thugs khur 'gang che ba gnang /thu'u bkwan rin po che nas rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa'i snying bo rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi bshad sgrub bde mchog sgrub mchod 'dzugs thebs la dngul srang sum brgya bstsal/ rgan gya nas 'khrungs pa'i khams la kha grub chen gyi sprul sku snyan grags rgya mtshos gang ci'i dbu 'dren mdzad pa dang sbyor 'jags bla lhag gnang zhing gser — 99 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu yos lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bor 'dzin bdag mdzad dgos pa ser skya tshang mas gsol ba btab pas spyi 'jog la dngul srang nyis brgya dang rta nor lug gsum sogs grangs mang gnang / de nas dgon khrir zhabs sen bkod pa la dpon slob kun dga' bkra shis/mkhar gong sprul sku sangs rgyas rab 'byams pa ngag dbang mchog grub/ rje dkon mchog bde chen bcas kyis dgon par 'du khang dang spyi khang bskrun pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ khri chen 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge / hor sprul sku blo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ rgyud pa slob zur 'jigs med mkhas mchog rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ 'gyang ro mchog sprul 'jigs med rgyal mtshan (gshin po'i dge rtsar grwa tshang grong du phebs bzhin pa dgon du blangs)/ stag lung sprul sku blo bzang nyi ma/ a mchog 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs/ khri rab brtan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ khri sprul dkon mchog grags pa/ nyan tsha sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ gtsos rdo rams pa dkon mchog don yod sogs dang thang dkar lha rams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin/ gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgya mtsho/ de'i sprul sku bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs kyis tshogs chos sgrig lam la dag thon dang gtong sgo cha rkyen gang ci'i 'dzin skyong gnang tshul gung thang lnga ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus su gsal/ kun mkhyen lnga ba dang drug pa'i sku dus su/ bla brang gling sprul ba'i sku skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho/ dgon li tshang / se li tshang / de'i rjes su gung ru mchog sprul pa'i zhus ngor gling sprul skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho slar khrir bzhugs gnang ste bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag srol ltar dgon 'dir smon lam btsugs/ tsho 'du tshang skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ mgon shul nas 'khrungs pa'i gdan sprul sku/ khyom dge blo bzang bstan dar rgya mtsho/ mdzod dge tā dbon pa blo bzang 'phrin las kun dga' seṅge/ hor blo gsal ba'i sprul sku skal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ dbal chung lnga ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog dgon 'di'i khri bzhugs gnang skabs su 'du khang zhig gsos mdzad pa dang sgrig lam 'chad nyan sogs rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po'i gsang sngags kyi bka' srol yongs su rdzogs pa phyag len tu btab pas gsang sngags grub pa'i sde kun gyis smon yul du gyur/ he ru ka dpal rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dgon 'dir lan du mar phebs nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u thog mtha'i lung dang yid dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang / brag dkar dgon gyi ser skya brgya phrag lhag la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom lung gnang ba dang / brag dkar dgon du grwa ja btang ste dngul srang sum bcu'i spyi 'jog thog bla ma'i zhabs brtan dmigs brtse ma mang bo 'don du bcug gar thig dbyangs gsum gang thad nas mi nyams gong du 'gro rgyu'i gsung gnang / gung ru'i gzim khang nas phyag mal byas te rten byin dag la mjal/ gnas skor dang gnas khang nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor pa sogs shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/ chibs sgyur mdzad de dgon grong so so'i 'dod mos bzhin chos bka' sogs kyis re 'dod bskangs shing / gnas khang du gnas gzigs dang tshogs 'khor bcas thugs smon rgya chen gnang ba'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar mang du — 100 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/byung / skyabs mgon blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang / gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs rje bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo sogs lan du mar phebs/ mdo smad chos 'byung du bkod pa'i snga sor skyong khur gnang zhes pa'i stag ring khri rgan tshang ni/ sku phreng dang bo dge 'dun rgya mtsho yul dbus byang phyogs su sku bltams/ lha dang bla ma'i bka' lung bzhin mdo smad du grub pa'i gnas 'dir byon te legs byas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol/ dgon pa yun ring skyong khur gnang stabs kyis stag ring khri rgan tshang zhes 'bod/de'i spru la sku blo bzang bstan pa/ yul mdo smad du 'khrungs shing rab tu byung ste rgan gya'i brag dkar dang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar 'grims shing thos bsam sgom pa mang du mdzad de me bya lor rdo rams pa'i dam bca' dang por 'jog mkhan a rig snyan grags/ stag ring sku skyes zhes chos 'byung du bkod pa de nyid yin cing /rje 'di'i sku dus su brag dkar dgon dang bla brang du gzim khang bskrun/ chos skyong mgon po phyag drug pa'i rdo sku byin can bsten/ sku phreng gsum pa thub bstan lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rgan gya gong ma'i stag ring klu phyug gi rus su sku 'khrungs/ mchog sprul gdan sar bkod de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar 'grims nas slob gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad/ bla ma mang bo'i sku gam bcar pa la kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog nas kyang gzigs pa che/ bla brang kyai rdor dang shing la'i kha/ sgom me/ sog po'i urge'i khri lo mang bzhugs shing dus rgyun 'chad nyan mdzad do/ / de'i sprul sku skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags lug(1921)lor rgan gya gong ma'i tsho bar yab bkra shis rgyal dang yum sgrol ma'i sras su sku bltams/ dgung lo bzhi'i steng kun mkhyen lnga bas stag ring sku gong ma'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang nas gdan sar bkod/ rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas bka' chos ci rigs gsan/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs nas phar phyin dam bca' bzhag dngul rwa dgon dang / chu kha ma'i dgon/shing bza' dgon sogs kyi khri ba mdzad/ stag ge sku phreng lnga ba skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho dang rje nyid nas mtsho sngon du kun ma khyen drug pa'i yang sprul khyi'u rnyed par phebs pa dang / paṇa chen bcu ba mchog sku 'bum du gdan sar bkod skabs su bla brang bla tshab tu chas/ 195ra lo'i rjes su btson du lo gsum bcug mthar ngal rtsol la zhugs pa dang chos sgo slar phye tshe brag dkar dgon dang kyai rdor grwa tshang tsi dmar btsan khang bcas nyams gso'i bskyar bzheng la mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar/ rgan gya dang rkang tsha'i (mtsho sngon rkang tsha)rtswa don bsdum par phebs/ rgan gya'i shis skor dge ri'i lab rtse bstad cing bsang yig mdzad/ da lta bsang chu rdzong gi srid gros su rgyun u'i 'gan bzhes pa legs mdzad yar ldan du mchis so/ /gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi 'du khang chen mo'i nang rten gyi gtso la khams la kha tā li hu thog thus rgya yul nas gdan drangs pa'i rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi 'dra sku byin can dang / gung thang rin po ches gnang ba'i jo bo lo ke shwa ra/ thub pa rdor gdan ma/ gung ru dpal mo'i bka' bzhin ri dar nas bzhengs pa'i byams mgon/sangs rgyas stong sku nas bzhengs pa'i byams mgon/ sangs rgyas stong sku dang li sku mang bo/ 'jam dbyangs — 101 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bstan 'dzin gyi sku byin can/ stag phu'i sgrol ma/ klong rdol bla ma'i phyag tsha thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / gung ru dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo'i dbu thod dang rje btsun ma gtso sku byas te bskrun pa'i gos sku/ gsung rten la rgyal ba'i bka' bstan dang / rje yab sras/ kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud gzhung sna tshogs bcas po ti mang bo/ thugs rten la khams grub chen dang mkhas dbang dbyig kyā tshang gi sku gdung mchod rten/ khyad par du tsan dan dkar pos bskrun pa'i bde mchog gi blos bslangs bcas bzhugs so/ /sde 'di'i chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ zla dang bo'i nang bla brang phyag srol ltar btsugs pa'i smon lam/ zla gnyis par dpyid chos/ zla gsum par bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bzhi bar ma ṇi smyung gnas/ zla lnga bar dbyar chos/ zla drug par chos 'khor dus chen nyin bde mchog gi sgo nas tshogs skor byas te ma ṇi ril sgrub/ zla bdun par rab gnas dang dbyar gnas bcas/ zla brgyad par ston chos/ zla dgu bar gsang 'jigs zung gi bdag 'jug zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod dus bzhi'i chos thog dag snga so ltar re re'i zla chos/ da dung gung ru rig 'dzin dpal mo sogs kyi gdung mchod/ chos skyong rab gsal gyi skor dang srung ma'i gtor chog bskang gso sogs bzlas bzhin mchis/ 'du khang chen mo'i dbus su dmangs mang mthun snang du grub pa'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi lañja bris 'bur gyi ngos su dus rgyun bdud rtsi 'bebs pa mngon/ rgyud sde kun gyi spyi bor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam gyi gnad la nges shes rnyed pa'i brag bkar bka' bcu ba dang /gung thang 'jam dpal/ gung ru'i mchod dpon dar rgyas/ mkhyen spyan yangs pa tsha kho'i bstan pa/btsun pa'i mchog gyur dge slong 'jam dbyangs dam pa/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa da lta'i gung thang drung yig ngag dbang dar rgyas sogs 'du 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig byung / da dung rgan gya'i gcod pa skyabs kyi lha khang bzhengs pa'am nang rten bka' bcu bas bzhengs pa'i byams khang / ston chos/ dam can dang bsre khrab pa'i btsan khang / spyi khang / kun mkhyen/ gung thang / gung ru/ stag ring / la kha tshang gi nang khag bcas bzhengs/ byang chub mchod rten/ dgon mtha'i ma ṇi 'khor khang mang bo/ grwa shag lnga bcu lhag tu btsun pa las sne spyi ba dge bskos byings 'dren bcas 'dzoms/ khri ba dang 'go ba bla brang nas bskos/rab rgyal sa khyi 1958lo'i 'khrug zing gi rkyen las nyes skyon yod med gang rung gi dgon pa rtsa ba nas bsnubs/'phro lus lha khang 'du khang nang 1962lor re zhig grwa ba 'ga' re tshogs chos spel kyang / rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul spel ba'i nang rjes shul med par btang ngo / /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel lo'i 19nga0zla bcu ba'i nang kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog rgan gya'i bla grwa ser skya thun mong nas zhus pa dgyes bzhin sprul ba'i gnas chen dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang shar gnya' gong brag dkar du rten 'brel gyi gnad la dmigs te phyag phebs/mchog sprul gung ru mkha' 'gro mas kun gzigs mchog la byu ru'i bum pa dang bde mchog dkar bo'i 'dra thang — 102 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bcas mdun gdar mjal rten du zhus pa dang / dgon pas kyang bsnyen bkur che cher btegs te mjal rten sku gsung thugs rten rim par phul/ kun gzigs mchog gis gnas khang nas bde mchog smon lam sogs gsungs te shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/ rgan gya'i mkha' 'gro ma dang stag lung sku skyes sogs kyis zhus ngor/sham+bha la'i smon lam dpal ldan dang po ma dang skyabs 'gro/ ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma/ seng gdong ma/ tshe gzungs/ lo gyon ma/ gu ru si bhi sogs kyi lung gnang skabs 'ja' chen gsal ler nam mkha'i mthongs su shar/ legs byas bya ba gsar du bzhad pa'i lcags bya lor brag dkar dgon pa'i chos sgo slar phyes te dam pa gung ru tshang gis tshe lha rnam gsum gyi stong mchod dang 'brel bar grwa tshang la mang 'gyed kyi thog ma dkar yol 'bras gang re dang dar dkar/ shog sgor ja bcas 'gyed gtang / rjes su bde mchog gi snang brnyan bzhengs te 'du khang phug tu bzhugs/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog la snyan seng brgyud de bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'du khang me stag lor(1986)bskyar du bzhengs 'go tshugs te phyi lo legs par grub/ gung ru tshang gis 'phags pa brgyad stong ba dang mdzo mo dkar dkar shog sgor brgya phrag bcas dga' sto na du bstsal/ 'du khang chen mor nang rten gtso bo rgyal dbang mchog gis gnang ba'i brgyad stong ba dang paṇa chen bcu bas gnang ba'i tshe sku/ kun mkhyen mchog gis gnang ba'i ston pa thub sku/ dbus su pad thar nas bzhengs pa'i byams mgon/ nye sras brgyad dang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / bde gas nga 'jigs gsum gyi snang brnyan/ su dug gis phul pa'i lung ston byams pa'i gos sku rje yab sras sogs kyi snang brnyan sogs mang bo/ gsung rten la su rug pas blus pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / shis skor nas blus pa'i sde dge'i bstan 'gyur/ thugs rten la bde mchog gtso sku byas te bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten che legs can bcas la kun mkhyen drug pa dang rje gung thang drug pas rab gnas mdzad/ bde thang 'bas drung dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang gnang / da lta dgon par 'du khang dang byams khang / spyi khang / dam can dang bse khrab pa'i btsan khang / grwa shag sum cu lhag grub phub cing grwa ba 'al grangs bdun cu bzhugs te 'dul 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gtsos grwa rgan tshang mas rgyud pa'i phyag len ltar las gzhan du cung zad bsgyur du med pa'i ngang nas 'chad nyan spel bzhin mchis so/ /da lta dgon 'dir bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud dang / sham+bha la'i smon lam dpal ldan dang po sogs kyi dpar brkos pa'i par khang chung chung dang / sman khang / tshong khang / brag dkar gnas khang du mjal ba khrid pa'i yong 'beb yod/ ba sde rting ril la kun mkhyen drug pa'i bka' gnang ltar khri chen hor gtsang bdun pas thugs khur bzhes bzhin 'jam dbyangs lha khang dang sgrol ma'i lha khang bcas lha khang gsum po'i rten dang brten pa bzhengs/ rab rgyal sa phag lor 'jam mgon bse drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang / bde mchog gi zas mchod/ smon lam/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sham+bha la'i smon lam bden tshig lhun po'i lung sogs gnang ste zab rgyas chos kyi char chen phab/— 103 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/khyom dge bla mas dbang lung du ma gnang ba dang bkra shis lung dkar gyi lab rtse bstad cing rlung rta'i dar lcog dbu rtser btsugs/ rje gung thang drug pas gnas khang rdo thog la phyag rjes ba'ag rgan gya'i sto da smad kyi ri bo dpal dkar dang / bkra shis lung dkar/ rkong ri lha gnyan dag lab rtse rgyas par bstad pa ma zad/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa'i rdo rje rgyal po dam pa brtan po'i skye ba bzhes skabs su khong phyogs 'dir phebs nas bdud 'ga' 'ig dam la btags / da lta dmar bsang gtong mi chog pa'i rgyun rje gung thang bas bcad do/ /bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan ldan pa'i yul 'dir mkhas grub chen po kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ g.yer gshong zla grags/ mkhan sprul dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ ko'i ba chos rgya mtsho'i sprul sku/ dbyig byā sprul sku sku mched lnga/ rgan bya'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rgyal mchog lnga ba'i dngos slob rgan rgya'i bla ma dkar dkar rin chen bkra shis/ khams la kha grub chen pa'i sprul sku snyan grags rgya mtsho/ bde chen sprul sku ngag dbang dge 'dun bkra shis/ 'be shes rab mchog ldan/ lha zhes sprul sku 'jigs med/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma dkon mchog chos kyi sgron me/ dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo/ sga bu zhabs drung byams pa rgya mtsho/ stag ring sprul sku thub bstan lung rigs rgya mtsho/ de'i yang srid skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ grub pa dung sna ba skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ su nyid dge 'dun dar rgyas/ sprul sku skal bzang grags pa/ hor gtsang tshong 'du blo bzang rgyal mtshan/stag lung che ba'i sprul sku skal bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho/ khri chen hor gtsang 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho/mdzod dge tā dbon pa blo bzang 'phrin las dar rgyas/ zhabs dkar ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/grub chen bzang po'i mchog sprul blo bzang 'jigs med rnam rgyal sogs dam pa'i skye rabs kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa'i sprul sku phyogs 'dir 'khrungs te rang sde gzhan smon 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur to/ /zhol phug ri khrod/zhol phug ri khrod ces pa da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi rgan gya'i brag dkar nye 'dabs su chags/ da ltar slar gsos zin/ri khrod 'di mdo smad chos 'byung du sus phyag 'debs mdzad pa mi gsal yang / ngag rgyun du sngon chad zhol bla ma zhes pa zhig mtsho sngon khri ka nas sku 'khrungs shing / dbus su phebs nas 'brog ri bo dge ldan mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gling du slob gnyer dpyis phyin mdzad mthar bla ma'i bka' ma bcags par mdo smad kyi gnas 'dir phyag phebs nas gzhis btsugs te sgrub pa la gzhol gshis zhol bla ma'am dga' ldan a lags zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ khong gis gnas 'dir rje yab sras gtsos pa'i sku brnyan mang bo dang byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ rje de nyid sku tshe smad la rang yul khri kur chibs bsgyur ces zer ba dang / rab byung bcu ba'i — 104 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lcags sbrul lo(15rnga1)chos pa rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnas 'dir sgrub pa mdzad cing rje mi la'i sku brnyan phyag bzo gnang / phyis su a lags bzang bo zhes pa phyag phebs nas ri khrod kyi sgom sgrub 'chad nyan skyong khur bzhes/ de min bla ma rnga rgod rin po che bzhugs nas srung ma mgon po phyag drug pa bkur pa dang bla ma bzang bos srung ma hor mo bsten/spyi lo195〈lo'i rjes su nyams chag thebs/ nye ba'i lo du mar dad ldan rnams kyis bskyar du sgom khang phub cing rje yab sras dang 1990lor brag gseb nas rnyed pa'i dngul grub mchod rten sogs sman sku dang thang ga dang 198 2lor byang chub mchod rten bzhengs par dge slong 'jam dbyangs mtshan can gyis gzungs gzhug tshad ldan phul cing rten dang brten par kun mkhyen drug pa dang gung thang drug pa rnam gnyis kyis rab gnas mdzad/ da lta khri chen hor gtsang bdun pa 'khrungs yul sde ba'i dbus su ri khrod shul yod la/ dus rgyun phyag mchod bskang gso mchod gtor byed bzhin mchis so/ /nā ga ra brag dkar sgom grwanā ga ra brag dkar sgom grwa rgan gya'i gnya' gong brag dkar gnas ri ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu(zhwa ho)rdzong rgan gya zhang du chags/rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo'i rang rnam las/ brag dkar sprel rdzong /gnya' gong brag dkar/ dan tig shel gyi yang dgon rnams tsa ri dang byin brlabs mnyam pa'i gnas chen du nges/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas mchog nā ga ra gnya' gong brag dkar zhes gsungs pa 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par lhun gyis grub pa'i ya mtshan sngon byon dam pa rnams kyi thugs 'phrog pa'i dben gnas khyad mtshar can yin/ rnal 'byor ba chen po rong bo skal ldan rgya mtsho mchog dgung lo nyer lnga son pa'i ha lam rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags lug lo(spyi lo1621)tsam la rgan gya'i tsung li bsod nams bkra shis dang bla ma dkar dkar zhes pas gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur phul cing / mthun rkyen sbyar te sgrub sde gsar du btsugs/sku 'bum rab 'byams pa tshe brtan rgya mtsho bla mar bskos/ phyis su sgrub sde gnas spos nas brag dkar dang gnas ri'i mchod rten lung ba sogs su sgrub la gzhol mkhan rab byung bcu drug pa'i rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i bar du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa ldan zhing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las skad cig kyang mi g.yo ba'i rnam thar 'dzin mkhan mang du byon nas dben 'ing nyams dga' ba'i gnas 'dir sgrub pa la sngags brjod tshe/ brag dkar gnas ri'i dbus su ri bo dar rgyal dang mnyam pa'i rgan bya'i dpa' dkar lha gnyan stobs ldan nor bu dbang rgyal gzi 'od 'bar ba'i ri'i rtser rgan gya'i rlung rta'i dar lcogs btsugs/ snga sor rgyal mchog lnga ba'i dngos slob du grags pa'i rgan gya'i bla ma dkar dkar dang phyi ma gung ru lnga bas bstad/ de'i rjes su rgan gya'i gcod pa dang / snying lcags/ 'jigs dga' bcas nas zhus te rje gung thang drug pa'i bka' gnang bzhin/da 105 da

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rgan gya'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / stag lung / stag ring sku skyes/ dge 'dun dar rgyas gtsos dgon lha sde spyi'i rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug lo'i (spyi lo1988) zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin bskyar du bstad/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma mchog gis gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i grub gnas kyi rgyab ri dung dkar rtse nas bsang yig ma dzad/ de'i rjes su rgan bya'i lha sde spyi nas lha gnyan 'di rgyas par bstad/ gnas 'dir grub dbang skal ldan ras pa'i sgrub phug dang dpa' ris sgom khang / gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i sgom khang / grub pa dung snang ba dang khri ga'i be+e ri grub chen bzhugs pa'i 'brong ri rtse sgom khang / mchod rten lung bar kun mkhyen ‘lnga bas ngos bzung ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gnas/ snga sor ri khrod pa zam ma chad par rgya tshang jo mo tsha kha'i jo mo sogs1958lo'i bar du sgrub pa gzhol mkhan mang du byung / sgom khang dag gi g.yas g.yon tu grub chen rnams kyi phyag rjes zhabs rjes/ lha sku sogs kyi rnam pa du ma brag ngos dang pha bong la gsal/gnas ri'i rtser thugs rje chen po dang / sgrub khang gi brag ngos su 'khor lo bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor / mdo'i pha bong chen po'i steng du rje mi la dang mar ba/ rigs gsum mgon po'i ri rtser mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas sogs sangs rgyas byang sems mang bo zhal gzigs bcas deb ther rgya mtshor gsungs/kun ma khyen lnga ba chen po phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad de bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi gnas ngos bzung /de sngon gnas 'di'i ri dwags gang yang gsod mi chog pa'i bka' tham can gyi yi ge gung ru'i yig mdzod du yod/deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor spro sangs pa tshos gnas gzigs skor gnang sa'i gtso gnad kyi sa cha zhig tu gyur/ brag dkar gnas bstod he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du/ mdo smad gser ldan yangs pa'i do ra ru/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i legs byas smin pa'i shugs/ /bde ba mchog gi rdo rje pho brang ngam/ /mig gi ltad mo shar ba brag dkar mdzes/ / zhes gsungs gnas 'dir tsa ri la rtse bskor/ rong bskor/mtha' bskor gsum mchis pa kun mkhyen bzhi ba dang gung ru mkha' 'gro mas zhal ston gnang / rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dang / kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog zung gis zhabs kyis bcags byin gyis brlabs/ skal ldan rgya mtsho'i chos 'byung du/ o rgyan gyis sprul ba du ma bkye ste/ tan tig mtsho snying / gnya' gong brag dkar rnams gnas sgo phye gsungs pa bden gsungs par 'dzin dgos pa'i nā ga rā'i gnas chen gnya' gong brag dkar gyi gnas khang phug thag ring zhing / nang du lha sku rang byon gyi rnam pa du ma mchis zhes gsungs so/ /deng skabs brag dkar dgon pa'i grwa ba dag gis gnas ri ngo sprad pa ltar na/ skal bzang sangs rgyas stong sku dang / dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ gnas brtan bcu drug 'jigs byed/ slob dpon pad+ma'i pad sdong / mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi lha sku'i dbyibs mtshungs 'dra'i rang byon gyi rnam pa mang bo/ mkha' 'gro'i brda yig mdzo mo'i mkhar/ mu tig skye gnas sogs phug pa'i gnas yod zer ba'i gtam gleng / rdo rje phag mo'i dbu rang byon zer ba mthong / gsang ba'i dur khrod ces pa nas gung ru mkha' 'gro dpal mas sha rlon — 106 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhig rnyed de zhang thabs mkhas tshang la gnang ba rnam thar du snang la/ dur khrod zer ba'i gnas yang yod/de min lha mo'i tshes gtor zer ba dang bla mtsho yod skad/ ngo mtshar dad yid 'a dren pa'i gnas khang du dus bzang rnams su rol sgra du ma byung tshul thos zer ba mang / dus rabs nyi shu nang du gcan gzan glo snying med pa zhig gnas khang nas phyir 'bud cing shi ba zhig rnyed de brag dkar dgon pa'i btsan khang nas btsan/ bsod nams ye shes dbang bo la brag dkar gyi rgyun las o rgyan/ sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs rnams bzhugs pa'i snang ba shar/ o rgyan thugs sras g.yu sgra snying bo'i sgyu 'phrul stong 'khor yon tan rgya mtshos kyang yul bzhi'i dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar 'dus pa'i tshogs 'khor mdzad pa dang / dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge 'dod 'jo'i ba/ dpag bsam shing / ma rmos pa'i lo tog mtsho rdzing / rtsi shing / phyi rol du dur khrod chen pos bskor ba gzigs/ thu'u bkun rin po che dang ye shes spyan ldan gung ru mkha' 'gro mas gnas khang nas a yig sogs gzigs/ rje brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas pas oṃ badz+ra gu ru rdo ngos su sor mos bris pa'i sngags yig gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag rjes gnas khang 'di'i sgor babs/ grub dbang gung ru gnyis pa dang gling sprul bzhi ba'i phyag rjes zhabs rjes mngon/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas/stong 'khor yon tan rgya mtsho/ tā dbon gzhon nu seṅge / bsod nams ye shes/ grub dbang chos pa rin po che/ sde ba chos rje/ skal ldan ras pa/ mkha' 'gro ma blo bzang chos sgron sku phreng rim byon/ gser khang rab 'byams pa 'phrin las/ kun mkhyen sku phreng snga phyi/ gung thang sku rim byon/ rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ g.yer gshong zla grags/ mkhas dbang dbyig gyu/ khams la kha grub chen/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ grub dbang sde khri/ bla ma bsod grags/ khri chen hor gtsang tshang zam tsha tshang / bla brang mkhan po tshang sogs mang po phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad de 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs 'khor mdzad/ khyad par du kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba mchog dang sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa phebs te srid 'bar ma'i smon lam sogs gsungs/ mkhas chen g.yer gshong zla grags dang /zhang ston pa thabs mkhas/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las bcas kyis gnas bstod mdzad do/ /ru ngar bkra shis dge 'phel dgon/ru ngar bkra shis dge 'phel dgon pa(ru ngar ri khrod kyang zer)ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong rgan gya'i ru ngar du chags/dgon pa 'di sngon chad ri khrod tsam du zad mod da lta rgya bskyed pas dgon par gyur/ mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag sngon tsam du rong bo'i shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob ru ngar dpon slob blo bzang dar rgyas kyis btab/ 'di bas rong bo'i dgon chen du thugs gnyer gnang zhing rgyud pa'i khri mdzad/ seṅge gshong dgon pa btab/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed bka' sdod rnam gsum dang — 107 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pas mngon spyod la mnga' brnyes/ ri khrod btab nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol/de'i rjes su rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i 'dul 'dzin pa zam ma chad par phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad cing sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma chos 'brel zhus te bla mar bsten tshul sogs bshad cing / de dus rong dmag gis yang yang bcom stabs / sde khri mchog nas bstan srid bde ba'i thabs zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol byams pa chos dar la zhus nas ri khrod bcol/ sku 'di ba ni mdo smad zho 'phong gnyan brgya zhes pa'i sde khrod du yum bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags glang 178 1lor sku 'khrungs/gzhon nu'i dus rab tu byung ste chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs gsar rnying gi bla ma mang bo'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mang du gsan phyis mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ chos rgyun 'dzin nus pa'i bu slob mang bo byung / yu la dbus dang bal bo sogs yul khams 'grims nas 'gro ba mang bo'i don mdzad/brtsams chos dang rang rnam bcas 'a po ti 'ga' mchis/ ru ngar ri khrod nyams gso mdzad par gsar rnying gang bstun gyis cho ga 'ga' zhig btsugs pa ma zad/ byang chub mchod rten chung chung bzhengs pa phyis su rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos 'ig gso mdzad/ de'i sprul sku 'bas dkar rig 'dzin rgya mtshos rje gong ma'i 'khrungs yul phyogs su sku bltams/ mchog sprul du ngos 'dzin gnang phyin gdan sar 'khod/mkhas grub bla ma du mar mjal nas gzhis byes kun tu gsar rnying gi chos rgyun mang du gsan/ kha gya'i 'al dkar lab rtse bstad/ spen steng sgar nas sgrub pa snying bo mdzad/ hor gtsang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling phyag 'debs mdzad skabs mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar/ gzhan phan gang gyur mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang /grub pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can ma nga po dmangs khrod du gleng rgyu yod/ de'i sprul sku reb gong rong bo nas 'khrungs shing mtshan blo bzang byams pa chos 'phel gsol/ sprul sku gdan sa 'khod de slob gnyer mdzad pa dang sku 'bum gser sdong mdun nas mar me khri phrag phul cing rje bstan pa mjal ba'i smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mtshams sbyar/ 195ralor rjes su btson 'jug byas te yin ring btson bzhugs dang grol rjes yun ma ring bar sku gshegs/ dad ldan ru bar thub bstan gtsos sde bas bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs ched du bla brang phyogs nas mang 'gyed btang / de'i sprul sku zhabs dkar 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog ni bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel1kha〈 0lor rgan gya'i ru ngar 'brog sde nas yab ngag dbang don grub dang yum mkha' mo tshe ring gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgu rong rgyal sras pas mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste me bya1992lor gdan sar bkod/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bka' gnang bzhin khri chen hor gtsang ba'i yongs 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtshos rab byung gi dge tshul bsgrubs/ rje gung thang ba'i drung yig ngag dbang dar rgyas dge rgan du bsten nas rig gnas thams cad sbyangs shing / nges pa don gyi gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du dbang lung mang bo gsan te/ da lta zhabs dkar gong ma'i gdan sa rong bo bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad bzhin mchis so/ /— 108 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ga'an yang khyab bdag he ru ka dpal rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog dang / brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis gdan zhus ltar phebs te yul gyi lha chen gnyan dmar ri la lab rtse bstad/ ye shes spyan ldan gung ru rig 'dzin dpal mo gdan drangs te chos 'brel zhus pa dang sgrub sde skyong khur gnang / mkha' 'gro ma'i bka' ltar brag dkar 'du khang phug gi byams mgon bzhengs/ de'i sprul sku dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo dgon sde 'di nas yun ring bzhugs shing chos 'brel zab/ de'i sprul sku gung ru drug pa skal bzang dam chos sgrol ma a bur the bi dang sde 'di gnyis yun ring ma mthun pa'i mi bsad rta 'gyel che ba'i sa rtsod bar la phebs te phan tshun gyi 'gal zla bsdum par mdzad/ da dung
