btsun pa'i mchog gyur ge sangs dge slong / sangs dmar mtshams pa ba/ 'dul 'dzin pa 'jigs med bsod nams/la dwags mkhan po zhes pa sogs skyes chen 'di dag gis dgon 'dir 'chad nyan skyong ba'i khur bzhes tshul bshad/ da dung mkhas pa'i dbang po tshe tan 'bas drung dang ka ring rta mgrin rnam gnyis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs zhor rgan bya'i dge 'phel dgon pa mjal bar phyag phebs/ rdo sbis shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis1962lor rten 'gangs du ma gnang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i mjug tsam du dgon 'di'i g.yas g.yon gyi kha dkar dang nyi ma lung ri khrod gnyis jag dmag gis gtor nas shul tsam med par btang / rab rgyal sa khyi 1958lo'i rjes su yang dgon pa'i lha rten chos gsum ci yod nyam sa chag thebs so/ /slar chos sgo phyes te lcags bya1981lor ru ngar thub bstan gtsos mi sde tshang ma gros mthun gyis dam pa kun mkhyen mchog dang rje gung thang tshang rnam gnyis la zhus te dge 'phel dgon 'dir bla brang dus 'khor ltar gyi phyag len ngos gtsang tshugs rgyu'i gsol ba btab/ lo 'di'i nang kun mkhyen mchog gi bka' ba'in rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dngos slob bla brang a khu dge 'dun che ba phyag phebs nas dbyar bzhugs gnang ste phyag len 'ga' btsugs/ de bzhin dgon pa'i chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ zla gcig pa'i nang smon lam/ zla gnyis par bsten pa gza' ru hu'i bskang ba khri/ zla gsu ma pa kun rig bdag 'jugazla bzhi ba smyung gnas cho ga dang maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ lnga ba ma ṇi/ zla drug pa rje stong mchod/ zla bdun pa gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ zla brgyad pa sman bla'i stong mchod/ zla dgu ba stong bshags phyag mchod/ zla bcu ba lnga mchod/ 'jigs byed cho ga'i phyag srol/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gdung mchod dang / mgon chos kyi gto bsngo bskang gso sogs tshugs/ da lta 'du khang dang / byams khang / spyi khang / ma bza' rdo gsum gyi btsan khang / rje gung thang dang zhabs dkar ba'i gzim khang / sde dge'i bka' bstan/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis gnang ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang /dam pa kun mkhyen mchog gis gnang ba'i kun mkhyen gong ma'i 'dra sku dang glegs bam/ gung ru mchog gis gnang ba'i 'phags pa brgyad stong ba/ stag lung sku skyes kyis gnang ba'i rten sogs mang bo bzhugs/ paṇa chen bcu ba mchog gis1980lor gnang ba'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen sku rim byon gyi na bza'/ gung thang — 109 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag dpe dang na bza' sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa'i byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ da skabs dgon du grwa ba lnga bcu bzhugs shing chos spyod yar ldan du mchis/ grwa tshang 'di'i nang gi btsun chung 'jam dbyangs mtshan can 'ig la khyab bdag bse bla ma chos kyi rdo rje bas grub chen bzang bo'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan 'byor dga' ston gyi skabs so/ /gnya' gong brag dkar e waṃ dga' 'khyil gling /mkha' spyod bde stong gnya' gong brag dkar gyi e waṃ dga' 'khyil gling ni da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi rgan gya zhang du chags/grub pa'i zhing mchog 'di 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang dngos yin pa tshad ma'i skyes bu dam pa 'ga'i zhal gcig tu mthun la/ ma cig mkha' 'gro'i rnam sprul gung ru ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gdan sa'ang yin/grags snyan gyi ba dan g.yo ba'i a mdo lha khang ka med zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par mang du bzhugs/zhi byed gcod kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun ma'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi mas mdzad pa las/ bde mchog rig pa'i rdo rje phag mo/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma/ khams gung rur blo bzang chos sgron/ blo bzang sgrol ma/ dkon mchog chos sgron/ dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo/ skal bzang dam chos sgrol ma sogs bla rgyud byon tshul gsungs/ de yang ye shes spyan ldan khams gung ru sku gong ma blo bzang chos sgron zhes bya ba khams gung ru nas sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus nas dam pa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pa zhig yin gshis khams dang dbus phyogs su 'phrin las 'phel zhing / sngon yum chen lab kyi sgrol mas thugs smon mdzad pa'i dus babs mkhyen nas dgos dbang gis mdo smad du byon/ sde ba chos rje'i zhabs la gtugs/ bya khyung dang sku 'bum sogs dgon sde du mar phan grogs mdzad/ rdo sbis lcang shar dgon pa rje btsun ma'i ngag bkod ltar sbyin bdag gnyis kyis btab tshul snang / shel dgon nas tshe chu bum pa gter nas bton/ phyogs phyogs su phebs par phyag len thebs pa'i 'bum pa dang lha khang zer ba mang / sku tshe smad du smad khams gung ru phebs pa dang sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang sgrol ma mdo smad du sku bltams/ dbus sam khams gung rur phebs te mgon khang mjal rgyu yin zhus par/ mkha' 'gro ma gshegs nas mgon khang gi sgo 'byed ma myong / lde mig gar yod mi shes zer/ 'di bas lde mig 'di na yod ces snyan shal mang bo'i gseb nas lde mig blangs/sgo phye bas na mkha' 'gro ma gshegs dus spar ba'i mar me da dung yod pas gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i skye bar ngos bzung / gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog gtsos gzhung nas bka' shog gis gzengs bstod tham ga bstsal/slar mdo smad du phebs nas grub chen pha dam pa'i dbyug pa nang bzhugs zhes pa'i lo rgyus can mchod rten dril gsil ma zhig gsos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus a mdo chos 'byung du mchis/ da dung brag lung ri khrod dang /— 110 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang rgan gya'i brag dkar sgom khang nas bde mchog rtsal 'don gyi thugs dam mdzad pas nyams bzhes rtse gcig tu grub/ de'i sprul sku dkon mchog chos sgron ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang lor rgan gya'i shis bskor du yab lha skyabs dang yum bzang mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gung ru'i bla brang mkha' spyod bde stong e waṃ dga' 'khyil du gdan sar bkod/ rje gong ma'i brag dkar sgrub khang nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags bye chen mang du bzlos/ kun mkhyen bar ma'i drung nas dbang mi tra sogs gsan/ rje thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas phyag phreng phul te bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i rnam thar snang / de'i sprul sku dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo bod rab byung bzhi ba'i shing khyi 1814lor yab be'u tshang g.yung drung skyabs dang yum lha mo rgyal gyi sras su rgan gya'i gser chen nas sku bltams/ pha ma gnyis la sngon byis pa ma 'tshams pa'i stabs kyis rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis tshang la gsung brtag zhus par mgon po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blug na skyon med gsungs/ dgung lo bzhi'i thog 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me mchog la mjal bas gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ rje nyid kyi drung nas rab byung bsgrubs shing mtshan dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo bstsal/ rta dkar bo zhig yod pa bla mar phul nas bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang dang / mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs bla ma'i zhal snga nas chos gsan pa'i thog ma bstsal/ de nas brag dkar mkha' spyod bde stong e waṃ dga' 'khyil du bzhugs nas thugs gnyer mdzad/ bla ma mang bo'i zhabs gtugs te mdo sngags kyi gsan pa spyi dang zab don snyan brgyud kyi 'phrin las spel ba'i sde/ kun spyod gtsang bas thams cad dad gus che/ lo kyā tun bde mchog rang byon gnas su lan drug phebs nas bdag 'jug mchod sprin spros/ de dus lo kyā tun nas rdo'i ka bā li bdud rtsis gsar rnyed/ da dung brag dkar dgon dang rang gi lha khang sogs zhig gsos dang / sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ thu'u bkun rin po ches bde mchog lha lnga'i cho ga 'dzugs thebs bstsal/ nyin re bzhin thun drug rnal 'byor chag med mdzad/ nangs rer dmigs brtse ma dang bde mchog gi cho ga dang brgya rtsa mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor dkar gtor bcas gtong / phyi dror mgon po lha mo gnyis kyi bskang chog chos skyong ga'an gyi gtor bsngo/ lus sbyin bcas 'di rnams chag med gnang / zla ba dang bo'i tshes gcig nas bde mchog dkar bo'i tshe sgrub sngags 'bum 'gro nges gnang ste bla ma rnams la bum chu 'bul/ lo re bzhin bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang rnam 'byor ma rnams kyi bdag 'jug nyin bdun re 'don zhing / rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi sku brnyan gser thang dang bde mchog gi sku brnyan/ gsang thang ma cig sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i mdun nas rgyun phyag 'tshal cing / sgril bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul dra bas rol pa las/ /dag pa'i brtan dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rten dang brten par shar la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes gsungs/ da dung rje btsun mas mdzad pa'i gsung thor bu tshigs bcad can brtsams pa mthong / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la mang 'gyed lan bdun dang brag dkar dgon la 'gyed mang btang ste rje btsun ma'i chos — 111 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rgyun 'dzin pa'i bu slob zhang ston thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i rnam thar pad dkar 'khri shing du gsal/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags yo sa18 2 1lor sku'i me tog thor ro/ /de'i sprul sku gung ru dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu 'brug 'o ra rdo sbis lcang shar sde khrod du yab don grub dang yum mkha' mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ 'ang ston thabs mkhas pas rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs shing khong gis phyag phreng gnang ba bzhin mtshan dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo btags/ dus 'khor gsung rab dge rgan du bsten nas chos spyod sogs thugs 'dzin gnang / de dus dge rgan gsung rab kyis zhus te kun mkhyen bzhi bas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs mdzad/dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung thang blo gros tshang la chos rgyun mang du zhus/ grub dbang bsod grags pa'i bka' bzhin zab mo gcod kyi phyag len lhur bzhes gnang ste dpa' ris pa brag dkar a lags 'jigs med rab gsal sogs gcod rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu slob 'ga' byung / gung ru mchog sprul sku phreng rim byon bzhugs pa'i gdan sa'i gnas su gtsug lag khang tshoms chen sum thog can bzhengs/ da dung gzim khang bde yangs nang chen rgya skyed du bskrun te gang du 'dod dgu byas pas chog ste/ phyogs 'dir bla chen su phebs bzhugs pa'i pho brang du gyur/ bla ma kirti mchog nas 'di ga'i gzim khang cha 'dra ba zhig bzheng rgyu'i bkod khyab gnang zhes/ dge mtshan 'bar ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di dag gi nang rten du bde mchog gi sku brnyan byin can dang /dus 'khor snang brnyan bdud rtsi 'bebs pa sogs li sku mang bo/ gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur/kun mkhyen yab sras dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung 'bum dang /bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud gsung sna tshogs dang / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ sher phyin mdo sogs po ti mang bo/ shugs rten rje gong ma'i sku gdung dngul las bzhengs pa 'ga' zhig dang / gter nas bton pa'i gsung byin can du ma/ bka' shog dang tham ga che chung yod pa gang dag bdag dam mdzad/ de nas byang gi dgon chen bzhi dang ri bo tan tig lang ju sde bzhi'i phyogs su pha dam pa'i sku gdung bzhugs nas tā mo wang dang / lo kyā tun bde mchog rang byon sogs su phebs par mchod 'bul gzab/ grub pa'i rtags mtshan gyi rnam thar 'ga' gleng / rje btsun ma dang / thang rang sprul sku/ stag lung sprul sku rnam gsum 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bla mar sku mched du 'khrungs/ dgung lo zhe bzhi ba shing phag1925lor sku gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku gung ru skal bzang dam chos sgrol ma ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me byi1926lor reb gong rgyal bo'i 'brog sde nas yab mkhar rtse dang yum klu mo thar gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen pos mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste dgung lo bdun par gdan sar bkod/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i drung nas gtsug phud phul te mtshan gsol/ rje nyid kyi drung nas zab don bsnyen rgyud kyi phyag len lhur bzhes gnang ste blang dor bka' ba'in bsgrubs/ bla ma'i bka' ba'in sku 'bum byams pa gling nas grwa mang la gcod kyi lung 'ga' thob/ rgyud sde cho ga gang yod bstan pa 'phel phyir bsnyen pa — 112 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mdzad/ brag dkar 'du khang dang gdan sa'i lha khang sogs zhig gsos mdzad/ 1956lor rgyal khab nang phyogs su gong rim nas lta skor la khrid/ 1961lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwar zhugs pa la phyir lo mthar phyin dpang rtags gnang / 1962lor zhing chen na gzhon mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs u yon la bdams/de'i rjes su kha gya stod nas ngal rtsol du lo 'ga' zhugs/ chos sgo slar gso phye bas na rgan gya'i slob grwa'i mtshan 'dzin slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes te slob grwa yar ldan du song bar gong gi bya dga' gnang / rgan gya dang rkang tsha'i sa rtsod bar la phebs nas phan ldan legs 'dum byung / gong sa paṇa chen bcu ba mchog nas khong la na bza' cha tshang gnang / thu'u bkwan bdun pas phyag phreng bstsal/ khul rdzong gi srid gros rgyun las u yon/khul nang bstan tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ khul bud med mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi 'thus mi/ bla brang jo mo dge btsun ma dag gi dgon pa'i kru'u rin sogs kyi 'gan bzhes/gzhan yang zab don bsnyen rgyud kyi 'phrin las spel ba'i sde 'di'i gtsug lag khang rgya che zhing / mkha' spyod bde stong e waṃ dga' 'khyil pho brang du bzhugs pa'i gung ru mkha' 'gro ma khong nyid dang / yongs 'dzin dam pa/ gnyer dpon po zhabs phyi ba sogs rgyun bzhugs grwa ba bcu phrag tsam yod cing / sku gong ma'i phyag srol ltar chos spyod spel/ sngon chad nang chen rang la su rig mtsho sngon rdo sbis dang hor gtsang tsag tsag rgan gya'i mkhar lung sogs su sa zhing / la nag tu nags tshal bcas yod cing / 1958lo'i rjes su rten brten pa tshang ma 'jig nyams su song / da lta rgan gya'i mang tshogs thun mong nas bskyar du gzim khang / bde mchog dang ma cig lab sgron gyi sku brnyan bka' bstan mgon po'i rten sogs gsar du bzhengs te rnam pa gsar ba'i mchod zhing du gyur to/ /kha dkar sgar dga' ldan bstan 'phel gling /kha dkar sgar dga' ldan bstan 'phel gling ni/ gan lho'i bsang chu rdzong rgan gya zhang kha gya sde ba'i dbus su chags/mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing rta spyi lo18 24lor g.yer gshong dge 'dun zla grags kyis phyag 'debs mdzad cing bca' yig ba'ag 'jam mgon khri rin po che sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pos skyong khur bzhes/ phyis su jag dmag gis gtor/ 'phro lus byin rten 'ga' zhig brag dkar dgon du spyan drangs te bzhugs zer/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags 'brug2 0 0 0lo'i zla dang bo'i nang du stag lung sprul sku skal bzang lung rigs rgya mtshos kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi zhabs brtan du dmigs te ri khrod gnas su gdugs dkar 'bum khang che legs can zhig bzhengs rgyu'i bkod khyab gnang ste dbu btsugs/ da dung 'bum khang nang rten du rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan dang / bla mchod tshogs zhing / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang sum cu lhag kha bya'i sde bas bzhengs/ 'bum khang mthar ma ṇi — 113 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'khor lo bsgrigs pa dang / stag lung tshang dang gung ru tshang rnam gnyis nas gzhis byes kun tu bstan pa'i bya ba gang byas gegs med lhun grub 'ong ba'i thugs smon gnang / de dang nye bar kun mkhyen gong ma 'khrungs sa lhas khra sdings yod/ 1995lor bā sde gzhung nas zhus par bse rdo rje 'chang rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gis ser skya khri phrag brgal ba la thugs rje chen po dpal mo'i lugs kyi dbang dang / gdugs dkar gyi dbang / bde mchog zas mchod dang bde mchog smon lam sogs kyi lung bstsal/ yang bse bla ma nyid nas bā sde'i yul gnyan stobs btsan zhes pa dang nye logs gnam lha gong ma'i lab rtse rnams bstad cing rang byung gi mtshan ma mngon par grags/ sde dkyil gyi rta mgrin 'bum khang ma ṇis bskor pa der rab gnas bgyis/ ma ṇi smyung gnas kyi rgyun btsugs/ kun mkhyen blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog bā sde sting ring du sku gong ma'i 'khrungs gzhis thab sgyed du ma yum gyi phyag rjes/ bla ma lung gi bzhugs khri sogs yod sar phebs/ yang bā sde nas sgrol ma'i lha khang dang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang / kun mkhyen gtso bzhugs lha khang gsum bzhengs/ skyabs mgon mchog dang / rje gung thang tshang / bse sprul ba'i sku rin po che/ rje thu'u bkun tshang sogs bla chen khag dang / bla brang rgyud stod grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa phebs nas rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs mdzad de byin rlabs kyi gter chen po bsgrubs/ da lta lha khang rnams bla brang dgon pas bdag dam mdzad de dkor gnyer las sne gtong bzhin mchod 'bul byas so/ /lha chab sgar bslab gsum dar rgyas gling /lha chab sgar bslab gsum dar rgyas gling ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong mda' smad zhing gi khongs su chags/dgon pa 'di ni rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob hor bka' bcu ba dang / hor rab 'byams pa gnyis kyis btab/ gdan rabs rdzogs ldan gtam gyi rang sgra zhes bya ba las/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ma dgon yin zer te/ rgyu mtshan ni bkra shis 'khyil gsar tshugs kyi dbu chos gnyis po dgon 'di nas phebs pa yin la/ rje skal ldan ras pas kun mkhyen bla mar dbus su 'byon dgos kyi bkas bskul tshul/ sku tshe gang bo'i mdzad pa zhal gdams su lung bstan tshul bcas bse khri rgan ngag dbang bkra shis kyis gsungs par dpag na'ang dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i zhal bkod dpog 'dug skad/ de bzhin kun mkhyen mchog gis dgon 'di'i dge 'dun pa rnams bla brang gi smon lam dang / bdun pa'i rigs grwar phebs chog pa'i dmigs bsal btod cing / da dung gaṅga'i rgyun ldan 'dzad med lha yi chab/ /bslab gsum nyams med skyong ba'i dar rgyas gling / /zhes bsngags/ bar skabs shig la bkra shis 'khyil ba dang reb gong shog pa'i bar 'khrugs te lha chab dgon pa nyams/ dgon shul du btsun bgres tshul khrims zer ba gcig po lus pa las gzhan dag bla brang gi chos grwar 'grims/ phyis su kun mkhyen bzhi ba dang shar bla ma'i bka' drin thugs rje las gyod don — 114 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bsdums pa dang gter lung phyogs nas dgon pa zhig gso bgyi bar rogs ram thob/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i ring bla spyi gzhung gsum gyis 'du khang sogs bskyar bzhengs legs par grub pa dang / kun mkhyen nyid nas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgo nas rab gnas gnang / kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang gnang zhing sgrub mchod gsar du btsugs/ de nas kun mkhyen lnga ba lan du mar phebs nas 'chad nyan spel ba dang bca' yig mdzad/ bde thang blo bzang nyi mas shog pa'i skya ser thun mong la dbang lung thengs 'ga' bstsal to/ /dgon pa'i nang rten gtso bo la thugs rje chen po'i sku brnyan byin can dang / paṇa chen dgu bas gnang ba'i rje tsong kha ba chen po'i sku li ma bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ bla brang mkhan pos gnang ba'i spyi don sham bha la'i thang ga khrag rgyun 'bab pa/ da dung gser dang zangs sam sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i sku che 'bring chung sum brgya brgyad cu lhag bzhugs/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur bris ma dang / bla ma seng gdong bas sbyor 'jags gnang ba'i lha rdzas mchod cha/ seng gdong zangs rkang byin can bcas yod la/ dgon pa'i chos thog gi rim pa ni/ zla dang bo'i nang smon lam bkra shis 'khyil ba dang mnyam tshogs/ zla gnyis par dgon nang chos spyod/zla gsum par bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ zla bzhi bar maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba nyin gcig dang ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin zhag bcu gcig zla lnga bar yul lha gzhi bdag ste khra rtsi dang sde brgyad/ ser bdag bcas pa'i rim gro nyin gcig zla drug par gnas bcu'i phyag mchod dang dzam dkar gter sgrub nyin gnyis/zla drug par dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par gnod sbyin shaṃbha la'i gtor zlog nyin gsum/ zla dgu bar kun rig sgrub mchod sbyin sreg nyin drug zla bcu bar lnga mchod dang mgon chos lnga'i rnga 'chang nyin drug zla bcu gnyis par dge bskos kyi lta rtog bzhin dge 'dun pa rang rang gi bsnyen sgrub ci thon/ zla bcu gcig par sbyin sreg dang sku rim rnam gsum sogs 'phrin bcol rgya che'o/ /dus rgyun zla yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong chag med thog kun rig dang lha mo/ rnam sras kyi cho ga'i 'don rta/ gtor ma bca' bzo sogs bla brang dus 'khor dngos dang / cho ga gzhan dag gi phyag len 'don rta bla brang rgyud med ltar spel/ dgon pa'i las sne la dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi ba che chung / dkor gnyer bcas yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i rjes su dgon pa'i lha rten mchod gsum bsnubs/ btsun pa thams cad dgon sde gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rang rang khyim du log1981lo lcags bya la dad ldan mang tshogs skom pa chu ltar dad pa'i shugs kyis chos sgo phye nas 'du khang bskyar du bzhengs pa dang bde mchog gtsos pa'i sku brnyan thams cad slar legs 'grub byung / khyad par du dge slong byams pas rgyan drug mchog gnyis bzo drub thang ga sbyor 'jags gnang / sprul sku dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtshos sde 'di'i srung ma spyan drangs nas chos 'phrin tshul bzhin bsgrubs/ rje rab brtan rgya mtsho bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho bas rten thang zhig dang / mda' smad rdo rje gtsos dbyen zlum mchod rten sku — 115 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'bum nas blus/ rje dge legs ma rten gtsor bzhugs/ rje gung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis mchod rten la rab gnas dang skabs de'i dge 'dun pa 'al nyi shu bor shog sgor lnga bcu re'i 'gyed btang /dgon par sngon chad mkhas grags che ba rgyud pa'i dpon slob hor blo gsal rgya mtsho zhes pa yin la/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang 'jam dbyangs dang / hor kha gyar 'khrungs pa'i seng gdong sprul sku bcas yin no/ /zom chen ri khrod/zom chen ri khrod ni/ kun lho 'i bsang chu rdzong mda' smad 'ing lha chab bslab gsum dar rgyas gling gi thag nyer chags/a ma do chos 'byung du rje skal lda na pa'i dngos slob hor bka' bcu ba dang / hor rab 'byams pa gnyis kyis btab pa lha chab dgon dang / zom chen ri khrod gnyis su ga'i gsum gyi phyag len ma nyams pa skyong gsungs pa'i gnas de yin cing / phyis su dben pa'i ri khrod 'di nas grub dbang sde khri tshang dang / mkhan sprul ngag dbang dge legs nga 'i sprul sku ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis ri khrod zhig gsos dang /ri khrod du bcad rgyar bzhugs/ ri khrod 'di'i sto da smad du snga sor sde khri dang mkhan po zung gi nang chen gyi nags tshal yod/ dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri rabs zhe gsum pa su nyid dge 'dun dar rgyas sku phreng gnyis pa sog po nas 'khrungs pa'i dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho bla brang phyag mdzod kyi dgongs pa grol rjes rwa zi brag dkar dang / zom chen ri khrod nas sgrub pa la gzhol skad/ de'i sprul sku rgan gya nas 'khrungs pa skal bzang grags pa rgya mtsho da lta ba yin/ ri khrod 'di rab byung bcu drug pa'i 'go tsam la jag dmag gis me btang nas bsnubs rjes nyam sa gso cher ma byas so/ /o brtan sgar bsam 'phel dar rgyas gling /o brtan sgar bsam 'phel dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi mda' smad zhing gi sran thang du chags/sgrub grwa 'di ni bse sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis(1729da wa1812)mchog gis phyag 'debs ma dzad/ ha lam spyi lo1800lo yas mas su dgon chags par gleng / srung ma dam can bsten/ sngon chad dgon par 'du khang dang / bse'i gzim chung / 'gying rgan gzim chung / grwa shag bcu phrag bcas bzhengs shing dge 'dun pa zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa grangs bzhugs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtso bo sran thang dang g.yis khug sde ba yin/ bse bla ma'i bca' yig bsrungs/ gter lung dgon pa'i le lag tu gyur/ de bzhin du bse bla ma sku phreng rim byon te khyad par bse sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rjes bdag skyong ci thub gnang bas sgar ba bskyar gso la phan pa shin tu che ba thogs/ rten du gtso bo kun mkhyen gnyis pas gnang ba'i ston pa dang / byams sku/ rje sku/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ tshe dpag — 116 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/med/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs li ma kho na brgya lhag dang sman sku mi nyung ba bzhengs/ bka' bstan 'gyur/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ rje'i gsung 'bum/ tshogs 'don cha tshang bcas pota lnga brgya lhag dang byang chub mchod rten sogs li ma gsum bzhugs/ las sne la rdo rje 'dzin pa dang dbu mdzad/ dge bskos sogs bsko res byed cing / lo hril bo'i chos thog smad rgyud ltar 'chad nyan sgom sgrub 'brel sgos bde mchog ma rgyud gtsos pa'i srol bstar ba la/ spyi'i chos thog zla gcig par gsang 'dus mgon chos/ dus mchod chog rkyang / gnyis par kun rig dang dam can bskang gso/ gsum par ltu nga bshags phyag mchod/bzhi bar ma ṇi bum sgrub/ lnga bar rje tsong kha ba'i stong mchod/ drug par dbyar gnas dang gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ dgu bar gsang 'dus bdag 'jug bcu bar lnga mchod nyin gsum/ bcu gcig par gsang 'dus chog rkyang / bcu gnyis par sku rim dang chos skyong gtor bsngo sogs ma nyams rgyun chags su dar zhing 'jam dbyangs skal ldan dang tshul khrims phun tshogs dang thabs mkhas bcas rang sa'i skyes chen du rtsis pa byung / spyi lo192 5lo(bod rab tshe shing glang /) la dmag shed mā chis bla brang du dpung 'jug btsan gnon byed skabs su o brtan dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa mang bo 'phrog bcom dang sreg zar gtums nas re zhig nyams par gyur kyang phyis su slar gsos/ sngon chad o brtan thang dang sdom phreng rtsa yan chad/ tsha tshi nyin ga man chad dgon pa'i sa yin skad/ der mu'u gsum tsam gyi sa khyon du rab rgyal sa khyir yang bskyar bsnubs rjes da lta 'du khang stabs bde khang mig bzhi can dang grwa shag gsum phub/ btsun pa dgung lo gya gsum pa bzhes pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dang chung ba brgyad las ma 'dus kyang / khong nyid kyis o brtan sgar gyi bstan pa'i me ro slar gso ba la thugs tshegs byed bzhin pa dang bse bla mas dam can chos srung zhig gnang /1981lor gling sku phreng bzhi ba'i 'al bkod ltar sdong bo mdo du lha chab byams pas thig rtsa bzung ste rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs so/ /gter lung dgon yid dga' chos 'dzin gling /gter lung dgon yid dga' chos 'dzin gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong lbang gur thang zhing gi shar nye ru chags te bse sku phreng rim byon gyi gdan sa yin/dgon pa'i lo rgyus bsdus su dkod na/ zhi byed gcod kyi gdams pa'i mnga' bdag ma cig lab kyi sgron mas/ ( 10 21— 1129) 'byung 'gyur sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang skye 'gro'i bde skyid yun ring 'phel rgyas sogs dgos pa du ma'i ched/ yum sras so sos rang rang gi thugs bskyed dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus bab dang bstun pa'i thugs smon yang dag pa gnang ste gter rdzas bsags/ sras che ba thod smyon rdo rje seng ges gter bum bzos/ stong sde ngag gi dbang phyug gis gter yig bris/ ma cig rang gis gter bum rgyas btab cing / bkra shis pa'i gter rdzas sna tshogs bsnams nas yum sras 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul gyi ngang — 117 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/g.ya' ri'i rmig lung du byon/ gter lung gi lung ba'i phug gnas der klu bdud nag po'i pho brang dang /'og tu pha bong dkar bo bong bu nyal ba 'dra ba/ brag sog po/ chu mig gsum yod/ (chu mgo dngos/)phug de'i byang ri seng ge phyogs bltas su nyal ba g.ya'/ ri rgyud mchod rten brtsegs 'dra sar brag ri dzam lha'i lto ba 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i nang du gter sbas/ chos rgyal dang zhal bzhi ba gnyis la gtad de yum sras rnams slar e lab tu rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs zhes grags/ lung ba'i mdor rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs zhes grags/lung ba'i mdor brag lha mgon po dang / chos rgyal ri yod/ brag sgom pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na rab byung gnyis pa'i yos(1099)lor lab sgron 'khrungs pa'i dbang du byas na/ dgung lo gya drug pa rab byung gsum pa'i shing 'brug( 1184)lo'i hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin gter sbas par gsungs so/ /de nas bzung gter lung du grags/ de'i rjes tsam du 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i (1142da wa1217)dngos slob 'bri gung rin chen bzang bo dang / tsho bzhi'i dge bsnyen/ tsong kha'i rdor bzang sogs grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba gtso 'khor 'ga' 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor ba gtso 'khor 'ga' 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa spel phyir yul mdo smad du lhags shing / stag tshang lha mo brgyud de g.ya' ri'i rmog lung 'dir phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa dang / klu bdud btsan gsum dam la btags/ kha gnon du mgar ba'i sol khung du grags pa'i gnas su(tis rtags ri )mgar ba'i til tsha zhes grags pa'i mchod rten mgo mjug bzlog par brtsigs/ ri mthon po'i mdor dung g.yas 'khyil gyi mtshan ma yod sar(dgon pa'i rgyab ri)gter mang bo sbas/ brag lha mgon po'i rtsar mgon po zhal bzhi ba zhal gzigs te slar brag la thim/sa 'dul gyi rdo 'bum dang bla rtse 'ga' re yang brtsigs par grags so/ /'bri gung mkhas pa mi gsum du grags pa gnas 'dir bzhugs skabs su/ yul 'dir phyug skor sde ba bzhugs pa'i sngags 'chang rnal 'byor ba nyan po lha rgyal du grags pa de ni 'bri gung rin bzang ba'i slob mar gyur te 'bri gung mkhas pa rnam gsum gyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i shul du/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin rab byung ba'i ba'i chu rta (1222) lor phyogs de'i grwa rgyun 'ga' bsdus te dgon chung zhig gsar 'debs mdzad cing /'du khang bzhengs/ de nas bzung gter lung dgon du grags/ de dus dgon pa'i yi dam gtso bo rta mgrin yang gsang dang rdo rje phur bu ba byas pas bka' rnying 'dres ma'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i sde zhig tu snang / phyis su bla brang rang nas yang gsang dang phur bu lo re ba'in ma chad pa byed pa'i srol ma nyams par yod pa'ang de'i rkyen gyis red/ nyan po'i gdung rgyud de las mkhas pa du ma byon nas sde 'di rim gyis bskyangs/ gdung rgyud de las 'khrungs pa'i nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan(nam 'khrungs mi gsal)zhes bya ba dbus su byon te rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog mjal/ chos 'brel zhus/ de dus 'bri gung dang sne gdong bar sde gzar khel bas/khong nyid 'bri gung thel du bzhugs ma bde bar 'bras spungs su phebs nas yun ring bzhugs shing slar rang yul du phebs/ rab byung dge ba'i sa rta(155rdo)lor pha bong ri khrod dang rta rdzong ri khrod sogs gter lung — 118 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon du bsdus nas dgon pa dge lugs par bsgyur cing / grwa btsun lnga brgya shong ba'i 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ de la nyan po'i 'du khang du grags/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dkyil tsam la grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho g.ya' ri'i rmog lung gi phug tu phebs nas sgom sgrub yun ring mdzad/ sa de la sgom khang thod zer/ de dus nyan po bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus mdo smad du phebs te chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil btab pa'i rjes su/ khong gis sa phyogs 'di na ma cig lab sgron gyis rje rang gi skal ba'i gter zhig sbas pa 'dra zhes sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon par shes pa gsal bor yang yang gsungs kyang /dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi thugs brel dbang gis re zhig lus/ khong dgung lo don gcig bzhes pa'i skabs shig glo bur du da gter 'don pa'i dus yin gsungs te/ phyogs so so'i sa ming dri ba mdzad par bu slob 'gas phyogs 'di na gter lung zer ba'i sa yod ces zhus pas/ lab sgron gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /rdo rje'i ming du sprul nas kyang / /gter chos 'di la spyod par shog / ces gsungs pa de nga yin gsungs/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi( 1718 )lo'i hor zla dang bo'i yar tshes la gter lung du phebs/ gter kha ma rnyed pa'i tshul gyis phyogs so sor btsal pa'i skabs su/ brag mgo nas bya rog zhig 'phur 'ongs shing shug sdong gi lo ma bcad pa zhig brag rtsar 'phangs/ chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul du ma khyen nas de'i rtsar phebs na pa brag ngos su gter sgo yod pa gzigs nas kun mkhyen mchog thugs shin tu mnyes te zhabs zhu ba rnams la brag sgo rko ru bcug pas rko ma thub/ kun mkhyen mchog gi thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis pa la khyod song nas rkos zhes gsungs pas thugs sras tshang gis brag srubs shig yod pa gzigs nas de rko bar brtsam pa na/ brag srubs de rang shugs su chen por gyur/ kun mkhyen thugs mnyes te/ ngag dbang bkra shis la khyod rang brag phug tu song la gter gang yod longs gsungs pas/ gter bum dang / tshe sku/ chos dung dkar po/ gter yig bcas blangs nas kun mkhyen la phul cing / slar brag phug tu phebs tsa na/ brag srubs de sgo brgyab pa lta bur dam por song bas thugs sras tshang gi sku gzan kyang brag sbugs su lus pas/ kun mkhyen gyis khyod rang gis rjes su gter kha 'di bsrung dgos pa 'dra gsungs/brag sgo'i shul du dzam lha 'brug zhon pa'i bum gter bzhag pa dang / brag ngos la gter bton tshar zhes rdo yig brkos/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi bzhugs khri bcas da lta yang mjal du yod/de ltar kun mkhyen yab sras gnas der zla ba gcig lhag tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ nyan po dka' bcu bas gter lung dgon du kun mkhyen yab sras gdan drangs/ chos 'brel zhus te kun mkhyen mchog la dgon pa phul pa na/ kun mkhyen gyis/ ngas gnas 'dir gter blangs pas don grub/ ngag dbang bkra shis pa rten 'brel 'grig la/ ming yang bzang bas/ khyod kyis dgon pa 'di la bdag po byos zhes gsungs/thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis ( 1678—1728) kyis bla ma'i bka' spyi bor blangs nas dgon pa'i — 119 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bca' yig ljags rtsom mdzad dus de nas bzung gter lung dgon pa thugs sras sku phreng rim byon gyis 'dzin bdag gnang ste bshad sgrub chos spyod bcu'i bya ba spel ba'i gdan sa'i gtso bor gyur to/ /kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa'i rdo rje'i thugs sras dam pa smra ba'i dbang phyug khri chen bse ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang bo ni/ mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha reb gong gser mo ljongs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnas bdag se gu bya khyung zhes pa'i gnas ri'i nye 'dabs bse nya lung zhes pa'i sde bar/ yab rin chen skyabs dang yum rong bo dge ring snying mo byams zhes bya ba'i sras su/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho rta'i( 1678 ) lor sku bltams/ dgung lo drug steng grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob mgar gong tshe brtan rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la sbyin pa rgya mtsho gsol/ dgung lo dgu bar mkhan po de nyid kyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo bcu drug pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu bya( 1692 ) lor/ yab dang 'grogs nas dbus su phebs pa'i lam du 'jug pa'i skabs su/ gnas bdag rnams la dam bca' phul te kho bo dbus su slob gnyer la song nas rang gzhan la phan thogs nges kyi yon tan zhig ma byung bar rang yul du log na/ khyod rnams kyis nga tshar chod ces dam bca' mdzad/ dbus su byon te mkhas grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi ya gyal bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ sgo mang slob dpon don grub rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag mnos/ yun mi ring bar bgro gleng legs par mdzad thub pa byung / skabs shig sngon gyi bag chags kyis bskul pas/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyi tshad ma'i gzhung la sbyang 'dod skom pa chu 'dod lta bu byung bas/ dgung lo bcu bdun par rwa stod du phebs/ 'dzin grwa gsum gyi tshig bzhag thugs 'dzin mdzad de/skyor sbyangs mdzad bzhin zhabs la khrag rdol gyi bar rje'i rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad khang zer ba'i sku 'bul la skor ba mdzad pas lung rigs smra ba la 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang bsnyes/ dgung lo bco brgyad par slar bkra shis sgo mang du phebs nas slob dpon 'od zer rgya mtsho'i drung nas/ phar phyin yongs rdzogs dang dbu ma gsan sbyong mdzad pa dang / gzhung sar phar phyin gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyugs ring phul pas/rgyal dbang drug pa chen pos thugs dgyes pa'i gsung dang gnang cha gang rgyas bstsal/ dpe gzigs dang skyor sbyangs sbrags ltu nga bshags gsungs nas gshar sbyong mchod 'bul sogs la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu brtson pas/ na bza' dang chas ka gra bsgrigs lta ci/ tha na na bza'i phral 'tshem tsam yang mi gnang bar tshogs chos grwa la phebs nas dus 'da' ba dang / zhabs rjen yun ring phebs pas 'bas la ser kha chen po byung ste khrag 'dzags pa kun gyis mthong / khang tshan ra skor du mtshan skyor mdzad pa'i tshe/ gzim dkrog pa'i ched du pha bong zhig la rdo rdeg bzhin tshig bzhag skyor bas pha bong de rdo snod chen po lta bu zhig tu song ba snga sor klu 'bum khang tshan na mjal du yod/ yang gzim spyil nang du mtshan skyor gyi tshe mgrin pa la thag pa btags nas lcam gyi gseb tu 'char bus sbrel te brtol nas tshig bzhag skyor bar mdzad pas mgrin pa sha smen yod pa zhal slob — 120 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rnams kyis gleng / lan cig snyung ga'i drag po byung ste dge 'phel ri khrod du kun mkhyen rin po cher skyabs 'jug zhu bar btang bas dgyes bzhin srung mdud dang bum chu gnang ba la tshur 'ong dus phyi dbugs chad pas mal sogs spos tshar kyang srung mdud bcings/ bum chu zhal du blugs ma thag dran pa sangs zhing dbugs kyi rgyu ba byung / de dus yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho 'bras spungs su bzhugs yod pas/ rje 'di ba bsnyen rdzogs ma thob par 'chi ba la thugs 'phreng ba gsan nas chos gos shig gnang / ming la dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes btags pa yin gsungs/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa lcags 'brug lor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi slob dpon du phebs/ khong gis kun mkhyen gyi drung nas dbu ma rigs tshogs/ bud dha pā lu ta/ tshig gsal sogs 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung dang / rtsa 'jug ṭīk+ka dang stong thun sogs rje yab sras kyi gsung ngam dbu ma'i gzhung la gsan sbyong mthar phyin mdzad/ phyis su lung rigs gter mdzod kyi smad cha dang stod cha'i sems bskyed gsum pa'i bar thugs 'dzin mdzad de kun mkhyen mchog la rgyugs ring yang phul pas mnyes pa chen po gnang / skabs 'dir mnal lam du bya rgod phung bo'i rir yang yang phebs pa dang / gtsug lag khang zhig na mgon po klu sgrub bzhugs pa'i mdun du slebs kyang / dar dkar gyi yol ba zhig gis bsgribs pa sogs rmi ltas byung / tshul de kun mkhyen mchog la zhus par/ khyed la stong nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i skal ba yod ces gsungs/ de ltar bka' pota lnga'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs shing / lhag par lta ba'i gnad la dpyad pa yun ring mdzad pas dgung lo nyer drug gi tshe lta ba 'phrul med rnyed par gsungs so/ /dgung grangs nyer bzhi bar yang 'dzin grwa gsham du babs te kun mkhyen mchog gi drung nas dbu ma cha tshang tshar gnyis gsan sbyong mdzad de dogs pa'i cha phra mo tshun chad bsal nas mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ dgung grangs nyer lnga ba chu rta lo'i zla ba bcu ba'i tshe drug la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mkhan po gnang ste dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs te tshul khrims kyi phung bo yongs su rdzogs pa'i gter du gyur/dus de nas mya ngan 'da' bar du/ sku chings bkrol pa dang glo sa la phab nas gzim ma myong bar mtshan mor gzim dus yang tsog pu 'ba' zhig la gzims pas sbyangs pa'i yon tan mnga' brnyes/ dam chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa bzhin phyag len du thebs pa mdzad nas lhung ba'i nyes byas phra mo tshun chad nas ma gos par/bslab khrims mig 'bras bzhin bsrungs/ snyigs dus kyi nye bar 'khor gnyis pa lta bur kun gyis thun mong du gleng ngo / /dgung grangs nyer brgyad par bka' pota chen po lnga'i sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad nas gsang phur bka' bcu'i mtshan btags gnang bas mkhas pa'i snyan pa phyogs kun tu grags/ dgung grangs nyer dgu bar shog lhung sta gon byas te kun mkhyen rin po che'i drung du rgyud la phebs rgyur dgongs pa zhus pa na kun mkhyen mchog gi zhal nas/ da 'gro ran song bas gsang sngags kyi gzhungamatha' dag la slob gnyer bzang thag chod cig gyis zhes dgyes bzhin gnang ba bstsal/ rje nyid kyi thugs la so so skye bo'i blo la nges pa med pas dam — 121 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bca' zhig bya dgos dgongs/ rgyud pa'i grwa ja zhig gi skabs su bdag rgyud grwa la zhugs nas bskyed rdzogs ṭīkra dang bcas pa'i gzhung don yongs su rdzogs pa dpyis phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i bar du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar bcad na ye shes kyi mgon po dang dam can chos kyi rgyal po gnyis kyis nga rang tshar chod cig ces dam bca' nan po mdzad/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i drung du/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la gsan sbyong yu na ring gnang bas/ lo der ṭīka chen yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin mdzad/rgyud pa slo ba dpon gyi drung du bskyed rdzogs dang rgyud 'grel rdzogs par gsan te dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod nga/nga yang mdzad pas tshig don yongs rdzogs byang chub pa'i pha rol tu son/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i drung du'ang 'brel ba batshi sbrags kyi gzab bshad thengs du mar gsan/ dgung grangs so gcig par chu mig lung du rig ‘snga'i dmar khrid bskyangs skabs nya gcig 'og sgo nas zhugs pa'i snang ba byung bas/ de ni rtsa dbu ma'i mang du rlung zhugs 4nas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i 'od gsal gyi nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas su gsungs/'o nger rgyud kyi dam bca' chen mo mdzad skabs/ mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyang rje 'di'i rnam dpyod 'gran zla dang bral bar gzigs nas sngags brjod yang yang gnang ba sogs ma ḍabar shing grags pa'i snyan pa phyogs kun tu khyab po/ /sngo na a ma lab sgron gyi spyan sngar thugs smon mja da pa'i 'bras bu dus su babs pas/ dgung grangs so gnyes pa sa glang ( 1709)lor kun mkhyen rin po che'i zhabs phyir mdo smad du byon/ lam bar du phyag g.yo ga gang dgos zhus pa'i zhar la nyin mo mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad la dogs gcod dang / mtshan mor gzim gur la phyag skor dang 'brel po ti lnga'i skyor sbyangs mdzad pas kun mkhyen nyid kyang sngar las lhag pa'i thugs ma nyes byung / de ltar mdo smad du byon nas kyang kun mkhyen mchog sku ma 'das kyi bar du mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas te sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa/ 'phags seng gi snang ba gnyis/ byams chos lnga/'jug pa rang 'grel/ lam rim che chung sogs gzhung du ma'i bshad pa dang / khrid chen brgyad dang / man ngag rnam gsum sogs srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ lcags stag la rtse gzhung du grwa tshang gsar tshugs skabs su rje 'di ba dge bskos mdzad de yab sras grwa tshang dang bcas pas 'chad nyan mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang rgyog mdo brgyud de bkra shis 'khyil du phebs tshe/kun mkhyen mchog gis dgon gnas la mar me'i brtag pa byed rgyu yin pas/ bkra shis 'khyil/ glas drugagad pa lug mang gsum gyi skal du mar me gsum khyer shog gsungs/ rje 'dis bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas skal gyi mar me phul pa la/ kun mkhyen mchog gis rten 'brel gyi gnad du dgongs nas rje 'di la khyod kyis kyang mar me la brtag par gyis gsungs pa ltar brtag pa mdzad pas yab sras gnyis ga'i mar me bkra shis 'khyil du mthun 'dug pas bkra shis 'khyil du dgon pa 'debs par thugs brtag bcad/ kun mkhyen mchog gis sa brtags pa dang bslang ba lto 'phye thig gdab pa sogs gnang tshe rje 'di la las kyi rdo rjes gsungs — 122 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa ltar ma dzad/ lo de'i sto na khar kun mkhyen mchog gis sngar sgo mang chos grwar bzhes pa'i ras ber dang /zhwa mo rnams gnang ste khyod rang bla ma gyis la 'di gyon nas chos khri'i steng tshig bzhag thongs zhes bka' nan gnang ba ltar lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sde'i 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la 'bas kyi pad mo nye bar 'khod do/ / de'i tshe rje khong chos grwar phebs dus rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i khri la skor ba dang g.yon ngos nas phyag gsu ma mdzad de khri la bzhugs/ zla 'di'i tshes bco lnga la gso sbyong gi mgon du thog mar byon nas so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ de nas bzung dgung lo re gcig gi bar 'chad nyan sha stag mdzad cing / chos thog tu ma zad chos mtshams la yang rtsi ba'ag chas med du btang nas/ lo drug gi khongs su 'dzin grwa bcu gsum la po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan tshugs thub pa byung ngo / /dgung grangs so drug par kun mkhyen rin po che'i drung du mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang dang mgon po'i rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub kyi man ngag 'ib rgyas dang rje 'di gcig pu la drug cu ba'i man ngag 'al shes ba7'a rgya ma gnang /shing lug lo'i smon lam dang gsung chos la kun mkhyen mchog nyin 'gar phebs rjes/ da nas bzung rje 'di la khyod kyis lo ltar smon lam dang gsung chos rgyas pa re ma chad pa gyis gsungs pa ltar/ rje 'di dgung lo drug cu ba'i steng bsnyun tshabs chen ngo bzhes pa'i bar lo ltar smon lam dang gsung chos rgyas pa gnang / /lo 'dir kun mkhyen mchog gi bka' ba'in rigs grwa dang gling bsre gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgung grangs so brgyad par phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i tshig gcig kyang ma chad pa'i rtsi bzhag btang tshar bar kun mkhyen rin po che thugs shin tu mnyes/ lo de'i dgun chos la phar phyin ston mo gsar du tshugs/ dgung grangs bzhi bcu bar kun mkhyen rin po che'i drung du rim lnga gsal sgron gyi gzab bshad dang mgon po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa shog dril bcu gsum pa sogs mkhas grub rjes bsgrigs pa'i be'u bum gyi skor phal cher gas na/ zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la kun mkhyen mchog nas/ khyed rang 'du khang steng du spos gsungs pa lta ra de nas bzung 'du khang ya nga rtser phyag phebs te bzhugs/ de dag gi skabs kun mkhyen mchog gis tshig ba'ag la myur myur gyis zhes ya nga yang gsungs pas/ lo der gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa dang po la dbu ma yo ngas rdzogs kyi tshig bzhag gnang /dgung lo zhe gcig pa sa khyi( 1781 ) lo'i smon lam grol nas kun mkhyen rin po che dang lhan du gter lung la phebs te gter sgo yod par gzigs nas kun mkhyen mchog thugs shin tu mnyes nas zhabs phyi ba rnams la brag rko ru bcug pas rko ma thub/ de nas kun mkhyen mchog gis rje 'di la khyod song la rkos zhes gsungs pa ltar brkos pa brag srubs shig yod pa gzigs nas de rko bar brtsams pa na brag srubs de rang ba'in gyis chen por gyur/ kun mkhyen rin po che thugs shin tu mnyes te rje 'di la khyed rang brag phug tu song la gter gang yod longs gsungs pas/ gter bum dang tshe sku/ chos dung dkar po/ gter yig rnams spyan drangs te kun mkhyen la phul rjes brag srubs rang bzhin gyis sgo brgyab pa lta bur dam por song bas/ rje 'di'i sku — 123 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gzan kyang brag phug tu lus pas/ kun mkhyen gyis/ khyod kyis rjes su gter sgo 'di bsrung dgos pa 'dra gsungs/ de ltar yab sras 'khor bcas gnas 'dir zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs ring / nyan po dka' bcu bas gter lung dgon du gdan drangs te dgon pa phul pa na/ kun mkhyen mchog gis/ gnas 'dir gter blangs zin pas da bsam don grub/ khyod kyi ming bzang bas phyin chad dgon pa 'di la'ang bdag po gyis gsungs par brten rje nyid nas dgon pa'i bca' yig ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas kun mkhyen mchog la gsang rnam rtsa ba'i lung zhus par 'bul ba zhig khyer shog gsungs par/ rje 'dis gos chen dkar po yug gcig dar ljang yug gcig bcas 'bul tshan bcu gsum pa phul te dgon pa 'dir skye ba bcu gsum la skyong ba'i smon lam 'debs zhus pas/ kun mkhyen mchog nas dar gos 'dom la 'jal dgos gsungs te/gos dar yug gnyis ka phyag gis 'dom la gzhal pas/ 'dom bcu gsum re byung bar kun mkhyen mchog shin tu thugs mnyes nas/ khyed kyis smon lam btabs pa de ltar 'grub ces zhal bzhes gnang / yang kun mkhyen mchog gis/ rje 'di gcig pu la gshin rje'i snying khrag lta bu'i gdams pa shin tu gsang ba man ngag rnam gsum zhes grags pa'i man ngag zhal shes phyag khrid dang bcas pa zhib rgyas su gnang zhing mdor na drag po'i lam gcig pu yang zla ba gcig gi bar du gnang ste phyag len man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ dgung lo zhe bzhi bar/ kun mkhyen rin po che bsnyun bzhes tshul bstan par/ rje 'di nyid kyis ched dmigs su sku mtshams bcad nas mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang 'brel shā sa na bye ba bsgrubs pa dang /phyag rdzas gang yod zhabs brtan du phul nas brtan bzhugs dang zhabs brtan mang bo bsgrubs/ gzhan yang brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba yang yang btabs pas rjes su zhal bkod cig cis kyang gnang dgos zhes nan zhu mdzad pa la/ kun mkhyen mchog gis zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas/ khyod rang gi tshe gang bor 'chad nyan gyis/ zhes gsung gi tha ma bstsal/ de nas kun mkhyen mchog gis gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i sku gdung gi mdun du dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa dang / bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo bshad sgrub gyi 'chad nyan yin gsungs nas/ dpyid chos de nyid nas bzung lhag par du tshig bzhag dang rtsod pa la dmar bar mdzad do/ /dgung grangs zhe lnga bar sku bsnyun cung zad bzhes pas/ grwa mang nas zhabs brtan dang brtan bzhugs phul par/ gsungs las/ thos bsam las lhag pa'i zhabs brtan med pas slob gnyer la 'bad na/ sku phyogs rin po che nas nged la tshems gnang dus rje thams cad mkhyen pas 'jam dbyangs rje la tshems gnang ba'i dpe gsungs te/ 'jam dbyangs chos rjes 'bras spungs bskyangs pa ltar/ khyod kyis grwa tshang 'di skyong dgos gsungs pa dang / da dung gsung gzhan zhig kyang yod pas de dag la bsams na re zhig mi 'chi ba 'dra zhes gsungs/ de'i skabs rje nyid kyis dbu mdzad nas grwa ba sum cu dang bcas lhan du mgon po'i rgyas po'i gtor sgrub zhag dgu'i bar du bsgrubs/ nyin zhig sha ra ma 'then skabs rje 'di'i nyams snang la dom chen po — 124 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhig gi mchu rje'i mdun lcog la gtugs nas sna su ru ru byed cing / mjug ma tshom mdor thug pa/ spu mdog legs shin tu zhi zhing dul ba zhig yun ring gzigs/ de nas bzung nyin re bzhin gnod sbyin 'cham dbyangs re 'thon gsungs pa ltar gtor sgrub kyi dus su chag med mdzad/ lo de'i dgun gyi chos mtshams la gtsos sku skyes kyis gdan drangs pa ltar/ gtsos dgon par phebs nas bstan 'gyur la dge legs char 'bebs kyi sgo nas rab gnas sbyin sreg bcas pa mdzad/ dgung grangs zhe drug par kun mkhyen sku gdung mchod rten skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dang byams sku mthong ba don ldan gnyis grub par dge legs char 'bebs ltar gyi rab gnas dang sbyin sreg rgyas pa mdzad skabs rje nyid kyis chos 'jug bzhes pa na grwa mang kun gyis dpal mi skyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dngos su byon snyam pa ma gtogs/ mi phal ba'i rnam pa su la'ang mi 'char ba lta bu'i snang ba thun mong du gleng / lo 'dir byams khang gi g.yas phyogs kyi gtsang khang du kun mkhyen rin po che'i thugs dgongs ltar/ bzo bo dam tshig ldan pa a mgron ri khrod pas chos skyong rnams bzhengs mgo brtsams pa na/'jigs byed kyi nang rten du kun mkhyen gyis rje nyid la gnang ba'i 'khor lo khyad par can ring bsrel mang bo thugs bkod gnang ba las bri bsgrub mdzad pa'i srog shing sogs gzungs gzhug rnams man ngag ltar bzhugs pa dang / mgon po dang chos rgyal gyi nang rten du kun mkhyen rang nyid kyis bris sgrub mdzad pa'i srog 'khor bka' rgya ma rje 'di nyid la gnang ba de gnyis gtsor byas ga9zhan byin rten sna tshogs bzhugs pa dang / de dag gi rgyu 'jim pa spar gang rer nyid kyis ya ma ra dza du ma re gsungs te/ ljags sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang kun mkhyen gyis ya ma ra dza dung phyur gsungs pa'i ril bu dang shangs khrag mang du bsres te rgyud dang man ngag nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bzo bor thugs bkod phra zhib gnang ste/ 'jigs byed dang mgon chos gnyis kyi lder sku bzhengs/ skabs der grwa tshang la ras 'gyed cig byung bas grwa ba phal cher gyi sku skal la/ras de dag gi steng gzungs sngags nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad de bzhugs pas/ 'jim pa kho na tshon gang tsam las mi 'dug par gsungs so/ /lo snga phyi 'dir yul 'khrug gi dus gzar ha cang che ba'i rkyen gyis dgon par yang gleng ba sna tshogs byung /nyin zhig snga dro'i chos grwa 'tshogs rjes su/ nyid phebs nas sgrol ma tshar mang bo gsungs pa'i mjug tu tshogs gtam gnang ste gsung rgyur/ yul phyogs 'dir ji 'dra zhig byung yang nga tsho'i dgon pa la skyon mi 'ong / sku phyogs kyi gsung la/ bod kyi gtam dper mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim dbus ma dbus su 'ong ba las 'os med zer ba ltar/ 'dzam gling 'jig la thug kyang nga'i dgon pa 'di re zhig sa cung zad cig la brten te bsdad yod gsung yod pas/ khyod tshos zhed snang ma byed gsungs/ dus 'khrug gi rkyen gyis dgon pa'i mang ja sogs je zhan du song bar/ rje gtsos/ 'bo ra/ kha gya/ mdzod dge sogs rong phyogs la bsod snyoms su phebs/ dad 'bul gyi rta nor dngos rdzas ci yod dang / tha na ras gur thab cha sogs phyag rdzas ci yod spyi 'jog dang grwa tshang la bsngos/ phyi lo zla gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nas mgon khang rab gnas dge — 125 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi khongs/legs char 'beb ltar ma dzad skabs/ grwa ba dge legs rgya mtsho zer ba chos grwar zhugs rgyu'i snyan gas na phul pas thugs dgyes te mgon chos kyi thugs rje las grwa rgyun 'phel bo 'byung rgyu red gsungs la/ de nas bzung grwa tshogs shin tu 'phel bar gleng / zla ba gsu ma pa'i tshes ba'i'i nyin rje nyid nas spos sna mdzad de mgon khang rnying ba nas kun ma khyen rin po ches rab gnas gnang ba'i bris sku mgon khang gsar bar spyan drangs shing /bskang gso gtong mkhan grwa ba ba'i re zla rer bskang ba stong re dang / dus gtor nyin grwa ba bcus bskang ba tshar brgyad re dang / nyin gnyis la mgon chos kyi dbyangs yongs rdzogs 'then pa'i srol tshugs/ dgung grangs zhe dgu ba zla ba dgu ba'i yar tshes la nyan po dka' bcu ba dang thang sa ri khrod pa rab 'byams grags pa bcas kyis gdan zhus ltar/ gter lung du phebs par rten 'brel legs pa byung bas thugs shin tu mnyes/dge 'dun pa rnams la 'ag bco lnga'i ring lam rim chen mo dang / bsdus don spyod 'jug sogs kyi bshad lung dang gzhan 'dod chos sna tshogs bstsal/ grwa ba mang bor mkhan slob bsgrags pa'i sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs gnang / 'du khang nang du dmag zor ma'i zhal thang la snyan dar phul te/ de'i gtor bsngos tshogs la btsugs shing 'phrin bcol mdzad de khyod tsho'i chos skyong dmag zor ma yin gsungs/ grwa tshang gis brtan bzhugs phul pas/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /zhes pa nas/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas ma nyes par byed/ /ces tshig mtshams su 'bul ba phul pa 'grig par byung bas rje nyid thugs dgyes te/ /pyod rang rnams tshe rabs thams cad du bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel 'dug gsungs pa dang / nyid kyi sku ber zhig kyang rten skal du gnang ste slar bkra shis 'khyil bar phebs/ lam nas lam lung du gdan drangs pa la phebs/ dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos par nan zhu byas pas/ dgon sar gzigs te rab 'byams pa grags pa la gnas der dgon pa 'ig 'debs rgyu'i bka' slob gnang / dgung grangs lnga bcu ba'i lnga mchod dus su gdugs dkar 'khor lo rgyud ltar bri bsgrub gnang zhing rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la bzhag ste nyid kyis spos sne mdzad/ grwa tshang gis gdugs rgyal mtshan rnga rol so gas kyis mchod de dgon par g.yas skor gyis phyogs ba'ir rgya' chen ba'i la gtor ma phul pa bcas rgyal mtshan 'du khang steng du btsugs/ de phyin nad rims sogs zhi zhing bkra shis yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas so/ /lo 'di nas bzung lnga mchod kyi dus su rgyal ma tshan gsar bar brjes pa'i srol tshugs/ rgyud pa'i slob dpon dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa ltar 'grel ba ba'i sbrags dang / bskyed rdzogs ṭīk+ka dang bcas pa'i gzab bshad gnang ste de nas bzung rgyud pa'i lam ltar 'grel ba dang ṭīk+ka rdzogs par gnang ba'i srol tshugs/ chos mtshams su gdan zhus ltar gtsos dgon du phebs nas ma ṇi ril sgrub gnang / dgung grangs nga gnyis par dzam sku'i g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang rje sku che ba gnyis bcas sras chen brgyad kyi lder sku gsar bzhengs dang byams khang gi logs ris la cho 'phrul chen mo'i bkod pa dang / gser gdung khang gi logs ris la mdzad bcu dang rje'i rnam thar brgya dang nga gsum pa/ 'al ris lha khang du gnas brtan bcu drug dang / ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod — 126 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs gsar bzhengs mdzad/ ston khar dpon mo rnam rgyal phebs pa la/ rje 'di'i zhal nas khyed rang rnam sa kyis gyon pa gsar sgrub kyi gong ba la sgrog gu ma btags na mjug ma grub zer ba ltar sku phyogs rin po che dang khyed rnams kyis dgon pa btab kyang / gser gyi rgya phibs ma grub pas da lta rgya phebs shig ba'engs dgos/ ngas kyang mgon po la 'phrin bcol dang nged cag gis kyang grogs byed ces gsungs par/ dpon mo nas kyang zhal bzhes gnang ste/ las grwa'i mgo brtsams/ dgung grangs nga gsum par nyid kyi zhal bkod bzhin kun mkhyen rin po che'i gsung dbu phar dang mdzod kyi dpar brkos pa legs par grub/ 'di dus grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu rje nyid kyi sku bstod cig rtsom dgos pa'i zhu ba nan cher phul pa na/ 'al nas nged kyis skye ba 'di la rang gi bstod pa mi rtsom pa'i dam bca' byas yod/ ga' srid bla brgyud kyi khrod du 'don rgyu zhig dgos na paṇa chen sku phyogs la zhus/ dbus na de 'dra'i sro' yod gsungs/dgung grangs nga bzhi bar gser kha rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs bshes gnyen gsum la/mnga' ris chos ston nas brgyud pa'i geṭa pā la'i las sbyor dang gleṭa pā la spre'u khrid kyi skor kha tshang / mgon po'i sgo nas piṅka 'bri sgrub byed tshul gyi shog dril mgon po'i gtor bshad bsten sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag bka' rgya ma bcas gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la nye sras sogs kyi rten bzhengs gsar grub rnams 'a dge legs char 'bebs kyi rab gnas mdzad/ dgung grangs nga lnga bar bstan don la dmigs nas nye gnas dge bshes 'ga' zhig la 'jigs byed kyi zhi rgyas kyi 'phrul 'khor dang / rab 'byams pa sgom pa rin chen rgya mtsho dang / gser kha mkhyen rab bstan pa gnyis la 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag zhal shes rdzogs par gnang / zla ba dgu ba'i nyer lnga la rgya phibs kyi bzo legs par grub nas der gdugs dkar 'khor lo dang / gzungs gzhug rnams rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bri sgrub mdzad de phul/ rgya phibs 'dogs pa'i tshe rje nyid kyis bya 'dab 'og nas phyag gis btegs te/ dpon po sogs la yang de ltar mdzad du bcug nas/ khyod rnams kyis kyang / nged kyis smon lam 'debs pa ltar thobs shig gsungs te/ nyid kyis gsung skad mthon pos skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rje'i bla ma'i bstan pa dgung du 'degs par shog ces smon lam gnang / ston zla tha ma'i tshes la dge legs char 'bebs ltar gyi rab gnas rgyas pa sbyin sreg bcas rje nyid nas rab gnas kyi bshad pa rgyas pa gnang / dpon dga' ldan ju nang gis ston mo mdzad de rje nyid tshogs dbus su gdan drangs shing / dpon chen wang dga' ldan ju nang sogs bla dpon mang bo lhan tshogs kyi khrom chen po 'du khang du mi shong ba tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rab 'byams pa gnas brtan dang /rab 'byams pa chos skyong rgya mtsho gnyis kyis tshogs gleng byas/ de'i tshe rje nyid nas rgya phibs legs par grub pa'i dga' ston du dpon mo sogs la chibs rta re dang bsod nams kha btags re phul/ bal bo'i bzo bo rnams la yang ston mo dang yon gyis tshim par mdzad/ yang rje nyid kyis dpon mo rnam rgyal la/ sngon rgya bza' kong jos jo bo rgya nag nas bod du gdan drangs pa ltar/ khyed kyis dbus nas jo sku zhig gdan 'dren — 127 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dgos zhes bka' phab pa ltar dpon mos kyang zhal bzhes mdzad cing de ltar 'grub ba'i smon lam btab bo/ /dgung grangs nga bdun skabs chos mtshams rnams su kun mkhyen ba'ad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum phal che ba'i ljags lung bstsal/ srad rgyud slob dpon a gsal gyis mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang zhus par rje'i 'al nas deng sang chos nyan mkhan yod na bshad mkhan gyis sa khyab 'dug nga la'ang mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang 'ig 'don 'dod yod kyang / de ni bton pa'am ma bton pa gnyis kyis bstan pa la gang phan mi shes par 'dug gsungs te zhal bzhes ma gnang ba la slar nan gyis zhus pas/ de lta yin na khyod gcig pur gnang /gzhan la mi 'ong gsungs/ lo der rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i thugs dam rten 'bum thang jo bo la dbu rgyan dang rin po che'i phreng ba phul nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon gnang / dbyar gyi chos mtshams la nya tshang sman pas gdan zhus ltar phebs lam du bde mo thang du bzhugs skabs shig la gnyan rje'i ngos nas sprin mthing nag gi mdog can gyi dkyil nas gnyan rje rang gi cha lugs bstan nas 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs pa sogs/phyogs gang phebs kyi gnas bdag rnams kyis rang rang gi gzugs bstan nas zhabs tog dang 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzad/ phyi lor dpon tshang nas rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar dbus nas jo sku che ba zhig gdan drangs pa/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshe gcig la arge steng du 'byor ba la rje nyid nas phebs bsu mdzad cing / jo bo 9pa khrus gsol gnang / de dus dpon rgan sku gshegs par rje nyid phebs te bdun phrag gcig bzhugs shing /gdung rus dgon par khyer nas mchod rten bzhengs rgyu yin gsungs pas/ dpon mos gdung rus phyed phul/'di dus nyid nas dpon rgan 'di tā ra nā tha'i skye ba yin par gsungs pa sku 'khor nang ma 'gas gleng / lo de'i ston khar dpon mo rnam rgyal sku bsnyun bzhes pa la/ rje 'di nyid gdan drangs te arger phebs te mgon po'i gtor sgrub mdzad nas dpon mo'i bsnyung gzhi dwangs te phyir phebs skabs/ jo sku la mjal bas jo bos rje 'di la gsung byon/ de tshe sku 'khor pa 'ga' zhig gis nyams snang la jo bo'i sku bskyod pa zhig mdzad pa'i snang ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis jo bo'i zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad par snang ba dang / phal cher gyis ci yang ma shes par sgra lta bu zhig grags snyam pa shar zhes sna tshogs gleng / de'i skabs rje 'di nyid nas dpon tshang gi mi rnams la/ jo bo rin po che nas nged la dgon par phebs rgyu yin zhes gsung byon pas 'di la sus kyang bar chad bya mi nyan gsungs par/ dpon mos kyang khas blangs thog lo der jo bo rin po che bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ rje nyid kyang nyi ma lung gi mdor bsu bar phebs/ lam bar du nyid kyi gzim gur du bzhugs shing khong gzim dus ma gtogs jo bo'i sku mdun rang du bzhugs pa mdzad/ de ltar rim gyis phebs par bka' rams pa brgya phrag lhag gis rgyang nas skya bsu dang / dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs sogs sri zhu bcas zla ba dgu ba'i yar tshes la bkra shis 'khyil du 'byor/ jo bo rin po che'i 'du khang steng gi rab gsal du gdan drangs nas bzhugs shing / mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod/ bdun phrag gcig la rab gnas bya rgyu yin gsungs kyang / nyin gcig rab gnas 'bring bo 'ig mdzad pas na/ khong gis jo bo — 128 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rin po che la nga tshos rab gnas mi dgos/ sangs rgyas dngos yin 'dug gsungs pas rjes su rab gnas ma mdzad/ dgung grangs nga dgu bar/ jo bo'i lha khang gsar ba grub pas rje nyid nas spos sne dang dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang bcas jo sku gdan drangs te bzhugs shing / khrus gsol sogs rgyas par gnang /'du khang rab gsal la byams sku gtsos li sku mang bo bzhugs pa dang / gnam yol dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas mang bo phul/ rigs grwa'i chos mtshams la ko'u dge ri khrod pas zhus pa ltar ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa bstsal/ khong gis da dung mtha' dpyod rgyas pa ljags rtsom mdzad do/ 'al nas nged la rtsom pa gang byed na'ang mgo la rtags re dang / mjug la rtags re 'ong gin yod pas/ 'di'i skabs mjug rtags ma 'ong ba de gang yin nam gsungs/ de'i phyi lor sku bsnyun bzhes tshul bstan pas/ grwa tshang gis zhabs brtan nan cher bsgrubs pa dang / brtan bzhugs phul/ dbyar thog der rje nyid 'du khang rab gsal du spar te bzhugs shing / dgun chos sogs chos thog rnams la tshig bzhag chag med du gnang /sngar sku khams bde ba'i dus su dbu phar mdzod 'dul rnams kyi tshig bzhag la yig cha'i tshig zur tsam yang mi 'khrul bar/ tshig don so sor phye nas gsal zhing dag pa ngo mtshar ba zhig gsungs kyang / 'di dus sku bsnyung lcir song bas sku 'khor rnams kyis 'chad nyan ma thub kyang zhabs pad re zhig brtan pa gal che bar zhus na'ang / zhal nas 'chad nyan rnam dag cig bya rgyu ma byung bar/ rang 'gar bsdad pa la dgos pa med gsungs nas/ snyung gzhi lce na yang tshig bzhag ma chad pa byas pas/ sngar las lhag par yig cha'i tshig rnams dag cing gsal ba dang / dka' gnad kyi ljags bshad shin tu brling ba zhig yod pas/ sku khams mi bde ba'i ljags rtags cung mi bde ba ma gtogs ci yang mi mngon par snang / bsdus grwa rnams thugs thog kho nas gnang ba sogs phal ba'i blor shong dka' ba zhig tu kun gyis thun mong du gleng / tshogs chen nas zhabs brtan du ya ma rā dza dung phyur gsum/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma dung phyur gnyis sogs bsgrubs/ de'i tshe grwa 'khor rnams la khyed rnams kyis smon lam 'di ltar thobs gsungs nas/ nyid kyis dbu bskul nas ston pa bla na med pa'i bstan pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / bdag gis 'chad rtsod rtsom pa seng ge sgras/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/'a khor rnams la'ang smon lam de ltar 'debs su bcug yang zhal nas bla ma'i rjes su 'dzin pa'i gtso bo ni bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa yin pas/ ngas kyang rang nus ci yod kyis bla mas gsar 'debs gnang ba'i dgon pa 'dir po ti lnga'i tshig bzhag gtsor byas pa'i mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi 'chad nyan la shin tu nan tan byas/ rnam thar gsol 'debs dang kun rig gnyis ma gtogs tshogs 'don dang sgrig lam gang la yang bla ma'i zhal bkod ma mdzad pa'i rang bzo gcig kyang ma byas/ bla ma'i gdung mchod 'di gal che bar bsams te rang gi nus tshod kyi bar du gdung mchod byed skabs/ ci 'byor gyi mchod pa gang rgyas re phul te smon lam re btab/ bka' pod lnga'i gzhung zur bkod/ grub mtha' chen mo sogs kyi par gsar du brkos pa sogs bla ma'i zhabs 'degs cung zad cig sgrub thub pa 'di skal ba bzang gsungs so/ /— 129 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dgung grangs re gcig pa sa rta (172〈)lor bu slob rnams kyis rje nyid la rnam thar zhig ji gas rtsom gnang rgyu'i zhu ba nan cher byas kyang / 'al nas dbus su slob gnyer byas tshul bla rgan 'ga' 'ig la bshad yod/ sku phyogs kyi phyag g.yog byas tshul nyid kyi rnam thar na gas la / dgon 'dir 'chad nyan byas tshul khyed rang rnams la nges pa de yin/ rnam thar 'ig 'dod na khyod tshos sgrigs dang des chog gsungs/ 'al nas/nged kyi ḍa ma ru dang dril bu phreng ba rten gsum rnam sa ma thor ba gyis dang / sprul sku zhig myur du 'ong bas/khyed rang tshos la la bla ma dang la la dge rgan gyis la phan pa yod/ slob gnyer bzang bo zhig byed du chugadakor gyis ma sbags pa gyis zhes dang / yang zhal nas/ 'brom ston pa gshegs khar slo ba ma/ rnams la khyed rang rnams kyis bla ma mdo sde la gyis gsungs pa ltar/ khyod tshos kyang / rje ba'ad pa'i rdo rje'i bka' pod rnams la bla ma gyis/ ces sogs kyi zhal chems 'os 'tsham re gnang ste/ grwa ma nga la mjal kha sngar lugs ltar gnang / dpon po phebs nas mjal kha zhus pas/ zhal nas khyed kyis dgon pa 'di la thugs khur rgyun bzhes shig gnang dgos gsungs/ de nas 'ing 'di'i gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad zin te sku 'da' khar nye ba na thugs dam nyin lnga gnang / zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer lnga'i skya rengs shar ba na/ rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad pas/ da lta 'od gsal ma bu bsro ba'i skabs su babs pa'i gsal 'debs zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi sku dkyil dkrung dang phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gis phyag rgya mdzad de thugs dam la zhag gsum du bzhugs te gzugs sku rags pa'i za ma tog zhing 'dir ba'ag ste/ ye shes kyi sku'i snang ba chos kyi dbyings su bsdus so/ /de nas bdun phrag gnyis lhag la grwa dpon slob thams cad kyis/ khrus gsol dang smon lam bdag 'jug sogs bzhes te dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ sku gdung yang dgon pa'i g.yas kyi sa dkar yar kha la gdan drangs te sbya ngas 'bul byas/ bdun phrag gcig nas gdung kha phye bas/gdung rus rnams shin tu dkar zhing 'od 'tsher ba/ ring bsrel dang zhun thig gang mang 'phel/ rje'i zhal bkod ltar gdung rus phyed la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dpar te grwa mang la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku re dang zhun thig re 'gyed/ lo de'i ston khar gdung rten gyi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa legs par grub pas nyid kyi gdung rus sgam chung gang dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sku stong phrag du ma dang bcas gzungs 'bul legs par grub nas/ kun mkhyen mchog gi gdung gi g.yas su bzhugs su gsol te/ dge legs char 'bebs ltar gyi rab gnas sbyin sreg dang bcas gnang ngo / /'jam mgon khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis zhes mtshan snyan gyi rol mo sa steng du khyab pa 'di nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pa'i zhal slob kyang / lta ba'i gnad la dpyad pa rdzogs shing myong ba rtsal du thon pa'i bshes gnyen rgyud pa dpon slob blo bzang don grub/ dbal mang blo bzang don grub/ 'gying ro ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ gling don grub rgya mtsho/ gser kha bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'be bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rkang tsha ngag dbang mkhyen rab/ rnga ba chos skyong rgya mtsho/ rnga ba rab brtan rgya mtsho/ rnga ba ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ rnga — 130 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ba go thob/ rnga ba bsta na rgyam/ rnga ba mkhan dkar dang mkhan nag rnam gnyis/ rab 'byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams/ rin chen chos bzang sogs lta ba'i gnad la myong ba thon 'ing / mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /bse sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa ni(1729—1〈1 2)rgan gya gong ma'i tsho bar sku 'khrungs / grub dbang sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub kyis 'jam mgon khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil du chos sgor zhugs nas gsan sbyang mthar phyin pa mdzad/ dgung grangs nyer gsum steng gdan sa'i khur bzhes te tshogs chen khrir bzhugs/ dgung grangs nyer ba'i ba rab byung bcu gsu ma pa'i chu rta (1762)lor gter lung dgon du phebs te bla brang gsar bzhengs dang / jo khang thog brtsegs can bzhengs/ de nas mgar rtse dgon du phebs te 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang gsar bzhengs dang / dgon par :'chad nyan gsar 'dzugs gnang ste bca' yig kyang bzhag de'i skabs re skong phyogs kyi sa skyong nang so dang mchod yon gcig tu 'brel te nang so mchog gis rje nyid la gzim khang bkod legs rgya chen po bzhengs shing rje'i sku phreng rjes ma thams cad kyi sku rgyab gdung rtsa bya rgyu'i khas len phul/ rje nyid nas kyang zhal bzhes mdzad de rong bo dgon chen gyi khrir bzhugs/ sku tshe smad du kha gya shog pa ba'i'i skya ser thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ kha gya'i dgon du phebs nas 'chad nyan gsar 'dzugs dang 'brel dgon par bdag skyong mdzad cing bca' yig gsar 'jog kyang gnang / shog kha ba'i'i gzhung nas rje nyid la gzim khang rgya chen bzhengs te phul pas sku tshe smad la phal cher kha gya'i dgon du bzhugs/ spyi lo1〈12lo'i gter lung dgon du sku bshegs so/ /bse sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas ni (1814—1rnga79)mdo smad reb skong nang so'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ rong bo dgon chen du thugs gnyer mthar phyin mdzad de tshogs chen khrir yang bzhugs/dgung grangs nyer dgu ba chu stag ( 1〈42)lor dbus su phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du chos bzhugs mdzad/ lo der gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho po ta lar gsar phebs kyi khri 'don mdzad sgo byed pa'i skabs su khel/ rje 'di nyid mdo smad phyogs kyi mjal 'grul thams cad kyi thog ma yin pas rgyal dbang mchog la stong 'bul sbam mtho ba phul/ de tshe bod kyi srid skyong tshe smon gling ba ho thog thu thugs mnyes chen po byung / rje 'di nyid la sde ba gzhung nas dmigs bsal gyi gzengs bstod dang bkur bzos chen po byas thog lha sa'i grong khyer gyi dga' ldan khang gsar nang bzhugs su bcug ste snga phyi bar gsum thams cad du rgyal tshab srid skyong rin po ches gtsos gzhung zhabs che 'bring mang pos dmigs bsal gyi bsnyen bkur sogs gzigs skyong gnang / dgung grangs sum cu pa chu yos (1842)lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i za bas rgya' dbang tham/sa cad mkhyen pa mchog lha ldan du phebs pa la/ sde ba gzhung nas mdzad ston — 131 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rgya chen bgyid pa'i skabs srid skyong tshe smon gling ba ho thog thus rje 'di ba dmigs bsal gyis mdzad sgo'i gras su gdan drangs par ma zad no mo han gyi cho lo dang bka' shog kyang bstsal/ shing 'brug(1844)lor dbus nas rang yul du phebs khar srid skyong rin po che nas slar yang snam phrug dang gzim spos sogs dngos po sbam mtho ba'i gnang skyes bcas byang nag chu'i bar du 'u lag btang ba dang / gzhung zhabs pa gnyis kyis phebs skyel byas/ lcags khyi (1nga50)lor gter lung dgon rnying de mthon po'i mdo dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi mtshan ma yod sa'i ri'i gsham sngon 'bri gung mkhas pa mi gsum gyis gter sbas pa'i gnas gur zhabs thang dgon gnas 'dir spo rgyu'i rtags mtshan yang yang byung bar brten/ mdzod pa chos rje sogs sne mo pa rnams dang gros bstun gnang ste hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la de ga'i grong sde'i rgan gzhon rnams gur 'bas thang du bos te dgon rnying gi mdun ri'i bkag nags dang gzhan yang rta nor sogs zang zing gi dngos po'i gnang cha phon che ba bstsal te yul mi rnams mgu bar byas shing / khral dang btsan thabs ma yin par bdag po las sa bslangs/gnas mchog khyad par can der lo de'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin/ rje nyid dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa brgya phrag gsum lhag dang bcas pa phebs te/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ltar sa brtag bslang sbyong ba rnams phyag len bzhin bgyis/ bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong gi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs/ nyin de nas bzung / mdzod pa rab 'byams pa dang / gnyer ba blo bzang mkhyen rab kyis las khur gyi 'gan bzhes te las mgo brtsams/ hor zla lnga ba'i yar tshes la bla brang gi gzim chung legs par grub ste rje nyid kyang der bzhugs shing rim gyis 'du khang gyan lnga bcu can dri gtsang khang bcas pa/ jo khang gyan nyer lnga thog brtsegs can/ lha mo'i btsan khang gyan bcu lhag can/ tshoms chen rgyan sum cu can dang mgon khang / gzim khang bde yangs che chung sum thog can dang / phyag gnyer khang sogs rwa skor che chung lnga dang / dgon pa'i spyi khang sogs grwa shag brgya phrag lhag legs par grub/ lcags sprel(1rnga60)lor hal ha'i a 'ban tshe tsin rgyal po'i bla ma/ yu lags su ho thog thu tshang gis mi sna yang yang btang ste rje nyid smad sog tu gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar/lo de'i hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la phebs 'go brtsams te/ rim gyis ha la zhan dang pa yan zhan/ tho wor sogs su byon/ da gung ho shul dgon du phebs nas yun ring bzhugs shing 'dod chos sna tshogs gsungs/chu khyi lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la ri bo rtse lngar byon nas nub phyogs kun bde gling gi grwa ba rnams la 'dod chos sna tshogs dang dbang rjes mang po bstsal/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gcig la mergan wang gi ho shul dgon du phebs nas yu lags su ho thog thu/ pe zi rin po che/ gong ma'i dmag dpon chen po the tsi'i bu/yi dam tho yon gtso byas te wang dang be gu sogs dpon rigs che chung du mar ser skya dmangs tshogs brgya phrag lhag la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang dang sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang sogs dbang lung rjes gsum srog gtad kyi rigs mang du bstsal/ sa phyogs de ga'i skye dgu thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i slob dpon du gyur cing — 132 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mtshan snyan shin tu rgyas/ dgung grangs nga dgu ba chu sprel lor (1872)pe zi rgyal bo sogs nas hal ha phyogs su phebs dgos zhes gdan 'dren yang yang zhus kyang dmag dpon chen po the tsis dang pa yar la wang sogs kyis rje nyid la hal ha phyogs su dmag 'khrug ha cang che bas phebs na mi legs pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma zhus rkyen der ma phebs par pad dkar chos gling du yun ring bzhugs/ lo der chin rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung kri khri lo bcu gcig pa ste gnam bskos gong ma mchog gis btsun mo gsar bzhes kyi dus skabs su khel 'dug pas/dmag dpon chen po the tsis dang pa yar la wang rnam gnyis kyang mdzad sgo chen mor phebs dgos rkyen/ rje 'di nyid la khyed da skabs sog yul 'di na 'phrin las rgyas shing snyan grags che bar brten/ da reb pe cin du phebs na khyed la zhabs 'degs bzang po zhig sgrub thub ces zhus pas/ rje nyid kho tsho dang lhan du pe cin gyi gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin pe cin yong ho kung ngam bde ldan byin chags gling du ja sag tā bla ma dang / pa yar la wang sogs dang lhan du gong mar mjal phyag zhus/ rjes su gong mas gzigs skyong gis lha khang ser por bzhugs su bcug cing rgyal phan chos spyod slob dpon tā shrī zhes gzengs bstod kyi 'ja' sa dang / g.yang ṭi'i rgya tham bcas kyi gsol ras bstsal pas/ rje nyid kyi bzhed don mtha' dag bde blag tu grub/ rjes su dmag dpon chen po the tsis dang / pa yar la wang / ja sag tā bla ma bcas la bka' drin thugs rje che zhus kyi mdzad ston yang rgya cher byas te slar ho shu'i dgon du phebs/ de nas slar yang u tsin tā wang dang pe zi rgyal po rnam gnyis kyis hal ha phyogs su gdan 'dren zhus kyang / rje nyid gnam bskos gong ma chen por dngos mjal zhus te cho lo'i bdag rkyen grub pa dang / rang gi gdan sa'i gdan 'dren gyi mi sna yang mang po slebs 'dug pas rang yul du phyir phebs rgyu'i thugs 'dun che bas zhal bzhes ma gnang bar pad dkar chos gling du phebs/ de nas ha la 'an du phebs te ha la zhan wang gis lag bde ba bcu lhag dang dmag mi nyis brgya bcas kyi rdzong 'bul bcas a lag sha brgyud lan ju'i mkhar la 'byor/to the ye dang tā lo ye gnyis kyis yā men du gdan drangs te gong ma'i 'ja' sa la bkur gzo dang bcas bsnyen bkur nyin 'gar byas/ 'dod chos kyang mang du bstsal/ mthar rgya'i skya dmag lnga brgya rdzong ba phul kyang rje nyid kyis ma bzhes par brten/ bod shing sgo yan chad nas brag lcog po bar gyi sa ri sgar bcu(gnam lha khag gsum/ hor gtsang shog bzhi/ kha gya shog bzhi/ gtsos shog bzhi/ rong ngar tsho gsum/ de lnga'i dgon pa dang grong sde bcas) spyi bdag(tsung bkwan) zhes ba so'i tham ga dang rgya'i bka' yig lheb lteb ma bcas gnang zhing skyel mi nyis brgya dang bcas men ju'i mkhar du bskyel/ der men ju'i tā lo yes bsnyen bkur bcas nyin 'gar ngal gsos mthar rang yul du 'byor/ mdzod gnyer dang bla sprul mang pos bsu ma bcas hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la gter lung dgon du 'byor/ de nas lo gnyis tsam bzhugs pa na yang a lag sha wang gi gdan 'dren pa yang yang 'byor bas/ dgung grangs re gsum par slar yang a lag shar phebs te yun ring bzhugs/ mthar spyi lo1879 lor a lag shar zhi bar gshegs so/ /— 133 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ bse sku phreng ba'i ba blo bzang bkra shis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni (1rnga80—1〈rngakha) yul re bskong sa skyong nang so'i rgyud par 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun pa na gter lung du gdan sar 'khod kyang bar chad kyi rkyen gyis dgung grangs dgu ba'i steng gshegs so/ /bse sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni (1890—1927)yu' reb skong sa skyong nang so 'i khyim du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun steng gter lung du gdan sar 'khod/ dgung 'o bcu gsum/ steng rong bo dgon chen gyi chos sgor zhugs te slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad/ dgung grangs/ su ma cu bar rong bo dgon chen gyi tshogs chen khrir 'khod/ dgung grangs so gcig pa lcags bya(1919)lor 'bag chen tshe ho ka lo'i hos dmag 'bor chen bod nang du yong nas bla brang dgon pa bcom/ gter lung phyag mdzod mgon lo'i dge slong dang / gnyer ba rgya mtsho gnyis kyis sa ri sgar bcu'i bod dmag drangs te shing sgo nas dam ga 'thab drag po yu na ring byas kyang mang sne nyung gis ma zin par hos dmag gis hor gtsang dang gnam lha khag gnyis kyi sde ba mang bo mer bsregs/ rgyu nor btsan 'phrog dang / mi ser mang po bsad rkyen bza' mi bon gzhon byis pa thams cad skor skor byas te g.ya' ri'i rdza gseb tu bros te zla ba gcig lhag tsam bdi da/ de'i skabs hos dmag gi dmag sgar gyi lte ba gter lung dgon du byas/ lha khang 'du khang tshang ma mer bsregs/sku gsung thugs rten dang rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs bcom/ dpe mdzod dang dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 'gangs che ba tshang ma mer btang / grwa ba brgya lhag bkrongs/ de dus sprul ba'i sku rang nyid rong bo dgon chen du bzhugs pas sku la nyes skyon med tsam ma gtogs gzhung sger gyi rgyu rdzas tshang ma rtsa med du song / de'i rkyen phyi lo nas bzung rje nyid kyis lo 'ga'i ring la reb skong rtse khog sogs 'brog phyogs dang rong khul sogs la 'bul sdud dang slong mo byas te slar yang 'du khang dang lha khang gsar du bzhengs/ bla brang zhig gso dang 'bre' 'du khang nang byams sku thog tshad can nye sras brgyad can dang / lha khang nang du jo sku gtso byas rje stong sku dang gshegs lha so lnga li sku/ bla brang yang rtse ru gnas brtan bcu drug gtso byas li sku sna tshogs brgya phrag gsum lhagagasung rten co ne bka' bstan gtsos glegs bam stong phrag lhag sogs sku gsung thugs rten dang / gser tog rgyal mtshan/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs sogs gsar bzheng rgya chen po mdzad/ rim pa thams cad sngon ma ltar rgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin gsang 'jigs dang kun rig sa chog dang bcas pa rgyun ma chad par bskyangs/dgung lo zhe bdun pa spyi lo1927lo'i zla ba gsum par gter lung du sku gshegs so/ /bse sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje dpal bzang bo ni/ rong bo'i nang so'i lha 'bangs rong bo sde bdun du grags pa'i ya gyal the bu zhes pa'i sde bar/ me glang lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad(spyi lo192rilo'i zla dang po)la/ yab phur ba tshe ring dang / yum lha mo skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/de'ang1927ste me byi lo'i zla gsum par sku gong ma zhal ma bzhugs/ lo de'i bod zla lnga bar kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa dgu ba chen po rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan — 134 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs skabs/ rong bo'i sa skyong nang so 'jigs med rnam rgyal gtso byas sa ri sgar bcu gcig gi bla dpon rnams kyis/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gter lung yid dga' chos 'dzin gling du spyan drangs nas rtse thog rnam rgyal khang bzang du bse snga ma'i dgongs rdzogs thugs smon smin rgyas gnang ba bcas nyin lngar bzhugs/ mi ser la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang / tshes bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong gi mgon du byon/ sa ri sgar gyi bla dpon ser skya rnams kyis gzim chung du phyag dbang zhus skabs/ phur ba tshe ring nang so'i zhabs phyir yong pas gral mjug tu mjal ba'i tshe/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas dus gsum gsal bar gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs te/sngon ma nas srung mdud dmar po zhig phyag tu bsnams nas phur phur mdzad bzhin pa de/ bse 'di ba'i yab kyi mgul du gnang ba la/ 'der mthong thams cad kyis 'di ci zhig snyam pa'i dogs pa 'char/ nang so gtsos pas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyis thog drangs pa'i rgya dngul rta mig ma brgya phrag gcig sogs dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs/ zhal nas/ da nas nyin bdun gyi rjes su khyod tsho bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs shog de dus yang sprul 'khrul ba med pa zhig ngas thag gcod nges yin/ zhes bka' lan gnang bas thams cad dga' spro'i dpal la rol par gyur to/ /nyin bdun gyi rjes su nang so gtsos sa ri sgar gyi sku tshab mi sna rnams bla brang dgon du song zhing / kun gzigs mchog la gzim chung mjal kha zhus par/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog sku dngos kyis phyag yig dam sbyar ma zhig gnang bzhin zhal nas/ da lor yi ge 'di'i kha ma 'byed/ khrus gsol gang mang dang / lha mo'i bskang bshags 'bum/ tā re bye chen sogs kyi zhabs brtan gang mang bsgrub dgos/lo rjes ma stag gi lor skar tshes bzang po zhig la kha phye chog ces bka' bstsal/ mtshan yig gdan drangs pas/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i spyi chen gtso byas grwa mang gis spos sna dang bcas sde
