khri'i bla brang gi tshoms chen nang gi khri steng du bzhugs su gsol/ bla brang dang / sa ri sgar/ reb skong phyogs kyi bla dpon rnams nas kha btags phul/ phyi nyin mtshan tho gter lung bla brang gi phyag mdzod kyis phrag tu khur te bla dpon rnams rang gi gdan sa'i bla brang gi tshoms chen 'dod dgu g.yas 'khyil gyi bzhugs khri'i steng bzhugs shing / grwa tshang gis khrus gsol bcas sku ston gzab rgyas bgyis pa dang / ser skya thams cad kyis mjal kha dang lha dar phul/sa stag lo'i bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin/ rong bo'i sa skyong nang so 'jigs med rnam rgyal/shar bla brang gi phyag mdzod dge legs rgya mtsho/ rong bo dgon chen gyi grwa tshang so so'i sku tshab sogs dang / sa ri sgar gyi bla dpon ser skya'i mi sna yongs rdzogs bcas gter lung bla brang gi tshoms chen 'dod dgu g.yas 'khyil du 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ gter lung bla brang gi mdzod pa chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho nas mtshan yig dam sbyar ma'i kha phyes/ a khyung sgar ba sku skyes kyis mtshan tho bklags/ de'i nang du yul reb skong phyogs/rong dgon gyi nye 'dabs kyi byang shar mtshams/ pha ka sde'i ming mtha' can/ ma a sde'i ming can gyi bu/— 135 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/mtshan la blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje zhes thogs/ zhes srung mdud dang bcas bstsal 'dug pa thams cad la bsgrags pas/ tshang mas gros bsdur dang dpyad pa nan mo btang mthar/ rong bo dgon chen gyi nye 'dabs byang shar gyi mtshams su/ the bu zhes pa'i sde ba'i nang du/ sku sngon ma'i sku sring gi bu phur ba tshe ring la/nye sngon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gter lung du phebs skabs/ mjal ba'i khrod du sku dngos kyis srung mdud dmar po 'ig gnang ba rje 'di'i yab kyi rtags su gsal bar lung bstan pa'i dogs gzhi thams cad la yod pa dang / rtags thams cad gcig mtshungs su song bas bla dpon ser skya thams cad kyis the tshom chod cing / 'dun pa gcig mthun gyi sgo nas bla dpon thams cad kyis yab la kha btags phul/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ mdzod pa chos rje dang / sa ri sgar gyi mi sna reb skong du song ste mtshan tho phul pa dang sbrags bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi kha btags phul/ dgung lo bzhi'i steng sku phreng rim byon gyi gdan sa chen po gter lung yid dga' chos 'dzin gling gi bla brang tshoms chen 'dod dgu g.yas 'khyil gyi mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs kyi pad mo mdzes par bkod do/ /dgung lo bdun gyi steng dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po kun dga' dpal bzang po yongs 'dzin du bsten te/ 'phral sbyor gyi klog dang / gzab gshar gyi yi ge rgyan 'jug sogs 'don cha'i rim pa mtha' dag dang / sum rtags dag gsum/ snyan ngag me long ma dang dgyes glu sbrags pa'i mdzub khrid rnams rim par gsan te sbyang ba phul du phyin pa mdzad/ lo der skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang a rol rin po che nas dge bsnyen dang / bar ma rab byung / dge tshul rnams dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs/ de nas bzung skyabs rje a rol rdo rje 'chang bla ma'i gtso bor bsten te dbang lung khrid gsum/ man ngag zhal lung thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan te sras kyi thu bor gyur/ dgung lo bcu'i steng rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog bshes gnyen rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa tshang mtshan nyid yongs 'dzin du bsten te bsdus grwa blo rtags/ sa lam/ don bdun cu sogs dang / lam rim/ spyod 'jug sogs kyi dpe khrid zhib rgyas su gnang zhing /rtsod pa dang / dpe blta/ dpe khrid nyin rer chag med mdzad/ bse bsdus/ blo rtags/ don bdun cu/ sa lam/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ 'grel ba don gsal/ mdzod rtsa/ legs bshad snying bo'i sems tsam bar du thugs 'dzin mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du chibs bsgyur mdzad de/jo shākya rnam gnyis gtsos lha sa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang rgyud grwa stod smad sogs kyi rten gtso khag rnams la mjal phyag dang / mchod 'bul/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bcu bzhi ba chen por gzim chung phyag dbang zhus te dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba bstar/ hor zla bcu ba'i nang/ gzhung dang / 'bras spungs bla spyi/sgo mang mkhan po sogs kyis chibs bsu dang thab bsu bcas 'bras spungs su phebs te klu 'bum khang tshan du bzhugs/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin 'bras spungs tshogs chen du dge 'dun pa chig khri 'dus par dngul sgor gnyis re mang ja'i bsnyen bkur byas/ tshogs chen dus sprul sku che khag gi gral du bzhugs/ sgo mang chos grwar phebs — 136 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/par gong sa mchog gis ched mngags rtse mgron gdan zhus te gong sa'i srung mdud dang / mdzod dar che legs/ gsol ja/ sder kha bcas gnang / sgo mang grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa bzhi stong lhag la dngul sgor gnyis re gung tshigs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus thog spyi 'bul du rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi zhal thang chen po lnga legs par phul/ klu 'bum khang tshan dang bsam blo khang tshan gyi bsnyen bkur byas dge 'dun pa rer dngul sgor gsum re/ dbal shul 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ don bdun cu nas bzung gser phreng sbrags phar phyin mtha' dpyod skabs brgyad ka dang / zur bka' dge 'dun nyi shu nas bzung kun gzhi'i bar du dpe khrid zhib rgyas gnang / rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed steng rtsa 'grel sbrags pa'i khrid zhib rgyas gnang zhing / chos grwar chag med kyi sgo nas rtsod pa dmar ba mdzad de sbyang ba rdo rus thug pa mdzad/ dgung lo bco lnga ba'i smon lam dus su gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog gsung chos chen mo'i dbur phebs pa la/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i bshad pa gnang ba rdzogs par gsan/ lo de'i dbyar la gong sa mchog gis nor bu gling khar se 'bras dge gsum gyi dge 'dun pa rnams dang gzhis byes kyi ser skya dmangs tshogs la dpal thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ rgyan 'jug gnyis dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ljags lung bstsal pa gsan bzhes mdzad/ se ra dang dga' ldan dgon par phebs nas tshogs chen la dge 'dun pa re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor re mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dang / dga' ldan byang rtse grwa tshang dang / klu 'bum khang tshan gnyis kyi dge 'dun pa re'i phyag tu dngul sgor gnyis re gung tshigs kyi bsnyen bkur byas/ de nas gtsang la phebs te bkra shis lhun por kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gzim chung phyag dbang zhus thog dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i ljags lung zhus/ dge 'dun pa lnga stong lhag re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor re mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dang / kun gzigs mchog dang / yab gzhis nas sne len gang gzab gnang bas dbyar zla gsum la bzhugs/ kun gzigs mchog gis thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas no mo han gyi bka' shog dang /tham ga'i cho lo bstsal te dmigs bsal gyi gzengs bstod rgya cher gnang / phyi lor 'bras sgo mang du phar phyin dam bca' bzhag rjes gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par thon phyag phul te slar mdo smad du chibs bsgyur mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa shing lug(1955)lor/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang /paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis rgyal sa pe cin du tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i phyir lam bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la snga gzhug tu phebs khong snga phyir lan kru'u la byon nas rgyal dbang yab sras gnyis la rim bzhin phyag mjal zhus shing thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mchid kyi bka' drin bstsal/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bla brang nas phyir phebs lam du gter lung nas ja thab gang rgyas zhus phyag dbang dang / dngos 'bul gyi rnam grangs mang du phul/ dpyid thog rong bo dgon chen gyi mkhas dbang dus 'khor pa stag lha'i mdun nas rgya bod kyi rtsis gzhung lnga bsdus nas gza' lnga'i bar dpe khrid zhus te sbyang ba mthar phyin mdzad/ sprel lor brag dkar spel — 137 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rdzong dgon du rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po skyabs rje a rol rin po che'i drung du byon te/dbyar zla gsum gyi ring dus 'khor dbang chen dang / mi ṭa rdor phreng sogs spyi zur gyi dbang rjes gnang /lung khrid so gas mang du gsan bzhes mdzad/ dbus kyi yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog sprel rdzong dgon pa'i dge rgan du byon yod pa gter lung du gdan drangs te/ grub mtha' chen mo rtsa 'gre' sbrags pa dang / mngon pa mdzod rtsa ba'i steng nas dpe khrid zhus shing / mdzod rtsa'i tshig rgyugs kyang phul/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / lam rim/ 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid kyang gnang / phyi lor slar sprel rdzong dgon du phebs nas skyabs rje a rol rdo rje 'chang mkhan slob sbrags ma dang / 'dul 'dzin chen po skyabs rje mi nyag rin po che gsang ston mkhan po mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dus 'khor dbang chen sogs dbang rjes lung gsum mang bo dang / mi nyag rin po che'i drung nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs dang / dmigs brtse ma'i be'u bum sogs 'u nga rkyang gi rigs gsan/ ston zlar yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho gter lung du byon pa'i drung gung thang 'dul sdom dang / sdom gsum bslab bya/ gzhi gsum cho ga sogs kyi dpe khrid zhib rgyas gsan/ lo je'i dgun zlar bshes gnyen chen po bzhag ldom a khu rin po che gter lung du gdan drangs te dbyangs can sgra mdo sbrags 'grel ba gsal ldan gyi dpe khrid zhus te sgra rig par sbyang ba mthar phyin mdzad do/ /1958sa khyi lor dus 'gyur gyis bstan pa la nyams 'grib chen po byung bas rje nyid kyang rgyal khrims la sbyar te zi ling du bskyal/ btson ra'i nang du skyabs mgon shar skal ldan bdun pa chen por 'phrad de gsang thabs kyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la bsten pa'i lus srung gi gsang ba'i man ngag bka' rgya ma'i khrid dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i lung bcas thob/ skyabs mgon mchog la chos rnam gyi rgyu'i byin rlabs zhus pa gnang bas bslab khrims srog las gces par mdzad/ de ltar1962lo'i bar btson khang du gsang thabs sgos bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi rtsa sngags 'bum phrag lnga bcu re/'jam dpal mtshan brjod tshar lnga brgya gsungs/ spyi zla dgu ba'i nang btson grol thob ste bla brang dgon du phebs/ kun mkhyen drug par dngos mjal dang / tshogs chen 'du khang chen mor dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho 'tshogs pa'i skabs su mchod mjal rgyas pa dang / kun mkhyen gong ma yab sras kyi sku gdung dang /mgon khang sogs la mchod mjal bcas thugs smon gnad smin gnang / gter lung dgon du phebs te tshogs dbus su bzhugs/ yang gtsos su phebs nas srid gros chab srid sbyong brdar 'dzin grwar zhugs te ngal rtsol dang / chab srid slob sbyong zung 'brel byas/ 1964lo'i lo mjug bar zhing chen chab srid slob grwar phebs nas chab srid slob sbyong nan mo byas/ 1966lor rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i 'go tshugs pa nas 'thab dgag bsgyur gsum gyi rlung 'tshub nang lhung zhing phyi lor slar btson du bcug btson 'jug lo gcig gi ring la 'jigs byed kyi snying bo 'bum brgya/ ma ṇi bye chen/ ltung bshags dang / bzang spyod lnga stong re — 138 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gsungs so/ /1968lor btson las bkrol te bla brang dgon par bla dpon rnams bkag bskyil byas pa'i nang du mngags te slob sbyong dang ngal rtsol zung 'brel byas/ phyi lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa'i zhwa mo bskon te wang gur thang dga' phug rgya sder ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed par mngags te lo bcu gcig la bzhugs dgos pa byung / de dus gter 'u nga ri khrod pa rgyal mtshan zhes pa grong sde zhig tu bzhugs yod pa'i sar mtshan mor gsang thabs kyis yang phebs nas lo rer bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug thengs 'ga' re bzhes pa dang / zla re'i dus bzang nam yod la gsang thabs kyis thar chen dang / sman chog chen mo re gsungs pa dang / nyin re'i rgyun gyi zhal 'don steng / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod re ma chad pa gnang / ngal rtsol gyi zhor la/ gsang thabs kyis gzhan phyogs nas phyag dpe sna tshogs g.yar te lkog tu rje'i lam sngags dang / rim lnga sogs bskyed rdzogs skor dang / lam rim blo sbyong dang / rig gnas skor la dpe gzigs rgyun chad med pa gnang ba dang 'brel nyams len kyang mdzad/ 1979lor dkar 'don byas te khul mi rigs slob grwa'i dge rgan du phebs te dge slob rnams la snyan ngag gi slob khrid gnang ba dang 'brel snyan 'grel tshangs sras bzhad sgra ljags rtsom mdzod/ 1980lor kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gan lho'i bla brang dgon du phyag phebs par/ rje nyid hor gtsang shing sgor bsu bar chas te mjal 'phrad gnang skabs spyan chab rgyun chod dka' ba byung / kun gzigs mchog nas thugs brtse'i nyams dang bcas zhal nas/ rig gnas gsar brje'i nang du sku ngal chen po byung ba thos pas da lta sku gzugs bde'am/ zhes pa'i mtshams 'dri'i bka' gsung ba bstsal/ kun gzigs mchog dang lhan du ja thab kyi gsol tshig rol rjes/ gter lung dang gnam lha'i ja thab steng du byon/ kun gzigs mchog nas dmangs tshogs la skyabs 'gro dang / gzungs sngags sna tshogs kyi ljags lung / phyag dbang bstsal/bka' drin gtang dag gi dngos 'bul mi nyung ba phul te kun gzigs mchog dang lhan du bla brang dgon par phebs/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che nas bla brang du tshe dbang bstsal pa gsan bzhes mdzad/ rje nyid kyis gsol ba btab pa ltar/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog thengs rjes mar 'di phyogs su phebs dus gter lung dgon dang / gtsos dgon par phebs rgyu'i zhal lan gnang / 1981lor gter lung dgon gyi chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan thob par brten bla brang rang gi tshoms chen gsar bzhengs mdzad de dge 'dun pa bcu phrag tsam 'dus te bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad pa'i dbur phebs nas chos sgrog pa'i mdo dang / so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ de nas bzung dgon 'dir sngon ma'i phyag bzhes ltar gyi tshogs dang /chos thog gi rim pa mtha' dag dang / gso sbyong sogs ma chad pa byung / phyi lor kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa slar kun lho'i phyogs su phebs skyod gnang ba'i thog mar gter lung dgon du phyag phebs/ tshoms chen steng du gsol tshig lhan bzhes gnang zhing thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mchid lhug — 139 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/par gnang / dmangs tshogs la ljags lung dang / phyag dbang bstsal cing / 'du khang sogs la rab gnas kyi bka' drin brtse gzigs mdzad/ gtsos dgon par phebs skabs rje 'di nyid ser sbreng gi dbur byon nas lha dar phul pa dang / 'du khang steng du gsol tshig lhan bzhes ngang thugs mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ dgong zhig glo bur du kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gtso byas sku 'khor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ gung thang rin po che/ dpon blo bzang tshe dbang / khul gyi 'go khrid pa bcas lhan du rje 'di nyid bzhugs sa'i sger khyim du phebs nas mtshams 'dri dang gsung gleng mang du mdzad/de dus kun gzigs mchog nas rje 'di nyid la/ khyed pe cin du yong nas nged la rogs gnang dgos/ zhes bka' bstsal pa dang 'brel zang zing gi bdag rkyen mi nyung ba gnang bas brtse gzigs bskyangs so/1985lor/ krung dbyang slob u dang / zhing chen srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ba ltar/ rang khul du mi rigs dge thon ched gnyer slob grwa gsar du btsugs te zhing chen srid gzhung gi bka' yig ltar slob grwa'i gtso 'dzin gzhon par bskos/ 1986lor kun gzigs rin po che mchog gi bka' ltar pe cin du phebs/skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par mjal phyag zhus shing sku mdun du bzhugs/ spyi zla drug par gong sa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa zi khron dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / bod ljongs chab mdo sa khul/ yu nan bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul/ tā lis grong khyer sogs la gzigs rtogs gnang bar phebs pa'i zhabs zhur chas te sku mdun kho nar phyag g.yog bsgrubs/ phyi lor kun gzigs mchog gi bka' phebs ltar pe cin du krung go bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i gra sgrig tsho chung gi gras su byon te slob deb gsar sgrig tsho chung gi 'gan gtso bo'i phyag las zla ba bzhi lhag gnang / de dus kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gis/ rje 'di la nang bstan slob grwa 'di gsar du btsugs pa la slob gso'i bya bar nyams myong yod pa'i 'go 'dren zhig dgos/ da lta'i bla sprul nang na de'i nyams myong can dkon/ lha sa na rgan pa 'ga' re bzhugs kyang dgung lo smin pas pe cin du slebs mi thub/ khyed slob gso'i sde khag tu yod pas nyams myong yod/ khyed pe cin du yong nas nang bstan slob grwa 'di'i bya bar 'gan khur na bzang snyam pas/ khyed e 'thad/ ces dri ba gnang bar/ rje nyid thugs ha cang 'tshab cing skrag ste/nged la slob gso'i nyams myong yang med/ nga'i pha rgan sogs kyang lo na ha cang rgas pas nged pe cin du yong rgyu'i dgongs pa gnang rogs thugs rjes gzigs zhes nan zhu zhus par/ zhal nas/ gal te khyed kyis slob grwa'i 'gan khur bar mi 'thad na'ang / khyed rang slob grwa 'di'i dge rgan gyi gras yin/ lo rer slob khrid zla ba gsum re nges par du bya dgos/ zhes bka' bsgos pa dang du mi len thabs med gyur/ sa 'brug lo nas khong pe cin du phebs te nang bstan slob gling nas dpe khrid dang / zhor du kun gzigs mchog gis ched du bka' gnang ba ltar du dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i slob deb brtsams/ lo de nas sa stag lo'i bar bgrang bya bcu'i ring pe cin du phebs nas nang bstan slob gling gi dpe khrid zla ba gsum re rgyun ma chad pa gnang / lo — 140 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/der khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams/ phyi lor kun gzigs rin po che bod ljongs su phebs/bkra shis lhun po'i mchod gdung bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa legs grub byung ba'i dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo'i skabs su rje nyid kyang kun gzigs mchog gis gdan drangs pa ltar lha sar phebs/lha sa'i gtsugs lag khang dang / rtse po ta la/ se 'bras dge gsum sogs la zhib mjal gnang rjes bkra shis lhun por 'byor/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dang mjal 'phrad gnang ste btsug lag khang gi rab gnas kyi gras su bzhugs/ mdzad sgo'i dga' ston tshogs chen steng kun su'i 'thus tshab gnang ste bkra shis pa'i zhal gsung gnang / da dung chos lugs pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'dur zhugs rjes/kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par thon phyag zhus par/ thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i bka' gsung bstsol bzhin lha dar dkar po che legs phyag tham can gnang / yin na'ang de ni kun gzigs mchog gi zhal dngos su mjal ba dang / gsung dngos su thos pa'i tha mar gyur/ khong slar lan jur phebs pa'i tshe kun gzigs mchog gi sku glo bur du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul gnang ba gsan pas thugs skyo tshad med mdzad pas zhag 'gar mnal ma khug bla brang dgon dang / gtsos/ gter lung rnams su sku dngos phebs kyis gong sa'i 'dra dpar mdun du gdung mjal dang / dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros so/ /de snga sa 'brug 198rngalor kun gzigs mchog pe cin du bzhugs skabs/ rje nyid kyis kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par/ gter lung dgon pa'i lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi rten gtso bo la/ sngon chad gter lung dgon par chags 'jig gnyis byung bas/ dang po lha khang 'di jo sku gtsor bzhugs kyis sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang yin/ de ni hos 'khrug skabs su mer bsregs/ de nas nged kyi sku gong mas jo sku gtsor bzhugs kyi rje stong sku bzhengs pa 1958lor gtor/ da reb lha khang gi rten gtso gang byas na legs tshul gyi snyan zhu phul par/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog sku dngos kyis pe cin lha khang ser po'i nang du bzhugs pa'i paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten chen mo'i nang bzhugs kyi paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung tsha las grub pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku dang 'od dpag med kyi sku gnyis/kun gzigs rang nyid kyi dbu skra bub gcig na bza' cha tshang bcas bstsal te/ da skabs tshe 'das rnams la 'pho ba gsung mkhan dkon pas khyed kyis rten 'di dag nang bzhugs kyi 'od dpag med sku brnyan gtso sku byas na shi gson thams cad la phan thogs par nges/ zhes rjes su gnang ba'i bka' bstsal pa ltar/ lo 'dir 'od dpag med kyi lha khang gi rmang gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi dbu tshugs/ 1990lor kun gzigs mchog gi byin rten dang / bla brang gi kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs dam rten gyi gtso bo mgon po klu sgrub kyi phyag bzo klu'i 'jim pa las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku brnyan mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis bskor pa dang /se ra dgon pa'i nang rten rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi li sku/ sde phrug rin po che nas ched du gnang ba'i byin rten rnams nang rten gtsor bzhugs kyi 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan khru tshad bcu gsum can dang / jo sku dang /— 141 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rje tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan khru tshad brgyad can sogs legs par bzhengs/ phyi lor khong la zhing chen nas rgyal khab rim pa'i slob dpon chen mo'i dpang rtags thob/ chu sprel lor mgar rtse dgon grong gis gsol ba yang yang btab pa ltar/ hor zla brgyad par mgar rtse dgon nas/ mgar rtse mchog sprul rin po che dang / pe cin nang bstan slob gling gi slob gtso gzhon pa dga' ldan nags tshang rin po che gtsos/ bla ma dang dge 'dun pa lnga stong lhag dmangs tshogs drug khri brgal pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur zab mo phyag len rgyas pa'i lugs su gnang / zla dgu ba'i nang gter lung dgon pa'i 'od dpag med kyi lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa legs grub kyi dga' ston rgya che ba spel/ 1994lor rje 'di nyid kyis thugs bkod zhib phra gnang zhing gtso 'gan bzhes pa'i gtsos sras mkhar dgu thog legs grub kyi mdzad sgor khri gung thang rin po che zhal 'dzoms ngang rab gnas gnang / shing phag lor gter lung dgon du bde mchog gi sgrub mchod smad rgyud kyi phyag bzhes ci bzhin gsar 'dzugs gnang / 1996lor 'du khang chen mo gsar bzhengs kyi rmang gzhi btings/ 2 0 00lor yongs su rgyas par grub/ 'du khang chen mo ka ba bzhi bcu can gyi steng 'og gi rten ni/ 'du khang nang gi dbus su dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gyan thang dang / rten khri'i g.yas su jo sku khru tshad lnga can nyan thos bcas pa/ rje 'di ba'i 'dra sku khru tshad lnga can/ g.yon du rje tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan khru tshad lnga can sras gnyis dang bcas pa/ sgrol ljang khru tshad lnga can/ mtha' skor du gnas brtan bcu drug dbus dpar bka' 'gyur/ sde dge'i bstan 'gyur sogs gsung rab mang bo/ 'gram g.yas 'jigs byed/bde mchog gsang 'dus/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / gshegs lha so lnga bcas dang / 'gram g.yon rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'khor chen/ kun rig gdugs dkar sogs rgyan thang dang / sgo chen nang logs kyi zhal yar 'khor g.yas su mgon po dang / lha mo/ g.yon du chos rgyal dang / rnam sras te skyes bu gsum gyi chos skyong gi rgyan thang sogs bzhugs/ 'du khang steng gi rgya mthongs kyi dbus su skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / g.yas g.yon du sku phreng drug ga'i 'dra ris gtsos pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi gyan thang dang / jo 'brom yab sras/ sman bla'i tshogs zhing bcas bzhugs/ sgo chen phyi'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / srid pa'i 'khor lo/ sham+bha la'i zhing bkod/ yul skyong gzhi bdag chen po gnyan chen dang / g.ya' ri'i rgyan thang sogs bzhugs/ dri gtsang khang du ring bsrel rnam bzhis zhib par gtams pa'i byams sku mthong ba don ldan khru tshad nyer brgyad can khri rgyab yol bcas pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du nye ba'i sras chen brgyad khru tshad brgyad re can/ byams sku'i g.yas su ston pa'i mdzad rnam las lha babs kyi mdzad pa'i gyan thang / g.yon du ma gha dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod kyi gyan thang mthar bde gshegs so lnga'i logs ris cha tshang / byams khang gi g.yon du mgon chos kyi zhal thang byin rlabs can bzhugs pa'i mgon khang dang / dri gtsang khang gi bar shod du/ dzam dmar gtso bzhugs kyi dzam lha rigs lnga'i lder sku dang /nam mkha' mdzod kyi bum gter bcas bzhugs pa'i dzam khang / lha khang sum thog g.yas su dpal gsang ba — 142 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las zhan su'u glegs bam/'dus pa dang / g.yon tu dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi blos bslangs tshad ldan/ dbus su sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe sku byin rlabs can/ lha khang gi logs rnams su lam rim bla ma brgyud pa'i brnyan ris sogs rten gtsug lag khang dang brten pa lha dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi dri ngad ldang zhing dngos grub kyi char ba 'beb pa/dgos 'dod kyi nor bu dang / dpag bsam gyi ljon pa lta bur skye dgu thams cad kyi re ba yongs su bskong zhing /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam pa/ mthong thos dran reg gis bsdus pa'i lus can mtha' dag thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon khyad par can skrun par byed pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen por gyur/ /da dung dgon par gsang 'dus kyi bdag 'jug gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang / lo de'i zla drug par rje khong rong bo dgon chen du phyag phebs te/ shar skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gtso byas pa'i bla ma rnams dang / dge 'dun pa bzhi stong lhag dmangs tshogs lnga khri lhag 'tshogs par sems bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga nyin gnyis la gnang / 'du khang chen mo'i steng 'og bar gsum thams cad bde blag ngang legs grub byung bas/ bod zla dgu ba'i tshes gsum nas tshes lnga bar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyud smad grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa gdan drangs te dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi slo nas rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs phyag bzhes ltar gnang ba la bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo brgya cig char du phye ba dang / rje khong nyid kyi ljags rtsom gsung 'bum lcags dpar can pota drug dngos su dpar zin/pota bdun pa brgyad pa dang bcas mu mthud du dpar mus/ /gnam lha'i sgar sar gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling /gnam lha'i sgar sar gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling zhes pa da lta'i kun lho khul gyi bsang chu rdzong lba thang zhang gi sgo mo'i thang du chags yod/dgon 'di'i ma dgon ni bsang chu dang g.yon chu 'dres mtshams shar ngos su bla ma ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang / ye shes rgya mtsho sogs kyis btab pa'i a khyung sgar bkra shis chos gling / sprul ba'i sku blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mchos bskyangs tshul sogs mdo smad chos 'byung du snang / pho brang du thub sku rgya gar shing rtse ma/ rje bkra shis do kha ma/ 'jam dbyangs dang bu ston gyi sku brnyan byin can/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'phel gdung lug ril tsam gyis gtsos gzhan 'phel gdung lnga brgya sogs rten sna bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ phyis su ma dgon bkra shis chos gling / 'khyil kho'i dgon/ ka tog dgon/ smyo shul dgon/ nī gi dang bem chung dgon chu mig dgon chung sgrub sde mtha' dag gis khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po gter lung bse tshang la dgon gsar 'debs mos mthun ngang sa brtag zhus/ a khyung bla ma rnam gsum lha ldan dbus su kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang bo mjal skabs su gnas chung gi lung bstan pa gsung mthun pas/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu sprel lo(1872)a khyung bla ma sgar ba'i mchog sprul blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar — 143 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/te gnam lha'i sgar sar gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling btab po/ /spang ljongs nags tshal gyis brgyan pa'i gnam lha zhol ma'i lha sde dag gis 'byor tshogs la brten nas dgon 'di'i 'du khang dang byams khang sogs gsar bzheng gi rmang btings/ lo rgyus 'gar rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu sprel la dgon btab tshul bkod pa de 'phyugs/ 'du khang chen mo'i dbus su bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa rgya gar shing rtse'i sku brnyan byin can ma dgon nas spyan drangs pa dang byams pa khyung mgo ma rten gtso'i nang bzhugs pa'i byams khang rten brten pa khyad mtshar can bzhengs/ spyi khang dang btsan khang / nub byang mtshams su bdud 'dul mchod rten bcas bzhengs/ 'debs pa bo sprul ba'i sku rang nyid las bla brang smad rgyud phyag len ltar bca' yig mdzad/ dgon mgo gter lung la phul te dus 'di nas bzung bse bla ma sprul sku'i phreng rim gyis 'dzin bdag mdzad/ de yang a khyung bla ma sgar mchog gi sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa kha gya'i chu nag sde khrod du sku 'khrungs/ bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas sogs kyi zhabs pad bsten nas chos bka' rgya cher gsan/ rang dgon gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling dang kha gya stod sgar sar sogs kyi khri mdzad/ kha gya stod ri rgyal dpon po'i bla mar bkur/ yul gyi ri bo gcod dge sgang la dar lcogs btsugs/ dad 'bul nor zog mang du 'dus te su rug bzung / a khyung gnyer ba rgya mtsho zhes pas kha gya'i sgar rnying nas gzim khang rnying ba'i shing cha drangs te kha gya stod dge bstan 'phel gling dang gnam lha'i sgar du gzim khang bskrun/ chu rta lor(1882)kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog kha gya'i phyogs bcu'i lha gnyan g.yu rtser bstad zhor gnam lha zhol ma'i sgar la phebs skabs bsnyen bkur phul/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gis gang ci'i mdzad pa mtha' dag ya rab mkhas pa'i srol bzang bos sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling mchog phyag 'debs mdzad de snga na med pa'i bka' drin che ba gcig tu mdzad/ de'i sprul sku a khyung sgar tshang skal bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu 'brug lor(1892)yab mdzod dge dpon po mgon po tshe brtan dang yum pad+ma 'tsho'i sras su kha gya nas 'khrungs/ rje blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog dang kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te phar phyin dam bca' dang rdo rams pa'i dam bca' bzhag kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i rang rnam las a khyung sprul sku skal bzang lung rtogs la er ti la mi rgan mkhan po'i bka' shog bstsal pa snang / de'i rjes su rang dgon gnam lha'i sgar sar dang / kha gya'i sgar sar dgon nas khri yang mdzad/ gdan sar gzim khang rgya bskyed de bzhengs/ sku dar yol ba'i dus grwa sa nas log ste 1958lor btson du bcug nas1961lor sku gshegs so/ /gzhan gnam lha zhol ma'i sgar sar dgon dang a khyung sgom grwa shes rab gling du bla ma a khyung zer ba'i sprul sku gsum bzhugs pa las/ so so'i rnam thar gyi sa bon nges can dpyod mi nus kyang / de dag mdzod dkar ba a khyung zhabs drung zhes pa lags ling ju sde bzhi sogs kyi dkar chag phyogs bsgrigs nang du a khyung blo bzang — 144 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mchog grub nyi ma zhes bkod pa mthong / de'i sprul sku a khyung zhabs drung blo bzang lung rtogs dpal 'byor rgya mtsho mchog ni rong ngar dgon dang chos sde gang mang la 'gyed dang / tsher sdod klad nas sgrub pa mdzad tshul gleng / de'i sprul sku a khyung zhabs drung tshul khrims lung rtogs rgya mtsho mchog ni/ pad dkar stag mgo'i dpon po bkra shis dang / yum bsod nams 'tsho'i sras su sku bltams/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling du gdan sar bkod/ skyabs mgon blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas gzhung dang gdams pa mang bo byang bar gyur te/ smad sog rgya nang lan du mar phebs te sku gsung thugs rten mang bo sbyor 'jags bgyis/ gtsug lag khang dang gzim khang dag zhig gsos mdzad/ rje 'di bar dad zhen che ba da lta rang lo brgyad cu lhag son pa'i bar mdo'i rdo rje tshe ring gis dgung lo don gnyis steng du gshegs song zer/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags 'brug lor(1940) kha gya'i phying gur phug gi yab tshe ring 'brug dang yum lha mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chos grwar slob gnyer mdzad de kun spyod gtsang ma'i yon tan mnga' brnyes pa zhig byung / lcags bya lor(1960)sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /gzhan yang gnam lha'i phyogs su snga sor 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen dam pa la/ gig skyes ko gya bla ma/ 'be sku skyes ngag dbang theg mchog a khyung mkhas mchog dpa' bo/ bla ma nī gi sprul sku tshul khrims lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ da lta ba dge bshes grags pa bla ma dkar bo dang sgo mang mkhan sprul dag gi yongs 'dzin dpal ldan sogs mchis so/ /'du khang chen mo'i nang rten gtso bo thub sku rgya gar shing rtse ma dang / rje bkra shis do kha ma/ 'jam dbyangs dang bu ston gyi sku brnyan byin can dang / tshe lha rnam gsum gser bzhengs/ gnas brtan bcu drugabla ma glang dkar ba'i bum pa sogs rten gsum mang bo/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan dang rje yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum mang bo bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / 'du khang steng du mgon khang / gtor sgrub khang /dzi khang / klung rta'i khang bcas 'dzoms/ byams khang mthong grol chen mo dang nye sras brgyad bzhugs pa'i byams khang / ma ṇi spyi khang du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sogs gya nom pa/ srung ma dam can rdo sku byin can nang bzhugs kyi btsan khang / bdud 'dul mchod rten dang mtha' 'khor du ma ṇi bcas bzhengs so/ /da dung dgon du a khyung sgar ba'i nang chen dang / sgom grwa tshang dang zhabs drung tshang nang gcig pa'i nang chen/ gter lung nang chen bcas gsum dang / grwa shag drug cu tsam phub par grwa ba brgya tsam 'dus/dgon pa'i 'chad nyan ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i smad rgyud ltar tshugs/ chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ zla gcig pa'i nang smon lam/ zla gnyis pa'i nang yid dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyi bsnyen mtshams/ zla gsum pa'i nang bde mchog lca i ba'i bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ zla ba bzhi ba maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba dang gsang 'dus bdag 'jug zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi bla ma'i gdung mchod dang chos spyod kyi rim pa 'ga' zhig zla ba drug par thugs — 145 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ma ṇi ril sgrub/ tshes bcu nyin a khyung bla ma gtsos grwa tshang gnam lha'i brag dkar rtser phebs nas 'dzam gling spyi bsang phul/ zla bdun par sman lha'i stong mchod dang dbyar gnas/zla brgyad par dus bzhi'i chos thog gi ston chos/ bla mchod smon lam/ zla dgu bar 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i bdag 'jug sa chog klu chog sbyin sreg bcas/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mor chos spyod rab gsal gyi rim pa mang bo/ gsang 'dus chog rkyang / zla bcu gcig pa'i gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ bla brang dus 'khor ltar gyi lha mo'i dbyangs dang rnga 'ching sogs shin tu mang bo/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du lo rnying sku rim dang / da dung dus tshigs bzhi la mgon chos rgyal gnyis kyi dbyangs dang rnga 'ching / srung ma dam can gyi gtor chog bskang gso rgyas pa bcas mdzad kyin gda' 'o/ /dgon pa'i las sne la bla ma gsum gtsos khri ba dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ gnas brtan nam rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sgrig bdag spyi ba che chung / rgan pa drug chab ris/ dkor gnyer/ ja ma bcas bsko/dgon par sngon chad sa zhing nags tshal cung mang ba dang mchod gzhis lha zhol mi sde spyi dang / sgar mtha' mdzod grwa zhol ma bcas yod cing / grong tsho so sos ma ṇi smyung gnas 'dzin pa la/ lo re'i dbyar dus gnam lha'i khyad rta brgyad kyis phyogs 'di'i gnam lha'i brag dkar ri rtse dang rdza rgan bla rtse bstad de lha dang bla ma'i dbu 'phang bstod pa'i srol rgyun spel/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i rjes su dgon pa chag 'jig byung bas lha rten sogs bsnubs tshar rjes dgon shul tsam du btang mod kyang / lcags bya lor slar chos sgo phye nas 'jam mgon bla ma bse chos kyi rdo rje bas thugs rje bdag khur gnang ba dang ri mthon pa'i sgang la rlung rta'i dar lcog btsugs/ma dngul sgor khri phrag dgu tsam snga phyi gnang ba rkyen byas te 'du khang chen mo gser tshon bskyar du bzhengs/kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog dang / kun mkhyen drug pa mchog gis dgon 'dir lha rten chos gsum re gnang / rgyal dbang dang bo dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhabs chags dang / srung ma dam can gyi rdo sku byin can bzhugs/ drag po gsum 'dril gyi sku 'bum brgya lugs/ dad ldan dag gis byams pa'i sku brnyan sogs bzheng rabs gleng zhing dge slong 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa gtsos dge 'dun pa zhal sum cu/ rtsa grangs nas sngar srol chos spyod thams cad yar ldan du spel bzhin mchis/ byams chen yang bzhengs zer/ bse bla ma'i gsung bzhin sngon gyi bdud 'dul mchod rten bskyar du bzhengs so/ /gnam lha'i brag dkar sgom grwaganam lha'i brag dkar sgom grwa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi lbang gur thang zhang gi khongs su chags/sgom grwa 'di gna' dus nas bka' brgyud pa dang phyis su dge lugs pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson mkhan mi nyung bas sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i gnas mchog zhig red/ gnas phyogs nas sgrub la — 146 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gzhol mkhan skyes chen dam pa ni mkhas mchog dpa' bo dang / a khyung bla ma sgar ba'i sku phreng snga phyi/ tsa na bla ma/ nyin shar ko rgya bla ma/ mtsho kha'i ma ṇi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ rwa bsod nams sprul sku/ gnam lha'i shes rab sogs mchis/ khyad par du rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho ba'i 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i snang brnyan dang / bde mchog mkha' spyod ma'i rten thang gnas 'di'i sman lung ba rje 'jam dbyangs shes rab par gnang zhing / khong gis kyang gnas nyid nas 'dod chung chog shes kyi sgo nas yid dam bsnyen sgrub du ma'i nyams len brtson/ rje 'di ba kha gya'i sman lung gi snying dkar rgyal dang yum thar mo skyid kyi sras su me 'brug ste spyi lo1916lor sku 'khrungs/ dme shul mu to skal bzang mtshan can yul phyogs 'dir phebs lam byis pa nyid la gzigs pa che zhing srung mdud gnang nas rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i thugs sprul red gsungs skad/ rab tu byung phyin sman lung rang dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos grwar zhugs te bla kho rdo rje 'chang dang yongs 'dzin grags pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas mdo sngags dang rig gnas la mkhyen dpyod che ba'i blo gros rgyas/ tsa lus nas 'khrungs pa'i tsa ne bla ma'i yongs 'dzin bzhugs/ brag dmar mkhas grub dang bcas te sman lung dgon pa'i 'du khang la gser tshon byug pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa dang dgon par lha rten mchod gsum spyi rdzas 'jog pa che/ gcod dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dag la dus rtag tu brtson zhing dus kyi mtshan ma khyad par can lan 'gar byung / gnam lha dang hor gtsang / kha gya/ sman lung sogs kyi skye bo'i na tsha sdug bsngal bkrol bar mdzad de 'gro phan rlabs po che bar mngon/ 1958lor 'khrug rkyen las sgom grwa nas nyes med btson bzung thebs/ btson bkags bkrol tshun byams pa'am rje'i stong mchod mang bo dang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro ma'i bsnyen rgyud kyi bdag 'jug 'phags pa thar ba chen po stong tshan sogs grub mthar/ 1977me sbrul lo'i zla9ba'i tshes5nyin bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'phel mkha' spyod gur khang du thugs dam la bzhugs bzhin gzigs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i ngang tshul mdzad do/ /brag ri dang spang ljongs dang nags tshal gyis rnam par spud pa'i sgrub gnas 'dir sprul mchog a khyung ba gtsos pa'i gnam lha'i khya rta brgyad(gnam lha zhol ma)kyis dbyar zla lnga ba dang drug pa'i nang lha bsang gtong ba dang rlung rta'i dar lcog 'dzugs par bya/ gter lung bse sku phreng snga phyi gnas su phyag phebs nas bstan don 'phel rgyas dang 'bangs mir bde skyid lo legs 'byung ched rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bstad/ da lta sgom grwa slar gsos pa'i gnas su kun spong ba skal bzang sbyin pa zhes pa rgyun bzhugs sgos sgom sgrub lhur len pa'i skabs so/ /a khyung sgom grwa thar ba gling /a khyung sgom grwa thar ba gling ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi thang dkar nang zhang dang wang gur thang zhang gnyis kyi sa mtshams g.yon chu'i nyin ngos su chags/— 147 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/sgom grwa 'di a khyung mkhas mchog ye shes dpa' bo zhes pas btab/ rje 'di'i sku phreng gi gdan sar gyur te 'dzin bdag gnang / kun mkhyen gong ma mdo smad du phebs skabs gdan 'dren zhus par/ khong gis ri khrod kyi gnas 'di bde mchog sgrub pa'i gnas yin 'dug pas bde mchog tshogs 'don gyis zhes gsungs pa bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ rje a khyung ba 'di'i 'khrungs yul mdzod grwa gong ma red zer/ dbus kyi dge bshes chen por gyur gshis kun mkhyen rnam thar du rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bsngags/ de'i sprul sku a khyung ngag dbang mkhyen rab mchog gis gzhon dus grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang rnga rgod nam mkha' seṅga sogs mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas chos grwar zhugs zer/ mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la thugs gnyer mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/ brtsams chos rje bla ma'i bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal bo'i do shal zhes pa'i mtshan rtags sogs mdzad pa'i pota gcig ste snga sor sgom grwar kha gya'i dpar kyang yod/ gdan sa rang dang / kha gya'i sgar sar/ rong ngar dgon pa sogs skyong khur gnang / de'i sprul sku dkon mchog blo gros rgya mtsho bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos grwar zhugs/ klog bzang bas rje'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung mang du gnang ba sogs kyi rnam thar a mdo chos 'byung du snang / de'i sprul sku dkon mchog 'phrin las lhun grub/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te kun mkhyen bzhi ba bla mar bsten nas thos bsam slob gnyer mdzad/ gdan sa thar ba gling sogs kyi lha khang dag zhig gsos mdzad/ sku tshe smad du gdan sa'i ri khrod nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mi mngon par lhur bzhes gnang / de'i 'phror sprul sku snga phyi gnyis las snga ma klu tshang skal bzang 'phrin las dang phyi ma mdzod dge ba blo bzang 'jigs med e yin snyam/da lta ba a khyung sgom rwa'i mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sbrul lor 192khamadzod dge'i brgya dpon lha mo skyabs dang yum mkha' te'i sras su sku bltams/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen pos a khyung sku gong ma'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin gling du lha babs dus chen nyin la gdan sar bkod/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs rim par bsten te thugs gnyer mdzad/ phyis su sgrub sde thar ba gling du bzhugs nas rje gong ma'i dus ltar gdan sa'i sgom grwa rang dang rong ngar bcas skyong khur gnang / rab rgyal sa khyi lor btson du bcug pas lo 'gar lus/ btson grol thob phyin khyim tshang bzung ste pha yul dme bo'i 'brog tu bzhugs so/ /sgrub sde 'di'i gtsug lag khang la 'du khang dang / spyi khang / sgom grwa tshang dang a khyung zhabs drung sku gnyis nang gcig gi nang chen/ grwa shag 'ga' dang mtha' 'khor ma ṇi 'khor khang bcas 'dus/ 'du khang gi nang rten gtso bo skyabs mgon bzhi bas gnang zer ba'i bde mchog bdud rtsi 'bebs pa/ zhabs drung sprul sku tshul khrims lung rtogs rgya mtshos smad nas gdan drangs pa'i ltung gshegs lha so lnga dang / sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug dang yid dam rgyud sde mang bo'i li sku che chung brgya phrag du ma 'du khang — 148 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang nang chen lha khang du til gyi gang bu ltar gzi 'od gsar ba bzhugs/ gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' bstan dang / rje yab sras/ kun mkhyen yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum mang bo/ a khyung bla ma sku gong ma dag gi gdung rten nam rgyal mchod rten 'ga' zhig dang mchod pa'i yo byad mang bo/ mkhas mchog dpa' bo dbus nas dge bshes chen po byon pa'i skabs su rgyal dbang mchog nas gnang zer ba'i sil snyan khams can sogs rten 'gang can du ma yod/ rgyun bzhugs bla ma gcig dang rdo rje 'dzin pa gtsos btsun pa bcu tsam bzhugs te bla brang smad rgyud ltar btsugs pa'i gnam lha'i sgar sar gyi bca' yig phyag len bstar/ zla ba'i yar ngo dang dus bzang la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga chag med sgrub pa dang / dbyar gnas ma ṇi smyung gnas tshugs/ bla sgang dang mdzod grwa gong ma zhes pa'i grong tsho ni sgrub grwa 'di'i sbyin bdag gtso bo dang gnam lha zhol ma spyi nas mchod bkur che/ sngon chad tsher sdong che chung gi nags tshal dang / wang thang bar ma'i mdo sogs su sa zhing mang / rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i rjes su chag 'jig byung bas phyis su gyang khog ma gtogs med par btang mod kyang / nye char a khyung bla ma da lta bas dbu bskul cing lha sde dag gis sgom grwa bskyar du bzheng so/ /mcho kha'i ri khrod/hor gtsang mtsho kha'i(mtshe'u kha)ri khrod ceru pa da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi mar thang zhang du chags/ri khrod 'di ni gangs can pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i gnas drang srong dgyes pa'i lte gnas shig yin par grags/ gna' yig ltar na/ ri khrod kyi mtshan dngos la mtsho kha'i ri khrod phun tshogs nor bu'i chos sdings zhes bkod pa dang / bla ma mtsho kha ba dang rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho zung gis sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i dben gnas 'gangs chen red/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma sku phreng snga phyi hor gtsang che chung du phebs zhor lan 'gar bzhugs pa dang / khyad par du kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis kyang rang gi bla ma bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi sgrub gnas yin zhes gsungs nas phebs rtsis mdzad do/ /de yang 'dir skabs su bab pa'i rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar til cung 'god pa la/rje btsun chen po 'di ba rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag(spyi lo1866)lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ka ring zhes pa'i sde khrod nas yab rta mgrin dang yum lha mo byams kyi sras su sku bltams/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas bla kho sku gong ma'i yang srid la ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo dgu bar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du spyan drangs shing 'phags pa'i gnas brtan pa rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho las rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs/ rdo rams pa 'phrin las dge rgan du bsten nas gsal byed 'phral klog sogs dag thon pa mkhyen/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i drung nas tshe dbang gsan/ mkhas dbang zhang ston pa'i zhabs spyi bor bsten nas skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang dga' ldan lha — 149 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/brgya ma'i lung gsan pa la 'brug skad lhang lhang grags pas bla ma thugs mnyes te rten 'brel bzang gsungs/dgung lo bcu gnyis pa bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs grwar zhugs nas bka' pota 'ba' zhig thugs gnyer brtun gshis mkhas grub chen po'i snyan pa rgyas/ yang mkhan chen rje btsun ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang dang gdams pa thugs bzhes/ rje sgo mang rin po che la bde mchog dang zab don bsnyen rgyud kyi dbang lung du ma zhus pa dang de nyid nas dgung lo nyi shu ba shing bya'i steng bsnyen par rdzogs te ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rje bor gyur/ de bzhin bstan pa'i mig rkyen dang gdul bya la phan pa'i thabs kho nar dgongs nas me khyi lo'i(18〈7lo)smon lam dus su rgan gya'i brag dkar gyi gnyan khrod brgyud de hor gtsang mtsho kha'i ri khrod du phebs nas sgom sgrub snying bor mdzad/ de dus khong gis/ rnam dag nges 'byung brtan po 'dzin ma'i gzhir / bsrung sems sa bon grung bo skyed bsrings pas/ theg mchog byang chub 'bras bu g.yur za bar/ phan bde'i dga' ston gong nas gong 'phel shog ces gsungs/gnas 'dir khong gis rje tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa dang rje'i gsung 'bum blus nas bzhugs/ rje'i sku 'bum thar gcig blugs/ spyi 'jog tu dong tse chon brgya dang 'bru rigs 'jag bzhi gnang / 1940lor gnas nyid nas thugs rje chen po dang / skyabs 'gro/ dmigs brtse ma/ ma ṇi bcas kyi dbang lung gnang /lam rim bsdus don gyi 'grel ba brtsams/ rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum pota drug mchis pa ri khrod 'di nas par shing 'grub par brkos te yul byes kun tu khyab par btang / bla brang bkra shis dge 'phel ri khrod nas kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' bzhin me tog bcud len gyi sgo nas bsnyen sgrub zab mo mdzad pa dang / bde mchog mkha' spyod ma/ zhal bzhi ba bcas kyi rten bzhengs/ yang bla brang rje'i lha khang gi nang rten gtso bo bcas sku gsung thugs rten dang yo byad bsgrugs/ tshogs chen 'du khang zhig gso la phyag rjes de bas che zhes kun gyis gleng / khong mkhas btsun bzang bo'i yon tan gyis thugs rgyud bltams pas paṇa chen bcu ba dang / kun mkhyen lnga ba/ gung thang drug pa bcas kyis gtsug rgyan du bkur/ dgung lo gya gsum pa sa glang lo'i (1949)hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /rje btsun 'di'i thugs zin bu slob ni bya bral ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin zhes pa yin te/ khong sa stag lo(1ra7rngalo)la kha gya'i sman lung gi khyim brtan don grub kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su byi ba dang ri dwags mang bo bkums/ nyin 'ig la byi ba zhig gsod pa'i skabs su byi bas kyang thal mo sbyar te srog nyen bgrol ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu tshul bstan/ de 'phral dge sgrub sdig gshags kyi rgyud bskul stabs rang lo nyer bdun steng khyim pa spangs nas rab tu byung / rje bla kho rin po che dang bde thang ba bdun pa'i zhabs gtugs te gnas 'di nas gtan chags su sgrub pa'i snying bor mdzad/ dus shig sgrub logs brag gseb nas dngul mang brnyed pa yul 'di'i grong tsho la zhen chags med par phul/ dad ldan tshos kun spangs par gzim khang bskrun/gnas 'di nas khong gis smyung gnas sum stong drug brgya dang / yig drug dung phyur gsum dang bye ba lnga/— 150 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yon chab sa ya lnga dang 'bum bzhi/ brkyang phyag sa ya lnga dang 'bum/ bzhi bcas dge sbyor gyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar mdzad/ dgung lo nga gcig skabs su bya bral sman lung bas ri khrod kyi lha khang dang nang rten thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal bzhengs pa la/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal gzigs par grags/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po lcam sring bsten cing mchod gtor 'bul ba'i sgrig btsugs/ bse bla ma'i bka' bzhin hor gtsang dang / gnam lha/ kha gya'i sgar grong gi ma ṇi smyung gnas kyi bla mar bkur/ de'i phyir mtsho kha'i ma ṇi ba zhes pa'i dge mtshan thogs/ 1956shing sprul lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin ri khrod nas sgom sgrub ngang sku 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ gdung rus la yig 'bru 'phel ba kun gyi mthong snang grub pas ngo mtshar ba byung ngo / /1958lor ri khrod rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ da skabs slar lha khang dang rten thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ rje tsong kha ba/ bla kho rin po che sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhengs/ mtsho kha sde bas blus pa'i bka' 'gyur dang rje gsung 'bum bzhugs/ bya bral sman lung bas dge sbyor mdzad pa'i yig bzhag gsal kha can bsten/smyung gnas bla ma mdzad pa'i ri khrod pa zhig kyang bzhugs pa'i dus so / /glag tshang sgom grwahor gtsang gi glag tshang sgom grwa da lta'i gan lho khul gyi bsang chu rdzong mar thang zhang gi khongs su chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du/ grub dbang bskal ldan rgya mtshos phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i hor gtsang sgrub sde bzhi'i gras yin par gsungs/ sgrub khang gi rten gtso ni gsang bdag snub ris byin can dang / sku gsung thugs rten 'ga' bzhugs/ bla ma bstan pa ba sku rim byon dang hor gtsang grags pas bskyangs/ chos thog tu gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / dus bzang dag tu bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs chos spyod spel/lcags phrug chos 'dzin sogs btsun pa bdun brgyad rgyun bzhugs gnang ba dang / dgos nges ltar tsag tsag dgon nas grwa mang mngags par bya/ sgom grwas srung ma mgon po phyag drug bsten pa dang / rnam 'joms khrus gsol gyi 'gro phan che tshul brjod/ 195〈lo'i rjes su sgom grwa rtsa ba nas bsnubs mod kyang / da lta slar mang tshogs kyis nyams gso byed bzhin mchis so /kha bar sgom grwa kun bzang 'gyur med gling /kha bar sgom grwa kun bzang 'gyur med gling ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong mar thang zhang gi khongs su chags/sgom grwa 'di mdo smad chos 'byung du/ grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos btab pa'i hor gtsang sgom grwa bzhi'i ya gyal cig yin/ nang rten la thub dbang / byams pa/ nye sras bcas mi nyung ba bzhugs/ tsag tsag dgon pa ma btab pa'i sngon la grwa ba bcu phrag lnga tsam 'dus/ chos spyod la gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang /— 151 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dus bzang rnams su bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs rgyun 'dzin legs/ srung ma mgon po zhal bzhi ba bsten gshis sku brnyan che legs shig bzhengs/ bla ma dbu rtse bas legs por bskyangs pas gzim khang bskrun/dbu rtse ba dang bo ni ya shul dgu snying gi gzungs go'i gnam lha rgyal gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ gnyis pa to ma gya zhes pa nas sku 'khrungs/ gsum pa 'bru 'dren ya shul hor gdong klad nas yab 'od zer gyi sras su bla ma seng gdong ba dang sku mched du 'khrungs/ bla ma mang bo'i zhabs la gtugs shing mdo smad gang sar 'gro don du lan 'ga' phebs/ kha ba sgom grwa dang tsag tsag dgon du gzim khang brgyab pa dang sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ sku thog bzhi ba skal bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa rab rgyal lcags bya(1921)lor hor gtsang dkon te'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ phri/ chen hor gtsang drug pas ngos 'dzin gnang / tsag tsag dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs nas thos bsam mang du gzhol/ skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pas sgom grwa dang dgon pa'i 'chad nyan gyi khur chen bzhes/ dbus su chas te mchod 'bul gang rgyas gnang / 195〈lor ma nyes kha g.yogs ngang bzung ba la btson nas sku gshegs so/ /sgom grwa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad/ gzim khang / spyi khang / grwa shag bcu phrag bcas sa khyi lor chag 'jig shor/ btsun pa rgan gzhon rnams rang rang pha yul du bskrad/ dge bshes kha gya'i bstan pa zhes pas ya shul lung mdor bzhengs (1952lor)pa'i byang chub mchod rten 'jig da lta bse drug pa'i sku drin las sgom grwa bskyar du gsos shing byams pa dang mgon po zhal bzhi ba'i snang brnyan sogs bzhengs/ bla ma dbu rtse ba sprul sku'i don yar zhu ba'i sgang yin la/ tsag tsag dgon pa'i phyag len btsugs shing grwa ba dus rgyun gtong bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /mar thang sgar/hor gtsang gzhung gi mar thang sgar zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong mar thang zhang gi nye 'dabs su chags/sgar ba 'di ni hor gtsang shog pa spyi gzhung gi lo re'i ma ṇi dang lnga mchod tshogs gnas red/ nam tshod btab pa rtsad ma chod kyang mdo smad chos 'byung dang blo ldan rgan po'i ngag rgyun ltar na/ sngar sa skya'i lugs bzhin spel ba'i sgrub sde zhig gi gnas shul du hor gtsang gser khri 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge (1747da wa1815)mchog dang / mar thang sprul sku rnam pa gnyis kyis dbu bskul cing / hor gtsang shog pa sbyin bdag bgyis te 'du khang che legs can zhig bzhengs nas nang rten la thugs rje chen po dang /thub dbang / rje yab sras/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang byin can du ma/ pha lung sog phrug blo bzang gis smad sog nas gdan drangs pa'i ston sku li ma mi tshad can/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan dang / phyis rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten bcas mang bo bzhugs su gsol zer/— 152 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gzhan logs su byams khang rten brten pa khyad mtshar can zhig kyang bzhengs/ rje hor gtsang rin po che nas spyi bla mkhan po dang / rje nyid nas bla tshab na rim bskos te hor gtsang gzhung gi khri mdzad pa dang / co de'i khya dge ba rje dkon mchog blo gros rgya mtsho sogs bzhugs myong / rung khang ngam spyi khang du tshogs slang che chung lnga dang ca lag yo byad 'dzoms po bsgrugs/ mar thang du sa zhing / ya shul dang snod shul du nags tshal rgya che gnyer/ khyad par du gter lung bse tshang sku phreng snga phyi dang / ko nyid zhal dkar ba sku phreng snga phyi/ kirti sku phreng snga phyi sogs sgar gzhong 'dir yang yang zhabs bcags nas thugs rje byin rlabs bdag gir mdzad/yang hor gtsang bla spyi gzhung gsum nas zhus te skyabs rje kirti bcu gcig pa blo bzang ye shes mchog gis gzhung 'di nas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dang 'chi med tshe dbang lung 'gro drug stong phrag du mar bstsal/ lo re'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig nas bcu bdun bar hor gtsang ma ṇi sgrub sde mar thang du lhan 'tshogs sgos ma ṇi ril sgrub sogs kyi chos spyod rgya cher spel/ yang zla bcu ba'i nang sgar ba'am dgon pa brgyad gas lnga mchod re mos su 'dzin pa'i srol dar ro/ /mar thar bla ma blo bzang 'jigs med nyi ma zhes bya ba de hor gtsang 'bru 'dren gyi lung bar sku 'khrungs/mar thang du gzim khang brgyab pa la mar thang tshang zhes dus su thogs/ sku na phra dus nas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing mar thang dgon dbus su sgrub khang brtsigs te dam chos rtse gcig tu bsgrub par gzhol/ de'i phyi ma kha gya tsho drug gi nang tshan gtsos shog pa nas sku 'khrungs/ gdan sar bkod rjes re zhig mar thang sgar nas bzhugs pa dang / tsag tsag dgon pa btab phyin dgon de nas gzim khang bskrun te bzhugs/ mar thang sku phreng gsum pa skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho ni shing stag lo ste spyi lo1914lor hor gtsang ko nyin dpon tshang gi yab dar rgyas dang yum dbang mo'i sras su bltams/ tsag tsag dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs shing bse lnga ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ gdan sa'i 'chad nyan sogs la skyong khur bzhes/ 1958lo'i rjes su khyim pa brten cing rgyal khab kyi las byed pa'i gas su zhugs pa dang / phyis su rdzong dang khul gyi srid gros u yon sogs khur sna tshogs bzhes mthar1991lo ste rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags lug la bkra shis 'khyil nas dag zhing du chas so/ /1958lo'i rjes su hor gtsang gzhung sgar 'di rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ da snga mang tshogs kyi dad pa'i dbang dang srol rgyun chos spyod slar gso'i dgos mkhor dmigs nas snga ma'i 'du khang shul du slar lha khang chung chung 'ig bzhengs/ bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rjes dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba'i snang brnyan bzhengs pa dang mchod sprin tshigs su bcad pa gsungs/ zhal dkar ba'i rten thang zhal bzhi ba la rab gnas mdzad/da dung sbyin bdag bkra shis zhes pas thugs rje chen po dang / chu sngon rta mgrin zhes pas byams pa bzhengs pa la sogs sku rten byin can dang gsung rten mi nyung ba bzhugs/ de bzhin da lta spyi gzhung nas spel ba'i dus gtong bskang gso bcas dang / mdo smad chos 'byung du gsungs pa'i sa ga zla ba'i ma ṇi sgar sgrub ces pa dang /— 153 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'jam mgon bla ma rje bdag nyid chen po dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du re zhig sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen la dmigs te tshugs pa'i rjes dran lnga mchod chen mo rnam dkar dge tshogs 'di'i chos spyod rgyun 'khyongs bzhin mchis so /hor gtsang gsang snga gas dar rgyas gling /hor gtsang sngags mang zhes pa'i gsang sngags dar rgyas gling ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi ma/ra thang zhang mgo ba thang du chags/gsang sngags rnying ma'i rdzogs chen dgon pa 'di ha lam rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu bya ste spyi lo181 2lor grub dbang kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas 'gro mgon tshogs drug zhabs dkar bas btab tshul brjod/ rje zhabs dkar bas 'du khang bzhengs skabs rgyu rkyen gang dgos sbyar ba ma zad/ khong gi thugs bzhed ltar 'du khang nang rten gtso bo bal yul nas spyan drangs zer ba'i rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug gis pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi li sku mi tshad gtso 'khor dang / rgyal dbang mchog gis gnang ba'i rta mgrin yang gsang dang mi 'khrugs pa li ma/ khru bcu gnyis can gyi 'jam dbyangs dang rje sku bcas bzhugs shing / rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces bla ma gong ma dag gi gsung rgyun ltar lags shing / gzhan yang mkhan slob chos gsum/ gu ru mtshan brgyad 'jim sku lha grangs bcu druga.o rgyan stong sku/ snang srid zil gnon lnga brgya dang bcas sku mang bo dang / rje 'bangs nyer lnga bcas thang sku/zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod sogs kyi gyan thang du ma bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la rin chen gter mdzod po ti brgya dang nyi shu can gtsos pa'i gsar rnying gi gsung 'bum sna tshogs dang / thugs rten du zhabs dkar rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten sogs gsar rnying thugs rten du ma bzhugs/ khyad par du kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyis gnang ba'i las can dag pa'i 'khor lo lnga dang / hor gtsang gter khungs nas 'khrungs pa'i zhabs dkar dkon mchog zla bas dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i snga phyi mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar/ zhabs dkar lnga ba blo bzang chos 'byor rgya mtshos smad nas drangs pa'i lha cha mchod cha mang bo spyi 'jog gnang / da dung 'byor ldan 'gas gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang gos chen gyi 'cham lwa bcas gya nom pa phul/ yang sgos gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgrub grwa 'di phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo/grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol byams pa chos dar/ zhabs dkar rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/ blo bzang byams pa chos 'phel/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs sku phreng gis legs par bskyangs/ zhabs dkar sku gong ma'i dngos slob nyang mtshams bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bca' yig mdzad de 'chad nyan gyi rgyun ring du spel/ sde 'dir reb gong phur thogs stong gi khongs su gtogs pa'i hor gtsang — 154 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rig 'dzin sngags 'chang drug cu lhag la kun spangs bya btang nyang mtshams pas sngon byon rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ chos kyi rtsa ba rig pa 'dzin tshul/ mdo sngags kyi chos kyi nying khu lam rim blo sbyong / gsang sngags rgyud kyi dgongs don bskyed rdzogs chen po'i gnad rnams kyi don gsungs/ sprul ba'i skyes mchog dam pa gang gi bka' drin las/ dus kyi mthar yang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs la rgyud gsang ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sde 'di'i srung ma ni ma gza' rdo gsum bsten cing thang ga byin can yod do/ /dgon par chos thog mi nyung ba re yod de/ bod zla dang bo'i nang bde mchog nang sgrub kyi stong mchod dang / sa zlar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings kyi sgo nas zhi khro bstan pa rigs brgya/ lha 'cham/ zla lnga ba'i nang gza' 'cham/ zla bcu ba'i nang gu ru drug po'i bsnyen sgrub dang gza' 'cham/ 'od dpag med dang o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i bka' brgyad stong mchod/ yar ngo'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu la srung ma'i gtor 'bul bskang gso bcas tshugs/ sde 'di nas gsang sngags gsar ma slob gnyer gyi ched du khams phyogs su phebs te rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i lam khrid 'a na grangs nyer lnga gsan mkhan/ snying thig gi rtsa rlung gi khrid spyod mkhan yang mi 'ga' byung / de min reb gong gi sngags 'chang dam pa rdo rje rnam rgyal dang / kha rgya'i brag dmar dpal rdzong ri khrod 'od gsal gling gi gter bton mngon shes mnga' zhes grags pa'i drung nas sngags phrug du mas chos bka' gsan tshul snang / khyad par du yul phyogs kyi dben gnas dang rang gi spyil khang nang sgom sgrub rtse gcig tu gzhol/ bstan pa spyi sger gyi zhabs brtan nyams len la snga phyir bzhed dgu bsgrubs/ dgon pa'i 'du khang / zhabs dkar ba'i gzim khang / rung khang / rnam thar tshoms ra/ rig 'dzin so so'i spyil khang bcas yod kyang 195〈lo'i rjes su 'jig 1980lor chos sgo slar gso phye nas bse bla ma'i gsung gnang ltar/ 'du khang khang mig so lnga can bskyar gsar du bzhengs te gser tshon btang / sngar gyi rten gtso rig gnas gsar brje skabs su sngags rgan don gos nyar tshags byas/ da lta 'du khang rten gtsor dpon slob gtso 'khor gu ru mtshan brgyad/ sman 'dam gyi slob dpon stong sku/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ thugs rje chen po bcas kyi sku brnyan che chung du ma/sngags 'chang rgyal bos bzhengs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol dang / zangs mdog dpal ris zhing bkod/ rje 'bangs nye lnga bcas kyi zhal thang dang gyan thang / gos chen gyi mchod rdzas sna tshogs/mchod pa'i yo byad du ma bcas bsgrugs/ deng skabs sngags 'chang don go (skabs der lo don brgyad)gtsos rig 'dzin pa zhal grangs sum cu tsam gyis 'chad nyan cho ga'i phyag srol ltar spel/ khro bcu'i gtor bzlog dang / rta mgrin gtor bablog seng gdong gtor bzlog sogs 'don mkhan mang / pad+ma bka' thang dang / gu ru si dhi bzlas sgom byas te sngags kyi nus mthu la bsten nas skye bo mang bo'i don mdzad de/mchod gzhis gtso bo hor gtsang mgo ba thang gi sngags sde yin no/ /— 155 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/hor gtsang kirti'i dgon dge ldan bstan 'phel gling /hor gtsang kirti'i dgon dge ldan bstan 'phel gling ni gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi mar thang zhang du chags/dgon pa 'di ni hor gtsang bla ma rgyal mtshan gyis sras mo'i sgar/ shing chen bla ma'i sgar/ ma ra'i sgar/ri khrod dang bcas sgrub sde thams cad phyogs bsdus kyis kirti sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog la gsol ba btab ste/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu lug18 2 2lor btab/ de rjes kirti rin po che nas bdag rkyen dang / sbyin bdag dkon mchog rgya phyug shog pa'i khur len gyis 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ 'du khang gi nang rten gtso bo 'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas gdan drangs pa'i thub sku khru tshad can/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma/ skya thig rang babs kyi rje tsong kha ba yab sras gsum gyi logs ris che ba sogs zhal thang du ma/ kirti thogs med blo bzang 'jam dbyangs pas sku gzan khug tu bzung ba'i gzan phyed nang bzhugs kyi mchod rten khru nyer lnga ba/ khya dge sprul sku'i gdung rten bcas sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhugs shing / 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po'i dngos slob rong chen ljags nag pa'i sku phreng 'dzin pa/ grub dbang kirti sku phreng rim byon mchog sa blo gsal gling gi yig cha'i steng nas 'chang nyan ma/dzad/ kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis stag tshang dpal gyi dgon dang ri khrod 'di nas yi dam du ma'i ljags bsnyen mang bo mdzad tshul rnam thar bkra shis gser gyi 'khor lo thub bstan mdzes rgyan zhes su gsungs/ khyad par du kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog mdo smad rtse gzhung (kho tshe)gi sa'i char yab sngags 'chang ba bde chen dang yum jo mo thar gyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa bya(spyi lo1849lor)sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga bar kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtshos rong bo chos rje'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad/ mtshan blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho bstsal/a lags bstan pa yongs 'dzin du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog slob 'go tshugs/ rje dkon mchog smon lam bzang bo'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ hor gtsang dgon gsar du cho 'phrul smon lam gsar 'dzugs dgos pa'i gsung bkod dang spyi rdzas sbyor 'jags gnang / smon lam gsar du tshugs pas gsung chos la phebs/ mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs gnang ste bla ma mchod pa'i khrid bstsal pa dang bca' yig mdzad/ dgung lo nyer ba'i ba chu sprel lor rje btsun ngag dbang chos 'phel mchog gi drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ chu bya18 2 2lor chos sde chen po rnga ba'i kirti legs bshad gling phyag 'debs mdzad cing gdan sar bzhugs te 'chad nyan gyi srol bzang spel/ de nas mdo smad kyi dgon sde phal mo che dang sog yul gyi dgon sgrub sde sogs la mchod 'bul dang / chu sprul lo'i snga phyir du hor gtsang che chung gis bsus te dkon mchog rgya phyug gi ser skya'i gzhung nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin gtsos gser khri mchog dang / ko nyin zhal dkar/ tsho 'du tshang / ser skya lnga brgya skor la grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur/ mi tra dzo ki'i thugs bcud/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du ma'i phyag bzhes dang rjes su mthun par legs par bstsal/— 156 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang dang / 'jigs byed las bzhi'i 'phrul 'khor dang lcags mkhar gyi zab khrid/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras dang / grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras nas bzung yab rje 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jigs med bsam gtan dpal bzang bo'i bar du brgyud/ zhal shes man ngag rnams gzhir bzung khrid rgyun gzhan las 'ong ba'i gsung rgyun gyis zur brgyan te gnang / bla ma mchog gi bka' bzhin gnyan rje sngo la g.yu rtse mchod bkur che zhing / kirti brgyad pas gnyan chen gyi gtor tshogs kyi lung bstsal/ dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing sprul(spyi lo1kha0 5)lor rang dgon stag tshang kirti nas sku gshegs/ gsung rtsom po ti bcu gnyis bzhugs/ kirti dgu ba dge 'dun chos kyi dbang phyugakirti bcu ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa dpal bzang bo de nyid dgon 'di la yang yang phebs te rje gong ma'i dus ltar skyong khur gnang / kirti bcu gcig pa rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta lor rnga ba'i mdzod dge the bo zhang stag mgo nas sku 'khrungs shing / kun mkhyen lnga ba chen pos rong bo chos rje'i kirti dang don gcig sprul sku thag bcad de gdan sar bkod/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mar rim par bsten nas mdo sngags gnyis gar thugs gnyer mthar phyin gnang / yang hor gtsang kirti dgon 'di nas bzhugs shing rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi lha khang bzhengs pa sogs la rab gnas mdzad/ hor gtsang che chung gis bla spyi gzhung gsum nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin zab chos 'dod dgubastsal/ phal cher dgon spyi'i bya ba mtha' dag gter lung sku phyogs tshang la gtad de/ da lta rje nyid bstan 'gro'i dpal du 'phags yul na zhabs pad lhun chags su brtan pa'i skabs so/ /yang sgos su rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i thugs zin pa'i slob ma dge bshes blo gsal rgya mtsho mchog ni chu khyi192 2lor reb gong seng gshong nas 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas a rol rin po che blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas gtsug yur phul te rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas mdo sngags la sbyangs pas mkhas grags rgyas/ dgung lo nyi shu nas so bzhi'i ring du dgon 'di nas bzhugs te 'chad nyan gyi srog bzung zhing / chos spyod nyams len gyis dus 'da' gshis/ 'bras bur zhi dul bag yod/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ldan pas kirti bcu gcig pa rin po che nas yang yang bsngags/ de rjes gter lung dgon dang / kha gya stod dgon/ gtsos dga' ldan chos gling / sog tshang dgon/ reb gong seṅge gshong gong 'gab bcas kyi khri mdzad de da lta bzhugs shing bka' drin che tshul kun gyis gleng / khong la gsung rtsom po ti bzhi yod/ chos rgyun 'dzin nus pa'i slob ma bla grwa mang / grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan yab sras kyis dgon 'di nas 'chad nyan 'phel rgyas gtsor 'don mdzad/ kirti 'phrin las rin po che nas dgon 'di'i rtsod rgyugs phul par gzigs rtogs mdzad de thugs mnyes pa'i sgrub pa'i mchod pa bla na med par gyur/ a lags bstan pa tshang / khya dge tshang / seng gdong tshang / mar ma'i bla ma ngag dbang dar rgyas/ shing chen bla sar dkon mchog tshogs gnyis/ ko nyin — 157 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhal dkar blo bzang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ hor gtsang mkhar dmar dge bshes (tshul khrims rgya mtsho)/'breng dkon mchog bsam gtan/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bla ma ngag dbang tshul khrims bcas kyis dgon 'di'i khrid dang 'chad nyan skyong khur bzhes so/ /dgon pa'i lo 'khor gcig gi chos spyod gal che la/ zla dang bo'i nang du cho 'phrul smon lam/ zla gnyis par dpyid chos 'go ma/ zla gsum par dpyid chos chen mo/ hor zla bzhi ba'i bcu gcig nyin grwa tshang gis dung ri'i rtse nas bstan 'gro'i lhag bsam 'grub pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ bco lnga gzhung sgar gyi ma ṇi sgar sgrub/ zla lnga bar dbyar chos/ zla drug pa'i bcu gsum nyin dgon grong spyi'i dung ri'i rtse nas yul khams bde 'jags kyi ched du bsang dang rlung rta rgyas par 'don/ de rjes dbyar gnas/ bdun pa'i rig grwa dang 'jigs byed bdag 'jug brgyad pa'i ston chos/ dgu ba'i kun rig bdag 'jug legs bshad gser phreng / lnga mchod/ zla bcu gcig pa'i nang dgun chos/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang dam pa'i zhabs rim mgon chos sogs kyi bskang bshags/ gzhan bla ma kirti'i gdung mchod/ dus rgyun zla re'i tshes brgyad la gso sbyong / bco lnga gsang 'dus cho ga nyer lnga gnod pa phyir bzlog nyer dgu la mgon chos bskang ba/gzhan zla ba dgu ba'i nang bcu bdun nas nyer lnga bar gyi nyin grangs mi 'dra ba'i chos thog sogs lo 'khor mar nyin125re/ rgyun ja'i tshogs chag med/ zla ba byings kyi yar ngor skyor zla dang chos thog skabs mtshan skyor/rtsod 'don gnyis ga'i rgyugs/ tshogs kyi zhal 'don dang sgrig lam ma dgon stag tshang kirti'i dgon pa ltar byed/ khri ba kirti nas gtong la/ sku tshab kirti nas bsko/ khri ba bla ma/ gzhung las pa/ dge bskos/dbu mdzad che chung gnyis/ sku tshab rgan pa bzhi bcas las sne bcu 'dzoms/ 'du khang dang / sangs rgyas stong gi lha khang / byams khang / rnam sras lha khang / btsan khang bcas lnga/ kirti tshang / khri ba tshang /hor gtsang bla ma/ seng gdong tshang / tshogs gnyis tshang / shing chen bla ma/ mar pa'i bla ma bcas pa'i nang khag chos ra/ bdud 'dul mchod rten/ ma ṇi khang / grwa shag sum cu tsam grwa ba bdun cu bzhugs/dgon pa'i gzhung nags/ sa zhing mu'u brgya tsam yod pa gang dag1958lor gzhung du bsdus shing dgon pa gtor/chos sgo slar phye phyin bse drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog hor gtsang kirti dang / tsag tsag dgon la gdan zhus ltar phebs te khong gis gsung gnang bzhin/ mar ba'i stong sku'i lha khang thog mar bzhengs/ lcags bya19nga1lo nas tshogs 'tshogs thub pa byung / lha khang nang rten du rgyal mchog bcu bzhi bas gnang ba'i ston pa thub dbang gi gtso 'khor thang sku/ rje tsong kha ba yab sras/ kirti rin po che'i snang brnyan/ skyabs 'gro bla mchod/ byams pa'i zhing bkod/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyi sku thang gsar rnying nyi shu lhag dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ yid dam chos skyong zhal bzhi ba sogs kyi gyan thang /bka' bstan gnyis/ rje yab sras dang / kirti ba'i gsung 'bum sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang bo — 158 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzhugs/ dad ldan 'jigs byed nas bdud 'dul mchod rten bzhengs par bse rin po ches rab gnas mdzad/ bzung lung tshe lo spun mched nas thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs/ kirti tshang dang / seng gdong tshang gi nang khag srung ma dpal rtsal gyis btsan khang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang / mchod rten/ dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor du ma ṇi brgya lhag gi 'khor khang du ma bskrun/ grwa shag nyi shu tsam phub cing grwa ba bzhi bcu 'dus/ lha mo'i dge bshes blo bzang bstan 'dzin khri mdzad de 'chad nyan yar ldan du spel/dgon 'dir deng skabs gang ci'i skyong khur gnang mkhan bla ma seng gdong tshang yin zhing / skal bzang legs bshad dang skya ser thun mong gis sngon gyi 'du khang bskyar du bzheng ba sta gon byed bzhin yod/bla ma seng gdong ba sku gong ma bsang rdzong lha chab hor kha gya nas 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas rab tu byung zhing lha chab dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs/ kirti 'phrin las pas lha chab dgon du bde mchog lha lnga bcas dbang gnang skabs bka' chos du ma gsan cing / seng gdong ma'i bsnyen mtshams yun ring bzhugs stabs mtshan yang seng gdong tshang zhes su chags/ khong gi sku tshe smad du o brtan sgar bsam 'phel dar rgyas gling dang / kirti'i dgon 'dir sgrub pa rtse gcig gzhol bzhin gshegs/ de'i yang srid hor gtsang 'bru 'dren dgu snying gi sde khrod du yab 'od zer gyi bu la bla ma dbu rtse tshar rnam gnyis sku mched du 'khrungs / hor gtsang kirti'i sgar gsar du chos grwar 'grims/ de nas smad sog la phebs nas 'phrin las rgyas/ lha rten mchod gsum spyan drangs te kirti'i dgon la spyi 'jog gnang / dgon 'dir gzim khang rgya bskyed de bzhengs/seng gdong sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta1kha42lor yab ban phrug tshe ring dang yum tshe kho'i sras su hor gtsang tsha kha nas 'khrungs/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan drung nas seng gdong gi yang srid thag bcad de dge ldan bstan 'phel gling du gdan sar bkod/ dge slob chos ldan rgya mtshos yi ge 'bri klog sogs bslabs/ dge slong bsam gtan drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul zhus/ bshes gnyen sangs rgyas yongs 'dzin du bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la brtson pa bgyis/ lha mo kirtir chos grwar yin ring 'grims zhing 'dul 'dzin pa dalon mchog mtshan can gyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/dgon der tshogs chen khri lo bzhi dang / dus 'khor khri lo bzhi/ the bo bza' ri'i khri'ang mdzad/ 'phags yul rdo rje gdan sogs su phebs nas bla ma kirti tshang la 'bul nor ngos gtsang phul/ me byi lor lha mo'i dgon dang hor gtsang sgar sar du dpal yid dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs gnang / rgyu rkyen sbyar te mdo sher phyin snying bo rdo rje gcod pa/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bcas kyi par khang btsugs/ da lta sku nyid dgung lo nga bdun son cing zhabs pad lhun chags su brtan lags so/ /gzhan yang hor gtsang bla ma dang / mar ba'i bla ma/ shing chen bla ma skye rgyun 'dzin cing / 'o se hor gtsang bla ma'i dgon ni 'di'i mnga' khongs su mchis/ dgon pa'i mchod gzhis gtso bo la hor gtsang dkon mchog rgya phyug shog pa/ tshul lung tsha mdo/ mar ra thang ser/ 'o se shing chen bcas sde dmangs gsum dang khyim tshang brgya — 159 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/phrag lhag yod do/ /tsag tsag dgon dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling /tsag tsag dung ri dkar bo'i nye 'dabs su chags pa'i chos sde dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong mar thang zhang gi khongs su chags/bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i chos sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs rim par mdzad tshul sogs a mdo chos 'byung du/ hor gtsang che chung gnyis su sman bla bcu gcig sgrub sde bzhi/ sgar ba brgyad rnams yod pa las/ ko nyin sman bla gsum/ 'di'i mchod gzhis dpon skor du khri chen dpal ldan grags pa 'khrungs shing tsag tsag du gzhis ka yod ces gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen po rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs zhor snga phyi hor gtsang nang chen gtsos ko nyin dpon po 'brug rgyal gyis tsag tsag hor gtsang gzhis kur gdan drangs te/ kun mkhyen mchog gis bstan 'gro'i zhabs brtan du dmigs nas rim gro phon chen bsgrubs/ nang chen du bde mchog bsnyen rgyun gyi bdag 'jug gnang / da dung bskang ser ma dang rten 'brel snying bo'i gzungs bcas gsungs te gnas byin gyis brlabs/ hor gtsang nang chen nas gos dngul sogs 'bul ba gzab pa sogs/lo rgyus nges can kun mkhyen rnam thar du snang / shing 'brug190 4lor rgyal tshab dam pa khri chen skal bzang grags pas phyogs 'dir dgon pa 'debs rgyu thugs la dgongs te rten 'brel 'grig thog rgyab ri dung ri dkar bo/ mdun ri bkra shis rgyal mtshan yin stabs sa dpyad tshang ba dgon gnas byas na bzang zhes dpon po blo bzang dang / 'bru 'dren 'od zer bcas la gsung gi me tog 'thor tshul gleng ba ma zad/ bla dpon dag gis dngos song gi dam tshig la bkar te shing chen bla ma'i phyag nas dgon sa nyos te chos grwar sbyar/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing stag spyi lo1914lor khri chen hor gtsang ba'i dpon po blo bzang dang / ko nyin zhal dkar dpon po bstan 'phel gtsos sgar khag so so'i bla dpon sogs ser skya gros mthun gyis/ mtsho kha'i sgar ba dang / ban sgar/ 'bru 'dren ya shul stod ma'i sgar/ ko nyin kya kya'i sgar/ mar thang sgar/ khyu mchog dus bzang sgar bcas sgar chung rnams phyogs bsdus sgos dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad/ 'du khang grwa khang gi las 'go btsugs te rim par bzhengs/ skabs der khri chen hor gtsang drug pa sku na phra stabs/rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos bkra shis gso sbyong sogs kyi 'go mdzad pa ma zad/ khong gis rgyu sbyar te dngul rdo tshad lnga las grub pa'i kun rig rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo mi 'khrugs pa gsum mtho tshad thog phyed dang gnyis can bzhengs te gnang / da dung tshe dpag med dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi thang ga che chung sum cu 'du khang grub pa'i rten du gnang ba dang / dgon pa'i mtshan la dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling btags/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i phyag len cho ga'i bca' yig mdzad/ dge 'dun pa brgya phrag gsum tsam 'dus te — 160 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/'chad nyan 'phel ba'i rten 'brel 'grig bla grwa mang bas zhus pa ltar thog mar rje 'jigs med 'phrin rgyam pas rigs gsum spyi'i rjes gnang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / thugs rje chen po/ kun rig gdugs dkar sogs kyi dbang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ gsang 'dus/ smon lam sna lnga/ theg chen gso sbyong gi lung / 'jam dpal zhal lung / dga' ldan brgya lha ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma rnams kyi khrid/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras bcas kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ bsgrub bya mang bor dge tshul slong gi bslab pa bsgrags/ rnga ba'i smon lam dang smad sog chos rgya mtsho gnyis gdan drangs te dgon pa'i dge rgan du bskos/ bse bla ma'i snyan ngag gi dge rgan kun dga' zhes pa dgon 'di nas byung /dgon pa 'debs pa'i snga phyir hor gtsang bla mas spyi 'jog dang gnang sbyin che/ hor gtsang tsho 'du ba 'jigs med don yod dang a lags bstan pa sogs kyis kyang dgon par skyong khur gnang / pha lung sog phrug blo bzang gis smad phyogs nas spyan drangs pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug li ma gtsos lha rten chos gsum mang bo spyi 'jog che/ bar skabs shig la bstan pa dang skyes chen la zhen nag pa'i jag dmag mang bo bla brang phyogs su lhags pas/ bde bar sdod pa'i skabs ma byung bar/ rje bla kho rin po che dgon 'dir phebs te dkon mchog la gsol 'debs dang chos skyong la 'phrin bcol gang drag bgyis phyir dgon 'di nyid brlag skyon cher ma byung / rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul blo bzang grags pa dang / /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku tshe phreng brgyud kyi/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthu byin las/ /nag phyogs gdug po'i bsam sbyor zhi bar shog/ ces pa'i tshig nan kyang gsungs/ 'du khang zhig gsos sogs thugs khur bzhes te rim gro phon che ba bsgrub tu bcugarab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags 'brug 1940lo'i zla brgyad tshes gcig nyin hor gtsang shog kha bzhis bsu ba bkur sti'i ngang khong gdan drangs te zhus pa ltar/ slob ma rjes 'dzin dang sa chog thig tshon skabs nyin bdun gyi ring la paṇa chen bde lam gyi khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang / 'jigs byed bsnyen chen skor dang / zhal bzhi ba'i bstod pa/ lha mo'i gtor chen gyi lung yang bstsal/ dbang gi sta gon gyi skabs su 'brug sgra ldir zhing sbrang char babs pa sogs skal ba ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi yid kyi bum bzang byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis yongs su gang zhing / zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdud rtsi mchog gi dngos grub legs par rnyed/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs nam mkhar sprin phung 'khrigs/ /yi dam lha yis dngos grub char chen 'bebs/ /dam can chos srung tshogs kyis bgegs dpung 'joms/ /bkra shis dge mtshan snang bas khyab gyur cig/ ces rje bla kho rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa don dang mtshungs so/ /hor gtsang khri chen drug pas rje 'di'i drung nas dbang gsan pa dang shog bzhi'i dgon grong gis 'go mdzad de chos kyi bka' drin zhus/ 'bul ba rgya chen bstar/ yul lha bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i hor gtsang che ba nas zhus pa ltar rje bla kho tshang gis bstad/ bsang dang rlung rta'i srol btsugs/ chos sde 'di'i 'chad nyan sgrig lam kun spyod sogs thams cad kyis thugs la bsnams na rim gyis skyed thon yong zhes gsungs/ lha khang gtsug lag khang sogs nyams — 161 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gso mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur gzab/ yul 'di'i mtsho kha'i ri khrod dang tsag tsag dgon du yun ring bzhugs te bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ kun gyis dad gus bsngags gsum gyi yul du gyur/ rje bla kho tshang gis tsag tsag dgon par bzang spyod gsar btsugs kyi thebs la dong tse khron drug brgya dang nas bre nyis brgya gnang / khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i mchog sprul rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho lcags 'brug1940lor mtsho khar phebs te mchod 'bul dang / rje bla kho rin po che'i drung nas dbang lung rjes gsum gsan pa dang / hor gtsang che bas dbu bskul te dgon 'di'i jo khang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs mdzad/ ༄ bkra shis 'khyil ltar mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi phyag len phal cher btsugs te legs par bskyangs/ dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs brgya phrag gnyis lhag 'dus/ khri rin po chen khong gis rgyal ba mi pham mgon po dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i tsan+dan snang brnyan bzhengs/ sman 'dam las rje yab sras sogs bzhengs te 'du khang du bzhugs/ lha mo'i bskang gso bye chen 'ga' gsung du bcug srung ma lha mo bsten nas 'phrin bcol tshul bzhin bsgrubs/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan dang rje yab
