sras/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam mang bo bzhugs/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gos sku khyad mtshar can bzhengs pa dang / bkra shis 'khyil ba'i phyag len cha 'dra ba'i smon lam tshugs/ rang nyid khri la bzhugs shing cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i bkod pa dang 'chad nyan sha stag mdzad pa ma zad/ bstan 'gro'i phan bder dmigs te lcags mkhar dang 'cham gsar 'dzugs gnang / bla ma dbu rtse skal bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang / bla ma mar thang ba skal bzang legs tshogs rgya mtsho bcas rim par khrir bskos/ shing rta1954lor khri chen nyid nas sa dpyad legs par gzigs te dgon pa'i byang shar du hor gtsang che ba bas sbyin bdag bgyis pa'i mchod rten dge 'dun dbyen 'dum thugs mthun 'phel rgyas bzhengs/ dge ldan bstan 'bar ma bton te bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo smon nan tan byas tshul sogs dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rna lam du gyur/gzhan yang hor gtsang khri chen sku gong ma dag gi rnam thar gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/gdan rabs lha'i rnga chen/ brag sgom pa'i chos 'byung / kun lho'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus sogs su gzigs chog tor gtsang che chung phyogs gang du sa nags zhing gsum ha cang mang /tsag tsag thang gtsos 'bru 'jag sum brgya 'debs sa dang / hor gtsang ko nyin dang / snod shul/ mda' smad sogs su nags kyang ha cang che/ snga sor hor gtsang khri chen drug pa'i dbon po dam chos zhes pa bdag dam byas/ hor gtsang khri chen rin po che'i 'phro ma dgon 'di'i bla ma ko nyin zhal dkar tshang yin gshis/bla ma zhal dkar sprul ba'i sku blo bzang chos 'byor rgya mtsho mchog nas zhal dkar sku gong ma rnams stod dbus gtsang sa skya'i dbang bsgyur pa'i dus nas dgos dbang gis yul 'dir phebs te bla rabs mang bo byon/ reb gong gdan rabs rdzogs ldan gtam gyi rang sgra zhes par/ zhal dkar sku phreng dang bo pad+ma don grub la tā ming khri lo bco lnga steng rgya'i thob gnang tshul bkod pa dang / gzengs bstod dang ba so'i tham ga gnang nas hor — 162 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gtsang wang gur dgon dge ldan gling zhes btags/ de'i phyi ma zhal dkar blo bzang don yod/ ko nyin zhal dkar nas 'khrungs shing lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas lbang sgar dgon legs par bskyangs/ gsum pa 'al dkar dkon mchog zla ba hor gtsang gter khung nas 'khrungs shing skyabs rje bse bar ma'i zhabs la gtugs te chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ bzhi ba 'al dkar blo bzang kun dga' rgya mtsho reb gong phyogs su 'khrungs shing gdan sa lbang gur du bkod/ mkhyen gter bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas pa'i zhabs pad bsten nas blang dor bka' ba'in bsgrubs/ lbang gur(da lta bong dkar ram lbang gur bris pa yod) dang gter lung nas gzim khang brgyab cing hor gtsang bla ma'i sgar nas zhal bzhi ba'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad/ gter lung dgon du bzhugs zhar kha gya stod dgon pa'i khri yang mdzad/ zhal dkar sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang chos 'byor rgya mtsho ni/rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu byi1912lor reb gong nang so'i rus su yab ban de bkra shis kyi bur 'khrungs te dgung lo lnga'i dus zhal dkar sprul sku ngos 'dzin gnang ste hor gtsang dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling du gdan sar bkod/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ bse blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho bkur te mdo sngags zab chos mang bo gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun par bla ma'i bka' bzhin hal ha'i phyogs su phebs te bse gsum pa'i bzhugs gnas ho shu'i dgon sogs su lo ngo nyi shur bzhugs te ga'an phan gyi 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten gdan drangs te tsag tsag dgon dang / gter lung dgon la 'jog pa gnang / rje bstan pa'i 'byung khungs rgya gar 'phags yul du phebs/ ha ha rgod po'i dur khrod du rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi ba'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad/ 1981lor rang yul du phebs te tsag tsag dgon la 'al bdag gnang / me glang 1987lo'i hor zla bcu bar rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo rje tsong ba chen po dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du gshegs pa'i dus chen dmigs te bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du zhi bar gshegs so/ /bse rdo rje 'chang gis gang ci'i thugs khur bzhes te gnang skyes dang /dgongs rdzogs kyi skabs dang rjes ma'i sprul sku gdan sar 'khod pa bcas la brnag/ zhal dkar sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal 'byor rgya mtsho rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags lug1991lor kha gya'i sprel lung zhes pa'i sde khrod du yab rdo rje skyabs dang yum dkon mchog skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen drug pa rin po ches ko nyin 'al dkar sprul skur thugs thag bcad de/ tsag tsag dgon par gdan sa bkod cing bsnyen bkur zhus/khri chen hor gtsang bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/da lta bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te rnga ba'i sangs rgyas dge rgan du bsten cing thugs gnyer 'phel ba'i skabs la gas so ) )hor gtsang bla ma/ tsho 'du tshang sku gong rab gong sngags rgyud cig tu 'khrungs ning chung dus na4 chos sgor zhugs 'don cha chos spyod sogs bslabs/ zhal dkar blo bzang kun dga' rgya mtsho zhabs rdul bsten cing / sku tshe smad du zhal dkar bas gdan zhus ltar hor gtsang lbang sgar du gshegs/ de'i phyi ma hor gtsang tsho 'du 'jigs med don yod rgya mtsho zhes pa hor gtsang ko nyin nas 'khrungs shing / kun mkhyen bzhi — 163 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ba chen pos ngos 'dzin gnang ste wang sgar dge ldan dar rgyas gling du gdan sar 'khod/ bla ma du ma'i zhabs la gtugs pas mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la mkhas/ hor gtsang dge bshes nas hor gtsang gzhung du rig gnas yon tan gser gyi pha bong zhig yod kyang len mkhan deng dus med gsungs pa rje 'di ba yin/brtsams chos po ti gsum bzhugs pa phyis su bor brlag tu song / kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i drung nas bde mchog tshogs 'khor bya tshul zhus/ tsag tsag dgon pa skyong khur gnang / rgan gya'i dga' ldan bla ga'i byang chub mchod rten dang shing sgo'i dus 'khor mchod rten thog ma bzhengs dus thig rtsa bzung / bslab bya mang bo bsnyen rdzogs la bkod pa dang dgung lo brgyad cu gya lnga bzhugs te gshegs/ hor tshang tsho 'du sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang 1949lor yab mgon po tshe ring dang yum rta mgrin skyid kyi sras su rgan gya'i zho phug sde bar sku bltams/ dgung lo bzhi'i steng du sku gong ma'i dbon po blo gros kyis paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog la zhus pas yang sprul thag gcod mdzad/ tsag tsag dgon pa'i gdan sar mnga' gsol/ dge rgan bkra shis bsten nas 'dod chos bslabs/ 1958lo'i rjes su khyim sa bzung ste grong gseb tu bzhugs so/ /dgon 'di'i bshad sgrub chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo/ zla gnyis par dpyid chos la rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge'i gdung mchod/ zla gsum par khri chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / rje bla kho rin po che'i gdung mchod/ bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bzhi bar ma ṇi sgar sgrub sde sman bla dang bcas pa hor gtsang gzhongs su mnyam 'tshogs byed/ zla lnga bar khri chen hor tshang drug pa dang paṇa chen dgu ba'i gdung mchod/ zla drug par gsang 'dus bdag 'jug zla bdun par rigs grwa dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par khri chen lnga ba skal bzang grags pa'i gdung mchod/ zla dgu bar ston chos 'jigs byed bdag 'jug zla bcu bar dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo hor gtsang gzhongs nas sman bla bcu gcig gi dgon sgrub sde mnyam du 'tshogs te sgrub mchod rgya cher spel/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos kun rig chos spyod rab gsal gyi skor gzhan dag mchis/ zla bcu gnyis par mgon chos dang lha mo'i bskang gso gtong 'bul/ lo rnying sku rim/ paṇa chen bcu ba'i gdung mchod sogs gzhan zhal ba'i ba dang /srung ma lha mo'i gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol sogs dar/ dgon pa'i las sne khri ba dang spyi ba dge bskos dbu mdzad bcas bsko 'jog sgos dgon pa don dam byed/ lha khang dang nang khag gi skor la/ tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i jo khang / spyi khang / lha mo'i btsan khang / khri chen hor gtsang mchog dang / ko nyin zhal dkar/ hor gtsang tsho 'du tshang / mar thang tshang / bstan pa tshang / dbu rtse tshang /rdo sbis a lags bcas kyi nang khag dang / grwa shag brgya dang gsum phub pa'i rnam pa byung / dgon 'di'i shar phyogs su kha bar sgom grwa kun bzang 'gyur med gling dang / shar byang mtshams su hor gtsang gzhung sgar/ nub phyogs su mtsho kha'i ri khrod/ lho phyogs su klag tshang sgom grwa/ mgo ba thang sgar sogs dgon — 164 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dekar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'di'i khongs su gtogs shing grwa ba yang dgon 'di nas gtong bzhin mchis/ 1958lo'i rjes su dgon pa re 'ig bsnubs so/ /1980lor paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan bla brang phyogs su phebs lam hor gtsang che chung dgon grong gis bkur sti zhus/ phyi lo lcags bya nas dgon pa slar gso byas te 'du khang nang rten gyi thog ma rje tsong kha ba yab sras bzhengs / kun rig sman bla sogs sman 'dam gyi sku brnyan/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gtsos yi dam chos skyong 'ga'i 'al thang dang gyan thang sogs gsar du bzhugs pa dang / bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur dbus dpar can/ khri chen hor gtsang drug pa'i sku gdung mchod rten rwa lo tsā ba'i phyag mdzub nang bzhugs pa'i dngul grub mchod rten/ bla ma dbu rtse tshang / mar thang bcas kyi sku gdung mchod rten bzhugs/dgon pa'i 'byen zlum mchod rten de bla ma zhal dkar tshang gi thugs mos ltar dang snyan grags tshang gis dbu bskul te hor gtsang che ba sbyin bdag byas te bzhengs pa dang / khri chen hor tshang bdun pas rab gnas mdzad/ sangs rgyas stong sku bzhugs pa'i jo khang rten brten par deng skabs bzhengs bzhin mchis/ 'du khang gser tshon sogs gang ci'i thugs khur gnang mkhan zhal shul ri khrod pa blo bzang tshul khrims zhal snga nas sgor khri phrag bcu tsam gnang bas sbyor 'jags che/ da lta dgon 'dir hor gtsang dpon po grags pa dang brtson 'grus gtsos dgon pa'i don dam 'gan khur bzhes te dge 'dun bdun cu lhag bzhugs shing chos spyod sngon srol ltar yar ldan gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin mchis/ hor gtsang khri chen dang / ko nyin zhal dkar sogs kyi nang khag dang grwa shag du ma bskyar gsar du bskrun cing / bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi srol mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog zla ba gzhon nu gang dag gdan sa rang dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du mdo sngags 'dom la 'jal ba'i snyan pa rgyas/ dgon du da dung bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sku par/ lha mo dang mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ gang ser ma bcas kyi par shing gsar du brkos/ tshong khang gnyer mkhan mchod gzhis gtso bo ko nyin lha gsum/ 'bru 'dren ya shul sman lha gsum yin no/ /spyir dam pa'i skyes rabs kyi phredwa ba mdzes pa'i khri chen dpal ldan grags pa/ khri chen gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ khri chen hor gtsang gsum pa 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge / ko nyin zhal dkar pad+ma don grub/ zhal dkar gnyis pa blo bzang don yod/ zhal dkar gsum pa dkon mchog zla ba/hor gtsang tsho 'du 'jigs med don yod rgya mtsho/ stag lung che ba blo bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ bla ma dbu rtse ba skal bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sku snga phyi/ mar thang ba skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho sku snga phyi/ to mo dgon pa'i bla ma blo bzang rgya mtsho sku snga phyi dang ka ju sogs byes kyi bla ma 'ga' 'khrungs yul yin pa dang / tsa ne dbu dkar ba/ bla ma seng gdong tshang / bla brang snyan grags tshang / sgyis tshang sngags rams pa blo bzang chos grags/ hor gtsang bka' bcu ba grags pa rgya mtsho/ hor gtsang rab 'byams pa bstan skyong / 'go ba sku skyes/ g.yang gya zhabs drung byams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bshes gnyen khyu mchog blo gros/ tsag tsag — 165 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/kun dga' bcas kyi sku yul yin 'ing / khyad par du yul mdo smad kyi mgadha dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma'i 'khrungs yul yin pa sogs lo rgyus ngag rgyun ma nyams par yongs khyab zhib bsher byas so/ /hor gtsang bla ma'i sgar/hor gtsang bla ma'i sgar ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong mar thang zhang gi khongs su chags/ bstan srung chen po stobs 'phrog nag po dpal mgon 'al ba'i ba'i 'phrin 'a/sa thogs med du bsgrub pa'i gnas red/mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ hor gtsang bla ma'i sgar du na bza' brag phug pa'i shangs khrag las bzhengs pa'i mgon po zhal gyi thang ga dang / kha'u brag rdzong gi bla rdo/ bka' 'gyur mtshal dpar/ byams pa'i sman sku thog tshad bzhugs pa'i 'o se sras mo'i sgar red gsungs/ hor gtsang bla ma sku rabs mang bo'i ring du bsten pa'i chos skyong chen po'i lo rgyus nges can ma shes pas snga sor hor gtsang mgon po zhwa de mgon po sha zer ba'i brda chad 'bod tshul byung / gung thang bstan sgron pa'i hor gtsang spyi'i chos skyong dang 'brel yul lha'i gsol mchod du/ he ru ka dpal dbyings rig dbyer med mkhar/ /char sprin gar gyi ri mo gdong bzhi ba/ /yum bzhi nyer gcig bshan pa'i sde dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig/ces gsungs shing / bde mchog gi sprul ba yin par gleng / rgan bya'i brag dkar gyi nye 'dabs rnga mda' dung gsum gyi gnas su hor gtsang bla mas chos skyong de nyid stod sa skya phyogs nas spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus smra rgyun yod/ yul mi thams cad kyis gtsigs su dang bas bkur/ hor gtsang mgon po zhal dron po/ lha gson po bos na a zer/ bcol na ya zer zhes gnyer du gtad/ sku 'di'i nges don lo rgyus bla ma gong ma dag gi gsung rgyun ltar na/ kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang bo yab sras dang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ thu'u bkun chos kyi nyi ma/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ bse bla ma rnams kyis srung mar bsten cing / chos srung gi legs so'i mchod sprin gyi cho ga mdzad/ da dung ma cig lab sgron yum sras kyis gter lung phyogs su zab gter sbas te dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba gnyer du gtad ces grags/ de bzhin bstan srung dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba ni bram gzigs sogs rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu gsum bzhugs te/yum g.yung mo nag mo/ gtum mo ljang khu/ srin mo dmar mo/ sing ga li ma ser mo/ srog gi sgo bdud ma nag mo/ las kyi bshan pa nyer gcig bka' sdod shu tra nag po/ shu ta dmar po/ bag tse lcam sring /be srog btsan gsum rnams dang / bod du byon pa'i dregs pa phal cher yang de'i bka' gnyan yin tshul sogs grub dbang klong rdol ba'i gsung 'bum du gsal/ /1958lo'i rjes su lha khang dang lha sku/ bka' 'gyur sogs chag 'jig thebs/ kha'u brag rdzong gi bla rdo sgar gnas su sbas/ chos sgo slar phye tshun bse bla ma rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rjes bkas — 166 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bskul pa las/ bla bcad skor gsum dang 'o se sde bas khur blangs te 'du khang chung chung gnyis thog can bzhengs shing / rten du zhal bzhi ba 'o se 'jigs byed kyis bzhengs/ tsha kha'i stag ring sde bas byams sku dang / kun spangs pa glang chen tshul khrims kyis thugs rje chen po bzhengs/ lo rgyus su na bza' brag phug pa'i shangs khrag las bzhengs pa'i mgon po'i zhal thang nyes thar ma/ 'o se tshe ring rgyal dang mgon pos blus pa'i bka' 'gyur/ chos 'phel gyis phul pa'i zhal bzhi ba shing sku/ gzhan rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dang gang ser ma bskang gso'i par shing sogs lha rten chos gsum mi nyung ba sbyor 'jags thob/ da dung bse bla ma'i thugs rje dang grub dbang kirti/ bla ma seng gdong ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar/ 'phags yul ha ha rgod po'i dur khrod nas spyan drangs zer ba'i mgon po'i bla rdo'ang tshags su dam/ bse bla ma rim byon bstan 'gro spyi sger gyi ched du dgon 'dir yang yang phebs te chos spyod kyi mchod sprin rgya cher bstar ba dang / zhal bzhi ba dang bram gzugs/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal thang / ma ṇi 'khor lo bcas la bse bla mas rab gnas gnang /'ing skyong lha mchog ma hā kā la'i nag phyogs bdud sde'i 'phrin las drag po me char gyis thal bar brlags pa dang /chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i gang zag bu bzhin skyong ba'i chos skyong la mchod gtor snga srol ltar gtong bzhin pa'i skabs lags so/ /yi ge thang dgon pa gsang sngags mi 'gyur gling /legs byas kyi snye ma g.yur du za ba'i gsang chen chos kyi gzhi rten nyams pa med pa hor gtsang shing sgo'i yi ge thang dgon pa gsang sngags mi 'gyur gling ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong chu sngon zhang gi khongs su chags/dgon 'di ni bod shing sgo can zhes pa'i gnas yul du gtogs/ ngag rgyun ltar na gnam bskos gong ma chen po hor se chen rgyal pos rab byung bzhi ba'i chu glang(spyi lo 1252) lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa gdan drangs shing bla mar bkur te bod shing sgo can thams cad kyi dpon dang bla ma zung 'brel bskos skabs su/chos rje 'di'i bkas gtsang gi hor sde nas mi mang bo phyogs 'dir 'ongs pa gzhi chags te hor gtsang zhes pa'i ming thogs/ yi ge thang zhes pa ngag rgyun du sngon rgya nag gong ma thang rgyal rabs kyi dus su ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta thang zin bla mas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas dam pa'i chos rgya nag yul du spyan drangs pa'i lam du yul 'dir brgyud/ glegs bam 'ga' zhig rlung 'tshub kyis gtor phyir/ khong gis slar bsgrigs pa'i gnas red ces grags/ dgon pa'i g.yas g.yon brag ngos su sngon chad lo rgyus brkos pa'i yi ge mjal rgyu yod zer/ gang ltar sngon chad yi ge thang zhes pa'i gnas su hor gtsang phyag btab dgon zhes pa zhig chags/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba rgya yul du phebs lam shing sgo'i dpon pos bsus te phyag btab dgon du zhag bzhugs gnang / phyis su khri chen hor gtsang lnga ba rje skal bzang dpal ldan grags pas( 1866da wa 1912 ) thugs smon gnang — 167 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/nas 'bas kyis bcags shing rje nyid kyis rab byung bco lnga ba me bya ste spyi lo 1897lor hor gtsang yi ge thang sde ba'i phyag btab dgon dang / chu sngon sgar/ hūṃ yag sgar/ dpon skor sgar bcas phyogs bsdus kyis yi ge thang sde bas dgon sa phul pa'i gnas su dgon pa gsar du btab/ dpon skor gyi bu stag 'o ba klu 'bum yag la 'du khang gi gnas kyi sa brkos nas rdo thog mar 'jog tu bcug pa'i dus su/ rje khri chen nyid nas rgyud kyi rgyal bo dpa' dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa sngags dang smon lam dag gis mtshams sbyar/ rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku bcar hor gtsang blo bzang gi phyag nas byung ba'i rje dge legs ma 'khrul med rdo rams pa dge legs rgya mtshos 'di ga'i rten gtsor sbyor 'jags zhus pa dang / byams pa'i sku brnyan/dus 'khor bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ rigs ldan nyer lnga'i zhal thang dang ldebs ris du ma bcas gsung rten la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las nyung ngur bsdus pa ste bsdus rgyud ces bya ba'i 'grel ba rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos 'byung rgyud kyi sngon 'gro'i gsal byed/ dus 'khor sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs kyi sgrub thabs dpag bsam snye ma dang / rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yig cha du ma ste khri chen nyid kyis dbus nas blus pa'i nyer mkho'i glegs bam/ thugs rten chos dung dkar bo g.yas 'khyil bcas thog mar dgon 'di la sbyor 'jags che/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang ltar dus kyi 'khor lo'i thig rdul tshon la sogs phyag len rnam dag tshugs/ rje sku phreng rim pas bskyangs/ chu sngon sgom pa yag gis mang 'gyed 'go ma bgyis pa dang / 'chad nyan pa'i thog ma ni tsho 'du'i 'jigs med don yod rgya mtsho dang / hūṃ yag rdor ldan ma ṇi sprul sku blo bzang 'phrin las/ lo seng bla ma chos ldan/ tshe rgya bla ma sku phreng gsum pa/ dpon skor yon tan rgya mtsho/ hor gtsang gser khri drug pa blo bzang dpal rgyam/ tshul khrims go yus/ dge gzhol brtson 'grus/ blo bzang 'phrin las/ bstan dar la sogs dgon pa'i 'chad nyan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin par bzhugs myong / hūṃ yag rdor ldan ma ṇi bas dus 'khor blos bslangs bzhengs/ hūṃ yag lo seng sprul sku dang chu sngon tshe rgya bla mas smad nas sku gsung thugs rten/ lha cha mchod cha drangs pa spyi 'jog gnang / khyad par du hor gtsang drug pas dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar dgon 'di'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang khrir bzhugs nas 'chad nyan dar rgyas su mdzad/ lcags 'brug (spyi lo1940 ) lor bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog gis dgon 'di nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang / kun rig mngon byang / gdugs dkar bcas kyi dbang dang / gtor ma brgya rtsa'i lag khrid/ lung kha shas bcas gnang / dgon pa'i dus 'khor mchod rten la rab gnas mdzad/ spyi bla hor gtsang rin po che gtsos rdor ldan ma ṇi ba sku phreng snga phyi dang / lo seng sprul sku blo bzang chos ldan/ to mā kya blo bzang rgya mtsho/ lo bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ tshe rgya bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs dgon 'di nas chos grwar 'grims so/ /dgon par lo hril bo'i chos spyod gal chen la/ zla dang bor bla mchod smon lam dang bcas pa'i cho ga'i — 168 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/phyag len/ zla gnyis par yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / chos skyong lha mo'i bsnyen mtshams/ sbyin sregazla gsum par dus 'khor bdag 'jug dang klu chog sogs/ zla ba'i bar hor gtsang gzhung sgar nas ma ṇi sgrub sde mnyam tshogs su grwa mang phyag phebs/ zla lnga bar dge 'dun pa'i smyung gnas dang rje'i stong mchod/ zla drug par gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ zla bdun par dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par rnam snang mngon byang gi bdag 'jug zla dgu bar kun rig bdag 'jug zla ba bcu bar dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo hor gtsang gzhung sgar mnyam 'tshogs/ zla bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis par bstan 'gro'i zhabs brtan sku rim rnam gsum dang lha mo'i gtor 'bul bskang gso rgyas pa bcas bsgrubs so/ /dgon pa'i sgrig dang 'don cha'i phyogs su bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa gtsos dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi ba che chung bcas kyis do dam mdzad/ 'du khang gi nang rten la rje dge legs ma/ dus 'khor bdud rtsi 'bebs pa/ rje btsun byams mgon/ gnas brtan bcu drug dus 'khor cho ga'i glegs bam du ma/ gser khri lnga ba'i gdung rten mchod rten dang / 'du khang nang lha mo'i btsan khang / gzhan spyi khang / hor gtsang tshang dang / rdor ldan ma ṇi ba/ tshe rgya bla ma'i nang khag grwa shag sum cu tsam phub par btsun pa brgya phrag bzhugs/ dgon pa'i mdun rir hūṃ yag phyogs kyi bkra shis nags dang / ser mo'i nags/ chu sngon sgom grwa'i na gas yod/ shar lho'i phyogs su da dung sa zhing mi nyung ba zhig bogs mar btang / 1958lo'i chab srid las 'gul gyi gegs rkyen las dgon pa'i lha rten chos gsum thams cad gtor/ 1kha66lo'i rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su dgon pa'i dus 'khor mchod rten bshigs pa ma zad kha gya'i mgar ba kwa bos brdungs pa'i nyi zla bcas dngul rgya ma brgya dang brgyad cu longs pa gang khyer rtsad med du btang /chos sgo slar gso'i dge mtshan ldan pa las/ mchog sprul bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje bas dbu bskul te lcags bya(spyi lo1kha8 1)lor snga gzhug tu dus 'khor mchod rten dang yi ge thang dgon pa bskyar bzhengs kyi mgo bcoms/ da lta 'du khang grub ste rten gtso ston pa dang byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i sku brnyan zhal thang mang bo dang / dus 'khor dang bde 'jigs sogs kyi gyan thang / chos 'phel dang snying lcags gnyis kyis phul pa'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ gser khri gong ma'i gdung rten mchod rten chung ba sogs bzhugs su gsol/ chu sngon skyabs lo dang shing sgo'i nor bu rgyal/ bo gru'i tshe lo gsum gyis 'du khang la gser tshon byugs/ chu sngon bstan 'dzin gyis sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba'i snang brnyan spyan rang gsal bsten cing / dus 'khor bskang gso rgyun ma chad par mchis/ me bya(spyi lo1992)lor hor gtsang gser khri sku phreng bdun pa 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho yi ge thang dgon du thog mar phebs pa dang gzim khang bskrun/ 19rnga 5lor sprul sku dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtshos hūṃ yag nas thugs rje chen po dang tshe dbang / dgon pa nas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje mngon byang bcas kyi dbang lung du ma gnang / 1996lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rdo rams pa rje dge 'dun — 169 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/lags kyis bkra shis gso sbyong bskyar 'dzugs gnang / rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog la par byang smon tshig zhus shing dgon pa gtsos shing sgo'i nor bu rgyal gyis sbyin bdag byas te par khang btsugs/dus 'khor gyi sku brnyan che legs can dang / lha mo/ dus 'khor/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rdo rje'i tshigs bcad/ dpal ldan sham+bhala'i smon lam/ rnam bcu dbang ldan/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ gang ser ma sogs kyi par shing brkos/ da lta rdo rje 'dzin pa shing sgo'i tshul khrims che ba dang / do dam pa shing sgo'i tshul khrims chung ba gtsos dge 'dun pa zhal grangs sum cu lhag 'dzoms/ dgon pa'i mchod gzhis grong tsho gtso bo ni chu sngon gong 'gab/ shing sgo/ hūṃ yag yi ge thang bcas so/ /dgon pa'i nub pyogs te mchod rten khug ces par bla kho rin po ches gnas bcags shing yi ge thang sde bas bskyar du bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten dang chu sngon sgom grwa yod/ byang ngos su rdzong thog sgom grwa dang /byang shar du shing sgo sde gsum gyi ma ṇi gzhung khang chen po/ shar lho na byin rlabs kyi gter chen po lo rgyus can hor ga tsang dus 'alor mchod rten bzhengs shing bsang chu'i pha rol tu hūṃ yag sgar/ de dag las glag tshang sgom ga kha bar sgom ga chu sngon sgom ga rdzong thog sgom grwa bcas dang / phyis chu sngon sgom grwar byang chub rma/chong rten zhig bzhengs yod/ dpon skor sde ba'i rgyab ri'i sgang du bo gru'i tshe los sbyin bdag byas te bskyar du bzhengs pa'i smyung gnas sgar (dpon skor sgar) dang / shing sgo'i mkhar gyi nang rol tu sa yos (spyi lo1999)lor 7bse rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gi thugs smon dang bka' drin las/ byang chub mchod rten chen mo bkra shis zil gnon bzhengs shing zhar la seng dkar thang sde ba'i gtso sku gdugs dkar gyis mtshon pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten grub/ gya rdo sde bas gzhung khang gi ra bar sgrol ma'i sku 'bum bzhengs/ lcags 'brug (spyi lo 2 0 0 0 ) lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin khong rin po ches ngal ba la ma 'dzems par hūṃ yag sde bar phebs te byang chub mchod rten 'bring tsam bzhengs pa'i gnas bcags shing 'ar la slob grwa'i sa rtags brgyab cing mchod rten gyi gtso sku gu ru rin po che gtsos bka' dang bstan 'gyur bcas gsung 'bum mang du bzhugs so/ /yi ge thang dus 'khor mchod rten/hor gtsang shing sgo'i yi ge thang dgon pa'i dus 'khor mchod rten ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa gling (spyi lo1nga89) lor grub chen pa chas pa rgya mkhar mkhan po mchog 'gro don rgya yul du phebs lam yul 'dir brgyud de gnas 'di nas dus 'khor mchod rten zhig bzhengs na legs zhes gsungs/ phyis rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog gis mchod rten gyi dbyibs 'dra ba zhig rdo yis brtsigs te gnas byin gyis brlabs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags bya(spyi lo192 1) lor chu sngon khug ru'i a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos sbyin bdag khas blangs shing zhal 'debs bsdus te mchod rten rmang 'ding skabs de gar gri mdung — 170 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs ma tshon cha rnying bar thug pas/ mchod rten gyi thig rtsa 'dzin mkhan kha gya'i a khu bstan pa tshang gi gsung ltar ma chod rten bzhengs pa'i zhabs su bcug mchod rten bzhengs skabs bum pa'i tshad la slebs tshe a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho smad la phebs te sku gshegs/ skabs der zhwa a lags sku phreng dgu ba smad la phebs te gdul bya bskyangs shing mthar rang dgon du phebs nas 'du khang la gser tshon 'bul bar 'dod kyang mchod rten bzhengs 'phror lus pa mthong bas/ dngul sgor brgyad brgya'i sbyin bdag byas pa gtsos shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pas chu phag(spyi lor192 2) lor mchod rten legs grub byung 'ing mdo smad kyi dus 'khor mchod rten bzhi'i ya gyal du gyur/ lcags 'brug (spyi lo1940) lor a lags bla kho rin po ches rab gnas mdzad/dus bzang rnams su mchod rten gyi bum pa las ngo mtshar ba'i rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs grags pa dngos su thos zhes grwa rgan don grub zer bas rgyun du bshad/ me rta (spyi lo 1966)lor rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su mchod rten bshigs pa ma zad ma ṇi shog pa'i skye pho mo rgan gzhon thams cad kyi dngul yod tshad gcig tu bsdus pa rgya ma brgya dang brgyad cu longs pa'i nyi zla'ang gang khyer rtsad med du btang ngo/ /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsu ma pa'i rjes su/ paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan bod khams su phebs lam/ sngon gyi dus 'khor mchod rten bskyar du bzhengs dgos zhes gsungs pa dang mchod rten gyi zhal 'debs la sgor stong gnyis dang 'od dpag med kyi sku sogs gzungs gzhug tu gnang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya (spyi lo 1981)lor shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pa gtsos yul mi yongs kyis sbyin bdag byas te mchod rten bskyar bzhengs kyi mgo brtsams/ kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang rje gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas rten byin can 'ga' gnang ba ma zad/ khyab bdag rje btsun bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog nas rten gyi gtso bo la dus 'khor gyi sku bzhengs shing de ga'i dgon grong nas sher phyin brgyad stong ba/ shir phyin 'bum/ rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can gyi sku 'bum du ma gzung gzhug tu bzhugs/ dus der grub chen 'ig gis rdo dril cheg rnyed pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla brang a khu dge 'dun che ba tshang la zhus tshe thugs shin tu dgyes te nang rten du bzhugs/ mchod rten gyi thig rtsa 'dzin mkhan lha chab byams pa dang yul 'di'i don gnyer ba chos 'phel bcas yin/ chu khyi (spyi lo 1982)lor paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan thengs gnyis par bod phebs lam du rab gnas mdzad do/ /shing sgo'i mchod rten bkra shis zil gnon/mdo smad hor gtsang shing sgo'i byang chub mchod rten chen mo bkra shis zil gnon ni/ ha lam rab byung drug pa'i sa sprel(spyi lo1 268)lo ste ming rgyal rabs kyi ring la rgya bod gnyis kyi so mtshams su grags pa ste deng gi kun lho bod rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong chu sngon zhang shing sgo'i ru 'gab ma sde ba'i rgyab ri'i zhing mtha' ru — 171 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/mkhar rnying 'dzin ma'i sked rags lta bu'i ches mtho tshad la smi brgyad dang zheng la smi drug gi mthug tshad yod la/bsang chu'i tshur rol nas ri rtsar smi lnga brgya sum cu lhag dang pha rol tu mus brgya phrag lhag la slebs der rgyu 'grul dag gi bgrod lam gyi mtshams su shing sgo re yod pas sngon gyi shing sgo de deng gi gzhung lam gyi yar 'gram du brtol pa dang / nye sar gna' bo'i mchod rten gyi shul du sgang 'bur zhig yod par da lta'ang mchod rten sgang zhes grags/ chos rgyal 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sku ring ste rab byung bzhi ba'i chu pho khyi(spyi lo1 262)lo yas mas su mchod rten zhig yod pa'i ngag rgyun snang ba ma zad/ mchod rten bskyar bzhengs kyi rmang 'ding skabs sa 'og nas thig tshad dang dbyibs da skabs bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten dang kun nas mtshungs pa zhig rdo leb che tshad cig gi steng brkos yod pa slog byung ba sogs ltas ya mtshan shin tu mang / phyis lo rgyus la 'gyur ldog sna tshogs byung rkyen mchod rten yang ming gi lhag mar gyur/tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyin byed phyogs su 'dzum pas/ sa sbrul(spyi lo19rnga9)lor sa 'di ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs yongs kyis skyabs mgon rin po che dang gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ yul dpon blo bzang tshe dbang bcas la mchod rten bskyar bzhengs kyi re 'dun zhus tshe/ gnas skabs rde'u 'bum zhig blugs na chog ces khong rnam pa'i thugs smon las mchod rten gyi dod du bde steng zhabs drung gi sku bcar gtsos shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pas rde'u 'bum che tshad cig blugs so/ /rab rgyan sa stag(spyi lo1998)lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin gyi snga dror/ bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog 'gro ba'i don du pe cin dang shang gang du phebs lam shing sgo'i ru 'gab ma'i klu rgyal 'bum tshang gis gdan 'dren zhus te/ dmangs yongs kyi 'thus mi rgad po klu 'bum dang zla ba la sogs pas rang re sde bar lo 'di nyid cig la lo legs mi 'byung zhing phyugs la god kha ma nga ba dang sde ba'i gsar bu 'ga' yang dar shi byung ba sogs dka' khag mang ba dang sngon gyi mchod rten bskyar du bzhengs pa'i re 'dun zhus tshe/ byang chub mchod rten bkra shis zil gnon zhes mtshan dang gtso sku o rgyan rin po che bzhengs zhes bka' gsung gnang / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos (spyi lo 1999)lo'i hor zla2pa'i tshes1 2nyin/shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pa'i ser skya yongs kyis chibs bsu'i khrod khong rin po che bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje phebs te mchod rten bskyar bzhengs kyi gnas bcags shing / mchod rten 'di bzhengs pa'i phan yon dang dge mtshan bcas 'al gsung gal chen gnang / zhar la seng dkar thang sde ba'i rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs sa'i gnas bcags/ zla2pa'i tshes2nganyin mchod rten gyi rmang gzhir bla brang dus 'khor grwa tshang gi grwa ba 'gas sa bdag stobs chen gyi thig btab pa dang rim par gter sgrub sogs rgya cher byas/ zla2pa'i tshes15nyin 'dzam gling spyi bsang phud cing2 2nyin mchod rten gyi rus shing bzhag zla4ba'i tshes 5nyin mchod rten gyi sku khang du sman sku dang shog 'bum glegs bam bcas rim par bzhugs/ zla5ba'i tshes11nyin rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos sogs gsung 'bum chig stong lnga brgya lhag dang / shog 'bum dang bum — 172 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gter sna tshogs brgya phrag gcig gzungs gzhug ha cang rgyas pa phul/ zla5ba'i tshes 15nyin bkra shis pa'i ltos bzang bcas nyi zla bkod/ zla6pa'i tshes8nyin nas shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pas chibs bsu rgya chen po byas te/ mchog sprul bse tshang dang hor gtsang tshang / bla brang gi smad rgyud grwa tshang gdan drangs te rab gnas rgya chen po mdzad/ gzhan mkhan po tshang dang thur ma tshang / sbyin bdag chos 'phel sogs snga gzhug tu khul dang rdzong / zhang rim pa'i 'brel yod sde khag gi 'go 'dren bcas nyin gsum gyi ring la skya ser stong phrag 'ga' 'dus te mchod rten bskyar bzhengs legs grub kyi dga' ston spel/'dir ched du gleng dgos pa zhig ni mchod rten 'di bzhengs pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du khong rin po che bse blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gi bla na med pa'i bka' drin dang mdzub ston las/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge slong skal bzang dge 'dun gtsos rtsig dpon sgrol ma skyabs kyis mchod rten bzhengs pa'i 'gan ba'es shing / shing sgo'i ma ṇi shog pa'i chu 'gab ma dang / chu sngon lung ba'i rtswa thang che chung / gya rdo/ yi ge thang / hūṃ yag glog dmar/ dpon skor/ bo gru/ ru 'gab ma/ seng dkar thang bcas sde ba bcu gcig gis sbyin bdag byas te/ bla brang sham bha la'i gsol khang gi tshong dpon chen mo/ rnam dkar dge ba'i las la gtong phod che ba'i sbyin bdag chos 'phel lags kyis dngul sgor khri tsho bcu gnyis kyi zhal 'debs gzhi byas te/ glog dmar pad ma don grub kyis zangs ser gyi nyi zla bzhag bo gru'i chos skyong skyabs kyis shug pa'i srog shing ba'ag chu 'gab ma'i tshul khrims kyis gtso sku o rgyan rin po che bzhengs shing / kun lho khul dang bsang chu rdzong / rma chu rdzong / lha sa sogs kyi las khungs dang mi sger gyis zhal 'debs dang rgyab skyor bla na med pa byas par brten/ hor gtsang phyogs kyi phyir sdod las byed pa dkon mchog dang / grags pa rgya mtsho/bkra shis don grub/ lung rtogs/ phyag rdor tshe ring / bla brang gi bkra shis don grub/ lha dga'/ snying te sogs mchod rten bzhengs pa'i mgo mjug bar gsum gyi mdzad sgo glog 'char du phab/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang hūṃ yag don grub la sogs pas rang nus gang thub kyis zhal 'debs sogs phyogs gang thad nas mthun rkyen bsgrubs shing / bo gru'i chos skyong skyabs/ glog dmar pad ma don grub/ zhang gi rdo rje rin chen/ chu 'gab ma'i skyabs lo/ ru 'gab ma'i klu 'bum dang zla ba/dgon pa'i tshul khrims/ yi ge thang gi lha lung bcas tshags brgyab brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i chu 'gab ma'i mgon po tshe ring / pad ma don grub/ gya rdo'i 'jam dbyangs/ te kya/ rtswa thang chung ba'i skyabs dga'/bstan 'dzin/ rtswa thang che ba'i sangs rgyas/ klu rgyal 'bum/ yi ge thang bde lo/ lha lung che ba/ bstan pa/ hūṃ yag dpon tshang blo gros/ pad ma/ o rgyan/ rdo rje chung ba/ lha lung thar/ seng dkar thang mgon po don grub/ tshe ring thar/ mchog ldan/ nya tshe don grub/ glog dmar dkon mchog thar/ blo bzang ye shes/ snying lcags rgyal/ dpon skor snying te/ 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bo gru'i snying dkar rgyal/ rta mgrin/ ru 'gab ma'i lha lung thar/ tshe ring don grub/ yi ge thang dgon pa'i shes rab/— 173 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/skal bzang 'phrin las bcas mchod rten bskyar bzhengs kyi las sna ba'i bcu lhag gis zla ngo gsum gyi ring la nyin mtshan dus drug tu 'bad pa byas mthar/ rgyal bstan gyi nyi gzhon la dge legs kyi snang bas khyab cing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i mdo smad hor gtsang shing sgo'i byang chub mchod rten chen mo bkra shis zil gnon zhes bya ba bskyar bzhengs kyi mjug yongs su rdzogs la/ 'di'ang bstan 'gro'i bar chad dang rgud pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing bsam don thams cad yongs su grub pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gu/ /chu sngon sgom grwachu sngon sgom grwa zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho khul gyi bsang chu rdzong chu sngon zhang gi dkyil tsam gyi nags tshal dang spang gis spras pa'i rdza ngos su chags/sgom grwa 'di ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i( 1606—1677) chos 'phrin rnam bzhi spel ba'i sgrub sde bzhi ga'i gcig tu snang / ha lam rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dkyil tsam la rje 'di bas phyag 'debs mdzad par grags/ sgom grwar nye ba'i dben gnas nyams dga' ba chu sngon khya gzigs zhes pa'ang grub dbang skal ldan ras pa 'di ba'i sku mtshams dang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor chag med gzhol ba'i sgrub phug tu ngos 'dzin te dus bzang dag tu rdza kha de nas snyan 'jebs chos sgra bsgrags zhes dad ldan mi ser mang bo'i thos 'dzin du byung zhing gleng bzhin mchis/ sgom grwar 'du khang chung ba zhig bzhengs pa la/ rten gtso rigs su 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan/ 'jigs mdzad rdo rje ba'i zhal thang 'gangs chen sogs mi nyung ba bzhugs/ phyis su hor gtsang bla ma rab rgyas zhes pa yun ring bzhugs pa dang / hor gtsang grags pa zhes pas sgrub sde gong 'og nas sgrub pa nyams len bla lhag tu mdzad/rgyun bzhugs grwa ba 'ga' re'i khar yi ge thang dgon pa nas grwa ba re mos mngags pa'i srol tshugs/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / dus bzang rnams la bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi chos spyod legs par 'khyongs/ skabs der grwa ba'i 'tsho ba rang khyim brten pa dang spyi nom yong ba'i thon khungs nags lung cung re yod/1958lo'i rjes su sgom grwa'i lha rten chos gsum dang 'du khang grwa shag rung khang bcas pa lhag lus med par bsnubs/ lo ngo nyi shu 'das pa'i tshun la dad ldan mang tshogs thun mong gi 'bad brtson la brten nas snga gnas su 'du khang chung chung zhig bskrun/ chu sngon bstan 'dzin dang lcags thar sogs gtsos pas thugs rje chen po dang skal ldan ras pa'i snang brnyan ngo mtshar yid smon pa bzhengs/ yid dam 'jigs byed sogs kyi thang ga rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs dam chos glegs bam mang bo brtsigs te bkur/ sngar gyi byang chub mchod rten de bzhengs pa la co ne bde thang zhabs drung mchog gis rab gnas gnang / da dung lo rer sgom grwa'i mchod gzhis gtso bo chu sngon dpon tshang dang / rtswa thang / chu 'gab ma/ gyal rdo bcas rong sde lnga gas — 171 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/dben gnas 'dir ma ṇi smyung gnas srol rgyun du spel bzhin yod/ dus rgyun la kirti'i a khu(dge slong )glang chen skal bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs te sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying bo byang chub par rtag gus brtson pa ma btang bar mdzad/ khong gis dmar zas stor zhing dkor zas 'dzem bzhin skyes bu dam pa 'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/ gnam lha dang / hor gtsang gi grong tsho 'gas ma ṇi ril sgrub dang so skye'i smyung gnas la sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i 'phrin las la dbu khrid pa'i ngang bzhugs so/ /rdzong thog sgom grwahor gtsang rdzong thog sgom grwa zhes pa ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong chu sngon zhang gi khongs su chags/sgom grwa 'di ni shar skal ldan rgya mtsho mchog gi sgrub sde bzhi ga'i gcig red/ rab byung bcu gcig pa spyi lo1686pa'i sngon tsam la rje skal ldan rgya mtsho phyogs 'dir phebs te sku mtshams dang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor chag med du bsgrubs te sgom grwa grub/ gnas kyi 'du khang ngam lha khang du 'phags chen spyan stong mnga' ba'i snang brnyan dang dus 'khor snang brnyan/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi 'al thang la sogs sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung tsam bzhugs shing / srung ma mgon po phyag drug pa bsten/ ma ṇi'i par shing sogs kha shas bsgrugs/ gnas 'dir snga phyir rje skal ldan rgya mtsho rang dang / hor gtsang bka' bcu ba grags pa rgya mtsho/rdor ldan ma ṇi ba/ tshe rgya bla ma/ mtsho kha'i ma ṇi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin bcas byon nas theg chen gso sbyong blangs te smyung gnas kyi cho ga gsungs/ ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i bzlas brjod ngo mtshar/ rgyun bzhugs btsun pa drug bdun tsam dang chos spyod gal chen du yi ge thang dgon pas bkod mngags bya/ dus rgyun gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dngos gtsang dang / dus bzang la bde gsang 'jigs gsum chos spyod rgyun 'khyongs so/1958lor sgom grwa brlags/ da lta bse bla ma'i bskul ngor dad ldan rnams kyis sgom grwa slar gso khul bgyis pa la dge slong don grub lags kyis bdag skyong gi khur bzhes bzhin no/ /rong ngar mi 'gyur gsang sngags gling /gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i sde rong ngar mi 'gyur gsang sngags gling zhes pa ni/da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong thang dkar nang zhang gi khongs su chags/sngags 'chang blo ldan bgres po rnams kyi ngag rgyun ltar na/ tsa yus bla ma phun tshogs chos ldan gyi sa bon dgon zer ba zhig gsang sngags rnying mar bsgyur te btab tshul bshad/ 'du khang gi nang rten gtso bo slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ mkha' spyod ma sogs sman 'dam gyis bzhengs pa sogs sku brnyan che chung sum brgya lhag dang /gsang bdag dpal ris zhing bkod thang ga sogs rgyan thang mi nyung ba bzhugs/ gsung rten du bskal — 175 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'phags ting gsum/ klong chen mdzod bdun dang nyer mkho'i glegs bam du ma/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten khru do can bcas bzhugs/ snga sor sngags 'chang sum cu lhag gis hor gtsang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling gi cho ga'i phyag len ltar zla dang bo'i nang gu drag dang / zla ba'i ba zhi khro/ zla brgyad pa bka' brgyad/yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs la chos spyod bar ma chad/ sngags 'chang don gnyer can 'gas gu ru si dhi gtso bor bzlas te bsgrubs pa las nus ldan 'ga' byung / reb gong dang khams phyogs nas klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid dang / gter gsar lugs kyi rtsa rlung / 'phrul 'khor dmar khrid/ bka' brgyad dang gsang snying gi dbang lung gsan/ gter lung bse tshang dang / a khyung sprul ba'i sku/ ko nyin zhal dkar sogs kyis sde 'di la zhal bdag mdzad/ khyad par du rong ngar dpon tshang gis 'jam mgon khri rin po che sku phreng snga phyi rigs kyi paṇa chen du bkur/ 1901me lug lor skyabs mgon bzhi ba sman lung nas bla brang phyogs su phebs lam du rong ngar dpon tshang gis gdan drangs/ 'pho lung dang g.yang 'bod gsungs/dpon pos kyang dngul srang lnga bcu dang mdzo mo gcig yon 'bul btegs/ da dung rong ngar dpon po'i btsun chung gis zhus pa'i sku ngor gzhi bdag rwa rgod ces bya ba la bsang yig brtsams/ 1958lor sde 'di'i lha rten chos gsum yongs su rdzogs pa bsnubs so/ /bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me glang19kha7lor sngags 'chang rnams kyi re ba ltar/ rje btsun bse blo bzang dpal ldan mchog la zhus te gnang rkyen dang zhal 'debs bsdus nas 'du khang rten dang brten pa gna' srol ji bzhin bzhengs zhing gser tshon byugs/ slob dpon gtso 'khor dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad /gsang bdag dpal ris zhing bkod bcas kyi sku brnyan sman 'dam las bzhengs pa dang / rgyan thang zhal thang / bsten pa ma gza' rdor gsum gyi sku brnyan bcas grub/ da lta sngags 'chang ba tshe lo gtsos rigs sngags 'dzin pa bcu gsum gyis chos spyod gang 'dzoms rgyun ldan du spel bzhin mchis so/ /sman lung dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling /sman lung dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi thang dkar nang zhang khongs su chags/chos sde 'di ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa phag spyi lo1659lor rab 'byams pa smon lam mchog grub kyis rgyal sras rin po cher dgon pa zhus pa'i gsung lan ltar btab/ phyis dgon pa 'debs pa bo'i dgonargyud du 'khrungs pa 'dul 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab kyis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bor sgar mgophul pas dgon lag ang bcu gsum par bshad/ de nas bzung khri ba bla brang gis gtong / skyabs mgon skuphreng gsum pas bca' yig mdzad/ grub dbang sde khri bas gnas 'di'i thad du bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyiblos bslang gzigs shing dgon par tsen zhig gnang / khri chen hor gtsang bzhi bas sde 'di'i srung ma'i gtso— 176 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bor lha mo'i rten thang bzhengs te gnang / sman 'dam gyi byams sku che tshad bzhengs pa'i nang du gser khang byams pa'i nang bzhugs kyi rten sna cha tshang bzhugs/ khyad par du gsang chen gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rje shes rab rgya mtsho dgung lo zhe drug steng du sman lung dgon par phebs te gso sbyong la so thar gyi mdo gsungs/dbyar dgag gso gsum nyid kyis btsugs/ don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la dpal ldan lha mo dang bla mchod/sgrol dkar kyi tshe khrid/ byams chos sde lnga dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud sogs kyi lung gnang / chos thun gyi rjes su nyid nas lam rim smon lam dang bstan 'bar ma gsungs te bsngo smon gyi dbu bskul/ sman lung dgon gzhung nas rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung zhus/ rje'i gsung 'bum gyi mdo phyogs skor rgyas pa gnang skabs su dbal mang rin po che'i bka' shog 'byor ba'i nang du/ sa dmar dang a 'khor du phebs te bde mchog lha lnga dang lus dkyil gyi bkod khyab gnang / me lug1908lor skyabs mgon bzhi ba mchog sman lung dgon par phebs te ser skya thun mong la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskul cing spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i lung gnang / khri thog pa sprul sku gtsos 'dus sde thun mong nas dngul rdo tshad dang nas bre stong btegs/ bla brang sku phyogs tshang nas grwa tshang la mang ja gzab rgyas btang thog dong tse nyis brgya re'i 'gyed phul/ dmigs brtse ma dang / myur mdzad ma sogs rim gro gnad smin bsgrubs/ sa 'brug1928lor khyab bdag bse sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog kha gya stod du phebs lam sman lung dgon grong nas chos 'brel zhus pa ltar chos sbyin bstsal/ shing byi1924lor kun mkhyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog sman lung bkra shis chos 'phel gling du phebs te/ lha mo'i mdun du mchod gtong gsar bzo bcas bka' rams la rnga rol sbrags lha mo gsungs shing snyan dar phul pa dang / gnyan chen la lha bsang btang ste gangs can shar phyogs ma tshar gsum gsungs/ sman lung dgon grong gi ser skya la tshe dbang gnang / dngul srang lnga brgya dang nas bre stong gi 'bul 'debs zhus/ rje nyid nas rnam rgyal li sku byin rten dang 'bri g.yag gnyis kyis grwa tshang la spyi 'jog gnang ba ma zad/ tsa ne sprul sku gtsos grwa ba khag dang /mi khyim 'gas gdan drangs te 'pho lung sogs kyi thugs 'dun bskangs/ sa stag 192ralor rje bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi bka' gnang ltar rje shes rab rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i gnas shul du byams khang rten dang brten par bzhengs pa dang / sgar grong nas rdo rje gcod pa rgyun 'don gyi srol tshugs/ rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos thugs zin pa'i kun spangs 'jam dbyangs mtshan pas dgon par mchod rdzas sogs spyi 'jog byas/ thub pa tshul khrims ma'i li sku byin can/ sgrol dkar gyi sman sku bdud rtsi 'bab pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i lo rgyus can kha shas dang / dbus kyi lha mo'i zhal thang sogs bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs mang bo/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / rje tsong kha ba yab sras/ kun mkhyen gong ma yab sras/ lcang skya sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs kyi gsung 'bum dang / gsung 'bum thor bu du ma/ mchod rten sogs rten gsum mang du bzhugs so/ /— 177 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa'i lo hril bo'i 'chad nyan chos spyod kyi gtso bo ni/ zla dang bo'i nang bla mchod smon lam/gsang 'dus dang / kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ sman bla bcas kyi bdag 'jug sbyin sreg sogs rgyun sde'i chos spyod du ma tshugs/ zla bzhi ba dang drug pa'i smyung gnas dbyar gnas/ gso sbyong chag med/ dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo yod/ dgon pa'i srung ma gtso bo dpal ldan lha mo bsten/ de'i tshes gtor dang bskang mdos mgon chos lnga dang bcas pa'i cho ga phyag len dngos gtsang dar/de dag so so'i nyer spyad dang rol chas/ mchod rdzas yo byad gang legs yod/ lo ltar nyin brgya dang nga brgyad la 'char can tshogs kyi srol gnas te bstan rgyun la sman pa byung / khri ba dang / bla ma gnas brtan/dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ spyi ba gsum/ rgan pa bzhi/ dkor gnyer/ ja ma/ dung 'bud bcas kyi las sne so so'i khur 'dzin/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi1958lor 'du khang dang byams khang / nang khagagrwa shag nyi shu/ grwa ba zhe gsum bzhugs/ 1966lo'i rjes su sku gsung thugs rten phon che ba chag 'jig thebs so/ /1982lor kun gzigs paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog kun lho'i phyogs su phyag phebs pa la sman lung mdo nas dgon grong thun mong nas phebs bsu bsnyen bkur zhus/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog dang / yab rje bse mchog gi thugs bzhed bzhin/ bsang chu rdzong gis chos sgo slar gso byas pa'i chog mchan dngos su gnang / chu phag gya gsum lor brag dmar mkhas grub gtsos sman lung sde dmangs nas 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ tsa ne smon lam dang rdo rgyam byams pa sogs nas nyar tshags byas pa'i sngon rten thub pa tshul khrims ma'i li sku byin can dang / lha mo'i rten thang / sngar sor gyi rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ rje yab sras dang /kun mkhyen yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum/ gzhan gsung thor bu phal mo che po ti lnga brgya tsam slar spyan drangs te bzhugs shing / sman 'dam gyis sman bla dang / byams pa/ rje sku/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs lha rten chos gsum mang du bzhengs/ me stag1kha86lor rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug mchog sman lung dgon du phebs te dge rten du byang chub lam rim chen mo bstsal/ sman lung dgon grong nas tshe dbang zhus/ spyi lo1991lor kun mkhyen drug pa sman lung dgon du bkur bsti gzab rgyas ngang gdan drangs/ rje 'di bas ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i ljags lung gnang / 'bul nom thams cad de 'phral 'du khang gser tshon byug pa'i thebs su sbyar/ me byi1996lor mchog sprul dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtshos(bde thang zhabs drung)dgon 'dir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang sogs bka' rjes gnang du ma gnang / sman 'bru'i lab rtse bstad/ bla brang sman pa'i khri ba dge bshes dpal ldan mchog gis gso sbyong btsugs/ da dung byams khang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyar du bzhengs/ dgon pa'i mchod gzhis sde ba bdun yod/ grwa rgan brag dmar lhun grub kyis dge phrug mang bor chos spyod sogs bslabs te deng skabs grwa ba bzhi bcu phal cher nye zhing 'chad nyan yar ldan spel bzhin mchis so/ /— 178 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/thang dkar nang bkra shis rnam rgyal gling /thang dkar nang bkra shis rnam rgyal gling ni gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi thang dkar nang 'ang du chags/dgon 'di sngon dus bka' rgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i sgrub gnas su kha gya'i phying dkar phug gi dpon po rgyal go so gas kyis sbyin bdag byas te thang dkar rab 'byams pa dang mtsho tsha'i sku skyes gnyis kyis btab cing / lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par bskyangs/ bar skabs shig sri ngan zhugs pas grwa ba mang ba grongs pa la/ 'jam mgon rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa'i gsung gnang bzhin/ ser skya thun mong gis mu to dpon slob rgya mtsho la skyabs 'tshol zhus shing dgon der phul/ khong gis dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhi bzhengs pas dam sri chad/ dus de nas bzung mu to bla rabs rim byon gyis 'dzin bdag mdzad/ mu to sprul sku dkon mchog don ldan gyis 'jigs byed sgrub mchod dang / dus phyis kun rig sgrub mchod tshugs/ la kha sprul sku 'jigs med don grub kyis dbyar gnas dang / rnga rgod ri khrod pa zhig gis thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ril sgrub btsugs pa'i rgyun yun ring du gnas/ rjes su mkhyen gter bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas pa'i gsung gnang ltar/ rong ngar dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling / thang dkar nang bkra shis rnam rgyal gling / khyi snying ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling bcas smon lam mnyam du 'tshogs/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog dgon 'di la phebs te bstan pa spyi sger gyi rim gro bsgrubs/ tshe dbang bstsal/ rong ngar stag mgo'i thang du gnyan chen sngo la g.yu rtse la bsang dang mchod gtor phul te bstan 'gro sman pa'i 'phrin bcol nan tan mdzad/ skabs shig dgon 'di dang rong ngar dgon pa gnyis cung ma mthun pas190 2lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog phebs te kha mchu bsdums/ da dung bla brang smad rgyud ltar gyi cho ga'i phyag len btsugs/ rdo rje 'chang rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos dgon 'di la bde mchog bdag 'jug gsar btsug gi rten zangs ma'i dung rtse chon brgya dang lnga bcu gnang / bde mchog gi rten thang bzhengs/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi shangs mtshal gyis bzhengs pa'i nag thang /paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas gnang ba'i mdo ting 'dzin gser bris/ 'jigs byed lha gsum ma'i thang kaman chin gong mas gnang ba'i rgyal mtshan ser bo tshem drub can/ kun mkhyen bla ma sku phreng sku byon gyi na bza'/bla ma mu to sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ gser dngul zangs las bzhengs pa'i lha sku dang 'jim sku thang gamachod pa'i yod byad byur bur gtams/ sa rta1918lor 'bog chen tshe ho kā lo'i (lnga chi)dmag dpung gis dgon pa 'phrog bcom dang mi ser mi nyung ba bsad/ skam thang la kha'i 'gyang ro'i dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang bshigs/ de rjes phying dkar rgya mtsho zhes pas rgyu sbyar te 'du khang nyams gso rgya bskyed dang 'jam dbyangs lha khang rten bcas bzhengs/ dngul bzhengs thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad ma dang /pad+ma rā ga'i tog gnyis/ mu tig brgya rtsa brgyad/ sgron ma gsung byon/ cang te'u/ kha ṭaṃ ga skam thang — 179 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/la kha'i dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang nas 'phro lus byin rten 'ga' zhig bcas dgon 'di dang kha gya'i dgon la spyan drangs/ bla ma mu to tshang gis thugs khur dang nyams gso gang rgyas mdzad/ khyad par du mu to sku phreng gong mas bkra shis rnam rgyal gling la thugs rje bdag gir mdzad tshul rje brag sgom pa'i chos 'byung du gsungs/de'i sprul sku dkon mchog don ldan klu shod du 'khrungs shing gdan sa bkod de slob gnyer mthar phyin gzhol/sku gong ma'i dus ltar dgon ri khrod bskyangs/ dgon par sgrub mchod sogs btsugs/ de'i sprul sku mu to bla rgan klu shod phyogs su 'khrungs shing / rje gong ma'i dus ltar thos bsam la slob gnyer gnang / de'i sprul sku skal bzang sbyin pa rgya mtsho ni sku gong ma'i dus su klu shod zhol sde nas 'khrungs shing / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs/ mdo sngags rig gnas la sbyangs pa dang / rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i drung nas lam mchog snying bo klu gter/ rgyal mtshan thod 'khod rnams kyi khrid/ lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung dang /me tog bcud len kyi khrid bcas gsan/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhi'i rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig gso dang gzim khang bskrun/ khyad par du khyung ri thang du klu shod dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad/ bla brang smad rgyud ltar gyi bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod btsugs/ dngul rwa dang chas pa'i gshis khri dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs chen khri la bzhugs/ rje nyid dgung lo don gsum pa me bya (1957)lor klu shod dgon du gshegs/ dme shul mu to sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang ye shes rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing byi1984lor yab phur ba skyabs dang yum bkra shis 'tsho'i sras su co ne chas pa'i gshis nyin pa zhes pa'i sar 'khrungs/ shing byi 1994lo'i zla gnyis pa'i bcu gcig nyin klu shod dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub bstan dar gling du gdan sar bkod/ 'bo ru mu to skal bzang 'jigs med pa'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul zhus / rdo rams pa skal bzang phun tshogs dge rgan du bsten 'bri klog sogs bslabs/ da lta bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs te slob gnyer gnang ba'i skabs lags so/ /dgon par lo gcig gi chos spyod gal chen la/ zla dang bo'i nang smon lam byams pa gling bskor/ srid gsum bdag mo'i tshes gtor dang ma ṇi/ zla gnyis par bde mchog sgrub mchod dang sbyin sreg tshogs skor klu chog 'don rta dbyangs bla brang smad rgyu ltar/ zla gsum kun rig sgrub mchod dang ras bris sgrub mchod phyag len bla brang dus 'khor ltar/ zla bzhi bar gsang 'dus sgrub mchod/ sbyin sreg klu chog 'don rta dbyangs smad rgyud ltar/ lnga bar rma blon lab rtse bstod par grwa tshang dang tsho ba yongs phebs dgos/ drug par gsang 'dus dang 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang gi ril sgrub/ dbyar gnas la mu to nang chen gyis sbyin bdag byed/bdun par 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi stong mchod/ gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ ltung bshags phyag mchod/ zla brgyad par rta mgon sbrags sgrub/ dgu bar 'jigs byed bdag 'jug smad rgyud ltar/ bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ smon lam/ gsang 'dus bskang gso bcas bla brang tshogs chen ltar dang / bcu gcig par grwa tshang yongs bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ zla bcu gnyis par mgon po chos rgyal lha mo rnam sras — 180 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kyi gtor sgrub dang / bsten pa dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod gtor sogs kyi srol rgyun spel/ las sne la'ang khri ba dang / dbu mdzad chen po/ dge bskos/ dkor gnyer/ spyi ba/ do dam pa sogs bsko srol dar/dgon 'di'i gtsug lag khang ni 'du khang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang / spyi khang / mu to nang chen/ sde khri'i nang chen/ grwa shag sum cu lhag grwa ba 'al grangs bdun cu tsam bzhugs/ dgon mthar ma ṇi 'khor khang dang / rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod rten bzhi bcas bzhengs/ 1958lo'i 'khrug zing rkyen byas te dgon 'di'i lha rten chos gsum tshang ma chag 'jig byung / chu thang du dgon par sa zhing mu lnga bcu tsam yod pa gzhung la bsdus so/ /lcags bya lor(19〈 1)skyabs rje bse blo bzang dpal ldan pa'i gsung bzhin 'du khang dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i gzhi tshugs pa dang / bse bla mas 'jam dbyangs sku brnyan bzheng pa'i gzungs gzhug tshad ldan phul/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bsang khog rgya mtsho dang / mtsho sngon rkang tsha'i smra khams tshang zhes pa'i rgyu sbyar mthun rkyen la brten/ dgon pa'i 'du khang bskyar du bzhengs shing gser tshon byugs/ rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhi ka slar bzhengs/ 'jam mgon rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog lo ltar dgon 'dir phebs te thugs rje bdag gir mdzad cing dge 'dun 'dus pa'i 'khor lo gnang / yon tan ga'i gyur ma sogs kyi lung bstsal/ kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo rje ba'i zhal thang khyad mtshar can dang / dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku brnyan bcas bzhengs/ ston pa dang / sa bcu'i dbang phyug byams pa/ rje yab sras kyi sman 'dam snang brnyan dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi sku thang dang rgyan thang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ yab sras kyi gsung 'bum blus / mchod rdzas sna tshogs bstar/ da skabs dge 'dun pa sum cu lhag bzhugs shing grwa khang bcu phrag lhag bskrun bzhin mchis/ me glang1997lo'i lha bab dus chen nyin 'du khang legs par grub pa'i dga' ston du mu to blo bzang ye shes rgya mtsho mchog dang / bse bla ma sogs spyan drangs/ dgon pa'i lha sde gtso bo thang dkar sgang thang gsum yin/ga'an ya nga dgon 'dir shing par la rnam bcu dbang ldan/ gang ser ma/ zab gsung rdo rje gcod pa'i gzungs sngags sogs dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i bster rgyud gtor 'bul bsdus pa bcas yod/ phyogs 'dir thang dkar lha rams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin/ tsho tsha'i sku skyes/ 'gyang ro sprul sku ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ son mkhan dge slong / sgyis tshang sngags rams pa/ mtsho tsha'i 'jigs med dga' bo/thang dkar dge slong / stag lu dge slong / a tse'i dge slong zhes gsang sngags rgyud grwa skyong mkhan sha stag byung / de min bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes thang dkar dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ phying dkar 'jam dbyangs/ ko nyin zhal dkar ba dpal ldan rgya mtsho bcas kyi sku yul yin no/ /rong ngar dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling /

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/chos sde rong ngar (ru ngar)dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling zhes pa da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong thang dkar nang zhang du chags/sngon rong ngar dgon pa'i sbyin bdag sde ba ma ṇi 'og sgang drug po zhes pa'i phyogs 'di'i mi rgyud ni/mdo smad rdzong chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal mgo log stag mo rdzong nas mched cing mgo log dba' shu' dpon skor ma zer ba'i 'brog khyim zhig yin pas sde ba'i ming dpon skor thogs(rong ngar dpon skor sde ba)/ ma go log sngags mtsher nas mched pa rong ngar 'brog gshong klad kyi lung g.yon du bsdad pas lung g.yon thogs (lung g.yon sde ba)/ mgo log lcags phye rdzi gnas mched pa da lta'i lcags sbug sde ba/ mgo log lngo nga ye sku spug nas mched pa'i ldong skor zhes thogs pa(ldo nga skor sde ba)mgo log a bo 'bum shis kyi mi rgyud nas mched pa'i 'bum chung sde ba/ sde ba lnga bo las mched pa phyugs skor zhes thogs pa(phyugs skor sde ba)bcas yin pa ma zad/dpon skor sde ba nas spun gsum skyes pa dpon rgyud yin pas rong ngar tsho gsum gyi dpon por bskos/ drug po de las mched pa'i mda' mkhan dang / gzhu mkhan/ sga mkhan/ a rtsig ga'ong rko/ rong tsha/'be tsha/ mtsho tsha/ thang dkar/ rgyu sne/ rkang tsha/ g.yu tsha/ mgo tsha/ tog tsha sogs kyi mi rgyud 'phel nas ma ṇi 'og gong gi tsho ba dang / gzhung gzhi'i sman lung tsho ba ste dpon po'i tsho gsum du grags pa rim par da lta'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /rong ngar dgon pa ni dang thog ri khrod cig yin zhing / phyis su lha rams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin byon nas da lta'i rong ngar dgon pa 'di nyid phyag 'debs gnang / de yang thang dkar lha rams pa sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang chos 'dzin dpal bzang bo ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing 'brug lo(spyi lo1784)la thang dkar gyi rus su yab sgom pa byams dang yum bu chog skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/ rje 'di nyid ming sring bdun las che ba yin pas khyim thab len rtsis byas kyang khyim du bzhugs ma 'dod par a khyung zhabs drung gi mdun du bros te rab tu byung / khong la thang dkar lha rams pa sku gong ma'i skye bar lung bstan pa bzhin rje gong ma'i mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa na dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du byon/ 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ a rig dge bshes dge legs bzang bo chos grwa'i dge rgan dang tsha kho zangs dkar ba tsa na dpon po dkon mchog yar 'phel 'jig rten dge rgan du bsten/ gzhung bka' pota lnga la slob gnyer dbu btsugs te sbyangs mthar 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon du bskos/ phar phyin ston mo'i dam bca' dang grwa ja btang / bla ma byams pa'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes shing gling bsre'i bka' bcu thon/tog ra khams tshan gyi dge rgan du bzhugs/ kun gzigs mchog dga' ldan du phebs shing mchod mjal skabs su zhal 'dris che ba byung / dgung lo so bdun pa lcags 'brug la lha rams pa'i grwa skor mdzad cing lcags rwa bde chen dpal 'bar gyi mkhan por phebs zhabs bkod/ dgung lo zhe gsum steng phyir mdo smad du phebs te rgyal rong rtse lha sgrub khang du lo gsum la lo mtshams bzhugs/ lce smad nas ta re legs sbyar gyis ri — 182 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khrod cig btab pa khong la phul/ de nas byang mjal la rang yul du byon/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa mo khyi'i(spyi lo1790)lor khya dge don grub rgya mtsho phebs te gnas gzigs dang sa 'dul mdzad/ thang dkar lha dmas pa blo bzang chos 'dzin dpal bzang bos rong ngar dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling phyag 'debs mdzad cing / tsong kha brgyad cu dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi thang ga che legs sogs bzhengs te dge 'dun 'du ba'i bsti gnas dam par mdzad/ kun mkhyen mchog gi mdun du bcar te rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gsan cing rgyal mo'i gshag ral du lo shas la sgrub pa mdzad/ rgan bya'i brag dkar gyi khri dang tsha gan be shing /mtshan sgrogs dgon/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dus 'khor grwa tshang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rgyud pa'i khri/ tshogs chen khri ba(gdan rabs zhe drug pa)bcas bzhugs/ lo du ma'i rjes su khri zur bzhugs shing rang dgon thugs skyong rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i mthar dgung lo don dgu bzhes pa chu khyi lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims so/ /sku phreng gsum pa rong rta'i lha rams pa blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang bzhi ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ lnga ba skal bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas ni rma chu'i dngul rwa lha sde'i bu rgyas tshang yab rab lo dang yum dbyangs sgrol gyi sras su rab byung bco lnga'i me 'brug lo(1916)la 'khrungs/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas lha rams pa'i yang sprul thugs thag bcad/ bkra shis 'khyil du lo ngo dgur chos grwa 'grims shing phar phyin ston mo dang dam bca' bzhag kun mkhyen lnga ba'i sku rgyab mkhan po mdzad de dbus su sgo mang chos gyur zhugs/ phyis su bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud stod grwa tshang dang khro kho chu kha ma'i dgon pa/sog po'i stag lung dgon pa/ tho bor dgon/ mda' mtshan dgon/ kho tshe dgon sogs kyi khrir bzhugs mthar ri khrod gong mar spyi lo(195 2)lor rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu mo sprul gyi lor sku gshegs so/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gling dang / rong ngar thos bsam dar rgyas gling / khyi snying ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling / ru chung dgon bkra shis rnam rgyal gling / a khyung sgom grwa thar ba gling / sman lung bkra shis chos 'phel gling sogs rong ngar dpon po'i mnga' dbang du rtsi/ dgon pa de dag gi chos thog rim pa dang las sne bsko 'jog rong ngar dpon pos bdag gir bzhes/ skabs shig bse sprul pa'i sku la rong ngar dgon pa'i dgon mgo phul cing bse sku phreng phyi ma dag gis skyong khur mdzad/ srung ma'i gtso bo dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ nang rten gyi gtso bo rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos thang dkar lha rams par gnang ba'i gser zangs las grub pa'i rje sku byin can ring bsrel 'phel gdung 'babs pa yin la/ bsod grags tshang gis gnang ba'i gdugs dkar gyi sku li ma/ bla ma a khyung gis gnang ba'i rje sku li ma/ bde mchog rang byon bdud rtsi 'babs pa/ dzi lha rigs lnga sman 'dam las grub pa'i ston pa dang rje yab sras gtso 'khor da gsum pa/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug thugs rje chen po sogs sku brnyan byin can mang bo bzhugs/bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / srung ma gza' ra hu la bsten/ mgon chos lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig— 183 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/spyan ras gzigs rigs drug 'dren pa/ bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos gnang ba'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang ga bcu gnyis/ bla ma sngags rams pas dbus nas gdan drangs pa ma ṇi bum sgrub kyi bum pa gser nag las grub pa/ rje btsun byams pa/ dzam lha rigs lnga/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma gsung 'byon/ lha mo gtso 'khor gsum pa/ yang smon rgyal bas gnang ba'i rje sku li ma/ dpon tshang dar rgyas kyi rgyal ba seṅge nga ro'i bzos grub kyi gos sku skyes bu'i gzhu 'doms nyi shu can sogs shin tu mod pa dang /byang chub mchod rten brgyan dang rgyal srid sna bdun dang / nor 'dzin pa ṭa'i rtse mor gser gyi dra phyed brgyan pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ dbu'i gser gdugs bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ dngul las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la rin po che sna lnga'i phras brgyan pa/ gzhan dung chen/ dung dkar/ rgya gling / 'khar rnga/gser kong / dngul kong / bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ yum sogs po ti stong phrag lhag bzhugs so/ /phyogs 'dir dgon sde khag skyong ba'i skyes chen dam pa byon pa la/ gnam lha rong ngar gnyi ga'i spyi dgon gyi bla ma a khyung drung rams pa mkhas mchog ye shes kyis a khyung sgom grwa thar ba gling btab/ khong la mkhas mchog dpa' bor 'bod/ kun mkhyen gong ma mdo smad du phebs skabs gdan 'dren zhus par/khong gi ri khrod kyi gnas 'di bde mchog sgrub pa'i gnas yin 'dug pas bde mchog tshogs 'don byos gsungs pa bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ kun mkhyen rnam thar du rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bsngags brjod gnang / de'i sprul sku a khyung ngag dbang mkhyen rab kyis grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / rnga rgod nam mkha' seṅge / mkhan chen drung yig blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub mang bo slob dpon du bsten/ bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba mchog gis rje nyid la snyan ngag khrid/ khong la rnam thar/ snyan rtsom/ chos spyod/ cho ga sogs gsung rtsom pota gcig bzhugs so/ /de'i sprul sku dkon mchog blo gros rgya mtsho bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwa zhugs/ klog bzang bas rje'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung mang du gnang / de'i sprul sku dkon mchog 'phrin las lhun grub dang / a khyung zhabs drung sku phreng dang nang gcig tu bskyangs/ de rjes 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho ni rong ngar dgon gyi khrir bzhugs/ khyi snying ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling sgyis tshang sngags rams pa stobs ldan pas btab/ 'di'i sprul sku dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho/ blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ da lta'i sprul sku skal bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho bcas byon te 'di phyogs kyi sgrub sde rnams dag bskyangs so/ /de ltar dam pa gong ma rim byon de dag gi sku drin dang thugs rje las rong ngar thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi 'chad nyan bshad sgrub kyi rim pa ni/ hor zla dang bor maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ byams pa gling bskor/ shwa 'cham/sgrol ma'i g.yul mdos/ me tog mchod mjal sogs dang / zla gnyis par grwa tshang bsnyen mtshams/— 184 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gdugs dkar bzlog chen/ zla gsum par lha mo'i bskang gso khri sgrub/ bde mchog sgrub mtshon/ bde mchog bdag 'jug seng gdong ma'i gtor bzlog zla bzhi bar gsang 'dus sgrub mtshon/ gsang 'dus bdag 'jug(bzhi ba'i smon lam zer)/ lha mo'i bskang mdos/ zla lnga bar phyi dror sku rim/ ma ṇi ril sgrub(drug pa'i ma ṇi zer)/ drug par dbyar tshugs/ zla dgu bar 'jigs byed sgrub tshon/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug (dgu ba'i bdag 'jug zer) zla bcu bar las sne gsar rnying brjes pa dang gnyer bas rtsis sprod/ lha tshes/ lnga ma chod chen mo(bcu ba'i lnga mchod zer)/ zla bcu gcig par lha mo'i gtor sgrub/zla bcu gnyis par me tog mchod pa bzo ba/ lo rnying sku rim sogs mang bo spel to/ /de'i zhor du grwa gzhon rnams kyis sgra snyan sman rtsis dang / thig rdul tshon/ gar dang phyag rgya/ gdangs dbyangs rol mo sogs sbyangs pa la skyes bu grags snyan can dper na blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rong sras tshul khrims rgya mtsho/sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho sogs dang / khyad par du dpon tshang dar rgyas rgya mtsho la japaṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba mchog gis mkhan po'i thob kyang gnang ngo / /sgrub sde 'di rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa rta(spyi lo1918)lor mā pu'u h+phang jag dmag gis 'du khang mer bsregs pa nas nang rten gtso rib /sa mi ser tshos nags khrod du sbas pas lus/ de rjes mi ser dang dpon tshang gis 'du khang ska/ ba brgya dang bcu drug can bzhengs pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas sogs legs par bsgrugs/ dgon par 'du khang dang lha khang bzhi/ grwa shag so brgyad/ bla ma'i nang chen bzhi ste bse dang lha rams pa/ a khyung / sngags rams pa bcas/ grwa ba brgya yas mas bzhugs so/ /dgon gzhung la tsha bo che sa sgang man chad dang sman thang mdo yan chad btsan nags dang grwa shag rang rang la sa zhing mi nyung ba/ lhag par khyim pa'i mchod zhing mu'u lnga bcu tsam mchis pas grwa mang yong 'beb cung bzang /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur skabs dgon pa'i rten brten pa gtor skyon byung ba dang rig gnas gsar brje'i nang dgon pa'i 'du khang dang grwa khang bshig nas rgya sgo sde bas zhing btab pa sogs las 'jig par gyur to/ /de nas spyi lo1985lor kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba kun lho khul du phebs nas rang sa'i thang dkar nang dad ldan mang tshogs kyis chibs bsu ja thab zhus/ rje 'di bas skyabs 'gro'i lung sogs gnang / rong ngar tsho gsum gyi mang tshogs chig khri lhag la phyag dbang thob/ grwa btsun dge slong yon tan rgya mtsho dang blo bzang bsam grub rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i ser skya yongs kyis zhal 'debs sgor chig khri lnga stong lhag phul/198〈lor dgon par lha khang chung ba bzhengs/ lha khang 'di'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi rim pa ni/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa/ byams pa/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ gnas brtan bcu drug bse sprul ba nyid kyi tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang ga sman bla'i zhing bkod/ bde gsang 'jigs/ lha mo nag thang / rigs gsum mgon po/ cho sa rgyal/ sgrol ma nyer gcig rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/— 185 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/lha rams pa'i sku yul nas bka' 'gyur dang rje rin po che'i thang ka bzos drub/ yum tshar gsum/ ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs pota mang bo bzhugs/ 1992lor bse bla mas rong ngar dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa mi nyung tsam gter lung du gdan drangs te bde mchog bdag 'jug gsar du btsugs pa'i skabs bstun/ rong ngar gna' dpon mgon po skyabs gtsos dge 'dun pa lhan rgyas kyis khong la tshogs chen 'du khang bzheng rgyu zhus par thugs dgyes te bzheng rten la shog sgor khri gcig gnang ba dang / 1999lor 'du khang dang byang chub mchod rten bzhengs grub pa'i dga' ston du bse tshang nas thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang /rang dgon do dam 'gan bzhes pa dge slong dam chos rgya mtsho(phyis su sprul skur ngos bzung ) dang 'jigs med rgya mtshos sgor khri sanyis 'al 'debs khas blangs/ dge slong thog ma 'di bas rang dgon ma zad/ skye 'gro tham sa cad la sman pa'i 'phrin las mu mthud spel ba mdor tsam spras na/ khong ni dgon pa rang gi tshogs 'don dang cho ga phyag len yi ge 'bri klog sogs legs par mthar phyin pa'i rjes su/ spyi lo1989lor kun su'u tshing chen nang bstan slob gling du zhugs te snyan ngag dang mngon brjod/ yig rtsal/ sa khams/ krung go lo rgyus / rgya yig khyad par du byang chub lam rim chen mo sogs lam rim blo sbyong gi rigs sbyangs pa dpyis phyin bgyis/ khos do dam gyi 'gan bzhes rjes dgon pa'i rnam pa sngar las lhag par mdzes pa dang /'dzugs skrun je mgyogs/ chos khrims je gtsang / mi rigs slob gso je dam du gtong ba sogs la byas rjes gsar ba bzhag dang 'jog ba'in mchis te/ tshogs chen 'du khang rten dang brten pa bcas pa bskyar du legs par bzhengs grub pa ma zad/ gser tog dang rgyal mtshan mchod rdzas yo byad sogs yongs rdzogs gsar du bsgrugs/ bka' bstan gyis mtshon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten bkang bar blus/ dgon mtha' yongs rdzogs ma ṇi 'khor khang dang / mchod rten/ mtha' 'khor du sdong phrug dang me tog sna tshogs btsugs/dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho ba je bzang dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyi khur bo je yang gtong ched dgon par chu drangs shing spyi khang phub/ tshong khang dang / sman khang btsugs/ gzhan yang mang tshogs la rlangs 'khor gyis zhabs phyi byas pa dang / dbul phongs la lto zos dang gyon pa/ gso sman sogs sbyin pa mang du btang /1995lor the wan gyi h+pha yan zi dgon pa dang zhin khran zi dgon pa gnyis kyis ched du gdan 'dren zhus pa ba'in khong nyid tha'e pe dang the nan/ the krung / go zhon sogs su phebs nas chos char rgya cher 'jo bzhin sdod dmangs lnga brgya lhag nang ba'i chos 'og tu bkod/ zhar la rgya brgyud nang bstan gyi phyogs la slob sbyong gang legs byas pas nyams myong mi nyung ba thob/ nye char gna' srol bcos sgyur bgyis te dge 'dun pa'i sger shag dgon gzhung la 'bul du bcug cing dgon gzhung nas grwa ba'i sdod gnas dang za ma sogs kyi 'gro gron khur du bzhes pa khag theg byas te ngo mas 'dul gzhung la mthun pa'i dge 'dun thun mong 'tsho bzhugs kyi lam lugs gsar du btsugs la snga phyir sgor sa ya gcig 'bum gnyis khri bdun btang / slob gnyer gyi thad du1996—1997lor gtsos mi rigs dge thon slob grwa dang rma chu'i slob 'bring bcas na bsgrubs pa'i bod — 186 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kyi rig gnas zab sbyong 'dzin grwa'i sbyin bdag byas nas bod kyi slob gso la rgyab skyor dang / dgon pa rang gis zab sbyong 'dzin grwa bsgrubs nas grwa btsun rnams kyi slob gnyer rting skul dang sgor chig khri phul te rong ngar stod ma'i dmangs sgrub slob chung gi slob khang bskyar du phub/ de bzhin da lta dus rabs gsar ba'i chos sde khag gis rong ngar dgon pa'i sgrig lam/ do dam/ 'tsho sro' sogs bcos sgyur byas pa mig dpe gsar btod byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /khyung rtse ri khrong/rwa zi'i brag dkar khyung rtse ri khrod ces pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi thang dkar nang zhang khongs su chags/rgan po'i gna' gtam ltar na/ gnas 'di kha sbyor rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang mngon par mdzad pa'i sngon bal bo'i pham mthing ba chung ba lbo kya tun du phebs lam bzhugs myong bar grags pa'i gnas red zer/ klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug las sprul pa'i zlos gar du grags pa'i rje shes rab rgya ma tsho dang /brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab/ dme shul mu to sprul sku/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i dngos slob cha ba chos kyi seṅge/su nyid dge 'dun dar rgyas/ chas pa rgya mkhar grub rje sku phreng snga phyi/ dpa' ris brag dkar 'jigs med rab gsal rgya mtsho/ kha gya'i 'gyang rgan 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen drug pa'i yongs 'dzin dkon mchog bsam grub/ rnga ba'i kun dga'/ co ne'i grags pa bshad sgrub/ kha gya'i lo ba dam chos sogs sgrub la rtag gus brtson pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba dag gi dben gnas red/ khyad par du dpa' ris 'jigs med rab gsal rgya mtsho dang rnga ba'i kun dga' rnam gnyis yun ring bzhugs te sgom sgrub 'bad/ dpa' ris 'jigs med rab rgyam ni/ yul dpa' ris sa nas1880lor sku 'khrungs/ gzho na dus nor lug stong phrag 'tsho ba'i rdzi bo byas stabs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thugs skyo dang sun 'byin par na bza' dang lam chas su rta mchog dkar bo btsongs te 'khor ba spangs/ bkra shis 'khyil du yong lam nas gter lung bse bla mar mjal ba dang / bla brang rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku drung nas lus la ngur smrig na bza' gsol cing bla ma de gtsug tu bkur/ bla kho rdo rje 'chang dang gung ru dkon mchog bstan pa'i dbang mo'i spyan snga nas zab don bsnyen rgyud kyi gdams pa gsan cing gnyan khrod chu mig brgya rtsar phyag phebs/zhi byed gcod rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu slob nyer bdun byung / yang bla ma'i bka' bzhin1rnga99lor brag dkar ngos su gzim khang phub te sgom sgrub mdzad/ mngon shes gzhal mtha' dben par grags/ rong ngar dang sman lung kha gya phyogs su smyung gnas dang ma ṇi'i rgyun mang bo spel pas kun gyis brag dkar a lags ma ṇi ba zhes gus zhen che/ me sprel te1956lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu nyin sgom khang 'dir sku zhi bar gshegs/kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung ltar bla ma 'jigs dge zhes pa phebs te thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i mchod sprin bstar/— 187 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gdung rus kyis bde mchog dang mkha' spyod ma'i sku 'bum blugs/ kun spangs pa rnga ba'i kun dga' zhes pa'i dam pa de'ang chu glang1912lor mdo smad rnga ba'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung ste rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar nas chos grwar zhugs/ phyag rdzas ci 'byor chos la btang zhing phyogs phyogs su phebs te sgrub pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te bde thang ba blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i drung du bka' chos ci rigs bslabs pa dang bsnyen rdzogs mnos/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal dngos su gzigs pa'i nyams snang mang du byung / rwa zi'i brag dkar rtse la rlung rta'i dar lcogs btsugs pa dang bla ma'i bka' bzhin1944lo nas yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen mdzad/ yul gyi mi rnams la ma ṇi smyung gnas kyi bla mar phebs/ zho tshang blo gros zhes pa sbyin bdag yin gshis bkur sti gzab/ me stag ste spyi lo1986lor sgom khang nyid du thugs dam ngo mtshar ngang gzugs sku'i rnam pa bsdus/ sman lung dgon pa dang grong skya thun mong gis dgongs rdzogs rgyas pa bgyis so/ /gzhan smyung gnas pa'i sprul sku rjes ma yul 'di'i a dzi'i khyim du 'khrungs zer zhing ri khrod 'di kyang bzhugs/ sku gshegs khar byang shabha lar 'gro rgyu yin pas yang srid med tshul kun mkhyen lnga bas gsungs so/ /rwa zi'i gnas kyi brag ngos su lha sku rang byon du ma yod pa dang sgom khang nye logs su khyung rtse ri khrod ces pa 'brel/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i grwa rgyun kha gya'i dar rgyas dang 'dzin grwa gcig pa'i rnga rgod smyung gnas pa zhes pas btab/ thugs rje chen po'i gnas su grags pas de'i nyams len skor tshugs shing / sho ba'i rta mgrin rang byon dang byin rlabs mnyam pa'i rta mgrin gtsos rten gsum mi nyung ba bzhugs/ srung ma k+ṣi tra pā bkur cing bskang gso gtong 'bul gyi srol legs/ 'du khang dang / nang khag gcig rgyun bzhugs ri khrod pa bzhi/ lhag dgos rnams sman lung dgon pas gtong bar bya/ 195〈lor ri khrod kyi rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs rtsa slog btang / da lta ri khrod du sgrub khang zhig phub pa dang snga srol ltar gyi thugs rje chen po'i sku 'bum che zhig lo ba'i dam chos zhes pas nyams gso mdzad cing rgyun bzhugs kun spangs la zhig kyang mchis so/ /khyi snying ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling /khyi snying ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling zhes pa dang da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi thang dkar nang zhang gi khongs su chags/ da ltar slar gsos/ri khrod 'di grub dbang sngags rams pa sgyil tshang stobs ldan pas phyag btab cing dus mnyam pa lags kyis rwa za'i brag dkar gyi nye 'dabs su phyag 'debs mdzad cing khong gis gzim khang brgyab pa dang 'du khang bzhengs pa la/ rten gyi gtso bo thub pa gtso 'khor gsum pa dang / mu 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod/ rdo brkos — 188 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/thugs rje chen po/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sngags rams pa'i gser bum sogs bzhugs/ de nas 'debs po'i yang srid la blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho/blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ hor gtsang ya shul nas blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ da lta ba rdo rje mtshan can de rong ngar bsod rgyal dang yum 'brug mo yag gis sras su sku 'khrungs par bse bla mas ngos 'dzin mdzad kyang / phyis su skya sar bud de 'jig rten 'khor bar byang ngo / /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyir bsnubs kyang da lta yul de'i sde dpon ma cig gtsos mi ser thun mong gis sgom khang bzhengs shing bse bla ma'i bka' bsgos bzhin bkra shis 'khyil ba'i kyai rdor dge bshes chen po bsam grub rgya mtsho lo mtshams su bzhugs/ dge bshes 'di ba ni bod rab tshes chu phag ste spyi lo192 2lor the bo yu ba'i ba pār sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu gcig nas kyai rdor grwa tshang du zhugs te zhal 'don gar thig phyag rgya bcas thugs 'dzin
