gnang ba dang skar rtsis rgya rtsis cha tshang sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu dgu nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su bsdus grwa nas dbu ma'i bar thos bsam rnal ma bgyis/ so gcig pa slar phebs nas paṇa chen bcu ba'i yongs 'dzin bsang khog 'jigs med mdun du mdo sngags mang bo sbyangs pa dang mnyam du sum rtags dag gsum sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris sogs bslabs pas mkhas chen du gyur/ khyad par du lo bcu'i god chag nang skar rtsis kyi zin tho mang bo btab/ da snga khong la gsung rtsom skar rtsis kun btus nor bu zhes pa dang /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ rtsis kyi rnam grangs dang rtsis kyi lo rgyus/ 'grel rkang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi 'grel ba/ bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag ces pa sogs mang / da dung snga phyir nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang / krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob gling / mtsho sngon slob gso'i slob grwa chen mo bcas su slob khrid thengs mang phebs/ krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob gling gi zhib 'jug pa chen mo la sogs kyi las 'gan mi nyung ba phrag tu bzhes pa dang / 1991lo nas da lta'i bar lo drug ring thengs re rgyun 'khyongs nas sgom sgrub kyi mtshams la bzhugs pa dang sku gam bcar ba'i dge 'dun pa rnams la lam rim dang skar rtsis sogs dmar khrid byed bzhin mchis so/ /ri khrod du dam pa gong ma dag gis srol btsugs ji bzhin chos spyod dang 'chad nyan bshad sgrub mi dman pa spel te/ zla re'i tshes brgyad bco lnga nyer lnga nyer dgur dus bzang / zla dang bor maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ zla gnyis par grwa tshang bsnyen mtshams/ zla gsum par bde mchog sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog zla bzhi bar gsang 'dus sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug lha mo'i bskang mdos/ zla lnga bar rim gro dang ma ṇi ril sgrub/ zla drug par dbyar gnas/ gnas bcu phyag mchod/ rnam 'joms bum sgrub/ klu dbang rgyal bo'i bum sgrub/ zla dgu bar 'jigs byed sgrub mchod dang 'jigs byed bdag 'jugazla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo nyin lnga/ zla bcu gcig par nyin lnga'i lha mo'i gtor sgrub/ zla bcu gnyis par me tog mchod pa dang / lo rnying rim gro sogs rgyas pa dar ro/ /— 189 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/kha gya'i sgar rnying dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling /kha rgya'i sgar rnying ngam dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling ni/ kun lho khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) kha gya smad zhang gi khongs su chags/snga 'gyur sa skya'i lugs bzhin sgrub sde chen po btsugs zer ba'i kha gya'i gser rgyal ba'i dgon pa 'brug chu'i nyi ma mthil tshe klad du chags tshul lo rgyus ring mo'i rgyun du gleng zhing / dgon shul dang grub thob bka' gtogs pa'i sgom sgrub mdzad pa'i gnas shul yod pa mthong / deb ther rgya mtshor kha gya'i sgar ni bai ser du 'byung ba'i dgon rnying zhig yin zer ba dam pa gong ma dag gis dgon 'di ngos 'dzin pa ma zad/ bla ma 'gyang ro gong ma 'khrungs rabs mang du song ba dang / bla ma klu tshang / kha gya'i paṇ+ḍi ta sogs kyis sgrub sde skyong khur gnang ba'i gdan sa yin zhes bshad cing / phyi ma'i mchog sprul dag la 'brel gtugs te zhus pa na de ltar yin tshul gsungs / da dung dgon 'di kha gya'i zhe'u chen brgyad cu zhes pa'i spyi dgon yin zer zhing grwa btsun brgya phrag 'ga' longs zer ba'i dpyad gtam ngag rgyun yod / gang ltar gser rgyal ba'i dgon pa 'di dang / ri rgyal sgom phug grwa ma phug gi sgom grwa sogs bsdus te kha gya stod smad ser skya gros mthun ngang nas nags tshal stug pos kun nas bskor ba'i spang ljongs me tog gi dga' tshal du 'chad nyan rgyas pa'i rten 'brel la dmigs te grwa sa'i thang du ha lam dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang tsam zhig la 'gyang ro gong ma zhig gis btab tshul a mdo chos 'byung dang kha bya'i lo rgyus zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer du 'byung / de nas ma 'gyang bar yul phyogs kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dbu mdzad 'og kha gya'i dpon po mgon po bsod nams gtsos sde dpon so sor dad pas kun nas bslangs te bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun 'dus pa'i 'du khang chen mor khyad mtshar ka ring bcu gnyis can bzhengs rjes/ tshogs chen 'du khang chen mor bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang dngul las grub pa zer ba'i sku brnyan byin can ma dgon nyi ma mthil tshes nas sde 'di la lung rtogs bstan pa 'phel rgyas gyi ched du dmigs te spos sna dang bcas bzhugs su bcug de min dung gi tshe dpag med dang ma bza' rdo gsum gyi rten thang byin can sogs rim par dgon 'dir gdan 'dren zhus tshul lo rgyus yig rnying zhig tu gsal/ de dag las kha gya'i gser rgyal ba'i skye ba rags pa 'gyang ro bla ma gur dmar gser tog can du grags pas dgon 'dir thugs rje bdag gir bzhes te sku phreng na rim gyis skyong khur gnang / da dung kha gya'i bla ma dkar bo zhes pa'i skye bar ngos 'dzin pa'i bla ma 'gyang ro chung ba/ bla ma klu tshang blo bzang rgyal mtshan/bla ma grwa tsha blo bzang ye shes sogs kyis 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi mnga' bdag mdzad de 'chad nyan rgyas pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad/ khyad par du mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yab sras skyong mdzad dpon po u jing tha'i jis gdan drangs te kha gya'i dgon par byon/ chibs bsu dang ser sbreng rgyas par byas/ der zhag gcig bzhugs/ ri dgon thun mong nas ston mo dang 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ rig pa'i dbang phyug a khyung rab 'byams pa gnas der mjal bar byon/ khong dang yongs — 190 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i zhal snga nas kyis tshogs gleng mdzad pas/ phyogs gling dang / chos grags gnyis dam pa'i chos kyi brgal brtag la gdan 'dzoms pa ltar gyur te kun mkhyen mchog kyang mnyes/ kun kyang ngo mtshar snying nas skyes te mjal ba mang du 'dus pa la phyag dbang 'don chos kyi char phab/ smin grol gyi lam bzang bo la bkod/ 'gyang ro sprul skus sger mjal zhus pa la/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi bshad lung gnas pa sogs kun mkhyen gong ma'i rnam thar du snang /chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras ni bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la 'dod dgur spyod pa'i chos kyi dga' tshal du phebs te zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs te bka' drin mchog tu che/ yang sgos su kun mkhyen gong ma yab sras gsum gyi dngos slob 'dul 'dzin pa'i ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis dgon 'dir smad rgyud cha 'dra ba'i bca' yig bzhag gsang 'jigs kyi cho ga dang / kun rig bdag 'jug rgyud smad ltar gyi bskang gso dbyangs dang rab gnas/ 'dir gzim khang phug ste sku phreng rim byon bzhugs pa'i gdan sa'i gtso bor gyur/ gur dmar gser tog gi dus bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur dngul bris kyis gtsos bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis sogs rten gsum mang / sa skyong kha gya'i be hu mgon po bkra shis gtsos kha gya shog pa bzhi'i skya ser thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pas 'jam mgon bla ma rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal bzang bo kha rgya'i dgon du spyan drangs/ 'chad nyan gyi srol gsar 'dzugs kyis dgon par bdag skyong mdzad cing bca' yig gnang / shog kha bzhi'i gzhung nas rje nyid la gzim khang rgya chen bzhengs/ sku tshe smad du phal cher kha gya'i dgon du bzhugs pa sogs gter lung yid dga' chos 'dzin gling gi lo rgyus gdan rabs su gsungs/ mgon po gang gi bka' drin gang 'tshams thabs mkhas kyi mdzad bzang mnyam pa med pas bskyangs pa'i drin chen nyid las/ bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub bslab pa gsum dang rim nyis kyi nyams len la sogs pa bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' dag dbyar gyi lang tsho'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa'i bstan pa'i dga' tshal yid smon pa'i 'ing mchog tu gyur/ gzhan yang snga sor 'du khang chen mo'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal ma gser las grub pa'i wu ma ma'i tshad tsam gyi nang rten grub chen thang stong rgyal bo'i phyag phreng sogs byin can gyi sku brnyan rje 'dis/ dam pa'i dmigs rkyen du sbyor 'jags mdzad pa sogs kyis mtshon/ bla ma snga ma sus kyang bsgrun du med pa'i lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi sgo nas mas bu skyong bzhin du mdzad pas grwa btsun lnga brgya lhag tu 'phel bar bshad/ rje 'di'i bka' drin las bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes rtser son ta re rdo rams pa khri ngag dbang mchog ldan dang / bla ma grwa tsha dpal 'dzin/ mdzod dge skyor dpon phya le ba gsum khrir bzhugs te rim par bskyangs/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i yig cha'i steng nas 'dzin grwa dgus po ti yongs rdzogs rtsod/ mgon po gang gi yang sprul rje blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas mchog gis kyang rje gong ma'i dus ltar skyong khur bla lhag tu gnang ste 'chad nyan gyi rgyun yun ring du bsrings/ 'gyang rgan sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med rgyal mtshan/ 'gyang ro chung ba sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang — 191 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/mkhas btsun rgya mtsho/ a khyung sprul ba'i sku blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs dgon 'di'i chos khrir bzhugs te legs par bskyangs/ bar skabs shig la don dag phra chung rkyen du song ste kha gya stod smad ma dgon dang bu dgon gyi tshul du phyes te bgos skabs der bse tshang dang / gser kha tshang / grwa tsha tshang / a khyung tshang bcas kyi gzim khang nang chen yod/ sgar sar la 'du khang nang chen yod/ sgar sar la 'du khang gi tshab la ston pa'i gos sku chen po dang / rten skal du jo bo/ nyi ma mthil tshe ma dgon kyi tshogs zangs smad kyi lha sde he mkhar yar la sbyar/ sgar gsar dgon shul gyi tshab tu stag tshang klad dang / a skyabs sde ba sogs smad la sbyar/ ri rgyal sde ba'i phyed ka 'phel rgyas gling gi mchod yon du byas/ da dung khye'i dkon gong ma sgar sar dang / kha gya'i be hu mgon po bsod nams kyis bzhengs zer ba'i khye'i dkon thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa'i sde zhol ma smad ma'i tsho bar sbyin pa'i lo rgyus snga sor yi ge yang yod/ de rjes kha gya stod smad gnyis kyis zhabs dkar pa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog spyan drangs te kha gya'i zhal dkar la rtse bstad/ dus 'di nas bzung /kha gya shog bzhis bstod pa'i srol tshugs so/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin 'gyang ro sprul ba'i sku dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad po sku phreng gong ma rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me byi lo mdo smad rnga ba'i yul du spro tshig ces pa'i rus su 'khrungs/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mdzad pa gsal bas/ kha gya'i dgon du spyan drangs te ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis pa'i drung nas dge tshul bsgrubs/ mkhas mang zhig gi khrod du thos bsam byed 'dod cher skyes pa dang / 'jam mgon khri rin po ches kyang gsang 'phrin bskur ba rkyen byas/ bros stabs kyis bkra shis 'khyil du byon/ dgon pa mthong ba dang tshogs dung 'bud pa dus mnyam du byung tshul rje gong ma mjal skabs zhus te mnyes/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras gtsug gi cod paṇa tu bkur te mdo sngags kyi chos bka' rgya cher mnos/ bla ma'i zhabs tog sngon gyi dam pa'i rnam thar dang mthun par mdzad/ tshogs chen zhal ngo dang rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad pa byas shing tshogs chen khri yang mdzad/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi mdzad par mig ltas kyis chos la don gnyer che zhing rnam thar bzang bo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dad tshugs shin tu brtan/ smon lam chos spyod 'ga' zhig gsungs nas phebs pas thams cad nyams mtshar ba zhig byung / kun gyis mtshungs med chos rje zhes bsngags brjod da lta'i bar du snang / khyad par du kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal bo 'jigs med dbang bo dang / 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang phyug rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa'i rigs brgya'i cod paṇa yongs 'dzin tu bkur/ bkra shis 'khyil dang sgar rnying nas gzim khang gsar skrun mdzad/ dgon pa'i khri yang bzhugs/ byams sku thog tshad gnyis pa rten brten pa bzhengs/dgung lo re bdun pa chu rta lor sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /sku gdung mchod rten da lta bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang gi dri gtsang khang du bzhugs/ 'dir rnam thar shin tu mdor bsdus bkod la/ zhib par gdan rab lha'i rnga chen dang kha gya'i lo rgyus zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer zhes bya las shes par bya'o/ /— 192 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/de'i sprul sku 'gyang ro sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med 'phrin las mdzod dge nas 'khrungs te chu rta lo ba/(1762da wa1772) dgung lo bcu ba lcags yos la gshegs so/de'i sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sbrul lor sog po mda' tshan du yab byams pa dang yum dbal shul bza' tshe dbang skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs dus 'brug grags skyabs mgon mchog gis lbang gi urger rdor phreng gi dbang gnang skabs/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ dgung lo bdun pa la bkra shis 'khyil du gdan sar bkod/ bcu gnyis steng kha gya'i dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs te 'ba' ri rgyal mtshan gyis dge rgan byas te bsdus tshan brtsis/ bcu drug par bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs chen mang ja dang ja bag re 'gyed thog tshogs su zhugs/ kha gya'i dar rgyas sogs dge rgan du bsten bka' pota rnams kyi rgyugs phul/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/nyer gnyis pa la smon lam rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags thon/ 'di ga'i rgyud grwa rgan gya'i brag dkar gyi khri mdzad/ de'i rjes su sde 'dir khri yang bzhugs te bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod cha tshang ba 'dzugs rgyu'i thugs smon gnang / rgyud khri zur nas kun gzigs mchog gdan 'dren gyi ched dbus su phebs/tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong snga srol ma nyams pa'i steng 'du khang chen mor gyan gnyis khebs pa'i bzang gos kyi bla bre/ gser zangs las bsgrubs pa'i 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku brnyan sbyor 'jag gnang / de nas lbang gi erge khri dang tsha gan pe shing gi bla mar rim par phebs/ don brgyad pa lcags khyi( 1850 )la gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni/ rong ngar sprel lung sde khrod du sku 'khrungs/mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo sogs bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ rje gong ma'i dus ltar kha bya'i dgon pa sogs skyong khur gnang ste gtsug lag khang dag la zhig gso du ma mdzad/ rje 'di'i 'khrungs lo gsal kha can gyi rnam thar ma mthong yang kun mkhyen bzhi ba bsten tshul rang rnam las mthong ngo / /de'i sprul sku 'gyang ro 'jigs med rgya mtsho'am pad+ma rdo rje mchog sog po'i rgyal po lbang gi rus su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu phrag lhag son skabs skyabs mgon mchog gis mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba zhabs pad bsten te kun gzigs mchog gis rigs gsum mgon po dang gto bzla sogs kyi lung gnang ba gsan/ bla ma'i bkas bskul las mtshan pad+ma rdo rje zhes bstan srid de bde 'jags su 'gro ba'i gang phan du khyim so 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' phebs tshul gleng / reb gong sgro ring nas yun ring bzhugs te gdon gyis gtses pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gis mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad cing /gegs las grol ba'i lo rgyus ya mtshan mang du mchis/ de dus rong bo bla brang gi gyod don legs 'dum byung ba'i thabs la 'bad tshul mngon/ de'i rjes su sgro ring bo nas khyim gzhis gnas spos/ bsang khog tu gnas — 193 —

dan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gzhis chags te 'gyang mtshan pad+ma rdo rje ba'i sras chos lo/ de'i bu sgrol ma skyabs/ de'i bu mo gdugs dkar skyid da lta yod pa'i gzhi khyim gtsos deng skabs bsang khog 'gyang ro zhes 'brog sde zhig chags yod cing sku phreng rim par mchod bkur che/ gzhan yang grub dbang pad+ma rdo rje bas kha gya'i dpa' bo rdo rje'i gnas skabs sgar rnying du bdun pa'i shwa 'cham sogs gsar btsugs gnang tshul bshad/ rje 'di mgon po rdo rje'i skye bar grags/me yos lor sku gshegs zer zhing rje nyid kyi zhal chems ltar bsang khog khyung rtse klu'i ngos g.yog du gdung zhugs 'bul zhus so/ /de'i sprul sku 'gyang rgan 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta lor (1920)mdzod dge ru stod ma'i rdo ma ṇi tshang gi yab skal bzang skyabs dang yum gu ru 'tsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen pos mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ gung ru drug pa'i dge rgan sa dmar dpal bzang dge rgan du bsten nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi 'don cha rnams bzung / rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog bla mar bsten nas zab chos du ma zhus/bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs nas phar phyin dam bca' sogs rim par bzhag dge bshes lha mo'i tshul khrims la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ gdan sa'i sgar rnying gi khri yang lo mang du bzhugs/ 1958lor khrims 'dzin byas te lo 'ga' song / rig gnas gsar brje chen po yi skabs su dgag rgyag khel/ legs nyes ci byung dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang yar la bstod mkhan yin cing kun gyis dad zhen che/ rdo'i steng du zhabs phyag rjes dang phyag phreng gis brabs pa'i phreng shul babs pa dang chu med lung ba skam por chu bton pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan khyad par can bzhag pa kun gyis mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du gyur/ chos sgo slar gso phye nas gdan sa'i dgon grong so sor bkod khyab mdzad/ lcags bya gter lung 'du khang bzhengs grub dga' ston du phebs/ rje gong ma'i dus su bla brang nang chen snyan grags tshang gi phyag tu shor/ rje 'di'i sku ring la nang chen smad sog nor bu tshang gis blus/ rje nyid nas sprul sku rjes ma mkhas btsun blo bzang gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs ma med pa zhig 'khrungs rgyu'i smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar ba yin gsungs/dgung lo nga lnga ba shing glang lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin bla brang nas gshegs so/ /rje nyid kyi zhal chems ltar 'dren mchog 'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje dpal bzang bo gdan 'dren zhus/kun mkhyen mchog gi bkod khyab gnang ba ltar gdung rten mchod rten chen po bzhengs te da lta gdan sa'i 'du khang dbus su mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs so/ /de'i sprul sku 'gyang rgan sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang dge legs rgya mtsho mchog ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me stag lor yab ban de sgom dang yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su klu chu'i a la zhes pa'i the mdo sde khrod du sku 'khrungs/ dam pa kun mkhyen mchog dang / bse tshang / sde ba tshang gis thugs thag bcad de shing khyi lo'i (1994)zla gnyis pa tshes bcu gnyis nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du thog mar gdan sar bkod dang / gdan — 194 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sa kha gya'i sgar grong nas bsu ba ser sbreng gis bkur te dga' ston gzab/ da lta bkra shis 'khyil du blo gros mchog tu yangs pa'i 'jam dbyangs mtshan can dge rgan du bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la gzhol mus/ bla ma gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung nas bka' chos mang du gsan pa sogs/ thos bsam la thugs gnyer mdzad bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /kha gya'i bla ma 'gyang ro che chung gnyis las 'gyang ro chung ba'i sku phreng rim byon gyi lo rgyus rten yig ltar na/sku thog dang bo kha gya'i o brtan nas 'khrungs shing dbus su phebs te dga' ldan du chos grwar zhugs/ mtshan la kha gya'i bla ma gur dkar ram/ kha gya'i bla ma dkar bo zer/ mtsho sngon zhabs drung dkar bo dang mnyam du dga' ldan byang rtse pa ne khang tshan gsar 'dzugs gnang ste mtsho sngon dang kha gya tsho drug gi lha sde dag phul ba pa ne khang tshan sgrig yig lo rgyus (1952)gsal bo yod/ sku tshe smad du rang yul du phebs te kha gya stod nyi ma mthil tse klad dgon du dga' ldan byang rtse ltar gyi kun rig dang gsang sngags rgyud pa grwa tshang gi mgon chos ji bzhin dang mgon dkar sogs tshogs 'don btsugs/ mthar gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i sprul sku 'jam dpal lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni yul mdo smad co ne sho ba khang thog phyogs su gtogs pa'i pho lung nyi ma sde bar 'khrungs/ lhan skyes dam pa'i rang bzhin dang / 'khrul bral lung gi gtan tshig la brten nas gdan sa kha gyar bkod de thugs gnyer mdzad/ dgon pa yang skyong khur gnang mthar kha gya ru gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang mkhas btsun rgya mtsho ni/ kha gya'i be hu la 'khrungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis dam pa gong ma'i yang srid pha ma'i ming zur dang bcas gsal bor phyag yig dam sbyar ma gnang / de yang kha bya'i be hu dang bo'i ming la mgon po bsod nams/ de'i bu mgon po bkra shis/ de'i bu mgon po don grub zer/ sog skad du us jang the cu zer ba'i dpon mgon po don 'grub kyi bur 'khrungs pa dam pa gang de'o/ /sku na chung dus nas dbus su phebs 'dod che yang yab kyis ma gnang bas/ 'gyang ro'i nang chen du lha sa'i jo bo'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i jo sku dang / lha khang nyis thog tshon rtsi gser tog bcas bzhengs rjes lha sar phebs su bcug da dung lha khang de'i nang du 'jim bzos kyi gnas brtan bcu drug bka' 'gyur dag tshar gnyis bcas bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur gcig 'jam dpal bstan pa'i sgron me'i rgyan 'brel sde ba'i rgyab ris kha nas phyag bris mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur yin/ gzhan yang rje 'di la paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis gnang ba'i mkhan thob/ khong nyid kyi zhal thang phyag tham can/ sku chas/ bka' shog dang / yab be hu mgon po don grub kyis phul ba'i be hu'i thob/ ba so'i tham ga dang rma bya'i sgron/ be+e ḍūr+ya sngon po'i tog sku chas cha tshang bcas gnang / de nas bzung be hu'i sku rgyud chad/ khong nyid chos srid zung gi bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin zhes pa'i yi ge ma phyi ltar/ da dung lo re bzhin zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu dgu'i 'cham la be hu bzhugs zhing be hu'i sde ba gong co shar du song nas 'cham dgos pa dang /rjes su 'gyang ro'i mang chen gyi 'cham gos g.yar dgos la chos rgyal yab yum gnyis kyi 'cham gos 'gyang ro — 195 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ngag dbang mkhas btsun rgya mtsho khong nyid yab yum gos lwa yin stabs kyi g.yar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gleng /gang ltar lo rer gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshes gcig gi nyin tshoms chen du thob tshang ma 'grem ston byas nas mchod 'bul dang / bzhugs gral 'tshogs rgyu'i srol195 2lo bar du gnas so/ / sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dpal bstan pa'i sgron me/ rje gong ma'i dbon nag spun kha gya'i yu mo'i dpon po rdor nag dang / rong ngar dpon po'i rgyud du grags pa'i yum rin chen 'tsho'i sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu khyi lor sku 'khrungs/grub pa dung sna bas mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ rje gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i spyan sngar rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs zhus te mtshan yang gnang / gtsos gser khri blo bzang rgyan ser tshang dang / mkhyen gter bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas tshang bla mar tshul ba'in bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag mkhas par sbyangs skad/ kha gya'i dgon dang / gtsos dgon/ lha mo'i dgon dag nas chos grwar 'grims/ rig gnas du ma bslab 'bul zhus/ sku phreng lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rong ngar sprel lung zhes pa'i 'gyang ro 'og ma tshang du 'khrungs/ tsha rdor no mo tan gyis mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ gdan sa 'di nas chos grwar 'grims/ gtsos gser khri tshang bla mar bsten bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ smad phyogs su phebs nas sku gsung thugs rten du ma spyan drangs te dgon pa dang nang chen la spyi 'jog byas/ shing byi1924lor gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku 'gyang ro chung ba skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug lor mdzod dge bis byung shes rab dang yum 'brug mo rgyal gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ de sngon 'gyang ro dpon po bstan 'dzin seṅge bas dbus su gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo bcu gsum pa yang sprul ngos 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug zhus pas phyag yig dam sbyar ma gnang bas bka' gsung ltar kha phye/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste sgar rnying du gdan sar bkod/ kha gya'i gsung rab rgya mtsho thog mar klog gi slob dpon du bsten/ rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs/ dge bshes oṃ 'khyil skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten nas gzhung chen po sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par/ dgon pa 'di'i khri mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te phar phyin dam bca' bzhag gdong gral bla ma'i thob thang gnang / yongs 'dzin dngul ra'i grags pa tshang nas bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad steng dme shul thang ser dgon pa'i khri yang mdzad/ 195rngadus zing rkyen byas te 'dzin bzung gis btson du lo gsum 'gor/ chos sgo slar phye nas bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzhengs dang / bla brang zam tsha gser khri/ dbal mang che ba/ gling sprul lnga ba/ 'gyang rgan bdun pa sogs mchog sprul gdan sar bkod skabs thugs khur cher bzhes gnang / da lta bsang chu rdzong gi srid gros u yon dang / khul nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi drung yig chen po gzhon pa bcas kyi khur bzhes so/ /kha bya'i bla ma klu tshang blo bzang rgyal mtshan ni kha gya'i klu chen a yon tsho bar 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bla ma — 196 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos bka' rgya cher mnos/ 'bras sgo mang bya bral khang tshan du slob gnyer mdzad pas dge bshes rtser son/ sgar snying dgon du mtshan nyid btsugs kyang ma gnas par khri chen bse ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pas mtshan nyid bskyar tshugs gnang ste bca' yig kyang bzhag bar skabs shig la smin gling du gter ston mjal/ rig gnas bslab/ thu med lha btsun dang mnyam du 'khor ba dbyings sgrol sogs bka' chos mang po zhus/ thu med lha btsun gyis sbyin bdag byas te 'khor ba dbyings sgrol tshogs 'don du btsugs pa snga sor gnas so/ /de'i sprul sku klu tshang 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dbang phyug bkra shis 'khyil du gzhung lugs spyi dang / sgra ka tsan/ sdeb sbyor skar rtsis/ snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/ kirti sprul ba'i sku dge 'dun chos kyi dbang phyug gi mtshan nyid gsan sbyang gi yongs 'dzin mdzad/de'i sprul sku klu tshang 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan the bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang sku mched du 'khrungs/a rig rwa brgyar thos bsam dang dbus su yang byon/ shing bzang dpon slob las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'di ba'i gong ma dang khong gnyis kirti'i rgyud khrir bzhugs pa'i rnam thar a mdo chos 'byung du snang / klu tshang sku phreng bzhi ba mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ba'i rjes su gshegs so zer zhing mtshan yang nges can ma rnyed/ klu tshang sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar ma mthong / rje 'di'i mtshan khyab 'jug rā hu la'i spyi btab mdzad pa'i lo rgyus gsal kha can rnyed/ phyogs phyogs su phebs te 'gro don mdzad tshul thos/ co ne sa skyong gi dbu bla mdzad tshul gleng / khyad par du bla ma klu tshang rje gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan mchog gis gza' mchog khyab 'jug zangs ma'i bu gu'i nang du bzhugs par bcug ste kha gya'i phyogs su spyan drangs zer ba'i lo rgyus grags che/ kha gya'i sgar gsar rnying spyi dang sgos su bla ma klu tshang sku phreng gis srung ma'i gtso bo bsten cing /'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bshad tshul mang ngo / /klu tshang sku phreng drug pa skal bzang bstan pa rab rgyas rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag lor 'bo ra'i yag pa'i yar ka grong nas yab rin chen rgyal dang yum 'brug mo rgyal gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste kha rgya'i sgar du gdan sar bkod/ btsun pa'i mchog gyur dge slong bsam gtan dge rgan du bsten nas chos spyod sogs thugs 'dzin gnang / rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog zhabs pad bsten nas bka' chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ co ne sa skyong gi snga srol ltar gyi bla mar bkur/ 195ngalo'i 'khrug zing nang du g.yang sar lhung /da lta bsang chu rdzong gi srid gros u yon dang / khul nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin gyi 'gan bzhes so /gzhan yang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes rtser son te rdo rams pa ngag dbang mchog ldan la sku phreng bzhi byon zer ta re skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan da ltar bzhugs/ rje 'di'i sku gong ma dang khong gi yongs — 'dzin blo gsal tshang rnam gnyis dgon 'di'i khri yang mdzad/ mchog sprul ta re pas 'du khang dbus su kun rig snang brnyan bzhengs/ lha khang sogs zhig gsos mdzad de bka' drin che tshul gleng ngo / /— 197 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bshad sgrub 'phel rgyus gling 'di nas zhwa ser ring lugs 'dzin pa rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog gis dgon 'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang tshe dbang gnang / kha gya'i bla ma 'gyang ro tshang nas 'bul ba phul tshul sogs rnam thar gas/la/ dgon 'di'i grwa rgan be hu chos grags rgya mtshos zhus ngor/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos dus 'khor dbang chen sogs gnang / kirti blo bzang 'jigs med ye shes rgya mtshos tshe dbang gnang / yid kyis smon pa bzhin du 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par lhun gyis grub pa'i dgon grags pa can cig yin/dgon 'di nas kha gya'i yong sha dge bshes kha gya dar rgyas rnga ba go thob sogs 'dul 'dzin pa mang du byung /khyab 'jug gza' ma chog ra hu la bsten nas phyogs phyogs su gnam 'gog tu phebs mkhan mang / grub chen chas ba rgya mkhar tshang dang mdzod dge stobs ldan tshang dgon khrir bzhugs myong ngo / /sde 'di'i gtsug lag khang gi rim pa ni/ tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo/ byams chen lha khang / rje lha khang / chos 'khor lha khang / seng ge sgra'i lha khang bcas dang / gsan chung dang gza'i btsan khang /tshogs chen spyi khang sogs dang / rngam gzi che ba 'gyang ro'i nang chen/ klu tshang / ta re/ kirti tshang /snga sor kha gya'i stod 'bo rar 'khrungs pa'i mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i nang khag bcas dang /grwa shag ka ba brgya phrag lhag dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor du ma ṇi 'khor khang mang bo/ dbyen zlum mchod rten che ba bcas bskrun cing 'di dag lha khang so so'i nang du sku gsung thugs rten che chung ci rigs dang / mchod pa'i yo byad du ma gos sku sogs mchis/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan gser bris dngul bris po ti mang bo bzhugs/ grwa tshang 'di'i 'chad nyan chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ hor zla dang bo'i nang du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ltar phyag len btsugs pa'i smon lam/ zla gnyis par bka' 'gyur gsung ba dang phyag mchod/ zla bzhi dang lnga bar sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba sogs dang / dpyad chos thog ma dang / kun rig gi cho ga gsang 'dus 'jigs byed kyi cho ga rgyan 'jug sogs kyi chos spyod/ zla drug pa ma ṇi'i chos thog yin te/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas 'khor ba dbyings grol gyi sgo nas cho ga zla bdun pa shwa 'cham/ dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad pa ston chos/zla dgu ba gsang 'dus bdag 'jug sogs dang / zla bcu ba lnga mchod chen mo'i chos thog yin te/ 'don pa kun rig gi cho ga chos spyod/ /zla bcu gcig par dgun chos/ zla bcu gnyis kyi tshes bco lnga lha mo'i tshe gtor/ lo rnying sku rim/ mgon chos lnga'i gtor chog dang lha mo'i tshe gtor/ chos spyod bcu dang bya rog gi 'cham bcas yod do/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag la kha gya smad ma'i shog pa spyi dang / sran thang / khye'i dkon zhol ma/ gtsos rgyan 'brel sde ba/ ri rgyal sde ba'i khyim tshang brgyad bcas mchod gzhis lha 'bangs du ma dang / sgar lung spyi'i spyi dpon spyi ba/ rgan pa bzhi sogs dang / dgon pa'i chos bdag khri ba/ 'grig bdag dge bskos dbu mdzad bcas las sne 'dzin bdag gnang / dgon pa spyi la sa zhing mo'u stong lhag nags tshal mo'u — 198 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/995yod/ 1958rjes su gtor bshig thebs te rten dang brten pa 'jig go /lcags bya lor slar dgon 'dir yang tshogs 'tshogs thub par byung / de'i phyi lor19〈2lo kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan yin lho'i phyogs su phebs lam du kha gya stod smad bla sprul ser skya thun mong nas rta bsu thab bsu ser sbrengs bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / dpon slob sde dang bcas skyabs 'gro dang /ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma sogs kyi lung gnang / 'dren mchog chos kyi rdo rje bas kha gya stod smad kyi ser skya mtha' dag 'bral med rjes su 'dzin rgyu'i skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus/ spyi sger so so nas 'bul ba gzab/kun gzigs mchog mnyes te rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar byung / bla ma 'gyang rgan drug pas kha gya stod smad kyi dgon grong dag 'jam mgon bla ma gter lung bse tshang la skyabs bcos byas/ gzhan yang 'gyang ro bla ma che chung gnyis kyi thugs bskyed dang / kha rgya'i ser skya dag gi 'dod mos ltar/ kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog dang / dam pa kun mkhyen/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che la zhus pa ltar/ sde 'di nyid rnga dar dung gsum 'dzoms pa'i snga sor te paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis lung bstan pa'i gnas su btab na bshad sgrub 'phel zhes pa'i gsung ltar dgon gnas spos te bskyar 'debs skabs su/skyabs rje thu'u bkwan dam pa'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho gtsos dge slob bzhi ldan bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas gdan drangs te bkra shis kyi gso sbyong dang / lto 'phye thug btab/chos 'khor gyi dam bca' sogs tshugs te legs byas gcig tu gzhol/ rab byung bcu drug pa shing glang lor(1985)'du khang chen mo bzhengs 'go brtsams/ me yos lor(1987)legs par grub pa'i dga' ston kyang byas/ 'du khung dbus su dge slob bsam gtan rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i jo sku/ 'byor ldan ske li'i tshe te nas bzhengs pa'i byams pa/ khang them klu dgas bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ gzungs skyabs kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ 'phrin las kyis bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas gtso 'khor gsungs pa/the bo'i phun tshogs kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba tsong kha ba dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi snang brnyan/da dung a skyabs sman pa grags pas bzhengs pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad dang / gzhan yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang gyang thang du ma gsar du bzhengs shing / rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi gos sku'ang bzhengs yod/ gsung rten bka' bstan gnyis dang / rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum dang / grub dbang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung 'bum bcas bzhugs/ thugs rten 'du khang dbus su 'gyang rgan pa'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten che legs can bzhugs pa/ 'di bzhengs skabs sgro ring bo dang bsang khog 'gyang ro'i lha sde nas zhal 'debs dngul dang shog sgor mang du phul/ de min rang rang gi ci 'byor zhal 'debs mang bo phul dgon pa'i nub byang du dbyen zlum mchod rten che legs can zhig bzhengs/ bla ma 'gyang ro'i nang chen dang / rung khang / seṅge sgra'i 'khor chen/ grwa shag nga lnga/ grwa ba bdun cu lhag bzhugs shing srol ltar chos spyod yar ldan du spel/ deng skabs dgon pa'i 'tsho ba'i rten gzhi smad ma shog pa spyi'i mchod — 199 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bkur che/ ri rgyal sde ba'i khyim tshang brgyad dang / rgyan 'bras sde bas sngar srol lta ra gnas/ dgon rang nyid la zab gsung rdo rje gcod pa sogs kyi par shing du ma yod pa'i par khang / tshong khang / sman khang /nags tshal kyang mang bo yod do/ /da dung dgon shar lho'i phyogs su sgong be ri khrod dang / khye'u dkon sgom grwadagon pa'i nub byang mtshams su dgon li shar ri khrod bcas gsum yod de/ yul nyid ni 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po bse mchog sprul drug pa dang / 'gyang rgan mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi bka' drin las bshad sgrub zung du spel ba'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po'i grib bsil ci dgar rol ba'i skal ba can dag chos srid dpal gyis brgyan pa'i kha gya'i smad phyogs su dam pa'i skye rabs kyi phreng ba mdzes pa'i bla ma klu tshang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ a lags kha gya tshang / grub dbang mdzod dge stobs ldan tshang dang / de'i sku mched mtsho kha ba tshang / bla ma 'gyar ro chung ba ngag dbang mkhas btsun rgya mtsho dang / de'i sprul sku 'jam dpal bstan pa'i sgron me/ da lta'i dbal mang chung ba mchog sprul skal bzang mtshan can sogs skyes chen dam pa du ma'i bsod nams chu gter dpal las 'khrungs pa'i sku yul yin no/ /dgon li shar ri khrod yid dga' chos gling /dgon li shar ri khrod yid dga' chos gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gtsos grong khyer gyi khongs kha gya smad zhang khongs kha gya'i sgar rnying dgon pa'i nub phyogs su chags/ri khrod 'di ni skyid thang blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis btab cing rim byon sku phreng gis bskyangs/ 'du khang dbus su kha gya'i be hu mgon po don grub kyis bzhengs pa'i byams mgon bla ma li sku che legs byin can dang /rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa'i sku'i 'khrungs rabs zhal thang che ba/ drag po gsum 'brel gyi snang brnyan sogs dang / gsung rten yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo sogs kyi gdung rten mchod rten dag sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs/ phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang du grags shing rnam 'joms zhabs khrus kyis 'gro phan che tshul deb ther rgya mtshor gsungs/ 'jam mgon bla ma rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis ri khrod 'dir thugs dam nyams bzhes ngang yun ring bzhugs/ gnas su 'du khang dang / spyi khang / grwa shag kha shas bcas yod cing / srung ma mgon po bram gzugs bsten/ rgyun bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa gtsos grwa ba brgyad tsam bzhugs shing chos spyod gal chen skabs kha gya'i sgar rnying nas grwa ba mngags bzhin mchis so/ /chos spyod kyi rim pa la zla dang bo'i nang smon lam ni sgar rnying du mnyam tshogs dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ dus bzhi'i chos thog sa zla la rdzis khog shog par 'tshogs pa'i smyung gnas/ lnga bar dmigs brtsi ma sgrub pa nyin gnyis/ zla dgu bar bde mchog lū hi ba'i bdag 'jug dus rgyun yar ngo mar ngo'i dus bzang chos spyod rab gsal gyi rim pa mang bo kha gya'i sgar snying gi phyag srol ltar spel/ srung ma'i gtor chog bskang gso rgyas pa dus rgyun mdzad kyin mchis so/ /— 200 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/1958lo'i rjes su ri khrod kyi rten gsum ma lus pa 'jig da snga slar gsom bgyis par lus/ /sgang ye ri khrodakha gya'i sgang ye ri khrod ni/ gan lho'i gtsos grong khyer gyi kha gya smad ma zhang gi khongs su chags/kha bya'i sgar rnying dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi shar lho'i phyogs yin zhing / kha bya'i lo rgyus zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer las gsang sngags grub pa'i rnal 'byor ba sgang ye nyi ma thag gtod ces pa'i sgrub gnas yin/ de rjes 'jam mgon bla ma rje ngag dbang bkra shis dgung grangs zhe bdun pa la rje 'di nyid bla brang dgon pa'i mang ja'i ched du/ rong phyogs gtsos kha gya'i sgar rnying du bzhugs skabs su ri khrod 'dir phebs te rigs gsum mgon po'i bzlas sgom dang / dmigs brtse ma'i bsnyen mtshams sogs la bzhugs shing / ri khrod 'dir dmigs brtse ma gtsor 'don byed pa'i rgyun btsugs/ gzhan yang bla ma 'gyang ro che chung dang / bla ma klu tshang / bla ma ta re tshang sku phreng snga phyi mchog gis ri khrod 'dir bdag skyong gnang /khyad par du kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi yang yang phebs/ de rjes rdzogs chen dpal sprul ba'i gsung gnang ltar/ bag tsha nas shing cha drangs te 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ 'od dpag med dang / spyan ras gzigs/ rje tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan bzhengaji // skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing dga' ldan lha brgya ma bcas pa'i thang sku/ bla mchod dang sangs rgyas stong sku'i gyan thang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum bcas kyi glegs bam/ da dung rdzogs chen dpal sprul 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis sman 'dam gyis mkhan slob chos gsum bzhengs pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs shing / /ba gya'i sgar rnying gi phyag srol ltar smon lam chos spyod kyi cho ga 'ga' zhig spel/ sa zlar kha sog shog pa mnyam du 'tshogs te smyung gnas/ zla lnga bar dmigs brtse ma gtso 'don nyin gsum/ zla dgu ba 'od dpag med kyi stong mchod sogs srol btsugs/ rgyun bzhugs kha gya'i gsung rab dang a khu rgyal bo zhes pa dge btsun 'ga' bzhugs pa dang / sgar rnying nas grwa ba gtong bzhin mchis so /1958lo'i rjes su ri khrod 'jig da skabs sngon ltar slar gso byas te ma ṇi smyung gnas rnam dkar gyi rgyun gnas so/ /khye'u dkon sgom grwakhye'u dkon sgom grwa zhes pa ni gan lho khul gyi kha gya smad zhang gi khongs gtogs gnyan chen po sngo la g.yu rtse'i byang shar du gtogs pa'i nye 'dabs su chags yod/sgom grwa 'di'i lo rgyus nye char kha gyar nyar tshags byas pa'i yig rnying dang lo brgya 'tsho ba'i rgan po dag gi ngag rgyun ltar na/ kha gya'i o brtan du 'khrungs pa 'gyang ro sprul sku'i zhal bkod bzhin dang 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i lung las kha bya'i be hu mgon po bsod nams sbyin bdag byas te btab zer/ be hu mgon po — 201 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bkra shis dang mgon po don grub gsum gyi ring sgom grwar mchod bkur che/ 'du khang gi rten gtso thugs rje chen po/ rgyun bzhugs btsun pa bcu phrag 'gas kha bya'i dgon pa'i phyag len ltar chos spyod spel/ bse sprul ba'i sku gsum pa dang / kun mkhyen bzhi ba sogs kyis zhabs bcags/ cha skam dpon po dbang lo zhes pas mchod sbyin yang yang bgyis pa dang / bla ma ta re sku phreng gsum pas skyong khur gnang / bla ma 'gyang ro sku phreng snga phyi dang / 'gyang ro dpon po tshul khrims kyis sgom grwa nyams gso byas pa'i mod la/ shog pa'i dgon 'go dgar ba'i dus su cha skam gong ma kha gya stod dang cha skam zhol ma'i sgom grwa kha gya smad la sbyar/ de nas bzung kha stod cha skam gong ma dang phyogs bcu/ ta thang zhes grong tsho dag gis mnyam du bsang la rtse dang ma ṇi smyung gnas 'tshogs pa'i srol tshugs pa dang / cha skam zhol ma'i sgom grwa 'dis mchod gzhis gtso bo kha gya'i sgar rnying la smon 'a ma gtong ba'i srol yod/ rab byung bco lnga'i mjug tsam du ka ju'i yul 'khrugs skabs der yun cis(zo༅)mā zhin zhes pa'i dmag mis kha gya'i cha skam phyogs kyi nags tshal bcad stabs/ kha gya shog pas lan ju'i (༅ nya/ / )tsong tu'o la gtugs/ mā chis dmag dang sa sgo'i mā zhin gyi dmag gis 'khon lan slog par1926lor(me rta)dmag brgya phrag du mas kha gya'i khye'u dkon sgom grwa dang / cha skam gong 'og gi dud tshang drug cu lhag pa 'khrug thengs gcig tu tshar bcad/ sgom grwa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ta re yongs 'dzin blo gsal rgya mtshor nyams nyes med par kha gya'i sgar rnying gi khri bzhugs phebs pa dang / khye'u dkon a khu rnam grol dang dge phrug mgon po sogs ho the kha bya'i dgon nas chos grwar zhugs/ 1kha49lo'i zla11pa'i nang sgom grwa 'di'i gnas tshul kha gya'i spyi ba bsam gtan dang phyogs bcu'i klu 'bum rgyal che chung / hor gtsang rgya zhar bcas kyis yul dpon chen po blo bzang tshe dbang(zocho7)la zhus par/ cha skam sgom grwa dang sgrub sde gong 'og nyams gso chog pa'i bka' lung 'byor/ da lta kha gya stod smad kyi blo ldan du mas sgom grwa 'di slar gso rgyu'i re ba bcang bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /kha gya stod dgon pa dge ldan bstan 'phel gling /kha gya stod dgon pa dge ldan bstan 'phel gling ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gtsos grong khyer(de snga bsang chu rdzong khongs)gyi kha gya stod ma zhang du chags/thog mar chags pa'i dus ni/ mkhyen gter bse gsum pa rin po che chen po hor gyi yul du phebs shul kha gya nang ma 'cham pa rkyen du gyur te stod smad gnyis su phyis/ stod ma'i grwa ba rnams re zhig tshogs gsum klad du 'tshogs shing bzhugs pa na/ 'jam mgon blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas pa'i gsung gnang ltar rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu 'brug 1892lor gser kha sprul sku blo bzang don grub kyis dbu mdzad/ spang ljongs me tog gis brgyan pa'i gnas bzang bal dkar zhes par dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi skar 'dzin byed skabs/ ko nyin zhal dkar kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ltar sa brtag bslang sbyong ba rnams phyag len — 202 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzhin bgyis te bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong gi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs/ the bo'i blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis 'du khang las khur bzhes te 'brug snying dang rdor gsum nas shing cha drangs te 'du khang chen po legs par bzhengs/ gser zangs las ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo'i ngo bo jo sku mthong ba don ldan gtsos kha bya'i sgar rnying nas spyan drangs pa'i byin rten du ma/ skyabs mchog bse gsum pa rin po ches smad sog nas gdan drangs pa'i li sku mang bo/ khyad par du dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling nas spos sna byas te spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas sku sha ma sogs gos chen las grub pa'i ston pa'i gos sku mthong grol chen mo/ dad gtong 'byor ldan du mas bzhengs pa'i bla mchod tshogs zhing dang / skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi rgyan thang dang zhal thang / paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma dang / skyabs rje bse lnga ba mchog nas phyag dam sbyar ba'i rten pa lha mo'i rten thang / gza' thang khyad par can/ mda' sgro'i snyan grags las bzhengs pa'i dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin sogs kyi thang sku sna tshogs/ kha gya'i spyi ba bsam gtan dang snyan grags gnyis nas sbyin bdag byas te bzhengs pa'i rgyal yum dbang gi lha mo rigs byed ma dang / dam can chos kyi rgyal bo'i snang brnyan gzi 'od 'bar ba/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung bya sgom tsam/ grub dbang smra ti'i phyag tsha/ rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu mnab/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur rgyal dbang lnga ba dang / rje skal ldan pa/ 'ju mi pham bcas pa'i gsung 'bum/bse lnga ba'i gdung rten mchod rten dang sku mnab dang phyag dril/ chos srung mgon po'i rdo sku byin can rang byon sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhugs shing / bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi mchod rdzas mang bo bstar/ rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa'i yig cha'i steng nas mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa phyogs brgyar spel ba'i khri la thog mar gser kha sprul ba'i sku blo bzang don grub/ tshogs gsum 'jigs med 'od zer/ ko nyid zhal dkar blo bzang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ kha gyar 'khrungs pa'i a khyung sgar ba'i sprul sku/ sgyis tshang blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ 'dul 'dzin pa gtsos rgya mtsho/ grwa tsha blo bzang snang gsal/ gser kha 'jigs med skal bzang rgyal mtshan/ a khyung sgar sprul skal bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ kha gya'i mkhan chung blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gtsos nu phrug blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ 'be blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ g.yus dkon mchog 'phrin las pa'i sprul sku/ byang rtse dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ tshogs gsum blo bzang rgyal mtshan/gtsos bla ma bstan 'dzin tshang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ grwa tsha blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ lo ba dkon mchog rgya mtsho bcas khri ba dang / rigs pa smra ba sog po'i chos grags khri tshab tu bzhugs te phyag rjes gcig las gcig che ngang nas mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan rgya cher spel/khyad par du dgon pa 'dir phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i snga phyi skyabs mchog bse rin po che'i bka' bzhin/gser kha rdo rje 'chang dang / bla ma tshogs gsum tshang / zhal dkar tshang bcas kyis 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis bka' drin skyong khur bzhes tshul gleng / sgos su grub dbang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho — 203 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dpal bzang bo/ kha gya tsho drug gi yul spyi dang / kha gya stod ma'i dgon sar dge ldan bstan 'phel gling /du phebs nas sgar grong thun mong la kun rig dang tshe dbang bstsal/ rim gro kha shas gsungs/ phyogs bcu'i sde bar mgon po'i sbyin sreg gnang / gnyan dang zhal dkar la bsang chog gsar rtsom mdzad/ kha gya dang mdzod dge'i gyod chen legs par 'dums/ skyabs mchog bse gsum pa rin po che'i rnam thar ljags rtsom ma/dzad/ bse bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i yang sprul gdan sar 'god rgyu sogs gsung bkod zhib rgyas bstsal/'jam mgon bse lnga ba rin po che'i bka' chos gsan bzhed kyi slad du gter lung dgon sogs su phebs te rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang / dzam dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs sgrol dkar phyag drug pa bcas kyi ljags lung gnang / mchog sprul rin po cher gsung gleng rgyun ring dang thos bsam/ slob gnyer gnang tshul so gas bsla ba bkod rgyas pa bstsal/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snang brnyan zhig gnang ste zhabs pad yun ring brtan pa dang / bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad dgos tshul bslab pa nan tan gnang tshul skyabs rje 'phrin las pa'i rnam thar bkra shis gser gyi 'khor lo thub bstan mdzes rgyan du gsungs/ de rjes su 'dren mchog bse lnga ba rje btsun blo bzang bkra shis rgya mtsho mchog dgon 'di la phyag phebs te zhabs tog bsnyen bkur tshad med pa bstabs/ gong sa 'phrin las pa'i gsung gnang bzhin lcags khyi lor kha gya'i sgar gas ra du rje lha khang rten brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ de rjes jag dmag gis dgon pa'i nor rdzas 'phrog bcom byas te grwa rgan grags pa bcas mi ser 'ga' bkrongs/ mchog gsum thugs rje las dgon pa la skyon cher ma byung / mkhyen gter bse lnga ba chen po'i gsung bzhin bdud 'dul mchod rten bzhengs pa'i gzungs gzhug tshad ldan dge bshes bstan pa tshang la 'bul du bcug zu bya192 2lor khri dpon nags nas shing cha drangs te byams khang bse gzim khang bskrun rgyu'i gzhi brtsams/ mda' sgro'i snyan grags kyis stobs bcu mnga' ba byams pa khyad mtshar can bzhengs pa sogs gser ljongs zhing gi gdan rabs rdzogs ldan gtam gyi rang sgra zhes par bsngags/ nye sras 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu la ser mo skye ba sogs kun gyis mthong 'di dus rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mdzod dge phyogs su phebs lam kha gya stod brgyud de mkhan sprul ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs gzhis gnas su phyag gsum btsal/ gam 'khor bas ci yin zhus par bdag gi bla ma'i 'khrungs gnas yin gsungs/ de nas kha gya'i dgon du thog mar phebs te bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig bsnyen rdzogs la bkod/ byams khang bzhengs skabs dong tse chon stong gnang tshul rje nyid kyi rnam thar du snang / da dung kha gya'i dgon sar chags pa'i gnas su gzigs te grwa ba lnga brgya shong ba'i gsung lung bstsal/ khyad par du bse lnga ba chen pos gang ci'i thugs khur bzhes te dgon 'di'i 'chad nyan bskyangs/dgon dbus kyi thar rgan lab rtse bstad de dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon gnang / gnyan zhal dkar sogs su gter mang du sbas pas 'dod dgu'i snod bcud la g.yang chags/ ma ṇi smyung gnas kyi rgyun mang du btsugs/ khri chen bse lnga ba rin po che 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs la kha gya'i dgon grong spyi nas rgya chen — 201 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bsgrubs/ me phag 1946lor 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog thog mar chibs bsgyur gnang / kha bya'i dgon grong bla grwa yongs nas bsu ba bsnyen bkur rgya cher ma dzad/mgon po gang gi zhabs pad ring du brtan pa'i rten 'brel la/ dgon grong spyi 'bul ba gya nom phul te chos 'brel zab mo zhus/ sa glang lor skyabs rje bse drug pa rin po che 'gro don sho ba khang thog phyogs su phebs lam kha gya'i 'brug khang lab rtse bsta da de lha rje sngo la g.yu rtse dgyes pa mtshan mar mngon/ da dung thar rgan 'a/ba rtse bstad de rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan btsugs/ de rjes lha ldan dbus su byon dus rdzong skyel dang / phyir phebs bsu ba rgya cher bstar/ khyad par du lung dang rigs pa'i bshad grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i thugs smon gnang ste/gzhung brgya smra ba'i rje blo gsal rgya mtsho mchog me sprel1956lor mtshan nyid kyi dge rgan du bskos so/ /spyo gros brtang bo'i rmad byung mthu dpal las/ /ngag la 'dwam pa'i dbyadas kyi byin chags pa/ / thuXb bstan yongs rdzogs smra ba'i dbang phyug che/ /lus can byā matwo'i mgon des dge legs stsol/ /zhes rje blo gsal pas bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol btab tshigs su bcad pa gsung ste/ bsdus grwa'i brtsi ba'ag thugs thog mar gnang 'ing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dbu brnyes so/ /rje 'di la rigs pa smra ba'i 'al slob sog pa'i chos grags dang zla ba / bsod nams sogs grags che ba mang du byung / me bya spyi lo1995lo/ dgon grong thun mong nas zhus ngor skyabs rje bla ma chos kyi rdo rje pas tshe dbang dang sbrags chos srid gang ci'i thad nas gsung lung gi bdud rtsi char ltar 'jo bar bstsal/'chad nyan chos spyod kyi rim pa la/ dpyid zla dang por cho 'phrul smon lam bla mchod smon lam gang mang /'cham gtor rgyag gos sku/ byams pa gling skor skabs su ser sbreng dang dmigs brtse ma rgyang 'then/ dpyid zla gnyis par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dag 'don chos thog yod/ gsum par dam bca' dang brtsi bzhag chag med/ sa zla'i dbyar chos skabs su kun rig dbang chen/ gsang 'jigs bde mchog bde chen stong bar ro mnyam ma sogs kyi cho ga 'ga' 'ig tshogs 'don gnang / bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i chos mtshams rnams su yang rgyan 'jug gsungs shing sku rim dang chos grwa tshugs te rtsod grwa chag med/ zla drug par thugs rje chen po'i 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgo nas ma ṇi chos thog byams khang du sgar grong yongs kyis ma ṇi sgar bsgrubs/bdun par rigs grwa'i shwa 'cham gdang dbyar gnas/ brgyad par ston chos/ dgu bar sa dkar chos thogabacu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ bcu gcig par dgun chos/ bcu gnyis par lo rnying sku rim te bstan pa spyi'i rim gro/ mgon chos lnga'i gtor chog lha mo'i tshe gtor/ bza' rgod rā hu la'i bskang 'phrin sogs tshugs/dgon pa'i khri ba gter lung sku zhogs nas bskos/ da dung dge bskos dang dbu mdzad/ spyi ba sku tshab/rgan pa bzhi bcas nas dgon grong gi chos srid khur bzhes gnang ngo /gtsug lag khang gi skor la mgon khang 'du khang chen mo/ byams khang / rje lha khang / ma ṇi dung phyur lha khang / chos ra/ mchod rten ma ṇi 'khor khang lnga bcu lhag bcas bzhengs pa dang / rung khang / bse — 205 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gzim khang nang chen/ gser kha tshang / grwa tsha tshang / a khyung sgar ba tshang / mkhan chen ngag dbang dge legs tshang / bla ma kirti tshang / kha gya'i mkhan chung tshang / bla ma tshogs gsum tshang bcas pa'i nang khag 'ga' dang / dge bshes bstan pa tshang dang dge rgan blo gsal tshang gi gzim khang / snga mar grwa ba brgya longs/ grwa shag drug cu rtsa grangs/ dgon 'di la kha gya smad dang tor tshang khyu mchog ces pa'i gnas su sa zhing / grwa ma phug tu dgon nags cung tsam zhig dang / dgon pa'i mdun nags/ gnas khang rdza lung gi rtswa thang sku zhogs bse tshang dang dgon pa la dbang / rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i snga phyir sku zhogs bse tshang dang kirti tshang gi su dug dgon pa bcas la rta nor brgyad brgya tsam yod ces gleng / 1958lo'i 'khrug zing rkyen byas te spyi sku tshab grwa rgan du ma btson du tshud/ dgon pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gtor/ sgar zog brgya phrag 'ga' dpal ldan dang skal bzang bcas la 'ded du bcug ste lan kru'u ru song / 'phro lus gser tog rgyal mtshan gos sku/ bla ma grwa tsha'i byin can tshe sku bcas1965lor shor/ 'di dus nang bstan las rigs kyi mi sna dag la dgag rgyag 'jigs snang snga na med pa zhig khel/ lcags bya1981lor chos sgo slar gso phye bar yab rje chos kyi rdo rje ba'i gsung gnang bzhin bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun pa slar 'tshogs te bla ma grwa tsha tshang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan khrir bzhugs shing dgon pa'i do dam gyi khri ba lhur bzhes/ phyi lor kun ba /zigs bcu ba gtsos phyogs su phebs lam kha gya stod smad nas lhan du chibs bsu ja thab steng nas lung 'ga' zhig zhus/ skyabs mchog bse bla mas kha gya stod smad kyi dgon grong mtha' dag 'bral med rjes su 'dzin rgyur zhus/ gya gsum lor rje lha khang grub pa'i dga' ston du 'dren mchog drug pa rin po che gdan zhus ltar phebs te rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo ma cig 'dod khams dbang mo bzang bdud ra hu la'i rten thang byin can lo rgyus can de nyid spyan drangs te bka' sgos gnyer du gtad/ sprul ba'i chos skyong chen po'i bskang 'phrin thugs dam rje rim pa sogs kyi gsung gi phebs sgo mang du bstsal/ chos skyong chen po dgyes pa'i rtags mtshan ngom/ da dung rdo rje blo gsal bas bzhengs pa'i rje sku dkar chag yod pa de nyid dang / dad ldan de tshos bzhengs pa'i chos ra'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ dgon pa'i zhol du chags pa'i sde ba dag gis bskyar gsar du bzhengs pa'i bdud 'dul mchod rten bcas la rab gnas bsdus pa'i sgos rten so sor dam ye sre ba'i byin rlabs mdzad/lo 'dir bla ma nyang tshang mkhan chen dge legs pa'i sprul sku/ 'gyang rgan tshang / gung ru tshang sogs dgon 'di la phebs te bla ma grwa tshang gtsos dgon pas bsnyen bkur zhus/ dgon pa'i par khang du skyabs 'gro dang /dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ sa lam sku gsum/ bla mchod/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sngon 'gro'i sbyor chos/rgyan 'jug gnyis sogs par shing brgya phrag 'ga' bzhugs su gsol/ rje blo gsal tshang dgon 'di'i khri la bzhugs te mdo sngags rig gnas gang thad nas 'chad nyan legs mdzad rmad du byung bas bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ smon lam dga' ldan ma/ bde mchog smon lam/ dge ldan lugs bzang rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs zhus pa ltar grwa tshang yongs la lung yang gnang / rje blo bzang dpal ldan — 206 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mchog lo 'dir dgon 'di'i smon la gdan zhus ltar phebs te rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang /byang sham+bha la'i smon lam sogs zhus pa dgyes bzhin lung gnang / phyogs bcu'i lung bas bse gzim khang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ bse rin po che 1995sa phag lor 'du khang bskyar bzhengs grub tu phebs shing 'du khang du mchod rdzas ka 'phen cha dang / byams pa'i gos sku bcas gnang / dgon grong gzhung nas nye sbam mtho ba btegs/ 'du khang nang rten ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo/ rgyal ba byams pa / thugs rje chen po/'jigs byed/ bse gnyis pa dang drug pa'i snang brnyan/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i sku brnyan rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gnyis dang bstan 'gyur sher phyin 'bum sogs bzhugs pa la skyabs rje nyid nas rab gnas mdzad de byin gyis ba rlabs/ khyad par du me glang lo'i zla bdun par dgon grong spyi nas zhus pa ltar bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje bas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang smin rgyas su ser skya stong phrag du mar bstsal/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshar spyi 'jog gnang / skabs der 'bul zog brgya dgon pa dang / kha gya'i slob grwar sgor lnga stong dang / zog bcu/ khams bsang gong mar lo tog ser bas bcom pa la 'bru rigs rgya ma khri gcig gnang / lug brgya tshe thar du btang ba sogs bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la phan pa sogs lung dang rigs pa'i dga' ston legs par spel to/ /deng skabs kha gya'i sgar sar dgon 'dir/ 'du khang dang / mgon khang / rje lha khang / chos ra/ ma ṇi dung phyur lha khang /dgon mthar ma ṇi 'khor khang mang bo/ rung khang / bdud 'dul mchod rten/ bse bla brang / grwa tsha tshang /ko kya tshang bcas pa'i nang khag rje blo gsal rgya mtsho tshang bcas pa'i gzim khang / da dung dgon pa'i par khang dang / sman khang / grwa shag bdun cu lhag phub/ da ltar grwa ba brgya longs tsam bzhugs so/ /mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung pas/ kha gya'i dge ldan bstan 'phel gling mchog tu/ /khrims gtsang ngur smrig gos kyis rab mdzes shing / /bshad sgrub nor bu'i bang mdzod rgyud gtams pa'i/ /dge 'dun dad pa'i zhing mchog 'phel gyur cig ces gsung lung mdzad/de yang 'dir grwa tsha sku phreng rim bzhin 'dren pa la/ sku phreng dang bo blo bzang ye shes ni kha gya'i khams bsang grwa tsha'i khyim du 'khrungs shing / gzhon dus rab tu byung nas dbus 'bras sgo mang grwa tshang nas thugs gnyer mthar phyin gnang ste lha rams pa'i skor mdzad tshul ngag rgyun khungs ma nyams par da lta'i grwa rgan rnams kyis gleng / dbus dang bkra shis 'khyil nas 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i drung nas chos bka' mang du gsan/de nas rang yul phyogs nas thugs dam la gzhol bzhin gshegs/ de la sprul sku grwa tsha blo bzang dpal 'dzin ni kun lho'i klu chu'i zam tsha nas yab ngag dbang mchog ldan dang yum bsam mo'i sras su sku bltams/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas grwa tsha'i yang srid du thag bcad de bkra shis 'khyil nas chos grwar zhugs/ mdo sngags da ske0bogatomakha4barmago 'bababarnye4ba sogayoyomadotshasa'i grabodusnangan —khakhyalig rartang3sa khri yang mdzad/ gzim khang brgyab/ dge sbyor la brtson bzhin dgon 'dir gshegs/ grwa tsha blo bzang ngag dbang — 207 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dbyangs ldan ni/ kha gya'i sman lung stod du yab rab rgyas dang yum lha mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ bse khri chen gsum pa blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas pas bla ma grwa tsha'i yang srid du thag bcad de kha gya'i sgar rnying du gdan sar bkod/ skyabs rje bse gsum pa dang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las pa'i zhabs pad bsten nas slob gnyer gnang / dgon pa'i khri yang mdzad/ kha gya nang ma 'chams pa'i rkyen dbang gis ya tsi'i mkhar du 'dzin bzung byas te gshegs/ sku gdung rin po che yang 'bad pa du mas spyan drangs te mchod rten bzhengs/grwa tsha sku 'phreng bzhi ba blo bzang snang gsal ni mdzod dge dme bo'i rong du sa sol zhes pa'i sde khrod du yab byams pa dang yum mkha' mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ mkhyen gter bse lnga ba blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtshos bla ma grwa tsha'i sprul skur thag bcad de/ dge ldan bstan 'phel gling du gdan sar bkod/ a dgu'i chos 'dzin sogs dge rgan du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs bslabs/ khri chen mchog dang kirti brgyad pa'i drung nas chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ dgon pa'i khri yang mdzad/ de nas rgya yul du phebs lam go gya ko'u nas gshegs tshul sogs grwa rgan dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang dpyod ldan khams bsang ban de mkhar nas sa bon 'tshol sdud byed pas zur brgyan bris/ grwa tsha sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1940lor grong brdal ka ju'i mkhar nas yab lbang yi zhin dang yum krang khron len gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu'i thog tu rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje pas lwang chen khro zhes pa'i khye'u de nyid bla ma grwa tsha'i yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang ste mtshan yang blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bstsal/ kha gya'i sngo khyug sog po'i bsam gtan bcas kyis khur len byas te chu 'brug1952lor dge ldan bstan 'phel gling du gdan sar bkod/ a khyung bkra shis rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten nas spyod rab gsal gyi skor bslabs/ khyad par du mkhas dbang rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i drung nas gzhung lugs la sbyangs 1958rjes su grwa ba grong khyim du phebs dgos byung yang 'dul khrims mig 'bras ltar srung pas dam pa'i dmigs rkyen la phan/ kha gya stod sman lung mdzod dge phyogs su dad ldan du mas gdan drangs pa ltar phebs te zhus pa'i 'dod chos bskangs/ chos sgo slar phye tshun dgon pa'i khri dang do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyi 'gan bzhes/ kha bya'i lte ba'i slob grwa'i mtshan 'dzin slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes te khul dang rdzong rim pa'i bya dga' dang gzengs bstod thengs mang thob/ gya dgu'i lor krung go bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob gling gi phar phyin ched sbyong tshan khag nas mthar phyin gzhung rgyugs phul/ rang dgon dang / 'khrungs gzhis ka ju'i mkhar nas gzim khang bra brang bzhengs/ sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhengs pa sogs phyag rjes che/ da lta khong gis kun lho khul gyi srid gros u yon dang / gtsos grong khyer gyi srid gros u yon gyi 'gan bzhes so/ /mkhan chen dge legs sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog ni/ yab mgon po dang yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su me sprel lor kha bya'i 'bo ra nas 'khrungs/ kun gzigs mchog gis mkhan sprul dge — 208 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/legs pa'i yang sprul ngos 'dzin gnang / bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs te thugs gnyer mthar phyin mdzad/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri rabs nga gcig pa bzhugs pa de nyid yul 'di nas 'khrungs pa ma zad/ kha gya'i mkhan chung tshang yab snying byams dang / yum pad lo'i sras su kha gya'i o brtan nas 'khrungs shing mkhyen gter bse lnga ba mchog gis rgya bo'i mkhan po tshang gi yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ a dge'i chos 'dzin sogs dge rgan du bsten nas slob gnyer mthar phyin gnang / dgon 'di'i khri yang mdzad/bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing sogs bzhengs/ dgung lo brgyad cu lhag la bzhugs mthar gshegs/ gdung rten mchod rten bcas bzhengs so/ /'gyang ro chung ba sku phreng gong ma kha bya'i bla ma dkar po/ sgang kha sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ mkhan chen ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ a khyung sgar ba'i sprul sku/ bla ma tshogs gsum sku phreng rim byon/ kha gya'i mkhan chung blo bzang rgya mtsho/ ko kya bla ma blo bzang smon lam/ to mā kya bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs bsod nams dpal du 'khrungs pa'i phyag yul/ gzhan yang rab 'byams gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i dge bshes bsta na pa tshang / rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ a dga'i chos 'dzin/ a khyung bkra shis rgya mtsho/ chos grags bsod nams zla ba sogs bsngags 'os pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan ldan mang du byung ngo /gzhan yang dgon 'di'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa byang shar phyogs su ri khrod 'od gsal 'phel rgyas gling / spen steng sgar phan bde legs bshad gling / lho shar phyogs su tshogs gsum klad/ nub byang phyogs su stag lung ri khrod bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling bcas chags pa ma zad/ bu dgon la dga' ldan chos mchog nor bu'i gling zhes pa de nyid khyab bdag bse bla ma'i bka' gnang ltar rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me bya1992lor sog dge blo bzang la 'debs su bcug 'du khang nang rten rje yab sras sogs bzhengs shing /bdud 'dul mchod rten zhig kyang bzhengs/ grwa ba sum cu lhag gis sgar sar dgon pa'i zla ba dge rgan du bsten/ sog dge blo bzang nas grwa ba 'di dag khrid de 1998lo'i chos 'khor dus chen nyin rong bo'i dgon chen nas skyabs rje chos kyi rdo rje ba'i drung nas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed mchod pa mnos/ rim pa gong gi chog mchan thob pa ltar mtsho sngon du chags shing ka ring dgon pa yang 'bod/ da dung sog dge bas kha gya'i sgar sar 'du khang gser tshon 'bul ba'i mthun rkyen gang dgos sbyar ro/ /to ma kya dga' ldan bstan 'phel gling dang / spen le dgon dga' ldan chos gling bcas da skabs dgon sar gyi le lag gi tshul du gnas so/ /stag lung ri khrod bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling /stag lung ri khrod bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin pa dang / de snga kun lho khul(da lta gtsos grong khyer gyi khongs) gyi kha gya stod ma zhang stag lung nang du chags/— 209 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ri khrod 'di ni ha lam rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mjug tsam zhig tu/ tsa lus a lags bka' bcu 'phrin las rab brtan mchog gis btab/ rje nyid nas dbu bskul te kha gya'i 'bo ra'i sde dmangs sbyin bdag byas te 'du khang rten brten pa bzhengs/ sde 'di 'debs pa bo rang nyid nas gnas 'di dang a dzi/ tsa lus zhal dro ri khrod/ gzhi dge sogs nas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsug sa/ gsang 'jigs/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ ma hā ma ya/ yi dam chos srung du mar ljags bsnyen sogs thugs nyams su bzhes/kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten cing 'phrin las shin tu rgyas/ khyad par du 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i sku phreng snga phyi gnas 'dir yang yang phebs te gzigs skyong gnang / gzhan yang rin po che tshang dang / gnas rgan tshang zer ba yun ring bzhugs/ gnyis ka 'phur nus skad/ gdung bzhus pa'i sar shug sdong re skyes pa ya mtshan du gleng / lnga ba chen po'i phyag dril dang / gsol dkar/ dgon gsham byang chub mchod rten gyi nang du la kha grub chen gyi tshems kyang bzhugs zhes a mdo chos 'byung du gsungs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu khyi192 2lor bse sku phreng lnga ba'i bka' bzhin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bzhag sdom bstan pa rgya mtsho'am kha gya'i a khu tshang gnas 'di ru yun ring bzhugs shing gzhan don kho na mdzad pas bstan 'gro'i dmigs rkyen la phan pa chen po ldan/ mkhas dbang de nyid lcags 'brug1886lor mdzod dge bzhag sdom nas 'khrungs shing / khang sar bshad sgrub nor bu'i gling nas rab tu byung ste 'jam mgon bse blo bzang bkra shis rigs kyi cod pan tu bkur/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs/ bka' pota lnga dang rig pa'i gnas sogs thugs gnyer yongs su rdzogs/ ri khrod 'dir phebs te thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la gzhol/ 'du khang nyams gso dang nang rten thugs rje chen po spyan stong mnga' ba'i sku brnyan/bsten pa mgon po phyag drug pa'i snang brnyan/ byang chub mchod rten bcas gsar du bzhengs/ kha gya'i sgar sar dang ri khrod 'di ru gzim khang bskrun/ dgon ri khrod gnyis su 'chad nyan mdzad/ sgar sar byams khang gi nye sras brgyad bzhengs/ kha gya tsho drug gi phyogs su mchod rten che chung nyi shu lhag gi thig rtsa bzhengs/'dod chung chog shes dang zhi dul gyi spyod lam legs pas kun gyis gtsug tu bkur/ chos rje bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan pa'i sgra gzhung dge rgan mdzad/ 1955lor bla brang a lags gling tshang dang thugs yid gcig tu 'brel te kha gya stod 'bo ra'i khog tu chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar gyi srol btod/ zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung ljags rtsom mdzad de deng seng mdo smad kun lho'i phyogs kun tu bed spyod byed pa de nyid yin/ skye bo kun la sman sbyin dang bstan 'gro kun la bka' drin che ba'i legs nyes blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i mig dper gyur te lcags glang1961lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i bco lnga nyin kha bya'i dgon gsar du gshegs gdung rten mchod rten kyang bzhengs so/ /gzhan yang ri khrod 'dir gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ma nyams pa'i thog sa ga zla bar ri khrod pa rnams kyis smyung gnas phyogs brgyad/ zla brgyad pa sa dkar chos thog dgu ba bde mchog sgrub mchod/ bcu — 210 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ba'i lnga mchod/ myur mdzad phyag drug pa'i gtor 'bul sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa 'ga' zhig mchis/ snga sor 'du khang / mgon khang / rung khang / tsa yus a lags dang kha gya a khu'i gzim khang / grwa shag 'ga' yod cing / ri khrod 'dir bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rgyun bzhugs grwa ba brgyad bzhugs/1958lo dang rig gsar gyi chom pos 'du khang sogs rten dang brten pa thams cad rmeg med du bcom/1kha8 2lor stag lung ri khrod bas ma gtan gling gi byang chub mchod rten bskyar du bzhengs/ mkhas dbang rje blo gsal rgya mtsho tshang gdan zhus ltar phebs te gzungs gzhug tshad ldan bsgrubs/ bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog ri khrod 'dir dngos su phebs te mchod rten la rab gnas mdzad pa dang / mtshan la stag lung ri khrod bsam gtan gling zhes bstsal/ yul 'di'i lcags byams dang / dpal ldan/ rdor te sngo 'khyil tshe rgan sogs dad ldan dag gis sgom khang zhig gnas 'di nas bskrun/ bla brang kyai rdor ba yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po sa yu bsam 'grub rgya mtsho tshang kha gya'i slob dpon klu rdor nas gdan drangs te mgon po'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs te rtags mtshan khyad par can byung / dus bzang rnams su rnga dang rol mo'i sgra snyan pa sna tshogs thos zer mkhan mang / deng dus a khu bstan pa tshang gi dngos slob ba'ag sdom sman pa bstan go tshang sogs ri khrod 'dir 'byon bzhin mchis/ ri khrod 'dis mchod gzhis gtso bo 'bo ra'i dud kha lnga bcu/ ri rgyal o brtan/ 'brug chu sngo 'khyil lcags dar sgar rgyud bcas mi khyim chig stong lhag tsam mchis so /spen steng sgar phan bde legs bshad gling /phyogs bcu'i spen steng sgar phan bde legs bshad gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho'i(da lta gtsos grong khyer khongs) kha gya stod ma zhang gi mnga' khongs su chags/sde 'di phyogs skyong chen po srid pa'i gnyan rje sngo la g.yu rtse'i lha zhol du btab yod la/ rmang gzhi ni 'jam mgon bla ma rje 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa'i bka' gnang bzhin dngul ra chos rje zhes pa byon te khra sig ri khrod thog mar btab/ yi dam bde mchog la brten nas sgrub par gzhol/ rjes su bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas pa'i thugs zin slob ma kun spangs pa lam mgyogs tshang gis ri khrod rgya bskyed bzhengs te sgrub pa yun ring mdzad/ zhabs dkar ba rig 'dzin rgya mtshos kha gya'i zhal dkar lab rtse bstad cing ri khrod du sgrub pa nyams len mdzad/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog kha gya'i sgar gsar dge ldan bstan 'phel gling brgyud de phyogs bcu'i sde bar mgon po'i sbyin sreg blugs/ de dus rgya tshang ri khrod pas 'di bar rje gsung 'bum phul pa dgyes nyams che bar mdzad/ gnyan chen la bsang chen btang / lcags yos1891lor gnyan chen gyi gtor chog sogs brtsams shing kyai gsang bdag pad+ma'i bka' nyan stobs kyi bdag po sa brgyad sems dpa'i las byed sprul ba'i blon snang srid kha lo bsgyur ba'i drag rtsal can mthu ldan gnyan gyi rgyal bo 'khor bcas mchod/— 211 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhes gsungs shing ma tshe'u rna ba can la gter phul gnyan gyi gnas ri'i phyogs nas sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrugs te 'ongs pa la bzhugs sgar la skor ba byas te lha gnyan chen po dgyes pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ lha chos sgrub par drang srong dgyes pa'i bsti gnas zhes bsngags/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug1928lor phyogs bcu'i rgya sgom pa yag gtsos dad ldan mang bo'i re 'dod ltar/ khri chen bse lnga ba blo bzang bkra shis rgya mtsho mchog gis khra sig ri khrod sogs bsdus te spen steng sgar phyag 'debs mdzad/ phyogs bcu'i sde 'bangs nas 'du khang sogs bzhengs/ nang rten 'phags chen spyan stong mnga' ba'i sku brnyan dang / khye'u dgon sgom grwa nas gdan drangs pa'i rten gsum byin can 'ga' dang / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/dung phyur ma ṇi'i 'khor lo sogs lha rten chos gsum du ma bzhugs/ bse nyid kyi bka' drin la brten nas cho ga chos spyod kyi phyag len 'ga' dang / sa ga zla bar ser skya mnyam tshogs kyi smyung gnas phyogs brgyad kyi rgyun spel du bcug spen steng sgar du yab rje bse bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang / 'dul 'dzin pa chen po kha gya'i bstan pa tshang / rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs sgar 'di nas bzhugs gnang mdzad/ 1958lo'i rjes su rkyen dbang gis sgar ba'i rten gsum sogs bsnubs so/ /chu phag198 2lor skyabs rje bse bla ma blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog phyogs bcu'i klu 'bum rgyal dang tshe ring nor bu gtsos sde spyi nas gdan drangs te yul dus bstun pa'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar yangs bor phye/ skyabs 'gro/ rigs gsum mgon po/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma bcas kyi bzlas lung bstsal / srid pa'i gnyan rje la lha bsang rgyas pa gnang / dgon pa'i mtshan 'di gsar du 'dogs gnang mdzad/ 'du khang bskyar bzhengs dang nang rten spyan ras gzigs stong sku brnyan/ paṇa chen bcu ba dang / rje bse drug pa sogs kyi snang brnyan bcas sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan sogs glegs bam du ma bzhugs/ da skabs to ma sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho smyung gnas bla mar bskos zhing / zla bzhi ba dang dgu bar sgar nas phyogs bcu'i mi khyim brgya tsam pas ma ṇi smyung gnas kyi rgyun slar gso byas so/ /chogs gsum ri khrod bde chen 'od gsal gling /tshogs gsum ri khrod bde chen 'od gsal gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs/) kha gya stod zhang gi kha gya'i sgar rnying dge ldan bstan 'phel gling gi lho ri'i ngos su chags/tshogs gsum mtshams pa ba 'jigs med 'od zer gyis sgrub khang thog mar bskrun cing mtshams bsnyen sgrub mdzad de dus 'da' ba dang / skabs shig tshogs gsum smyung gnas pa'ang 'dir phebs 'byor/ der bstun gser kha rdo rje 'chang blo bzang don grub bcas lhan rgyas tshogs gsum rol pas tshogs gsum klad ces pa'i ming thogs/ rab tshes me glang lor kha gya sgar stod smad du gyes skabs tshogs gsum rin po ches stod ma'i — 212 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/grwa mang gnas 'dir gdan drangs te re'u tse mang po phub/ rab tshes chu 'brug (spyi lo1892)la chu nag dpon pos sa phul cing sbyin bdag bgyis par brten rje gser kha bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul blo bzang don grub pas ri khrod dngos phyag 'debs mdzad de sde 'di'i tshogs gur gyi shul du gser kha'i gzim khang rgya mi chung ba gsar du bskrun cing rim byon dag gis bskyangs/ nang rten la'ang ston pa gtso 'khor/ spyan ras gzigs sogs mang bo dang / srung ma mgon po k+ṣi ṭa rdo brkos byin can bzhugs/ dgon gsham du byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ mtshams pa bas kyang ri khrod 'di nyid la snga rting du mthun rkyen dang skyong khur legs par mdzad do/ /de nas gser kha rdo rje 'chang gis chu nag dpon po dang lcags lder dpon po gtsor byas pa'i chu nag rong 'brog sgang gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/ sgang stod sde ba brgyad la dgu ba'i nyer gnyis kyi smyung gnas cho ga dang / lnga ba'i smyong gnas phyogs brgyad kyi rgyun btsugs pa da lta'ang de bzhin du sgrub kyin 'dug skabs der sde ba brgyad kyis gser kha'i nang chen gyi nye 'gram du lha khang zhig bzhengs te/ gshong mo che'i pha bong dum bu gsum du byas pa'i ngos re la ston pa'i sku dang / spyan ras gzigs/ mgon po bcas kyi sku brnyan byis pa lo tshod brgyad tsam gyi rang byon mched gsum du grags pa brkos/ thub pa'i sku brnyan de kha gya'i sgar sar du bdud 'dul mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhug tu phul/ cig shos lha khang de'i rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa tshogs gsum mgon po zhes grags pa'i sku byin can dang / thugs rje chen po'i sku brnyan sogs rten mang du bzhugs/ri khrod du 'du khang lha khang nang chen spyi khang grwa shag bcas 'dzoms pas nang dgon 'ig gi rnam par grub/tshogs gsum mtshams pa ba 'jigs med 'od zer/ rab 'dod shing khyi(spyi lo1814)la chu nag rong ba ste da lta'i bsang chu rdzong mdzod dge rte'u phur du sku 'khrungs/ khong gzhon dus su zhing la phru slog byed tshe 'bu mang po bsad pa gzigs pas thugs la nges 'byung drag po 'khrungs te rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/gsar rnying gi bla ma du mar bsten rjes tshogs gsum klad la phebs te/ sgrub khang brgyab mtshams bsnyen sgrub kyis myong ba thon thon du 'bad pas/ tshogs gsum mtshams pa ba zhes grags/ dgung lo nga lnga ba sa 'brug(spyi lo1868)la gtsos dge ldan chos gling gi khri mdzad/ dgung lo re ba'i ba me gling spyi lo1877la kha rgya'i sgar sar gsar 'debs kyi snga gzhug tu nyams bzhes thugs khur gnang / dgung lo don gcig par brag dmar dpal gyi yang rdzong (kha gya'i gnas khang )du sgrub khang gsar du brgyab cing / gter ston sku rgan yab yum gnas 'dir gdan drangs te ras dkar po yug gcig dang sgrub khang gsar ba bcas phul te gtan du bzhugs su bcug dgu lo bdun cu don dgu ba chu 'brug (spyi lo1892)la bal gur ris cha la gur sgar spar te/ 'du khang gsar bzhengs la sbyor 'jags gnang zhing / dgung lo gya gsum 'tsho bzhes kyi bar du khri khur bzhes te/ sgrig lam kun spyod dang chos 'chad nyan la phan gang mang mdzad/ rab tshes me sprel zla bzhi ba'i gnam gang nyi shar du ri khrod nyid du gshegs so/ gdung rten byang chub mchod rten gzungs gzhug rab — 213 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gnas dang bcas pa gtwer ston sku rgan gyis bsgrubs/ bu slob gter ston sku rgan rin po che dang / gtsos sdugasakhamadzokodasakhog/ ༄ ngawas rdo — thosama'isa'ib/nyipo'onga'irang chemi me bya(spyi lo1897)la yab klu 'bum dang yum bu chog gi sras su kha gyar sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par gter ston sku rgan rin po che'i drung du klong chen snying thig gi dbang lung rdzogs par gsan/ dgung lo bcu bar 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi dbang rjes gnang dang / rdzogs chen bla ma'i sbyang khrid nyams len sogs 'chad nyan gsan sbyong mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu tsam na zhi bar gshegs so/ /tshogs gsum sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan ni/ rab rgyal sa lug(1919)la yab a khyung bzod pa rgyal mtshan dang yum sangs rgyas 'tsho'i (mdzod dge dpon mgon po tshe brtan gyi sku sring)sras su kha gya'i rdza lung du sku 'khrungs/ bse khri chen lnga ba bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtshos sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ dge ldan bstan 'phel gling nas rab tu byung ste tshogs zhugs gnang / dge slong a dgu yongs 'dzin du bsten nas chos spyod kyi rim pa dang / mdo sngags rig gnas bcas la thugs gnyer mi dman pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa chu sprel(spyi lo195 2)la kha gya'i sgar sar dge ldan bstan 'phel gling gi khri dang / 'di ga'i nang chen gyi gzim khang yang gsar du bzhengs/ mthar dgung lo sum cu ba sa khyi(spyi lo1kha58)lor gtsos gser khri'i nang chen du btson 'jug skabs su sku gshegs so/ /rab rgyal sa khyi(spyi lo1958)la dus dbang gis rten dang brten pa 'jig rab rgyal lcags bya spyi lo(1981)la bse khri chen drug pa bse blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje rin po che'i bka' gsung ltar sgang stod sde ba brgyad kyis khur du blangs te byang chub mchod rten bskyar du bzhengs shing kha bya'i sgar sar nas dge bshes gdan drangs te rab gnas mdzad/ smyung gnas kyi cho ga sngar ltar btsugs so/ /gnas khang rnying ma'i ri khrod 'od gsal 'phel rgyas gling /kha gya'i gnas khang ri khrod brag dmar dpal gyi rnying ma'i g.yang rdzong 'od gsal 'phel rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ yin lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) kha gya stod ma zhang gi khongs su gtogs pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgrub grwa zhig yin/gnas 'di spang ri brag dmar gyi rtse 'dzin ngo mtshar can la o rgyan gnas khang dang / rta mgrin gnas khang / sgrol ma'i gnas khang bcas phug pa shin tu zab pa gsum dang / brag ngos bla ma bcas lhun gyis grub cing rnam pa yid du 'ong ba'i rdza dngos su rgya gar gyi pha dam pa dang ma cig lab sgron/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho rnams kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog tu grub/dben gnas dam pa der rab tshes shing sbrel(18〈4)lor tshogs gsum mtshams pa ba 'jigs med — 214 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'od zer mchog gis yul dpon la sa bslangs te o rgyan gnas mdun du sgrub khang thog mar brgyab/ rje rang nyid rten 'brel 'grig pa'i phyir bdun mtshams su bzhugs/ mtshams grol phyin gtsos sras mkhar dgu thog bzhengs pa bo rje btsun chos dbyangs dang / gnas sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms sam gter ston sku rgan rin po che yab yum gnyis bcas sgrub gnas 'dir gdan drangs nas dpon slob thun mong nas sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang dang / thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi dbang sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bstsal pa la/ kha gya'i yul dpon/ skya ser/ gtsos/ mdzod dge re skong / hor tshang sogs mjal ba stong phrag du ma 'dus pa'i dbang gral du tshogs gsum rin po ches lha dar yug gcig bcas sgrub khang gsar ba nyid gter ston mchog la dngos su phul/ khong nyid kyang gnas rir gdan du bzhugs pa'i zhal lung brda bkrol gang rgyas mdzad gshis gter ston sku rabs rim byon gyi gdan sar gyur/ lcags stag(1890)la brag dmar dpal rdzong gi gnas ri'i mgul du ka ba bcu gnyis can gyi sa'i rgya khyon thig gis gzhal te gtsug lag khang gsar skrun gyi sbyor ba brtsams/ rdo shing tshon rtsi dag gi bzo bo rang snyom rnams kyis dang len bgyis te bgegs chad med par grub/ nang rten ni las smon mthun pa'i khra tshang gi ri khrod pa chos sgrogs rgya mtsho'i sku tsher ci 'byor gyis bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan rnams rten 'brel gyis bkrams so/ /lcags byi(190 0)la bris 'bur mkhas chen lha ris pa gu ru skyabs kyis nang rten bzhengs skabs su/skyabs mgon kirti blo bzang 'phrin las rin po che 'di phyogs su phebs pa gdan drangs/ o rgyan pad+ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'jigs lung dang / tshe 'gugs g.yang 'bod/ mjal mi'i tshogs la pho lung bcas bstsal/ lha khang rten gtso thub dbang gnas bcu'i skya ris grub pa la rab tu gnas pa'i me tog gtor ba sogs mdzad/dbus kyi gtso thang la sangs rab bdun ma dang / thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug g.yas gral du tshe dpag med dang 'od dpag med yab yum/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma gtsos rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs/ g.yon gral du rje btsun byams pa dang nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zhing bkod/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ rje dge 'dun grub/ mgon po rnam sras chos rgyal bcas skyes bu gsum gyi bka' sdod sogs/ g.yas dngos kyi dang bo rigs 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba'i 'khrungs rabs yongs rdzogs/ thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi lha tshogs/ mkhan
