slob chos gsum/ dpal chen phyag rgya rgyas pa gtsos khrag 'thung rigs bzhi/ bla med/ rig 'dzin/ dregs pa/stobs ldan bcas sgrub sde brgyad/ bla ma drag po'i rta khyung 'bar ba/ rta mgrin 'dus pa rnams/ mkha' 'gro sde chen rgyal mo gtsos zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ mkha' 'gro drag mo seng ge gdong can ma phra men drug dang bcas pa/ g.yon dngos su rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang / thub pa'i dbang bo/ grub chen te lo ba/ paṇa chen na ro ba/ mar ba/ mi la/ chos rgyal zla bzang / rigs ldan pad dkar bcas rgyud pa dang / dus 'khor dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor lugs kyi rdo — 215 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rje sems dpa'/ dpal kyai ba rdo rje thob pa can/ gur gyi mgon po dang bram gzugs/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i 'ing bkod lhun rdzogs/ rgyal ba'i yum chen mo/ gdugs dkar/ sgrol ma/ sngags gsang ka tsa dri/ mgon po ma ning / legs ldan/ gza' bdud ra hu la / gter srung badz+raju/ tshe ring mched lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ gnod sbyin tsi dmar/ dur khrod lha mo ngan rnam bcas gser tshon gyi bkrag mdangs/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams sgeg bcas bkod legs phun sum tshogs pa bzhugs/ ga'an yang sra sa pad+ma theg mchog rang grol gyis gu ru pad+ma sam bha'i 'bag dang / rdzogs chen bla ma'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten la rin po che sna tshogs kyis phra btab pa sogs bzhugs pa la/ gter ston yab sra sa 'dus pa kha shas bcas rten gsum la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo ba'i dgongs don lta ra mdzad do/ /chu 'brug(1892)la mchod khang gsar du bskrun pa'i rten gtso la o rgyan chen po'i snang brnyan bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa zhig bzhengs grub pa la/ gzungs gzhugs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'phel gdung dang / o rgyan pad+ma'i zab ber/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi na bza'/ gsang sngags gsar rnying dang grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa'am gter ston pa rim byon gyi na bza' dang dbu skra/ rang bsrel rigs ba'i dang sman sgrub phon che ba ma zad/ gnas de'i sa rdo bslogs pa'i khrod nas glang chen gyi sog pa'i tshal bu gnyis dang / lder bzo'i gi wang gnyis thob pa byin rten rnams dang / 'dra 'bag ldeb bris la sogs pa'i sku brnyan shin tu mang po bzhugs su gsol/ skabs der gter ston khong nyid kyis dpal chos rdzong gi bca' yig ltar gzhi gsum gyi nyams len dang / sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i phyag srol mtha' dag legs par btsugs /glang chen snying thig dang rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor thams cad rdzogs chen o rgyan bsam gtan gling gi phyag len lta bur spel to/ /gter ston sku rgan rin po che zhes pa'i gsang sngags kyi skyes bu chen po de nyid ni/ re skong dkyil 'khor sha dge rgan tshang ru 'og ma'i ris sa skya dang / nang so'i gdung 'dzin yab mkha' 'bum rgyal dang yum mkha' mo lha'i sras su chu 'brug(1ra 2 2)lor sku 'khrungs / ma'i mnga' du gnas skabs be+e ru grub chen tshang zhus par khong gis sgrol ma'i nyin thang zhig bzhengs nas mas phyag mchod la brtson na khye'u go chod cig 'byung srid/ming la 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang grwa sar bzhag na legs zhes lung bstan/ dgung lo bdun par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi sde khri gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma'i (1779—1〈62)drung du rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ a khu nor bu las 'bri klog chos spyod la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu bar gtsos bla ma khe thal gyi yang srid du thugs thag bcad de gtsos dge ldan chos gling gi gdan sar bkod/ khri chen blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge / bse khri chen blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas/ khu shing rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos 'phel/ dung phrug blo bzang 'jam dbyangs seṅge sogs mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mkhan du mar bsten nas mkhas mchog tu nar son/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo — 216 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nyer lnga bzhes thog lha bla ma'i mo lung la khag bka' te rmi lam dang yid snang gang dran gyi zog tshig byung rgyal du smras pas dbyar mar bsod dang / ston 'bru bsod dag long med brel 'tshub kyi 'du 'dzis g.yeng bar thugs sun stabs/ gshin gson gyi dkor rdzas bag med du longs su spyod pa spangs nas re zhig mdo sngags kyi slob gnyer la rem / de nas yang bla ma'i bka' ba'in gos lham gzan dkar sogs gyon/ phur bu dang rkang dung sked par gzar/ ṭā ra phrag par bkal/ kha ṭ+wāṃ lag tu thogs te rdzogs chen o rgyan bsam gtan gling du phebs/ de ga'i mkhan rin po che pad+ma theg mchog rol ba'i rdo rje las lo ngo drug gi yun du rdzogs chen ga'i lam 'bras bu'i dbang lung man ngag phyag len bcas par thugs gnyer dpyis phyin par mdzad/ mtshan yang rdo rje bdud 'joms rol pa zhes thogs/ bla ma sangs rgyas tshe ring la rlung sbyor 'phrul 'khor gyi phyag bzhes thams cad rgyas par bslabs/ de nas rdo grub sogs bla ma du mar bsten te dben gnas dag tu sgrub pa nyams len 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig thog slar rang yul du phebs te re skong gur tshang ri khrod dang kha gya'i gnas khang ri khrod gnyis btab/ gnas khang ri khrod 'di gdan sa'i ma thil mdzad cing tshe dang sgrub pa snyom par gzho' / dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi bzhes mthar zhi bar gshegs/ gsung rtsom dpe sna mang zhing bu slob skyes chen du ma byon no/ /sla ra yang o rgyan 'jigs med ces pa mchog gis rdzogs chen dgon nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos mang du gsan cing gdan sa ri khrod 'dir rdzogs pa chen po'i phyag len gyi cho ga thams cad btsugs/ zla rer tshes bcu la bsam pa lhun grub ma dang nyer gsum la mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ nyer lngar rig 'dzin tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum chung bkrams/ zla gnyis pa nas gsum pa'i nang stong mchod dang gling chen snying thig zla bzhi bar zhi khro/zla lnga ba drug par rdzogs chen snying thig sngon 'gro'i khrid sogs/ grol byed kyi dbang / de nas zla gsum ring bla ma gong ma dag gi gdung mchod dang rtsa rlung thig gsum ri khrod rang dang hor gtsang dang chos rdzong gi rig 'dzin pas sbyangs/ yang ri khrod du spyi khang dang bla ma'i gzim khang / nye 'dabs su myang 'das mchon rten chung ba bcas bzhengs/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs sogs kyi dpar shing brkos/ 1958lo'i rjes su chag 'jig thebs shing o rgyan 'jigs med btson du sku 'das so/ /da skabs bse rdo rje chang gis bskul pa dang len sgos o rgyan 'jigs med pa'i bu tshe dbang 'jigs med dang gnas khang sgrol ma gnyi gas 'du khang chung ba gsar du bzhengs shing nang rten mtsho skyes rdo rje/ gnyan zhal dkar ba/ gter ston sku rgan rin po che sku gong ma dag gi dbu thod la sogs bzhugs so/ /rkang tsha dgon dga' ldan bsam grub gling /rkang tsha dgon dga' ldan bsam grub gling zhes pa kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs dme bo zhang du chags/— 217 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/sgrub sde 'di ngag rgyun ltar na/ rma pha ri'i bya khyung dgon pa dang rma tshur ri'i rkang tsha dgon pa gnyis ka ni mdo smad phyogs kyi ches snga ba'i dge lugs chos sde yin par gleng / de bzhin mdo smad chos 'byung deb thar rgya mtsho dang lam rim bla brgyud kyi rnam thar du/ rkang tsha'i dgon dga' ldan bsam grub gling phyag 'debs pa bo ni/ paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang chos rgyan(1567 162 2)gyi bu slob ri khyod pa zhig gi sras kyi thu bo drung ba rgyal tshab pa'i slob mas btab ste 'du khang bzhengs zhes dang / yang dgon pa 'dir klu 'jim gyi rje'i sku brnyan bkra shis do kha ma sogs rten 'gangs chen du ma gdan 'dren mkhan du mdo smad chos 'byung nas bshad pa'i tog ra rgya bo ni/ dga' ldan khri chen nyer bzhi ba chos rje byams pa rgya mtsho'am khri mngon dga' ba byams pa rgya mtsho'i phyag mdzod yin/ khri mngon dga' ba ni rab byung bcu ba'i shing phag nas lcags sprul(1565 1581)lor khrir bzhugs pa dag la gzhigs na/ dgon pa 'di btab pa'i lo chigs ni rab byung bcu ba'i smad dang bcu gcig pa'i stod yin par mngon/ rkang tsha ba yang bod rus chen bzhi'i ldong gi rigs las tsha chen bco brgyad gyes par bshad pa'i rgyud du nges pa zhar du byung / dbon dka' bcu ba bsod nams kun dga' la rkyang shul dpon pos sgar mgo phul pa ltar na dgon 'debs dus gnang / phyis kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa/ rab 'byams grags pa rgya mtsho'i khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa nas khri ba blang brang gis gtong / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len bcas yar ldan du gnas par khri ba/ gnas brtan/ dge bskos/dbu mdzad/ spyi ba gnyis/ rgan pa gsum bcas kyi dam thon bgyis/ snang lugs sman rgan dang sman pa skya shog sogs sman gzhung la mkhas pa grags can byon/ mdzod dge dge legs rin po che ni kun mkhyen thar 'dod rgya mtsho'i bla mar bzhugs/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsung bkod gnang ba ltar chos skyong rgya mtshos sbyin bdag bgyis te byams khang zhig gso byas/ dgon pa'i ltag g.yas steng du tsha kho smyung gnas pa dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten sum brtsegs can gyi steng du brag sgom pa bstan pa rgya mtshos gsung bkod gnang ste gdugs dkar lha khang bzhengs par grags/ bla brang gi nang khag dang / dbal mang dang / yongs 'dzin tshang / brag sgom pa/ snang lugs bcas kyi lha khang gnyis dang nang khag lnga dang tshoms chen gcig mchis so/ /chos sde 'dir yang sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs can bzhugs tshul/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis 'du khang rtsig pa gsar du bskrun pa'i rten gtsor klu 'jim gyis bzos pa'i rje'i sku brnyan bkra shis do kha ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pas glang chen skyes pa blangs pa'i glang chen de'i sog pa g.yas pa bde mchog rang byon can/ li yul nas gdan drangs pa thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso ma/ snang lugs gzim khang du tog ra rgya bo khong gis gdan drangs pa'i rten thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum pa/ byams 'jam dbyangs/ rje rin po che/ jo bo rje/ rgyal ba seṅge nga ro/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ sku zhabs 'khrungs rabs bla ma mchog gsum ma cha tshang sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rje 'jigs med dbang — 218 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bo dang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje rin po che byin can/ tsha kho smyung gnas pa dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas gnang ba'i rgyal ba tshe dpag med/phyag mdzod bde gshegs tshang gi dbon po sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i tsan dan jo bo dang ba so'i ston pa byin can/ lam rim bla brgyud byams khang du rgyal ba byams pa thog tshad dang nye sras brgyad/rta mgrin rang byon/ gdugs dkar lha khang du gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad/ legs ldan mched gsum/ bde gshegs bcu/ lha mo nyer gnyis/ lab sgron sde lnga/ khros nag lha lnga/ seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum sogs sku brnyan du ma dang bzo bkod rmad du byung ba'i bris sku brgya phrag 'bur sku che chung mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dngul bris ma gcig co ne bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/bstan 'gyur gcig 'bum pa tshar bzhi/ rje yab sras dang rgyal ba paṇa chen kun mkhyen sogs kyi gsung 'bum sogs pota sum stong lhag thugs kyi rten la/ kho tshe tshang dang dge legs tshang brag sgom pa sogs kyi sku gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa/ gser zangs las grub pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten/ chab mdo ri khrod pa byams pa dge legs kyis bzhengs pa'i dgon gsham gyi byang chub mchod rten/ paṇa chen chos rgyal gyi paṇa zhwa/ rje bstan pa'i sgron me'i phyag phreng yig drug rang byon ma/ ri khrod pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i 'ja' chen zhabs cag jo bo'i chos snam sogs rten 'gangs chen mang bo mchis so/ /dgon pa'i chos spyod gal chen la/ kun gzigs chen po nas gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i cho ga bdag 'jug dang bcas pa gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i steng rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun can de yab rje dh+wa dza'i zhabs kyi dbang gnang nas gtong thebs bzhag pa dang sman gyi rgyud bzhi'i 'chad nyan btsugs/lnga mchod nyin bdun la ras bris steng nas mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub mchod/ cho 'phrul smon lam gyi ring kun rig sgrub mchod nyin bdun rdul tshon bcas pa/ nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub mchod nyin bdun rdul tshon bcas pa/ stobs ldan sngags rams pa'i gsung bkod ltar chos 'khor bskos pa'i dus chen dang sbrags ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin drug tsha kho smyung gnas pa dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis rkang tsha'i sgar grong sbyin bdag brten nas sa ga zla bar smyung gnas rgyun btsugs/ dbyar gnas gso sbyong dang bcas pa'i rgyun yar ldan du gnas shing lo mtshams zla mtshams dum bcad de dmag zor ma dang dam can la thugs dam gong 'phel gyis zhabs pad ha cang brtan te/ lo 'khyud 'khor gcig gi bshad sgrub chos spyod nyin brgya dang zhe lnga spel/ sde 'di nas phebs pa kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i bla mar bsten pa mdzod dge dge legs rin po che/ snang lugs sman rgan dang / sman pa bla ma rwa bsod skya shog sogs mkhas chen 'ga' byon/ bla brang yongs 'dzin tshang / brag sgom tshang / snang lugs tshang bcas kyi gzim khang rgya che/ sngon mā chi jag dmag — 219 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/si g.yo khram rkyen gyis nyams chag chen po thengs gnyis byung / 1958lor 'du khang dang / gdugs dkar lha khang / byams khang / snang lugs nang chen/ rwa bsod nang chen/ brag sgom nang chen sogs bzhengs pa dang / grwa shag sum cu lhag bcas bla grwa drug cu 'al bzhugs/ phyi lor dgon pa yongs su bsnubs so/ /spyi lo1kha〈 0lor mi ser dad ldan thun mong nas chos sgo slar phye/ da lta 'du khang dang / byams khang /gdugs dkar lha khang / dbyen 'dun mchod rten/ grwa shag ba'i bcu phub par dge 'dun pa zhal drug cu 'dus/ bod sman khang dang tshong khang tshugs/ dad ldan pa'i chos kyi re smon bskong phyir chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel sgang lags so/ /shug yag ri khrod/shug ya ga ri khrod ces pa ni gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gtsos grong khyer khongs mdzod dge rkang tsha'i shuka ya ga sde ba'i stod du chags/ri khrod 'di ni rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba yun ring bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus mdo smad chos 'byung du snang la/ da dung ma dzod dge ri khrod dbang bo zhes bya bas thugs khur ma/dzad/ rtogs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed las/lung sde ba'i mtha' dag gi dgongs don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa 'dul 'dzin chen po zhes bsngags shing / 'dul ba'i bslab bya ljags rtsom mdzad pa shing dpar yod/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu glang18 5 2lor gsang chen rgyud sde'i bla ma bla brang rje shes rab rgya mtsho mchog kha gya'i brag dkar brgyud nas shug yag ri khrod la phebs te 'dul 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i gzim shag nas bdun phrag gcig la bcad rgya ma dzad/ de rjes kun mkhyen bzhi bas ra lung ri khrod dang shug yag ri khrod nyams gso mdzad dgos pa'i bkod khyab gnang zhing ra sprul bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul myur byon gyi smon tshig ljags rtsom mdzad/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i gsung gnang ltar ra sprul ba'i sku skal bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtshos bcom ldan yid bzhin ma rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgo nas bsnyen chen yun ring bzhugs pas ri khrod gdan sa lta bur gyur cing / rwa lo tsā ba'i lcags nag gi rdo rje dang rdo las grub pa'i dbang bo sogs mang bo bsgrugs/sman lung dang kho tshe/ kha gya/ mdzod dge phyogs su phebs nas skye bo mang bo'i don mdzad/ gter lung sku zhogs bse tshang dang / bla ma kirti'i zhabs la gtugs/ khong gis bza' rgod ra hu la dang phyogs bcu'i gnyan chen gtsigs su bkur cing 'phrin las tshul ba'in du bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus mang / 1kha58lor rje 'di nyid btson 'jug thebs te gshegs pa dang ri khrod bsnubs par gyur to/ /rwa lung ri khrod gsang sngags chos 'phel gling /rwa lung ri khrod gsang sngags chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gtsos grong khyer(sngon bsang chu rdzong) gyi mdzod dge rkang tshar chags/— 220 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/a mdo chos 'byung du rkang tsha'i khri ba snang lugs bka' bcu bsod nams kun dga'i bzhugs gnas rwa lung ri khrod ces gsungs/ klong brdol grub pa'i dbang phyug gis sprul ba'i zlos gar du grags pa'i bla brang rje shes rab rgya mtshos kha gya'i brag dkar nas sher phyin brgyad stong ba'i lung gnad dang / chu glang 1ra52lor rwa lung brag rgyal mtshan ri khrod du phebs nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyar ces gsungs/ de rjes kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i gsung ltar dbal mang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos rgyu sbyar te btab/'du khang nang rten dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku brnyan khyad par can dang / yi dam chos skyong du ma'i sku thang sogs lha rten chos gsum mi nyung ba bzhugs/ bla brang sku zhabs kyi gzim shag grwa khang bcas bzhengs/me rta1906lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba gnas 'dir phebs shing brag rgyal mtshan gyi rtser byon te lab rtse bstad/rwa lung ri khrod nyams gso bya dgos pa'i gsung bkod gnang / da dung 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis rwa lung du dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad nas rgyal bstan spyi dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad la dar rgyas mdzad pa yin phyir/ gnas 'di la gzigs rtogs zhib rgyas gnang ste ri khrod du bde mchog snyan rgyud phyi dkyil lha lnga zhal 'don mdzad du bcug cing shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/shing khyi1924lor kun mkhyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan re zhig rwa lung ri khrod du bzhugs pa dang spong ba ba rnams kyis zhus ngor/ 'du khang dang phyi skor gyi skor tshad phan yon bcas ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang sgrol ma'i li sku byin rten du bstsal/ ri khrod kyi chos spyod gtso bo zla re'i yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu/ zla re'i gso sbyong /bde mchog lha lnga'i bdag 'jug bcas kyi srol btsugs/ snga sor ri khrod pa a rigs sangs rgyas sogs bzhugs/ 1kha58lo'i rjes su ri khrod bshig da lta slar nyams gso byas so/ /ri khrod 'di'i lung ba'i phu na shug ral sgrub gnas gong 'og yod la/ rje skal ldan ras pas/ lho shug ra sgrub gnas gong 'og 'di/ /sngon mkhas grub mang bos byin gyis brlabs/ /dus da yang rang byon sna tshogs bzhugs/ /zhes bsngags/ rje skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras dang / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyis gnas 'di nas sgrub rgyun gyi bstan pa spel bar grags che/ tsha kho smyung gnas pa dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis kyang smyung gnas gtsor 'don gyi sgrub pa mdzad/ rkang tsha'i sgar grong gis sbyin bdag byas/ sa zlar smyung gnas kyi rgyun btsugs/ sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhengs/ bla ma smyung gnas pa'i thugs zin pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs shes rab/ rtis tshang ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis/ brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab/ khri rab brtan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku dkon mchog chos ldan sogs gnas 'dir phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad/ da dung yab rje dh+wa dza'i mtshan can yun ring bzhugs pa'i gnas su ri rtser rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub khang dang / grub gnas 'og mar rdo rje phag mo rang byon bzhugs pa'i gnas khang du/ dus bzang la rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra ldir/bdud rtsi'i grub chu 'bebs so/ /bde ba'i 'khor lor sdom mdzad te ru ga'i/ /gnas mchog shug ra gzhan med khang chen du/ byon tshe dpa' bo tākis gar bsgyur tshe/ /dgyes pa'i thal sgra dang bcas gad rgyang bsgrags/ /— 221 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhes rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du byung / 1924shing khyi lor kun mkhyen lnga ba gnas khang du phebs/rdo rje phag mo rang byon dang / lha mo'i bla mtsho/ skyabs mgon bzhi ba'i zhabs rjes sogs mjal/ 'jigs byed rang byon zhig gsar du ngo sprod mdzad/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du bde mchog dang tshogs mchod/smon lam lnga/ bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs/ lha bsang btang bas ri klung thams cad dkar 'jam yugs gcig tu song tshul rje nyid kyi rnam thar du snang ngo / /mdzod dge sgar rnying dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling /mdzod dge sgar rnying dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling ni rje gung thang gsum pa bstan pa'i sgron me'i 'khrungs yul gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu(da lta gtsos grong khyer khongs) rdzong mdzod dge dme bo'i zhang du chags/thog mar yul ming sogs gleng bar byas na/ mdzod dge zhes pa ni sngon bod rgyal khri ral ba can gyi phyag mdzod dga' ye shes dar rgyas dge slong gi cha byad du spras nas da lta'i zi khron rnga ba khul gyi mdzod dge stod ma'i gling ngos bya bar gzhir bzung phyir de'i rgyud dang ru sder mdzod dge zhes grags/ mdzod dge dme bo zer don ni mdzod pa'i rgyud kyi dpon rigs shig gis reb bza' dang stag ri bza'/ 'ba' bza' ste mna' ma gsum bsus par bu re skyes/ 'ba' bza'i bu blo gros bzang gi rgyud las 'bos dpon po dang gling ba'i dpon po/ bzhag sdom dpon po byon/ bzhag sdom gyi mes po zhig gis mdzod dge gling ba nang dme byas/yul phyogs dme rkyen du thebs gshis khong rnams co ne dang kha gya'i bar mtshams su byol nas sa g.yar sa'i ming la mdzod dge dme po'am dme bo'i rong dang dme bo'i ru stod ma zhes yul rong 'brog gnyis su grub/ mi rabs du ma 'das phyin dpon gzungs thar zer ba la bu lnga byon te dme bo dang ru stod ma/ nang ba/ 'brug ge lha do bcas shog pa lnga gyes/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags stag(spyi lo1710)lor mdzod dge shog pa lnga'i spyi bla tā dbon tshul khrims seṅge dang skya ser dpon rigs kyis kun mkhyen ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog a mchog rgya sgar thang du chibs sgyur mdzad skabs sku gam du bcar te/ nged tsho'i sar 'bum khang gi ri glang bo zer ba zhig yod pa der dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos tshul zhus pa la/ kun mkhyen gyis mdzod dge'i sku skyes zhes pa sa dpyad du mngags kyang sa dpyad ma legs pas re zhig lus/ de rjes tā dbon tshul khrims seṅge dang bka' rams pa brgyad (the bo rab 'byams pa dpal ldan seṅge sogs)shog lnga'i dpon po bcas khya dge dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho la zhu sna bcol stabs/ kun mkhyen sku dngos kyis da lta'i dgon sa 'di thug brtags gnang zhing slar rje khya dge ba khong la dgon pa 'debs pa'i bka' bsgos/ shing rta(1714) lor bka' rams pa brgyad gas bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad pa dang dgon pa'i gnas dod du yul dpon gyi gdams pa ltar/ sku rim rnam gsum gsung ba'i srol tshugs pa dang dgon pa dngos su phyag 'debs mdzad cing rab — 222 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gnas gnang / bca' yig bkod phyin 'jigs byed dang mgon chos smad rgyud ltar btsugs/ mtshan la dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling gsol/ 'du khang ka ba brgya can bzhengs zhes stobs ldan sku phreng bzhi ba'i gsan yig tu gsungs/ yang tā dbon bas kun mkhyen la tshe rabs rjes 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i sku bstod zhus pa la khong gis sgo dbyangs la dmigs rtse ma dang gzhon nu'i dus nas ma ṇi sbrel nas 'don rgyu dang / chos skyong bag tse bsten pa'i bka' bstsal/ yang sngags rams pa stobs ldan rgya mtshos(1696da wa 1759)shing glang(1745)lor thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba'i ma ṇi ril sgrub btsugs pa dang ril chog pad dkar phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bcoms/ rje 'jigs med dbang bos lcags 'brug(1760)lor 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs bstsal cing mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga gsar 'dzugs kyi bkod khyab gnang / yang khong gis sde 'di'i bca' yig ke ta ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bcoms/ sa phag lor khong gis dgon pa'i las sne dang shog lnga'i dpon po tshor dgon 'dir mthun rkyen dang grwa tshogs dga' bo 'dug kyang chos 'chad nyan med pa mi legs pas rgyud grwa tshugs na bzang gsungs shing rgyud grwa btsugs te chu yos lor 'du khang la rab gnas gnang /'on kyang lcags phag(1791)lor shog pa'i nang rtsod las dme bo dang ru stod ma sgar mgo gnyis su bkar pa la/ shog pa gsum gyi dge 'dun pa snga mus su dgon 'dir bzhugs/ 'di'i yan sgar rnying ni shog pa lnga'i spyi dgon yin zhing tā dbon rim rgyud kyis spyi bla mdzad/ bse 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pas sa byi(17kha8)lor dgon 'dir paṇa chen gyi bag tse bsten sgrub me'i spu gri las bag tse glo bur 'phrin bcol bya tshul gnam lcags thog rgod ces pa'i cho ga bkod cing sngar yod cho ga nyams mi chog pa'i bka' bstsal/ kirti sku phreng brgyad pa rje blo bzang 'phrin las pas rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing sprel(1884)lor bde mchog lū i ba'i dpang rta dag bstsal pa dang / bla brang smad rgyud kyi byang 'dren chos rdzong blo rgan gdan drangs nas smad rgyud kyi phyag len ji bzhin bslabs bcug chu sbrul(1nga92)lor gsang 'dus sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs dang me bya lor bla brang tshogs chen dbu mdzad mgon shul snyan grags gdan drangs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i phyag len ji bzhin gyi cho 'phrul smon lam btsugs/ brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtshos sa 'brug(1928)lor paṇa chen dgu ba'i bka' ltar bag tse zhi ba'i gtor sgrub btsugs shing sgrig yig bkod/ stobs ldan lnga ba rje skal bzang 'jigs med stobs ldan rgya mtshos lcags stag(1950)lor sde 'dir bkra shis 'khyil ba ltar gyi lam rim rigs grwa btsugs pa las chos sde 'di 'phel rgyas chen po byung ngo / /sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas yo byad la/ dgon du 'du khang chen mo dang / rta mgrin nam rje lha khang / chos ra/ rung khang bcas bzhengs pa'i rten du kun mkhyen gong ma'i 'dra sku byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / thub pa rdor gdan ma/ byams sku nyis thog can/ rta mgrin stong sku sogs shin tu mang po dang 'phags pa/ bka' bstan/ lam sngags/ kun mkhyen yab sras gsung 'bum sogs pota grangs stong phrag gnyis lhag khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho'i gdung rten mchod rten dang byang chub mchod rten gnyis/— 223 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dbyen zlum mchod rten gcig bcas dang / ma ṇi 'khor lo brgya lhag mchod rdzas yo byad sogs gya nom pas bltams/ tshoms chen dang bde yangs ldan pa'i bla brang chen mo dang / stobs ldan nang chen/ bse nang chen/ rtsig bkod legs pa'i kirti dang tā dbon nang chen yod/ las sne du'ang khri ba dang dge bskos che chung / dbu mdzad che chung / spyi ba/ rgan pa gsum/ sku tshab bcu gcig bcas bsko ba'i srol dar la/khri ba dang sku tshab gcig re bkra shis 'khyil nas mngags/ grwa shag brgya longs tsam du btsun pa 'al grangs sum brgya lhag bzhugs/ spyi rdzas su dngul sgor chig khri lhag mchis so/ /chos sde nyid kyi chos thog la zla gcig par 'jigs byed sgrub mchod/ gos sku/ shwa 'cham/ smon lam/byams pa gling skor/ zla gnyis bar bsnyen mtshams/ zla gsum par dbyangs bcag dpyid chos/ zla bzhi bar dbyar chos/ zla lnga bar ma ṇi ril sgrub/ zla drug par gsang 'dus sgrub mchod/ dbyar gnas/zla bdun par rigs ga zla brgyad par bde mchog sgrub mchod/ zla dgu bar ston chos/ bag tse gtor sgrub/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod dang 'cham chen/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos/ yang zla gnyis par bskang gso/ bag tse go bur las bcos/ de ba'in zla rer gso sbyong gnyis re dang tshes bcu'i bde mchog bco lnga dang nyer dgur bskang gso/ nyer lngar bdag 'jug kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gdung mchod sogs lo hril bor nyin nyis brgya drug cu'i chos spyod spel to/slar yang dgon 'dir bka' drin can gyi bla ma du ma phyag phebs pa'i tshul phran tsam gleng na/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho sku rim byon dang bse mchog sprul sku phreng rim byon/ kirti brgyad pa dang / khyad par du mdzod dge dme bo'i shog pa lnga'i spyi bla tā dbon pa sku phreng rim byon yin te/ tā dbon sku phreng dang bo tshul khrims seṅge rab drag lcags yos spyi lo(1651)lor sku 'khrungs/ ('di'i yan dpal sa skya nas mdo smad du rgyu ba'i bar bla rabs bdun cu byon zer ba ha lam lo bcu rer tā dbon pa sku phreng re 'khrungs dgos tshul snang bas e dag the tshom du gyur/ deb ther rgya ma tshor tā dbon lha btsun gyi rgyud ba ste blo bzang seṅge dang / tshul khrims seṅge /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' 'od zer sogs mtshan sna du ma byung ) lha mo'i gser khri gnyis pa khri blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅges rab byung gi mkhan po mdzad pa dang khya dge dpon slob bsten nas kun mkhyen gyi zhal bkod ltar dgon pa btab/ rab nyi chu phag la sku gshegs/ tā dbon gnyis pa don yod seṅge zhes pa rab nyi shing byi1744lor sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos grwa 'grims te rab 'byams pa'i mtshan thob/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa bsten nas sgrol dkar dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bag tse'i bsang mchod 'jigs rung dur khrod ma gnyis ljags rtsom zhus pa dang / sgrol dkar yi dam bsten cing rgyud pa gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ shing phag ste1815lor sku gshegs/ tā dbon gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med seṅge chu 'brug spyi lo18 22lor sku 'khrungs/ 'di ba'i gcung rnam rgyal bkra shis pa'i sras tā dbon bla ma dge 'dun 'phrin las seṅge zer ba yin/ khong gis dgon pa bskyangs nas rab tshes me yos la sku — 221 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gshegs/ tā dbon bzhi ba dbu se ba(mtshan dngos mi gsal) ni da lta'i bsang chu rdzong sman lung du rab tshes sa 'brug spyi lo1868lor yab gu ru skyabs dang yum snying mo byams kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chu khyi'i(1922)zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku gshegs/ tā dbon lnga ba blo bzang 'phrin las kun dga' seṅge zhes pa da lta'i mdzod dge(dme bo)lung gam zhol ma'i sna rigs yab lha mo tshe ring dang yum bu chog skyid kyi sras su chu phag ste192 2lor sku 'khrungs/ dme bo'i shog pa gsum gas bse lnga ba'i ngos 'dzin ltar gdan sar bkod/bkra shis 'khyil nas phar phyin dam bca' bzhag kun mkhyen lnga ba'i zhal bkod ba'in chos rdzong dang rgan gya'i brag dkar(gnya' gong )dgon/ bla brang sngags pa grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs/ rang dgon du cho 'phrul smon lam gyi me tog mchod pa btsugs/ 1981lor dgon pa slar gso ba'i mgo brtsams rjes khong gis bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang kun rig ma ṇi ril sgrub dang smon lam sogs myur du slar btsugs pa dang /gzungs bzhugs su paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis gnang ba'i ba so'i ga bu can gyi bag tse'i sku brnyan byin can bzhengs/ 'cham chen slar gsos shing zhing 'dren bskos/ yang khong gis nan zhus ngor bse blo bzang dpa' ldan chos kyi rdo rjes dgon pa'i bca' yig gsar du mdzad/ 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/19〈0lor khul bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang du phyag phebs nas bod kyi gso rig khang gsar 'dzugs kyi bya bar zhugs pa dang bod sman lag len du rang gi sku na rim rgyud kyi man ngag spyad pa dang khyad par du rgyal khab rim pa'i gso sman las pho ba smug po'i sman se 'bru bcu drug sbyar te 'gro ba mang bo'i na tsha'i sdug bsngal bkrol/sman pa 'bum rams pa'i cho lo mnga' brnyes/ 1988lor dgung lo re lnga'i steng sku gshegs ('di yan mtshan rjes su seṅge re mchis)/ gdung rten rang dgon 'du khang dbus su bzhugs/ tā dbon drug pa blo bzang 'phrin las dar rgyas/ 'di ba1990lor rgan gya'i kha gya ru skor du yab lha mgon tshe ring dang yum khyi mo thar gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ 1995lo'i lugs rnying zla dgu ba'i tshes gsum nyin kun mkhyen drug pas bkra shis 'khyil nas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dang zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la shog pa lnga'am sgos dme bo shog pa gsum bcas gas gdan sar bkod do/ /dgon pa skyong mdzad chen po bla ma stobs ldan tshang sku rim byon ni/ dang bo sngags rams pa stobs ldan rgya mtsho me lug nas sa yos(1696da 1759)bar 'tsho bzhugs/ gnyis pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho lcags sbrul nas sa bya(1761—1789)bar 'tsho bzhugs/ gsum pa byams pa rgya mtsho mdzod dge dme bo'i rkang tsha nas sku 'khrungs/ bzhi ba dkon mchog stobs ldan rgya mtsho me lug nas sa phag(1847da 1899)bar 'tsho bzhugs/ lnga ba 'jigs med skal bzang stobs ldan rgya mtsho mchog mdzod dge ru stod ma'i mdzod pa tshang du sku 'khrungs/ dgon par lam rim 'chad nyan gyi srol btsugs/ sku gshegs rjes gdung rten rang dgon du bzhugs/ drug pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho zhes pa shing gling1985lor bsang khog gi sde ba ru skor du yab blo bzang bkra shis dang yum tshe ring sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ shing khyi ste1994lor kun mkhyen — 225 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/drug pas stobs ldan sku na rim gyi yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad de gdan sar 'khod/ khyom dge 'jam dbyangs blo bzang rgya mtsho las rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te slob gnyer byed skabs so/ /bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor dgon pa yongs su bsnubs pa dang lcags bya la slar gsos te 'du khang dang rta mgrin lha khang / byams khang bcas bzhengs/ sngon gyi mchod rten rnams bzhengs grabs byed bzhin pa dang grwa shag drug cu rtsa dang dge 'dun pa zhal brgya sum cu lhag 'dus te bse drug pa'i bca' yig ltar/rigs lam la bse bsdus dang / lam rim la paṇa chen bde lam/ bskyed rim la rje shes rab seṅge'i rgyud ṭīka dwags po'i 'dus pa sogs 'dzin chos su spel to/ /khra tshang ri khrod/khra tshang ri khrod ni kun lho'i khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) mdzod dge dme bo zhang gi khongs su chags/ri khrod 'di ni the bo rab 'byams pa dpal ldan seṅges btab/ sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis dbyar gnas btsugs/ lo ltar mdzod dge sgar sar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling nas dbyar bzhugs kyi dge 'dun kha ga' zhig mngags te rgyun sdod dang do dam byas tshul a mdo chos 'byung du gsal/ kun mkhyen bla ma sku phreng rim byon las rje kun mkhyen ba'i ba 1906lor ri khrod 'dir phebs te zhag bzhugs gnang / kun mkhyen lnga ba/ bse khri rgan/ kirti mi skyod dgyes gar rdo rje ba ri khrod 'di nas bzhugs te gang 'tshams kyis chos sbyin gnang / snga sor khra tshang ri khrod pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sgrub gnas su/ gsar rnying gi 'du khang gnyis/ bla brang sku phyogs tshang dang / yongs 'dzin tshang gnyis kyi gzim khang / spyi khang / grwa shag 'ga' dang / 'dul 'dzin pa thang gur bsod nams sogs grwa ba bdun tsam rgyun bzhugs gnang /1958lo'i rjes su ri khrod rmang gting nas bshig chu khyi1kha8 2lor kun gzigs paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dang rje gung thang bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs mdzod dge shog lnga'i dgon grong gi ja thab de khra tshang ri khrod mdun du bgyis/ ser skya thun mong nas phebs bsu bkur bsti phun sum tshogs par zhus/ kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog gis 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po sogs kyi gzungs lung 'ga' zhig bstsal/rjes su kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras mchog la zhus te gsung gnang ltar/ khra tshang ri khrod du 'du khang bzhengs pa dang nang rten mgon po dang / gnas brtan bcu drug spyan ras gzigs/ chos skyong phyag drug pa/dzam lha sogs sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs shing / rgyun bzhugs grwa ba'am dkor gnyer dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gi gtong bzhin mchis/ lo re bzhin zla bzhi ba'i nang mdzod dge rong sde dgu mnyam du 'tshogs nas ma ṇi smyung gnas rnam dkar gyi rgyun ma nyams pa byed bzhin no/ /— 226 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rte'u phur sgom khang /rte'u phur sgom khang zhes pa ni/ drang srong dgyes pa'i bste gnas shig yin la/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) mdzod dge dme bo'i rte'u phur sde ba'i gong du chags/rte'u phur sgom khang la sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug rgya gar pha dam pa sangs rgyas bzhugs shing de'i zhabs rjes yod zer ba'i lha sgrung mchis te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang rgya gar gyi grub chen nyi phug pa zer ba gnas 'di nas yun ring bzhugs shing thugs rjes byin brlabs las khor yug ljon shing du mig sman bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa skye bo'i mig sman gyur pa dang / grub chen nyi phug pa gshegs pa'i sku gdung thugs ljags spyan gsum ni gnas 'di'i rten gtso yin tshul bla ma mtsho kha ba da lta bas dngos su gsungs/ de rjes grub thob nyid kyi sku skye rnga rgod ri khrod pa gnas 'di nas yun ring bzhugs shing / nyi phug pa'i sku skyes su nges bzung ba'i mtsho kha ba rje dkon mchog chos 'phel zhes pa gnas 'dir sgrub pa mdzad/ de mngon shes gsal zhing 'phrin las rgyas/ sgom khang steng 'og gi gzim khang bskru na/ nyid kyi dngos slob the bo dkon mchog gis brtsams pa'i rnam thar mdzod dge sgar sar du snga sor par yod/ de'i sprul sku kha gya nas 'khrungs pa dkon mchog tshul khrims rgya mtsho mdzod dge dpon pos bdag byas/ sku gong ma'i tsha bo byams pas khur blangs te sgar sar rab rgyas gling du gdan sar bkod/ sgar sar dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te slob gnyer gnang tshul deb ther rgya mtshor snang / de'i sprul sku mtsho kha ba skal bzang bstan pa'i rgya mtshan rma chu'i dngul ra nas 'khrungs shing / bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas la ngoms pa med par sbyangs te mkhas btsun bzang bo'i snyan pa rgyas shing / kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i drung nas chos bka' ci rigs mnos shing rtsa ba'i bla mar bkur/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i kyai rdor khri zur dang tshogs chen khrir bzhugs/ de'i sprul sku mtsho kha ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta1920lor mdzod dge rkang tsha'i sde khrod du yab 'phags pa dang yum lcags mo skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/kun mkhyen lnga bas yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs kyi zhabs pad bsten cing bka' chos mang du zhus/ bkra shis 'khyil nas phar phyin chen mo'i dam bca' bzhag kun mkhyen lnga ba'i yang sprul 'tshol gras su phyag las mang du mdzad/ sa khyi'i rjes su ngal rtsol la zhugs/ bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzheng skabs su las don khur bzhes gnang / da lta bla brang sngags pa grwa tshang gi khri mdzad/sgom khang 'di'i phyi nang mtha' 'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems dang yid dam/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum chos skyong mgon po phyag drug pa sogs kyi lha sku rang byon rnam pa dngos 'dzin mang ba sogs gnas bstod pad+mo'i phreng mdzes zhes bya bar snang / 1925lor kun mkhyen lnga ba mdzod dge'i rwa lung ri khrod du phebs — 227 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhor mtsho kha sprul sku'i yul skyed shul tshang la gdan drangs te 'pho lung zhus pa dang / rte'u phur sgom khang du phebs par ri khrod pa dag gis mchod sprin bstar/ 'dul 'dzin pa dkon mchog bstan pa dang / dkon mchog tshul khrims gnyis kyis sgom khang du smyung gnas gtsor byas/ 1958lor gnas 'di'i 'du khang dang sgom khang gi rten brten pa tshang ma brlags/da snga chos lugs slar gso byed pa'i dge mtshan ldan 'og bla ma mtsho kha bas dbu bskul te gnas kyi 'du khang dang sgom khang bskyar du bzhengs/ 'du khang nang rten la thugs rje chen po gtsos bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi gyan thang dang zhal thang sogs sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs la/ khyad par du grub chen nyi phug pa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i srung ma myur mdzad phyag drug pa'i sku 'bum tshar brgya tsam blugs pa bzhugs/ kun mkhyen drug pa dang rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug sogs sgom khang du lan cha re du mar phebs te 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen mtshams bdun phrag gcig la bzhugs te sbyin sreg kyang mdzad/ mdzod dge dang kha gya'i dad ldan mang bos gus 'dun lhun len byas/ da lta gnas bdag bla ma mtsho kha bas bskyangs pa dang rte'u phur mi khyim bdun cu lhag gis mchod sbyin byed pa'i skabs so/ /bde chen rtse ri khrod/bde chen rtse ri khrod ces pa ni sngon chad gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi (gtsos grong khyer khongs)mdzod dge sgar rnying dge ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi nye logs su chags/ 1958lor 'jigadaben gnas 'di ni thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas(1727da wa180 2)gnas gzigs mdzad pa'i mur/ shing rta lo(1956)la bla ma stobs ldan lnga bas btab/ dam pa 'di la paṇa chen dgu ba chos kyi nyi mas de sngon sgrol ma'i sku zhig gnang ste rigs bdag la bsten gsungs pa dang / kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas 'od dpag med kyi sku bde smon gsung ba sogs bstsal pa ltar dben gnas btsugs shing bde smon sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ de min dgon pa'i ltag phyogs lung mdo na rje bstan pa'i sgron me 'khrungs gnas su pha bong la ta re dang thad kyi brag ngos su 'dra sku sogs rang byon du ma mjal rgyu yod do/ /shug shar ri khrod/shug shar ri khrod ces pa ni gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)mdzod dge dme bo zhang gi khongs su chags/sgrub gnas ri khrod 'di mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob sngags rams pa bsod nams phun tshogs dang / tsa lus a lags(bla ma)sku skye rnam pa zung gi sgrub gnas yin par gsungs so/ /phyis su shug shar mkha' 'gro ma sku thog gong ma rig 'dzin dbang mo zhes khams nas sku bltams shing / sku na phra mo'i dus nas bstan pa'i chos sgor zhugs shing rdo grub chen rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs pa na/— 228 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'di bas khong la thugs dam gyi gtso bo ma cig khros ma nag mo'i sku brnyan chung chung gnang zhing rjes bka' bsgos pa thugs su bzhes te/ a la 'jigs med ces pa'i rjes 'brangs nas mdo smad 'di phyogs su phyag phebs/khong gis thog mar bla ma brag sgom par zhal mjal zhus pa dang de nas shug shar zhes pa'i dben gnas 'dir byon nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas sgrub pa snying bor rtse gcig tu gzhol cing skye bo nyam thag can mang bor chos sbyin bstsal/ dgung lo bdun cu'i nang ri khrod nyid du sku gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku blo bzang rig 'dzin zhes pa mdzod dge rkang tsha'i sog sde zhes pa'i grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ rje gong ma thug rtsis che ba'i bla ma brag sgom pas ngos 'dzin gnang ste shug shar ri khrod du gdan sa 'khod/ dus de nas gzod shug shar mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa'i mtshan chags/ rje brag sgom pa'i bkas bskul bzhin mdzod dge sgar rnying gi btsun pa zhig mngags te blo bzang rig 'dzin la dge rgan bsten du bcug pa dang sgar rnying dgon pa'i phyi rol du khong mos gzim khang brgyab ste dge sbyor la brtson cing sgrub pa snying bor thon/ yang khong mos bskul ba ltar sgar rnying gi shog pa dang 'brug ge shog pa'i skye bos brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan la nan zhus bgyis pa las brag sgom pas kho tshor dus 'khor dbang chen lan gnyis gnang / sku tshe smad tsam gyi dus su 'jam dbyangs blo gros zer ba zhig la 'grogs nas gnas byin can mang bo phyag mjal dang rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags bye chen mang bo grub zer la/ dgung lo bzhi bcu'i nang tsam sku gshegs so/ /de'i rjes ma slar yang rkang tsha'i sog sde nas yab skal bzang rnam rgyal dang yum lha mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ brag sgom bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan pas ngos 'dzin dang mtshan 'jam dbyangs rig 'dzin sgrol ma zhes gsol/ khong mo sku chung dus nas bag med kyi spyod pa 'jom par dam chos kho nar sems phyogs pa zhig yin par grags/ mdzod dge mtha' sngo dkar dpon po gtsos pas 'di ba shug shar ri khrod kyi gdan sar bkod cing kha gya'i stag tshang btsun ma blo bzang sgrol ma 'don chos kyi dge rgan du bsten te rnying dge zung gi bka' chos mi nyung ba gsan/ yang chos rdzong ri khrid dang zam tsha'i chos 'khor ri khrod sogs su bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor ri khrod bsnubs/ khong gis sdom khrims phul te khul srid gros u yon du bdams/ 1994lo'i lo mjug sku gshegs so/ /ri khrod dga' ldan phun tshogs gling /ri khrod dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes pa ni kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gying (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) mdzod dge dme bo'i sgar snying dge ldan bkra shis dge 'phel gling gi nye logs su chags/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jigari khrod 'di 'brug pa kun legs kyi sku skyes su grags pa rje blo bzang rgya mtshos rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel ste spyi lo192 2lor btab/ 'di ba lha ldan du byon nas skyabs rje pha bong kha ba byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho las bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs te mtshan gsol/ ri khrod du dmigs brtse ma'i sgo nas sgrub pa — 229 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/snying bor mdzad cing zla bzhi bar smyung gnas btsugs/ phyis su brag sgom pa la phul rjes 'du khang bzhengs nas dbyar gnas tshugs pa la sgar rnying dgon nas grwa ba bdun re dbyar gnas su mngags pa dang zla rer gso sbyong gnyis re dang tshes brgyad la maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ bco lngar gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ nyer dgu'i bskang gso sogs dar bar gyur to/ /mdzod dge ru stod ma'i dgon dga' ldan bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling /mdzod dge ru stod ma'i dgon dga' ldan bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)mdzod dge dme rur chags/'debs po ni/ nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po rje mkhas grub bstan 'dzin mchog yin/ khong ni ru stod ma'i sa char mdzod pa sgom pa rgyal dang yum 'brug mo skyid kyi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i bgrang bya bdun pa chu phag lor(spyi lor1742)sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad steng rab tu byung / bco brgyad par rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo mdzod dger phebs skabs mjal cing dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang rgyas pa thob/ dgung lo nyi shu tsam na co ne'i dgon li mkhas mchog las dge tshul bsgrubs pa dang so bdun pa sa phag spyi lo(1772)lor kha gron nang ba'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ zhe lnga nas zhe brgyad par gser khang byams chen gyi gzungs gzhug phyag len ngos dag 'bul bar rem pa la 'di ba ni grub chen red 'da' ba'i rnam sprul yin par paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis gsungs zhes grags/ chu byi lo kun mkhyen mchog gi yang srid myur 'byon gyi rim gro bsgrubs shing sku gdung mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhug 'bri sgrub mdzad cing ma cig lab sgron gyi bka' lung bzhin du klu bdud phyogs su mchod rten brtsigs/ dgung lo re gsum pa(spyi lo1rnga 0 5)shing glang lo'i tha skar zla ba'i dmar phyogs khong gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings thim tshul bstan to/ /khong la rnam thar rgyas pa rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed ces pa dang reb tsha'i bka' 'gyur ba dkon mchog dam chos yar 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i theg mchog lam bzang gsal ba'i nyi ma bzhugs so/ /khong nyid la bka' rtsom ni sbyor ba'i chos drug dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshe sgrub/ bum sgrub/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ lam bzhi'i thabs thig sku gzugs dang sats+tsha gdab pa'i smon lam zla med ma/ bde lam zin bris/ rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'dod gsol smon tshigasdom gsum bslab bya/ lam mchan snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i me long / bde lam zin bris shel dkar phreng mdzes le tshan gsum can la sogs bka' rnam pota gnyis bzhugs so/ /dgon pa 'di mdzod dge dpon chen dkon mchog rab brtan la bka' gros mdzad de ru stod ma'i dpon po(yul dpon)tshe dbang mgon po dang pad+ma rdo rje gnyis gtsos pa'i mdzod pa dang thang yul/ rgya 'dres/ ma kha bcas 'tsho ba bzhi'i ser skya thun mong nas zhus pa ltar rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma co ne kha drod nang ba sogs kyis — 230 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bskul ngor brten te rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me 'brug(spyi lo1726)lo'i nag zla'i nya la kun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi gzim khang bkra shis dga' tshal(phyis su glegs bam sogs mang bo rten du bzhugs pas dgon pa'i dpe mdzod che shos su gyur)zhes pa mdzod dge mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyis bzhengs shing de nas rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi sku thang dang brgyad stong ba'i glegs bam bshams te mchod tshogs phul cing bkra shis gso sbyong dang sher phyin stong phrag brgya ba'i lung gi dbu btsugs nas sa 'dul sogs mdzad/ 'du khang gsar bar ston pa'i rnam thar/ gtso sku 'jam dbyangs thog thub ma/ thub pa gtso 'khor gsum pa/ co de'i bka' 'gyur/ seṅge brgyad gtegs kyi kun mkhyen bzhugs khri/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ bla mchog gtso sku li ma dang tsan dan 'jam dbyangs mi tshad las che ba khri drug 'gyog can gnyis(dbal mang dbon po dkon mchog nor bus bzhengs)/ de min bla sku dang / gnas brtan/ 'dod lha so gnyis sogs bzhugs/ paṇa chen rin po che dang kun mkhyen mchog gi 'khrungs rabs/ gshegs lha/ rje yab sras/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ dpon slob byams pa/ bka' chen yongs 'dzin/ stag phu ba/ kun mkhyen sku phreng dang bo dang gnyis pa/ rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me(gung thang sku phreng gsum pa)sogs kyi zhal thang dang gser dngul zangs las dbyen 'dum mchod rten dang byang chub mchod rten sogs bcu gnyis bzhengs/1860lor grwa sa rgyas pas 'du khang rgya bskyed par mdzod dge bla ma phun tshogs zhes pas yongs su grub cing mchod cha la rdo dril/ ṭa ma ru/ khrus chas/ dzam chas/ theb tse/ kong bu la sogs spus legs kyis bkang / rab byung bco lnga'i shing glang (spyi lo1925)lor zing 'khrug gi skabs(lo de'i zla bdun pa'i nang ha'e rigs mā lin gyi dmag dpon mā pu chin gyis dmag chig stong lhag khrid de bod yul dgon pa dang sde ba mang bo mer bsgron/)su 'du khang dang byams khang / dpe mdzod bcas brlags/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta lor mdzod dge'i rje mai tri'i mtshan can dpon g.yog sog yul nas thengs dang bo phebs te dpe mdzod kha thor legs sgrig la dpe thum gnang zhing bya lo nas kun mkhyen sku phreng rjes ma gsum dang klong rdol/ rje rat+na dh+wa dza'i mtshan can/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs kyi gsung 'bum bsgrugs/shing byi(spyi lo1804)lo'i dgun skyabs mgon mchog sprul 'jigs med rgya mtsho dgon par spyan drangs te ji srid nam gnas bar du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon lag bya rgyu'i yi ge nyid kyi gsung bkod gnang bzhin gtan la phab cing dpon po dang / rgan po rnams la mi 'gyur ba'i thel rtags 'jog tu bcug dgon pa'i ming la dge ldan bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling zhes bstsal/ shing glang lor dgon pa'i sgrig lam gyi skor yi ger bkod cing dbal mang bas ri khrod byams pa ba re zhig bdag tu bskos/ me stag lo bzhi ba'i bco lngar skyabs mgon mchog nas dgon par sgrig yig gnang zhing dbal mang dgon khrir phebs te lo nyer lnga bzhugs/ brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas pas rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu glang (spyi lo1872)lor rje rat+na dh+wa dza 'das pa'i gdung mchod la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi bdag 'jug btsugs pa dang dbang lung rjes gsum gnang — 231 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhing gzim khang bskrun te lo bcu phrag la bskyangs/ shing glang lo 'du khang brla4sa gshis dpon po tshogs gu skyabs dang mkha' 'bum rgyal gnyi gas 'go khrid cing ser skya thun mong gis gros mo'/ byas mthar phyi lor 'du khang bskyar bzhengs thag bcad/ mgon shul skal bzang yon tan rgya mtshos 'grub bar du(spyi lo1928la grub) bza' btung bsnyen bkur gnang / khong nyid ni yul 'di'i mdzod pa 'phags pa tshang du sku 'khrungs/mgon shul sprul sku thag bcad rjes dgon pa 'dir grwa rgyun mdzad cing gzim khang brgyab/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos(spyi lo1927)lor yongs grags su mdzod dge bla ma phun tshogs sa ma rje skal bzang byams pa rgya mtsho de kun mkhyen lnga bas tshogs chen khri las dgongs bkrol gnang rgyu'i re ba zhus tshe khong la dgon pa slar gso'i 'gan dang sog por phebs pa'i bka' gnang / chu sprel lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rje mi tri'i mtshan can khong sog yul nas phyir rang dgon du byon cing thub dbang mi tshad che ba gtso 'khor gsum la lam rim bla rgyud li ma dang gser tog khru drug rgyal mtshan khru lnga can cha/ chos 'khor dang ri dwags pho mo/spen pad nyis rim khebs pa'i spen rgyan sogs phul pa dang / da dung sa zla'i smon lam la mkho ba'i slo nga bzed/'khar sil/ dbu rgyan/ bum pa khru do can gser byug pa/ zangs dngul gyis brgyan pa'i khrus gzhong /bya ma bum rgyan phreng can steng khebs ldan pa/ maṇ+ḍal 'khor khru gsum/ gdugs tog dang tsi cha re/ spos 'khyer phrag khebs dang spos phor cha re/ gtor rgyag gi mkho chas cha tshang bcas gnang / skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho(rab brtan rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi ba)mchog da lta dgung lo gya lnga'i skabs nyid kyang tshogs khrir lo du ma bzhugs/ dus 'khor ba 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rgya mchos dge phrug mang du bskyangs/ 'du khang du thub pa dang rje tsong kha ba sogs kyi 'jim sku thang sku gya nom pa bzhengs pa las gzhan ston pa dang rgyal dbang /paṇa chen/ 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ sde khri tshang / dbal mang tshang bcas sku phreng rim byon gyi dbu banab/ sku 'gag sku gzan/ sku sham sogs dang phyag 'khor sku thul mang bo rten du bzhugs/ da dung rab byung bcu drug pa nas gsar du bzhengs pa la'ang bde gsang 'jigs sogs kyi dkyil 'khor brgyad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i stong sku thang ga bzhi/ zhal thang gzhan pa drug cu lhag rje btsun 'jam dbyangs lha du mas bskor pa zheng khru nyi shu dang srid khru sum cu can gyi gos sku sogs bzhengs/ dgon pa'i byams khang de rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me sprel(spyi lo1〈 27)lor ru stod ma'i sgar grong thun mong gros mthun sgos phyi lor dbal mang dkon mchog nor bus gtso byas sbyin bdag so sos 'brel 'jog gang thub las nyis thog can zhig bzhengs shing tsan dan dang shug dmar las jo 'brom yab sras gsum dang kun mkhyen yab sras gsum bzhengs te bzhugs/ phyi lo'i zla lnga bar rje mkhas grub bstan 'dzin khong gis gser khang byams chen du gzungs gzhug bsgrubs pa dang co de'i bstan 'gyur gdan drangs kyang rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor sku gsung thugs rten gyi 'phrin las mjug bsdus shing me lug lor dgon pa rmang nas bshigs so/ /dgon pa dar skabs btsun pa brgya dang bcu kha zhal bzhugs la grwa shag kyang drug cu rtsa phub/ rgyud pa'i lha khang dang /— 232 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bla brang gzim khang / byams khang / chos ra khang / rung khang sogs thams cad grub/ phyi rol tu mchod rten ma/thong grol chen mo bzhengs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag yin pas kun mkhyen bca' yig bsten/sa 'ing mu'u nyer lnga tsam mchis so/ /dgon pa 'di ni dge lugs pa'i lam rim grwa tshang gtsos pa'i rgyud grwa can yin te/ chos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub 'phar rim la 'dzin grwa gong bar zhol gsum du phye ba las/ 'dzin grwa zhol ma'i gsar bu rnams kyis dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge dang / yig dkar nag sogs zhib tu slob pa dang / chos spyod dang cho ga bdag 'jug bskang gso sogs rgyugs ring thung zhib tu 'phrod nas 'dzin grwa bar du 'bud/ las sne chung gas nas dge bskos bzhugs nas gong du bud/ dbyar gnas drug pa'i bco brgyad nas zla ba gcig la chos grwa khri rin po ches paṇa chen bde lam gyi rtsi ba'ag 'chad pa 'dzin grwa gsum pas skyor dgos/ zla dgu ba dang bcu gcig par 'dzin grwa bar mas gso sbyong dang thun mong lam sbyong gi ched bde lam thun bzhir zlo sgom gyi dmigs pa grangs dang go rim ba'in myong ba gang thon du bskyangs dgos/ 'dzin grwa gong ma rnams zla dgu ba dang bcu gcig par srad dben gnyis kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bde gsang res mos/ dpa' gcig dang chos rgyal nyin ltar zlo sgom skabs su yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pas bsags sbyong dang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim pa gnyis la mnyam mjog gnad smin gnang dgos/ dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma chags pa dang / tshogs nam yod kyi nyin dang bo rnams la bsang btang nas rma gnyan dung gsum dang spyi bsang chog gsum/ dkar gtor rgyas bsdus bcas byed srol yod/zla ba cog gi tshes bcu la zhag ja mchod thabs bsang shug phul te bde mchog bla rgyud bdag mdun dang gtor bsngo yongs rdzogs/ smon shis bcas kyi bar dang mjug tu dge ldan bstan 'bar ma sogs nam yang rgyun 'khyongs/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos nas lo rer gdugs dkar dang maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba khri rdzogs re byas/chos thog so so'i bye brag zhal 'don yang mang / khyad par du zla gnyis par rnam rgyal stong mchod dang /gsum par gdugs sgrol khri re/ maṇ+ḍal stong phrag lnga lhag bzhi bar ri khrod du chu mchod kun bzang /brgyad par chos rgyal bag tse'i gtor sgrub/ lha 'cham dang dkar 'cham bcas mchis pa dang / chos mtshams rnams su 'dzin bshar sbyong gsum dang sgrub pa nyams len du/ 'dzin grwa gong bar zhol gsum phye ba las zhol mas dbyangs gsal ngos 'dzin dang yig dkar nag slob cing / chos spyod dang cho ga bdag 'jug bskang gso sogs go rim bzhin 'dzin pa dang rgyugs dge bskos dang byings 'dzin la zla rer lan gsum re zhib tu 'bul dgos/ 'dzin grwa gong bar gnyis kyis zla gcig pa'i bcu dgu'i phyi dro nas dmigs brtse ma bzlas mtshams la bzhugs te dmigs brtse ma khri gsum re zhal 'don dngos dag gnang ba dang / zla gnyis par dbang dang rjes gnang thob pa'i dge slob gzhon nu bcu lhag bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ 'khor chen/rta mgrin/ seng gdong / kun rig sgrol dkar/ mgon po/ dpa' gcig chos rgyal/ beg tse — 233 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bcas res mos kyi las rung gi bsnyen par bzhugs nas nyer lngar kha skong sbyin sreg lugs mthar grol/ yang nyer lnga nas gsum pa'i tshes dgu'i bar snga dro bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang 'khor chen/ mgon chos kyi dbyangs chen/ chos spyod/ smon lam 'don sgrig sogs brjed gso dang zhib sbyong byas shing phyi dro dgon sde'i rim gror gdugs sher/ sgrol ma/ seng gdong sogs gtso che rigs bsgrubs/ dgung mor dge bskos dang chab rim gyis mgo khrid bzhin 'dzin grwa zhol mas rang rang shag gling nas brda ma grol bar skyor sbyong bya dgos/chos thog so so'i sngon du rang rang skabs de'i dbyangs chags dang skyor sbyong nyin bzhi tsam yod/ 'dzin grwa bar ma thun mong du rgyud sbyong dgos pa paṇa chen bde lam khrid pa'i sku mtshams bzhugs dgos/ bzlas mtshams dang bsnyen mtshams chos thog sogs sgrub par gang byed kyi snga nyin dang dus chen/ nya stong brgyad sogs la lam rim gyi phyag len ltar gnas khang spyi dang mchod 'bul byed pa chag mi rung / de min dgon pa'i gling nye 'khor thams cad gad dar legs po bya dgos so/ /chos sde 'di 'phel 'grib thengs 'ga' re byung yang rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi lor slar gso'i skal ba ldan rjes/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang bdud 'dul mchod rten/ byams khang / bla brang gzim khang bcas bskyar du bzhengs pa'i rten du mdzod dge mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i ras ber dang dbu banab/ gzhan dge ldan bstan pa'i sku gsum thugs rten gya nom pa bsgrugs/ dge 'dun pa zhal lnga bcu lhag 'dzoms par grwa shag so gnyis phub/ gos sku chen po grub/ rang gso'i ched du tshong khang chung ngu zhig dang phyugs rigs sum cu tsam gnyer bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /ru stod ma'i ri khrod thar ba gling /mdzod dge ru stod ma'i ri khrod thar ba gling ngam ri khrod dbang bo ni ru stod ma'i dga' ldan bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling gi shar logs su chags/ yongs grags su mdzod dge phyag rdor 'khor chen zhes 'bod/ri khrod 'di ni rje mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa khong sku mtshams la bzhugs shul du/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i bgrang bya bdun pa chu bya(181 2)lo'i chu stod yar tshes la 'jam dbyangs bla ma bstan pa'i sgron me mchog dang / khri thog rat+na dhā dza rnam gnyis phebs shing byin gyis brlabs te sgom khang zhig bzheng ched bla ma 'jam dbyangs pas dben gnas thar ba gling zhes mtshan gsol/ phyi lo sgom khang grub ste bla slob tshang mas brgyad stong dang bstan 'bar ma gsungs shing shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/ phyis su 'byung bzhi'i rkyen las nub tsam la gyur/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya so gnyis pa'i khyi(18kha8)lor grub dbang chas pa rgya mkhar grub chen pas ri khrod 'di cis kyang zhig gso bya dgos pa'i bka' bstsal cing chu mchod kun bzang gi 'grig gnang/bzhi ba'i nyer bdun nyin la slar btsugs/ lha khang gi rten gtsor phyug rdor 'khor chen bzhengs/ da lta lha khang dang rten 'khor chen bzhengs pas gza' klu dang rgyal btsan sogs kyis gnod pa bzlogs shing dbu skra skyes — 231 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa sogs byin rlabs kyis mtshan ma khyad par can tu gyur to/ /dzam mdo'i ri khrod/dzam mdo'i ri khrod ni gan lho khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) gi mdzod dge dme ru zhang gi dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gi shar phyogs su chags/ri khrod 'di ni gnas bstod pad+mo'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dang dgon pa'i lo rgyus ltar na/ mdzod dge dpon po thog ma mgon po rab brtan gyis dzam mdo'i ri khrod bzheng rgyu'i dam bca' byas pa dang / dpon phyi mas mthun rkyen sbyar gung thang bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung lo lnga bcu'i nang btab/ ri khrod kyi 'du khang nang rten la rje yab sras kyi sku byin can 'ga' bzhugs/ chos thog tu bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bdag 'jug dang bde mchog dkar bo/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe sgrub bcas rgyun 'khyongs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs ri khrod kho na'i phyag rgyun du spel zhing / dbyar gnas la lo ltar grwa ba bcu tsam dgon pas mngags shing dbyar bzhugs byed/ gling sprul bzhi ba skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho ri khrod du lan 'gar phebs mthun rkyen mi nyung ba sbyar/ gung thang gzim khang dang grwa shag bcu tsam skrun pa'i skabs te sa khyi(195〈)lo nas bzung rten dang brten pa gsar rnying ma lus par bsnubs/ da snga mang tshogs kyis rang mos su gung thang drug par nan zhus dang khong gi zhal bkod ltar ri khrod du 'du khang dang / nang rten rje yab sras sogs gsar du bzhengs/ me byi(1kha96)lo'i lnga ba'i bco lngar rje gung thang ba drug pa gdan drangs rten dang gnas la rab gnas mdzad/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas rab byung bco lnga'i chu rta(1〈rnga2)lo nas tshugs pa'i dung skyong ma ṇi ril sgrub ces lo re'i zla drug pa'i nang rnam dkar dge srol slar gsos so/ /mdzod dge sgar sar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling /mdzod dge sgar sar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(gtsos grong khyer khongs)mdzod dge dme ru zhang du chags/dgon pa phyag 'debs dang dar tshul/ mdzod dge zhes pa'i yul ming ni rnga ba'i stod rgyud du bod rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi phyag mdzod du grags pa dga' ye shes dar rgyas zhes pa'i mi rgyud dar zhing grags che bas mdzod dge'i ming thogs la de nas mar gyes pa bcas mdzod dge stod (rnga ba khul du gtogs) smad gnyis co de'i sa skyong dang gcig pa'i shog pa yin/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byin rlabs mngon gyur ces bya bar/ ka yi lho rgyal 'dzam gling byang gi phyogs/ /kha ba can gyi cha shas mdo khams smad/ /ga ju tho'u ju'i nye 'khor mdzod dge smad/ /nga yi lte khrag 'pho ba'i sa cha yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / srong btsan sgam po'i dus su mdo smad rta'i chol khar gtogs pa'i gas yin/ phyis su kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas(1468—1721)gter lung nas gter 'don pa'i dus shig la dme bo'i dpon po shes rab — 235 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/seṅge dug gis na ba la/ khong gter lung du song tshe de'i nyin gter bton pas dpon po'i bso da nams yin/gter bum/ dpon po 'di'i lag tu zhogs gsungs nas gter bum dpon po kho'i lag tu gtad/ bum chu zhus nga sa khyod kyis bum chu len snod du chu gang khyer shog gsungs/ chu des khong gi zhal lan gsum bshal rjes phyir snod du blug pa dpon pos 'thung bas na kho rang dug nad las bkrol ces grags/ rje khong gis gur dkar bsang yi ga gsungs pa'i nang du/ yu la 'di'i bde skyid 'phel zhing khyad par du/ /zhwa ser bslab gsum ldan pa'i dge 'dun gyi/ /bshad sgrub phan bde 'byung gnas 'bral med pa/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa'i 'phrin 'a sa ma dzod/ /ces ched du mdzod dger 'phrin bcol gnang ste ru stod mar dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos pa'i 'u nga dpon por bstan/ de nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i smad mi 'gas mdzod dge smad ma'i dgon pa bkra shis chos 'phe' gling gi rgyud grwa dang 'bum khang ri khrod bshigs/ dme bo'i dpon po dang ru sto da ma'i dpon ngo gnyi gas rgyud pa dang lam rim gyi dgon pa gnyis 'dzugs rgyu byas/ dpon po dkon mchog rab brtan gyis skyabs mgon mchog la dgon pa'i grwa rgyun phul cing dgon pa dngos su 'debs dgos pa'i gsol ba btab / sa rta lo'i(spyi lo179〈)zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dgon sar gung thang sku phreng gsum pa dason ma chog bstan pa'i sgron me(1762—18 2 2)mchog gis bkra shis gso sbyong dang lto 'phye brtags shing sa 'du‘ra gyi cho ga bsgrubs/ bcu ba'i nyer gcig la tho btsun nyis brgya lnga bcu bsdus/ ja thug dang 'gyed gnang zhing dpon slob kyis smad rgyud ltar bskang gso btang ba dang gtor rgyag gnang ste rten 'brel gyi sgo mo phye/de nas kun mkhyen gsum pa'i gdan sa ra gsar du bzhugs shing dpon po dkon mchog rab brtan gyis dgon mgo bkra shis 'khyil la gtad/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel ( 18 0 0) lor dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dgon pa'i khri dang bor phebs te bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi smad rgyud kyi bying 'dren yu lis bstan 'dzin dge rgan du gdan drangs/ khong rnam pa gnyi gas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga sgrub mchod/dgon chos chos spyod sogs kyi dbyangs dang bar rta phyag rgya sogs bslabs/ a mchog rgya sdi'am phun tshogs bstan 'dzin gyi dge phrug tsha kho bkra shis kyis thig rdul tshon dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dkyila'akhor so so/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg phyag len/ blos bslangs bzhengs tshul gyi rgyun tshugs khrid/ 'dzin grwa gong ma la lam rim dang 'dul ba'i bslab bya res mos brtsi bzhag blo sbyong ci rigs gsung chos mdzad do/ /sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas yo byad la/ rten gtso kun mkhyen gnyis pas gnang ba'i tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa'i jo bo lo ke shwa ra/ rgya gar gyi sdong bo bdun grub ces pa'i nang tshan gcig kun mkhyen gsum pa blo bzang bstan pa'i 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan gung thang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas phyag bzo sku dngos gsung 'byon ma/ gung thang bstan sgron 'dra sku tsarjan dkar bo las grub pa/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan dbu skra skye bzhin pa/ gung thang khong gis bzhengs pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ lha sa ltar gyi rang byon lnga ldan te rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ ri bo rtse lnga/ ri bo gru 'dzin/— 236 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/brag dkar rta so/ lo kyā tun(ka ju ste da lta'i lin zha'i khongs gtogs bde mchog gi gnas) mchod rten bya rong kha shor/ lo mā sa la ga mtsho ma pham pa/ chu bo gaṅgā sogs kyi sa sna dang sman spos las grub pa'i sigau la'i gling gi tsan+dan sbrul snying las 'khrungs pa'i thugs rje chen po/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi thugs dam rten sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis/ paṇa chen dpal lda na ye shes(1728—1780)kyis gnang ba'i paṇa chen 'khrungs rab zhal thang bcu gsu ma dang mgon po'i 'al thang dang gri ring sogs/ gung thang dkon ma/chog bsta na sgron gyi phyag bzos rdo arga las grub pa'i thub sku/ mdzod dge ri khrod dbang bo mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i gsu nga bkod lta ra ma dgon du 'jigs byed dgon po chos rgyal rnam gsum gyi zhal thang da lta'ang mgon pa'i rten gtsor bzhugs/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bkod ltar 'jigs mgon chos gsum dang lcam sring / dam can bcas kyi nag thang bdud rtsi 'bebs pa/ dzam khang du kun ma/khyen gyis bzhengs pa'i dzam bha lha dkar po 'brug bcibs/ rgya gar ba nā si nas spyan drangs pa'i ston sku sogs /sgrol ljang glang dar khrims phog gsum 'byon ma/ bstan sgron 'dra sku sde khri rin po ches phyag bzos/ thub pa tshul khrims ma/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i bstan srung rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ par khang du bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan gzungs gzhug 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sku rang byon can/ dme bo dpon por kun mkhyen gong mas gnang ba'i gter lung gi gter bum/ gsung gi rten gtsor bka' bstan lam sngags/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags sogs pota grangs stong phrag gsum lhag bzhugs/ gzhan mdo sngags rig gnas mang bo'i par shing la brgyad stong ba 'grel rkang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mtshan can/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags kyi gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud 'grel ba'i dgongs 'grel/ legs bshad gter gyi bang mdzod/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mgos khug pa lhas btsas kyi gsung 'dus stong thun chen mo/ brtse ba shes rab seṅge'i rdzogs rim rdo lag brgyud ma/ gung thang gnyis pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa dang bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga sbrags nyams su len tshul nor bu'i bang mdzod/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum/ ldong ston chos dar ba'i bka' 'bum/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi don de nyid yang gsal/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar/ po dong ba phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i spyi'i rnam bzhag lhun rtse ba 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyi 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs chen mo/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi bka' 'bum/ gung thang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam thar/ 'brong rtse lha btsun rin chen rgya mtsho'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs/ ma cig lab sgron gyi rnam bshad chen mo/ klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang ba'i gsung 'bum/ rgya rong dge bshes tshul khrims nyi ma'i gsung 'bum/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba/ rje shes rab seṅge'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu ma'i lta khrid/ dpal khang lo tsā ba'i dag yig ngag sgron/ gung thang bstan dbang gi gsung mgur bslab bya thor bu/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi skyes — 237 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rabs so bzhi'i 'grel ba sogs/ thugs kyi rten la mchod rten mthong ba don ldan/ gung thang bstan pa'i rgya mtsho'i dkar chag dang bdud 'dul mchod rten dkar chag gung thang bstan sgron pa'i sku gdung mchod rten/lcang skya rol rdor gyi tshems yod pa'i mchod rten/ mya 'das mchod rten rdo dkar las grub yig gzugs rang byon can/ nyan thos chen po shā ri'i bu'i 'dra sku phyag mngar du sku byon can/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros kyi dbu thod a rang byon can/ rnam 'dren gsum pa 'od srung gi tshems kyi cha shas/rgyal ba yab sras dang kun mkhyen yab sras rnams kyi na bza' nyer spyod du ma/ gzhan du gna' rdzas mchod cha yo byad grangs kyis mi longs so/ /dgon pa'i lo hril bo'i chos thog dang skyes bu dam pa 'ga'/ lo gcig gi nang cho 'phrul smon lam/gos sku/ dpyid gdung mchod dang rab gnas chen mo/ dbyar gnas la gsang 'dus/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas ma ṇi ril sgrub/ smad rgyud lugs kyi gter chen/ ston chos/ lnga mchod/ dgun chos/kun mkhyen yab sras kyi dus mchod gling me/ srad rgyud lugs kyi lo gyon ma'i ril sgrub bcas gal chen nyin brgya zhe lngar longs/ spyir smad rgyud yin na'ang de'i nang gi grwa ba lnga bcur zab mo lam spyod kyi nyams len tshugs pas lo re bzhin gnyan sar chu mig 'grim pa/ bsnyen pa gtong ba/ chos thog tu bdag 'jug len pa/bstan 'gro'i zhabs brtan du sngags sgrub dang la sa bzhi'i sbyin sreg sogs yod stabs grwa tshang gnyis kyi srol dar/las sne la khri ba(dpon slob yang zer)dang bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge bskos che chung / byings 'dren che chung /dkor gnyer/ spyi ba/ tshogs 'du rgan pa bcas bskos/ gung thang bzhi ba'i dus su a khu dge bshes tshang zer bas 'bras sgo mang gi lha rams pa'i dam bca' bzhag cing rang dgon du bla ma dbu mdzad bzhugs pa'i thog ma yin/ 'gro ba'i tshangs dbyangs zer ba la grwa tshang 'di ga'i 'don phyag len bskyed rdzogs ṭīk+ka sogs kyi khrid rang sgra snyan lha ris sogs la mkhas/ gung thang lnga ba'i mchod dpon chen mor bzhugs/ dge slong 'phrin las kyis ldi'u rtsa ri khrod nas dpe gzigs gnang / khor sku zhabs zhwa dmar rin po che yis bla ma'i mtshan gnang / mdo sngags mkhas pas rma rgya sprul sku sogs bu slob mchis/ dge slong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang man ngag mang bor mkhyen rgya che/ ma kha sangs rgyas zer bar 'bras sgo mang nas smon lam rab 'byams pa'i dam bca' mnos te gzhon pa tshul khrims nag po tshang gi dge phrug yang rtser gyur/ de min bzo la mkhas pa'ang a mchog lha ris pa dang klu chung lha ris pa/ bstan 'dzin lha ris pa bcas co ne'i kha bad lha bzo'i dge phrug yin/ ma kha lha ris pa dam chos ni bris thang 'jim bzo gnyi gar byang rgya che bas blos bslangs dang bris thang mang bo dgon par bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i lha khang dang nang khag 'du khang steng 'og thams cad sku gsung thugs rten dang lha cha mchod rdzas yo byad thams cad kyi gras su byir bur gang ba'i rin po che kong bu chen po gcig yod/ rung khang /byams khang / chos ra/ mchod rten mthong grol chen po/ par khang bcas lha khang drug dgon mthar ma — 238 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ṇi 'khor khang brgya nyer bzhi/ bla brang chen mo/ gung thang nang chen/ dbal mang che ba'i nang chen/ gling tshang nang chen/ yongs 'dzin nang chen/ mtsho kha ba'i nang chen/ dus 'khor ngag dbang bkra shis kyi nang chen/ khri rin po che'i nang chen/ dme bo'i dpon tshang nang chen bcas nang khag dgu bor tshoms chen dang bde yangs/ gzim chung / thab chen bcas 'dzoms/ grwa shag brgya dang nyi shur grwa ba nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ dgon par spyi rdzas dngul sgor stong du ma mchis te dbul tshong dang phongs por bogs gtong ba dang / rtswa thang ni khongs gtogs mi sde'i sa cha gang sar mtsher sa bya chog la/ nang chen dag dang grwa mang rang la rta nor lug gsum stong phrag yod de 'tsho rten phyed ka der brten/rab rgyal sa khyi lo dang me rta lor dgon pa yongs su 'jig dge 'dun pa mang po skya sar bud pa dang bla ma sogs che khag mi nyung ba btson du bcug(phyis su dkar 'don gnang)pa dang dad ldan rang rang gis chos spyod lkog tu spel bar btang / 198 2lor gong rim srid jus dngos 'bebs dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'dod mos bzhin slar 'du khang dang byams khang / rung khang / gung thang nang chen/ dbal mang che ba'i nang chen/ grwa shag drug cu lhag bzhengs pa'i rten dang bcas pa grub cing dge 'dun pa zhal brgya longs 'dus nas chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel ba dang rang gso sman khang dang tshong khang / sgo phyugs du ma gnyer bzhin no/ /sna sbyag chos rdzong dgon/sna sbug chos rdzong dgon pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) sna sbug zhang gi bra ti'i thang zhes par chags/nang ba'i chos sde 'di'i thog ma ni mdo smad chos 'byung du byung ba'i sna sbug sgom khang zhes pa rje skal ldan rgya mtsho dang de'i slob ma byang chub mi la sogs bzhugs myong ba'i gnas yin/ chos rdzong sku skye bzhi ba dkon mchog bstan pa dpal bzang bos rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa 'brug lo(spyi lo18 08)phyag 'debs mdzad/'be shes rab mchog ldan nas sku rabs du ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar brjod pas na/ sku phreng dang po 'be shes rab mchog ldan te khong rgan bya'i tshwa kha nas sku 'khrungs/ dbus su slob gnyer mdzad pas rig pa'i dbang phyug ka ring dka' bcu bas 'chad dang / rtsod dang / rtsom na nga zhes pa'i sgo yig sbyar ba la sun 'byin mkhan 'di ba yin pas lha rams pa'i mtshan btags byung / dbus nas phyir rang yul du phebs pa dang gtsos lha khang shar du bzhugs shing / gtsos dga' ldan chos gling btab/ de'i sprul sku ngag dbang theg mchog gnam lha nas sku 'khrungs/ 'bo ra mthu stobs dang tsa lus phun tshogs sogs mnyam por dbus su phebs shing kun mkhyen mchog la dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sbyin bdag bya rgyu khas blangs/ phyir log rjes sna sbug sgom khang phub nas yun ring bzhugs/ thugs dam la sgrol sku rang byon bzhugs/ gtsos dgon du — 239 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dpon slob dpa' ris ngag dbang dpal ldan dang bcas kyis chu 'brug la rgyud grwa btsugs/ urge lbang gis bla mar bsten/ dgung lo go bzhir bzhugs/ sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med grags pa zhes pa sna sbug klu go tshang la sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil nas kha gya'i bkra shis dge rgan du bsten/ kirti'i rgyud pa zhig grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs/ me yos lor sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku 'be'i sku skyes dkon mchog bstan pa dpal bzang bo zhes gtsos 'brong lce'i dpon po yab snying dkar dang yum lha mo tshe ring gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chu sprel la gdan sar bkod cing yab rje dh+wa dza'i zhal snga nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ bka' 'gyur ba dkon mchog dpal 'dzin las bka' 'gyur gyi lung gas na/ kirti kun dga' chos 'phags bstan pa'i nyi ma las bsnyen pa rdzogs/ khong dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu yos(spyi lo178 2)la yul 'khrug byung rkyen sgom khang rnying ba bsnubs shing dar sri byung / de nas khong gis gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me la dgon sa spo ba'i re ba zhus pa na/ dgon sa pra ti'i thang zhes pa de kho na legs par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa lug(18 0rnga)lor dgon pa bskyar du btab ste 'du khang dang / dam can btsan khang /gzim khang / sku zhabs bla brang sogs bzhengs/ rje 'di ba smad sog dag tu lan gnyis phebs pa dang bla brang rgyud pa'i dbu mdzad/ dus 'khor/ rgyud pa rang / shis tshang chos 'khor/ sgar sar bcas kyi chos khrir mnga' gsol/ dgung lo re dgu pa la sku gshegs/ 'be sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang shes rab rgya mtsho zhes pa dngul ra'i snang sgo ra mo che'i gdung rgyud mgar ba tshang du/ rab byung bco lnga'i shing phag(1875lo)lor yab mgon po dang yum bsod nams kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi'i steng gdan sar bkod cing bkra shis 'khyil gyi mkhan po 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun rgya mtsho las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos pa dang dgon de'i chos grwa 'grims nas dge bshes dkon mchog rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten pa bcas las phar phyin dam bca' ba'ag sog yul du phebs nas phyir rang dgon la rta mgrin lha khang bzhengs/ de'i rjes slar sog yul du phebs rjes dgung lo so bdun steng ste gnyis pa'i bco lngar re zhig sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ljags rtsom po ti gnyis bzhugs/ chos rdzong sku phreng drug pa skal bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho yin te/ gtsos dbon skor mgar bza' tshang du yab dka' thub rgyal dang yum lha mo 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog gis sku gong ma'i yang srid du thugs thag bcad/ dgung lo brgyad kyi dus su mkhan po 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun rgya mtsho las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/dge bshes 'jigs med rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten pa dang dgung lo nyer gcig steng phar phyin dam bca' bzhag cing mdzod dge ru stod ma dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/ de'i phyis sog yul du chibs bsgyur ba dang 'phros nas rkyen dbang gis pe cin du sdom khrims phul nas gtan bzhugs mdzad mthar dgung lo nga bdun steng rang shag tu sku 'das so/ /dgon pa'i rten bzhugs gal chen la kun mkhyen rim byon gyi 'jim sku dang / ston pa/ spyan ras — 240 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gabrigs/ sman bla/ sgrol ma/ rigs gsum mgon po/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ rje dhā dza'i sku brnyan sogs li ma sha stag dang / thub pa sangs rgyas kyi sgrol sku brgya rtsa brgyad la rab gnas mdzad pa'i gras kyi sgrol ljang gsung 'byon ma/ thub sku tshul khrims kyi dri bsung thul ba/ rta mgrin gyi phur bu dus 'khrug las rang gnas 'phur byon pa sogs shin tu mang ngo / /dgon pa ni bkra shis 'khyil gyi dpon slob rim bskos kyis smad rgyud 'chad nyan yar ldan du bstar bas chos thog la/ zla gcig pa'i nang 'jigs byed sgrub mchod dang sa chog klu chog dpal mang dkon rgyal gdung mchod/ gnyis pa'i nang kun mkhyen bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ bzhi ba'i nang bstan pa'i dpal bzang gi gdung mchod/ gsang 'dus sgrub mchod dang sa chog klu chog gtor chen/ lnga ba'i nang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gdung mchod dang dpal sprul rin po che'i gdung ma chod/ drug pa'i nang mgon chos dang gsang 'dus gtong chen/ bdun pa'i nang bde mchog sgrub mchod dang sa chog klu chog rnam rgyal stong mchod/ gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba sogs/ dgu ba'i nang bde gsang dang mgon chos/rje 'jigs med rgya mtsho dang ngag dbang theg mchog 'jigs med grags pa bcas kyi gdung mchod/ bcu ba'i nang rje 'jigs med dbang bo'i gdung mchod dang 'jigs gsang mgon chos bcas/ bcu gcig pa'i nang la nang chen gyi mgon chos lnga dang gur 'al sogs kyi bskang gso/ nyi ldog la gnam lcags mkha' 'gro'i dgongs rgyan nyin gsum/ bcu gnyis par rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang bde gsang sogs kyi mtshams bcas yod/ mtha' ba sde ba ni nang mgon gnyi ga'i lha sde dang rdo dkar khog dpal rgya mtsher/ sho ma rong / sna sbug bcas sngar mchod thebs su sbya ra ba'i bka' shog yod pa dang / chos rdzong ru bdun po'ang sbyin bdag dngos yin no/ /chos sde 'di de snga rkyen dbang gis lo bcu phrag gnyis tsam ring yongs su 'jig na'ang / da lta bse mchog sprul blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje dang gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug zung gis thugs khur sbyor 'jags las 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ sngon gyi bca' yig ltar chos 'chad nyan 'don rta dbyangs slar gso sa shing las sne rnams 'thus tshang du btang / khyad par du 'be drug sku gdung pe cin nas phyir gdan drangs te mchod rten khru bzhi can bzhengs nas 'du khang du bzhugs pa dang / grwa shag sum cu rtsa grangs la dge 'dun pa zhal lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ sngon gyi rten gtso rje nga 'dra ma gur gyi thugs kur bzhugs pa slar rnyed pa sogs gya nom pa 'dzoms par gyur to/ /chos rdzong ri khrod theg chen gsang sngags dar rgyas gling /chos rdzong la mgo'i ri khrod theg chen gsang sngags dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)sna sbug zhang gi khongs su chags/— 241 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gsang sngags rnying ma'i sgrub grwa 'di rab 'dod me khyi lo ste spyi lo1766lor rig 'dzin pa ngag dbang theg mchog ces pa gnam lha nas sku 'khrungs pa des phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang chos rdzong dgon pa'i sngar gnas de thog mar ri khrod 'di yin/ ri khrod dar ba'i ring la dge slong 'du khang dang dge slong ma'i(jo mo)lha khang gnyis/ dpal sprul nang chen/ par khang / grwa shag brgya lhag bcas bzhengs shing / rdzogs chen dpal sprul sku phreng dang bo dpal dge dang / sku phreng gnyis pa o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo/ sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med 'phrin las rnam rgyal bcas kyis yun ring bdag skyong mdzad/ sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs bral 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes pa yul nyid kyi brag mar ri'i sgang lam tshang gi yab sangs rgyas skyabs kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga nas chos rdzong dgon pa'i grwa sar zhugs/ bcu gsum gyi steng a 'dzoms 'brug pas dpal sprul sku phreng gsum par nges 'dzin gnang / kha gya'i gter ston gyi mdun nas snga 'gyur snying thig gi grub mtha' sbyangs/ nyi shu'i steng gdan sar phebs/ rje 'di'i slob bu rnams la zhal gdams mang bo yod kyang da lta zhal gdams tshan pa gnyis te sho lo ka bcu ba'i dang / 'don cha gnas srung gsol mchod bzhugs so/ /grub mtha' ni rnying ma'i klong chen snying thig gi srol 'dzin la ma gza' rdor gsum srung brten bzhin/rten gyi gtso bor o rgyan rin po che dang / rags kyi phur bu/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo/ dpal chen/ phur ba/ gro lod/ gnas brtan bcu drug rgyan drug mchog gnyis/sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ sangs rgyas mdzad bcu/ kong sprul rin po che/ sa skya gong ma dag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ sgrol ma'i sman sku/ thub dbang rdor ldan ma/ rwa lo'i thugs dam o rgyan li sku/ rje tsong kha ba sogs sa dge rnying gsum gyi skyes chen dam pa'i li sku 'jim sku thang ga bcas nyis brgya bdun cu longs pa dang / bka' 'gyur dag tshar gsum dang rin chen gter mdzod/ 'jigs gling bka' 'bum/ mdzod bdun/ dpal sprul bka' 'bum sogs pota sum stong lnga brgya lhag dang / tsan dan gyi rnam rgyal/ myang 'das/ byang chub mchod rten / dpal sprul gdung rten sogs sna lnga bzhugs pa dang / gos chen gyi rgyal mtshan dang gdugs la sogs rgyas par bsgrugs/ par khang du klong chen snying thig dang zhi khro/ sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum/ thar lam gsal sgron/ tshes bcu rnam bshad/ 'don cha sogs par shing sum stong longs pa mchis/ gtsos sngags pa grwa tshang / tsa lus sngags pa/ a mchog sngags pa/ dme shul sngags pa/ klu chu'i sngags pa/ chos 'khor ri khrod/ da dung the bo/ co ne/ zi khron/ mtsho sngon la sogs kyi sngags 'chang rig 'dzin pa rnams la chos 'brel zab cing / rdo sbis mchod rten zhig gso sogs la thugs khur sbyor 'jags che'o/ /sgrub grwa'i sgar mgo gtsos dgon par gtad cing chos rgyud da lta'i zi khron a 'dzoms zhes par khungs bstun/ bca' yig ni o rgyan 'jigs med chos dbang bas mdzad pa la/ sngon chad dge slong sum cu dang jo — 242 —
