krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mo brgya nyer lnga/ sngags pa nyer gcig bcas 'dus te sgrub mchod sna mang spel/ sgom sgrub la thog mar kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung nas/ thar lam gsal sgron/ 'khor 'das ru bshan/ rtsa rlung sogs rim par 'phar te/ zla dang bo dang gnyis par rdzogs pa chen po dang / zla bzhi bar smyung gnas/ zla lnga bar 'das mchod dang bla mchod dngos grub rgya mtsho/ zla drug par dbyar gnas dang mar ngor gso sbyong / zla bcu ba'i mjug nas zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga bar rtsa rlung sbyong / yang zla bcu gcig pa'i nang kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang thar lam gsal sgron sbrags zla bcu gnyis par zhi khro dam pa rig brgya dang rta khyung zlog pa sogs spel/lhag par bla mas rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang yi dam dpal chen 'dus pa/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo/gsang mdzod las sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sems dpa' sogs gtsigs su zla re nyin gsum 'khyongs de ba'in ri khrod du'ang mngon par grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa dpal sprul 'jigs med 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ kha gya'i gter ston pa/ gnam rdzong zhabs drung / a kong grub chen/ shug shar mkha' 'gro ma sogs gsung dang bka' chos can du ma byon/ 195〈lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nyin dpal sprul rjes ma btson du bcug pa dang phyi lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes drug btson ra nas sku gshegs so/ ri khrod du mdzo g.yag khal ma brgyad cu zhon rta nyi shu dang gzhung gsog 'bru rigs rgya ma khri phrag dngul sgor stong phrag du ma/ mchod rdzas yo byad la rgya gleng / rkang gleng /dung chen/ sbub/ tsen/ rnga chen/ mchod rnga/ maṇa rags gtor gsum/ theb tse/ kong bu/ ṭa dril la sogs gser dngul rags gsum las brdungs pa brgya phrag yod/ ri khrod kyi rten dang brten pa thams cad spyi lo1966lo'i rig gnas gsar brje las 'gul skabs yongs su bsnubs kyang slar1980lor zhig gso'i 'go brtsams/ 1996lor dgon pa slar gso'i chog mchan thob/ da lta dge slong rtogs ldan pa 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi ste1997 2 7sku 'das pa de'i sku drin du dgon sa mu'u brgya tsam gyi sngar gnas su 'du khang stabs bde bzhengs pa'i rten du dpal sprul ba'i dngul brdungs mchod rten dang / bka' 'gyur/ rgyud 'bum/ o rgyan/ 'jigs med gling ba/ mdzod bdun/ dpal sprul dang grags pa bshad sgrub/ gtsos gser khri sogs kyi gsung 'bum dang klong chen snying thig sogs kyi par shing sogs bzhugs shing grwa shag sum cur dge slong drug dang dge tshul slong jo mo lnga bcu nga bzhi 'al 'dzoms te yul phyogs mi ser la gsang sngags dam chos spel sgang yin la/ dge slong thub bstan rgya mtsho lags gtsos dge tshul jo mo bcas thun mong nas tshogs chen 'du khang snga mo las zab rgyas 'phyor nyams ldan pa bskyar bzhengs grub pa dang / thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dpal sprul yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang ba dgon du phyag 'byor nas gdan sa skyong ba'i 'phrin las spel sgang yin no/ /gtsos dgon pa dga' ldan chos gling /gtsos dgon pa dga' ldan chos gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi (da lta'i gtsos — 243 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/grong khyer khongs) sna sbug zhang ste rang skyong khul lte gnas gtsos grong khyer gyi byang 'gram nyin khug tu chags/mtsho tshad smi nyis stong dgu brgya longs/ thog mar ru sde chags tshul dang gtsos ming thogs tshul brjod pa la/dgon pa 'debs pa bo'am gser khri rim byon gleng bar bya ste/ sngon ring mo'i dus nas bzung yul lung 'di ni yid 'phrog pa'i bde snyoms kyi ri dang / sngo ljang g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal dar gyis phyis 'dra'i 'jam ljang ljang gi sa ga'i/ mdzes pa'i ri lung kun tu sa gshin po mchis pa'i yul ljongs 'dir gna' snga mo nas ri dwags gtsod khyu tshogs skor skor rgyu ba'i gtam rgyud gang byung du grags pa thos 'dzin ut+pal gyi rgyan du smin/ ru sde 'di thog mar mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis bod kyi rus chen ldong la tsha chen bco brgyad yod pa'i nang tshan g.yu tsha zhes pa'i rgyud las yul 'dir bskos pa'i g.yu tsha dmag dpon gyi rgyud pa klu rgyal byams zer ba de nyid kyis bo'i(sbrul)smad kyi sa gzhi bzung ste ru nying tsho drug dang / rjes su dbus nas 'ongs pa'i dpon lha 'bum(de snga sna sbug dpon tshang)dang / stod sog nas dpon po bstan 'dzin(de snga hor lam dpon tshang)/ smad nas 'ongs pa'i sgo rdzong be hu(sgo rdzong brgya dpon tshang)sogs dpon khag bzhi'i ru gsar chags te tsho ba bcu bzhi dang / dpon skor tsho ba sogs las da lta'i tsho ba nyer gcig 'di grub po/ /g.yu rtsa dmag dpon gyi rgyud pa klu rgyal byams sa 'dir gzhi chags pa'i lo tshigs mi gsal na'ang spyi lo1957lor khyim tshang gi dpon rgyud 'brug pa rgyal zer ba des brtsis na mi rabs bcu bdun yin zhes gleng gin 'dug de bzhin gtsos zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul ni/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ gtso bo mes klu rgyal byams dang / tsa yus kyi gong ma klu rgyag gnyis spun/ g.yu tsha dmag dpon gyi rgyud pa gtso bo che chung dang / gtso bo phan tshun yang zer/ zhes gsungs/ bka' bcu 'phrin las rab brtan gyi rtogs brjod pad dkar chun po las/ mdo smad phyogs kyi gtso bo phan tshun gnyis/ zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ mdo smad lho phyogs gtso bo yul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar na mdo smad phyogs kyi gtso bo'i mes gong ma klu rgyal byams sogs don gyis gtso bo zhes bstan pa dang / yul 'di'i sa ming 'bod bde ba'i ched du gtso bo'i yul zhes pa'i gtso yig la sa mtha' sbyar te yul lung 'di la gtsos zhes yongs khyab tu grags pa dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum las/ phyogs phyogs mtshams bkra shis rtags kyis bskor/ /phu dkar phyogs lha yi pho brang mdzes/ /mda' dad ldan yon tan tshogs kyis gang / /mtshan snyan grags dga' ldan chos kyi gling / /zhes gsungs so/ /gtsos dgon dga' ldan chos gling 'di su zhig gis btab pa dang dus nam zhig la btab pa bshad tshul du ma snang mod/ bo'i(sbrul)smad dpon tshang gi dpon rgyud bzhi ba rab brtan gyis rab byung bcu ba'i sa lug(1619)lor rong bo bla ma dmar dmar zhes grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor de yul 'dir gdan drangs shing /khong gis sa dpyad shin tu legs par dgongs pa bzhin ri khrod gsar 'debs mdzad de mtshams khang brtsigs par sa 'og nas ston pa'i sku li ma zhig rnyed pa rten 'brel 'grig pas lo du ma'i ring sgrub pa mdzad/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi(1626)lor rje skal ldan rgya mtsho ri khrod 'dir phebs te lo 'ga'i rang sgrub pa mdzad da 244 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/par grags/ de'i phyis khang zhi khri lo bcu bzhi(1675)lor co ne dpon po tshe dbang don grub kyis gnam bskos gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar bod kyi dmag bskul te tho'u ju'i mkhar na yod pa'i ngo log jag pa thams cad brtul ba'i skabs dbus nas yong ba'i gtsos yul gyi dpon po lha 'bum gyis jag 'dul dmag 'thab nang dpa' bo'i lag rjes mang du bzhag par/ dpon po tshe dbang don grub kyis gong ma chen por gzengs bstod kyi cho lo'i bka' drin 'thob pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus par/ dpon lha 'bum la be hu'i brgya dpon tshe lo dang tham ga gnang zhing / dpon lha 'bum yul phyogs 'di'i kha gya tsho drug gi 'go 'dzin du bskos te yul dpon gyi bkur gzo thob/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta(1678)lor rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob 'be shes rab mchog ldan dgon 'dir gdan drangs te/ dgon sde 'debs pa'i gsol ba btab pas / chos sde rgyab ri khyung chen mkha' la lding 'dra/ yid bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ri ngogs/ dge tshogs ngang gis 'phel ba'i sa'i char/ sngon gyi ri khrod du yab rje'i thugs dam gyi rten mi la ras pa'i sku gsung 'byon mar grags pa dang byin rten na bza' 'gangs chen sogs snying bor bzhugs pa'i lho brag sras mkhar dgu thog gi dbyibs 'dra ba'i sku 'bum chen po zhig gsar skrun gyi thugs bzhed yod pa ltar dpon pos sbyin bdag byas/grwa slob thams cad kyis zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rmang 'ding ba'i tshe na sa 'og nas mi la ras pa'i rnam thar bris thang dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil rang byon rnyed/ de nas ri khrod de rgya bskyed cing grwa rgyun bsdus te chos sde gsar 'dzugs gnang / mtshan du dga' ldan chos gling zhes gsol/ rjes su kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gdan drangs/ khong gis dbang lung bka' chos mang bo bstsal te bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi chos grwa 'dzugs dgos pa'i bka' lung bstsal/ shing sbrul(172 5)lor sho ba rin po che'i sprul sku brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab dgon 'dir bzhugs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa sbrul(1749)lor kun mkhyen bla ma'i dngos slob khri rgyal mtshan seṅge gdan drangs te dgon 'dir gzhung bka' pota lnga'i 'chad nyan btsugs/ge ri mthu stobs rgyal mtshan khrir bskos/ de nas bzung dga' ldan gser khri nga gsum pa gtsos dga' ldan chos gling gi gdan sa'i bdag por gyur cing / 'dus sde dang yul lung phyogs thams cad 'di'i gdul bya 'phrin las kyi sgo 'byed du gyur pa'i rten 'brel rmad du byung bar grags so/ /da ni mkhas grub dam pa khri chen sku phreng rim byon mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ dga' ldan khri rabs nga gsum pa rje rgyal mtshan seṅge mchog ni gtsos gser khri sku phreng dang bo yin/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta( 167〈)lor da lta'i klu chu rdzong zam tsha'i chos 'khor sgang (dga' ldan dpon pa'i lo rgyus su mdo smad tā dbon chos 'khor ba zhes/ khri bzhugs lo172 2 — 1728 ) ka sdong mgo'i yab tshe ring bkra shis dang /yum snying mo lcags kyi sras su gza' skar 'phrod sbyo ra phun sum tshogs pa'i dge tshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ khong sku na phra dus nas byis pa phal ba'i spyod pa dang bral zhing dpe gzigs dpe klog gi gral du zhugs te yi ge 'bri klog dang 'don sbyor sogs la tshegs med/ nyi ma skar ma dus chen la sgom khang du 'gro — 245 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/grabs dang gnas dben par song nas ma ṇi 'don pa la thugs dgyes pa'i bag chags sad de sngon nas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du byon/ dgung lo bcu gcig par tā dbon pa bla ma tshul khrims seṅge las rab tu byung ste mtshan la rgyal mtshan seṅge gsol/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa dbus su phebs te kun gzigs paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes mjal/ rje khong gis lung bstan ba'in 'bras spungs sgo mang tā dbon khang tshan du bzhugs te lam rim chen mo/ 'jam dpal zhal lung / myur lam sogs mdo dang rgyud sde'i sbyong ba mthar phyin gnang / da dung kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ khri chen 'jam dpal grags pa/ phri chen blo bzang dar rgyas/rje phun tshogs rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan mang bo bsten nas shing rta chen po rnams kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i dka' gnad dri ba dang dogs gcod mdzad/ dgung lo so dgu ba la lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa che cher thob/ dbang lung man ngag dang mdo rgyud rig gnas la sogs pa'i gter du gyur/ de nas zla ba rgyal mtshan pa'i gdan sa kong po 'bru lha'i mkhan khri lo gsum la bzhugs rjes rgyud stod dang sngags la sbyangs pa dang grwa tshang gi bla ma dbu mdzad bzhugs/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa bya lo nas rgyud pa'i khri ba dang dga' ldan shar rtse chos rje zung 'brel mdzad/ dgung lo nga lnga ba chu pho byi ba'i(172 2)lo nas dga' ldan gser khri rin po che lo brgyad kyi ring zhabs pad bkod/ ye shes pa rang byon dga' ldan chos rgyal gyi ljags la sngar sus kyang zhig gso ma thub pa rje nyid kyis phyag bstar zhig gsos gnang ba sogs khyad par du 'phags pa'i grags snyan lha yi rnga chen ldir/ dgung lo re gsum pa nas gzhon nu byang chub 'od kyi gdan sa bya yul mang ri'i mkhan khrir lo brgyad la bzhugs pa sogs dbus gtsang gi phyogs thams cad du 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa'i don rlabs po che khur du bzhes/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhes par(1747)sa skyong mi dbang chen po chin lbang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gis rgyal mchog bdun pa rje skal bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba brtse gcig tu btab pas/rgyal mtshan seṅge 'di nyid mdo smad kyi skye dgu'i cod pan du gnang dgos zhes zhu ba nan cher phul par brten/gong sa mchog gis sngar dga' ldan khri ba sa mthar phebs pa'i srol cher med kyang / khyed bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gzhan dang mi 'dra bas khri chen rin po che nyid kyi thugs dgongs dang bstun chog ces bka' bsgos thob/khong nyid rang yul phyogs su chibs sgyur byas pa na/ rgyal mchog bdun pas tham ga gru sgor ma dang bka' shogathugs dam gyi rten mang bo/ dngos rdzas spus legs gya nom rnam grangs stong lhag gi phebs rdzongs gnang ba ma zad/ bod gzhung nas kyang phebs rdzongs bsgrub dgos pa'i bka' bstsal pa ltar bsgrubs/ lo de'i bod zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin khong dang mchod yon gnyis lhan du zhal 'dzoms gnang ste/ chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar tshogs chen 'du khang du phebs/ kun mkhyen sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang bor sku chos sogs phul/ lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gsung gnang zhing / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde dpon tshang la phyag dbang dang dngos chas bstsal/ grwa tshang la dngul ṭam re'i 'gyed — 246 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/btang / rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug(1748)lor stag tshang lha mo'i bla brang gzhi bzung ste/ zla bcu ba'i tshes bdun la bshad grwa btsugs shing dbang lung bka' chos mang du bstsal/ phyi lo sa sbrul nas bzung gtsos sgar lung gis gdan drangs te dge legs rgya mtsho dang rtse thog sku skye gnyis kyis gtsos ser skya drag zhan kun gyis 'dun pa gcig dril gyi sgo nas dgon pa dang tsho ba nyer gcig phul te 'chad nyan gyi bshad grwa 'dzugs dgos zhes zhu ba nan cher phul pa bdag gir bzhes/ rtsi bzhag gis thog drangs 'chad nyan gyi dbu btsugs/rgyud sde ba'i'i lha tshogs rnams kyi rjes gnang / gzungs sngags zab mo rnams kyi lung / bka' bsgo bsrung ba/'pho khrid/ bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor ba sogs kyis rang rang gi rgyud la dkar bo'i dge ba'i sa bon bskrun yul mang du byas/ de nas kyang yul gru mang bos gdan 'dren zhus pa'ang gang la gang mtsham gyi chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/ thugs sras bu slob kyi gras la/ khri chen ngag dbang chos grags dang / khri chen ngag dbang tshul khrims/ rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ brag yer sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/tsha rdor no mon han/ stobs ldan sngags rams pa/ mer rgen rje nam seng ba/ brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab/ khang lung ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ gnyan rtse dpon slob ngag dbang chos 'phel/ tā dbon pa blo bzang seṅge sogs nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang bo byon/ dgung grangs don dgu ba me byi (1756)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su thims pa'i tshul bstan/ gsung rtsom la po ti gcig bzhugs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa khri blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me glang(1757)lor 'bo ra'i khrom thog stag chu'i phan gyi mi khyim sngags chung drung pa bla ma zhes pa'i khyim du yab lcags po byams dang yum lcags mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ drung ba bla ma de skyabs mgon khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes su kha zhe med par dad cing tshad mar 'dzin mkhan yin pas/ snga sor rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i sku brnyan gsar bzhengs bgyis par khri rin po che gdan drangs te rab gnas gnang mthar/ nga la drung ba'i khyim 'di nas khang ba zhig gsar rgyag bya dgos pa'i bka' phab myong / sku bltams ma thag zhabs gnyis dkyil drung bzhugs shing / sku gzan lta bu'i ras srab mo phrag par bkal ba'i rtags ya mtshan byung skad/ lce thog tu'ang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'i ri mo dang / smon mtshams su nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi ri mo bzhad par gleng / chos skyong rgya mtsho'i drung du gtsug phud phul te/ mtshan la blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge gsol/ dge slong blo bzang zhes pa thos bsam klog gi slob dpon du bsten pas dus ma ring bar byams chos sogs chos spyod rnams thugs su chud/ gtsos dga' ldan chos gling du'ang lo re mos phebs pa'i 'dod chos kyis re ba bskangs pa'i lugs mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug thog rje bla ma'i bstod pa mi 'gyur mchog yangs ma'i 'grel ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ nyes gsum pa me phag lor paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa banos te bslab gsum nor bu'i do shal gtsug gi rgyan du mdzes/ nyer drug pa dbus gtsang bstan pa'i 'byung gnas su bskyod de rgyal tshab tsha rdor ngag dbang tshul khrims dang / klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang bcas kyis — 247 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rgyal ba'i dbang bo phyag na pad+mo blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya ma tsho dpal bzang bo'i gser 'al thog mar mjal ba ma zad/ rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho gtsos pa'i rgya' tshab tsha rdor rin po che dang /zung chu ngag dbang bkra shis pa rnams kyi mdun nas bka' pota lnga gtsos gzhung lugs rgya ma tsho sbya ngas/ dgung lo so gnyis pa sa pho spre'u lo mdo smad du chibs kha bsgyur skabs su rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya ma tshos khong la dga' lda na bstan pa'i gsal byed er ti ni paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i cho 'o dang / tham ga bka' shog sku sasung thugs rten sogs gnang ba dpag med bstsal/ gtsos dga' lda na chos gling gis chibs bsu rgya chen dang de nas lha mo'i dgon dang / mdzod dge zam tsha sogs kyi ser skya mang bos dga' bsu rten 'brel spel/ bla brang ngabang ldan lhun po nas bse khri rgan ngag dbang bkra shis pa dang khong gnyis lhan du dbang lung rjes gsum bstsal/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa 'brug lor thengs gnyis pa lha sar 'byor/ rgyal dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho gdan sar gsar du bkod par mjal/ dgung lo nga drug pa phyir mtsho sngon brgyud mdo smad du phebs shing gtsos dga' ldan chos gling du 'byor/ blo bzang rab rgyas gdan sar bkod cing rab byung dang dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang ba'i bla ma mdzad de dbang lung rjes gsu ma dang chos bka' ci rigs gnang / dgon sde che chung mang bor bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa btsugs/ dgung lo go gsum bzhes par gtsos dga' ldan chos gling nas lha mo'i dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub pad dkar grol ba'i gling du phebs/ zla dgu ba'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin me chur gru steng nas phebs te bzhugs sgar btab/ nyin bcu'i ring spyan gnyis gnam mkhar gzigs pa dang thugs dam rtse gcig tu gzhol mthar dgu ba'i nyer gnyis lha babs dus chen yin gsungs te tho rengs kyi dus su bzhugs mal nyid nas sku drang bor bsrangs shing zhabs rdo rje dkyil drung / phyag g.yas pa'i steng phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs bzhin/ zam zhi spros bral ngang 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du re zhig thib pa'i tshul bstan to/ /sku phreng gsum pa khri blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing stag(1854)lor da lta'i gan lho'i kho tsher yab sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ yum jo mo thar gyi sras sam kirti blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku mched du 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtshos mtshan la blo bzang bstan 'dzin zhes gsol/ sa rta(1〈58)lor gtsos dgon dga' ldan chos gling gi bla brang tshoms chen du gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs kyi pad+mor bkod/ bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge zhes gsol/ 'di bas bsdus grwa nas blo rtags sogs tshegs med du mkhyen pas rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la gzhan dring mi 'jog par gyur/ snga phyi rong bo dgon chen dang sku 'bum/ rang dgon sogs chos grwar zhugs te rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod gser gyi yu bar brten nas bslab gsum nyams len dmar ba mdo smad du grags/ dbus gtsang du phebs te jo shāka rnams gtsos pa'i se 'bras dge gsum gyi rten thams cad la mchod 'bul dang / bsngo smon rgya cher bsgrubs/ blo bzang — 248 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dpal ldan grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ ljags rtsom la sems bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga 'don sgrig dang phan yon sogs pota gcig bzhugs/ rje 'di ba dgung lo nyer gsum steng gzugs sku'i bkod pa bas/reb gong gnyan thog tu khong gi sprul sku zhig 'khrungs kyang gdan khrir ma 'byor par dgung lo bzhi'i steng du sku gshegs so/ /khri chen sku phreng bzhi ba rje btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge zhes grags pa'i ba dan dkar bo srid pa'i rtse mo bsnyegs pa'i bdag nyid can de ma dzod dge stod kyi sar nye ba'i sa cha bla ri mgul gyi tsha sgo'i sde ba'i nang tshan/yab rdo rje rnam rgyal dang / yu ma lha mo thar zhes bya ba la rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya bcu gcig pa me glang(1877)lo'i chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por skar ma rgyal gyi nyin skya rengs shar ba'i dus su mngal gyi chu 'dzin mngon par grol/ de ma thag zhabs gnyis dkyil krung ma dzad cing phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag brgya'i stangs ka dang bcas bzhugs pas a ma zhes lan gsum gsungs pas ma ya/ mtshan pa'i gnas la bkod/ de nas kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho dang tshogs gsum rin po che rnam gnyis kyis brtags pa gnang ba lung bstan mthun par byung ste dam pa 'di nyid yang sprul 'phrul med yi na par thag bcad/chu pho rta'i lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi snga dror gtsos dga' ldan chos gling gi bla brang dpal ldan lhun por 'byor phyag phebs nas skyabs mgon gong ma'i mi 'jigs seṅge chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por 'bas g.yas pa'i mthil du dung dkar ri mo mngon ba'in bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan dang dus ston rgyas pa bgyis/ rje blo bzang 'phrin 'a sa bstan pa rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge zhes gsol/ ye shes chos 'dzin zhes pa yongs 'dzin bsten nas thugs 'dzin gyi rim pa mtha' dag la bstun pa lhod med kyis sbyangs par/ brjod bya rjod byed kyi tshig don mtha' dag rdo la ri mo 'bri ba ba'in du mi rjed pa'i gzungs dang spobs pa'i rtogs pa mngon tu gyur/ rje bla ma dang kun mkhyen lnga ba chen po'i sku tshe mdzad pa sogs ji lta ba ba'in 'ong ba'i ltas su mngon/ lcags glang lo'i sa ga zla ba dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par dbus phebs kyi sgar 'bog bstan 'dzin thang du byas/ lha sar 'byor ba na gong sa'i bkod khyab ltar rdo ring shag tu phebs gnang / nyin re bzhin jo shāka rnam gnyis la lha mdzes mar me gdug spos sogs dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod sprin phul te bstan 'gro'i thugs smon rgya cher mdzad pa dang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs su tshogs zhugs/ de nas 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnams par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs te gser gdung chen mos gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la mchod tshogs dang tshogs la dngul ṭam gyi 'gyed phul ba ma zad/ se ra theg chen gling du mang 'gyed dang mchod tshogs phul/ rgyal dbang ngag dbang blo bzung thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gser zhal mjal te nang mdzod lha rdzas sku gsung thugs rten gser sbyang thum bu btegs/yang rje tsha rdor rin po ches mkhas slob sbrags ma dang / cog ru bla ma ngag dbang 'byor ldan pas gsang ston slob dpon mdzad de dge slong gi dngos po bzhes/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che la lha rdzas dngul rta mig — 249 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ma bdun phul/ lha sar bzhugs ring ser skya drag zhan bar ma ci rigs pa zam ma chad par drung du lhags nas lung bstan gang zhus tsham tshom med par bka' lan bstsal pa don du khel pas dad 'gro kun gyis khong la a mdo rgya' ba byams pa zhes bsngags/ de nas slar rang gi gdan sar phyag phebs/ dgung grangs nye brgyad pa khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug gi lo snron zla'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum par da cha kha gya'i gter bton gyi ri khrod du cis kyang 'gro dgos gsungs shing der phebs nas tshes bcu bzhi'i tho rengs kyis dus su sku dngos kyi gdul bya re zhig rdzogs so/ /sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang thub bstan dpal ldan seṅge / rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing sbrul(190 5)lor bla ru mgul du sku 'khrungs / dgung lo lnga bzhes thog gtsos dga' ldan chos gling gi gdan sar bkod de bse blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho las rab tu byung 'ing dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma lan kro'ur phebs skabs dge slong gi dngos po bsgrubs/ paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang dpal ldan yongs 'dzin du bsten nas bka' poṭa lnga la sbyangs pa mdzad/ rang dgon sras mkhar dgu thog zhig gsos mdzad pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten ma/nga du bzhengs/ lcags ri'i mtha' skor du ma ṇi dung phyur mang po'i 'khor lo bzhengs pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'don chog gi brgyud pa spel/ lo re bzhin sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu ba'i'i smyung gnas pa stong phrag drug bdun nye ba la bka' chos 'chad pa dang / gung tshugs 'dren pa/ bco lnga'i nyin rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje ji lta ba bzhin ma ṇi'i mgur dbyangs gdangs ring bo 'then nas dad ldan tham sa cad la tshe 'di'i snang shas bzlog pa thar ba'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ phyis su skya sar log nas dgon zung du bzhugs/ dgon pa skyong khur gtso bo phyag ma dzod (dbon po) la gtad/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar 'khrab ston thugs skyong gnang ba dang chos srid kyi 'brel ba rgyun ldan du gnas pa'i skul ma dus rgyun du btang / dgung lo re bzhi ba la kun su'u an zhir btson bzhugs skabs su glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs pas rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa lug ( 1979)lor gdung sku dgon nang phyir drangs pa'i tshems bzang du 'phel gdung rang byon grub pa dad ldan mi nyung bas mngon sum du mthong bar gyur to/ /'khor lo gcig gi chos thog dang tshogs 'don gyi skor la/ hor zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i dus chen dang sha 'cham/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag 'jug gos sku/ gar 'cham/ me tog mchod mjal/ byams pa gling skor/ zla gnyis par dpyid chos chen mo'i skabs su dpe khrid dang dpe gzigs 'dzin grwa gong 'og gi rtsod rgyugs/ zla gsum par dus bzang gi 'jug bsdu ba dang / dpyid chos bar ba'i nang 'dzin grwa gong 'og rtsod grwa gtug rgyu'i la rgya che ba'i phyag srol yod/ sa ga zla bar sngon rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje mchog 'tsho bzhugs skabs btsugs pa'i bzhi ba'i smyung gnas zhes dge rtsa byed pa'i thugs bskyed dang bsngo smon mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas byang chub mchog gi sa bon bskrun/ zla lnga bar dbyar chos chen mo zla gcig ring la brtsi bzhag gi blor rgyugs dang rgyan 'jug chos spyod mgon chos sogs dang / zhal ngo — 250 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsar zhugs mdzad de sgrig lam kun spyod phyogs gang thad kyi phyag srol khur du bzhes/ zla drug par ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin ba'i dang / rigs grwa'i gtor chen/ zla bdun par shog pa'i tshogs dang gung tshugs la tshogs langs/ brgyad pa'i tshes gcig par du dbyar dgas dbye gso sbyong gsum shin tu dam par mdzad/ zla brgyad pa'i ston chos chen mor rtsod rgyugs dang 'dzin grwa gong 'og phan tshun dam bca' 'jog res te rnam dpyod rtsal gyis nyams su len pa/ dgu ba'i tshes gcig dus bzang rgyas pa mjug bsdu bar rgyun 'khyongs/zla dgu bar sa dkar chos thog la sa rtsi kun gyis gtong ba'i phyag srol ma nyams par las sne lta rtogs dang gtsang sbra'i rgyun sro' khur len ma zad/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge mchog gi gdung mchod la bla ma mchod pa/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ chos spyod/ rgyan 'jug gling me sogs mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba dang / lha babs dus chen du yang mchod pa'i bye brag gi bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ zla bcu bar skyor sbyangs dang dam bca' bcas 'dzin skyong dang dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i tshogs chos grwa dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ chos spyod/ rgyan 'jug gling me sogs rje bla ma 'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i thabs la 'dun pa rtse gcig tu 'bad/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos chen mo zla chos gcig gi ring la rtsod rgyugs dang lha rams pa'i dam bca' dang / zhor du 'cham gshar sbyangs bya ste/ lo rnying nang 'cham rgyugs dang chos thog gi mjug bsdu/lo rnying bgegs gtor chen mo nyin lnga'i bar du tshogs 'cham dang bgegs gtor drug cu ba sogs rim gro/chos rgyal gyi lcags mkhar dang khyad ma mchis pa'i zor 'phen bgyis pa'i bskal 'phrin gang rgyas kyi gdangs dbyangs snyan pos 'tsham par gegs med du bsgrubs/ zla rer tshes bcu'i bdag 'jug dang / mgon po'i gtor sgrub/ gur gyi dgra chos/ gang babs kyi chos 'phrin mtha' dag rgyun ldan du bsgrubs so/ /chos sde 'dir 'dzin grwa dgu yod de/ bka' rams pa dang / ma/dzod/ dbu ma/ phar phyin/gzhung / rtags rigs/ bsdus chen/ bsdus chung / kha dog dkar dmar tshang ma rgyud nas tshad ma rig pa la sbyangs rjes lha rams dam bca' 'jog pa dang / lha rams pa'i mtshan rtags thob nas kha gya'i sgar sar gyi khri ba dang / sog tshang dgon pa'i khri ba lo gsum/ rang dgon gyi khri ba lo gsum bcas mthar khri gdan zur gyi go gnas thob/ sde 'di'i khri chen sku phreng rim byon gyi thugs kyi bzhed don gtso bo chos 'chad nyan/bslab pa slob gnyer/ 'dzin gshar sbyong / rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pas 'dzin grwa gtugs te rtsod rgyugs dang / rigs grwa'i tshogs langs/ skyor sbyong / tshogs rgyugs/ mtshan phud/phar phyin ston mo'i dam bca'/ smon lam rab 'byams pa'i dam bca' bcas bka' poṭa lnga la nyams len phyag rgyun ltar bslab ston gzhir bcas rang gzhan kun gyi tshogs gnyis bsags te sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum la bag chags bzang bo 'jog pa'i go bskal thob po/ /sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs can la/ sku'i rten la tshogs chen 'du khang du rten gtso 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs byin can/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku li ma/ rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje mchog gi phyag — 251 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bzo rje yab sras 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ dam can chos kyi rgyal bo rang byon/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor sogs sku gsung thugs rten gyan thang dang thang ga mi nyung ba dang byams khang du rje btsun byams pa nyis thog can/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ sgrol ma stong sku/ rab gsal du 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i blos bslangs/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ gnas brtan bcu drug rje stong sku/ tsong kha brgyad bcu sogs 'khrungs rabs kyi gyan thang bcas bzhugs/ jo khang chen mor tsan dan las grub pa'i jo bo me thar ma gtsos pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku sogs dang / sras mkhar dgu thog gi skor gleng pas na rje btsun mi la 'i thugs sprul du grags pa'i bshes gnyen blo bzang dar rgyas sam chos dbyings rdo rje de nyid gtsos yu la gyi bya skor grong du 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga bar dgon pa'i tshogs chen khri rin po che las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la blo bzang dar rgyas zhes btags/ bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas kyi sku drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ yum lo drug cu re lnga son rjes dge bsnyen gyi tshul khrims bzung nas ma bu dbus gtsang phyogs su mjal skor phebs/ lho brag sgra bsgyur mar ba rin po che gzim phug ste rje ri la'i sras mkhar bcas mjal ba'i rkyen gyis mi rtag rgyud bskul sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i skyo ba drag pos gdung / gnas dang sgrub phug drod ma yal ba thams cad mjal skabs spyan chab 'khrugs cing sku lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba'i mos gus bcos min du thob/ lo gsu ma gyi ring la gnas mjal bgyis rjes rang yu la du byon/tshogs gsum sgrub sde bde ldan g.yas 'khyil du phyin pas tshe rabs nas chos 'brel zab pa'i rigs kyi bdag po rje bla ma tshogs gsum rin po che dpal bzang bo'i gser zhal mjal/ sngar chung ngu'i dus nas khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge / chos rje sa skya'i mkhan rin po che/ bse sku zhogs/ bka' drin gsum ldan skyabs rje tshogs gsum rin po che sogs kyi drung nas sa dge rnying gsum gyi dbang lung khrid gsum mang du thob/ sras mkhar gnyis pa grags pa'i mthong grol lha khang chen mo dgu thog gis bzo bkod bya dka' la thabs sna tshogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'char sgo bsten nas rje mi la'i sras mkhar brtsigs pa'i rtsol sgrub don ldan du grub/ lha khang gi stong 'og bar gsum kun tu rgyal kun 'dus zhal rje mi la'i sku 'bum rten 'brel 'phro can du bzhugs pa de rten gyi snying bor dril te bzhugs su gsol ba'i rtse thog tu/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud rim te lo na ro ba dang / rje sgra bsgyur yab sras kyi sku brnyan la ye shes pa phebs pa'i byin rlabs dad pa'i sa bon thebs pa'i rten du byon te/ rje mi la'i snang brnyan sngon nyams snang la mjal ba'i sku bkod ltar bzhengs skabs 'du byed kyi rkyen tsam las sku stod rang babs su byon pa mthong grol gyi rten skal du gyur/ gdul byed blo dang 'tsham par rje btsun gyis sprul bsgyur sna tshogs pa'i rnam thar zhal thang sogs dang /'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dgongs bcud/ rgyud lung man ngag sde gsum klong dgu'i bka' gter dag snang yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum gtso 'khor gyi snang brnyan/ dbu ma chen po'i bka' babs rje bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag — 252 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/nyams med dī paṃ ka ra yab sras/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi man ngag gab pa mngon byang gi bstan pa dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mnga' bdag rje btsun tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa yab sras/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi 'dren mchog lnga ba rje btsun byams pa lung ston sogs kyi rten gtso rnams grub mtha'i kha 'dzin phyogs lhung gi gdon gyis ma sbags par tshul mthun du bzhengs pa dang / gnod sbyin tse'u dmar mched bdun dang / jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga gnyer du gtad de lha khang gi steng 'og bar gsum tsag sgra dang thig chom sogs thos tshor du gyur pa srung ma mgon po'i cho 'phrul du nges so/ /bla ma rje btsun pa dang sang sang rin po che'i slob bu gsang bdab zer bas dgu thog gi rtse mthar lcags thag khor mo yug tu 'gel bar bgyis/ 'gro ba'i mchod sdong chen mo'i mtha' bskor du mchod rten chig stong lnga brgya phreng bstar du bzhugs so/ / sku gdung lha khang du bzhugs pa'i khri chen sku phreng rnam pa gsum gyi ring bsrel byin can gyis gtsos sangs rgyas stong sku/ gser khang chen mor byams sku nyis thog gi tshad can dang / dus gsu ma sangs rgyas kyi lha khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas dang rten byin can mang bo bzhugs/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i lha khang du 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ dbyangs can ma'i sku/ thang sto nga rgyal bo'i lha khang du thang stong rgyal bo dang / rje yab sras/ slob dpon pad+ma'i li sku byin can/ rje stong sku bcas bzhugs/ rta mgrin lha khang du yang gas nga 'phros lha dgu'i sku dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs bzhugs/mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang du rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa gtsor bzhugs kyis byin rten mang bo bzhugs/ zhabs brtan lha khang du sgrol ma dang / mi g.yo ba/ phyag rdor gyi sku/ tshoms chen du grub chen thang stong rgyal bo dang / rje stong sku bcas/ mgon khang chen mor sde 'di'i srung ma'i gtso bo chos skyong rdo rje gur mgon dang 'al bzhi ba/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma / mgon chos lnga/ ga'an yang thub sku/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku dang / gu ru rdo rje gro lod sogs dang / sngags pa'i phur bu bcas/ yang na lha mo'i mgon khang / dzam khang bcas mang bo bzhengs so/ /gsung gi rten la chos sde 'di'i lha khang phal cher gyi nang du co ne bka' bsta na 'gyur bzhugs pa dang / rje yab sras kyi gsu nga 'bum/ rgya gar paṇa grub dang mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi mkhas grub mang bo'i gsung 'bum bzhugs shing / khri chen sku phreng ba'i'i gsung 'bum/ mkhas grags a brtan gyi gsung 'bum/ khri chen sku phreng gi rnam thar nyi 'od dang / bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas kyi rnam thar/ bla ma ma tshams pa'am rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje mchog gi rnam thar bcas dang / rnam thar 'di dag gi par shing bcas bzhugs/ yang na rje btsun pa'i mtha' dpyod dang ma dzod/ rgyan 'jug don bdun cu/ sa lam/bse bsdus/ gzhi gsum gsal byed/ chos spyod yongs rdzogs/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ mgon chos lnga'i gter chog gser 'od sa bcu ma/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ pad+ma bka' thang rgyas bsdus/ bla ma mchod pa/ dbyangs can dgyes glu/ sgra gzhung / sa ris kyi skor/ sku rim rnam gsum bcas par shing mi nyung ba dang dkon po mang bo bzhugs/ gzhan yang dgon pa'i mtha' skor du bka' 'gyur ma ṇi dang /— 253 —

rin lho bod rigs rang sbyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi khongs lam rim/ gu ru sid+dhā / serge sgra bcas kyi 'khor chen bzhi dang / chos kyi 'khor 'o gun ri ga su ma brgya dang ba'i bcu bzhugs so/ /thugs kyi rten la dgon pa'i lho nub mtshams su dbyen 'dum mchod rten dang / de'i g.yon du bdud 'dul mchod rten shin tu che ba gnyis/ byang shar mtshams su mchod rten chen po rten bzhugs su mchod rten chung ngu 'bum phrag bzhugs pa sogs dang / nang chen khag dang grwa shag gi lha rten chos gsu/ma brjod kyis mi long ngo / /chos sde 'dir lung dang rtogs pa'i bang mdzod 'dzin pa dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med pa khri chen sku phreng rim byon dang / 'be shes rab mchog ldan/ gser khri a brtan/ rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje sogs dam pa du ma byon/ de yang sde 'di'i gtsug lag khang ni/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang / jo khang chen mo/ mthong grol sku thog chen mo/ gser khang chen mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i lha khang / mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang / sku gdung lha khang / rta mgrin lha khang / mgon khang chen mo/ zhabs brtan lha khang / rtse gur mgon lha khang dang / gser khri'i nang chen gyi lha mo khang /tshoms chen/ chos ra chen mo/ par khang chen mo bcas thun mong rtsig bkod shin tu rgyas/ gser khri'i bla brang dpal lda na lhun pos gtsos pa'i nang chen shar bla brang / kirti bla brang / bse bla brang / be ru bla brang /mkhan po bla brang / 'gyang ro bla brang / mtshams pa ba'i bla brang / g.yu tsha bla brang bcas nang khag che ba brgyad/ bstan 'dzin tshang / chos 'dzin tshang / gser mgo tshang / sog tsha tshang / dung phrug tshang /mu to tshang(mu to gzhan par 'brel med) mar sne bkra shis rgya mtsho tshang / bo'u(sbrul)smad tshems dkar tshang /khe ta tshang / sgo rdzong tshang bcas nang khag chung shas bcu ste bla sprul che chung bco brgyad zer/ bla sprul phal cher sde 'dir rgyun bzhugs dang / kha shas rang rang gi gdan sar bzhugs na'ang sde 'dir spyan skyong rtag tu gnang / sngon dge 'dun stong phrag 'dus pa'i chos sde chen po dang rim gyis nyams rgud byung bas rab byung bcu drug pa'i mjug tu/ dge 'dun pa zhal grangs lnga brgya yas mas dang / grwa shag kyang sum brgya lhag mchis so/ /chos sde chen mo gtsos dga' ldan chos gling 'di rab byung bcu ba'i sa lug( 1619)lo nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i me lug(1967)lo bar skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyis yun ring bskrun pa'i thugs smon ba'in sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che cha tshang la ma nor ba rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang nyams bzhes chad med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzad/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs rtsig rdo gcig kyang shul du ma lus par sa gzhi bde bar bsnyoms te rgya grong dang las khungs kyi gzhis chags/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa rta lo nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs dad mos kyi srid jus dngos su bab ste/ dgon pa nyams gso la/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i skyes rabs sku phreng drug pa bse sprul rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog gis skyong khur mdzad/ thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis pa nas sku — 254 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/phreng du ma'i ring gtsos gser khri rnam gnyis dang phan tshun chos kyi 'brel zab lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba'i thugs gnang gshin po'i bla slob tshad ldan du gyur gshis/ de ltar thugs rje 'dod med kyi klong nas pha nor bu la bstsal ba'in deng gi dus 'dir 'jam mgon rgyal ba ring lugs 'dzin tshul/ 'chad pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i yon tan/ rtsod ngag rdo rje'i thogs mda' mi 'jig dam bca' bzhi ldan/ rtsom 'bri dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa/ nyes ltung dri ma bral ba'i brtul zhugs brtan pas btsun pa/ bdag las gzhan gces pa'i lhag bsam bzang po'i rtsa lag lha bcas skye dgu'i phan bde'i legs tshogs kyi nyer 'tsho chen po tshad ldan bla ma dam pa nyid la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten te/gtsos dga' ldan chos gling gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa la rgya bal dbus gtsang dang / rgya nag mdo smad sogs kyi gnas khyad par can gyi rten 'gangs chen dang /gzungs gzhug la mchog tu sngags pa'i gsang ba ring bsrel dang / gzungs ring / nye ba'i snying bo/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi nye brgyud dang ring brgyud gnyis ga'i mtshan sngags/ yi dam mang bo'i snying bo nye ba'i rtsa sngags mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'gangs chen mang bo las sman sku dang / lha shing gi sku/ li ma sogs rgyal ba'i sku brnyan mi nyung ba la gzungs gzhug rab gnas sogs bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi phyag ltar du bsgrubs/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang / mthong grol sras mkhar dgu thog chen mo/ mgon khang chen mo bcas kyi nang byin rten bsrel ba'i rgyu phun tshogs las gus ldan gdul bya yongs kyi mchod pa'i rten du go rim bzhin bzhugs pa'i yas mas kyi gzungs gzhug gi bar stong rnams dri bzang sna tshogs pas khengs par byas shing / snga phyi bar gsum rab tu gnas pa sogs tshul ldan gyis bsgrub par bgyis pa'i lung rtogs mkha' nor dag gi yon tan gyi gzi byin lhun grub tu chags/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing phag lo'i zla dgu ba'i tshes gsum nyin kun mkhyen drug pa sku dngos sde 'dir phebs nas sras mkhar dgu thog mthong grol lha khang chen mo'i nang du bse rdo rje 'chang dang rnam gnyis gtsos grub chen be ru mchog gi yang sprul thugs thag bcad cing /dgu ba'i nyer gnyis lha babs dus chen la bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas pas tshogs chen 'du khang gi khri la 'bas zung bkod de tshogs gleng dang brtan bzhugs phul te rten 'brel rang 'grig tu song ba skye bo'i tshogs spro ba dang rjes su yi rangs par gyur/ de ba'in bse bla ma nyid kyi sku drin las sku gsung thugs rten gsar du bzhengs pa dang / tshogs chen 'du khang gsar bzheng skabs su rje yab sras dang / 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad grub 'phral/19rnga 2lor kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams can mkhyen pa mchog gis rab gnas dang spyan 'dren khrus gsol mdzad de/ thugs dgongs rnam par dag pas mthong grol dgu thog chen mo 'di bskyar du bzhengs rgyu'i thugs bkod gnang zhing / na bza' byin rten gnang sbyin bstsal pa dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs sngags sogs lung rjes mang bo'i bka' drin thob/ kun gzigs paṇa chen khong dang kun mkhyen rin po che dang gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ bse mchog sprul rin po che rnam pa bzhi dus gcig tu — 255 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi longs/chos sde 'dir lhan 'dzoms byung / thub sku byin rlabs can gyi gzungs gzhug la sangs rgyas 'od srung gi tshems gdung bzhugs pa'i rten gsum/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sku dang / sman bla/ tshe dpag med/byams pa/ sgro' ma/ gser khri sku phreng lnga ba'i sku gdung dngul gyi mchod rten/ phri chen sku phreng rim byon lhan gcig tu bzhengs pa'i sku gdung mchod rten/ tsong kha brgyad bcu'i 'gel thang dang / khri chen sku phreng rim byon gyi 9rekhrungs rabs gyan thang / mgon chos lnga 'i rgyan thang / rgyal chen ba'i dang / kun bzang 'khor lo sogs kyi sdebs ris bzhugs/ rtse thog mgon khang chen mo gsar bzhengs grub rjes lo de'i lha babs dus chen gyi zhogs par srung ma rdo rje gur mgon spyan 'dren zhus te khang bzang du bzhugs su gsol pas thig sgra dang rnga sgra'i ldir sgra byung / 'al bzhi ba dang mgon chos lnga k+ṣe tra ba sogs bzhugs/ bse rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa ltar 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma rang byon gyi tshul du bzhugs pa dang / rta ma grin/ slo ba dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ phyag rdor 'khor chen sogs sku dngos kyis gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas gnang ste snod bcud kyi legs tshogs rdzogs lda na dpal mo'i dus kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i thugs smon rlabs chen ma dzad pa dang /sde 'di'i 'chad nyan la bse rdo rje 'chang gis ched mngags gnang ba'i nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo gsal rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me sbrul lo nas grwa rgyun rnying pa dang gsar zhugs pa rnams la/ thugs rje gzigs skyong chen pos dam pa'i chos la nyams len snying bor byed pa'i bslab bya snying gi thig ler 'god pa'i 'chad nyan rgya cher gnang zhing gsung 'bum pota gnyis brtsams / sde nyid kyi 'tsho bzhugs pa bla sprul sog tshang sku phreng lnga ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis lo du mar mdo sngags rig gnas bcas gsan sbyong mdzad pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i do dam las sne'i 'gan bzhes shing bse bla mar gzhogs 'degs sgos thub bstan 'dzin skyong spel gsum la mu mthud rem pa dang / 'dul 'dzin pa chen po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin zhes da lta'i gsar slob ma nga bor 'don rta dbyangs dang brtsi bzhag gi bsdus grwa nas mtshan nyid kyis gzhung 'chad pa dang rtsod pa rgyun bsrings pas 'dzin grwa dma' rim nas gong rim par rtsod pa'i rigs lam brdar sha chod cing dmar ba'i mdzad rjes bla sprul kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa dang / da lta be ru sprul sku drug pa legs bshad rgya mtsho mdzod dge ru stod mar 'khrungs pa 'di'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs so/ /dge slong bstan 'dzin dar rgyas rab rgyal sa glang ba ni/ lo na chung dus nas dge tshul slong gi sdom pas bcas mtshams mtha' dag phra zhing zhib par bsrungs shing / bslab khrims la nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos par dge sbyong la spro ba che la rang lo bco brgyad nas bzung dge slong tshad ldan gyi sgo nas sha dang / sgog tsong sogs grib zas thams cad dang dad rdzas/ gshin rdzas/ dalor zas gtan du spangs/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i cho ga bum sgrub gzungs mchog rtsod pa rgyun bzhin gnang ste smyung gnas stong phrag gcig bzhugs nas nangs nub thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor g.yel bar mthar phyin mdzad pa dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen mtshams la sngon 'gro'i phyag mchod maṇ+ḍal sogs legs tshogs grub cing bsnyen mtshams dngos gzhi dang / sbyin sreg bcas lo — 256 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsum bzhugs/ mu mthud du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dag tshar gsum bklags pa de nas ma ṇi dung phyur bsgrubs pas ril bu bum par byur bur gang ba'i ngo mtshar byung / da dung gshegs lha so lnga bsgrub pa'i thun mtshams la bzhugs so/ / dge bshes blo bzang shes rab kyis gtsos sras mkhar dgu thog bskyar bzheng gi las 'gan phrag tu ba zhes/ sras mkhar rmang gtong nyin nas rten dang brten pa yongs su bzhengs grub dang / mu mthud bdag gnyer do dam sogs kyi thad du 'bad brtson byas so/ /de bzhin du sras mkhar dgu thog mthong grol lha khang chen mo bskyar bzheng gong rim gyi chog mchan thob pa dang / bse mchog sprul la sa 'brug ( 1988 ) lor rje mi la yab sras kyi lung bstan sbas ma ngon brda chos ci rigs su bstan pa ltar/ lha khang gi sa brko bar sngon ma'i mkhar shul btsal kyang ma rnyed pa'i skabs su glo bur du kha char babs pas phyogs ston lta bur sngon ma'i rtsig shul rang byung du brdol/ da ba sras mkhar dgu thog ces pa bzo bkod kyi rtsol sgrub don ldan du grub/ kun mkhyen drug pas dmangs sgor khri phrag lhag dang nang rten 'ga'/ khri chen gung thang rin po che 'al snga nas bdag rkyen sbam mtho ba gnang tshe mkhar rnga'i sgra rang ldir byung ba skya ser kun gyis thos / gser gyi rgya phibs bzheng bar ma rtsa dmangs sgor khri phrag bcu gnang / rgya gar 'phags pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang chos sde 'ga'i snyan lam du gsan phyin rten dang na bza' 'gangs chen sogs bskur gnang mdzad/ lha sa dang / pe cin/ mtsho sngon/ si khron/ nang sog bcas bod sog rgya gsum yu la gang mang nas ma bskul dang len gyi sgo nas zhal 'debs phul/ sa khul rang gi bod rigs kyi lag rtsal ba'i las grwa tshugs pa dang bse bla ma'i bka' sgrub pa dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan/gtsos lung ba'i rgan sems shes/ las sne la grong tsho bdun bcu lhag gi dad ldan skya ser gyis rten dang brten pa thams cad skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bskrun/ lha khang chen mo'i tshigs thog re rer bzhugs pa'i rten gyi rim pa ngo sprad na 'di lta ste/tshigs gting ma'am dang bo'i dbus su rten gtso lung ston byams pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du nye sras 'jam dbyangs dang / phyag rdor/ dbus gral du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje mi la ras pa/ston pa shākya thub pa/ sman bla/ sgrol dkar/ rnam rgyal ma/ tshe dpag med/ zhal shar gzigs su grub thab nyi ma 'dzin/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ grub chen mda' 'phyar ba/ gtsang smyon he ru ga grub chen thang stong rgyal bo/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma bcas/ dbus gral g.yon du gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong / sgrol ljang / yum sher phyin ma/ jo bo shākya mu ne/ seṅge sgra/ zhal nub gzigs su rigs ldan nyer lnga ba drag po'i 'khor lo can/ bod rgyal so gsum pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/rgya bza' dang bal bza'/ bod kyi rgyal rabs dang po gnya' khri btsan po/ rgyal rabs so bdun pa khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom can/ rgyal rabs so brgyad pa chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ rgyal rabs zhe gcig pa mnga' bdag khri ral ba can/ thon mi sam bho ṭa bcas dang / gur lha brgyad/ chos rgyal nang sgrub/— 257 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/seng gdong ma gsum gyi rgyan thang bcas bzhugs so/ /tshigs gnyis pa'i dkyil dbus su rten gtso zhwa ser grub sde'i mes po 'jam mgon bla ma shar tsong ba blo bzang grags pa/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje/ rje shes rab seṅge / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje dge 'dun grub/ rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen sku phreng ba'i ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba rje btsun blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rje grags pa 'jam dpal chos bzang ngam bla ma 'jam dkar ba/ gnas brtan bzang skyong ba/gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan/ gnas bstan byang seng ba/ rje shes rab grags/ rje 'jam dpal bkra shis/ bshes gnyen dpal skyong ba ste 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab ste jo 'brom yab sras/ po to ba rin chen gsal/spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ rgyal sras phu chung ba ste bka' gdams sku mched gsum/ gtsang pa rab gsal/g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya ste bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ paṇa chen shākya shri/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan te sa chen gong ma rnam lnga dang 'gro mgon phyag na/ zhal shar gzigs su khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge / khri chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge / khri chen blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge / khri chen blo bzang dpal ldan seṅge / khri chen blo bzang thub bstan dpal ldan seṅge ste khri chen sku phreng rim byon/ mdzod pa a brtan bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rong bo shar grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho/ a rol sku phreng gsum pa rje blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ rong bo shar sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho/kirti bstan pa rab rgyas/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las/ zhal nub gzigs su kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/ khri chen gung thang sku phreng drug pa rje bstan pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis/ bsre sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ bse sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas/ bse sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ bse sku 'phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje ste sku phreng rim byon/ sngon ma'i sras mkhar dgu thog bzheng bo rje mi la ras pa'i rnam sprul grub chen chos dbyings rdo rje/ 'be shes rab mchog ldan/ tshogs gsum bla ma rin po che/ bshes gnyen sman rams pa blo bzang bstan pa/ kirti bshes gnyen blo gsal rgya mtsho sogs ri bo dge ldan pa dang / bka' gdams pa/ sa skya ba'i grub mtha'i srol 'byed dngos brgyud kyi bla ma dang bshes gnyen sogs kyi 'dra sku bzhugs/ gsung rten/— 258 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bka' bstan rin po che gtsos gsung 'bum sna tshogs pota lnga brgya lhag bzhugs/ thugs rten mchod rten rnam brgyad/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod dang mi 'khrugs pa'i 'ing bkod bcas bzhugs so/ tshigs gsum par rten gtso slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan te bod kyi mkhan slob chos gsum/ lha lcam man dha ra ba/ lha mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gu ru shākya seṅge /gu ru blo ldan mchog sred/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer/ gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha/ gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ gu ru pad+ma rgyal bo/ gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs/ gu ru rdo rje gro 'od de gu ru mtshan brgyad/ lo tsā ba be ro tsa na/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ bi ma mi tra/ gter bdag gling ba 'gyur med rdo rje/ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'phrin las/'jigs med gling ba/ klong chen rab 'byams pa/ smin gling gter chen/ rta mgrin yang gsang / rdo rje phur ba sogs rnying ma brgyud pa'i bla ma dang yi dam gyi sku brnyan dang / zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod/bka' brgyad kyi rgyan thang bcas bzhugs so/ /tshigs bzhi bar 'jam dbyangs/ thugs rje chen po/ gsang ba'i bdag po ste rigs gsum mgon po/ rnam snang mngon byang / kun rig rdor dbyings/ 'od dpag med/ so sor 'brang ma/ don yod zhags pa so gas gsang sngags rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lha tshogs dang /'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon phyogs glang / dpal ldan chos grags te 'phags yu la paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku brnyan dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gnas brtan bcu drug bcas bzhugs so/tshigs lnga bar lha khang chen mo 'di'i spyi'i rten gtso/ dbus nas spyan drangs pa'i rje sgra sgyur mar ba chos kyi blo gros/ rje mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ sras dar ma mdo sde/ yum bdag med ma/mar ba'i thugs sras mes ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rngogs ston chos sku rdo rje/ ras chung ba rdo rje grags/ras pa 'i ba 'od/ ngan rdzong ras pa/ 'bri sgom ras pa/ se pan ras pa/ khyi ra ras pa/ ra rdzi ras pa/bde skyong ras pa ste mi la'i thugs sras ras pa brgyad/ mkhas grub khyung bo rnal 'byor/ rje garma dus gsum mkhyen pa/ rje phag mo gru ba rdo rje rgyal bo/ rtogs ldan dar ma dbang phyug zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ stag lung thang ba bkra shis dpal/ grub chen gling ras pa pad+ma rdo rje/ chos rje gtsang ba rgya ras/ mtshur phu garma ba/ rje rgod tshang pa/ dwags po sgom tshul sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi 'dra sku dang / rje mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyan thang dang bo dang gnyis pa 〈co ne lha ris pa mgon po 'phrin las kyis bzhengs pa) bcas bzhugs so/ /tshigs drug par gtso sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ bde mchoga'ajigs byed/ kye rdo rje/ bdag med lha mo/ ma hā ma ya/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ ye shes dbang phyugagur rigs bsdus sogs rngog dkyil bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang bla med kyi yi dam skor/ nye sras brgyad kyi nang tshan sa'i snying bo/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ nam mkha'i snying bo/ kun tu bzang bo rnams kyi sku brnyan dang / rje mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi gyan thang gsum pa dang bzhi ba (reb gong lha ris pas bzhengs pa) bcas bzhugs so/ /tshigs bdun par gtso sku rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / grub chen te lo ba/ paṇa chen nā ro — 259 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs / — ——ba/ rgyal bo en+d+ra bhu ti/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ grub chen li u pa/ grub chen dril bu ba/ grub chen nag po spyod pa/grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ grub chen dza la ṅgār/ gsang ba pa/ mnga' bdag mai dri ba/ grub chen ṭo bhi ba/ rus sbal zhabs/ grub chen rnam rgyal zhabs sogs bde gsang 'jigs kye ba'i'i bla ma brgyud pa'i 'dra sku dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang / gsang bdag 'khor chen gnyis kyis gyan thang bcas bzhugs so/ / tshigs brgyad par gtso sku mi skyod pa/ rnam snang / rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub ste rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya thub pa/ srid gsum dbang bsdud lha mo rigs byed ma/ khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba sngon po/ nye sras nang tshan spyan ras gzigs dang / byams pa'i sku brnyan/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad dang / gshegs lha so lnga'i rgyan thang bcas bzhugs pa dang / tshigs dgu ba'i dbus su kyai rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan thang sogs bzhugs so/ /tshigs gsum pa nas brgyad pa'i bar gyi sku brnyan thams cad lha shing la brkos pa sha stag yin 'ing /g.yas g.yon gyi dra mig kun tu rje mi la ras pa'i sku brnyan khru tshad ma chig stong nyer lnga/ ston pa'i sku brnyan khru tshad ma sum cu lhag bzhugs/ lha khang chen mo'i sgo khyams g.yas kyi sras mkhar lha khang gi srung ma'i gtso bo bstan ma khang du tshe ring ma gtso byas pa'i tshe ring mched lnga dang / bka' srung gnod sbyin tse'u dmar gyi sku brnyan/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi bris 'bur bcas bzhugs/ sgo khyams g.yon gyi dzam khang du dzam dmar gtso byas pa'i dzam lha rigs lnga'i sku brnyan/ phongs sel sgrol ma dang nor rgyun ma bris 'bur/ sgo'i logs g.yas g.yon du rgyal chen bzhi'i gyan thang bzhengs/ spyir rje mi la ras pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa gtso byas pa'i ris su ma chad pa'i nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' so so'i srol 'byed kyi bla ma dang / kyai rdor gtso byas gsang sngags brgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gyi lha sna tshogs/ da dung sangs rgyas dang / byang sems/ chos skyong / dzam lha/ gnod sbyin sogs kyi sku brnyan rigs mi 'dra ba nyis brgya bco lnga dang / mi la'i stong sku chung ba bcas khyon bsdoms chig stong nyis brgya bdun cu bzhugs/ rtsig pa nang ma'i mthar skor du zangs las grub pa'i dam chos 'khor chen brgya dang sum cu/ phyi'i lcags ri'i mtha' skor so phag las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rten khru do tshad can chig stong lnga brgya bzhugs/ rtsig bkod steng du zangs gser gyi rgya phibs nyis brtsegs/ gser tog gsum/ rgyal mtshan bzhi/ ri dwags pho mo/ chos 'khor gsum/ rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon pa'i spen rgyan bcu drug lha khang spyi'i rgya khyon spyi khru bzhi stong brgya dang bco brgyad/ mtho tshad spyi khru bzhi bcu lhag bcas bzhengs so/ /de ltar(1994)rab byung bcu drug shing khyi lo'i zla dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi chos lugs cus kyi sku tshab dang / kun su'u zhing chen mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang / kun lho khul srid gzhung gi 'go khrid dang 'brel yod sde khag bcas kyi mi sna/ lha sa da 260 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang / mtsho sngon/ si khron bcas kyi 'brel yod sku mgron/ gung thang thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gis tshogs chen gyi gtso 'gan bzhes shing bse mchog sprul rin po che nas sras mkhar dgu thog mthong grol lha khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs legs grub kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'phar rab tu phye/ mjal ba khri phrags 'tshogs pa thams cad kyi rgyud la thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun te/mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel tshad don lda na mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma yab sras chos dang zang zing gang 'tsham lhun grub gzhan don gyi mdzad pas rten 'brel gdul bya mtha' dag 'phral yun gyi gdung ba las bskyabs pa dang / phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa'i ga'al du med pa'i bka' drin brjod las 'das par gyur/ bse rin po che sku dngos kyis lung ston byams pa gtso sku bzhugs pa'i gos sku che ba zhig gnang skyes kyi bka' drin bstsal pa la gung thang rin po che khong rnam gnyis kyis rab gnas dang mchod tshogs phul par nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las 'ja' tshon shar ba ni dam pa'i rang bzhin ngang gis gsal bar mngon no/ /da dung dgon pa'i rten bzhugs gsar ba'i gras su gsu nga gi rten las par shing gi skor la/ rtsi bzhag gi skor nyung shas dang / dbyangs can dgyes glu/ pad+ma bka' thang / gser 'od sa bcu ma/ thar mdo/bkra shis brtsegs pa/ chos spyod kyi skor la mgon chos lnga'i skor dang / kun rig rgyan 'jug smon lam rnam lnga sogs bsgrugs/ thugs kyi rten la dgon pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su byang chub mchod rten chen mo bzhengs/ grwa tshang gi 'don cha'i sgrig rim ni sngon gyi phyag srol ma nyams pa rgyun 'khyongs te/ 'dzin grwa yang sngon gyi gong rim dgu yod/ mtshan nyid gtso bo byas te 'dzin gshar sbyong / bslab pa slob gnyer/ rig gnas sbyong ba dang sgrig lam kun spyod sogs chos 'dul ba'i dgongs par bstun pa'i grwa btsun brgya dang drug cu lhag bzhugs/ de min bse bla brang dbang lda na lhun po dang / be ru tshang gzim khang / sog tshang gzim khang bcas bla grwa'i gzim shag drug cu phub pa bcas pas re zhig bris chog par byas pas dge legs 'phel gyur cig/dung phrug ri khrod bsam gtan gling /gtsos dung phrug ri khrod bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) sna sbug zhang ste kun lho'i gnas gtsos grong khyer lho ri dung phrug phyug mo'i byang khug tu btab/mdo smad chos 'byung du/ thog mar se ra dpon slob blo bzang nyi ma la bla ma byams pas thub sku zhig gnang ste/ gcig bur bsdad na dge sbyong 'phel gsungs/ dpon slob der yun ring bzhugs shing skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' bzhin ri khrod btab/ des dung phrug gong ma sogs don gnyer can mang bor chos bka' bstsal pa dang / phyis su re zhig se ra 'jigs med rgya mtshos bskyangs zhes gsungs/ da lta'ang slar — 261 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/rtsad bcad pa na/ shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'ang re zhig gnas der bzhugs skad de khong gi ma gur 'bum du phu dkar phyogs lha yi pho brang mdzes zhes gsungs shing dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas yin par ngos bzung nas gnas bstod mdzad/ da dung khong gi dngos slob 'dul 'dzin pa rin chen zhes pas mtshams khang brtsigs te sgrub par gzhol/ rjes su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me rta spyi lo1726lor dben gnas brten pa'i blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor gang ci thub yun ring gnas pa'i thugs smon gyi mtsham/sa sbyor nan tan du mdzad de/ 'du khang zhig bzhengs par ston pa gtso 'khor gsum gtsos pa'i bde ma chog dril bu lha lnga byin can dang tsan dan gyi mkha' spyod ma bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' sogs dam chos gsu nga 'bum mi nyung ba bzhugs/ gtsos gser khri dang bo rgyal mtshan seṅge'i tshems dang na bza' nang bzhugs can gyi mchod rten sogs cung mod pa dang srung ma dpal ldan lha mo dang beg tse gnyi ga bsten/ dung phrug sku skyes gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa seṅge zhes pas ri khrod du sku tshe hril bor sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol pas sa dang po rab dga' thob pa'i grub chen gang shar dag snang 'byams klas pa'i dge mtshan byung bar grags / de'i 'phros pa rigs drug 'jam dbyangs thub bstan zhes pa dang de'i phyis dbus pa blo bzang chos 'dzin/ sku skyes lnga ba blo bzang chos grags zhes pas skyong khur bzhes te rab rgyal sa khyira'i bsnubs bar bskyangs/ khong nyid kyang phyis su grong nas bzhugs pa dang198 1lor gzigs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /ri khrod nyid la sngar skyes chen du mas 'bas bcags shing sgrub pa mdzad de/ gnas dpyad du'ang dbus lha'i gnyan ri/ g.yas rlung rta'i ri/ g.yon phyag rgya'i ri/ mdun nor bu'i ri/ lho bum pa can sogs kyi dge mtshan las 'dul 'dzin pa rnams kun spyod dang ga'i gsum gyi phyag len rmang gzhi sgos so byang sngags gsum rang rang gi bslab sdom spyi dang nyes kun rtsa ba gtan du spong bzhin thugs sgrub bzhes/ gtsos dga' ldan chos gling gi shwa 'cham skabs su rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje mchog gis mgon po rdo rjer ja mchod 'bul dus dung phrug gnas ri mchod par bya/ rab rgyal ya ra sngon bla ma dang btsun pa bcu phrag bzhugs kyang da snga ri khrod sla ra ma gsos so/ /tsa yus dgon dga' ldan chos 'phel gling /tsa yus dgon dga' ldan chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) tsa yus zhang gi stod tsam du chags/chos sde 'di mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na rab drag chu mo phag ste spyi lo168 2lor btab/ dgon pa 'debs po tsa yus phun tshogs mchog ldan(da lta thog ga tshang ngam thog ga zhabs drung du 'bod/)zhes pa 'di gna' dus bod rgyal khri ral ba can gyi bod so mtshams srung bar btang ba'i g.yu tsha dam/ga dpon gyi rgyud pa/gtsos mes gong ma klu rgyal byams kyi phu bo red/ klu rgyal byams rgya sgar thang du phebs te da lta'i dpon skor du — 262 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gzhis chags/ be hu'i go gnas thob ste tsa yus dpon por gyur cing srid dmag chos gsum bdag tu bzung zer/ de'i bu che ba dpal phyug rgyal la bu drug byung / bu drug ga'i khyim shul mkha' sgra'i dpon tshang dang the bo'i dpon tshang zhes pa sogs thogs/ phyis su nang ma 'cham par dpal phyug rgyal gyis mgo bsdus te dpal phyug tsho ba dang / bu drug pos rang gi tsho ba re bzung ba bcas tsho ba bdun du gyur cing grong sde nyer dgur 'phel/ phun tshogs ma chog ldan khong ni lcags stag ste spyi lo1650lor sku 'khrungs(dgung lo bcu bzhi steng yul dbus su phebs chos grwa 'grims)/ gcen po rang chung dus nas rab tu byung zhing dbus su phebs te slob gnyer mdzad/ 'di bas paṇa chen lnga ba blo bzang ye shes la rang yul gyi dgon sa zhus par gnas rtags gsungs/ de bzhin khong rang yul du chibs bsgyur nas da lta'i dgon gnas 'dir khong gis thog mar byams khang bzhengs/ btsun pa dgu tsam 'dus/ reb gong nas 'dan grub chen gdan 'dren zhus/ rten du khong gis bzhengs pa'i klu dbang gtso 'khor lnga dang shangs mtshal gyis bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal phyi sgrub zhal bzhugs shing srung ma'i gtso bor bsten/ yang khong gi nu bo bsod nams nyi ma gdan 'dren du dbus su thengs gsum phebs kyang de ma phebs pas snga phyir a lags tsa yus(gzhi dge'i ri khrod phyag 'debs po)dang co ne khya dge dpon slob gdan drangs/ thengs gsum par khong gis dbus nas kun mkhyen ngag dbang brtson 'grus la nan gyis zhus pa la/ bla rgan khyod kyi phyir dka' tshegs chen po byas song / da khyod rang yul du song dang / nga yang mi 'gyang bar 'ongs te dgon pa zhig 'debs rgyu yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i bka' dang len sgos dgung lo nga bzhi'i dus phu bo dang mnyam du rang yul la phebs/ dgon skyong cher ma mdzad par shug shar ri khrod du sku tshe mthar phyin mtshams la bzhugs so/ /de rjes phu bos nu bo bsod nams nyi ma'i yang srid de gtsos dmar sgang du lcags glang (spyi lo172 1)lor 'khrungs pa'i 'phrin las bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes pa btsal te dgon khrir bkod cing rang nyid dgung lo don bdun steng sku 'das/ sku phreng gnyis pa khrir bzhugs kyi rjes tsam dbus 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang 'grims pa la bra nye sum ra ma'i zhabs drung du grags/ phyir phebs nas sku gong ma'i dam bca' ltar dgon pa bskyangs/ dgung lo nyer bdun steng bla ma tsa lus dang mnyam du 'du khang khang mig zhe dgu can du rgya bskyed pa dang dgon shar du bdud 'dul mchod rten bzhengs/dgung lo nga bzhi'i steng sku gshegs so/ sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog dge legs rgyal mtshan(ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas yang 'bod)zhes pa bsang gshong dar lcog thang gi yab yum skyabs dang yum gnam bza' 'brug mo skyid kyi sras su sa khyi ste spyi lo1779lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho las klog dang 'don chos bslabs te 'dzin skyen pas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nyin gcig ring thugs su chud/ nyi shu ba la gung thang bstan si 'i sgron me las bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer gsum dus smad sog tu chibs kha bsgyur cing phyir phebs nas rang dgon du 'jigs byed blos bslangs bzhengs pa dang shing phag la smon lam rab 'byams pa mdzad cing shing li kha'i khrir bskos/ snga phyir yul gru so sos dge tshul slong lnga brgya tsam — 263 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/bsgrubs/ dbang lung 'don chos mang po gnang / cung gar dgon bde chen gling du ga'i gsum gyi phyag len dang sku zhabs 'khrungs rab bzhengs te lnga mchod gling me'i srol btsugs/ rang ga'is tsa 'u/sa dgon dang shing li kha'i dgon gnyis la mang 'gyed dang / byams khang steng gañjir/ mchod rdzas bzhag sa gling lor(spyi lo1〈 29) tsa yus kyi ser skya thun mong bsdus nas dgon mchod ga'is dang bcas pa kun ma byen gsu ma pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho(1792—18 5 5)la gtsang 'bul zhus pa la kun ma khyen gyis ga'i gsu ma cho ga ngang smon lam sogs bla brang ltar gyi bca' yig mdzad/ dkon mchog dbang phyug ces pa khrir phebs shing 'bas drung khong gnyis kyis rgyud smad ngos gtsang dang sde khri 'jam dbyangs bstan nyis rdor dbyings cho ga phyag len btsugs/ chu 'brug la thog ga khang bla brang sman khri dang shing 'brug la rgyud khri/ me rta la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen khri rabs zhe gnyis par bzhugs/ dgung lo don dgu me 'brug ste spyi 'o 18 56'o ra sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho zhes pa tsa yus rgya sgar thang du be hu'i khyim bgos the bo tshang la chu byi ste spyi lo1862lor sku 'khrungs/ gdan sar bkod rjes dge bshes 'jigs med blo gros ni bsam sbyor gnyis kyi dge rgan bsten nas lam sngags byang chub gas na/ khong mkhas chen du gyur kyang thugs yid shin tu btsan pas bu slob mang bo rang ma byung / dgung lo nga gsum par sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng lnga ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa a mchog gi a rdog lung du yab mgon po tshe brtan dang yum gdugs dkar skyid kyi sras su lcags sprel(192 0)la sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du rje dpa' ris rab gsal yongs 'dzin du bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas dpyis phyin pa mdzad kyang dgung lo su ma cu'i skabs su sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng drug pa skal bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho zhes pa slar a mchog ya ru rgyud dgon ga'is nang nas sa rta lor(1978)yab tshul khrims dang yum dkon mchog 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ gung thang bsta na pa'i dbang phyug mchog gis thugs thag bcad cing shing khyi lo'i dgu ba'i nyer gnyis gdan sar bkod/ da lta bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du khri chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog yongs 'dzin la bsten cing chos grwar 'grim pa'i skabs so/ /dgon 'di'i sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs chen rigs su paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis gnang ba'i thub pa rdor gdan ma dang / sangs rgyas 'od srung gi tshems nang bzhugs byams sku gsu nga 'byon/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'bab pa gsum dang shangs khrag bzhur ba snyan shal can gcig kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa'i dam can rten thang dang kun mkhyen 'dra sku phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya rang shugs sa gnon/ 'jigs med dbang bo'i 'dra sku gsung 'byon/ byams chen/ sgrol ma bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor thig rang bab can/ gos sku chen po/ 'jigs byed blos bslangs che chung sogs sku rten sum brgya lhag tsam dang / gsung rten la sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'gyur ro cog dang gsung 'bum sna tshogs bcas po ti stong phrag longs pa/ thugs rten yang bdud 'dul mchod rten/ gung thang blo gros kyi sku gdung / thog ga'i sku gdung /— 264 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lha brtan sku gdung / tsa yus bla ma'i sku gdung / yongs 'dzin grags pa'i sku gdung sogs bzhugs/ de bzhin mchod rdzas yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i 'du khang dang / btsan khang / lha khang gsum/ nang khag la bla brang nang dang / thog ga tshang / lha brtan tshang / tsa yus tshang / 'dan tshang / gung thang tshang /bse tshang / yar nang nang bcas brgyad yod pa dang / dgon pa dar dus btsun pa sum brgya zhal 'dzoms kyang rab rgyal sa khyi lor zhal grangs brgya bzhi bcu tsam du nyams la chag 'jig kyang thengs gsum byung /dgon par btsan nags yo/da pas lha khang grwa shag phub par cha rkyen ha cang 'dzoms so / dgon pa'i 'don pa dang chos spyod gtso bo la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ rdor dbyings sgrub mchod/ paṇa chen bde lam/ mgon po chos rgyal/ lha mo sogs te/ zla dang po'i nang dam can lha tshes smon lam/ gos sku/ byams pa gling skor so gas/ zla gnyis par bla brang rgyud smad ltar dpyid chos su gsang 'dus chog rkyang dang bdag 'jug lhung bzed mchod pa/ bde mchog chag rkyang dang bdag 'juga'ajigs byed bdag 'jug mgon chos sogs/ zla gsum par gas nga 'dus sgrub ma chod/ sa chog rdul ma tshon/ tshogs 'khor klu chog sbyin sreg gtor chen/ zla bzhi bar smyung gnas dang bde la ma / zla lnga bar dbyar chos su ma ṇi ril sgrub/ zla drug par rdor dbyings dbyangs bcags 'jigs byed sogs dang zla bdun pa'i nang bar dbyar gnas/ zla dgu bar bde mchog dang sa chog sbyin sres so gas/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu gcig par grwa tshang yongs mtshams bzhugs/ zla bcu gnyis par zhabs brtan dang gtor rgyag sogs lo hril bor chos thog ha cang rgyas pa dar/ der bstun dgon pa'i chos thog sbyin bdag tu shog pa gsum dang tsho ba drug yod pa dang bla ma las sne la bla ma thog ga dang tsa lus khri ba dang dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ byings gnyer che chung / sku tshab/ spyi chen gnyis/ tshogs 'du drug bcas tshang bar grub/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor dgon pa yongs su 'jig cing dge 'dun pa lhag lus/ rnams grong gseb tu log19〈1lor gong gi chog mchan thob bzhin chos sgo phye bas mi ser gyis rje lha khang dang dam can lha khang /spyi khang / mchod rten/ grwa shag bzhi bcu lhag bcas grub cing btsun pa bdun cus chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel ba'i skabs so/ /gzhi dge ri khrod bkra shis chos 'khor gling /gzhi dge ri khrod bkra shis chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi tsa yus khog tu chags/ da skabs dad ldan gyis slar gsos/gzhi dge ri khrod ces pa 'di tsa yus bla ma dka' bcu ba 'phrin las rab brtan pas btab/ 'di ba tsa yus me tog shar du sku 'khrungs/ lha bstan pa las rab tu byung / dbus su phyag phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te bstan gzhung brtson par sbyangs gshes gsang phu'i dka' bcu mdzad/ gsung pota — 265 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gcig bzhugs/ phyir rang yul phebs nas ri khrod nyid btab pa la khong gi sku na rim gyis bskyangs/ sku rabs ba'i'i lo rgyus mdo smad chos 'byung du cung gas la/ sngon chad 'du khang / lha khang / rung khang / grwa shag du ma 'dzoms par gyur cing rten 'gangs mang du bzhugs/ spyi lo195〈lor rtsa med du 'jig kyang da lta mi se ra dad ldan dag gis bla ma tsa yus pa'i gzim khang zhes pa'i khang mig bcu phrag phub pa la dge slong sbyin pa rgya ma tsho dgung 'o bdun cu lhag pas gnas srung ba bzhin du 'tsho bzhugs gnang ngo/ /zhal dro ri khrod bkra shis chos 'phel gling /'al dro ri grod bkra shis chos 'phel gling zhes pa da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi tsa yu sa lung bar chags/ da lta yongs su 'jiga'al dro ri khrod ces pa 'di 'dan grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis btab/ rje nyid khams nas sku 'khrungs shing 'dan chos 'khor gling gi mkhan po mdzad/ khong ni yul gyi rgyal po la ma 'grig si ra reb gong brgyud de sa 'dir phebs/ tsa lus phun tshogs mchog lda na gyis khong gdan drangs shing zhal dro'i sa yu sa pa nas ri khrod btsugs/ phyis su 'dul ba zhabs drung zhes pas ri khrod 'di gnas spos te rgyal rje glad du sla ra btab cing snga 4 'i sku gsu nga thugs rten byin can rnams 'dir bzhugs gshis zha'/ dro'i gnas stong bar gyur ces mdo smad chos 'byung du cung rgyas par gsu ngas/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i yar sngon du 'du khang so gas rten dang brten pa/ btsun pa du ma yod kyang de bsnu bas pas sla ra gso'i bskal ba ma ldan no/ /mgo 'dal ri khrod/mgo 'dal ri khrod ces pa da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bas nga chu rdzong tsa yus zhang gi khongs su chags/ da skabs sla ra gsos/ma go 'dal ri khrod ces pa ni bla ma lha brtan pa ngag dbang 'phrin las zhes pas btab zer/ gnas 'dir sngo na byon bla ma gong ma rnam sa kyis/ bas nga chab sngon mo 'i g.yas phyogs na/ / brag ri gru gsum chos 'byung nang / /'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang yod/ /tsa ru tra dang gnyis su med/ /ces gsungs pa la rang sa'i mi ser gyis tsa ru 'es pa sgra ma dag par tsa yu sa su 'gyur te yul ming du thogs zer/ rjes su thog ga tshang sku rim byon gyis bskyangs la rgyun bzhugs dge 'dun pa lnga drug la sa 'dal na dgon du phebs dgos pa dang ma 'dang na dgon pas kha bskong dgos/ sngon chad 'du khang zhig dang sku 'bum sogs yod kyang rab rgyal sa khyi 'o ra bsnubs/ da lta mi ser gyis slar gsos te 'du khang chung ngu zhig dang gung thang rin po che'i gzim shag cig bzhengs shing btsun pa bcu lhag rgyun par bzhugs so/ /rdo dkar mchod rten shar dga' ldan bkra shis rab rgyas gling /— 266 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las 7na su 'u glegs bam/rdo dkar dgon pa'am mchog rten shar dga' ldan bkra shis rab rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi ( da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs ) sna sbug 'ang rdo dkar zhes pa'i nyin lung srib lung gnyis ga'i mdor chags/dgon pa 'di rdo dkar nyin rgyud dang srib rgyud kyi dgon chung gnyis bsdus te grub pa yin/ rab byung bdun pa'i me sbru la( 1 4 16)lor bsil ljongs kyi dbus su 'phags yul dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang gnyis su med pa'i rig grol gyi sde chen por 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po'i zhal bkod dang lung bsta na ltar/ khong nyid kyi dngos slob 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis sgo ma nga dang / blo gas 'a gling so gas grwa tshang bdun btsugs/ de nas rim par mdo smad dang bcas lul gru ma tha' dag 'a ngabu' sda nga nga zam ma chad par btang / rim pa brgyud pa'i 'bul sdu da pa gang la sa / mdo smang sacos kyi ru 'a gruri sa 'dzin gyi dang bo/ gzhis chags kyi thog ma'i mgon skyob/ thob dang bka' thog gi bangs ngo ra gyur pa 'i grags pa ma/do dbus su khyab cing / phyogs kyi btsan rdzong du gyur pas kun gyis slo rdzong zes 'bod pas /rang phyogs su 'bul sdu da pa gang 'byor mchod yo na du bkur/ sgo rdzong dpon rgyud rab ‘rabyam sa nga bsta na skyong gis rdo dkar srib rgyud kyi ru sde drug gi sa zhing mi ser dang bcas pa 'bras spungs smo ma nga ga tshang nga ma chod thebs su phul zer zhing / 'bras spungs 'bul sdud pa bod pa chos rje mchog gis ma chong rtser ༅ra nga4nga ñca na bkra shis rab rgyas gling thog mar btab skad (lo lnga brgya las 'das par yid rdon chog ste 1 zhu 0 0 snga pye ) nge nas sgo mang grwa tshang gis bla dpon rim par gtong ba'i srol btod nas sgo zu nga dwo ma ri gatshes ka chen po chig chags shing sgar grong gnyis kyi kha 'dzin mdzad/ ga'is ka de'i srung ma ra sgo ma nga ma lan ngo 'i dbu sngas su bzhugs pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa rdo sku rang byon gnyis yo da pa las gcig gdan drangs / de nas rim pa ra brgyud de paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes ( 166 2da 1727) mchog gis de la gnod 'gal mi byed nga 'i b.la' shog gnang ba mdo smad chos 'byung du bkod/ ga'is de la brten nas chags pa'i sde grong la sgo ma nga snge ba ches da lta 'ang 'bod/ sgar grong gnyis kyis sgo mang grwa tshang la mi ma ngags nas gnam 'o gas ra tshes su 'o gas ra 'bu' ba dang sgo ma nga gzhung gis kyang lha gas mi skya se ra la khyad ma tshar gyis sa tshwa chen po re rten ska' du gnang ba bgres po rnams kyis dngos su ma thong bar bshad/ de 'dra'i sa tshwa chen po 'bras spungs su da skabs kyang ma jal rgyu yod pa ma zad/ sgo ma nga rban po drug ces pa'i gnyer ba skya ri rnam sa kyi khyim rgyud re 'ag('a nga srabs kyang ngos 'dzin rgyu yo da/ phyis su kun ma khyen 'jigs med dbang bo ma chos dbus su phebs skabs sgo ma nga grwa tshang gi thugs bzhed lta ra sa 'ing mi ser gyis do ra gzhung baches sbyor 'jags ngang dngul rdo tshad nyi shu phung nas bzung dgon mchod gzhis bcas pa bkra shis 'khyil bar 'jags shing ༈ bla 4rter ngang sku tshab rim par btang nas sgo mang bla ma'i gzhis ka dang mi sde gnyer 'ing kha 'dzin mdzad pa ma zang nge ga'i ma gon khang gi rten dang brten pa/ bsang bsur a mchod bskang saso 'o gtor bcas bla brang 4zhung thing gcer/ rab 2 di7 ———

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/ — — ོda wa rgyal sa khyi'i bcos bsgyur bar dar/ dgon pa'i srung ma gnas chung yin/ dang thog dgon mgo sgo mang grwa tshang le lag nas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dbang du bsgyur bar sgo mang mchod rten zhes grags pa yin/ dgon chung ga'an zhig ni rdo dkar nyin rgyud ru sde drug gi dgon pa yin la rdo dkar dgon pa zhes bya ste/ dang thog chos rdzong dgon pa'i dgon lag tu gtogs skad/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gnyis pa'i dus su gtsos dang bla brang gi nang 'gal sogs kyi rkyen dbang dang 'brel/ nyin pa de ru sde drug gis lo ngo bco brgyad lhag la nang ('khrug bslangs mthar bla brang lha sde'i gras su rdo dkar nyin srib gnyis shog pa gcig tu bsdus pas nyin gyi dgon nga/ de mchod rten shar du bsres shing 'du khang rgya bskyed de tshon rtsi byug pa bcas legs por grub/ de nas bzung rdo dkar mchod rten shar zhes 'bod/ bkra shis 'khyil gyis rgya rams pa dang / ma kha ngag dbang bsta na 'dzin bla gnyer sbrag ma so gas dbu mdzad du rim par bskos nas 'chad nyan sogs yar rgyas byung /dang thog dgon sde 'di la ched gnyer ba'i bla sprul zhig med stabs/ bog tsha'i bla rgan zhes bya bas tshe dang snyo ma sa par bskyangs pa dang / sde khri rin po che dang / drung ba tshang sogs kyis skyong 'khur lhur bzhes gnang bar grags/ brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab(rdo dkar ru chung sde bar 'khrungs)kyi dbon po blo bzang mthu sto bas zhes pa dbal mang ba'i bka' drin la brten nas kun rig skyor rta gsar slob la dbyangs dpon gdan drangs / sgrig lam la dag ther dang bca' yig ba'ag khri ba zur bskos kyi srol phye ste thar mi che'i yang sprul khrir bsko ba'ag gnang nas da lta'i bar bla rabs zam ma chad par bskyangs pa dang / khyad par du brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab mchog dang de'i yang sprul bstan pa rab rgyas rnam gnyis kyis skyong khur byas pas dgon bdag tu nges shing / da lta'i bar du sku phreng rim byon gyis bdag skyong gi bka' drin zab pa gnang bar brten/grwa tshang gi phyi'i lcags ri dang nang 'grig lam/ 'don rta dbyangs/ cho ga phyag len sogs gtsang 'ing nges pa'i gzhi chags/ dgon pa'i grwa rgyun 'phel zhing / lha khang dang nang chen gyi gzhis ka grwa shag bcas rgya che bar rgyas stabs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng rim byon gyi thugs nye yul du gyur te zhabs kyis yang yang bcags pa ma zad/ sku phreng lnga ba mchog gis dgon pa 'di'i grwa ba dag lo gsar smon lam la bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs su phebs chog pa'i dmigs bsal gnang ba dang / ru sde rnams lha sde nang ma'i gas su bcug grwa ba brgya nye bar 'phel la/ btsun pa de dag las sgrub pa nyams len la gzhol ba'i me tog bcud len mkhan dang / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen sogs la bzhugs mkhan dang / sman rtsis sa dpyad sogs rig pa'i gnas dang / gcod dang chu mig la 'bad mkhan mang du byung / khyad par du kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i bkur yul du gyur pa'i tshe mtshams pa ba bstan pa rgya mtsho ste rdo dkar mtshams pa ba'i sku phreng dang bo dang /dge slong bstan pa rgya mtsho thod pa zhes pa rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing / 'jigs byed bsnyen chen dang me tog bcud len sogs la yang bzhugs pa/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thugs gnyer mthar phyin mdzad cing mkhyen rab kyi klong rdol ba/ sman rtsis sa dpyad la khyad par du mkhas pa dme sde'i dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho/— 268 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sgu ru steng dge slong brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ ar te sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs bshes gnyen du ma byon no/ /dgon sde 'di dge lugs pa'i rgyud grwa zhig yin zhing btsugs pa'i cho ga chos spyod/ thig rdul tshon/rig gnas slob gnyer/ mtshams bsnyen pa/ dbyar dgag gtso gsum/ gtor sgrub gtor zlog sogs kyis mtshon pa'i chos thog dang
