bshad sgrub chos spyod kyi phyag srol shin tu rgyas na'ang 'dir gtso che'i skor la/cho 'phrul zla bar tshogs su skyabs 'gro dang sa lam skabs gsum/ khrus gsol rgyas pa/ sgo mang mgon khang du gsol kha sogs gsungs/ zla gnyis par gar 'cham gshar sbyong dang sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal ba'i ba/ kun ma khyen sku phreng bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ dus 'khor sa chog gshar sbyong / zla gsum par brag sgom pa bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gdung mchod/ dus 'khor sa gar dang sa chog dngos gzhi/ dus 'khor mchod gar dang bdag 'jug sbyin sreg mtshams pa ba sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gdung mchod bcas/ zla bzhi bar rje'i stong mchod dang / smyung gnas bcas/ zla lnga bar gnas bcu'i phyag mchod dang lo tog rim gro dang ma ṇi/ tshes bcu drug bcu bdun gnyis gar bka' 'gyur klog par bya/ zla drug par drug pa'i smon lam yar tshogs la dge bskos kyis dgon pa'i bca' yig 'don pa dang byams pa gling skor/gsang 'dus sa chog gi dngos ga'i/ gso sbyong / dbyar gnas yar tshogs/ rdul mtshon la brten pa'i gsang 'dus bdag 'jug dang sbyin sreg mgon chos lnga'i gtor sgrub/ zla bdun par gsang 'dus dang mgon chos gnyis/ rdul mtshon la brten pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag 'jug dang sbyin sregamagon chos lnga'i gtor sgrub bcas/ zla brgyad par dbyar ston dus sa lam skabs gsum dang sku rim rnam gsum sogs/ dge bskos sogs las sne gsar ba khrir bsko ba/ mtshams pa ba bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gdung mchod bcas/ zla dgu bar kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa'i gdung mchod dang rdo bcal sku rim/ kun rig sa chog rdul mtshon la brten pa'i kun rig bdag 'jug dang sbyin sreg bcas/ zla bcu bar dga' ldan lnga mchod la chos spyod rnam thar dang dus 'khor/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs dang tshes nyer brgyad nyin kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gdung mchod bcas/ zla bcu gcig par mgon po'i gtor sgrub rgyas pa/ brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rab rgyas kyi gdung mchod/ zla bcu gnyis par mtshams bsnyen pa dang sgo mang mgon khang gi lo gtor brjes pa/ seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog mgon chos lnga'i gtor sgrub bcas sgrub pa nyams len 'di dag rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i sngon du 'khyud 'khor gcig gi nang la chag med yin te nyin nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun longs so /dgon pa'i gzhi khyon dang rten gtso'i rigs la/ 'du khang ka ring ba'i gshar sum thog rgyan bdun can du thub sku byin can gcig rje yab sras gsum dang kun mkhyen sku phreng gi 'dra sku me tog bzhes shing rngul chu 'bab pa'i byams sku byin can gcig dus 'khor li sku mi tshad longs pa mdzod spu las bdud brtsi bab pa gcig dang / thang ga la thub dbang gi stong sku/ spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi zhing bkod/ rgyud sde gong 'og — 269 —

kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs /dang ma gon chos lnga/ rgya' chen batshi'i gyan thang / me skyon las thar ba'i jo sku dang gnas chung gi thang gajag ngamag gis gnod ma thub pa 'i rang gling rang grags dang / gnam byang me lce rang 'bar ma bcas kyis ma tshan pa'i mchod chas yo byad byin can/ ma chod rdzas gsar rnying cha gsum/ sogs ma chis tshe mtshams pa ba ngasnga na nga rgya ma tshos bzhengs pa'i mi 'khrugs nga 'i lha khang du khong nyid 'a ri bo rtse lnga nas rgya mi zhig gis btsongs par rin sprod pa'i bar gar song cha med du gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga ba khru tshad las babol ba/ de 'a brten nas bachengs ba 'i rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa sku'i dbu tsan dan las grub cing khang thog gnyis kyi tshad phyin pa/ mi 'khrugs ba 'i 'ing bkod ga'an las khyad ma/tshar can/ mchod rdzas yo byad ga'an dring mi 'jog pa bcas/ma tsham sa pa ba sku phreng gnyis pas bachengs pa'i byams khang du khong nyid kyi mtshan lam du rgyal ba byam sa pa'i 'al gzigs ma thong bar brten nas bzhengs pa byams sku byin rlabs can thog tshad gnyis longs pa tshan kha 'bar pa so gas gtsos pa 'i sku dang thang ga mang bo/ mchod rdzas dang yo byad gya nom pa/ rta mgrin lha khang du sgu ru steng gi klu 'bum phyug gis bzhengs pa rta mgrin gtso skur bzhugs pa'i sgrol ma stong sku/ thang ga dang o rgyan pad+ma'i sku so gas ma nga bo/ khyad par du dgon pa'i g.yas zur sde khrod du bla brang sku tshab rim pas gnyer ba'i ga'is ka( sngar gyi sgo mang bla ma'i ga'is ga) zhes par byin rlabs kyi tshan kha dang grags pa dkyus gcig tu 'bar ba'i ma gon po phyag drug pa rdo sku rang byon zhig bzhugs te/ sngon chad a tsa ra 'gro 'ong cha med du gyur pa zhig gis sgo ma nga grwa tshang gi mkhan po 'ig la gnang ba'i rdo sku rang byon gnyis dbu sngas su bzhugs yod pa las/ mgon po rang byon 'dis nga mdo smad du 'gro ba yin zhes ma khan po'i mtshan lam du byung ba ltar/ gzhis ka 'di'i rten du gnang bar grags/ snyan dar rang 'gul dang / rgya 'khrug skabs su rnga rang grags/ srung rta rang rdul byung ba/ rten gtor la gtor spu skyes mi na las sa phyogs de ga'i lo tog legs min dang / lo sar tshe gcig snga mo ra rtogs pa'i chu rtags kyi byung lta sa las lo gcig gi bya ba'i legs nyes 'byed pa sgos yul mi kun gyis yi da gtod chog pa'i rtags ma tshan ma ngon sum pa 'char bar gyur/ ga'an lha cha mchod cha mi nyung ba/ngagon pa'i gling du grwa shag so lnga dang / brag sgom pa tshang / mtshams pa ba tshang / sde ba tshang / drung ba tshang / spyi khang bcas nang chen lnga/ rung khang bcas gling skor yongs su grub/spyi rdzas dang rgyu 'byor phyogs kyi thad du'ang rang 'thag gnyis/ g.yis khang gcig sgor rkyang khri lnga bcu lha ga ba'on ma ba'i bcu lhag rta zog brgya tsam/ lo rer nas rgya ma nyis khri lhag bcas ni rab rgyal sa gyi 'o ra gzhung bzhes bar skyong gnyer mchis/ dgon pa'i phyag len dang cho ga'i phyogs ni dus 'khor gyi 'dod chob bkra this 'khyil gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang ltar te/ dbyangs rta gsar rnying gnyis las dbyangs rnying ba'i rgyud du gtogs / 'jigs gsang gnyis kyi 'don chog bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud smad ltar dbyangs rta gsar rnying gnyis la sa dbyangs gsar ba'i rgyud du gtogs / kun rig gi 'don chog ni skyor rta yin par grags pas bkra shis 'khyil dang dbyangs phyag gnyis kyi cha nas cung mi ma thun/ de las chos sbyo nga dang rnam thar gtor sgrub — 270 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs bkra shis 'khyil ba bzhin bya/ gzhan chab ril su bskos na des 'gan dang du blangs nas yul phyogs kyi lo tog gi bar chad bsel phyir seng gdong ma'i sgo nas ser ba 'gog pa dang / char chu dkon pa'i lor klu dbang bum sgrub kyi sgo nas char 'bab pa dag la byin rlabs kyi tshan kha myur ba yu 'a mi kun gyi mngon gsal du gyur/ dgon pa'i las sne'i bzhugs tshad la/ bkra shis 'khyi' nas btang ba'i khri ba lo gsum re/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'o gsum/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos / chab ril / dkor gnyer rnam/sa lo gnyis re/ spyi ba che ba gcig dang chung ba gnyis ni 'o gsum re yin la/ ga'an ya nga tshogs 'du zhes pa'i grwa ba rgan shos gsu ma gyi rang gi las thog tu byung ba'i bya ba gal chen rnams gros bsdur gyis thag gcod pa dang / khyad par gal che ba'i bya ba byung tshe grwa rgan rnam/sa dang / gzhon shos yan gyi grwa mang bsdus nas/ gros bsdur bya rgyu'i srol tshugs so/ /dgon pa'i mchod gzhis ni rdo dkar 'tsho ba gsum/ ste/ 'go ba gnyis dang brgyad cu tham pa zhes pa nyin srib gnyis kyi lung khog tu ru sde bcu bzhi la khyim sgo nyis brgyar nye zhing / dad ldan gyi skye 'gro stong dang lnga brgya tsam zin/ nye 'khor gyi yul gru gtsos/ 'bo ra/ gyi ling / ma dzod dge sogs kyis dad cing /dus 'khor gyi chog 'don du rgyun par rang khyim la gdan 'dren zhu mkhan mang / de ba'in dgon pa'i chag 'jig zur tsam gleng na/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing khyi192 4lor dang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yo sa(1927)lor snga phyir jag dmag mā chi dang zi hro con zhes pa'i ha'e dmag gis yul phyogs 'di dang dgon par lan gnyis brlags/ snga ma las phyi mar nyes skyon lhag par che bas dgon pa'i lha khang dang 'du khang /nang khag dang grwa shag tshang ma mer btang / lha rten dang mchod rdzas mang shos 'phrog pa ma zad/ skya ser sum cu lhag dmar gsod byas shing grong gi khyim pa'i khang ba thams cad bsregs pas gyang chag tu gyur/ rab rgyal sa 'brug nas sa khyi lo'i bar gyi lo ngo bcu phrag gnyis su nye ba'i ring la sgar grong thams cad slar gso bgyis te/'du khang bskyar du bzhengs shing grwa ba brgya la nye bar 'phel ba bcas re zhig sngar las 'phel zhing rgyas/ 'on kyang sngar las dar rgyas byung ba'i spyi rdzas dang 'byor ba/ lha rten mchod gsum re 'ga' las ma lhag par rab rgyal sa khyi lo ste bcos bsgyur gyi skabs su 'jig 'du khang dang grwa shag tu grong khyim dang mdzod khang / rgyal gnyer zhing rwa dang phyug las kyi gnas gzhi byas/ yang bar skabs su chu stag lor rten bzhengs gang mang byas kyang / rig gsar las 'gul gyi skabs su dgon pa'i snod bcud thams cad yongs su bsnubs te khul phyugs rgyud legs spel gyi phyugs zog gso rwa tshugs/ lcags sprel lo ( 198 0) nas rim par slar gso bya mgo brtsam sa/ 'du khang rdo rtsig dang bcas rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs/ grwa shag lnga bcu lha ga tu grwa ba brgyad cu zhal 'dzoms/ 'du khang sngar las legs grub byung / 'du khang snga ma'i rtsig zur dag ni k+ṣe tra pa las 'phen gyi yo da pa be ru mthu stobs rgya mtshos sku gzan phag nas khong gi gsol thab yod par bstan pa dang / da lta nyams gso'i skabs rtsig rnying lhag ro'i zur rdo dum bur gyur pa'i khog ngos su a dkar bo rang byon yod pa ma nga tshogs der 'dus kun gyis mthong snang du gyur lags so/ /— 271 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi khongs/rgyal mo dgon dge ldan dar rgyas gling /rgyal mo dgon dge lda na dar rgyas gling(gcig gyur ma bgyis gong rgyal mo bas ma grub gling zer)zhes nga gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs rgya' mo dgon 'ang gi khongs su chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du gsu ngas pa lta ra na/ sprul sku dge legs ṅgarmas btab bam skal bzang dbon po sogs kyis btab nas khong la phul / bla ma bsod nams chos dbang nas 'di ba'i bar bla rabs bco brgyad song zer ba'ang snang / 'di'i sngon sku phreng gsum tsam phebs 'dra zhes bka' 'gyur ba spru' skus gsungs/dge legs ṅgarma dang de'i dbon po yo na tan rgya mtsho sku phreng rim byon gyis bskyangs/ dge legs gorma'i sprul sku bka' 'gyur(reb tsha'i bka' 'gyur ba sku phreng dang bo)blo bzang nyi ma rma chu tshur kha'i ru khrod dbal shul gyi rigs la sa 'khrungs / dgung lo brgyad cu barbal ba sa khyi (spyi lo1778)la brag lung ri khrod du gshegs/khong ni bkra shis 'khyil gsar tshugs kyi grwa rgyun/ kun mkhyen mchog dang khri rgan bsten nas thugs gnyer mthar phyin mdzad pas dge bshes grags che/ de'i sprul sku dkon mchog dam chos yar 'phel ma dzod dge smad nas sa phag la 'khrungs / dgung lo brgyad pa la kun mkhyen bar ma las/ dge tshul bsgrubs/ thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang bkra shis 'khyil du mi ṭa'i dbang gsan pa dang 'don cha dang su ma rtags sogs 'ib par bslabs/ nyi shu ba la gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs las bsnyen par rdzogs shing khong rin po che rang gi gdan sar spyan drangs pa dang dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang dang par+ṇa chen sogs skyes chen dam pa du mar chos 'brel zhus/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rtogs brjod chos dung dkar bo'i sgra dbyangs/ don rgyan so lnga'i dpe brjod/ rnam thar du ma/ bla mchod zin bris sogs brtsams chos mang / dgung lo lnga bcu'i nang gshegs so/ khong gis nga la sprul sku med gsungs so / /'on kyang sku rtsa rnams kyis nan zhus ltar kun mkhyen mchog gis dngul rwar 'khrungs pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho mchog kyang yang srid yin par nges bzung nas bla tshab tu gnang / sku dbon yon tan rgya mtsho(reb tsha sprul sku thog ma)lha khang lung ltag tu reb tsha'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ lo ngo gsum bzhi nas dmigs brtse ma dang a ra pa tsa bton/ sprul ba'i sku dge legs chos dar las rab tu byung dge tshul bsgrubs pas sku drung du bcar/ 'don chos rdzogs par bslabs/ dgung lo bcu bdun steng dbus su dga' ldan chos grwas dgung lo lnga bcu'i bar bzhugs shing lo shas rang dgon bskyangs/de nas spros pa btsan chod kyis ri steng khar tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ bdun cu'i nang gshegs/ de'i sprul sku klu shod du 'khrungs pa ngag dbang byams pa sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mdzad pa gsal/ sman rtsis snyan ngag la mkhas/ byang chub mi la'i slob ma/ de nyis kyi bstod pa rin chen phreng mdzes sogs brtsams chos 'ga' re snang / nyi shu ba la 'bras sgo mang du bka' pota gsan sbyangs las lha rams pa thon/ lnga ba chen po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal dbang mchog nas hu thog thu mergan chos rje'i cho lo dang bka' shog rje nyid nas bsgrub gnang mdzad pa'i dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo bcas gnang / mthar dbon po bsod nams lhun grub la — 272 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su'u glegs bam/gdan sa gtad de rang nyid brag lung(brag lung ri khrid ni sku rjes mas btab zer ba'ang snang)du bzhugs shing dgung lo nga ba'i ba la gshegs so/ / reb tsha gsum pa a lags rgyal mo dge 'dun rgya mtsho rngog rigs su sku 'khrungs / chung dus nas thub pa/ byams pa/ rje rin po che sogs kyi gzigs snang byung / lha mo dang be har gyi srung skyong g.yel med mdzad/ chos 'khor ba bsod nams dpa' 'byor klog gi slob dpon du bsten te 'don chog 'a sbyangs / yongs 'dzin skal bzang sangs rgyas zhes pa mdo sngags rig gnas mkhas grags su byon pa bsten/ bdun pa la bkra shis 'khyil du khri rgan las rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ rong bo chos pa'i slo ba ma sta ga lung ba bstan pa dar rgyas dang po to ba rin chen gsal du 'khrungs pa'i skye ba dran/ sku dngos kyi rnam thar bka' bcu spru la skus bsgrigs/ ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin dang lung nag spog pa'i sgang /gser 'od ma do(rnga rgod nam ma/kha' seṅge 'khrungs yul)/ thang tshang ste rngog dgon sde lnga'i dge 'dun rnams 'dir 'tshogs nas dbyar ston rdul tshon la brten nas kun rig dang gsang 'dus sgrub mchod nyin bdun re chag med ma dzad pa'i srol thog mar btod/ me khyi lor kun mkhyen mchog co ner phebs lam rang dgon du gdan drangs/ ma chod ga'is rngog tsho ba lnga ni rngog chos sku rdo rje dang rus gcig tu gtogs zer/ don drug pa me sbru la(spyi lo18 5 2)la gshegs / reb tsha bzhi ba dkon mchog 'phrin las rgya mtsho(18 0 1da 1rnga75)gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sa bsnyen par rdzogs/ reb tsha lnga ba dkon mchog thub bstan rgya mtsho/ reb tsha drug pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo yin te/ dgung lo bcu drug gi steng lcags lug lo'i(spyi lo1921)sno zla'i yar ngor kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung du sgo mang mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs pa'i sprul sku bskal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho bcas reb tsha'i bla sprul/ dge 'dun 'phrin las rgya mtsho khong nyid dang / dbon po/ gnyer ba/ zhal ngo / grwa tshang gi las byed mi sna/ rngog tsho ba lnga'i sems shes thams cad 'dun pa gcig bsgril gyis dgon sde che chung bcu ga phyogs gcig tu bsdus te mdo sngags zung gi bshad grwa'i bca' yig chos khrims kyi bdag po dang chos 'go bla brang la gtad cing rgyal mo'i dge lda na dar rgyas gling zhes mtshan gsol cing srung ma dpal ldan lha mo bkur/ dgon ma lag du ma'i gras ltar khri ba dang zhal ngo bar ma chad par mngag rgyu bcas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag tu tshud/ rje 'di ba rang lo nyer gnyis steng gshegs/ reb tsha bdun pa 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ 'di ba co ne'i khongs gser gzhong nang du yab ban de phyug dang yum rta mgrin 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga bas(1916—1947)ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo bdun steng bla ma stobs ldan las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ nyi shu ba la slar bla ma de nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sdom khrims btsun cing byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud dag pa du mas bcings pas/ dgon pa slar gso dang gong spel du phyag rjes che ba dang 'dod chung chog shes ngang sgom sgrub lhur len du bzhugs so/ /sgo mang mkhan sprul sku rabs gnyis brgyud pa'i dang bo ni skal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ 'di ba dgung lo lnga bcu'i nang sku gshegs/ de'i yang srid skal — 273 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs /bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ co ne rdzong gi tha tshang a mgon de'u(reb tsha'i bla dpon skar ma zhes pa'i 'khrungs yul) sde ba'i yab tshe dpal rdo rje dang yum ban de 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu dgu'i steng rang dgon du tshe dbang thob/ da lta grong skye'i tshul du dgon pa skyong khur bzhes pa'i skabs so / / gzhan rgyal mo'i dgon zhes pa ni lha khang lung ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du/ dgon 'di la 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal lda na dmag zor mas mngon su ma du bdag gir mdzad pa'i gnas chos kyi sde chen po rgyal mo'i bsam grub gling zhes mtshan gsol ces so/ /bar skabs su rngog dgon sde che chung bcu ga dang reb tsha sgrub sde bco brgyad ces gleng bar bya/ dgon sde bcu ga las tsha mdo dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gug chen 'bas drung gong mas btab/ kha 'dzin reb tsha nang bas byas/ dgon li mkhas ma chog 'di nas 'khrungs / shing ra dgon bkra shis dge 'phel gling gug chen 'bas drung gis btab/ kha 'dzin reb tsha nang bas byas / bsam grub bstan 'dzin rgya ma tsho dang a mchog mu to tshang dgon 'di'i nang tshan du 'khrungs/ rngog sbog pa'i sgang dbang rgyal lha ri'i dgon bshad sgrub gling chas pa sku skyes kyis btab/ rgya nag nas gdan dngas pa'i rgya nag chos 'khor zer ba than se la char bsu nus ldan can bzhugs pa da lta'ang lus / lha khang lung ba rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang khong gi dngos slob bam rtogs brjod rtsom mkhan chas pa sku skyes gnyis 'di nas 'khrungs par grags/ sku rjes mar khwa ta'i bstan bcos sogs brtsams chos thor bu mang / gser 'od mdo dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling ni rwa lung dpon slob blo bzang shes rab kyis btab/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang mgon po phyag drug pa byin can yod pa da lta 'ang bzhugs/ rnga rgod byams pa rab rgyas dang bla ma rin chen chos bzang de nas 'khrungs/ thang tshang dgon dga' lda na bsam grub gling ni thang tshang blo bzang shes rab kyis btab/ 'di bas rje tsong kha ba'i sku byin can gcig sog yul nas gdan drangs pa bzhugs/ sde thang mkhan po dgon gyi thub pa gsung 'byon ma 'di bas gdan drangs zer/ lung nag sgar thub bstan rab rgyas gling 'debs pa bo mi gsal/ kun mkhyen ba'i bas gnang ba'i thub pa rdor gdan ma da lta'ang bzhugs/ kun ma khyen sku phreng gnyis pa dang sde ba tshang gi sman pa nor bu dang sman pa ban phrug dang sman pa a se ra rgya mtsho 'di nas byon/ reb tsha phu dgon bkra shis chos gling 'debs pa bo mi gsa' / rnga rgod sku phreng gis bskyangs/ mtsho kha ba dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bzhengs pa'i byams sku jo sku dang a skyid sto bas ldan sprul skus phul pa'i bka' 'gyur der bzhugs/ lo ba'i sgar bkra shis chos 'khor gling rong khams zhabs drung gis btab/ phyam dkar dang nyang tshang khrir phebs/ byams pa gsung 'byon ma 'ig rtecha du bzhugs/ gyi ling sgar dga' ldan dar rgyas gling ni(gcig bsdus kyi khongs su ma 'dus par rang rkya'i dgon pa zhig tu grub)rong khams 'bas drung chos rgya mtshos btab/ sha ri'i ri brod pa dkon mchog phun tshogs 'di nas 'khrungs/ reb tsha sgrub sde'i ma dgon rgyal mo bsam grub gling sprul sku dge legs dh+warmas btab/ gong kha'i byams pa byin can dang 'khar rnga/ sbub 'gangs chen bcas der bzhugs — 274 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/so/ dbon ma lag grub sde bco brgyad(da lta je mang du 'phel )du grags pa lnga mchod smon lam la mnyam tshogs kyis dge 'dun chig stong nye bas nyin gsu ma la ras bris steng nas gsang 'dus bdag 'jug smad rgyud ltar dang nyin lhag ma rnam sa la rgyud stod phyag bzhes bzhin rnga chings gtor rgyag 'o sa ra tshes gtor bcas tshugs/'dus sde ni rgyal mo rngog dang / thang tshang / gse ra 'od ma do/ 'u nga nag tsha ma do/ shing ra/ reb tsha phu/ gyi ling / lo ba bcu dang / chos rdzong / rdo dkar/ brag dkar/ rtse dbus/ lha 'dus/ rnga rbod/ bar gdungs/ rong bo'i du khung sdong bcas mchod ga'is co ne rdzong dang bas nga chu rdzong gnyis kyi grong tsho su ma cu longs/ spyi khyab tu rngog tsho ba lnga'i ma dgon la ngos 'dzin no/ /reb tsha'i sku zhabs ngag dbang blo gros bsta na pa zhes pa ni rang sa'i a mgon nang sde bar sku 'khrungs /bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi thos bsam gling du zhugs par yongs 'dzin dkon ma chog bsam grub dang 'dzin grwa gcig dgung lo nyer gnyis la dbus su slob gnyer phebs te sa dge rnying gsum gyi gdams pa la mnga' brnyes shing bka' 'gyur gyi lung thob/ nga bdun pa rang yu la du phebs nas lam rim dang kun rig rgyan 'jug gsang 'dus so gas kyi dbang lung bstsal/ don drug la rang yul du sku gshegs par gdung rten da lta 'ang dgon du bzhugs shing nang rten du glang dar khrims phog ma zer ba bzhugs so/ /dgon pa 'di rab rgyal sa khyi lo nas me rta lo 'jig skabs su tshogs chen 'du khang dang rgyud pa'i 'du khang /gnas chung btsan khang / rgyud pa'i btsan khang / grwa tshang so so'i rung khang / spyi khang bzhengs pa dang /grwa shag brgya nga drug phub par dge 'dun pa bzhi brgya gya bzhi 'dus/ rgyal mo'i nang chen/ ma/khan po'i nang chen/ sro nga bo'i nang chen gsu ma yod/ dgon pa'i rten gtso bo thugs rje chen po dang / klu dbang rgyal bo/thub pa rdor lda na ma sogs lha grangs chig khri ya na dang / gsung rten la co ne bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/skyes chen dag gi gsung 'bum sogs po grangs nyis stong lhag thugs rten du bka' gdams mchod rten sogs byin can lnga mchis so/ nags tshal dang sa 'ing / spyi rdzas sogs gzhung gi dpal 'byor ha cang phyug por gyur cing / khyad par du reb tsha'i bla dpon skar ma zhis par chos srid zung gi khyad dbang lha ga tu lda na no/ /rab rgyal sa khyi lo nas me rta lo bar dgon pa 'jig na'ang da lta( 19rdo 0lor)sla ra gsos rjes nang rten gtso bo shul lus paṇa chen dgu ba blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma sa gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba dang / thub pa rdor ldan ma/ sangs rgyas mar me ma dzad/ byams pa/ sgro la dkar/ klu dbang rgya' bo'i thang ga bka' gdams ma chod rten sogs du ma/ 'du khang bskyar bzheng du mang tshogs kyi dngul sra nga sto nga phrag lnga lhag gi sbyor 'jags thob/ dgon par grwa tshang gnyis te rmad byung thos bsam gling dang smad rgyud grwa tshang tshugs/ da lta'ang 'du khang lha khang tham sa cad bskyar du bzhengs/ dge 'dun pa zhal bzhi brgya tsam 'dzoms par grwa shag brgya dang brgyad cu phub/ las sne la tshogs chen khri ba/ bla ma gzhung las pa/ tshogs chen 'al ngo / tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ chab dag ma/ tshogs chen spyi ba/ dkor gnyer che chung / ja — 275 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dpon dang / rgyud par bla ma/ dge bskos/ byang 'dren che chung sogs 'gan yun lo gcig nas gsum /'chad nyan sgom sgrub thad du mtshan nyid pas kha dog dkar dmar/ bsdus 'bring / rtags rigs /gzhung rgyugs spro da pa/ gzhung zhol / gzhung gong / phar phyin dang phar phyin dam bca'/ dbu ma/mdzod/ bka' rams bcas 'dzin grwa dgu'i srol tshugs pa dang gzhan rig gnas kyi skor sbyong bar bya/smad rgyud la thog mar mgon chos nas rgyud gzhung / rgyugs sprod/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ thig rdul tshon/ rab gnas / mtshams bsnyen so gas mchis/ de bzhin zla re'i chos thog kyang zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam/ zla gnyis par dpyid chos/ zla gsum par dpyid chos gnyis pa/ zla bzhi bar smyung gnas sdom pa/ zla lnga bar dbyar chos/ zla drug pa dang bdun par dbyar gnas/ gtor chen/ rigs ga zla brgyad pa nas dgu bar ston chos dang bo dang gnyis pa/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos chen mo sogs chos thog rer rnga chings dang bcas pa tshad ldan du spel bar bya/ da dung 'cham dang lcags mkhar/ gtor rgyag so gas cho ga dad ldan mig dbang 'phrog pa mang bo yod/ de snga reb tsha'i sprul sku dang / mkhan po skal bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dus 'khor sprul sku skal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho gsum pe cin du paṇa chen bcu ba gdan 'dren phebs skabs rin po che khong gis klu dbang rgyal bo'i thang sku byin can gcig dang na bza'/ phyag tshwa/ 'dra dpar gnang ba dang gung thang drug pas skye rabs so bzhi'i thang ga cha tshang / thub pa rdor gdan ma byin can bcas gnang ba dgon nang du bzhugs/ 198 2lor paṇa chen rin po che rang dgon du phebs te phyag dbang chos bka' mang du bstsal pa dang shing byi la gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug phebs nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al gyi dbang dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi tshem drub gcig gnang / me stag la kun mkhyen drug pa phebs te dgon pas rang kha rang gso byed par 'al bkod gnang / rje rin po che'i li sku zhig bstsal/ dgon pa rang gso'i thad du sman khang dang tshong khang / skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor sogs gnyer zhing chos spyod thams cad yar rgyas rgyun ldan spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /lha khang lung ri khrod dge 'phel bsam gtan gling /lha khang lung ri khrod dge 'phel bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)rgyal mo dgon zhang tsha mdo sde ba'i shar 'gram du chags/ri khrod 'di lha khang lung ba'am reb tsha'i bla ma(a lags rgyal mo)sku rabs gsum pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dgung lo bzhi bcu lcags sbrul(spyi lo180 01)lor btab/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs su dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho rten du phyi rol tu zhag bdun las lhag mgron gsol gnang dpe/ lha khang du lha mo srung mar bsten cing dge 'dun par 'dul phyag rnam dag btsugs/ kun mkhyen bla ma ri khrod du gdan drangs/ lha khang du rten gtso lha ldan nas spyan drangs pa'i gong kha'i byams sku byin can/ tshe dpag med/ bka' 'gyur sogs gsung 'bum — 276 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mang bo bzhugs pa dang / lam rim dmar khrid/ rje dge rgyam pa'i rnam thar/ rdor gcod/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs kyi par shing bsgrugs/ gzhan lha khang lung ba rang gi nang chen du gong kha'i byams pa/ thub pa/ tshe dpag med/ tsong kha pa/ sgrol dkar ljang sogs li ma/ gnas bcu dang rje gzigs pa lnga ldan tshem drub thang ga brgyad stong ba gser bris/ bka' 'gyur/ rgyal mo'am reb tsha sprul sku drug pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gdung rten sogs bzhugs / nang chen la rta dre'u phyugs zog brgyad cu lhag dang nang ba'i nags lung ra gnyis/ rgyal mo'i dgon gnas 'dus pa'i sa zhing mchis/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor ri khrod dang me rta lor nang chen bsnubs so/ /spyi lo1988lo nas rgyal mo'i bla ma'i nang chen du gzim shag che chung dang der mkho sku gsung thugs rten la paṇa chen bcu bas gnang ba'i 'jigs byed/ thugs rje chen po mig 'byed/ rta mgrin chos skor sogs sna mang 'dus par bzhugs so/ /brag lung ri khrod dge ldan dar rgyas gling /brag lung ri khrod dge ldan dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)rgyal mo dgon zhang gi stod du chags/ri khrod 'di gna' dus slob dpon pad+ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba nag po/ sprul sku bsod nams ye shes chos dbang sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin par grags/ bka' 'gyur ba gnyis pa blo bzang nyi mas sgrub sde btsugs/ srung ma lha mo bkur cing / rten gtsor rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang shar li byin can/ sman bla'i blos bslangs/ blo nyi ba'i gdung rten/ rje yab sras/ bka' 'gyur/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i seng gdong ma byin can sogs bzhugs/ rje 'di ba'i gsung 'bum po ti gcig ga'i par shing brkos/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma blo bzang chos mtsho'i slang rus kyang bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur ba sku thog dang bo dge legs dharmas rgyal mo bsam grub gling phyag 'debs mdzad cing yun ring skyong bar grags/ bka' 'gyur ba gsum pa dkon mchog 'jigs med(a lags brag lung zer)de snga skya sar bud de ri khrod bskyangs/ brag lung du lha khang dang bka' 'gyur ba'i nang chen/ grwa shag khang mig du ma bcas bskrun/ ri khrod rang la su rug rta dre'u phyugs zog drug cu rtsa dang shog sgor lnga brgya'i sa zhing / rdo dkar dme sde khe'u kyog kha tshun rtswa sa bdag gir 'dzin/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor ri khrod bsnubs so/ /da lta brag lung bka' 'gyur ba dkon mchog 'jigs med dgung lo don brgyad slebs pa'i dus 'dir lha khang rten dang brten pa/ nang chen ra chen po khang mig du ma can bcas slar bskrun cing btsun pa gcig dang dge slong ma gsum/ khong khyim tshang sku 'khor bcas lung bar 'dus te dad ldan mi ser gyis rim gro chung shas dang phyag mo lung bstan rem la spyi lo2 0 0 2lor sku 'das so/ /— 277 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs / zen— ba 4— 4 bsgo— — —— — 444———— ———— —44ge —— ———— ———snyetho —gser 'od mdo'i mgon po'i lha khang /gser 'od ma do'i ma gon po'i lha khang zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul (da lta 'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)rgyal mo dgon 'ang rngog gse ra 'od mdo'i mkhan chen rnga rgod nam mkha' seṅge'i 'khrungs sde'i grong 'gram du chags/lha khang byin can 'di da ba rgyal shing phag 'o ste spyi lo1925'o ra bzhengs / srung ma mgon po byin can li ma dang mgon po nag thang bkur/ rten gtso rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang li ma / sto na pa gtso 'khor gsum pa / rta ma/grin/ tshe lha rnam gsu ma/ sman bla/ sgro la dkar ljang / blo ba dpon/ rje ya ba sras/ gnas bcu/gshags lha so lnga/ thugs rje chen po/ dga' lda na lha brgya ma dang / bla mchod/ skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing dang rgyal chen/ srid pa'i 'khor lo/ rigs lda na rgyal bo so gas li ma sman sku thang ga mang / gsu nga rten du bka' 'gyur/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ la ma sngags sogs mang bo bzhugs/ 'o re'i zla lnga ba'i nang thugs rje chen po mi ṭa dzo ga'i sgo nas ma ṇi ril sgrub tshugs pas sems can la shin tu phan par gyur/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor bsgrubs/ dad lda na mang tshogs kyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos la lha khang slar bzhengs shing srong bo sku phreng lnga ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gdung rten sogs bzhugs/ da lta ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi cho ga slar gsos so / /tsha mdo'i phyag rdor 'khor chen lha khang /tsha mdo'i phyag rdor 'khor chen lha khang zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)rgyal mo dgon zhang tsha mdor chags/'khor chen lha khang 'di rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing phag lo ste spyi lo1〈75lor bzhengs/ srung ma lha mo nag thang bzhugs / rten gtsor phyag rdor 'khor chen 'khor brgyad ka dang 'khor chen sku 'bum bco lnga/ga'an thub pa dang 'od dpag med/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ 'jigs byed/ rta mgrin/gnas bcu/ gdugs dkar/ sgrol dkar ji nga / grub chen thang sto nga rgyal bo/ rnam sras rta brgyad/ rje tsong kha ba so gas mang bo dang / gsu nga rten du co ne'i bka' 'gyur/ yum/ ting 'dzin/ 'phags pa/bskal bzang / gzungs 'dus / lam rim / sngags rim so gas sna tshogs pa bcas bzhugs / lo re'i zla lnga ba'i nang thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs ma ṇi ril sgrub rgyas pa tshad ldan du spel / rab rgyal sa khyi 'o ra lha khang bsnubs / 198khalor lha khang bzhings shing rten bzhugs thams cad bzhengs pa dang ma ṇi ril sgrub rgyun 'khyongs byas so/ /jog u rgyan lha khang /rngog u rgyan lha khang zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)rgyal — 278 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mo mgon 'ang rngog gshis khog steng khug tu chags/rig sngags 'chang ba rnying ma'i lha khang 'di rab rgyal shing glang lo ste spyi lo192 5lor rngog gi a myes zhes pas bzhengs/ srung ma ma gza' rdor gsum bkur cing rten gtsor slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs/gzhan gu ru mtshan brgyad/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ slob dpon stong sku sogs sku'i rten dang / gsung rten la yum 'bum pa/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gas nga sngags rnying ma'i gsung 'bum shin tu mang bo bcas bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor 'jig pa1995lor mi ser dad ldan re gnyis kyis rten gtso sogs dang lha khang stabs bde tsam slar bzhengs / /shar ba mthil lha khang /wa ci'i shar ba mthil lha khang zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)gi rgyal mo dgon zhang smad du mchis/shar ba ma thil lha khang ngam sgom khang de bla ma sro nga po 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rab rgyal lcags phag pho(spyi lo1911lo)mchod khang lta bu bzhengs pa yin te/ dam can rdo rje legs pa srung mar bsten cing sma na bla bde gshegs brgyad/ thub pa/ spro la dkar/ 'jigs byed/ mgon chos/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rta mgrin/ slob dpon/ tshe lha rnam gsum / dga' lda na lha brgya ma/ skyabs 'gro'i tshogs 'ing / thugs rje chen po phyag ba'i ba/ gnas brtan bcu drug gdugs dkar so gas sku'i rten li ma gang mang dang /bka' 'gyur/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gzungs 'dus / gso rig rgyud ba'i so gas gsu nga rten bzhugs/ 195〈lor lha khang 'jig pa dang bla ma sku gshegs so / khong la su rug rta dre' phyugs zog lnga bcu tsam yod/ 1996lo'i zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis pa srong po tsho bas bla ma'i ya nga srid blus shing gdan sa reb tsha'i rgyal mo dgon dge lda na dar rgyas gling du slar yang nang chen gzim shag bkod legs shig bzhengs grub bo/ /gyi ling dgon dga' ldan rab rgyas gling /gyi ling dgon dga' ldan rab rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)klu shod 'ang gi khongs su chags/chos sde 'di dang thog kun ma khyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i skabs(spyi lo1791lo'i sngon) su rong khams zhabs drung chos rgya mtsho('jam dpal rdo rje zer ba'ang snang)zhes pas gyi ling thang ga'i gdugs dkar gnas ri'i mdun du phyag 'debs mdzad cing bca' yig mdzad zer/ 'bas drung 'di nyid nas sku phreng gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bstan pa seṅge / sku phreng bzhi ba 'jigs med nam mkha'/dbal mang rim byon yun ring bskyangs/ chos skyong du lha mo bsten pa dang gnyan chen phying ba bzhugs /— 279 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/dgon du 'du khang dang byams khang / mgon khang / gdugs dkar lha khang / spyi khang bcas ba'engs/rten gal chen la'ang 'jam dbyangs dkar bo gsung 'byon/ tsan dan gyi jo bo shākya mu ne/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / dus gsum sangs rgyas/ gnas brtan bcu drug rje bstan pari sngon me'i phyag bzos rje 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i 'dra sku/ rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i gzungs gzhug sangs/ rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung bzhugs pa/ tha 'og pa/ gdugs dkar 'al gcig phyag gnyis gsung 'byon ma/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / tsan dan 'a sa grub pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al/ mi 'khrugs pa lha ngagu/btags drub jo sku/ khyad par du 'bas drung dang bos gnang ba'i mkhar brag rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'i mgon po bram gzugs kyi rdo sku rang byon/ 'jam dkar gsung 'byon ma / sgrol dkar gsu nga 'byon ma/bstan sgro na pa'i phyag bzos rwa lo tsā ba'i phur bu/ bskal bzang gser bris/ mdzad bcu'i thang ga sogs dang / rong khams 'bas drung nyid kyi dung dkar dang ma cig 'a ba sgron/ rong khams 'bas drung gnyis pa'i sku gdung / klong rdol bla ma'i sāts+tsha / lab sgron ma'i 'bas cag rje yab sras na bza' so gas dang /'jigs med dbang bo'i dbu zhwa dang sku chas/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ gung thang blo gros kyi smad g.yog grub chen mirte ba'i sāts+tsha/ gzhan bris thang sogs dang mchod rdzas gya nom pas bkang bar byas/ gsung rten du bka' bstan gser bris tshar re/ yu ma(dung bris)dang rje yab sras/ bab/'a gdams pha bu/ bstan sgron sogs kyi gsung 'bum / tsong kha brgyad cu bzo drub can/ sku'i rten la dbyen 'dum mchod rten sogs yod kyang rab rgyal sa khyi lor rten dang brten pa gcig kyang ma lus par 'jig go/sngon chad dgon par grwa shag nyer dgu dang btsun pa re gsum bzhugs kyang / bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag yin/ sbyin bdag a mchog stod ma khyim pa brgya lhag dang gyi ling grong sde du ma yod/ chos spyod kyi thad du chos rgya mtsho mchog gis thog mar rgyud stod phyag srol ltar zla dang bor smon lam dang grong chog skor/ zla gnyis par spyi bskang dang gdugs dkar bdag 'jug zla gsum par gdugs dkar sgrub mchod/ sa chogaklu chog sbyin sreg zla bzhi bar bka' 'gyur/ zla lnga bar ma ṇi dang byams pa gling skor/ zla brgyad par mgon chos rten mjal sogs/ drug pa'i nang lha bstod/ dbyar gnas/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jugagator sgrub/ gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ rjes su dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pas zla gsu ma pa'i nang spyi shod pa chos dbang grags pas gsungs pa'i gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i sa chog dang klu chog sbyin sreg gi sgrub mchod dang / zla lnga bar mi la'i rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i shwa 'cham/ zla drug par smad rgyud ltar gyi gsang 'dus dang dbyar gnas te/ 'don pa la chos spyod sa sog dang smon lam sna lnga/ gser zhun ma sogs/ gzhan dkyil 'khor ras bzhengs ltar gyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag 'jug zla dgu bar kun rig sbyin sreg klu chog bcas ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dus 'khor lugs yin/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod skabs su gsang 'dus la sogs/ zla bcu gcig par dgun nyi ldog gi cho ga dang 'jigs byed/ mgon chos — 280 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gnyis/ paṇa chen dpal ye'i gsu nga las gdugs dkar zlog chen/ gtor rgyag zla bcu gcig par dge slong rang nyid kyi lha'i bsnyen bkur dang bdag 'jug sbyin sreg sogs kha snon ma dzad/ dus rgyun du zla yar ngo'i gso sbyo nga dang nya la gdugs dkar bdag 'jug yang tshes gnyis la tha 'og pa dang lha tshe/ zla rer mgon chos lnga'i 'phrul mchod bzhi re bcas so /19rnga 2lo'i zla drug par gyi ling chos sgo sla ra phye/ 1984lo'i rjes nas bzung byams khang dang /mgon khang / ma ṇi bcu phrag dbyen 'dum ma chod rten/ rung khang so gas ba'engs pa ma zad da lta tshogs chen 'du khang bzheng skabs yi na te/ dgon du btsun pa 'al brgyad cu lha ga dang grwa shag so lnga phub la / 'du khang dang lha khang gi nang rten la shul lus tsan dan gyi thugs rje chen po/ ci ga sgro ma jo bo 'phags grub ma/skyes rabs so ba'i/ kun mkhyen drug pas gnang ba'i rje sku dang 'od dpag med/ gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis gnang ba'i dpal mar me mdzad dang bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing / dbal mang bzhi bas gnang ba'i rigs gsum mgon po/ byams pa/ gshegs lha so lnga/ rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ gzhan dpag bsam 'khri shing / b.la' bsta na sogs mang bo bzhugs pa dang / bkra brtsegs / thar ma do/ gdugs dkar/ gzungs sna tshogs so gas kyi par shing spus legs brkos pa bcas so/ /klu shod dgon bshad sgrub bstan dar gling /klu shod khyung ri thang dgon bshad sgrub bsta na dar gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul (da lta 'i gtsos grong khyor khongs) klu shod 'ang gi khongs su chags/klu shod dgon pa 'di sngon gyi dgon rnying ngam ri khrod bzhi mnyam du bsres te gsar du btab pa zhig yin te/ dang thog mu to dgon bkra shis bsam gtan gling ni gna' dgon zhig red/ 'don cha kyi rdor sgrub mchod dang bde mchog lu hi ba'i bdag 'jug gas nga 'dus bdag 'jug kun rig bdag 'jug sa chog dang mgon po gur chos skyong du bkur/ mgo ba glang gya'i mu to so gas nang khag ba'i yod pa'i bla ma dam pa byon/gnyis pa bkra shis g.yu lung 'khyil ba zhes pa khri chen dh+wa dza'i zhal snga nas 'brog tis bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho la 'debs bcug des sgo ma nga mkhan spru' blo bzang dkon mchog chos dar la phul pas sku phreng rim byon gyis 'jigs byed sgrub mchod btsugs te bskyangs shing sgo mang tshul khrims rgya mtshos 'du khang gsar skrun mdzad pa dang thugs rje chen po'i bdag 'jug dang 'khor chen bdag 'jug btsugs/ gsum pa rnga rgod sku phreng gsum pa nam mkha' seṅges ri khrod bkra shis bshad sgrub gling de rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya spyi lo174 1lor rnga rgod nyin sgang du btab cing rten gtsor rje nyid kyis phyag bzos thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sku stong rang byon can/ (yul phyogs kun gyi ser skya mjal skor phebs) da lta shul du khang chung gnyis tsam dang rten tsag — 281 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/tsig bzhengs mo da/ bdag po rgyag mkhan nyung bar gyur/ snga ra rten la bzo bo bi sha rkarmas bzhengs pa'i rje sku byin can/ thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga lda na/ rje nam seng nyid kyis sa theb re dang sngags tshar re bzlas nas ma gon po byin can bzhengs pa so gas bzhugs/ 'don cha 'jigs byed bdag 'jug cho ga dang bcas/gas nga 'dus / bde mchog lu i ba'i bdag 'jug phyag mchod/ kun rig bdag 'jugs cho ga bcas yo da/ba'i ba pad+ma'i steng gi dgon chung ni skyid thang ma ṇi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis btab/ 'don cha'i rim pa la 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gas nga 'dus dang kun rig bdag 'jug sa chog thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya ma/tsho'i bdag 'jug bcas tshugs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu lug lor(spyi lo194 2 )kun ma khyen lnga ba bsta na pa'i rgya' ma tshan gyis gong gsal mu to dgon dang bkra shis g.yu lung / rnga rgod sgang / pad+ma'i steng ba'i ga phyogs gcig tu khyung ri thang sde ba spa ra shul du bsdus pa dang / dme shul mu to skal bzang sbyin pa rgya ma/tshor dgon pa 'dzin bdag byed pa'i bka' bstsal/ 'di nyid kyis gsar du gnas ma chog der btab cing khong dgung lo re gsum pa shing sprel ( 1944)lor rgyu yon phul te 'du khang ka ba brgya dang nyi shu gsar du bachengs / 'khor chen lha khang dang mu to'i 'du khang / rdo rje legs pa'i btsan khang bzhengs/ de nas rje nyid kyis grwa ba bu slob rnams la bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang kun rig rta phyug byung gsu ma/ sogs yi dam rgyu da sde du ma 'i dbang 'u nga legs par bstsal / kun ma khyen lnga ba dang mu to skal bzang sbyin pa rgya ma tsho gnyi ga'i thugs smon ltar dang la ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag len bstar ba yin no/ /rnga rgod sku phreng dang bo shes rab rgya mtsho ni rnga rgod klu 'bum phyug gi rgyud du sku 'khrungs / gcen merban bka' bcu rdo rje rgyal mtshan sku 'bum du slo ba gnyer ma dzad/ ma/cho sngon bstan 'dzin chin lbang gis bla ma ra bkur/ gcung bka' bcu shes rab rgya ma tsho 'di nyid 'bras sgo ma nga gi chos grwar zhugs/ gleng bsre bka' bcu thob/ rgyal dbang lnga ba(1617—168 2 )chen po nas lo tsā bar bskos te mergan cho lo gnang / sku phreng gnyis pa rnga rgod nas 'khrungs kyang nar ma son par sku gshegs / sku phreng gsum pa nam ma kha' seṅge mchog gser bo ma do sde ba'i rngog rigs su sku 'khrungs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsu ma 'dzoms pas gsu nga rtsom pota gsu ma/ bzhugs/ sku phreng ba'i ba blo bzang byams pa dar rgyas kyang ma khas pa khyad par can byon pas gsung rtsom po ti gnyis bzhugs / sku phreng lnga ba 'jam/ dbyangs bsam grub bkra shis zer/ sku phreng drug pa skal bzang bsta na pa rgya mtsho'ang ma khas chen gyur stabs gsu nga rtsom po ti gcig bzhugs/ ga'an yang rje blo bzang chos dar sgo mang mkhan por bzhugs/ gzhung po ti lnga la mkhas par grags/ dme shul mu to skal bzang sbyin pa rgya mtsho dbang lung rjes gsum gyi 'byung gnas gyur zer/ dgon par 'du khang dang 'khor chen khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang / gzhung khang tshom sa chen/ dam can lha khang sogs yod pa dang nang chen la dme shul mu to tshang dang sgo mang tshang / rnga rgod tshang / glang bya'i mu to tshang / skyid thang tshang / sug thung tshang bcas drug yod do/ /— 282 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/chig dgu nga brgyad lo'i sngon du dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs la so gas ni/ gser zangs las grub pa'i jo bo shākya tsan+dan jo bo gnyis/ tshe dpag med khru bdun re can/ thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum pa/ gsang 'dus/ kun rig thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al/ rnam rgyal ma/ sgro'/ dkar ljang / gnas brtan bcu drug sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ rnam rgya' sogs mchod rten bcu drug 'dod lha bdun cu don brgyad so gas li ma brgya drug tu lhag dang / 'jigs byed blos bsla/ngas gser bzhengs / sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje gtso 'khor gsum pa/ byams pa/ tshe dpag med/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan sto nga /chos rgyal / byam sa pa/ mgon pa so gas khru tshad mthon po dag dang / seṅge sgra shing las grub pa khru bco brgyad can/ 'khor chen khang du gser bzang las grub pa'i phyag rdor 'khor chen khru bdun can dang dngul gyi byang chub mchod rten khru drug can/ shing bzhengs 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso/ mchod rten khru bdun re can gsum/ phyag rdor blos bslangs khru bco brgyad can sogs dang / gyan thang dang thang ga sum brgya lhag gsung rten la co ne'i bka' 'gyur tshar gsum dang co ne'i bstan 'gyur tshar gcig ga'an gsung 'bum/ stong lhag bzhugs/ par shing gi thad du rnga rgod nam seng gsung 'bum dang rnga rgod byams pa rab rgyas gsung 'bum/ a khyung ngag mkhyen gsung 'bum/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ kun rig cho ga klu chog sman bla ring thung / smon la ma yo ngas rdzogs/ chos spyod cha tshang / gcod pa/ tshe mdo/ rdor sder/ gzungs sna tshogs bcas dang / sku par la rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ gdugs dkar/ srung 'khor sna tshogs/ sgo mang mkhan po'i 'dra sku/ 'dod lha sna tshogs bcas shin tu mang / thugs rten ma/chod rdzas la gser tog dang rgyal ma tshan/ ri dwags chos 'khor/ spen rgyan/'khar rnga/ dung chen/ tsi tog rkang gleng / sbub/ tsen/ rdor dril/ spos phor/ maṇ+ḍal /tshogs bum/ las bum// khrus sder/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/dngul kong / dngul theb/ li theb/ rag theb/ rag kong / spyi blug bya ma bum/ 'khar gsil/gdugs/ ka 'phan/ ka thum/ nor chab/ chos 'jug rigs lnga / zhwa mo/ lda ldi/ snam sbya ra/chos gos / mthong 'khor/ sbra yo la/ ja pra thug pra/ ras gur/ tshogs zangs chu zo nyer lnga can/lag rnga/ ma chod rnga/ lhu nga bzed la so gas gya nom pa bsgrugs so/ /dgon par chos thog shin tu mang ya nga 'dir mdor bsdus na/ zla gcig par smon 'a ma chen mo bkra shis 'khyil ltar/ gnyis par dpyid chos yar tshogs/ gsang 'dus bdag 'jug lhung bzed mchod pa/ma gon chos / gdung ma/chod/ bde mchog chog rkyang / 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gtor chen/ chos mtshams smon lam/ gsum par bde mchog sa chog dpyid chos yar tshogs/ bde ma chog bdag 'jugachos mtshams smon lam/ bzhi bar smyung gnas/ gsang 'dus sa chog gsang 'dus bdag 'jug chos mtshams smon lam/ lnga bar dbyar chos yar tshogs/ bde mchog sgrub mchod/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug— 283 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi khongs/ma ra ngo'i mgon chos/ dgu gtor 'bring / drug par lhung bzed mchod pa/ yar ngo'i gsang 'dus/rab gnas chen mo / bdun par ya ra ngo'i gas nga 'dus/ gsang 'dus bdag 'jug mar ngo'i ma gon chos/ bde ma chog bdag 'jug chos mtshams smon lam/ dbyar gnas nyi ma zhe lnga/ brgyad par ston chos yar tshogs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ril sgrub/ mgon po 'i rgyas sbyin sreg lhung bzed mchod pa/yar ngo'i gas nga 'dus/ bde ma chog sgrub ma chod/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug ma ra ngo'i ma/gon chos /gtor chen/ dgu bar chos mtshams smon lam/ 'jigs byed sa chog sa dkar chos thog 'jigs byed bdag 'jug klu chog bcas/ smyung gnas / bcu bar lnga ma/chod ya/ra tshogs/ lnga ma chod chen mo/ bcu gcig par chos mtshams smon lam / gtor rgyag nyi ldo ga cho ga dgun chos chen mo// yar ngo'i gas nga 'dus/ gas nga 'dus sgrub mchod/ bde mchog sgrub mchod/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug mar ngo'i ma gon chos/ gtor 'bring / bcu gnyis par yar ngo'i gsang 'dus/ chos mtshams smon lam/ gtor sgrub bcas 'o hri' bor nyin brgya lnga bcu lhag 'o ngas/ lnga mchod dang smon la ma tshogs chen dang chos thog ga'an pa smad rgyud ltar/ zhogs par dus rgyun khri chen gyis gong bar zhol gsum la brtsi bzhag 'chad pa dang gung tshigs su dbyar dus 'grel ba ba'i sbrags khrid/ dgun la bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho gnang / sku rim 'a gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud gzhi byed/ 'a sa sne la khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ byang 'dren che chung sogs yod/ zhar du dge 'dun rang mos kyis rig gnas dang / sman rtsis/gzhung chen gang yod slob par byed/ skabs der dgun du grwa grangs brgya dang drug cu bzhugs pa la rab rgyal sa khyi lor grwa ba gtor cing rten dang brten pa yo ngas su 'jig go/da lta dgon pa rdzong gis sla ra gso 'i chog ma chan gnang bas btsun ma nga rgan gras rnams slar 'dus shing /klu shod lung ba'i dad ldan ma nga tshogs la brten nas tshogs chen 'du khang dang rung khang / mchod rten/ gung thang gzim khang sogs bzhengs pa dang / grwa shag bzhi bcu rtsa phub par grwa mang 'al brgyad cu 'dzoms te sngar srol chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel bzhin yod la/ dgon pas rang kha rang gso byed par tshong khang sman khang sogs stabs bde re gnyer bzhin mchis so/ /reb tsha'i dgon/reb tsha'i dgon zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)klu shod zhang lo ba'i khongs su chags/reb tsha'i dgon (dngos gnas lha khang lta bu rgya khyon ha cang chung) zhes pa rab nyi'i lcags 'brug (spyi lo170 01)lo yas mas su btab par grags/ lha khang du srung ma lha mo'i nag thang bsten/ ston pa me thar ma byin can rten gtsor bzhugs/ tshe lha rnam gsum dang 'jam dbyangs/ rje yab sras bcas li ma dang /— 284 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dus gsum sangs rgyas/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / 'od zer can ma/ phyag rdor sogs sman sku/skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod/ gnas brtan bcu drugagadugs dkar sogs kyi thang ga bka' 'gyur gser bris sogs mang / rab rgyal sa khyi lor bsnubs/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug lor dad ldan mi ser rnams kyis lha khang gi rten dang brten pa snga ma'i lhag cig bzhengs so/ /bde chen sgang ri khrod/reb tsha'i bde chen sgang ri khrod ces pa ni/ gan lho khul( da lta'i bsang chu rdzong khongs)lo ba sde ba'i nye logs kyi bde mchog gi gnas yin par gleng ba'i sgang der rab byung bcu gnyis pa shing stag(spyi lo1724)bde chen sgang du ri khrod btab/ thub sku ngo mtshar byin can zhig rten gtsor byas pa dang / bde mchog yab yum/ 'khor chen/ rje yab sras/ rta mgrin sogs dang mchod rten gcig bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi(1kha58)lor 'jig kyang chig dgu go gnyis lor lha khang slar gso sa nas thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang mgon po bram gzigs/ slob dpon le ma sogs cung rgyas pa 'dzoms par bgyis stabs dad lda na rnams kyis phyag mchod chag med byed par gyur to/ /shwa ri'i ri khrod/gyi ling shwa ri'i ri khrod ces pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi(da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)klu shod 'ang gyi ling sde ba'i mar lung du chags/ri khrod 'di ni kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i(172〈—17kha1)ring la rje sgra sgyur mar ba'i rnam sprul du grags pa 'bar ba'i dkon mchog phun tshogs zhes pas btab/ lha khang du rten gtso la tsan dan las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po phyag ba'i gsung 'byon ma dang / 'od dpag med/ lab sgron/ rta mgrin sogs shin tu mod par grags/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor bsnubs kyang da lta mang tshogs kyis slar gso'i sta gon dang phyag mchod byed bzhin no/ /reb tsha phu'i mgon po'i lha khang /reb tsha phu'i mgon po'i lha khang zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs skyong khul (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)klu shod zhang reb tsha phu sde 'gram du chags/mgon po'i lha khang grags can 'di rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel(spyi lo192 2)lor btab/ rjes su mtsho kha ba dkon mchog chos 'phel mchog gis gnang ba'i tsan dan dkar bo'i thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong rten gtsor bzhugs/ mgon po'i nag thang ha cang byin can yin pa bzhugs te srung mar bkur/— 285 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gnas brtan bcu drug thag ga bka' 'gyur/ yum 'bum pa/ ting 'phags bskal gsum la sogs bkang bor bzhugs/ lo re'i zla lnga bar thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi cho ga'i sgo nas ma ṇi ril sgrub tshad ldan bsgrub par bya/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor 'jig kyang1kha8 2lo nas slar gsos/ da skabs sngar bzhin mtsho kha ba skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'al bkod ltar snga ra gyi yan tsam rten dang brten pa tham sa cad bsgrugs shing ma ṇi ri' sgrub rgyun 'khyongs / 1kha91'o ra gung thang drug pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo phebs te lha khang bkod legs der rab gnas ma dzad do/ /'u nga nag lha khang /lung nag lha khang khyad par can 'es pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bas nga chu( da lta 'i gtsos grong khyer khongs)klu shod 'ang gi lung nag sde bar chags/reb tsha'i bla ma ste a lags rgyal mo drug pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rgya mtshos bod rab byung bcu drug ba 'i chu sprel(spyi lo192 2 )'o ra 'al bkod gnang ba dang len sgos lung nag sde bas bzhengs/ kun mkhyen 'jam ba'ad bzhi ba bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ( 1rdo56—1916) gis de snga gnang ba'i thub pa rdor gdan ma rten gtsor bzhugs pa dang srung ma lha mo gtso 'khor gsu ma pa byas / ga'an 'khor chen brgyad dang klu dbang rgyal po'i sman sku/ dga' lda na lha brgya ma'i zhing bkod/ gnas bcu/ bla mchod tshogs 'ing /co ne'i bka' 'gyur/ gzungs 'dus 'a so gas bzhugs pa dang / gdugs dkar dang gdong skor gyi par shing / mchod rdzas mod po bsgrugs / lo re'i zla lnga bar thugs rje chen po mi ṭa dzo ki'i cho ga nas ma ṇi ril sgrub bgyid par bya/ bod rab rgyal sa khyi lor bsnubs/ 19〈kha'o ra lha khang 'u nga ba'am a lags rgyal mo bdun pa 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya ma tsho'i zhal bkod ltar lha khang dang nang rten thams cad snga las bzang bo bsgrugs shing par shing brkos/ ma ṇi ril sgrub rgyun 'khyongs so/ /gyis tshang sgar dga' ldan chos gling /sgyis tshang sgar(spa nga ri'i dgon)dga' ldan chos gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi sgyis tshang zhang du chags/dge lugs pa'i smad rgyud sgrub grwa 'di/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa'i rdo rje mdo smad du byon pa'i rjes su sgyis tshang mkhas btsun gyis mchod gnas shig dgos tshul zhus pas/ bkra shis 'khyil rgyud grwa gsar tshugs dus kyi nyang dka' bcu ma/chog grub la dgon pa 'debs par bkas gnang / nyang tshang ba bla ma sman lung du sgrub khang brtsigs te yun ring bzhugs thog sgyis tshang mkhas btsun gyis sbyin bdag byas te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta ( 172ra)'o ra dung phrug ri khrod pas bzung ba'i sgom khang gi 'dabs su dgon pa btab cing nyang tshang rim byon gyis bskyangs/ rab byung bcu ba'i ba'i lcags byir(1〈40)nyang tshang rje dh+wadza — 286 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su 'u glegs bam/ste dbal mang paṇ+ḍita la dgon pa phul pas dgon gnas sman khang ma dor spos/ smad rgyud kyi grwa tshang btsugs shing 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu can bzhengs/ spyi rdzas ba'ag khri ba bla brang nas ma ngag rgyu dang bla dbu ma dzad bsko srol phye/ kun ma khyen 'jigs med dbang bos thog ma'i bca' yig gnang yang de 'jig pas kun mkhyen lnga bas bskyar mdzad gnang / sngon chad bla brang nang chen dang nyang tshang nang chen/ sgyis tshang smyung gnas pa'i gzim khang / grwa shag zhe gnyis su dge 'dun pa zhal brgya lhag bzhugs / ma chod ga'is sam sbyi na bdag tu tsho ba la rin chen dang bum gshes gnyis/ lha sde la sde ba dgu ma chis so / /dgon pa'i las sne la khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad/ gnas brtan pa lo gsum re dang dge bskos lo gcig re/ byings 'dren che chung lo gsu ma re bcas bsko bar bya/ dgon pa'i rten gtso shas la/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i shangs ma tsha' las bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed dang rig gsu ma mgon po/ byams sku khri nyer ba'i 'o ngas pa/ nye sras brgyad/gshegs lha so lnga/ kun rig dang tshe dpag med/ 'od dpag med/ sto na pa gtso 'khor gsu ma / gnas bcu so gas dang / bla brgyud dang rgyud sde ba'i'i lha tshogs/ tsong kha brgyad cu so gas sku brnyan grangs brgya su ma cu lhag lo ngas/ sde dge'i bka' bstan/ co ne'i bka' bstan bcas tshar gsum / yu ma 'bum pa tshar ba'i('bum dang ting 'phags bskal gsu ma gser bris dang dung bris) bsta na pa'i sgro na me dang 'ang sto na bsta na pa rgya ma/tsho'i gsu nga 'bum bcas pota chig stong ya na bzhugs/ gser zangs dang tsan dan gyi ma chod rten brgyad/thugs rje chen po/ rta mgrin/ klu dbang rgyal bo/ phyag rdor/ btsan khang bcas lha khang lnga/ bla brang dang nyang tshang nang chen/ smyung gnas pa'i gzim khang dang so sor rten mi nyung / ñca gas rir ma ṇi 'khor khang rtsig bla brgyud dang rgyud sde'i lha tshogs du ma'i skus gtams par bzhengs so/ /dus chos gal chen la zla dang bor smon lam chen mo nyin bdun/ gnyis par gdung mchod nyin gsu ma/gsu ma par dpyid chos nyin bcu gsum/ bzhi bar kun rig sgrub mchod dang smyung gnas sogs nyin bcu gcig lnga bar stong mchod sogs nyin bcu gsu ma/ drug par chos thog bde mchog sgrub mchod sogs nyin bcu gnyis / bdun par gsang 'dus sgrub mchod sogs nyin bcu drug brgyad par stong mchod gnyis/dgu bar 'jigs byed sgrub mchod sogs nyin bcu gsu ma / bcu bar lnga ma chod nyin lnga dang bcu gcig par dgun chos nyin bdun/ bcu gnyis par gtor sgrub dang bdun mtsham sa so gas nyin nyer dgu bcas dar ba dang dus rgyun btsun mang la/ khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad kyis 'brel ba ba'i sbrags 'chad pa dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rim skyor sbyong bya/ grwa mang rang gis kyang 'don rta dbyangs / khrid phyag len/dpe khrid sogs gang la gang dgos 'bad brtson bgyi'o/ /de ba'in du sde nyid du sgyis tshang smyung gnas pa zhes pa mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i rab 'byams pa der ljags rtsom pota du ma mchis/ spyi lo1927lor mā chi'i jag tshogs kyis dgon pa bsnubs skabs yongs su 'jig pas yid phangs par gyur to/ /rab rgyal me lug lor dgon pa thengs gnyis par bsnubs kyang / nyang — 287 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/skal bzang kun dga' bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bdag skyong las lcags bya lo nas slar gso'i chog mchan thob/dad ldan mang tshogs kyis bla brang gzim khang tshoms chen bzhengs/ shul 'u sa rje gling 'phel ma byin rlabs tshan kha 'bar ba dang kun mkhyen 'khrungs rabs thag co ne'i yum tshar gcig mdo ting 'dzin gser bris so gas slar rten gtsor bzhugs/ grwa shag lnga bcu rtsa dang dge 'dun pa brgyad cu 'al 'dzoms nas mu ma thud du 'du khang dang / byam sa khang / sto na chos sogs rten dang brten pa bzhengs grub/ rang gso 'i ched du sman khang dang tshong khang / bzo khang / glog 'thag bcas btsugs kyang rnam pa chung bas phan nus phran bu las med do/ /rme rgya dgon thos bsam nor bu gling /rme rgya dgon thos bsam nor bu gling zhes pa'i rgyud grwa ni/ da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong sgyis tshang(sngon gyi dme shul)'ang gi khongs te thang sar dgon dang nye ba'i lho phyogs/ sgyis tshang spang ri dgon pa'i shar phyogs kyi nye char dang / brag ri so sor lha 'i khro ci rigs gnas pa'i brag so ga po sogs sa pra shin tu legs pos bskor ba'i dbus sa ma rme rgya'i thang du chags/ma dgon stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri'i dgon la ga rme rgya ni thog mar dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i skabs sam rab byung bcu gnyis/ pa'i mjug tsam du/ rme rgya tsho gsu ma gyis sbyin bdag byas te/ stag tshang lha mo'i ri khrod pa gro dpon slo ba blo bzang bstan pa mchog gis phyag 'debs ma dzad/ khong gis 'dzin skyong spel gsu ma ci nus bgyis te 'du khang dang rten gsu ma gsar bzheng legs grub byung ba'i mod la/ dbus su phebs te dga' ldan khri rabs nga gsu ma pa khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge ( 1678—1756) phyir mdo smad yul du phebs khar mjal zhing / me rgya dgon grong gnyis sku nyid la phul te bdag skyong gnang rgyu thugs la 'dogs dgos zhes nan gyis zhus pa 'al gyis bzhes/ gro dpon slob khong rang lha sa nas 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge phyir mdo smad du phebs rjes kyi174〈lor stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri dgon phyag btab mdzad nas de'i phyi lor rme rgya la phebs te jo bo rje'i zhal thang mdun du mar me chung ngu tsam gyis mtshan thub pa'i byin can dang / lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra sku mthong ba don ldan/ rje yab sras kyi gsu nga 'bum sogs gnang zhing / rgyud smad grwa tshang ngos gtsang gsar 'dzugs dang bca' yig phyag rtsom mdzad de dgon par thos bsam nor bu gling zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ dbang lung ci rigs gnang ste 'brel tshad smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ rten dang brten par rab gnas gnang ba'i byin mthu las gser rtsi dang tshon mdangs gzi 'bar nyams med du gyur/ lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge(1757da 1〈 49)mchog gis dgon par rten gsum dang mchod rdzas/ gral gdan dang de min mkho chas — 288 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs phyag rdzas mi nyung ba bstsal/ skabs shig khong rme rgyar phebs lam gyi bkra shis lung gong mar 'byor 'phral/ dpal lda na lha mo bsu bar byon pa mngon sum du gzigs te chibs rta las bshol/ de nas bzung dgon pa'i bstan srung gtso bor dpal ldan lha mo bkod pas 'phrin las tshul ba'in bsgrub par thogs pa med/sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge(1rnga54—1875)gdan sa dngos mar re zhig ma 'byor bas dgung lo nyer gsum las ma bzhugs/ sku phreng bzhi ba rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge(1877—1929)mchog rme rgya dgon grong la lan du mar phebs te co ne dpar gyi bka' 'gyur sogs gsung rten gnang zhing / dbang bka' rjes gnang bcas kyi chos char gang mos phab nas 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ chos seṅge sku phreng rim byon gyis skyong bkur gang legs gnang ba'in mchis/ ma dgon lha mo'i gser khri nas a la de'u mgo'i dgon dang sbog tsha'i dgon/ rme rgya dgon gsum la khri ba gcig lcogs kyis mngags srol gtod pa las/ khri rabs so so a la de'u mgo'i dgon dang gcig mtshungs yin no/ /sku gsung thugs rten rags tsam bkod pa la/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje ya ba sras dang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ byams pa dang jo sku/ tshe dpag med dang 'jam dbyangs/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub so gas mi tshad las brgal ba dag dang / khri chen sku phreng bzhi ba'i 'dra sku bdud rtsi 'bab pa nyid kyis rab gnas ma/ rta mgrin yang gas nga gi rdo sku lo rgyus can/ bde gsang 'jigs gsu ma dang sangs rgyas stong sku'i thang ga che chung sogs kyi sku rten mi nyung ba dang / co de'i bka' 'gyur dang sde dge'i bstan 'gyur/ rje yab sras dang khri chen gnyis pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo dang thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/'i gsung 'bum gyis mtshon pa'i gsung rten dang / khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge'i sku gdung mchod rten dang sku 'gag gsol tog rje blo bzang bstan pa'i sgrol me'i gdung rten gser las grub pa'i thugs rten sogs bzhugs/ gzhan 'khar rnga mdzo mo dgu zin ma zhes pa legs nyes kyi snga ltas su rang grags byung ba sogs kyi mchod rdzas mkho chas tshod tsam yod/ 195〈lo dang1966lar dgon pa bsnubs so/ /lo hril gyi chos spyod phyag srol gtso bo ni/ hor zla bzhi ba dang lnga ba dgu ba la smyung gnas re/ zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu drug nas ma ṇi bdun sgrub/ chos 'khor/ zla drug par smon lam dang / tshes bco lnga nas zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig bar dbyar gnas kyi skabs su sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba dang gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/zla dgu bar 'jigs byed dbyangs bcags dang bdag 'jug zla bcu bar lnga mchod/ zla bcu gnyis par chos skyong rnams la lo gtor dang dgu gtor/ ga'an yang / khri chen sku phreng rim byon gyi gdung mchod gang bab dang / zla re'i mjug tu dgu bskang chag med dang bcas so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi(198 2)lor chos sgo slar yang phyes pa nas bzung ste/ gser khri sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge dpal bzang bos thugs khur che bzhes ngang 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang bzhin pa dang / chos dad mang tshogs rang mos kyi sbyin bdag dang zhal 'debs la brten nas snga — 289 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/gzhug tu 'du khang rten dang brten pa/ gser khri'i nang chen dang rung khang bcas legs grub byung zhing / nye char rdzong chos lugs cus kyis 'ib bsher gnang nas / sngar srol khor yug dbang ba'i khrim sa bstun gyi chos lugs bya 'gul spel sa'i dpang yig cha tshang thob yod/ mig sngar/ grwa shag nyi shu nye ba la grwa ba su ma cu lhag 'al 'dzoms pa las/ do dam u yon lhan khang dang bla ma las sne so gas kyi bdag gnyer rtsa 'dzugs cha tshang ba bcas kyi sgo nas thugs mthun khrim/sa gtsang dang chos spyod phyag len so gas ya ra lda na gyi skabs so/ /thang ser dgon dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'apel gling /dme shul thang ser dgon dga' lda na bkra shis chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi sgyis tshang 'ang du chags /sngon 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che rab byung lnga ba'i me yos(spyi lo1 267)'o ra rgya nag lang kru'u sar phebs skabs yul phyogs der brgyud cing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas shig yin par grags / de'i rjes bka' gdam sa glegs bam du 'u nga bsta na pa ltar bsta na pa'i sgro na me dang rje dh+wa dza dbal mang rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan thugs sgres gcig tu gnang gshes/ rab byung bcu ba'i ba'i sa bya lo ( 18 49)hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gcig la ru drug phug bde sgar ba gzhi byas nas rong bo skal ldan rgya ma tsho'i dngos slob don yod seṅges btab pa'i g.ya' lung ri khrod dang / phyi sho'i nyang tshang ri grod ko'u tshang sgar bshad sgrub gling /go chen the bo'i dgon/ lo tsho rwa nag ma'i ri khrod ngo ba nang rnam/sa gcig tu bsdus/ dme shul sde grong bco lngas sbyin bdag byas/ bkra shis gso sbyo nga dang sa brtag slo nga lto 'phye'i thig gnang / tshogs chen 'du khang dang / byams khang / rung khang / rje 'di nyid kyi gzim khang / grwa shag so so 'i sa bcad bgos/ dbal mang gnyis pa rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa khong nyid kyi 'bas sor dgon pa'i khri la bkod/ de nas phyis su chos sde 'di kun mkhyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho tshang la/ phul cing / rje de nyid kyis gas nga 'dus dbang dang de'i sgrub mchod kyi thebs bstsal/ rjes su ya nga brag sgom pa dkon mchog bsta na pa rab rgyas kyis kyai rdor sgrub mchod/ 'dzin grwa gsum la bde lam/ dwags po'i bskyed rim / sngags kyi spyi don brtsi ba'ag sku rim la brtag le'u gnyis ci 'go khri ba na rim gyis brtag gnyis ṭika chen dang kyai rdor bskyed rdzogs gang rigs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad do/ /chos sde 'di'i 'chad nyan gyi bya ba la 'jigs byed/ gsang 'dus/ kyai rdor/ mkha' spyod ma 'i sgom sgrub gtso bo ste smad rgyud ltar yin/ mgon chos lnga bo chos spyod brgyad cu dang 'don rta gar 'cham bcas ni dgongs lung ri khrod bde chen gling ba'i phyag len ltar tshugs/ ga'an sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris dang sum rtags dag gsum/ mngon brjod sdeb sbyor so gas sbyangs pa dang lo rer kun mkhyen rim byon la lo tho 'bul ba'i srol dar chos spyod la lnga mchod chen mo nyin lnga dang / gsum pa'i gsang 'dus sgrub mchod nyin bdun/da 290 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/ba'i ba'i mkha' spyod ma 'i sgrub mchod dang gar 'cham nyin brgyad/ drug pa'i smon lam chen mo nyin bcu/dbyar gnas zla gcig nyin bco lnga/ brgyad pa'i 'jigs byed sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ zla rer rgyud sde mgon chos ba'i sogs dus bzang nyin drug re bcas dar ro/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi'i sngon la tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang gnyis/ btsan khang gcigarung khang / par khang bcas dang / bla brang tshang / dbal mang tshang / dme shul mu to tshang / rnga rgod tshang / shis shod nyang tshang bcas kyi nang chen lnga/ grwa shag brgya tsam la dge 'dun pa 'al grangs brgya bzhi bcu lhag bzhugs/ dgon mthar ma ṇi dang bka' bstan gyi 'khor khang mang bo dang byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ sku gsung thugs rten la 'du khang du rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa nyis thog can dang thub pa gtso 'khor gsu ma/ byams pa/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al/ klu dbang rgyal bo/ lung ston byams pa/ rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'al thang / byams khang du byams sku dkyil krung bzhugs pa tshad nyis thog can/btsan khang du ma gon po gur dang kyai rdor rta mgrin phyag rdor khyad par du bsod grags rdo rje 'chang gis gnang ba'i kyai rdor gser zangs las grub cing bdud rtsi rgyun du 'bab pa dang / sman 'dam las grub pa'i kye rdor dbal ma nga 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos snyan shal 'bul dus dbu sgur sgur byed pa grwa ma nga gis mthong ba dang / khong gis gnang ba'i lha mo gser zangs las grub pa byin rlabs kyi kha tshar can bcas bzhugs/gsung rten la bka' bstan dang sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung 'bum mang bo bzhugs/ par khang du dgon pa'i 'don cha kha tshang dang bde lam / myur lam/ mkhas pa 'ga'i gsu nga 'bum par shing yod do/ /dgon par skyes bu dam pa ma nga tsam byon pa las khyad par du dme shul dga' gong a khu chos 'phe' zhes pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa lug(spyi lo1〈 59)lor sku 'khrungs shing rang dgon du mkhas mchog brtson 'grus dge rgan du bsten nas rgyud gzhung dang dag yig rtsis sa ris sogs sbyangs/ gsung rtsom la rgyu rtsis rtsa ba brtag thabs shes rab ral gri dang dag yig mkhas pa dga' skyed kyi 'grel ba/ rab byung du ma'i spyi bzhag sum rtags rtsa ba rmongs mun 'joms pa'i nyi 'od sogs dang gnas bstod bzhugs so / /19rnga 1lor slar yang chos sgo phye bas chos spyod thams cad rgyun lda na du spel te 'du khang gas ra du bzhings pa dang ma ṇi 'khor khang / grwa shag bzhi bcu lhag grub/ da skabs dge 'dun pa zhal grangs dgu bcu lhag bzhugs so/ /brag sog po'i ri khrod/brag sog po zhes pa'i gnas rnying ri khrod 'di gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong sgyis tshang 'ang gi khongs su yod/ri khrod 'di nyid ha lam rab byung bcu gsum pa'i nang tsam du phug sde dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis — 291 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/btab/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la brtson mkhan mtha' dag gis sgrub gnas shig yin pa ma zad/grub dbang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gnas 'dir phebs te/ / mdo smad bod chen rong khams yul ljo ngas kyi/ / gnas 'dir lus ngag yid kyis dge ba'i las/ / khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len la/ /'bad na gnas dus ga'an las 'gyur che zhing / /zhes gsungs pa'i shis brjod kyi me tog char du phab cing / byin rlabs kyi gter du bsgrubs / kun mkhyen ba'i ba chen po skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo mchog chu yos1kha0 2'o ra gnas 'dir phebs gnang ma dzad de bde ma chog rkang brgyad dang /sgrol ma/ gnas mdun nas 'ing shar+bha la'i smon lam gsu nga ba'in steng gi a yig sogs la gzigs te/ sku 'bum sogs la bskor par phebs skabs su skye bo pho mo mang bas ma ṇi dbyangs su 'then tshul sogs kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i rnam thar du gsal / gang ltar sgrub pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can 'ig yin cing / sgrub khang rten dang brten par1958lor chag 'jig byung / deng skabs sgrub la gzhol mkhan 'ga' zhig gnas shul du bzhugs lags so/ /sngo na po thang dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling /'bo ra'i khrom shog dgon pa'am sngon po thang dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong 'bo ra 'ang gi khongs su yo da/dgon pa 'di chags sa 'i ngos nas rgyab ri spang gi ri bo gser gyi rgyal mtshan mkha' la bsgrengs 'dra dang /mdun ri nags kyi ri bo g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal tshom bur spungs 'drar yod/ dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi thang na stag chu sngon mo dal gyis 'bab cing / gong na rgyal ba rigs lnga'am rigs gsu ma ma gon po'i gnas ri yod la/'gab na〈bka' gdams bu chos〉las/ byang rgyal bo chen po'i mdun drung na/ /thang sngo na po g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal la/ /zhes dang / thang lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūr+ya/ / zhes pa'i lung bstan dang mthun pa'i sngon po thang yod pa dang / ma cig lab sgron gyi ma 'ongs lung bsta na dang mthun par sa ming la mdo zer ba gsum gyi dbus sa'i dge bcu yo ngas su tshang ba'i sar dgon sde chags yod la/ dgon pa'i gzhi khyon gyis ha lam sa mu'u nyis brgya lhag zin no/ /chos sde chen po 'di nyid thog mar phyag 'debs ma dzad pa bo ni/ 'dan chos 'khor gling gi ma khan po 'dan grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi sku rabs gsum pa 'dan ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pas khong gi slob ma rgyal rong ba nam mkha' lhun grub kyi skye bar lung bstan pa/ chin lbang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gis thar mi chi zhes bsngags pa rje blo bzang don grub rnam gnyis te/ khong rnam gnyis thun mong gis rab 'dod sa stag spyi lo1758lo'i zla bcu ba'i yar tshes la khrom thog sngon po thang du gas ra 'debs mdzad cing / mtshan dga' lda na bshad sgrub gling zhes gsol/— 292 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/chos sde 'di btab nas lo nyer gnyis pa rab 'dod sa phag1779lor 'dan mkhan po nyid kyis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo rang dgon du gdan drangs te dgon mgo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la phul/ kun ma khyen gnyis pa'i bka' drin las gzhis dgon rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pas/ dgon pa'i khyon sngar las je rgyas su gyur/ kun mkhyen gsum pa mjigs med rgya ma tsho'i sku ring la dgon pa da lta'i dgon gnas gong ma 'dir spos/ rje 'di bas dgon pa 'dir shwa 'cham gyi srol btsugs/ de bzhin dgon pa 'di ni dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i ring lugs skyong ba'i chos sde zhig yin la/ phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung la thos bsam byed pa gtso bor 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang gcig pu las logs su grwa tshang gzhan tshugs med cing /yig cha dang rgyugs brtsi ba'ag sogs kyi phyag len ma dgon bkra shis 'khyil dang mthun pa dang / grwa tshang yongs la 'dzin grwa dgu yod/ dgon pa 'di ga'i 'don cha sogs ni/ 〈rnam thar dad pa'i sgo 'byed shel dkar phreng mdzes〉las tshogs 'tshog tshul/ zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams bkra shis 'khyil ltar dang / rnga 'ching sogs de dang mthun/ lha mo gsar 'dzugs gnang ba yin/ chos grwa 'tshog tshul sogs de ltar gnang /zhes dang / lo 'di(lcags 'brug17(40)nas rigs grwa nyi ma bco lnga re bzung / tshogs langs byed dgos pa'i srol btsugs/ 'di nas bzung lo re ba'in smon lam chen mo bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag len ltar gnang /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ lo rer cho 'phrul smon lam/ dpyid chos dang bo gnyis pa/ dbyar chos/ drug pa'i ma ṇi/ bdun pa'i rigs ga dgu ba'i ston chos/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod/ dgun chos chen mo bcas chos thog dgu yod do/ /1958lo dang rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i sngon la/ dgon pa 'dir dge 'dun pa sum brgya nyi shu lhag bzhugs shing / lha khang sogs la tshogs chen 'du khang nyis thog mgon khang sum thog gi tshul du bzhengs pa ka ba ring thung nyis brgya lhag can dang / byams khang / mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang / seṅge nga ro'i lha khang /btsan khang gnyis/ mchod rten/ chos khri/ dpar khang / rung khang / btsugs shing / bla brang nang chen/ thar mi tshang / 'dan tshang / rgyal tshang / sgyis tshang tshang / khyom dge tshang / mu to tshang / drung ba tshang / kirti tshang / jo dkar tshang / 'bo ra tshang bcas kyi nang chen dang tshoms/ grwa shag nyis brgya bcu lhag bcas yod/ nang rten la thar mi chi tshang gis yon sbya ra te bzhengs pa'i rgyu gser zangs las grub ba'i jo sku mi tshad can dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i sgrol ma'i sku brnyan mi tshad can/ sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i ston pa dang / byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs bcas kyi sku nyis thog gi tshad can/ nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / rje yab sras gsum/ jo 'brom yab sras sogs kyi rgyu gser zangs dang tsan dan sman 'dam las grub ba'i sku brnyan che chung mang bo dang / thang ga lo rgyus can/ bka' bstan dang / rje yab sras/kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum gyis gtsos pa'i glegs bam pota mang bo/ 'dan tshang dang rnga ba go thob kyi sku gdung mchod rten sogs gdung rten du ma bcas lha rten mchod gsum 'bor chen zhig mchis pa phyis su — 293 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/phal che ba dus zing gi dbang du gyur cing / 196〈lor dgon pa yongs rdzogs bsnu bas te shul tsam du bzos/198 1'o ra tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus dngos 'bab byung bar brten/ dgon pa'i chos sgo slar yang phye zhing sla ra gso byed ma go brtsam sa/ sprul sku rin po che nu to tshang/ drung ba tshang / khyom dge tshang /sgyis tshang bcas kyi dbu khrid 'og rang sa 'i ma/nga tshogs kyi sto bas shugs la brten nas 'du khang ka ba ring thung lnga bcu lhag can rten dang brten pa bcas gsar du ba'engs/ 1992lor dgon pa 'di'i sngon gyi tshogs chen 'du khang gi shul slar yang dgon pa rang la phyir thob pa'i sa ra sngon gyi 'du khang las kyang khyad du 'phags pa'i 'du khang zhig bzhengs/ gong smos 'du khang chen mo gnyis las da dung mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang dang / mu to tshang / khyom dge tshang / drung ba tshang / sgyis tshang tshang bcas kyi nang chen/ grwa shag brgya dang lnga bcu lhag dgon mthar ma ṇi 'khor khang gyan bdun cu lhag dang 'khor khang che ba gcig bcas te/ da skabs shul du lus pa dang gsar du bzhengs pa'i nang rten gtso gras ni rgyu gser zangs las grub ba'i jo sku mi tshad can dang /thub pa khrims phog mar grags pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas / sgrol ma/'i sku sogs yin la/ ga'an yang rje ya ba sras dang / byams pa/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ jo 'brom yab sras/ kun ma khyen sku phreng rim byon sogs kyi sku brnyan dang thang ga shul lus dang gsar bzhengs sum brgya lhag bzhugs / gsung rten gsar blus bka' 'gyur tshar lnga/ bstan 'gyur tshar gnyis / ga'an gsung 'bum pota lnga brgya tsam dang /gser bzhengs dngul gdung mchod rten gcig dang zangs la sa grub pa'i ma chod rten bcu bzhugs so / /dgon pa 'di'i sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i 'bo ra'i tsho ba'i ste/ ston pa'i bu ba'i zhes grags pa rnams ni/khrom thog sngo nag sbog tsa/ tsho dgu/ gad skya ko'u da bcas te/ da skabs dgon pas spyi tshogs la 'bas phyi dang 'tsho rten rang sgrub bya ched par khang gcig sman khang gcig tshong khang gnyis bcas gnyer bzhin yod la / par khang du bse ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i zin bris bcu gsum dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba'i 'a ma rim 'jam dpal 'al lung / a khu gung thang blo gros tshang gi sdom gsum bslab bya/ gzhi gsum la ga len sogs kyi par shing yo da do/ /a mchog dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /a mchog dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu(zhwa ho)rdzong gi a mchog zhang bde mo thang du chags par rdzong thog bar spyi le bdun cu lhag yod cing dgon khongs su dad ldan mi ser zhang gnyis 'dus/chos sde 'di ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa rje 'jigs med dbang bos ( 172〈—1791) par+ṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes( 172rnga—17rnga 0 )dang / rje nyid kyi bla ma gong ma — 294 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/yab sras kyi thugs dgongs ba'in/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba tsong kha ba sa glang lor(spyi lo1409)'brog dga' lda na rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab pa'i dus bstun nas / rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus mchog1709lor dbus nas phyir mdo smad rang yul du bkra shis 'khyil 'debs par phyag phebs shing rtse gzhongs su bzhugs pa dang khong gi bu slob sde khri blo bzang don grub(1672—1747)bcas kyis a mchog gi gnyan chen gong sngon ma dun sa bde mo thang du bkra shis 'khyil gling gsar 'debs kyi gnas gzigs shing smon lam mthun rkyen sbya ra ba'i skar 'dzin mdzad shul der/ rnga rgod dpon slob nam mkha' seṅge dang mu to dpon slob dpal bzang rgya mtsho/ a mchog stod kyi tsho ba brgyad ga'i rgan sems shes 'bring ba(sa ming)phyag rdor 'bum bcas thugs mthun zhal gros bgyis/ 1760'o ste ñca gas 'brug lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin a mchog yul gyi thog ma 'i dben gnas te rje nam seng ba'i ya ru'i dgon lam rim grwa tshang dang rje mu to ba'i ma ru'i rgyud pa grwa tshang zhes pa gnyi ga('jigs dbang rnam thar du dgon 'di dgon chung ngam ri khrod drug bsres tshul gsungs kyang deng sang rjes shul mthong rgyu yod pa 'di gnyis/ tsam mo)bde mo thang gi 'dab g.yas su gnas spar cing de'i dbus su thos bsam gling gsar du bsnan pa'i tshul gyis grwa tshang gsum 'dzoms kyi bshad sgrub a mchog dga' ldan chos 'khor gling 'es pa gsar du btab/ rab byung dge 'dun pa zhal drug brgya tsam 'tshogs/ rje 'jigs med dbang bos khri thog dang bo 'bas kyi mnga' gsol cing chos grwar nyin mang bzhugs te chos sde gsar ba bkra shis par tshugs bcug da dung khong gis lha sa nas sku rjes khrid 'ongs pa'i bu slob se ra blo bzang nyi ma(phyis a mchog dpon slob gsum gyi ya gyal/ se ra sku phreng dang bo) mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi khri rabs gnyis pa dang /rnga rgod nam seng lam rim khri ba/ mu to dpal bzang rgya mtsho rgyud pa'i khri ba bcas bskos/ bla ma 'di dag gi sku ring ngam dus rabs bcu dgu'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i ring bar kun ma khyen sku na rim gyi dgongs pa lta ra dbang bka' chos/ khrims sgrig lam sogs phyogs gang thad nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung / ches dar ba'i dus su grwa ba 'al dgu brgya nye bar slebs byung zhes dbal mang paṇa ṭi ta'i rnam thar du gsungs/ chos sde'i grwa rgyun gtso bo a ma/chog rang tsho ba brgyad da lta'i a mchog zhang dang nyi ma lung zhang)yin pa ma zad/ skabs shig 'bo ra dang klu shod/ sgyis tshang / dme shul/ kho tshe/ tsa yus/ rnga ba sogs nas grwa rgyun phebs par gleng /khyad par du dbal mang paṇa ṭi ta khong dgung lo lnga bcu'i dus( 1〈14lo'i zla dgu ba)a mchog dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs nas chos sde la gsar btod rang ba'in gyi srol bzang mang bo gtan la phab/ khong dang thog phebs 'a ma bab 'u nga nyag khe'u nas a mchog dgon pa ma/thong 'phral zhal nas smad kyi rong sde de'i ming la ci zer zhes zur za'i tshul du gsungs shing / lo drug cu tsam gyi ring dgon pa 'dir khrims sgrig lam sogs legs pas ma bcun par thugs skyo gnang / khong phebs te khri rabs gsum lo ngo dgur skyong khur mdzad de bla btsun thams cad sgrig lam do dam zhib mo bcos pa ma zad/ sgar grong chos srid mnyam skyong gi srol spel cing /khong gis bsngags kyi sbyangs pa dang lugs rtogs kyi yon tan yod na rab/ med kyang tshul khrims gtsang ma — 29 5 —— 294 —

rkar ljo bod rigs rang sbyong khul bsang chu rdzong ri khongs/bsrung dgos zhes gsungs shing / phyi la lcags ri brdungs shing nang la bca' yig bzhag dgon mthar 'brog mtsher chags pa/ grwa bas grwa chas mi banabs pa/ bud med gling du gang byung sogs mtshams bcad/lo hril bo'i dus bzhi'i chos thog je ma nga btang ste/ zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis nas chos 'khor dus ston gyi smon la ma btsugs/ da dung grwa ba rnams la par brko'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel te/ ma/do smad chos 'byung dang deb sngo na sogs mdo mi da du ga'an dring ma mchis pa par du btab ste ga'is byes skya se ra thams cad la blu ru bcug1919lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer drug la he rigs mā chi jag tshogs kyis a mchog tsho bar btsan 'dzu' byas te nang chen gnyis tsam las ga'an dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa/ grwa shag bcas pa/ rong sde ba'i bcu tsam 'phrog bcom me sgro na btang ba ma zad/ skya ser pho mo bdun brgya tsam dmar gsod byas/ de rjes spyi lo192 0lo nas1957lor bar a mchog sgar lung gnyi gas dgon pa bskyar 'dzugs la par shing mang shos ma gtogs pa'i rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs bskyar gsos so/ /rje 'jigs med dbang bo dang khong gi bu slob sku rabs dag gi ring la a mchog yul du chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam srol rim bzhin spel/ a mchog spyi ba dang a mchog sku tshab kyi khri srol 'dzugar tshul ni/ spyi ba dang sku tshab gnyi ga btsun pa bzhugs pa lo gsum rer khri khur lo mtshams yin/ 'dem bsko bya skabs dgon pa'i spyi gnyer las sne dang a mchog tsho ba brgyad kyi grong sde'i tshegs brgyab ('thus tshab) sems shes bcas (radus nas spyi ba(dpon po)dang sku tshab(bla brang dgon pa'i dbang tshab)bdams/ bla brang yig tshang du zhus pa dang chog mchan thob rjes gzod khrir 'khod/ gal te khri mtshams rgyun ma thud mkho bas na bskyar 'dem brgyud dgos/ srol 'dir brten nas snga yod sde dpon tshang ma'i khyad dbang khrims srol bsnubs shing shog pa'i rgyun sro la tham sa cad bla brang ngam a ma chog dgon pas bdag tu bzung ste sgar mgo shog ma go gcig gyur du bskyangs/ lung ba shog pa'i gyod kha 'thab 'khrug che
