sde don chung bza' don thams cad spyi ba'i spyi dbang zer ba'i khrims sgo nas bsdums par bya/ a mchog shog pa ni a mchog dgon pa'i bdag por yin pa ma zad bla brang dgon pa'i mi sde btsan drag can zhig tu gyur pas/ lo rgyus su mā chi jag tshogs dang g.yas g.yon shog pa'i bar 'khrug rtsod thengs mang ste mi ser ma nga bo g.yul las dang jag las su bkums par gyur to/ /dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad la gnod 'tshe ya nga ba thebs kyang rab rgyal sa khyi lor slebs dus su/ dgon pa'i tshogs chen(mtshan nyid)'du khang dang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang / lam rim/ 'du khang /der bstun rung khang dang spyi khang dang drug rgyud pa'i a myes btsan khang / mgon gur btsan khang /gser khang chen mo/ gdugs dkar lha khang / rta mgrin lha khang / par khang nyis thog can/ chos khri sgang ba'i/ btsugs shing skyed tshal gsum/ mchod rten sogs bzhengs/ skabs der bla grwa sum brgya bdun cu zhal 'dzoms shing grwa shag kyang brgya lhag phub/ de bzhin dgon du bla brang tshang dang / yongs 'dzin tshang /dbal mang che ba tshang / dbal mang chung ba tshang / gung thang tshang / bsod grags tshang / sgo mang tshang /— 296 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rgya' tshang bcas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bla chen du ma dang / a mchog rang gi bla sprul la rnga rbod dang / se ra/'u to che ba/ gling rgya'i mu to/ sug thung / zam tsha'i dus 'khor/ dme shu' mu to/ 'bring ba/ hor tshang/ skyid thang / rnga ba/ bse tshang sogs bla sprul gyi nang chen nam gzim/ khang bskrun/ khang tshan rag smo ra brgya dang gnyis lo ngas pa ma zad/ dgon pa rang 'a khral sa khral khang / spyi rdzas 'bor chen/ bla sprul tshor su rug so gas ru skor grong sde ra khyab/ rten gtsor srung ma dpa' lda na lha mo/ dang / gos sku ngo ma/tshar che ba/gse ra babyungs 'phags pa kun tu bzang bo/ kun ma khyen ya ba sras kyi na bza'/ b.la' 'gyur/ bsta na 'gyur tshar du ma so gas sku gsung thugs rten rgya chen pos bltam sa/ khyad par du par shing la ma/do smad chos 'byung dang / nyi ni nga / rgyan snang / bsla ba btus / dpe chos rtsa 'gre' / gtam rgyud rin chen phreng ba/rgyud sto da ṭīkra deb thar sngon po/ lam rim ma chan gcib/ ma/ dbal mang ba'i gsu nga 'bum/ cha tshang /dag yi ga shes bya rab gsal la sogs gnyer bzhin ma chis/ de min 'jim sku dang / gyan thang / thang ga'acham lwa / ma chod rdzas so gas/ kyis phyug par gyur/ mi ser rnams rgyun du 'khrug rtsod ma nga bo brgyung sta bas dge sgrub sdi ga bshags su dgon mthar 'do ba'i ma ṇi dang 'bo ra'i ma ṇi zer ba ma nga bo bcongs co / /dus rabs bcu dgu'i dkyil tsam nas dgon pa'i chos thog rgyun ldan du grub/ gnam 'o gas ra tshes nas bco lnga 'i bar tshe gtor dang / dge rban khri bar 'o sa ra legs skyes 'bul/ de nas dkor gnyer dang 'a' ngo / btsun pa bgres po rnams phud ga'an grwa mang rang rang grong khyim du dus chen rol bar phyag phebs rung ba dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i smon la ma du chas pa mang / tshes bcu drug nas dpyid chos chen mo'i nyin nyi shu/zla gsum pa'i nang dpyid chos gnyis pa nyin bco lnga / zla gsu ma pa'i nyer bdun nas dpyid chos gsu ma/ pa nyin bcu gcig zla ba'i ba'i nyin gsu ma gyi nang ma ṇi smyung gnas nyin 'gar grwa ba ming btags can('chad nyan gyi go sa spa ra ba)gyi mang ja nyin 'ga' re yod la / tshes nyer gcig nas dbyar chos chen mo nyin nyer lnga/zla drug par smon 'a ma nyi ma/ bcu dang bcu bdun nas dbyar gnas chos thog zla gcig (bdun pa'i rigs grwa 'du)/ zla brgyad pa'i nang sgrub mchod nyin bdun dang lnga mchod nyin bcu gsum/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos chen mo nyin nyer gnyis (lam rim grwa tshang gi dgun nyi ldo ga cho ga nyin gcig 'du) zla bcu gnyis par lha mo'i gtor sgrub nyin lnga so gas kyi srol tshugs / spyir dbyar gnas dang ming btags so gas kha shas bla spru la dang grwa bas 'gyed khur bab pa ma gtogs chos spyod ga'an thams cad tsho ba brgyad kyi dad lda na 4 nga tshosas kyis 'khur dgos te de la chos 'phen pa zer/ spyi gnyer 'al ngo gros 'cham sgos khyim pa phyug po tshor 'o res me sa kyis chos thog bgos pa lta ra bstan pa'i sbyin bdag nyin lnga re bya dgos shing / khyim tshang 'bring ba rmam sa nyin gcig rer 'dzin dgos / da skabs kyang gna' srol 'di slar gsos pa'i khar rang dbang rang 'thad dang sde dmangs thun mong gis chos thog sbyin bdag 'khor khel byed ba'in no/ /a mchog dgon pa 'di spyi lo191khalor gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa nas slar gsos pa195rngalo'i — 297 ——

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong gi khongs/gnyis pa'i tshes bco lngar dam ga 'khrug skabs su rtsa brlag thebs/ 1kha6〈lor chos sgo slar phye khul gyis tshogs chen 'du khang gcig dang grwa shag 'ga' phub kyang de rjes rig gas ra las 'gul nang1966lor 'jig198 0lor sla ra chos sgo phye ba nas bzung bor chung ri brod shul lus grwa rgan dang bcas chos sde gcig tu bsres pa'i khar 'bas brtan grwa tshang zhes pa bsnan te grwa tshang ba'i'i rnam pa can du btsugs/ 'du khang sta bas bde dang ga ru tog can gyi chos khri sgang bzhengs / grwa shag mi nyung ba phub/ yin na'ang dgon pa zhang srid gzhung 'a bcad nye ba so/gas kyi rkyen las snga ra gnas shar zung du spos te nas dgon pa gas ra du btab/ da lta 'du khang dang / grwa tshang bci'i dus bzang khang dang rung khang / btsan khang gnyis// chos khri sgang gnyis//par khang bzhengs / gos sku'i bsham stegs / btsugs shing bskyil/ bla blang nang chen/ ma ṇi 'khor khang che chung bcu phrag du ma bcas bzhengs/ grwa shag brgya dang brgyad cu phub par dge 'dun pa 'al ba'i brgya lhag 'dus shing rang gso 'i ched du tshong khang / sman khang / bzo 'khor khang sogs mang bo gnyer bzhin mchis so/ /a mchog snga gas pa grwa tshang /a mchog sngags pa grwa tshang gas nga sngags dar rgyas gling ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong a ma chog zhang gi g.yon zur ram a mchog dgon pa'i g.yas 'dabs su chags/sngags grwa 'di sngon chad gsang sngags snying ma 'i grub ma tha' 'dzin mkhan rnam sa las brgyud par kha rgyun du grags / a ma chog dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi skabs su khes dam ra sde ba'i a myes (sngags pa)kyis dgon sa mi ster ba'i dka' sdug myong ba'i bshad srol byung / da skabs kyang a ma chog a rdog 'u nga sde ba'i sngags 'chang ba dkon mchog ces pa'i bar mi rabs bco brgyad rgyud myangs pa'i khyim tshang gi bsngo yig nang sngags pa mi rabs gsal bo mthong thub/ kho tsho dang thog rong khams sngags brgya'i gras su gtogs shing tsa yus bla ma rin po che bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla mar bsten pa dang / rdzogs chen dpal sprul rin po ches bcings 'grol ya ra sngon bar du dbang 'u nga rjes ma na ngag gdam sa pas bla slo ba kyi 'brel ba yun ring / dus rabs 'di'i 'go stod tsam du a ma chog dang 'bo ra shog pa gnyis kyi bar la gyod 'khrug byung / a dmag gis 'bo ra'i rtswa sa 'i sngags sder dmag brgyab stabs/ a mchog stod nas zhugs pa'i sngags 'chang rnams rong khams sngags brgya'i nang nas khor mgor bud/ spyi lo1kha1khalor a mchog dgon pa yang me 'jig thebs gshis sngags pa rnams 'dus nas a mchog dgon pa'i gnas chung btsan khang gi shul du a mchog sngags grwa gsar du btsugs te o rgyan lha khang bzhengs shing / lo gcig gi dus bzhi'i chos thog la sngags 'chang rnams kyi tshogs chos sbyong tshugs / sngags 'chang kun 'dus nas spyi dbang dang ru sde/ dmag jus sogs lung ba shog pa la sku rim bsang ma chod bya sro/la dar/ 195〈lor rten la o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro bka' brgyad/— 298 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/slob dpon 'ga'i gsung 'bum/ 'cham lwa sogs bsgrugs pa dang / lha khang phyi skor la ma ṇi 'khor lo drug cu bzhengs / yin na'ang lo de'i zla gnyis pa'i bco lnga la 'thab 'khrug la sa me 'jigs kyis bsnubs/skabs der sngags pa so bdun yod do/ /sngags dgon 'di'i chos thog 'don pa ni/ zla gnyis pa'i zla dkyil gyi nyi ma gsu ma ba'i la dpyid chos dang gu ru drag po'i 'cham so gas / zla ba'i ba'i tshes brgyad nas bcu'i bar la 'od dpag med kyi ma/chod pa/zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas nyi shu'i bar gyi nyi ma bdun la thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus bcas dbyar chos/ zla dgu ba'i zla mjug gi nyi ma gsu ma tsam ston chos la rta ma grin/ dgun nyin ldo ga gi snga gzhug nyi ma bdun la dgun chos dang bka' brgyad 'cham bcas rgyun lda na spel / ga'an a/ ma chog tsho ba brgyad dang bkra shis 'khyil/ a ma/chog stod ma sgar 'u nga gi rim gro gang yod dus thog tu tshogs 'don dang / bla brang dgon pa'i sngags pa grwa tshang la 'brel ba zab/ chos spyod thams cad bod ljongs kyi o rgyan smin grol gling ba'i phyag len dang ma tshungs / grwa tshang la khri ba dang dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ mchod dpon/ rnga ro' ba/dung 'bud pa bcas kyi las sne bsko 'jog gi sro' dar ro/ /sngags grwa'i sngags pa rnams spyir khyim/ thab 'a brten cing tshang ma rong 'brog gi las gar zhugs / chos thog gi skabs su yang zas gos tham sa cad chos kyi cho ga lta ra du sdom srung gtsang sbra bya dgos pa dang ma nga ja skol 'dug kyang nyung bas chos thog gi yong 'bab cung 'an/ chos thog la sngags pa kho tshos res mos kyis bskol pa dang dus rgyun kha zas yul nas 'khyer dgos / sngags pa'am khyim gang yin dam ga dang g.yog rgyug 'u 'a ga la 'gro mi dgos pa ma zad/ rtswa rin chu rin gzan gla ster mi dgos pa dang / dpyid rmod sto na brnga'i sngon ma byed pa/ gyod dang kha ma chu byung na snga gas/ khyim lho da ya ngas gnang ba/ lo sar dang sto/na mo/ sogs la sngags pa tshor rang rang gi sbyin bdag des dpon skal zer ba'i lo sar dang 'tshams rtags ster dgos pa sogs kyi dmigs bsal chen po yod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyis slog pa'i mtha' ru ras dmar smug brgyab pas skya mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba dang ma go la ra' ba chen po dkri srol med kyang 'jog sro' che ba snang ngo / /198 1'o ra chos sgo phye ba dang / 1kharnga 4lor rdzong gis grwa tshang sla ra gso la sgor sto nga drug gnang ba bcas o rgyan lha khang dang gzhung las khang ba'engs shing lha rten chos gsum bzhugs/ a mchog tsho ba brgyad de 'ang gnyis dang sde ba ga'an pa 'ga' nas phebs pa'i sngags pa drug cu lha ga 'dus so / /bor chung ri khrod bkra shis chos 'phel gling /bor chung ri brod bkra shis chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ de sngon gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong a mchog 'ang du chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du/ sgrog chu dang dog(stag)chu 'dres mtshams lho ngos su chags pa'i bor chung ri — 299 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/grong bkra shis chos 'phel gling ni/ nag tis dka' bcus rang gi 'ing steng du khang ba(dus rabs bdun pa'i nang tsam ) bshigs nas rong khams 'bas drung la phul/ khong gis 'bring ba'i phyag rdor 0rabum gyi phu bo nam rma /ba' se d+me la gnang / phyis su rgyal ba'i 'phrin la sa pa chen po bka' 'gyur ba dkon mchog dpal 'dzin gyis bskyangs/ ches gsu ngas so / / nam ma kha' seṅge zhes pa'i dam pa 'di ni phyag rdor 'aribum gyi bu mgon po bkra 'eru (la ༅sa kyis gcung bo red zer ba'ang yod)dang klu mo skyid kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing bya sbe spye 'o 17’(〉 5'o/ra sku 'khrungs/ 'di ba sku nar son rjes kun mkhyen yab sras dag gi sku drung nas dbang 'u/nga rjes gamang sang ma/nga gas na cing yang bkra shis 'khyil dang co ne dgon chen du'ang dbang 'u nga rjes gnang lang ma/nga sas na/ bkra shis 'khyil dang co ne dgon chen so gas chos sde che chung mang bo nas bka' 'gyur co ba/ 5 kyi dbang bstsarwa / khya gya dang / sta ga tshang lha mo / bla ri mgul sogs dgon pa du ma'i khri ma dzad/rang si sadan sa bor chung ri khrod du bde gsang 'jigs kyi sgrub mchod je legs je rgyas su btsugs pa ma zad 'angon nga dang sgrig lam bsda mas shing dbang dka'i bdud rtsi lhug por bstsa' pas ser skya kun gyis 'bring ba(sde ci5 rnga ) bka' 'gyur ba zhes btags / dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes ma thar sku gshegs so/ / de'i ya nga srid 'dre kas med ngang 'a lda na rgya mtsho/ gsum pa skal bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ ba'i ba skal bzang smra ba'i rtse je( tsho1/0 2 5—— 1kha(〉 1)bcas kyis ri khrod skyong khur gang legs bgyis so/ /skabs der ri khrod du 'du khang dang 'bring ba na rim gyi nang chen/ dge 'dun pa 'al nyi shu bzhugs/rten gtso rta ma grin/ dus rgyun rta ma grin khrus gsol gsungs pas mi ser gyi nad gdon mang du grol bar gleng /1la1kha'o ra nā pi h+phang gi jag dam ga gis 'du khang dang 'bring ba'i nang chen mer bsgron kyang sla ra dad ldan tshogs kyis ba'engs pa rnam sa dang bcas1kha5〈lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod byed dus su rtsa ba nas bsnubs pa da lta gyang 'khogs dag las gsal ler mtshon no/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel lor a ma chog dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi chos sgo phye 'ing rten dang brten pa/ra gsar ba'ing gi dus nas sngar gyi ri khrod kyi grwa man 'tsho bzhugs pa rnam sa dgon du zhugs pa dang phyis/ su 'bas brtan grwa tshang ches tshugs pa'i rmang gzhi byas stabs da lta bor chung ri khrod sla ra gso med par gyur to/ /sgar cha kha'i ri khrod/a ma chog sga ra cha kha'i ri khrod ces pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong gi a mchog ya ru rgyud 'ang gi dgon gzhis sde ba'i byang sgang du chags kyang 'jigari brod 'di kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ( 18 56da 1916) dang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gzhan pa'i bla chen dpon chen rnams a mchog yul du dbyar gnas spro bsang du phyag — 300 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su 'u glegs bam /phebs pa'i gnas yin 'a / dus rgyun du a mchog dgon pas grwa ba 'ga' re mngags te ri khrod kyi chos spyod spe' ba dang195nga 'o ra bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod kyi la sa 'gul skabs su a ma chog dbon nga bsnu bas nga sa re 'ig bla grwa brgya lha ga gnas 'dir bzhugs te chos kyi 'phrin las bsgrub ci thub bgyis so / /wa sna'i brag dmar ri khrod chos lding bde chen dga' 'khyil gling /brag dmar chos lding bde chen dga' 'byil gling ( wa ni 'i ri krod ) zhes pa ni/ gan lho 'i bas nga chu rdzong a ma/chog ya ru rgyud 'ang gi ma/nga' khongs su chags/kun ma khyen bzhi ba rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug ma chog gis sa yo sa1rnga7 2lo ra a ma chog dgon nas tshe dbang gnang / sgro ga thang nas bde ma chog so gas bsngo smon dang bkra shis spo sa skor/ dmi gas brtse ma/ rgyang 'then byas/ de rjes su brag dmar du sgom/ khang gas ra sgrub kyi bkod khyab btang / cho kha bla mar 'phrin bcol / bka' ram sa pa rnam sa 'a ma gon po'i bshags gtor btang / gnyan chen song sngo na gyi ri rtser phebs nas bsang dang dpung rgyan gyi dar lco ga bsgrengs / a ma chog wa sna sde bar dzam dkar gyi gter bsgrubs te rgyab rir gter brgyab/ nyi ma lung dang / dngu' ra'i gyod bsdum/sa kirti 'phrin la sa pas a ma/chog rang 'a bla rtse bstad a mchob 'brog la rde'u 'bum/ spungs / lcags rta 1kha 2 0'o ra rje kucha ma khye na lnga ba chen po a mchog dgon dang wa sna'i sde gzhung nas gdan drangs par phebs / sman chang la snying gi gter 'bul ma dzad pas/ de ma/ thag char zim dang 'brug sgra da' bur bzhad pa so gas ngo ma tshar gleng / brag dam/ra sgom khang du phebs te bsnyen bkur zhus/ kun spa nga ba 'ga' thig rgyun bzhugs gnang zhing thugs dam gong 'phel du gnas kyang195〈lor sgom grwa 'jig go/brag dmar sgom khang 'di'i dbus su paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i spru la sku bso da nams ye shes dbang bo yu na ring bzhugs pa'i sgom khang ngam sgrub gnas dang / dam/ pa des byin gyis brlabs pa'i wa ni 'i chu'i nye 'khor du phyag zhabs kyi rjes dang chi bas drel gyi rjes deng sa nga ma/jal rgyu yod/ kun mkhyen ba'i ba gnas ri 'di'i rtser phebs te lha bsang btang ba dang gcod dar bsgrengs / kun ma khyen lnga ba ma/chog gis paṇa chen bso da nams dbang bo'i bzhusas gnas sogs ma jal gzigs gnang / 'jam/ ma gon bse sku phreng snga phyi dang / dba' mang sprul pa'i sku/ bso da grags sprul pa'i sku so gas dam pa du ma phebs nas gang 'tsham sa kyi chos sbyin spel/ nye logs skag tsha'i ri khrod du kun ma byen lnga ba phebs te ri brod sngags rams klu sgrub nas dkar spro zhus / ri khrod rten gtso khro bo rme brtsegs la snyan shal/ phul te grub chur rab gnas ma dzad/1kha5〈lo'i rjes su sgom khang dang skag tsha'i ri khrod sogs nyams chag gi dbang du song / me glang lor bkra shis sde ba zhes pa'i bkra shis thang du dge slo nga skal bzang dge 'dun gyis byang chub mchod rten bzhengs pa la rab byung bcu bdun pa'i hor gtsang yongs 'dzin mchog gis dge lda na bsta na dar bkra shis ma chod rten — 301 ——

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/zhes mtshan bstsal/ ri khrod kyang re zhig slar ma gsos kyang phyag skor ba cung mang bar grags so/ /kho che gur sgar dga' ldan chos 'phel gling /kho tshe gur sgar dga' ldan chos 'phel gling ngam bde chen chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bsang chu rdzong kho tshe 'ang du chags/dang thog kun mkhyen sku phreng gnyis pa rje 'jigs med dbang bo'i( 172rnga—1791) skabs su kho tshe zhes pa'i lha sde gsar du chags shing phyis ma 'gyangs par ser khyim 'ga' re byung ba la/ ha lam kun ma khyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i ring ste spyi 'o 18 27lor skya ser kun 'dus kyis chibs bsu ja thab rgya chen pos rten 'bul zhus pa na/ khong nyid kyang khyim tshang phal che'i sbra nang phebs pa ma zad/ 'thu khum thang du erge gur rgan phub nas ser sde dbu tshugs par grags/ ser sde des shog pa so so'i sku rim dang gshin bsngo sogs kyi re ba skong ci thub bgyis shing kun gyis kho tshe gur sgar zhes pa'i ming 'bod par gyur/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing rta ste spyi lo1〈94lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu la kun mkhyen ba'i ba skal bzung thub bstan dbang phyug( 18 5681916)thengs dang bor kho tshe gur sgar du chibs bsgyur te bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor sogs gnang/ yang lcags glang la phebs tshe kho tshe'i ma go gnyer gur gang bo thun mo nga gis zhus lan bka' bkod ltar zla lnga ba'i tshes ba'ir sa 'dul bya rgyu dang / grwa mang tshogs dbus su lha na tshogs gnang rgyu dang 'don cha'i skor chas pa rgya mkhar sku 'bas dge 'dun dpal grub pa'i rdo rje(18 29)la bka' phab pa ba'in dgon sa ngos 'dzin mdzad de sa rtags bslangs shing lto phye'i thig btab pa dang / bsang dang dkar gtor btang ste skyabs 'gro sogs 'don cha'i go rim 'ib rgyas 'al bkod gnang / srung ma btsan rgod yam shud dmar bo rang shugs kyis mgo bar ltas shar/ kun mkhyen nyid nas grwa mang la lha dar dang dong tse khron re 'gyed btang 'ing skar 'dzin mdzad/ shog pa gzhung gis 'du khang gsar bzheng 'go brtsams pa ma 'gor bar grub pa dang bla brang ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin nam bkris 'khyil ba'i grwa tshang so so dang nang chen khag gis sku gsu nga thugs rten/ ma chod rdzas yod byad sbyor 'jags gnang / phyi lor dbang lung khrid gsum gyi gter gyur sgo mang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho gdan khri thog mar phebs te bdag 'jug gtong thebs gnang ba dang gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsugs shing 'dul khrims zhib tshags mdzad/ dgon mtshan la dga' ldan chos 'phel gling du bsgyur te bca' yig phan bde 'dab brgya ba'ad pa'i nyin byed ces pa brtsams khri rabs gnyis pa brag dkar 'bas drung gi skabs su mi shed can 'gas 'then 'khyer gyis dgon gnas co ne cha thog zer bar spos/ khri rabs gsum pa gung thang lnga ba bstan pa'i nyi ma ( 1860da 192 2) bzhugs/dgon pa slar sngar gnas su spos/ 'du khang bskyar bzhengs dang gung thang mtshams khang legs par 'grub bcug 1927me yos lo'i mjug tu kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phebs nas dad ldan yongs la — 302 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag la sa gan su 'u glegs bam//chos sbyin lhug par bstsal/ phyi lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi skabs su gong ma 'i sgrub khang gzim/ chung du phyag rjes ngo ma tshar btab/ me spre 'a te spyi lo1956lor gung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug ma chog gis thugs khur na dzad de/ 'du khang 'ig ral du 'gyur ba'in pa'i ra skor dang rung khang bcas gung thang nang chen gyis bskyar bachengs dang bla ma se 'u tshang gis gser tshon byugs / 'du khang bcas grub pa'i dga' sto na du 'jigs byed dang gdugs dkar byad gro' sogs kyi dbang 'u nga chos char bsnyil to/ /bde 'jigs gcod gsum gyi cho ga tshugs / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag la kho tshe'i lha sde shog pa yo ngas la sa da dung nye 'o gas ru du ma ma chis/ sgom rim 'phar tshul la 'dzin grwa gong zhol bar gsu ma yo da pa'i bde 'jigs gnyi ga'i bskyed rim ya na chad dang / bde lam sogs rgyugs sprod sro la dang / dus chos ba'i ga dbyar dgun gnyis 'a rig gnas kyi rgyugs dang / ston dpyid gnyis gar bskyed rim gyi rgyugs 'bul /las sne khri ba dang gnas brtan pa bab bstun lo gsum yas mas su bsko spor byed/ dge bskos lo gcig dang khri ba lo gsu 4 / re bzhugs / sgrub ma chod khyad par ba ni bde mchog dang gcod kyi bdag 'jug bde ma chog gi rab gnas rgyas pa spel/ gung thang bsta na pa'i spro na mes btsugs pa'i shwa 'cham ma nyam sa par 'o rer rgyun 'khyongs/ 'o gcig ring smon 'a ma nyin bco lnga dang / gcod dang bde ma chog gi sgrub mchod bsdo mas pas nyin brgya lnga bcu 'o ngas/ ya nga kun mkhyen gsum pa'i rnam thar du kho tshe 'dir 'ang sto na bsta na pa rgya ma tshol gsu nga pota ba'i yod/ zam tsha gser khri/ gung thang lnga ba/ ga'an btsan po don grub rgya ma tsho/ rwa bso da nams dbang rgya' / kirti blo bzang 'phrin 'a sa gsum cho hor nas 'khrungs kyang sku na phra dus nas sa kho tsher nar so na/ da dung dge bshes dkon ma chog bsod nams/ se 'u tshang / a gas la sprul sku/ ma khas grags da lta ba gsu nga 'bum can kho tshe dge 'dun rgya ma tsho sogs ma nga du byon no/ /dgon du tshogs chen 'du khang dang / gnas chung btsan khang / slob dpon lha khang / chos khri/btsugs shing / sto na chos bcas bzhengs pa dang / gung thang tshang / skyor dpon tshang / dba' mang chung ba tshang gi gzim khang brgyab/ grwa shag lnga bcu rtsa grangs 'a dge 'dun pa brgya brgyad cu bzhugs / de ba'in dgon par sku gsu nga thugs rten la'ang / rje btsun mi pham ma gon po'i snang brnyan nyis thog can/ thar 'dod rgya ma tshos gnang ba'i tshe dpag med li ma gsu nga 'byon/ phyag ma dzod ma khan pos gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba dang rgyan drug ma chog gnyis sogs 'u sa tshad ma bcu phrag so gas li sku brgya lha ga dang / bse ngag dbang bkra shib/ kyi thugs dam rten gtso 'u nga ston byams pa'i 'al thang / bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin 'a/sa rgya ma tsho'i ma cig gi sku byin can/ byams chen/ rje stong sku'i zhal thang bris 'bag sogs ma nga bo/ skyor dpon gyis gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur dang rje yab sra sa/ kun mkhyen sku rim byon gyi gsung 'bum gtsos pa lnga brgya lhag dang / thugs rten du gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i gung thang gdung rten dang skyor dpon gdung rten/ se lu tshang gdung rten sogs bzhengs so/ /— 303 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bsang chu rdzong gi khongs/'du khang lha khang steng kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma dang gung thang bsta na pa'i dbang phyug gis smad so ga nas drangs pa'i gser tog rgyal mtshan chos 'khor cha tshang dang / smad nas blus pa'i shis phur che legs / la/ 'phan du ma / dra ba dra phyed bla bre rnga spub dung sogs rtsa chen mang du bsgrugs/ dgon mthar chos 'khor dang /btsan mo'i nang du rdo yi ge rang byon can bcas dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog 'ig yi na mod kyang / rab rgyal sa khyi lo dang chu stag lor dgon pa shul med du bsnubs so/ /1kha〈 0lor dgon pa'i chos sgo sla ra phye ba la/ btsun pa bgres dar sum cu zhal 'dzom/sa te da lta 'i bar 'du khang dang rung khang / sto na chos/ btsan khang / ma/gon khang / khri gung thang rin po che dang / skyor dpon/ dbal ma/nga / se lu/ a gsal nang chen so gas bzhengs pa sngon gyi rnam pa las lha ga tsam byung /rten rnying shul 'u sa tshe dpag med khru tshad ma gnyis dang / rgya' dbang gis gnang ba'i thub sku mtho tshad/ ma cig lab sgron ma tho tshad/ gsar du shing bzang byams sku bdud rtsi bab pa/ kun mkhyen drug pa'i thub sku che chung sogs byin can brgya drug cu dang / zhal thang brgya lhag gsung rten bka' bstan 'gyur/ rje tsong kha ba'i gsu nga 'bum so gas pota brgyad brgya lha ga thugs rten la bstan pa'i nyi ma dang skyor dpon/ se 'u tshang gi sku gdung mchod rten sogs bzhugs/ da skabs dgon pa'i sa khyon nu 'u brgya longs pa dang rtswa sa nu 'u nyis brgya'i ra bskyel/ da dung sman khang dang / tshong khang bcas kyi yong sgo las ga'an shi gson rim gro la so gas pa'i yon gyis brgya cha bdun cu grwa mang la phogs 'gyed btang na/ lo rer btsun pa cha snyo mas du shog sgor brgyad brgya bab pa dang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyi dam chos re smon bskong ci thub rem ba'in pa'i skabs so/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag la sa kun su 'u glegs bam//co ne rdzong gi khongs/co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling /co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling zhes pa da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong gi ma ru 'ang wo/ ngas/ te rdzong na khar gyi nyin ngos su chags/rab byung dzo ba'i bgrang bya dang bo'i me yo sa ( 1 2 67)'o ra sa skya'i gong ma/ 'gro ma gon 'ang gas pa blo gros rgyal ma tshan ma chog thengs/ gnyis par rgya nag tu phebs pa'i dus su / yu la de brgyud skabs ljo na shing rab tu rgyas par gzigs shing sa pra legs par dgongs / dngos slo ba shes rab ye shes ma chog 'a sa skya'i 'u gas kyi dgon pa chig gas ra 'debs mdzad par jo sku 'i(sa skya 'i gong ma 'di bas shākya thub pa'i sku tsan dan spru la gyi snyi nga bo la sa batshengs pa 'ig gnang ba da lta'i bar bzhugs )phyag rten gnang / de sngon ri rtsar chags pa'i bla ma blo bzang dpal lnga na pa'i gas nga sngags rnying ma 'i dgon chung chos kyi 'khor 'o zhis pa 'ig mo da pa ra rim ba'in sa skya'i 'u gas kyi dgon par bsgyu ra cing / 1 295lor khong gis gsang 'dus lha khang dang ma gon khang /sku brnyan so gas brten dang rten pa ri nyung ba gas ra bachengs mdzad/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa yo sa ( 1 'u 5 2 )'o ra co ne'i sa skyong gi sku spun dge slo nga rin chen ce na po zhes bya ba dbus nas phyir phebs rjes yang dgon pa de ri bo dge 'u gas par bsgyur/ ma tshan la dga' lda na bshad sgrub gling zhes gso 'a/ ba dang khāng 'i gong mas kyang ting 'dzin dgon(khran tin zi)zhes pa phyag bris gnang ste bstsal/ bu dgon drug cu lha ga yo da pa(bu dgon rang sar ma zad shing kun dang men ju/ bā tse so gas rdzong khag tu mchis )dang se ra theg chen gling du khang tshan lnga tshugs / de ba'in dgon pa 'di dang thog gi rnying dgon ha lam spyi lo1 2 5 4lo nas da bar lo ngo bdun brgya ba'i bcu lha ga so nga bas a ma/do'i yul gyi lo rgyus ches ring ba'i chos sde 'ig go/nang rten dang tshogs chos kyi skor la/ slob dpon grags pa bshad sgrub pas spyi lo1729lo(sa bya)zla dgu ba'i tshes la mdzad pa'i rten tho mdor bsdus dang der 'dus dgon chen gyi lo rgyus(bod yig snum dpar)lta ra na/ snar thang dang pe cin/ lha sa/ sde dge li thang / nan cin/ co ne bcas kyi bka' bstan cha tshang / gser gyi mchod rten che chung brgyad/ dngul gyi mchod rten che chung nyer bdun(ches mtho ba khru lnga/dngu' sra nga nyis stong lha ga) / tsan dan gyi sku nyer gsu ma/ tsan dan gyi ma/chod rten nyi shu/ gser dngul spe' ma 'i bka' 'gyur/ brgyad stong ba dbu yig gser brdung yi ge rer sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung spro sa pa(btsun mo blo bzang 'tsho'i phyag bris)/ bka' 'gyur skya pota dngul bris ma/ yum 'bum pa dang rje'i gsu nga 'bum gser bris ma/ bka' bstan par shing cha tshang 'ib cing dag pa/ lha sa 'i bka' 'gyur bris ma/— 30 5 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/ta la'i lo mar klu sgrub kyis bris pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan (lo stong phrag gnyis lhag 'das)/ 'phags pa brgyad stong ba gser bris ma / rje tsong kha ba'i gsung 'bum cha tshang gser bris/ dung gi spyan ras gzigs sku/dung dang be+eḍūr ya byu ru spos shel las grub pa'i rgyal chen rigs ba'i/ 'jam dbyangs sku thang gsung 'byon ma// sa ngas rgyas 'od srung dang thub pa'i 'phel gdung gi byams sku gsum btsags drub can/ g.yu'i sgrol ma/g.yu 'i tshe dpag med dkyil ma tho lhag can/ chos dpe dngul bris ma po ti gya gsum / gos sku tshem drub can bcu phrag du ma/ zi skud kyis drub pa'i thang ka nyi shu/ ra gan gyi mchod rten gnyis dang sku par gcigazangs ser gyi sku che chung bdun brgya bcu dag chos dpe sna tshogs stong phrag drug lhag 'jim/ sku chig khri lhagaldebs ris su ma brgya nyer bzhi(khyad par du co ne lha bzo grags can ma kha pa dang lha lung gis bzhengs pa'i ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis )/ thang ga sum brgya bco lnga/ co ne ba khri 'jam dbyangs tshul khrim sa dar rgyas(spo ma ra khang tshan zhugs ma thar dga' ldan shar rtse nas khrir bskos/ khri rma chu ba sbyin rgyam pa'i snga phyi thengs gnyis bzhugs/ so ga po'i 'khrug chings bar phebs/ tshogs mchod thog ma'i dbu 'dzin dang rgyal dbang drug pa'i yo ngas 'dzin gnang / 'ol dga' rdzing phyi dang tshal gung thang so gas kyi 'al 'dzin ma dzad/)kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i rje gling 'phur ma/ sto bas ldan sngags rams pas ya ma rā dza tshar re dang mtheb skya res batshengs pa'i 'jigs byed kyi sku brnyan/ gnas rten bcu drug gi sku byin can lo rgyus dang ldan pa/ chu lung dpon slo/ba kyis bzhengs pa'i gos sku dbu gtsug tu 'od dpag med rang byon tu phebs pa so gas che chung bdun/byams pa'i lder sku rje'i tshems rang bsrel can/ ge sar rgya bzhengs 'khor bcas/ rgya nag gi rig gnas pa'i gser tham du ma/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'o gas ris ya ma tshan can/ dge ldan gser khri zhe lnga ba tshul khrim sa dar rgyas kyis gnangs pa'i mgon po klu sgrub kyi phyag bzo klu 'jim las bzhengs pa'i ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ ma kha'i lha bzos bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i nag thang / bka' 'gyur 'khor chen/ sho ba gnam lha phyug gi rdo ring / rgya gar nas byon pa'i mi g.yo ba gnam srung ma /ga'an rgya gar nag dang bal bo'i li sku che chung nyis brgya lhag rgyal sras lha rje'i phyag mngar la thugs rje chen po kha sar+bha ṇi rang byon can/ de'u mgo tshang bas dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan sto nga can/ ba so dpung khru lnga can gcig 'jam dbyangs sku thang gsung 'byon ma/ 'phags lugs dzam bha 'a 'i dngul sku byin can/ dpa' bo rin chen dpal gyi gdung rus oṃ a hūṃ rang byon ma/ sangs rgyas 'od srung dang thub pa'i 'phel gdung drug ta la'i lo mar bzhengs pa'i brgyad stong ba/ mkhar dkon mchog dam chos rgya mtsho'i dbu thod/ sangs rgyas stong sku 'thag ris grub pa'i snam sbyar cha gcig rje tsong kha ba'i rang bsrel rje gling 'phar ma/ dpon slob grags pa bshad sgrub pa'i gdung rten/ pho brang po ta la nas spyan drangs pa'i rje'i sku tsan dan las bzhengs pa mi tshad ma/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi dbu thod/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / mchog sprul gnyis/ rje drung rin po che'i dbu zhwa sku 'gag sku gzan 'gan — 306 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su 'u glegs bam/'jir/ chibs sga sra/ba smad dang bcas pa/ ma/kha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi dbu thod/ paṇa chen nā ro ba'i(1916da 1 10 0)gtsug tor cod pan dang rus rgyan(ga'an gcig bal yul tu yod/)/dge lda na khri zhe dgu ba blo bzang dar rgyas(co ne'i khri a gzigs thang ba khri bzhugs lo1707— 1〈 1 2 )kyi dbu thod oṃ rang byon rma dang thub sku rten tu dpal mar me ma dzad dang sa ngas rgyas nyid kyi rang bsrel can/ khong gi paṇa zhwa sku chos sku sham ring 'gag 'bas 'chag bzhugs gdan bcas/ dung dkar 'brug grag dbus nas gdan drangs pa byams pa skor 'byon/ stong 'khor rin po che'i dbu zhwa sku gzan sku chings zhabs cag bcas/ rje tsong kha ba'i dbu zhwa snam sbyar sku gzan bcas/ bu ston thams cad ma khyen pa'i na bza'/ rje mkhas grub kyi ni ma/ sbyar tshal bu can/ rtogs lda na 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i dbu thod las byung ba'i ri' bu/ byam sa chen chos rje'i dbu zhwa/lho brag phyag rdor la sa/ngas rgyas lnga sa bskor pa/ byam sa sku ches ma tho dga' lda na byams mgon dang 'dra ba/mkhas grub khyung bo dang chos rje don yod pa'i ring bsril/ sku gdung mchod rten chen po drug bcas brjod kyis mi long ba so gas so / / ga'an gong ma dang dbus nas gnangs pa so gas byin rten ma nga bo 'god ma thub pa ni dus 'khrug yang yang byung ba'i skabs su dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la nyams 'grib tshabs chen byung bas rig gnas kyi dngos po phon che ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las mjug bsdus so// gong gas la phal mo che ni spyi lo1966lo'i zla bcu ba nas1976lo'i bar rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i minang 'khrug zing slo nga gi dus der yongs su rdzogs pa 6rnying ba'i ’dang ‘lha 'dre gdon bgegs su btsis nas brlags so/ /dad lda na skye bo ma nga bos rang srog ma 'dzems par bskyabs pa'i skor da lta dngos su dgon pa'i nang nyar tshags srung skyob bgyis pa ni/ dge ldan khri thog zhe lnga ba byams 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas mchog gis gnang ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyis 'jim pas bzhengs pa'i ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'gangs chen dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis rgya gar gyi shing ta le lo mar bzhengs pa'i ston pa'i sku bsnyan byin can/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi rdo nag gi mgon po'i sku rang byon (co ne'i sa skyong sku rabs rim byon gyi ga'u nang bzhugs pa'i dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi rten byin can) co ne'i 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas kyi dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi mgon po phyug drug pa/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma bdud rtsi rtag tu 'bab pa byin can/ 'jam dbyangs sku thang gsung 'byon ma byin can/ btsun mo rin chen dpal 'dzoms la paṇa chen drug pas gnang ba'i tsan dan sprul gyi snying bo las bzhengs pa'i rnam sras byin can/ gsang 'dus kyi bum pa ngo mtshar ba byin can/mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi dbu thod/ 'phags lugs dzam bha la'i dngul sku byin can(dbyar drug pa'i tsha sgang la dzam bha la'i mchod yon gsol skabs su gong gsal gsang 'dus bum pas bum chu gsol bas na dzam bha la'i dbu rtser 'khyag rum mu tig pheng ba lta bu rang byung du mngon par chags thub pa)/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho'i(ha lam spyi lo70 0—760)phyag ngar rgyal sras lha rje thogs med bzang po'i phyag ngar la thugs rje chen po kha sa r+bha ṇi rang byon can ngo ma tshar ba(rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub kyis gdan drangs)/ dge ldan khri zhe — 307 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs /dgu ba blo bzang dar rgyas mchog gi dbu thod a yig rang byon can khyad du 'phags pa/ ma khan chen dkon ma chog dam chos rgya ma tsho'i dbu thod a yig rang byon yo da pa byin can/ grub chen nā ro ba'i rus rgyan khyad mtshar can/ 'gro ma gon chos rgyal 'phags pas co ne dgon chen phyag 'debs skabs gnang ba'i rten ska' tsan dan sbrul snying la sa grub pa'i jo sku byin can/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi chos rgyal gyi sku rang byon can/ rje tsong kha ba sku dngos kyis phyag rtsom gnang ba'i le gas bshad gser gyi phreng ba/ dga' lda na khri zhe lnga ba byam sa 'jam dbyangs tshul khrim sa dar rgyas ma chog gis rab gnas gnang ba'i rje glang 'phur ma 'gangs chen/ kun ma khyen chos sku 'od zer gyi oṃ a hūṃ rang byung can gyi dbu thod/ byam sa chen chos rjes sman 'dam/ la sa bzhengs shing phyi rgyab tu phyag gi rjes brgya rtsa brgyad dpar ba dang khong 'das rjes nang bzhugs ‘ra kho'i gdung rus/ rten pa'i jo sku byin can/ rje byang chub 'od zer ( kham sa pa) ba'i dbu thod yi ge gsu ma ma /dpa' bo rin chen dpal gyi sku gdung yi ga gsum rang byon can/ paṇa chen dpal lda na ye shes kyi sgom zhwa/rje dge 'dun grub pa'i sna ma byi ra tshal bu can/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal lda na gyi dbu zhwa/ khri zhi dgu ba blo bzang dar rgyas ma chog gi 'bas cag rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub rin po che'i gdung rten/par+ṇa chen sku 'phreng kha shas kyi na bza' du ma/ sa skyong chen po'i btsun mo rin chen dpal 'dzom sa kyis gtsags drub tu bzungs pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi sku brnyan khyad mtshar can/ rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub rin po che'i gsu nga 'bum po ti bcu ba'i/ rgyal dbang lnga ba'i gsol 'al dang chos rgyal / tshe smon gling ba ngag dbang tshul khrims mchog gi na bza'/ min rgyal rabs kyi gong ma mi na khrin tso kra'o lis kyis yon 'o 'i khri lor gnang ba'i sbub wal 'u nga ma / rje gser khang ba'i tshem sa/ rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub rin po che'i chos gos dang snam sbya ra/ zhabs cag bcas/ khang 'i gong mas ma khan po tā ko shī ngag dbang 'bri na la sa rgya mtsho mchog la gnang ba'i be+eḍū r+ya sngo na po'i sder ma/ sman rdzas sogs dri bzang mang bos bzhengs pa'i 'jim sku sum cu rtsa grangs yod do/ /grwa tshang rnams kyi chos thog gtso rigs la/ hor zla dang bor tshogs chen cho 'phrul smon lam(sngon chad ha cang rgyas par 'tshogs dgos te/ dper na/ yer ba dang / nags mdo/ gong so / khya dge n+ta ga tshang / sho ba/ khang thog stod ma// yar thang / nyi ma thang / ra rdzi/ bang tshang / ra rong / shing kun chos sde dga' ldan chos 'phel gling / men ju'i byams pa gling sogs 'du ba'i lu gas dar ba yun ring chad ma myong)nyin bco lnga dang / tshes bcu ba'i'i nyin dga' ldan shar rtse rnam rgyal gling gi phyag sro la gyi 'cham gsar dang bkra shis lhun po'i phyag srol gyi 'cham rnying yod/ bco lnga'i nyin gos sku bshams pa dang byams pa gling bskor/ dgong mor rgyun ldan gyi dus bzang / me tog mchod pa(thengs rer mar spyi rgya lnga brgya lhag gis bzhengs)/ bcu drug la bkra shis lhun po'i phyag rgyun gyi lha 'cham/ rgyud pa grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang sngags ñca gas mkhar dang gtor rgyag zla gnyis par grwa tshang so so 'i dpyid chos zla gcig thos bas ma — 308 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gling bas bsdus gzhung so so'i gzhung rgyugs len pa dang rgyud pa bas mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang gtor rgyagagasu ma par grwa tshang so so 'i bar chos nyin bco lnga/ ba'i bar grwa tshang so so'i zla chos dang / rgyud pa grwa tshang la gas nga 'dus kyi rdul tshon dang bcas pa'i bdag 'jug de'i srabs su snga gas kyi dam bca' 'jog pa dang ma tshan nyid pa la bka' bcu dam bca'i ming 'dogs/ tshogs chen du sa ga zla ba'i smon lam/ gos sku/byam sa pa gling bsgor/ lnga bar tshogs chen ma ṇi ri' sgrub nyi ma bdun/ rten mjal/ grwa tshang so so 'i bar chos nyin bco lnga/ drug par dgon chen du drug pa'i bdag 'jug nyin bdun dang dbyar gnang / rnam sra sa kyi 'cham dang gos sku/ grwa tshang so/ so 'i bar chos nyin bco lnga/ bdu na par grwa tshang so so la ston chos zla ba gcig dang de'i skabs su bde ma chog bdag 'jug dang rdul tshon/ rab 'byam sa pa'i dam bca' dang mi nga 'dogs / brgyad par grwa tshang rnam/sa la bar chos nyin nyi shu dang rgyud pa la 'jigs byed bdag 'jug dang rdul tshon/ dgu bar thos bas ma gling gi byams pa'i smon lam dang / rgyud pa'i khrus gso la dang rab gnas chen mo/ so gas nyin bco lnga/ bcu bar bcu ba'i lnga mchod kyi skabs su rje'i smon lam dgongs chos dus bzang dang 'cham gas ra rnying gnyi ga bcu gcig par grwa tshang so so la dgun chos zla ba gcig bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu dgu'i nyin lha 'cham dang gtor rgyag ga'an zla dang bo dang drug pa bcu ba'i nang chos grwa 'tshogs pa dang ma/do phyogs kyi chos spyod ser smad lugs dang / rgyud pa'i 'don rta dbyangs dang rdul tshon ñca gas ma khar gtor sgrub gtor rgyag rol mo 'bud dkrol bcas lha sa'i rgyud sdod 'u gas lta ra spel/ tshogs chen du bka' bstan dag 'don byed par grwa ba lnga brgya 'tshogs pa dang 'bul ba dngul srang sum brgya'i gron dgos so / /lha khang dang / grwa tshang / 'don cha'i skor la/ co ne dgon chen ni lo rgyus kyi dus rabs nges can cig gi nang du spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur ldo ga dang 'khrug rtsod kyi dbang gis nyams 'jig thengs lnga(bcings grol sngo na du thengs gsu ma/ bcings 'grol rjes su thengs gnyis)thebs te gyong gud shin tu chen po byung / dgon pa ma/ bsnu bas gong gi lha khang dang 'du khang / nang chen sogs ni lo rgyus yig rigs su bkod pa la/ lha sa 'i rwa mo/ che'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas bachengs pa'i mdo phug gi gzim khang nyis thog can skyed tsha' dang bcas pa/ tshogs chen 'du khang rnying ba su ma thog ka ba brgyad cu can grwa ba lnga brgya lhag shong / ma/tshan nyid grwa tshang gi 'du khang nyis thog can/ rgyud pa'i 'du khang nyis thog can/ 'du khang chen po 'og ma sum thog can/dri gtsang khang nyis thog can/ mgon po'i lha khang / sa ris grwa tshang gi 'du khang nyis thog can/ 'cham/ pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang / chos 'khor lha khang / gdugs dkar lha khang nyis thog can/ dpe mdzod lha khang /gango /na li ma lha khang nyis thog can/ jo bo lha khang sum thog can/ g.yas li ma lha khang nyis thog can /byams pa'i lha khang sum thog can/ nyi ma sgang li ma lha khang nyis thog can/ rje lha khang / dgon chen sgo thog lha khang sum thog brkos ris kyis brgyan pa/ dgon pa'i lcags mkhar sgo thog gi lha khang / sman bla'i lha khang nyis thog can/ dmigs brtse ma'i lha khang nyis thog can/ gsang 'dus lha khang sum thog can/ shar ba'i — 309 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne+e rdzong gi khongs /lha khang nyis thog can/ nub ma'i lha khang nyis thog can/ bka' bstan par khang / (par shing sna tshogs sa ya gnyis lhag mchis pa'i gras su co ne bka' 'gyur kho na par gsar rnying gnyis bzhugs)bde ma chog lha khang nyis thog can/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi lha khang / kun rig lha khang / sku gdung lha khang nyis thog can/ tshe dpag med kyi lha khang / rnam rgyal lha khang sum thog can/ rgyal chen lha khang sum thog can/ mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang nyis thog can bcas 'di dag gi nang du rgya phibs gyo tog can nyi shu mchis/ de min co ne sa skyong gi lha khang(bde ya ngas)sum thog can(ming la sa skyong gi pho brang yo ngas 'dus rnam rgyal khang bzang yang zer)der sku gsung thugs rten dang de'i lo rgyus bcas cha tshang ba tshags/ o rgyan lha khang / klu ri ma go'i bcu gcig 'al gyi lha khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang / ge sa ra lha khang / se ra paṇ+ḍi ṭa'i sgrub khang bcas mang bo bzhengs / ga'an yang co ne dgon pa'i bla brang dang tshe smon gling ba'i bla brang nyis thog can dga' lda na bshad sgrub gling / rgya lung tshang nang chen (phyis su ri khrod 'grims pas nang chen spangs)/ yi lu'i nang chen/mar thang bla brang / gur yag bla brang / sde ba'i nang ba/ bla brang / g.yo sa 'i sku zhugs bla brang / gtsang ba bka' chen bla brang / rgyal thang bla brang / tsha rdor bla brang / khri chen gzim khang / (spyi khang yin pas khri ba bzhugs ring der gzim par bya) par khang gong 'og dang grwa tshang par khang drug sogs 'du khang dang lha khang /mchod rten sku 'bum bcas nang chen grwa shag brgya bdun cu lhag ba'engs pa khang mig sum stong dgu brgya lhag yod do/ /grwa tshang ba'ir phye ba las mtshan nyid grwa tshang ni/ sa skyong blo bzang don grub kyi sras tā ko hri no min han ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang grags pa bshad sgrub rnam gnyis kyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta( 1714)lo'i zla ba'i bar btsugs shing grags pa bshad sgrub pas grwa tshang gi bla ma mdzad/ 'dzin grwa der 'chad nyan lo gsum re/ mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan mkhas grub bstan dar ba'i yig cha dang rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub kyi yig cha gtsos bka' rams dam bca' ba'ag rjes dgon lag tu khri bar mngags/ zhal 'don phal cher ser smad lta ra yin la 'dzin grwa bcu gcig brgyud dgos/ gzhung ni dang bo kha dog dkar dmar nas bsdus chung lo gcig bsdus 'bring lo gcig bsdus chen lo gcig gzhung gsar ba/gzhung gnyis pa/ bar skabs zur bkod bcas 'o gsu ma/ dbu ma lo gcig bcas man chad brtsi ba'ag dang rigs lung gi rgyugs 'phrod na 'dzin grwa gong mar spo chog 'dul ba lo gcig mdzod 'o gcig bcas phal cher sgrig yo da kyang rig rno cung snga snur dang rtul bo 'phying yang lo gsum re'i nang gzhung rgyugs sprad de phar phyin dang / dbu ma/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'du' ba/ mdzod bcas po ti lnga khong du chud par bya/ dge bshes ang dang bo rgyud pa'i bla ma/ dbu mdzad lo gsum bzhugs rjes grwa tshang nyid kyi khri ba lo gsu ma dang de'i 'phror tshogs chen khri ba lo gsum bzhugs dgos/ grwa tshang gi do dam la grwa tshang tshogs 'du zhes pa ste grwa tshang dge bskos dang / dbu ma dzad/ dkor gnyer/ skyor dpon/ chab ris bcas las grub cing / kho tshos — 310 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/grwa tshang nyid kyi spyi'i chos spyod dang do dam sogs kyi 'gan bzhes pa dang / gzhan ma tshan nyid mkhan po gcig bskos pa des gzhung rgyugs dang rtsod pa/ brtsi bzhag sogs mgo mjug bar gsum du thugs nyams bzhes dgos sta bas 'don cha gzab nan che ba dang sgrig lam zhib tshags gcun pas rgyal ba'i bka' gsung 'dzin skyong spel gsum la nus pa chen po phud do/ /rgyud pa (sto da smad zung 'brel can) grwa tshang ni/ sa skyong dmag zor mgon po'i sku spun tha chung ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho rnam pa gnyis kyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya( 1729lo/)lor btsugs shing dpon slob grags pa bshad sgrub pas yun ring bskyangs/ 'dzin grwa 'phar rim 'o brgyad de bskyed rim lo bzhi/ rdzogs rim lo gnyis / 'don rta dbyangs dang thig rdul tshon sogs lo gnyis / bskyed rdzogs kyi 'don cha lag len gyi rgyugs 'phrod na 'dzin grwa gong du spo chog ga'an tikra gong 'og lo gnyis bcas te sngags rams pa lon rjes dgon lag gi rgyud grwa'i khri bar phebs dgos/ mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes ang dang bo thon tshe rang dgon rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad lo gsum/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang rgyud pa'i 'chad nyan pa lo drug bzhugs dgos/ tshogs chen khri ba lo gsu ma re grub rjes 'gro thang rtsa chen rnam/sa dga' ldan gser khri'i srol ltar tshugs/ thig rdul tshon gtor ma bca' srol dang 'bud rdung dkrol gsu ma gyi tshul ni se ra'i rgyud stod pa'i phyag bzhes dngos yin/sa ris grwa tshang ni/ mkhan po ngag dbang mkhas btsun rgya ma/tshos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me bya ste spyi lo1777'o ra btsugs(ma do smad chos 'byung du rtse dbus sa ris pa bso da nams rgyal mtshan pas btsugs gsungs)der rgyugs 'bul gyi sgrig yod de/ 'khor chen dang / kun rig tshe dpag med/ rnam/ rgyal ma/sman bla/ mi 'alngugs pa/ dmi gas rtse ma/ gnas bcu phyag mchod so gas tshogs 'don rgyas shing / nyin lngar cho ga gsu ngas pa'i mjug tu sbyin sreg klu chog dang bcas dkyil 'khor can rnams rgyud pas rdul tshon blug dgos/ de 'a brten nas zla ba dang bo dang drug pa/ bcu ba gsu ma gar chos thog re 'tshogs/ grwa tshang 'dir tshogs 'du ches pa med kyang chos spyod dang do dam/ bdag gnyer gyi thad du sa ris rgan pa dang dkor gnyer/ dkor g.yog chab tog pa bcas 'gan bzhes ma khan bskos so/ /'cham pa grwa tshang 'ig tshugs yod de/ ma khan po blo bzang bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang ste spyi lo1745lor btsugs/ de'i 'cham rnying gi lugs ni 'phags yul ltar rgyud 'dzin pa dang 'cham gsar gyi khungs ni gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi phyag rgyun la gtugs yod ces gleng 'ing 'cham srol dang 'cham lwa/ rol chas sogs dgon sde ga'an las khyad chos thun mong min pa bsgrugs/ grwa tshang 'dir 'cham dpon dang dkor gnyer/ dkor g.yog zhabs tog pa bcas bskos te sgrig lam dang grwa tshang bdag dam/ 'cham rtsen 'cham sbyong sogs kyi 'gan bzhes/ ga'an da dung lha khang so sor bdag dam mchod 'bul byed pa'i dkor gnyer gnyis nas gsum ba'ag pa dang nang chen so sor yongs — 311 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi bo/ ngas/'dzin dang gnyer ba/ 'bas zhu ba bcas mi 'ga' bkod sgrig bgyis so/ /dgon chen 'di dbu ma/dzad la bla ma dbus ma dzad ces 'bod mo/da/ de ni bla ma'am sprul sku dngos yin pa'i nges pa me da par 'e sa 'i sgo nas bla ma ches btags// dper na co de'i rgyud pa grwa tshang ni se ra theg chen gling ba'i rgyud sdo da smad zung 'bre'/ byas nga 'i 'u gas lta ra btsugs pa yi na pas / rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu ma dzad thog ma ra grwa tshang nying du dbu ma dzang 'o sasu ma dang / dga' lnga na shar rtse dang byang rtse'i 'u gas lta ra ma tshan nyid rgyud pa grwa tshang gnyi ga'i ma khan po lo gsu ma 'grim dgos shing de nas bzung tshogs chen khri ba lo gsu ma/ bzhugs pa'i thob dbang yo nga/ tshobs chen khri ba bzhugs rjes khri zur gyi go gnas su bzhugs chog ste co ne bas der dpon slob ces 'bod nga ri tsha nga sa sku tshe ma thar phyin par bla grwa kun gyis gus bkur bla na re da pa bya nges yi na/ 'di ci'i phyir che na/ bla ma dbu ma dzad chos kyi bo sa spa ngas nas khri bar bzhugs pa'i thob dbang ni gang lta ra thog mar lha rnga༄ 'i gdan sa gsu ma gyi dase bshes zhig gam ya nga na rang dgon mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi bka' bcu ba'i dge bshes a nga dang bo thob pa chig yi na dgos pas gong gas 'a 'a sa ga'an pa'ang spru la sku khri dbang thob chog mod/ ma tshan nyid pa'i dam bca' ma ba'ag na dmigs gas/la gtong ba med do/ /grwa rgyun 'byung khungs dang 'tsho rten sogs kyi skor la/ co ne mnga' khongs sa rgya che 'ing dbus nas mtha' bar nyin 'a ma bcu phrag gis mi chod pa dang / mi/ sde'ang khri phrag du ma yo da pas / dgon sde ni sa cha'i yu la bab dang bstun nas btsugs shing / grub ma/tha' dge 'u gas pa gtso bo dang ga'an rnying ma dang bon ngo/ ma nga tsam/ dar/ der brten co ne dgon chen gyi grwa ba rnam sa kyang mnga' 'og yongs nas phebs dasos pa'i nges pa me da la/ rang 'dod du phebs na 'dug mi chog pa'ang med/ yin na'ang dgon chen gyi grwa ba'i 'byung yu 'a gtso bo ni 'og sgang 'es pa bcu bdun du dbye yo da de/ 'og sgang rnam sa ri/ nyin 'og sgang dang srib 'og sgang / mar snyung 'og sgang / skyid lug 'og sgang / gru tshang 'og sgang / bcu bkod 'og sgang g.yo sa 'og sgang / thang nag 'og sgang / mkhar bar 'u nga zhi 'og sgang / sgo bzhi 'og sgang / dam ra 'o nga 'og sgang / a smon 'og sgang / dpa' bo 'og sgang / gsal po gsham 'og sgang / se tshang 'og sgang /pan dge 'og sgang / gshin tsha 'og sgang bcas yin/ 'di'i nang gi grwa ba re tshogs 'du thon par ba'ag pa la ri sna zer/ kho tsho dgon nang gi don chung shos sa ma/ grwa 'khon so gas bsdum pa'i las su zhugs / dgon pa le gas por skyong ma dzad mkhan po rin chen lhun po'i skabs su btsun pa sum stong brgyad brgya bzhugs par grags /1929'o ra dgon chen la btsun pa dgu brgya lhag bzhugs / 1kha5rngalor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod kyi skabs der btsun —4 lnga brgya mi long bar gyur/ 'du khang dang lha khang che chung nyi shu lha ga dang nang chen dang grwa shag brgya dang don gnyis yod/ 1ṭha46lor bod yul du grwa ba nyis 'bum/ lnga khri/ dang sprul sku stong ba'i yo da pa'i nang du gan su 'u yul du nang bstan gyi grub mtha' khag gi dgon pa dang ri khrod/ sgrub phug ba'i brgya yo da pa 'a sa co ne'i yu 'a du nang dgon rkyang ba che chung drug cu lhag dang bla sprul sum cu rtsa grangs mchis/ ma do — 312 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/—smad choru 'byung du co ne'i dgon khag lnga dbye ba ni/ co che dgon chen dang / nags mdo/ gong so/ a ra/ klu chung bcas red(ga'an co re dgon chen dang ma ra snyu nga / ye ra ba/ tshwa rdor/ nags mdo ba'ag pa'ang yo/da)/ da dung co ne'i yu la(da lta 'i the bo dang 'brug chu rdzong gi sa cha kha sha sa 'dus ) du gtogs pa'i dge 'u gas ngang rīng ma / bon po dbon pa che chung brgyad cu lha ga yo da pa'i gras su / dgon chen rang la nang dgon khri rgyun can 'a tho ba dason ma khas grub gling dang / khang thog yo na chab dar rgyas gling / stod ma 'i ngagon phun tshogs ngaga' lnga na gring gsu ma bslos bcad khri ba ma ngags pa'i dgon 'a ga dang / klu chung dga' lnga na phun tshogs gling / khya dge le gas bshad gling/ bang gtsang dgon bkra this phun tshogs gling / nags rma do dason blo bzang bde chen gling / gse ra thang dgon dga' lda na ma las ma nga babad sgrub gling/ ra rtsi ngagon dpa' lda na chos 'khor gling / gong so dgon byang chung gling / tsha rdor dgon bkra shis byams pa rnam rgya' gling / cog ro dgon ( 19 2kha'o ra bsnu bas) bcas dus bcad du khri ba mngags pa'i dgon lag dgu/khri ba ma ngags sro' med pa'i dgon 'a ga ni ye ra dgon bas ma/ grub gling/ ma ra snyung byam sa nga gling / sdo nga nag dgon bkra shis dar rgyas/ gling chos rdzong dpa' ma chog sde/ gling gas ra dgon nga// phang gya dgon pa/shing kun byams pa gling / su ru dgon pa/ sta ga tshang byam/sa pa gling / twa 'gag sde gas ra/ zhwa nag dgon nga / o/nga gsu ma dbon dga' lda na chos 'phel gling / nor bu dgon/ dus ser bde tshang dgon/ pā jo'i dgon pa/ ba ri dbon pa/ nags rtsa dgon/ tsa nang dargon/ lcang lung dgon/ sde rog dgon/spo sa 'u/nga dgon/ bar rtsa dason/ bī kong dgon bde chen lhun grub gling / tā yu sa ('u nga chen)dgon pa/sto nga 'khor dgon pa / de'u sgang dgon dag 'a ldan phun tshogs gling / ma gron tsha'i par+ṇa tshang dgon/ la rtsa'i sgam/ po bon dgon/ pe kun dgon bkra shis chos 'phe' gling / gser po ga'ong bon dgon/ e pe dgon bkra shis dar rgyas gling / ya ga hā dgon bas ma gtan bshad sgrub gling / pa bo'i dgon pa/ rgya ma khar thang dga' lda na dar rgyas gling sogs da lta 'i co ne dang the bo/ 'brug chu rdzong gsu ma du khyab pa ma zad/da dung ri khrong kyang cung ma nga ste/ dper na sta ga tshang ri grod/ ne'u mgo'i ri khrod/ ka ri stings ri khrod/phu tshang ri grod/ dam ra rtsa ri khrod/ chu 'a nga ri brod/ brag dgon ri brod/ rgyal 'u nga ri grod/ gur ya ga ri grod/ sna 'u nga ri brod/ su/ ru'i ri grod/ kha dog ri khrod/ 'om bu'i ri khrod/ rab so'i ri khrod/dason li ri khrod/ r+sha ga ris ri khrod/ ma ru ri brod/ rna ring ri khrod/ dam ga chen ri khrod/ klu ri sgrub gnas so gas ri nyung ba ma chis shing da dung bcings 'grol yar sngon bla ma khag gis bsdus pa mi nyung ba yo da do/ / bod dbus su rang sa'i grwa ba chos sder bzhugs/ gnas kyang dga' ldan dgon pa'i shar rtse grwa tshang du co ne khang tshan dang the bo lang tshan tshugs/ se ra ra dbon pa'i smad rgyud grwa tshang / ye ra ba khang tshan dang tsha rdor khang tshan/ ma ra snyung khang tshan/ a ra khang tshan/ the bo khang tshan tshugs / 'bras spungs dgon par sgo ma nga khang tshan dang the bo khang tshan/ 'bras spungs blo gas 'a gling khang tshan 'bring khag drug gi nang mi nyag khang — 313 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/tshan tshugs pas co ne pa rkyang ba ma zad da lta'i kun lho ba thams cad gang 'dod du 'chad nyan lta sgom du zhugs chog da dung yul gzhan te sog yul du/ he zhe khyon phyis nyi zo mo/ pa rag su nyid mdo sde lbang tho he the/cha har sgo lo shwa dang / gur yag sprul sku rim byon la a bag ja sag hwa hro dang / yu li sprul sku rim byon la tsong pu nyid mdo dgon/ cha hwa kho shar ra hwa nyi khyon mda' tshan shar ha hā dgon dang / rgyal thang sku skyes la sgo lo kho'i hwa mda' tshan hwa he sogs yod do/ /chos sde chen po 'di'i bla grwa kun gyi 'tsho rten ni/ rang khyim gyi kha zas bskya' pa dang rang gi dkor nom gyis nyos pa las gzhan/ chos thog so so'i sbyin bdag gi mang 'gyed kyi yong sgo'am chos mtshams su grong chog gam tshong du 'gro ba bcas kyi khar/ dgon pa thun mong dang bla sprul dag dang mkhan po bcas kyi yong sgo la sa 'ing nu 'u nyis sto nga lhag(sho tshang ma go ba 'das khar dgon pa la mu'u lnga brgya phul pa bcas)longs pa btab par so nam pas lo rer sa mu'u re'i 'bru rigs rgya ma lnga bcu dgon par ster ba dang / dgon pa'i lcags ri'i sgo chen mdun du dgon pas phub pa'i khang mig drug cu yod pa sdod mis mig re la zla rer dngul sgor re glas gla len/ dam ga ru mang bo'i mi ser sger gyi mang 'gyed las ga'an khri bas lo re la rong 'brog yongs su mar bsod(bso da snyo mas)nas bsod la phebs nas thob pa spyi gzhung la ster/ dgon pas spyi rdzas dngul sgor khri phrag drug /stag bogs btang ba'i bun skyed bcas ni mang 'gyed gtor rtsa bgyis pa ma zad/ lhag par du co ne'i sa khongs yongs kyi nags tshal brgya cha gsum tsam dgon par dbang bas 'dzugs skrun che shos kyi 'gro gron la nom pa'i rgyab rten 'dzad med du gyur to/ /dgon chen la gtso bo bla spyi tshogs gsum ste/ dgon sde'i spyi khyab tshogs 'du zhes par mkhan po dang /drung yig chen mo/ bla brang phyag mdzod/ 'go ba bon gzhon bcas kyis grub cing / ma/khan po'i mnga' 'og tu mkhan po'i bla brang tshogs pa btsugs yod de/ der las sne la 'go ba rgan gzhon gnyis dang phyag mdzod drug drung yig bcas 'du 'ing 'go ba rgan pas dgon chen rang dang nang dgon bco brgyad/ mkhan po'i las don thams cad bdag gnyer dang dgon lag gi khri ba(da lta bar khri rabs ha lam brgya dang zhe lnga brgyud pa'i skabs yi na) bsko 'jog bcas bya dgos/ 'go ba gzhon pas phyi dgon la ga brgya dang brgyad (ngo ma'i grangs ka mi long /)kyi do dam dang chos spyod sogs la thugs 'gan bzhes dgos/ bla brang tshogs pa'i 'og tu chab res(paṇa mtho)che chung gnyis dang las sne gnyis bcas la las g.yog pa grwa ba(paṇa las)lnga bcu'i mgo bzung nas dgon pa'i 'bas phyi'i bya ba sgrub kyin yod/ tshogs chen khri bas tshogs chen 'du khang dang de'i dbon po/ dbu mdzad/ grwa tshang bzhi ga'i mkhan po/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ dkor gnyer/gnyer ba/ khrims 'dzin bcas la thugs khur bzhes dgos pa dang / spyi khang tshogs 'du zhes pa 'ig yod de/der zhal ngo rgan gzhon gnyis dang spyi rdzas gnyer ba/ mi sna bcu bdun(grwa ba'i 'byung khungs bcu bdun gyi sku tshab)bcas las grub/ kho tshos dgon pa'i spyi gzhung gi lha khang dang 'du khang mang bo'i do dam bdag gnyer da 3141 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang spyi rdzas 'gro 'ong / rten bzhugs bcas kyi bya bar dngos su zhugs yod/ tshogs chen khri ba dang dbu mdzad rnam pa gnyis kyis dgon gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co rne rdzong gi khongs /chun po bcar kyang yo da do/ /dga' lda na khri rabs re gcig pa tshe smon gling ba sku phreng dang bo sa ma ti pak+ṣi khri chen ngag dbang kyi sdo ma pa baches / dgung 'o nyer gsu ma 'a slo ba dpon gyi bka' lta ra bod dbus se ra smang tsha rdor khang tshan du zhu4sa nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon ngang gzhung pota rnge dang b.la' chos ma nga bo khri 'dus pa'i dbus su rgya gzhung skor gyi dam bca' zhus pa la rbol 'a na tho4sa nga me da pas lha ram sa dam bca' dang bo thob/ de nas mu ma thud du dpa' lnga na 'bras sngu/ngas kyi hu nga rdo da grwa tshang 'grim sa nas rgyud sde ba'i'i rtsa 'gre'/ yo ngas rdzogs sbya ngas shing 'dzin grwa'i bla ma dbu ma dzad dang nge'i dga' lnga na shar rtse chos rje bzhugs/ dgung 'o che gnyis te chen chan 'u nga gong ma 'i bka' ba'in pe cin gyi dba' lda na byin chags gling do dam du phyag phebs / me bya 'o ra bod srid skyong 'o ngas 'dzin de mo ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya ma tsho sku gshegs pas khong nyid de 'dra la 177 2lor gong ma sa tshe smon gling ba dga' ldan shrī thu rno mi na han zhis pa'i cho 'o dang gse ra tham bstsal pa la sa de'i zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga ‘ra bong kyi srid khri 'a ma nga' gso 'a pa dang 177〈'o nas 178 'u'o bar dga' ldan gse ra khri dang rgya'/ dbang 'jam dpa' rgya ma cho'i mo ngas 'dzin du bskos / 17rnga 2'o ra pe cin du phebs nas chan 'u nga gong ma/'i ngabu bla thengs gnyis bzhugs mod/ bod la gorās btsan 'dzul byas pa bsdum phyir slar srid skyong du phebs nas don rkyen bde legs su 'grub nga ra mdzad/ dgung 'o bdun cu ste17ṭha1lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer bdun la sku rdo rje dkyi' dkrung du bzhugs shing 'a' nub phyogs su gzigs bcin dgongs pa ga'an don gshegs pa'i tshul bsta na/ rje 'di bas gsu nga rab ma nga bo sog skad du bsgyu ra pa dang rtse pho brang du gsu nga rtsom ngo ta gnyis bzhugs / khong si rnam thar rgyas pa shog grangs brgyad brgya lnga bcu 'o ngas nga rnam thar dad pa'i sgo 'byed de se ra smad ma/khan po blo bzang thugs rjes mdzad jo/ /khri rabs don gsu ma pa ho thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dang 'a tshul khrim sa rgya ma tsho ri/ rab byung bcu gsu ma pa chu byi spyi 'o 170 2'o ra co ne'i ma/do'i ma dzod len tshang 'es pa'i khyim pa thabs ma khas rgya ma tsho'i(sa skyong gi ma/go ba 'ig)sra/sa su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus khyad rtags ma/nga ba dang phyag mo lung bsta na 'a sa brtags par tshe smon gling sku phreng gnyis pa yin par nges bzung 'ing dgon chen gyi rgya' bo tshe smon gling ba'i pho brang du bzhugs nas chos grwar zhugs / 1〈 07'o ra ser smad grwa tshang zhugs mthar lha ram sa pa dge bshes dang bo thob cing tshang du bzhugs / dus 'u na thung ngu'i lha rams dge bshes ang dadra bo'i ma tshan snya na thob pa dang dga' ྅ na khri rabs gya drug par lo ngo bdun dang1kha07lo nas19 1 2lo'i bar bod srid skyong ( rgyal dbang rgya gar phebs shu' ) du bzhugs / spyi 'o 1kha0 ra 'o 'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgur rgyal dbang lha sar phyag phebs pa dga' bsu rgya chen po byas shing rtse po ta la 'i gzim shag nas khri bzhugs gnang du bcug cing gser tham/ sla ra 'bul zhus/ phyi lo nang 'o ga dam ga thengs ba'i ba bod dbus su slebs pa dang 'a ma bar dang grong khyer lha sa bcas nas rdung 'phrog btsan gnon mi las dgu las byas stabs rgyal ba'i thugs dkrugs pa dang bod dmag gis 'gog rbol la pham/ kha thebs/ yang rgyal dbang mchog rgya gar du bros byol dang rgyal tshab tu khong thengs gnyis par ri bzhugs thabs — 317 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs /med du gyur te gser tham phyag bzhes gnang / de rjes khong gis bar 'dum byed du bcug pa dang bod sdod nang log dmag kyang ma nga shos rgya gar brgyud de phyir log tu bcug cing rgya' dbang bod du phebs shing bod chos srid zung gi bdag po sla ra mdzad/ spyi lo1919lo ste rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa lug 'o ra dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thims so/ / tshe smon gling sku phreng ba'i ba ngag dbang thub bstan mkhas grub dge legs rgya ma/tsho dpal bzang bo ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya 'o spyi 'o 1kha21lo 'i zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la co ne'i bya rgod tshal sde ba nas/ da skabs bod rgyal tshang zhes pa'i yab rnying ma'i sngags 'chang ba don grub rin chen dang yum gzungs 'dus 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs(btsas ming 'jam dbyangs nor bu)/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtshos tshe smon gling sku phreng gong ma'i yang srid yin par thugs rtags gnang ba dang mtshan gsol / bka' shog dang tham ga sngar ba'in bod srid skyong bya dgos pa'i cho lo bcas 'byor/ spyi lo1919lor he dmag gis co ne dgon chen thengs dang bo mer btang skabs khong gi pho brang yang mes 'jig par bsregs/ 1kha21lo'i zla bcu bar dbus nas phebs bsu ba mi bdun mngags pa lhags rung co ne sa skyong gis phebs par thugs mthun ma byung / phyi lo khong gis sku 'khor rnam sa mgo bskor 'phral sku 'bum brgyud de lha sar phebs/ 192 2lo nas bzung194'u'o 'i bar rdo rams dam bca' bzhes pa ma zad lha rams dam bca' ang dang bo bzhes pas grags pa'i snyan pa thob/ 194〈lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun la glo bur du sku snyung med par re 'ig chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /tshe gling sku phreng lnga ba bstan 'dzin 'phrin las1949lor grong khyer lha sa nas sku 'khrungs / da lta bod ljongs nang bsta na ma thun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes skabs yin no/ / de ba'in da dung chos srid dag tu mdzad rjes rlabs po che ba mang ste/ chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas/ 'di ba rab byung bcu ba'i shing khyi ste spyi lo1574lor co ne'i sho bzang nas sku 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang gi tshab tu byams pa sprul sku dang stong 'khor sprul sku bcas sog yul du bstan pa spel bar btang / rgyal bo lha bzang gi dmag gis se ra brlags/ par shing zhig gso la zhal 'debs nom mang phul/ yang se rar co ne gzhon pa khang tshan gyi khang tshan spyi khang su ma thog can phub pa dang rtsod grwa bzhengs/ slar rgyal ba'i bka' ltar so ga po'i cha gar dang chad lod/ hal ha/ thu mod sogs su phebs par sa gnas rgyal bo dag gi dbu blar bkur/ mtshan la a chor dhā ra hu thog thu gsol pa dang gser dngul gyi tham ga gnang / 1620nas1626lo'i bar co ne'i ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling gi khri bar bzhugs/ 'du khang dang bde mchog lha khang gsar du bzhengs/ se ra'i sngags pa grwa tshang gi khri bar bzhugs shing gsung rtsom du ma mchis/ 164khalor sku gshegs par gdung rus steng na dung ris dang phyag ngar la a yig bzhad/ bu slob khri chen tshul khrims dar rgyas(sku tsha)kyis khong la rnam thar rgyas pa brtsams/rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub spyi lo1675lo ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos la co ne'i khya dge'i g.yo sa(rab rgod rab so zer) zhes pa'i grong nas yab gzungs 'bum skyabs dang yum skal bzang sman gyi sras su sku — 318 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su 'u glegs bam/'khrungs / dgung lo nyer gnyis steng rang yul du phar phyin dam bca' ba'ag rjes dbus su phebs te ra mo che dang se ra'i smad rgyud grwa tshang du chos grwar zhugs shing dgung lo su ma cu'i dus su se ra dgon pa nas lha ram/sa pa'i mtshan rtags byung / 1794lor khong dang bcas pas co ne dgon chen gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs gnang rogs su phyag phebs shing grwa tshang gi bla mar bskos/ dgon pa'i khri rabs thengs gnyis bzhugs/ 'brug chu u be dgon bkra shis dar rgyas gling btab/ gdan rabs legs bshad rin chen phreng mdzes/ mdo sngags chos rgyud kyi bla rabs bshad pa dngos grub 'byung gnas/ bstan rtsis/ gzhung chen lnga'i 'grel ba/ rgya skad dang sngags 'don thor bu bod skad du bkrol pa/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/brda gsar rnying gi rnam ba'ag mdor bsdus blo gsal yid 'phrog dag yig tshig gsal sgro na me/ dag yig blo gsal gzhon nu dga' byed/ dkar chag ngang ba'i snang brnyan 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bon chos skor gyi gsung rtsom du ma so gas bsdoms pas po ti chen po bcu ba'i yod/ 1748lo(sa 'brug)la sku gshegs so/ / the bo blo bzang bas ma gtan/ 'di ba ni the bo stod ma dred lung ya ru bya ba'i grong du ya ba dpal tsha shes rab dang yum thar bzang sngon long ma 'i sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me mo yos kyi lo(spyi lo1687lo)hor zla bcu ba'i tshes gcig la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa shing rta lor dbus mjal phebs te gtsang du paṇa chen sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang ye shes la bsnyen rdzogs bskyar du zhus par mtshan blo bzang bsam gtan gsol/ ju nang gi sgang thog tu rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho la mjal zhing chos 'brel zhus/ dgung lo sum cu ba me pho sprel gyi lor a smon dpon slob bla ma'i gtso bor bsten cing gdams pa mtha' dag zhus/ dgung lo so gcig pa me mo/ bya nas bzung dred sgang dang stag mdo'i ri ser zhol du sgrub khang brtsigs te re zhig bzhugs/ khya dge dpon slob/ rje blo bzang chos dpal/ paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang sbyin pa/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub/ bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang nyi ma sogs mkhas mchog du ma bsten nas slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nga brgyad bzhes pa shing pho byi ba'i lor rang dgon dga' ldan byang chub chos gling gi 'du khang dang nang rten grub/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsung la/ rang rnam tshig bcad ma dang / thob yig shel dkar me long / lam rim gnad bsdus/lam rim dmigs khrid yongs 'dzin bstan pa'i zhal chab skal ldan 'jug ngogs/ so so thar ba'i bsla ba bya thar 'dod 'jug ngogs/ byang sems bsla ba bya rgyal sras 'jug ngogs/ 'jigs byed dpal bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bslab bya blang dor gsal sgron sogs rnam grangs bzhi bcur nye ba pota gsum bzhugs/dgung lo re gnyis sam re gsu ma ste rab byung bcu gsum/ pa'i mgo tshugs rjes kyi sa pho 'brug gam sa mo sprul(1748da 2749)la sku gshegs so/ / dbyi li sprul sku mkhyen rab bstan pa/ bla ma 'di ba ni tho'u ju lbang her sku 'khrungs/ sku na che tsam lon rjes(1〈 2 1lo'i phyis su)co ne'i dgon chen gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang du zhugs/ ser smad grwa tshang du phebs nas lha rams dam bca' bzhag cing shes bya yon tan rgya che bar gyur /— 319 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khu' co ne rdzong gi khongs /rgyal dbang dang paṇa chen mchog gis thugs rtsis che bar gnang / skabs der 'in cang dbyi li'i dam ga dngo/na gyis dbu blar bsten cing sa der gdan drangs / de nas dam ga dpon 'a phyi'i gnod 'gog dang nang bde 'jags la dmag rogs mdzad pa dang dmag dpon pha ro' dgras bkrongs rjes dpon tshab tu g.yu la /'gyed ra rem skad/ kun gyis bla ma dbyi 'i tshang zer/ rjes su phyir phebs te co rbe dgon chen 'a ser zangs 'a sa 'u gas pa'i lha sku che chung brgya lhag phul pa dang nom ma nga 'gyed btang / dgon chen gyi gse ra phri ma nga' gso 'a /pe cin nas sku gshegs shing ring bsre' shin tu ma nga po byung / khong gis bdud rtul pa 'ig co rne sho ba dgon tu brten pa dang rde'u gsum bcings pa'i 'chang bu 'ig yo da pa co ne brag dkar dgon du brten/ long 'a gsu nga sna tshogs po ti gsu ma bzhugs so / / sna 'u nga lha ram sa pa ngag dbang bsta na pa/ 'di ba'i ma tshan 'a kun gyis ni lung khri chen yo ngas 'dzin rin po cher 'bod/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i 1kha0 2'o ra co de'i sna 'u nga grong du sku 'khrungs / dgung lo brgyad kyi steng rab tu byung ste co ne'i dgon chen gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang du zhugs /bod dbus se ra smad du 'grim sa nas gzhung pota lnga 'ib tu gas na sbyong ma dzad mthar lha sa 'i cho 'phrul smon la ma/ skabs su dam bca' ba'ag pas na lha ram sa dge bshes a nga gsu ma pa thob/ kho nyid nags ma/do dang gong gsol/ klu chung / chas pa'i gshis dgon pa dag gis gdan drangs te dbang bka' chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sman chab rgya cher bstsa' / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod rgya bskyed du byas skabs su khrims chad lo dgu bcad de btson du bcug ñca gas byi 'o 'i zla drug pa'i nang bu slob dge glo/ nga ngag dbang bzod pa rgya mtshos bya thabs sna tshogs sgos btson phyir sman bcos byed par khag ba'ag ste btson pa bkrol pa dang ñca gas bya lor dkar 'don dpang yi ga spra da/ 1kha(〈(4'o ra dgon chen nas pha yul du spyugs phyin nyin rer zhal zas thengs gcig re la sa ma saso la par ngal 'a bzhugs pa'i 'ar nas sgom du bzhugs /skabs der lkog tu dngos slob dran pa sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin 'a sa rgya mtsho dang / chos ma dzad ngag dbang bzod pa rgya mtsho/ dge slo/nga 'jigs med shes rab/ skyid da dge 'dun thub bstan/ sde ba'i nang ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ nyi ma mthil ngag dbang bzod pa sogs mang du bskyangs/ 1974'o ste shing stag lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes gsum nyin sku 'i bar bshegs pa dang gdung bzhu sbya nga gi skabs su rtags ya ma tshan bstan pa mi ser gdung mjal ba sto nga phrag lha ga gis ma/ngon su ma du ma thong / chos ma dzad ngag dbang bzod pa rgya mtsho gtsos dngul rdung gi gdung bzhugs mchod rten bzhengs pa co ne'i dason nga 'i 'du khang du 'gro ba'i mchod sdong du bzhugs su gsol to/ /co ne sa skyong sku rabs rim byon 'phros dgon chen gyi mkhan por bzhugs te ma dzad rjes chen po ba'ag pa sku rabs drug mchis / ma khan rabs dang bo rin chen lhu na po spyi lo1 4 0khalor sa skyong btsan po 'es pa 'i sku ma ched du 'khrungs/ dgon pa sngar gyi sa skya'i lugs nas dge lugs su bsgyu ra cing bu slo ba mang bo bskyangs /mkhan rabs bcu ba ngag dbang 'phrin la sa rgya mtsho spyi 'o 16rnga 6 (me sta ga)'o ra sa skyong dam ga zor ma gon po'i — 320 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su 'u glegs bam/sku ma ched du sku 'khrungs / dpon slo ba grags pa bshad sgrub dang bcas pas dbon chen du171 'u'o ra mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs pa dang klu chung / nags ma do/ gong so/ khya dge/ tshang rdor/ tha tshang / men ju'i dgon/ gling gas ra so gas/ rgya skyed cig gso mdzad/ ma khan rabs bcu gcig pa blo bzang bsta na pa'i rgya' ma tshan spyi 'o 1708 (sa byi)'o ra sa skyong 'jam dbyangs nor bu'i sku ma/ched du 'khrungs / khong gi dgon chen du rje a ba sra sa gsu ma dang grags pa bshad sgru ba so gas kyi gsu nga par brkos pa dang sangs rgyas 'khrungs rabs / par+ṇa chen 'khrungs rabs / la ma rim bla rgyud 'a' ga sogs ma nga du bzungs/ ma khan rabs bcu bachi ba dkon ma chog dam chos rgya ma tsho/ sa skyong 'jig med sto bas rgya' gyi sra sa su spyi 'o/1rnga 2 5'o (shing bya)'a sku 'khrungs / 1ra rnga 0'o ra 'brug chu'i gong smad dge 'phel gling btab nas yul phyogs de'i dase 'dun pa lnga brgya lha ga 'dus / ma/khan rabs bco brgyad pa spyi 'o 1kha 2 2lo(chu bya)la sa skyong rjes ma pad+ma dbang phyug gi sku mched du 'khrungs / dgon chen slar gso dang bdag skyong / gur ya ga ya nga srid gdan 'khod slo ba gnyer bcas 'a thugs khur che cher ma dzad do/ /ga'an ya nga grwa sa 'u la byes su ma khas chen dam pa mi nyung byon nga/ dper na/ dga' lda na shar rtse chos/ rje bzhugs pa ba'i ma chis te/ chos rje chos dpal rgya' mtshan dang chos rje ngag dbang lhu na grub/ chos rje ngag dbang nyi ma (ni 'u nga dga' lda tsha phun tshogs gling 'debs po)/ chos rje lā lis pa ( gla 'u nga ba ) bcas dang /ser smad ma khan po gsu ma ste/ ma khan rabs so bdun pa blo bzang rgyal ma tshan (bde thang ya ru ba)/ ma khan rabs e gcig pa tsha rdor tshul khrim sa dar rgyas/ mkhan rabs bcu gnyis pa dang 'bras sgo ma nga ma khan thog bcu ba'i ba phyogs 'a sa rnam/ rgya'// da dung 'bras spungs shag skor grwa tshang gi mkhan thog bcu dgu co ne rin rdor/ 'bras spungs mi da rgyud grwa tshang gi ma khan rabs nyer gsum/ pa blo bzang dpa' 'bar / dbus dgon ga'an par bzhugs pa'i ma khas chen la/ 'bras spungs rgyal ba bla ma bstan 'dzin chos bzang / gya g.yang ma khan po grags pa phun tshogs / ma tho lung ma khan po bzod ba rgya ma tsho/ pha bong kha dgon pa'i bla ma byams pa dge legs / gas nga sngags kha'i ma khan po tshul khrim sa dar rgyas / bshad dar gling ma khan po ngag dbang ma/khas btsun/ gse nga phu dgon mkhan po chos kyi bshes gnyen/ co ne chos/ rje sa ngas rgyas rgyal ma/tshan/rgyal rong chos chen dgon pa'i bla ma'am/ dbyi le'i ma khan po ngag dbang bzang po sogs byon to/ ya nga bya dge don grub rgya ma tshos ru ngar dgon thos bas ma/ dar rgyas gling gnas gzigs dang sa 'du' ma dzad/ byang chub mi la ngag dbang bso da nam sa( 1657lor 'khrungs ngag dbang bzod nga zer ba'ang snang) pas co ne'i lo rgyus phreng ma dzes so gas brtsam sa / co ne dgon chen gyi bca' yig ba'ag chos rje rin chen dpal 'byor pas co rne dgon chen gyi chos 'byung bla rabs dang bcas pa gas la ba'i nyin byed dbang bo bsgrigs / a smon(a mo)dpa' bo nor bzang gis bzang gdong ri khrod bkra shis dga' tshal gling btab cing de'e sku thog dang bo a smon blo bzang smon lam pas klu shod kyi wa de'u dgon gong 'og dang mu to dgon gsum btab/ skyid thang ma ṇi ba blo da 321 da

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/bzang bstan 'dzin gyis co ne dgon chen la gnas bstod kā la pang ga'i sgra dbyangs sogs pota chung longs pa bcoms/ skar rtsis mkhas chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan (gsung rtsom 'jig)/ mu ne dpon slob sangs rgyas dpal bzang la khri ba snga ma rje dge 'dun rgya ma tsho'i rnam thar blo gsal thar 'dod mgul rgyan zhes bya ba dang rin chen dpal 'dzoms kyi rnam thar dang dpon rabs rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba sogs gsung thor bu du ma brtsams/ ne'u mgo'i thugs sras blo bzang yang 'phel la dag yig tshig don gsal byed dang yi ge 'khrul spong sogs/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs pa chas bu gshis a khu blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog dang / da dung dgon chen du bla rgyud tshugs pa'i bla sprul yang che 'bring rigs la/ tshe smon gling ba dang / dbyi li sprul sku/ sku zhabs sde ba/ mar thang mkhan chen/ gur yag chos pa/ bka' chen dge bshes/ byang chub mi la/ g.yo sa sku zhabs te bla chen brgyad/ mu ne dpon slob dang / dka' bcu ba ngag dbang bkra shis/ gur yag dka' bcu ba/ gur yag ne'u mgo ba/ g.yo sa dpon slob/dpon slob mthu stobs rgya mtsho/ a smon sde chen/ men ju'i dpon slob/ skyid thang ja sag mkhan po/skyid thang ma ṇi ba/ dbu dkar hor tshang ba bcas bla 'bring bcu gcig gzhan 'phrin las ma rgyas pa dang bla rgyud mi gsal chung gras bcu phrag bcas pas/ co ne yul (sngon chad the bo dang 'brug chu'i sa cha mang shos 'dus) chos 'byor rig gsum du mdzad rjes bla na med pa bzhag pa dang mkhas mang gi mtshan snyan rgyang du bsrings pas yul mchog gi grags pa mdo dbus khams gsum du khyab par gyur to/ /co ne'i dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling rab rgyal sa khyi dang me rta lor sa rdo gyang chag tsam yang ma lus par bsnubs kyang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i lhan tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun te spyi lo198 0lor rdzong gis slar gso'i chog mchan gnang zhing btsun pa sdom khrims dag pa bdun cu lhag slar dgon sar 'dus te chos spyod phran bu re spel ba dang / phyi lor dngos su bskyar 'debs kyi dbu tshugs/ da lta sa stong der slar 'du khang stabs bde rung khang sbrags ma dang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi 'du khang( 1994lor dgras 'jig kyang da lta gnas spos te bskyar bzheng grub)/ lcags mkhar sgo chen/ jo khang chen mo/ chos grwa chen mo/byams khang / sa ris grwa tshang 'du khang / mkhan po'i pho brang / gur yag bla brang / co ne lung ba'i bdud 'dul mchod rten bcas bzhengs pa dang / grwa shag brgyad cu lhag phub par dge 'dun pa zhal brgya sum cu 'dzoms te sngar srol mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang / rgyud pa grwa tshang / sa ris grwa tshang gi 'du khang grub cing grwa ba'i slob gnyer dang thun mong chos spyod phal cher slar gsos/ 1992lo'i lugs rnying dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la gur yag drug pa gdan sar 'khod/ chos sde'i bstan don 'phrin las 'phel rgyas 'byung bzhin pa'i skabs yin la lo rgyus rgyas pa co ne blo bzang don grub bam se ra chos mdzad ngag dbang bzod pa lags kyi a mdo'i gna' dgon ting 'dzin gling zhes bya bar gsal bas 'di tsam gyis 'thus par bgyis so/ /— 322 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khya dge dgon dge ldan legs bshad gling /khya dge dgon legs bshad gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khu' co ne rdzong gi khya dge zhang du chags te khya dge dpon slob rin po che'i gdan sa yin/nang ba'i chos/ sde 'di bka' bcu don yod rgya mtsho ches pa rus khyung bo can des rab byung bcu ba'i me phag(spyi lo1587)lor dbus kyi dge bshes grub chen 'ig gi lung bstan lta ra btab/ de dus dgon sa dngos da lta 'i dgon gnas yan du rgyang grags tsam gyi lung ba'i phu sdings su yod stabs mi ser gyis gnas rnying der sgar ba'i cha zer/ dgon pa'i lha khang bcongs pa dang bka' 'gyur sogs dam chos gdan drangs / sku gshegs khar thugs dam du bzhugs shing gdung rus la rang bsrel bab pa phyis su nang bzhugs mchod rten yod/de'i dbon po dge slong bstan pa rab gas la ni khya dge dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho yin/ 'di ba la skabs der na mtshungs dge 'dun tshos blo gros dig pa zer te/ sku na phra ba'i dus su khos 'ang bo'i zhwa gyon pa la sa grib kyis ma nol pas ljags cung rtul bar gyur/ khong shing 'brug(1664)lor khya dge'i ri bar ma'i khya ra zhes pa'i grong du sku 'khrungs/ rab tu byung nas dbus su 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/ dang thog bsdus grwa'i rigs lam chags dka' ba byung bas khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs gnyis 'dzin grwa gsham du bab nas phar phyin bskyar sbyong mdzad/ yang ri bo dge 'phel nas gtsang ba ngag dbang sbyin pa'i spyan snga nas lam rim gyi bshad khri dang dbang / rje gnang bcas gsan/ de ba'in mkhas par gyur tshe bla ma des khyed rang yul du so nga nas gzhi gsum cho ga dang dbang bskur gyis gsungs shing / nyer mkho'i dpe cha rnams gnang / dus der khong gis da dung pha bong kha'i ngag dbang bstan 'dzin las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang gsang phud bka' bcu ba'i grwa skor mdzad/ khri blo gros rgya mtsho(khri rgya nag pa)sogs skyes chen du ma'i 'bas la gtugs/ tsa lus zhang 'grul la bsten nas rang yul du byon te ri khrod du bzhugs/ yul mi skya ser rnams kyis dgon pa nyams gso bya dgos zhes nan du zhus pas lcags sbrul lor(170 1)dgon gnas spar te da lta'i gnas sdings 'dir 'du khang gyan bdun dri gtsang khang bcas pa rgya phibs sum thog can legs par bzhengs/ paṇa chen rin po ches gnang ba'i phyag yig sogs de'i nang rten du bzhugs/ gzhi gsum sogs 'dul ba'i phyag bzhes rnam par dag pa gtsor 'don gyi bca' yig khong nyid kyib4 bzhag cing sgrig khrims bsdams pas 'dul 'dzin gyi snyan pa rgyas/ / shing bya la khong sku 'bum dang dgon lung sogs mdo smad chos sde dang gnas chen dag tu mjal bar phebs shing bshes gnyen rta gdong dkar bo blo bzang chos dbyangs dang bka' chen tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs la chos 'brel zhus/ ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi rdzas rgyun dang de'i sgrub skor bsnabs nas phyir phebs te ma ṇi dung phyur gyi sgrub rgyun btsugs/ co ne mkhan dpon blon gsum gyis bla mar bkur/ mdzod dge shog pa lnga'i bla dpon tā dbon pas nan zhus ltar kun mkhyen mchog la zhus rjes mdzod dge bkra shis chos 'phel gling— 323 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne+e rdzong gi khongs/(ma dzod dge sgar rnying) gas/ra 'debs ma dzad cing lcags sta ga (spyi 'o 1710 ) la bca' yig gtan la phab/ya ra ma ra phebs chor la ma dzod dge dang rkang tsha/ kha gya/ gtsos/ bas nga khog a khyung sogs dgon sde ri grod dag 'a dbang 'u nga rjes gsu ma gang dgos kyi chos char phab/ bkra shis 'byi(ra du ma khyen gter ngag dbang bkra shis gtsos bla grwa nyis sto nga 'a/ bde gas nga 'jigs gsu ma dang kun rig gi dbang 'u nga phu' / ya nga ma 〉(ma ra snyu nga)dang chas pa/ ye ra ba/ bong so / tsha rdor/ rdo dbus byam sa pa gling / co ne dgon chen ma zad ri grod rnams la dbang rjes man ngag gi lung khrid ci ma kho yo da tshim re skong du bstsal/ gong so dgon par dbyar gnas gas/ra du btsugs / reb rtsa(reb rtsa khag ba'i zer)pha ri dgon sde gsu ma ri brod dur ma nga 'gyed dang dbang 'u nga / dge tshul slo nga sgrub par ya nga ya nga phebs pa dang sho ba dgon pa'i ma bon khang la thebs rtsa gnang / lcags spre la 'o 'i ( 17'u 0 ) zla gcig pa'i tshes gsum la sku gshegs / khong 'a gzhung 'gre' dang rnam thar/ 'al gdams mgur ma sogs gsung rtso ma pota gcig bzhugs/ rang rnam skal ldan re skong / thugs sra sa sgom chen blo bzang bkra shis pa'i zur 'debs/ chos skyong gis mdzad pa'i gas nga ba'i rnam thar pad dkar phreng ba/ dbal ma nga 'jam dbyangs bsta na 'dzin rgya ma/tshos ma/dzad pa'i gas nga ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs bcas yo da do/ /khong gi thugs sra sa blo bzang bkra shis ches bya ba khya dge tho'u gyol grong du chas pa'i rigs su sku 'khrungs / de'i rgyud pa gong ma ra chas pa'i bon nag zer ba'i ma thu rtsal can byon pa la phyis su nang ba la bsgyur nas sngags pa grags can du gyur/ rje 'di ba'ang snga gas rgyud bzung ba legs pas bas nga gtong skabs bsang mgron dngos su spyan drangs pa dpon slo ba khong gis mthong gsungs / kun ma khyen gnyis pa la sa bsnyen par rdzogs shing bla ma dpon slo ba la bsten nas sdom gsu ma gyi rab dbye zhib par bsla bas shing dben gnas chu bzang steng (ri brod 'gab)tshe dang sprub pa snyom/sa par ma/dzad/ de snga ma lum 'das pa'i bsngo smon skabs su / ban chung bzhi khyim du phebs nas kun rig gsung skabs su/ tak+ki hūṃ dzaḥtaza dza hoḥ zhes de'i 'phro'i tshig ma dran par yang yang bzlas pa na/ rje de'i zhal lce las glo bur du/la sa ngan a ma shi tsa na/ takla dzaḥl 'dzad du med/ las chen pha ma shi tsa na/ takli dzaḥ yi 'phro nyid na/hūṃ 'a sa skyes pa'i rdo rje ma/ngon/ zhes blo sne drangs par grags/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang bo 'a sgrub thabs rgya ma/tsho'i rjes gnang dang blo gros rgya ma tsho'i gsu nga 'bum gyi 'u nga phul/ ñca gas 'brug ( 1760)lor sku gshegs pas gdung rten sgrub sde'i rten gtsor bzhugs / chas pa blo bzang 'phrin 'a sa kyis dpa' sha pa ri dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul yin par gsungs/ ring bsrel cha shas bkra shis 'byil gyi
