can yin/ spyan ras gzigs kha sar pā ṇi byin can/ lha sa'i jo bo'i sku rgyu las grub pa'i rdo rje phag mo/ rgyal dbang gnyis pa rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag bzo tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i chos rgyal/ khri rin po che tshul khrims dar rgyas kyis gnang ba'i byams pa gsung 'byon ma/ rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i thugs dam rten gas thub dbang rdor gdan ma/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba/ kun bzang / sgrol dkar/ rje bkra shis do kha ma/ bde bshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten yu — 351 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/gur blo bzang yar 'phel gyi dkar chag can sogs bzhugs/ sngon chad nags tshal lung ba du ma dang spyi rdzas dngul srang stong phrag 'ga'i ma nom yod kyang spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur las yongs su 'jig mod rab rgyal chu khyi lo nas mang tshogs dang rdzong srid gzhung gis zhal 'debs rogs ram gyis 'du khang gyo tog can rgyan lnga dang grwa shag sum cu lhag bcas slar bzhengs shing lha mo bsod nams kyis dbu mdzad de chos spyod du ma slar gso ba'i skabs so/ /gong so dgon byang chub gling /gong so dgon byang chub gling zhes pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong ma ru zhang dag yig khog dang dpal yul khog bar sgang du chags/gong so dgon pa byang chub gling zhes pa ni 'jang ba grags pa lhun grub kyis ha lam yon rgyal rabs te rab byung drug pa'i nang btab zer/ dgon pa'i rten gtso la dzhai khyi las grub pa'i jo bo'i sku brnyan gzi byin 'bar ba dang co ne'i bka' bstan sogs sku gsung thugs rten shin tu mang / dgon pa ches dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun sum brgya lhag 'dus/ srung ma lha mo bsten/ khya dge dpon slob kyis dbyar gnas btsugs/dgon pa 'di co ne'i yul gyi ches snga ba'i skor yin pas bon dang rnying ma gsar ma bcas brgyud rim gsum byung ba dang spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog dpal 'byor dar rgud bcas kyi rkyen dbang gis chag 'jig thengs mang byung /nags tshal lung ba du ma dang sa zhing nyung ngu re yod la/ spyi nom bogs gtong sogs kyi srol tshugs so/ /dgon rnying 'di'i chos thog la zla gcig pa'i smon lam chen mor lha mo'i lcags mkhar sogs dang / zla gnyis pa'i nang 'du khang rab gnas dang yum rgyas pa/ zla gsum pa'i nang 'jigs byed dang bde mchog sgrub chod sbyin sreg gtor chen/ zla bzhi ba'i nang gsang 'dus/ bde mchog gi bdag 'jug rje tsong kha ba'i gos sku bshams/ lha mo'i bskang gso/ tshogs rgyugs len/ zla lnga ba'i nang ma ṇi ril sgrub/ byams pa dang nang rten 'gangs can gling skor/ zla drug pa'i nang dbyar gnas/ bdun pa'i mgon po'i bskang gso/zla brgyad par bde mchog dang sbyin sreg gzhung rgyugs/ zla dgu ba'i ma ṇi dang smyung gnas/ zla bcu bar mgon chos lnga'i bskang gso/ lha mo'i bshags gtor/ zla bcu gnyis par dgu gtor chen po sogs tshugs shing / gzhan sbyin bdag grong sde'ang mtha' gong dang mkha' bo/ chos khri/ brag nang / sde chung / phe pa/chu shed/ yun 'gyang / la lung / mdo ba/ khyung mgo stag rtsa/ nang mo/ dpal yul gong ma sogs yod pas dgon pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi dang me rta thug bar bstan pa yun ring bskyangs/ rab rgyal sa khyir bsnubs grwa mang rang khyim thon skyed du zhugs/ gnas skabs 'byor ba dang dad pa sogs rkyen dbang gis nags mdo dgon pa dang bsres te slar gsos so/ /gur yag ri khrod bkra shis bsam gtam gling /— 352 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gur yag ri khrod bkra shis bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong ma ru zhang gi khongs te co ne dgon chen gyi mdun ri'i nags dkyil du chags/ri khrod grags can 'di co ne'i sa skyong blo bzang don grub dang dmag zor mgon pos sbyor 'jags dang rogs ram gyi mthun rkyen las rab byung bcu gcig par(1684lo) ne'u mgo ba ngag dbang rgyal mtshan(1624da wa1716)gyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ de nas yu gur ba blo bzang yar 'phel(1686da wa1750)dang / gur yag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin chos 'phel/ dag yig gshes dkon mchog rigs pa'i seṅge / gur yag bra rigs ngag dbang brtson 'grus sogs bla ma du ma brgyud de ri khrod legs par bskyangs/spyi lo1958lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la 'thab rtsod rgya bskyed pa'i gras su ri khrod 'jig da lta slar gsos med pa dang sku snga ma'i zhabs zhu tshang gi bgres po zhig gis shul tsam srung bzhin mchis so/ /1992lo'i lugs rnying zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la gur yag sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dngos grub rgya mtsho dgung lo bcu gcig steng co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling du gdan sar bkod/ 'di ba the bo rdzong steng ga zhang gi khya sgo grong tsho'i yab lcags po thar dang yum klu sman 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ da lta bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer 'bad bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /mkhar chen dgon dge ldan rab spel gling /mkhar chen dgon dge ldan spel gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong mkhar chen zhang srid gzhung sdod gnas su chags/nang ba'i rgyud sde 'di gna' snga mo nas yul der chags shing dgon pa che shos kyi gras shig yin te/ sngon chad tshogs chen 'du khang dang / sgrol ma'i lha khang / phyag rdor lha khang / rta mgrin lha khang / nang chen gnyis/ mchod rten gnyis bcas bzhengs pa la/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon du dge 'dun pa zhal bcu lhag bzhugs/ grwa shag dgu tsam phub/ chos spyod thams cad rgya che zhing lha 'cham ngo mtshar ba sogs dar /dgon mthar ma ṇi'i 'khor khang chen po drug cu rtsa grangs bzhengs/ yin na'ang bod yul bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rtsa med dang rig gnas rnying ba sde khyad par du chos lugs snub skabs su dgon pa bsnubs nas shul du zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung tshugs/ chos lugs dad mos rang dbang thob rjes dad ldan rnams drin dran dgon dang ri khrod khag gcig tu bsres par gyur to/ /mkhar chen ri khrod yid dga' chos 'jin gling /mkhar chen ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong mkhar chen zhang du chags/ri khrod 'di gna' snga mo nas btab pa zhig yin kyang lo rgyus mi gsal/ dmangs khrod du wa ma chu'i ri — 353 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/khrod gsang sngags rab 'phel gling zer/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dus tsam la mkhar chen dge slong legs bshad rgya mtsho mchog bod dbus 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas phyir rang yul du phyag phebs shing khong gi zhal gdams bzhin du gsang sngags pa rdor phyag dang rin chen dpal bzang / dbang phyug rgyal mtshan sogs kyis rdo mkhar zhes pa'i sa nas ma ṇi bum sgrub kyi rgyun btsugs pa dang / de rjes shing pho bya lo zhig la bya bral ba dkon mchog chos 'phel zhes pas slar brag mgo 'dir gsar du phyag 'debs mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo bar rgyun 'khyongs kyang de 'phral bsnubs/ da skabs mi ser dad ldan rang mos kyis slar gso byed mus su'o/ /drin dran dgon bshad sgrub dge 'phel gling /drin dran dgon bshad sgrub dge 'phel gling zhes pa'i chos sde rnying ba 'di ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong gi mkhar chen zhang du chags/dgon pa 'di'i lo rgyus sngar yod kyang phyis su me rkyen dang rgya 'khrug las 'jig cing deb ther rgya mtshor bkod pa tsam lus 'dug mod/ ngag rgyun dang co ne dgon chen lo rgyus kyi zur nas dgon pa 'di ha lam sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta(spyi lo12 46)rgya nag ling kru'u sar hor se chen rgyal pos gdan zhus ba'in phebs lam nas khong gi bka' lung ltar btab pa grags 'dug ste de'i phyis su gzhan sus phyag btab bam zer rgyun mi mthun pa byung med/ dgon gzhis mu'u nyi shu tsam bzung / gna' dus chos sde(spyi khyab tu drin dran ri khrod zer)'dir khongs su 'dus pa'i dgon pa'am sa skya'i lugs kyi bshad grwa bzhi yod de/ gcig ni mkhar chen yid dga' chos 'dzin gling dang / gnyis ni wa chu gsang sngags rab 'phel gling / gsum pa chos grags dgon/ bzhi ba drin dran dgon rang yin la/ rim bzhin dgon pa 'phel 'grib dang mi ser sbyin bdag gi dbang gis phyogs gcig tu rang shugs su 'dus skad/ de rjes co ne'i sa skyong blo bzang don grub(1679—1706)kyi dus su dge lugs par bsgyur pa dang gur yag sprul sku rnam pa zung gis dgon pa 'di nyid zhig gso mdzad cing rten zhugs mi nyung ba bsgrugs/ rje 'di ba rang sa'i ske gung(gad sgo'u)zhes pa'i grong du sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo bdun nas bcu dgu'i bar rang dgon du klog bslabs te bzhugs pa dang nyi shu ba nas don bdun 'tsho bar se rar bzhugs/ drin dran dgon zer don ni 'gro mgon smad du phebs skabs der yul phyogs 'dir 'khrug pa mang zhing mi ser la than pa sogs mnar gcod mang bo thebs sgang yin pa dang / chos sde zhig 'debs mgo bcoms pa nas yul 'khrug 'jags shing sgo phyugs 'phel pa'i dus bde lo legs byung gshis kun gyis 'phags pa'i sku drin dran pa las thogs par bshad/ dgon du ser smad mkhan po mar snyung dgon chen gyi bla dpon dge bshes lha rams pa ang dang bo thob pa blo bzang dkon mchog mkhan zur du lo ngo bcu bdun bzhugs shing khong mkhar zur skabs su se ra theg chen gling gi sku phreng dgu ba chos kyi nyi ma(18〈 2—— 354 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgom dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/1927)bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la 'byor skabs su rang yul rang dgon du phyag phebs nas ser skya dad ldan chos dang zang zing gi dngul sgor dang gser skyems yo byad bcas gnang / slar se ra theg chen gling du byon nas sku tshe hril bor rgyal dbang mchog la tshe sgrub gnang nas bzhugs/ dgung lo re gsum gyi steng se ra'i mkhan po'i go gnas blangs/ de'i sprul sku dpal ldan lha mo dang / de'i sprul sku bya khri chen po/ de'i sprul sku rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos thugs thag bcad pa'i 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang ye shes yin/ khong rang sa'i klu tshang grong du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu'i steng rab tu byung / dgung lo zhe gsum steng rang dgon gyi khrir bzhugs shing bā tse rdzong nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi rgyun las u yon dang gan lho khul gyi nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi u yon du bzhugs mthar spyi lo1989lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer bzhir bsnyung rkyen las sku gshegs so/ /rab rgyal chu khyi'i yar sngon du dgon pa'i grwa rgyun ni mar snyung dgon pa'i khongs su gtogs/ 'di dgon gyis mar snyung(ma ṇi dgon zhes pa snang ste gna' dus yul 'khrug las mi ser mang bo brlag bkums thebs pas dge sgrub sdig gshegs su ma ṇi 'don dgos phyir grong ba rnams thun mong du 'du tshogs tshugs pa'i shul de rim sgar chos sder gyur zer) gi phyag srol ltar du bla ma las sne bsko 'jog gi lugs yod de/ gtso bo bla ma chos sne dang / tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ tshogs chen dge bskos/ rgyud pa'i spyan 'dren chen mo/ rgyud gzhung spyan 'dren/ rgyud pa'i dge bskos/ dkor gnyer bcas kyis sdom khrims nang ba'i rgyud stod ltar lag len bya/ dge lugs pa'i chos sde 'di'i srung ma mgon po dang rten gtso la byams pa byin can bzhugs/ 'du khang dang rung khang / nang chen gcig bcas bzhengs pa dang rab rgyal sa khyi'i lor dgon pa cung rgud de thun mong grwa shag drug tu dge 'dun pa zhal su ma cu rtsa grangs 'dus shing grong tsho nyer brgyad kyis bskyangs te/ mkhar chen dang / ser shul/ ki ga drin dran/ rta bzhi kha/ srib lung nang / wa chu nang / chos dro/ rta rig nang / sa rti/ ra rkyang / gong rtsa dag chu mod/ gzhi bdag ru ba bde ba/ lag gtsang kha/g.yang lug a 'bum tshal/ bam sde/ lha rdzas tsha/ 'gro ru/ bon shog tshab cheng / rkya kha ma/ban de chum/ g.yang 'ba'/ ltag dgon pa/ rdo rtsa bcas so/ /dgon pa'i bca' yig ni chos rje kun dga' don grub pas mdzad/ dgon pas lam rim 'chad nyan gtsigs su 'dzin pa dang / hor zla dang por smon lam nyi ma brgyad/ gnyis pa'i bdag 'jug bcas nyin bdun/ gsum pa'i sman bla sgrub chog sogs chos thog nyi ma bdun/ bzhi ba'i gsang 'dus bdag 'jug nyin brgyad/ lnga bar lung ba shog pa'i ma ṇi ril sgrub nyi ma bdun dang byams pa gling skor sogs/ brgyad pa'i kun rig bdag 'jug bcas nyin brgyad/dgu ba'i dus bzang bcas nyin bzhi/ bcu ba'i dus bzang nyin bzhi dang lnga mchod nyin bzhi/ bcu gcig par byams smon/ nyi ldog sku rim bcas nyi ma gsum/ bcu gnyis par paṇa chen gdung mchod nyi ma gsum/dus rgyun zla rer nyi ma bdun re'i chos thog bcas dar/ spyi lo1958lo'i sngon du rang dgon du dge 'dun — 355 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/pa sum cu rtsa grangs bzhugs pa'i khar nye logs dgon lag tu brtsis pa'i rta gzungs mdo dang chos lung / ba ru/ mkhar chen zhes pa'i dgon pa chung ngu dag gi grwa btsun phyogs gcig tu 'tshogs pa la zhal bdun cu lhag bzhugs so/ /sngon dus dgon rnying 'di'i sku gsung thugs rten byin can la/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i byams sku gsung byon 'phel gdung rgyun 'bab mi tshad can gtsos gser sku che chung sum cu/thub dbang stong sku/ rigs gsum mgon po/ jo bo shākya mu ne/ tsong kha ba rgya tham ma/ lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i snar thang par gyi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ kirti'i gsung 'bum/ rgyal po zhing gi gzungs 'dus/ mo'u gal bu'i mdo/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ be+eḍūr+ya sngon po dang be+eḍūr+ya ser po/ gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gnyis/ gzhan mchod cha sogs zangs dung dang rgya gling / rkang dung / sil snyan/ ting shags/ dril bu/ ḍa ma ru/ 'khar rnga/ gur yag chos pas nang ba'i bdun tshar spus mtshar can bcas grangs mang / kong bu mar rgya ma brgya shong ba gcig dang 'bring chung mang bo/ tshigs zangs che chung / me phor/ spos phor/ rnam bum/ las bum/ zangs bum/dngul kong / tshogs gdan/ sog gdan/ khri rgyab yol/ rnga gdan/ dngul sgor/ 'bru rigs/gos chen/ 'bri mdzo mo sum cu lhag dang / nags tshal/ sa zhing sogs mang ngo /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyir rdzong nas dgon pa slar gso chog pa'i bka' rgya 'byor cing / khri 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang ye shes dang bcas pa'i grwa rgan gzhon/ mi ser thun mong gis sbyor 'jags las 'du khang dang lha khang bskyar du bzhengs pa dang nang rten du sngar gyi tsan dan dmar bo'i byams sku lus pa gcig po dang sman sku'i byams pa chos 'khor ma khru bdun can/ byams pa'i gling skor ma khri gsum/ sangs rgyas stong sku/rje tsong kha ba'i sku tshar brgya/ rigs gsum mgon po/ jo bo mi skyod rdo rje/ rje a ti sha mkhan chen 'dra sku/ mkhan chen sku gdung mchod rten/ bka' 'gyur lha sa'i dpar ma/ rje grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ rje kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung 'bum/ brgyad stong ba/ bskal bzang / gzungs 'dus sogs stong phrag bzhugs/ da lta ser smad mkhan thog don drug pa blo bzang dkon mchog pa'i thugs skyong las grwa ba zhal grangs bzhi bcu lhag 'dus shing grwa shag sum cu tsam phub/ slar yang dgon pa rang gso'i ched du phyugs ra zhig dang tshong khang chung ngu gcig btsugs so/ /mang ngos ri khrod gsang sngags chos 'phel gling /mang ngos ri khrod gsang sngags ches 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong mkhar chen zhang gi khongs su chags/ri khrod 'di gna' snga mor sngags 'chang rig 'dzin zhig gis btab cing da lta'i bar gnas te/ spyi — 356 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lo1958lor bsnubs kyang da snga mang tshogs kyis slar gsos nas dge lugs pa'i btsun pa bcu phrag 'dus te gtsug lag khang mig gsum can zhig dang grwa shag drug tsam phub/ btsun pa bcu bdun bzhugs/ rten du gtso bo sman bla bde gshegs brgyad dang gser zangs las grub pa'i byams sku khru gsum can/ yum dum pa bcu gnyis sogs bzhugs/ sbyin bdag sde ba wa ris gong ma dang zhol ma/ gad sgo'u gsum yod do/ /chos grogs ri khrod/chos grogs ri khrod ces pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong mkhar chen zhang gi khongs su chags/chos grogs ri khrod ces pa 'di mdo smad chos 'byung du mkhar chen gshis su chos rab ri khrod ces pa e yin rgyus ma lon yang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo bar yod pa ma zad/ da skabs kyang dad ldan rnams kyis slar gsos te gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag bdun bzhengs la dge 'dun pa zhal du ma 'dus/ chos spyod spel/ rten du gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i byams sku khru gsum can dang / rje yab sras gsum sogs li sku nyer bzhi/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi thang ga sogs dang / yum/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bcas bzhugs so/ /dar dge dgon phun tshogs dar rgyas gling /dar dge dgon phun tshogs dar rgyas gling zhes ba ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong mkhar chen zhang gi klu ba zhes pa'i grong du chags/chos sde rnying ba 'di mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ dang thog yung lo'i(140 2lo'i sngon)dus mkhas grub chen po byams pa dge 'dun dang blo gros yangs pa gnyi gas chas pa'i gshis ka ru bzhi mdor btab pa 'jig rjes slar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug(170 2)la dgon chen gyi khri nyer bzhi ba bstan pa yar 'phel dang bde thang mkhan po blo bzang tshangs dbyangs bcas chas pa'i spyi dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling bde thang ri bo cher spar nas btab/ phyis su nang 'khrug gi rkyen las dgon pa kha gyes/ 'di bar khri rabs zhe brgyad song zhes bkod gshis dgon 'di ha lam spyi lo1780lo'i yar sngon btab par snyam/ sngon chad chas pa kong bu nang ba dang chas pa klu chung(stag tshang dgon pa/) chas pa ya ru(bde thang dgon)/ chas pa rgya mkhar/ chas pa dar dge rang ni chas pa'i dgon khag lnga bo zer/ de bzhin chas pa blo bzang don grub sogs bla sprul khag lngas rang rang gdan sa skyong khur mdzad/ ha lam spyi lo1929lo tsam na dgon pa nyams rgud du gyur stabs ye shu'i chos sgrog mkhan gyis 'dre lag bsrengs te dgon par shan shugs tshabs chen thebs/btsun pa kha shas kyang ye shu'i chos nang zhugs shing a me ri ku'i chos sgrog mkhan gyis nom chen btang nas 'du khang nyos te ye shu'i chos khang du bsgyur/ dgon pa rang sar gnas thabs zad stabs nyi rgan thang du spos nas — 357 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/slar btab pa dang dge 'dun pa 'al grangs bdun cu lhag 'dus/ dad ldan mi ser thun mong gis rten dang brten pa sngar las lhag pa bzhengs/ spyi rdzas dngul sgor sogs mang du 'dus pa dang nags tshal sa 'ing mi nyung ba khyad du gnyer bas rten la byin can rgya bod sog gsum yul nas bsgrubs par mi ser gyi dge lugs chos spyod kun la shin tu dad par gyur cing / spyi lo1958lo'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la 'thab rtsod rgya bskyed pa'i nang dgon pa yongs su bsnubs phyin slar gso ma nus par mkhar chen zhang srid gzhung der chags/ sku phreng cheb phyi ma ba dar dge mkhan po lags yun ring so ga yul du 'tsho ba las19〈 2lor slar rang yul du phebs nas stag ru nang grong du da lta bzhugs shing co ne rdzong srid gros u yon du bdams so/ /chas pa kong bu nang dga' ldan bkra shis bsam grub gling /chas pa kong bu nang dga' ldan bkra shis bsam grub gling ngam chas pa kun rtogs gling(yar thang dgon pa)zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong gi a gzigs thang zhang gi yar thang sde 'gram du chags/ shar phyogs rdzong bar spyi le bdun cu yod/thog mar mdo smad chos 'byung du bkod pa'i khri rabs bcas mgo brtsams te gleng bar byas na/ sngar rgya'i hran kri khri lo'am rgyal dbang lnga ba'i skabs su(ha lam spyi lo1661sngon tsam mam dgon pa'i ma phyi gzhan zhig tu sprel1426lo bkod pas brtag par 'tshal)khri chen blo bzang yar 'phel gyis dgon chung zhig btab(stag 'dul sprul ba tshang zhes pas btab kyang zer)pa la/ chas pa blo bzang 'phrin las dang khya dge sprul skus gong spel du mdzad/ blo bzang 'phrin las(sku rabs rim byon la mi ser dang dpon phyogs kun nas yar thang bla dpon zhes 'bod) 'di ba bad steng gi yab phan bde 'byung gnas dang yum ma ṇi 'tsho'i sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa stag(spyi lo1648)lor sku 'khrungs/ chas pa dbon po gza' ro'i yang srid la thugs thag bcad de dgung lo brgyad pa la gdan sar bkod/ gong tshang sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims las rab tu byung zhing yi ge sogs ngag thon pa bslabs/ de'i phyir rang dgon du bzhugs stabs ma bde bar gdong nag dpon chen dgon du re zhig bzhugs pa dang kun mkhyen gong ma co ner phebs drung du bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'jigs byed kyi dbang gsan/ yang 'om bu'i ri khrod du khya dge dpon slob la chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang zhus pa dang bka' chos mang bo gsan/ bkra shis 'khyil du khri rgan/ co ner grags pa bshad sgrub/ stag tshang dpon slob/ rong khams zhabs drung / sprul sku ngag dbang blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ se ra paṇ+ḍi ta/'brog dge bla ma/ mu ne dpon slob/ lha khang lung ba/ nyang tshang sprul sku/ slob dpon blo bzang bstan pa sogs la zab chos mang bo zhus/ thang tshang bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang shes rab nas bka' 'gyur gyi lung gsan/ lcags byi lo(172 0)la sprul sku ngag dbang bas smad sog nas dngul srang sum brgya bskur pa'i steng nas 'du khang bzhengs/ shing yos la dbus su phebs rgyal dbang bdun pa/ khri nam bzang ba/ khri rgyal — 358 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mtshan seṅge / ba ri dpon slob yin+taka paṇa chen sogs mjal cing chos 'brel zhus/ sgo mang dpon slob chos grags dang mkhan zur zhal snga nas bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid gsan/ dge 'phel du khri nam bzang ba las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bskyar du bzhes/ rang yul du gnas bcu'i sku dpar tshar gnyis gdan drangs/ sa lug la ri bo rtse lngar mjal ba dang mtsho bdun du lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje la chos 'brel zhus/ bka' chen blo bzang bstan 'dzin las mi tra/ rdor phreng / brgya rtsa bcas bka' chos thob pa la mdo dbus bla ma bzhi cu lhag bsten/ me stag rang dgon du phyogs nas phreng dbang sogs chos rgyun spel/ sa 'brug la yang ri bo rtse lnga brgyud de hal ha rje btsun dam pa mjal cing slar dbus su phebs nas dge bshes seng gdong mar sgrub thabs rin 'byung zhus/ nam bzang ba'i bka' bzhin gser gdung du bzang gos kyi gur dngul srang drug brgya lhag gis bsgrubs shing mang 'gyed kyi thebs phul/ lcags lug la mtsho bdun du khri rgya nag pa las gsang 'dus kyi dbang gsan cing rwa kho dpon slob la chos 'brel zhus mthar rang dgon phebs 'phral bkra shis 'khyil dang co ne dgon chen/ yer ba/ khya dge sogs men ju'i yan gyi sgrub sde kun la mang ja dang phreng 'gyed phul ba ma zad rgyal dbang dang skyabs mgon la dngos 'bul sbam mtho/ smon lam zhal 'debs gdan sa gsum/ rgyud stod smad la grwa ja btang / sku tshe smad la ri khrod kun bzang bde chen(khya dge'i ri khrod cig)btab nas der sku mtshams bzhugs te thun mtshams su gtor ma brgya rtsa/ bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig sogs pota sum brgya lhag bklags/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la mnga' brnyes pas bu ston gyi skye bar grags/ mdzod dger phebs skabs rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag re bdun pa shing sprel(1764)lor sku gshegs/ nyid kyi slob ma gur yag bka' bcu ngag dbang bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod rin chen lhun po zhes bya ba yod do/ /de'i sprul sku 'jam dpal bstan pa'i sgron me co ne'i bse gtsang du sa byi(1768)lor sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar mdzod dge dge 'dun dpal bzang dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus grwa sbyangs/ skyabs mgon mchog bsten nas bka' chos mang bo gsan/sog yul du thengs snga phyir phebs/ bā tse(lin than rdzong)sa cha'i gnas bdag seṅge gdong drug ces par lo rer bu stag lo ba re'i sha khrag mchod dgos pas khong nyid kyis de la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang nas sems can gyi blo bde la bskyabs par grags pa dang khong gis rdo'i stag khar rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad pa zhig mthus bzos shing rab gnas mdzad de ro bo pad+ma can nye logs kyi stag gis mi la 'tshe ba'i sdug bsngal bkrol gshis chas pa stag 'dul pa zhes su grags/ khong la skyabs mchog 'jigs med dbang bo'i phyag nas thob pa'i bod rgyal srong btsan sgom po'i yin zhes pa'i be+etsār+ya'i sder ma zhig yod/ rang dgon du byams chen gyi sku 'dra sogs rten brten pa mang tsam bzhengs par phyag rjes che'o/ /de'i yang srid du co ne'i drug rtsa'i nang sde ba nas 'khrungs pa 'jam dpal bshad sgrub 'phrin las yin/ 'di bar srong btsan sgam po'i phyag 'khar dang sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi tshems sogs rgyal dbang lnga bas gnang ba du ma mchis/ de'i sprul sku sngar bzhin bse gtsang — 359 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/nas 'khrungs par mtshan la dkon mchog bsam gtan rgya mtsho gsol 'dug ste 'di gnyis sku tshe mtha' ma 'khyol to/ /lnga ba 'jam dpal bstan sgron yin te gshin tshang stag rtsa zhes pa'i grong du sku 'khrungs/ khong gi ring la dgon par bka' 'gyur dngul bris tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur gser bris tshar gnyis bachengs pa sogs mdzad rjes che bar mngon/ dgung lo bdun cu 'tsho ba la rang dgon du de'i dmar gdung bzhengs nas bzhugs so/ /de'i sprul sku 'jam dpal bstan sgron gyi sku tshar sa rta la 'khrungs par mtshan dkon mchog thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rtse dbus 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen las rab tu byung / bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar 'grims par kun mkhyen yab sras las zab chos mang bo gsan/ gung thang mchog las bsnyen par rdzogs/smad du lan lnga phebs myong / dgon de'i rten gal chen la byams pa dgung lo lnga can thugs gar dga' ldan rdor a yig rang byon bzhugs pa'i byams khang / rnam rgyal lha khang / mgon khang / klu dbang khang / jo khang / rung khang sogs su rten dang mchod rdzas/ byams pa thog bzhes ma rten gtsor bzhugs/ yo byad mang po phul/ sa bya lor kun mkhyen bar ma gdan drangs te dgon pa spo ba'i gnas gzigs mdzad cing gnas spos rjes 'du khang chen mo dang byams khang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang / dam can btsan khang / gzim khang bcas bzhengs/ bca' yig blang dor gsal ba'i me long gtan la phab ste dge 'dun pa'i nang khrims bsdams/ rgyud grwa btsugs nas drung yig sngags rams pa chos 'dzin dar rgyas khri ba dang / rab 9rabyams pa dge legs bla ma dbu mdzad du bskos te 'chad nyan dang sgrig lam smad rgyud ltar bgyis so/ /bdun pa ni bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'khrungs yul gong mtshungs/ de'i sku ring la sgrol dkar dang byams sku/ rnam sras/'jam dbyangs gsung 'byon sogs rten chen po dang byin can mang du bzhengs so/ / brgyad pa skal bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho yin/ gong gsal kha shas lo rgyus gsal tsam dgon pas 'don sprod med pas mtshan 'god pa las 'os med do/ /gzhan yang chas pa kun rtogs gling la khyad dge dpon slob dang bcas pas skyong stor gyi sku drin che bas khya dge sprul sku'i rnam thar dgon 'dir bris pa la/ 'jam dbyangs bstan pa chos ldan/ 'bring rigs su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags 'brug(spyi lo1760)las 'khrungs shing zhag gsum tsam nas a ma zhes bos pa la kun gyis khya dge'i dpon slob kyi sprul sku yin par brtags/ shing sprel lor rje blo bzang 'phrin las nyid kyi sku gam du dpon slob kyi phyag phreng ngos 'dzin du bcug pas thugs yid ches kyang sgom chen pa'i yang srid yin pa'i gsung rgyun thos/ lo der khong gis gzhan don du dgongs pa'i tshul bstan pas na kun mkhyen bar mas brtag zhu bgyis te sa bya lor dgon par gdan drangs/ the bo'i dpal shes steng ga'i nang gong ma'i rgya mkhar bla ma blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bkra shis 'khyil nas mdo sngags sbyangs/ gur yag bka' bcu ba las sum rtags dang sgra snyan ngag sbyangs/ tho yon chos rje 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun gyis zhus ngor sog por lan gnyis phebs/ bsngos sha mi bzhes par 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra zhib dang len mdzad/— 360 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/the bo rong phyogs dang khya dge khang thog gi mi ser la bka' chos gnang / a 'khor brag dkar du sa zla nyin snyung gnas kyi rgyun btsugs/ me 'brug la dbus su byon par byang rgyud chos sde khag la mang 'gyed btang / de nas rgya gar la phebs te bya rgod phung bo ri dang klu sgrub kyi sgrub khang rnams la mchod 'bum thugs smon 'dzem med zhus/ gnya' nang 'phel rgyas gling dang mi la'i sgrub khang / bal yul du slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi sku gdung / bya rung mchod rten la sku dkar gsol/ me sbrul nag zla'i tshes la ma pham g.yu mtsho nas sku gshegs so/ / 1995lo'i zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la yar thang sku 'bas sprul sku sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang 'od gsal rgya mtsho gdan sar bkod/ 'di ba da lta'i co ne+e rdzong a gzigs(bzi) thang zhang khongs kyi yab ban de mkhar dang yum klu mo 'tsho'i sras su spyi lo198 2lo'i gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen drug pas sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ da lta klog slob la gzhol ba'i skabs so/ /chos sde chas pa gong bu nang gi rten bzhugs gtso bo gong gsal las ga'an yang(byams pa thog bzhes ma'i dkar chag mkhar mo che ba blo bzang yon tan gyis bsgrigs) gnas chung btsan khang / khro bo me ba btsud pa'i lha khang / bka' chos 'khor khang du ma ma chis shing / lha mo dang dam can srung mar bkur/ sgo ma nga dpon slob chos grags kyis gnang ba'i bu ston 'dra sku/ tsan dan jo bo/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dpag med/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum rgya gar ma/ thub pa rdor gdan gsung 'byon/ rje mtshams 'phel dge legs ma/rgyal sras 'i ba lha dang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu zhwa/ rgyal dbang sku phreng rin byon gyi na bza'/ bde mchog gi blos bslangs/ jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig li ma/ khri dpal ldan grags pa'i thugs dam bde mchog zhal thang khri rgyal mtshan seṅge'i phyag nas byung ba/ kha'u brag rdzong gi rten rdo grwa gsum la bzhengs pa'i 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor lnga/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten/ kong bu nang ba gong mas dngul bzhengs bka' 'gyur/rje blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gdung rus la yi ge dang ring bsrel du ma byon pa nang bzhugs kyi mchod rten/'jam dpal bstan sgron pa'i dmar gdung / gser bzhengs byams pa khru bcu gcig can/ paṇa chen phyag 'ongs rten 'dus 'khrul ma byang ba keng rus skye bdud ril bu/ sgrol dkar/ rnam sras gser sku chen po/bshad sgrub bstan nyi'i ring bzhengs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten bcas/ skabs de'i dngul srang stong phrag du ma thugs kyi rten la bka' gdams mchod rten/ nā he'i mchod rten gnyis/ tsarjan gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten/byams chen chos rje'i gdung rus/ ri bo rtse lnga'i mchod rten/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi mchod rten/ rje rang byung rdo rje las byung ba za hor rgyal bo'i sras mo lha lcam marja ra ba'i skye bdud sku sha skye bdud brgya rtsa dang stong rtsa'i sku sha phyogs 'dus/ gter chen rarja gling bas snying gter tshun zab mo 'dus pa bskor bzhi ya bye thugs rje gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi myong grol 'khrul med/ bde mchog yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar las grub pa'i ril bu/ dga' ldan kham pa/ rwa sgreng shug pa/ dung dkar 'brug grag mnyam med jo bo'i na bza'/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku zlam tshal bu/ 'brom rgyal ba'i — 361 —

zhan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/'byung gnas/ mkhas grub rje/ kau shri dpal 'byor don grub/ rje dus gsum btsun pa sogs skyes cherno dam pa mang bo'i na bza'/ co ne'i bka' 'gyur/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur sogs shin tu 'bor che/gzhan yang dus 'khor rgya nag pa'i phyag rten ma ṇi gzungs can/ kun bzang me tog dur khrod sil ba tshal gyi tsan dan/ stag mo lus sbyin shing gi yal ga sku 'bum tsarjan ljon pa dang de'i lo ma me tog chu bo gaṅgā dang nā he'i chu'i sgrol dkar tshe sgrub kyi bum pa/ dus 'khor dbang chen dang smad rgyud kyi rdul tshon/ grong khyer sgrol ba'i 'khor lo/ mi mthun g.yul rgyal mtshan ma gsum sogs gna' rdzas 'gangs chen du ma/ sku zhabs bla brang / stag 'dul nang chen/ stobs ldan nang chen bzhengs/ chas pa dgon khag lnga'i nang gses/sbyin bdag grong tsho la ya ra dgon/ mi rdo/ spyan 'dus/ klu sras thang / dpe klu thang / tsha bu mched/lha gsum tshang / ra rgod/ yar thang / chos 'dzin/ phu gtsang sgang / rdzogs chen gshis/ nar tshur sgang / phu gtsang gshis bcas yin cing / sngon ches dar sgang(1958lo'i sngon) dge 'dun pa nyis brgya lhag dang grwa shag brgya phyin/ 'chad nyan la 'dzin grwa gzhug ma/ 'dzin grwa bar ma/ dkar rim 'dzin grwardzogs rim dam bca'/ sngags rim dam bca'i srol tshugs/ las sne la rgyud bla ma dang / khri ba/ dge bskos/ byang 'dren/ chab ris/ dkor gnyer sogs bsko/ yar thang sngags pa bla ma bya sbug dang phar thang mtshams pa bla ma sum pa sogs skyes bu dam pa byon/ bkris lhun gyi 'cham dar ba legs/ de bzhin dgon pa ma brlags gong tshogs chen 'du khang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang / byams khang / bka' chos kyi 'khor lo/ rje lha khang / dam can btsan khang / gnas chung btsan khang / khro bo me ba btsud pa'i lha khang bcas spus legs nyams ldan kho na bzhengs/ dgon pa'i sa khyon rgya che zhing nags tshal lung ba nyin srib gsum dang sa zhing mi nyung ba bcas dang / spyi rdzas gzhung nom 'bor che bas dgon pa chos dang 'byor ba rgyas mod kyang dus kyi dbang gis rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi dang me rta la yongs su 'jig pas nyams thag par gyur to/ /shing byi(1984)lo nas sgrub grwa slar gso'i chos sgo phye zhing bla ma 'od gsal rgya mtsho gtsos pa'i dge 'dun pa sum cu lhag 'dus nas sa khyon mu'u bzhi bcu tsam gyi steng slar 'du khang chung chung zhig dang lha khang zhigagrwa shag bco brgyad bzhengs/ rten rnying rje dge legs ma dang kun mkhyen drug pas gnang ba'i gser grub thub sku sogs rten gtsor bzhugs shing / sems can dad ldan rnams kyi 'gro don sgrub ci thub byed pa dang /zhor du sa zhing mu'u bcu bzhi tsam dang klu chu'i shing gru zhig gnyer bzhin mchis/ chos spyod gtso shos la zla dang bor smon lam/ zla gnyis par mgon po'i gtor sgrub/ zla gsum par gsang 'dus dang mgon chos/'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ zla bzhi bar bde mchog zla lnga bar ma ṇi/ zla drug par dbyar gnas dang sngags 'chang sogs/ zla brgyad par gsang 'dus/ zla dgu bar 'jigs byed/ zla bcu bar gsang 'dus dang mgon chos/ zla bcu gnyis par sngags 'chang dang bgeg gtor bcas dar bas legs par spel to/ /dgon li ri khrod bde chen gsung rab gling /— 362 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon li ri khrod bde chen gsung rab gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong gi a gzigs thang 'ang gi khongs su chags/dgon ming dang chags gnas la dge lung dang a bzi thang zhes bris pa'ang snang / mdo smad chos 'byung du dgon li(dge lung)dpon slob blo bzang mkhas mchog pa'i gdan sa zhes pa dang rgya yig tu skyid thang blo bzang rnam rgyal mchog gis btab ces mi gcig mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par skad/ 'di ba kha lung chos rdzong nas sku 'khrungs pa dang dbus nas 'bras sgo mang dang se ra'i co ne khang tshan sogs su zhugs mthar dge bshes thob cing slob ma mang bo byon/ mdzod dge mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyis bla mar bkur/ gsung rtsom pota longs pa brtsams/ de rjes ma tsha mdo dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ gtsos dpon skor blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ a mchog dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas sogs byon/ ri khrod kyang sku phreng rim byon gyis bskyangs la 'du khang du kha gya'i be hus(brgya dpon)bzhengs par byams chen/ rdo rje 'chang chen sogs rten 'gangs chen bzhugs su gsol/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i mchong skyod chen po'i las 'gul du phyugs ra btsugs shing lcags byi lor(1961)rgyal gnyer phyugs ra gtor dus dang bsdun ri khrod kyang 'jig/ da snga slar gso ba'i bskal ba ma ldan par lus so/ /chas pa'i gshis dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling /kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong gi mdo khog zhang ste rdzong lho nub kyi mtshams su spyi le drug cu lhag gi sa na chags pa'i chas pa'i gshis dgon pa bkra shis chos 'khor gling ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me khyi(spyi lo1886)lor bla ma dkar po sku phreng dang po tshwa kun ho thog thu rje btsun byams pa mthu stobs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen bco brgyad pa rab brtan rgya mtsho'i sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gtsos pas phyag 'debs mdzad cing / phyis su de ga'i sngar yod kyi ri khrod rnams gcig tu bsdus te chas pa'i gshis lung khog gi spyi dgon du gyur/rgya mkhar grub chen gyis mdzad pa'i chas pa'i bla rabs dang gdung rabs byung tshul gyi thog ma'i lo rgyus ltar na/ de yang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi nang tshan mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi gdung rgyud cig gis lha ldan skyor mo lung gi sa bzung zhing yul de'i bdag po mdzad nas mi rabs mang bo song ba na/ khong tsho'i tshong 'grul khag cig stod lung yangs pa can nas mched de khams phyogs su song nas mi thog gcig bsdad/de nas a mdo'i phyogs su khal mdzo ded nas a myes dpal rgan zhes yul gnyan gyi mdun du bslebs tshe khal mdzo rnams ngal dub kyis chad de 'gro ma thub pa dang / gzhis chags kyi gnas 'di yin nam snyam nas der bsdad pa la rgyang chad pa(rgyang mched kyang 'bri)zhes pa'i ming thogs zer/ kho tsho lam thag ring bo nas yong bas chas pa zer zhing / de nas bzung yul gyi ming la chas pa'i gshis zhes thogs zer/ mi ring bar g.yu lo — 363 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/lhun grub dang bstan skyong dbang bo/ bsod nams nor bu zer ba'i spun gsum gyis a myes dpal rgan mdun ——du bla rtse bstad de mchod bkur byas par/ g.yulosachosasnazhiga'abrasabazhinadanas795pa'icho4rgyudaskong chad par shog dang bstan skyong gis sta re rnon po zhig 'bul bzhin da nas dpa' rgyud mi chad par shog bsod nam sa kyis mchod kong mar gyis bkang ba zhig 'bul bzhin da nas phyug rgyud mi chad par shog ces dang rang rang gis smon lam btab/ de gsum las chas pa dang sta re kong mchod gsum gyi rus byung / zhes bkod pa dang / brag sgom pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung du'ang / de nas mi rgyud mang du 'phel bas chas pas sa 'dzin yul 'dzin/ chas phrug gnam gyi skar ma zhes pa'i gtam dpe byung / gong ma yung lo ste spyi lo1402dus su mkhas grub chen po byams pa dge 'dun dang / blo gros yangs pa gnyis dbus gtsang nas mar phebs te ka ru bzhi mdor(chas pa'i gshis stod rgyud kyi sa ming)dgon pa btab/ de nas mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan dang 'du' ba'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa'i phyag len tshugs/ gser dngul dung gsum gyi bka' 'gyur tshar gsum bzhugs/ chas pa bla rabs nyer gsum gyi bar 'phel rgyas byung zhing / bla rabs nyer bzhi ba bstan pa yar 'phel gyi dus su gnas spos bgyis/ phyis su chas pa'i gshis kyi stod rgyud du nyang tshang sku phreng gnyis pa nyang tshang bka' rgan nam bka' bcu mchog grub kyis rgyang chad ri khrod bkra shis bshad sgrub gling phyag 'debs mdzad cing / de nyang gdong zug bla rabs rim byon gyis 'dzin skyong byas pa dang /bka' 'gyur sogs gsung rabs mang po bzhugs pa1966lo'i rig gsar las 'gul bar du mchis/ da lta shul du 'du khang chen po zhig gsar du bzhengs te grub pa la rgyang chad sgar zer) rong khams zhabs drung chos rgya mtshos drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su bsngags pa nyin pa'i rgyal te'u mgo'i ri khrod bkra shis chos 'phel gling btab pa dang / der 'du khang dang byams khang bzhengs shing bka' 'gyur kyang bzhugs/ rjes su snang bzhugs dang rlangs bzhugs sku phreng rim pas bskyangs pa dang / rig gsar gyi skabs yongs su 'jigadaga' tshal sde bar sman pa shes rab dar rgyas kyis dbus nas grags pa bzang bo gdan 'dren zhus te btab pa'i dga' tshal ri khrod phun tshogs rab rgyas gling ngam bkra shis bsam gtan gling yod la/ phyis su de rtse dbus sku phreng rim pas bskyangs/ yul mdza' tshal chas pa blo bzang 'phrin las kyis ri khrod phun tshogs chos 'phel gling btab/ chas pa'i gshis kyi smad rgyud du kirti bstan pa rab rgyas kyis btab pa'i dgun pa'i ri khrod bkra shis phun tshogs gling dang khams ri khrod dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling / mgo tshang ri khrod dar rgyas chos 'phel gling / smar tshang ri khrod dga' ldan chos 'phel gling / mdo khog ri khrod phun tshogs dar rgyas gling / gzhan yang zho phug khri rgan gyis btab pa'i lung nag steng kha'i ri khrod thos bsam dar rgyas gling / bya 'og bka' bcu bas btab pa'i bya 'og ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gling / tā 'gag ri khrod bkra shis chos 'phel gling bcas de snga chas pa'i gshis su ri khrod bcu gnyis mchis/ rjes su bla ma dkar bo sku phreng dang bos dgun pa'i dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad de ri khrod de dag gcig gyur du bsdus shing rten gsum mang che ba — 364 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/bkra shis chos 'khor gling du gdan 'dren zhus/ shul du lus pa'i lha khang dang 'du khang / sku gsung thugs rten kun spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya nga brgyad lo dang rig gsar las 'gul gyi skabs su brlags so/ /dgon pa 'debs pa bo bla ma dkar bo sku phreng dang bo rje btsun byams pa mthu stobs kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing lug(1825)lor co ne chas pa'i gshis shing khams sde bar(zhing khams kyang 'bri)yab tshe dbang nor bu dang yum rnam 'joms 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung ste rgya bod hor gsum gyi yul gru mang bo zhabs kyis bcags nas sku tshe gang bor dge lugs pa'i dgon pa bzhi btab cing / ha sag rigs sogs mi rigs khag gis 'khrug zing gi sdug bsngal zhi 'jags su btang gshis shing glang(1865)lor chin srid gzhung gis ho thog thu'i mtshan byang bstsal/ me yos(1nga64)lor yu li'i(da lta'i zhin cang yu li)sa khul gyi dmag dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes te o go btsan rgyal ring lugs pas khong gis btab pa'i chos sde dang mi ser la gnod byas par rgol lan drag po mdzad pa dang / chu lug(1882)lor bod bal gnyis kyi kha mchu bsdums te zhi 'jugs su btang nas bod kyi chos srid la mdzad rjes mi dman pa bzhag pa la rgyal dbang dang paṇa chen nas gser dngul gyi tham ga dang cho lo mang du bstsal/mthar dgung lo re gcig par gdan sa rang nas sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa rje btsun skal bzang tshul khri ma sa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog rab byung bco lnga'i me sprel(1826)lor mtsho sngon gser khos/ tu sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas gdan sar bkod de rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs kyang dgung lo bcu bzhi tsam la sa zhal ma bzhugs par zhin cang yu li nas sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa rje btsun bskal bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan(dge 'dun bstan 'dzin nor bu)mchog rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags phag(1911)lor co ne gla lung khog nas sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus nas sku gong ma'i yang sprul du ngos bzung ste gdan sar bkod cing / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi thos bsam gling du zhugs te gzhung pota lnga sbyangs nas rang dgon bskyangs/ mthar dgung lo zhe gsum par sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta(1954)lor rngog rgyal mo'i 'dra spus sde bar yab bsam grub rgya mtsho dang yum lcags mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi steng sku gong ma'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad cing dgung lo brgyad kyi steng gdan sar bkod/ rig gsar gyi skabs su rang yul nas dmangs sgrub dge rgan dang ngal rtsol la zhugs/ mthar dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng sku gshegs so/ sku 'phreng lnga ba 'jigs med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa lug(1979)lor co ne chas pa'i gshis rgyang chad sde bar yab gcod pa skyabs dang yum mgon po skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo brgyadaṣ+ṭi༄blabrangabakya shima'༅sa4tulta / blamarabyabartanargya 4sku co ོba4 sdo /rdordo gi ri ji sdo /sgru 4 5 1 /tshobazung zhing kun mkhyen drug pas mtshan gsol/ chu bya(1922)lor sa dmar dgon bkra shis chos 'khor — 365 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/gling du pho shasnga bzhugs shi5 / lo de'i zla dgu bu'i tsheswa nyer gartigā la skyel bsu rgya che dang bcas tshes nyer gnyib yonacas lhabartse khe thetsho lakhu /sgo mi 4 ༄ tswagi lo 1stu nya josnya— bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs bzhugs gnang ngo / /de yang bkra shis chos 'khor gling 'di ji ltar phyag 'debs mdzad pa yin zhe na/ bla ma dkar bo sku phreng dang bo dgung lo nga gcig pa shing bya(1885)lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig la lha ldan nas rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho dang lhan du gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston mdzad cing / khong gis rang yul du dgon pa zhig 'debs 'dod pa dang / ri khrod dag gi rmang gzhi yod tshul zhus pas/ rgyal dbang mchog gi zhal nas sngon du yul der dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad grwa zhig btsugs na legs pa dang / rjes su rim pas grwa tshang gzhan dag btsugs na ri khrod rnams kyang 'dus 'ongs tshul lung bstan pa ma zad/ dus 'khor grwa tshang la bde chen chos gling zhes mtshan gsol/ da dung rgyal dbang mchog gis rten skal du kun gzigs lnga ba chen mo'i sku rab gnas brgya rtsa ma dang tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku rgya gar shar li ma gsum/ lnga ba chen po'i gsung 'bum/ lnga ba chen mo'i gzim chung gi rten khrod nas gnas bcu dang rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ chos skyong yongs kyi zhal thang lnga/ dga' ldan gser khri'i go bab dang mtshungs pa'i che rtags dang er ti ṇi paṇ+ḍi ta'i tham ga bka' shog dbu gdugs ser bo/ rta dar bcu gsum dang 'phel gdung /rin chen ril bu/ glang chen mche ba/ bse ru'i rwa/ glang chen gi wang sogs dngos skyes kyi rdzongs gtos gnang / yongs 'dzin byams pa/ (rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin) na bza' cha tshang dang nyid kyi gsung 'bum/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang bcu drug rdo ka ma ru'i thub sku gsung 'byon/ rten dam ril bu dang 'phel gdung bcas bstsal/ bod srid skyong rta tshag mchog gis nyid kyi sku phreng rim byon dang de mo sku phreng rim byon/ rwa sgreng sku 'phreng rim byon/ khri chen ngag dbang nor bu dang khri chen mkhyen rab dbang phyug bcas kyi na bza' gnang / paṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas tsan dan gyi tham ga bstsal/ tsha rdor rin po chen nas rje sku gsung 'byon ma dang thub pa tshul khrims ma/ dbang rim byon gyi thugs dam gyi rten gtso ta la'i lo ma'i ngos su lañca'i yi ges bris pa'i brgyad stong ba tshar gcig nyid kyi sku phreng rim pa'i na bza' bcas gnang / da dung 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang dang bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa/ sa skya dgon pa bcas nas rten skal mang du bstsal/ de nas khong gis rang yul du bzhugs pa'i khri chen sprul ba'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang gser bzang sprul ba'i sku gtsos ser skya kun la dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i ljags bkod slob ston gyi phyag yig phul/ phyag yig 'byor 'phral chas pa'i gshis ya 'gag ma 'gag sde ba nyi shu lhag) gi mi ser thams cad dga' bar gyur cing dgun 'ba' sde bas kyang dgon sa 'bul ba khas blangs/ ( dgun pa sde ba'i shul du dgon pa tshugs pas phyis su dgun pa'i dgon pa zhes 'bod) de nas kun gyis dgon pa gsar 'dzugs bgyi bar tshogs gnyis yongs su bsags te/ me khyi(1886)lor rgyal ba'i lung gis gzigs pa'i dus 'khor grwa tshang — 366 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bde chen chos gling gi 'du khang legs par grub/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas dus 'khor ba zho phung bstan 'phel dge rgan du gdan drangs te dus 'khor brgyud 'debs 'jam dpal dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'don rta khrid/ khri chen sprul pa'i skus dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / gser bzang sprul ba'i sku dus 'khor khri ba'i 'gan bzhes shing tshogs chen zhal ngo dang dbu mdzad/ dge bskos bcas bskos/ zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lngar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dus chen gyi srol btod/ bla ma dkar po khong nyid kyang lha sa nas pe cin du phebs te gong ma kwang zhus mchog gi rgyal yum dgung lo drug cu'i dga' ston du chas pa'i gshis su 'bas brtan 'dzugs bzhin pa'i gnas tshul snyan zhu phul/ gong ma thugs dgyes te rgyal yum dang gong ma dgung lo khri phrag bzhugs pa'i mtshan byang dang dgon pa la gser gyi dgon pa'am dgon ser zhes pa'i mtshan byang dang /gser yig dngul srang lnga stong bcas bstsal te gong ma'i zhabs brtan dgon par bkur/ sa glang(1rdo89)lor chas pa'i gshis stod smad bar gsum gyi ri khrod bcu gnyis kyi rten gsum mang che ba bkra shis chos 'khor gling du gdan drangs shing / grwa btsun rnams gcig tu bsdus te gsar du grub ma thag pa'i dus 'khor grwa tshang bde chen chos gling gi 'du khang du hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad nyin nas cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo 'tshogs/lcags stag(1820)lor mtshan nyin grwa tshang dang sman pa grwa tshang rgyud pa grwa tshang bcas gsar du tshugs te grwa ba rnams la khang sa dang grwa tshang so sor sa bgos shing ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel gling phyag 'debs mdzad par sa dpyad dang gnas gzigs gnang / phyi lor ri khrod 'du khang legs par grwab cing / ri khrod pa nyi shu lhag mchis so/ /chu sbrul(1822)lor mtshan nyid dang sman pa/ rgyud pa gsum gyi 'du khang legs par grub/dgon pa spyi'i sa khyon mu'u brgya lhag tu rgya bskyed par gyur/ dgon pa 'di nyid gong ma'i zhabs brtan dgon pa yin pas chin srid gzhung gis dgon pa dar rgyas dang grwa ba'i 'tsho bar rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen du srid gzhung gis lo rer tho'u ju(da lta'i bā tse rdzong)nas 'bru rigs bre stong lnga 'bul bar thag bcad de/ krung hwa min go'i lo drug pa(1917)bar du 'bru khral phul/ chas pa'i gshis ni snga nas bzung co ne yongs 'dus rgyal khab kyi khongs su gtogs shing mi sde'i dpon mgo co ne dpon po yin la/ chos mgo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la gtad pas/ bla brang dgon pa nas tshogs chen khri ba dang mtshan nyid dge rgan mngags srol yod/srung ma gtso bo gnas chung 'phrin las rgyal bo bkur zhing / bca' yig bla brang dgon pa'i bca' yig ltar yin zhes bla ma dkar bo'i rnam thar du gsungs so/ /shing glang(1925)lor sgo mang sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho tshogs chen khrir bzhugs pa ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas bskos pa'i bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi khri rabs dang bo yin/ de'i rjes su bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho(paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i yongs 'dzin) dang / mkhan rin po che skal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ snyan grags tshang / cung gar rjo /ga nga /// sgo ༄ lha /rdza shārti/ rdo shuste/lge dar rgyas sogs thugs rgyud phyug pa'i dam pa du ma phyag phebs nas khri rabs nyi shu yan man song / gung thang — 367 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/ bla snyan ni stsa gis nga dgo 'dī nastsa ngus 'khyorā da ༅ ṣ+ṭha 4 che gnang co / ༅ / ji 0 —ོ —ོ༅ shā stobang4swā ༷ sgo ba snarngos sdos brdo spyo — dbyi ba bgalha /banyi'i/smo rwa'adu khang ka ba sum brgya dang drug can/ sman pa'i 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu gya bzhi can dang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu gya drug can/ ri khrod 'du khang ka ba nyi shu can rnams dang / phyi stong sku dang nang stong sku las bzhengs pa'i jo'i khang chen mo/ sgrol ma'i lha khang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / tshe dpag med kyi lha khang / phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi lha khang / mchod rten chen po'i lha khang / chos ra khag lnga/ grwa tshang re re'i rung khang / bla ma dkar po dang / bla ma rab brtan rgya mtsho gtsos pa dang / sgo mang tshang seng bzang(rgyal lung ba)tshang / snang bzhugs tshang / mgar dge tshang / bya 'og tshang / bla kho rin po che'i nang chen dang bde yangs gzim chung bsdoms pas nyer lnga lham mer bzhengs/ de dag la gser tog dang rgyal mtshan/ri dwags chos 'khor/ gañjir/ spen rgyan sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan/ khyad par du chos sde 'di'i jo'i khang chen mo ni/ rab rgyal ñca gas lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas bla kho rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog gdan 'dren zhus te bum gter spos shing lho 'phye'i thig btab jo khang phyi so phag gi rtsig ngos su ston pa shākya'i sku brnyan 'bur grub stong tshar mang po lañja'i nang jo sku gtsos pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad stong sku li ma bzhugs pa bzhengs pa ste phyi nang sku stong tshar du ma can bod yul mdo dbus khams gsum ga'an du med pa ha cang brjid ldan bkod legs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig yin te yul mis dgun pa'i jo bo zer ro/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten gtso ste sku'i rten la/ jo'i khang chen mor lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku byin can dang sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi stong sku li ma dang / tshogs chen 'du khang du rje sle'u chung ma dbu skra skyes pa dang rdo ka ma ru'i thub sku/ sgrol dkar gsung 'byon ma/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku gsung 'byon pa dang rang byon can/ gser bzhengs rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku brnyan/ ston pa'i sku rgya gar shar li ma bcas dang / dus 'khor 'du khang du gser zangs las grub pa'i rje sku chen po/thub sku gsung 'byon ma/ thub sku thog thub ma/ rje nga 'dra ma/ rje tshong dpon dge legs ma/ rdo dmar gyi sgrol ma rang byon bcas dang / sman pa'i 'du khang du gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ rta mgrin gyi sku byin can dang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang du pe cin nas gdan drangs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i tsan dan jo bo dang / sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i rje stong sku/ bla ma dkar bo'i bde yangs lha khang du lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i jo bo mi skyod rdo rje mi tshad can bcas bzhugs/ ga'an yang sgrol ma'i lha khang dang thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / phyag rdor 'khor chen lha khang dang ri khrod lha khang /mchod rten lha khang / sogs su gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan dang gsung 'byon pa dang rang byon gyi sku'i rten shin tu mang ngo / /gsung gi rten la/ co ne'i bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang / tse de'i bstan 'gyur tshar gsum/ rgyal dbang pan chen sku 'phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum dang / kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon gyi — 368 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsung 'bum/ bla kho rin po che'i gsung 'bum bka' rgya ma pota drug bcas bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la/bla ma dkar po sku phreng dang bo'i gser sdong chen mo dngul srang sum stong nyis brgya lhag las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rten dang / sku phreng gsum pa'i gser sdong chen mo/ bla ma rab brtan rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten/lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i lha sa'i jo bo'i dbu rgyan/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi snam sbyar/ nā ro'i rus rgyan/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi sku sha rje rin che'i tshems kyi cha shas/ ma khro ma zla ba bzang bo'i thod rus/gnas chung gi 'theb rwa/ shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung sogs srid na dkon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyis dgon pa byur bur gtams so/ /grwa tshang so so'i 'chad nyan gyi bya ba ni mtshan nyid grwa tshang gis gtso bor sde snod gsum gyis bsdus pa'i mdo phyogs bka' pota lnga'i 'chad nyan la brtson pa dang / dus 'khor grwa tshang gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang rnam snang mngon byang / kun rig bdag 'jug sgra snyan ngag sogs thun mong gi rig gnas sbyong ba dang /sman pa grwa tshang gis sangs rgyas sman bla dang mi 'khrugs pa'i bdag 'jug gso rig rgyud bzhi'i phyag len man ngag bcas nyams su bstar/ rgyud pa grwa tshang gis gtso bor bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug dang 'cham chen/ lcags mkhar/ gtor sgrub/ bzlog chen sogs gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed par brtson/ grwa tshang rnam bzhi'i 'don rta dbyangs dang sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa thams cad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang mtshungs/ de ba'in du lo 'khor gcig gi chos thog dang chos spyod gtso bo ni/ hor zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo tshogs pa ste gos sku dang / bkra shis lhun po'i phyag len gtsang 'cham bka' rgya ma ste dgun pa'i 'cham chen zhes grags che/ grwa tshang so so'i me tog mchod pa/ byams pa gling skor bcas dang / zla gnyis pa'i dpyid chos chen mo dang / zla gsum pa'i dus 'khor gar 'cham/ zla bzhi ba'i nang rgyud pa'i rdul tshon dang bdag 'jug zla lnga ba'i ma ṇi ril sgrub dang / zla drug pa'i dbyar gnas/ zla bdun pa'i shwa 'cham dang / zla brgyad pa'i rgyugs chen dang / zla dgu ba'i ston chos chen mo/ zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod chen mo dang / zla bcu gcig pa'i dgun chos/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i bgegs gtor bcas dang /gzhan skabs su gang bab kyi bla ma so so'i gdung mchod sogs mang ngo / /dgon pa'i las sne la tshogs chen khri ba gtsos tshogs chen zhal ngo dang / tshogs chen dge bskos/tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang dus 'khor dbu mdzad/ sman pa dang rgyud pa la'ang khri ba dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ grwa tshang so sor spyi ba dang gnyer ba sogs bsko bar bya/ de min grwa tshang so sor ka ri bzhin mdo dang chu dkar lung ba'i nye 'khor du nags tshal gyi gzhi khyon chen po dang / bla ma ༷༷༷༷4༷༵byeX/laX/༷༵ ༷༷༷༷༷༷kho/ /borte shago— 369 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs /nyis brgya sum cu lhag la 'phel rgyas byung mod kyang rab tshes sa khyi(12 5ra)dang me rta(1466)lor yongs su 'jig tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun te rab rgyal lcags sprel lor(198 0) slar gso byed chog pa'i chog mchan gnang ba dang / lcags bya(12rnga1)lor dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang tshugs/ da skabs jo'i khang chen mo dang dus 'khor 'du khang / sman pa dang rgyud pa'i 'du khang / mtshan nyid chos ra dang / bya 'og sprul sku'i mchod rten chen mo/ bla ma dkar po dang bla ma rab brtan rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi ba/ sang sang sprul sku dang bya 'og sprul sku brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bcas kyi nang tshan dang bde yangs lha khang bskyar du bzhengs shing / grwa shag brgya dang nyi shu tsam phub par grwa ba bzhi brgya yan man gyis chos 'chad nyan la brtson bzhin mchis/ dgon pas sna 'dzoms tshong khang gcig dang /bod sman khang gcig btsugs pa dang / rlangs 'khor gsum nyos te tshong gnyer pas mi tshogs kyi khur po je yang dang dgon pa'i yong sgo je mang du 'gro bzhin no/ /bde thang dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /bde thang dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling ngam dga' ldan bsam grub gling (bde thang mkhan po'i dgon)zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi brag go lung (bde thang ma ru zhang nub) zhang du chags/chos sde 'di'i thog ma ni ha lam bod rab byung bdun pa'i me yos te spyi lo1 287lo tsam du bod dbus nas mkhas grub chen po byams pa dge 'dun dang blo gros yangs pa zhes pa gnyi ga phyir rang yul du phebs shing /spyi lo1426lo tsam la chas pa'i gshis ka ru bzhi mdo zhes pa'i 'brog sar dgon pa zhig btab/ mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan dang 'dul ba'i bslab khrims kyi phyag len btsugs shing gser dngul dung gsum las bka' 'gyur tshar gsum dang gsung rab sogs lo lnga'i ring rdzogs par bzhengs/ de nas bla rabs nyer gsum bar 'phel rgyas byung mod kyang rkyen dbang gis thor gshis dgon pa g.yis sgar ri bo cher spor skad/ rab nyi'i chu lug spyi lo170 2lor khri thog nyer bzhi ba bstan pa yar 'phel dang bde thang mkhan po blo bzang tshangs dbyangs pas co ne'i sa skyong sku mched rnams bsten te bde thang ri bo cher dgon pa 'di dngos su btab/ de bzhin bde thang rang dang / sgo mang / dar dge/ gdong nag dbon po chos rje ste bla khag lnga byung ba dang rang dgon du grwa tshogs mang bo 'phel ba la rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan btsugs pa legs/ bde thang sku thog dang po ni bsod nams bkra shis zhes bya ba bde thang ya ru'i 'brug rgyal gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dga' ldan khri rabs14ba rin po che rin chen 'od zer gyi skyes par grags/ dbus su slob gnyer mdzad de dka' bcu ba'i mtshan btags thob zer/ spyi lo1641lor sku gshegs/ khong la byang phyogs 'dul bya'i pad tshal kha 'byed ces pa sogs gsung rtsom mchis/ yang srid du gtsos kha yangs gong ma nas khyung bo u tsa'i rigs su rab byung — 370 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bcu gcig pa'i sa phag ste spyi lo165khalor sku 'khrungs pa bde thang blo bzang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khong nges shing / dgung lo bdun par gdan sar 'khod cing blo bzang tshul khrims las rab tu byung ba tshul khrims rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ bcu dgu ba la dbus su 'bras sgo mang gi chos grwar bzhugs te dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho ba bsten mdo sngags rab 'byams sbyangs mthar gsang phu bka' bcu'i grwa skor mdzad/ nyer gsum pa la rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyud stod chos grwar dpon slob 'bo ra ba blo bzang chos 'phel bsten nas gsang sngags sbyangs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes mjal te chos 'brel zhus/chu khyi la rang yul du phebs nas rgyal dbang paṇa chen zung dang blon po rdo rje grags pa sogs kyi bka' lung bzhin rang yul 'khor lo'i steng zhes par dgon sde 'di btab nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing grwa shag bcu phrag byung / chu sprel(16kha2)lor sog por phebs tshe ri bo dge 'phel mkhan chen blo bzang rin chen pa mkhar sngon(da lta'i grong khyer ha'o he ha'o themadu bzhugs pas khong dang tho yon bla ma bcas kyi bdag rkyen las ho sho o cen gnyis bla mar bkur/ ba so rje drung dang lcang skya rin po che rnam gnyis kyi drung nas dbang bka' chos mang du gsan/ rje nyid kyi bka' bzhin tho yon bla mas dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gsar du btab pa dang cha gan de yang ci'i dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gi bla ma mdzad/ lhag par sbrul lor sku 'bum brgyud de dbus su phebs nas rgyal dbang drug/ pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshor skyes 'bul dang dgon sde khag la gser dngul mu tig sogs kyi 'gyed phul/ rgyal dbang mchog gi rgyal gyi mkhan po mnga' gsol pa dang sde srid chen pos dbyangs can rol pa'i rdo rjer bsngags/ chu lug la rang yul du byon nas co ne sa skyong sku mched blo bzang don grub dang mchod yon bgyis te ri bo cher dgon pa btab/ lung ba yas mas kyi bon sde khag lnga dge lugs su bsgyur/da dung 'di bas a 'khor brag dkar byang chub gling dang klu chung(dar dge dgon)dga' ldan phun tshogs gling btab/ yang paṇa chen rin po cher 'khrungs rabs bka' rtsom zhus nas bkris lhun gyi tshogs 'don du btsugs/ dpon ju nang gis gdan 'dren zhus pa las mtsho sngon arger phebs/ lcags stag mkhar sngon du phebs nas der rgyun bzhugs gnang zhing snga phyir bka' chos rgya che ba bstsal/ rang dgon du byams khang(nang phyogs bzhir lha khang byas pa ra sa 'phrul snang gi tshul btod)gyo tog can gsar bzheng du rgyu dngos phon che bas rten dang brten pa bzhengs/ khong la ljags rtsom mkhan chen sprul ba'i sku tshangs sras sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dang / snyan ngag gi bstan bcos ka la paṅka'i sgra dbyangs/ sum rtags kyi rnam bshad/ mtshams sbyor lnga ba'i 'grel ba/ bstan rtsis gsal ba'i sgron me/ skar rtsis kyi bstan bcos be+estur+ya gsal ba'i do shal/spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang gi rnam bshad/ bde thang dgon pa'i dkar chag la sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' re snang /sa khyi spyi lo1718zla6tshes11nyin gshegs/ bla sprul nyid la bla rgyud dgra bcom pa 'od srung / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ byang chub rin chen/ sangs rgyas gling ba/ rong ba sher seng / blo gros chos skyong / legs pa chos 'byor/ rin chen 'od zer/ bsod nams bkra shis bcas — 371 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/las byon par gsungs/ zhal chems bzhin du dngul srang stong dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu/ gos yug brgyad/dar yug nyis brgyas bstan 'gyur dkar chag dang bcas pa co ne'i nang sos bzhengs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang chu bzang ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis ma/dzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang rtogs brjod seṅge'i sgra dbyangs bya ba mkhar mo che ba blo bzang yon tan gyis bsgrigs pa yod do/ /de'i yang srid 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog nyi ma ni ne'u mgo nas sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen bar ma 'jigs med dbang bo'i dngos slob/ mkhan po btsan po ma zer/ dbus su phebs te ser smad du 'phrin las rgyas pas phyag rdzas 'bor chen 'byor/ lcags 'brug(1760)la rang dgon du sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gdan drangs pa dang 'du khang sogs gtsug lag khang du ma gsar du bzhengs/ 'cham chen btsugs/ khong slar smad du phebs pa na ser wang dang dar han lbang ho shod dang bcas pas bla mar bkur/ spyi lo178 2lo'i zla12tshes2 2nyin rang dgon du sku gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs phyogs las rnam rgyal bde thang ya ru sde ba'i yab tshul khrims dang yum g.yung drung 'tsho'i sras su sa bya(spyi lo1789)lor sku 'khrungs/ ma/khar mo che blo bzang yon tan(dag yig ngag sgron 'grel ba brtsams/ dme shul thang sar du par brkos)sogs dge rgan bsten nas 'don cha dang rig gnas sbyangs pas ring bo ma thogs par mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol/rgyud grwa (radzugs pa'i lung bstan/ khong nyid grwa sar bzhugs 'dun che na'ang mi rtsa'i dbang gis sog por phebs shing phyir 'khor 'phral dgung lo nyi shu ba sa 'brug18 08lo'i zla12ba'i tshes2 2nyin sku gshegs/khong gi dge rgan ma khar mo che ba yon tan rgya mtshos khong la brtsams pa'i rnam thar bskal bzang yid 'phrog ces pa zhig yod do/ /sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma stag pa lung gi yab dka' thub thar dang yum yum 'tsho'i sras su lcags rtar(spyi lo1〈10)sku 'khrungs/ 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i sgron mes sku gong ma'i yang srid du thugs thag bcad cing rab tu byung / khong gi thugs mos bzhin bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad/ skyabs mchog blo bzang bstan pa'i 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing rje bradza'i zhabs la gtugs/ rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs/ a mchog tshogs chen dang urge'i bla ma mdzad/ rang dgon du shing 'brug(18 44)lor smad rgyud ltar rgyud grwa btsugs/ kun mkhyen gyis gnang ba'i rno lcags rdo rje rtse lnga ba de dam can gyi thugs gar bzhugs/ me lug la ja rong phyogs su chibs bsgyur nas bka' chos mang du bstsal/ sa bya(1849)lo'i zla 2tshes2〈nyin sku gshegs so/ /de'i yang srid drug pa slar sku gong ma'i rang khyim du 'khrungs pa'i 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtshos bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer mdzad/ dmu dge dgon dang urge dgon sogs dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i khri ba re lnga bar bzhugs/spyi lo1894lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes1la sku gshegs/ rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug pas mdzad pa'i bde thang mkhan sprul rnam thar dad pa'i chu gter 'phel ba'i zla shel zhes bya ba mchis so/ /sku rabs bdun pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ rab byung bco lnga'i shing lug(1895)lo'i zla gcig pa'i nang da lta'i bsang chu rdzong — 372 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gi bsang khog nas yab mgon po don grub dang yum o rgyan 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer mthar phyin cing nyi shu bar a bh+ya kurma las bsnyen par rdzogs/ chas bu gshis dang bla brang smad rgyud kyi khrir bzhugs shing lo rer 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi khri lan gsum re gnang / khong la rnam thar rgyas pa si gha'i mtshan can gyi bris pa rtogs brjod yod/ 1958lo'i zla10tshes5la lan kru'u btson ra nas sku gshegs/19〈0lor mgo log a khu dang bde thang zhabs drung rnam gnyi gas rang yul la gdan drangs te zhabs drung bde yangs su bzhugs so/ /sku phreng brgyad pa blo bzang don grub rgya mtsho zhes pa co ne'i brag go lung zhang gi brag ga lung yab bkra shis don grub dang yum o rgyan 'tsho'i sras su1979lor sku 'khrungs/ 1992lor kun mkhyen drug pas ngos bzung zhing gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la bde thang zhabs drung gtsos skya ser thun mong gis gdan sar bkod/ rdo rams pa co ne'i bstan pa dge rgan bsten nas bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer byed sgang 2 0 0 0lor glo bur du sku 'das so/ /gzhan ya ru sde grong nas ser smad mkhan po blo bzang rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba sku 'khrungs/ dgon 'dir skye rgyud kyang snang ngo / /dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa 'gangs chen gyi skor la/ bde thang khri ba blo bzang rgya mtsho'i ring khong dang bcas pas 'du khang gyo tog can ngo mtshar dang stag pa lung ba'i dam can btsan khang / ston chos khang /rung khang tshoms chen/ rta mgrin lha khang / nang chen thog khang gyo tog lcags ri ldan pa sogs legs bzhengs grub/ byams khang du byams chen gtso 'khor/ lha'i bzo bo bi shwa kurma'i phyag bzos thub dbang gsung 'byon ma dang de'i dkar chag ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa/ tsan dan dkar po'i byams sku/ gnas brtan brag ri ma gtso 'khor/ li thang dang co ne'i bka' 'gyur tshar re/ mdo 'dus brgyad brgya pa laji can/ 'od dpag med lha khang bzhengs pa/ hor sprul skus dkar chag bsgrigs pa'i khri ba btsan po mas bzhengs pa'i jo bo/ 'jam thag las bzhengs pa'i mi 'khrugs 'bum sku/ maṇ+ḍal sogs gser nag las grub pa du ma/bstan 'gyur bris ma/ chos 'khor lha khang du ba so chos rje'i khri rgyab yol dang / gser bzhengs byang chub mchod rten/ ba so 'khrungs rabs gyan thang / 'jigs byed thang ga rgyal dbang lnga ba'i phyag nas ma/ rje tsong kha ba'i shangs mtshal las bzhengs pa'i lha mo/ mgon chos lnga/ lha mo bdun/ sgrol ljang glang dar khrims phog ma/ bla ma zhing 'dra sku me thub ma/ rdo nag seng gdong ma rang byon/ sde gzhung rten gras gu drag byin can/ mkhas grub khyung bo'i thugs dam gyi khyung rang byon/ rje'i phyag tsha a tham ma/ 'bras spungs chos 'khor gling ba mergan dga' bcu mkhar sngon dpon mo'i ti shī(dbu bla)mdzad skabs rgyal dbang lnga ba'i lung bstan ltar bzhengs pa'i gser nag mchod rten sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung bcu gsum snying bo can/gong ma khang 'i'i gsol dkar/ rgya gar srung brgya dga' gdong chos skyong gi sku chas dkar po dpal lha'i mda' dar/ sku 'bum chos skyong gi phyag mdung rgyal mtshan ma/ 'du khang du rje gzigs pa lnga ldan dang bshags lha so lnga/ mkhan po tshangs dbyangs rim byon sku gdung mchod rten dang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ spyan — 373 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / lam rim bla rgyud/ rje tshong dpon dge legs ma// klu dbang rgyal bo/zhwa lu mkhan po blo bzang mkhas mchog gi gser gdung / rje shes rab saṅge'i sman sku/ bde thang ba'i 'khrungs rabs/ phyag dpe mang po/ bde gshegs brgyad ga'i mchod rten/ dngul gyi byang chub ma chod rten/gsang 'jigs kun gsum gyi blos bslangs gser ba'engs/ gos sku che chung gsum bcas/ rta ma grin lha khang(bde thang bdun pas bzhengs)du rta mgrin 'khor chen dang bka' 'gyur rgya nag ma/ seṅge'i gri sogs dang /spyi khang rung khang du tshogs slang che chung dang ja bra thug ze'u la sogs brjod kyis mi long ngo/ /dgon pas se ra smad rgyud kyi phyag srol ltar chos spyod gal chen spel ba la/ zla dang bor bod yul dge lugs pa spyi srol gyi smon lam chen mo dang / gos sku/ byams skor lha 'cham gtor rgyag zla gnyis par dbyar tshogs gsang 'dus bdag 'jug rgyud gzhung / gtor chen/ zla gsum par rgyud gzhung dang bde mchog bdag 'jug sa chog zla lnga bzhi bar dbyar tshogs dbyangs bcags/ thig 'debs/ gsang 'dus bdag 'jug zla lnga bar ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin bcu/ zla drug par bla ma'i gdung mchod/ dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par 'jigs byed bdag 'jug sa chog sbyin sreg mgon chos/ klu chog gtor chen/zla dgu bar smyung gnas/ zla bcu bar lha mo'i dbyangs bcags dang gtor sgrub/ 'cham gtor rgyag zla bcu gcig par lha mo'i bzlog pa/ zla bcu gnyis la bla ma rnam pa'i gdung mchod dang dgu gtor la sogs spel to/ /1958lo ste rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon dgon pa rang dang stag tshang dgon pa bcas pa'i bde thang khog tu bde thang mkhan po dang / bde thang zhabs drung / stag tshang dpon slob/ sum pa rdo rje 'chang / rtse dbus 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ nyin bzhugs/ ri la sprul sku/ he ru kha bh+ya phun tshogs bcas bla khag brgyad mchis pa dang / dgon nyid du grwa shag bzhi bcu tsam la dge 'dun pa zhal brgyad bcu bzhugs/ klu dbang rgyal bo srung mar bsten/ las sne la bla ma/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ dkor gnyer sogs bskos/ dgon sa mu'u bcu drug longs/ sbyin bdag sde grong la klu mdo/ dbang chen/ ya ru/ ma ru/bde thang srib/ mgon thang / r+pā de'u/ blo ru tshal/ stag pa lung dang / ga'an sder kha nang(bsang chu rdzong gtogs)sum pa/ sgang bya/ mkhar mo che/ nor bu nang bcas/ dgon par gzhu ru khog dang ma ru'i ra 'dus nang sogs su nags tshal mu'u rgya khyon bzhi stong sum rgya lhag dang shing skam sde ba'i nags skal yod/spyi rdzas dngul sgor khri phrag 'bru rigs sogs kyis phyug par gyur to/ /spyi lo198 2lor chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan rdzong srid gzhung gis gnang zhing phyi lor dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re smon dang bde thang mkhan po sku phreng bdun pa dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i(khong ka ju'i la'o kyā tun nas sku 'khrungs)nan zhus bzhin paṇa chen bcu ba dgon par phebs nas skya ser stong bdun tsam la mjal kha dang skyabs 'gro sogs kyi lung gnang / de nas da bar 'du khang dang mgon khang / spyi khang / rung khang — 371 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsar bzhengs grub/ grwa shag nyi shu rtsa grangs der btsun pa zhal bzhi bcu lhag 'dus nas chos spyod ci 'dzoms rgyun ldan du spel ba'i skabs so/ /stag tshang dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs gling /klu chung stag tshang dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho'i co ne rdzong brag go lung zhang gi khongs su chags/sngon bon dar skabs rlangs zhig rgyas pa blo gros dang / snang zhig dbang gi rgyal po('di rnga ba'i bon dgon sgang leb kyi snang zhig rtogs ldan pa las mched pa mdo smad chos 'byung du bshad)rtse 'ig stong nyid ye shes('di rgan bya'i rtse dbu dgon 'debs po stong nyid zhwa ser ba yin pa 'dra)/ khro gshen sprul sku rgyal mtshan bcas kyi spyi dgon gyi skabs/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa mchod yon gyi bkas(dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i smad)grwa chen rnams kyis bon bsgyur skabs gong smras bon rnams rtsod 'dun gyis 'ongs/ tā dbon pos byams smon dang bzang spyod kyi lung gnang ba'i gsung bshad kyis spobs pa zhum ste/ ban de byed par khas blangs/dgon pa rang rang gi grwa khang rnams phul/ tā dbon pas thub sku glang dar khrims phog ma rten skal du gnang ba da lta rtse dbus ri khrod(rtse dbus grags pa bzang bos btab pa dge 'phel bsam gtan gling ngam bde chen bsam gtan gling) du bzhugs pa de yin nam snyam zhes mdo smad chos 'byung du gsungs/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa 'brug(1688)lor co ne dpon po blo bzang don grub dang / bde thang mkhan po blo bzang tshangs dbyangs pa gnyis kyis dge lugs su bsgyur te mtshan dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes btags/ chas pa klu chung dgon yang zer/ rgyud stod grwa tshang btsugs par bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dang / tshogs chen btsugs par sman bla kun rig sogs tshogs 'don dang / lam rim dang / gzhan sman rtsis sogs rig gnas srol tshugs/ srung ma thub dbang rgyal bo zhes pa bsten/ rang byung bcu bzhi ba shing sbrul(1〈45)lor dgon gnas da lta'i gnas 'dir spos pa nas chas pa stag tshang dgon zhes ming chags/ sman bla gsung byon dang / byams pa skor 'byor/ byams sku khru bcu drug longs pa'i rten byin ldan sogs 'bag thang mi nyung ba bzhugs/ gsung gi skor la/ co ne'i bka' 'gyur tshar bzhi dang / co ne'i bstan 'gyur tshar gsum/yum 'bum pa gser snag gis bzhengs pa tshar gnyis dang gsung 'bum kha shas/ lo rer dus bzhir chos thogasmon lam/ gtor sgrub/ lcags mkhar/ lnga mchod bcas bsdoms nyin don dgu la rgyun bstar chos spyod kyi bya ba tshugs shing lo sar 'cham chen dang / sha 'cham dar/ rgyud grwar rgyud pa'i bla ma dang / khri ba/dge bskos/ dbu mdzad bcas bzhi dang / tshogs chen la khri ba/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ 'grig bdag bcas bzhi yis so sor grwa tshang gi las ka kun yal bar mi 'dor ba byed/ dgon du 'du khang byams khang nyis thog gyo tog can dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang sum thog gyo tog can/ da dung thub dbang rgyal — 375 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi wongs/bo'i btsan khang dang / snang 'ig ri la/ phun tshogs/ gur yag brag sgom pa/ 'bas drung bla ma thub bstan/ dkon ma/chog seje bcas kyi nang chen nam gzim shag brgyab/ rtse 'ig ni dgon nyid kyi sku drin che ba'i bla ma yin kyang nang chen med/ bla ma stag tshang ba'i nang chen stag tshang ri khrod du ba'engs / grwa shag bdun cu lhag phub par dge 'dun pa 'al dgu bcu rtsa grangs bzhugs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gshen tsha sgang gshis dam ga ru dang bcas pa'i sde ba chung chung nyer drug yod/ dgon pa'i spyi gzhung du klu chung pa na 'dzi lung ba dang klu chung stag mgo kha'o lung che chung bcas su nags tshal rgya chen po yod 'a / sa 'ing ya nga mu'u brgya lhag 'debs(grwa ba sger la bgos nas gnyer)pa dang / shing cha mang bo btsongs pa'i rin gyis lha khang sogs shin tu spus legs mdzes mtshar can bzhengs pa ma zad/ dgon pas ka ju'i ha'e dmag dang men ju'i rgya la nags btsongs pas spyi rdzas dngul sgor 'bum phrag du ma ma chis pas rab rgyal dus dgon pa 'jig kha co ne khongs kyi chos sde chung shas gas kyi ches phyug por gyur to/ /dgon pa ni1958lo nas1kha66lo'i bar chab srid las 'gul nang yongs su bsnubs gshis / rten 'gangs chen lus pa shin tu nyung / 19rnga 2chu khyi lor dgon pa slar gso ba'i chog mchan thob pa nas / bla ma snang zhig mchog dang bla ma phun tshogs skyes sprul gtsos pas mang tshogs kyi dad shugs la brten nas bskyar du tshogs chen 'du khang dang nang rten bzhengs grub cing / grwa shag lnga bcu lhag phub par btsun pa dgu bcu lhag zhal 'dzoms/ rang gso 'tsho rten sa zhing mu'u bcu phrag gnang ba gnyer bzhin chos spyod ci yod dar spel byed sgang ngo / /stag tshang ri khrod byang chub gling /stag tshang ri khrod byang chub gling ngam bkra shis chos gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho 'i co ne rdzong brag go lung(bde thang ma ru'i nub) zhang gi khongs su chags/ri khrod 'di ni dpon slob blo bzang rab brtan zhes bya bas phyag 'debs mdzad/ khong nyid sbra rigs kyi mes po kun bzang bod dbus nas mched/ thog mar shar tsong kha brgyud de phyogs 'dir 'ongs pa'i rgyud pa la gshen tsha(co ne gshen tsha sgang gshis dmag ru'i khongs gtogs)/ bde thang / thon chen zhes khyim mi stong tsam yod pa'i nang tshan las dge thang(da lta yul skad du 'gan thang zer)du rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug ste spyi lo1676lor yab dbang rgyal skyabs dang yum rta mgrin 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum steng bde thang sprul sku blo bzang rnam rgyal las rab tu byung / bcu dgu ba la 'bras sgo mang chos grwas dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho dang dpon slob kun dga' 'od zer ba bsten cing rgyal dbang drug par(168 2—170 5)rje'i lam rim chen mo'i lung zhus/ dge 'phel ri khrod nas lam rim bshad khrid gsan/khams tshan spyi khang gsar skrun gyi las dpon bzhugs/ chu rta la paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes las bsnyen par — 376 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rdzogs / snyi thang dang skyor mo lung / pha dam pa'i sgrub phug sogs su gnas 'brel gnang / shing sprel la rang yul du byon/ shing kun tu (da lta 'i lin tha'o khongs) zla du mar bka' 'gyur bklags/ chu 'brug lo171 2'a khu bos par+ṇa chen la zhus pa ltar ri khrod nyid btab/ don dngos su shin tu snga ba'i rnying ma'am bon po'i gnas shig yin par grags / de dus bkra shis gso sbyo nga / sa brtas bslangs/ lto 'phye brtags ma thar ga'i gsu ma phyag len dang gsal bde'i cho ga btsugs/ sku gsung thugs rten du ma ba'engs/ khrid dari gas so gas 'dzin skyong bya rgyu dang rgyugs len sogs thabs mkhas kyis lo sum cu lhag bskyangs pas sgrub sde khyad par can byung / dbus su mchod thebs ci lcogs snga phyir phul/ shing 'brug 'o ra rgyal dbang bdun pa ma tsho sngon du phebs par chos 'brel zhus pa dang me sprel lor( 1716)kun mkhyen co ner phebs pa dang ma jal/co re'i sa skyong gis lcags byi 'o ra bla ma ra bkur/ khong gis dka' chen blo bsta na dang rnga rgod nam seng /dka' chen blo rab/ gong dge dpon slob sogs la chos bka' rgya cher bstsal/ khong la rang rnam sogs gsung pota 'o ngas bzhugs/ dgung lo bdun cu ba shing glang ste spyi lo1745lor sku gshegs so/ /de rjes re 'ig chos mdzad 'jam dbyangs nor bus gdan sa bskyangs/ 'di bas dge thang ba ngag dbang 'jam dpa' grags pa bla tshab tu blus/ ma khar mo che ba blo bzang yon tan bsten nas rig gnas sbya ngas shing dpon slob kyi rnam thar kha skong rtsom mkhan sku skye wan+t+ra kirti 'es pa 'di ba yin/ de rjes blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma 'es gdan sar bkod/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs las dge tshul bsgrubs/ de'i sprul sku la dkon ma chog blo bzang rab brtan zer/ khong rab rgyal sa khyi 'o ra ma nyes kha g.yog ngang btson du thebs pas spyi lo196 2'o ra gan lho'i bā tse'u btson gnas su snyung ljid pas sku gshegs so / /sa khyi'i yar sngon du sta ga tshang dgon dga' lda na phun tshogs gling dar 'ing rgyas pas ri khrod du stag tshang bla ma 'i nang chen bde ya ngas sbrags ma dang grwa shag gsu ma bzhi la sa ga'an med par nyams su bcug de phyin lha ga 'dro da rig gas ra las 'gul nang 'jig da snga ri grod slar gso ba'i bskal ba ma ldan no/ /rtse dbus ri khrod dge 'apel bsam/ gtan gling /rtse dbus ri grod dge 'phel bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong brag go 'u nga (de thang ma ru'i nub) 'ang gi khongs su chags/rtse dbus ri khrod ni gna' bo'i bon sde 'ig ban sder bsgyur pa dang rtse dbus grags pa bzang bo zhes pas slar btab/ khong ni khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs( 164〈—172 4)dang gdung rus gcig par grags/phyis su bon la bsgyu ra tshul sogs mdo smad chos 'byung du cung gsungs pas 'dir ma spros/ de bzhin ri khrod skyong gnang ma khan la rtse dbus grags pa bzang bo dang bo yin pa dang gnyis pa grub thob stong nyid ye shes/gsum pa rtse dbus bla spog bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen ma dzod dge nas sku 'khrungs/ lnga ba 'jam — 377 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rgya bza' la sku 'khrungs/ drug pa dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho rdzong lung du sku 'khrungs/ bdun pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos bzang gshen drug(da lta'i rgyal mo dgon zhang gi khongs/)tu sku 'khrungs/ brgyad pa reb tsha'i rgyal mo nas sku 'khrungs/ dgu ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse rgya mtsho a 'khor rngog pa nas sku 'khrungs pa bcas sku rim par byon no/ /dge lugs rgyud smad ri khrod du rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi'i yar sngon du 'du khang dang mgon khang /rtse dbus bla ma'i nang chen/ grwa shag bcu kha btsun pa sum cu lhag yod de/ rten 'gangs chen la rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos gnang ba'i thub sku byin can dang / byams sku gser dngul las grub pa/ snang zhig rgyal ba skal bzang ba'i spur tsha'i thub sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ jo bo rje'i phyag tsha/ rje tsong kha pa'i phyag tsha mu ne ma/ bla ma byams pa'i gdung rus/ mkhas grub khyung bo'i ring bsrel/ rje grags pa bzang bo'i sku sadung zhun thig las byung ba'i sgrol ljang / kun tu bzang bo'i 'bur sku khru bco lnga can/ rtse dbus bla spo ga si 'i gdung rus las par btab pa'i rje nga 'dra ma/ snang zhig byang chub mchod rten/ rje 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen gyi gdung rten rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gzhan rgyal bo sku lnga'i 'alo/ ra shar phyogs sku rgyal bo brgya/snga garu/ pa phur thogs brgya/ srin mo skra zhig brgya/ 'khor gsum brgya sogs shin tu mang / 1958sa khyi lor ri khrod rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ kho tshos rgyud gzhung gtsigs su bzung ba'i khar rig gnas sman rtsis bslabs pa dang 'don rta dbyangs sbyong bar bya/ zla bzhi bar stong mchod 'bul/ dus bzhir bdag 'jug mchis/da snga ri khrod slar gso'i dmigs pa tsam las don dngos sgrub pa ci yang med pa'i skabs so/ /sum pa ri khrod bkra shis bsam gtan gling /sum pa ri khrod bkra shis bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne'i wa dmar zhang dang brag go lung zhang dang bsang chu rdzong (da lta'i gtsos grong khyer khongs) gi rgyal mo dgon zhang gsum gyi sa dkyil tsam ste sder kha nang sde ba'i sdings su chags/mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ sum pa ri khrod 'di bde thang rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad zur ba zhig gis btab/ de'i sprul sku chung dus nas gshegs zhes gsungs/ sku rjes ma ni zhabs drung dkon mchog tshul khrims zhes pa yin/ sku phreng gsum pa co ne khongs bde thang gshin tsha sgang gshis kyi gser 'od dgon zer ba'i sde bar spyi lo1904lo ste rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing 'brug la sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus nas rab tu byung ste bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs nas rgyud pa'i khri zur rdo rams pa rje blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten cing grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i tshul du skabs babs kyi rgyugs brtsi bzhag dpe khrid dpe bltas skyor sbyong sogs slad chos su ma song bar 'bad pas snga phyir drang nges legs bshad snying bo/ byams chos sde lnga/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ 'grel ba don gsal/ phar phyin skabs brgyad pa/ dbu ma lung rigs sgron me sogs thugs — 378 —
