krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'dzin mdzad/ spyir gzhung bka' pota lngas mtshon pa'i phyi nang gi shes bya'i gnas ma lus par sbyong ba mthar phyin gnang bas lung rigs bye ba'i gter mdzod du mnga' brnyes/ rdo rams pa'i dam bca' thon bar kun mkhyen yab sras kyi bka' ltar gsang sngags dar rgyas gling gi rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' gsol te grwa tshang gi spyi bye'i 'phrin las ma/nga du spel cing bu slob mi nyung ba bskyangs/ 1959lor dus rkyen gyi dbang gis lan kru'u nas btson du sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng ba'i ba1985lo shing glang la co ne'i brag go lung 'ang gi bde thang spel de'u sde ba'i yab chos skyong skyabs dang yum bkra shis sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs shing kun mkhyen drug pas thugs thag bcad nas mtshan la 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun rgya mtsho gsol/ 1992lo'i zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la sbyin bdag sum pa dang ri bo/ sder kha nang bcas grong tsho gsum ga'i skya ser thun mong gis sum pa ri khrod sngar gnas su gdan sa bkod do/ /rab rgyal sa khyi'i sngon du ri khrod 'dir lha khang dang sum pa'i nang chen bzhengs pa dang / grwa shag bzhi tsam mchis/ rten gtso rigs la ston pa dang rje sku las gzhan/ gnas chung 'phrin las rgyal bo sku lnga da lta'ang lus pa dang sum pa rin po che'i dngul gyi ga'u 'gangs can(da lta lus)gsung rten la yum sogs grangs mang bzhugs/ nang chen rang la sa zhing mu'u sum cu rtsa grangs 'debs pas ri khrod kyi 'gro gron gtong ba'i ma rtsa yin/ 1958lor ri grod phyugs ra sogs byas ma thar 'jig 19kha4lor sde ba gsum gas sbyor 'jags mi nyung ba btang nas ri khrod kyi bde yangs dang sum pa'i nang chen bcas khang mig bcu gcig bskyar du phub cing / nang rten la bka' 'gyur dang yum/ rje tsong kha ba'i lam sngags sogs dang ston sku li ma/rje yab sras gsum li ma/ sgrol sku li ma/ thugs rje chen po phyag ba'i ba li ma/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku li ma sogs mang tsam blus te bzhugs pas ri khrod sngar gyi rnam pa legs por gsos so/ /sa dmar dgon dge ldan bkra shis chos 'khor gling /sa dmar dgon dge ldan bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong wa dmar zhang gi khongs su chags pa rdzong mkhar dang spyi le bzhi bcu lhag yod/ mtsho tshad sum stong dang brgya yod/sgrub sde 'di dang thog dbal mang paṇ+ḍita sku phreng gnyis pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis rab 'dod chu phag lo (1nga0 2)la btab pa'i sa dmar phu'i bkra shis chos ldan gling dang / dgon li dpon slob blo bzang mkhas mchog gis rab 'dod shing byi lor(1804)btab pa'i sa dmar mdo'i dga' ldan bsam grub gling dang thang lung ri khrod gsum rmang gzhi yin te/ ri khrod gsum gar dge 'dun pa zhal brgyad cu lhag 'dus pa'i skabs te spyi lo1929lo(sa sbrul)la kwa zi lin mā krung dbyin jag tshogs kyis grong sde phu mda' bar gsum gyi mi ser bkums shing rgyu nom bcom pa ma zad ri khrid gsum ga dang gro tsho'i khang khyim spus legs thams cad — 379 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/mer bsgro na nas skya ser rnams ci bya gtol med du btang / de'i tshe dge slong brtson 'grus rgya ma/tsho/ dge slo nga gsung rab rgya ma tsho/ satso dpon dkon mchog tshe brtan(mgo dkar bo)dang dkon ma chog skyabs/ a myes ma gon po tshe brtan/ dge 'dun tshe ring sogs skya ser thun mong gis sngon dbal mang rin po che'i zhal chems ltar rab brtan rgya mtsho'i yang srid rje skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog la gtan bcol dang ri grod mnyam sdud kyi re smon zhus pa khong gi thugs su bzhes/ de nas spyi lo192 1ste rab rgyal lcags lug lor dgon pa gas ra 'debs mdzad pa nas rab rgyal sa khyi lo bar 'phel rgyas cung bzang po byung ngo /bgrang bya nyi shu lhag gi ring du rje rab brtan rgya mtsho sku rim byon gyi thugs skyong sbyor 'jags te khyad par du rje skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho lags kyis skyong khur las snga phyir tshogs chen 'du khang dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / o rgyan lha khang(dgon pa'i mar logs su bzhengs) rab brtan rgya mtsho'i nang chen/ rung khang / byang chub mchod rten bcas spus bkod khyad par can grub pa dang / grwa shag bzhi bcu rtsa grangs 'a dge 'dun pa 'al brgyad cu tsam 'dzoms/ skabs der sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs chen blus shing bzungs pa rmi gtso bo 'du khang du srung ma mgon po dang lha mo/ thub sku dang rje sku li ma/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig khya' dngu'/ grub/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang / chos rgyal 'al 'bog thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ mgi dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/ lam rim bla rgyud rnam thar/ jo bo rje'i rnam thar/ sham+bha la'i grong khyer/srid pa'i 'khor lo sogs thang ga dang ldebs ris sum brgya tsam dang / gsung rten la co ne'i bka' bstan/rje yab sras dang / dpon slob grags pa bshad sgrub/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ kun mkhyen sogs kyi gsung 'bum/ gser dngul spel bzhengs kyi ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs glegs bam stong phrag bzhugs/thugs rten du rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gdung rten ngo mtshar can dang gser dngul spel bzhengs byang chub mchod rten bzhugs/ gzhan dngul srang brgyad brgya 'a sa grub pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal sras sna bdun/ g.yu byur mu tig spras pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ bum pa/ ka pā la/ ril ba spyin blugs / 'thor nas/ theb/ kong bu/ me long / tsen/ sbub/ lag rnga/ rkang gleng / dung chen/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ tshogs dung / bla bre/ ka 'phan/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ gral gdan/ khri rgyab yol/ gos 'bol / gos ber sogs ma 'dzoms med pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rdo rje sems dpa'/ seṅge sgra/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al shing brkos/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing / rgyud sde ba'i/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / mi la'i rnam thar sogs/ ma ṇi 'khor lo sogs bzhugs su gsol/ o rgyan lha khang du o rgyan sman sku mi tshad dang gu ru mtshan brgyad/ zhal thang dang rgyan thang / rnga sbub dung mchod cha sogs phyug par byas pa dang bla ma'i nang chen du thub pa/ rje yab sras/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ mgon po phyag drug pa sogs li ma mi nyung ba dang / rje dang kun mkhyen sogs kyi gsung 'bum/ dngul grub byang chub mchod rten sogs rgyas pa bsgrubs so / /— 380 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/de ya nga bla ma rin po che dag gi sku drin dang bkra shis 'khyi' ba'i smad rgyud ltar gyi bde mchog khru i ba'i phyag ba'is gas ra du tshugs pa dang der bstun chos spyod gal chen ni/ zla dang po'i nang mgon chos lnga dang gnas chung sgra dbyangs/ dam can gyi bskang gso/ lo sar dga' sto na/ bla mar skyes 'bul/ lha rtse dang bla ma/ ma chod pa'i tshogs ma chod/ spyi gnyer zung gi grwa mang la lo sar 'gyed 'bul sogs dang / zla gsum par bde mchog sgrub mchod de sa chog dbyangs chog rgyugs sprod/ sbyin sreg klu chog rnga chings/ zla bzhi bar smyung gnas bdun gnyis dang byams pa gling skor/ zla lnga bar grwa mang grong du bzhud de bka' 'gyur klog pa dang dgon nas ma ṇi ril sgrub/ rje dkon mchog chos ldan pa'i gdung mchod/ rgyugs sprod/ zla drug par gsang 'dus sgrub mchod de sa chog dang dbyangs chog gsang sgrub sbyin sreg klu chog spyi gnyer zung gis grwa mar shing slong khrid pa/ tshes bco lnga nas dbyar tshugs bar dbyangs chog dang sman ring / 'jigs byed dpal gcig chos skyong kun 'dus/ sde brgyad mchod pa/ paṇa chen lha bsang / gnas bcu/smon lam sna lnga/ dbyar dus dbyangs chog lnga chings/ zla bdun par dbyar gzhung dbal mang gnyis pa'i gdung mchod/ lo gtor brjes pa/ mgon chos bskang gso/ dbyangs chog zla brgyad par dbyar ston/ston dus dbyangs chog lnga chings/ zla dgu bar 'jigs byed sgrub mchod de sa chog bdun sgru ba/ dbyangs bcags / sgrub ma chod sbyin sreg klu chog rgyugs sprod/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod/ zla bcu gcig par rje dkon ma chog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gdung mchod/ zla bcu gnyis par rdo bca' nyin gsum/ dgun dus dbyangs chog lnga chings sogs dar ba ma zad/ zla re'i dus bzang la bde mchog dang chos spyod gnyis re/yar ngo mar ngor gso sbyong / gsar slob rnams la lo rer tshogs rgyugs thengs drug re bcas dbyar dgag gso gsu ma gyi srol bzang sgrig legs ngang 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams rnam dag rgyun 'khyongs so/ /dgon 'di'i thog ma'i bla ma ni dbal mang gnyis pa dang dgon li dpon slob yin na'ang phyis su dbal mang bas ri khrod gsu ma ga bsdu thabs dang mi ser gyi re smon ba'in dgon mgo rab brtan rgya ma tsho'i sku skyes la gtad/ rab brtan rgya mtsho sku rim byon gyis dus rtag tu skyong khur mdzad pa dang bla rma 'i sku snga ma rjes dran gyi tshul la 'du khang nang khong sku rim byon sman sku bzhugs so/ /de brten bla rabs dag gi rnam thar phran bu re brjod na/ sku phreng dang bo mdo sngags bstan pa'i dbang phyug rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/ khong g.yi rus te rab nyi chu yos te spyi lo172 2lor sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwa 'grims shing rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan rtags thob nas rgyud grwa zhugs pa dang zhar du sman rtsis sogs rig gnas sbyangs/ srung 'khor lag len dang ñca gas mkhar/ gtor sgrub/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg gtor ma bca' bzo/ rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor/ mchod rten/ lto 'phye'i thig liṅga 'bri srol sogs bslabs/ dus 'khor grwa tshang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang khrir bzhugs/ dus 'khor dbang chen 'a na gsum bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang rjes gnang mang du bstsal cing 'jam/ dbyangs ba'ad pa la dngul srang stong phrag dang kun mkhyen gyi gser zangs — 381 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/las bzhengs grub bcas 'bul sbyor gya nom mdzad/ rong bo dgon bkra shis chos rdzong gling dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i las sne'am khri(khri rabs bco brgyad pa)bcas lo nyi shu bzhugs mthar lcags khyi ste spyi lo172 0lor sku gshags so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa rje dkon mchog chos ldan pa rab 'dod chu byi lor(1792)sku 'khrungs shing gung thang gsum pa bstan sgron gyis ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil nas gzhung bka' pota lnga sogs gsan sbyong dpyis phyin pa dang gso rig sbyangs la gnyan khrod du lan lnga phebs nas gcod dang sman gyis 'gro don khur du bzhes/ rgan rgya'i brag dkar(mgon khang bzhengs)dang rkang tsha'i chos tsha'i sgom khang / gshag ral gnas khang / maṇ+ḍal ri khrod bcas gnas dben pa du mar lan lnga 'grims/ 18 2 4sa khyi lor sa dmar phu mdo mda' gsum gyis sngar dbal mang ba'i bcog gdams khong la zhus pa thugs bzhes mdzad pa nas bzung sku rim byon gyis ri khrod gsum ga 'dzin bdag rem/ phyis dgung lo zhe bdun pa(1842lor)sa bya la sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ chas pa'i gshis rgya mched sde ba'i yab dkon mchog don grub dang yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su rab yid chu byi ste spyi lo185 2lor sku 'khrungs/gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil ba 'grims/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sa dmar bzhugs khri thang nas chas pa rgya mkhar sprul sku gtsos sa dmar sgar grong thun mong gis rta bas thab bsur phyin thog sprul ba'i skus bskul pa ltar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung gnang zhing mang 'dus la phyag dbang btang ste dad pa'i gzhi btsugs zhes/ kun mkhyen ba'i ba'i rnam thar du bkod/ 1886me khyi lor tsha kwan ho thog ste bla ma dkar bo sku phreng dang bo rje btsun byams pa mthu stobs kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang khong gnyis mnyam pas ya 'gag ma 'gag gi ri khrod bcu gnyis bsdus nas chas pa'i gshis dgon pa bkra shis chos 'khor gling 'debs mgo btsugs te thog mar dus 'khor grwa tshang dang phyi lor mtshan nyid tshugs shing 'dzin grwa zung gi khrir lo mang dang / shis tshang dgon sar dga' ldan bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling / bde mo thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling sogs kyi tshogs khrir mnga' gsol/ 1892chu 'brug lor sa dmar phyogs su chibs bsgyur te ri khrod gsum ga'i 'don pa dang ga'i gsum cho ga je legs su btang ba dang sa dmar kha yangs mdor seng gdong ma dang 'od zer can ma/ ga te gsum ga'i rde'u 'bum bsgrubs nas gdong sbrul nag lngar brgyugs kyi sa bkra mi legs pa bkags mthar sog yul dang sku 'bum du phebs shing12 0 5lor bkra shis 'khyil ba'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir zhabs pad bkod/ skabs der rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa sku 'bum du phyag 'byor bar 'tshams zhu dang rtsod rgyugs 'bul bar phebs/ spyi lo1907lo ste dgung lo nga drug pa me lug la gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su thum mo/ /sku phreng bzhi ba rje skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog da lta'i klu chu rdzong gi khongs shis tshang a grong chos 'khor tsho ba bcu gnyis pa'i rdzas tsha rong gi yab blo bzang rgya mtsho dang yum tshe ring sgrol ma'i sras su rab tshes sa bya ste spyi lo1909lo'i gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la sku 'khrungs/ khong sku mched gsum byon pa'i che ba stag tshang lha mo'i khri rgya nag pa dang / 'bring ba shis tshang ra rgya ba/ chung ba rje khong nyid — 382 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/de/ 1912lo dgung lo ba'i'i steng kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug pas thugs thag bcad cing phyi lo'i lha bab dus chen la gdan khrir 'khod/ bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin 'a sa rgya mtsho'i spyan snga nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos skabs su rje 'di ba'i mtshan skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho gsol(dus rgyun skya ser kun gyis bla ma rab brtan rgya mtsho zhes 'bod)/ sa dmar sbyin pa dge rgan dang rje skal bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ bsang khog thabs mkhas yongs 'dzin du bsten me yos la phar phyin dam bca' dang rab 'byams pa'i dam bca' bzhag de nas bzung sku tshe hril bor/ mdzod dge sgar sar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling dang mdzod dge sgang rnying dga' ldan chos 'phel gling(khri thengs gnyis) rdo dkar mchod rten shar dga' ldan bkra shis rab rgyas gling / khro kho chu kha ma'i bkra shis chos 'khor gling / rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar dga' ldan bslab gsum zung 'jug bde chen gling / bkra shis 'khyil dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang / chas pa'i gshis bkra shis chos 'khor gling / 'bo ra sngon po thang dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling / bkra shis 'khyil gyi ewaṃ chos 'khor gling / co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling / bkra shis 'khyil gyi kyai rdor grwa tshang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling bcas kyi gdong lnga'i gser khrir mnga' gsol te sku gsung thugs rten/ 'chad nyan sgrig khrims/chos sbyin mang 'gyed gang nus mdzad rjes khyad du 'phags pa gnang / khong dgung lo nyer bdun pa(1926)mdzod dge'i khri bzhugs skabs bod kyi khe nyen dang ma 'ong skyid sdug mkhyen nas rtsam mar dang gla rtsi wa lpags sogs gung khran tang gi dmar dmag rgyang skyod mkhan la legs skyes skyel du bcug de sngon1921lor bla kho rdo rje 'chang sku phreng gnyis pa rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang khong rnam pa zung gis sa dmar ba'i dgon sa gzigs shing rdo sbis yongs 'dzin sku phreng gnyis pa skal bzang dpal 'byor a mchog smad skyid nang la phebs nas dgon pa gsar bzheng gi shing cha bsgrugs te ri khrod gsum ga bsdus nas 'du khang dang gzim khang sbrags ma ka ring bzhi can lha khang gyan gsum can/ rung khang gyan dgu can bzheng mgo brtsams la dngul sgor lnga brgya gnang / dgon mtshan bkra shis chos 'khor gling gsol/ grwa shag khang mig bzhi bcu tsam phub/o rgyan lha khang de dgon sa'i klu sa btsan gsum gyi mgo gnon du thog mar bzhengs/ bla ma dang yongs 'dzin bcas kyis bum gter sbos pa dang bkra shis gso sbyong / sa bdag lto 'phye'i thogs rtags bslangs/ lo gsum ring yongs su grub rjes sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod rdzas nyer spyad yo byad sogs gsar 'jog gnang zhing bkra shis 'khyil gyi sa dmar dge 'dun mchog gdan drangs nas dpal ldan smad rgyud nges gtsang gi 'chad nyan dang gzhi gsum phyag len/ sgrig len kun spyod/ 'don rta dbyangs/ rol mo 'bud dkrol/ thig rdul tshon/ gtor ma bca' bzo la thugs bzhes bla lhag tu gnang / byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/dgon pa'i bca' yig blang dor gsal ba'i me long dang gnas bstod ljags rtsom mdzad/ yang bkra shis 'khyil gyi sa dmar bstan 'dzin rang dgon du gdan drangs sdom gsum bslab bya dang skyabs 'gro'i khrid yigs lam rnam bzhag sogs mang bo gnang bas sku drin che bar mngon/ 1942chu lug lor sa dmar phu bas — 383 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs /thugs rje chen po'i lha khang gyan gsum can gser tshon dang 'du khang du byams chen bzhengs/ sa bya lo'i sa ga zla bar dbus su chibs kha bsgyur te lam bar du nag chu'i 'bas brtan dgon dang / rwa sgreng / se 'i rbod tshang / stag lung / sha ra 'bum pa/ gling thang 'bum pa sogs mjal/ lha ldan nas ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang / po tā la lcags po ri/ gling khag ba'i/ se ra dang 'bras spungs / nye logs ri khrod bcas 'ib mjal dang ma chod 'bul/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ci rgyas bgyis/ rgyal dbang bcu ba'i ba rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya ma tsho mchog la 'byor phug zhus/ brag yer ba brgyud de rim par dga' ldan dang bsam yas/ dwags po/ pe har cog gdan sa mthil/ zangs ri mkhar dmar/ yum bu bla sgang / tsan dan g.yu'i lha khang / rtsed thang mgon po ri/ khra 'brug ya ra lung gi rten gsum gnas gsum phug gsum/ lho brag shel gyi sgrub phug smin grol gling dang / gtsang srib brgyud de rgyal rtse dang bkra shis lhu na po/ snar thang / byams chen gangs ri/ rong chen/ snye thang sogs mjal 'ing sku 'gyed mod po phul ma/thar lha ldan smon lam du gtong thabs bcas dngul srang nyis stong nye bas bsnyen bkur zhus/ tsha kho da tshang lhun grub gling gi mgon po rang byon ched du mjal phebs pa dang rnga ba'i dme sa skyong sku 'das su phebs bzhud gnang / chu sbrul lor rje nyid kyi gzim shag bde yangs gyan lnga bcu can bzhengs shing phyi lor thang lung 'phags pa tshe ring gis nan zhus dang len bzhes te yu la mi stong phrag du ma ra thugs rje chen po dang 'jigs byed dpal cig gi dbang dang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum pa 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo sogs kyi rjes gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang yon tan ga'i gyur ma'i lung / gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang bde 'jigs zung gi rim gnyis 'al lung sogs mang du bstsal/ 1kha56lor khong gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs shing khul srid gros kyi drung yig gzhon pa bskos pa dang zhor du skya ser thun mong gi re 'dun dang khong gi thugs mos sbyor 'jags ltar tshogs chen 'du khang rgya bskyed bskyar bzheng la dge slong gsung rab rgya mtsho/ 'phags pa tshe ring / pa na 'byung mgon po/ mkha' 'gro 'bum/ dge slong dpal ldan/ a skyes mgon po tshe brtan/ 'jigs byed skyabs sogs kyis zhal 'debs mthun rkyen 'a sa 'du khang phyi'i rdo rtsig dang nang shing cha ches spus legs ngo mtshar can zhig lo gcig lhag ring grub mod kyang / rab rgyal sa khyi dang me rta lo'i bar dgon du‘ ho nan 'dzugs skrun gzhon nu zhes pa'i rgya mi mang du bsdad mthar dgon pa sa rdo tsam du bsnubs/ 1958lo'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod kyi las 'gul skabs su khong zla du mar btson du bcug pa dang de phyis sa thod slog par sprugs shing co ne rdzong nyin pa 'ang gi rgya mched grong tsho'i ngal rtsol du zhugs/ 197〈sa rta lor co ne rdzong srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang lcags sprel lor gan lho khul srid gros kru'u 'i gzhon pa bskos/ chas pa'i gshis dgon pa chos sgo phye skabs su kun mkhyen drug pa gdan drangs/ lcags bya lor khong rgyal yongs srid gros skabs lnga ba'i u yon du bdams/ phyi lor sa dmar dgon pa slar gso 'i chog ma chan thob phyin ngo — 384 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dam kru'u ren khur/ paṇa chen bcu ba blo bzang 'phrin las chos kyi rgyal ma tshan mchog gan lhor gzigs 'ib tu phyag phebs pas khong khul srid gros tshab ma dzad de khul khongs rdzong khag bdun gar sku rjes 'brangs shing khyad par du sa dam ra bzhugs khri thang zhes pa sngar sa skya gong ma 'gro mgon 'phags pa1 2 5 2lor co ne brgyud de lang kru'u sde ba'ir phebs lam gyi bzhugs shul/ 16rnga 2lor ba so ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma sog po ju nang sis gdan drangs phebs dus brtsigs pa'i kun mkhyen rim byon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa der kun gzigs bzhugs su gso la cing19〈 2lo'i khrums zlar par+ṇa chen bcu ba mchog gis sa khri de nas skya ser dad lnga na stong phrag gsu ma la phyag dbang dang / skyabs 'gro/ dmigs rtse ma/ rta mgrin/ tshe lha rnam gsum/rigs gsu ma ma/gon po/ gu ru si dhi so gas kyi 'al lung bstsal/ de rjes tshe smon gling ba bzhi ba/ bla ma dkar po lnga ba/ khya dge ngapon slob ba'i ba/ rgya mkhar sku 'bas bdun pa/ gur yag drug pa/ dkon ma/chog seche gsu ma pa (sa dam/ra mdo nas 'khrungs) bang chang 'bas drung ba'i ba(sa dmar phu nas 'khrungs)so gas khri nger phebs bzhugs zhus/ rje khong gis nan bskul thengs mang las paṇa chen rin po che'ang chas pa'i gshis dgon par phebs thub cing dad ldan rnams kyis bsnyen bkur 'bas tog dang 'bul ba gtos chen btegs/ gdan sa 'i 'du khang stabs bde bskyar bzheng du khong gis sgor dgu stong lhag spyi 'jog dang shing cha nyo ba'i mthun rkyen sbya ra ba ma zad/ tshogs chen du khang tshad lda na spus legs 'byung 'gyur du sla ra bzheng la thog sgo ra lnga khri bstsal pa la rab rgyan lcags 'brug lor grub cing 2 0 0 6lor grub ston rgya cher spel/ 'ar la chas pa'i gshis dgon par bong jo thang ga sde bas ston chos khrid bzheng du bcug pa dang gos sku byams chen bzo drub can sbyor 'jags gnang / sa dam ra skya ser la rnam sras g.yang 'gug dang gter sgrub/ dgon mthar bum gter sbas/ bkra shis 'phyil ba'i 'cham chen gyi 'cham lwa bsgrugs shing tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzheng gi blo 'don par zhugs pa dang gung thang drug pa/ gling tshang / khong nyid/ dmu dge bsam gtan rnam pa ba'is lto 'phye thig 'debs dang bum gter sbas par zhugs shing kun mkhyen drug pa dbu bzhugs ngang nyam/sa gso'i skar 'dzin mdzad/ rma chu'i chu kha ma dgon par 'od dpag med kyi gos sku sogs sbyor 'jags sgor chig khri lhag btang ba dang a mchog skyid nang bas rje'i nang chen bskyar ba'eng gi shing cha phul cing snga phyir kun ma khyen drug pa dang gung thang drug pa/ sde khri brgyad pa/ lha mo gser khri lnga ba/ bse drug pa pa so gas rang dgon du gdan 'dren zhus/ bla ma dkar po khri bzhugs lta gos skabs rang dgon du bzhugs bcug chas pa'i gshis jo khang slar bzhengs grub dang rje nyid kyis grwa tshang bzhi ga dang 'cham chen/ shwa 'cham/ lcags mkhar slar gsos shing mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang gcod kyi 'bas brtan sogs gsar tu btsugs/ bkra shis 'khyil du nang chen bde yangs sbrags ma bzhengs pa dang kyai rdor grwa tshang la tshogs slang chu zo nyi shu shong ba dang co ne rdo rgyal glog grwar sgor skyes gnang / rgya rigs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rong h+phis la tshe dbang 4nang / spyir khong gi sku tshe hril bor sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum la nus shugs ci yod phul — 385 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi khongs/nas chos sde mang bo bskyangs pa dang nye ba'i lo du mar bla ma dkar bo sku phreng lnga ba 'jigs med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang seng seng sprul sku skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ khya dge dpon slob yang srid 'jigs med thub bstan blo gros rgya mtsho sogs bla sprul dang sa dmar/ chas pa'i gshis/ chu kha ma/ klu shod/bde thang / lha gsol/ dran pa/ rgyal dge gser thang / mdzod dge sogs kyi bsgrub bya nyis brgya lhag la rab byung dang dge tshu' gyi sdom khrims bstsal/ dbul 'phong nyam thag can la dngos sbyin lhug por btang ba dang mi ser bar gyi gyod gzhi mi nyung ba bsdums/ mi rigs yar thon du slob grwa du mar rnam sbyin rogs ram dang dmangs khrod zlos gar bskyar 'dzugs gnang / de bzhin khong snga phyir rgyal yongs dang 'ing chen srid gros u yon/ rgyal yongs nang bstan chos lugs mthun tshogs las 'dzin u yon dang zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ zhing chen nang bstan slob gling gi yon krang gzhon pa/ kun lho khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas bskos par bzhugs/ rje khong nyid dgung lo bgres shing sku bsnyungs pas spyi lo19kha4lo ste rab rgyan sa phag lo'i zla11pa'i nang bkra shis 'khyil gyi nang chen gzim shag tu re thig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /sku phreng lnga ba ni rab rgyan me byi lor co ne rdzong wa dmar 'ang gi kha g.yang sde bar sku 'khrungs/ lcags 'brug lo'i zla gcig pa'i bco lngar kun mkhyen drug pas ngos bzung 'ing dbo zla'i bcu gcig la sa dmar dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nang chen bcas nas gdan khri bkod/ da lta bri klog mgo tshugs pa tsam mo/ /de bzhin dgon nyid dang bkra shis 'khyil bcas su bzhugs pa'i sa dmar dge 'dun dang /bka' rams pa bstan 'dzin/ dge slong gsung rab rgya mtshos(rig gnas bcu la mkhas pa) dgon pa'i bca' yig dang gnas bstod sogs rtsom gnang mdzad do/ /rab rgyal chu khyi lor(198 2)dgon pa'i chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan thob pa nas da thug bar 'du khang dang 'du khang chen mo/ bla ma'i nang chen/ byang chub mchod rten bcas bzhengs pa dang dge 'dun pa zhal bdun cu rtsa grangs 'dzoms par grwa shag bzhi bcu lhag phub/ rgyud chos 'chad nyan dang de'i phyag len dbyar dgag gso gsum rgyun ldan du slar gsos/ zla bcu gcig pa'i bcu drug dang bcu bdun la yongs 'dzin sku phreng gnyis pa skal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo dang rje sa dmar dge 'dun gnyi ga'i gdung ma chod gsar du tshugs/ nang rten gsar blus byin can la thub sku li ma dag dang kun mkhyen dang bo nas lnga'i sman sku/ rab brtan rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi ga'i 'dra sku/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'al thang / thugs rje chen po'i zhing bkod/ bla mchod tshogs zhing / 'phrin las rgyal bo'i sku brnyan/ sde dge bstan 'gyur dang lha sa'i bka' 'gyur/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ gser dngul spel mas bris pa'i brgyad stong ba/ rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin dang skal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo/ rje skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho bcas kyi sku gdung mchod rten/ khyad par du dgon mtha'i byang chub mchod rten du rten 'gangs chen mang bo 'dus pa dang mthar ma ṇi lnga bcu bsgrigs/ da lta rang gso byed par sa zhing mu'u nyi shu dang tshong khang / sman khang /— 386 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/glog 'thag bcas gnyer zhing chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel ba'i skabs so / /mkhar mo che'i gsang sngags bdud 'dul gling /mkhar mo che'i gsang sngags bdud 'dul gling zhes pa'i rnying dgon ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong wa dmar zhang gi mkhar mo che zhes pa'i grong logs su chags /gsang snga gas rnying ma'i sde 'di sngar co ne bla sprul rgya lung ba zhes bya bas co ne sa skyong 'jigs med stobs rgyal ba'i bka' lung bzhin spyi lo1476lo 'i sngon nas co ne mdor sngags grwa zhig yod pa de dgon chen gyi nang du tshugs mod/ dge sbyong ba rnams mang shos kyi gnas yul thag ring bas chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel bar stabs ma bde/ phyis sngags 'chang ba mang shos kyi dgongs 'char ltar gur chen dpa' bo tshal zhes par spos pa dang de nas lo ngo gnyis tsam las ma 'das par bla ma sum pa ba'i dgongs 'dod ltar da lta'i mkhar mo che zhes pa'i grong sde'i mar logs nyin ngos su btab cing bla ma gsum pa bas sku gsung thugs rten mang du blus te bzhugs/ snga phyir smin grol gling ba'i chos rgyun spel mdzad/ 'phrin las rab brtan dang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ co ne a smon sku phreng lnga ba ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me rnam gsum dus mnyam du thugs khur 'dzin skyong mdzad pa dang / phyis su dgon li blo bzang mkhas mchog gis bskyangs/ ches dar dus sngags 'chang ba brgya lha ga 'dus/ de nas rgyud pa saṃ bha rdo rje 'chang dbang dang kirti mi skyod rdo rje/ khyad par du rje btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang rje btsun mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ skal bzang lung rtogs rgya mtshos bdag skyong gnang ba ma zad/ chas pa rgya mkhar ngag dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos rogs ram gnang zhing dpa' bo tshal nas da lta'i dgon sar spor skabs sbyo ra 'jags mthun rkyen sbyar/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon du sngags grwa 'dir 'du khang sum thog can gser tshon spras pa ngo mtshar zhig dang bla ma'i gzim khang / chos skyong lha khang /sum pa ba'i nang chen bcas bzhengs pa dang grwa shag thun mong can gyi khang mig ra gcig ma zhe drug phub par sngags 'chang ba gya gsum bzhugs/ bla ma rgyal lung ba'i bca' yig la bsten to/ /co ne dgon chen gyi dgon lag bdud 'dul gling ba'i sgrub mchod gal chen la/ zla gnyis pa'i nang thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus bdag 'jug dang kha bskong sbyin sreg dang / zla bzhi bar dbyar chos byang gter rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi bdag 'jug dang kha bskong sbyin sreg khro bo rol ba'i gtor zlog bsgrub/ zla dgu ba'i ston chos la gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul gyi sgrub thabs dang kha bskong gtor zlog sogs/ zla bcu gcig pa'i dgun chos la mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi bdag 'jug dang kha bskong mtsho rgyal bskang gshegs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong bdud 'dul nag mo'i gtor zlog byed cing / dus bzhir rig 'dzin kun gyis gu ru dregs dmar bkur cing rta mgrin yang gsang rim gro dang zhwa nag pa'i 'cham ngo mtshar 'ig 'a/sa sa'an dus rgyun khyim pa'i rim gro ci rigs dang len sgos sems can gyi na tsha dang god kha thams — 387 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co rne rdzong gi khongs/cad 'i bar bzlogs so / /sku gsung thugs rten gtso shas 'a / tshe dpag med phyag tu dpag bas ma shing sdong dngu'/ sra/nga lnga can/'od dpag med phyag gi lhung bzed dngul srang lnga lhag can/ thugs rje chen po mu tig phyag phreng can/ gtso sku o rgyan rin po che sku khra bdun lhag can gsum dbu zhwa'i nyi zla dang rdo rje gser nag can/ o rgyan sku brang rgyan dngul srang nyer lnga can/ ma kha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dbu rgyan dngul srang bco lnga baiḍūr+ya phra zung can gnyis/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ dang sgrol ljang khru lnga re can/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes / rta ma grin ya nga gsang / mkhan slob zung gi gser sku/ gu ru bka' brgyad/ o rgyan snang srid zil gnon/ gas nga bdag dregs pa kun 'dus / chos skyong ma gza' dam gsum// zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya/ de min li ma ma nga bo bcas bzhugs/ ga'an thang ga nyi shu lhag dang dngul kong / dngul 'bum / me 'o nga 'od 'bar/dngul brgyan tsi dang rkang gling / dngul brgyan dung / dngul theb/ dngul gyi ma ṇ+ḍal sogs dang rag kong rag theb/ dngul gyi spos ga'ong / dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs dang rag kong rag theb/ thug ze'u/ zangs dem/ ja pra/ me phor/ zangs skyog mkhar zangs/ sbub/ gdan cha so gas ma nga shas smad sog nas blus pa sha stag yin te skabs de'i rin thang ltar na ha lam dngul sgor khri phrag so drug 'o ngas la/ lo rgyus kyi rin thang can dang nom pa'i rtsa chen yin pas kun gyis yid smon pa 'dzoms/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon pa phyugs ra sogs byas te rjes su 'jig go/1kha8 4lor mi ser dad ldan rnams kyis nan zhus ltar sla ra gso 'i chog ma tshan thob/ rig 'dzin pa zhe lnga 'dus nas 'du khang stabs bde 'ig dang rung khang / thun mo nga sdod khang mig nyi shu tsam phub nas chos spyod ci nus dang rim/ gro gang mkho sgrub pa'i dus so/ /brag dkar ri khrod sprin 'dzin chos kyi dga' 'khyil gling /nang ba'i ri khrod sprin 'dzin chos kyi dga' 'khyil gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong wa dmar 'ang gi co ne sa skyong gi bla ri gnyan chen po a myes brag dkar gyi lho sdings su chags/ri khrod 'di rang yu la gyi grwa ba bkra shis 'khyil nas dge slong grags chen thob pa dkon mchog seṅge sku phreng dang bos 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ( 1916—1kha47)dang dbal ma nga rin po che'i 'al bkod bzhes nas/ khong nyid dgung lo lnga bcu'i dus su rang sa'i brag dkar mdun zhol gyi dgun sa zhes pa'i sde bas sbyin bdag byas pa ltar ri khrod byin can 'di phyag 'debs ma dzad cing gzim khang brgyab ste der bzhugs/ mthar min go khri lo bco brgyad pa(spyi lo1929lo)he 'khrug las dgon pa dang ri khrod gtses skabs khong nyid sku 'das/ khong gi sku gdung brag rigs gsum mgon po'i klad cha'i sku 'bum gyi 'og tu bzhugs par grags/ 'di ba'i sku phreng gnyis pa rang sa nas sku 'khrungs shing nar son rjes bla brang — 388 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bkra shis 'khyil du ma/tshan stan rgyas gshis dgon lag mang bo'i khri bar bzhugs bcug spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur che ba'i skabs su sku sdu ga mi nyu ba myangs cing phyis snyung lci mo las spyi lo19ra 4lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/sa so/ / sku phreng gsu ma pa sangs/ rgyas rgya mtsho mchog spyi lo1kha〈 4lo co ne'i sa dmar ma do'i yab ban de ma khar dang yum ma kha' mo/ skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs / 199 2'o 'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la kun ma byen drug pas dbon ma/chog se che sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin ma dzad cing rab byung bcu bdun pa'i r+shang gyi 'o 'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin a 'khor brag dkar byang chub gling gi gdan sa ra bkod do/ /ri brod 'di'i rten gtso la phyag rdor 'khor chen lha khang bzhengs pa'i dbus su thugs rje chen po thugs lar 'od zer 'phro ba dang / phyag na rdo rje dbu kri skyes pa/ rta mgrin 'jim sku na bza' za 'og ri mo rang ma ngon can so gas cung ma nga / gser khrab pa chos skyong du bkur/ ri khrod du zla drug pa'i tshes bcu ba'i bco lngar smyung gnas 'dzin pa dang zla re'i tshes bcu gcig dang nyer gnyis la dus 'khor gyi dbang dang bdag 'jugadus tshigs re'i tshes gsu ma nyin gcod kyi bdag 'jug zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin ri khyod kyi btsugs shing du ma/tshan nyid kyi chos grwa spel/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor thug dus phyag rdor lha khang dang 'debs po'i gzim shag sde khri bzhi ba blo bzang 'u nga rigs nyi ma'i(a 'khor rngog pa'i nang sku 'khrungs pa) pho brang / grwa ba bcu gsum bzhugs / dgun sa sde ba ma/chod ga'is/ yin pas lo re'i lha khang bdag gnyer dang grwa shag gi thigs bcag 'dam las la sogs byed par rem mo/sla ra rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos lor ( 19〈7) dgun sa sde ba thun mong dang khyad par du bla ma gter bton pa sku phreng gsu ma pa thub bsta na dkon ma/chog tshul khrims(khong mtsho sngon rdo sbis nas sku 'khrungs thing / grwa sa chos rdzong dason 'grims/ da lta grwa sa 'a sa 'o ga rjes dgun sa sde bar bzhugs/ 'di'i sku bong ma la gya'i sater rgan 'es pa yin) pas thugs sems bzhes pa las ri khrod du phyag rdor 'khor chen lha khang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa stabs bde bzhengs pa dang grwa shag khang mig 'ga' re phub po/ /a 'khor brag dkar dgon dga' ldan bkra shis byang chub gling /a 'khor brag dkar dgon dga' ldan bkra shis byang chub gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi co ne rdzong wa dmar 'ang gi khongs su chags/a 'khor dga' ldan bkra shis byang chub gling ni dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung 'bum du sngon spong ba du ma 'i bsti gnas su rab byung bcu ba'i chu 'u ga( 1 5rnga 2 )lor ri khrod tsam chags skad/ phyis su a 'khor ru gsum byi spyi dgon lta bur paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi gsung lta ra co ne dpon tshang gis mthun rkyen sbyar te/ bde thang blo bzang tshangs dbyangs pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug (170 2)la dgon 'di 'debs nga/ra ma dzad/ rgyud smad pa'i phyag len lta ra gyi co ne dgon chen gyi dgon lag lo shas na rab 'byams pa chos — 389 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul co ne rdzong gi bo/ ngas༈'dzin grags pas kun mkhyen gong ma/ khya dge dpon slob/ sgom chen blo bzang bkra shis sogs gdan drangs/ sngon ma gnyis dang co ne mkhan chen bcas kyis bka' shog bstsa' / rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sbrul(1761)la co ne sa skyong bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal 'phrin las rdo rje gtsos bde thang blo bzang rab brtan/ dgon li mkhas mchog bde thang blo bzang yon tan sogs kyis 'du khang bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ co ne mkhan rin po che dkon mchog dam chos rgya mtsho dang / sa skyong sku mched kyis bkas bskul bzhin dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pas bca' yig bzhag cing / lo rer bde gsang 'jigs gsum kun rig sogs bdag 'jug lnga/ cho 'phrul smon lam nyin gsum byams pa gling skor dang bcas pa/ hor zla ba'i ba/ lnga ba/ drug pa/ dgu ba/ bcu ba/ bcu gcig pa bcas la smyung gnas/ bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs/ gdung mchod lnga/ bsnyen sgrub/ zla re'i yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong so gas nyin brgya dang lnga bcu lhag la chos spyod kyi bya ba yod/ min go srid lo bco brgyad pa'am(1929)lor kā zi len jag tshogs kyis dgon pa gtsang sreg btang / rten gtso thub pa gsu nga 'byon/ rgyud sde ba'i'i lha tshogs li ma mi tshad can sogs dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing / lam rim bla brgyud dang bya rgyud rigs kyi rgyan thang dang thang ga mang bo dang mchod chas yo byad spus gtsang ba yod/ co ne/ sde dge/ dbus kyi bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/bstan 'gyur tshar gnyis/ 'bum tshang bcu gcig sogs pota du ma/ chas pa'i gshis blo bzang rgya mtsho dang bla ma dkon mchog seṅge sogs kyi dngul gyi mchod gdung lnga bzhugs/ gzhan yang / byams sku thog gnyis pa dang rje'i lha khang / mchod rten lha khang / brag dkar btsan khang rnams su'ang rten gsum shin tu mang ngo / /sde 'dir kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ dbal mang rin po che/ sde khri mchog rje dkon mchog seng gi rje skal bzang bzod pa rgya mtsho/ brag sgom pa/ mkhan chen dge legs dharma bcas sku phreng rim byon gyis spyan skyong gnang zhing thog ma dang phyi ma gnyis las gzhan bzhi ga dang stobs ldan tshang bcas la nang chen yod do/ /sde 'di rang nas byon pa'i mkhas chen mi nyung ste gsung 'bum can lha btsun dkon mchog chos 'byor la pota gcig dang bshes gnyen dkon mchog bzang por pota gsum bzhugs/ brag dkar blo bzang bkra shis/ngag dbang nor bu sogs byon zhing / 1958lo'i bla ma gsum dang dge 'dun pa brgya lhag bzhugs/bslab gsum nyams bzhes la gcig tu 'bad kyang lo de dang rig gsar las 'gul nang yongs su bsnubs/198 2lor dgon pa slar gsos/ da lta dgon du 'du khang dang / sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang / rje lha khang / rung khang bcas bskyar du bzhengs/ bla ma dkon mchog seṅge dang / stobs ldan tshang bcas kyi nang chen dang / sangs rgyas bla go dran pa/ gter ston bcas kyi gzim khang phub/ 1994lor dkon mchog seṅge gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho sa dmar ba gdan sar bkod/dgon pas tshong khang dang sman khang sogs gnyer la/ chos spyod thams cad dge 'dun brgya phrag tsam gyis rgyun ldan du spel bzhin no/ /— 390 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bā tse rdzong gi khongs/chas pa rgya mkhar dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling /chas pa rgya mkhar dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bā tse rdzong chu bo thang ga 'ang gi dung chung nang sde bar chags/de yang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes pa'i nang tshan mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi gdung rgyud cig gis lha ldan skyor mo lung gi sab zung zhing yul de'i bdag po mi rabs mang bo song ba na/ kha tsho'o tshong 'grul khag cig stod lung yangs pa nas mched cing khams phyogs su chas te mi thog cig bsdad/ de nas a mdo'i phyogs su khal mdzo ded nas da lta'i a myes dpal rgan(co ne'i chas pa'i gshis stod) mdun du slebs tshe khal mdzo ngal dub kyis chad pas gzhis chags kyi gnas 'dir yin nam snyam nas der bsdad pa la rgyang chad pa zhes pa'i ming thogs/ kho tsho lam thag ring bo nas yong bas chas zhes btags/ mi ring bar g.yu lo lhun grub zer ba dang / bstan skyong dbang bo zer ba/ bsod nams nor bu zer ba'i spun gsum gyis gnod sbyin dgra lha chen po dpal ldan skyes lha dang dgra lhar bkur bar a myes dpal rgan ri bo'i mdun du bla rtse bstad de mchod bkur byas par/ g.yu los chos sna zhig 'bul bzhin da nas chas pa'i chos rgyun mi chad par shog dang /bstan skyong gis sta re rnon po zhig 'bul bzhin da nas dpa' rgyud mi chad par shog bsod nams kyis mchod kong mar gyis bkang ba zhig 'bul bzhin da nas phyug rgyud mi chad par shog ces rang rang gis smon lam btab/de gsum ga las che ba sta re kong mchog gsum ga'i rus thogs/ de nas chas pa'i gdung rgyud rtogs ldan lha ri ring bo zhes bya ba'i sgom chen zhig byon te ri bya khyung gi rtse mor sgom khang brtsigs nas yun ring bzhugs/ de dus ma 'gag(da lta'i mdo khog zhang)na sde grong tha thor chags pa la las ya 'gag(da lta'i nyin pa zhang)na rong 'brog bi sde gang yang med/ rim bzhin chas pa'i mi rabs rnams dang bcas phyogs phyogs nas gzhis chags zer/ de rjes bla chen blo gros yangs pa(dgung lo sum cu'i steng dgon pa btab/ khong dgon pa btab phyin lo bzhi bcu ba dang dgung lo bdun cu bar sku 'das) zhes pa de yul dbus nas a mdo'i yul 'dir stag seng gis sgo bsrungs pa g.yas logs bya khyung gi ri bo yod pa'i mar tsam na sa yi gser gyi ka ba bzhi ldan pa'i lung mdo ru dgon gnas shig yod de der chos sde zhig gsar 'debs kyis dang gdul bya dang 'gro don yod ces rgyal dbang gnyis pa'i(rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho1475—1542)lung bstan thugs su bzhes pa dang /'bras spungs kyis tshogs dung ya gcig gnang ba khyer nas byon pas ka ru bzhi mdo zhes pa'i sar dgon pa 'dzugs pa'i gzhi btings pa na dus der khams nas 'gro mgon bstan pa rin po che'am byams pa dge 'dun — 391 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi longs /dgung lo bzhi bcu'i dus dgon pa btab (khong dgung lo re gnyis steng sku gshegs ) zhes ba gnyis zhal 'dzoms nas gong ma yo/na lo'i dus su (phyis kyi dgon khag gyes pa tsho'i 'o rgyus su dus bcig 'dra gleng med kyang /spyi lo14 2 4ba'i sngo na yin nges) dgon pa dngos su btab/ de nas bzung chas pa'i gshis zer ba'i yu la ming byung / chos sde der dge 'dun pa brgya lhag 'dus te lo drug cu tsam banas/ gsu nga rab ma nga du bzhugs / chu bya(spyi lo145 2)nas lo lnga'i bar dgon pa yo ngas su grub cing khri rabs gnyis lasu ma gyi bar 'gyangs / phyis blo gros yangs par sku gdung mchod rten dngul gyis khru gang can ba'engs nas chas pa dar dase dgon pa'i gtso rten du bzhugs/ de nas ta lam spyi 'o/160 2'o tsam na dgon pa dgra jag bis ya nga ya nga gtses pas bla grwa kun gyis dgon pa spo dgos dgongs te khri thog nyer ba'i ba bsta na pa ya ra ljo phel dang bde thang mkhan po blo bzang tshangs dbyangs / co ne sa skyong sku mched rnam sa kyis b.la' gsu nga ma thun rkyen ‘ra sa 'bras spungs chos skyong rdo rje grags ldan la brtag zhu phul bar shing ra'i ri bo che zer bar spor na legs nga/'i 'u nga bsta na/'on kyang rten 'brel 'phyugs nas g.yis sgar ri bo cher dgon pa spos shing dgon ming la dga' lnga na bkra shis yongs 'dzin gling btags/ g.yog sgang (mchod ga'is)sde ba bco brgyad longs༈ re 'ig grwa/ ba stong tsam 'dus shing bde thang dang sgo mang / dar dge rdo nag dbon po bcas pa'i bla khag lnga 'dus / de rjes yang dgon pa'i nang rkyen sogs la sa ma 'cham par chas pa rgya mkhar dgon dang bcas pa'i khag lnga ra gyur to/ /dgon nyid kyi bdag gyur chas pa rgya mkhar sku zhabs dang mkhan po rim byon zhes pa 'di gsham lta ra byon /mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ dgon 'di sku 'bas dang bo gtsos sga ru nas sku 'khrungs pa'i ngag dbang dpal 'byor yin/ dgung lo drug cu'i steng ka ri ba'i mdo'i dgon pa g.yis sgar ri bo cher spor/ 'ari nas dgon pa lo bcu bzhi'i dus su khong rang dgung lo don ba'i ba la dgongs pa rdzogs/ sku 'bas gnyis pa rngog rgyal mo'i tsha mdo nas sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo so gnyis steng sku gshegs/ chas pa'i mkhan sprul dang ngo blo bzang dam chos zhes pa dme shul mu to nas sku 'khrungs/ 'bras sgo mang nas slob gnyer mdzad par lha ra mas dge bshes kyi mtshan thob/ rang dgon du byon rjes dgon pa shing rar spo 'dun bcangs kyang don du khel ma thub/ tshang dpon slob pa'i rnam thar tu cung gsal / de dus klu chung g.yos sgar du lo rgyus kyi dbang gis grwa ba'i gras su ban bon gnyi ga 'dus pas tshogs chen las chos spyod gzhan pa rang rang du 'tshogs / skabs shig nang ma 'chams par dge 'dun rnams phyogs ris gsum du gyes te nang rtsod bslangs/ rgya nag hron kri khri lo bcu drug pa(1659)tsam nas dgon pa thor te kha shas yar thang(sbyin bdag gam lha sde g.yog sgang bcu gnyis yod)dang mu to'i ltag tu chags/ yang skor zhig spyang lung mkha' ru lung(spyang lung sde ba'i yar mdun lung kyog cig) du chags pa la chas pa mkhar lung dgon zer/ chas pa lha rams pa dgung grangs re lnga'i steng mkhar lung du sku gshegs / khong dgung lo nyer ba'i'i dus su mkhar ru lung nas yang dgon pa chags(da lta'i co ne rdzong wa dmar zhang gi dgon chags sde ba'i shul)su spor/ de dus klu chung phyogs bcas pa ga yo ga sgang — 392 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gcig yin pas re zhig dgon du ban bon zung gi chos spel la dus tshogs che ba las sngar srol ltar cho ga phran bu dag bon rnams logs su 'tshogs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa phag(1659)lor dgon pa thor ba dang klu chung ba klu chung lung bar song nas bon rnams ban ru bsgyur/ mkhan po gsum pa mkhas btsun blo gros rgya mtsho co ne'i a smon nor bzang gi sku mched du dgon li nas 'khrungs pa gdan sar bkod pa la dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga'i dus sog yu' du sku gshegs/ dgon pa yang a 'khor dgon chags kyi dus nas1956lo bar sa dmar phu mdo mda' gsum tshun chad kyi grwa btsun chos sder phebs/ skabs der mkhan po gnyis pa a mchog nyi ma lung nas sku 'khrungs pa la blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas zer/ khong gis dbu skra'i gri rdar de gzan gong lta bur bcings pa'i phyag mdzub kyi ri mo gsal le ba rten gras su bzhugs pa mi mang bas mjal myong / kun gyis khong la bla ma rdo bcings pa dang chas pa bla rgan zhes 'bod/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i dngos slob tu chud cing dgung lo don bdun bzhugs/ gzhung dang rig gnas la mkhas pas mkhar mo ches blo bzang yon tan dang / nyang tshang ngag dbang bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pas slob dpon du bsten/ da lta'i bar mchod gzhis gtso bo sngar bzhin g.yog sgang drug dang sa sgar lung brgyad de/ bos rus/ mda' rgyang /mkhar mo che/ sa dmar phu mdo/ thong rtsa yas mas/ nor bu sne sar dang / stag lung gshis/ ti gu mdo/ti gu phu/ wa dmar/ g.yu rtsi mdo/ dung chung nang / spyang lung / dgon pa rang bcas yin/ mkhan po bzhi ba dkon mchog bstan pa rgya mtsho skabs der dgon li nas sku 'khrungs/ sku nar son rjes dbus su chos grwa 'grims par sbyangs 'bras legs pas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas hu thog thu gnang zhing dzam dkar dang phyag rdor rnam sprul yin par gsungs/ rim bzhin dgon chags dgon sa mi legs par dgongs nas yang rdzo bo sgang(ti gu mdo'i mdun sgang)du spar nas re zhig chags/ de'i rjes sgar snying zhes pa'i da lta'i gnas 'dir spos zhing dgon li ba gnyis pa gdan khrir bkod/ sgar rnying zhes pa'i sa 'dir sngon chad rgya'am ci rigs kyi dmag sgar chags pa'i mkhar shul yod pas mi ser rnams kyis chas pa rgya mkhar zhes btags/dgon pa 'di nas 'phel rgyas byung bstun mtshan snyan grags par gyur/ sku zhabs kyi nang chen dang mchod khang dar dge dgon par yod pas khri ba dar dge nas mngags srol dar/ sog yul a lbag rta ri gang phyogs su sku zhabs na rim gyi sgar gzhis dang su rug yod pas thengs gsum phebs pa dang rang dgon du 'du khang dang btsan khang / rgyud khang / gzim khang bcas nyis thog can dang grwa shag bdun cu bzhengs/ rang lo so lnga bar gshegs dus gdung rus la yi ge rang byon bab/ mkhan po sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing stag(1794)lor mdzod dge ru stod ma'i stag 'dul grub dbang gi sku tshar 'khrungs/ spyi khyab tu bla rgan sprul sku zer/ mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na dgon pa chas pa rgya mkhar du spyi lo18 21lor spor ba dang bla ma 'di'ang dgung lo re gcig pa spyi lo1854la sku gshegs zhes gsungs /gnas brtan 'dul 'dzin pa mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i spyan snga nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa — 393 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/bzhes/ ti gu'i dge slong dkon mchog seṅge las 'don cha bslabs/ ma khar mo che blo bzang yon tan las —rig gnas dang sdom gsum bslab bya sogs bslabs/ gung thang rin po che bzhi ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang chos grwa'i dpon slob klu 'bum pa ngag dbang tshul khrims rgya ma tsho dang khri byang chub chos 'phel/ rwa sgreng khri chen/ ke'u bla ma rnam grol rnams bsten/ gtsang du paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma ra chos 'brel zhus/ rang yu la du byon skabs bod srid skyong tsha rdor no mon han nas dge ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed nom ci mkhan po zhes pa'i cho lo dang mkhan chas gnang / de nas bzung chas pa rgya mkhar ma khan ngo tshes pa'i mtshan thogs shing gzhis byes rnams su dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun spel/ sog yul rgya nang 'a na gsum phebs shing a wag rta ri gang ga phyogs su sku zhabs na rim gyi sgar gzhis dang su rug yod/khong gi nang chen dang mchod khang yun ring bar dar dge dgon pa'i ltag tu yod gshis mi ser gyis ltag gi khri ba tshang zer/ dgung 'o re gcig pa shing stag la gshegs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags yos lor dgon pa ni da rte 'i gnas su spos/ 'du khang dang / rgyud khang / btsan khang / gzim khang nyis thog can/ grwa ༅ga bdun cu bcas dngul srang chig khri nyis stong lhag gis grub par bzhengs shing rje'i sku 'khor dag pa rnam brgyang/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs gser zangs las bzhengs pa bzhugs/ sku zhabs lnga ba ngag dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho(chas pa rgya mkhar grub chen 'jam dpal grub pa'i rdo rje/)sa phag(spyi lo18 29)lor co ne khya dge'i bse tshang du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun steng gdan sar bkod(mkhan sprul gsum pa dgung lo nga bzhi'i skabs/)cing sa dmar chos 'dzin klog gi dge rgan bsten/ kirti kun dga' chos 'phags kyi drung du sgrol dkar dang myur mdzad ma'i lung gsan/ mkhan po gsum pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung ba dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ bcu gcig par bkra shis 'khyil gyi rmad byung thos bsam gling du bzhugs shing rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho zhes pa'i drung nas bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung thob/gung thang bzhi ba bstan rgyam pa'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa la mtshan ngag dbang dge 'dun sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gsol/ de rjes sog yul du phebs nas hal ha'i sngon gyi sbyin bdag bcas par thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / rang yul du 'byor 'phral tho'u ju'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis thugs rje chen po'i dbang zhus pa gnang / slar bkra shis 'khyil nas hor rin po che'i drung du dus 'khor dbang chen thob pa dang /dngul rwa'i rdo rams pa snyan grags las snyan ngag sogs rig gnas gzigs/ sum cu'i steng chab mdo'i brgya tshigs brgyud de dbus su phebs/ phyir phebs nas bkra shis 'khyil du dus 'khor grwa tshang gi rdo rje 'dzin par bzhugs mthar rang dgon du byon/ slar sog yul du chibs bsgyur te ja sag bsod nams tshe ring gis mchod gnas bsten pas yun ring bzhugs shing dus 'khor grwa tshang btsugs par 'don rta dbyangs bkra shis 'khyil ltar bgyis mthar chos sbyin rgya cher phab/ rang dgon du phyir phebs nas dbang lung rjes gsum bstsal cing bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor khri ba dang tshogs chen khri ba lo du ma bzhugs/ shing stag lor mkhan sprul sku — 394 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/'das/ tsha rdor no min han gdan drangs/ chu sbrul lo'i(1892)sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la bla ma dang dge 'dun bdun brgya/ skyes pho mo sum stong la dus 'khor dbang chen gnang / tshogs chen 'du khang zhig gsor zhal 'debs dngul srang bzhi brgya'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ bde mo thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi khri bar bskos/ sa gyi lo sog yul du phebs nas hal ha'i ho shis dus 'khor grwa tshang btsugs pa dang so nyid maṇ+ḍal dgon du dus 'khor grwa tshang btsugs pa dang dgon pa sngon por mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs/ ho sho su mi byams pa dar rgyas gling dang so nyid maṇ+ḍal dgon sogs su so skyes nyis stong lha ga la chos dbang mang du bstsal/gcod kyi bdag 'jug btsugs/ phag lor phyir phebs nas skyabs mgon mchog la dngul srang sum brgya dang dar gos mang bo phul/ thos bsam gling dang dus 'khor grwa tshang / rang dgon bcas 'a ma nga 'gyed dang rten bzhugs gya nom pa btang / khyad par du sku 'bas lnga ba khong gis lcags glang lo(1kha01)la a gzigs thang du dus 'khor mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa dang bum gter bsgrubs shing shis brjod rab gnas mdzad pa dang ma cig khros nag gi dbang gnang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi kyai rdor khrir bzhugs shing tshogs chen rung khang du sla nga lugs/ gsung rtsom du ma yod/ dgung lo re bdun steng sku gshegs so/ / mkhan po lnga ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i nyi ma/ khong ti gu rngog pa'i rtsa drug nam mkha'i sras su 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang 'phrin las rgya mtshos(1rnga75sngon) thugs thag bcad/ dgung lo bdun pa gdan sar 'khod cing dge 'dun sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwa la zhugs pa dang dgung lo nyer lnga ba la gung thang 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma las bsnyen par rdzogs / de nas khong tshe dbang bla ma'i phyag mdzod la bzhugs pa dang sum cu ba la sog yul so nyid g.yon ru sogs su phebs pa na mi dbang gi bla mar bkur cing gzhis ka dang tshoms chen bskyil pa ma zad pe cin bde ldan byin chags gling du bde yangs nang chen ra gong 'og bar gsum can bskrun la/ rgyal yum gyis khong la 'ja' sa dang gser yig gser tham/sgo pan gnang nas bde yangs bshad sgrub smin mtsho gling zhes mtshan gso' / rang yul du phebs dus tshogs chen 'du khang zhig gso grub par gser bzang gi 'od dpag med sku khru bco lnga can dang thugs rje chen po khru bcu can/ sangs rgyas stong sku khru gang mang bzhengs/ sog yul nas 'du khang la gser tog rgyal mtshan/ ri dwags pho mo/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan jo bo khri lnga can/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad ma/ rigs ldan nyer lnga khru gang ma sogs dang / sa gdan ka thum/ tsi mgo rgyal mtshan sogs re re sum cu/ smon lam chen mo'i mchod rdzas cha tshang / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang la ma sngags gser bris pota sum cu rtsa grangs bcas blus/ yar thang dgon pa dang rgya mkhar dgon pa gnyis dgon mgo gcig pas rgyud pa grwa tshang gi chos thog 'tshogs res byed pa'i srol de grwa rgan rnams kyis tshegs che bar dgongs pa las mgo gtor nas rang rang byas/ de nas co ne'i g.yog sgang drug dang bcas pas dngos su dgon pa'i sbyin bdag gi dbang du bsgyur/ grwa ba sum brgya bzhi bcu 'dus / me lug(1907)lor sku zhabs lnga ba skal bzang ngag dbang rgya — 395 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/mtsho gdan sar bkod/ khong chas pa'i gshis me ru nyin gyi rgad po ban de'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya ma tshos thugs thag bcad de dgung lo drug steng gdan sar bkod/ g.yu 'brug mdo'i(g.yu rtsi mdo'ang zer)bkra shis 'khyil gyi lha rams pa chos grags dge rgan du bsten/ phun tshogs skal bzang bas rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs/ chas pa'i gshis a khu bkra shis rgya mtsho las bsdus grwa dang blo brtag phar phyin skabs/ ba'i ba sbyangs / rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya ma/tsho las bsnyen par rdzogs shing kho tshe'i gur dgon du khrir lo gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo nyer ba'i ( 192 5) steng he 'khrug bslangs te tshogs chen 'du khang /nang chen/ mi 'khrugs lha khang / dam can btsan khang / spyi khang gnyi ga grwa shag nyer drug bcas rten dang brten pa mer btang ba dang grwa ba gsum bkums/ slar 'du khang bskyar bzheng du khong the bo stod smad du dbang lung bstsal bar 'al 'debs tshogs gsog mang po 'dus pa dang smad sog so nyid g.yon ru'i gzhi sgar du chibs bsgyur/ lo rdor dgon dang su mi dgon/ dgon pa sngon po/ maṇ+ḍal la'i dgon par phebs te thugs rje chen po dang brgya rtsa'i khrid/ 'khor chen dbang chen/ tshe dbang / mgon chos rjes gnang sogs bstsal/ da dung nā he dang a wa su mi/ pe cin du phebs te re zhig der bzhugs/ g.yog sgang gi mi ser gyis bla ma'i sbyor 'jags la brten nas me 'jig thams cad slar bzhengs/ rang yul du phebs phyin snga phyir bkra shis 'khyil gyi sman pa grwa tshang dang dus 'khor grwa tshang / kha gya'i sgar rnying / rang dgon bcas kyi khri la lo gsum re bzhugs/ de'i rjes byang gi dgon chen bzhi mjal skabs su thugs dam nyin bco lnga bzhugs bzhin/sku 'bum du sku gshegs so/ /me stag(1926)lor mkhan sprul drug pa da lta ba co ne'i bya rgod tshal ba dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rin po che sku bltams/ paṇa chen blo bzang nyi mas thugs thag bcad cing ti gu'i dge slong dkon mchog dpal bzang dge rgan du bsten/ mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i yang sprul phun tshogs skal bzang las rab byung dge tshul mnos/ chu sprel la gdan sar bkod/ bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwa 'grims te rdo rams pa sa dmar mdo'i bstan 'dzin las bsdus grwa dang blo brtag phar phyin sogs sbyangs 'bras legs pas ston mo byas/ rang dgon du bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor phyag len btsugs/ rme shul dkar po gshong mu to dgon pa'i khrir lo gsum bzhugs ring dgon pa de nyams gso gang legs dang rdo dkar dgon pa'i khri ba lo bzhi bzhugs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i 'du khang gi rten bzhugs thams cad rang gi tsho ba dang the bo'i mi ser mang bo'i zhal 'debs brten la nas rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag med/ mchod rdzas gdan cha sogs gya nom pa bsgrugs/ dgung lo so brgyad steng sku zhabs drug pa skal bzang sangs rgyas mtsho gdan sar bkod/ rje 'di ba kha gya'i sman lung du chu bya(192 2)lor yab tshul khrims dang yum snying mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ mdzod dge mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyi drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/bkra shis 'khyil gyi sngags rams pa shes rab dge rgan du bsten cing lcags 'brug la( 1940) gdan sar bkod/ bkra shis 'khyil nas mtshan nyid sbyong bar chas pa'i gshis dge bshes mtha' yas dge rgan du bsten/— 396 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sa khyi lor rkyen dbang gis pha yul grong gseb tu phebs nas thon skyed ngal rtsol du zhugs shing grwa ba las logarig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su btson du lo bcur bcug mthar dkar 'don thob rjes g.yu 'brug mdo'i grong du gzhis chags shing rang dgon slar gso la mdzad rjes che/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu phag lor sku gshegs so/ /'di ba'i gdan bzhugs dang dgongs rdzogs bcas pa mkhan po nyid nas bsgrubs/ da dung ma khan po dang sku 'bas bcas kyis dgon mtha'i mchod rten zhig gso dang ma ṇi 'khor khang mig drug la ma ṇi brgya lnga bcu/ a gzigs thang gi mchod rten 'ig gso legs por byas/ mkhan po sa khyi lor ngal rtsol sbyong brdar du zhugs pa dang ‘4rib gsar skabs rdung rdeg drag po myong / phyis su slar rang dgon du bzhugs nas rten dang brten pa bskyar bzheng la rem pa dang / lin than(bā tse)rdzong gi srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang khul srid gros rgyun u bzhugs ring 2 0 0 2lor sku 'das/ de nas yang mkhan rin po che gtsos pas198 2lor a mchog wa nang du yab rta mgrin skyabs dang yum gcod pa 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs pa sku 'bas bdun pa bstan pa rgya mtsho ma chog1994lo'i gnyis pa'i bcu gcig nyin gdan sar bkod do/ /chas pa rgya mkhar dgon du mtshan nyid dang smad rgyud/ 'ar du dus 'khor bcas 'dzin grwa gsu ma mnyam sbrags kyi tshul du chos spyod sna tshogs spel/ 'du khang gsum dang btsan khang gsum / bdud 'dul mchod rten/ lha khang gnyis/ spyi khang gsum/ sku zhabs dang mkhan po'i nang chen yod sar gser zangs kyi li sku nyis stong lhag dang gyan thang sdebs ris thang ga lnga brgya lhag bka' bstan sogs gsung 'bum sum stong /ma/chod rdzas yo byad so gas smad sog nas spyan drangs pa sha stag yin pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi dang me rta 'o ra rkyen dbang gis yongs su bsnubs / dgon par skabs der rang gso'i sa 'ing rgya 'jag bcu tsam gyi sa 'ing dang nang chen spyi gzhung bcas par phyugs zog brgya rta drel bcu lhag spyi rdzas dngul sgo ra stong phrag du ma mchis shing dge 'dun pa'i yong sgo gtso bo rang khyim dang mang ja la brten/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzom sa gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun te rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags/ sprel la slar chos sgo phye bas da lta dge 'dun pa brgya sum cu lha ga 'dus shing 'du khang chung ba dang gnas chung btsan khang / rnam rgyal ma chod rten/ spyi khang / nang chen/ ma ṇi 'khor khang du ma bcas grub la tshogs chen 'du khang bzhengs grub ste chos spyod spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /yer ba dgon bsam grub gling /ye ra ba dgon bsam grub gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bā tse ste lin than rdzong gi la'o hron 'ang ta re nang zhes pa'i nye smad du chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i(a ti sha981—10 54)dngos slob rig gnas lnga ra mkhas pa zhig gis btab/ de nas lo nyis brgya bcu phrag gcig la nye ba'i tshod rje bdag nyid chen po—— 397 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/(1257—141'a)'khrungs/ yang lo rgyus kha shas su rgya'i zon lho ma'i hro zhin khri rabs skabs(11 21—1161)btab kyang zer/ zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ ha lam rab byung gsum pa'i lo mgo me yo sa te spyi lo1147lo la garma bka' brgyud kyi chos sde zhig phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang a ti shi'i slob ma zhig gis bka' gdams par bcos nas yun ring 'das par grags/ de rjes 'gro mgon 'phags pa mchog dang blon chen yar klung khri chen rnam pa zung gis gnas gzigs dang zhal bkod lta ra bod yu la sa skya'i dgon lag brgya dang brgyad kyi gras su bcug kyang de nas rje byams chen chos rje'i bka' dang co de'i sa skyong gi dmigs 'dun las khong gis kyang dge lugs su bsgyur/ de bzhin mdo smad chos 'byung du'ang / co ne zhes bya'i sa yi thig ler ni/ /co ne khag lnga'i thog ma yer ba'i dgon/ /a ti sha dang thes se tshangs yan gyi/ /bu slob kyis btab byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs/ dgon khag lnga bo ni gong so dang yer ba dang(sngar 'og tu mkhar zlum po zhig yod/)co ne dgon chen/ nags mdo/ tsha rdor bcas dgon pa rtsi ba'am ga'an kha shas drangs pa'ang snang / skabs de tsam gyi ring ched dpon g.yang skal bzang dang de'i rjes 'brang bla ma tsha rdor ba zhes bya ba byon/ mi ser gyi khrod du dgon gnas la/ ri sdings bde maṇ+ḍal them/ khyung chen gshog pa brkyangs 'dra'i dgon zhes thogs so/ /dgon pa btab nas yun ring gi dus shig na yul de nyid nas bod mi grung bo gong nas tha'e kyam bskos myong ba dbon shes rab(hru'u h+yen) zhes pa zhig byon pa la/ 'di ba nar son rjes rgya yul du 'khyams pa dang rgya nang 'byor phyin kho'i yon tan dang rig pa'i khyad chos mkhyen nas/ khong bod dbus su rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa gdan 'dren du bka' mngags dang de min rgyal bos khong 'bar ma dang / bal bo/ rgya gar/'bras ljongs/ pha khi si than/ ma ta ka si khar sogs phyi gling rgyal khab dag tu thengs lngar pho nya mngags/sku na bgres pa'i tshe na rang yul du log dus khong la mkhan po'i go sa'i cho lo bstsal cing dngos po gya nom pa'i rdzongs pa gnang / brdzangs bstabs des yer ba dgon pa 'ig gso rgya skyed bla lhag tu btang / hū'u byen zhes pa'i sku'i 'das lo rtsad ma chod kyang / gong mas kho'i gdung mchod du blon chung gnyis mngags nas mya ngan byas/ de gnyis ni dbon shes rab la dad pa che ba'am yul dang dgon pa'i dgos ma kho'am ci'i don yul der lus shing sku tshe mtha' zon pa ma zad khong gnyis ga'i gdung yang hū'u khyen gyi gdung gi 'gram tsam du sbos shing rdo ring btsugs nas dgon pa dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus bkod/ phyis su 'khrug rkyen las rdo ring sar bsnubs zer mod da snga rngog ma thub par gter du lus/ hū'u h+yen dpon po lags kyi sku rabs rjes ma rnams e dag gsal cha 'byin dka' yang lo rgyus yig rnying 'ig dang dgon pa'i ma yig tu bkod pa rnams mtshan mi gcig pa re yod pa 'dir drangs na/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ye shes dpal ldan/ dbon po lags/ ban de 'phags/ 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas/ gling tsha/ ngag dbang thugs rje/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ grags pa rgya mtshan/ rta mgrin rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang don grub— 398 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/(dgon pa'i thag nyer sku 'khrungs/ khong gis dbus nas 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhig gdan drangs)dang / yang na bkra shis don grub/ skyes mchog bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje rgya' mtshan/bsod nams rin chen/ tshul khrims seṅge / bsam gtan seṅge / rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rin chen/ bkra shis seṅge / blo bzang 'jam dbyangs / bsam grub rgya mtsho (co ne'i rtsen po nas sku 'khrungs)sogs rim par byon skad/ da lta'i mkhan chen hu'u blo bzang yon tan rgya mtsho(hū'u krin min༈yo1wa)lags ni kun lho'i 'brug chu'i yul du sku 'khrungs pa la rgya skad du yā min the yī zhes 'bod/ 'o rgyus dag tu khong la sku rabs bco brgyad byon skad/ da lta 'di ba2007lor dgung lo96glebs pa 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba'i skabs yin la/ khong gis yer ba'i mkhan po'am blo dpon sku rabs bco brgyad bcu dgu 'das song gsungs/ gzhan yer ba'i zhabs drung mchog sku rabs gsum brgyud pa'i rjes ma ni 'bas drung rna bzhi skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa rgya mtsho lags te bkra shis 'khyil ba'i sman pa grwa tshang gi khri ba bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i lo rgyus ring ba dang chag 'jig kyang thengs mang thebs/ rje hū'u h+yen nam dbon shes rab kyis skyong skabs su 'du khang dang lha khang bcu gsum yod kyang 'khrus rkyen las mang shos 'jig pa dang slar bzhengs pa ni dgur gyur/ de rjes tsam la tshogs gsum sa skyong dang tsi pu'i btsan(btsan yer khyim gcig (stsaḥ—za)zer don ni yer ba'i rgyud las btsan mched)sa skyong gi stobs shugs der bsrings nas rgyab skyor sbyor 'jags bgyis/ yer ba'i bla dpon gyi dbang thang je cher gyur te srid don pho brang bkra shis dpal 'bar zer ba bzhengs shing gser dang dngul gyis sku gsung thugs rten mang bo bzhengs te/ snga ma tsam la yer ba'i skyes mchog bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba sku na phra dus rang dgon chos grwa 'grims shing phyis su dbus gtsang chos sde mang bor phyag phebs te mang 'gyed dang phyag skor gnas mjal mdzad pa dang / spyi lo1510lo ste rab byung dgu ba'i lcags lug la rang dgon du phyag 'byor nas tshogs chen 'du khang rgya bskyed pa dang lha khang du ma bzhengs/ btsan sa skyong(mgo tshang dpon po zer)dgon bdag gi gras su bzhag pa dang dbon shes rab bam hū'u gyen gyi rgyud pa dngos nas chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs lag tu bstar/1581lo ste lcags sbrul lor gdong gzigs nang gi dge slong blo bzang 'phrin las kyis dgon pa'i sngar gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi khar rgyud pa grwa tshang btsugs/ skabs de tsam la tshogs sum yāng sa skyong dang g.yang yong sde ba'i rus dbang can bcas yer ba'i dbon por bskos pas dgon pa slar dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa dang grwa btsun lnga brgya lhag 'dus/ 1862lor dgon par da dung lha khang dang 'du khang bcas bdun yod kyang ka ju dang tsong chu'i rgyud kyi don rkyen bslangs pa tshogs sum dang yer bar slebs te grwa ba mang bo bkrongs shing sku gsung thugs rten bcom/ lha khang dang grwa shag kha shas mer bsgron/ de'i rkyen grwa ba rnams lo bcu gnyis ring rang dgon du bzhugs ma thub/ 1875lo'i dpyid kur slar grwa mang gis spyil bu phub cing 'du khang dang /byams khang / kyai rdor lha khang / mgon khang / gnas bcu lha khang / 'jigs byed lha khang / sman bla — 399 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/khang / du4'kho ra ltakhangabacas rim par bzhengs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo sogs skyesaphob mang bo'i sku brnyan dang gsung 'bum bzhugs/ yang rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sbrul te spyi lo1929lor yul 'khrug byung skabs su ha'e rigs mā krung dbyin gyis dgon pa me btang zhing btsun pa rnams bkrongs/ rgyu nom 'phrogs nas brgya cha drug cu'i yan brlags/ de 'phral dgon par bzhugs pa'i mkhan po zon lags(rdo dbus tan zhi grong gi mi)ni krung hwa min go'i mtha' mtshams srung skyob tshogs pa'i kru'u rin gzhon pa dang sog bod rgyal skyong bla ma to'u to bzhugs pa des sku drin thugs skyong las slar tshogs chen 'du khang dang / thos bsam lha khang / rgyud pa'i lha khang / gnas bcu'i lha khang / sgo mo che'i thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bcas ci 'dzoms bzhengs grub/ rab byung de ga'i sa khyi lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi khyad dbang ma lus gtsang phyags byed skabs su dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad yongs su 'jig cing dge 'dun pa brgya dang bdun cu bzhugs pa rnams rang rang pha yul du bskrad pa la phal cher grwa sa las log par gyur to/ /yer ba dgon pa'i rten bzhugs su tā ming hūng wu stong khun rgyal bo'i mtshan byang gser las grub pa dang /nyug rum dbon shes rab(hū'u h+yen)gyi sku gdung rdo'i mchod rten srog shing skyes pa phyi nas mthong ba/ dom tsha nang so kon ting tā kau shri bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i gos sku chen po/ gser dngul las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/ gos sku ngo mtshan can/ bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten mthong grol gzhu 'dom bco lnga can/ chos srid 'al lce brkos pa'i rdo ka ma ru'i rdo ring / g.yang ṭi las bzhengs pa'i hū'u h+yen(dbon shes rab)/ rje btsun byams pa byin can/ tshe smon gling ba'i na bza'/ mgon po li ma rang byon/ dge bshes thang nag pa'i mgon po'i gna' thang / yer ba'i nang chen gyi rdo ma ṇi rang byon/dpal ldan a ti sha'i phyag ts+tsha mgon po phyag drug pa/ jo bo rin po che'i phyag ts+tsha rje sku/ yum dbu yig gser brdung glegs bam mtha' ru bkra shis rtags brgyad bkod pa/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gser nag gis brgyan pa/ tshogs sbub 'gangs chen(da lta dge slong yon bstan pa'i phyag tu tshags pa de shog sgor chig stong gis slar nyos nas dgon du tshags pa)de min rje tsong kha ba/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ gnas bcu sogs gser dngul zangs tsan dan gyi sku shin tu mod pa dang mdo gdugs sgrol gsum dang srung 'khor byin can dkon po'i shing par bsgrugs pa ma zad/ gtsug lag tu gtsug lag chig stong lhag bzhugs so/ /dgon par tshogs chen du thos bsam gling ba 'bras sgo mang ba'i phyag len dang / rgyud stod smad stag tshang lha mo'i phyag len gyi srol dar ba dang / yer ba'i mkhan po dang zhabs drung / mgo bzang(mgo tshang)bla ma pā'o bsam gtan/ khya dge'i zhol sgang bla ma/ brag sgom pa dang / dbal ma tshang / gur yag tshang bcas pa'i nang chen bdun yod/ grwa ba'i 'byung khongs ni co ne'i gshin gtsang dang khya dge sna lung /gtsang pa ba/ bā tse(lin than)rdzong gi khrang khron dang g.yang yong / lo'u hron/ zhin khrin/ bar mdo/— 400 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khrin chi bcas zhang bcu'i bod pa mang shos dang rgya rigs skor zhig rab tu byung / mchod gzhis su gtso bo tshogs sum nang dang gnyan gtsang / yer ba'i thang sogs yod pa dang / gdan sa gsum du yer ba'i dge 'dun pa chos sgor 'grim pa'i khang tshan sogs yod/ dgon pas sngar nas rang kha rang gso gtso byed pa'i srol du gtan gtsang dang stag pa lung / rta mgo phug ra rgya nang / ka ci phud(tha sna sgo bzhi)sgar 'og mtha' 'dug bcas su sa zhing mu'u sum brgya lhag dang lung stod du nags tshal yod/ dngul sgor stong phrag du ma skyed lci'i bu lon gtong ba ma zad/ lo re'i zla gcig lhag ring grong chog gam bso da snyoms slong ba'i lugs spel to/ /lo re'i chos spyod thad du zla dang bor lha mo'i phyag gtor 'bum dang / dbon shes rab hū'u khyen tshang dang tshogs sum/ gro bo dpon po(dpon tshang chung ba thig)gsum gas sman ring dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum lo gsum rer thengs re 'dzin pa dang / chos rgyal gyi lcags mkhar/ tshes bco lngar 'cham/ zla gnyis par rgyan 'jug dang sman ring / sku rim rnam bzhi/ zla gsum par kun rig bdag 'jug sbyin sreg zla ba'i bar rgyud pa'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ thos bsam nang sman ring / gsang 'dus sa chog dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg bcas/ zla lnga bar ma ṇi bdun sgrub/ zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas brgyad pa'i tshes gcig bar dbyar gnas/ zla bdun par grwa tshang lhan tshogs su rgyan 'jug zla brgyad par chos thog gong mthun nyin bco lnga/ zla dgu bar dus bzang bde 'jigs sa chog sbyin sreg bcas/ zla bcu bar chos res nang khag che gsum gyi mang 'gyed byed/ rje tsong kha ba'i gdung mchod/ bskang gso/ gtor rgyaga'acham sogs/ zla bcu gcig par grong chog phebs/ zla bcu gnyis par rgyud pa'i skang gso chen mo/ thos bsam gling ba'i bla dpon mkhan po'i mgon po'i gtor rgyag yod/ las sne la bla ma dbu mdzad gsum/tshogs chen khri ba/ grwa tshang 'chad nyan gsum sogs chos mdzad do dam pa rnams lo gsum re'i nang thengs re brjes/ de bzhin bcings 'grol rjes su chos spyod thams cad lo ngo bco brgyad mtshams chad pa de rab rgyal shing byi lo(1984) nas slar gsos te 'du khang dang grwa shag thun mong can khang mig nyi shu bzhengs shing /dge slong stag sum phu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho(brgyad stong) dgung lo don bdun bzhes pa dang btsun gzhon nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal 'dzoms/ dad ldan mang tshogs khyim tshang560ste mi grangs 2800lhag yod/ nye char chos spyod legs par spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /tsha rdor dgon bkra shis byams pa rnam rgyal gling /tsha rdor dgon bkra shis byams pa rnam rgyal gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bā rtse rdzong khrin chi zhang gi mā chi lung ba'i byang de'u ru chags/ da skabs lha khang gyan gsum bzhengs te mang tshogs kyis phyag mchod byed bzhin yod/— 401 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa 'di ha lam hor se chen rgyal bo'i dus ste spyi lo1260lo'i sngon du btab pas co ne'i sa skya'i dgon khag lnga'i gcig tu gtogs shing sa skya'i lugs nas dge lugs par 'gyur/ dgon pa dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun pa'i 'byung khungs la mar nang dang / bka' lung / steng ga rta bo sogs te da lta'i bā tse'i khrin chi dang hri min/ co ne'i tho yan/ gtsang pa ba bcas kyi zhang khongs gtogs/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang / sgro la ma khang / sman bla khang / ma ṇi khang sogs gser gyi rgya phibs can bdun bzhengs shing byams sku byin can lo rgyus can dang / sman bla klu byon ma/ rje thugs rje lhun grub pa'i thugs dam rten thub dbang gsung 'byon ma sogs 'gangs chen mang bo rten du bzhugs/ dgon pa'i chos spyod du gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ cho 'phrul dang sa ga zla ba'i chos res la 'cham/ byams pa gling skor/ bde gsang 'jig gsum/ kun rig tshe dpag med/ sman bla sogs kyi sgrub mchod rgyas pa dang / da dung dgon rnying 'di nas tsha rdor khri chen thugs rje lhun grub dang / de'i sku mched na len+t+ra'i mkhan po tshul khrims dar rgyas/ de'i dbon po rgyud stod mkhan po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ gshin gtsang ngag dbang dge 'dun/ tshe smon gling ba sku phreng dang bo tsha rdor ngag dbang tshul khrims sogs mang bo rim par byon kyang lo rgyus kyi dus 'khrug dang don rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang lo'i yar sngon du chag 'jig thengs mang thebs te rten dang brten pa ste sku gsung thugs rten dang btsun pa'i chos tshogs la gnod 'tshe ya nga ba byung ba dang / rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul nang zing skabs su sngar gyi 'du khang ngo mtshar du bzhengs pa de dang grwa shag yongs su bsnubs mthar rgya rigs gtsos pa'i grong tsho zhig tu gyur to/ /'di nas khyad du skyes chen gnyis ngo sprod rags tsam zhus na/ gcig ni tshe smon gling ba sku phreng dang bo bod kyi srid skyong du bzhugs pa ngag dbang tshul khrims rin po lags te/ khong ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang ste spyi lo172 1lor co ne'i tho yan zhang gi rta bo mdo'i yab chos skyong dang yum tshe g.yang gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun steng rab tu byung tsha rdor dgon par zhugs nas klog slob mdzad pa dang bcu drug steng co ne dgon chen du phebs te rje grags pa bshad sgrub mchog dge rgan du bsten tshad ma'i gzhung sbyangs/nyer gsum steng dge rgan gyi bka' ba'in se ra smad grwa tshang gi tsha rdor khams tshan 'grims te slob gnyer mthar phyin pa la175 0lor lha rams pa'i dge bshes ang dang bo thob cing rgyud stod pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad bskos pa dang / rgyud stod pa'i khri ba dang dga' ldan shar rtse grwa tshang sogs kyi chos rjer bzhugs/ 1768lor gong ma 'i bka' dang yar gyi mtshams sbyor bzhin pe cin du chibs bsgyur nas yo hong kon nam bde ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan por bskos shing mkhan po i ti ni no min han gyi mtshan bstsal/ 1777lor bod kyi srid skyong dang phyi lor dga' ldan khri rabs re gcig par bskos/ rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos yongs 'dzin du bsten/ bod yul du gdugs sum brtsegs kyi bla ma thogs pa de'i stabs yin/ dgung lo don gcig pa spyi lo1791lor se ra theg chen gling du sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /— 402 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/skyes chen gzhan gcig ni tho'u ju'i tsha rdor sku skyes zon ma khan po zhes pa de yin/ khong spyi lo1869lor da lta'i bā tse rdzong hri min(brag sgo la bod skad kyis rdo dbus zer)zhang gi dran chu ho'u grong du sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus nas tsha rdor grwa sa 'grims pas yon tan sbyong ba legs/ dbus su phebs nas lha rams pa'i dge bshes blangs pa dang se ra dgon pa'i mkhan po zhig gi go gnas la bzhugs / pha yul du phyag phebs gnang rjes mtshan snyan grags che ba'i dbang gis co ne ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling dang yer ba bsam grub gling /rang dgon tsha rdor bkra shis byams pa rnam rgyal gling gi gser khrir mnga' gsol ba ma zad/ men ju'i hwa tang dgon dang / kyang the dgon/ sna lung dgon/ nya'o yin dgon sogs chos sde bcu phrag gi bla mar bzhugs nas bstan don rgyas par ma dzad/ krung hwa min go tshugs rjes kyi1919lor go min tang srid gzhung gi bod sog u yon lhan khang gis to to'u zhes pa'i go gnas la gdan drangs pa dang krung go'i mtha' mtshams zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i kru'u rin gzhon par bskos shing rgyal srung chos rje zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / co ne ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling gi mkhan po blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs/ khong ni bod kyi slob gso dar bar thugs mos shin tu che bas/ co ne'i btsun pa'i chos spyod dang rgyal yig(rgya skad dang rgya yig la zer)slob grwa zhes bya ba btsugs nas grwa ba gzhon nus nyin phyed chos sbyong ba dang nyin phyed bod rgya skad yig slob tu bcug khong gis dgon pa skyong ba de lo rgyus 'phel rim la bstun nas mi rigs yar rgyas la thugs khur mdzad pa 'dir lo rgyus kyi don snying dang mig dpe'i dpang rtags su gyur 'dug go/ / /mar snyung dgon byams pa gling /mar snyung dgon byams pa gling zhes pa ma ṇi dgon yang 'bod de/ da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bā tse(spra tshal)rdzong gi chu bo thang ga 'ang gi khongs su chags/chos sde 'di ni lo rgyus su dar yun ring zhing rig gnas gzi dpal 'bar ba'i gnas mchog cig yin te/ming rgyal deb ther dang ching rgyal chan lung lo rgyus ltar na/ mar snyung dgon pa'i bla dpon gyis ching rgyal pho brang la phul pa'i 'brel yod zhu yig tu bstan pa'i bdag gyur ma ṇi dbon po zhes pa sku na phra dus rab tu byung zhing ming rgyal hung wu khri lo'i skabs(spyi lo1 272)su shog pa'i sne khrid de rgya'i gong mar mgo btags gshis/gong mas khong la blo gros rnam par rgyal ba'i bla dpon zhes mtshan bstsal cing bod dang bod yul 'ob 'gag bsrung bar mnga' 'bas su chu bo tsho ba nyer bzhi'i(tsho ba bzhi bo ni/ thang nang dang / ske gshis/ ma'ang /brag rtsa/ gzan po lung / zhi shis khog mtha' rna/ nor btsan/ pa 'ang / chu bo thang ga pho yon/phu rtsa gshis/ kha sho sgang / stag ra nang / nags rtsi sgang / dpa' shis/ cog ro/ spo shol/ tsha mgoblo ru lung / blo ru de'u/ dpa' de'u/ dpa' mo che/ paṇa lung thang)bdag por gyur ces bkod 'dugaming rgyal rabs ma tshugs pa'i snga rol yon rgyal se chen hu pi lis 'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan— 403 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/(12 25—1280)la sa skya'i chos sde brgya dang brgyad 'dzugs dgos pa'i bka' bsgos dang blangs mdzad pa'i gras kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ bstan bdag sku phreng dang bo bod dbus nas phyag phebs pa rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes pa'ang ma ṇi dbon po gang yin mu mthud brtag par bya dgos pa dang / sku rabs gnyis pa dpal ldan dbang phyug ces pa ste ming yon khri lo gsum pa(1405lo)sngar gyi rgyud 'dzin mdzad de mar snyung byams pa gling dngos su btab pa dang / ming rgyal dmag dpon chen po tsha'o go gung(li'u wun krung)gi rjes 'brangs nas the bo rong khul 'thab 'gug byas par grub 'bras legs pas khong la ma ti ba cho lo zhes pa dang rgyud 'dzin bla dpon sbrags brgya dpon zhes par bskos phyin chos srid zung 'brel gyi bla dpon lam lugs dngos su 'grub par rmang btings so/ /sku rabs gsum pa byams pa mkhas btsun zhes ming rgyal krin thung khri lo gsu ma pa spyi lo1428lor bla dpon gyi rgyud zhing pe cin rgyal sar rten 'bul du phyin pas blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i chos bdag ces pa'i bla dpon go sa bstsal/ sku rabs bzhi ba sangs rgyas tshe ring zhes pa ming rgyal krun te khri lo bcu gnyis par(1517)bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung ba la blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i chos bdag gi cho lo gnang / sku phreng lnga ba rgyal mtshan(thog mar mtshan du shes rab dpal bzang 'bod)te ming rgyal khri lo kyā cin la bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung zhing gong mar mchod 'bul phebs pas dgon mtshan gnang ba dang bkur gzo khyad par thob/ sku rabs drug pa thub dbang rgyal mtshan nam ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhes pas ming rgyal ban li khri lo ste lo1586lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / sku rabs bdun pa grags pa don grub ces pa ni ha cang spyang grung ldan pas brgya dpon zhor du bzhugs shing / hran zhi'i tsung tu'u(spyi khyab bdag skyong)lan kru'u h+phu yon zhes pa'i bka' thugs su bzhes te tho'u ju'i bod mi ser tsho ba so gsum(tho'u ju'i bod tsho ba so gsum ni/ tshe rtsi dang sgang bya/ srin po che/ rdzogs chen gshis/ bya tshang / yar steng / ra 'khor/ a 'bum tshal/lung ri bcas pa'i khar mar snyung tsho ba nyer bzhi bsnan)de dag gi mnga' 'bangs su 'dul 'bul bgyis/ sku rabs brgyad pa ngag dbang dbang phyug ces pa chin rgyal hron kri'i khri lo bzhi ba ste spyi lo1647lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / tho'u ju'i khongs gtogs bā tse(spra tshal)gdong sne'i tin chi1ṭha zhes pas rkyen log byas par khong gis bod dmag drangs nas de'i mgo bregs te gong mar phul pas byas rjes che bar mngon cing tho'u ju'i yul srung mkhan gyi cho lo thob/ khang zhi khri lo so dgu ba ste spyi lo1700lor slar gong mas blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i chos bdag gam shog pa'i krung mā zhes pa'i go gnas dang mar snyung dbon po zhes pa'i mtshan bstsal/ sku rabs dgu ba sho ba tshe ring zhes pas yon brin khri lo'i skabs su bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung zhing snga srol ltar mtshan rtags gsol pa dang dpung phyogs las sne khang nas mkhan po'i phyag rgya bstsal pa bcas tho'u ju'i lo rgyus su gsal ler bkod/ sku rabs bcu ba dpon slob grags pa rgya mtsho gong ma chan lung gi bka' ltar pe cin du phebs nas zhabs brtan bsgrubs pas na/ chan lung gi gcung gis slob dpon bkur cing sog yul krin hong mda' tshan gyi dgon pa'i khri ba mnga' gsol/ sku rabs bcu gcig pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis chan lung da 404 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khri lo bcu bzhi ba spyi lo1742lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / sku rabs bcu gcig byams pa bsam gtan 'es pas kyā chin khri lo bcu dgu spyi lo1rnga14lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / yang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la mā zhang zhes pa mtshan bstsal pas bla dpon tshang la rgya'i rus thogs pa ma zad mi ser gyi khrod rus mā 'dogs pa dar bar gyur/ sku rabs bcu gsum pa byams pa mkhas btsun zhes pa to kwang khri lo ba'i ba spyi lo18 2 4lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / sku rabs bcu ba'i ba mā khrin lung zhes par tho'u ju gzhung nas dpon rim drug ma'i zhwa tog zhus pa la gong ma 'i bka' bsgos ltar zi ling gzhung tshab dmag rgyag tu mdzad rjes ba'ag stabs zhwa tog sgro sngon can bstsal pa dang sa cha'i spyi khyab stong dpon tu grags/ de ba'in to kwang khri lo sum cu ba spyi lo1850lor bla dpon gzhung las gnyer ba dang mar snyung shog pa brgya stong dpon dud tshang can du bsgyur/sku rabs bco lnga ba mā krung kho(sku gong ma'i gsos bu)zhes pa sku na phra dus 'brog khul du nar son pas rta rgyug mda' 'phen byang ba dang sku gong ma'i zhabs rjes 'brangs nas zi ling gzhung tshab bcas pa 'gog rgol byas par mdzad rjes mchis phyir zhwa
