tog sgro khra can te to'u zi thob slar yang hran zhi'i kung khrang h+phu'u ru jag tshogs kyis bkum par bskyar ba'i dmag dpon skyob rog bgyis pas spyi lo1858lor bla dpon rgyud 'dzin dang zhor du shog pa'i stong dpon mdzad du bcug sku rabs bcu drug pa ngag dbang don grub ces pa thung kri khri lo bcu ba spyi lo1884lor bla dpon gyi rgyud bzung / sku rabs bcu bdun pa 'phags pa skyabs zhes pa zhon thung khri lo gsum pa spyi lo1911lor dbon po'i go sa nas bla dpon gyi tshab bzhes/ sku rabs bcu dgu ba mā khre zho ste mā chos skyabs zhes pa min go khri lo nyer lnga ba spyi lo1926lo nas1945lor(min rgyal khri lo so bzhi par)rgyud 'dzin bla dpon du bzhugs/ chos skyabs khong la do dam gyi nus pa cung zhan pas khong gi a khu gnam kho zhes pas bla dpon skyong rogs sam bla dpon gzhon pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ min rgyal khri lo so lnga ba spyi lo1946lor bla dpon gnyi gas rang mos su go gnas phud cing / dgon phyi nang gi don dag thams cad mā gser ro dang mā brgyad stong rnam pa zung gis rab rgyal sa khyi(1958)lo bar bskyangs pa dang chu stag nas me rta bar yang mā brgyad stong lags kyis thugs skyong legs par gnang ngo / /mar snyung dgon pa'i khongs gtogs dgon lag la drin dran dgon pa dang brag sgam nang dgon pa/phan yon dgon pa/ pe lin khre long ri khrod/ ba rwa'i ri khrod/ a smon ri khrod/ lo rwa'i ri khrod/ mdo rtsa ri khrod/ gtsang 'khor ri khrod/ rgyal lung ri khrod dang nang sog krin h+phang mda' tshan dgon pa bcas yod/dgon pa ches dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun pa zhal grang dgu brgya lhag 'dzoms zer/ dgon par bla sprul rgyud rim brgyad ma chis te/ mar snyung sku zhabs(bla ma che ba) sku phreng bdun brgyud de yang srid blu mtshams chad/bla ma mkhar chen pa(bla ma chung ba)ste mā bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan lags dgung lo nga bzhi'i steng1996lo'i zla lnga ba'i nyi shu ba'i lugs gsar zla bdun pa'i tshe dgur glo bur sku gshegs so/ /bla ma 'di gnyis ni dgon bdag tshang nas dngos su blu dgos shing go sa bla sprul ga'an pa las mtho bas dgon bdag gi tshab mdzad chog de da 405 da

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong si longs/min mar snyung rab 'byams pa/ skya bla ma/ mar snyung chos rje nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ a myes smra ra can/chos rje kun spangs blo bzang dar rgyas zhes pa sogs byon/ dgon pa'i sbyin bdag mi ser la ma ra snyung bla dpon gyi khongs gtogs da lta'i chu bo 'ang mang shos las da dung bā tse rdzong si gur chen 'ang dang brang kon 'ang /co ne rdzong gi ta tsu'u(bod rus chen pa)zhang dang mkhar chen 'ang gi mi ser mang bo bcas 'dus / dgon par mtshan nyid dang rgyud pa grwa tshang gnyis tshugs pa la tshogs chen 'du khang dang dri gtsang khang / rgyud stod 'du khang / mgon khang / bde mchog lha khang / kun rig lha khang / byams khang / gsang 'dus lha khang /sman bla'i lha khang / spyan ras gzigs lha khang / gdugs dkar lha khang sogs bzhengs shing rang rang gi sku gsung thugs rten yongs rdzogs dang sgrub mchod cha tshang yod/ de ba'in rten 'gengs chen byin can la gser zangs kyi byams sku thog tshad gnyis lhag can gyi thugs gar lha yul las byon pa'i byams pa bzhugs la byams khang yang de bstun bzhengs zer/ dngul srang stong phrag gis bzhengs pa'i thub sku byin can/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i na bza' cha tshang / rje sto nga sku li ma dang rigs lnga'i sku smin mtshams su mu tig phra re bkod pa sogs brjod kyis mi long / ta le lo ma'i bsta na chos glegs bam gcig dang bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur cha tshang / gong ma chan lung gis gnang ba'i gser tham dang sga chas sogs bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i lo rgyus ring bas man chin rgyal rabs gnyi gar mdza' 'brel zab cing / skabs de'i gong ma rnams kyis gzigs pa che la rang dgon du'ang mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i dam pa mang bo byon/ kha shas pe cin du phebs nas gong mar rim gro mang du bgyis la la sog po dang man ju pa rigs kyi sku drag tshos dbu blar bkur/ ming rgyal deb ther du/ ming rgyal rabs kron te khri lo bcu gnyis pa spyi lo1517nas162 4lo'i bar mar snyung dbon po dang bla dpon/ skyes chen dam pa/ gong ma mjal 'bul chas pas slar gsol ston bya dga' gna' srol snga lugs lta bu yin/ dper na ming rgyal lban li khri lo bcu bzhi ba'i zla12pa me khyi spyi lo1586lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la mar snyung dbon po rgyal sar gong mar 'bul rten bskyel pas ston mo rgyas pa bshams/ der mthud tshes bdun nas tshes bcu gcig slar bod dmag dgu brgya dang bcu khrid cing li sku dang mchod rten du ma mchod 'bul zhus/ gong ma'i 'bas spyi bor blangs shing khong la gnang sbyin spam mtho dang shugs rkyen legs tsam thob/ dge bshes ches grags snyan che ba bkra shis grags pa zhes par shes bya'i yon tan 'byams klas shing bstan gzhung byang du chub pas/ ming rgyal lban li khri lo'i dus su pe cin du bzhud pa la blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i chos bdag bstsal cing chos sde du ma'i khrir gsol ba la ho thog thu'i cho lo gnang ba dang sog po'i rgyal bos gtsug tu bkur/ dus de nas ching rgyal khang zhi khri lo bco brgyad pa spyi lo1892lo bar sku phreng bcu blus shing mar snyung ma dgon yin pas bsnyen 'bul rgya cher gnang / bla dpon sku rabs bcu ba grags pa rgya mtsho zhes pa gong ma'i bka' dang du bzhes nas rgyal sar phebs te gong mar dbang bka' chos mang du gnang ba dang gong ma'i gcung gis dbu blar bsten/ krin hong mda' tshan dgon — 406 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/par khri bzhugs ma dzad/ 'di'i rjes ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi sku gcung ngag dbang rin chen zhes pas chan lung /khri lo bcu ba'i ste spyi lo1749lor kung khrang gzhung gi tshe 'bum dgon pa bdag skyong mdzad/ mar snyung dpon blo bzang dkon mchog ces pa dbus nas grwa sa 'grims par lha rams dam bca' dang bo thob cing se ra dgon pa'i smad grwa tshang mkhan sa gnang(spyi khyab tu mar snyung mkhan po zhes thogs)ba ma zad/ rang yul drin can dgon pa'i(drin dran ri khrod)bla rabs dang bor bkur to/ /bla dpon gzhung gnyer khang(yu mon)du bla dpon khong nyid pas da dung drung yig gcig dang 'go ba chen po gcig 'go ba gnyis/ dmag ru'i dpon po(khrang 'an)gnyis/ gzhung g.yog pa mi du ma bcas las sne grub cing / yā mo na du btson khang tshugs par btson srung ba 'ga' re dang khrims chas sna tshogs bsgrugs te mi ser gyi gyod don gtug bsher sogs don gnyer byas so/ /dgon par yang ser dmag bco brgyad bskos pa ni rang dgon grwa ba gzhon nu'i gras nas bdams te/ phal che ba ni khyim tshang cung phyug cing rtsal stobs ldan la ba'on pa dang mtshon cha bsgrug thub nges can yin/ kho tsho'i 'gan dbang gtso bo ni dpon pos khrid de dgon pa bde 'jags bsrung dgos/ gzhan bla dpon sku srung ba brgyad bzhag pas bla dpon gyi bde 'jags dang yā mon bsrung ba'am nyes can 'dzin skyel/ bla dpon gyi rjes 'brangs nas g.yul las bya rgyu sogs yin no/ /dgon par sa cheng rgya 'jag('jag rer 'bru rigs rgya ma lnga brgya)so gsum ste mu'u su ma brgya sum cu dang nags tshal sa phyogs gcig phyugs ra gcig bcas gnyer bar khyim g.yog pa zer ba'i mi zer rnams 'khor res ngang rmo 'debs g.yul gcog sogs kyi ngal rtsol byed pa dang / 'ing las brel ba che dus nyin gla mi nyung ba re glas par las gla nges can ster/ grwa mang gi 'tsho rten gtso bo dad ldan mang tshogs kyi ma nga 'gyed rgyun ja dang dgon pa'i 'ing phyugs las yong 'bebs nyung shos la brten par bya la rang khyim nas mkho sprod med mi srid/spyir dgon pa'i bla dpon dang skyes chen dam pa/ mar snyu nga dbon po bcas ni sog po'am man ju rigs kyi gong ma dang rgyal bo sku drag rnams la 'brel 'dris che bas 'byor ldan 'di dag gi sbyor 'jags thob pa dang /rmi ser gyi khrod du'ang dbus gtsang dang / sog po phyi nang bcas su rgyu bas dgon par 'al 'debs dang rten rdzas 'gangs chen rin thang ga'al thabs med pa thob pa bcas kyis grwa mang gi 'tsho ba cung phyug por gyur to/ /khyad nga/ra gleng dgos pa ni thog ma'i mes po ma ṇi dbon po zhes pas ming rgyal hung wu khri lo drug par shog pa khrid de gong ma ra mgo btags par khong la blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i bla dpon gyi cho lo bstsal cing khongs gtogs bod rigs mi ser dang 'ob 'gag dang chu bo tsho ba nyer ba'i'i khyad dbang thob/ ming rgyal cin te'i khri 'o ra mar snyung dgon pa'i ma tshan gnang ba dang ching rgyal khang 'i khri lo so dgu lor bla dpon sku rabs brgyad pa ngag dbang dbang phyug la blo gros rnam par rgyas pa'i shog pa'i krung ma'am mar snyung dbon po'i mtshan gsol/dus de nas bzung rab rgyal sa khyi lo bar rgyud 'dzin lam lugs su grub cing khyim rgyud che shos btsun pa dag la chos srid zung gi khyad dbang chen po thob ste/ bla dpon gyi tshab bzhes chog cing gyod don gnad chen rigs — 407 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bā tse rdzong gi khongs/ gros bsduyobya rig4so/ / — — dgon pa 'di bdag skyong gnang mkhan las sne la khri ba dang tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ tshogs chen dge bskos/ spyan 'dren chen po/ rgyud pa'i dbu mdzad/ rgyud pa'i dge bskos / gnyer ba sogs du ma lo gnyis rer brjes te bzhugs / mtshan nyid 'dzin grwa gtsos pa'i lo re'i chos spyod gal chen la zla gcig pa'i smon lam dang / zla gnyis par 'jigs byed bdag 'jug rgyas pa/ zla gsum par rim gro so gas cho ga gal chen/ zla bzhi bar ma ṇi ril sgrub chen mo/ zla lnga bar dbyar gnas dang byams pa gling skor sogs/ zla brgyad par kun rig bdag 'jug rgyas pa/ zla dgu bar bla ma'i zhabs brtan sogs/ zla bcu gcig par lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu bar byams smon sogs cho ga sna mang spel to/ /de bzhin a mdo'i yu' du lo rgyus ring zhing rgya khyon che la/ gtsug lag phun sum tshogs pa/ gna' rdzas 'gangs chen mod pa zhig yin rung log spyod dbang sgyur gral rim gyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas nas lo rgyus su mi rigs nang khul g.yul 'gyed thengs mang byung stabs dgon pa chag 'jig thebs/ phyis su slar gsos kyang sngar bzhin bzheng thabs dben la btsun pa mi nyung ba skya sar bud pa dang bla sprul yang srid blu rgyun chad/ dgon pa phal cher gyang chag rtswa ldum can tu gyur pa la rab rgyal sa khyi lor dge 'dun pa bgres gzhon ba'i bcu lhag tu bri/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su tang gi srid jus dngos 'beb byas par brten198 1lor dgon pa'i chos sgo slar phye ba la dge tshul slong sum cu lhag zhal 'dus nas gzhung kha rnying ral du chos spyod spel ba tsam las grwa mang rang khyim du bzhugs pa dang khyim pa'i mkho sprod dang mang ja tsag tsig la brten nas 'tsho ba rol ba'in no/ /g.yis sgar ri khrod/g.yas sgar ri khrod ces pa ni/ de snga kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bā tse rdzong chu bo thang 'ang gi khongs su chags/ri khrod 'di ha lam lo ngo sum brgya'i yar sngon(chin rgyal rabs kyi dus)du g.yis sgar a myes dge legs sam dge slong zhes pa'i btsun pa grags can zhig yod pa des g.yis sgar sde ba dang sha bza' mdo sde ba gnyis ka sbyin bdag tu brten nas phyag 'debs mdzad cing / lha khang ka ring gsum ldan gser tshon spras pa rten dang brten pa dgon chung zhig la mnyam pa bzhengs/ phyis su co ne'i gur yag chos pa sku thog dang bo g.yis sgar a myes tshang la sku 'khrungs pa las khong nar son phyin ri khrod pha yul du yod pa bdag skyong gnang ri khrod pa dang sde bar dad gus ngang khong la ri khrod phul / skabs de nas rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar sku phreng lnga gas legs par bskyangs/ ri khrod du sku rten 'gangs chen mang bo ste bka' 'gyur sogs bzhugs pa dang / shug pa'i nags dkyil du dben gnas khyad par can logs su chu mig lhung lhung yan lag brgyad ldan gaṅgā'i chu sne lta bur sngags — 408 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa bcas ldan pas yul phyogs so so nas phyag phebs pa'i sgom sgrub nyams len pa bcu phrag yun ring bzhugs pa dang / dus rgyun mchod gzhis grong tsho zung gi dge 'dun bdun brgyad res grwa shag phub nas bzhugs/ kho tshos tha 'og pa srung mar bsten/ skabs shig kho tsho'i bka' 'gyur mtshar bo byin can de a mchog pa tshos brkus pa la yun ma 'gyangs par rkun mar cho 'phrul mang bo bstan gshis/ bka' 'gyur tshar gcig po 'dzin ma thub pa rje dbal mang che bar 'brel bgyis te slar mi sprod thabs zad du btang skad/ ri khrod du gur yag gzim khang phub/ chas pa rgya mkhar dgon pa'i smon lam dang lnga mchod kyi skabs su ri khrod pa rnams dgon pa'i 'og sgang yin bzhin phyag phebs gnang dgos/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor ri khrod rtsa ba nas bsnubs pa ma zad/da lta gyang shul lus pa rdza mgo'i nags brlags nas sngar nags tshal stug pos bklubs pa'i shul tsam yang mi mthong zhing da snga ri khrod slar gso ba'i cha rkyen ma 'dzoms so/ /

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/the bo rdzong gi khongs/gser thang dgon dga' ldan mkhas mang bshad sgrub gling /gser thang dgon dga' ldan mkhas mang bshad sgrub gling zhes pa ni / da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong gi bya 'bab(gtsang pa'ang zer)'ang srid gzhung gi nye logs su chags/dgon 'di'i dbyibs bkod kyi khyad par ni/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad tshang ba/ rgyab ri nor bu gsum brtsegs ldan pa/ mdun ri nor bu gsum brtsegs mngon pa/ de'i g.yarme g.yon gser nya kha sprod/mdun ri mtho zhing tshur la gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa/ chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan sne mo logs su bstan te bzhur ba/ dgon mtha' shing seng ldeng dang a gar dang tsan dan dkar po sogs kyi dri ngad 'thul ba bcas kyis ma dzes par bklubs so/ /dge lugs pa'i sgrub sde 'di ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa stag lor(spyi lo1lha 5〈)gser thang sprul ba'i sku sku phreng dang po bla ma thub bstan grags pas(blo bzang nyi ma bris pa'ang snang /) btab/ grub chen 'di nyid bsil ldan ra ba dkar pos yongs su bskor pa'i ljongs/ gser po rong chu tshur ri'i steng leb ces par yab mgon po rab brtan dang yum sgrol ma skyid kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me phag lor(171kha)sku bltams/ gzhon nu'i dus nas bshes gnyen du ma las klog bslabs pa sogs rim gyis gzhung sbyangs shing co ne'i nags mdo dgon du phebs te/ bla ma dam pa byang chub mi la zhes bya ba'i drung nas rab tu byung / phyis su rang nyid kyi bla ma de nyid sku gshegs rjes de'i gdung rus kyis sku 'dra 'debs skabs/ nags mdo dgon gyi li ma khang nas sku 'dra zhig blangs te par btab pa la bsnyad nas 'ga' zhig gis sa skyong dmag zor mgon po la phra ma bcug khong gis li ma khang gi sku 'dra la mi rus kyis sbags tshul zhus pas/ sa skyong des bka' drag po gnang nas chad par mar rgya ma lnga bcu bzhag pa la khor ngo chen ma byin par phul/ mar lhag ma'i tshab tu bka' 'gyur klog dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar tshar gcig bklags pa dang yang khong la 'don 'dod skyes te rgyal po'i zhabs brtan du bka' 'gyur tshar gcig 'don par zhus/ nyin re la po ti gnyis re gsungs pas rgyal po yid ma ches par grags pa bshad sgrub tshang la gsan du bcug dpon slob kyis kho gang zag khyad par can zhig 'dug dbugs gcig gi yun la'ang shog grangs mang po 'don par gda' gsungs pas na/ sa skyong dad pas bskul te yang bka' 'gyur 'don du bcug cing 'bul ba la bla ma'i chos gos cha tshang gnang ba ma zad bla chen gyi gral du bzhag dpon slob grags pa bshad sgrub pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs shing mdo sngags kyi bka' chos mang du gsan/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gror phan 'dogs pa'i ched du rang yul du phyir phebs nas khong dgung lo bzhi bcu'i dus su dgon pa 'di dngos su — 410 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/btab/ dgon sa yang bdag rkyen gyi tshul du co ne nas tshags med du bstsal/ de nas yul gyi chos phyogs bon pos bzung bas sa skyong la zhus te bon po rnams ban chos bya dgos tshul gyi bka' lci bar babs te bon mang ban du bsgyur/ 'du khang dang dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang / gnas bcu lha khang / sman bla khang bzhengs/grwa shag du ma phub/ de'i rjes su dgon pa'i sgrig lam dang 'don cha sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len mdzad/ dgon pa dang nye ba'i sar sgrub khang chung ngu zhig tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pas/ mdun ngos zhig tu skar ma zhig nyin ring la mi g.yo bar gnas pa dang / nye 'khor du 'ja' tshon ya nga shar/ kirti thogs med kyi lung bstan lta ra du bya bzang rgyab ri nas bde mchog pho brang gi gnas sgo gsar du phye zhing lha mo sgrub dus mchod me zhig nyin zhag du mar gnas pa dang / sku gshegs khar rtags mtshan mang bo dang bcas te/ dgung lo nga dgu ba me bya lo'i zla gsum pa'am nag pa zla ba'i bcu dgu'i nyin sku zhi bar gshegs so/ / sku phreng gnyis pa mkhas grub 'phrin las dbang phyug ni/ gser bo rong gi chu'i tshur ri bya bar dpa' mdzangs shing rtul phod pa/khyim gyi so nam las byar byang che ba stag skor zhes pa'i rus su yab mgon po don grub dang yum 'bum ris kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa khyi lo'i(1778)hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhir sku bltams/ de nas lo 'ga' 'gor rjes bstan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis ldan te co ne a smon gyi sku drung nas rab tu byung / kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas yul phyogs srung mar skyabs bcol te ngos 'dzin gnang zhing / kirti rgyud grwa'i thā la sprul skur bsten nas yi ge sogs bslabs shing bsnyen par rdzogs/ paṇa chen bsod grags pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs sogs 'don cha rnams blo la bzung nas sngags rams pa mdzad/ ni gu bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen las rig gnas thams cad sbyangs/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs las mi tra dang / shing bza' dpon slob las rdor phreng gsan/ lo mtshams zla mtshams du ma bcad nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs dang /bsnyen sgrub mang du mdzad pas nyams rtogs ngo mtshar brnyes/ gzhung lugs kun la gzhan dring mi 'jogadagung lo nyi shu'i bar der bzhugs/ gser thang dgon du phyir phebs nas tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang dang / rung khang rnams bskyar du phub/ lha khang rnying ba zhig gso byas la spyi rdzas sogs mang du bzhagabyams khang du byams sku dgung lo bcu tshad can bzhengs/ gzhan yang 'dod dgu dgon/ stong kha dgon/mgron tsha ban tshang dgon/ dpon chen dgon sogs la dbyar gnas gas ra du btsugs/ bde mchog gi mtshams la bzhugs skabs su ral gri khri gang zhig gis mgrin pa lte ba/ snying gnas rnams su yu ba nub tsam btsugs pa mtshams g.yog pos mthong ba dang rang dgon du zla rer sman ring tshogs 'don la zangs ma'i dung tse chon drug brgya dang / bcu ba'i lnga mchod la chon chig stong mang 'gyed du gnang ba rgyun 'khyongs pa sogs rgya mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho'i ljags rtsom bdud rtsi'i rdzang bu zhes bya bar gsal/ co ne bka' bstan sogs mang du blus pa dang khri ba co ne nas mngags srol tshugs/ dgung lo re drug pa yos lor mkha' spyod zer ba zhig mis shing zla ba bcu ba'i tshe4nyeragasumanyin rtags mtshan dang bcas te dag pa mkha' spyod dugashegs so/ /sku — 411 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/phreng gsum pa blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcoba'i ba'i shing 'brug(1ra44)lor rang shu stong gtsang sde ba'i 'og skor tsho ba'i yab grags pa rdo rje dang yum tshe ring sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rang bzhin du sgo gsum mi dge ba'i las la thugs su na cing dge ba'i phyogs la mkhyen rab dang spobs pa zung du 'brel bas yul mi kun gyi yid 'phrog pa byung / rjes su dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes dus rje tshe smon gling ba nas sprul skur thag gcod rgyu dang rab byung bsgrub rgyu byas mod/ de'i bar du rkyen zhig gis ched du sku thag ma bcad par lus so/ /yongs 'dzin rin po ches yi ge dang / 'don rta dbyangs/ cho ga phyag len/thig rdul tshon/ gtor ma bca' bzo sogs 'ib tu khrid pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam/sa rim gyis thob nas 'chal khrims kyis ma gos par gyur/ dgung lo so gnyis pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing phag lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyin thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'i bar gshegs so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba blo gros bzang bo 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni bya bzang yar ru kha tsho ba'i nang du ya ba 'jigs byed dang yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i me byi lor(1876)'ja' shar ba sogs rtags mtshan dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga'i thog gdan sar bkod/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang 'phrin las drung nas rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu'i steng stag tshang lha mo'i kirti'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang du tshogs zhugs gnang / yi ge 'bri slob dang klog pa sogs tshegs med par mkhyen pas gzhung lugs la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i go ba brnyes/ go rig zung du 'brel stobs kyis sgo gsum nyes spyod mtha' dag las ldog cing bag yod kyi spyod pa la gnas nas skye bo gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan 'ing / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim na gnas pa ni me dong du gnas pa ltar rig par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi dge ba'i bya ba gang yang rang ba'in gyis mi 'jug par bzhugs/ grwa sar dge tshul dang / rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho nas sku 'bum du bsnyen rdzogs sogs rim gyis thob ste gtso bo sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams las mi 'da' bar byed pa nyams len gtso bor mdzad/ de rjes gzhung po ti lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin te tshong ru'i khri bzhugs/ yang slar rang dgon du phebs nas dbang lung rjes gnang mang bo gnang / sde ba so so la ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi srol btsugs shing gtso bo dgon pa bskyangs nas dus 'da' bar bgyis/ mthar dgung lo don gcig pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin la sku gshegs pa dang sku gdung bzhug sbyong gi dus su phyag mdzub kyi rus pa'i steng du a rā pa tsi'i yi ge bkad do/ /sku phreng lnga ba 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi(1946)la 'khrungs/ la rtsa'i ltag ga sde ba'i yab mgon phrug dang yum gtsug gtor sman gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga'i thog gdan sar bkod/yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen chen po spen gtsang a khu dkon mchog drung nas rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu gcig thog grwa sa stag tshang lha mor mang ja bskol nas tshogs la zhugs/ bshes gnyen chen po gza' ru 'brog pa'i dkon mchog dge rgan du bsten/ 'bring ba'i bsam gtan mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ de — 412 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nas sngon goms pa'i bag chags rnams sad cing lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len/ lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan sogs khur du bzhes/ de nas1958lor dgon pa thor song ba'i rkyen gyis khong dpon g.yog gnyis ba'ag sdom nas lo 'ga' re bzhugs/ der dge rgan sku gshegs pas khong klu chu'i zam tsha'i dgon pa ru bskor du bzhugs nas lo 'ga' song / chos sgo gsar du phye skabs bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas a khu 'jigs med sku mdun nas dbang lu nga mang po thob/ tshul khrims nyi ma'i mdun nas bsdus grwa sogs gzhung mang po gsan/ dge rgan badz+ra nas sum cu ba dang / rtags 'jug sa ris rnams mthar phyin/ dpal ldan tshang nas bsdus grwa'i rig lam sogs sbyangs/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho chung ba tshang nas blo rtags sogs khrid/bshes gnyen chen po dge 'dun tshang nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas bzung sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams las ma 'das par nyams len gtso bor bgyis/ 19〈7nas19〈khalo'i bar stag tshang lha mo'i kirti dgon pa'i tshogs chen mkhan po'i 'gan bzhes nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'phrin las mngon par spel/ 1989lor gser thang dgon pa'i ser skya dad ldan thams cad kyi nan zhus bzhin phyir rang dgon du phyag phebs nas chos 'chad nyan/ sgrig dam bca' sogs nas do dam thugs khur bzhes so /sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ tshogs chen 'du khang / sgom khang gdung bdun bcas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang / byams pa'i lha khang / sman bla'i lha khang / bka' 'gyur bris ma tshar re/co ni bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur tshar re/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung 'bum/ grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ gzhan pa po ti lnga bcu sogs bzhugs/ sku phreng ba'i'i mchod rten khru bzhi can dang mchod rten che chung bco lnga/ dgon mdun du dbyen 'dum mchod rten gcig sgom khang nang du mgon chos lnga'i 'bag sku khams chen/ gdung mdun du 'jam dbyangs 'bag sku che ba/ spyan ras gzigs kyi 'bag sku/ phyag rdor 'bag sku/ jo'i sku/ tshogs chen 'du khang du gser sku la byams sku khru bzhi can dang byams sku khru gsum can/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dkyil krung khru gsum can/ rje sku mi tshad can/ rje yab sras sogs sku che chung nyer lnga/ gzhan bde mchog 'jigs byed che chung brgyad/ston pa nyan thos dang bcas pa mi tshad gsum/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal che chung brgyad/ 'od dpag med sogs bzhi bcu lhag bshags lha so lnga tshar gsum/ gnas brtan bcu drug tshar gnyis/ byams pa dang kun bzang sogs nyer lnga/ chos skyong / lha mo sogs che chung gsum/ tha 'og pa sogs chos skyong gzhan nyer lnga bcas gser sku khyon sdom bzhi brgya dang drug cu re lnga bzhugs so/ /yang byams khang / dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang sogs su byams pa dgung lo bcu ba'i sras brgyad 'jim sku/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsum dang / jo sku/ rje sku/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs sku che chung bsdoms pas sum brgya lhag bzhugs/thangagal༅mas pa'i gos sku bzo drub khru nye+ogacan/ rgyan drug mchog gnyi gagos sku khrubaco dzocan bcas — 413 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/thang ga dang ldebs ris bsdoms pas sum brgya longs so/ / ོ dgon 'dir skyes chen mang du byung ba 'di ltar/ kun mkhyen bla ma gser thang sprul sku sku phreng lnga dang /de nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthu las grub pa'i yang sprul bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin/ steng kha dgon gyi bla ma'i yang sprul rim byon/ kha smad a myes sku zhabs/ dog lung dgon pa'i bla ma'i yang sprul rim byon/ chu dkar dgon pa'i bla ma'i yang sprul sogs dang / dge slong chen po yongs 'dzin bya bzang ri khrod pa blo bzang 'phrin las/ yongs 'dzin spen gtsang dkon mchog steng leb a khu rdo rams pa/ tsug gu'i rdo rams pa skal bzang tshul khrims/ bya bzang rdo rams pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ rdo rams pa spen gtsang blo bzang tshul khrims/ bya bzang rdo rams pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ rdo rams pa spen gtsang blo bzang / rdo rams pa spen gtsang ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ spen gtsang dkon mchog 'phrin las sogs byung / rab rgyal sa khyi'i sngon du grwa ba khyon sdom nyis brgya bdun cu lhag bzhugs/ mchod gzhis sde grong la sgam 'ang / mdo tshang /bya tshang / cha ba/ de'u le/ mkhar sman/ spen gtsang / bong ho/ shes la/ thang ga mdzo yan/chu kha ba bcas bcu gnyis yod do/ /dgon pa'i phyag bzhes dang tshogs 'don skor ni/ hor zla dang po la cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo nyin bco lnga/ smon lam 'don sgrig phyag len bkra shis 'khyil ba ltar dang / sbyin bdag gis zhus pa ltar kun rig sogs gang mkho rgyas pa gsungs/ bcu gsum nyin la gos sku/ bcu bzhir 'cham rnying dang phyi dro gtor rgyag bco lnga'i dgung mo me tog mchod pa/ bcu drug nyin byams pa gling skor dang / shwa 'cham seng 'cham/gnyis pa'i nyer drug nyin la gser thang sku phreng bzhi ba'i gdung mchod/ gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar bka' 'gyur dag tshar gsung ba/ gsum pa'i bcu dgu nyin gser thang sku phreng dang bo'i gdung mchod/bzhi ba'i tshes drug nas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug nyin bdun dang rdul tshon/ sbyin sreg bcas/ bcu bzhi bco lnga la smyung gnas/ nyer dgu nyin la gser thang sku phreng gsum pa'i gdung mchod/ hor zla drug pa'i bcu drug nas dbyar dang dgag dbye/ yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong / tshes brgyad thams cad la sman bla'i tshes bcu/hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bcu bdun nas kun rig bdag 'jug bla brang dus 'khor ltar du tshugs nas rdul tshon/sbyin sreg bcas/ hor zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod la nyer gcig nas nyin lngar 'tshogs par gsang 'dus gtso bo bya/ bcu ba'i nyer gsum nyin gser thang sku phreng gnyis pa'i gdung mchod bcas dar ro/ /gcig dgu nga brgyad lor/ rgyal yongs kyi chab srid las 'gul rim spel nang dgon 'di yang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs rtsa med du gtong skabs su dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang dang rig gnas kyi dngos po/ gna' rdzas rtsa chen 'gangs chen/ nang ba'i rten gsum sogs mi dmangs kyis gces su 'os pa'i tshan rig dang rig gnas kyi dpyad gzhir rigs pa mtha' dag rtsa med du btang / 19〈1lor dgon sgo slar phye nas sa khyon smi grub bzhi ma12780gnas su 'du khang dang mchod rten/ bla ma'i nang chen gsar du — 414 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzhengs/ grwa shag nyer bzhi dang rung khang phub/ sil sdong rwa ba bskyil/ dge 'dun pa brgyad cu lhag zhal 'dzoms nas chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel bzhin no/ /lha gsol dgon chos 'khor 'dus sde gling /lha gsol dgon chos 'khor 'dus sde gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong g.yi ba zhang gi brag sgam nang du chags/dgon pa 'di gdong ba'i dpon po tshe dpal gyi nu bo dge bshes dkon mchog mtha' yas kyi thugs mos zhus pa ltar/ phu bo tshe dpal dang co ne a smon gnyi gas sbyin bdag byas te rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya lo ste spyi lo1645lor stag tshang lha mo kirti'i le lag tu dge lugs dgon pa btab/ dgon pa'i mtshan brjod stangs la gleng tshul sna kha gnyis yod de/ gcig ni kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas gnas 'dir lha bzo zhig btsal nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'jim sku bzhengs su bcug sku'i smad grub nas sku stod thengs mang bzhengs rung nyams legs po ma byung / zhag gcig rlung chen g.yugs shing char chen zhod pa la phyi nyin nangs snga mor sku'i dkon pa rang shugs su grub 'dug de'i phyir kun gyis lha gsol dgon zhes thogs zer ba dang / gleng tshul gzhan zhig ni dga' ye shes bsod nams stobs chen zhes pa ni g.yis stod srung dmag bca' sdod byas pa'i yul dpon red/ khod dmag khrid de g.yul sar zhugs skabs su yul lha gzhi bdag la mchod bkur rgya chen byas/ skabs der dgon gnas thog ma ni shin tu dpog par dka' zhing brjid chags pa'i rdza sgang mar+shal lta bu'i sa yin te/ kho tshos dgon pa'i ri sdings su gnyen bkur lha 'bod yang yang bgyis pa la'ang mi ser rnams kyis lha gsol dgon zhes btags zer/ gang ltar da lta'i bar dgon ming gzhan du 'gyur ba med do/ /khong rnams pas dgon pa btab nas gnas der sgom khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun pa brgyad 'dus pa la a smon rin po ches dgon pa ya tā sprul sku zhes par bcol pa dang lo 'ga' re'i nang ya tā dgon pa nas khri ba mngags rgyu bkas bcad/ de bzhin khri rabs bco lnga brgyud/ de'i rjes ya tā dgon pa nyams pas lo zhig la kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan thengs gnyis pa brag sgam nang phyag phebs mdzad de spyan ras gzigs kyi 'jim sku bzhengs pa dang yul gnyan rgan dar ba zhes pa bstod de bstan pa'i 'phrin las gdams/ da dung rdza ris ban de dbang phyug dang gdong ba lung rtogs mtha' yas/ nye ru'i dkon mchog bsam 'phel la sogs dge 'dun pa mchog gyur bcu gsum khong gi zhabs la gtugs nas dbang bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgon par kyai rdor bdag 'jug sbyin sreg 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor sogs kyi khrid dang 'don rta dbyangs btsugs/bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang co ne sa skyong gnyis mchod yon du 'brel tshugs/ gdong ba tshul khrims zhes pa dgung lo re bdun gyi dus su4 skyagashegs/ de nas lo rjes ca7re nangasazhig la bi dge 'dun chos kyi dang5nga phyug — 415 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/mchog gdan drangs nas mtshan tho bzhi becu lhag lase bdams te sngo mtshar shes rab cese pa sku gong ma'i yengo srid du blus/ dgung lo bdun steng du kirti'i byang stod pa tshul khrims zhes pa'i sku gam du rab byung sdom khrims bzhes pa dang dbang lung du ma thob/ de dus dgon pa'i grwa ba'ang bzhi bcu lhag tu 'phel/ khong yang dgung lo so brgyad steng sku gshegs/ sku phreng gsum pa rje dkon mchog smon lam zhes pa g.yi ba'i stag mdo'i snying ba grong tsho'i yab skal bzang bkra shis dang yum 'brug mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug steng kirti sku phreng bdun pa rje thub bstan nyi mas thugs thag bcad cing rab tu byung bsgrabs/ de rjes thub bstan nyi ma mchog sku gshegs phyin lo bcu gnyis ring khong gis kirti dgon pa thugs skyong mdzad/ de'i phyir khong nyid kyang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bla mar gyur pa dang dgung lo don lnga'i steng sku gshegs/ rang dgon dang kirti dgon pas gdung rten 'jim sku re bzhengs/ sku phreng ba'i ba skal bzang 'phrin la tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes kirti'i dkar chu kha ba rin kho tshang bkra shis rab brtan dang bde chen skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/dgung lo brgyad steng kirti'i grwa sa 'grims nas klog slob mdzad/ khong la sngar dpe bzhin brag sgam nang sde ba bdun ga dang ra rdzong gi dad ldan ser skya bla lhag tu bkur/ dgung lo so lnga'i dus su sku gshegs/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa zhal lnga bcu bas 'das mchod bsngo smon rgya cher spel/ sku phreng lnga ba kha ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa the bo gza' ru 'brog smad g.yi ba'i yab tshe dbang rab brtan dang yum bkra shis lha mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun steng kirti dgon par zhugs pa dang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis thugs thag bcad pa dang 'bring ba'i dge bshes yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku gam du bcar nas rab byung sdom pa mnos pa dang dbang bka' gal chen gsan/ skabs de tsam na kirti'i dgon du grwa ba mi nyung ba lcebs pa'i gegs gdon thebs pa la khong nyid kyang dge 'dun pa'i tshe bgegs sel phyir nyi shu'i dus sku srog lcebs/ de nas bzung dgon pa'i spyod ngan de mtshams chad/ sku phreng drug pa blo bzang thub bstan bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes pa mthong wor gyi yab bsod nams rgya mtsho dang yum sgrol ma skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ skyid dgu'i dge bshes blo bzang bstan 'dzin dge rgan du bsten nas gzhung bka' pota du ma dang rig gnas bcu sbyangs gshis mkhan po'i mtshan snyan thob cing dgon pa du ma'i khrir zhabs bkod/ kirti dgon nas rang gi gdan sar 'byor rjes bslab khrims bsdams pa dang chos spyod gang mang slar gso dang 'thus tshang du mdzad cing zhogs nub tu blor 'dzin dang klog bshar du bcug kirtis khong da dung kirti dgon pa dang lha gsol dgon gnyis kyi mkhan por bskos/ dgung lo nga bdun steng sku gshegs/ de dus dgon par grwa ba brgya bzhi bcu'i zhal 'dzoms/ de'i yang sprul nyams med thub pa'i dbang bo zhes pa ni yab tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang yum sgrol dkar lha mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs so/ /rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar sngon du dgon par 'du khang dang spyan ras gzigs lha khang / dzam+bha la lha khang /byams khang / btsan khang / rung khang sogs bzhengs pa dang rten du thugs rje chen po/ srung ma mgon chos — 416 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsum/ co ne'i bka' bstan sogs sku gsung thugs gsum gyis bkang bas dad ldan yid smon par byed/chos spyod la zla bzhi bar smyung gsan dbyar gnas zla phyed dang gcig bdun par gsang 'dus sgrub mchod/zla brgyad par dbyar nyi ldo/ga gi chos spyod/ zla dgu bar lha bab dus chen/ zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod chen mo la 'jigs byed sgrub mchod/ dgun chos chen mo sogs mang bo dar/ brag sgam nang du dgon pa nyid las da dung btsan pa dang / stag ru/ nyag ru/ na brgya/ mgar dgongs/ gdong ba bcas su ma ṇi sgrub khang bzhengs pa la thams cad lha gsol dgon pa'i mchod gzhis gyur/ rje brag sgom pa'i 'al gdams bzhin gnas sgo phye ba'i rig gsum mgon po'i gnas khang yod de/ a skyes rma chen gyi gnyan khongs dar 'dzin dpa' ri gnyan rgan dar ba zhes pas bskyangs zer/ de min yul ljongs ngo mtshar ltad mor grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i rbab chu(chu 'phyar)dang / rma bya'i rbab chu/ rig byed lha mo'i rbab chu/ rta mgrin rbab chu/ sgyu 'phrul ma'i rbab chu sogs mchis pa la/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dper the bo'i brag sgam nang na brag mang /yul khang ba ma yin brag gis bskor zhes grags so/ /dgon pa'i chos sgo spyi lo198 2lor slar phye nas tshogs chen 'du khang che chung gnyis dang / btsan khang /spyan ras gzigs lha khang / rung khang / grwa shag so dgu bzhengs pa la/ da lta btsun pa zhal grangs bzhi bcu lhag 'dzoms nas chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel ba'i skabs so/ /mtsho nge'u dgon bkra shis lhag bsam 'khyil/mtsho nge'u dgon bkra shis lhag bsam 'khyil zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong g.yi ba zhang gi sngo mtshar lung ba'i yar sne dang mar sne zer ba'i sde bar du chags/dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi lo ste spyi lo171ralor lung bzang dpon slob blo bzang bsam gtan zhes pas btab/ deb ther rgya mtshor lung bzang dpon slob blo bzang bsam gtan gyis btab pa sngo khye ri khrod bkra shis lhag bsam 'khyil zhes byung / gna' snga mo'i gtam rgyud lta ra na/ sgang rtsa sde ba'i mid pa nag rtsi zhes pa des sngo mtshar lung bar dben gnas legs po 'ig yod pa mthong bas kho'i bu gnyi ga nar son rjes gnas 'dir gzhis chags su bcug de'i rjes lung bzang dpon slob blo bzang bsam gtan pas 'dir ri khrod cig phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang bla ma kun bzang ba dang bcas pas ri khrod lo ngo go dgu 'das phyin slar ri khrod bcu kha dang dge 'dun pa so gcig mnyam du bsdus nas 'du khang bzhengs nas chos spyod sna du ma spel/ bla ma 'di ba'i yang srid rim byon gyis dgon pa bskyangs/ lha mo kirti dgon pa'i le lag yin/rten du srung ma dpal ldan lha mo dang / ga'an nang ba'i sku gsu nga thugs rten rtsa chen mi nyung ba brten/ smon lam/ lnga mchod/ dbyar gnas/ smyung gnas/ lo gtor la sogs mang bo spel to/ /dgon par mchod gzhis su yar sne dang mar sne/ re rdzong / la kha bcas ldogrong bzhi tsam la4med/— 417 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/'ardu khang bzhengs pa dang grwa shag nyi shu lhag phub/ dge 'dun pa rgyun bzhugs sum cu tsam yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon pa bsnubs phyir da snga chog mchan ma gnang gong slar gso'i tshul du 'du khang dang dang grwa shag khang mig bzhi phub cing dge 'dun pa zhal dgu 'dus nas mang tshogs sum brgya lnga bcu'i chos kyi re ba bskong bzhin no/ /stag mdo dgon bkra shis chos 'khor smin grol bde chen gling /stag mdo dgon bkra shis chos 'khor smin grol bde chen gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong g.yi ba zhang gi rta 'dogs lung ba'i snying ba sde ba'i nye logs ri sdings su chags/rab byung bcu gcig gi shing stag lo ste spyi lo1674lor snying ba chos rje blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis phyag 'debs mdzad/ deb ther rgya mtshor g.yis stod stag mdor chos rje ma ṇi ba blo bzang 'phrin las kyis btab pa bkra shis bde snang gling / kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas thugs rje chen po'i sku bzhengs/ kun mkhyen kong ma'i dngos slob stag mdo sngags rams pa 'di nas yin/ da lta skye brgyud snang / zhes gsungs/dge lugs pa yin pas lha mo kirti'i le lag tu gyur/ ha lam rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa yos(1929)lor rta 'dogs dang snying ba sde gnyis nang ma 'chams par grong ba na zhes pa(gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud 'dzin skor yin pa)dgon pa 'di las gyes/ rnying ma ba grong 'dug can zhe gsum yod par sku rten brgya phrag dang gsung 'bum pota drug cu lhag bcas lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/ rten gtso rigs thub pa dang 'jam dbyangs/tshe lha rnam gsum/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / gdugs dkar/ gsang 'dus/ slob dpon pad+ma/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs dang gsung rten la bka' bstan dang / yum tshar re bcas bzhugs pa shin tu mang ngo / /dgon pa'i mchod gzhis la snying ba dang / stag mdo/ pan yon/ phu leb/ sgang ba/ phug chen/mdo steng kha/ rgyal zho nang / nya bong kha bcas rong sde dgu yod cing mi ser thun mong gis bzhengs pa'i 'du khang dang grwa shag dgur dge 'dun pa bcu kha 'dus/ dgon sa khyon pas mu'u so gsum longs/1958lor dgon pa bsnubs/ 1988lor dgon chung 'di mang tshogs kyis slar gsos/ dgon mtshan ni stag mdo dgon bkra shis chos 'khor smin grol bde chen gling zhes su bcos/ da skabs co ne ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa'i dge slong phebs nas dgon pa skyong khur mdzad cing 'du khang khang mig dgu can dang thun mong grwa shag khang mig bcu gnyis phub pa la dge 'dun pa 'al grangs bco lnga 'dus pa'i skabs so/ /sgang tsha'i spo shog dgon bsam grub gling /sgang tsha'i spo shog dgon bsam grub gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong gi g.yi ba zhang du chags/— 418 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/the bo'i spo shog dgon pas bris pa'i ma phyi zhig tu sgang tsha'i spo shog dgon bas ma grub gling zhes bya ba 'di kirti sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa yin zhes bshad/ kirti sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni rdo stod du ldong rigs su yab tshe ring 'bum dang yum skyid mo yag gi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu 'brug(spyi lo1712)la sku 'khrungs/ khang sar bla ma dbu mdzad las rab tu byung / dgung lo brgyad pa la lam rim nyung ngu ljags slob mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa na rnga bar gnyan rtse slo ba dpon ngag dbang chos 'phel las dge tshul bsgrubs te bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang sogs gas na/ kirti dgon rnam rgyal bde chen gling la nang so'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing 'du khang rgya bskyed/ shing pho stag(spyi lo1724)la dbus gtsang du byon/ gangs can mgon po rgyal ba rin po che mgar thar du byon skabs kyi rgyal tshab tu rgyal sras 'jigs med ye shes grags pa bzhugs pa de'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ sems dpa' chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la drag po sum bsgril gyi rjes gnang sogs zhus/ gtsang du paṇa chen rin po che mjal ba dang / gzhung nas jo bo'i sku brnyan khri rgyab can/ bka' 'gyur sogs rten skyes mang du bstsal/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug(1811)lor dgon pa dngos su btab/ rang dgon du shar ba lha bzos bzhengs pa'i thub dbang / dngul gyi bka' 'gyur/ bkra shis khang gsar gyi lha khang rnams bzhengs/ shing byi la sde dge dpon bstan pa tshe ring dang mchod yon du 'brel/ der ngor ba dpal ldan chos skyong bzhugs pa'i drung nas gser chos bcu gsum/ gur zhal gyi skor/ rdo rje brag rdzong ma sogs snyan brgyud zab khrid kyi rigs mang du gsan/ shing sprel la dgon lung du lcang skya rin po che la mjal zhing reb gong dang gnam lha/ hor gtsang / kha gya tsho drug rong tsho chen bco brgyad/ co ne khul/ sog po mda' bcu gcig hor bod/ khe tha/ mdzod dge rnga ba/ ra mdo/ tsha kho rnams su 'gro phan che/me phag la kirti dbon rgan gyi sprul sku blus pa dang gzhi byes kun tu dbang lung rjes gsum mang du gnang / lha mor rgyud pa dang ka la ri'i dgon gyi 'dzin skyong mdzad cing rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ gsung rtsom yang pota gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo drug cu ba lcags yos(spyi lo1771)lo'i cho 'phrul gyi tshes brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so/ /de'i rjes ma rje mgon po lhun grub dang zam tsha bstan pa/ gtsang spyang / las pa 'brug dge sprul sku grags pa/ legs ldan/ paṇa blo bcas bla sprul bdun snga phyir chibs bsgyur te dgon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum du rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi bar bzhugs pa lha mo'i kirti'i dgon rnam rgyal bde chen gling gis bkas mngags so/ /yongs grags su dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'di'i lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag kirti sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dgung lo drug cu bzhes la nye ba'i tshe khong gi zhal bkod bstsal pa la brten nas lung bzang dpon slob blo bzang bsam gtan gyis dgon pa 'di phyag 'debs mdzad pa〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉— 419 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/las/ g.yis smad brag sgam nang gi ltagasol dgon dngaka sngo khye ri khrod bsashi4lha༄sam 'khyig sgang tsha'i spo shog dgon bsam grub gling bcas gsum po lha mo kirti dgon rnam rgyal bde chen gling gi dgon lag yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad nas da lta'i bar lo nyis brgya gyangs par grags/dgon par 'du khang dang / byam sa khang / mgon khang sogs gtso bo yin pa'i thog nang chen dang /rung khang / mdzod khang / grwa shag sum cu lhag yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i sngon du dge 'dun pa lnga bcu lhag bzhugs so/ /sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ dgon pa 'di'i sku'i rten la gser zangs las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun byams mgon/ byang chub sems dpa'/ rje tsong kha pa/ rje yab sras gsum so gas sku brnyan dang / kirti sku phreng brgyad pa/ jo bo rje/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ rnam sras dang sgrol ma/ rta mgrin brgya thang / 'jigs byed dang ston pa/ tshe dpag med brgya sku/ sangs rgyas dang rje stong sku/ mgon po 'od dpag med/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rgyal chen ba'i/ 'jig rten chags rim la sogs pa'i ldebs ris/ sog po phyi nang nas blus pa'i gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor/ ri rwags/ sgrub bum sogs 'gangs chen dkon po bsgrugs/ ma ṇi 'khor khang dang sku 'bum nyer lnga/ gsung gi rten la bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur/ rje gsung 'bum/ gzungs 'dus/ gzungs chen sde lnga/ 'phags pa/ bskal bzang / sa bcud ma/ mkhan chen dang kirti'i gsung 'bum sogs bzhugs so/ /chos kyi yo byad la'ang gser gyi theb tse bdun tshar bubs nyer brgyad/ rnga che chung bcu drugasbub cha bco lnga dang 'khar rnga che chung bzhi/ lag rnga bcu gnyis/ gcod pa dang / gdugs dkar/ rdo rje sder mo/ dpung rgyan sogs kyi par shing / dkyil 'khor/ rgyal mtshan/ ka thum/ ka 'phan yongs su 'dzoms/ tshogs slang bco lnga/ zangs dem che chung so dgu/ gdan cha sna tshogs shin tu mang ngo / /dgon pa 'di'i lo 'khor gcig gi chos thog dang chos spyod kyi gnas tshul ni/ hor zla gnyis par dpyid chos chen mo dang / bzhi bar sdom pa smyung gnas/ drug pa nas brgyad pa'i tshes gcig bar dbyar gnas/zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu gnyis par gegs gtor chen mo/ hor zla dang bo'i nang smon lam/zla re'i bco lnga dang tshes gcig dus bzang la chos thog tshugs/ dgon pa'i yon bdag tu gyur pa'i lha sde ni stod brag sgam nang ba man chad dang smad 'bru rdzi yan chad kyi grong tsho nyi shu la dud kha sum brgya bdun cu lhag gi mi ser nyis stong tsam yod de ches dar ba'i dus su grwa ba dgu bcu lhag bzhugs so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho khyi'i lor slebs pa'i tshe/ dgon pa 'di brlags nas ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur mod/ chu khyi lor sa khyon mu'u lnga bcu tsam gyi steng dgon pa slar gso thob ste 'du khang dang rten gsum mang bo/ grwa shag bcu lhag bzhengs/ da lta dge 'dun pa zhal grangs sum cu(rgyun sdod pa dgu)lhag bzhugs so/ /— 420 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dpal shes steng kha'i nang gong 'og dgon pa/dpal shes steng kha'i nang gong 'og dgon pa zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong steng kha zhang gi khongs su chags/the bo'i chos sde cung grags che ba 'di ni ha lam dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang tshan te rab byung bzhi ba'i me 'brug(spyi lo12 56)lor dpal shes rab 'bar(sa skya'i bshes gnyen/ phyis bla ma'i mtshan sa ming du thogs) zhes bya bas phyag 'debs mdzad/ gna' dus sa skya'i dgon lag yin pa dang phyis su dge lugs par bsgyur/ brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i deb ther rgya mtsho'i nang du/ the bo stod pa'i sa dpal shis steng khar grwa chen bzhi'i nang tshan dpal shes rab 'bar gyi gdan sa dpal shes nang gong 'og dam pa de nyid sa skyar 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i(12 25da 1280)zhabs la gtugs/ chos mang du gsan/ thugs zin gyi slob mar gyur/ 'phags pa mchod yon gyi bkas rang yul du dpal shes steng khar gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te bstan pa spel/ sngon gyi ngag rgyun 'gar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal(952da 10 25)gyi slob ma yin yang zer/ gang ltar dgon pa 'di 'debs mgo snga ba gsal/ mgon pa gong 'og ces de sngar steng kha zhang gi ltag logs ya ru dang ma ru zhes pa'i grong tsho'i bar du chags/ phyis su bla ma dang dbon po ma 'chams pas nang chen gong 'ogayonang gong ma bla ma'i dgon dang nang 'og ma dbon po'i dgon) gnyis su bkar nas bzhugs pa rim par dgon pa'ang gnyis su gyes/ dgon gong mar sngar dpal shes rab 'bar la thob pa'i bka' 'gyur mthing shog gi ngos la gser gar 'drong gis bris pa dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dbu zhwa/ bka' bstan snag dpar dang rje tsong kha ba'i gsung 'bum/li sku che chung stong phrag sogs dang / nang 'og mar sems nyid ngal gso/ bka' bstan dang rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang kun mkhyen gyi gsung 'bum/ li sku che chung stong phrag longs tsam bzhugs/ dgon gong 'og gnyi gar bla ma blu ba'i srol dar ba dang mi ser gyis bla ma zung la dpal shes pa lags zhes 'bod de dpal shes rab 'bar gyi sprul skur bkur/ rang rang dgon pa skyong bzhin phan tshun gnyer rogs gang legs bgyi/ dgon pa gnyi gar zla rer dus chos gsum re dang smon lam chen mo nyin bdun re 'tshogs pa'i skabs su lha 'cham dang gtor rgyag sogs dar ro/ /dpal shes sku phreng rim byon las brgyud pa'i gras kyi blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba stag tshang lha mo'i dgon nas slob gnyer mdzad cing rgyud pa dang dus 'khor grwa tshang gi khri bar mnga' gsol/ rab byung bcu ba'i lcags khyi(spyi lo1850)lor dbyar gnas btsugs nas mang 'gyed gtong la bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang ba sogs mdo smad chos 'byung du cung gsal/ de'i rjes ma ni blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan lags te/ stag tshang lha mo'i dgon par 'grims/ phyis rang dgon dang lha mo'i rgyud grwa'i khri mdzad/ dbus su lan gnyis phebs/ nang 'og mar 'du khang dang rje yabawas sku brnyan bzhengs/ dbyar gnas btsugs — 421 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/shing bka' 'gyur sogs kyi chosabaka' mang du bstsal/ 'diba'i༄ngasred ngag dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa mdzod dge bzhag sdom du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo so gsum tsam gyi steng ste1960lor rtogs mug la sa si khron 'khor bsang sman khang du sku gshegs/ khong lha mo'i gser khri dgon gyi tshogs chen ma khan po'i 'gan bzhes/ nye logs kyi gling 'khyil dgon pa1958lo'i sngon 'jig dpal shes pa thub bstan dge legs dpal bzang zhes pa da lta'i klu chu rdzong gi zam tsha rong nas sku 'khrungs/ de'i rjes ma blo bzang yo na tan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes pa 'di gdan sa'i shar gyi gdong bzang sde ba'i yab gzungs skyabs dang yum gu ru 'tsho'i sras su rab rgyal chu sprel(1922)lo'i rgyal zlar sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bsta na pa'i rgya'/ ma tshan gyis thugs thag bcad/ dge bshes blo bzang blo gros kyi 'bas pad gtugs nas klog slob mdzad pa dang rab 'byams pa yon tan bstan pa 'i mdun nas rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ khong sngar stag tshang lha mo'i khrir bzhugs pa dang the bo rdzong srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa da nga klu chu dang khul srid gros su u yon sogs kyi 'gan bzhes/ rab rgyan me yos lor sku gshegs/ 'di'i yang srid blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho(gu ru nyi ma)zhes pa1987lo'i zla10pa'i tshes1nyin steng ga'i mgo rtsa grong du yab dka' thub skyabs dang yum rgya mtsho sman gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun steng kun mkhyen drug pa dang gung thang / bse mchog sprul sde khri/dbyang don grub(co ne mkhan po)/ bcas kyis ngos 'dzin mdzad cing1992lo'i gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gdan sar 'khod/ da lta lha mo'i mkhan po ngag dbang grags pa dge rgan bsten nas slob gnyer 'bad ba'in no/ /nang gong mar 'du khang dang lha khang gsum bzhengs par khang mig zhe bzhi longs/ grwa shag sum cu phub par khang mig sum brgya don gnyis su grwa ba zhe bdun bzhugs/ rten bzhugs su co ne'i bka' bstan dang rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum sogs stong phrag lhag brten/ nang 'og mar 'du khang dang lha khang gsum bzhengs par khang mig zhe bzhi longs/ grwa shag sum cu phub par khang mig sum brgya drug cu yod cing grwa ba zhe bzhi bzhugs/ sku gsung thugs brten gya nom pas bkang bar bltams/ dgon sa khyon mu'u brgya bdun cu longs/ nang gong 'og la mchod gzhis steng kha'i ya ru dang ma ru/ wa chu/ hor du/ sa bon/ dzam bha/brgya tshang kha/ brgya 'dus/ myig can bcas sde ba dgu dang / g.yi ba'i 'bru rgyu/ sgang rtsa/ sag tshad/phu gdong / sha rdza/ rta ga phyar ral/ yag ngos/ 'bur sgang / rdzi bo/ yag gzi bcas sde ba bcu gcib/ yod/ 1958lor dgon pa gnyi ga sgo brgyab cing rig gsar las 'gul nang yongs su bsnubs so/ /rab rgyal chu khyi lor chos sgo phye ba na gong 'og dgon pa gcig gyur gyi sgo nas chos sgo phye ste sa khyon mu'u brgya yod pa'i wa chu sde ba'i mkha' chen sdings su 'du khang dang nang chen/ grwa shag nyer lnga bcas bzhengs pa la dge 'dun pa zhal grangs bzhi bcu lhag 'dus nas chos spyod gang mkho slar spel bzhin pa'i dus so/ /kha shis bkra shis dgon pa/— 422 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kha shis bkra shis dgon pa zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong steng kha zhang sngo sngo sde ba'i mdun ri'i sdings su chags/kha shis bkra shis dgon la kha shis(kha shi)ri khrod bkra shis bsam 'phel gling yang zer/ dgon chung 'di rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta lo ste spyi lo1642lor dpal shes rab 'bar gyi yang srid phyi ma zhig gis sbyor 'jags mdzad de btab pa'i dge lugs pa yin pa dang dpal shes steng kha'i nang gong ma'i dgon lag tu gtogs/ dgon pa'i mtshan de co ne'i sa skyong sku rabs bcu gcig pa blo bzang don grub mchog gi lcam mo blo bzang 'tsho zhes pas bkra shis dgon zhes btags skad/ de snga dgon pa thengs gnyis la gnas spos pa dang slar gso'ang thengs gsum byas myangs/ dgon pa'i chos spyod sgrub nyams len thams cad nang gong ma'i dar srol dang gcig mtshungs te dpal shes bla ma rim byon gyis thugs skyong ci lcogs gang nus mdzad do/ /rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i yar sngon du 'du khang dang lha khang mchod rten sogs bzhengs/ grwa shag bcu bdun phub par dge 'dun pa zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ 1958lor bsnubs/ mchod gzhis su grong sde la sngo sngo dang nyin sa sogs bcu gsum yod/ da skabs slar gso ba'i skal ba ldan yang cha rkyen dang gong gi bkod sgrig gi dbang gis dpal shes dgon par bsres na'ang dgon sar lha khang chung chung zhig bzhengs pas nye logs dad ldan mi ser gyi chos kyi re ba skong bzhin no/ /de'u sgang dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs gling /de'u sgang dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong dpal shes steng kha zhang wa pa lung ba'i yag ngos sde ba'i 'gram du chags/chos sde 'di rab byung bcu ba'i sa byi lo ste spyi lo1588lor blo bzang ban chung gi slob ma sgom pa sku skye blo bzang dar rgyas kyis btab zer/ dge lugs dgon pa lha mo gser khri'i dgon lag yin na'ang co ne'i sa skyong gis bka' khrims yul lugs brtsi dgos shing grong snge bco brgyad kyis sbyor 'jags byed/ deb ther rgya mtshor bkod pa ltar na/ blo bzang dar rgyas pa'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse ser smad du stag ra dge bshes blo bzang gi dge phrug byas/ de'i sprul sku da lta'i 'di ba bkra shis 'khyil du bzhugs/ dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgyar nye zhing / dbyar gnas/ smon lam lnga mchod rnams la gsang 'dus bdag 'jug rgyud stod ltar gtong / sa zlar smyung gnas/ lo mjug tu dgu gtor nyin bdun/ zhes gsungs/ sngon chad grong sde so so'i nang du ma ṇi khang dang nye logs su sgrub gnas mang bo yang de rgyun bzhugs btsun pa mi nyung rung sgom sgrub lhur len bgyis/ phu mdo'i a rgyal mgo long dang u bza'i sgom pa bka' bcu/ nyin khong sa ris dka' bcu ba gsum gas blo bzang dar rgyas mchog la sbyor 'jags gnang nas 'du khang dang lha khang bzhi la sku gsung thugs rten byanom pa bzhengs so/ / — 423 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i yar sngon du 'du khang dang btsan khang bzhengs pa dang rung khang / grwa shag zhe gsum phub/ dgon pa'i sa khyon mu'u sum cu tsam longs/ dgon du bla ma gcig dang dge 'dun pa drug cu rtsa bzhugs/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags lug(1991)la gong gi chog ma/chan ltar dgon pa slar gsos 'du khang bzhengs shing dge 'dun pa zhal nyi shu 'dus la grwa shag bcu lhag phub pa'i dus so/ /ra gong ma dgon chos kyi bde chen bkra shis dar rgyas gling /ra gong ma dgon chos kyi bde chen bkra shis dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi kha pa zhang mi tshe lung ba'i g.yi bzang sde 'gram du chags/chos sde chung chung 'di rab byung bcu ba'i shing rta lor(spyi lo1594)rang sde'i dge bshes ting 'dzin rin chen zhes pas sbyor 'jags gnang nas btsugs pa'i dge lugs pa en 'dzi tsha kho dgon pa'i le lag yin/dang thog ri sgang du btab kyang rjes su ra gong ma'i ri 'dabs su spos/ yun ring tsam 'das rjes dgon pa'i grwa ba je mang dang chos spyod sna 'dzoms su gyur/ rab drag shing yos lor 'du khang snga ma bshig nas slar 'du khang rgya bskyed de bzhengs/ rab nyi lcags glang la ra gong ma'i rten dang brten pa thams cad mes 'jig kyang /lo du ma'i rjes su yang dad lda na mi ser thun mong nas spyi 'jog gang 'dzoms byas te 'du khang khang mig bcu gnyis can bzhengs pa dang grwa shag ra dgu khang mig brgya dang brgyad longs pa phub cing bcings 'grol yar sngon bar lus/ dge 'dun pa zhal nyi shu rtsa grangs 'dus so/ /ra gong ma'i dgon pa 'di gtso bo g.yi bzang sde ba gcig po'i chos spyod thams cad spel gnas tsam yin la srung ma tha bag pa gtsigs su bkur/ dgon sa /khyon mu'u bdun tsam yod/ 1958lor dgon pa bsnubs rjes da lta slar gso'i chog mchan gong nas ma gnang yang mang tshogs rang 'thad rang mthun sgos ma ṇi khang dang grwa shag khang mig 'ga' phub cing btsun pa rgan gzhon bcu gsum slar 'dus so/ /nying sgam dgon pa/nying sgam dgon pa zhes pa'i dgon chung da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong kha pa zhang gi snying sgam sde ba'i nye logs su chags/dgon pa de rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu byi lo ste spyi lo1672lo la dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog ces pas dbu 'dzin ma dzad cing dad ldan mi ser thun mong nas btab pa'i dge lugs pa ste dpal shes steng kha nang 'og ma dbon po'i dgon gyi dgon lag yin/ de nas rim bzhin blo bzang mkhyen rtse dang / blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ bkra shis don grub sogs skyes bu dam pa du mas skyong khur bzhes/ dgon par mchod gzhis la nying sgam/ nyin yib/ bar dkyil kha sogs sde ba bcu gsum mchis te 'chad nyan do dam shin tu legs so/ /lo re'i zla ba'i ba'i nang smyung gnas bzhugs skabs su chos spyod ci yod la steng kha dbon po'i dgon gyi — 424 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/dge 'dun pa rnams nying sgam dgon du phebs pa dang zla gcig pa'i smon lam gyi skabs su nying sgam gyi dge 'dun pa rnams steng kha'i nang 'og mar 'tshogs pa'i srol tshugs/ bcings 'grol skabs tsam la 'du khang khang mig bcu drug can rten dang brten pa 'gangs chen gyis grub pa dang / grwa shag bcu bdun khang mig nyis brgya dang bzhi yod pa btsun pa bcu dgu zhal 'dzoms/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon pa 'jig da skabs re zhig bar slar gso byed ma thub par lus so/ /kha pa klung dgon pa/kha pa klung dgon pa zhes pa 'di ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong kha pa zhang gi kha pa kha sde ba'i nye logs kyi ri sdings su chags/dgon pa 'di ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags sbrul lo ste spyi lo170 1lor chos rje chos 'byor bstan 'dzin zhes bya bas 'brog ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs kyi grub mtha' ltar btab/ dgon pa'i bla ma sku phreng dang po ni blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho zer/ khong kha pa'i ri sgang du sgom sgrub la bzhugs pa'i grwa ba zhig yin te/phyis su bod dbus su phyag phebs nas slob gnyer mdzad pa la dga' ldan shar rtse'i dge bshes kyi mtshan snyan thob/ khong gis dbus nas phyir rang yul la spyan ras gzigs kyi sman sku dang mgon po li ma ba/dan drangs te dge lugs pa'i bstan pa shugs cher spel/ skabs der mi ser rnams kyi 'dun pa khur du bzhes nas khong co ne'i sa skyong gi sku mdun du dgon sa zhig slong bar phebs/ sa skyong gis khong kha pa dgon gsar 'debs mkhan byed chog pa'i bka' bstsal pa dang tham ga brgyab pa'i dar nag cig gnang ba ma zad/ yul de'i mi ser kun gyis khong bla mar bkur dgos pa'i bka' bsgos/ de bzhin kha pa klung dgon du blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i sprul sku sku phreng bdun brgyud pa las/ sku phreng gnyis pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bsam grub/ sku phreng bzhi ba dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang dpal ldan/sku phreng drug pa blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin/ sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba/ kha pa'i 'od yas kha zhes pa'i grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me sprel(1kha56lo)la gdan sar bkod/da skabs the bo rdzong srid gros u yon dang kha pa klung dgon pa'i do dam kru'u rin bcas kyi 'gan bzhes/gzhan chos 'byor bstan 'dzin khong dgon pa'i bla ma dang dgon bdag yin pas nye logs grong tsho bcu gsum mgo bsdus nas 'du khang bzhengs pa dang rjes ma sku rim byon gyis dgon pa rgya bskyed gshis dge 'dun pa 'al re gsum 'dus/ sa khyon mu'u nyi shu tsam gyi gnas su 'du khang gnyis khang mig nyer bzhi/ nang chen gcig khang mig bcu/ rung khang khang mig bzhi bzhengs/ grwa shag nyer gcig khang mig nyis brgya dang drug bcas phub/dgon pa'i chos sbyod skor la zla gcig pa'i nang smon lam chen mo'i skabs su mar me dang chu mchod sog sa — 425 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/stong mchod du ma 'bul/ las sne la bla ma dang / khri ba/ spyi ba/ dge bskos/ gnyer ba bcas mi gcig re bzhugs pas dgon pa'i chos spyod legs par gnyer/ rab rgyal me rta lor dgon pa brlags/ 198 2lor chos sgo slar phye thub pas da lta 'du khang khang mig bcu gnyis can zhig bzhengs pa dang grwa shag nyer drugam gron khang gcig bcas phub par dge 'dun pa rgan gzhon zhal nyer bdun bzhugs pa'i skabs so/ /tsha kho dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling /tsha kho dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong kha pa 'ang gi en 'dzi lung bar chags/chos sde 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me sprel lo ste spyi lo1776lor kirti thub bstan rgyal mtshan dang shes sgo sde ba'i tshong ba phyug po bkra lo gnyis zhal gros thugs mthun sgos sdong bo che zer ba'i ri 'dabs su btab/yang ma do mi da chos 'byung du/ en 'dzi khog tu tsha kho dgon/ nang gong ma'i dgon lag lung bzang sprul skus bde mchog tshogs 'don du btsugs/ zhes gsungs/ dgon pa 'debs par dang thog sngo gser kha kun tshes pa'i sa nas ri khrod pa bdun dang sdong bo che zhes pa'i ri 'dabs kyi ri khrod pa bdun bcas gdan drangs te dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'di btab/ dge 'dun bstan pa'i rgya'/ mtshan zhes pa'i bla ma 'di khams kyi tsha kho yul nas sku 'khrungs pas dgon pa'i mtshan yang bla ma'i pha yul ltar thogs zhes grags/ chos sde 'dir skyong ba'i bla ma la dge 'dun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid rim byon chos kyi dbang phyug dang /thub bstan nyi ma/ blo bzang 'phrin las/ skal bzang blo gros/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ 'jigs med ye shes rgya mtsho sogs brgyud par mdzad/ dgon pa ches dar dus su dge 'dun pa zhal nyis brgya lhag 'dzoms kyang phyis su brgya lhag tu nyams par gyur/ 'du khang che ba khang mig bdun can zhig dang 'du khang chung ba khang mig lnga can zhig byams khang khang mig gsum can/rung khang bcas rten dang brten pa thams cad 'dus par bzhengs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing rta lo(1〈94)la dgon pa yongs rdzogs me 'jig thebs/ shing yos lor(1915)snga ma'i rnam pa ltar bzhengs grub cing 'du khang du sangs rgyas stong sku tshar du ma sogs dang bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ lam sngags sogs gya nom pa bsgrugs nas slar bkur sti chen po bgyis/dgon pa'i mdun rir nags tshal skor zhig yod/ tsha kho dgon pa'i chos skyong la zla gcig pa'i nang lha mo'i tshe gtor/ smon lam chen mo'i skabs gzungs 'dus/ byams pa gling skor/ lha 'cham/ gos sku la sogs dang / zla gsum par lha mo'i bskang gso/ zla bzhi ba'i smyung gnas/ zla lnga bar gsung 'dus bdag 'jug dang / srung ma'i bskang bshags bsang mchod/ zla drug pa'i bco lnga nas brgyad pa'i tshes gcig bar dbyar gnas/ zla bcu ba'i nang bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bcu gnyis bar lha mo'i bskang gso dang lha 'cham — 426 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs chag med du spel ba'i srol dar ro/ /dgon pa'i mchod ga'is kyi khongs su rong ga kha dang / shes sgo/ tshur kha/ tshong 'dus/ gnyan bza' bcas grong sde lnga yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar 'du khang che chung gnyis dang grwa shag nyi shu/ btsun pa so lnga tsam las med par rgud/ 195rngalor dgon pa bsnubs rjes slar198 2lor(chu phag)dgon pa'i chos sgo phye nas 'du khang dang grwa shag drug bzhengs pa la dge 'dun pa zhal bcu gsum 'dus te chos spyod gang 'dzoms spel ba'i skabs so/ /bang tshang dgon bkra shis phun chogs gling /bang tshang dgon bkra shis phun tshogs gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong gi bang tshang zhang tshe ring nang gi nye logs su chags/brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyi mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ bang tshang dgon bkra bshis phun tshogs gling ni sngags ram sa pa blo bzang tshul khrims dang sngags rams pa sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis bzhugs pa las chags zhes dang / co ne dgon chen nas khro bo bla ma stag mo dang ma ru bla ma gnyis khri bar mngags/ grwa ba bzhi brgya lhag la kun rig dang 'jigs byed sgrub mchod/ smon lam nyin bco lnga/ gos sku/'cham/ byams pa gling skor/ bco lnga'i mchod pa bcas dang / sa zlar smyung gnas/ drug pa'i dus bzang / dbyar gnas/ bzhi mchod/ lnga mchod nyin bdun sogs gtsang dgon chos spyod kyi tshugs legs zhes gsungs/ yang klu chu bla ma ye shes skal bzang bas btab ces byung ba ltar na/ sngon hor yul nas 'ongs pa'i spun gsum gyis sa bzung / kho tsho'i spun che bas bang tshang bdag khur bzung ba dang gcung bo'i gzhis phar ba khar chags/ tha chung gzhis tshe ring nang bar chags/ de'i sngon sa 'di'i phug na dge bsnyen pa'i ri khrod cig yod pa la hor ba rnams kyis the nyin ngo bla ma blo bzang ye shes(spyi lo172 0yas mas)skyabs yul du gdan drangs nas ri khrod 'dir bzhugs su bcug khong gis gtsos hor ba zhabs drung spun gsum dang yul mi rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i phan bder gzhigs te blo bzang ye shes la ri khrod las mi chog par dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin rab nyi shing glang ste spyi lo1745lor co ne'i dgon chen gyi dgon lag tu bang tshang dgon bkra shis phun tshogs gling btab kyang zer/ sa khyon mu'u brgya lnga bcu lhag yod/ yun mi ring bar klu chu bla ma ye shes skal bzang kirti rin po che'i bka' mngags ltar the bo'i phyogs su chu mig dang dur khrod 'grims te phebs tsa na dgon 'dir bzhugs/ de nas khong rnam pas 'du khang ka ring gnyis can/par khang ka ring bzhi can gsar du bzhengs/ sku gsung thugs rten dang sgrig lam kun spyod 'don cha sogs phyag len mdzad/ par khang du rje'i lam rim chen mo/ bskal bzang / brgyad stong ba/ thar mdo/bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan yongs rdzogs ma/ dge 'dun kun brjod ma/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/— 427 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/gse ra 'od/ kun rig dus 'khor las phyi rol gtor ma/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ smon lam sna lnga/lung rigs lung bsta na/ rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ sku rim rnam gsum so gas mang bo 'dus/ dang thog grwa rgyun cung zhan cing nyams na'ang phyis su ches dar ba la btsun pa zhal ba'i brgya lha ga 'dzoms par gyur/ co ne dgon chen nas mngags pa'i chu bo bla ma bstan smon dang bla ma ma ru ba zung gi drin 'a sa rgyud pa'i snga gas rams pa mi nyung ba byung / dgon bla sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin mchog ni rdo ru'i the nyen ngor sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs nas gzhung pota lnga dang brda sprod la slo ba ga/nyer ma dzad/ dkyil 'khor dgon dang gtsang nyin dgon gnyi ga'i khri bzhugs/ bslab pa gsum gyi nyam sa len dang dgon pa'i bya ba mtha' dag gong du spel/ kun ma/khyen skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug( 1rnga5(〈—1916)gi sku gam du bca' sdod dang drung yig chen por bzhugs/ phyis su bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'alor grwa tshang gi rdo rje 'dzin par bzhugs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don thugs su chud par grags/ rang dgon du phebs nas khong dang hor ba'i zhabs drung sku rabs gnyis pa 'bas drung(blo bzang ye shes kyis ngos 'dzin gnang)gnyis kyis dgon par 'du khang ka ring brgyad can bskyar du bzhengs shing sku gsung thugs rten mang bo blus/ de'i skabs su grwa tshogs drug brgya lhag 'phel bar gsungs/ dus 'khor gar 'cham dang thig rdul tshon/ me tog mchod pa'i srol tshugs/ ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa dang ya ba sras gsum ga'i grub chen skor/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ rnam sras rta bdun 'brug chen zung gis bskor ba/nam mkhar mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rang 'gul gar du rol pa/ kun rig dang 'jigs byed sgrub mchod/smon lam sogs ni phyis su bkra shis 'khyil ba ltar legs por rgyun 'khyongs/ de bzhin zhabs kyis bcags shing dbang lung rjes gsum gnang ba'i bla ma la rje skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog dang tsha rdor rin po che/ rnga rgod sku phreng gnyis pa/ stag g.yas tshang bcas yod do/ /sku phreng gsum pa skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yang sku phreng gnyis pa'i khyim du slar the nyin ngo'i yab sangs 'brug dang yum klu mo'i sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho 'brug(spyi lo1928)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi'i dus bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas kun mkhyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ( 1916ba1kha47) mchog gis sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang /bdun steng bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan gsol/chos grwar zhugs nas dbang lung man ngag thob pa dang rdo rams pa blo bzang rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas thos bsam dang gzhung sbyangs/ bcu gcig steng gdan sar bkod/ bcu bdun phar phyin ston mo dang dam bca' bzhag nyi shu'i steng smon lam rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad/ lha mo tshul khrims kyi mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ 'on kyang rab byung bcu drug pa ste chig stong nga brgyad lor zing 'khrug byung ba'i dbang gis bla ma'i mdzad pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la nyams rgud chen po byung stabs/ gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs nas tshong khang dang / sman khang / 'bru mdzod/ dmag chas sogs srung skyob la rem — 428 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yang / mthar khong rang grwa sa nas grong du phebs pa dang btson du zla brgyad bkag myangs/ rjes su rdzong dang khul srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ khul srid gros rgyun u bcas bskos/ dgon pa sla ra gso bar grwa mang sgrig lam dang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs sogs la 'bad 'bungs shugs chen mdzad/ 1992lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nyer drug la sku gshegs so/ /hor zhabs drung sku rabs gsum pa skal bzang mkhas grub rgyal mtshan ni bang tshang du yab go go(dkon mchog skyabs)dang yum tshe dpag sman gyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i ñca gas 'brug(spyi lo1940)lor sku 'khrungs/ gro tshang zhabs drung dgon du phebs rjes khong sprul sku yin pa thugs thag bcad/ chung dus nas blo 'dzin dang 'bri klog sogs la 'bad brtson byas pas 'don cha sogs byang chub/dgung lo bco brgyad steng du bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs/ rdo rams pa dkon mchog 'phrin las dge rgan du bsten bsdus grwa dang rgyan 'jug bslabs/ rang dgon du 'a ma sngags dang smon lam sna lnga sogs kyi par shing bsgrigs pa dang bla ma brag sgom pa spyan drangs te dbang lung rjes gsum zhus/ rang gis kyang dge 'dun tshogs kyi chos 'chad nyan/ kun spyod sdom khrims legs por bsdams/ 1958lo la rang dgon bkra shis phun tshogs gling du phebs pa na 'brug chu'i btson ra nas dgung lo bcu dgu'i steng sku gshegs so/ /'di ba'i yang srid de hor ba zhabs drung bla ma blo bzang yon tan rgya mtsho lags(skya ming khro bo skyabs)zhes pa/da lta'i co ne rdzong wa dmar zhang gi sa dmar phu'i yab 'brug rgyal mkhar dang yum ting 'dzin 'tsho'i (ting dga') sras su spyi lo1980lor sku 'khrungs/ 1994lo'i zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la kun mkhyen drug pa'i ngos bzung ltar gdan sar bkod/ da lta bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer la rem sgang yin no/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i yar sngon du bkra shis phun tshogs gling ni 'brug dkar chu bo'i(rkyang chu)bar rgyun du chags pas yul dben zhing 'bru rigs sogs lo tog sna tshogs g.yur du za ba smin pa'i gnas yin/dge 'dun pa dang grong ba rnams kyis nor longs spyod mod po phul te 'du khang rgyan bdun can dang 'jigs byed lha khang / rje lha khang gyan lnga can/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / sman bla'i lha khang bcas dang rten du gser gyi sku/ 'bag sku/ thang ga gyan thang / gsung 'bum/ gser tog rgyal mtshan sogs mang bo bzhengs/ tshogs chen 'du khang gtso byas te rags tsam zhus na/ sku'i skor la gser bzhengs thugs rje checha po dang byams pa/ gsang 'dus/ tsan dan jo bo/ 'jim grub thugs rje chen po khru bcu gnyis can/ston pa/ sgrol ma/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ rje gser rdung mchod rten khru bco brgyad can/ 'jam dbyangs/ thang stong rgyal bo'i sku 'gag thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / kirti bstan pa rab rgyas kyi 'dra sku/ rje mi la'i 'bag sku khru bco brgyad can/ dus gsum sangs rgyas khru bdun can/ bla ma ltag g.yang dang 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gser rdung mchod rten khru bdun can/ thang ga'i skor du rje yab sras gsum/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ gnas brtan bcu drug rigs ldan rgyal bo/ ston pa'i nyan thos shā re bu/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ tshe dpag — 429 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/med/ rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol ma sogs/ gyan thang la bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing / dga' ldan lhag brgya'i tshogs zhing / kun rig lha so bdun/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ dus 'khor/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ mgon chos lha lnga/ rnam sras rta brgyad/ byang chub ltung gshegs/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ rma chen/ srid pa'i 'khor lo/ sham+bha la'i gling / gsung gi thad du bka' bstan tshar gnyis/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ ting 'dzin gser bris/yum gser bris/ gzungs 'dus/ brgyad stong ba/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ lung rigs lung bstan/ma ṇi 'khor lo brgya lhag dang / byang chub mchod rten sogs drug ston pa dang tshe dpag med/ rje tsong kha ba/ rigs gsum mgon po bcas kyi stong sku bzhugs so/ /gzhan sa gdan dang ka thum/ gos rgyan/ nor khrab/ ka 'phan/ gser dngul g.yu zangs kyi malcel cha du ma/ gos sku khru nyer bdun can/ dung chen dang / dung dkar/ dngul gling / zangs gling /sbub cha/ kong bu sna tshogs/ bdun tshar che chung / rus rgyan/ 'khar rnga/ tshogs zangs/ ja pra/zangs dem/ rag thom/ dus 'khor dkar 'cham 'cham lwa/ shwa 'cham seng 'cham 'cham lwa/ gdugs/dus 'khor 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs mang ngo / /dgon pa bsnubs nas lo bcu bzhi'i rjes te chig dgu brgyad cu tham pa'i lor dgon pa'i chos sgo phye ba la bla ma skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dgon nyid kyi gras su gtogs pas phyir gdan drangs shing sa khyon mu'u zhe drug tsam lus pa'i gnas su nyin ngo sde bas 'du khang zhig gso byas/ rten du rje mi pham mgon po'i sku khru bco brgyad can shog sgor khri lhag phud de bzhengs/ dge slong bzod pa rgya mtshos bka' 'gyur dang rje stong sku'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ tshe ring nang sde bas rje yab sras gsum dang / gong ri kha sde bas gos sku bzhengs/paṇa chen blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog1982lor dgon par phyag phebs nas ser skya mang tshogs stong phrag lnga lhag la phyag dbang gnang / kun mkhyen drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang / stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge sogs kyis sku gsung thugs rten thams cad la rab gnas mdzad/ da lta 'du khang gsar rnying gnyis dang chos ra/ rung khang / nang chen(bla ma gnyis nang gcig)gcig sil tog ldum rwa/ grwa shag so drug grwa ba rgan gzhon drug cu rtsa grangs 'dus te dus 'khor lugs ltar chos spyod mi nyung ba slar gsos dad ldan mang tshogs kyi dkar po'i dge ba spel sgang yin no/ /'bras dog lung dgon pa/'bras dog lung dgon pa'am dog lung dgon zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong bang tshang zhang gi nyin par chags/— 430 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/'bras dog lung dgon pa ni rang sa'i dbus 'bras spungs sgo mang khams tshan du 'grims shing rdo rams dge bshes thob pa rje ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis rab byung bcu ba'i sa phag(1599)lor btab zer/ dgon 'debs kyi sta gon du dang thog yul der ri khrod gsum yod pa lhan du bsdus shing lha rams pa khong nyid gtso mdzad de dge slong nyi ma dang / dge slong rgyal mtshan/ dge slong tshul khrims/ dge slong chos 'dzin bcas dge slong lngas ram 'degs rogs ram bstun rtse dgyes so nam pa pad+ma bkra shis zhes pas dgon sa phul/nyin pa'i 'phrin las phun tshogs dang nyin pa'i ban phrug tsho yas ko'u bho do/ tshe lung ngo'i bla ma/ khe lung g.yag lo rnams sbyin bdag byas te 'du khang dang sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ sku zhabs tsha rdor rin po ches rje sku lugs ma gcig dang 'od dpag med kyi thang ga gcig rje'i thang ga rten skal du gnang zhing 'du khang rab gnas mdzad/ co ne dgon chen nas dpal ldan lha mo gtso sku byas pa'i mgon chos lnga'i thang ga dang sbub sil snyan dngul dung sogs gnang / dgon pa'i sgrig lam kun spyod 'don rta dbyangs dbyar dwags gso sbyong bcas cha tshang ba khong rin po ches btsugs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho mchog bya bzang ri khrod du bzhugs/ dgon pa skyong ba'i skabs su gro tshang sku zhabs 'bras dog lung dgon du phebs nas lha khang tshon dang ldan par gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang tshogs slang gnang / rnga rgod nam mkha' seṅge phebs te rje thang ga byin can zhig gnang / bla ma stag ya sa tshang phebs nas ston pa'i sku zhig gnang ngo / /sku phreng gsum pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni yab pad+ma bkra shis dang yum klu mo 'tsho'i sras su bya bzang nas sku 'khrungs/ lha mo gser khris thugs thag bcad cing lha mo'i chos grwar bzhugs/ slob gnyer mthar phyin rjes phar phyin dam bca' bzhag cing grwa tshang la mang 'gyed gya nom pa phul/ tshogs chen mkhan tshab tu khong gis lo re bzhin mang ja re gnang / thugs rje chen po khru gcig can zhig dang rje yab sras gsum bzhengs/ khong rang gi gdan sar phebs te sa zlar smyung gnas dang dgu bar kun rig bdag 'jug btsugs/ gser thang a myes gdan drangs pa la des sa/nas brtan bcu drug gi thang ga gnang / yang gser thang dgon pas tshogs slang dang tsi/ sbub sogs mang bo gnang / co ne'i bla ma gur yag chos pa gdan drangs pas byams thang 'ig gnang / tsho yas ko'u bho do zhes pas rgya nag nas byams pa zhig gdan drangs/ mgon khang gsar bzhengs mdzad pa bcas sbyor 'jags rlabs che'o/ /sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang dge 'dun rgya mtsho(bang tshang dgon pa'i bla ma hor ba zhabs drung rang yin)ni yab dkon mchog(go go)dang yum tshe 'tsho'i sras su bang tshang du rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing pho rta lor(1954)sku 'khrungs/ lha mo'i gser khri blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rig seṅges sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo bdun son dus yi ge 'bri klog sogs bslabs pa tshags med du byung /dgung lo dgu'i steng dge slong blo bzang bkra shis kyi sku gam du dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing bcu gcig pa'i dus gdan sar bkod nas rang dgon du bzhugs/ grwa tshang la mang ja gya nom pa btang / gser thang dgon dang lha mo gser khri dgon pa'i chos grwa 'grims/ dge bshes blo bzang zhes pa dge rgan du bsten/ gser — 431 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/ khri'i nang khag nas chibs rta dang zla gam/ zhwa mo/ phyag phreng sogs cha tshang re gnang / de phyis rang dgon du gdan zhus ltar phebs nas gos sku bzhengs pa dang smon lam btsugs/ byams pa gling skor dang gos sku bshams pa sogs mdzad rjes che na'ang sa khyi lor dgon pa rkyen dbang gis yo ngas su bsnubs/ khong nyid grwa sa las skya sar bud do/ /rab rgyal lcags byar chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan thob/ blo bzang dge 'dun rgya mtsho bang tshang dgon du slar phebs shing rang gis gdan sa'i chos spyod dang do dam sogs thugs khur mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes khri chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan bang tshang dgon du phyag phebs par mjal/ skya ser thun mong stong phrag lnga tsam la ma ṇi dang skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ gu ru sidhi sogs zhal lung thob pa ma zad/ rje khong gis sku gong ma'i gdung tsha dang na bza'/ khong gi 'dra par bcas rten du gnang / mi ser gyis gang phul thams cad chud mi za bar byams sku khru bco lnga can zhig bzhengs pa la lha mo gser khri dgon pas gzungs gzhug gnang / lha mo'i gser khri mchog dang kun mkhyen drug pas rab gnas mdzad/ da lta dgon par gos sku zhig dang mgon chos lnga'i lha khang / 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ dge 'dun pa zhal grangs sum cu tsam 'dus/ chos thog dus bzang sogs slar gsos/ rje khong nyid dgung lo zhe brgyad steng pe cin du paṇa chen rin po ches btsugs pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob gling du zhugs nas mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad du 'phags pa khag bsten te rje lam rim sogs gzhung du ma ba sbyangs shing gdan sar phebs te bdag 'jug sogs sngar ltar slar gso dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong nyams gso mdzad de mi nyams gong 'phel du gtong bzhin mchis so/ /de'u rang dgon dge 'dun phun chogs gling /de'u rang dgon dge 'dun phun tshogs gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong bang tshang 'ang gi mi yag sde ba'i logs su chags/chos sde 'di gna' dus bang tshang dgon bkra shis phun tshogs gling dang gcig yin/ dus skabs shig nas dgon nang ma 'chams par phyis su co ne sa skyong tshe dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi ring du sho bzang mgo ba mngags nas dgon pa bgos pa dang / sa phag lo ste spyi lo18kha9lor ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes dang nang ba shes rab gnyis kyis mi yag(da lta sde ming la ya ru zer)sde ba'i sa ma/chog tu 'a 'a dang rdo ru/ chu dkar chu gsum ga'i 'dres mdor dgon pa 'di btab pa la mi ser tshos mi yag dgon pa'ang zer/ dgon pa'i chos spyod phyag len co ne dgon chen ltar ma zad khri ba rin byon yang co ne dgon chen nas mngags/ dgon bdag la bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes mchog 'di ba'i sku phreng gnyis pa ni blo bzang ye shes rgya mtsho zer — 432 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/te bkra shis 'khyil ltar cho ga phyag len bsgyur/ sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rin po chen yin/ de'i rjes ma bsod nams don grub pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos te1929lor dpa' yon sde ba nas yab gu ru'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas ngos 'dzin mdzad cing dgon de'i grwa sa 'grims/ 1958lor dgon pa bsnubs rjes grong du skya sar bud/ da lta dgung lo nga bdun te 'khor yag grong du 'tsho bzhugs gnang ngo / /dgon par tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang / rje lha khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang / spyan ras gzigs lha khang / gsang 'dus lha khang / rung khang bcas bdun bzhengs pa'i nang du sku gsung thugs rten skor la rje yab sras gsum dang byams sku khru bcu gnyis can/ rnam sras sogs gser sku drug cu lhag dang sman sku mang bo bzhugs/ rgyan thang dang thang ga nyis brgya tsam yod/ gsung rten la bka' 'gyur dang yum/ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum sogs pota grangs nyis brgya lhag bzhugs/ thugs rten du dgon ma dun dbyen 'dum mchod rten dang phyogs bzhir sku 'bum sogs mang bo bzhengs/ ga'an gser dngul zangs gang rung gis brdungs pa'i dung chen dang rgya gling / maṇ+ḍal kong bu theb tse sogs dang gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ka 'phan gya nom pa bsgrugs te bkang ngo / /dgon pa'i chos spyod kyi thad du hor zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam
