nyin bcu gsum dang / 'cham gsar rnying gnyi ga gos sku/ byams pa gling skor bcas yod/ zla gsum par 'jigs byed bdag 'jugazla bzhi bar ma ṇi ril sgrub dang smon lam/ zla drug pa'i bco lnga nas dbyar gnas zla ba gcig zla dgu bar kun rig bdag 'jug zla bcu bar lnga mchod nyin du ma/ de min zla ba'i yar ngo mar ngor gso sbyong dang sgom khang gi dus gtor chag med sogs mang bo dar/ las sne la bla ma dang khri ba/ smon lam bla ma/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ dge g.yog tshogs 'du bcas tshugs pa dang dgon du ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang / 'a zi bla ma bskal bzang 'phrin las/ bang tshang bla ma skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ co ne khri ba'i nang khag bcas bzhi yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi ste dgon pa 'jig khar btsun pa brgya dang so drug phyogs bzhir mchod rten ba'i bzhengs/ grwa shag brgya lhag can bcas kyi rgya khyon du dar/ grwa ba'i 'tsho rten gtso bo mi ser gyi mang 'gyed las gzhan dgon pa'i lcags ri'i nang logs kyi sa zhing mu'u brgya lhag tu sil sdong sna tshogs btab pa dang spyi nom dngul sgor stong phrag bzhi lhag dang dong tse khron sum stong lhag bu lon du ba'ag pa/ grwa ba rang gi shag rar sil sdong mang bo btsugs pa sogs kyi yong sgor brten pa yin/ spyi lo1925lor krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag rgyang skyod skabs ma'o tse tung dang kro'u en le sogs dgon 'dir bzhugs myong / da dung dgon pa'i nye logs 'khor yag bde mchog gnas khang dang brag phug tu lha sku sogs lha ris dang srog chags kyi sug rjes sogs shin tu mang bo mngon par gsal to/ /nga lta mang tshogs kyis rang mos ltar 'du khang bzhengs te dgon pa slar gsos rjes dge 'dun pa rgan — 433 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/gzhon sum cu lhag zhal 'dzoms shing bla ma ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo bzhi bcu ba 'dis dbu khrid mdzad de rten dang brten pa gsar bzheng dang chos spyod gal chen 'dzin skyong la rem bzhin pa'i skabs yin no/ /tā ka dgon bkra shis bsam gtan gling /tā ka dgon bkra shis bsam gtan gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong dpal yon zhang gi skyid po lung ste zhang srid gzhung gi shar phyogs spyi le gsum tsam du chags/dgon pa 'di ha lam rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug lo'i yar sngon(spyi lo1726)tsam du dge slong chen po blo bzang nyi ma zhes pas btab cing dbu 'dzin mdzad pa ste co ne dgon chen gyi dgon lag red/dgon par khri ba mngags pa na gser thang dgon pa dang gnyi ga bdag 'dzin mdzad/ phyis bla ma dang khri ba nang mchams pas co nes khri ba ma mngags 'brel yang chad/ dang thog dgon pa rta phyug khug tu btab par jag rkun gyis gtses pas mthar steng sgang du spos/ zam pa'i bla sprul gyi sa gnas der dbyar gnas btsugs/skyid po gu dmag ru zhol ma sde ba'i rdo rams pas skyo nga khur mdzad/ rdo rams pa 'di ba bla sprul min kyang mi ser gyi gras su snyan grags che ba dang khong bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas slob gnyer legs por mdzad pas rdo rams dam bca' bzhag rang yul du log rjes mi ser rnams brten nas 'du khang rgya bskyed dang lha khang zhig gso mdzad do/ /chos sde nyid kyi bla ma'i ma tshan la blo bzang rgya mtsho'am bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang skya ming du bkra shis su 'bod/ khong zam pa'i bya bzang zhes pa'i grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ lo zhig la lha mo'i gser khri the bor chibs sgyur mdzad par skyid po gu nas zam pa'i ri lam brgyud/ blo bzang rgya mtsho'i a mas khong khrid de gser khri rin po che mjal/ rje 'di bas bu 'di'i khyad chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa mkhyen nas khong lho mo'i dgon par bskyel nas slob gnyer byed du bcug 'di bas bla ma'i sku gam nas zab chos mang du gsan pa dang dge bshes mang bo bsten cing / khong nyid kyang par gyur pas phyir gser thang dgon du phebs pa dang / rjes su mi ser gyis nan zhus ma bzlog par tā ga'i dgon bdag mdzad/ spyi lo1958lor btson du bcug cing1960lor btson bkrol rjes rdzong srid gros u yon du bskos/ 1972lor grong tsho'i 'tsho ba spangs/zam pa'i thang ga sde ba'i mdun phyogs phug par phebs te sgom sgrub la bzhugs skabs sku gshegs so/ /tā ka dgon pa'i chos thog la zla gcig pa'i nang smon lam dang / zla gsum pa'i nang lha 'cham gshar/zla bzhi bar yul lha'i bskang gso dang lha 'cham/ byams pa gling skor/ zla brgyad pa dang dgu bar bdag 'jug du ma/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos chen mo/ zla bcu gnyis par dgu gtor sogs yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i dus su lha khang gsum dang 'du khang che chung gnyis/ grwa shag nyer — 434 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/drug phub/ dge 'dun pa nga brgyad zhal bzhugs/ 'du khang du sku che chung stong phrag bzhengs pa dang paṇa chen rin po che'i na bza' sogs mod po bsgrugs/ 1958lor dgon sgo brgyab cing rig gsar skabs su yongs rdzogs bshig rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya lor(19rnga1)chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan thob/ sbyin bdag sde ba brgyad gas da lta rang sa'i rta phyug lung mdor sa khyon mu'u bzhi bcu tsam gyi steng 'du khang mig gsum can rten dang brten pa dang 'khor khang / nang chen bzhings shing rung khang mig gsum dang grwa shag nyer gcig phub/ grwa ba zhal grangs mi nyung tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs so/ /gtsang nyid dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling /ri dwangs gtsang nyid dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong ri dwangs zhang gi khongs su chags/ri dwangs 'bum skyabs zhes pas sbyin bdag byas te sbyor 'jags mang bo phud nas de snga'i nub 'dod dgu dgon dang shar gnam sgo dgon gnyis skyabs mgon sku phreng bzhi ba thar 'dod rgya mtshos phyogs gcig tu bsdus(grong sde bdun la brten)nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa mo glang gi lo(spyi lo1889)la dgon pa 'di btab cing rdo ram sa pa ngag dbang bsam gtan khrir 'khod/ de phyis dgon pa'i khri bar mnga' gsol ba'i skyes chen dam pa 'di dag yod de/ brag sgom pa/ gur yag chos pa/ rtags g.yas tshang / bang tshang bla ma/ zhabs drung tsher ma/ skal bzang legs bshad/ ('di'i snga phyi khri rabs lnga drug gi mtshan chad) bye ma lab tse mug phruga.a khu don grub/ bya bzang rdo rams pa/ rgyal bzang bzod pa/ gru bzhi rdo rams pa skal bzang tshul khrims/'bab gling rdo rams pa/ yer ba sprul sku/ rdo rams pa rab brtan/ skal bzang bstan pa/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams/ a se sprul sku bcas bzhugs so/ /gtsang nyid dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ tsan dan gyi byams pa khru bco brgyad can/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ sgrol dkar/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ sgrol ljang /legs bris ma/ gser bzhengs 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ sku zhabs mtshan mdong rin po che/dpal ldan lha mo tshems drub/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ lcam sring / thā 'og kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba/ kun mkhyen lnga ba'i sku 'gag gser bzhengs jo bo sku khru bzhi can/ gser bzhengs rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ ltung bshags lha so lnga/ tsan+dan jo bo/ gser bzhengs byams sku che chung lnga dang dag sku du ma/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong khru drug can/ kun rig so bdun/ paṇa chen 'khrungs rabs/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing / skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / rgya' dbang 'khrungs rabs/ rta mgrin/ gdugs dkar/ rgyal chen bzhi/ a ti sha rje mar ba/ rje mi la ras pa/ rnam snang / tshe dpag med/ rigs ldan nyer lnga/ dkyil 'khor sna tshogs/— 435 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/kun mkhyen 'khrungs rabs/ gos sku la rje yab sras gsum/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ dpal ldan zla grags/ sa ra ha pa/ 'jigs byed/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ thā 'og gsung gi rten la yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ ting 'phags skal gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ mdzangs blun/rje'i gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ gzhan pa chos gzhung pota brgya phrag gser ba'engs mchod rten brgyad sogs ma nga du bzhugs so/ /dgon pa ni ri bo dge lugs pa'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang yin te/ lo 'khor gcig gi nang chos thog gtso bo brgyad yod pa bsdoms pas nyin brgya lhag longs/ rgya lo'i zla dang bo'i nang smon lam/ gos sku/ 'cham/lha bshos mchod pa/ byams pa gling skor/ gnyis pa'i nang gdung mchod/ ba'i ba'i smyung gnas/ drug pa'i dus bzang / drug pa'i zla dkyil nas bdun pa'i mjug bar dbyar khas len/ dgu ba'i kun rig bdag 'jug dang dus bzang / bcu ba'i gdung mchod nyin bdun/ bcu gnyis par 'cham gshar bcas spel te bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon ma lag brgya dang brgyad zer ba'i gras so/ /dgon par byon pa'i mkhas pa grags can la 'dod dgu'i rdo rams pa ngag dbang bsam gtan/ ri dwangs rdo rams pa/ rgyal gtsang rdo rams pa skal bzang chos grags/ lung ba rdo rams pa mdo sngags zung 'chang a khu rnam mkhyen zhes bya ba sogs rang sar byon pa sha stag yin la/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i yar dgon skyong bla ma ni les 'jam dbyangs bsod nams te/ khong rab byung bco lnga'i lcags bya ste spyi lo192 1lor 'brug chu'i chu bar zhang gi pad bzang grong du sku 'khrungs/ stag tshang lha mo gser khris ngos 'dzin mdzad/ sku na phra dus nas gtsang nyid dgon gyi a khu sma ra dkar por bsten nas klog slob 'bad/ phyis su bkra shis 'khyil du chibs bsgyur te mdo sngags rab 'byams gsan sbyong gang legs bgyis shing dbus su phebs nas bkra shis lhun po dang 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang bcas su slob gnyer lo brgyad bzhugs/ khong la sgo mang rab 'byams pa'i mtshan thob phyin rang dgon du log 195 2lor 'brug chu rdzong nas gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs/1958lor btson du bcug phyis dkar 'don thob cing 'brug chu rdzong gi dmangs chen kru'u rin gzhon pa dang srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa bskos pa bzhin da lta 'tsho bzhugs skabs yin/ rang dgon gyi skabs der khong gis dgon pa slar gsor rogs ram ci thub gnang bzhin mchis/ 'di ba'i sku gong ma chu bar dgon pa'i bla ma yin te bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyud pa'i khri ba bzhugs shing skabs der pe cin du rang dgon la mchod rdzas yo byad nyo bar phebs pa na pe cin du sku gshegs pa de'i gdung rten gdan drangs pa da lta dgon du bzhugs so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo la dgon par sa khyon mu'u nyis brgya lhag yod de 'du khang sum thog gyan bdun can dang / byams khang / btsan khang / mchod rten bzhengs/ grwa shag lnga bcu/ dge 'dun pa zhal bdun cu lhag bzhugs/ bla brang nang khag gur yag chos rgya mtsho'i nang khag 'dod dgu bla ma'i — 436 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/nang khag zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs bsod nams pa'i nang khag grwa rgyun 'byung khungs sde ba bco lnga bcas yod/ da dung ri dwags snying ri'i gnas khang dang grong sder lha khang gnyis dang ma ṇi khang mchis so/ /198 2lor chos sgo phyes nas 'du khang dang bla ma'i bde yangs/ rung khang / 'khor khang bcas bzhengs pa dang grwa shag so gnyis phub/ sil sdong ra ba bskyil/ dge 'dun pa zhal grangs lnga bcu bzhugs te cho ga phyag len sngar srol ltar rgyun 'khyong bzhin no/ /sa skya dgon bde chen lhun grub gling /r+pā kung sa skya dgon bde chen lhun grub gling ni da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong rdo ru ri zhang r+pā kung sde ba'i ri sdings su chags/dpal sa skya'i bdag chen 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bos(10 24—110 2)rab byung dang bo'i chu glang lo(spyi lo1072)la sa skya'i dgon pa btab phyin gyi spyi lo12 44lor yon rgyal gong mas sa skya'i rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog lang kru'u sde bzhi'i khongs te da lta'i kun su'u wu we char gdan drangs/ khong gi sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa zhes pa rjes su khrid/ de nas spyi lo12 56tsam na 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i thugs sras dpal shes rab 'bar(da lta'i the bo dpal shes steng ga'i bla rabs dpal shes pa'i sku thog dang bo ba1gyi gong ma dang bla ma'i bka' dang du bzhes nas thog mar dpal shes steng gar sa skya'i grub mtha'i chos sde phyag 'debs mdzad kyang / phyis su dge lugs par bsgyur/ de na r+pā(pad)gong sa skya'i dgon pa 'di ni rab byung bcu ba'i sa pho khyi lo(spyi lo1658lo)la sa skya'i grub mtha' ltar da lta'i si khron rnga ba'i mdzod dge rdzong gi chos rje'i dgon pa drag sngags bla ma'i yang srid sku rten rin po che dang rdo ru'i sde ba'i rgan pa rin po che rnam pa zung gis phyag 'debs mdzad cing dgon mtshan gsol/ dgon sa mu'u sum cu yod de mdzod dge chos rje dgon pa'i dgon lag yin/ r+pā gong / ra rtsa/ shis bzang bcas srib sde gsum dang / rdo ru'i ri sngon/ mdzod dge'i mda' dpung sogs sbyin bdag yin/ dar yun lo brgya phrag 'ga'i ring du bla ma sku thog brgyad byon nas rim par chos sde cung che zhing 'thus tshang bar bskyangs/ bla ma dang bcas pa'i skyong khur sbyor 'jags mkhan sku drin can 'di dag yod de/ bla ma nang bas kyai rdor bdag 'jug btsugs/ bla ma spun bcu bas gos sku bzhengs/ bla ma phyis gtsang bas kun rig bdag 'jug btsugs/ bla ma nang 'brus pas mchod pa'i lha mo dang gnas brtan bcu drug bzhengs/ bla ma bsam gtan pas nā ro mkha' spyod cho ga btsugs/ bla ma chos grags pas bka' 'gyur chos thog dang rdo rje phur bu btsugs/ bla ma dkon mchog grags pas tshogs chen 'du khang dang nang chen bzhengs/ r+pā gong skar ma rdo rje bas ston sku bzhengs/ ngag dbang ye shes kyis mchod rten bzhengs/ tā hu mgon po tshe ring gis sgrol ma'i stong sku bzhengs/ a khu dpal ldan dang dbang phyug gnyi gas dngul gyi mchod rten bzhengs/ srib ba'i ma rgan —gyis gsang 'dus bdag 'jug gi sbyin bdag byas/— 437 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/byams khang du byams sku 'dom bcu phrag can ngo mtshar bzhengs/ gong gsal las da dung rten dang brten pa/mchod rdzas yo byad gya nom pa yod kyang dpe mtshon tsam gyis chog par byas/ de skabs shig la dgon sa da lta'i gnas su spros/ snga gnas su da dung 'du khang dang byams khang gi gyang khog gsal ler snang / chos rje'i dgon nas khri ba mngags srol dar/ de ba'in bla ma nor bu dang rgyal rje ba/ shes grags pa/ bsam gtan/chos grags/ ngag dbang bkra shis sogs kyis skyong khur mdzad de da lta'i bar sa skya'i grub mtha' spel ba rgyun ma chad par gyur to/ /chos spyod kyi thad du/ hor zla dang bor smon lam dang mgon po khro bcu/ 'cham bcas nyi ma bco brgyad/zla gnyis par kyai rdor bdag 'jug nyi ma bdun/ zla gsum par kun rig bdag 'jug nyi ma bdun/ zla ba'i bar bka' 'gyur dang smyung gnas/ rdo rje phur bu bcas nyi ma bdun/ zla lnga bar nā ro mkha' spyod nyi ma bdun/ zla drug pa nas dbyar gnas zla gcig nyi ma bco lnga/ zla dgu bar gsang 'dus bdag 'jug nyi ma brgyad/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod nyi ma bdun/ zla bcu gcig par nā ro mkha' spyod nyi ma bdun/ zla bcu gnyis par dgu gtor nyi ma gsum bcas spel bar rgyun 'khyongs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i phyed snga ma la dgon du 'du khang dang byams khang / gsang 'dus lha khang / jo khang / sgom khang sogs bzhengs pa ma zad/ nang chen gcig grwa shag brgya/ btsun pa zhal nyis brgya dang lnga bzhugs/ yin na'ang lo de'i lo mjug tsam la bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ngo rgol byed skabs su dgon pa rtsa ba nas bsnubs so/ /1981lor dgon pa chos sgo phye zhing 'du khang dang nang chen bskyar du bzhengs/ chos ra dang rung khang /'cham stegs/ grwa shag drug cu lhag la dge 'dun pa brgya tsam 'dus te sngar srol chos spyod ci yod slar gso la 'bad 'bungs rgyun ldan gyi skabs so/ /ra rtsa dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /rdo ru'i ra rtsa dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong rdo ru zhang gi zhang srid gzhung 'gram du chags/ra rtsa dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling 'debs pa bo ni klu chung ye shes skal bzang(da lta ra rtsa'i sprul sku'ang zer)dang the nyin ngo ri khrod pa blo bzang ye shes yin/ de'i sngon kirti rin po che'i sbyin bdag klu chung a shis tshang gi bu rab tu 'byung ched lha mor bros/ kirti'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing khong gis lha sar mngags stabs dga' ldan gyi tshogs su zhugs/ 'don cha bslabs shing / bshes gnyen du ma bsten te lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len dang lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan sogs gtso bo mthar phyin te phyir phebs/ kirti rin po ches khyod the bor dgon pa zhig 'debs par song gsungs/ khong chu mig dang dur khrod/ bang tshang ri khrod dag du 'grims pa dang the nyin ngo ri khrod bla ma blo bzang ye shes(skabs der dgung lo brgyad cu bzhugs)— 438 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/kyis ra si ngori bsod nyams phun tshogs la gdan 'dren du bcug pa bzhin rje klu chung ba lo bcu phrag bzhugs shing der dgon chung zhig btab kyang gzhi bdag nag phyogs pas phrag dog gi dbang gis 'du khang 'og tu chu brdol te sdod ma tshugs par bla ma gnyi ga der phebs nas dgon sa gzigs pa dang kirti rin po che sa phyogs 'dir phebs te dgon sa bzang yang mtha' ma rgya grong du 'gyur e 'gro snyam gsungs/ sa bdag ni ra rtsa yin pas dgon sa ma phul/ the nyin ngo'i tson bkwan(spyi dpon)rdo rje dbang phyug dang bon lu kha'i mgo ba sngon klu gnyis co ne'i sa skyong drung la dgon sa slong du song / sa skyong gis khyod tsong bkun bskos pa'i go sa mi dgos na dgon sa sbyin chog ces pa'i tshig shor bas na/ rdo rje dbang phyug gis de ltar gsung ba lags na go sa mi dgos zhes lan zhus/ de bzhin rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa lug(spyi lo1799)lor dgon sa gnang ba dang dgon pa'i bka' shog 'byor/ de'i phyi lor dgon pa slar dngos su btab nas lha khang chung ba dang grwa shag sogs phub cing the nyin ngo'i bla ma blo bzang ye shes kyis tsan dan jo bo dang byams pa/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal byin can bzhengs/ klu chung bla mas sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ gsung 'bum sogs gdan drangs/'a zha lung ba'i rab byung ba dag 'dir zhugs/ de'i sngon yul der stag yul dgon bkra shis 'khyil gling zhes pa zhig yod kyang rim bzhin grwa ba mang shos dgon 'dir 'khor/ klu chung bla ma dus rgyun du mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen mtshams mang du bzhugs pa dang dgung lo go gsum pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa khyi(18 28)lor sku gshegs shing sku gdung byang chub mchod rten du bzhugs/ 'di ba'i sku tsha a khu rab 'byams pa zhes pas dgon par 'du khang dang rung khang / grwa shag bzhengs rogs byas so/ /klu chung sku phreng gnyis pa dkon mchog blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma ni r+pā kung yab ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sras su rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags byi lor(spyi lo1〈40)sku 'khrungs/ khong chung dus nas nga'i dgon zhes mdzub mo bstan te bdag tu bzung / rang khyim du nyi ma'i 'od zer la skud pa btags pas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis thugs thag bcad/ lo bco lnga'i ring a khu rab 'byams pas dgon pa bskyangs/ bla ma dgung lo bco lnga'i steng gdan sar bkod cing bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs grwar zhugs/ phyir phebs te dgon pa'i chos spyod thams cad la thugs khur lho med mdzad/ khong gi nang khag gcig tu klu chung bla ma khong nyid dang the nyin ngo bla ma/ 'a zha skal bzang 'phrin las rnam pa gsum bzhugs/ bang tshang dgon pa shugs che bas the nyin ngo bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bang tshang dgon pa'i gdan sar bkod/ khong nyid the nyin ngor sku 'khrungs shing ra rtsa dgon dang bang tshang dgon bskyangs par dgung lo bdun cu lhag 'tsho bzhugs gnang /dkon mchog blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma khong dus rgyun du ma ṇi dang yi dam sogs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad de grub thob par gyur/ re zhig grwa ba'i nang ma 'chams par dgon pa thor la nye skabs su bla ma'i thugs dgongs la/dgon par mi dbang can zhig bdag po dgos dgongs te tshur ga'i sangs 'brug dang gsung gleng mdzad de yid mthun byung / dgon pa co ne sa skyong la phul/ bla mas co ner bla ma zhig khrir phebs dgos zhus/ de nas khri — 439 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/dang bo'i bla mar sku zhabs shig phebs/ khri gnyis pa nas co ne dgon gyi yon tan mthar phyin pa re lo ngo gsum rer khrir bsko ba'i srol tshugs/ khong nyid dgung lo brgyad cu'i steng sku gshegs so / /klu chung sku phreng gsum pa'ang sangs 'brug gi khyim du 'khrungs/ lha mo gser khri sku lnga ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin /khri seṅge 'a zhus par re zhig sku bgegs 'byung bas gsongs gsungs/ nang chen myur bar phub pas na bla ma 'khrungs zhes grags pas lo gnyis steng sku 'das so/ /klu chung sku phreng bzhi ba rdo ru 'dang thang du yab lhun grub dang yum klu sman gyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu khyi(spyi lo192 2 )dbyar 'bring ba'i tshe bcu bdun nyin sku 'khrungs/ sa ngas 'brug gis lha mo'i gser khri gdan drangs te lo gsum gyi steng thugs thag bcad de mtshan la blo bzang brgyad ldan chos kyi dbang phyug gsol/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis lha bab dus chen la mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri la bkod nas dga' ston chen po mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi bka' rams pa blo bzang bstan pa slob dpon bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog dang 'don cha phyag len phra zhib pa sbyangs/ bcu gcig steng co ne chas pa'i gshis kyi chos sgor zhugs/rang dgon dge bshes the bo dkon mchog dang nyin gtsang bskal bzang dar rgyas/ brgya mched sbyin pa rgya ma/tsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ bsdus grwa dang blo rtags/ tshad ma/ 'grel ba don gsal/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/'dul ba/ skyed rdzogs sogs mang du gsan/ nyi shu bar bkra shis 'khyil du bla kho rin po che nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la ska(ra bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gsol/ da dung mu mthud du tshul khrims sogs dge bshes bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas sbyong ba mthar phyin mdzad/ chu rta lor rang dgon gyi rung khang dang the nyin ngo bla ma'i nang chen dang grwa shag du ma me 'jig byung / khong gis mang tshogs bskul te slar myur par bzhengs pa dang / dgon par me tog mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lha mo rang 'gul can bzhengs / gzhan mdo rgya'i 'du khang rgya bskyed pa dang byams khang gsar bzhengs grub ste kun rig bdag 'jug bla brang dus 'khor ltar rdul tshon dang bcas gsar du btsugs/ the nyin ngo'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa yang khyim gcig tu sku 'khrungs/ klu chung sku phreng gsum pa chas bu gshis dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi dus 'khor khri lo bzhi/ sman pa'i khri lo gsum/ rgyud pa'i khri lo gsum bzhugs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me bya(1956)dgung lo so lnga'i steng co ne dgon chen gyi bla ma'i mtshan rtags dang rang dgon gyi khri ba'i bka' shog blangs te dgon khrir bzhugs/ smon lam gsung chos kun bu gshis ltar btsugs/ sa khyi lor dus 'khrug gi dbang gis sku gsung thugs rten dang dge 'dun gyi sde yang med par btang / dgung lo so brgyad steng 'brug chu'i btson ra nas bkrol te rang khyim du phebs pa dang sku lus nam mkhar 'phags pa'i gzim tshul mdzad ba'in dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims so/ /klu chung sku phreng lnga ba bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho rdo ru'i tshe ring ngo grong tsho'i yab klu 'bum dang yum 'brug mo 'tsho'i sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags glang lor(1961lo)sku 'khrungs/ mtho rim slob 'bring mthar phyin rjes rab tu byung / krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling dang gan su'u nang bstan slob gling nas lo drug la mdo sngags rig gnas basbyangs/ kun — 440 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mkhyen drug pa dang lha mo gser khri rnam pa gnyi gas sku gong ma'i yang srid du bkas bcad cing1992lor gdan sar 'khod/ da lta mu mthud du slob gnyer gnang ba dang / rdzong srid gros rgyun u dang lo rgyus yig rigs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon par bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i rten gsum dgas tsam bshad pa la/ dgon par 'du khang dang byams khang / sgom khang /ma chod rten sogs bzhings pas mi tshad dgon pa dang grong sde re rer co ne'i bka' 'gyur tshar re bzhugs/rje yab sra sa gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ gzungs 'dus/ ting 'phags bskal gsum dang gzhan pota grangs mang bo bzhugs/ tsan+dan jo bo mi tshad can/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ bla mchod tshogs zhing /sgrol ma nyer gcig rnam sras rta brgyad/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong /mgon po/ chos rgyal/ 'jim sku dang / gyan thang / gos sku thang ga sogs shin tu mang / mchod cha la/dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal gnyis/ byu ru maṇ+ḍal/ dngul gyi rgya gling / zangs gling / dngul kong / rag kong che chung chig stong brgya lhag bdun tshar brgya dang lnga bcu/ zangs dung dngul dang rag gis byan pa/ rkang gling zangs rdung dngul dang rag gis byan pa/ rnam rgyal las bum bcu/ sbub dang gser tog rgyal mtshan/ ri dwags pho mo/ lañja/ gdugs dkar/ 'bag 'cham lwa/ tshogs zangs che chung la sogs ma 'dzoms pa med do/ /dgon pa'i phyag bzhes dang chos spyod tshogs 'don bshad pa la/ hor zla dang bo'i nang cho 'phrul smon lam dang rje gzigs pa lnga ldan gyi gos sku/ 'cham chen/ gtor rgyag me tog mchong pa/ byams pa gling skor/bzhi ba'i nang ma ṇi ril sgrub/ smyung gnas/ smon lam/ rje stong mchod/ drug pa'i nang maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/dbyar gnas/ bdun pa'i nang gnas brtan phyag mchod/ brgyad pa'i nang dgag dbye/ dbyar grol/dgu ba'i nang rdul tshon/ bdag 'jug sbyin sreg klu mchod/ bcu ba'i nang lnga mchod/ dus chen/khrus gsol/ sgom khang bskang gso rgyun 'don/ zla ba'i yar ngor gso sbyong ba'i nang khag gsum dang grwa shag brgyad cu lhag dge 'dun pa nyis brgya lhag bzhugs/ dgon pa'i las sne la/ khri ba/ bla ma gnyis/mkhan po/ dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ dge g.yog tshogs 'du mi sna brgyad bcas bzhugs so/ /dge slong skyes chen byon pa la/ klu chung bla ma sku phreng dang bo nas gsum pa'i bar rang sar sku 'khrungs/bkra shis 'khyil du bzhugs pa'i dge bshes the bo dkon mchog bla ma dkar po sku phreng gnyis pa'i yongs 'dzin/the bo skal bzang dar rgyas stag tshang lha mo'i dgon gyi mtshan nyid dge rgan/ the bo shes rab klu chu'i shis tshang dgon pa'i dge rgan/ the bo tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang rna bzhi zer bas mdo sngags zung gi dam bca' bzhagabakra shis 'khyil du bzhugs pa'i lha bzo grags chen dkon mchog tshul khrims sogs/ gzhan grwa sa so sor 'grims te bka' rams dam bca' bzhag pa du ma mchis so/ /spyir dgon pa'i bla ma gnyi gar sa zhing mu'u bzhi bculhag/yod 4dngashe kho gamang mu mong ni rang khyim dang mang tsho'agyed banyen nama'atshobarlowa/ stan yul da 441 da

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/kham sa tshan du me phag lo( 1957)la 'du kheng rnying ba rgya bskyed de ka ring bzhi bcu can bzhengs/ nyi na gtsang khams tshan gyi 'du khang chu sprul(1kha5 2)lor ka ring bzhi can du zhig gso byas/ khams tshan gnyis su gyes (dgon pa'i gling stod smad phye ba la yar nang khams tshan dang mar nang khams tshan zhes so) yod/ga'an sde ba'i lha khang dag tu rnying ma'i rgyan thang mang / 1kha58lo dang1966lor dgon pa yongs su 'jig go/lcags bya lo ste1kha81lor the bo rdzong srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang chos sgo phye/ skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gtso 'dzin mdzad de dge 'dun pa rgan pa bdun dang bcas kyis dgon bskyar gso'i dbu btsugs/ dgon sa khyon mu'u bdun cu lhag yod/ tshar kha sde ba'i gzhung khang 'du khang du bcos pa dang stag yul 'og sde'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho bcas kyis sgom khang gnyis thog can bskyar du bzhengs/ rten rnying byams pa/thugs rje chen po/ tha 'og pa dang chung ba bcu phrag phyir gdan drangs/ 'bras sgo mang grwa rigs the bo mkhas grub rgya mtsho dang dga' ldan grwa rigs 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs dang grong mi yongs kyis tsan dan sku dang gyan thang / thang ga 'jim sku/ shing sku gsar du bzhengs/ de min 'cham lwa mchod rdzas chos 'khor/ri dwags pho mo/ dung chen/ rkang gling / sbub/ sil snyan/ rigs lnga/ co paṇa sogs yongs rdzogs bsgrugs/ rung khang dang nang chen phub/ 'cham stegs brtsigs/ sil tog ldum ra bskyil/ da skabs grwa shag sum cu rtsa grangs phub/ dge 'dun pa bzhi bcu tsam bzhugs so/ /'a zha yar spungs bkra shis chos 'khor gling /'a zha yar spungs bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i man lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong 'a zha zhang gi khongs su chags/ yongs grags la 'a zha yar spungs dgon zer/dgon pa 'di ni rgyab ri gnyan dgra 'dul gyi brag dkar po mngon par mtho ba/ mdun ri nor bdag sog mo gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa/ mtha' skor du ja shing dang tsan dan/ a gar/ 'bras ldan gyi shing sna tshogs pas mdzes par brgyan pa/ dbus su phra zhing brtan pa'i rang byung brag gi steng la sa dkar po 'bras yar spungs pa lta bu zhig yod pa'i gnas der chags pas/ yar spungs dgon zhes pa'i ming de thogs/ rab byung bcu ba'i ba'i bgrang bya nyer gsum pa sa mo glang gi(spyi lo18 29)lor dge slong tshul khrims shes rab kyis gsar du btab/ tshul khrims shes rab khong nyid sde 'di'i khri rabs dang por bzhugs/ dgon 'di gsar du btab pa'i thog mar grwa ba bcu drug 'dus par gnas brtan bcu drug gi grangs dang mtshungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ rje 'di ba 'a zha'i yul dpon gu ru rgya mtsho'i sras sku mched lnga ga'i gnyis pa yin/ skabs der 'a zha'i khongs ra bzi bon dgon las nang dgon med pas khong sku na phra mo nas rdo ru'i dgon du zhugs/ de nas dge bskos dang / bla ma dbu mdzad bzhugs/— 442 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dason dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa der phebs te khong la tshe dbang dang 'jigs byed ma ṇi sogs kyi lung bstsal/dbus su phebs te rje tshe smon gling ba mjal zhing phyir phebs te yab kyi bka' ltar co ne'i sa skyong phyag nas dgon sa gnang chog pa'i bka' shog 'thob phyir sa skyong sku rabs bcu drug pa 'jigs med stobs rgyal gyi mdun sar bcar cing yi ge blangs pa dang dgon pa btab/ khong dgung lo bdun bcu'i steng du sku gshegs/ 'di ba'i ring dgon du thub sku dang gnas bcu/ sgrol ma/ rje tsong kha ba yab sras/ yum 'bum pa sogs mang bo blus/ dgon pas sbyin bdag grong tsho'i nang gzhis ka btsugs nas yong 'bab cung legs/ de rjes khong gi tsha bu blo gros rgya mtsho dang dar rgyas sogs re zhig khrir bskos/ rdo ru'i nyin gtsang ri khrod khong gis btab cing der yun ring bzhugs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa skal bzang 'phrin las ni lha mo'i gser khri bzhi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge'i bka' lung bzhin tshegs med par ngos bzung / khong1925lor co de'i sa skyong gi khongs the bo dmag ru'i nang gras 'a zha'i zhi rgyas sde grong du sku 'khrungs/ yab la dam dga' dang yum la 'brug mo zer/dgung lo brgyad steng gdan sar 'khod/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bka' rams pa blo bzang bstan pa klog slob dge rgan du bsten/ bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las dge tshul mnos pa bskal bzang chos 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu gcig nas cho ga phyag len/ sum rtags dag gsum/ yig gzugs/ bsdus grwa sogs sbyong ba la rem/ smon lam rab 'byams pa'i go gnas thob cing dge bshes lha mo tshul khrims las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom khrims bzhes/ chab srid dus 'gyur dbang gis1958lor dgung lo nyer bzhi steng 'brug chu'i btson ra nas sku gshegs so/ /dgon sde 'di ni dge lugs pa'i sgrub sde zhig yin pas sngon cho ga chos spyod kyi 'don rta dbyangs dang chos thog gi phyag len rnams co ne dgon chen gyi phyag srol ltar spel/ phyis su chos thog 'ga' rer phyag len bla brang gi phyag srol ltar du bsgyur/ lo re'i zla dang por cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo nyin bcu gsum/ smon lam chen mo'i skabs 'dir 'cham dang gos sku/ byams pa gling skor sogs yod/ zla bzhi bar ma ṇi dang smon lam nyin bcu gcig zla drug par tshes bco lnga nas dbyar gnas dang gnas brtan phyag mchod tshugs/ zla dgu bar bdag 'jug tu tshon sogs nyin bdun/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod nyin gsum/ de min yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong dang sgom khang gi dus gtor chag med sogs spel/ las sne la bla ma khri ba/ mkhan po/ dbu mdzad/dge bskos/ dge g.yog tshogs 'du bcas bzhugs yun lo gnyis re yin no/ /sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ dgon pa 'dir rje yab sras gsum/ byams pa/ jo bo/ sgrol ma/dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi sman sku bsdoms pas brgya dang nyi shu lhag gos sku che chung gnyis/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i gyan thang sum cu/ yang jo'i sku che ba gcig thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang gdugs dkar gyi sku khru bdun longs pa re/ mi tshad can gyi nye sras brgyad/ sgrol ma'i stong sku/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ — lhamagon chos gsum/ rnam sras/ lcam sring / tha 'og chos rgyal gyi sku sogs bzhugs/— 443 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul the bo rdzong gi khongs/de min ting 'phags skal gsum dang yum/ nyi khri/ gzungs 'dus sogs dpe cha sna tshogs dang / dbyen 'dum mchod rten sogs bzhugs/ gzhan grong tsho 'ga' rer rnying lugs rgyun 'dzin gsang sngags rig 'dzin pa mi nyung ba yod la gnas khang dag tu dus chen la rnga sgra sogs thos pa'i gtam mang ngo /dgon pa 'dir 'du khang gcig dang / byams khang / btsan khang bzhengs/ bla ma'i nang chen dang /khri ba'i nang chen/ rung khang khang mig lnga/ grwa shag zhe drug sol tog ldum ra/ dgon 'dus btsun pa brgya sum cu longs/ 1958lor dgon pa 'jig kyang da lta chos sgo phye skabs198 2lo nas bzung 'du khang dang rung khang / ma ṇi khang bskyar du bzhengs/ grwa shag bcu bdun phub cing dgon du dge 'dun pa zhal nyi shu bzhugs te chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel bzhin no/ /mgo rje mgon pa/mgo rje(mgo brgyad bris pa'ang snang /)dgon pa zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi the bo rdzong gi stag ra(rta ra dang gcig)zhang mtsho ba sde ba'i nye logs su chags/dgon chung 'di rab byung bcu ba'i sa sprel lo ste spyi lo1608lor dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan dang yon tan bkra shis rnam pa zung gis sbyor 'jags dbu 'dzin mdzad de phyag 'debs gnang ba la sa khyon mu'u drug cu lhag longs/ dgon pa 'di da lta'i si khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba'i mdzod dge'i a skyid skya tshang dgon pa'i le lag yin/ rje blo bzang bsam gtan pa'i yang srid rjes ma zhig ni blo bzang bstan pa zhes bya ba kha pa'i nyin yib ces pa'i grong du sku 'khrungs shing a skyid skya tshang du slob gnyer mdzad/ de'i sprul sku rjes ma zhig ni klu khang tshang zhes pa stag ra'i mgo rjer sku 'khrungs/ da lta'ang dgon pa'i bla mar bkur bzhin mchis so/ /dgon pa 'dis gtso bo srung ma gser khrab pa bkur pa dang / zla gcig pa'i nang smon lam dang bzhi bar smyung gnas zla lnga bar dbyar gnas/ lo mjug tu bgeg gtor sogs yod/ bcings 'grol byed skabs su 'du khang mig dgu can dang rta mgrin lha khang / gsang 'dus lha khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang / rung khang mig bzhi can/ spyi khang / nang chen/ grwa shag don brgyad khang mig sum brgya bcu gnyis phub/gtan sdod grwa ba gya drug(spyi grong dge pa bcas brgya lhag)zhal 'dzoms/ 'du khang du co ne'i bka' bstan gnyi ga dang glegs bam bzhi brgya lhag bzhugs/ yon bdag grong tsho la 'khyil pa dang / brag kha/ brag nang / gnyan nang bcas bzhi yod de mi ser rnams thub pa'i bstan par mos gus shugs drag pas gna' srol rgyun 'khyongs pa legs so/ /dmar dmag rgyang skyod pa dpung skor gnyis pa dang bzhi ba blo mthun kru'u te dang li'u zhan nyan sogs kyis khrid de yul 'dir brgyud skabs nyin bcu lhag bsdad pa dang / krung go'i gsar brje lo rgyus 'phros kyi mgo rje'i gros tshogs zhes pa'i grags che ba de'i 'tshogs gnas kyang dgon pa 'di red/ spyi lo1958lor — 441 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon sgo brgyab pa dang rig gsar las 'gul dus bsnubs/ 19〈 2lo(chu phag)la sa khyon mu'u nyer lnga lhag gi gnas su slar chos sgo phye bas da lta 'du khang dang lha khang gnyis/ rung khang mig gsum can bcas rten dang brten pa yongs su legs por bzhengs/ grwa shag dgu phub par khang mig nyer bdun longs/ dgon bzhugs dge 'dun pa rgan gzhon so brgyad 'dus so/ /

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/ong gsum dgon dga' ldan tshogs 'phel gling /ong gsum dgon dga' ldan tshogs 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong gi shar lho spyi le sum cu'i gnas te bar lung('ba' ling )zhang khongs su chags/dgon pa 'di'i nye logs grong tshos bskor cing ri bo ljang zhing chu phran dwangs pa'i sdings cha khyad par can te gser 'od nang zhes par btab/ 'ba' ling zer ba de nas thogs kyang zer/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhi'i spang thang dang btsugs shing 'dus pa la sa khyon mu'u zhe lnga lhag longs kyang da lta phyed ka las med par btang /a mdo chos 'byung du ong gsum dgon dga' ldan tshogs 'phel gling ni/ jo to tshul khrims yon tan zer ba smad du song / gong ma chan lung gis a chi thi mergan chos rje'i cho lo gnang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes bka' gnang bzhin rang yul tu a myes yu gur ba gdan drangs te khyi lor(1694lo)dgon pa btab/ dngul srang sum brgya skor gyis 'du khang bzhengs/ dgon pa'i mtshan kyang lcang skya rin po ches gnang / chen lung khri lo lnga bar khri ba rim byon la ku shri'i bka' shog bstsal/ se ra'i lha rams pa zhig gis ser dgon ltar gyi bca' yig bzhag lha mo dang chos rgyal srung mar bsten cing rten gtso rje btsun byams pa mgon po dang rje tsong kha ba bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i lor dge 'dun pa dgu cu lhag zhal 'dus par grwa shag zhe gsum phub/ bshad rgyun ltar na jo to ba(da lta'i nyin ngo ba)tshul khrims yon tan zer ba se ra'i grwa sa 'grims pa zhig dngos gnas rang yul du byon/ se ra theg chen gling nas lo bcu lhag bzhugs par gzhung sbyangs 'bras bu rab tu smin pas grags snyan khyab/ 'chad rtsod la shin tu dmar bas rgya nag gong mar legs skyes bsgron pa'i pho nyar mngags/skabs 'dir bstun rgyal sar gong ma'i dbu bla lcang skya rin po cher mjal zhing bka' chos thob/ dgung lo so brgyad steng rang yul la phyag phebs/ de'i lo dngos ni chan lung khri lo so gcig pa(rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me khyi lo)la 'du khang chen mo bzhengs/ ching rgyal chan lung khri lo so dgu bar(1774lo)tshul khrims yon tan slar pe cin du chas shing lcang skya rin po ches gnang ba'i dgon mtshan dga' ldan tshogs 'phel gling zhes pa'i gong ma'i bka' shog khyer yong / gong ma'i bka' shog de da lta'ang brlag 'jig med par dgon pas rten du gnyer yod de bod rgya yig rigs dag las bod yig dngos bshus gsham gsal ltar/gong ma'i lung gis/ gwan ting phu'u shan gung tshi tā go shrir bsngags pa lcang skya hu thog thur 'bod pa'i gtam/ nged la tshad mar 'dzin pa'i ser skya drag zhan spyi dang a mdo stod smad co ne'i char gtogs rong ba hes phyi han/ gdung nag tha ba/ jo shan/ phyi khu/ sag tsi zam pa'i sa cha'i bdag po dang skan jo'u — 446 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegaca/ bam/min jo'u sogs kyi sa'i char gnas pa'i rgya bod kyi mchog dman bar ba mtha' dag gis re rgyur se ra smad dang han chos rje rab 'byams pa shes rab rin chen dang / gnyer ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan/ dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas bcas kyis phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yu na ring du gnas pa de 'dzin gyi skyes bu spyi dang khyad par7bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi rje'i snying bar rol ba'i stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur pa'i gong ma bdag po chen po 'bas pad bskal ba khri phrag gi bar du brtan cing mnga' 'bangs bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba/ ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams byang zhing dag nas bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa sogs kyi ched du dmigs/ rang yul sag tsi zam pa'i nye 'dabs su dga' ldan mtsho(tshogs) 'phel gling zhes pa'i dgon pa gsar 'debs byed 'dug pa 'di la lo lo bzhin smon lam tshar gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod chen mo sogs kyi skabs dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag bcas kyis tshogs 'don bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ bskang gso 'khor bcas tshang ma kun rig sman bla smon lam bstod tshogs bcas bstan 'gro la sman pa'i rnam dkar bsgrub pa la/ khyed gong 'khor rgya bod kyi ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag gis bsnyen bkur mthun rkyen phan grogs gang che byed pa las gzhan pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang dgon pa'i nang khrims la 'gal ba'i rigs gtan nas mi byed tshul bzhin dgon pa 'di'i bsnyen bkur zhabs 'degs sgrub pa rnams la nged nas kyang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs rje 'phrin las bskul nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'grub pa'i smon pa byed ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge gnam skyong sgang(dgung )lo so dgu ba'i(1774lo/)sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal khab chen po nas bris/'ba' ling bar lung sa khul ni sngon chad co ne'i sa skyong gi khongs su gtogs/ yong gsum dgon pa'i chos dbang yang co nes bdag tu bskyangs/ ching rgyal rabs dus mjug nas 'jam dbyangs sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug(1ra56—1916lo)mchog yul phyogs 'dir chibs kha bsgyur cing chos spyod mang bo spel/ skabs der gser thang dgon pa'i spyi ba dang grong tsho lnga ga'i(snyung bu stong dang zed ya/bco lnga/ pe glu/ to yid)mgo ba dang btsun pa brgya dang brgyad cu bzhugs pa bcas dgon mgo kun mkhyen bla mar gtad/ de nas bzung 'brug chu'i chos sde che ba gsum las gser thang dgon pa gcig po bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag tu bsgyur to/ /1958lo ste bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin khyad dbang la ngo rgol byed pa'i dus su byams khang gi rten gtso rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong /khru drug can gyi nye sras brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug sgrol ma/ kun mkhyen rim byon sogs dang dam chos yongs su rdzogs pa bsnubs/ 1966lor rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i nang yong gsum dgon pa'ang dgon pa gzhan dag dang 'dra bar 'du khang sogs bshigs/ byams khang sum thog can de rten med 'artsamadzodargya te lus/ —tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengasagasumapa'i tshun te — 447 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya lo1981lo'i zla drug par dgon pa slar gso'i bskal ba ldan/ sbyin ba dargo dasde ba dgu'i mang tshogs kyis 'du khang thengs gsum par lhag tu mdzes shing brjid chags te mi rigs dang khyad chos yongs su ldan pa 'ig bzhengs/ gna' bo'i mi rigs dang deng rabs bod rgya'i khyad chos ldan pa'i 'du khang de mchod rten dbyibs gsum thog mda' yab gnyis rtseg ka ba dmar po rdza g.yam g.yu mdog can la gser tshon brgyab pa'i rgyal mtshan dang gan ji ras brgyan pas nang bsten gyi chos lugs rig gnas kyi gzi 'od 'phro ba'in mchis/ dgon pas kyang ching rgyal dus kyi 'cham lwa dang 'bag chos spyod la mkho ba'i yo byad cha tshang bsgrugs/ ri rked mar nang gi lha bzo bkra shis don grub kyis rang shag tu bzhengs pa'i lha sku sogs rten du bzhugs/ nye char chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel sgang yin/ dgon par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas sku tshab mngags/ dper na min go khri lo bco brgyad pa nas(1kha29lo)tsa yus 'jam dpal dang mtha' ba'i 'phrin las/ blo bzang sna ring sogs sku tshab lo gsum rer brjes/ yin na'ang lam thag ring 'ing phebs stabs mi bde bas sku tshegs kyi yun je ring song ba kha shas snang / da skabs shes pa'i khri ba 'di dag bzhugs snang yod de/ rab brtan rgya mtsho/ da lta'i 'ba' ling(bar lung)snyung bu stong nas sku 'khrungs shing bkra shis 'khyil du rdo rams dam bca' bzhag rjes rang yul la mngags nga 'i khri rabs drug pa red de khong lo du mar thengs gsum bzhugs / bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i wu'u tu'u 'phen ya zhang 'phen ya sde bar sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du rdo rams dam bca' bzhag phyin yong gsum dgon par mngags/ 'jigs med/ da lta'i 'ba' ling (bar lung)'ang gi srib sder sku 'khrungs shing bkra shis 'khyil du rdo rams dam bca' ba'ag pa 'ig yin/ bzod pa zhes pa'ang gong gi sde bar sku 'khrungs shing bkra shis 'khyil gyi rdo rams pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ gal te dgon par khri ba mngags gnang med tshe ser sde rang nas 'os 'tshams re khri ba dang rdo rje 'dzin par bsko lo/ /1986lor kun mkhyen drug pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog phyag phebs nas ser skya mang tshogs la gzigs zhib dang mjal 'phrad gnang / dgon pa'i chos spyod gal chen la zla dang bo'i tshes gsum nas bco lnga bar smon lam/ kun rig bla chog mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/tshes bcu bzhi lha 'cham/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad nas nyer bzhi bar kun rig bdag 'jug zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga bar bka' 'gyur dag 'don/ zla ba'i ba'i tshes brgyad nas bco lnga bar sman ring tshogs 'don/ zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin thar mdo/ zla bdun pa'i tshe bco lnga'i nyin bde mchog bdag 'jug zla dgu ba'i tshes bco brgyad nas nyer bzhi bar kun rig bdag 'jug zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer ba'i nas nyer drug bar ni zla dang bor mtshungs shing nyer drug nyin lha 'cham/ zla bcu gcig gi dgun nyi ldog la mgon chos dang gtor rgyag zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer gcig la paṇa chen bcu ba'i gdung mchod/gzhan zla re'i tshes gcig dang tshes brgyad/ bco lnga/ nyer lnga/ nyer dgur dus bzang gi tshogs bcas — 448 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gna' srol ltar da lta'ang lag bstar du snang la/ 1990lor zhang srid gzhung spos shing sngar lus khang ba rnams dgon par phyir gnang / da lta btsun pa re gsum 'dus nas chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel ba lags so/ /lan ga gshis bde chen bshad sgrub gling /'a na ga gshis(lan dga' gshis)bde chen bshad sgrub gling zhes pa da lta kun lho rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong gi bar lung 'ang gi lan ga gshis sde ba'i 'gram du chags/dus 'khor lugs kyi dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu ba'i lcags bya ste spyi lo172 1lor lan ga gshis pa sangs rgyas kyis nom pa'i sbyo ra 'jags dang mi ser gyi zhal 'debs la brten nas/ rang sa'i dge slong blo bzang tshul khrims zhes pas sa khyon mu'u nyer gsum lta bu'i gnas su dgon pa btab ste/ rim bzhin 'du khang dang / byams khang / rnam rgyal mchod rten sogs bzhengs shing rten bzhugs su thub pa dang / sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ 'od dpag med/ tshe dpag med/ sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje yab sra sa/ 'jigs byed kun rig dkyil 'khor/ dngul gyi sgrol ma/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ gnas brtan bcu drug kun mkhyen rim byon/ 'du khang mtha' ru ma ṇi 'khor lo brgya dang brgyad bzhengs/ sngon chad dar dus su grwa ba brgyad cu lhag bzhugs la las sne ba dang / dbu mdzad/ spyi chen spyi chung bcas bskos/ rang sa nas skyes bu dam pa khri ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / dbu mdzad shes rab rgya mtsho ni bkra shis 'khyil so gas kyi chos grwar 'grims pa'i rdo rams pa lnga dang / bka' rams pa a khu bstan pa/ rab byams pa gcig bcas byon/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon pa yongs su 'jig cing dge 'dun pa mi nyung ba sku gshegs so/ /spyi lo1986lor dgon pa slar gso ba'i dus su skal bzang don grub dang / sgrol ma 'tsho/ yon tan gsum gtsos mi ser rnams kyis 'du khang bskyar du bzhengs shing rten la sangs rgyas stong sku dang / rje tsong kha ba stong sku/ byams sku brgya/ mgon po klu sgrub/ rnam snang dkar po/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'od dpag med/thugs rje chen po/ phyag rdor/ rnal 'byor ma/'i mchod rten/ skyabs mgon gnyis pa'i li sku/ bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis / yu ma/ sogs mang du bzhugs/ da lta dge 'dun pa 'al sum cu lhag 'dus te chos spyod ci yo da slar gso rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i skabs so/ /zang le dgon bkra shis bde chen gling /gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gi 'brug chu rdzong 'ba' ling (bar lung) zhang zang le dgon bkra shis bde chen gling zhes pa ni/ ha lam spyi lo176〈lo'i snga phyir rang yul dge slong blo bzang shes rab co ne'i grwa sa 'grim sa te mkhas par gyur pa des phyag 'debs mdzad do/ / chos dze+e'adokhyon tsheb zhig min kyang chos 'a chad nyan slobaganye ra bzang zhingasdom khrim4gzab pagod — 449 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/thug bar dge bshes mtshan ldan mi nyung ba snga phyir byon/ dper na lha sa'i dga' ldan grwa sa 'grimase pa lha rams pa blo bzang chos 'phel dang / thengs dang bor bla brang shis 'khyil du tshogs rgyugs gnang nas rdo rams dam bcag bzhag cing gung thang lnga ba 'jams dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i(1ra60—192 2)yongs 'dzin du bzhugs pa dge 'dun 'khrungs/gdan sar 'khod rjes dgon du klog 'don gnang ba dang kirti dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa sa brgyud de slob gnyer mdzad pa na rab 'byams pa'i mtshan rtags thob/ rang dgon du phebs nas dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi 'gan bzhes/ 'du khang gi mkhar brdungs shing ka 'go 'degs grabs kyi skabs su jag pa skor 'ig slebs te nom pa bcom zhing shing cha mer bsgron/ khong nyid kyang dgung lo gsang 'jigs gsum/ sman bla/ rnam sras/ dus 'khor/ rta mgrin/ rje tsong kha ba — 462 —

yum/ rje'i gsung 'bum la sogs 'du khang dang lha khang du rdo ltar brtsigs/gzhan yang gser byan rkang gling / gser dngul kong bu dang theb tse/ 'cham lwa/ 'al 'bag sogs ma 'dzoms pa ci yang med par gyur to/ /dgon pa'i khri ba dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos bcas las sne ba bla brang bkra shis 'khyil pas bsko 'jog byed de/ khri rabs dang bo ni dge slong blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog da lta'i u pe sde bar sku 'khrungs/ dgon mgo bla brang la ma gtad pa'i sngon du gtan 'khel pa'i khri ba nges can med par kun gyis chos blo bzang ba la dbu mdzad dang thugs skyong byed pa'i 'gan bkal/ rje blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dus der kun mkhyen bzhi ba phyag phebs pa la dgon pa phul/ skabs der blo bzang rgya mtsho khri rabs dang por bskos/ rjes su khri ba dag ni bkra shis 'khyil nas mngags pa dang sku tshab pas tshes brgyad nas bco lnga bar bde mchog bdag 'jug btsugs pa da skabs kyang rgyun 'khyongs/ khri rabs gnyis pa dge slong skal bzang rgya mtsho/ 'di ba u pe'i sde bar sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs gsum pa yag hwa sngags rams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa yag hwar sku 'khrungs/ khong khri bar bzhugs skabs su bkra shis chos sde ri khrod ces pa phyag 'debs mdzad/ khri rabs bzhi ba dge slong bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i wu'u tu'o 'phen yang zhang 'phen yag grong tshor sku 'khrungs/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du rdo rams dam bca' bzhes rjes dus 'khor grwa tshang gi rdo rje 'dzin par bzhugs/de rjes u pe dgon pa'i khri bar bskos/ khong gis dgon pa thugs skyong gnang skabs su gso sbyong tshogs par lugs rnying zla re'i nya dang nyer dgur gtan du khel ba da skabs kyang rgyun 'khyongs/ khri rabs lnga ba dge slong don grub rgya mtsho'ang da lta'i wu'u tu'u rdzong gi 'phen yag zhang du sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs drug pa dge slong rab brtan rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i bar lung('ba' ling)gi zha'o kren zhes sar sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs bdun pa dge slong bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes pa khrir bskyar bzhugs gnang / khri rabs brgyad pa dge slong rdo rams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lags da lta'i u pe'i khye ma khug tu sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs dgu ba dge slong blo bzang mkhas grub ces pa da lta'i bod yul zhang khe dmar sde bar sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs bcu ba dge slong 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i thar ba zhang a smon sde bar sku 'khrungs/ khri rabs rer lo gsum re yin yang khong bstud lo drug bzhugs/ khri rabs bcu gcig pa dge slong lung rtogs rgya mtsho zhes pa u pe'i sde bar sku 'khrungs/khri rabs bcu gnyis pa dge slong dge legs rgya mtsho zhes sku yul gong mtshungs/ khri rabs bcu gsum pa dge slong mkhas btsun rgya mtsho zhes pa'ang sku yul gong mtshungs/ khri rabs bcu bzhi ba dge slong lhun grub rgya mtsho zhes pa ni da lta'i da nyan zhang du sku 'khrungs/ gong gsal rnams ni bcings 'grol yar sngon rkyang ba yin pas 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshod mi gsal ba dang da snga chos sgo slar phye phyin khri ba dngos su gtan khel bgyis pa med/yang a khu rtsa ka rdo rams pa lung rtogs dang co ne dgon chen gyi g.yung mo bka' bcu ba thabs mkhas bkra shis — 463 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/sogs bzhugs pa'i dus su gur yag bka' bcu ba dang/ dpon slob rnga mo gdong ba/ a smon sku skyes sogs dam pa du ma byon/u pe dgon bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi zhabs drung sku phreng dang bo ni u pe sde ba'i mgon po don grub ces pa'i khyim du sku 'khrungs/ yab yum dang sras kyi mtshan dang 'khrungs 'das lo zla mi gsal yang / khong nyid bod dbus 'bras sgo mang grwa sar brgyud de lha ram/sa dge bshes kyi mtshan bzang thob/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas lha sar thugs gnyer lhur len pa'i skabs su rje 'di ba khong gi yongs 'dzin du bsten pa dang phyis su kun mkhyen gyi sku rjes 'brangs nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ sku phreng gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog spyi lo1kha0 0lo(rab rgyal lcags byi)la u pe'i kwa hwa grong tshor zhing ba skal bzang rgya mtsho tshang la sku 'khrungs/ yab mtshan mi gsal ba dang yum mtshan du yum 'tsho(skal bzang rgya mtsho ni mo rang gi khu bo yin)zer/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug u pe dgon par phebs skabs su zla kha ma/ bkang bar a ma'i pang nas bla mar ma/jal ba na kun mkhyen gyis de nyid u pe sku gong ma'i yang srid yin par ngos 'dzin gnang / mtshan du dbyangs can rol mtsho zhes gsol te dgon par gdan drangs/ rjes su bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs su zhugs pa la 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten/ bla mar mtshan bzang 'jam dbyangs blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho gsol/ rang gi gdan sar phebs phyin1962lo'i lugs rnying zla dang bo'i tshes nyer gcig nyin sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /de'i yang srid sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho zhes pa198 2lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang co ne rdzong brag khog lung zhang gi mtha' tshang nyin pa'i dud khyim zhig tu yab ban de yag dang yum sgo ma phyug gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ lo phyed tsam ring rtsad gcod/ zin 'god/ ngos 'dzin bcas kyi dus rim brgyud rjes kun mkhyen drug pas zan bsgyur te1992lo'i lugs rnying zla dang bo'i tshes bcu gsum nyin la bkra shis tshe brtan de sku phreng gnyis pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang zhing mtshan la blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho gsol/ zla dang bo'i tshes bco lngar u pe dgon pas sku tshab mngags te khyim la snyan dar bsgron pa dang de rjes sprul sku bsang chu rdzong gi rgyal mo bsam grub gling du gdan drangs nas zla gcig ring bzhugs/ 1992lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin la rgyal mo dgon du mang tshogs kyis chibs skyel dang dgon pas bsang mchod rgya chen po byas mthar zla de ga'i tshes pa gsum(lugs rnying zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig)la gdan sa u pe dgon thog tu 'byor nas zhabs gdong lnga'i khri stegs su 'khod do/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan zla ba zhes pa'ang u pe'i mi yin te/ sku na phra dus su u pe'i dgon nas dam chos bklags/ dgung lo nyi shu'i rjes lha sar phyag phebs te mdo sngags gzhung gi rgya mtsho'i 'jings su brtson 'grus kyi gru gzings brten nas zhugs pa dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi lha rams pa'i mtshan snyan thob/gtsug lag khong du chud pa ngo mtshar bas kyang thengs du mar dga' gdan gser khrir bsko ba'i mtshan tho bkod myangs/ de snga slar khri 'gan gsol ba'i dus bab tu dgung lo bgres shing sku khams zhan pa'i ngang spyan gcig — 464 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/da walong grib kyis bsgribs pas bzhugs skal ma ldan kyang mu mthud du mkhas chen du ma dang bla sprul rnams kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad do/ /bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi chos thog gal chen la/ lugs rnying zla re'i tshes gcig dang tshes brgyad/tshes bcu/ tshes bco lnga/ tshes nyer lnga/ tshes nyer dgu bcas la dus bzang gi tshogs dang / zla re'i tshes bco lnga dang nyer dgur gso sbyong yod/ zla dang bo'i tshes brgyad la 'cham dang / bco lngar dgon grong spyi'i smyung gnas/ zla gnyis pa'i nang kun mkhyen dang bo/ ba'i ba/ lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nas bco lngar bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lngar ma ṇi smyung gnas/ drug pa'i nang chos thog gcig dang zla mjug nas bdun pa hril bor dbye srung dang chos thog nyin gsum/ zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer dgur 'cham dang kun mkhyen gsum pa'i gdung mchod/ kun rig lha so bdun pa'i tshogs chen/zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lngar rje tsong kha ba rjes dran gyi lnga mchod dang kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gdung mchod/ da lta yang zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la gdan sa'i bla ma rin po che'i gdung mchod/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig pa paṇa chen bcu ba'i gdung mchod spel nas kun gzigs mchog la rjes dran byed ba'in pa lags so/ /u pe ri khrod bkra shis chos sde/u pe ri khrod bkra shis chos sde zhes pa da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi ug spos(o phen)zhang gi dgon pa bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi shar phyogs spyi le gcig tsam gyi sar chags/dben gnas 'dir rgyab ri mdun chus bcad cing ljon pa stug po'i yal 'dab las gson shing gi rlabs phreng ldem par yul ljongs mdzes shing dri za'i yul 'a 'gran pa'i tshor snang thebs srid de/ sngon dus kun mkhyen bzhi ba chibs sgyur ma dzad skabs su u pe dgon pa'i zhabs drung gnyis pa'i bzhugs gnas ri sdings der gzigs nas bde mchog gi gnas shig red gsungs/ phyis su u pe khri rabs gsum pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos lha khang bzhengs te ri khrod btab/ dang thog btsun pa sku bgres 'ga' re der bzhugs nas sgrub pa nyams len mdzad pa dang gnas mchog der rtswa chu nags tshal ldan pas rgyun par gzig dang dom sogs gcan gzan ri khrod kyi nye logs su rgyu ba ma zad/ dom nag cig kyang dus nges med par lha khang logs su gnyid log na'ang mi la 'tshe nyams gtan nas byung ba med par grags/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor chos sde 'di 'jig pa nas da snga slar gso ma thub po/ /kwa hwa dgon bkra shis dge 'phel gling /kwa hwa(sgang de'u zhes pa'i don)dgon bkra shis dge 'phel gling zhes pa da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong yug spos(o phen)zhang gi khongs su chags/ mdo smad chos 'byung du gsal ba ltar na/ tsung bkwan gyis shing rta zer ba'i dus(shing rta lo zhig la yin da 465 da

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/ zer)btab/ de'i bu bsam grub kyis 'du khang dang byams khang bcas bzhengs/ reb tsha bka' 'gyur ba'i sprul sku dang / rtse dbus 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen rnam gnyis gdan drangs te rab gnas mdzad/bka' 'gyur bas gsung bkod gnang ste dbyar gnas btsugs/ sngon chad 'du khang lha khang gnyis bzhengs/grwa shag bcu phub/ dge 'dun zhal bcu gnyis bzhugs/ sa khyon mu'u gsum tsam las med/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag tu gtogs/ chos rgyal srung mar bsten/ rje btsun byams pa dang tsong kha ba gtsug tu bkur/ rab rgyal me rta lor bsnubs so/ /sbyin bdag grong tsho gcig pas1991lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nang rdzong gi chog mchan ltar/ dgon pa slar gso khul bgyis stabs da skabs dge 'dun pa zhal gnyis tsam bzhugs shing mchod khang mig gsum bzhengs/mchod khang de 'du khang ltar bzhengs shing nang du rten bzhugs sman sku nyer bzhi rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan ngo mtshar ba dang gzhan thang ga drug yum 'bum pa pota bcu gnyis/ mchod rdzas rnams cha tshang ba bcas 'dzoms so/ /yag hwa dgon bsam gtan bshad sgrub gling /yag hwa dgon pa bsam gtan bshad sgrub gling zhes pa da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu'i ug sbos(o phen)zhang du chags/nye logs su yag hwa ri khrod chos sde chung ba 'di ma zad bkra shis chos sdings zer ba zhig yod kyang 'debs lo sogs mi gsal na'ang dgon par sngon chad 'du khang dang / grwa shag nyer gcig dge 'dun pa so gnyis mchis/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su bsnubs/ da lta'i lha khang mig gsum ga de19〈5lor yag hwa(yar de'u yi don)sde bas bskyar du bzhengs shing1991lor zla bzhi bar dngos su rab(slar gso chog mchan thob)gnas mdzad/ yag hwa dgon pa ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag yin zhing / dge tshang bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang / gser sgo(da lta'i 'brug chu rdzong mkhar)dpon po'i mdun na 'don snying bo phyug mchod yon gyis byams khang bzhengs/ gcod pa/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ g.yang 'bum rnams kyi par brkos/ co ne'i dge bshes ngag dbang chos grags dang yer ba'i grwa ba rgyal mtshan bstan 'dzin gyis bskyangs/phyi ma 'di la brtsams chos thor bu'ang snang zer ro/ /da skabs dgon par dge 'dun pa zhal bdun tsam bzhugs shing grwa shag thun mong ba khang mig bdun phub/lha khang du rten bzhugs sdebs ris gcig dang chos spyod kyi yo byad mi nyung ba bsgrugs/ de min grwa ba rnams la rang kha rang gso byed par sa zhing mu'u brgyad sprod yod pa bcas so/ /mda' hwa dgon bkra shis dge 'phel gling /mda' hwa dgon bkra shis dge 'phel gling zhes pa da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu'i — 466 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gong smad chu bo'i bar rgyud de ug spos zhang gi kwa chu lhor 'bab pa gong smad chu chen 'dres mtshams kyi lung ring nub byang ri sdings su chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du bkod pa ltar na/ 'di se rwa'i rab 'byams pa zhig dang / yer ba'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang blo bzang gnyis kyis dge phrug mang bo bzung nas dpe cha bslabs pa las chags/ yag hwa dang gnyis gar dbyar gnas/ bzhi mchod lnga mchod bgeg gtor smon lam bcas yod gsungs/ phyis su bu slob mang bo dang mi ser gyis chos spyod spel ba las rim bzhin dgon pa zhig tu gyur/ yul mi rnams kyis dgon pa ha lam rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya lo spyi lo1801lo btab par snyam/ sngon chad lha khang cung che ba gcig dang grwa shag nyer gcig bzhengs/ dge 'dun pa zhal so gnyis bzhugs/ dgon sa'i sa khyon mu'u lnga tsam/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag yin/ srung ma chos rgyal dang rten gtso byams sku/ rje tsong kha ba chen po sogs bzhugs/ rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul skabs te rab rgyal me rtar 'jig1991lo'i zla bzhi bar mda' hwa sde ba'i(mar de'u zhes pa'i don)bsod dkon zhes pas skya ser mang tshogs skul slong dang shing bzo sogs btsal nas sngar shul du 'du khang bar khyams ldan pa gdung bar lnga can zhig bzhengs/ gna' srol chos spyod rnams slar gsos nas bzhugs pa dang / da snga mi ser dad ldan rnams kyis 'du khang chung ngu zhig bzhengs pa grub po/ /hwa bo dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling /hwa bo dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes pa gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong ta nyan zhang gi khongs su chags/ rgya skad du zhwa ho tsi zi zer/chos sde 'di ha lam lo ngo nyis brgya'i sngon yul phyogs su sa g.yo chen po byung ba'i rjes su/ dge slong ban de rgya mtsho zhes pa zhig gis mi ser grong sde lnga bskul te ta nyan sde ba'i 'gram du 'du khang zhig bzhengs nas co ne dgon chen gyi dgon lag byas/ skabs der dgon sa mu'u bcu lhag bzung ba la grwa shag brgyad/ dge 'dun pa zhal sum cu 'dzoms/ rten du gtso bo byams pa dang rje yab sras gsum bzhugs shing lha mo srung mar bkur/dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi thang ga byin can brten/ rab rgyal me rta lo ste spyi lo1966lor bsnubs shing dgon gnas su slob grwa tshugs so/ /da lta dad ldan mang tshogs rang mos sgos 'du khang sogs rten dang brten pa'am cho ga kha shas dge 'dun pa nyi shu 'dus nas stabs bde phub cing chos spyod rgyun ldan spel bzhin no/ /a smon dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /a smon dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong thar ba zhang gi khongs su chags/— 467 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/a smon dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling zhes pa dgon pa chung chung 'di ni/ sngon chad lha ba blo bzang bkra shis mchog gis phyag 'debs mdzad ces grags/ de'i rjes su gser rgod zer ba'i dpa' bo zhig dang mkhas shing btsun pa'i dpal ldan mgon po zer ba gnyis byon par ljags rtsom mang bar gleng ste/ da lta'ang co ne'i lo rgyus yig tshang du kho gnyi ga'i rnam thar yod ces pa thos so/ /dgon pa 'di nas byon pa co de'i ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling du tshogs bzhugs gnang ba gnyis dang /bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs su dgu bzhugs te dge slong chen por gyur pa dang byes nas khri 'gan bzhes/'du khang nang rten du 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang nas gdan drangs pa'i sman sku dang byam sa khang du sangs rgyas stong sku bzhugs / 1958lo'i yar sngon du btsun pa 'al lnga bcu lhag 'dus pa dang da skabs zhal bcu dgu tsam las 'dzoms med do/ /1987lo'i lugs rnying gi zla bzhi ba'i nang bskyar du 'du khang sum thog gdung bar gsum dang g.yas ṭ+wāṃyon du khang mig gsu ma re can zhig bzhengs/ da skabs chos spyod gang 'dzoms rgyun ldan du spel pa'i skabs rgya mkhar thang dga' ldan dar rgyas gling /rgya mkhar thang dga' ldan dar rgyas gling zhes pa da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gong smad zhang srid gzhung sdod gnas kyi nub byang spyi le gcig dang phyed kyi rgya mkhar thang(rgya skad du them pa grong zer)du chags/mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ co ne sa skyong gi mnga' zhabs he zhi span smad tshig tu mkhan dpon zung 'brel gyis khur bzhes gnang ste rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags phag1851lo la dmag ru ba'i'i dgon ri khrod sum cu lhag phyogs bsdus kyis rgya mkhar thang du dga' ldan dar rgyas gling btab/ grwa tshogs bzhi brgya lhag byung / sngon 'bras sgo mang ltar lha rams pa blo bzang ye shes bya bas mthong zhing sa 'bur sgang du lha khang bzhengs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du bsgrub pa sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa spel bar mdzad/ de'i gcen blo 'jam gyis dbus su mi sna btang ste mang 'gyed lan gnyis dang / sku 'bum du rang nyid kyis mang 'gyed lan dgu btang / rang yu la du lo gsum re nang gson dge zhes pa'i dge rtsa re byas/de nas mi rabs drug pa na dpa' bo gser rgod zer ba byon/ de'i sras bon chos la mkhas pa'i sngags pa bon skyabs/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i chung ba sngags 'chang dpal ldan mgon po yin/ shing lug lo ba/1776rang lo bco brgyad pa cha byi la co ne mdo'i ya mon gyi drung yig pa'i gras sa bcagarir mi tshorwa ris mi riring spyir 'brug chu'i khungs dang nye logs bod rigs la ming rgyal skabs nas bod nag zer te/ mi rigs gzhan pas bod mi'i gyon pa'i kha dog la bltas pa'am dma' 'bebs gnyi ga'i don can ming btags/da 468 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gna' snga mor bon chos dang de rjes rnying mar 'gyur/ dge lugs su sgyur yun cung thung / gsung rab spyi'i go rgya dang rig gnas la mkhas pa de nyid kyis bcoms pa'i lugs kyi bslab byar/ zas zhim dgu mthong tshe drung ma bcar/ /las bya ba'i cha las phyir ma 'then/ /don cung zad grub tshe 'dzum ma ston/ / cung ma 'grub 'phral du bzhin ma sdud/ / dbang chung mar ma gtod rang thag chod/ /las ci byed sna thag rang gis bzung /mi drin can sun du ma 'jug bkur/ /bkra ngo nag gnya' bar 'chor ma 'jug/ rang 'byor tshe dman la sdang ma che/ /'on phongs gyur bzang bo'i 'tshang ma 'bru/ /rang mthon por slebs la nga rgyal dmad/ /skyid gzhan la ma ngom spyod shes 'tshal/ /zhes sogs rtsom thor bu mang la nyams che/ bzhi bcu ba shing khyi(1〈14lo)la thong shi dgon dga' ldan chos gling btab cing don bzhi ba sa sprel(1848)la 'das/ nyid kyis sras bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis chu yos la bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar snang / dpal ldan mgon po btsas 'phral rtsis mkhan gyis brtsis par/ g.yung drung rwa ba ma chag pas/ /gser gyi rdo rje nam mkhar 'gying / /dngul gyi dril bu si li li/ / mnga' thang tshe dpal rgyas te bzang / zer ba babs/ cung zad nar son pa'i skabs bla ma rab 'byams pa bya bas phar khrid tshur khrid byas te 'di rang ga ba zhig min gsungs/ 'di ba chu yos(1rnga5 2lo)dus 'khrugs kyi skabs sku 'bum du bzhugs dus 'phur nas thar/ sbrang 'khyams kyi rnam pas phyogs mang bor byon/ rgyal spyi ban gyi gad phug tu sku gshegs/ gdung mdangs ma yal bar glang lo'i bar bzhugs/ de nas thams cad kyis rten skal du zhus nas tshar/ shul du 'bum khang brtsigs zer ro/ /rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i rjes su dga' ldan dar rgyas gling brlags pa'i gnas shul nas rig gnas skor gyi rdo ring bzhi rnyed/ gong smad zhang du sbrag tar khang gser 'bubs kyi skabs su las ka ba tshos rdo ring dag khang ba lho 'khor shar gcig gi 'og tu bsgrugs pa de tsam dang gyang khog skya rengs pa las rig rdzas yongs su rdzogs pa 'jig go/gong smad dgon dge 'phel gling /gong smad dgon dge 'phel gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi go smad zhang gong sman gong ba sde ba'i 'gram du chags/dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'di rang sde'i dge slong le'u yum don grub ces pas mi ser gyi spyi 'jog bsdus pa dang co ne'i sa skyong tshe dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi sbyor 'jags rogs ram las/ rab byung bco lnga'i lcags 'brug ste spyi lo18ra0lor phyag 'debs mdzad/ dgon par 'du khang snga phyi che chung gnyis bzhengs shing rten du sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rje tsong kha ba sogs bzhugs pa dang / mchod rdzas yo byad kyang shin tu mang bo bsgrugs/ gsung rten du co ne'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ gsung 'bum du ma bzhugs/ chos sde — 469 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs /'di spyi lo1966lor brlags dus bar khri ba sogs las sne rnams co ne'i dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling gis bsko 'jog byas/ khri rabs dang bo le'u yum don grub dang / khri rabs gnyis pa dkon mchog shes rab/khri rabs gsum pa sangs rgyas/ khri rabs bzhi ba dka' thub dge legs sogs du ma brgyud do / / chos sde 'di'i chos thog gal chen la/ zla dang bor smon lam chen mo dang / zla bzhi bar smyung gnas/zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nas dbyar gnas nyin zhe lnga/ zla dgu bar kun rig bdag 'jug nyin bdun/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo dang kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ gzhan zla re'i tshes brgyad la sman bla tshogs 'don bcas kyi srol dar/ 1966lor dgon pa bsnubs so/ /nye char mi ser gyis dgon pa slar gsos kyang rten dang brten pa sngon ltar sor chud ma byung yang btsun pa zhal grangs sum cu lhag 'dus nas dad ldan rnams kyi re ba skong bzhin no/ /'thob lung dgon pa/'thob long dgon pa zhes pa da lta'i yin lho bod rigs rang khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong gi gong smad zhang khongs 'thob lung srid 'dzin sde ba'i nub byang mtshams su chags/dgon pa 'di'i 'debs lo mi gsal/ dgon pa'i rgyab byang mdun shar du 'khor cing ri bo'i sdings cha nas rgyang du mthong rgya ring bar snang / sngon chad co ne'i sa skyong gi bka' bsgos chos sde'i khongs gtogs su lo re'i zla bzhi ba dang lnga bar smon lam tshogs chen yod/ de dus thon skyed nus shugs zhan cing phongs pa'i khar 'grim 'grul shin tu rjes su lus pas chos sde nas spel ba'i 'don pa'am cho ga gang rung mi ser gyi 'dun pa bskong ched/ btsun pa gzhon nu skor res chos spyod kyi yo byad khur nas grong bar brgyud/ kho tshos grong tsho re re nas 'cham dang gsung yon thob pa dgon pa skyel du 'bul/ 'di ltar bsod snyoms yong 'bab dgon du rgyun bzhugs gnang ba'i khri ba dang grwa rgan rnams kyis longs spyod pa dang kha gcig dgon pa'i spyi 'jog byas stabs/ skabs der 'thob lung dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa je legs su btang ba ma zad btsun pa'i gras su'ang slob gnyer dang rig gnas yon tan sogs dgon pa gzhan las legs par 'phar/ 192 1lor dgon pa me 'jig tshabs chen thebs kyang slar gsos pa gna' las bzang bar btang / khyad par du dgon pa rgya bskyed de bod rgya'i rtsig las kyi rnam pa lhag par mngon zhing bltas pas chog mi shes par gyur/ ra skor gru bzhi'i nang 'du khang sum thog bya 'dab nyis rtseg steng du gyo ljang dang gser gyi rgya phibs bkab pa nang bstan 'phel rgyas mtshon pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs ma tshang ba med par rab tu spras/ de'i phyogs bzhir khra mig ldan pa'i lha'i pho brang brjid chags par mchis so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang lo ste spyi lo1927lo'i ston 'jug tu dgon de spyir 'khrug zing cung che bas grwa ba gzhon nu slob gnyer la mi rem pa rdo g.yis tshe ring gis rung khang du sdom khrims ci yang mi bsrungs — 470 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa'i ma chen du 'then/ dge 'dun zhes par kha shags 'thab pa la de pham sa rdo g.yis tshe ring gi dpral bar brdungs/ don de gong smad du bsdad pa'i co ne'i yā mon te srid khang la gtugs/ yā mon 'go bas rkub g.yog mi 'ga' khrid nas bden rdzun gyi dbye ba mi phye bar dge 'dun zer bar khrims chad lci bo bcad pa dang btsun pa rnams kyis yun ring bsod snyoms las bsags pa'i nom pa dang 'bru rigs/ mchod rdzas bcas gzhung bzhes byas/ de bzhin dgon pa slar nyams nas rten zhugs dag la mchod me tsam yang 'bul nus med la/ khyad par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku brnyan la mtshan 'bul chad pas/ mar ru'i a khu khri ba dang a khu rgyal legs/ a khu gsung rab bcas kyis sde ba'i mi ser rnams dang na mthun grwa ba'am shes rgya cung zhan pa rnams la slob gso gong 'gug ci thub bgyis pas na/ tshang ma yid mthun byung nas rang stobs rang spel sgos sa rgod bslogs nas 'bru rigs dang so ma btab ste zas gos 'dzoms pa dang mchod cha mi nyung ba bsgrugs/ lha khang la gnod 'tshe che yang bskyar du sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer 'phro ru bcug pa dang / grwa ba'i 'tsho ba dka' sdug byung yang spro nyams 'khol bar gyur to/ /rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su 'thob lung dgon pa dang ban byams dgon pa'i rten gsum yongs su bsnubs/ da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i 'od zer dang thugs rjes mi ser gyis yid smon byed pa las lha khang zhig po stong ba 'jig nye can zhig mig dbang du mthong thub pa tsam mo/ /bkra shis chu gdong gling /bkra shis chu gdong gling zhes pa ni da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong bod yul zhang du chags/de sngon dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing khyi lo ste spyi lo1814lor sprul sku mkhas grub ces pa zhig gis btab pas da thug bar lo ngo brgya dang brgyad cu lhag 'das/ rjes su bla ma rta mgrin skyabs zer ba zhig gis bdag skyong gnang nas dgon pa rgya bskyed pa khang mig gdung bar don bdun phub/ de'i gras su 'du khang stabs bde bkod legs gdung bar bzhi can zhig bzhengs/ sa khyon smi sum stong lhag longs shing grwa btsan zhal drug cu lhag 'dzoms/ khyad par du dbyang bstan pa zhes pas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas dge bzhes kyi mtshan blangs phyin rang dgon gyi khri ba dang spyi bar bzhugs shing dgon par rgyas 'dzugs kyi mdzad rjes che'o/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo ste1958lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin khyad dbang la ngo rgol byed skabs su chu gdong dgon pa de gzhan dag dang 'dra bar sku gsung thugs rten yongs su rdzogs par gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs/ 19〈4lo nas dgon pa'i chos sgo phye ba dang 'brel yod sde khag dang rang sa'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs rogs ram las sngar gyi gyang ro'i shul du deng rabs can gyi bod rgya'i lha khang gi khyad — 471 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi lo/ ngas/chos ldan pa zhig bzhengs pa dang / logs su thun mong grwa shag khang mig bzhi phub/chu gdong dgon pa'i bla rabs dang bo ni dpal ldan mgon po lags te da lta'i thar ba 'ang bi a smon du sku 'khrungs/ sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i chab 'og 'ang gi dga' ru nas sku 'khrungs/ sku phreng dang bo dang gnyis pa dbus su phebs nas bkra shis lhun po dgon par slob gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad/ sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang ma khas grub ces pa rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu rta ste spyi lo1rngang 2lor da lta'i bod yul zhang gi khe dmar sde ba'i rong khyim zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i grwa sa 'grims rjes co ne ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling gis rang yul chu gdong dgon pa skyong khur bzhes su mngags/1955lor khe dmar grong tsho nas dgung lo don gsum steng sku gshegs so/ / da skabs dgon chung 'dir btsun pa nyer gcig 'dus shing chos spyod rnams slar gso rgyun ldan yong bar 'bad ba'in pa'i skabs so/ /dga' ru'i dgon bkra shis chos gling /dga' ru'i dgon bkra shis chos gling zhes pa da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong chab 'og zhang gi khongs su chags/chos sde 'di ha lam bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i kun mkhyen sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i( 17kha2—1〈 55)dus te spyi lo1750lo'i sngon tsam du dga' ru'i dbus pa zhes pa'i rab 'byams pa blo bzang mkhas mchog dang ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho rnam gnyis rang yul du phyag phebs rjes 'du khang dang byams khang bzhengs nas dgon pa btab/ nang rten du gser nag gi thub sku byin can sor bzhi can dang / dngul gyi thub sku khru khri gang can/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i 'gyogs byams/ mdo smad chos 'byung du/ de dus phyogs 'dir bon ma gtogs rab byung gi ming tsam yang med skad/ dang thog rab 'byams pa 'khyams nas dbus su slebs/ 'bras spungs su lo shas bsdad/ rang yul du gzan sham/ gnyis khyer 'ongs pas 'di lha yul du slebs pa red ces thams cad ngo mtshar/ dad 'dun che bas 'phrin las rgyas/ de nas mi rabs 'ga' na a myes dge slong dge 'dun dar rgyas zer ba byung / khul srid gros kyis bkod pa'i gcod pa'i ma phyir dgon mtshan du thub bstan dar rgyas gling zhes pa ma dag pa dang 'debs pa bor dpyad rgyu yod pa 'dra zhes bsgyur mkhan gyi mchan/ 'di dus cho ga 'don pa dar ba dang 'di'i tsha bo rab 'byams pa shes rab seṅges lha mo'i gser khri dgon du ming btags byas/ dgon chen(co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling)gyi grwa ba rab 'byams pa zhig byung ba gnyi gas lha khang gong ma zer ba ste dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang bzhengs/ khang chung gnyis phub ste dgon pa'i gzhi btings/ snga ma'i tsha bo rab 'byams pa blo bzang mkhas mchog gis yer ba(da lta'i bā tse rdzong khongs)dang / rjes ma'i tsha bo ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtshos co ne dgon chen du mtshan nyid la sbyangs/ gnyi gas co ne'i rgyud grwar cho ga phyag len gyi skor mkhas par — 472 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bslabs/ dpon slob skyes bu dam pa bsten nas rig gnas dang bslab bya bskyed rdzogs kyi mdzub khrid zhus/rang dgon du cho ga chos spyod sogs rgyud stod ltar mdzad/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang dgon pa'i mthun rkyen ched sog yul du byon pa der gshegs/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'du khang gsar du bskrun/ bka' 'gyur ba sprul ba'i sku gdan drangs te rab gnas dang dkar chag zhus/ gung tshigs chags med mdzad cing dus rgyun dpe gzigs dang thugs dam dge sbyor kho nar 'grus/ dgung lo nga lnga'i steng bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin zhal 'don gsung bzhin gshegs/ skye rgyud kyang snang / gong ma blo bzang mkhas mchog pa'i tsha bo rab 'byams pa mkhas btsun gyis skyong bar yod/ 'di bas ser smad du thugs gnyer dang lam rim chen mo sogs dpe shog stong phrag lhag tshogs rgyugs la phul pas rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags byung / mdo dbus gnyis kur dam pa du ma las zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan te rgyun spel/ bka' 'gyur ba'i sku las me long rtsa 'grel la sbyangs pas snyan ngag smra ba'i spobs pa brnyes/ dgon par se ra'i phyag bzhes bzhin dbyar gnas btsugs/ dgon nang du bud med 'ong ba/ chab len pa/ skad log rgyag pa/ grwa bas phu dung gyon pa/mgor ras nag dkri ba sogs byas mi chog pa'i sgrig bsdams/ 'di dang 'dabs 'brel du dam pa nyid kyi bzhugs gnas brag lung dben gnas khrims ldan byang chub gling du nyid nas lha khang dang / rigs lnga'i stong sku sogs bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan mang du bzhengs/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/gsang 'dus/ mgon chos tha 'og pa'i bskang gso rnams tshogs 'don dang kun rig skyor rta yang btsugs/dbus rgyud ltar dga' ru/ mda' hwa/ yag hwa gsum du chos thog res mos la so sor chos thebs bzhag ces gsungs so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi dang me rta lo'i bar te lhag par du rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul nang dgon pa rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ nags tshal mu'u brgyad cu lhag gzhung bzhes btang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'joms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun du tang gi mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi srid jus rim par dngos 'beb byas pa las1985lo'i zla bdun pa nas yul de ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis zhal 'debs bgyis pas/ sngar gnas sa khyon mu'u nyi shu tsam du lha khang sum thog gdung bar lnga can zhig bskyar du bzhengs pa da snga yongs su grub cing chos spyod spel gnas shig snang bar gyur/ 1991lor zhang srid gzhung gis bzung ba'i grwa shag rnams dgon par phyir sprad pas sngon gyi dben gnas su btsun pas phyag mchod dge sgrub byed pa'i chos lugs kyi khor yug tu grub po/ /dga' ru dgon pa'i bla ma(zhabs drung)sku phreng dang bo dpal ldan mgon po zhes pa da lta'i 'brug chu thar zhang gi a smon du sku 'khrungs/ sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho zhes pa da lta'i chab 'og zhang gi dga' rur sku 'khrungs/ gsung rtsom yod/ sku phreng dang bo dang gnyis pa lha ldan gyi bkra shis lhun po'i grwa sar phyag phebs nas thugs gnyer mdzad/ sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang mkhas grub mchog kyang1882lor — 473 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/'brug chu'i da lta'i bod yul zhang gi khe dmar grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chos 'grims rjes kun mkhyen gyis u pe dgon pa'i khri rabs dgu bar bskos/ 1955lor khong nyid 'khrungs sder sku gshegs pa la dgung lo don gsum 'tsho bzhugs gnang / ga'an ngag dbang grags pa rgya mtsho dang / bstan pa rgya mtsho/ shes rab rgya mtsho sogs rdo rams dam bca' can dang rtsis sa ris la mkhas pa du ma byon/ da skabs dgon par dge 'dun pa zhal sum cu rtsa grangs bzhugs mod kyang bla ma'i yang srid gdan sar 'khod rjes gzod sngar srol thams cad slar gso rgyun ldan du 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'byung nges so/ /de ba'in bkra shis chos gling gi chos spyod gtso rigs rgyud grwa ltar lags te/ zla dang bo kun rig chos thog dang smyung gnas/ 'cham sogs/ zla gnyis pa'i nang kun rig stong tshar/ zla gsum par kun rig bdag 'jug zla bzhi bar smyung gnas/ zla drug pa dang bdun par dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bcu bar lnga mchod dang smyung gnas/ zla bcu gcig par gsang 'dus bdag 'jugazla bcu gnyis par mgon po dang tha 'og pa'i bskang gso/ kun rig dbyangs gyer tshogs 'don bcas tshugs phyin sbyin bdag grong tsho drug ga'i mi ser gyi bstan don 'bad bzhin no/ /phud stod bkra shis lhun po dgon/bkra shis lhun po dgon zhes pa da lta gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong chab 'og zhang gi phu stod grong ba'i nye logs su chags/dang thog dgon pa sde ba'i nub lho phyogs kyi gson sdong chen po'i 'gram du btab/ de rjes190 5lor sde ba'i shar phyogs smi sum cu tsam gyi sdings char 'du khang gdung bar lnga gnyis thog can te steng du gyo thog ljang khu bkab cing nang rten du 'jim sku che chung bcu phrag du ma bzhengs te bzhugs/ rten 'gangs chen la rang yul ba dge slong tshul khrims zhes pas log gdan drangs pa'i skor yin la dgon gnas la'ang ri bo rtse lnga can zhes gsol par grags/ skabs der dgon pa'i khri bar bskos pa'i gnyer ba lha mo skyabs zhes pa'i rab byung ba des/ le dbar stong phrag sa nas yul du 'phrin yig springs te yul phyogs kyi chos dad pho sar gnyis mngags nas rje tsong kha ba'i li sku gser dngul zangs gsum gyis bzhengs pa dang tsi dung dkar dung chen sogs mang bo gdan 'dren rgyu rgan bgres rnams gros byos gsungs pa na/ grong tsho thams cad dga' drag cing rang 'thad pa lam chas mi dgos zer ba'i ye shes dang chon tu'u dbye zer ba gnyis dbus su gden 'dren du mngags pa gros 'cham byung / kho gnyis gas mi ser thams cad kyi re smon stong zad du ma btang bar phyi lo'i zla bcu ba nas zla gsum gyi ring 'os 'gan de gzi brjid ngang yongs su grub/ ye shes kyi lag ya dgun kha'i grang ngar gyis khengs/ kho'i rnam dkar gyi las la kun gyis yi rangs byas so/ /yid phangs pa zhig ni1958lor zing 'jags dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol skabs su rje sku de nyid sogs mi ser rnams kyis brag phug — 474 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/tu sbas pa las gzhan pa'i sku dang mchod rdzas thams cad gar song cha med du 'jig tshar ro/ /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun la gzod rje sku 'gangs can 'di slar gdan drangs nas sde ba'i 'bru mdzod khang du bzhugs te sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer lham mer 'phro ru bcug yin na'ang1990lo'i lugs rnying zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum gyi snga dror dgon bdag khrin h+phun khrin gyis mchod me 'bul dus su rje sku khru gang lhag can de gang khyer mthong med du btang 'dug pas grwa mang la sems nyes chen
