po phog par gyur/ da skabs dgon par rten du lus pa dpe cha po ti bcu drug dang 'phrin las nyams shing dad ldan btsun pa rnams kyang sngon gyi rten mchog dran zhing mdun gyi thor zhig btang ba'i rten dang brten par gzigs bzhin skyo snang gi tshul du gnas so/ /cha ba dgon dga' ldan chos kyi bsam 'phel gling /cha ba dgon dga' ldan chos kyi bsam 'phel gling zhes pa dgon pa chu bo'i bar rgyud da lta'i 'brug chu rdzong chab 'og zhang gi cha ba sde bar chags/rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu byi lo ste spyi lo1912lor chu ba rab 'byams pa zhes pas sde ba'i shar sdings su thog sum rtseg can mchod rten gyi bzo bkod lta bu'i lha khang dang 'du khang ci byed chog pa zhig bzhengs shing /rten du gtso bo ston pa dang / thugs rje chen po/ rje tsong kha ba/ thang ga byin can ngo mtshar ba shin tu dkon po bcu drug sogs bzhugs su gsol/ dgon pa'i sa khyon mu'u bcu lhag la dge 'dun pa zhal sum cu 'dus shing grwa shag kyang khang mig bcu lhag phub/ rig gnas gsar brje ste rab rgyal me rta lor thams cad bshigs nas bsnubs/ da lta dad ldan mang tshogs kyis 'du khang nyis thog can stabs bde bzhengs pa dang spyi khang ngam sdod khang mig gsum phub par btsun pa bcu gnyis zhal 'dzoms nas chos spyod gang mkho spel ci thub byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /u rtsa bkra shis chu dkar gling /u rtsa chu dkar gling ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong rgyang 'phen zhang gi u rtsa(nyin rtsa)sde 'gram du chags/bkra shis dgon pa ni nang bstan gyi rigs su gtogs kyang phyag 'debs po dang tshugs lo da snga rgyus ma lon par lus/ dgon pa'i rten la byams sku dang rje tsong kha ba'i sku/ spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi sman sku du ma dang dam chos mi nyung ba bzhugs pa dang mchod rten bzhengs yod/ sngon chad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas phyir phebs pa'i dge bshes shig gis dgon chung 'di bdag skyong mdzad do/ /dgon par chos spyod gang 'dzoms spel ba la bla ma dang dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ gnyer ba/ mchodagayogasogs las sne cha tshang zhing / chos spyod gal chen zla dang bor smon lam dang zla gsum par nyin — 475 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/—gsum la kun rig bdag 'jug zla dgu bar bde mchog bdag 'jug zla bcu bar lnga mchod sogs spel/rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i sngon du dgon bzhugs btsun pa nyer lnga tsam bzhugs pa rig gsar las 'gul nang rten dang brten pa bsnubs/ da lta btsun pa bcu gsum tsam bzhugs/ gzhan chos sde nyid kyi nye logs su sgrub khang 'gangs chen zhig yod do/ /spang ting dgon dam chos dar rgyas gling /lam sgang lung ba'i phu'i spang ting (spang sdong)dgon dam chos dar rgyas gling zhes pa da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'brug chu rdzong spun lte 'ang gi pu tse sde ba'i byang rgyud spang ting rdza rtsar chags/dge lugs pa'i sgrub sde 'di ching rgyal rabs kyi ca chin(gyu chin)khri lo nyi shu ste spyi lo1815lor sa de ga'am dgon pa nyid kyi bla ma dang po a grub rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos rgyan gyis skyong khur bzhes te ri khrod cig thog mar btab/ yang mdo smad chos 'byung du/ 'bras dge bshes po to bas btab/ phyogs 'dir se ra'i a 'bum dge bshes zer ba kun gyi smon yul byed pa zhig byung / sprul sku lan kha shas byon kyang phan ma thogs zhes gsungs pa'ang mchis/ skabs der dgon rgyab ri la brten cing dgon mdun chu la nye ba ma zad gdod ma/'i nags tshal sdug pos yongs su bklubs/ lcags 'brug18 2 0lor bu bsten dang / a grub/gus po/ kha stod sde ba bzhi'i sbyor 'jags las ri khrod rgya bskyed de rnam pa cung che ba'i dgon pa lta bur bsgyur cing dus 'khor lugs kyi chos spyod spel/ 'on kyang gnas rlan drags pas snon chas thams cad g.ya' chags pa dang / lhag par gnas dben pas jag rkun rgyun par yong nas dgon pa'i spyi rdzas thengs mang bcom/de'i rkyen las ching khang zhu'u khri lo'i skabs tsam du grong tsho'i sbyin bdag mā gu ru dang / dbyi shes rab/ cing ban de/ thar ngo ba sangs rgyas bcas kyis 'go khrid de dgon pa spang ting nas pu tsi'i gtsang dkar them du spos/ 'du khang nom stobs 'an pas re zhig 'grub ma nus kyang phyis su hra'an zhi nas 'ongs pa'i dpon chung ha'o krang ken(4goṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)te yul mi tshos khor lcags mgar 'go ba zer ba des sbyor 'jags dang mang tshogs bskul pa las 'du khang sum thog can/ rung khang / grwa shag khang mig nyer brgyad bcas pa yongs su grub/dge 'dun pa zhal lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ yid 'phangs ni rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul skabs su rtsa med du bsnubs so/ /dgon pa'i bla ma sku rim byon ni sku phreng dang po ngag dbang chos grags dang sku phreng gnyis pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog dam chos/ dgon gnas spos phyin sku phreng 'di ba lha sar slob gnyer du phebs shing rjes su yang rgya gar du phebs pas gnas tshul go thos med par gyur/ dgon pa'i grwa tshang chung bas chos spyod chen po bsgrub nus med kyang / lo re'i zla dang bor smon lam nyi ma bzhi dang / zla bzhi ba ma ṇi ril sgrub nyi ma bdun/ smyung gnas nyi ma gsum/ zla drug pa'i nang dbyar gnas nyi ma bcu gsum/— 476 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zla dgu ba'i nang kun rig bdag 'jug sogs dang dus 'khor chos spyod gzhan pa tshugs yod cing / do dam gyi thad du khri ba dang / dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ spyi ba/ tshogs 'du bcas kyi las sne dang / smon lam gyi dus su lo rgyun lha 'cham stabs bde re skya ser thams cad kyi dga' ston du spel ba'i srol dar ro/ /tang gi chos lugs srid jus lhod por btang ba dang bstun dad ldan mang tshogs kyis nom pa phul cing ngal rtsol la brten nas19〈6lor sngar gnas su slar spang ting dam chos dar rgyas gling btab/ dge 'dun pa zhal nyi shu rtsa grangs 'dus te 'du khang mig gsum can bzhengs pa'i nang du rten la dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs bzhugs su gsol ba las da dung 'du khang zur du rung khang mig drug can bcas yod do/ /chu bur dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling /chu bur dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling ni/ da lta'i yin lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi nub phyogs spyi le re lnga 'brug chu'i ngogs kyi chu bur zhang gi khongs su chags/mtshan la a khu shes rab zhes pa'i dge slong zhig gis dgon pa yun ring bdag skyong mdzad pas shes rab ri khrod kyang zer/ dge lugs pa'i sgrub sde 'dir ha lam ching rgyal rabs kyi dus 'gor mgo g.yas dpon chung zhes pas sbyor 'jags gnang nas dgon pa 'debs pa'i sta gon bgyis shing / ching yung kreng khri lo bdun pa ste1729lo la rgya nag gong mas chu bur chos sde la khri gdugs dang gser grub khri lor shog ces sgo byang sogs bstsal par grags/ 1721lor spang rtsad dang / chu mig thu'o ko'u pa/ ta he bcas kyi dgon chung rnams bsdus nas chu bur dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling btab/ de rjes chu bur nang ba byams pa zhes pas thugs skyong mdzad par grags so/ /chu bur nang ba byams pa zhes pa mdo smad chos 'byung ltar na/ sngon rabs dpon po'i tsha bu rdo rje bkra shis zhes pa'i mtshan lam du bla ma zhig dang dpon po zhig gis gnas tshang g.yor ba rmis/ yun ma ring bar kho bo'i chung mar bu sbrum/ khyo bo byes su chas pa'i shul du bu mtshe skyes par chung ma ngo gnong nas mtshe chung phyugs ra'i sa 'og tu sbos/ khyo bo phyir rang khyim du 'byor 'phral kho tshang bu mtshe skyes shing chos srid kyi 'phrin las rgyas par bshad de yang yang chung mar dris/ chung mas rgyu mtshan bsnyad rjes yab de 'phral gdungs rkyen tshe las 'das/ bu mtshe che nar son pa na khyim thab len dgos pa lab tshe ma nyan par co ne dgon chen du bros te rab tu byung / de rjes khong gi pha yul gyi khang ba dang sa zhing / mi ser bcas pa gnyen nye la sprad nas khyim shul chad du bcug khong nyid thugs gnyer dpyis phyin pas rab 'byams pa'i mtshan thob/ rang dgon du gzhi gsum gyi phyag len yun ring 'bad pa lhur len mdzad stabs dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhes grags snyan 'bar/sku na bgres pa'i tshe dge tshang ri khrod ces pa btab nas der lta sgom du bzhugs pa la kun gyis dge tshang a myes zhes 'bod pa dang dgung lo tshe mthar phyin pa dang zhi bar gshegs so/ /dgon pa'i nang rten du gtso bo sangs — 477 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul 'brug chu rdzong gi khongs/7rgyas thub pa dang / mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ bshags lha so lnga/ 'od dpag med/sgrol dkar/ tshe lha rnam gsum sogs li ma che chung mang bo dang / sde dge'i bka' 'gyur bcas bzhugs so/ /dgon par sngon chad mdo sngags zung 'jug gi mkhas pa grags can dang snyan ngag pa/ gso rig mkhan po mang tsam byon pa dag las/ shes rab kyi me tog rnam par bzhad cing sdom khrims kyi rgyud brtul pa'i mkhas grags li'u bla ma zhes pas kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog ( 1856da wa1916)gi zhal bkod bzhin the bo'i gtsang nyid dgon pa'i khri ba dang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad la bzhugs pa dang smad sog tu phyag phebs pas dad ldan skyes bu mang du byon/ khong gis gtsang nyid dgon par thub sku dang chos 'khor/ ri dwags pho mo/ rnam bcu dbang ldan dang tsi dung sogs mang du gdan drangs/ chu bur dgon pa'i bla ma sku phreng dgu ba kra'o dkon mchog ces pa the bo'i gtsang pa'am bya 'bab tu sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi bco lnga'i dus su stag tshang lha mo'i dgon gyi chos grwar 'grims shing / dgung lo nyer lnga'i dus yab rjes 'brangs te chu bur dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/ bcings grol rjes su 'brug chu rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'am rdzong srid gros rgyun u bcas kyi 'gan bzhes te 'tsho bzhugs skabs so/ /dgon pa'i chos spyod gal chen la zla dang bor smon lam chen mo dang 'cham/ gtor rgyag zla gsum par sman bla'i sgrub mchod/ zla bzhi bar ma ṇi ril sgrub dang / smyung gnas/ zla drug par mkhril ba'i ba/zla dgu bar kun rig gi bdag 'jug zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ de min lo re'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes brgyad la sman bla tshogs 'don sogs yod do/ /dgon pa 'di sngon chad dmag gis 'phrog bcom gtor bshig btang ba dang rgyal yongs kyi chos sde gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo ste spyi lo1958lo dang rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i dus zing du gtor rlag tshabs chen thebs phyin da snga slar gso ma nus par dgon sa zhang gi slob chung du gyur to/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/klu chu rdzong gi khongs/stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub pad dkar grol ba'i gling /mdo smad yul gyi chos sde chen po stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri dgon ni/ dga' ldan khri rabs nga gsum pa khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅges rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug ste spyi lo174rngalor phyag 'debs mdzad/gnas yul ni chu klong chen po klu chu gang las 'bab pa'i stod kyi shar lho'i ngos/ 'brug dkar gtsang bo'i chu 'go thon yul/ gan su'u dang mtsho sngon/ zi khron zhing chen gsum gyi 'brel mtshams/ sa yi dge bcu 'dzoms shing sa dpyad shin tu legs pa/ sngon slob dpon pad+mas bdud srin btul bar grags pa'i gnas mchog da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong lha mo zhang gi khongs yin/chos sde 'di gsar 'debs mkhan khri chen rgyal ca/tshan seṅge ni/ sngon ston pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon skabs dgra bcom pa ste nye bar 'khor dang / shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung sngags rdo rje theg pa'i tshul spel bar mdzad pa rje btsun shes rab seṅge dang / 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo'i thugs kyi bzhed don la lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgya cher spel bar mdzad mkhas shar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs kyi sku'i skyes pa du ma bzhes/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta1678lor zam tsha'i(klu chu rdzong khongs)chos 'khor sgang ste ka sdong mgo zhes pa'i sde khrod du/ yab tshe ring bkra shis dang yum snying mo lcags kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ dam pa 'di nyid sku na phra mo'i dus nas byis pa tha mal ba'i spyod pa dang bral te yi ge 'bri klog sogs tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig par tā dbon tshul khrims seṅge las rab tu byung ste rgyal mtshan seṅge zhes mtshan gsol/ nyer bdun steng dbus su phebs te kun gzigs paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes mchog gi lung bstan bzhin 'bras sprungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ khri chen dpal ldan grags pa/ khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas/ rje phun tshogs rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bcu phrag du mar bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang dbang lung man ngag bcas la gsan sbyong dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ sku nyid chos grwa phebs bzhugs kyi dus dang rnam pa kun tu dam can chos rgyal phyi bzhin 'brangs pas 'di skyes bu ga'an dang mi 'dra bar 'dug ces 'jams dbyangs bzhad pas sku 'khor la dngos su gsungs/ so dgu ba la lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ nga bo 'brug la'i mkhan khrir lo gsum/ zhe dgu ba la dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang gi bla ma dbu mdzad la bzhugs/ nga gnyis pa nas rgyud — 479 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/pa'i khri ba dang dga' ldan byang rtse'i chos rje zung 'brel mdzad/ dgu lo nga lnga ba(1722 )nas lo brgyad kyi yun la dga' ldan gser khri la zhal mthil bkris 'khor lo mngon par bkod/ dga' ldan chos rgyal rang byon gyi ljags zhig gso dgos pa sngar sus kyang ma nus pa rje nyid kyis phyag bstan zhig gsos gnang ba sogs khya da par du 'phags pa'i mdzad pa phul du byung/ re gsum pa nas gzhon nu byang chub 'od kyi gdan sa bya yul mang ra'i mkhan khrir lo brgyad la bzhugs pa sogs dbus gtsang gi phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che khur du bzhes gshis/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs mdzad 'phrin gyi sgo nas zhwa ser bstan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad do/ /dgung lo bdun cu ba(1747)la/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong sog po'i chin lbang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gis rgyal dbang bdun pa rje skal bzang rgya mtsho mchog la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge 'di nyid kho bo cag gi rigs kyi cod pan du gnas dgos zhes zhu ba nan cher phul lan du/khri chen khong nyid kyi thugs dgongs dang bstun mchog ces/ bka' gnang rje rang la gsol ba btab pa na/lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan dus la babs par mkhyen nas/ pha yul mdo smad phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur pa la phyogs pa'i tshe/ rgyal dbang gis tham ga gru skor ma dang / bka' dang bstan bcos du ma las bstan pa'i bdag por ji ltar lung gis bstan pa snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur pa'i khri chen dh+wa dza seṅge zhes 'khor ba'i bka' shog khyad par 'gangs chen po'i thugs dam gyi rten rdo rje phreng ba dang mi tā brgya rtsa'i dkyil thang cha tshang ba gnang nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i bdag po mnga' gsol zhing / byin rten dang dngos rdzas spus legs gya nom pa rnam grangs stong lhag gi phebs rdzongs gnang ba ma zad/ sde ba gzhung nas kyang phebs rdzongs rgya cher bsgrub dgos pa'i bka' bstsal pa ltar bsgrubs/ de nas lo de'i bod zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin mdo smad du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur cing / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin chin lbang gi urger mchod yon zhal 'dzoms/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs te/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis par sku chos sogs phul cing chos srid lugs zung la 'brel ba'i bslab ston gnang nas dge 'dun 'dus sde dang dpon tshang bcas la phyag dbang dngos chab bstsal te tshogs su dngul ṭam re'i 'gyed btang / phyi lo(174ra)mchod yon gnyis chab tshan la phebs te lha mo'i gnas mdun du bzhugs sgar btab pa dang 'brang rgyas kyi gnas 'di dgon gsar gzigs pa dge mtshan gyi ltas dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa byung bar bla brang gi gnas gzhi bzung ste dgon gsar 'debs kyi dbu brtsams/ sbyin bdag chen po rgyal bo chen lbang gis sku gsung thugs rten dang rta nor lug dngos rdzas sogs 'bul ba dang gser khri'i dbon rgyud du sog po nas bas ji sbra khag 'ga' dang lha sde/ su rug skyong sa'i mtsher sa bcas phul/ co ne sa skyong dmag zor mgon po yab sras gnyis kyis rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs spyi bor bsten te bka' 'gyur dpar phud kyis mtshon pa'i rten gsum dang — 480 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dngos chas gya nom pa dang / sa zhing nags tshal dang dgon lag mchod gzhis lha sde sogs phul nas sbyin bdag byed par zhus/ mdzod dge a bkra dpal dgon gyis gling ba/ byams me/ bzhag sdom/ 'bo'u sogs shog kha bzhi mchod gzhis kyi thog mar dngos rdzas sbyor 'jags dang grwa rgyun gyi thog ma phul te lo re chos thog chen po bzhis sbyin bdag byed par khas len zhus/ de min mchod gzhis lha sder gyur pa zam tsha rong 'brog a la shog kha lnga/ rkyang tsha tsho ba gsum/ gus ma ru skor lnga/ tshong ru sde lnga/ the bo rong gsum/'bring ba'i snod ljongs/ rdo chags/ mtha' ru gong ba gnyis/ bre lun pa/ dme gya/ sum mthil/dgon chags/ mtha' ba lha sde gsum sogs kyis snga gzhug tu chos sde 'di nyid gsar 'debs la mthun rkyen dang zhabs tog gang legs sgos sbyin bdag byas/ gtsos nas gdan drangs pa bzhin der lam du mar phebs nas gtsos dge legs rgya mtsho dang rtse thog sku skye gnyis gtsos pa'i ser skya drag zhan kun 'dun pa chig sgril gyi sgo nas dgon pa phul pa bdag gir bzhes/ sa sbrul(1749)lor gtsos dgon par bshad grwa btsugs/ de nas rim bzhin mdo smad phyogs kyi dgon sde dang yul gru mang por zhabs kyis bcags cing byin gyis brlabs/thugs sras bu slob kyi gras la/ khri chen ngag dbang chos grags dang / khri chen ngag dbang tshul khrims/ rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ brag yab blo bzang bstan pa/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ tsha rdor no mon han/ stobs ldan bsngags rams pa/ mergen rje nam seng ba/ brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab/ khang lung ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ gnyan rtse dpon slob ngag dbang chos 'phel/ tā dbon pa blo bzang seṅge sogs nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang bo bskyangs/ byang chub lam rim pa dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i cha mang pos brgyan pa dang / gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel le'u lnga ba yan/ rje rang nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ bka' 'gyur dkar chag klu shod rdzong lha bcu gsum gyi bsang yig ma dgon lha mo dang gtsos dgon lag gnyis kyi bca' yig sogs bka' rtsom du ma bzhugs/ de ltar bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo don dgu bzhes pa me byi(1756)lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga la zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil dkrung dang phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag ngang sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus kyang mdzad 'phrul gyi sku gdung hrul bo de/lo nyis brgya lhag la skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi dpal du bzhugs pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags khyi(1970)lo'i bar lha gson po red ces gzhan dbang gis bzhus pa'i gdung rus 'phel gdung dang bcas da lta slar bzhengs pa'i gser gdung khang du gdung rten che legs bzhugs so/ /khri chen sku phreng gnyis pa rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me glang(1757)lor 'bo ra'i khrom thog stag chu'i(bsang chu rdzong khongs)sar yab drung ba lcags po byams dang / yum lcags mo'i sras su sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun par drung ba bla ma sedha'i mtshan can gyis thugs thag bcad de/yab rje gong mas phyag 'debs gnang ba'i lha mo'i gser khri dgon du gdan sar bkod/ 'bras sgo mang lha rams pa khā shi blo bzang shes rab yongs 'dzin du bsten/ dam pa gong ma'i mdzad 'phrin gyi rgyun bskyangs te — 481 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/yul mdo smad dang khyad par du dbus kyi 'bras sgo mang gi chos grwa rnams su mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu gsan sbyong mthil phyin pa mdzad/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la dbu 'phang brnyes shing mkhas btsun bzang bo'i yon tan gyis thugs rgyud yongs su phyug cing dbang lung man ngag gi gter tu gyur/ dbus su lan gnyis phebs/ rgyal dbang brgyad pa chen pos cho lo dang tham ga gru sgor/ bka' shog sku gsung thugs rten/ gdugs rta dar sogs rnam grangs stong lhag gi dngos rten bstsal/ mdo smad kyi bod yul phal mo che dang / rgya hor sog gsum gyi yul gru mang po zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs nas skal ldan gyi bu slob brgya phrag du ma rjes su bzung / mthong thos dran reg gis gdul bya bgrang las 'das pa'i 'khor ba mtha' can du mdzad/ khyad par du khri chen gong ma'i gdan sa lha mo'i gser khri dgon dang gtsos dge ldan chos gling gnyis lugs kyi cha nas ris med kyis bskyangs/ gsung 'bum la mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i skor pota brgyad bzhugs/ dgung lo go gsum bzhes pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa bya(1〈49)lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdu bar mdzad pa sogs rnam thar chen mor gsal lo/ /khri chen sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin seṅge ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing stag(1854)lor kho tshe(bsang chu rdzong khongs) ru yab sbyin pa rgya mtsho dang / yum jo mo thar gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku mched yin par gleng / lha mo dang gtsos dgon gong 'og gnyis kyi las sne che bgres rnams gros mthun gyis re zhig gtsos dgon par phebs rgyu'i thag bcad pa ltar/dgung lo bzhi ba la gtsos dgon par gdan drangs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen smon lam rgya mtsho tshang yongs 'dzin du bsten/ 'khrungs yul dang nyushrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud dngos rgyal bo chin lbang gi urger chibs kha bsgyur te/ khri chen gong ma nas mchod yon gyi 'brel khyad par ba yar ldan du spel/ dgung lo nyer gcig par dbus su chibs bsgyur skabs gdan sa lha mor phebs pa na/ gser khri nang chen gtso byas pa'i sgar grong gis phebs rdzongs rgya chen phul/ dbus nas slar rang yul du zhal phyogs la nye ba na/ rgyal mchog bcu gnyis pa chen pos byin rten du ma dang / gzhung nas bka' shog bstsal/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po chen bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad de/ dgung grangs nyer gsum bzhes pa rab byung co lnga ba'i me byi(1870)lor gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa bsdu bar mdzad do/ /khri chen sku phreng bzhi ba rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me glang(1877)lor/yab rje sku phreng gnyis pa 'khrungs yul 'bo ra'i drung ba tshang nas yab klu 'bum bkra shis dang / yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su sku bltams/ dgung lo bzhi bar gdan sar bkod/ bdun pa chu lug lor mkhan rin po che blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas mtshan nyid bcu ldan gyi theg — 482 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten nas gzhung bka' pota lnga dang / gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi/ bcu phrag rig gnas la sogs thugs sbyangs dpyis phyin pa mdzad cing /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang mi tā brgya rtsa/ rdo rje phreng ba sogs kyi dbang bka' rjes gnang khrid lung man ngag gi skor mang bo'i rgyun phyag len dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ me bya lo nas rang dgon la lo rer chu mchod bye chen dang / mar me stong phrag 'bul ba'i srol gsar du btsugs/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i bsnyen chen gyi bcad rgya bsdoms pa'i khongs su nang mchod khol te 'phyur ba sogs rnal 'byor gyi rtags mtshan du ma byung / shing 'brug lor dus 'khor grwa tshang e waṃ chos 'khor gling phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang / rjes su par brko grwa tshang yang btsugs/ mdzod dge shog pa so so dang / zam tsha rong 'brog a la sgar grong / 'bo ra bcas yul gru du mar dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bka' rjes gnang khrid lung man ngag gi chos char phabs/ rje 'di nyid ni rwa lo tsā ba slar byon pa lta bu gsang gsum gyi nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab cing / dus gsum gzigs pa'i mngon shes dang lha srin bran du bkol pa'i grub rtags sogs brjod kyis mi long/ gdan sa chen po'i grwa tshang so sor 'chad nyan bshad sgrub kyi rgyun gang tshugs nyams med yar rgyas dang / chos spyod sgrig lam la rting bskul dang 'dzin skyong spel gsum bla lhag tu mdzad/ dgung lo re gsum pa sa yos(1929)lo 'ja' 'od du gur dang / 'brug sgra bsgrags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad do/ /khri chen sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge ni/ zi khron mdzod dge rdzong khongs bzhag sdom zhes bya ba'i sar yab shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / yum sbrang mo'i sras su sa stag(1928)lor sku gong ma bzhugs bzhin du dge mtshan gyi ltas dang bcas sku bltams/ de yang ji skad du/ 'dul 'dzin bstan spung chen po'i lung bstan du/ phu gnyan chen rta dkar can gyi 'dabs/ / yul mdzod dang dge bcu'i dpal 'dzoms sar/ /nga rwa lo'i yang sprul mchog nyid ni/ /yab shing yos pradz+nyā dh+wa dza dang / /yum shing stag sbrang mo zhes bya ba'i/ /sras mang sring gsum gyi bar ma ru/ /lo sa stag ston rang tshes rta'i nyin/ /yongs skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing du 'khrungs/ /mtshan tshe ring bsam grub rdo rje gsol/ /zhes dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa mi 'gyur rdo rje bka' lung gis gsal bar zin cing lung gi tshig zur re re'i cha nas brjod bya'i don rnams ji ma ji bzhin du gsal bar mtshon pa la bsnyon du med pas dam pa gong ma'i mchog sprul du nges pa rnyed/ mdo sngags rig gnas la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhan rje yon tan rab rgyas yongs 'dzin du bkur/ bdun pa la ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung /dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge zhes gsol/ rje de nyid dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma tshul bzhin bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang / dbang bka' rjes gnang / khrid lung man ngag gi skor mang bo'i rgyun phyag len bcas la gsan sbyong mi dman pa mdzad/ chu 'brug lo nas zam — 483 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/tsha rong 'brog gis gtsos dgon sde yul phyogs khag gi ser skya khri phrag mang po'i tshogs chen dus 'khor dbang chen thengs gsum smin rgyas su bstsal cing / a la sbog tsha'i sgar de de'u mgo'i dgon du chig sgril mdzad cing dge bskos dgon nas mngags/ nyi shu ba la dbus gtsang du phebs/ dga' ldan gser khri sprul ba'i sku'i go bab sngar srol bzhin 'bras sgo mang chos grwar zhugs nas sgo mang mkhan po rje skal bzang legs ldan yongs 'dzin du bsten/ jo shāka rnam gnyis la mchod 'bul dang rgyal ba yab sras la dngos 'bul/ se 'bras dge gsum dang rgyud grwa stod smad sogs la mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur bcas yab rje gong ma rnams las mi dman par zhus/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba chen pos tshe dbang gnang zhing / yongs 'dzin rin po che gling tshang gis bla ma lnga 'dzoms kyi sgo nas dge slong bsgrubs/ sa khyi(1958)lor slar gdan sa lha mo'i gser khri dgon du phebs shing spyi tshogs bsgyur bkod dang bstun/ rgyal khab kyi zhabs 'degs las khur bzhes/ lcags sprel(1980)lor chos sgo slar yang phyes pa nas bzung ste/ dgon ma lag dang bcas par bstan pa yang dar gyi me ro slar gso la thugs khur bzhes nas rten dang brten bzheng gsar skrun gyi bya bzhag la dbu khrid yang dag dang thugs bkod phra zhib mdzad de/ rten gsum dang dngos 'bul sbyor 'jags sogs kyi mthun rkyen gang legs 'bras ldan du sgrub bzhin mchis/ dgu lo nga drug steng slar dbus gtsang du phebs te jo shāg la gser rtsi dang na bza' mchod 'bul/ dga' ldan chos rgyal rang byon la na bza' snyan shal phul zhing / gdan sa gsum dang bkra shis lhun po sogs la mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos mnyes pa bgyis te/ sku gsung thugs gsum gyi rten skal phon che ba mdo smad kyi gdan sar spyan drangs/ sku 'bum byams pa gling dang gdan sa lha mo'i kir gser dgon gnyis dang bcas par mang 'gyed bla lhag tu bgyis/ da lta krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi rgyun mdzad las 'dzin dang / kun su'u zhing chen srid gros kyi u yon/ zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ kun lho khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ khul nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan bzhes bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /'chad nyan bshad sgrub kyi skor rags tsam gleng ba la/ thos bsam gling ba ni/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅges chu sprel(1752)lor btsugs/ lo hril bo las lo bcu gnyis ring gi cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo dang /nyin brgya nyi shu'i ring gi dus bzhi'i chos thog chen mo bzhi/ nyin drug cu'i ring gi bar chos bzhi/ nyin bco lnga'i ring gi rigs ga nyin lnga'i lnga mchod dang nyin lnga'i bgeg gtor bcas bsdoms grwa tshang 'dir chos thog bcu gnyis la nyin nyis brgya dang bcu bdun longs/ sgo mang yig cha gzhir bzhag gi thog bsdus grwa 'dzin grwa gnyis/ blo rtags 'dzin grwa gnyis/ phar phyin 'dzin grwa gong 'og gnyis/ dbu ma dang mdzod 'dzin grwa gnyis/ bka' rams pa 'dzin grwa gong 'og gnyis bcas 'dzin grwa bcu yod la/ slob gnyer ba rnams kyis thog mar rgyan 'jug gnyis dang chos spyod sogs kyi rgyugs chung dang / gzhung po ti lnga'i rtsa ba dang mtha' dpyod sogs skabs bab rgyugs chen 'bul dgos/ de nas rim bzhin gzhung yongs rdzogs la rtsod pa zhib mo — 484 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/'gro dgos pa dang / phar phyin dam bca' dang lha rams dam bca' bzhag nas gzhung bka' pota lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i ming btags len/ rigs grwa'i skabs su zhogs tshogs dang gung tshigs tshogs gnyis la tshogs gleng ba'i skabs su gang bab ltar du bsdus grwa blo rtags/ dbu phar/ mdzod/ 'dul ba bcas kyi bgrod gleng / chos mtshams rnams su nyin lnga re'i 'phror chos mtshams dam bca' dang lo re bzhin gyi rtsod rgyugs lan gnyis 'bul ba dang / 'dzin grwa gtugs pa/ rgyun par mtha' dpyod khag dang pota lnga'i rtsa ba/ byams chos sde lnga/ spyod 'jug chen mo/ legs bshad snying bo/ 'grel don sogs gzhung chen mang bo 'dzin skyor sbyong / dpe gzigs bcas dang / sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris sogs rig gnas dag la sbyong ba don ldan bya dgos/ gzhan yang / dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mos mtshon pa'i skyabs mgon khri chen yab sras kyi gdung mchod dang / dus bzung / gling me/ chu mchod bye ba/ ma ṇi ril sgrub/ rigs grwa dang lnga mchod gnyis kyi mjug tu gtor chen/ rigs grwa la shwa 'cham dang lo mjug bgeg gtor la gtsang 'cham/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gos sku dang gar 'cham/ bcu bzhi nyin gtsang 'cham gtor rgyag bcas/ bco lnga'i nyin ma ṇi'i lung / bcu drug byams pa gling skor sogs so/ /rgyud pa grwa tshang ni/ khri chen sku phreng gnyis pa chen po'i thugs bkod ltar dbus nas sngags rams pa grags pa 'phel rgyas gdan drangs te gsar 'debs mdzad/ grwa tshang gi na bza' gyon lugs dang / 'don rta dbyangs/ thig rdul mtshon/ 'bud brdung dkrol gsum/ gtor ma bca' bzo/ mchod rten cha brgyad kyi thig rtsa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sogs kyi phyag len ni lha sa'i dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa ji bzhin/ chos thog so so'i sgrub mchod dang / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ chos spyod bskang gso/rab gnas chen po/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug mgon po'i gtor chen/ lcags mkhar/gtor sgrub/ gdugs dkar bzlog chen sogs chos spyod kyi phyag srol shin tu rgyas/ /dus 'khor grwa tshang ni/ khri chen sku phreng bzhi bas rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing 'brug(1904)lor gsar du btsugs/ bla brang bkris 'khyil gyi dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa kwa mdo ba ngag dbang bkra shis gdan drangs nas dus 'khor dang / rnam snang mngon byang / kun rig gsum gyi bdag 'jug tshugs/ sbyin sreg dang klu chog sogs lo ltar gang rgyas dang / gar thig dbyangs gsum gyi rgyugs 'grig lam kyang shin tu dam/ gzhan yang / sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris/ lañja wartu sum rtags dag gsum bcas la sbyang dgob pa dang / khyad par du skar rtsis dang nag rtsis/ gza' lnga dbyangs 'char bcas la 'ib sbyangs kyis nyi 'dzin dang / zla 'dzin/ sa glang brtag pa sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag kun la'ang nang byan chud dgos so/ /sman pa grwa tshang ni/ khri chen sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge dpal bzang bos sngon gyi khā shī ri khrod gzhi byas nas phyag 'debs mdzad/ grwa tshang 'di'i phyag len ni sman bla dang mi 'khrugs pa'i jus gtogs bkra shis 'khyil ltar dang / sa ga zla bar smyung gnas/ gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ gnam lcags — 485 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/thog mda'/ zla rer dgu bskang / gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba cha lag bcas pa legs par sbyangs te gso ba rig pa'i phyag len man ngag sogs rgyud 'dzin gong 'phel du bstar dgos so/ /par brko grwa tshang ni/ khri chen sku phreng bzhi ba chen pos gsar 'dzugs gnang / lo re'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin brgya dang bdun cu'i ring la grwa tshang mnyam 'tshogs bgyis te par brko ba dang par rgyugs 'bul dgos pa'i sgrig lam ltar/ par brko dge rgan dang do dam pa gnyis kyis rang 'khur dang du blangs te lta rtog nan mo byed/ par brko ba gcig gis nyin rer par yig thig 'phreng gcig dang phyed ka ma chag pa byas te/ gong smos kyi nyin brgya dang bdun cu'i nang la mi gcig gis bsdoms pas par shing sna ring bcu bdun brkos nas 'grub dgos pa ma zad/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshe gcig nyin tshogs chen las sne la par rgyugs dang / khri chen rin po che la rgyugs chen 'bul dgos/ par yig gi dag cha dang brkos pa'i yig gzugs tshad ldan yin min sogs la lta rtogs dang rgyugs len pa'i sgrig lam yang shin tu dam mo/ /chos sde 'dir sku gsung thugs rten byin can dang gna' rdzas 'gangs can gyi skor che long brjod pa la/grwa tshang lnga'i 'du khang dang / gser gdung chen mo/ byams khang / rta mgrin lha khang / shugs ldan btsan khang / gser khang chen mo/ mgon khang / mchod rten lha khang / dpe mdzod lha khang / seng gdong lha khang / zhabs brtan lha khang / u rgyan lha khang / gzhan yang / gser khri bla brang gis gtsos dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i sku rten byin can ni byams chen nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa'i gzungs bzhug tu dga' ldan chos rgyal rang byon gyi ljags dang / tsa miṇ+ḍi'i kha ṭ+wāṃ/ rje tsong kha ba'i chos snam/byams khang bzheng dus sa 'og nas thon pa'i gser gyi rdo rje/ murti dz+nyān kirti'i phyag tsha/ rje sku byin can/gnas brtan brag ri ma/ thub dbang rdor gdan ma/ jo sku gtso 'khor gsum/ gnas brtan bcu drugabashags lha so lnga/ khri chen gyi 'khrungs rabs/ 'dul 'dzin nye bar 'khor nas brgyud pa'i skyes rabs nyer lnga'i 'dra sku/ sngags rams pa grags pa 'phel rgyas la zhal gzigs pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa'i zhal thang /sgrol sku gsung 'byon ma/ 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi sku gsung 'byon ma/ khri chen gnyis pas phyag bzo'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sku byin can dang 'jigs byed dpal cig gi sku/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od kyi shangs mtshal las bzhengs pa'i yi dam gyi sku brnyan/ rje'i shangs mtshal las bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed dang mgon po/ chos rgyal gsum gyi zhal thang rgyal dbang bdun pas gnang ba/ rgyal dbang brgyad pa'i thugs rten tsan dan sprul snying las grub pa'i jo bo lo ke shwa ra'i sku byin can/ tsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang / paṇa chen bsod grags pa'i sku brnyan byin can sogs kyis gtsos rgya gar nag dang / dbus bod sog gsum bcas nas gdan drangs pa/ gser dngul zangs rag g.yu byur mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku brnyan lo rgyus can bzhi stong lhag las che gras nyis thog gi dpangs tshad longs pa dang / 'tshem gtsag bris — 486 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsum gyi thang ga brgyad brgya lhag bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la'ang bka' 'gyur gser bris tshar gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur dang / rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ khri chen sku phreng rim byon dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i gsung 'bum sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dpe pota nyis khri brgyad stong lhag dang par shing drug stong las brgal pa/ rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub rje rnam gnyis kyis phyag bzo'i gdugs dkar gyi srung 'khor byin can bka' rgya ma sogs bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten ni/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge'i sku gdung hril bo bzhugs shing rgyu gser dngul g.yu byur/ mu min mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku gdung mchod rten chen pos mtshon pa'i khri chen sku phreng rim byon gyi sku gdung mchod rten dang / rgyu rin chen las grub pa'i mchod rten che chung bdun lhag bzhugs/ gzhan chos sde 'di'i gdan rabs rim byon ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnga ba chos skyong rgya mtsho/ 'bras mang sgo lha rams pa khā shī blo bzang shes rab/ zung chu rgyam kho mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ sog po blo bzang chos 'phel/ shar rtse lha rams pa sang sang ngag dbang rin chen/ khā shī dpon slob ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi(1958)lo'i yan lag khri rabs drug cu re bdun byon pa dang /khyad par du chos sde 'di ba'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi grags can ni/ mdo sngags rig gnas kun dang dbang lung man ngag gi mdzad 'dzin khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge'i sku phreng rim byon dang / rnga ba chos skyong rgya mtsho/tā dbon pa blo bzang seṅge / dpon slob ngag dbang phun tshogs/ 'bras sgo mang lha rams pa rnga ba blo bzang shes rab/ skyabs mchog blo bzang bstan pa'i sgron me/ gyis tshang skong lung ba blo bzang bsod nams/dzam+bha lha'i sprul bar grags pa a la bkra yā bla ma 'jam dbyangs don grub/ rgya tshang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ shing bza' blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mkhan po 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ rgya nag pa blo bzang thub bstan nyi ma/ mkhan rin po che 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho(lha mo tshul khrims)/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta yongs 'dzin yon tan rab rgyas sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa mi nyung ba byon/ lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'pho 'gyur ma byung gong du nang khag bco brgyad dbye tshul ni/rang dgon gyi nang du gser khri'i nang chen dang / tshogs chen mkhan po/ khā shī/ rgya nag pa/ khā shī sgang ma/ sum po/ rgyud rgan/ shing bza'/ spyi chen/ gdung mchod spyi ba bcas nang khag bcu dang /dgon pa'i phyi rol du gtsos dgon du gser khri'i nang chen dang / bang tshang dgon du gser khri'i nang khagatā dbon dang spang mthil/ sum mthil/ g.yu bla/ zhabs drung / ko'i dge ste nang khag brgyad dang /gzhan yang / chos seṅge tshang dang dpal shes pa nang gong 'og mkhan po bstan pa dar rgyas tshang / mkhan po bstan 'dzin tshang / sum po tshang / sgyis dge tshang / byams me dpon bla/ khro kho tshang / dran pa dge ser / thang skor sprul sku/ sprul sku tshul khrims/ tog lung sprul sku/ de'u dgon sprul sku/ rgyud pa'i mkhan po/ dus 'khor mkhan po/ an 'dzin bla grags/ mkhan po 'jigs rgyam/ nang so'i sprul sku/— 487 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/sa ngan dran pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ta lo'i sprul sku/ bstan pa dar rgyas/ ma yum sprul sku/yon tan skal ldan/ nag tshang sprul sku/ bla ma gling dga' sogs nang chen che chung ci rigs dang / rgyud pa/dus 'khor/ sman pa/ cha gnyer/ mchod rten bcas spyi khang lnga yod/ de bzhin dgon pa'i las sne la/nang khri mkhan po gsum dang / phyi 'brog khri gsum/ rong khri gsum/ tshogs chen bla ma gzhung las pa/rgyud pa'i bla ma/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sman pa'i bla ma/ lha rams pa/ dbu mdzad che chung brgyad/spyi ba che chung nyi shu rtsa gsum/ par khang do dam pa gcig tshogs 'du bzhi/ sku tshab gsum/ gnyer ba gcig ste bsdoms pas las sne lnga bcu lhag dang / bla sprul nyi shu rtsa grangs/ grwa ba drug brgya nye ba/ grwa shag nyis brgya lhag bcas yod do/ /chos sde chen po 'dis snga gzhug tu dgon grwa gzhan dag la chos spyod phyag len dang 'cham cho ga sogs kyi rgyun spel tshul ni/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa yon tan dar rgyas kyis a skyid dga' bo lung dgon par kun rig bdag 'jug btsugs/ dus 'khor ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis byams me 'bras spungs dgon par rnam snang mngon byang gi bdag 'jug btsugs/ yongs 'dzin rje yon tan rab rgyas pas gro tshang dgon par bca' yig brtsams/ sman pa grwa tshang gi bla ma blo bzang bsam gtan gyis gro tshang dgon par mi 'khrugs pa'i bdag 'jug btsugs/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang bstan pas gro tshang dgon par rnam snang mngon byang gi bdag 'jug btsugs/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jigs med 'od zer gyis gling ba'i rwa bong dgon dang dpal shes steng ga'i dgon gong 'og la kun rig gi bdag 'jug btsugs/ dus 'khor ba byams me dpal kho sa rwa bong dgon par dus 'khor bdag 'jug btsugs/ sa ngan dran pas a la de'u mgo'i dgon dge 'dun dar rgyas gling la bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug gsar 'jug mdzad/ mkhan po 'jigs med rgya mtshos me stag(1996)lor a la de'u mgo'i dgon par gtsang 'cham gsar du btsugs/dus 'khor ba 'cham dpon ngag dbang bsam gtan gyis dpal shes steng ga'i dgon par gtsang 'cham btsugs pa bcas so/ /khyad par du gtsug lag khang so so'i rten dang brten pa/ mchod cha mchod rdzas/ rol cha dang 'cham chas/ rol khang khag gi thab chas yod byad sogs nom rdzas grangs mang bo'i rin thang rjod kyis mi longs pa je legs su btang ma thub kyang / lo re'i dus chos bzhi dus tshigs re la zla rer 'tshogs dgos pa'i dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi chos thog bzhi/ spyi rdzas tsam dang rtswa zhing nags gsum gyi sa 'god pa la dus bzhi'i chos thog gi thebs su spyi rdzas dngul sgor 29088yod/ shog sgor72dngul gcig la brtsi srol ltar na bsdoms pas dngul sgor404yod pa de/ gzhan la bu lon btang nas dngul gcig la 'phel ka mar rgya ma70nas12 0gang rung re len srol yod/ de bzhin grwa tshang khag dang lha khang so so'i spyi ba tshang mar spyi rdzas dngul grangs nges can 'du khang zhig gso'i thebs la spyi rdzas dngul sgor 22110yod pa'i 'phel ka lo rer — 488 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sgor10 0la sgor18yin pas/ lo re'i skyed ka kho na sgor 5770lhag zin/ dgon pa gsar 'debs skabs nas rim gyis sog po'i chin lbang dang / mdzod dge a bkra dang dpal mgon gnyis/ co ne sa skyong dmag zor dgon po sogs kyis khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge dang sku phreng gnyis pa bcas la phul pa'i rtswa sa dang nags tshal/ zhing sa mi chung ba re yod pa las/ zam tsha dang mdzod tsha'i rtswa sa/ bzhag sdom rdzus hor dgun sa'i chu'i tshur kha tshun chad/ rme chu zhang gi 'bo'u spo tshang gi rtswa sa sogs gser khri'i dgon pa'i nang chen so so'i su rug 'dzin sa'i rtswa sa yin pa ma zad/ da dung mdzod dge shog pa bcu gnyis kyis sne gang nas gser khris su rug bzung na sus kyang the gtogs byed mi rung ba'i chings yig bkod/ nags sa ni rkyang sol rgan khog tu lung ba gsum gyi nags dang / stag chen khog dang tā mo gdong gsum ga'i nags tshal gyi bdag po gser khri dgon yin/ 'ing sa la rkyang tsha'i dran pa na gser khri'i nang chen la zhing sa dang / tā mo na brag shug spyi ba'i zhing sa/ the bo'i rgya than nyin chad na gser khri'i bzhes rtsam nas dkar 'debs sa'i zhing sa dang /a la'i a thang du de'u mgo'i dgon par khri ba'i zhing sa/ zam tsha'i rong na gser khri nang chen gyi zhing sa bcas kyi cha rkyen 'dzoms / gong smras rten dang brten pa phon chen po de dag rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor spyi tshogs gsar sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jig nas ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur to/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel(1980)lor/ chos sde 'di'i chos sgo slar yang phye ba nas bzung /slar gso bskyar skrun gyi las don la gong rim 'brel yod sde khag gi 'go khrid 'og khri chen mchog sprul lnga bas thugs khur che bzhes/ dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs ma skul rang 'gul sgos dngos shugs rgyu gsum gyis sbyin bdag rgyab skyor/ zhabs 'degs gang nus bsgrubs pa dang sgrub bzhin par brten nas/ da lta byams khang dang / gser gdung chen mo/ btsan khang / rta mgrin lha khang / dpe mdzod pho brang rgya phibs g.yu thog can/ zhabs brtan lha khang / dbyen bsdum mchod rten/ tshogs chen 'du khang rgya phibs snga phyi bar gsum g.yu thog mdog gnyis can bcas kyi rten dang brten pa dag 'dul ba'i dgongs don dang bstun pa'i phyag srol ltar du bzo bkod phun sum tshogs par gsar bzheng legs grub byung / gtsug lag khang 'di dag las gsar du bzhengs shing blus pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor rags tsam ni/ byams sku thog tshad can 'khor sras chen brgyad dang bcas pa/ rgyu shug pa las bzhengs pa'i sku chen thog tshad can bcu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang ston pa gtso 'khor/ rje yab sras rnam gsum/ gser zangs las grub pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku/gser khri rim byon gyi 'dra sku che legs lnga/ ston pa dang rje rin po che'i stong sku re/ rgyu sde bzhi dang rta gdugs sgrol gsum gyi sman sku/ tshogs chen 'du khang gi logs ris sangs rgyas stong skus mtshon pa'i rgyan thang dang /thang ga dang / gsung rten du bka' 'gyur tshar bcu gcig dang bstan 'gyur tshar bzhi/ mdo sngags dam chos gzhung dpe dang gsung 'bum pota stong lhag thugs rten du khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge'i sku gdung mchod rten rgyu rin chen gnyis pa kho na las bzhengs pa/ logs bzhi sgo khyim dang bcas pa g.yu byur spos shel sogs — 489 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/rin po che'i phra rgyan gyis bltams pa thog tshad can gyis gtsos pa'i mchod rten che chung bzhi bzhugs so/ / snga ra yod grwa tshang lnga dang de dag gi chos spyod phyag srol dag slar gso thub ste/ bla sprul 'ga' dang re re'i nang chen/ grwa ba sum/ brgya lhag dang grwa shag brgya las brgal/ nye char gong rim 'brel yod sde khag gis chos lugs bya 'gul spel sa tho 'god rtsis len byas te dpang yig bstsal pa ltar na/ deng skabs dgon par khrims bstun ngang dbang ba'i lcags ri'i phyi nang gi rgya khyon bsdoms pas mu'u70 0nye bar bdag gnyer byed ba'in mchis / gzhan yang sngar srol bla ma las sne sor dang dgon pa'i dmangs gtso'i do dam u yon lhan khang rtsa 'dzugs gang legs dang / rgyal gces chos gces thugs mthun khrims gtsang sgos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub yar ldan gyi skabs dang / rang gso'i thon skyed bcas la 'bad 'bungs byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /bla ri mgul sgar rnying dga' ldan chos 'phel gling /bla ri ma/gul(bla ri mgo)sgar rnying dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling ni/ kun lho bod khu'4 klu chu rdzong bla ri mgul zhang gi khongs su chags shing / dgon sar sa mu'u sum brgya lhag dgon pa nas rdzong mkhar bar spyi le nyer bdun dang / mtsho ngos nas dpangs la spyi khru sum stong nyis brgya yod/sde 'de rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang bo rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang(1709)lor mdo smad du phyag phebs pa'i lo bzhi ba 'brug lor rkyang tsha'i chab tshan sogs su byon pa'i phyir lo/ thang dge lhun grub gtsos mi chen kha shas dang kun mkhyen mchog gi thugs sras dam pa rang sar 'khrungs pa'i gzhung ba rab 'byams pa bstan pa bcas kyis sde 'dir mchod gzhis shig dgos pa'i snyan zhu'i gsol ba btab pa la/dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te dgon sar gzigs shing rab gnas mdzad/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu 'brug ste spyi lo1712pa la 'du khang gi rmang btings pa sogs gzhung ba bstan pas btab/ sde 'di rje ring lugs par gtogs shing / mgon po phyag drug pa/ lha mo/ gnas chung rgyal po sku lnga srung mar bkur/kun mkhyen sku phreng dang bos bca' yig mdzad pa tsho bcu gnyis nang 'khrug skabs 'jig kyang / phyis su kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis mdzad/ mtsho kha ba sku phreng bzhi bas blangs/sgrub grwa gtso bor gnyer/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gong rol tu/ grwa shag gnyis/ grwa ba brgyad cu nas brgya dang sum cur 'phel/ sku zhabs bla brang dang / gtsos gser khri/ bla ma khā shi(kha chu'ang zer) bla ma nying tshang / sangs sang tshang / dpa' ris pa sogs la gzim khang yod la/ rgyud grwa'i 'du khang / gnas chung btsan khang / bka' 'gyur lha khang / rje lha khang / rung khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang bcas bzhengs so /de yang kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon/ mtsho kha ba sku phreng bzhi ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang lnga ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/ dme shul mu to tshang / a mchog hor/ rje dge co ra/ nyang — 490 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/tshang / kha bya'i 'gyang phrug khu shi han tshang / thang ring tshang(da ltar bzhugs)sogs skyes chen dam pa sde 'dir bka' drin mchog tu che/ thang dge lhun grub gtso byas ka thang bzhi sogs tsho bcu gnyis kyang dgon sde 'di la bka' drin shin tu che/ kun mkhyen mdo smad du byon nas dgon gsar 'debs la zhal bkod gnang ba'i ang gnyis par mngon/ de nas lo bzhi ba shing lug(1715)lor skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' bzhin/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug gi 'don rta dbyangs/ thig rdul tshon/ bdung rol mo tshogs cho ga'i skor gtsang gi phyag len bzhin btsugs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug(1751)lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo phebs nas rje'i lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi zhal bkod bstsal/ rim gyis lam rim gyi 'chad nyan/ gzhi gsum nyams len/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga bskyed rdzogs/gar phig dbyangs gsum/ gtor ma bca' bzo/ sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris sogs rig gnas slob rgyun ma nyams par gnas/ zla re'i nang rgyugs len gnyis re dang / lo ril bor rgyugs chen lan gcig bcas lan grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhir kher rgyugs len pa sogs phyag srol gyi rim pa mang bo tshugs/ 1949lor bla brang ltar shwa 'cham btsugs/ zla re'i dus bzang gi chos spyod la/ tshes gnyis la gnas chung lha tshe/ tshes lnga la lam rim/ tshes brgyad la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang 'don cha'i rgyugs kher len/ bcu gsum la phyag rdor 'khor chen/ bco lnga la gsang 'dus/ nyer gnyis la mgon chos lnga'i bskang gso dang rgyugs sngar ltar/nyer lnga la bde mchog nyer dgu la bskang gso drug cu ba/ dgong mo'i rdo gcal sku rim mtshan gsol/hor zla dang po'i tshes bdun nas bcu drug bar smon lam chen mo/ bcu drug la smon lam gtor rgyag gnyis pa bde mchog bdag 'jug tshes nyer gnyis nas nyer brgyad bar/ gsum pa lam rim thog tshes nyer dgu nas zla phyi ma'i tshes lnga bar/ bzhi ba ma ṇi ril sgrub tshes dgu nas bcu drug bar/ drug pa 'jigs byed bdag 'jug tshes bco lnga nas nyer gcig bar/ bdun pa gsang 'dus bdag 'jug tshes bco lnga nas nyer gcig bar/ nyer dgur dbyar gtor rgyag brgyad pa rnam sras g.yang 'bod(dus nges gtan med)tshes nyer bdun nas zla phyi ma'i tshes la mgon po rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub/ bcu ba dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo tshes nyer lnga nas nyer brgyad bar/ bcu gnyis pa bgeg gtor chos thog tshes nyer gcig nas nyer brgyad bar/ nyer dgu'i nyin gtor rgyag sogs 'char can gyi tshogs nyin brgya dang sum cu rtsa grangs la kun rig dang chos spyod brgyad cu sogs skabs gang babs la 'don sgrig ltar ma chag pa byed ba'in no/ /dgon 'di'i sku rten gtso bo rje bkra shis do kha ma ni phyogs 'di'i bla ma 'od zer bzang bo rab byung gsum pa'i me rta(1786)la dbus su byon/ dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling sogs su bshes gnyen bcu lhag bsten te mkhas grags rgyas/ yos lor mdo smad du 'byon khar / rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos nyid kyi dbu sku nang gzhug tu phul pa bstsal/ rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i thub pa chos 'khor ma dang / slob dpon gsung 'byon/ rtse po ta la nas gdan drangs pa tsarin las grub pa'i jo bo lo kai sha ra byin can/ spri — 491 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/ti'i phyag tsha byin can sogs dang / kun mkhyen gnyis pas gnang ba'i rje sku sogs rgyu sna tshogs las bzhengs pa'i bris 'bur ma'i sku brnyan brgya bcu gcig bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la bka' 'gyur gser bris/gser 'od gser bris/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ bstan 'gyur/ kun mkhyen sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum gyis mtshan pota grangs stong kha longs/ thugs kyi rten la/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i sku gdung mchod rten che ba phra brgyan can gcig mtsho kha ba sku phreng bzhi ba'i sku gdung sogs che chung ba'i bzhugs/ chos sde nang nas gsung rtsom nyung ngu re bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa kha shas phebs kyang dpe rnams 'jig pas zhu rngo mi thogs/ khri ba bla brang gis mngag pa bzhugs yun lo gsum/ gnas brtan rang dgon nas bsko zhing bzhugs yun lo gsum/ dbu mdzad che chung gnyis slob pa'i go rim ltar bzhugs yun lo gsum/ dge bskul dang dkon gnyer gnyis bzhugs yun lo gcig yin/ de dag gis rang babs dgon pa'i don bsgrubs/sngon chad sde 'dir rten dang brten pa 'gangs chen mang du bzhugs mod kyang / 195〈lo'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur dang phyis kyi rig gnas gsar brje skabs su rten gtso bkra shis do kha ma dang / thang dge lha mo gos grub ma gtogs yongs su 'jig tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i thengs gsum pa'i krung u lhan 'dzoms gros tshogs tshun chod du/ srid jus bzang bo'i bka' drin dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyi sbyor dngos kyi mthun rkyen gang legs bskrun pa la brten/ sngar gyi 'du khang sogs bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung ba'i khar/sangs rgyas stong sku sogs gyan thang bzhi bcur nye ba/ tsong kha brgyad cu/ paṇa chen 'khrungs rabs/ kun mkhyen 'khrungs rabs sogs zhal thang sum cu so grangs/ shing sku dang sman sku che chung bzhi bcu zhe grangs/bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen rim byon dang bstan pa'i sgron me/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho sogs kyi gsung 'bum cha tshang / gtsos gser khri'i sku gdung dang rnam rgyal mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa gnyis bzhengs/ da ltar dge 'dun pa drug cu re lnga dang / grwa shag bzhi bcu zhe gcig bzhengs shing / sngar gyi bca' yig gsar ma gzhi byas thog 'chad nyan sgrig khrims sogs yar ldan du 'gro mus su snang la/ grwa ba'i 'tsho rten gyi cha la chos thog dang gshin dge'i 'gyed phog so so'i yul ba'i rgyab brten la rag las/ nags tshal sa mu'u sum cu lhag dang / sman khang / rlangs 'khor/tshong khang bcas kyi yong sgo gtso bo dang / tshogs la 'don bcol gyi 'bul sdud sogs spyi nom du bsags so/ /gdong gzigs dgon phun tshogs rab rgyas gling /nyang tshang gdong gzigs dgon phun tshogs rab rgyas gling zhes pa da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi klu chu rdzong gi zam tsha zhang du chags/ rdzong mkhar dang spyi le bdun cu yod/nyang tshang gdong gzigs dgon pa ni 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i slob ma nyang mgon po blo gros — 492 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kyis sa skya'i lugs su phyag 'debs mdzad/ rje de nyid bod kyi btsan po srong btsan dus su chab srid kyi gdugs dkar srid rtser 'degs mkhan mgar stong btsan gyi rgyud/ mnga' bdag nyang ston chos kyi 'khor lo sogs gsang sngags rnying ma'i mkhas grub kyi skyes chen zam ma chad par byon pa'i rgyud du yul nyang stong gtsang gi sar sku'i skye ba bzhes/ chung dus nas thugs sgam zhing rnam rig can du grags/ mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas rnying chos dang rig gnas kyi rting tshugs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa(1255da wa1280)bla ma'i gtso bor bsten te bka' chos mang du zhus shing thugs mthun gyi slob mar gyur te grwa chen bzhi'i gras su drangs/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bka' las grwa chen rnams kyis bon bsgyur pa ltar mdo smad du chas nyer tā dbon po(ngag rgyun du rje sa skya'i dngos slob nas bla rabs bdun cu lhag byon par bshad pa dang sa gzhan du mtshan mtshungs du ma mchis)dang nyang mgon blo 'di gnyi ga smad du byon nas men ju'i phyogs nas re zhig sgrub pa mdzad/ rab byung lnga ba'i dbang phyug ces pa me glang(spyi lo1277)lor sku nyid 'khor bcas paṇa chen ri'i(rjes grub kyi ming /)ngos nas sa 'dir 'byor te mi ser la 'brel bzhin dgon pa zhig 'debs pa'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ sa dpyad thams cad bla ma'i lung dang mthun pa byung bas dgyes nyams bcas bka' bstsal par/ yul 'dir gar gzigs dang / sa nyi zla nor gsum 'dzoms ki a tsi pha bong ma gi'i steng na yig drug rang byon du phebs 'dug nga 'dir bsdad na ma 'ong bar bla ma nyi ma lta bu dang grwa ba bzang bo 'ong ba'i rten 'brel yod pas nyi ma'i sgang du dgon pa zhig 'debs gsungs/ gdong khang de nas gnas gzigs mdzad pas rjes su der gdong gzigs mdo thogs/ lo de'i dbyug zlar 'du khang grub bstun nyid kyis gsang chen mkha' spyod grub pa'i gling zhes bstsal/ zam tsha/ sgyis tshang / a la(a lags zer ba yin par bshad)ste rgyal skor gsum gyi gus 'dud dang sbyor 'jags lhur blangs so/ /yang gtsang myang(nyang ) stod nas rje nyid kyi sku mched gsum 'ongs pa dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su gzhis chags pas sde 'di'i tsho khag snga shos su brtsis/ de la mched pa myang khag tsho ba zer te da lta nang ma dang phyi ma gnyis su gyes shing tsho ba nang mas dbon po'i khur 'dzin bgyis/ hor rdzas tsho ba ni mdo smad phyogs su khyab pa'i hor ba khag cig yin par bshad/ mched gsum gyi che ba dpal 'od kyi rgyud pa ni a bha dpal ldan yin la de'i rgyud da lta ba lha mo don grub zer/ khor sras lcam sring bdun yod pa'i gnyis pa rta mgrin rdo rje ni yul gyi khu bo'i bu skal la song bas tsho ba phyi mar gtogs/ dpal 'od mched gsum gyi rgyud du nyang ta thā ga ta/ nyang mañju phri nyang lo ke shwa ra/ nyang ar+ya de ba/ nyang dom zhu can/ nyang ral ba can/ nyang sha med gangs dkar/ shes rab 'bar/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan rnams byung / 'di rnams kyis khu bo mgon po blo gros zhabs kyi spyan sngar gdams pa mtha' dag zhus shing sgrub pa mthar son pas grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ snga ma gsum gyis 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bsnyun pa dang gzhan rnams mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su zung 'jug grub pa'i sku bzhengs pas lang tshang bla dgu zhes grags che ba sha stag yin pa ngag rgyun du grags/ lo ba'i nyang tshang dang phyi — 493 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/sho'i nyang tshang / sgyis tshang nyang tshang / dme shul nyang tshang rnams nyang tshang bla dgu'i gras su 'dren mkhan snang la/ de yang rtsa ba'i bla ma nyang dbon mgon po blo gros la slob ma grub thob dgu byung ba dang bgres gzhon gyi khyad par las dus mnyam/ skabs shig grub thob sku mched rnams lhan du tshogs te dgong tsha bzang bo bshams/chos kyi bgros 'phel/ re re bzhin thugs 'phreng ba'i nyams kyis 'bral mi phod bzhin du so so gyes/ de phyin nyang tshang mthun thor ram thug thor zhes pa deng sang mi ser kha na grags pa dang phyis 'ga' re skye rgyud 'phel ba mngon/ nyang dbon mgon po blo gros kyi sprul sku sangs rgyas 'od zer ni yar steng ca dge tshang du 'khrungs/rgyal skor gsum gyi dbu bla dbang phyug can du grags pa 'khrungs shing gzhis kyi rgyab ri nas sgrub pa mdzad/mi'i ming yul la chags nas deng sang sangs rgyas klad ces 'bod bzhin yod/ sku phreng gsum pa nyang tshang bka' rgan nam bka' bcu mchog grub kyis dbus su thugs gnyer dang gsang phu bka' bcu'i mtshan rtags bzhes/ gdan sa 'di nyid du 'dam khu tshur tsam la ya ma ra dza bye ba bsgrubs nas lo dgu la grub pa'i byams sku khyad 'phags sogs mang du bzhengs/ gyis tshang sgar dang brgya mched ri khrod phyag 'debs mdzad/ sku phreng bzhi ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis gdong ltag ri khrod sogs su sgrub pa mdzad/ sku pheng lnga ba grub pa mchog brnyes kyis gzugs med dregs pa can bran du khol ba dang ting 'dzin la chig dril mdzad/ sku phreng drug pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gdong gzigs hor rdzas tsho ba'i a tse'i khyim rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ 'di bas gdan sa dge lugs su bsgyur cing cho ga gdangs dbyangs smad rgyud ltar gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dngos gtsang btsugs/zam tsha'i mdzod tshang gis sbyin bdag byas te lnga mchod tshugs shing rgyal skor gsum ga'i grwa rgyun phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa'i srol btod/ sku phreng bdun pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos dbu ma'i lta ba la bshad sgom dang rdo rje rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzad/ sku phreng brgyad pa blo gros kun dga' bstan 'dzin ni co ne'i khya dge nas sku 'khrungs/ khya dge dpon slob kyis bskyangs shing nyer gsum pa nas sog yul dang dbus phyogs su phebs/men ju chan lung gong mas hu thog thu gnang zhing zhabs brtan gyi dgon pa btab pa dang rgya dar yug gsum gyi 'ja' sa dang tham ga tsi pen/ erti ni hu thog thu'i cho lo dang dar han nang so'i thob byung / gdan sa 'dir gdan drangs pa'i rten gsum dang gser dngul sogs kyi yo chas 'gangs che mang / kun mkhyen ngag dbang brtson 'grus(1648da wa1721)la thugs 'brel zab pas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gzim khang brgyab/ gsung rtsom 'ga' snang / dgung grangs nga dgu ba sa bya(spyi lo1669)la sku gshegs/ sku phreng dgu ba ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma ni co ne'i yul zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing rong bo dgon chen du bsdus tshang dang 'bras spungs sgo mang nas gzhung mang sbyangs/ grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs dbang lung man ngag gi gter du bzhugs shing bcud len grub pa'i stabs kyis dgung lo dgu bcu'i bar bzhugs/ sku phreng bcu ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni gyis tshang sku rten la 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer mdzad cing / sog po thu med phyogs nas 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang bde mchog lus dkyil — 494 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/—sogs kyi dbang gsan stabs mergan hu thog thu'i cho lo thob/ nyang gi bla rabs lo rgyus rgyas pa brtsams pa rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar bzhugs pa mer bsregs/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya grangs la gshegs/ sku phreng bcu gcig pa dkon mchog tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni na 'ban mgon po tshe brtan gyi sras su sku 'khrungs shing bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer legs/ smad sog nas sku gshegs/ sku phreng bcu gnyis pa blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni lo tso'i bse chen tsho ba'i yum sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ spyod lam rtsub pas bla smyon thogs sam sog tshang bla ma zer/ bsam sbyor log pa 'ga'i byad bab las sku bkrongs/ sku phreng bcu gsum pa nyang tshang dpon slob rin po che blo bzang thub bstan nyi ma ni co ne'i brgya mched a gar tsho bar 'khrungs shing nyams rtogs che la thun mong rig gnas byang chub pa zhig byon/ sku phreng bcu bzhi ba blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las ni bla ri mgul mdo bar yum lha mo 'tsho'i sras su rab tshes me yos(spyi lo1867)la sku 'khrungs/ sog yul du phebs pa'i phyir lam gdan sa ma 'byor bar lcang dkar nang zhes pa'i sa nas dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa rta la gshegs/ sku phreng bco lnga ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni rgan gya'i ri ngan du yab mkha' 'bum rgyal dang yum mkha' mo skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad par khri 'don mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs nas lha mo'i dge bshes tshul khrims dar rgyas yongs 'dzin du bsten/ bcu gsum par sku gshegs/ sku phreng bcu drug pa rje btsun ska9 pa bzang kun dga' bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni mkhar rtse'i the bur yab bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang yum 'brug mo skyid kyi sras su rab rgyas shing khyi(1924)lo la sku 'khrungs/ skya mtshan la tshe ring bkra shis 'bod/ lcam sring bdun gyi gnyis pa/ paṇa chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang skyabs mgon lnga ba rnam gnyis kyis ngos 'dzin mdzad/ dbyug zla'i nyer gnyis la khrir 'khod/ dgun pa'i(chas pa'i gshis)dge bshes 'jigs med klog slob dge rgan du bsten/ bkra shis 'khyil du mtshan nyid la bzhugs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa nas a mchog dgon pa'i lam rim khri dang mdzod dge sgar rnying gi tshogs chen khrir bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi la dus rkyen las grwa sa gtor cing rten gsum bsnubs/ khong rang grong du ngal rtsol la phebs pa dang lcags byi lor khul srid gros u yon du bdams/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa me stag(1986)la kun su'u zhing chen gyi bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling du gdan zhus te slob khrid gtso dngo/na la bskos pas bstan pa'i 'phrin las la 'bad bzhin mchis so/ /dgon chung rnying ba 'dir sngon chad rten 'gangs chen mang bo bzhugs yod de/ nyang tshang byams sku(dgon pa'i rten gtso)lo dgu ma rang grub tu rgya cher bskyed pas lha khang thengs gnyis bskyar du bzhengs/mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbu skra nang bzhugs byams pa byin can/ byams sku gsum pa bla brang gser khang chen mo'i byams pa dang phyi dbyibs nang gzhug gnyis su med pa/ ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung ma bu lnga byams pa'i nang gzhug da lta lus/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i shangs khrag rten du bcug pa'i byams sku bzhi ba/ rgya gar nas drangs pa'i tsan dan jo bo/ skyabs 'gro'i lam rim tshogs — 495 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/ zhing / gser gyi thub dbang rdor gdan ma/ mi la'i sman sku lha'i bdud rtsi gang sogs chig stong brgya lhag gsung rten la bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur/ 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gsung 'bum sna tshogs bcas pota drug brgya lhag thugs rten la phyi'i rnam rgyal mchod rten dang 'du khang nang du gdung rten du ma bzhugs su gsol/ mi'i ka lis grub pa'i nyang ral ba can gyi ṭa ri/ byu ru'i sdong bo/ glang chen mche ba cha gcig sbub 'brug ris can/ gna' bo'i geg gleng chu srin gdung ris can/ rol mo khyad par can so gas bzhugs so/ /dgon par sngon chad grwa ba brgyad cu tsam dang grwa shag sum cus sa khyon mu'u nyi shu lhag bzung / da lta dgon 'go bkra shis 'khyil bar gtad/ nyang tshang nang chen/ nyang tshang gzim shag bzhengs/ chos kyi byed sgo skor la kun rig dang 'jigs byed/ gsang 'dus gsum gyi ras bris la brten pa'i sgrub mchod de/zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam/ zla gsum par bstan pa'i zhabs rim/ zla bzhi bar smyung gnas / zla lnga bar shing slong / zla drug par dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad par dbyar ston/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/zla bcu gnyis par bsnyen mtshams dang khyad par du nyang tshang brdung ngam zam tsha srib pa'i brdung du grags pa'i mgon po'i gtor sgrub chen mo sogs dar thog da lta'ang kun mkhyen drug pa'i bka' lung ba'in bde ma chog lca i ba'i lugs kyi cho ga spel/ dgon du 'du khang ka ring bzhi can dang rdo rje legs pa'i btsan khang bzhengs /nyang mchog sprul sku rim byon dang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shangs 'dren che chung / dge bskos bcas las sne 'dzoms/ mchod gzhis sbyin bdag ni gdong gzigs dang spyi lo tso/ mgar brgya/ g.yu bla/ dgon chags sogs gtsos pa'i zam tsha rong 'brog tsho ba drug sgyis tshang ru tsho bdun/ a la shog pa lnga bcas /rgyun tshogs/ rgyun bskang / zhabs rim sogs rgyun 'khyongs shing phyag len tshad ldad du mchis so /rab rgyal lcags byar chos sgo phye ba'i skal ba ldan pas nyang dbon po skal bzang kun dga' bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog slar gdan sar bkod/ rgyal skor gsum gyi sde phyogs tsho ba thams cad kyis brgya 'bul stong 'bul gyi sbyor 'jags gzab phyir 'du khang gser du bzhengs/ rten rnying bdud rtsis gtam/sa pa'i rje btsun mi la'i sman sku dang rje sku kha shas/ gsar bzhengs rje btsun byams mgon sogs li ma dang sman sku/ sdeb ris thang ga sogs bzhugs/ da lta btsan khang / gdong gzigs tsho khag gnyi gas dbon po'i gzim khang dang spyi khang bzhengs/ grwa ba lnga bcu tsam 'dus shing grwa shag nyi shu phub/ rang gso'i ched du sa 'ing mu'u bcu drug dang tshong khang bcas gnyer ba dang 'tsho ba gtso bo grwa mang rang gi khyim pa dang mang 'gyed la brten no/ /rmog ri dgon dga' ldan byams 'phel gling /rmog ri dgon dga' ldan byams 'phel gling zhes pa ni da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi klu chu rdzong zam tsha zhang gi khongs su chags/— 496 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su'u glegs bam/zam tsha'i rmog ri dgon dga' lda na byams 'phe' gling ches pa'i sgrub grwa 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lo ste spyi lo172 0lor zam tsha gser khri blo bzang 'jigs med nam/ ma kha' mchog gis phyag 'debs mdzad par grags/ ma/ dgon lha mo'i kirti dgon pa byas skabs de'i sbyin bdag ni dge slong bzhi dang yar ngos dgon dang / rmog gdan dang gdan thang ri khrod ces pa'i grong sde'i khyim pa bzhis sbyor 'jags byas par sngo rengs par+ṇa chen brgyad ces ngag rgyun du khyab/ de nas rim ba'in lo ngo nyis brgya lhag gi nang dar cing rgyas par byung nas 'du khang chen mo dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / rta ma grin lha khang che chung / lha mo 'i btsan khang / rje lha khang / o rgyan lha khang / tsi dam ra lha khang / chos ra/ spyi khang / ri khrod du zam tsha'i nang chen/ byang chub dang rnam rgyal ma chod rten/ 'khor khang du ma bcas ba'engs/ zam tsha gser khri sku phreng dang bo nam ma kha' bzang bo zam tsha'i rmog ri'i gdan thang du spyi lo1690lo(rab myos)la sku 'khrungs/dgung lo bco lnga'i dus su khri rgyal mtshan seṅge dang lhan du dbus su phyag phebs shing mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jings brgal gshis/ spyi lo1746lor dga' lda na gser khri nga lnga bar bzhugs / spyi lo175 0lor sku 'das/ zam tsha gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang 'jigs med nam mkha' spyi lo1768lor sku 'khrungs/ rgya nag tu gong ma'i dbu bla hi thog thu zhes pa'i cho 'o thob pa dang dgra lha dpangs bstod kyi na bza' cha tshang dang tsan+dan las grub pa'i rnam sra sa bang ma dzod kyi gso la ras bstsal pa bcas zam/ tsha gser khri sku na rim gyis skyong khur ma dzad/ 1rnga 0khalo nas dgon ma tshan la dga' lda na chos 'phel gling thogs/kirti brgyad pa blo bzang 'phrin la sa kyis bca' yig ba'ag de'i rjes rong chen ljags nag pa'i sku skyes brgyad pa blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho la dgon ma go phul pa nas rang phyogs dgon ma lag bco brgyad kyi gras su tshud cing khri ba mngags pa'i sro la btod/ logs su sngags grwa rig 'dzin ri/nga 'dzin pa bdud 'joms rdo rje rog po'i rtsal gyi phyag bzhes can zhig dang ri khrod 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug ser smad rgyud kyi phyag srol bcas 'dzoms so/ /de ltar dgon pa rten gsum ya nga rta mgrin gsung bkrol/ tsan+dan jo sku dang rje tsong kha ba'i gser sku mi tshad/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al/ khri rgya nag ba sa sku gdung ma chod rten/ snar thang bstan 'gyur/co ne'i bka' 'gyur/ lha mo'i sku thang byin can/ lha mo thog thub ma / rje btsun byams ma gon/ bka' brgyad/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo// rigs gsu ma ma gon po/ seng gdong ma/ khri chen rgyal mtshan se ter dga' ldan chos rgya' rang byon phyag nas byung zer ba'i tho dbyug byin can/ khri rgya nag pas gnang pa'i rgyal dbang dang paṇa chan gyi na bza'/ kirti'i ba so 'i tā mar/ ngos dgon pa'i rnga chung sogs bzhugs pa mang ngo / /dgon pa'i chos thog la rgyud stod 'u gas lta ra 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi srol la 'dzin grwa dang bor lam rim dmar khrid dang gnyis par gas nga 'dus bskyed rim/ gsu ma par bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rdzogs rim /— 497 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/gsar slob pas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga dang mgon chos lnga/ paṇa chen bsdus lam/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ sa lam chos spyod sogs blo 'dzin bya(dang thog srad rgyud lugs yin skad) zla dang bor smon lam dang 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang lha mo/ tshes gtor/ lha tshes/ gos sku/ gtsang 'cham/ smon lam chen mo/ byams pa gling skor/ zla gnyis par bde mchog lca lugs kyi bdag 'jug dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ zla gsum par dpyid chos chen mor mgon chos bskang gso/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ zla ba'i bar ma ṇi ril sgrub/ zla lnga bar gsang 'dus bdag 'jug cho ga phyag len zla gnyis pa ltar/ zla drug pa dang bdun par dbyar gnas su gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dbyangs dang bcas pa/ lam rim/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum zhi rgyas dbang drag gi thig rgyugs bskang gso chen mo sogs/ zla brgyad par 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag 'jug zla dgu bar ston chos chen mor mgon chos bskang gso 'grel ba ba'i sbrags/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu gcig par dgun chos bskang gso dang sgrol ma'i cho ga zla bcu gnyis par mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang bgeg gtor bcas yod pa ma zad/ da dung lo hrul bor rgyun tshogs dang zla rer rgyud gzhung gsum/ gso sbyong gnyis/ lha chos gnyis/ bskang gso bzhi dang rgyud pa'i bsgral chog chen mo/yar ngor 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang mar ngor mkha' spyod ma bdag 'jug yod/ do dam dang chos spyod spel bar las sne la khri ba lo gsum dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dbu mdzad che chung / dge bskos/ sku tshab/ tshogs 'du/ dkor gnyer/ tshogs chen spyi ba/ smon lam spyi ba/ smyung gnas spyi ba/ zam tsha gser khri dang kirti'i sku tshab re bsko srol dar/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor 'jig nyen slebs dus su bla ma zam tsha tshang dang kirti tshang rnams pa zung gis mu mthud bskyangs pa la dge 'dun pa brgya lhag zhal bzhugs/ grwa shag lnga bcu phub/ da dung dgon par spyi rdzas dngul sgor stong phrag du ma dang zam tsha bla ma'i su rug nor lug mang bo/rtswa thang nags tshal ci mkho mi ser du khyad dbang ches cher yod/ skyes bu dam pa dge bshes skal bzang 'jigs med ces pa dgon pa'i rgyud sde bzhi nyams len dang bskyed rdzogs kyi cho ga phyag len dpyis phyin pa dang ri khrod sa 'dul gnang nas/ 'jigs byed bsnyen chen la lo bco lnga bzhugs pa'i sgrub rtags su ṭā ma ra'i steng la ya ma rā dzā mngon sum du bzhad/ sku dngos kyi 'du khang gi nyis thog tu bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi blos bslangs ka bar gsum du bzhengs/ dge bshes skal bzang lhun grub la mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan dang slob gnyer dpyis phyin pas lo rgyus dang gsang yig rtsis sa ris sogs ljags rtsom thor bu mang du snang ngo / /19〈 2lor rmog ri dgon pa slar chos sgo phye nas 'du khang dang rta mgrin lha khang che chung gnyis/ zam tsha nang chen/ o rgyan lha khang / dpa' rtsal gyi rgyal khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang du ma bcas bzhengs/ lha mo thog thub ma'i thang ga dang gser zangs las grub pa'i ston sku sogs rten rnying dang rten gsar mang du bzhugs/chos mgo kirti dang sgar mgo bkra shis 'khyil yin/ zam tsha gser khri'i yang srid blo bzang rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan198 2lo'i zla bzhi ba'i bcu dgur mtsho sngon thon te rdzong nas yab rnam rgyal dang rdo rje 'tsho'i sras su sku — 498 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'khrungs/ gung thang drug pa dang kun mkhyen drug pa/ sde khri brgyad pa/ lha mo'i gser khri bcas kyis ngos 'dzin mdzad cing sbyin bdag gtso bo rmog ru dang gdan thang bcas kyis gdan sar 'khod pas dad ldan mi ser gyi re ba bskangs/ grwa btsun bdun cu tsam zhal 'dzoms pa dang grwa shag sum cu lhag phub/ nags las lung chung du ma dang phyugs rigs khyu chung bcas rang gso'i don du gnyer bzhin mchis so/ /bang tshang dgon gsang chen chos 'phel gling /bang tshang dgon gsang chen chos 'phel gling ni da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi klu chu rdzong zam tsha zhang gi khongs su chags/chos sde 'di ni lha mo'i gser khri gnyis pa'i skabs gser khri bla brang nas g.yu bla(g.yu la dang gcig)dpon por khyod kyis bang tshang dgon btsugs gsungs pa bka' spyi bor bzhes shing 'ur de'u sde bas dga' ru 'khyil zhes pa dgon gnas su phul/ sa 'dul dang sa rtags blangs/ rdo rje 'chang lha mo'i gser khri rgyal mtshan seṅge nyid kyi 'khrungs gzhis de ka de'u mgo'i gzhis ga'i rten bzhugs dang ri khrod pa bcas gdan drangs pas/ bla grwa bcu phrag gsum lhag bzhugs pa 'dir spos pa'i sgo nas rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing 'brug ste spyi lo1844lor g.yu bla dpon po blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos btab ces mdo smad chos 'byung du byung /rim par sngar gyi rgya rab dgon pa'i grwa ba dang 'phags gī'i bla ma'i ri khrod pa/ lo tsho'i dge slong rnams kyis gdan sa 'di nas dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang btsugs/ lha mo dgon du bzhugs pa'i dbus kyi sngags rams pa grags pa 'phel rgyas gdan drangs nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang mgon chos sogs kyi dbyangs bar rta/thig rdul tshon/ 'bud brdung dkrol/ gtor bca' bzo sogs kyi phyag len lha sa'i rgyud stod grwa tshang gi phyag srol ltar btsugs/ lha mo gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge bas bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dbang lung rjes gsum mang du bstsal/ de dus dgon pa'i mtshan la gsang chen chos 'phel gling zhes gsol/ rje 'di bas bsang yig mi 'gyur spras ma zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad cing skyabs mchog de nyid la dgon mgo phul/ lha mo nyin pa'i dgon lag byas pa la khri ba dang sku tshab mngag pa'i srol tshugs bzhin bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa yun ring bskyangs pas grwa tshang rgyas par 'phel/g.yu bla dpon po zhes pa ni g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rnying ma'i sras kyi sras shig khri lde srong btsan gyi skabs su yul skyid sna nas 'khor 'bangs skor zhig sa mdo smad du 'ongs pa la/ 'bangs rnams khag gsum du gyes pa gcig shas klu chu'i srib tu gnas/ gnyis pa sa ga'an du chas/ khong nyid khyung ri yod sa 'di nas chags na mi rabs phyi mar klu nad mi thebs par dgongs nas bzhugs shing ri rgyab g.yon du sgrub khang zhig btsugs/ khong gi mtshan la skyid sna'i dpon g.yu thog bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta lha rje zer/ rig gnas sna mang mkhas pa ma zad/ khyad par du gso rig la byang chub che bas yul de'i mi ser la phan bde rgya cher mdzad/ de phyis yul — 499 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/mi rnams kyis khong la g.yu bla dpon po'am g.yu la bla ma zhes bsngags/ yul 'di nas rnying thig pa'i gdung rgyud mang shos song skad/ skabs shig g.yu bla dpon po bka' chen du grags pa zhig byon nas dbus su yun ring bzhugs/ gsang phur bka' bcu'i grwa skor thon/ phyir log phyin ri bo dge ldan pa'i sgrub sde 'ur steng sgar rnying zhes pa'i chos sde btab/ bshad grwa btsugs par grwa tshogs rgyas te phyis dgon gnas spos pa g.yu bla dpon po gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub mtha' nas dge lugs gsar mar bsgyur pa la da bar sku phreng drug byon/(yongs grags su co ne dpon po dmag zor mgon pos a la zam tsha bcas kyi dgon grong khri rgyal mtshan seṅge la phul bar bshad)/dgon par rten dang brten pa gna' rdzas 'gangs chen la tshogs chen 'du khang dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang / rta mgrin lha khang / spyi khang / gser khri'i nang chen dang g.yu bla nang chen bcas bzhengs pa'i nang chen du ma'i nang du dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i tsan dan byams sku dang /thub pa rdor gdan ma gsung 'byon/ thog gnyis re longs pa'i byams chen dang nye sras brgyad/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub gsum/ rje yab sras gsum/ tsan dan jo bo/ sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs/ ston pa/sman bla/ tshe lha rnam gsum sogs li ma brgya lhag dang / lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng dang bo rgyal mtshan seṅge dang /sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge / bzhi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin seṅge'i 'dra sku/ g.yu bla sku phreng gnyis pa'i 'dra sku/ grags pa 'phel rgyas kyi 'dra sku sogs gyan thang dang thang ga sum brgya lhag gsung gi rten du gser 'phags gtsos bka' bstan gyis mtshon pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha mo'i gser khri gnyis pa'i gsung 'bum/ lcang lo paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung 'bum/ yum 'bum pa dang mdo ting 'dzin bskal bzang / rje tsong kha ba'i lam sngags sogs pota che chung stong phrag lhag thugs kyi rten la byang chub mchod rten dang rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ dung / rgya gling / rnga sbub/ rol mo/ maṇ+ḍal/ bum pa/rdor dril/ ting phor/ mchod kong sogs rtsa chen mod pos bkang ngo / /lo khyud 'khor gcig gi chos thog dang tshogs gal chen skor la/ ho zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo dang byams pa gling skor/ gos sku/ 'cham/ zla gnyis par bde mchog bdag 'jug zla gsum par gdugs dkar sgrub mchod dang bzlog chen/ zla bzhi bar kun rig bdag 'jug bsnyung gnas/ zla lnga bar gsang 'dus bdag 'jug zla drug par ma ṇi ril sgrub dang tshes bco lnga nas bdun pa'i nyer dgu'i bar dgag dbye/ zla brgyad pa'i nang dbyar ston/ lha mo gser khri sku phreng bzhi ba'i gdung mchod/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug dang rab gnas chen mo/ bskang gso chen mo/ zla dgu ba'i nang gser khri dang po'i gdung mchod/ zla bcu bar lnga mchod chen mo/ zla bcu gcig par 'jigs byed dang chos rgyal gyi bsnyen mtshams sbyin sreg bcas/ zla bcu gnyis par lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa dang bgegs gtor/ 'cham/ gtor rgyag zla re'i bdag 'jug gang khel la rdul sbyin sreg klu chog bcas dang / gzhan zla re'i nya la dus bzang — 500 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang gso sbyong / g.yu bla sku 'phreng lnga ba'i gdung mchod/ mar ngo'i nyer dgur dus gtor dang gso sbyong /tshes bzhi dang nyer bzhir rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan gyi lha tshes chag med yin la/ dgon pa'i 'a/sa sne la khri ba/bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dge bskos/ byang 'dren/ spyi ba che chung / tshogs 'du/ lha mo'i sku tshab bcas yod do/ /dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo slebs bar chag 'jig ci yang ma byung bas dge 'dun pa brgya dang sum cu lhag zhal 'dzoms mod kyang lo de dang me stag lo'i rig gsar las 'gul gyi skabs su bsnubs/lcags bya lor slar gso'i bskal ba ldan te 'du khang dang rta mgrin lha khang / shugs ldan btsan khang / lha mo gser khri'i nang chen/ g.yu bla nang chen/ ma ṇi 'khor khang du ma/ byang chub dang dbyen 'dum/ bdud 'dul bcas kyi mchod rten dgon mthar bzhengs/ grwa shag bzhi bcu tsam phub/ lha mo gser khri sku phreng lnga ba mchog gis snga gzhug tu sde dge dang lha sa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang rten skal sogs gnang / btsun pa zhal bdun cu lhag 'dus nas chos spyod rgyun ldan du spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /chos 'khor zil gyi ri khrod/chos 'khor zil gyi ri khrod ces pa mi kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong zam tshang zhang chos 'khor sde ba'i dbus su chags/kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog dang rong chen kirti 'phrin las pa'i slob ma kun spang ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin zhes pas ri khrod 'di btab zer/ rje 'di ba de skabs zab tsha'i rtsa mtha'i gnas khang du phebs te bde mchog tshogs 'khor gnang ste gnas mjal byas mthar thugs rje chen po dang / bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku gzugs yod pa sku 'khor rnams la bstan te shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/ shing sprel1884lor rong chen kirti 'phrin las mchog zam tsha shog pa'i gzhung nas spyan drangs par phebs te zam tsha stod smad kyi rdzas tsha dang chos 'khor bar gyi gyod bsdum par mdzad/ 'di dus zam tsha'i chos 'khor sde grong dang ri khrod du phebs te theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom rgyud dang / thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas kyi lung gnang / de'i rjes su kun spang ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pas ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i sgo nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol ba dang na tsha can dang 'chi nyen can mi nyung ba bskyangs par grags/ 'di ba'i dngos slob tshul khrims dbang bos dge btsun ma 'ga' zhig bsdus te dmigs brtse ma'i bzlos sgom dang ma ṇi tā re sogs zhal 'don mdzad/gtsos rdzogs chen dpal sprul mchog nas ri khrod bdag gir bzhes te 'du khang dang gzim khang bskrun/ 'du khang gi nang rten slob dpon gtso 'khor dang / mkha' spyod ma/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas kyi sku brnyan 'ga' bzhengs shing / tshes bcu la chos spyod 'ga' spel/ 195〈lo'i rjes su ri khrod gtor/ de sngon shugasharamakha' 'grom riga'adzin sgrol ma/ ane yeshesalogs bzhugs/ da lta ri khrod slar gso — 501 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/mdzad de dge btsun ma 'ga' 'ig bzhugs so/ /gyis tshang dgon phun chogs dge 'phel gling /sgyis tshang nags ri'i dgon phun tshogs dge 'phel gling ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi klu chu rdzong a la zhang gi khongs/ sgyis tshang nags ri'i dbus su chags/de yang / thog mar dgon sde 'di ni sgyis tshang(kha gya'i rdzi'i tsha nas rus mched pa'i bshad sro' yang yod)sde tsho bdun kyis sbyin bdag zhus te/ rje sgrub khang ba'i slob ma grub dbang gi gras co ne a smon blo bzang smon lam(1672da wa1725)dpal bzang bos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags yos(1711)lor phyug po 'u nga mdo'i nyin ngos su phyag 'debs mdzad(sgyis tshang phyug po'i sgar yang zer)de bskyangs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug(1751)lor/ co ne sa skyong sku rabs bcu gcig pa dmag zor mgon ngo yab sras kyi skabs su/ dgon pa 'di lha mo'i gser khri dgon phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge mchog la phul pa bdag gir bzhes shing / dus de nas bzung lha mo'i dgon lag tu gyur pas dgon bdag lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng rim byon gyis 'dzin skyong spel gsum bgyis te sngar gyi dgon pa de da lta'i gzhi 'dir gnas spor ba dang / rim du ma dgon lha mo nas
