khri ba mngags pa'i srol btod do/ /rten dang brten pa'i skor la/ 'du khang dang mgon khang / rta mgrin lha khang / gser khri'i nang chen dang sgyis dge nang chen/ khri khang / rung khang dang spyi khang / ma ṇi 'khor khang bcas pa las/ sku rten du/bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag bzos spyan ras gzigs byin can dang / byams chen nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus gtsang nas gdan drangs pa'i jo sku dang rje tsong kha ba'i phyag tsha/ grub chen thang stong rgyal bo'i sku brnyan dbu skra skyes pa dang / rje dge legs ma sogs sman 'dam dang gser zangs las grub pa'i 'bur sku che chung mang bo dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan sogs rgyan thang dang thang ga gsung rten du/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang bstan 'gyur/gsung 'bum sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i skor phal cher ma tshang ba med/ thugs rten du/bka' gdams mchod rten byin can sogs bzhugs so/ /dge lugs smad rgyud grwa tshang 'di'i chos spyod 'chad nyan gtso bo ni lha mo dang bla brang gi phyag len ci rigs sgos/ hor zla gcig par smon lam/ gtsang 'cham/ byams pa gling skor/ gnyis par thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sa chog dbyangs dang de'i sgrub mchod/ gsum par kun rig gi dbyangs gcags dang de'i sgrub mchod/ bzhi bar smyung gnas dang gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod/ lnga ba'i nang ma ṇi ril sgrub/ drug pa'i bco lnga nas dbyar gnas spyi mtshungs/ brgyad par 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod/ dgu bar smyung gnas/bcu bar lnga mchod/ bcu gnyis par bsnyen mtshams/ mgon chos lnga'i gtor sgrub/ 'cham gtor rgyag — 502 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang bcas/ gzhan yang / rgyun tshogs dang gso sbyong / gdung mchod/ dus bzang / zla rer dgu bskang chag med bcas dar ro/mchod gzhis gyis tshang sde tsho bdun las li to'i sde khrod du/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta mdo sngags rig gnas kyi mdzod 'dzin dge bshes lha mo blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho(1ra89—1958) dpal bzang bo 'khrungs/lha mo 'i gser khri'i dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi slob ma mang po dang gsung 'bum pota 'ga' bzhugs/ 1958lor spyi tshogs bcos sgyur gyi skabs su sku mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan kha'i zhal chems ltar ma bcos rang grub kyi sku dmar gdung de lo brgyad kyi yun la skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi dpal du gson po lta bur sa 'og tu bzhugs bzhin pa/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i skabs rang yul du 'phrin las kyi mjug btsan gyis bsdu dgos byung / rgya ra'i sgyis dge tshang la 'khrungs pa'i sgyis dge sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug(190 4—1967)mchog yang snga gzhug tu lha mo dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ rim du zam tsha'i bang tshang dgon dang shis tshang sgar rnying sgar sar/ tsa yus dang rgan gya'i brag dkar/ bla brang gi rgyud stod smad dang kyai rdor/sman pa grwa tshang gi khri ba dang / bla brang tshogs chen khri ba bcas kyi 'phrin las khur bzhes so/ /sa khyi(1kha58)lor sngon du grwa shag zhe gsum dang grwa ba gya gsum bzhugs/ khri ba dang lha mo'i gser khri'i sku tshab/ bla ma gzhung las pa/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ spyi ba bcas las sne bskos/ spyi rdzas dang sa zhing nags tshal sogs ma tshang ba med/ 19〈 2lor slar yang chos sgo dngos su phye nas lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅges thugs brtse byams skyong dang / chos dad mang tshogs rang mos kyis rgyab skyor rogs ram la brten nas 'du khang sngon ma las bzo bkod spus legs bzhengs te sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs/ gser khri 'di bas dgon par lha sa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dang /sde dge bstan 'gyur sogs kyi rten skal gnang / gser khri'i nang chen dang ma ṇi 'khor khang nyis brgya brgyad cu/ bdud 'dul mchod rten sogs legs grub byung / da lta grwa shag nyer lnga dang grwa ba lnga bcur nye ba bzhugs pas rgyal gces khrims srung sgos sngar srol gyi chos spyod phyag len mtha' dag rgyun ldan ngang spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /de'u mgo'i dgon dge 'dun dar rgyas gling /gangs can mdo smad gan lho'i yul gyi de'u mgo'u dgon dge 'dun dar rgyas gling ngam bde chen thar ba gling ni/ klu chu dang bsang chu/ co ne rdzong gsum gyi sa mtshams dang 'brel bar gnas pa'i a la shog pa lnga'i sa dkyil te da lta klu chu rdzong ya la zhang gi khong sa su/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che(1988—1989)sku — 503 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/phreng bcu bas 'bas kyis bcags shing byin gyis rlabs te sa ming brjes pa'i gser thang dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa( 164ra/ —172 2)sku phreng dang bos dgon sa 'ig gi sa ra lung du bstan pa'i a thang / sta ga tshang lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng rim/ byon sogs skyes chen dam pa du ma sa dus 'khor bcas kyi dbang lung rjes gsum gnang sa'i dbang thang gsum gyi dbus sa ma/ klu chu'i 'gram du chags 'dugad lta 'i a la 'ang gi khongs gtogs su gna' snga mo/ nas bon sde nyung shas re yod pa/ sngo na sa skya ba'i dus nas rim du sa skya ba dang de nas dge 'u gas par bsgyur nga 'i dgon sde dang ga'is ka dgu lha ga chags yo da pa snga phyi ltar rags tsam bkod pa 'a sa / 'gro ma gon( 12 25——12〈0)'phags pa'i grwa chen nyang dbon mgon po blo gros dang / dpal shes rab 'bar/ dbang dbon po blo bzang tshu' gri/ mas/ twa dbon po ba'i mdo smad lho phyogs kyi bon bsgyu ra bar phebs te so so sa gcis ka re re brtsigs / tā dbon pos 'bar tsha sde khrod nas gcis ka zhig bzung ba la a la gas tshang zhes 'bod pa dbus skad lta ra zur chags nas a la tshang dang /ming de rim du sngar klu shod stod ma zer ba'i sa char thogs te a la ches 'bod ba'in pa 'di yin no/ /de ya nga / a 'a tshang gi bla ma na rim gyi gzim khang du dus gsu ma sa ngas rgyas kyi sku che legs dang / slo ba dpon pad+ma'i sku brnyan 'al ras la rdul mi chags pa'i byin can so gas rten gsum du ma/ bzhugs / ma do smad chos 'byung du tā dbon lha btsun gyis mdzod dge sto da smad dang klu thod phyogs bzung bar bshad pa a la tshang dang zam tsha'i spang mthil dgon pa'i nang gong 'og la go dgos pas / ma dzod dge dang a la tshang gnyis nas gcig mthun gyis tā dbon pa bla rabs bdun cu tsam byon zer ba'ang khungs med hab bshad tsam min par snyam / ko'u dge dang / khyom dge gyis dge bse( sa) dge tshang ba'i ya nga thog mang a la tshang nas chad par bshad/ a la yar ru'i bse dge'i rgyud du nyi ma rta chon dang g.ya' ma me 'bud so gas grub chen 'ga' zhig byon pa'i gzim khang du/ byam sa chen ma thong grol bdud rtsi ma sogs rten gsum ma nga tsam bzhugs/dga' gdong chos skyong gi phyag ma tshan sku chos so gas rgyal mchog lnga ba chen po'i(1617da 178 2)bod so ga skad gnyis smra ba methon dka' bcu shes rab rgya ma tsho'i phyag tu byung / merban bā thur gyis a la'i sa ra gdan drangs te sngon a la ma kha dang skyid tsha sde gnyis kyis sbyin bdag gi gtso byas nas sde ba skyid shod pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin la sa(162khad —16〈 2)ma thong ma khar dgon gas nga ji gas smin grol gling du rten dang brten pa mang bo bachengs kyang / yu la 'khrug dang ma chod bkur ma nus pa bcas kyi dbang gis 'o bcu phrag ba'i lha ga la sa ma gnas par nyam sa so nga / 'od dpag me da kyi sku byin can 'ig yod pa kirti blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal ma tshan(1712da wa 1771)gyis lha mo'i kirti dgon du gdan drangs pa la skyid tsha'i rgyal bo zhes pa'i srung ma 'brangs pa dgon de'i rgyal rten du bzhugs shing chos skyong khog zhugs kyang da lta'i bar du mchod ba'in yod do/ /a la sbog tsha'i sgar dga' lda na chos 'phel gling ni/ sngon tha la ri khrod 'debs ma khan te gnyis su — 504 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mtshan snyan rgyas pa'i dga' ldan the bo bla thung zhes pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang phyag 'debs mdzad/dbus nas dga' ldan du slob gnyer dpyis phyin pa dang bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher spel/ don brgyad par dag zhing du gshes/ de'i sprul sku lha mo'i gser khri dgon pa'i tshogs chen mkhan rabs bcu drug pa ngag dbang blo bzang chos 'phel yin/ de nas bzung sprul sku ma byon/ me sprel1956lor lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng lnga bas sgar 'di de'u mgo'i dgon du gcig gyur byas/ skyid tsha'i skal ba rams 'byams pa blo bzang grub rgyan gyis skyid tsha'i mchod rten ngor ri khrod cig btab kyang dgon gnas btsal nyes pas grwa ba 'ga' rer sa grib thebs pa bcas kyi phyir yun ring ma gnas/ skal rams pa'i sprul sku dbus kyi gzhung ba zhabs drung / de'i sprul sku zhig blus pa'i rgyud la deng sang dme shul chud gshong phyi sho'i nyang tshang rim byon yin zhes mdo smad chos 'byung du gsungs/ co ne a smon blo bzang smon lam(1672—1625)gyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang snga gzhug tu lcags yos1711lor 'gong ba nang bkra shis 'phel gling dang sgyis tshang phyug po'i dgon phun tshogs dge 'phel gling / chu 'brug(1712)lo la 'bo ra'i sgar rnying byams pa gling gsum phyag 'debs mdzad/ de yang / gong smras dgon pa gsum phyag 'debs mdzad pa co ne a smon ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu byi(1672)lor co ne brgya skor a smon sde gsum gyi nang ru mo che ru sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par rab tu byung ste co ne dgon chen gyi chos grwar zhugs/ nyer gcig par dbus su ser smad chos grwar gzhung bka' pota yongs rdzogs la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ nyer dgu ba la paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal dbang drug pa las lam rim gyi lung zhib par gsan/ so brgyad pa la mdo smad rang yul du phebs khar rje sgrub khang ba(1641—1712)chen pos dbu zhwa sogs rten skal du gnang / dam pa 'di dang hor stag mgur ba/ skal ba rams 'byams pa gsum rje sgrub khang ba dge legs rgya mtsho'i dngos slob grub dbang gi gras yin/ shing lug(1715)lor urge nas rgyal dbang bdun pa la mjal te chos 'brel zhus/skabs shig nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad lam rim gyi tshig kho na'i yig 'bru dkar pos bltams pa gzigs/ re bzhi ba shing yos la gshegs/ khong gi na bza' sku chas sogs sa khyi(1958)lo'i bar du de'u mgo'i dgon du bzhugs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug(1751)lor/ co ne sa skyong dmag zor mgon po dang sras 'jam dbyangs nor bu gnyis kyi skabs su/ stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri dgon phyag 'debs mkhan khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge mchog la a smon gyis btab pa'i 'gong ba nang dang byams pa gling gnyis phul pa bdag gir bzhes/ byams pa gling gi byams khang rten gsum dang bcas sngar gnas su sa bdag 'bo ra'i sde bas da lta'i bar du mchod bkur byed bzhin mchis/ gser khri sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge la sgyis tshang phyug po'i dgon phul/ de nas bzung ste dgon pa 'di gsum lha mo gser khri'i dgon lag tu gyur/de bzhin dgon bdag lha mo'i gser khri sku phreng dang bo khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge nas da lta 'tsho bzhes kyi sku phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang rna ma rgyalalungarigasaselha'ibarabaskyangs/ — 505 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/da wa ༷ tsā rabs rags tsam bkod pa la/ ma dgon lha mo'i gser khris sa glang(1829)lo nas a la sbog tsha'i sgar dang 'aso/nga ba chang / byams pa gling / tshud gshong dme rgya(rme rgya)dgon bzhi la khri ba gcig lcogs kyes ma ngag sro ra tshugs pa'i khri rabs dang bo/ dzam+bha la'i sprul ba a la bkra yā bla ma 'jam dbyangs don grub(1 78'u 1ra 56)pas/ gser khri bla brang gi thugs bkod ltar sa glang(182kha)lor 'gong ba nang dang byam sa pa gleng gnyis de'u mgor gnas spo bgyis te chig sgril mdzad nas de'u mgo'i dgon bde chen thar ba gling 'es pa 'i ma tshan gsol zhing kun rig dang gsang 'dus kyi bdag 'jug gsar du tshugs/ de nas gung brda bla ma/ blo bzang mkhas mchog chos seṅgi sku phreng gnyis pa sku phyogs rgya tshang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ khri rabs 'ji bas chos spyod sgrig lam dag ther dang bca' yig gsar bsgrigs mdzad nas sngon gyi mtshan te dge (redun dar rgyas gling zhes par bsgyur/ mkhan po 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i khri rabs skabs kyi me stag(1926)lor gseng khre dbon pa'i phyag srol ji bzhin gtsang 'cham gsar du tshugs nas da lta'i bar du ma nyams gong spel gyi za bas dang de nas khri blo bzang phun tshogs/ khri klu che ba blo bzang bstan pa/ dran pa'i sprul sku'i lī rabs la gser khri bla brang gi thugs smon ltar bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod btsugs/ de ba'i na dukhri blo bzang seṅge dang blo bzang dar rgyas/ dge steng blo bzang 'phrin las/ mkhan sprul yon tan da ra rgyaru rgya ma tsho(rag to) khri blo bzang mtha' yas sogs sa khyi(1958)lo'i yan la khri rabs bzhi bcu rtsa grangs phebs pa dang / chos seṅge sku phreng dang bo nas da ltar bzhugs pa'i sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan seṅge sogs kyis byams skyong gnang ngo / /rten dang brten pa rags bsdus tsam 'god pa la/ spyir de'u mgo'i dgon ni snga gzhug tu dgon sde 'ga' phyogs bsdus chig sgril byas phyir/ rten dang brten bzheng ngam mchod rdzas mkho chas sogs gang thad nas ga'an la smon mi dgos pa zhig 'dzoms/ 'du khang che chung gsar rnying gsum dang / byams khang /mgon khang / lha mo'i btsan khang / rta mgrin lha khang bcas kyi sku rten du/ ston pa gtso 'khor dang rje yab sras/ bla sku ci rigs dang rig gsum mgon po/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang tshe lha rnam gsum/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gsum dang rta gdugs sgrol gsum sogs kyi sku mi tshad las brgal pa dag dang rje dge legs ma stong sku/ byams chen thog so gnyis can 'khor sras chen brgyad dang byams pa khru tshad ma stong sku/ dngul sku'i slob dpon pad+ma 'khor gu ru mtshan brgyad gser zangs las grub pa/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seṅge'i shangs mtshal las bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed dang lha mo/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dga' ldan the blas dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i lha mo gsung 'byon ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ bkra yā bla ma'i phyag bzos chos rgyal sogs byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha shin tu 'bar ba de dag so so'i gzungs gzhug tu/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung dang rje me thar ma/ mirti'i phyag tsha dang rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa dang lnga ba/ paṇa chen bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i dbu skra na bza' sogs rten 'dus ci 'byor bzhugs/ gzhan yang / snar thang nas gdan drangs pa'i skyes — 506 —

krung so'i bod brgyud nang dason dkar chag las bam su 'u gle4sa bam ༈da wad wa da wa rangang so bco ba dang rtsa rgyud bla ma/'i 'khrungs rabs / 'ing bkod dang tshogs cing rgyud sde so so 'i lha tshogs dang rgya 'a chen rigs ba'i/ mgom chos lnga'i 'alor ngang bcas pa'i gyang thang su ma cwa lhag dang 'tshem satsagaru briru gsum gyi thang ga mi nyung ba bzhugs / gsu nga rtem du co mi'i b.la' bar+ṣa na ngang nge cin nga5 ra gyi 'a bum rje ya nga sra sa rwa so gas nga/'i gsu nga 'bum dang ma ngo sngabs rig grenas sko nga gyi ngange cha pota grangs nyis sto nga ni 4/ bzhubaca / thusas rten du/ lha mo/'i gser khri dang chos se je sku dri nga co me ma smon/ dga' ldan the bla/ bku yā bla ma bcas kyi gdung rten gser zangs la sa gub nga 'i ma chod rte na che chung ci rigs bzhugs/de ri na rton ji ra dang ri dwags chos 'khor rgyal ma/tshan/ ro rma bcu dbang ldan ngang spen rgyan ci 'tsham sang rung dang / co4chod rdzas ma chod cha dang 'cham 'u 0'a 'bag ro 2 cha so gres ma kho chas kyi nas me 'brug( 19(〈 (〈da —— 19༅16 )'o 'i bar gyi rig gnas gas ra brje ches pa'i zing 'tshub ya nga ba'i srabs su rtsa gtor rang ba'im gyi nyam sa rgud tshabs chen thebs / ñca gas glang ( 196 1 ) lor dge rtsa 'a bsgyub nga/ sang mo sa bya dpos / sngags kyi grog thabs dang su ma rtags / rtsis sa ris / dbu can dbu re da la ñja'i yi ga gzugs bcas la sbya ngas pa nges can re byed sro 'a/ yo/da do/ ༈ zhan lho bod rigagarang skyongakhulakluchu ngashakhongs/ gzigs nyang tshang sku rabs shig li to nas dge bshes lha mo'i blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho gsung 'bum can dang de'i sku tsha rdo rams pa 'jam dbyangs nyi ma/ rgya ra'i sgyis dge tshang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug sogs sku phreng / a la ma kha ru lha bzo'i yang rtser son pa'i grub rgyud du byung ba'i lha rgan tshe ring bkra shis dang de'i bu mkha'i dge slong zhes pas mdo smad kyi chos sde khag gi thang ga dang logs ris bzheng bar skya thig thebs 'phra' nas ye shes pa zhugs shes mdo smad chos 'byung sogs las gsungs/ bla brang dgon pa'i rdo rams pa ngag dbang don grub(1721—1)dang lha mo'i mkhan po thub bstan tshang / bla brang dus 'khor tshang sku rabs shig ya/nga sde 'dir 'khrungs/ a la skyid tsha nas mchod rten ngo 'debs mkhan bka' rams pa dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chen khri rabs so bdun pa phun tshogs seṅge / chos seṅge sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan seṅge / bla brang dus 'khor grwa tshang dang a mchog se chang bcas kyi khrir bzhugs pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ kha gya'i 'gyang rgan sku phreng drug pa/ the phu nas skyid thang ma ṇi ba sku rabs shig 'khrungs par bshad/ a la 'bo ra'i mgo ba tshang gi dpon slob kun dga' seṅge ste sngon thang ser dgon gnas su ri khrod 'debs mkhan dang / mgo ba bla ma skyabs kyi sras rdo rams pa ngag dbang dar rgyas/ bla ma blo gros bsta na pa sku phreng gnyis/ a la brgyad cu'i gras go can du bkra yā bla ma 'jam dbyangs don grub dang mkhan po blo bzang chos ldan sogs 'khrungs so/ /lha sde dang sbyin bdag gtso bo ni a la shog pa lnga dang / de min a la brgyad cu/ skyid tsha phu mdo sde gnyis/ gzhan yang / nye 'khor yul phyogs gzhan dang bcas pas sngar bzhin lo re'i chos thog la rang mos kyis tshogs bsags sbyin bdag gang nus ci thub byas dang byed bzhin mchis/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya(1981)lo la slar yang chos sgo phyes na'ang / rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis sngar gyi dgon sar ma phyogs par gnas skabs gtan chags kyi gnas gzhi med rung snga ma'i dgon shul gyi nye logs tsam du lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa'i dgon sa thang du spo dgos byung bas/ zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u dang mi rigs chos lugs don gcod lhan khang nas1988lor dgon gnas spor thengs su ma dngul sgor khri drug ched du gnang ba la bka' drin che na'ang / bar rkyen du ma'i dbang gis da lta'i bar spo ma thub par lus/ yin na'ang nged cag dgon pas rgyun ldan gyi chos spyod spel ched dang / chos dad mang tshogs kyi re ba skong phyir 'du khang chung ngu 'ig bzhengs nas/ der rgyu tsan dan dang shug pa las grub pa'i byams chen thog so gnyis can 'khor sras chen brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku rten mi nyung ba dang / bka' bstan dag tshar bzhi dang 'bum tshar 'ga' re bcas kyi gsung rten ci 'byor/ gser zangs las grub pa'i mchod rten gyis mtshon pa'i thugs rten sogs ci rigs bzhugs shing / mchod rdzas mchod cha dang 'cham chas yo byad ci 'dzoms dang / ma ṇi 'khor lo sum brgyar nye ba/ gser tog rgyal mtshan dang ri dwags chos 'khor rung khang dang der mkho'i ca lag cha tshang / grwa shag chung ngu sum cu rtsa grangs bcas tshags su chud/ ga'an yang / rang — du08 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gso'i thon skyed kyi thad du tshong khang zhig dang sa zhing mu'u lnga lhag bcas don gnyer ci thub byed rung ma rtsa dang bstun pa'i yong 'bab nyung tsam las med/ mig sngar/ grwa ba brgyar nye ba bzhugs pas 'chad nyan sgom sgrub dang / chos spyod phyag len sogs gang thad nas sngar srol nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel sgos/rgyal gces chos dad kyi dgon pa thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhig brtson pa chen pos sgrub bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /shis tshang sgar sar dga' ldan bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling /shis tshang sgar sar dga' ldan bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi klu chu rdzong shis tshang 'ang gi khongs su chags/nang bstan chos sde 'di mdo smad lho rgyud kyi yul gru las chos 'khor shis tshang tsho ba bcu gnyis mchod gzhis su gyur pa'i gnas yin/ lha dang bla mas lung du bstan pa a zhes bya ba'i yul du nyan thos kyi dgon sde khyad par can 'byung ba ltar shis tshang dgun sa'i yar thang gdan khri rtseg 'dra'i sa dbyibs kyi steng zhwa ser bstan pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid chags/ de'i g.yas phyogs su yul bkra shis nor bu dmag dpon dang lha gnyan mthong chen dung ri dkar bo 'gyings shing mdun du klu chab dal 'bab ring mo rgyu bzhin mchis/chos sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad po ni sde khri sku phreng gsum pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma dpal bzang bo yin/ khong mdo smad rtse gzhong du ha thon mda' tshan gyi yab yi bo phun tshogs dang yum lha mo skyid kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa mo phag ste spyi lo1779lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs/ shing 'brug la kun gzigs mchog gis gser khri'i go gnas kyi cho lo dmigs su gnang / phyis su gung thang dang hor tshang / zam tsha bcas gser khri rnam bzhir grags/ de nas tsha gan be shing dgon pa'i khrir lo gnyis tsam bzhugs pa dang / sog yul du thengs bzhi phebs nas sgrub sde du ma btsugs par gleng /slar byon nas gdan sa'i tshogs chen gyi phrir zhabs sen bkod/ de nas dgung lo re gcig bzhes pa sa phag la the bo'i chab tshan du chibs bsgyur gnang lam a gsal bla mas gdan drangs pa la dgon chung lha sde 'ga' yar 'bul dang spyi dgon gsar 'debs kyi sbyor ba bcoms/ shis tshang dpon po bsod nams rgya mtsho dang thang lung mgo bas shis tshang dgun mtsher yar thang dgon sa phul/ phyi lo ste spyi lo18 29lor chos 'khor tsho ba bcu gnyis kyis slar gdan drangs nas dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus pa'i skabs su kun mkhyen gong ma'i dngos slob blo bzang nyi mas btab pa'i ma nge dga' ldan rin chen gling dang / kun mkhyen dngos slob gzhung bstan pas btab pa'i bla ri mgul bkra shis chos 'phel gling(da lta spyi dgon gyi logs su yod) shis tshang dgon bde chen chos gling / hor dka' chen brtson 'grus rgya mtshos btab pa'i hor sgar ba/ be ru mthu stobs rgya mtshos btab pa'i be ri sgar/ a la'i sgar/ sgar skor sgar/ sum mthil sgar/ ko'u dge sgar/ a gsal — 509 —

makan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzo nga gi bongs /da wa da wa sga ra / rgya sgur sgar/ je ru stsa ra/ 9nya tshang sgar/ chos 'khor sgar/ cha riru4 r+sha ra/ rdzaca tsha'i r+sha ra bcas dgon dra na bcu drug byo gas gcig tu bsdu sa me rta 'o ra spyi ngabon du chogs chen 'a du bang nga nga du shībyam/sa khang / sde ba tshang zwa brang so gas legs par grub/ lo de'e ngapyeng bar 'angir thabs sma/ da so sa nadu pyi na drangs nga 'i gse ra gyi rgu' ma tshan dang gañji ra/ sku gsu nga thugs rtem ga nom pa spyi 'jog garang nga ༷ nga choru nyan dang sgri ba ra ma / bun sbyo da so gas lebs ji na ngo nga bar thusas baches ma ngod/ snge lnge ‘ tshe nga mang rdzung rka ma do'i 'cham rnying bsgyu ra naṭa༄ chos rgya' ya ba 'u ma ngang lha mo gtso 'khor gsu ma bsna na cing drub/ cu nga dang sbre la ngaben sa 'i ce gas ma khar gyi sre 'a btod/ zam sne 'a rta ma grin gyi sku ('bum bachengs bi sa pyi ru su byin rlabaru che bar grags/ dgung 'o bya bache ba chu gyi1 rnga ( 2 'o 'i gnis pa'i tshes batshir gzusas sku'i babod pa chosar dbyings su thim tshu‘pa bstan to/ /sde dri sku phreng dang bo grub nga 'i dbang byu ga sde pon blo bzang don grub ( 1 6༅1 2—— 17ṭaX 7 ) ba ri ma de khong ma ngo smad khri sanyis la'i 'a na kyo ches nga 'i yu 'a gyi lta ga ring gi rus 'a sa ya ba bla dwags dbe bstem gyi snga sa su sku 'khrungs / ngagung lo bcu drug steng dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs bkra this sgo ma nga gi chos grwar zhugs ༈dgung 'o nyer lnga ba'es thog lha lnga na smon ra ma chen ro 'i dus su dam ngaca' ba'ag ba 'i ma chod spri na rgya cher stos sheng de mas sgo ma nga ba'i 'a4na baches / co bdun ste nga kun ma byen bla ma 'i khyabs byi/ra ma do mi nga du thebs zing bkra shis 'khyil ba gas ra 'angebs kyi skabs su bla ma'i bka' lta ra 'a du khang dang grwa khang / sku 'bas bla brang so gas dason nga 'i ga'is gas ra skrun dang 'a brel ba'i bya 'a sa kyi sgo ( ra phar yongs su phye/ dgung 'o nga dgu'i steng rgyud nga 'i khrir babod pas rgyud khang phugs su dri gtsang rten 'brel ngang bcas pa legs par bachengs / sa rta 'o 'i dbyar gdan sa 'i tshogs chen khrir ma nga' bsgyu ra te 'dus pa rgya ma tsho'i gtsug gi rgyan du gyur sde khri sku phreng gnyis pa 'a jigs med lung rigs rgya ma cho ( 17 49da — 174 〈 ) ma chog ma khan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbon por sku 'khrungs bkra 'is 'gyil byi chos grwar zhugs / ci nga skya rdo rje 'chang nas er ti mi re ra san she re thu ma/lan po 'es pa'i cho 'o dang / bka' zog so gas kyis gzengs bsto nga gnang / dgung 'o nyer gceg pa la 'bras bkra shis sgo ma nga si chos grwar b.la' pota lnga 'i thugs lanyer ma/dzad/ rgyal dbang dang pa ca chen gyi cho 'o ngang bka' shog thob/ me bya17177'o ra rang ngagon tshogs chen gyi gser khrir ma nga' gso ‘2 to/ snge khri sku phreng batshi ba lu nga rigs nyi ma ( 18 6 2 da 1rnga74 ) ma chog co ne sa skyong gi khongs gtogs a 'khor ti gu rngos si 'i ya ba nam ma kha' don grub dang yu ma/ ma/kha' 'gro'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse dzor ma jal skor du phebs pa dang rim/ gyis bā rin bai nga / a ru thor chen be li so gas su chibs bsgyur gnang ngo /sde khri sku phreng lnga ba 'jibs meng thub bsta na nyi ma ( 1 ri 75da 1 rnga9〈 ) ma/chog sla ra sku gong ma/'i khyim du ya/ba yu ma/ de zung gi sras su sku 'khrungar / dgung 'o (nge 'i steng dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyi' nas gdan khrir ma nga' gso la /smad sog dang rgu nag so gab༄ yu 'a gru mang bor phebs ma thar r+shas tshang du phebs nas ser skya thun mo/nga 'a chos sbyin da ri ) 10 ——

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul klu chu rdzong gi khongs/dkar bo grags can/ ma ṇi 'khor khang mang du bzhengs/ 'on kyang gong gi lha khang du ma'i chag 'jig ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya192 2lor yul gyi gshed ma la'o ta khrang gis jag dmag khrid de dgon pa'i rten dang brten mang shos brlags pa'i sgor gyur/ gzhan bla brang nang dang / sde khri/ zam tsha/ pra nye mkhan po/dbal mang / bsod grags/ cung gar/ brag sgom pa/ rnga rgod/ se ra/ sum mthil/ a gsal/ko'u dge nor bu/ be ri/ hor tshang / ra rgya/ tsa yus thog ga 'bring ba/ dpon po/ mgo ba bcas kyi nang chen gzim shag bskrun cing sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs chen shin tu mang bar grags/ grwa shag brgya lnga bcu phub/ bod rgyal sa khyi dang me rta lor snga phyir dgon pa yongs su bsnu bas shing grwa mang lnga brgya bdun cu bzhugs pa rang khyim grong sder log nas thon skyed ngal rtsol du zhugs so/ /slar rab byung de ga'i lcags sprel te spyi lo1980lor dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re 'dod dang srid jus ltar chos sgo phye/ da lta tshogs chen 'du khang dang lha mo'i btsan khang ga nas bcu lha khang / bla brang nang / tshoms chen bcas rten dang brten pa mang tsam bzhengs/ grwa shag brgya sum cu phub/ dus bstun dgon pa rang gso byed par tshong khang dang sman khang / 'grul khang / par khang / skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor sogs nyer mkho'i las rigs mang du spel/ dge 'dun pa zhal grangs sum brgya lnga bcu 'dus nas chos spyod thams cad rgyun 'dzin dang gong du spel ba'i sgang lags so/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rma chu rdzong gi khongs/mtshan sgrogs dgon dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling /mtshan sgrogs dgon dga' lda na bkra shis chos 'phel gling ni/ da lta'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong khro kho smad ma 'ang du chags/rab nyi'i me yos(spyi lo1687)la mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen yon tan grags pa nyan rtse'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs nyer lnga ba lcags yos lor dbus su mdo sngags gsan sbyong la phebs/ ser smad grwa tshang du thugs gnyer ma dzad nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi yang rtser son te mtshan sgrogs mkhan por bzhugs/zhi ba'i ste lcags khyi nas mtshan sgrogs ma khan zur bzhes shing mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal rgyal blon kun gyis bla mar bsten nas thugs rje chen po 'al bcu gcig pa'i rjes gnang sogs bka' chos gnang phyin rang yul mdo smad du phebs grabs kyi dus tsam la rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya ma tshos bka' shog la phyag rtags byu ru'i rgya che ba'i rtags dang / dgon sde bskrun na dga' ldan rab rgyas gling zhes mtshan gsol na 'grig ces gsu nga shing rje nyid ma/tshan 'bas pa yin pa'i bdag rkyen du sku ber sogs gnang ba ma zad/paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis dbu nab sogs na bza'i rigs gnang / nga gcig pa me sbrul la dngos su rang yul du phebs par rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis ston pa'i snang brnyan byu ru las grub pa byon legs shig skyes su gnang ba dang rje nyid kyi dbu zhwa/ sku ber/ gdugs/ rgya gling cha/tsan+dan gyi kun dga' ra ba/ tsan+dan gyi mdun cog sogs sku chas yongs rdzogs phul/ rgyal po pho lha bas thob zhwa so gas rgyal chas yongs rdzogs phul/ ga'an po ti mang po sogs sku gsung thugs rten dang dngos rdzas gya nom pa gnang / da dung lam du 'brog sde so so nas khong gi thugs 'dun ltar mthun rkyen gang dgos bsgrub pa'i bka' shog dang sa phyogs gang du bzhugs kyang der gnas dpon 'bangs kun gyis sbyin bdag dang mchod gnas bya dgos pa'i bka' shog gnyis 'a bod rgyal gyi mtshan rtags su mtshal dmar gyi tham ga bstsal/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas bod gzhung gis nag chu khar bskyal/ nag chu'i 'khor chen dang g.yang ra'i 'khor chen sogs dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis bskrun/ rgyal stod khrod du zhabs kyis bcags te 'du khang bzhengs la sku gsung thugs rten rnams der bzhugs/ rang yul du dkar chen byams pa gling sogs phyag 'debs mdzad/dgung grangs don lnga ba lcags pho sbrul gyi lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan cing ser smad yer ba khams tshan du tshoms khang bzhengs pa rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar du yod do/ /mkhan chen sku phreng gnyis pa nam mkha' rdo rje rab 'dod chu rta la sku bltams te stod la dwags kyi gnas su sgrub pa mdzad nas — 513 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khu' rma chu rdzong bi longs /bzhugs so / / me (ru ga (spyi lo17ra 7) la mkhan chen sku phreng gsu ma pa dkon mchog 'phrin 'a sa ma dzong dge ba'ag sdom/ du dbal shu'/ gyi rigs su sku 'khrungs / khe tha' gnyis pa ngag dbang bsnga na nga 'i rgya' ma tshan gyis ngos 'dzin mdzad cing re cig hor shis tshang nang chen gyi bla ma byas/ chu bya la dgon gnas su gdan 'ja4sa shing ga'is bzung / bco brgyad pa shing byir mtshan sbro gas sku phreng gsu ma par ngos bzung bas rgya' ba skal bzang rgya ma tsho'i sku ber dang nga/༅ chen blo bzang ye shes kyi dbu cha5 nab ba'ag ste rgya' sto da kyis hor nas blus te gdan sa ra 'byor/ rje 'di nyid tsha kho dam pa rgyal blon gyis gdan drangs pas der phebs / sa der than pa byung bas 'dod pa ba'in rgyal mo danu rdo nas phur bu 'ig gter nas bton tshe rgyar bos phur bu nga 'a gnongs zhes nan zhus pa khor gnang nas than skyon bas la/ tsha kho rgya' bos long 'a kor ༅ bzlog byed kyi ma dung phu'/ pa dang ma khan chas / bzhugs gdan/ 'bol stan/ gdugs rta dar so gas gas ra du bsgrugs /lo gcig la bzhugs nas slar dbal shul stod smad du byon/ ñca gas rtar dbus gtsang du gnas skor la phebs tshe paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma ra dgon sde 'ig bskrun na chos srid ru na ring du gnas pa'i thugs smon dang thugs dam brtag bsgri' gyi 'u nga bstan 'ig gnang bar zhu zhus pas dgon pa'i ma tshan du dge lda na bkra shis chos 'phe' gling zhes ma tshan gso la nas bka' shog gnang ba la rang yu la du phyag phebs / chu bya (spyi lo18 1 2 )lor bkra shis gso sbyo nga dang sa brtag bsla ba sbyong gsum gnang 'ing der bzhugs gdan 'a ngags shing ga'is bzung / dgon ma tshan 'byung ga'i'i tshul rje grub dbang ye shes rgya mtsho'i lung bsta na du/ mtshan lung snang mtha'i mgon pos nyer gso la cing / / dben dgon bkra shis bye ba'i dpal ldan pa/ / chos sri da mnga' thang 'phel ba'i thabs kyi gtam / 'dzam gling ljo ngas 'dir kho bos lha nga lha nga sgro gas/ / 'es gsungs / lto 'phye brtasas te rtsig rmang btings 'du khang bzhengs/ dbal shul sto da ma'i dpon mi 'gyur dang smad ma/'i dpon dbal shul rgyal ma tshan gyis 'go bzung 'ing khri dpon gyis lam rim 'khor khang dang / stag smyon lcags pos 'du khang bzhengs/ tsho ba smad ma 'i ma nga' yo ngas kyis grwa shag phub cing grwa rgyun mngasas pa dang sku gsu nga thugs rten/ mchod rdzas yo/ byad/ tshogs zangs/ ja pra/ thug ze'u/ gral gdan so gas gang dgos kyi mthun rkyen rnams rim par bsgrugs/ skyabs mgon blo bzang thub bsta na 'jigs med rgya ma tshos na bza'/bzhugs gdeng / /khri rgyab yo 'a / gser tog khri khebs bcas gnang / bde gas nga 'jigs gsum dang rab gnas chen po sogs dge ldan pa'i phyag bzhes gnas par byas/ gsang sngags smad rgyud kyi nyams ba'es su bde gsang 'jigs gsu ma dang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun re yod/ rab gnas chen po nyin gsum/ yar ngo mar ngo'i dus bzang nyin bzhi dang rnga chings nyin gnyis sogs yo da/ smad rgyud kyi las sne 'dzin pa bla ma dbu mdzad gcig dge skos gcig spyi ba gcig byang 'dren che chung gnyis/ dkor gnyer gcig chab ril gcig dung rkang ba ba'i sogs bskos / shing 'u ga 'o 'i zla drug pa'i tshes brgyad la dbal shul stod ma 'i dpon mi 'gyur tshe las 'das / shing sbru la 'o/'i zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer lnga la dpon —— 514 —

krung se'i bong ju rgyud nang dgocha dalar cha4 'a nga khan su 'u glegs bam da wa da wa —— — da da wa —— da wa dbal shu' rgyal ma tshan ya nga gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ ma tshan sgro gas sku preng bzhi ba dkon ma chog 'jam dang 'a yo na tan dbyangs can bas ma 'phel dbang gi rgyal bo je nyid 'on 'es pa'i yul du khyo rigs ya ba bso nga nam sa tshe 'phel gyi sras ñca gas rta lor ( 1〈70 ) sku 'khrungs / dang thog ma tshan la bas/ma 'phe' dbang rgya' saso la / dgung 'o bdun pa me byi 'a brtag dbya da sna tshogs la brtsen nas ma tshan sgro gas ma khan po sku phreng ba'i bar thubs thal bcad cing 'jigs bral gdong lnga 'i gser khrir lha bab kyi dus chen du rten 'brel ngang mnga' lange rdo — / so gsu ma nga dung 'a khor grwa tshang e waṃ bde chen gling bskrun nas rim par bskyangs pa dang dus 'khor rdul tshon dang sa gar ma chod dkar sogs cha 'a ga yo ngas su rdzogs par ma dzad/ dus 'khor kun rig dus 'khor sdo ma chen/ mi 'khrusas pa/ sa chog sogs cho ga yo ngas su rdzogs pa re re sgrub mchod nyin bdun brgyad re ngang / seng gdong gtso 'alor gsum gyi gtor sgrub nyin gsum/ zla rer chob rkyang nyin ba'i re dang rnga chi ngas nyin gnyis re yod/ 'a sa kyi sne 'dzin pa 'a bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dase bskos/ spyi ba/ dbu ma dzang/dazar gnye ra/ chab ril / dung rkang ba so gas bskos / gar 'cham pa mi bcu bdun bdam sa/ zhe lnga ba shing sta ga lor bas nga snga sas snga 'gyur gyi sro la dpa' chen rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs kyi phyag le na zhib phra'i skor dang 'a' 'don zab chos du ma'i kha bskangs te se ra byes pa mkhas mang grwa tshang gi gtor sgrub phyag batshes ba 'in btsugs pa la 'bas/ rten gra tshang es ma tshan gso 'a / bkra shis 'khyil gyi gas nga sngags dar rgyas gling si phyas hro la ba'in phyag na rdo rje 'bo/ ra chen gyi sgrub chog tshugs te mtshan la gas nga snga gca/ dar rgyas gling btags /chu byi 'o ra spyod rgyud rnam/ sna nga ma ngon byang gi sa chog cho ga yongs rdzogs gsar du tshugs / 'bas brtan grwa tshang gi nyams baches su phyag rdor 'khor chen/ rnam sna nga mngon byang / sman chog chen mo / ltu nga bshags stong ma chod bcas sgrub ma chod nyin bdun brgyad re dang rta mgrin gtor sgrub nyin bcu/ yar tshogs zla rer nyin bdun re'i chos thog yo da/ las kyi sne 'dzin pa la bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa gcig dbu mdzad gcig spyi ba gnyis ༈ dalor gnyer gcig dung zang ba ba'i sogs bskos// me 'brug ( 19 1 6 )lor par brko grwa tshang btsugs te nya ya sa bzhes su nyin rer par thing mda' tshad ma re'i thig 'phreng gsu ma dang zhu dag dpar skrun bcas zla ba drug ring 'a sa rgyun yo da/ nge ra 'a sa gasnyer ba la zhu dag pa gcig par yig pa gcig do ngam/ pa gcig spyi ba gcig bskos / tshogs chen la cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo nyin bcu gsum yar tshogs lha ga ma tshad lhag dang / sman bla'i sgrub ma chod nyin bcu gsum ya ra tshogs lha ga ma chod bcas/ dbyar gnas zla ba phyed dang sanyis kyi nang ma gon po'i gtor sgrub dang rigs grwa bcas yod/ lnga ma chod chen mo 'a nyin bcu gsu ma ya ra chogs lha ga bcas kyi sgrub ma chod re rer nyin bdun re la grwa ba lnga brgya lhag bzhugs / las kyi sne 'dzin pa la khri ba/ gzhung las pa/ 'a' ngo / spyi ba/ dbu mdzad/ dkor gnyer/ chab ril sogs bajo sa sku phreng ba'i ba 'di nyid dgung lo nga dgu ba sa 'brug ( 19 2 rnga ) gi chu stod zla ba'i rdzogs pa tha ma'i nyim sbu ngang ngor ngasrings te zugs dam zab mor gzhol ba'in phyag rgya chen po mngon du ma/dzad de zhag bdun gyi — 515 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/bar thugs dam las mi g.yo bar bzhugs te dgongs pa rdzogs so/ /mkhan chen sku 'phreng lnga ba rje blo bzang 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho rab rgyal sa sbrul(1929)lo'i snron zla dga' ba dang bor ldo nga gi rigs su yab khro rgyal dang yum ma cig gi sras su sku bltams/ chu bya 'o ra mtshan sgrogs khri la 'khod cing bcu dgu ba me phag lor smad rgyud kyi 'du khang gsar du bzhengs/ phyi lor nor bu sgang du dben gnas yid dga' nor bu'i pho brang zhes pa'i ri khrod btab/ chu 'brug la mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs kyi dbu brtsams/ so gcig pa sa phag(1959)lor rkyen dbang gis sku bkrongs so/ /mtshan sgrogs mkhan po sogs dgon der skyes bu dam pa mi nyung ba byon pa la/ mtshan sgrogs dang bo yon tan grags pa'i dbon po tshul khrims rgya mtsho(yer ba'i lha rams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang lha rams pa nor bzang rgya mtsho gnyis khong gi tsha bo yin)ser smad yer ba khams tshan du thugs gnyer mdzad de bka' pota lnga la mkhas par grags/ rang yul du 'byor nas spro tshugs dge ldan lung rtogs chos ldan gling gi gnas spos/a mchog mtshan nyid dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs/ nor bzang rgya mtsho yer bar bzhugs te nang don rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa dang khyad par du dbu ma'i gzhung la mkhas par grags / lha rams dam bca' bzhagarang yu la du dgon pa skyong khur gnang / bka' rtsom pota gsum bzhugs/ dbal shul rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bo sgo mang rdo rje 'chang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos dgon par sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas yo byad du ma phul pa dang a khu thabs mkhas rin po che'i rnam thar sogs khong la bka' rtsom du ma bzhugs/ dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing nyams su blangs te klong rdol ba'i rtags su mgrin par a gsal/ dgon par lung bstan pa'i skor dang sgyu ma'i be'u bum gsungs pa sogs gsung rtsom pota gnyis lhag bzhugs/ a mdo dkon mchog ces pa'i dge slong de dgung lo bdun pa nas bzung 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/ grwa tshang dge bskos bzhugs mthar dgung lo gya gcig steng dga' ldan shar rtse'i chos rjer 'khod de lo du mar bzhugs/ rdo bla ma blo bzang dge 'dun phun tshogs kyis gzhung bka' pota lnga dang khyad par du byang chub lam gyi rim pa la mkhas shing nyams su blangs/ khong sku gshegs khar khong gi sngar gyi rje'i brnyan las bdud rtsi bab pa dang khong gi bzhugs gdan du ring bsrel gtams pa sogs der 'dus dge 'dun du mas spyan lam mjal cing rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar du yod pa dang log rtogs ba mo 'joms pa'i nyi ma sogs gsung rtsom du ma bzhugs/ mkhan chen sku phreng lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin ye shes dar rgyas gzhung mang mkhas la khyad par du tri ka bskyed rdzogs la mkhas/ khong la dgon pa'i lo rgyus zhib gsal sogs pota gcig lhag bzhugs/ 'jam dpal mthu stobs rgya mtsho dgung lo nyer lnga la dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang du lha rams dam bca' bzhag rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba'i bkas bskul te dben pa dgon dang rgya mtsho gling gnyis la mtshan nyid gsar du btsugs/ gsung rtsom la sgra mtshan zin bris pota che ba gcig dang dbyangs 'char gyi zin bris pota bdun bcas dben pa dgon dang rgya mtsho gling gnyis su bzhugs/ sman pa dge slong — 516 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rnam grol dang rta dkar sman pa sogs yod pa las rta dkar sman pa dbus gtsang du phebs skabs sman rtsis mkhyen rab nor bu dang 'al 'dzoms 'ing gzhung dang lag len mkhas pas yul phyogs grags pa che'o/ /tshogs chen 'du khang dang smad rgyud 'du khang / dus 'khor 'du khang / zhabs brtan 'du khang / rta mgrin lha khang / dam can lha khang / sats+tsha khang / mgon khang / bag tse btsan khang / stobs po che'i lha khang bcas su rten bzhugs shin tu mang ba la sa 'du khang gtsos rten 'gangs chen du ma bkod na/ ston pa thub pa'i sku brnyan rgya gar shar phyogs li dkar nas phebs pa khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ rje'i dge legs ma rin chen sna lngas grub pa'i bdud rtsi dang rang bsrel rgyun 'bebs can/ mkhan chen sku 'phreng bzhi ba'i dngul gdung chen mo/ mkhan chen gyi gdung rus lha'im 'a 'i yig 'bru 'bur du gsal ba da lta bzhugs/ lha rams pa sku phreng gnyis pa'i dngul gdung 'dra sku dang de'i sku las bab pa'i ring bsrel khri phrag klong rdol rin po che'i ts+tsha kong / mkhan chen gyi dbu thod 'jigs byed rang byon can/ thub sku thugs ga'i mdun rgyab dro ba rang byon can/ rje btsun byams mgon dus bzang bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ kun mkhyen gsum pas gnang ba'i gser bzhengs jo sku bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ par+ṇa chen bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma'i lung bstan ltar bzhengs pa'i shog thang dang rin chen sna lngas bris pa'i bskal bzang tshar bcu gsum/ gser dngul gyis bris pa'i yum 'bum pa tshar bdun/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku skabs su bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ 'jam dbyangs phyag ba'i ba byin can/ sku sum brgya can gyi thang ga sgrol ljang bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i phyag bzos 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thang sku/ dbal mang shes rab kyis dgon shul nas blangs pa'i phyag rdor rdo sku rang byon/ li bzhengs bya khrid kyi sku mchod 'dzin ma khru gang can/ bag tse'i 'dra sku mchod me 'dzin pa/ dam can khro zhal zhi bar gyur pa/ gser bzhengs 'jigs byed bzhengs dus sku mdog mthing gar gyur pa/ mgon po rdo sku rang byon/ yul lha a skyas phul pa'i mgon po'i bla rdo/ chos rgyal gas ra bzhengs skabs thod dbyug nam mkhar btegs pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung /bag tse nad bzhes pa/ chos rje don rin pa'i phyag 'khor/ ma ṇi 'khor khang che chung dgon mtha' phyed tsam longs pas bskor/ ga'an ri khrod nor bu'i pho brang du rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin lcang skya ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis gnang ba'i byu ru'i thub sku/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas gnang ba'i 'jim sku mi la/ mkhan chen lnga bas bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal dkar po/ stobs po che rab gnas byed skabs me tog bzhes pa sogs thun snang du grub pa sha stag yin/ da dung shugs lung ke'u tshang ri khrod dang btsan ra'i ṭā ki'i ri khrod/ gad skya'i gsang chen ri khrod/ gnyan rtse'i dpal chen ri khrod/ dgon gnas phan bde'i ri khrod/ khe thal tshul khrims dar rgyas kyi ri khrod sogs dben gnas mang ngo / /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya lor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng bcu ba blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ yab mgon po tshe brtan/ yum bsod nams sgrol ma/ yongs 'dzin rgya yag — 517 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyongakhularmachurdzingagilo/ ngaru da wasku skye blo bzang bsta na pa'i rgyal ma tshan/ kun mkhyen drug pa thub bsta tsha chos kyi nyi r+ṣa // kung thang drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug a blo dpon blo bzang tshe dbang sogs skyes bu ma nga bos dben pa chubang byes bcasas shing sngo na chad par+ṇa chen bdun pas gnang ba'i gser bachengs thā 'og sku so sas 'a ra ba gnas satsha — nga lta tshogs chen 'du khang dang bla ma'i gzim khang / nang chen che 'bring gnyis / ngabal shu0༄ sdo nga ñcha da la bde yangs lang gnyis/ grwa shag brgya lha ga bcas bzungs shing dge 'dun pa ba'i brgya lha/ga 'dus te chos sbyo/nga thams cad rgyun ldan du spel ba'in pa'i skabs so/ /khro wo/ smad ma'i ri khrod/bro/ kho smad ma 'i ri gro/ da ces pa ni/ gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khur gyi rma chu rdzong dro lo mi da ra rwang ge khongs su sngon chad ri khrod 'gre' re skyes/ chen dam pas btab myong 'a// rab rgyal sa khyi 'o ra 'jib/ ma thar da snga sla ra sa/so sa pa gcig kyang med mod/ lo rgyus su dus rabs nyid kyi dus dkyil bar ma/chi rud nga sa ma tshan cam dgod par bya ste/1 shug 'u nga ke'u chung ri khrod ces chags nas 'jig nge ga bar 'o ngo sum/ cu tsam las/ ma 'das par bshad/2 btsan re'i ṭāki'i ri khrod ces pa ni ma/kha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gnas yin pa dang khyu dpon ri brod pa 'es paca5 yu na ring bskyangs so/ / 2 gad skya'i gsang chen ri /brod ces pa ni sngon chad gas nga sngags rig 'dzin 'chang ba mang po'i sgrub gnas yin/ do dam/ mam skyong khur ma dzad mkhan 0pa bstan pa dang / ngag sgrub / nge zes 'jam dpal / tshul khrims la sogs byon no/ / 4 gnyan rtse'i dpal chen ri khrod ni rta mgrin gyi sgrub gnas shig yin na'ang / 'u na ring sgrub mi dang bdag skyong mkhan mang bo phyag phebs myong med par rang shugs su nub po/ / da ga'an da dung 'al shul dgon gnas dang rgyab ri'i phyogs su sngon chad skyes bu sta ga tshal ba'i sgrub gnas phan bde ri khrod zer ba dang / dben gnas chags shul sos/sa mchis nga/ la/ da lta gong gsa' rnam/sa gyang shul rdo ra'i rnam pa tsam las mi mngon par gyur to/ /dngul rwa'i gnyan thog dgon dge ldan dam chos kun rgyas gling /dngul rwa'i gnyan thog dgon dge ldan dam chos kun rgyas gling zhes pa ni༈ da lta 'i gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong dngul rwa zhang du chags /chos sde 'di kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku phreng gnyis pa rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo dgung grangs lnga bcu ba rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me bya(spyi lo1777)lor dngul rwa lha sde zhes pa'i sar gsar 'debs mdzad pa'i lta gon byas byung shing lcags gling(1781)la grong du ban ser mo'i sbra dgon thog mar tshugs te/ bca' khrims su gtan phab gnang ba ltar dus 'khor grwa tshang gi phyag len dar du bcug 'chad nyan la yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong / dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye sogs gzhi gsum gyi da 518 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nyam sa len dang lnga ma chod so gas kun mkhyen gong ma rnam sa kyi dus mchod 'brel ba'in kun rig 'jigs byed/ mi 'khrugs pa so sas kyi sgrub ma chod/ sa ga'i nya la smyung gnas ngang ma ṇi bum sgrub nyin 'dun /ma gon chos sogs kyi bskang gso dang dbyangs rta bkra this 'khyil ltar byas/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags byi ( 190 0lo)la kun mkhyen ba'i ba rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dang la bzang bos ru grong gi se ra sde de dgon par bsgyu ra dgos zhes gsu ngas shing drug pa'i bcu gsum nyin dgon sa zhal gzigs phebs pa dang / bco lnga'i nyin gnyan thog gcod pa ba ska la bzang thabs ma khas rgya mtsho dgon gsar 'debs kyi sne khrid par bskos shing shing 'brug lor rje kun ma khyen pa dang gnyan thog pa rnam pa zung gis dgon sar lto 'phye'i thig brgyab/ 'du khang dang nang chen so gas gsar bzhengs mdzad/ shing glang 'a skyabs ma gon lnga ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ye shes bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog ma tshan sgrogs dgon du dgun bzhugs gnang skabs gnyan thog gcod pa bas khong gi bka' bsgos smin zla'i tshes nyer lnga la tshogs/ chen dang nyer dgu la gso sbyong si dbu tshugs/ rab rgyal sa sbrul( 1929)'o 'i dus su dge 'dun pa'i 'a' grangs sum brgya lnga bcu tsam long du 'dzoms / kun mkhyen mchog gis bca' yig gsar rtsom mdzad/ e lbe chos 'khor gling nas ma chod zur bskal bzang rab rgyas dbyangs dpon dang / rab 'byams pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho 'al ngor bskos te phyag len mtha' dag bkra shis 'khyil ji bzhin bsgyur/ lcags lug ( 192 1)lor khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rje rat+na sa ras dgon sde 'dir dpa'/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la 'brel ba'i dbang bdun dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bcas pa bstsal to/ /'du khang ka ring ba'i can spen tog steng gañjir dpangs khru bcu gcig rgyal mtshan dpangs khru dgu cha can/ spen rgyan dpangs khru gsum cha can gyis ma dzes par bzhengs/ nang rten la gser zangs las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig 'al gyi sku brnyan khru dgu/ jo sku khru bdun/ rje sku khru drug skyabs mgon ba'i ba dang lnga ba'i sku brnyan/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ sgrol ma/ thugs rje chen po mig 'gyed gzi 'bar bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ tshe dpag med gsu nga 'byon ma/ shar li'i thub sku/ chos rgyal gser zangs las grub pa/par+ṇa chen dpal lda na ye shes kyi bzhugs khri tsan dan dkar pos bzhengs pa/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i dbu mnab/ rgyal ba mi phab mgon po'i sku brnyan/ 'jigs byed/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ sogs kyi sman sku che legs/ bka' bstan gnyis dang gsung 'bum sna tshogs skor bcas pota stong phrag tu nye ba/ gzhan yang dngul dang zangs kyis lugs pa'i mchod cha khyad mtshar spus legs du ma dang 'bud dkrol rdung gsum gyi rol chas sna tshogs/ gos chen rigs mang las bzos pa'i dra phyed phye 'phur/ gnam yol so gas mchod rdzas du ma/ gar 'cham 'cham lwa/ rus rgyan bcu bdun sogs dngul srang khri phrag du mas bsgrugs pa sha stag yod/ da dung kun mkhyen gzim shag dang bde yangs che chung du sku gsung thugs rten/mchod rdzas gya nom par gyur/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi'i dus su gnyan thogs nang chen/ mdar bla'i — 519 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/nang chen/ grwa shag bdun cu rtsa grangs/ dge 'dun pa zhal grangs bzhi brgya nye tsam bzhugs/ las sne ba ni khri ba dang / dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa/ zhal ngo / dbu mdzad/ spyi chen/ sku tshab sogs gang dgos bsko mngags yod do/ /dgon pa'i dus 'khor lugs kyi chos thog la/ sa chog gar 'cham/ 'don rta/ kun rig sgrub mchod sa chog bcas dus grwa ltar dang / 'jigs byed sgrub mchod sa chog smad rgyud ltar te sgrub mchog gsum ga nyi ma bdun re/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod nyin gsum/ cho 'phrul smon lam nyin bco lnga/ dgun chos chen mo sogs zla chos ba'i/ lnga mchod chos thog nyin bcu/ dpyid chos gnyis pa nyin nyi shu/ dpyid chos 'a rigs grwa'i chos thog sa dkar chos thog rnams nyin bco lnga re/ lnga mchod dang gter chen/ gtor 'dra/dus mchod gzhan pa/ zhog ga'i rgyun ja/ brgyad dgu'i rnga chings sogs tshogs chen/ 'bud rdung dkrol gsum gyi rol mo sogs phyag len dar bas mi tshad/ smon lam dang dpyid chos skabs su lam rim dang sngags kyi dam bca' yod/ rig gnas la sgra dang snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag yig gzugs ri mo/ gtor ma bca' bzo sogs rgyugs zla chos bzhi ga'i dus su sprod pa'i phyag srol dar ro/ /dgon du mkhas mchog du ma byon pa'i rnam thar mdo tsam brjod na/ rje btsun skal bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam thar de bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs so bzhi ba rje 'jam dbyangs skal ldan rgya mtsho dang bshes gnyen chen po rje blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dag gi 'khrungs rabs su gsal/ gling dkar stod kyi sa'i char yab rgya mtsho dang yum ma cig skyid kyi sras su me sprel(spyi lo1ra96)la sku bltams/ dgung grangs lnga ba lcags byi la kun mkhyen bzhi bas sprul skur 'al bzhes mdzang de bkra shis 'khyil du dam pa gong ma'i gdan sar bkod cing rje de nyid las rab tu byung zhing ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes/ rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ mtha' yas rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ khyab bdag he ru ka rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dang khri chen rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ sgo mang mkhan chen rje blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bde thang mkhan po 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ a khu rin po che blo gros rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi bshes gnyen dam pa du ma zhabs pad bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten/ sman lung a khu dge 'dun gyi mdun nas sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor lañja/ warti sogs yig gzugs sbyangs/ rje btsun ngag dbang bstan pa rgya mtsho las rtsis dkar nag las dbyangs 'char gyi skor/ rgya nag rtsis gsar bcas sbyangs/ kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i spyan snga las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ nyer dgu'i dus smad sog tu chibs bsgyur cing so gsum pa phyir phebs te dgon par sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas sogs legs par bstsal/ lcags lug la dus 'khor dbang bdun rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bcas sbrags pa gnang / chu sprel(1922)lor slar smad du phebs nas paṇa chen dgu ba las dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang sogs zab chos gsan/ chu byar smad nas thad kur bkra — 520 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/shis 'khyil du phyag phebs te kun mkhyen la dngul srang khri phrag dang dar phrugs gsum sogs legs skyes gya nom pa phul/ zhe gnyis pa me glang la dbus su thengs dang bo chibs bsgyur te gdan sa chen po bzhi sogs la mchod sprin rgya cher bstar/ lcags sbrul la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ khong la bka' rtsom ni kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ga'i rnam thar mdor bsdus dang gong sa lnga ba'i rnam thar chen mo/ dge ldan rtsis kyi bstan bcos rigs ldan snying nor mkhas grub dgongs rgyan/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i bstod pa byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yongs 'dus 'khri shing / tshigs bcad dngos grub 'gug pa'i lcags kyu/ sgrol ma'i lha khang gi dkar chag 'phags ma'i lo rgyus 'bras bzang smin pa'i don ldan gtam gyi 'khri shing la sogs 'dus pa'i pota lnga brtsams pa las da lta pota gnyis lhag lus/ rab rgyal lcags byi(19〈1)dgung lo gya lnga bar sku gshegs so/ /gnyan thog gcod pa ba rje skal bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtsho/ gling dkar stod kyi sa'i char bar ma zhes pa'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas rab tu byung zhing dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwa 'grims/ kun mkhyen skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sogs bsten nas gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan sbyong dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol pas spang dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gter du gyur/ rab tshes shing glang(192 5)lor sde 'di'i 'chad nyan gyi khur bdag ger bzhes te khri'i thog ma mdzad nas lo lnga bskyangs/ bshes gnyen chen po skal bzang rab rgyas 'di ba dus 'khor grwa tshang la tshogs zhugs gnang skabs kun mkhyen bzhi ba'i mtshan lam dung dkar cheg phyag tu 'byor pa rmis pas dus 'khor gyi lha zhig gi sprul ba yin par grags/ kun mkhyen khong las rab tu byung zhing dbang rjes lung mang du gsan/ grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan gar thig dbyangs gsum mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur/ dngul rwa'i rang dgon sogs chos sde che chung du ma'i dge rgan dang a mchog dus grwa'i bla mar phebs/ mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug rgyan rgya tshang ri khrod pa chos kyi seṅger sher phyin gyi mdo'i 'grel ba sogs ljags rtsom pota gnyis bzhugs/ mdo sngags dang rig gnas la mkhas pa lnga brgya'i dkon mchog tshul khrims dang sa dpyad la mkhas pa yi lu ye shes/ snyan ngag sogs la sbyangs pa'i mkhas grags dge 'dun rgya mtsho/gzhung lugs kun la rnam dpyod yangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i mdzod 'dzin sprul sku skal bzang shes rab bstan 'phel/ lam rim dang 'dul bar mkhas pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang skal bzang mkhyen rab/ gso rig mkhas chen rgyun dge tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ lam rim thugs 'dzin dang sgra snyan rtsis sogs la mkhas pa skal bzang blo gros/ sdeb sbyor snyan tshig spel mkhas skal bzang mthu stobs/ sgra rig khyad du byang ba skal bzang dge legs la sogs mang bo byung ngo / /zhal shul dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub bkra shis 'byung gnas gling /zhal shul dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub bkra shis 'byung gnas gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod — 521 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong smad ma zhang gi khongs su chags/dgon 'di'i 'debs pa bo ni khe thal tshul khrims dar rgyas yin/ khong rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta lo spyi lo179rngalor gdung shul chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan khro kho khag gsum po'i ya gyal khro kho smad pa'i zhal shul tshang la sku 'khrungs/ rab tu byung rjes dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs shing dge bshes mang bo bsten nas gzhung bka' pota lnga la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad pa dang / rig gnas mang bo thugs su chud de rdo rams pa'i mtshan rtags thob/ kun mkhyen gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i( 1792—1855)bka' gsung gtsigs su bzhes nas khya dge legs bshad gling dang rnga ba'i a mchog mtshan nyid dgon dpal ldan smra ba'i seṅge gling / mtshan sgrogs dgon dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'phel gling sogs su lam rim gyi khrid dang / dbang lung rjes gsum sogs rgya cher gnang ba dang bsgrub bya du mar rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ de yang kun mkhyen gyis 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gad la 'phrin las bcol na legs zhes pa'i bka' bzhin srung ma der 'phrin bcol gnad smin byas pa las chos rgyal zhal thang gi thod dbyug nas khrag chen dngos su babs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu byi lo ste spyi lo1852lor khong dgung lo nga lnga'i dus su kun mkhyen gyi bka' lung ltar zhal shul dben gnas zhal shul ri khrod 'di phyag 'debs mdzad/rta phyag khyung gsum gyi sku gzungs rang byon byin rlabs drod 'khyil can gter nas bton/ rang byon 'di rnams dang dge bskos kyi rten lcug khyad 'phags can bcas da skabs kyang lus te bzhugs su gsol/ khong gis ser sde nyid la lo rer ma ṇi dung phyur re bsgrub pa'i srol btsugs/ mthar dgung lo drug cu'i skabs su yang srid kyi yab yum mtshan bcas lung du bstan rjes me sbrul lor sku gshegs/ 'di bar gsung 'bum la sdud pa'i 'grel ba sbas don gsal pa'i nyin byed skal ldan 'jug ngogs dang / shes rab snying bo'i 'grel ba/rig gnas kyi skor sogs mang ngo/ / zhal shul sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang bstan pa rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rab byung bcu bzhi ba sa rta lo1858la khro kho smad ma'i ru sar du sku gong ma'i lung bstan ltar yab tshag lo dang yum pad+ma 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs pa'i nyin grub chen rat+na lāk+ṣi phebs par 'phrad nas zhabs spyi bor blangs nas dung khri zla ba dkar po zhes pa'i mtshan bzang gsol/ kun mkhyen bzhi bas ngos 'dzin mdzad de gdan sar 'khod/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs nas bshes gnyen du ma bsten cing chos grwa chag med dang 'dzin skyong lhod pa med par mkhas pa'i snyan pa khyab/ rab tshes sa yos lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba zhal shul du phebs skabs su bkra shis 'khyil bar dgon mgo phul stabs thugs dam gyi rten skal du sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku brnyan byin can gnang / dgon mtshan la dga' ldan bshad sgrub bkra shis 'byung gnas gling zhes gsol/ yang kun mkhyen gyi bka' lung ltar dmu dge dgon pa'i khri rabs dang por bzhugs/ rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar gyi khrir thog mar phebs nas mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs dang skyong khur gnang /de rjes dngul rwa'i nyin srib dgon pa dag gi khri ba mdzad/ rang gi gdan sa bla med rgyud rgyal gsum gyi sgrub — 522 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mchod dang / 'dzin grwa gong mar lam rim dang 'dzin grwa 'bring la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rtsi bzhag ṭīka chung /blo rtags/ 'dzin grwa chung bar bsdus grwa'i 'chad nyan gyi srol btod/ khong gi ring du 'du khang dang byams khang / chos ra/ rta mgrin lha khang sogs gsar du bzhengs nas rten du byams sku nyis thog can dang jo bo bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen dkon mchog 'phrin las pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i li ma'i mchod rten/ skyes bu gsum gyi chos srung / rta mgrin gsang sgrub thugs dkar rta phyag khyung gsum byin rlabs can sogs bzhugs/ dgung lo drug cu me sbrul lor dmu dge dgon du khri phyi ma'i skabs sku 'das pa la sku gdung rang dgon du gdan drangs/ 'di ba'i gdung rus la 'jigs byed kyi rtsa zhal bab pa da lta'ang bzhugs/ khong gi slob ma gtso bo rgya zhabs drung skal bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ gnyan thog gcod pa ba skal bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtsho/ rnga smad rtogs ldan wa dbal sprul sku/ sngags 'chang dge slong 'jam dbyangs/ sngags 'chang byams pa grags pa/ dpa' ris dge bshes blo bzang chos 'phel sogs mang / gsung 'bum la'ang lam khrid dang lam rim smon lam gyi 'grel ba/ yi dam sgrub skor/ bstod tshogs/ rgyal bo rā ma ṇi'i gtam rgyud dri med shel gyi 'bab stegs/ snyan ngag dang sgra rtsis/ rtsa rgyud sdong 'grems/ mngon brjod/ sum bcu ba'i snying bo rin chen lde mig rtags 'jug gi go don dka' ba'i brjed byang bcas da lta pota gnyis bzhugs so/ /zhal shul sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang phun tshogs zla ba rab tshes sa rta lo(1919)la khro kho smad ma rnga ba tshang yab rta mgrin dang yum skal bzang sgrol ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen lnga bas ngos 0 dzin gnang / gnyan thog gcod pa ba skal bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtsho las rab byung dge tshul sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan gsol/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos grwar zhugs nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ rang dgon du phebs rjes phar phyin gyi 'chad nyan dang bya phur nan gtad bzlog phyir gdugs dkar bdun sgrub sbyin sreg rgyun ja sogs gsar du btsugs/ kun mkhyen drug pa'i bka' bzhin kho tshe dang rnga ba/ be shing dgon pa dag gi khrir phebs/ de rjes bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs shing rab rgyal shing lug lor smad ma'i ser skya mang tshogs la thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / rang dgon du lha sku dang gdung rten/ bka' bstan/ gos sku/ gsung 'bum/ ma ṇi/ mchod rten sogs mang bo bzhengs pa dang / 'di'i skabs su khong gi nang chen che chung gnyis dang / rgya zhabs drung gzim khang /gnyan thog gcod pa ba'i gzim khang bcas bskrun/ grwa btsun sum brgya sum cu lhag zhal 'dzoms/ dgung lo zhe drug(1962)steng yang srid kyi 'khrungs yul dang khang khyim 'khor phyogs sogs lung bstan nas sku 'das so/ / zhal shul sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho rab rgyal chu phag lor da lta'i bā tse rdzong chu bo zhang gi yar dgon sde bar sku gong ma'i lung ltar du yab rta mgrin skyabs dang yum mgon po 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen drug pa mchog gis ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rab brtan rgya mtsho sku 'phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo gya gcig dus dang ldong skal bzang 'phrin las dar rgyas/ rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho gtsos pas — 523 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/na bza' bsgron/ lo der gdan sar 'khod rjes bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen khyom dge mchog sprul las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos so/ /de yang zhar du gleng rgyu la ldong sprul sku phreng dang po chos kyi dar rgyas mdzod dge nyin mar sku 'khrungs/gsung rtsom poṭa gnyis bzhugs/ sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis dngul rwa nas sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo sum cu tsam las sku ma bzhugs/ sku phreng bzhi ba da lta ba skal bzang 'phrin las dar rgyas zhes pa rab rgyal sa 'brul ste spyi lo1928lor bsang chu rdzong gi mdzod rkang tshar yab sangs rgyas skyabs dang yum mkha' mo yag gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga bas ngos 'dzin gnang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar 'grims shing dme shul 'jigs med dang mdzod dge chos 'byor sogs dge rgan du bsten/ gzhung brgya slob pa dpyis phyin rjes kun mkhyen gyi bka' bzhin mdzod dge gling ba'i(rnga ba'i mdzod dge'i)khrir bzhugs/ 1979lor smad ma slob grwa'i dge rgan du gdan drangs pa dang de rjes mtshan 'dzin slob dpon du bsten/ 1982lor dgon pa slar gso skabs khong gis sngar gyi dgon sar slob khrid gnang zhing paṇa chen bcu bas dga' ldan lung ba 'di legs gsungs pa ltar dgon sa spos/ 'di ba'i sku drin las 'du khang dang rta mgrin lha khang / bge khrab btsan khang / dgon mthar chos 'khor mang bo dang mchod rten gnyis/ chos ra/ nang chen gong 'og grwa shag bcas gsar du bzhengs/ rten du byams sku thog so gnyis can dang zhal shul sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i gdung rten dngul dkar las grub pa phra rgyan can/ gter nas bton pa'i rta phyag khyung gsum rang byon/ byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ me stag lor sman pa grwa tshang gso rig rin chen gzhan phan gling gsar du btsugs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i dbu lnga nas thon pa'i sman mdo gser bris byin can dang chos srung zhang blon zhal thang sogs bzhugs/ da skabs su dge 'dun pa zhal grangs nyis brgya sum cu lhag 'dus/ ldong bzhi ba 'di kun mkhyen drug pa'i bka' lung thugs su bzhes nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud stod grwa tshang gi khri dang dngul rwa dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs pa dang / da dung rdzong dang khul/ zhing chen gyi 'brel yod go gnas dang las 'dzin sogs kyi 'gan bzhes pa'i skabs so/ /nur ma dgon gsang sngags thar ba gling /nur ma dgon nam nur ma'i gsang sngags thar ba gling zhes pa ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong mtshe ru ma zhang gi khongs su chags/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta spyi lo1920lor dga' ldan gser khri chen po hor tshang sku phreng drug pa rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho zhes bya bas phyag 'debs mdzad pas grub mtha' dge lugs pa yin/dgon pa 'dir gtso bo hor tshang zhes bla sprul gcig yod de/ sku phreng dang po dpal ldan grags pa/gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ gsum pa khri chen 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge / bzhi ba 'jigs — 524 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ lnga ba skal bzang dpal ldan grags pa/ drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ 'di ba'i dus su chos sde dngos su phyag 'debs mdzad/ khong spyi lo1910lor nur ma'i dbal shul tu sku 'khrungs la/ spyi lo1958lor mya ngan las 'das/ sku phreng bdun pa 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho/ 'di ba spyi lo1979lor rgan gya'i dga' ldan la kha nas sku 'khrungs/ da lta bzhugs pas dgon pa'i bstan bdag yin te/ sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong la spel bzhin bzhugs/ dus rgyun gyi khri ba ni dga' ldan byang rtse nas mngags pa bla mar gtsug tu bkur/ byi'u chung na'ang nang khrol cha tshang zer ba'i dpe ltar dgon pa'i gzhi rgya chung yang /dgon chen zhig gi sgrig gzhi ltar tshang ma 'dus/ dper na las sne'i skor dang 'don chog sogs/ gzhan yang dgon pa 'di btsugs nas da bar du nur ma'i mgar shul du sku 'khrungs pa'i gzhi shub rin po che zhes pa gzhung bka' pota lnga'i gnas la mkhas shing dbang lung sogs kyi rgyun khyad par 'dzoms pa zhig dang / ra ba'i ri khrod pa bsod nams dam chos rgya mtsho zhes pa dus kun tu thugs bde chen ngang du gnas pa zhig lhag par bkra dge 'jam dpal rgya mtsho zhes pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mchog tu gyur cing gsung rtsom shog dril mang po bzhugs pa can sogs bstan pa'i srog shing du gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang bo byon no/ /dgon pa 'di ri bo dga' ldan pa'i ma lag tu bkur pa'i sku'i rten rnams phal cher bzhugs kyang gser sku mang bo med/ hor tshang khri chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang khri chen blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gnangs pa'i lha mo'i btsan thang gnyis dang thang ga gzhan pa lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dga' ldan ba so sprul skus gnangs pa'i rtse shod bka' 'gyur dang 'bum dam pa/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen gsung rtsom sogs du ma bzhugs/ da dung dga' ldan byang rtses gnangs ba'i 'khar rnga rtsa chen gnyis/ ljags gling dang dung / rkang gling sogs mchod rdzas yo byad mang po bsgrugs/ dgon pa'i dus mchod la ri bo dga' ldan pa'i dus chen dang sgrub mchod gtso bo rnams lugs ltar gnas shing / hor tshang khri chen sku phreng rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs bcas yod pa ma zad/ dus mchod la lo gcig gi nang gsang 'dus dang 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ bde mchog kun rig bcas kyi bdag 'jug bdun sgrub/ dbyar dgag la gso gsum gzhigs gsum/ gsal byed nyams len gsum gzhir byas pa tshad ldan du gyur/ 'di'i skabs bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang a mchog mtshan nyid dgon pa nas skyabs khrid dang blo sbyong / lam khrid/ dbang lung sogs legs par gdams pa'i bla ma'am dge bshes sogs mngags pa'i srol ldan phyir/ dgon chung 'di bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon lag yin/dgon chung 'di rab byung bcu drug pa'i me bya spyi lo1957lor/ rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtshos chos sde'i 'du khang chen mor lha khang bcu gnyis yod pa can dang / grwa shag zhe drug tsam la khang mig brgya dang so gsum yod pa can zhig la gzhi rgya bskyed kyang de'i phyi lo ste spyi lo1958lor tshang ma 'jig bla grwa brgyad cu lhag bzhugs yod pa rnams rang shugs kyis grol/— 525 —

gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/rab byung bcu drug pa lcags sprel spyi lo1980lor tang gi mi rigs chos lugs srid jus don du 'khyol pas chos sgo phye/ de nas dus rabs gsar ba'i lugs su dgon par do dam u yon lhan khang btsugs/dgon pa sngar bzhin bskyar du bzhengs/ grwa shag brgyad la khang mig nyer bzhi tsam yod pas grwa ba dgu bcu lhag bzhugs/ de dag gi 'tsho ba yong khungs ni sngar dgon pa dang khyim tshang kho nar brten dgos te spyi tshogs gsar ba'i nang du rang kha rang gso'i lam lugs gsar gtod byas yod pas ser mo ba mang tsam zhig dgon pa la rgyun sdod min/ so sos dud sgo khag theg byas pa'i yong sgo la brten na'ang / da dung gtso bo khyim tshang rogs ram la brten dgos/ dgon pa spyi la yong sgo sogs ha cang dbul/ dgon pa'i 'don chog dang bca' khrims/ dus mchod sogs chos spyod sngar ltar ming tsam slar gso thub pa la brten nas bla grwa rnams dang dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che spel ba la mu 'thud du 'bad brtson cher skyed gnang bzhin yod do/ /mche ru ma'i dgon/mtshe ru ma'i dgon pa ni mtshe bla ma sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dpal bstan pa'i nyi ma'i skabs su/ grong du sdod pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams mnyam du 'tshogs nas/ dge ldan lnga mchod chen mo dang sa ga zla ba'i smyung gnas/ ma ṇi bgeg gtor sogs kyi srol tsam tshugs pa nas rim gyis gong du 'phel ba yin/mtshe bla ma sku phreng dang bo mkhan po blo bzang chos grags ni/ khang sar du sku 'khrungs pa dang dbus su phebs nas/ dga' ldan gyi dge bshes te lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i mtshan zhabs pa gnang zhing shar rtse'i mkhan po byung / des dga' ldan du dam bca' btsan po ma zer ba gsar du btsugs/ rgyal dbang mchog gis rang gi sku sngas kyi thub pa rdor gdan ma dang / mi 'khrugs pa bdud rtsi rang 'bab can/ rje'i sku brnyan nga 'dra ma la rje'i dbu skra gzungs gzhug tu bzhugs pa sogs gtsor byas pa'i rgya gar shar nub kyi li ma byin can mang bo dang / gdugs rta dar bcu gsum gyi thob/mkhan chas cha tshang sogs kyis mngon par bstad de mdo smad du chibs sgyur bka' yis bskul pa bzhin phebs nas rnga yul stod smad bar gsum gyi gdul bya mtha' dag la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ dme sde'i shos tshang mkhan sar la 'khrungs pa dang / dbus su phebs nas dga' ldan du lo bcu gsum la bzhugs shing mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ mdo smad rnga yul/mtshams ring / khro kho/ 'ju sag ja sag sogs mdo smad khams kyi bla mar bskos zhes pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' shog dang bcas mdo smad du phebs/ rjes su mtshams ring 'thor dus/ mtshams ring sgar ba'i sbra gur gnyis dang sa cha rnams khong la phul pas/ khong gis nang chen gyi sbra de lha gur byas/ sbra tshang dang bog gu sogs khyim tshang bdun gyis su dug byas nas sa bzung('di paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang dus mnyam yin — 526 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nam snyam) mtshe bla ma sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dpal bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ ṣe thal dbal dkom tshang la 'khrungs shing a mchog dgon du grwa sar zhugs/ cho rje ma/ ma skor/ dga' skor sogs skyabs 'tshol ba'i ru ba mang bo byung bas/ grong gi dge 'dun pa rnams mnyam du 'tshogs nas lnga mchod dang / bzhi ba'i smyung chen/ ma ṇi dgu sgrub sogs kyi srol btsugs/ (khong dgung lo dgu bcu tsam la bzhugs pa 'dra)/ sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni/ khro kho smad ma'i dbal shul chos ldan tshang la1899lor 'khrungs pa dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du grwa sar zhugs shing / phyis su tsha gan be shing dang chu kha ma/sog po bcas yul gyi dgon pa'i khri la bzhugs/ 1946lor ru nag dang mtshe ru ma gnyis lhan bsres shing der dge 'dun pa bzhi bcu byung ba 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug dang / kun rig gi bdag 'jug bdun sgrub sogs kyi srol btsugs/ rjes su mtshe ru ma dang ru nag gnyis so sor 'thor na'ang mtshe ru ma'i ser sdes sngar ltar dus mchod rnams ma nyams par bskyangs/ 1958lor dus 'khrug gi dbang gis so sor 'thor ba dang mtshe rin po che yang1959lor rnga yul du dag zhing du dgongs so/ /1982lor gangs can 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi zhabs pad gser gyi 'khor lo rma chu'i ljongs su bsgyur pa'i tshe na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i chos kyi sgo mo ches cher phye bas/ mtshe ru ma'i ser sde sngar lugs bzhin 'tshogs pa'i go skabs ldan te/ 1kha82lor mtshe bla ma'i sku gdung bzhengs pa dang bla ma chung ba'i sku gdung blus pa gnyis bzhugs pa'i lha khang1984lor mtshe ru ma sde dkyil nas bzhengs pa dang der dge 'dun pa nyi shu tsam 'dus/ 1988lor gung thang rin po che mtshe ru mar phebs par ser mang gis dgon sa gang bzang zhus pa la nor spongs zhes pa bzang zhes gsung gi dga' ston bstsal/ de nas gnas der lto 'phye'i thig btabs nas thog mar 'du khang bzhengs skabs/ sa 'og nas ral gri gnyis dang gter bum rdza chas las grub pa zhig rnyed pa sogs rten 'brel ha cang bzang ba byung /1991lor 'du khang legs grub byung ba dang grwa shag yang bcu phrag lhag phub ste/ skye 'gro mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi tshogs 'dum pa'i phyir mig gi dga' ston dang yid kyi dad rten du bzhengs pa 'di lags so/ /chu kha ma dgon bkra shis chos gling /chu kha ma'i dgon pa bkra shis chos gling ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong chu kha ma zhang gi khongs su chags yod de/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa rta spyi lo1918lo la brag sgom pa sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtshos chos sde dngos su btab/de yang thog mar bod la rus chen bzhi'i nang tshan ldong dang / de'i shul chen bco brgyad du gyes pa'i dbal shul ldong dpal chen skyabs kyi rigs la skabs shig dbal shul phur ba thar ram ldom mi nag gu gu ra skad zer ba de sa rma khog gi mi yin/ de'i sras su ge li/ ge tse/ ge 'phan byon cing ke li'i bu chung dbal zhar — 527 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/gyi mi rgyud kha shas 'das tsa na dbal shul khro kho'am/ dbal shul khe thal dpon rigs te dbal shul khyo kho zer ba byung / khyo kho'i bu che ba gzungs 'bum rgyal zer/ de'i bu la dbal yum dbal don 'bod cing phyi ma'i bu ming la dbal shul mkha' 'gro 'bum mam mkha' 'gro skyabs zer/ des kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo(1728—1791)la yon mchod kyi 'brel btsugs pa dang / dbal ba de rang lo brgyad cu'i dus 'chi khar/ bos khog zer ba'i sa cha na yod skabs/ kun mkhyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho gdan drangs te kun rig gi dbang bskur/ kun mkhyen de nyid dang dbal shul ma cig skyabs yang mchod yon du 'brel/brag sgom pa sku phreng thog ma 'dul 'dzin pa sho ba blo bzang rnam rgyal dang kun mkhyen mchog dang dbal shul gzungs 'bum rgyal gyi bu rnams skabs mnyam yin/ de nas kun mkhyen blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho(dbal ban tshang dang bla brang bar don rkyen bud skabs 'khel)dang brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas rnam pa chu kha ma'i shog par thugs 'brel thugs rtsis che ba'i khar/ yang kun mkhyen rjes ma skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog dang dbal shul 'dug dge(dpon ming)mchod yon rgyun 'khyongs/ de nas brag sgom pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtsho rab tshes sa 'brug spyi lo1878lor sku 'khrungs pa dang sa byi(1888)la chu kha ma'i dpon po dbal shul bsod nams rab brtan skyes/ khong bla dpon zung 'brel bgyis te/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa rta spyi lo1918lo la nang ba'i chos sde bkra shis chos gling zhes pa 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad par shing cha thams cad chu khol sha ro nags dang gser mkhar nas btus shing / 'du khang chen mo zhig thog mar gsar du bzhengs mgo bcoms te/ rab tshes chu khyi spyi lo192 2lor yongs su grub par mdzad de mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bshad sgrub bstan 'phel gyi srol tshugs/ shing byi spyi lo1kha2 4lor bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dbang gnang / sa 'brug spyi lo1928lor kun mkhyen lnga ba chu kha mar khyim phebs thengs dang bo gnang zhing / yul lha'i lab rtse bstad cing bsang gzhung 'jigs mdzad ma zhes pa gsungs/ rab rgyal shing phag spyi lo1925lor chu kha ma'i shog pa bla brang gi smon lam sbyin bdag byas/ rje brag sgom pas mi tra rdor phreng gi dbang gnang / me byi spyi lo1926la bla dpon dag gis kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs drung du dgon mgo phul nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag tu bsgyur cing 'dod gsol khri ba dang / dge rgan du sku yon che ba re mngags pa'i bkas bcad bzhes so/ /bla sprul gyi skor/ de'ang chu kha ma'i dgon pa la bla sprul gsum gyi rabs yod de/ brag sgom pa'i sku phreng skor/ sku phreng dang bo blo bzang rnam rgyal ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags lug spyi lo1621lor sho ba yul ra ba'i drod lung nyin du yab rgya gar skyabs dang yum mkha' 'gro 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo1696 4 11nyin la khong rang nyid kyi dgon pa khang thog dgon nam yon chab dar rgyas gling zhes pa phyag 'debs mdzad/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing sprel spyi lo1706lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim mo/ /sku phreng gnyis pa brag sgom pa blo bzang shes rab ni rdo dkar ri chung du rngog rigs su sa sprel spyi lo1728la sku 'khrungs/— 528 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / kirti blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bka' bzhin sho ba dgon par byon rjes/sho ba rin po che'i sku chos dang mkha' 'gro'i dbu thod rtsad bcad de mjal pas 'dul 'dzin pa'i sprul pa yin par ngos bzung / mkhas dbang du mar bsten nas mdo sngags bka' chos mang po gsan/ gsung rtsom yang du ma yod/ sku phreng gsum pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ 'di ba lcags bya spyi lo1801la gtsos dpon skor bstan 'dzin sde grong 'brog khyim du sku bltams/ mdzod dge ri khrod dbang bos thog ma'i mtshan la 'jam dpal don grub btags/ dgung lo lnga ba na kun mkhyen gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtshos brag sgom pa'i yang srid la ngos bzung / dgung lo drug par dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta las rab tu byung ste mtshan dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas su gsol/ de nas nga gsum gyi bar du bsam sbyor gnyis kyis gtsug tu bsten pas nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhes mtshan snyan bod yul du khyab/ spyi lo1865lor khong gis〈mdo smad chos 'byung 〉yongs su grub/ dgung lo re bdun te spyi lo1〈67lor dgon pa dbal mang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang bsod grags rnam gnyi gar don bcol pa zhal gyis bzhes stabs khong nyid chag gi ri khrod du dgongs pa rdzogs so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs bstan pa rgya mtsho ni sa 'brug spyi lo186ralor shis tshang bla ri mgul du sku 'khrungs / zhe dgu ba me 'brug1916lo dbus su byon/ de nas bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan pa ltar khro kho chu kha ma sogs dgon sde du ma phyag 'debs mdzad/ dgung lo don bzhi ba lcags sbrul1941lo'i nag zla'i tshes gsum la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim par gyur to/ / sku phreng lnga ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho(skal bzang 'jigs med ces pa'ang snang)mgo log khang sar du bla brang yul dpon blo bzang tshe dbang gi sku tshar 'khrungs shing dgung lo lnga'i steng brag sgom pa'i yang srid la kun mkhyen lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan(kho'i a zhang yin)gyis thugs thag bcad/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi yongs 'dzin dkon mchog bsam grub sku rin po che las rab tu byung / dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i dus te rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lor rgyal khab kyi las byed gras su zhugs nas skya chas ngang 'tsho bzhugs pa'i skabs so/ /nag ge rin po che'i sku phreng skor/ sku phreng dang bo blo bzang chos 'phel ni chu kha ma'i bar zhi zer ba'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ 'di ba grwa sar phebs nas dge bshes kyi thob thang blangs/ lo rgyus zhib par mi shes/ sku phreng gnyis pa nag ge sprul sku zhes chu kha ma'i mgo sha tshang zer ba'i khyim tshang zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ mtshan sogs lo rgyus mi gsal/ sku phreng gsum pa nag ge 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'di ba spyi lo192 2lor chu kha ma bar zhi'i ris shis zer ba'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ ra ba'i ri khrod pa'i sku phreng skor/ sku phreng dang po blo bzang dam chos ni nur ma'i rwa ba ngo zer ba'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo don bzhi bar bzhugs/ sku phreng gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho ni chu kha ma'i sko chen zer ba'i sa char spyi lo1927lor sku 'khrungs/ da ltar bzhugs pa bcas chu kha ma'i dgon pa la sprul sku'i rabs de dag go/ gdan rabs kyi skor/ me glang lor(1927)khri chen rab brtan rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgon 'di'i khri thog dang bor 'dod zhus ltar — 529 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/phebs/ phyi lor ma dgon ltar smon lam tshugs/ de nas khri rabs gnyis pa rong rten lha rams pa/ gsum pa rje bsod nams grags pa'i sprul sku rin po che/ bzhi ba mtshe sprul ba'i sku/ lnga ba mkhan chen sgo mang rin po che/ drug pa stag ring sprul sku/ bdun pa a mchog mu to rin po che sogs chos kyi bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa can du ma phebs/ 'chad nyan gyi ched du sog po 'jam dbyangs brtson 'grus dge rgan gyi thog mar phebs pa dang rnga ba dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ rdo sbis bzang bo/ mgar rtse sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ thal hur bstan pa rnams rim par phebs nas dge 'dun pa gang bzang mang po bskyangs so/ /de'ang dgon pa 'dir bla ma nag ṣe sku phreng gsum gyi thog ma dga' ldan dge bshes sog po blo bzang chos 'phel dang bstan gsal gyi yang srid sogs byon/ /las sne'i skor/ dgon pa'i las sne khag la khri ba dang / gzhung las pa / sku tshab/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ rgan pa/ dkor gnyer/ ja ma chu len sogs lo gnyis gsum nang res mos bsko 'jog gi srol dar/ /gzhan yang / chu kha ma rang sar 'khrungs pa'i bla ma ni/ rtse dbus gcod rgan/ co ne'i khya dge tshang / dbu dge bde tshang / brag dkar tshang / dgon sar tshang / bshes gnyen chen po rdo rams pa blo bzang dbyig gnyen bcas kyis chos sde 'dir skyong khur gnang ba'i mtshan snyan grags can gyi mkhas pa mang bo byon/ yang chu kha mar dbus gtsang nas dga' ldan pa dang gtsang bla re'i dbu bla'am 'bul sdud pa yong ba bsu ba'i srol yod/ sngon o rgyan pad zhwa'i gnas rir gcod pa bstan gsal ri khrod dang / nag ṣe bla mas dbang lung khrid gsum gnang ba'i gnas ra gnyis dang ri khrod gang mchis rnams kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gi gsung bkod bzhin rang bkra shis chos gling du thim mo/ /sngon chad dgon pa 'dir 'du khang chen mo gcig lha khang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis tsam yod de/ de'i nang rten gtso bo ni/thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gsung 'byon ma/ dga' ldan nang rten jo sku li ma 'od 'bar/ sgrol dkar li ma lus tshad/ byams pa li ma mi tshad/ thub pa dge 'dun 'phel shar li/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis li ma khri do dang tshun gsum ran gyi sku brgyad/ brag sgom sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i dngul gdung mchod rten/ gsung rten du bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig kun mkhyen sku phreng rnams dang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ sa chen gong ma lnga/ thub bstan chos grags/ bla brang a khu rnam gnyis sogs kyi bka' 'bum sogs mi nyung ba bzhugs pa ma zad/ ser mo ba(bcings 'grol ma byas gong)nyis brgya bdun cu lhag bzhugs pas grwa shag sum bcu so lnga la khang mig brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam yod/ slob gnyer skabs so sos gzhung ka pota lnga la sbyong ba'i khar/ rang mos bzhin sman rtsis sogs rig gnas slob pa ma zad/ mchod pa nyin bcu bdun tshogs rgyu yod do/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel spyi le1980lor dgon pa slar gso ba'i
