chog mchan thob pas thog mar bla grwa rgan gzhon brgyad cu lhag 'dus/ chu phag spyi lo1982lor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la skyabs mgon snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang kun mkhyen drug pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/— 530 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gna' dpon blo bzang tshe dbang(a pa a blo ) / khri chen ska' bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho(rab bstan rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi ba)sogs sgom thang rma sde chu kha mas gdan drangs shing bsus pas/ bzhugs grwa dam bca'/ skyor sbyong / phyag dbang / skyabs 'gro sogs lung rjes gnang 'gangs chen mang du bstsal pa ma zad/ da lta dgon pa la 'du khang gcig de la khang mig zhe gnyis/ lha khang gsum/ de la khang mig zhe gnyis dang /dge 'dun pa nyis brgya so gnyis tsam 'dus par grwa shag zhe bzhi la khang mig nyis brgya gya bdun yod pa bcas kyi chos sde chen po chags srid pa de rgyal khab kyi srid jus ltar rang kha rang gso byed pa'i lam la chas bzhin mdzad do/ /rmur bye'i rnying dgon bsam gtan chos gling /rmu ra'am rmur bye'i rnying dgon bsam gtan chos gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chung ngam chu rmur bye(chu ra dang bye chung)zhang chos lung mdo la chags yod de/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing bya spyi lo1885lo la 'dug ge ri khrod pa blo bzang shes rab rgya mtshos btab pa'i grub mtha' khams gaḥthog pa'i ris su 'dzin pa'i ri khrod cig yin/chos sde 'di rnam 'dren bzhi ba mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la mtshan nyid rgyud kyi theg pa dang /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis yod pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la rmu ra bsam gtan chos gling zhes thog mar nag sgar dang de nas ri khrod/ rim bzhin dgon pa chags tshul bcas kyi go rim ldan te/gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying bo'i chos bdag rgya mtsho'i ming can gsum gyi nang nas o rgyan lhun grub rgya mtshos dpal chen po sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad tshe/ mgo log phyogs kyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag rnams mdun du 'ong nas bka' bzhin bgyid cing 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs pa ma zad/ de nas bzung mgo log phyogs su zhi chen gyi chos rgyud rnams byung / o rgyan lhun grub rgya mtsho khong gis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bzhi'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pas sprul ba'i sku bzhi yod pa las rgyal ba'i las kyis bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i zhi chen skyabs mgon rin po che mtshan gyi grangs la rig 'dzin 'jam dpal rdo rje/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ dbang bo'i sde zhes pa yod/ de nyid la khams gaḥthog gi bla ma rmog sprul chos dbyings rdo rjes rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsang yig mdo smad shar phyogs su gnang nas/ khyed kyis shar phyogs sgrog gi bā yan ri rgyal lhun po'i dbu la bla rtse dang / thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi sgrub mchod btsugs na 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung zhes lung bstan cing / khong sa 'dir byon nas ri zhol la lab rtse bstad pa dang dbang bskul te gdams ngag mang bo gnang bzhin thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi sgrub mchod nyin dgu la 'tshogs pa'i srol btod par mdzad/ rab byung bcu — 531 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/gnyis pa'i chu glang spyi lo172 2lor rmu ra'i bla ma stobs chen sogs kyis zhi chen tshang la dgon mgo gtad nas grwa rgyun 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang lha sde bya rgyu khas blangs par/ zhi chen skyabs mgon rig 'dzin 'jam dpal rdo rjes thog mar nag sgar zhig btsugs/ de nas zhi chen mkhan sprul skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyis rim bzhin rjes su bzung nas dbang rjes gnang lung gdams ngag sogs lugs gnyis kyi spyan dkyus yangs pos bskyangs so/ /de'i rjes shig la rmu ra ban rgan dar rgyas kyis kun mkhyen gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang po dbus su phebs skabs/ mgron gnyer nang ma'i sgo nas zhabs phyi zhus pas/ khong gi dbu sngas kyi thub pa rdor gdan ma dang shangs mtshal gyis bris pa'i gnas chung thang ga bka' shog bcas gnang zhing smon lam shog ga'i gras su bcug de rjes zhi chen bai ro tsa na mkhas grub bstan 'dzin byon nas dbang dang gdams ngag mang po gnang zhing / da lor byang chub mchod rten zhig bzhengs na bstan 'gro spyi la'am khyad par du sa 'dir bstan pa dar zhing dge 'dun pa'i sde la phan thogs chen po 'byung zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rmu ra bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel sogs kyis bka' bzhin bsgrub par mkhas blangs nas legs por grub cing / gzungs sgrub dang rab gnas bcas khong gis legs par bgyis te mjug grub mdzad/ gzungs gzhug la rmu ra chos mdzad sogs kyi gser bris 'bum tshar gcig dang thub dbang li sku sogs rten 'gangs can mang bo bzhugs/ da dung si dhi'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ grub chen byams pa chos 'dzin sogs kyis rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i skyes mchog dam pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar gyis gdul bya bstan 'gro'i gsos su thugs bskyed rnam pa dkar ba'i stobs las 'khrungs pa skyabs mchog mi yi seṅge blo bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho zhes grags/ lta ba yum don spros bral gyi dgongs pa klong du gyur nas spyod pa lam lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la nyin mtshan kun tu brtson zhing gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus chen pos sku tshe gang bor sku chings ma bkrol pa dang nyin gcig kyang mi g.yeng bar mtshan mo'i sum cha gcig ma gtogs gzim pa med par sgrub pa nyams len du gzhol pa dang bsnyen gnas srung ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ ra skor bar 'gro ba/ zhal 'don bzlas pa/ sku dang sa ts+tsha 'debs pa/ chu gtor dang las sbyin gsung ba/ khrus chos dang bsngo smon gsung ba/ skyabs gnas rang rang 'dod mos la mthun pa'i byin rlabs byed pa sogs sku tshe hril bor nyin gcig gi 'gro stangs mi 'da' bar mdzad/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing bya spyi lo1855lo rmur bye'i 'dug dge ri khrod pa dgung lo so gnyis pa shing bya spyi lo1〈85lor rmu ra 'jam bstan sogs kyis gros mdzad nas dkar sgrogs gnyis kyi bar mtshams rma 'gram lug pa'i lung ba ri khrod 'di phyag 'debs mdzad de/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang sogs bzhengs so/ /de'ang 'dug dge ri khrod pa me byi spyi lo1926lor sku gshegs rjes/ gdung rten mtho lha khang mnyam pa — 532 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dngul brdung can grub cing rin po che sna tshogs pas phra tshom bkra ba'i mchod rten bzhengs/ de dus bka' dge gsar rnying gi grwa btsun brgya lnga bcu lhag 'dus/ de'i rjes su skyes bu dam pa khong bla ma zhi chen pas dbu bzung nas rmu ra'i grwa rgan gzhon thams cad kyis ri khrod la bdag gnyer byas pas rim bzhin rmu ra dgon par bsgyur/ skabs der sa cha'i mthun rkyen sogs zhan phyir lo du ma'i ring la chos sde gzhi nas chags ma thub par byung bas dgon pa 'debs mkhan dang dus sogs nges can zhig med/ dus mtshungs su rmu ra bla ma bsod rgyal sogs kyis chos bcu chen mo nyin brgyad 'tshogs pa'i srol btsugs/ de bzhin 'dug dge ri khrod pa/sku phreng dang bo 'dug dge blo bzang shes rab rgya mtsho ni grub mtha' ris med du bskyangs shing / mtshan gzhan la lus rab kyang zhu/ spyi lo1852lor bye gshong du sku 'khrungs la/ spyi lo1885lor ri khrod 'di phyag btab mdzad/ spyi lo1kha25lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ sku phreng gnyis pa 'dug dge byams pa chos grags ni rnying ma'i lta ba kho na 'dzin pa'i dge bshes shig yin/ khong spyi lo1926lor bye gshong du sku 'khrungs shing /spyi lo1958lor dag pa'i zhing khams su gshegs/ tshul kho bla ma sku phreng dang bo mtshan la tshul kho zhu ste rdza mgo zer ba'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ lta ba jo nang ba yin/ sku phreng gnyis pa dge legs rab gsal/ rmu ra ngag skor ru spyi lo1940lor sku 'khrungs shing lta ba rnying ma ba kho na lags te mkhan po yon tan can zhig yin/ da lta bzhugs mdzad/gzhan yang / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i skyes srid bla ma rdzi ma ba dang / bya bla ma 'jigs dar sprul sku sogs bzhugs pa ma zad/ rag grom dgon pas mngags pa'i dga' grol rin po che/ bya bla ma sbyin pa'i sprul sku rnams dang a khu thu thu zhes mkha' spyod ma nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba sogs phebs bzhugs gnangs/ de'ang dbu mdzad dang mchod dpon/ dge bskos sogs las sne bzhugs pa de dag bsko bzhag byed skabs/ ma dgon zhi chen dgon pas thag gcod dgos/ khyad par du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgya cong dkar mkhan po rmu ra'i sgo dar tshang la sku 'khrungs shing khong pha yul du thengs du ma phebs te thugs brtse gnang zhing dbang lung man ngag gis bka' drin bskyangs/ yang zhi chen skyabs mgon gyi sprul sku dbon rdo rje 'chang rmu ra'i gur mgon tshang la sku 'khrungs/ khong gis skyes bu dam pa mang po bsten nas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dbang rjes gnang khri lung man ngag sogs lugs gnyis kyi spyan dkyus yangs pas bka' drin che/ da skabs bod phyi byol pa'i 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi mkhas pa chen por gyur/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa byi spyi lo1948la zhi chen sprul sku kun bzang nyi ma byon nas bdud klong byang gsum gyi dbang lung thams cad gnang ba dang phur ba sgrub chen gyi dam rdzas myong grol phab cing dus mchod rnams kyi dbu bzhugs mdzad pa sogs bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i lha khang la khang mig dgu yod pas der rten gtsor thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gser sku gsung 'byon ma/ 'dug dge tshang gi thugs rje chen po'i gser sku gnyis/ gser zangs las grub — 533 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs /pa'i mchod rten cha brgyad/ nye sras brgyad kyi 'jim sku/ bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ klong chen mdzod bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi/ snying thig dum gnyis/ 'jigs med gling ba'i gsung 'bum/ rin chen gter mdzod/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ gsung chos dang sgrub skor/ bskyed rdzogs nyams len gyi skor sogs pota stong phrag bzhugs/ 'dug dge ri khrod pa'i sku gdung dngul las grub pa'i mchod rten dang / dngul gyi mchod kong chen po bzhi/ dngul theb chen po bcu/ dngul kong 'bring ba brgya lhagadangul theb stong phrag tsen dang sbub/ gling bu/ dung dkar/ mkhar rnga/ maṇ+ḍal 'a sogs mchod rdzas mang / 'du khang la ka ring bzhi dang ka thung nyi shu can de la ka bar gsum cu so drug yod/ de'i rten gtsor mgar klong gi gter ston gu ru chen po'i gser sku dang thub pa'i li sku rdor gdan ma khru gang can/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gser sku khru gang can/ gnam lcags kyi phur bu gter ma/ gser zangs las grub pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa/ gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/ sgrol dkar ljang gi 'jim sku/ sgrol sku khri rgyab yol bcas stong dang lnga brgya/ rgyan thang nyer bzhi/ dpe cha nyer mkho pota brgya lhag 'du khang la gser tshon brgyab/ gser mchod dngul mchod zangs mchod cha tshang / dung dkar dang gser gling / dngul gling / zangs gling /gser dung / dngul dung / rkang dung / bla bre rgyal chen/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa chas/ khri chas ka 'phan gdugs zom/ rnga 'khar/ tshogs gur la sogs thams cad 'dzoms pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i chos skyong gtso bo phyag bzhi ba dang / zhing skyong tsi'u dmar sogs la bsten dgos/ de'ang gling bzhag o rgyan lhun grub kyi shangs khrag gis phyag bris mdzad pa'i tsi'u dmar gyi thang ga zhig bzhugs pa lhag tu 'gangs gal che/195〈lor bor brlag tu song / skabs der grwa shag lnga bcu lhag la khang mig nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam yod pas dge 'dun pa nyis brgya lhag bzhugs so/ /lo gcig la dpyid dus tshes bcu chen mo dang sa ga zla ba la bsnyen gsan dang sku rim/ dbyar zla drug pa'i tshes 'go nas phur sgrub nyin bdun/ dbyar gnas la thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol nyin bdun/ston mjug tu thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi sgrub mchod nyin dgu dgun khar lnga mchod chen mo dang sku rim/ bum sgrub nyin bdun/ rgyal zlar bgeg gtor nyin gsum/ gso sbyong dus thog ltar du 'tshogs/chos thog rnams su sdom gsum dang spyod 'jug chen mo sogs blo rgyugs sprod pa dang bla sprul re bzhugs skabs dus thog bcad pa med par chos thun rgyun tshogs yod do/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya spyi lo1981lor chos sgo phye nas chos lung mdo la dgon pa slar gso mdzad/ sngar ltar 'du khang chen mo la ka bar so drug can dang / lha khang gcig la khang mig dgu yod pa rten dang bcas pa bzhengs/ dus mtshungs su dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin la sprul sku mkhan po bstan 'dzin bzang po(da lta khong rdzong srid gros su 'gan gnangs bzhin mchis)dang / kru'u rin gzhon pa la sprul sku dge legs rab gsal/ u yon la mkhas grub dang thub dpal/ kun gsal/ 'brug chung /— 534 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lha bo sogs bsko bzhag mdzad yod pa de dag gis bstan pa skyong la spel bzhin bzhugs/ dge 'dun pa rnams sngar bzhin so so'i shog pa nas yong bas da lta grwa shag bzhi bcu yod pa la khang mig brgya dang drug cu yod/ser mo ba'i grangs ka brgya dang bcu bzhi la slebs zin/ 'du khang dang lha khang / grwa shag bcas ni sngar las spus ka che zhing rngam brjid ldan la mdzes sdug kyang ldan/ de'ang dgon pa la lo re'i yong sgo'i sgor sum khri tsam yod pa gtso bo dgon pa'i 'dzugs skrun dang mchod pa sogs la 'gro song gtong bzhin yod la/ phyug zog brgya lhag yod pa dud 'brog dbul phongs brgyad tsam la bcol pas de dag gis mar dang zog btsong pa'i rin pa ma gtogs/ phyugs las thon rdzas kyi yong sgo tshang ma rang la dbang bas 'brog khul dbul skyor bya ba la byas rjes cung bzhag mdzad/ ser mo ba re la phal cher cha snyoms zog gnyis/ lug nyi shu/ rta re yod pa so so'i khyim tshang la bcol zhing grong chog tu 'gro ba sogs la brten nas rang kha rang gso dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dus 'bab gsar ba dang mthun pa'i dgon sde zhig la 'bad brtson gnangs bzhin mchis so/ /bye gshong dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling /bye gshong dgon nam bye gshong dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling zhes bya ba ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong rmar bye zhang gi dung dkar kha cha zer ba'i sa cha ru/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags lug spyi lo1871lor dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis btab/de'ang dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang dbang phyug ni mgo log a skyong khag gsum las dpon po dmag zor mgon po'i khyim rgyud kyi bye gshong tshe rgyal 'bum gyi gdung rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ khong sku na chung ba'i dus nas yi ge 'bri klog skyor gsum sbyang ba dang / khyad par tu khong gis bla na med pa'i 'dun pa 'grub ched/gsang stabs kyis dbus su phebs nas se ra theg chen gling gi chos grwar zhugs te/ snga gzhug tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo'i zhabs pad bsten nas gzhung bka' pota lnga sogs la legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rgyal dbang rin po che 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rig slob dkyus su bskos par grags/ rjes su phyir rang yul du phebs dus 'ju mi pham dgung lo nyi shu'i thog ste spyi lo1nga66lor khong nyid dgung lo lnga bcu nas bcu'i mtshams su rnam gnyis gsung gleng gi mthar/ mi pham gsung 'bum nang la rten 'brel gyi tshul du tshig brgyad 'brel bzhugs/ de nas bzung a rig ra rgya dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba sogs la lo shas re phebs pa ma gtogs/ pha yul bye gshong du gtan bzhugs mdzad/ nam rgyun khong gi thugs la mtha' 'khob kyi yul 'dir lhag par pha yul la ri bo dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thugs smon gnang ba ltar/spyi lo1871lor bye gshong ser sde'am nag sgar zhig gsar du btsugs shing / mtshan la dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du gsol/ rten 'brel gyi dbu brnyes pa'i rtag mtshan du rje lnga mchod chen po nyin lnga dang / mchod pa nyin bzhi/ dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ltar bca' yig kyang brtsams/ de'ang 'dug dge — 535 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/ri khrod pa sku dang bo'i sa zla'i smyung chen nyin gsum la tshogs pa'i srol yang tshugs/ dgon sde 'dis bsten pa'i chos skyong ni 'dod khams dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang sgos su dge bshes mchog nas se ra theg chen gling nas spyan drangs pa'i thā 'og chos rgyal ni dgon sde gnyis nas gcig 'gyur gyis bsten/ de dus ser mo ba'i grangs ka lnga bcu lhag go/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don la ga bstar las chos sgo phye thog du chen gyi drung yig tshe bho gtsos pa'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis shing cha dang nom pa/ phyugs zog ma dngul sogs kyi zhal 'debs phul te sngar gyi nag sgar ri khrod de dgon par bsgyur/thog mar rdo rams pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i thugs bkod ltar sde 'bangs yongs kyis bdag rkyen sbyar te19〈 2lor khams sde dge nas mtshal dpar gyi bka' 'gyur dang snag dpar gyi bstan 'gyur de min po ti brgya lhag gdan 'dren zhus/ spyi lo198 2lor ru sde yongs nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi lha khang la ka ba lnga bcu nga bdun can dang / mgon khang mig bzhi yod pa bcas gsar du bzhengs/ dus mtshungs su spyi lo1987lor 'du khang gcig la khang ka ba bcu nga bdun yod pa can zhig bzhengs pa/ spyi lo1996lo la 'du khang ston mo la 'bad bzhin mchis/ grwa shag sum cu la khang mig brgya dang nyi shu bcas khyon sa rgya spyi khru gru bzhi ma khri tsam la brgal zhing / ser mo ba'i grangs ka sum cu tsam zin/ de'ang sngar gyi lugs srol ltar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon lag tu gyur to/ /sngar gyi nang rten gtso bo la/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi li sku rgyal dbang rin po che'i phyag nas phebs pa glang dar khrims thar mar grags pa dge bshes khong gi sku spun bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis bod kyi sku drag cig la bsnyun gzhi ha cang lci ba'i dus der/ gso dpyad kyis phan chen po thogs pa'i stabs kyis khong la sku de dang (da skabs bzhugs)/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gter cha(bzhugs med)/ bod sde ba gzhung gi bka' shog bcas bstsal bar bshad/ yang khog gi thugs dam gyi rten tsan dan las grub pa'i bde mchog gi sku khru gang longs pa de dang(da bzhugs)/ tsha rdor tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pas gnang ba'i sgrol sku byin can dang / dbu zhwa(bzhugs med)/ zhi chen ma 'das kyis gnang ba'i slob dpon rin po che'i sku tshabs nyer lnga'i nang gi slob dpon snang srid zil gnon(bzhugs med)/ rwa sgreng khri rin po ches gnang bar grags pa'i thub pa shar li ma/ kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba ni bye gshong dga' rab kyi chung ma'i zhang bo yin stabs/khong gis gnang ba'i na bza' cha tshang dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil(bzhugs med)dge bshes mchog gi slob grogs a rig dge bshes chen mo'i ra rgya'i par khang chen mo nas par thengs gnyis pa mtshal dpar bka' 'gyur tshar gcig gnangs/ de dag spyi lo1958lo la nyams song ngo / /deng sang gi nang rten gtso bo la/ khams sde dge nas dpar ba'i bka' bstan dang gzhan bka' 'gyur tshar drug dang 'bum brgyad/ rje dang gzhan gsung 'bum so so/ kun mkhyen drug pa chen mos gnang ba'i — 536 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhal thang lnga dang zhal 'don thar mdo/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen mos gnang ba'i sku 'gag rab rgyan sa 'brug lo la rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyag rmur bye'i phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo thog mar bsgyur skabs/ khong gis gnang ba'i ston pa'i gser sku gcig dus mtshungs su 'du khang gnas sa la byin rlabs dang rab gnas sogs mdzad/ rdo rams pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos gnang ba'i ston pa'i gser sku dang 'od dpag med/zhu chen bai ro nas gnang ba'i sgrol sku gnyis dang rdor sems kyi sku/ zhu chen dpon sprul nas gnang ba'i ston pa'i gser sku/ ṣe tshang dkon mchog rgya mtshos gnang ba'i ston pa'i gser sku/ gzhan khams sde dge nas spyan drangs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' gdams mchod rten lcags rtse ma cha gcig bye gshong tshe zhar gyis dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur skabs sbas pa'i pha a skyong dmag zor mgon po'i me mda' dang khrab sogs blangs te chos skyong gi mdun du spyan gzigs phul/ chos dad mang tshogs kyis phul pa'i 'jim sku las grub pa'i rje stong sku dang bzo grub kyi gos sku chen mo/ shing las grub pa'i byams chen/ sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs so bzhi'i thang ga tshar gsum dang gyan thang nyer lnga sogs bzhugs yang / dgon sde 'di la skad grags can gyi bla sprul dang mkhas grub mang po yod pa ste/ bye gshong dge bshes chen mo'i yang srid sku phreng snga phyi gsum bcas bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa brgyad/ dge bshes sku snga phyi gsum/ byams me dpon bla sku phreng gsum/ ṣe tshang sku phreng snga phyi pa/nyis/ 'dug dge ri khrod pa phun tshogs sogs sgra rig sman rtsis mkhas pa'i skyes chen gsum/ bye chung gu ru sogs gsang sngags nyams bzhes la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags pa nus ldan gnyis bcas kyi thugs khur spyan bskyangs zam ma chad par mdzad do/ /sngon dge bshes mchog dang dam pa de nyid rnams kyis btsugs pa'i lnga mchod dang mchod pa smyung chen dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod kyi khar/ spyi lo1985lo nas mtshan sgrogs dgon gyi rogs skyor 'ogasmon lam chen mo nyin dgu dang kun rig dang mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs byed/ bde mchog sogs sgrub mchod —bdun sgrub re re dbyangs ltar sa gsum dang bcas pa lo re bzhin chad med sgrub bzhin yod/ mkhan po'am khri ba gang yin kyang sngon gyi grwa bgres gcig gis 'gan bzhes pa yin/ dge bskos dang dgon don sogs dge bshes sku thog gsum pa nyid nas bsko bzhag byas pa las gzhan gyi srol med/ da lta dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin rdo rams pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang kru'u rin gzhon pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ u yon blo bzang brtson 'grus sogs nas bdag gnyer gyi 'gan gnang bzhin bzhugs te/ dgon pa la dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan pas/ rang sde'i chos dad mang tshogs kyi dkar thigs dang zhal 'debs spyi 'jog las yong sgo gzhan med/ mang tshogs kyi bcos 'dug dang ser mo ba 'ga' 'os 'tsham gyis grong chog 'gro ba(grong chog song na mtho na sgor mo lnga re yin/ de'ang dgon pa'i sgrig ltar rtag par 'gro mi chog)sogs khyon yongs kyis yong sgo lo rer sgor mo khri gnyis la zin mi thub/ de dag tshang ma 'du khang bzhengs pa'i ma dngul la bzhag mdor na/ bye gshong dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling ni sngar las lhag pa rma klung dal — 537 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/'gro ring mo'i nye 'gram 'dzum dkar 'o ma'i thang zhes bya ba la mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che las ri bo dge lugs pa'i bstan pa yun nas yun du dar zhing rgyas pa'i smon 'dun la 'bad 'bangs cher bskyed gnang bzhin yod do/ /dbal ban rnying dgon thub bstan yongs 'dus gling /gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong dbal ban tshang zhang gi dbal ban rnying ma'i dgon thub bstan yongs 'dus gling gi lo rgyus 'god par bya ste/gdul bya rnams kyi khams dbang bo bsam pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus pa gang mchis thams cad rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po gang gi rmad du byung ba'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu las byung / /bdag cag gi rigs bdag sa gsum 'gran bral gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med 'phrin las 'od zer dpal 'bar gang nyid ni/ don la bskal ba dpag med pa'i sngon rol nas khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum sku'i klong du gdon ma'i mgon po khyab bdag rigs drug pa chen po dang dbyer med par mngon pa byang chub tu zin/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje 'jigs med gling ba'i rdo rje'i lung las lha sras sprul pas chos sgo 'byed/ ces lung zin gyi thugs sras lha sras mu rub btsan po sangs rgyas gling ba sogs kyi yang srid du lung bstan pa ltar rtsod bral dus babs kyi skyes bu chen po zhig yin/ khong dang sde 'dis rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gi yu ba nas bzung bas dpon rabs gong ma dbal shul gzung dmar dang lugs gnyis kyi 'brel thag gser gyi srad bu la dam sel gyi g.ya' yis ma gos par dam zhing sra ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rjes su dbal shul rdor nag ma'i khyim la gzhi chen gu ru bstan 'dzin dang bai ro tsa na gnyis gdan zhus ltar byon/ dbal rdor gyis nged tshang gi dpon rgyud je zhan du mi 'gro ba'i skyabs 'jug dang lung bstan zhus pa la khong rnam gnyis nas khyed kyi zhu don ltar 'grub pa gangs can skyabs mgon rig 'dzin pad+ma ka ra'i gsol 'debs phur tshugs su byed pa si bhi'i sgrub pa zhig nges par 'dzugs dgos zhes gsungs ste/ gu ru'i rjes gnang dang si lha'i lung sogs gnang / de rjes sdom brtson mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma dam pa dbang dar zhes pa klong chen ngos thig gi chos rgyud 'dzin par byon nas klong snying rtsa gsum sogs snying thig gong 'og gi dbang lung mang du gnang / ri gong du ban ser 'ga' zhig gnas pa rnams rma klung dal 'bab ring mo'i 'gram nas nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs mchod bdun sgrub kyi 'tshogs srol spel zhing ri khrod cig chags/ skabs de'i bla ma la rtogs pa'i dbang phyug mgar ba bla ma zhes pa mkhas grub rnam thar ldan pa yin no/ /— 538 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon 'di'i bstan srol btod pa bo bla ma dam pa dbang dar bskyed pa'i yab yum dang / mdzad 'phrin gyi rnam thar sogs rgan po'i ngag rgyun ltar na/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i skabs tsam du nges/ chos sde 'debs pa bo rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug nges don mkhas mchog rdo grub dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma 'phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po de nyid yin te/ khong bod kyi dus chen bzhi las a lcag 'bri'i rigs su mched pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa'i chu 'go so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i nang gses/ gnubs kyi rigs su gyur pa'i rgyud pa las byung ba'i rigs khyad par can du nges/ sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling ba/ yongs grags su rgas li gter ston nam lcags khrung gter ston zhes bskyed pa'i yab dang / yum sha za ṭā ga'i rigs bsod nams 'tsho'i sras su rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo glang ste spyi lo1865lor 'gros sgang zhes pa'i ri zhol te da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi nye 'dabs su mtshan dpe'i pad+mo mngon par bzhad/ zhabs mthil du chos dung 'bud dod byung ba sku nar smon pa'i bar mngon/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku na chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dbang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa nas byang bar mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan dang / rdo grub kun bzang sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod/ rdza stod du 'phags pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngur smig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po dpal dge rdo rje 'chang o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo zhabs drung ched phebs kyis/ byang chub spyod 'jug chen mo sogs mdo rgyud man ngag gi chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lha'i rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lor brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lor rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus shing / rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid blo thog nas gnang / dpal sprul rin po'i che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byas pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpags na/ lung gis bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes te bsngags brjod bgyis/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo dang rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong rnam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nyag bla gter chen 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo rgyud sems gsum bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thugs gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi'u tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig cha gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pota lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying gi grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub la thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pa'i mkhas grags ches cher byon/ rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi — 539 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/lo1nga80lor mgo log pad+ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched phul bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes gsar du bzhengs pa la phyis ming 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes 'bod/ khong gis dgon pa g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong ma zhes pa dben khrod rgyal bo'i lha khang du sgrub pa rtse gcig gzhol pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung khyab par gyur cing ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus te glegs bam skyel 'bul bgyis la nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mngon par thon/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum la sogs gsar bzheng gi 'phrin las rgya cher spel/rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad ma me stag gi lor(1929)gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus/ yang chos rje de nyid kyis rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing yos te spyi lo1915lor ri khrod kyi dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa kha bskong du dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa dkon mchog smon lam rdo rje slob dpon du bskos nas 'phags yul dgra bcom pa gnas bstan pa ku li'i lhung gzed rten skal du gnang / dus de nas bzung sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying bo 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang dbyar chos dgun chos sngon 'gro'i 'bum lnga tshes bcu'i sgrub mchod sogs btsugs nas dgon par bsgyur/ dgon pa'i gdan rabs thog ma dam pa khong nyid bzhugs/ri khrod dgon par gyur pa'i bdag rkyen gtso bo grub dbang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bka' drin las byung ba gang gi 'debs pa bo rdo grub sku phreng gsum pa khong yin no/ / gdan rabs gnyis pa bslab gsum rgyan ldan bla ma rang grol/ gdan rabs gsum pa sprul ba'i sku mchog grags pa dpal bzang / gdan rabs ba'i ba dam can 'du ba'i rten mkhar dge slong o rgyan lhun grub/ 'di ba ni bstan srung chos skyong rang shugs kyi 'du zhing khog zhugs byed pa'i sku rten chen po yin pa ma zad/ rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi rnam dpyod don la gnas pa zhig tu gyur to/ /dgon pa'i btab gnas ni gangs ri'i ra bas yongs su bskor pa'i ljongs te mdo stod mi yi chol kha rma klung dal 'bab ring mo'i 'gram ngogs rma khog g.yang gi ra ba/ gling sa mthong ba kun smon du grags pa bsod nams chos kyi yul gru/ bde skyid las kyi sa cha/ legs brgya 'dus pa'i gdan sa/ spang ri snum la lhun chags pa/ chu bo dwangs la dbyangs snyan pa/ rtsi shing rgyas la bcud ldan pa/ ne'u gseng 'jam la khod yangs pa/ mngon par bkra ba'i gnas yul bkra shis skong gseng thang zhes pa'i spang ljongs dkyil du/ mdo mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje'i yab yum dang sha za mkha' 'gror sprul ba'i sku 'khrungs yul gdan 'bur gong 'og bar gsum las bar ma/ shar na rgya stag khra bo'i mche sder ngom 'dra'i sa 'dzin grub sa/ lho na g.yu 'brug sngon mo dgung la 'khyug 'dra'i chu bo bzhur sa/ nub na rma bya gzhon nus sgro gur phug 'dra'i lhun po brjid sa/byang na rus sbal ser po spang la 'gying 'dra'i rdza ri phyug sa/ steng na mkha' dbyings sngon mo 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad tshul du ldan sa/ 'og gzhi spang ljongs sna tshogs bkra ba 'dabs brgyad me tog bzhad sa/ mdun na — 540 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/drag po'i thun zor gnam la phyag 'dra'i mgon po'i tshogs kyi bdag pos gnas ri la gnas bdag chen po gling gi po ti dmar yag mgon po'i dmag tshogs bye ba dung phyur dang bcas pas phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong bar nyin gyi bya ra mdzad pa/ rgyab na lcags kyi mda' mo skong gi lha ri rgyal mo sman po stod dang lnga brgya'i nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzad pa/ bar na btsan mdung dmar bo gnam la bsnyegs 'dra'i dam can mkhar ba'i gnas ri yul bdag chen po sha ri rdo rje thog rgod rtsal ldan btsan dmag bye ba 'bum sde'i dpung dang bcas pas dgon ri grong thams cad kyi dkar bo'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs byed cing / nag po'i dgra gegs kyi brag ri gtor ba/ gnag phyug longs spyod kyi dngos grub rtsol ba sogs sa dpyad kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa tshang ba'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du btab po/ /rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i nang la bla ma dam pa dbang dar nas sde 'di'i rmang gzhi tsam dang gangs ljongs bstan pa'i gsal byed gcig pu o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa gang nyid gdul bya thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs gsum la pha nor bu skal gyi tshul du gnang ba'i dbang bo'i man ngag dang theg dgu'i yang rtse a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len snying bor byas pa'i klong chen snying thig gi bstan pa'i srol btod/ de dus grwa btsun bcu phrag gcig lhag 'dus/ bla ma mgar ba zhes pa bla mar bzhugs/ khong ni khams phyogs kyi mkhas dbang dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi 'dul 'dzin pa zhig yin/ skabs der ri khrod dam nag sgar gyi rnam pa tsam yin pas chos khrims dang las sne sogs med/ rjes su rab byung bco lnga ba'i nang tshan shing yos lor(1915)'dus pa gzhi gsum gyi las byed slob dpon du bla ma dam pa dkon mchog smon lam bsko bzhag mdzad de dgon par bsgyur/ sbyin bdag ni dpal chen rta mchog rol ba'i rnam sprul dpon bla dbal shul rta mgrin zhes pa yin te/ khor bsten nas rten skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi dngos por sgrub pa mchod yon gyi 'brel ba sngar las je zab tu btang / dbal rtam la gnod sbyin tse'u dmar gyi srog gtad kyang mdzad par grags/ mchod gzhis sde ba bdun dud tshang sum brgya tsam po gsar rnying ris med kyi yon bdag bgyis/ de dus sde 'dir zhwa dmar gser gyi sgrub sde gnyis mnyam du rma chu'i 'gram ste deng skabs kyi ri khrod ces pa'i sar chags/ de rjes mi ring bar kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje/ 'di'i rjes ye shes rdo rje rol ba zhes nyid kyi yang srid du lung bstan pa ltar mdo mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje zhes pa 'khrungs/ 'di ba dgon gnas 'dir phebs nas bur rgyas tshang gi sbra gur chung ngu g.yar nas bzhugs/ khyi mchog chen po de'i gdung sras ral gri yin/ de'i sras khams gsum zil gnon dgyes pa rdo rje bstsal/ khong rab byung bco lnga lor mes po mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje'i lte khrag gtor pa'i gdan sa 'dir byon te rdo dang so phag las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rten bzhengs/ mchod rten bum sgo gser zangs las grub pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i 'dra sku khru phyed do'i tshad can byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/sku gsung thugs rten byin chen bgrang yas pa dang / gser dngul g.yu byur sogs rin chen sna tshogs kyi bang mdzod bkang ba/ phyi'i lcags ri dang nang gi gzungs gzhug sogs blos gzhal dka' ba zhig yod ces bshad — 541 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/rgyun snang yang da lta de dag gi dkar chag dang lo rgyus gsal 'byed dka' bar gyur/ grub dbang sku phreng bzhi ba 'jigs med thub bstan 'phrin las dpal bzang bo rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin sku skyes lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje'i bka' lung las/ rig kun khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /sprul gzhi rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo dang / /dbus gyur longs sku'i zhing khams chen po ru/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan sprul ba bzhi/ /khyad par 'phrin las sprul ba'i zlos gar ni/ /dgon gnas de yi gshin rje phyogs pa'i sar/ /rin chen brag ri ljon shing 'dzoms pa'i gnas/ /thabs shes ka dang da yi ming can la/ /rigs ldan khye'u me yos lo ba yis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba sman pa'i lhas bzung 'byung / /ces 'khrungs yul dang bcas pa gsal bar lung bstan pa'i don ltar/rgyal mo rong gi stod phyogs/ chu bo gsum du gyes pa'i g.yas phyogs/ gser rta bo kha bkal smar gyi lag ces pa'i ngag sgros bzhin gser khog/ grub chen dgon gyi lho sgo gshin rje'i phyogs/ gser chu'i 'gram tsi grong ba zhes pa'i nang rje kur shog leb dpon gyi mi sde yang rje kur gyi rigs las byung ba dgra lha zhes pa/ bskyed yum kwa bzhi zhes dpa' mdzangs kyi grags snyan yod pa'i rigs brgyud ka li skyid ces pa las/ rab byung bcu drug gi thog ma me yos lo spyi lo1927lor 'khrungs nyin tho rangs dus na 'od kyi snang bas khyim thams cad rang gsal bas yab yum gnyis kyis lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul red snyam zhing skrag bzhin du yum la gnod med ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcas/ mngal gyi pad mo las grol/ sku na chung dus nas dam pa'i rig pa sad/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar shin tu mang / khyab bdag bla ma mchog nyid dgon sde 'dir thengs du mar zhabs kyis bcags shing / klong snying rtsa gsum gyi dbang / rta mgrin dang phur ba'i dbang / sa bdag 'khrug bcos/seng gdong byad grol sogs dbang bka' lung mang du gsungs/ dbang phyug chen po rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje zhes pa khyad du 'phags pa'i dam pa de nyid kyang lan du mar byon nas/ chos bka' mang du gsungs pa dang /sde 'di'i longs spyod nor gyi 'byung gnas klu'i rigs rnams yul phyogs gzhan du byin pa slar yang gdan drangs phyir mtsho dang chu klung rnams dang sgos dgon gnas kyi byang phyogs nye 'gram 'bru rigs dang rin chen sna tshogs kyi gter sbas/ dper na khong rnams gnyis da dung chos sde 'dir gnang sbyin byas par mtshon na/ bka' chos tshar gcig dang thub pa chen po gu ru sgrol ma sogs kyi li sku du ma/ rol mo sil snyan sogs mchod rdzas cha tshang / gser dngul sogs rgyu rdzas kyi gnang sbyin rgya chen pos gna' bo'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ sprul sku rin po che yar lung bstan pa'i nyi ma khong nyid nas klong chen snying thig gi dbang bka' gnang zhing dngos rdzas kyi gnang sbyin mang du bstsal/ bcos bsgyur sngon la bdud 'joms rdo rje'i gdung sras grub dbang sku phreng gsum pa'i sku gcen rdo rje dgra 'dul/ sprul sku dri med grags pa rnam gnyis kyis gter gsang dbang dang rnying thig gong 'og gi dbang yongs rdzogs gsungs/ gzhi chen mang 'dus rin po che byon te thugs chen sdug bsngal rang grol gyi dbang 'pho khrid sogs gnang / chos rje sku phreng bzhi ba'i thugs bkod ltar/ rdo grub dgon gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling gi mkhan chen rnam bzhi snga phyi gnyis las ma — 542 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzhi'i ya gyal/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis brgyan pa'i mkhan shes rab grags pa dang bla ma dam pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnams snga phyir rim bzhin byon nas yun ring bor sngon 'gro kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung /spyod 'jug sdom gsum sogs kyi khrid dang klong snying gi dbang lung mang du gnang ba dang / 'don rta dbyangs rdung phyag len thig rdul mtshon bca' bzo las 'grig sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ma nor ba dpyis phyin pa slob ston bgyis/ kyā la mkhan po chos mchog gis sngon 'gro rtsa gsum bsnyen yig sogs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum mang bo bstsal/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun/ mi rigs chos lugs srid jus dngos 'bebs dang lag len don 'khyol byas par brten/ shul lus grwa btsun rgan gzhon bcu phrag rnams kyis mig rgyang ring bo dang spobs pa cher bskyed sgos/ spyi lo1980lor chos sde 'dir chos sgo phyes/ gdan rabs lnga ba sngags nus mthu rang 'byor chen po dge slong shes rab rgya mtsho dang sku phreng bzhi ba thub bstan 'phrin las dpal bzang pos bka' gnang ltar khri bzhugs dang las sne'i slob dpon gyis 'gan bzhes gnang / deng skabs kyi rten gtso bo gu ru'i gser sku dang 'phags pa'i slong bzed sogs rten gsum mchod rdzas du ma srog nyen la ma 'dzems par khrims las mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad de dam pa gang gi sbed skor byas pa dgon par phul/ gdan rabs drug pa mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid rmad du byung ba pashes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa shes rab mthar phyin zhes pa lags te khong chung ngu'i dus nas rgyud la snying rje chen pos brnyes la theg pa chen po'i rigs su sad/ rdo grub dgon du thos bsam 'grims nas 'dod chung chog shes gnyom chung tshul mthun ngang yon tan bslabs/ 'dus sde 'dir chos sgo phyes rjes kyi bstan pa'i me ro slar gso ba la 'bud rdung rol dbyangs dbyar chos/ dgun chos sogs steng na dbu chos rtags brgyad/ 'og na grwa btsun dkyus ma sogs chos srid lugs zung gi bya ba las 'khor lo mtha' dag thugs 'gan du bzhes/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid lan du mar gnang ba dang / sdom gsum rnam nges kyi rtsa ba dang 'grel ba/ spyod 'jug rtsa 'grel/ sum rtags dag gsum sogs kyi khrid lung mang po gsungs mthar spyi lo1990lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /gdan rabs bdun pa lung dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyugs bla ma gsang chen zhes pa yin/ khong gis rdo 'dzi rmar gsum sogs lho kha phyogs kyi mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i skyes bu dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas gsan bsam sbyong ba mthar phyin mdzad/ sngon 'gro kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang sngon 'gro kun btus spyod 'jug chen mo sogs kyi khrid lung mang du gsungs/ rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum dang klong chen mdzod bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi sogs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog mang bo dgon par bzhag 'jogs bgyis mthar spyi lo1995lor sku zhi bar gshegs so/ / gdan rabs brgyad pa mchog sprul ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho ni/grub dbang sku phreng bzhi ba thub bstan 'phrin las dpal bzang pos 'dus grwa spyi'i mtshan tho brgya phyag lhag las thugs brtags mdzad de 'dus sde 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag por mtshan snyan gser gyi me tog gi chun por phab/— 543 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/da skabs khong gis sgo gsum zol med 'bad pa chig sgril gyis bstan dgon 'di la lugs gnyis kyi bya ba gang 'os kyi sgo nas zhabs phyi sgrub bzhin pa'i skabs lags so/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog mkhan grags po 'od zer rgya mtsho ni zhwa dmar ser gyi dgon sde khag tu dka' ngal la ma 'dzems par rdo rus thug pa'i slob gnyer gnang ste lung rtogs nor bu'i mdzod la ci dgar dbang bsgyur ba'i bshes gnyen mchog tu bzhes mur dgon 'dir 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan thog mar bsgreng ba nyer ldog rtsom pa'i skabs lags/ khri chen gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug mchog nyid gnas 'dir lan grangs gnyis zhabs kyis bcags shing chos 'brel gsungs pa dang /rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs gos drub zhal thang bcu phrag gcig dang / khong nyid zhal 'don glegs bam gcig bcas rten gsum du ma dang / nor sgor khri phrag bdun lhag gi dngos rdzas kyi gnang sbyin rgya chen po bstsal pas chos srid gang ci'i thad bka' drin gyis bskyangs/ sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med 'od gsal zhes mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ldan pa nyid nas snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang / sangs rgyas stong dbang /rtsa gsum gyi dbang / bde chen zhing dbang / thugs rje chen po'i dbang / snying thig dum gnyis kyi lung dang rten gsum dngos rdzas kyi gnang sbyin rgya chen po bstsal/ yang mdo smad bstan bdag kun mkhyen drug pa khong nyid kyi zhabs pad gdan sa 'dir bkod de chos 'brel gsungs zhing sku gsung thugs rten mang po gnang zhing dgon par 'chad nyan sgom sgrub thugs mthun khrims gtsang sogs kyi bsngags brjod mdzad do/ /da lta sku gsung thugs rten rnying ba'i skor la/ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi 'dra sku lus tshad can/ tshe dpag med shing las bzos pas sku 'dra che ba gcig gu ru ston pa sogs kyi gser sku li ma byin can du ma bzhugs/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur tshad gcig brgyad stong ba dang bskal bzang sogs gser bris dang dngul bris po ti bcu phrag lhag rin chen gter mdzod snying thig ya bzhi gling chen mdzod bdun 'jigs gling pota dgu/ yig brgya'i dung 'khor dang thar mdo'i dung 'khor sogs gsung rten bzhugs/ thugs rten zangs gser las grub pa'i mchod rten cha brgyad dang byang chub mchod rten/ deng skabs kyi rten gsum dang lha khang la/ 'du khang che chung gnyis/ tshogs chen 'du khang thub bstan chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtsug lag khang chen po/ thig 'geb dang bcas tshigs gsum can/ phyi'i rdo rtsig dang spen rgyan mda' yab steng gyo 'beb brgyan cing ri dwags chos 'khor phyogs bzhir rgyal mtshan dang / dbus su byams khang steng du gser tog spud pa/nang du kwa ba ring thung bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i kwa tshar gyis mdzes shing / 'brug khyung chen tsir mgo pa tra shing lo sna tshogs dang gser mtshon gyi mdangs bkra ba sogs bzo bos mdzes rtsal phul du byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod/ rten 'jim sku bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa thugs rje can dang de'i g.yas su slob dpon snang srid zil gnon/ g.yon du rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po/ gzhan gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang mkhyen rabs bdag po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi 'jim sku gu ru bran brgyad lus tshad can — 544 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang khri gang tsam gyi thang stong rgyal bo'i bla sku/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'dra sku sogs bzhugs/ 'du khang nang 'khor steng 'og la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs kyi gyan thang gsum/ phyi khyams su rgyal chen bzhi sogs gzhan sangs rgyas stong thang / slob dpon stong thang / gu ru mtshan brgyad dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs bzo drub thang ga du ma/ mdzad bcu sogs bcu phrag drug lhag yod/ gsung rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshar bcu gnyis/ bstan 'gyur tshar gsum/ bka' 'bum pota bcu phrag lnga bcu lhag bde 'dus bka' brgyad/ gsang rdzogs bka' brgyad/ khro rol gdams ngag mdzod pota dgu/ ya bzhi/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ dpal sprul gsung 'bum/ rdo grub 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum sogs khyon pota stong phrag gnyis lhag bzhugs/ thugs rten du gser dngul las grub pa'i rdo grub rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku gdung khri phyed gnyis tsam rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra rgyan can/ 'du khang chung ba'i nang du zangs gser las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje'i 'jim sku lus tshad can/ rdo grub sogs dam pa du mas gnang ba'i ston pa/ tshe dpag med/sman bla/ sgrol ma sogs gter ma dang lu ma'i sku 'dra chung ba bcu phrag gu ru snang srid zil gnon stong sku/sgrol ma'i brgya thang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gyan thang / gsung rten bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig rin chen gter mdzod/ rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum/ mi pham gsung 'bum pota dgu/ mdzod bdun/ ya bzhi sogs dpe tshogs pota stong phrag tsam bzhugs/ thugs rten la dngul grub byang chub mchod rten chung ba dang mchod rten che ba/ rta mgrin lha khang gi nang rten la rta phyag khyung gsum/ klu dbang rgyal bo/'jam dbyangs/ thugs rje chen po sogs kyi 'jam sku lus tshad can mang po/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshwa khang byin can/ mtha' skor du bka' chos thar samado lam rim yig brgya sig dhi ma ṇi sogs kyi dung 'khor brgyad/'khor 'phreng du 'khor chung nyis brgya lhag bcas kyis dad ldan gang zag thams cad la gsang chen snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bstan don rgya cher spel bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /dbal ban tshang gsar ma'i dgon bkra shis dpal ldan gling / dbal ban tshang gsar ma'i dgon bkra shis dpal ldan gling zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong dbal ban tshang zhang gi khongs su chags/bkra shis dpal ldan gling ni khu sha ri khrod bkra shis dar rgyas gling dus kyis dbang gis nyams rgud du gyur pa dad ldan pa'i yid kyis ma bzod par dbal ban tshang gi grwa btsun shul lus 'ga' dang / dpon sde zung 'brel gyis bstan pa mi nyams yun gnas kyi ched du bla sprul rnams kyi mdun nas kun rig dang 'jigs byed sogs rgyud sde 'ga'i dbang lung khrid sogs zhus pa la/ kun rig bdag 'jug bdun sgrub dang ma ṇi bdun sgrub/ lnga mchod rnams la ru skor spyis mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten te yun ring gnas/ rjes su spyi — 545 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/lo1872la rnga ba ri khrod pa blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog dbal ban tshang gi sa cha skong gser khra mdo'i rma 'gram du sa de ga'i grwa mang dang lhan du rtse gcig sgrub pa la gzhol bar mdzad nas bzhugs/ khong ni lcags phag lo ste spyi lo1851lor yab dpal ldan tshe ring dang yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nga bzhi ba chu yos lo ste spyi lo1904lor dgongs pa rdzogs/ skabs der bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon ma lag brgya dang brgyad kyi nang tshan du dbal ban ser sde zhes 'khod/ lcags byi lo ste spyi lo1900lor gsar ma ba'i rtse dge blo 'phel zhes pas gtsos grwa ba bdun nag ṣe rin po che blo bzang chos 'phel mchog gi mdun la song nas lam rim chen mo'i khrid dang / mchod chog gi lung sogs zhus te khong gi thugs 'dun ltar 'bum lnga'i dus mchod bsgrub rgyu dang len bgyis par dbal ban tshang gi dpon dbal shul paṇa chen skyabs kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te legs par tshugs/ rje 'di ba ni chu kha ma'i nag ṣe tshang zhes pa'i khyim du chu khyi lo ste spyi lo1862lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gsum pa shing glang lo ste spyi lo1925lor dgongs pa rdzogs skad/ khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs su ṣe tshang sku phreng bzhi ba dkon mchog rgya mtshos dgon pa 'di phul/ de yang ṣe tshang sku drug po ni/ dang po/ rgya gar gyi chu bo ghang ga gyen du drangs pa'i grub dbang dharmā pā la'am grub chen nyi ma 'dzin zer/gnyis pa sgom chen blo bzang thub bstan mchog gsum pa dmu dge'i ṣe tshang ste grub dbang blo bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ bzhi ba ṣe tshang blo bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho mchog gis dgon par dus mchod 'ga' dang gso sbyong dang dbyar gnas gsar du btsugs shing gzim chung bzhengs pa'i gyang ldebs su skyabs mchog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bla ma mchog gsum ma hor yig can dang dus 'khor rtsa sngags sogs lan war can/ stong chen yig lnga yig drug dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs rgyud sde so so'i rtsa sngags dang dkyil 'khor tshon ris bris/ ṣe tshang sku phreng lnga ba mchog ni bye gshong yab dpon po yid bzhin mgon po dang yum dbal bza' chos 'tsho'i sras su lcags stag lo ste1nga90lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa me glang lo ste1922lor dgongs pa rdzogs/ de nyid kyi yang sprul ṣe tshang blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni bye gshong yab bdud 'dul dang yum mgon po 'tsho'i sras su me glang lo ste1927lor sku 'khrungs/dgung grangs bdun bzhes skabs su kun mkhyen lnga ba dang ye shes mkhyen rab rgya mtsho gnyis kyis thugs bzhes yongs mthun ngang sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo brgyad kyi steng khrir 'khod/ shing bya lo ste1945lor yang srid mchog nyid gtsos grwa rgan tshos 'du khang gsar bzheng gi gnas legs par gzigs te 'du khang ka ring bzhi ldan thog mar grub po/ /'di'i rten bzhugs gsung rten gyi skor la bka' 'gyur mtshal dpar gtsos po ti lnga brgya lhag sku'i rten la thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa dang sgrol ma gnod sbyin li ma sogs gser sku dang sman sku shing sku sogs brgya lhag thugs kyi rten khyad par can gyi gdung rten bcas dang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan tsi dung rnga sbub sogs mchod rdzas 'dod dgu lhun gyis bkang 'dug skabs der dge 'dun gyi sde la bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge — 546 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bskos/ spyi ba/ tshogs 'du rgan pa/ dkor gnyer/ mchod dpon sogs las sne cha tshang la tshogs 'don gyi char yang rgyugs brtsi bzhag 'don dbyangs rta sngar las bzang ba gsar du tshugs/ me sprel lor dad ldan bsod nams dar rgyas kyis sbyin bdag byas nas cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar du 'dzugs skabs/dngul rwa dgon nas 'don rta dbyangs dang dgon pa'i phyag len sogs cha nges pa'i rabs 'byams pa chos shul rnam rgyal dbyangs dpon du bsus te/ dbyangs phyag len sogs smon lam chen mo'i cho ga 'thus tshang legs por tshugs/ dgon par 'du khang gzim chung 'khor khang sogs khor yug gra 'grig cing grwa ba brgya lhag dang grwa shag nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa bcas sa pho khyi yi lo ste1958lor dus dbang 'thor rlung drag pos gtor bshig tu btang nas gyang ro 'ga' lus su bcug rjes su lcags mo bya lo ste19ra1lor chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus nyi gzhon gsar ba'i 'od snang las chos mthun chu skyes kyi tshal rab yongs su bzhad pa'i dus bzang slar shar ba dang bstun/ thog mar ṣe tshang mchog sprul rin po che dang grwa rgan 'gas bstan 'gro'i skyabs mgon dam pa gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug la dgon gnas gang du spor rgyu'i bka' lung zhus pa la bkra shis chos lung du legs zhes sa ming gnang ba ltar gzhis gsar du 'du khang dang grwa shag sogs kyi cha rkyen med par sbra gur nang re zhig 'tshogs nas rim bzhin grwa shag 'ga' phub/ chu pho khyi lor kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog sku dngos su phebs pa'i skal bzang thob/ dad ldan ser skya yongs la dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ dmigs brtse ma/ sham+bha la'i smon lam/ dpal ldan dang bo ma sogs kyi lung dang chos srid kyi dgongs don gnad la 'khel ba'i zhal gsung zab rgyas gnang zhing / rma nyin bkra shis chos lung da lta'i dgon sa 'dir thugs smon rgya chen pos rab gnas gnang zhing byin chags par mdzad/ chu phag lor tshogs chen 'du khang gsar du bzhengs shing / bkra shis 'khyil gyi sngags rams pa 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel gyis byin rlabs mdzad cing de phyis kun mkhyen drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas rab gnas gnang / yang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bshes gnyen rje sbyin pa rgya mtshos lam gtso'i khrid dang / 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang sta gon bcas gnang / me yos lor dpal ldan bla ma sbyin pa rgya mtshos lam rim chung ba'i khrid lung dang / rig gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang skyabs 'gro'i khrid sogs dang dge tshul slong gi sdom gyi bslab pa bkod/ gung thang rin po che rje 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug lags phyag phebs dus su/ dbal shul dpon po dkon mchog skyabs sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yin pas de'i thog drangs dad ldan ser skya khri phrag du mar slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i dbang dang bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs bcas dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed dbang gi rim pa dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang rnams zab rgyas su bstsal/ de 'phral 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis dbu khrid de tshogs chen 'du khang nang bkra shis 'khyil dang / sgo mang sgar/ mtshan nyid sgar sogs 'dus pa'i rtsod grwa tshugs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig par mdzad/ dus 'khor gyi mchod rten bzhengs pa'i rten du/ dpal dus kyi — 547 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/'khor lo'i sku gtsos sku 'bum phrag brgya dang brgyad cu lhag bzhugs/ chos kyi bya ba la yang bskyar dngul rwa dgon pa'i rab 'byams pa skal bzang don grub kyis 'don rta dbyangs sogs kyi phyag len nges pa khrid cing ṣe tshang blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos 'chad nyan sngar yod gong 'phel dang sngar med gsar 'dzugs bgyis so/ /dgon pa 'dir rgyun tshugs 'chad nyan gyi rim pa la/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo cho ga cha lag 'thus tshang dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag 'jug bdun sgrub la thigs chog gar 'cham sbyin sreg klu chog bcas/'jigs byed kun rig gsang 'dus sogs rgyud sde/ dbyar gnas mchod pa nyin bcu la rgyun 'tshogs/ rnga chings lha tshes gso sbyong sogs kyi phyag len phal cher bkra shis 'khyil dang bstun/ da lta 'du khang chen mo/grwa shag lnga bcu lhag btsugs shing ra ba/ shar du rnam rgyal mchod rten/ lho ru 'od dpag med kyi lha khang /nub tu rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu'i lha khang / byang du 'od dpag med dang thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/jo 'brom rnam gnyis/ mi la ras pa/ sgrol ma dkar sngon/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ ma cig lha lnga sogs bzhugs pa'i lha khang / dbus su sangs rgyas stong sku'i lha khang / da dung mgon khang dang rung khang sogs bskrun/ gzhan spus ka legs pa'i 'khor khang che chung mang po bcas bzhengs/ da lta bla btsun brgya lnga bcu lhag bzhugs nas chos spyod thams cad rgyun ldan du spel bzhin mchis/ dgon pa slar gsos rjes da thug bar khri thog dang bo rab 'byams pa blo bzang mthar phyin te/ khong rje tsong kha ba bdag nyid chen po'i gdan sa 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas ched mngags dbal ban tshang gi dbu blar phebs pa dang /khri rabs gnyis pa bya btang ri khrod pa skal bzang nyi ma/ khri rabs gsum pa rab 'byams pa skal bzang dar rgyas lags/ khong gis lha khang che chung dang / 'khor khang ring thung / mchod rten/ 'cham lwa rus rgyan la sogs dang / gzim khang bcas pa'i rten bzhengs dang spyi 'jog 'bor che bas dad ldan skye bo kun gyis bsngags shing yid du 'jags par gyur/ zhor du dgon pas rang gso'i ched du tshong khang dang / sman khang tshugs/ rlangs 'khor nyos/ phyugs zog brgya phrag du ma bskyangs so/ /rtse dbus ri khrod dga' ldan bsam grub gling /rtse dbus ri khrod dga' ldan bsam grub gling zhes pa ni/ kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong nyin ma zhang du chags/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing yos spyi lo1725lor gcod pa ye shes tshul khrims kyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ grub mtha' gtso bo dge lugs su gtogs kyang rnying phyogs kyi chos spyod kyang du ma zhig phyag len byed ba'in yod (dang thog bon po'i lugs yin tshul bshad rgyun yod)/ gcod pa ye shes tshul khrims 'di nyid dbus su lan gnyis phebs nas paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya — 548 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mtshos snar thang bka' bstan dang sku rten mang du gnang / rta tshag rin po che'i zhabs brtan du gtor ma brdabs par mtshan ma khyad par can byung ba sogs kyis a mdo'i grub chen phu rung ma zhes pa'i snyan grags rgyas/ri khrod btab dus dang rjes su 'du khang sogs thabs chag tsam las med kyang / phyis su gung thang tshang gis mthun rkyen sbyar nas 'du khang dang gzim khang rgya bskyed/ tshoms chen dang bde yangs gsar du bskrun/dkon mchog 'od zer gyis gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsugs/ gcod pa sku phreng rim byon gyis bskyangs/ grwa shag bco lnga tsam phub/ nang rten gyi skor la/ jo bo pad+ma ra ga dang thub sku/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba/ tsong kha brgyad cu/ bka' bstan 'gyur/ rgyal dbang rim byon dang rje yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum bcas mang du yod/ lha sde'am mchod gzhis su nyin ma spyi'am de'i nang nas rtse dbus pa(rtse zhig) yin/ sngon ri khrod 'di ha cang dar dus su 'du khang dang rung khang / tshoms chen/ mgon khang gsum/ grwa shag bco lnga/grwa ba drug cu lhag bzhugs/ spyi lo1958lor lha khang dang grwa shag nang rten sogs thams cad 'jig nas shul med du song / da lta nyams gso legs po zhig byung med do/ /be shing dgon dga' ldan rab rgyas gling /mdzod dge nyin ma'i be shing dgon ni/ da lta kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rma chu rdzong du chags/sngon paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan rgya gar du phebs dus/ skyabs mgon mchog la sngon gling rje ge sar gyis bzung ba'i yul/ mdzod dge phyogs su mi rabs du ma dar 'dug kyang da phan gang 'dra yod mi shes pas/ de'i sa gnad zin pa zhig tu dgon pa btab na phan thogs yod pa 'dra/ khyod kyis dgon pa zhig thob zhes bka' gnang ba thugs la btags/ de nas phyogs mang bor brtag pa'i nang nas sa dkar(tsha gan)steng 'di legs tshul byung ba bzhin dgon pa 'debs rtsis mdzad kyang/ mdzod dge'i dpal mgon sogs kyis sa ma thub pas/ kun mkhyen nyid kyis 'dir dgon pa btab na khyod tsho la bzang / gang ltar dgon pa zhig 'debs rgyu yin zhes gsungs so/ /rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags byi lo1780lor brag lung gong ma nas dgon pa'i dbu 'dzugs tsam mdzad phyir/ gnas gzigs dang sa brtag bslangs/ bkra shis gso sbyong sogs mdzad/ de'i phyi lo lcags mo glang spyi lo1781lor be si nas rdo rams pa blo bzang dang / bka' bcu dpal ldan rgya mtsho sogs grwa ba kha shas bsdus te rdo rams pa khong gis dge bskos gnang / rkang tsha'i bsod nams rgya mtshos dbu mdzad byas te grwa tshang tshugs/ rdo rams pa dang tshar tsha'i dge legs rgya mtsho gnyis kyis tshogs gleng byas te rten 'brel bsgrigs/ hor tshang gser khri rin po che khri bar bskos/ khong gis 'du khang ka ring gnyis dang rgyan nyi shu can zhig bzhengs/ skabs der grwa shag bco lnga tsam yod/ sku gsung thugs rten la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sman sku sogs 'ga' bzhugs par bshad/ khri rin po ches lo dgu'i ring la skyong khur gnang zhing /— 549 —

kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rma chu rdzong gi khongs/de nas bla brang tshogs chen gyi khri bar phebs/ khri tshab tu zam tsha sprul ba'i sku gdan sar bkod/ de nas skabs shig kun mkhyen mchog nas zam tsha rin po che la rma rme 'dres mdo 'dir lha 'dre mngon sum du gnas pa lta bu'i sa shin tu rtsub pa'i stabs kyis 'di phyogs su sa gnon gyi dgon pa zhig 'debs rgyu'i thugs dgongs kun mkhyen gong ma la paṇa chen mchog gi bka' yod cing / de bsam thog tu khel bas dgon pa spo ba'i gros mol mdzad nas khong rnam gnyis tsha gan be shing du mtshan mor phebs te/ gnas gzigs dang lto 'phyes brtag cing shis brjod sogs mdzad/spyi lo1790lor dgon sa spos pa dang khong gis sbyor 'jags su thebs rtsa mdzod dge'i a ma tshang la rta brgya gnang ba dang / shar ba rnam rgyal/ a was byams pa sogs khyim mgo nyi shu bsnan te dpon po lha rgod/mgon tshe/ bsod nams gsum la bcol gtam mdzad/ dngul rwa'i dgon sar dge ldan dam chos kun rgyal gling tshugs bar du dngul rwa lha sde dang de'i khri ba gcig mthun yin/ yang zam tsha 'jigs med nam mkha' dpal bzang gi khur bzhes kyis chos sde 'di sa rta'i bar du bskyangs/ de nas khong rgya nag tu phebs dgos byung bas/ tshab tu mkhan chen sku phreng gnyis pa grags pa rgyal mtshan khrir bskos/ khong khrir lan gsum bzhugs nas yun ring bskyangs/ sngar brag lung gong mar gnas skabs kun mkhyen bar ma phebs te bde mchog sogs bka' chos mang du gsungs nas bde mchog gi sgrub mchod btsugs/ gnas 'dir spos rjes rim gyis 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur te/ rab byung bcu bzhi shing phag la kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtshos chos grwar brtsi bzhag gnang ste mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa thog mar tshugs/ sa phag la kun mkhyen bzhi bas dus 'khor gyi sgrub mchod btsugs pa dang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag la kun mkhyen lnga bas gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod btsugs te mdo sngags zung gi 'chad nyan bshad sgrub kyi srol byung / sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ 'jigs med dbang bo'i sku brnyan dang gnas brtan bcu drug tsan dan jo sku/dus 'khor gyi sku sogs shin tu mang / gsung rten la/ bka' 'gyur gser bris/ rje yab sras gsum/dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me sogs kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs/ sngon dgon pa ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su grwa ba brgya dang lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ nyung dus la nges pa med/dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi skor la dgon pa'i lha sde'am sbyin bdag gtso bo ni mdzod dge nyin ma'i ru sde bcu gnyis yod/ de la dud khyim lnga brgya lhag yod par tshang ma 'brog las yin/ sbyin bdag de dag gis dgon pa lo rer mar chur dang sha phye rtsam sogs 'bul bzhin yod pas de'i lo gcig gi grwa ba'i 'tsho ba'i yong sgo brgya cha'i sum cu lhag zin/ gzhan grwa ba rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i yongs khungs de rang khyim dang grong chog bcas la brten pa yin/ dgon pa'i slob gso'i skor la/ dgon pa 'di ni bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi dgon sde zhig yin/ bshad grwa'i mtshan nyid skor gyi yig cha ni/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas sbyangs pa yin/ sgrub mchod skor la/ dus 'khor dang / bde mchog thugs rje chen po/ gsang 'dus — 550 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs yod/ dgon pa'i mkhan po'am khri ba ni rgyal tshang dang smad sog nor bu tshang sogs bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas mngags/ dge bskos dang dbu mdzad do dam u yon lhan khang gi mi sna rnams ni dgon pa rang nas bsko ba yin/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1958lor dgon pa'i lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams rmang nas 'jig go/dgon pa yang bskyar slar gso byas tshul ni/ spyi lo1982lor khul chos lugs cus kyis dgon pa yang bskyar chos sgo phye chog pa'i chog mchan thob ste sngon ma nang bzhin rta mgrin lha khang / tshogs chen 'du khang /grwa shag nga lnga bcas bzhengs/ sbyin bdag gtso bo mdzod dge nyin ma'i mang tshogs rnams yin/ nang rten gyi skor la/ rgyal tshang dang smad sog nor bu/ rta mgrin/ byams sku sogs shin tu mang / da lta dgon par grwa ba brgya dang bcu bzhugs/ deng skabs dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi yongs khungs ni/ dgon pa gzhung la 'bri brgya lhag skyong / rdzong thog tu mgron khang gyan bdun dang tshong khang gyan gsum yod pas de gnyis nas lo rer sgor chig khri lnga stong lhag thon gyin yod/ dgon pa gzhung la par khang zhig yod pa bcas gong gi de dag gi yong sgo rnams kyi grwa ba'i 'tsho rten byed pa yin no/ /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/༄khya/ / yin zha ha'e rigs rang spyong khul/lin zha rdzong gi khongs/bod dgon dkar chagalin zha rdzong ni kun su'u zhing chen gyi lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul te rma chu'i lho ru chags/ shar du skya ga'am ho ṭin rdzong dang ka ju mkhar/ tong zhang rdzong la 'dres/ lho ru gnyan chen phyogs bcu'i a mye'i byang 'dabs nas gtsos grong khyer gyi mnga' khongs kha gya stod dang 'brel/ rgya dang he/ tung zhang / sa lar/po an/ hor/ bod sogs mi rigs du ma 'dus la/ bsdoms pas mi grangs sum 'bum yan du brgal/gna' snga mo nas 'jang dang bod sogs rigs du ma 'dus sdod che ba'i yul gru zhig yin par bshad/de yang rdzong 'dir nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa ni rgyal phran bcu drug skabs nas dar skad/ thang po yon(longalo)skabs su/ rma chu dang tsong chu'i rgyud sogs ni bod kyi sa yin/ bod brgyud kyi nang bstan yang rim gyis 'phel/ jo sras kyis srid dbang bzung skabs bod brgyud nang bstan snga ma las je rgyas su phyin/jo sras kyi blon po lis li tsung(ཿ༅za)bya ba tsong dkar bla chen dang / mnga' ris stod kyi btsun pa dga' ldong bcas bla slob stong dang bcas 'dir phyogs te sangs rgyas kyi chos spel/ skal ldan gyi dang ba drangs/yon rgyal rabs kyi dus su bod btsun don yod rgyal mtshan dang rje de nyid kyi spun mched han dpal mo bya ba ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hong lbu srid lo drug pa(spyi lo1 272)la sa 'dir tshong zog brin/ hong lbu srid lo nyer gnyis pa spyi lo1289bar/ bod btsun don yod rgyal mtshan gyis dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang mnyam du bla ma dbu mdzad kyi khur bzhes/ hong wu srid lo nyer lnga ste spyi lo1292par dgon pa de nyid mes 'jig pa dang / gong ma chen po'i bka' lung yar sgo rnying ba(༅ཿ༅)la dgon gsar rgyag mdzad pa nas bzung ste/ han cis(da ltar rdzong gzhung gnas yul)phyogs kyi dgon pa'i las khur ba ni don yod rgyal mtshan/ han lis/ bkra shis pa/ rin chen bzang bo/ dbang stobs dpal ldan/ nam mkha' snying po/han lo han sogs dang / rgyal po'i dbu blar phebs myong ba bsod nams rgyal dang / han pad ma/ han dkon mchog skyabs/ rten lung bkra shis/ pad ma bsod nams sogs mchis/ de'ang rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa sa khyab rdo khyab lta bur gyur pa ste/ ming dang man ju rgyal rabs ni sa cha 'di gar bstan pa bla lhag du dar ba'i skabs so/ /— 552 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/de'ang sngar gyi grangs su thebs pa bsdoms pas nang ba'i dgon pa bzhi bcu zhe dgu yod par bshad mod/da ltar dngos su'am bstan du yod pa sum cu so brgyad las med/ 'di dag phal cher bod dgon nam bod dgon du 'gyur ba yin tshod red/ da ltar grwa btsun bcu gcig dang / bla ma gcig do dam las sne bcu drug dad ldan mang tshogs drug khri nyis stong lhag 'dug ces chos lugs do dam las khungs kyis smras/ des na 'dir mdo smad chos 'byung du yod kyang mi gsal ba'am yang na brda mi mtshungs pa sogs ci rigs mchis na'ang / dri gtug dngos las byung ba dag gzhi bcol te spel ba gsham gsal lo/ /pa li zi'am sgo mog bkra shis bde chen gling /pa li zi'am sgo mog bkra shis bde chen gling ni da lta'i lin ha rdzong ma ṇi dgon lung zhang bkwan than sde khrod du chags/ grub mtha' dge lugs/ rten pa lha mo/thog mar bzheng ba'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hong lbu srid lo nyer lnga ba spyi lo1292pa yin/sde 'di sngar nams lho sgor bsod lo(tshelkotsho༅)chags/ man ju rgyal rabs kyi dus dkyil tsam du sa le brgyad kyi mtshams te da lta'i dgon sa 'dir spos shing mtshan la pa li zi'am(sa le brgyad kyi don)bkra shis sgar du gsol/ de phyis nye logs kyi bkwan pa dgon dang lhan du bsres/ grwa grangs ba dun brgya son/ dgon sa mu'u lnga bcu lhag tu 'du khang che chung gnyis/ bla brang nang chen dang grwa shag la gyan nyis stong lhag sa zhing mu'u brgya lhag phu lung gnyis dang mdun ri rgyab ri'i nags tshal thams cad/ dar rgyal rdza rgyud du rtswa sa sogs mi nyung ba yod/ mchod rten mthong grol chen mo dang rgyal ba'i bka' rin po che/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ bde mchog sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhugs kyang / man ju gong ma kong zhi(lkolko)skabs dang1958lo'i dus zing gi dbang du gyur/ gna'i cong chen ming grags can zhig yod pa de lcags bzhu chen po'i skabs su 'jig rdzing rdo las grub pa'i rdo seng ge cha gnyis bzhugs pa las cha gcig ka ju'i mkhar grong gi hong yon bya ba'i spyi gling dga' tshal gyi sgo chen khar bshams pa de dang / cha gcig ni snga mar dar shing gi rmang rdo byas/ da ltar lha khang gi gyang sne zhig las med par skyon thebs kyang re re'i rgyab ngos su dar mo che re btsugs te mjal yul du snang bas/ snga ma'i lo rgyus kyi bden dpang gi tshul du bzhugs/ sde de'i rdo rtsig lhag lus dag kyang mthong ba tsam gyis bod kyi bzo bkod kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa tshegs med du rtogs thub/ sde 'dir chag 'jig lan du mar byung na'ang ming go srid lo nyer brgyad pa(spyi lo1929)dang(1980)la mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs la brten bskyar bzhengs kyang lan du mar byas pa'i bka' drin gyis/ da ltar yang btsun pa gcig las ma yod kyang / snga ma'i phyag len bzhin/kun rig dang 'jigs byed/ lha mo'i bskang ba sogs 'don pa ste/ gcig pa'i smon lam/ bzhi ba'i smyung gnas/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod/ zla rer ma ṇi 'don pa'i srol sogs rgyun 'khyongs/— 553 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/sde 'di bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i le lag tu gtogs la/ a lags rgya zhabs drung che chung sku na rim gyis bskyangs/ da lta chung ba tshang rgya gar du 'khrungs yod/ pha yul dngul rwa red ces zer('di srid gzhung gis khas 'ches rabs ni med)gang ltar 'dir nang chen yod pa ma zad/ bla brang du'ang nang chen yod/ de yang rgya zhabs drung ngam krang kya zhabs drung gi skye rabs skor la/ deb ther rgya mtshor/ gong ma chen pos kyis 'ang tas lo zir(rtsa1༈ṣ+ṭhalhasner+sha)bsngags shing / dngul phog kyang 'thon/ krang kya zhabs drung gi gong ma se ra'i lha rams pa zhig yin/ sku phreng mang zer ba tsam las zhib cha ma rnyed/ gzhung nas mkhan chas dang bka' shog gi gzengs bstod che/ de'i skye brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tsun du shan zhin gyi bsang yig zhu mkhan dkon mchog skal bzang yin la/ de'i sprul sku 'jigs med blo gsal rgya mtsho da lta bzhugs/ krang kya 'bas drung blo bzang 'jigs med dpal ldan gyi sprul sku bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri mdzad pa(khri rabs so gsum pa)'jam dbyangs skal ldan/ de'i sprul sku mkhas btsun 'dzoms pa blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho khong yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa las blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sprul sku gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang bo skal bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho kun lho rma chu dngul rwa'i yab chos shul rgya mtsho dang yum mu thal ma cig skyid kyi sras su rab tshes me sprel 1896lor 'khrungs pa de'o/ /de'i sprul sku gong du zhus pa rgya gar du yod ces pa de'o/ /'dir bshad pa'i krang kya zhabs drung blo bzang 'jigs med dpal ldan pa krang kya che ba'i skye phreng dang / gong zhus se ra'i lha rams pa ni krang kya zhabs drung chung ba'i skye phreng dang bor bshad/ de'ang 'di gnyis la bshad tshul mi 'dra snang ba dang / krang kya chung ba'i skye rgyud yod kyang 'dren du ma nges pa sogs dpyod ldan dag gis dpyad 'tshal/mdor na dgon sde 'di lo rgyus ring zhing 'chad nyan 'bar ba'i stobs kyis/ snga mar phyi nang sog po'i yul nas kyang gnas mjal du slebs pa shin tu mang bar bshad/ da lta 'du khang phyogs bzhir khyams ra yod pa gyan gsum can zhig bzhengs pa la/ sgo chen yang 'os 'tshams shig dang grwa khang gyan drug bskrun yod/ 'du khang nang du smi gang dang phyed can gyi thugs rje chen po dang dpal ldan lha mo'i 'bog sku/ rje rin po che dang thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi thang ga re/ lam sngags sogs sgo 'phyor rgyal chen bzhi bzhengs yod/ dgon sa mu'u gsum/ dad ldan dud khyim drug brgya lhag la mi grangs sum stong lhag tu son/da lta'i dgon bdag btsun pa yon tan rgya mtsho lo nyer lnga(1997) can/ bod skad smra shes shing hor tshang tsag tsag tu slob gnyer la 'bad mus su snang ngo / /ma ṇi zin gya sku skye'i dgon/ma ṇi zin gya sku skye'i dgon pa ni yul gnyan chen po dar rgyal lhun po'i shar byang ste/ da lta'i lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi ka ju rdzong ma ṇi dgon zhang(/khuzazolo༅r+shahāspyirmyu)zin gya sku skye'i dgon pa(7 r+sār+sha)zhes pa de red/— 554 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon pa'i mtshan de mdo smad chos 'byung du zin gya sku skye'i dgon zhes 'bod de/ zin gya sku thog gong ma yul 'di nas zin gya rus tshang la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas rdo ldan byams pa gling gi chos grwa 'grims te bla ma ma ṇi ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ khong gis bla ma'i bka' bzhin rang yul du ma ṇi chu 'khor grags can zhig bzhengs/ de nas bzung yul der ma ṇi lung zhes thogs/ sku nar son phyin shar ri bo po ta lar phebs nas mjal ba dang 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i 'khor bcas la rim gro phan ldan bsgrubs/ rim gro'i phan yon du kyā ching gong mas khong la dgon pa 'debs pa'i rten 'brel du tsan dan gyi byams sku dang / dngul lugs jo bo/sangs rgyas stong sku li ma/ gzungs 'dus mtshal dpar/ chos dung g.yas 'khyil/ gzengs bstod kyi bka' shog sogs bstsal par grags/ rang yul du log phyin ma ṇi yod pa'i nye logs su dgon pa zhig btab pa la ma ṇi dgon zhes dad ldan tshos btags/ 'du khang thog mar bzhengs te gong ma'i rten skal rnams bzhugs pa dang / sman 'dam las thugs rje chen po khyad legs bzhengs/ de phyis btsun pa'ang brgya tsam zhal 'dzoms te yul grong du ma ṇi dang smyung gnas kyi rgyun rgya cher spel/ de'i phyi ma kun lho'i hor gtsang bsang dkar thang du sku 'khrungs/ gdan sar 'khod rjes bla ma du ma'i zhabs bsten cing gdan sar 'chad nyan legs po btsugs pa dang / thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyams len la gzhol/ khong gi gzim khang phub/dbyang tshang dpon mo(༈rmoza77)zhes pas bkur nas dgon pa bdag gir bskyangs/ zin gya sku phreng gsum pa slar hor gtsang 'bru 'dren zhes pa'i grong nas sku 'khrungs/ sku gong ma'i dus la dgon pa skyong khur mdzad/ zin gya bzhi ba yang hor gtsang shing sgo'i dpon skor nas sku 'khrungs shing gdan sa rang nas slob gnyer gnang / 1928lo'i snga phyir dmag gshed mā chis dpung bskul te dgon pa 'phrog bcom byas pa khong gis bsod snyoms byed pa la sogs brten nas nyams gso ci thub mdzad/ sku phreng lnga ba 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho da lta ba/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag1928lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nye logs za yus lam shar grong tsho nas yab tshe ring dang / yum skal lo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen lnga bas zin gya sku skye yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar 'khod/ bla brang dus 'khor grwa tshang gi chos grwa 'grims thing / nu gu skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul mnos pa dang / dus 'khor blo gros dge rgan du bsten nas grwa tshang gi rgyugs 'bul bcas thugs bzhes gnang / zhor du rang gi dgon pa skyong khur byas/ 1985lo'i rjes su dgon pa rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ rje 'di ba gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs te lin zha rdzong (ka ju)srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes/ 1982lor paṇa chen bcu ba yul 'di dag tu phyag phebs nas chos sbyin bstsal pa dang / yul mis dgon pa slar gso'i snyan seng yang yang zhus par/dgon gnas snga ma las thang ga zhes par spar te dad ldan thang ga dang / kun than/ kra'o gya bcas grong tsho gsum gyi mang tshogs chig stong lhag gis 'du khang gsar du bzhengs pa dang / rten du sngar ltar thugs rje chen po zhal bzhi ba dang lha mo'i snang brnyan sogs cung rgyas pa bzhengs/ da lta dge 'dun 'ga' re 'dus nas — 555 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/dus chos rgyun 'khyongs dang sri zhi'i mchod 'bul tshe gtor sogs gtong bzhin mchis/ dgon mthar ma ṇi zangs shum can bcu phrag bsgrigs pa la smyung gnas srung mkhan mi ser mi nyung ba yod/ da skabs rje 'di ba kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong du bzhugs shing rdzong srid gros kyi u yon byas pa'i skabs so/ /dgon chung 'dir sngon chad bla ma rnam pa'i sku drin dang mang tshogs kyi dad dbang gis 'du khang bzhengs pa ma zad/ spyi khang / lha mo'i btsan khang / zon gya bla ma'i gzim khang / grwa shag bcu phrag phub la/dge slong dar rgyas zhes pa gtsos pa'i dge btsun nyi shu rtsa grangs zhal 'dzoms/ de bzhin chos spyod spel ba la zla dang bor cho 'phrul smon dang / sa zlar ma ṇi bum sgrub dang smyung gnas/ zla brgyad par kun rig bdag 'jug zla bcu bar dga' ldan lnga mchod sogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i phyag srol ltar 'ga' re tshugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi'i phyis su dgon pa gtor ba dang btsun pa rnams grong tsho'i zhing las su zhugs/ bla mas rgyal khab kyi bya ba phyag las su gnang / yin na'ang zon gya sku skye khong gi sku drin thugs rje spyan ring las da lta dgon pa'ang cung legs lam du 'phel ba'i skabs so/ /tshon gya mu'o khro yen dgon/h+phan gya nu 'e khro yon dgon ni lin zha rdzong ma ṇi dgon zhang go tung hran sde khrod du chags/sde 'di thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni man ju gong ma'i dus su bshad la/ ming go srid lo brgyad par 'jig spyi lo1942lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ 1968lor rig gsar gyis rkyen te 'jig1981lor slar gso mdzad/ sa mu'u gcig dang phyed kyi steng la lha khang rgyan gsum/ logs khang rgyan gcig bcas bzhengs/ de la dad mi dud khyim nyis brgya sum cu lhag las med do/ /han gya dgon/yul mdo smad kyi lha gnyan dar rgyal spun gsum gyi shar mtshams su 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sku dbon tā dbon che chung gnyis las chung ba yin zer/ drung ba don yod rgyal mtshan pas tā'i ming rgyal bo las ku shri'i 'ja' sa blangs/ yon rgyal rabs kyi mgo tsam la ka ju'i phyogs su drung pa mgon po seng ges han ngos su btab pa'i lo rgyus tā dbon lo rgyus su gsungs/ gtsug lag khang sogs rgya che zhing ngos gtsang / sde ba chos rje'i rnam thar du/ / han dpon pos gdan drangs/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa rab gnas dang /rje'i tshems kyis gtsos pa'i rten dang brten pa mang ngo / /tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa'i ring bsrel las grub pa'i thub sku/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i snam sbyar/ byams chen chos rje'i sku chos/ gong ma rgyal bo'i dbu zhwa sogs dang / tā dbon lo rgyus las 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i phyag dril gser mgo ma yang 'dir bzhugs par chos 'byung du gsungs/ gang ltar bla dpon zung 'brel gyi sgo nas dgon 'dir legs par bskyangs pa'i han sku phreng rim byon ni/ a mdo chos 'byung ltar na sprul ba'i chos grags rgya mtsho da lta'i rkang tsha nas 'khrungs pa — 556 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang / sku phreng bcu gsum dang ba ku la'i sprul ba zer/ de'i sprul sku hor gtsang shing chen nas 'khrungs tshul bshad/ 'di'i sprul sku skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho mchog co ne khya dge nas 'khrungs shing / kun mkhyen lnga bas han mchog sprul thag bcad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan sar bkod/ sa dmar bstan 'dzin dge rgan du bsten nas gzhung lugs la sbyangs pas phar phyin dam bca' bzhag sman pa dang / shis tshang dgon pa'i khri yang mdzad/ 1958lo'i zla bzhi ba'i bco lnga nyin bla brang nas dgung lo nyer bdun steng sku gshegs so/ / sngon chad dgon 'dir 'du khang / mgon khang / rung khang / han nang chen rgyan so bdun dang /grwa shag sogs kyi nang du rten gsum du ma bzhugs shing / sngon dus dgon pa dar dus grwa ba stong phrag gsum tsam 'dus skad dang / srung ma dam can bsten cing / bla brang smad rgyud ltar gyi phyag len dngos gtsang tshugs/ ho'u kya zi dang / krang kya zi/ bkwan ho zi/ rta gsar dgon/ brag phug dgon/ h+phu han dgon/ han gya dgon sar/ han gya zi zhol ma/ lung chen dgon bcas sde 'di'i dgon lag tu gtogs/sngar thugs rje chen po'i sku byin can zhig yod skad las gzhan mi gsal/ 1958lor han sku phreng nyer gcig pas dar rgyal mtsho las gser nag gi bum pa zhig rnyed pa rtecha 'gangs can du brtsi'ang da ltar mi snang /gser zangs tsan dan te rgyu sna kha gsum las grub pa'i tham ga che chung gsum yod skad kyang mi bzhugs/ zla ngo re'i bco lnga dang gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la dgon nang du chos spyod kyi bya ba snang la/ bla mchod smon lam/bskang ba sogs gsung / snga mar rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang /han tshang sku phreng rim byon gyi gdung rten dang thugs rten bzhugs/ da lta'i dgon bdag rgya skal bzang zhes pa dgung lo bdun cur nye ba des shog sgor sum stong drug brgya phul te dgon par sgo chen tshon ldan zhig bzhengs/dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'bul sdud la brten nas lha khang gyan gsum/ rung khang gyan gnyis/ mgon khang /grwa shag kyang gyan 'ga' bzhengs grub/ thugs rje chen po dang / sman bla/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/mgon chos lnga/ dam can seng zhon ma dang dam can ra zhon ma'i thang ga bcas bkur/ da ltar mthun rkyen 'dir brten te skya ser gnyis ldan gyi do dam las sne btsugs shing / rgyun ldan gyi chos spyod spel mus su snang bas dad ldan rnams dga' 'os pa'i ngang du gnas so/ /'bog chen mo na ku'i ri khrod/'bog chen mo ni ku'i(ṣ+ṭha༅hāsnyi)ri khrod ces pa ni/ de da lta'i lin zha ste ka ju ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi ka rdzong 'bog chen nam mo ni ku'u zhang(/ṣāzaza༅hāspyi༅)gi khongs su chags/mdo smad deb thar rgya mtsho ltar na ri khrod 'di gnas rnying zhig yin pa 'dra/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu stag1792lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo chibs sgyur gnang skabs su ri khrod nyams chag tu gyur te gnas sdod pa re gnyis tsam las med stabs/ khong gis yul mir bskul ba mdzad phyir slar dge 'dun pa — 557 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/bcu lhag 'dus skad/ spyi 'jog tu dong tse chon sum brgya dang rta nor mang tsam 'tsho rten du bstsal cing /khong gi gzim khang zhig skrun pa'i bkod khyab yod la sdong rgan zhig la 'dre 'khor ba khong gis spyan khro mdzad de zhi ba byung tshul snang / 1902lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mchog gis bstan srid kyi 'phrin las 'ba' dgongs te yul phyogs der phyag phebs/ 'bog chen khog gi yul dpon che chung dang rgya che'i mi ser gyis mdun bsu bkur sti rgya cher spel/ skabs der ri khrod nyid sngar bzhin lhun chags par mchis/ phyis su yang bla kho rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rnam thar drangs po'i gtam gyi tshang zhes par mo ni ko'u a dpon gyis byang rgyud kyi dgon sde rnams brlags zin nas lho rgyud 'joms su 'ongs zhes pa ltar ri khrod la gnod 'tshe thebs/ 'bog chen bla ma yul phyogs gzhan du byol pa dang 'bog chen to mo dgon pa sogs bsnubs/ mchod gzhis rgya bod mi ser gnas spor ba'i nyen gtse khel te rang sar ha'e rigs grong sde du ma chags gshis da lta gna' shul tsam du mngon no/ /g.yang gya la ga'i zon gyi dgon/g.yang gya la ga'i zin gyi dgon zhes pa ni/ da lta'i lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi ka ju rdzong mā ci zhang(/khyazazobra༅༅༈rmozar+haca༈4)4r+sha)gi khongs su chags/dgon pa'i lo rgyus rtsad chod pa ltar na/ gna' dus su sgrub la gzhol mkhan zhig yun ring bzhugs pa'i shul du g.yang gya dpon po zhes pas bla ma gang gi bka' bsgos ltar 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po gtsos pa'i rten bzhugs sa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs/ mthong thos kyi skye bo mang bos bkur mchod lhur blangs gshis legs tshogs kyi bya ba thams cad yar ldan du byung zhing mi ser gyi dad pa'i 'dod mos tshim/ skabs shig 'khrug rkyen sogs las lha khang nyams chag tu rgud cing lo re bzhin mi ser gyi lo tog sad ser
