gyis yang yang bcom nas med mug gi sdug bsngal thebs/ mi ser mi nyung ba sdod ma tshugs par yul byes su 'tsho rten dmigs par chas/ de nas mchog gsum la dad 'dun che ba'i g.yang gya dpon mo g.yang ne ne(༈rmo༅7)zhes pas grong tsho dag bskul cing sne khrid de/ da lta'i kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong gi hor gtsang shing sgo'i bsang dkar thang nas 'khrungs pa'i zin gya sprul sku(yo)za.oṃlta)zhes pa gdan drangs te/ g.yang gya grong tsho'i dkyil nas drag po gsum sbrel gyi sku 'bum lugs shing / bla mas lo drug cu tsam gyi ring la yul 'dir sad ser mi 'byung ba'i dam bca' bsgos/ phyi lo ma zad lo de nyid nas kha dro bkra shis yong bas mi ser rnams rang shugs su zin gya bla mar dad gus rtse gcig tu byung / g.yang gya dpon mo dang bcas pas dgon pa dang grong tsho'i mgo khong la gtad cing phul/ dus de nas bzung zin gya sku rim byon gyis lha khang bdag skyong gnang /mi ser la chos sbyin gang dgos yid tshim pa bstsal pa'i srol dar/ srung ma lha mo bsten cing tshes gtor bskang gso rgyas pa 'don/ zin gya bla ma'i gzim khang dang / grwa shag 'ga' phub/ 1902chu stag lor skyabs — 558 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mgon skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug 'bog chen phyogs su phyag phebs par yul mi thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur rgya chen zhus/ yang rje thu'u bkun skal bzang dam chos nyi ma bla brang du phebs lam 'bog chen khog tu brgyud cing mi ser la zhi ba lam zab dang / zhi byed gcod kyi lus sbyin gsungs nas chos don zab mo spel/khyad par du bka' drin can gyi zin gya mchog sprul dang g.yang gya a khu bcas kyis rigs gsum bzlos brjod yun nas yun du gzhol cing / smon lam sogs chos spyod kyi cho ga phyag len rnam dag re rgyun 'khyongs/ dus 'khor blo gros dang dar rgyas sogs rgyun bzhugs mdzad do/ /1958sa khyi lo'i rjes su dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bsnubs/ de snga chos sgo slar phye rung ba'i chog mchan 'khod phyin zin gya sprul sku 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos mi ser dad ldan rnams bskul te dgon pa'i lha khang dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i dang lha mo'i rten rnams slar bzhengs/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung rin po ches kyang dgon 'di nas mes po yar 'phel zer ba zhig byon zhes gsungs/ da skabs su g.yang gya la ga dang / kun then/ kru'u bun gya bcas grong tsho gsum mi grangs stong phrag lhag gi mchod gzhis yod la/to ma dgon dga' ldan bstan 'phel gling sogs kyang bod rgya mi rigs zung gis bskyar 'debs byas so/ /yun khrang dgon/yun thang dgon zhes pa ni/ da ltar lin zha rdzong tan gyi cis su chags myong / de thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs yin par bshad/ sngar dgon pa rgya che zhing brten dang rten pa phun tshogs pa bzhugs/ bla grwa'ang nyis brgya lhag tu son/ sa zhing la mu'u stong phrag lhag yod par grags/ grub mtha' dge lugs/ bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub grwa gtso bo yin tshod/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lu'i srid lo bcu bzhi ba spyi lo1416par/ sngags 'chang ba zhig la chan shri(ཿlo/ )zhes pa'i 'ja' sa'i tham ga dang bka' shog bstsal/ man ju gong ma'i ring la'ang gau shrī(༅lo/ )rgyal po'i dbu bla zhes pa'i cho lo'i tham ga bka' shog dang bcas pa bstsal/ 1958lo'i yar sngon tsam du grwa ba ha lam bzhi bcur nye ba bzhugs skad/sde 'di lo rgyus ring zhing grags pa che bas/ nye 'khor rdo sbis/ bis mdo sogs mtsho sngon zhing khongs kyi dad mi dang hor gtsang shing sgo phyi nang gi skye 'gro thams cad mchod mjal du yong bar yang grags mod/ man ju thung ṭi rgyal po'i skabs dang1958lo'i bar rkyen sogs dus zing du mas rkyen pa dang slar gso rang byed ma nus par bag la nyal lo/ /hri mu'i dgon/hri mu'i dgon ni lin zha rdzong ṭang tsi go'u zhang khongs sa dkar sde ba'i l+yang cin re la chags/ snga mar nam bzhengs dang brten rten pa 'don pa phyag len gyi lo rgyus rang mi gsal/ 19rnga2lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ mā ṭing yu'o bya bas 'dzin bdag bzhes/ bdag gnyer ba skya ser drug las grub/ rgyun bzhugs — 559 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/kyi chos spyod pa mi gsum/ 'du khang ngam lha khang la smi lham po 90dang / dgon sa spyi la smi lham po140yod/ /rta sar dgon/rta sar dgon ni lin zha rdzong ṭang tsi go'u zhang khongs rta sar sde khrod du chags pa'i cha nas dgon ming la'ang de ltar 'bod/ spyi lo1925bar gsar du bzhengs par grags/ 1942lor rgya bskyed pa las brten dang rten pa legs tshogs su song / dgas rtsis byas na'ang sgor chig khri'i ma rtsa yod/ de dag thams cad1958lor 'jig 19rnga1lor bskyar bzhengs/ rgya bla ma zhes pa'i lo sum cu yas mas can zhig gis 'dzin bdag mdzad/ dgon sar mu'u phyed las med/ dad ldan dud khyim bdun cu longs pa la mi grangs sum brgya bdun cur nye/ da lta'i rten brten pa bsdoms na'ang sgor drug stong lhag longs zhes dri gtug las thos /gad pa'i khug dgon pa/gad pa'i khug dgon pa ni lin zha rdzong ṭang tsi go'u zhang khongs gad pa ru sde'i khrod du chags/ thog mar chags dus ni spyi lo zhes pa ma grags pa'i gong rol yin par bshad/ phyis su ming rgyal rabs su bod brgyud nang bstan du 'gyur/ thung ṭi'i skabs dang1958lo'i dus zing gis 'jig 1992lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ dgon sar mu'u phyed las mi 'dug lha khang la smi lham po60dang / grwa shag logs khang la smi lham po 40yod/ dgon par rgyun bzhugs pa grwa ba gcig dkor gnyer lta bu'i las sne gcig rten par thang ga re gnyis ma gtogs gsung dang thugs kyi rten rang mthong yul du mi snang ngo / /phu kong dgon/phu kong dgon(smo༅r+sha)ni lin zha rdzong ṭang tsi ko'u zhang gi cha'o kya pho(sbyo4lo)sde khrod du chags/thog mar 'debs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hong spu'i skabs te spyi lo1400ba yin par grags/sde 'di'ang han tshang sku na rim gyis 'dzin bdag mdzad/ grwa grangs brgyad cu lhag tu son myong / khri ba bla brang nas gtong / 'du khang la gyan lnga/ shar nub gnyis su gyan bcu lhag yod/ phyis thung ṭi'i skabs dang1958lo/ rig gsar bcas dus rkyen du ma'i nang du 'jig 19〈7lor slar gso mdzad/ bod btsun bgres po dgung lo brgyad cu gya grangs su son pa zhig bzhugs/ mtshan la blo bzang 'od zer du 'bod/khong la dri gtug zhus kyang lan gsal rang mi 'drongs/ zhus ru'u cwang dang mi lnga las grub pa'i dgon pa do dam las sne tshos yar ldan du spel mus su yod/ da lta'i dgon pa'i sa khyon smi lham po drug brgya drug cu lhag yod do/ /— 560 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/l+yang cin dgon/l+yang cin dgon ni lin zha rdzong ṭang tsi go'u zhang khongs pe thu yo'am sa dkar sde khrod du chags/ thog mar bzhengs dus ni thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bshad/ 1958lor 'jig 1995lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ 'go 'dzin la ṭo ston men zer/ bdag gnyer ba mi mda' bzhi las grub/ dgon sar khyon smi lham/ po1ra0yod/ rdzong srid gzhung chos lugs las shag gis bskyar bzhengs kyi thebs su sgor bdun brgya lnga bcu gnang / /kra'o the pe hran dgon pa/kra'o the pe hran zi(lor+haskakhular+sha)dgon pa ni/ da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin hā rdzong zhin ci zhang zha hrong thang sde bar(lo༅༅rwalokhro)chags/ chos sde 'di kra'o dbyin tru(lo7cho)zhes pa dgung lo don lnga bzhes pa'i rgya rigs chos bdag cig gis skyong bzhin mchis/ chen rgyal rabs nas dgon pa 'di yod zer/ rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul nang shul lus dang bcas bsnubab / sngon chad mchog gnas legs shos yin te nang ba'i bstan pa rgya brgyud gang rung spel skad/ da lta'i lha khang gyo tog can mig lnga bo dang / logs khang mig gsum bcas pa1996lor mang tshogs kyi re 'dod bzhin gong nas chog mchan thob phyin bskyar du bzhengs/ ston pa gtsos pa'i lha sku mi nyung ba dang mchod rdzas nyung shas re bsgrugs/ sbyin bdag dud khyim nyis brgya bcu lhag la mi grangs1050yod pas lo re'i zla dang bo dang bzhi ba/ dgu bar chos spyod spel ba rgya che zhing dmangs khrod rnam thar/ lab rtse bstod pa/ ser 'gog la sogs bsgrub par bya ba'i skabs so/ /yon lba zi dgon pa/yon wa zi(k+ṣakhyahatshor+sha)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa(ka ju) rdzong zhin ci zhang zi wan sde bar(/slazazar+sāzo༅༅7)chagab//dgon pa 'di 'debs 'go cung snga zer ba las khungs dag yig rigs ma rnyed mod/ da lta bod rigs dge 'dun pa krang skal bzang (1dzi 7 za) zhes bya ba dgung lo nyer gsum can gyis skyong bzhin mchis/dgon pa nyid spyi lo1989lor nye logs mchod gzhis mang tshogs grong tsho gnyi ga'i mi ser sum brgya lhag gi sbyor 'jags la brten nas/ da lta ston pa'i lha khang gcig(sme so drug)dang logs su grwa shag sgo chen bcas khang mig lnga thub pa la/ do dam las sne mi drug mang tshogs kyis bskos par/ lo re'i zla dang po dang bzhi ba/dgu ba bcas par chos spyod cung rgya cher spel pa las dus rgyun mang tshogs tshos mchod bkur 'phrin bcol re byed ba'in pa'i skabs so/ /— 561 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/krang chi dgon/krang chi dgon ni da ltar lin zha rdzong zhin ci zhang khongs mu'i gya sde khrod de ka ju dang hrung khrin gnyis kyi sa dkyil gyi nub ri'i sked du chags/snga ma'i lo rgyus mthong yul du ma smin/ dri gtug la gzhol yang ma rnyed/ da lta'i dngos gzhi tsam bri ba la/ spyi lo1982par bskyar du bzhengs/ sa khyon mu'u gnyis kyi steng la lha khang rgyan lnga dang grwa shag gyan bzhi phub/ lha khang du mgon po/ lha mo/ rnam sras sogs mgon chos lnga'i thang ga re dang / rje rin po che/thugs rje chen po/ sgrol ma bcas kyi sku rten dang / ting 'phags bskal gsum/ rgyan 'jug tshe mdo/kun rig bskang ba/ smon lam rnam lnga/ gzungs 'dus/ brgyad stong ba/ lam rim chen mo/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs gsung rten bzhugs/ rnga gcig sbub gcig dung dkar gcig tsi cha bcas mchod cha bsgrugs/ lnga ba'i tshes lnga ni dus chen du brtsis nas mgon chos dang bla mchod sogs gsung /ngagon bdag thub bstan rgya mtsho bya ba rgya skad du krang the ye zer/ sngar bla brang du slob gnyer byas/ da ltar khyim las log ste dgon nang du sku tsha gtsos lud to'i nang sde khrod nas 'ongs pa'i btsun chung zhig dang mnyam du rgyun bzhugs mdzad mus/ dus rgyun chos thog ces nges gtan zhig ma mchis pas grong chog la brten te 'tsho ba rol/ 'tsho ba las lhag ma dag dgon pa zhig gso dang rten bzheng gi rgyu ru gsog mus yin zhes btsun chung gis smras/ sde 'di'i lha sde la ri grong bdun dud khyim bdun brgya lnga bcu lhag yod do/ /phun lo ye'i gdan sa phun kya dgon/mdo smad chos 'byung du phun lo ye'i gdan sa phun kya dgon zhes gsungs pa ni/ da lta len zhwa khul len zhwa rdzong ka zhin ci zhang yar to'i hran zhes pa'i sde dbus su chags/dgon 'dir sa skya ba dang bka' brgyud pa'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa dag gis sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i lte gnas yin tshul ngag rgyun du grags/ de rjes phun lo ye'i zhes pa'i kun spungs 'di nyid las yid dam chos skyong du ma'i bsnyen mtshams mang du bzhugs nas ser ba bkag skabs nye 'khor thog skyon ma byung ba dang /dad zas gshin zas mi za ba'i tshul mthun zhig byung zhes gsungs/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kirti 'phrin las rdo rje dgon 'dir gdan drangs te chos 'brel zhus/ rje kirti bas yul grong mang bo mthong sa nas gang ser ma gsungs shing shis pa brjod/ phun lo ye sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang 'jigs med zer ba ni hor gtsang ko nyin kya kyin du 'khrungs/ gdan sar 'khod rjes hor gtsang tsho 'du 'jigs med yon tan gyi drung nas rab byung dge tshul mnos/ rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phren las rgya mtsho'i drung nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang dus 'khor dbang chen sogs chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ hor gtsang tsag tsag dgon pa'i chos grwar yun ring 'grims shing gzim khang bskrun pa dang / gdan sa'i 'du khang rgya bskyed du bzhengs shing / nang rten da 562 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/thugs rje chen po dang / mnyam med tsong kha ba chen po'i sku brnyan/ lha mo'i rten thang sogs lha rten chos gsum mi nyung ba bzhugs/ tsag tsag dgon pa'i phyag len ltar bde gsang gi cho ga spel/ ma ṇi dmigs brtse ma zhal 'don gang rgyas gnang mthar dgon 'di nas sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku phun lo ye sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang rgya mtsho ni sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul hor gtsang kya kyin zhes pa'i sde khrod du yab dkon lo dang yum sgrol ma thar gyi sras su sa byi1948lor 'khrungs/ hor gtsang khri chen blo bzang dpal ldan pas ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ kya kyin gyis ye shes dge rgan du bsten te chos spyod sogs bslabs/ 1958lor dgon pa bshig 1980lor sprul sku 'das/ sku gdung tsag tsag dgon du bzhugs shing / dgon pa slar bzhengs rjes sngar gyi lha mo'i rten thang sogs la mchod 'bul byed bzhin yod cing / mchod gzhis sde ba gsum gar mi khyim sum brgya lhag mchis so /hu'u kya zi dgon pa/ hu'u kya zi(/lkomor+sha)zhes pa ni/ da lta 'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong hong the zhang zan ta ban grong(0r+ha༅ngamalokhro)'gram du chags/dgon 'di'i mtshan tsam mdo smad chos 'byung du drangs 'dug rtsad chod pa ltar na chin rgyal rabs( tsho4shu)mjug tu btab kyang cung ma 'gor bar1918lor yul 'khrug tu 'jig de nas1924lor dgon pa sngar gnas su slar bzhengs par sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs chen mang bo bsgrugs shing dge 'dun pa rgya bod gnyi gas bskyangs zer/ 'byor med gral rim rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul nang dgon pa bsnubs nas slob grwa chung ba btsugs/ 1982lor slob grwa'i zur du dgon pa'i lha khang bskyar du bzhengs/bod rigs btsun pa wang pa'o zhi(4༅zlo)dang do dam las sne lngas skyong bzhin zla re'i tshes bco lnga la chos spyod rgyun ldan tsam spel ba'i skabs so/ /khyon pa'o lha khang /chon pa'o lha khang(2༅lo)zhes pa ni/ da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong hong the zhang du chags/mi ser gyis gleng ba ltar na/ chen rgyal rabs mjug tsam du btab pa dang rgya brgyud bod brgyud nang bstan sbrags ma spel myong skad/ 1958lor lha khang rten dang brten pa thams cad shul tsam ma lus par bsnubs/ 19nga0lor slar gsos shing de phyin thub pa'i lha khang mig gsum dang logs khang mig bzhi can phub pa dang ston pa sogs 'jim sku du ma bzhengs/ lo re'i zla rer chos spyod gnyis re rgyun 'khyongs/ dad ldan mang tshogs stong phrag bzhi lhag yod/ da lta'i bdag gnyer mkhan po kra'o blun ho(lo4waṃ)rang lo nga lnga ba dang do dam las sne gsum gyis pas skyong khur byed bzhin no/ /— 563 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/byams chen dgon pa/byams chen dgon(nga.oṃr+sha)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa hong the zhang yo ha'o grong tshor(༅r+ha4smodi1gokhro)chags/gna' dus bod dgon yin la sangs rgyas kyi li sku che zhing mtshar ba zhig rten gtsor bzhugs pas yul mi rnams kyis byams chen gnas mchog ces 'bod skad/ 1958lor rten dang brten pa yongs su bsnubs/1984lor mi ser dad ldan du mas slar gso'i re 'dun yang yang zhus mthar chos lugs bya 'gul spel gnas byed du bcug thub pa khang dang bcas pa'i khang mig bzhi phub/ sa khyon smi lham po sum brgya longs/mchod gzhis sde ba gsum la mi grangs bzhi brgya lhag yod/ da lta'i bdag gnyer mkhan li'u dbyi(mo1༅)zhes la rang lo nga lngar zon pa dang gzhan las sne bzhi yod/ lo re'i zla dang bo dang zla re'i nya tshes la mchod bkur klog 'don rgyun ma chad par spel bzhin no/ /hra'u gya dgon chung /hu'u gya dgon chung ni(/ṣ+ṭha47/)r+sha)da ltar len zhwa rdzong hong the zhang du chags/han gya dgon pa ste a lags han tshang gi gdan sa de'i dgon lag tu gtogs/ sngar gyi byung ba lo rgyus rang mi nges/ da lta lha khang gyan gsum can gcig dang / mgon khang gyan gsum/ grwa shag gyan lnga bcas bzhengs shing / dus gsum sangs rgyas dang thugs rje chen po/ sgrol ma/ mgon chos lnga'i thang ga dang /lam sngags gnyis bcas sku dang gsung gi rten du bzhugs/ dgon par lha sde khyim tshang nyis brgya lhag yod la/dgon pa'i dus chen ni zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lnga yin/ da lta do dam las sne mi 'ga' las grub ste dus rgyun chos spyod kyi bya ba'i khur bzhes te yar ldan du spel mus so/ /tā ko'u zi chos 'khor gling /tā ko'u zi chos 'khor gling dgon pa 'di da lta'i len zhwa khul len zhwa rdzong hong the zhang(ram̐1tshe༅ mtshosnyidzo'i)gi khongs su chags/deb ba ther rgya mtsho ru/ gsang phu'i dka' bcu mdzad pa ser smad dge bshes shes rab kyis stag lung dgon las zur du phye nas btab/ de'i sprul sku ngag dbang rgyal mtshan ser smad du chos grwar 'grims/kor+sha'i dmag 'khrug dus gzhung gi bkas dmag thog tu phebs dgos byung / bse khrab pas 'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas g.yul las rgyal/ gzhung gis bdag rkyen che bas khams tshan du mchod rdzas sogs 'jog pa che/ de'i sprul sku dbang drag rgyal mtshan/ han tshang dang sku mched/ ser smad du thugs gnyer mdzad pas dge bshes thon/ smad du chu med sar char 'beb sogs la nus pa thon pas 'phrin las rgyas/ rang — 564 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon du 'du khang dang chos 'khor bzhengs/ co ner bka' 'gyur gdan 'dren du byon skabs dgon du dam bca' bzhag gong ma cheng skabs lud khrir bzhugs/ drug pa la ri khrod btab/ rgyun par 'jigs byed bla mchod chag med la/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod tshugs/ nyid tshogs nam yod la byon nas ri khrod pa rnams la bka' gdams pha chos bu chos dang / mar mi'i rnam mgur gsungs nas blo sna bsgyur thabs kho na mdzad/ paṇa chen rgya phebs dus sku 'bum du mjal/ ri khrod mtshan la theg mchog nor bu'i gling zhes bstsal/ gtong thebs dang bka' gnang bzhin ā+o kya tun du bde mchog gi cho ga bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ yar ngo mang ngo'i tshes bcu la chag med kyi 'don rgyun btsugs/ mi tra rdor phreng sogs bka' chos mang du gnang / kun mkhyen bar ma gdan drangs/ kun rig bsnyen yig kyang rtsom bskul zhus/ don gsum pa la gshegs/ hor tshang gser khri sprul ba'i sku dang dbus nas thugs 'brel che bas dgongs rdzogs la gdan 'dren zhus so/ /de'i phyi ma sgang kha sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin nyi ma ni/ kha gya'i phyogs bcu'i dkar bo steng du yab kha gya'i dpon rgyud klu 'bum dang / yum snying mo skyid kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos1747lor 'khrungs/ bse 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis sgang kha dbang drag rgyal mtshan pa'i sprul skur thag bcad/ stag lung sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma la rab byung zhus/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs stag lung dgon par phebs skabs phyag phyir khrid de 'di ga'i chos grwar zhugs bcug sngar nyid kyi gong mas kun mkhyen bar ma dgon par gdan 'dren zhus/ skye ba rjes mar bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa ba zhig yong ba'i smon lam zhus pa la zhwa mo gnang ste de ltar 'grub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thog tu khel/ phar phyin skabs dang bo dang 'grel ba don gsal bzung nas tshogs rgyugs phul/ nyer drug pa la smon lam rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags thob/ mdzod nas rang gzhis ri khrod du re zhig bzhugs/ de nas dbal shul stod smad/ rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar/ byams chen dgon/ mtshan sgrogs dgon rnams kyi khri mdzad/rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad lo bzhi dang / rgyud pa'i khri lo gsum gyi ring mdzad/ phyis zur bzhugs mdzad nas phyi nang gang du yang mi bsko ba'i bka' shog zhus te legs mdzad gong 'phel du gnang ba ma zad ri dgon gnyis legs par bskyangs/ de'i sprul sku sgang kha skal bzang 'jigs med ni/ bla brang sa dkar sde khrod du yab bkra shis dang yum byams ma'i sras su 'khrungs/ sgang kha sprul sku dngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/kun mkhyen bzhi ba mchog dang rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas zab chos zhus/ gdan sa'i ri dgon gnyis sku gong ma'i dus ltar yar ldan du bskyangs/ ri khrod du rta mgrin gyi bcad rgyar bzhugs te zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mdzad/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du rta mgrin lha khang gi rten brten pa bzhengs/ me glang1927lor sog yul nas sku gshegs so/ /de'i sprul sku rgan gya'i kha gya'i 'brog sder yab mgon po don grub kyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i khye'u skal bzang zhes pa de nyid/ kun mkhyen — 565 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/lnga bas sgang kha sprul skur dngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod rjes sku tshe mthar ma phyin par gshegs so/ /de'i yang srid sgang kha bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags yos1951lor yab tshul khrims dang yum sangs rgyas 'tsho'i sras su a mchog tu sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen drug pas ngos 'dzin brtag bsgril thog mar thag bcad de me bya lor gdan sar bkod/ dge bshes sbyin pa dge rgan du bsten nas 'bri gyi klog bslab/ nu gu skal bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho bla mar bsten nas chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ 1958lor rjes su dgon ri khrod bcas pa gtor/ sa zhing mu nyi shu yod pa sogs thun mong gzhung la bsdus/ chos sgo slar phye nas sprul sku dbu bskul te dgon pa bskyar du bzhengs/ khong nyid da lta gan lho'i bsang chu'i rdzong gi srid gros u yon gyi 'gan bzhes te zhabs pad lhun chags su brtan to/ /hrang gya lha khang /hrang gya lha khang(lozalo)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong hong the zhang lbang pa'o grong(༅r+sha༅rwa༅kho)du chags/rtsad chod pa ltar na/ lha khang 'di phal cher chin rgyal rabs mjug tsam du bzhengs grub/ rgya khyon chen por ma 'phel la bod brgyud dam rgya brgyud nang bstan mi sheb/ te1980lor rgya brgyud ltar bslar gsos/1958lo'i mchong skyod chen po'i las 'gul nang rtsa gtor btang / da skabs ston pa'i lha khang bskyar du bzhengs pa khang mig gsum rten dang bcas pa grub/ sa khyon yang smi lham po lnga bcu lhag las med/ zla lnga ba'i tshes gcig dang nya la spos 'bul chos 'don gyi cho ga phran tshegs rgyun ma chad par yod/ skyong khur ba thang san bkon(ṣ+ṭhastso+o)zhes pa'i dge bsnyen lo drug cur son pa zhig dang do dam las sne bzhis skyong ba'in no/ /cho'u gya go'u dgon pa/cho'u gya go'u dgon pa ni/ lin zhwa rdzong hong the zhang zhin khrin ci'i cho'u gya go'u bya ba'i sde khrod du chags pa'i cha nas de skad zer/ sde 'di'i lo rgyus de 'dra rang mi snga/ 1958lo dang rig gsar gyi chom po las 'dzur ma thub/ 1984lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang la smi lham po62dang / shar du smi lham po1ra/ nub tu smi lham po40can zhig bzhengs/ zhing sa la smi lham po 652 4/ dad can gyi grangs nyis brgya lnga cu/ grwa ba gcig do dam las sne mi gsum las grub/ /kwang h+pho zi dgon pa/kwang h+pho zi dgon(༅k+ṣar+sha)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong hong the zhang khrin kya hran(༅r+sha༅od+ku )grong nyer chags/— 566 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/chos sde 'di ha lam yon rgyal rabs tsam du btab pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa zhig yin/ rgya khyon chen po min yang lo rgyus rig gnas yod pa'i gras su brtsi/ 1927lor he jag mā krung dbyin(bra4sko༅)gyis bcom brlag thebs kyang bslar bzhengs pa de1966lo'i rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul nang brlags/ da lta sa mu'u gcig dang skar do'i nang ston pa gtso 'khor bzhugs pa'i lha khang mig gsum bzhengs/ bgres po lo don lnga can gyi mi drug gis skyong khur byed bzhin pa'i skabs te lo rer btsun pa re gdan drangs nas chos spyod dad ldan yid smin pa re byed bzhin no/ /hung the'i kha gya dgon/hung the'i kha gya dgon pa ni da lta lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong gi hong the zhang lis gya mu'o zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/ mdo smad yul gyi lha gnyan chen po rdo sbis dar rgyal lhun po'i shar byang phyogs kyi nye 'dabs su yod/mdo smad chos 'byung du dgon 'dir kha gya dgon zhes mtshan tsam las gsungs med kyang / shar tsong kha'i rgyal bo dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus nas btab pa'i dgon rnying zhig yin par grags/ 'du khang nang rten gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / khru drug can gyi ston pa/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor 'o / bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ mgon chos lnga'i thang ga sogs/ bskal 'phags ting gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ dgon bdag bla ma'i sku gdung mchod rten bcas bzhugs/ tsi dang sbub sogs lha cha mchod cha 'ga' bsgrugs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyud smad ltar gyi sgrub grwa tshugs/ dus rkyen gyi dbang gis dgon pa yang yang chag 'jig thebs nas1929la dgon pa nyams gso byas/ dgon pa'i mchog sprul skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis nyams gso rgyas par mdzad/ gzim khang bskrun/ dam pa 'di ni kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen po ha lam spyi lo1〈91lo tsam la han stag lung phyogs su chibs sgyur mdzad skabs/ kha gya dgon pa'i sprul sku zhig ngos 'dzin gnang nas mtshan la 'di ltar gsol/ kun mkhyen gyi drung nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma sogs gsan/ gter lung bse lnga ba sogs bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs te zab chos zhus/ grub dbang kirti ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa mchog 'bag chen phyogs su phebs skabs mjal nas gus 'dud lhur len byas/ dam pa 'di chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang zhing bshad sgrub kyi tshugs ma shor bar bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan kho na zhig yin ces rdo ldan byams pa gling gi mchog sprul ma ṇi ba blo bzang 'phrin las kyis gsungs/1958lor sprul sku rin po che dang dbon po thub bstan bcas nyes med btson du sku gshegs so/ /dgon par sa zhing mu'u nga gnyis dang / drel rta sogs yod pa gzhung la bsdus shing dgon pa bsnubs so/ /chu khyi1982lor dgon slar gso byas te lha khang rten dang bcas pa bzhengs/ srung ma dam can la bskang gso gtor 'bul byas/ kha gya'i cha skam sgom grwa nas phebs pa'i a khu rig grol dang de'i slob ma mgon — 567 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/po zer ba sogs grwa ba bcu phrag bzhugs/ smon lam dang lnga mchod bcas kyi chos spyod spel bzhin yod/mchod gzhis khyim tshang sum brgya tsam yod do/ /mo'u chi dgon/mo'u chi dgon ni lin zhwa rdzong khongs hong the zhang khrin tho sde khrod du chags/bcing grol sngon du bzhengs skad las nam yin gsal bo rang ma nges/ rig gsar skabs 'jig da ltar slar gso mdzad/ sa mu'u gcig gi steng la lha khang 'os 'tshams shig bzhengs yod/ dad ldan dud khyim brgyad brgya drug cu yod do/ /khro yin dgon/khro yin dgon ni lin zha rdzong g.yon byang bla kha(46lo) zhang tshule gya grong gi byang rir chags/thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par bshad/ sde 'di ni lo rgyus ring zhing gzhi rgya chen po zhig yin stabs/ rma chu dang tsong chu'i rgyun du ming grags ha cang che ba'i dgon sde zhig tu gyur/ rgyal rabs du ma brgyud pa las dgon sa lan du mar spar/ dper na man ju'i kong zhu rgyal po'i skabs su ka ju'i mkhar nang gi tā pis srang lam du spos/ der yang brten dang rten pa mang zhing grwa rgyun yang mi nyung tsam 'dus skad/ 1978lor da lta'i dgon sa 'dir spos/ khyon la smi lham po1950dang / khang sar smi lham po445lha khang chen mor smi lham po 20 0/ logs khang la smi lham po145/ grwa shag la smi lham po60yod/ dgon pa do dam las sne skya ser dgu las grub/ dgon bdag mi gcig ste rgya'i dge slong zhigamatshan la shag ru te zer/ dgung lo bzhi bcu son tsam/ lo bcu gsum nas rma chu rdzong be shing dgon du zhugs nas 'chad nyan la 'bad/ 1988lor phyir rang dgon du phebs te 'dzin bdag mdzad de bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du spel mus su yod/ /thugs rje chen po'i lha khang /thugs rje chen po'i lha khang ngam dgon pa ni lin zhwa rdzong g.yon byang bla kha zhang gi ṭu phan sde ba'i ka mon gya grong tshor chags/thog mar bzhengs dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi hong lbu srid lo gsum par bshad/ 19〈1lor slar gso mdzad/ dgon sa spyi la smi lham po40 0 0yod/ lha khang la smi lham po2 2 0dang / logs khang la smi lham po2ra0yod/ grwa ba gsum yod pa rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ gzhan grong ba gsum gyis las sne'i khur bzhes/'dir lha sde phal cher ni zhing khag brgyad dang ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs mi sogs kyang 'dir 'ongs/ /byung gya phen dgon/— 568 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dung gya phen dgon ni lin zhwa rdzong g.yon byang bla kha zhang gi hrang hri sde khrod kyi tung gya phen grong tshor chags/thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni man ju thung ṭi'i skabs su bshad/ de la chag 'jig lan du mar byung / rten brten pa gang yang ma lus/ 1981lor lha khang rgyan gsum/ g.yas g.yon gyi log khang la gyan drug ste dgon sa spyi la smi lham po600yod/ do dam las sne mi drug las grub/ mnga' 'khor du grong tsho brgyad dud khyim brgya dang brgyad cu la mi grangs bzhi brgya lhag yod/ da ltar srid jus bzang bo'i bka' drin las bya ba lam 'gro 'ong mus su yod/ /ko gya grong dgon pa/ko gya grong dgon pa ni lin zhwa rdzong g.yon byang bla khang zhang ko gya grong sde khrod du chags/thog mar chags pa'i dus ni dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs sum cu ba yin/ 1976lor bskyar bzheng gi tshul du lha khang gyan gsum logs khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa la smi lham po100yod/ dgon pa'i las sne skya ser mi drug las grub/ yon bdag gam dad can dud khyim brgya dang lnga bcu la mi grangs bdun brgyar longs/ sde 'dir yig cha rang ma mthong la/ dri gtug tsam yang bcol du ma snang bas 'di tsam las 'bri ma nus so/ /kyang ca tse'i lha khang /kyang ca ṭi'i lha khang( ༅zaṭhalo)zhes pa ni da lta'i len zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong nan yān zhang(tshelo༅ )du chags/chos kyi dben gnas 'dir sngon chad rgya khyon che zhing bzo bkod shin tu legs par gleng / 1958lo dang1966lor snga phyi mang tshogs kyis las 'gul spel skabs rten dang brten pa yongs su bsnubs/ rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul rdzogs tshun dad ldan mang tshogs grong tsho bzhi'i mi grangs nyis stong tsam gyi chos dad mkho ltar chog mchan thob nas lha khang mig gsum dang rten gsum bzhengs/ lo re'i zla dang bro dang gsum pa/ bzhi bar dgon du btsun pa gdan drangs nas chos spyod gzab rgyas spel ba dang / zla gnyis pa'i tshes lngar lab rtse bstod pa'i srol rgyun rgyun 'khyongs/ lha khang dang bcas pa'i rgya khyon smi lham po864yod/da lta'i skyong gnyer mkhan ta'o lban kha'o(༈1zosgo)ni rang lo re brgyad son pa dang do dam las sne mi bcu yod do/ /grang hu nub lha khang /krang hu nub lha khang(༅kho.olo)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong nan yān zhang(lolo༅77lokhro)du chags/— 569 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/bshad rgyun la ming rgyal rabs(wa/shu )su btab/ skabs der rgya khyon che zhing dge 'dun pa'i tshogs rgyas/ bcings 'grol byed skabs su mchod gzhis grong tsho chen po bzhi(hri zer ba'i 'og tu rang byung sde ba du ma 'dus)/ mi grangs nyis stong tsam gyis mchod bkur byas/ 1958lor lha khang bsnubs/1987lor slar gsos/ sa khyon ni smi lham po60 0yod/ lha khang rang dang grwa shag sgo chen stabs bde re phub/ pa dang rten gtso rnams sman skur bzhengs/ dus rgyun du zla re'i nya tshes la phyag ma chod 'bul ba dang /zla ba'i ba dang dgu ba'i nang chos 'don pa dang lab rtse bstad de lo de'i 'phrin bcol gzab rgyas byed/ da lta'i skyong khur ba'is mkhan ni krang zi la'o zhes pa'i dgung lo don bdun can dang do dam pa mi bdun bcas yod do/ /zha'o tse'i lha khang /'a'o ṭi'i lha khang(71)ཿlo)zhes pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong nan yān 'ang kra wang grong(tshelo༅nyidzirwakhro)du chags/dang thog dgon pa ming rgyal rabs su btab par gleng / bod brgyud nang dgon e yin snyan pa las gsal thag ma chod/ mchod gzhis grong tsho drug yod par lha khang dang grwa shag bcas rten dang brten pa mang mod/ dus phyis yul 'khrug gi chag 'jig che bar mngon/ da skabs sa khyon smi18 0gnang ba'i nang du lha khang chung chung phub par thub pa gtsos pa'i 'jim sku re bzhengs/ lo re'i zla lnga ba dang bdun pa'i nang dge 'dun pa 'ga' re gdan drangs nas chos spyod cung che ba spel/ da lta'i lha khang don gnyer pa ni krang zi ye zhes pa lo lnga bcu lha ga can dang do dam pa bzhis skyong khur bgyi skabs so/ /zhe gya pho lha khang /zhe gya pho lha khang(slo/zonyanyulo)zhes pa ni lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong nan yān 'ang zhe kya pho grong sder(khreganyasto༅khri༈pho'onyanyurnye1)chags/go thos ltar na chos sde 'di ha lam ming rgyal rabs(༅1shu)su btsun pa mkhas grags shig gis btab zer/ skabs der yul de'i chos grwa che shos shig yin te deng sang grong tsho bcu ba'i yod par mi grangs bzhi stong lhag gis mchod bkur byed/ phyis su dgon pa bsnu bas nas bskyar du bzhengs pa lha khang tsam du zad de/chos spyod spel sa'am sku rten bzhugs gnas phran tshegs phub/ sa khyon smi475yod/ zla gcig pa'i tshes gcig dang bco lnga/ zla drug dang bdun par lha la bsnyen bkur dang ga'i bdag la lab rtse bstod pa'i srol rgyun 'khyongs/ da skabs dgon pa bdag skyong du mi rabs du ma brgyud pa'i phyi ma zhe tsung don(khri༈zalko)zhes pa dgung lo bdun cu tsam dang do dam mi sna dgu yod do/ /— 570 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ha no dgon/ha no dgon da lta'i lin zhwa rdzong pad ma zhang gi khongs su yod/ sde 'di lo rgyus ring bar bshad/ bla brang gi a lags mgo sta tshang snga mar 'dir yun ring bzhugs pa'i bka' drin gyis/ bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ yon dang ming rgyal rabs skabs su rten bzhengs sogs ha cang bzang bas 'chad nyan yang dmar bar bshad/ phyis su man ju rgyal rabs kyi thung ṭi'i srid lo bco brgyad par chag 'jig byung / da ltar bskyar du bzhengs so/ /chin h+pha dgon/chin h+pha dgon da ltar lin zhwa rdzong khongs pad ma zhang du chags/ dgon bdag rgan pa zhig yod pa des sde 'di a 'gang rta mgrin rang byon dang dgon lung sgar(r+shar snyir+sha)las snga zhes par brtags na phal cher hor rgyal gong mas srid dbang bzung skabs shig e min snyam/ snga ma'i dgon par chag 'jig lan du mar thebs pa dang / lo'u gya chu mdzod chen po'i stabs kyis spo dgos byung / da ltar ri sked du spos shing / gos thang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / rta mgrin/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ 'jigs byed bcas rten du bzhugs snang / snga ma'i dgon sar mu'u gsum lhag lha khang la gyan lnga/ de'i phyogs bzhir lha khang bzo bkod khyad chos dang ldan pa dang / sku dang gsung gi rten mang bo bzhugs pa las thugs rten rang med/gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro ba ngang jag gte mā krung dbyen gyis sreg za'i phung bor bstums zhes gleng / da lta zla re tshes gcig dang bco lnga la dad can rnams rang bsam gyis mchod 'bul du 'ongs/dgon pa'i dkor gnyer sogs la ko re'i 'gyed rgyag de min nam rgyun a khu dag kyang rang khyim du so nam la brten te 'tsho bzhin no/ /a 'gang rta mgrin rang byon dgon/a 'gang chin cin zi(lkom+mu lhotshor+sha)bya ba da ltar len zhwa rdzong pad ma zhang(༅lo4 )yon kya sde ba'i 'gram du chags/a 'gang zhes pa'i mkhar grong du chags pa'i cha nas dgon ming la'ang de ltar 'bod/ spyir ming rgyal rabs sngon du chags par bshad mod dus nges can zhig mi gsal/ ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su snga ma'i rmang las rgya bskyed par bshad/ man ju gong ma khang zhi'i skabs su/ wes gya grong du grwa rgan gdong dmar ag tshom can zhig yod pa de pe cin la gong ma'i sar phyin/ ——gong mas bzhad slong gi tshul du gdong dmar ag tshom can zhes rtse mtshar bsnyad pa dang mnyam du/ 'ongs don dris pa dang / a 'gang chin cin zi'am dwangs dben dgon zhes pa'i mtshan gser bris kyi yig byang bstsal/ de dang mnyam du gong mas kyang gzhung dngul — 571 —

byang dang 'bru rigs sogs mi nyung ba bstsal pa'i bka' drin gyis/'bangs rnams bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod par gyur/ rje ring lugs mchog 'dzin bya/ mdo rgyud gnyis las rgyud sde'i phyag len dar/ cad 'jig de phyis gung thang sku phreng lnga ba rin po che la gtad de/ dgon pa bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ rta mgrin lha khang la gyan gsum dang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang la gyan gsum/ grwa shag gyan bcu bzhi/ cong khang nyis thog can sogs bzhengs/ skabs der grwa ba bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu'i bar 'phel/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs lan bzhir phebs pa'i bka' drin gyis 'chad nyan 'bar zhing 'bangs rnams rmongs mun gyi sdug bsngal bcil/ yang khong gi rnam thar du/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me 'dir gdan drangs pa la gso sbyong la so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon bstsal/ zhe the 'di dang thog ming rgyal rabs(wa/shu)su bod kyi dge slong zhig gis phyag 'debs mdzad par brjod kyang yig tshangs ci yang lag 'byor ma son/ phyis bod du dge lugs pa dar che skabs bod dgon du 'gyur skad/ dgon pa chags gnas ni steng them 'ig yin pas/ steng du mchod rten mtho shos shig bzhengs/zhol du lha khang tshoms chen 'ig dang thog so can gcig shar nub phyogs gnyis la'ang lha khang grwa shag sogs phub/ dgon pa'i lcags ri'i phyi nang kun tu g.yu lo'i tshang tshing dang me tog sna tshogs kyis ma dzes / nye 'khor — 578 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yu lin dang man lo/ yen cis sogs yul gru'i dad mi dag 'dir mchod mjal du 'ongs pa ni ha cang gis kyang mang / ming go srid lo bcu bdun pa spyi lo1928lo'i dus zing dang195〈lo'i dus zing gis rkyen pa las rten dang brten pa ci yod 'jig 1966lo'i rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul nang rnying ba bzhi gtor skabs rtsa ba nas bsnubs/ 1985lor mang tshogs kyi chos dad 'dun pa bskong ched rdzong gis chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan bkod/ da skabs slar gsos pa'i dgon du ston pa'i lha khang / spyan ras gzigs lha khang / sa'i snying bo'i lha khang / sgo chen/ rung khang grwa shag khang mig brgyad bcas rgya khyon cung che bar bzhengs/ sa khyon lham po smi170lhag longs/ chos dad mang tshogs nyis stong lnga brgya lhag yod de lo re'i zla dang bo bzhi ba sogs su bsang mchod bsnyen bkur dang / lab rtse bstod pa'i cho ga sna mang spel/ da lta'i skyong gnyer ba ni hri zhu'u yān(r+ṣa77)dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes pa'i dge slong zhig ga'an btsun pa lnga do dam pa mi ser bzhi bcas yod do/ /tsa ne a lags kyi yun than sgar/tsa ne a lags kyi yun than sgar ni/ lha gnyan sngo la g.yu rtse'i byang shar phyogs su gtogs shing / da lta'i lin zhwa khul lin zhwa rdzong she khre zhang du chags/mkhas dbang brag sgom pa'i chos 'byung du tsa ne a lags(tsa ne bla ma) kyi ri khrod yun than sgar zhes gsungs pa dang / sku thog dang bo tsa ne dbu dkar hor gtsang 'bru 'dren stod du 'khrungs/ dbus dang rgya gar sogs phyogs med kyi rgyal khams 'grim/ bya btang gi tshugs shin tu legs/ gnyan chen gyi thog 'phang bsam ma tshugs pa'i ngang rgyun snang / des brtsams pa'i bsang yig dag kyang kha gya dang sman lung phyogs su 'don mkhan mang / tsa ne gong ma'i sku gdung hor gtsang bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa'i gnas ri'i steng du bzhugs tshul gleng / tsa ne sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i rnam thar zhib cha ma rnyed/ tsa ne sprul sku 'jigs med mthu stobs rgya mtsho'i yang srid sman lung hor ba tshang la 'khrungs nas sman lung dgon nas chos grwar zhugs shing ri khrod 'di nyid skyong khur gnang tshul bshad/ de'i sprul sku tsa ne bla ma drug pa tsa yus rnam rgyal zhes pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs shing / kun mkhyen lnga ba chen pos tsa ne yang sprul thag bcad de gdan sar bkod/ sman lung 'jam dbyangs mtshan can dang kun mkhyen lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin gnyis bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas la sbya ngas/ bkra shis 'khyil nas chos grwar zhugs nas phar phyin dam bca' bzhag kun ma/khyen lnga ba chen po192 5lor sman lung dgon du phebs dus rang shag du gdan 'dren zhus/ sman lung bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi khri yang mdzad/ 1958'o ra btson du bzung nas grol rjes rang yul du gshegs/ ri khrod nyams chag tu song yang / chos sgo slar phye nas sman lung phyogs nas shing cha drangs te zhig gso mdzad do/ /— 579 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul lin zha rdzong gi khongs/to ma gya dgon dga' ldan bstan 'phel gling /to ma gya dgon nam zon chon zi(7r+sār+sha)ni/ da lta lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa rdzong gi te'o chi(tha3khya4)zhang gi khongs su chags/dgon pa de sngon chad gsom pa'i nags khrod du btab pas ming la(74r+sha)zer/ sa de nas stag gis grwa ba gnyis zas su bkums phyir dgon pa la'o mā(༅lo)zer sar spar kyang1980lor slob grwa tshugs stabs/ dgon pa slar gso ba'i skabs su chu dkar thang(lo7tshethokhrik+ṣi)zhes pa'i da lta'i gnas su bskyar 'debs mdzad/ sngon chad dgon pa'i nags tshal rgya che ba dang rtswa thang mi nyung ba yod/ da skabs su lha khang dang bla ma'i gzim khang gnyis thog can bcas rten dang brten pa bzhengs/ sbyin bdag grong tsho gsum la khyim tshang nyis brgya/ mi grangs chig stong bzhi brgya yod/ to bla ma to zhin blo bzang 'phrin las sku gong ma de nyid ka ju'i(bhe/khyaza)shar lho phyogs(loyi༅)nas sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas rab tu byung ste kha gya'i khye'u dkon sgom grwa dang / kha bya'i sgar rnying / gter lung dgon pa sogs kyi chos grwar 'grims/ mkhyen gter bse blo bzang bkra shis pa'i zhabs pad bsten cing bla ma'i bka' dang yul 'di'i sbyin bdag cig gis gdan drangs pa ltar dgon bskyar du btab ste sku phreng dag gis bskyangs/ da dung yul 'dir sgrub khang btsugs te bde 'jigs kyi chos skor la nyams len dge sbyor brtson pa'i nyams rtogs sad/ dus rkyen gyi dbang gis dgon gnas 'ga' spar te nyams gso dang byang chub mchod rten sogs bzhengs/ dgung lo brgyad cu'i nang sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1928lor hor gtsang shing sgo'i rgya bzhar bstan 'phel dang yum klu mo rgyal gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khye'u mgon po bsod nams zer ba de nyid dgung lo brgyad son skabs khri chen hor gtsang blo bzang dpal ldan pas to mā yang srid du thugs thag bcad nas gdan sar 'khod/ hor gtsang yi ge thang dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs te dge rgan yar 'phel zhes pa bsten nas chos spyod kyi skor bslabs/ de'i tshe na yar 'phel gyis khyod bla ma yin na grub rtags ston cig zer ba la/ khong gis rtsed mo'i tshul du banab gzan du me dmar blugs nas rgyang du chas kyang gzan ma tshig pas ngo mtshar du gyur/ rjes su hor gtsang kirti'i dgon du slob gnyer gnang skabs su glod bur sku mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten byang chub mchod rten chung chung zhig bzhengs/ to ma sku phreng gsum pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lags ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta spyi lo1954lor kha bya'i phyogs bcu'i dkar bo steng zhes pa'i grong tsho'i yab snying dkar skyabs dang yum ban de 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mdzad pa gsal zhing btsun pa'i mchog gyur dge slong bkra shis rgya mtshos lo bzhi'i tshad nas dge bsnyen la bkod/ kha gya stod dge ldan bstan 'phel gling gi grwa sa 'grims nas klog bslabs/ yang bshes gnyen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dge tshul bsten rdzogs bcas pa'i sdom khrims rim par mnos/ sngar gyi sku — 580 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/bdag chi khyon la'o(tsho༅༅)sogs kyis to ma'i yang sprul blu ba'i don du bse bla ma rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog la zhus pas/ rje 'di ba ni to ma'i 'khrul bral yang srid yin pa'i thugs bcad cing /1980lor yul mi rnams kyis gdan sar bkod/ gdan sar kha gya stod dgon pa'i chos spyod phyag len btsugs/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin bshes gnyen blo gsal gtsos kha gya stod grwa mang dgon du gdan drangs nas yul khams dge ba'i rim gro mang bo bsgrubs/ bla ma rang nyid nas kyang bse bla ma'i sku mdun nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / thugs rje chen po'i dbang / rigs gsum spyi sgril dang mgon chos kyi rjes gnang gsan/ de nas gdan sa rang dang phyogs bcu'i spen steng sgar du bzhugs te/ ma ṇi smyung gnas bla ma mdzad/1kha5rngalor dgon pa nyams rgud shul med du bsnubs kyang / chos sgo slar phye tsa na chu dkar thang zhes pa'i sar dgon pa gsar du btab/ nang du thub dbang gtso 'khor dang srung ma lha mo dang mgon po bsten/ rten rnying la ston pa'i li sku byin can chung ba zhig dang ras thang rnying ba 'ga' slar bzhugs su gsol/ da dung sngar gyi byang chub mchod rten bzheng rgyu yin zhes bla ma khong gi dmigs 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas so /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ci hri hran rdzong gi khongs/ci hri hran rdzong gi khongs/stag lung dgon thub bstan rnam rgyal gling /stag lung dgon thub bstan rnam rgyal gling zhes pa ni/ da lta 'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi ci hri hran rdzong zha'o ken zhang(r+ṣa5po sbra7/)cho༅)du chags/sngon gyi dus su a mdo'i yul la sa skya ba dang bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i chos sde 'ga' dar ba las stag lung dgon pa'ang de'i ya gyal zhig yin par grags/de nas shar tsong kha rgyal bo dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus su gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dga' tshal du gyur pa dang / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyis byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas 'gangs chen zhig red/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun pa stong phrag 'gas gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i srol tshugs na'ang / dus kyi 'pho 'gyur te 'khrug zing mang bo byung ba las sangs rgyas shākya'i bstan pa'i 'od snang rmag med du bcom na'ang / gtsang paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bos rje'i bstan pa 'ba' 'ig 'phar bar dgongs te khri chen stag lung che ba blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma yul phyogs 'di rgya stag ma bu 'tsho sar dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos gsungs pa'i lung dang du blangs pa ltar/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags bya ste spyi lo1801lor stag lung gnas su 'du khang dang / rje tsong kha yab sras kyi snang brnyan sogs rten dang brten pa bcas rim par bzhengs shing / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bshad sgrub phyag len dngos gtsang btsugs/ dus de nas bzung ste stag lung dgon pa dang stag lung sku phreng gi mtshan chags/ stag lung chung ba zhes pas skabs der dbu bskul nas rje lha khang chung ba bzhengs/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes1807me yos lo'i snga phyir gdan drangs nas lha khang so sor rten dang chos grwa gsar tshugs la brtsi bzhag gnang skabs dgung sngon du 'ja' tshon shar ba'i rten 'brel byung / bde mchog lū i ba dang gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang dang / bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dgon par spyi 'jog spam mthong ba gnang / bsgrub bya bcu bsnyen rdzogs la bkod/ sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ stag lung blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i drung nas rab byung zhus pa dang dgon nyid kyi chos grwar zhugs/ me rta spyi lo1906lor rje skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bos rgyal bstan dar spel gyi gnad du 'bag chen phyogs kyi dgon sde dang dpon che chung gis bsus pa la/ stag lung dgon du phebs nas tshogs dbus su bzhugs te dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / sham+bha la'i smon lam/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma bcas kyi lung bstsal/ stag lung nang khag che chung gis dngul rta phrug du ma drin gzor btegs so/ /— 582 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/da ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gdan rabs so gnyis pa khri stag lung ba sku phreng rim byon cung brjod par bya ste/ rje brag sgom pas stag lung che ba blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i skyes par grags shing / shar no min han gyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs su sa brgyad pa thob par gsungs/ 'di ba rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu stag178 2lor reb gong rong bo'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ lcags khyi lo'i zla brgyad par gdan sar bkod de shar no min han la rab byung dge tshu' zhus/ rong bo'i dgon chen dang dbus 'bras sgo mang chos grwar zhugs nas bstan pa'i gzhung brgya sbyangs/ mnga' ris sprul sku rje blo bzang dge legs kyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang rnam sras bka' bco lnga sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan/ gtsang paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' bzhin stag lung dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad/ lcags bya'i smon lam la 'jam dpal bshad pa gnang / kun mkhyen bar ma'i gsung bkod dus bab dang thugs gnyer 'phro skyong gi ched du bla brang du phebs te rdo rams pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas rdo rams pa thon/ bla ma mang po'i drung nas bka' chos gsan/ bla brang tshogs chen khri ba dang / rgan rgya'i brag dkar dgon/ dmu dge 'khor lo'i dgon/ shing las kha/ bla brang rgyud smad bcas kyi khrir mnga' gsol pa'i 'chad nyan dmar/ 18 26me sprel lor tsha gan bai shing dgon(da lta rma chu rdzong mdzod dge nyin ma'i khongs)du khri ba bzhugs skabs sku gshegs par thugs dam ngo mtshar can la bzhugs so/ /de'i sprul sku blo bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ 1840lcags byi lor hor gtsang dpon po stobs ldan gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga'i steng stag lung dgon par zhugs/dgung lo bdun par gdan sar bkod de bkra shis 'khyil gyi skyabs mgon mchog gi drung nas rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs/ co ne dge 'dun dpal bzang sogs dge rgan du bsten nas slob gnyer la gzhol/ phar phyin dam bca' bzhag skyabs mgon yab sras las bka' chos mang du gsan/ sa rta lor sde khri gsum pa rin po che'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ kun mkhyen bla ma bzhi ba rang dgon du gdan 'dren zhus/ chos rdzong dgon pa'i khri mdzad pa dang stag lung dgon pa rang dang / stag lung ri khrod/ stag lung dgon lag shan krang zi sogs chos sde che chung brgyad 'al bdag mdzad de chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ lha khang dang gtsug lag khang nyams gso'am lha rten chos gsum mang bo bzhengs/ bstan 'gro'i don du rgya nang du phebs lam ste sa glang1889lor lan ju'i grong du sku gshegs so/ / sku phreng gsum pa skal bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho ni/1890lor rdo sbis lcang shar du yab don grub dang yum mkha' mo skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ 1〈92lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug pas(1856 1916)stag lung che ba'i yang srid du thugs thags bcad nas gdan sar bkod/ chos grwar zhugs phyin bla ma mang po'i 'bas la gtugs/ bla brang gi gzim khang rgya bskyed/ rang dgon sogs kyi bshad sgrub chos spyod rje gong ma'i dus ltar spel/192 1lo'i snga phyir 'bag chen a dbon gyis byang rgyud kyi dgon pa rnams brlags pa'i rkyen ngan las stag lung dgon pa'ang nyen theb kyang dam pa sku nyid nas zhig gso mdzad/ gung ru sku phreng lnga bas dgon 'dir bde — 583 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ci hri hran rdzong gi khongs/gsang 'jigs gsum dang / mgon po chos rgyal/ mkha' spyod ma bcas kyi zhal thang byin can gnang /thag ring tshang gis tsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang bzhengs/ ('di gnyis kyi 'khrungs yul sa cha de yin) khong gis lha gnyan rdo sbis dar rgyal la bsang yig brtsams pa dang / dar rgyal ri rtse la phebs nas rlung rta'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ yang stag lung nyid nas kun mkhyen bzhi ba la bde mchog lha re gnyis pa'i dbang zhus so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu lug ste1942lor shar gnya' gong brag dkar gyi nye logs rgan gya nas yab rin chen rgyal dang yum 'phags mo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/kun mkhyen lnga bas dgung lo bzhi'i thog stag lung che ba'i mchog sprul du thag bcad de bkra shis 'khyil du khri la mnga' gsol/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i spyan snga nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom khrims mnos/rong bo'i thub bstan sogs dge rgan bsten nas mdo sngags sbyangs/ rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs nas phar phyin dam bca' bzhag gdan sa stag lung dgon dang stag lung ri khrod sogs rje gong ma ltar skyong khur bzhes/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i yar sngon dgon par dge 'dun pa zhal brgyad cu 'dus/ de rjes grwa ba rnams grong tsho'i zhing las nang bcug pa dang / sprul ba'i sku rang nyid rgyal khab kyi las byed par zhugs shing kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong srid gros su bya ba bsgrubs/ 1988lor stag lung tshang dang / stag ri sprul sku skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ gung ru skal ba zang dam chos sgrol ma/ skal bzang grags pa rgya mtsho rnam bzhis bsod nams dpal gyis brgyan pa'i rgan gya'i lha 'bebs stong phrag gis dbu mdzad cing rje gung thang drug pa'i bka' gnang bzhin rgan bya'i yul skyong gtso bo lha gnyan chen po stobs ldan nor bu dbang rgya' bstad de rlung rta'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ sa rtsod chu rtsod mang bo'i 'khon gyod 'dum 'grig mdzad/ da lta bsang chu rdzong gi yig sgyur khang du phyag las gnang ba dang / khul srid gros u yon/ rdzong srid gros rgyun u/ rdzong chos lugs mthun tshogs kyi drung yig chen mo bcas kyi 'gan bzhes bzhin mchis so/ /stag lung chung ba la kun gyis stag lung pā tā zhes 'bod/ sku phreng dag gi rnam thar gsal rgyus ma lon par lus/ stag lung dkon mchog tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i phyi ma de1958lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin la mtsho sngon sog po'i thod gos ces pa nas sku 'das so/ /snga sor tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo dang / rje lha khang / dam can btsan khang / spyi khang / grwa shag sum cu bcas phub pa dang / stag lung che chung gi nang khag yod/ 1958lo'i rjes su bstan pa nyams rgud chen po byung nas rten dang brten pa thams cad rtsa ba nas 'jig rgyu nom sa zhing bcas gzhung bzhes byas/1981lor dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re 'dun drag po las stag lung ba'i chos sgo slar phyes/ 'du khang dang /nang rten rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dang / tsong kha ba yab sras sman 'jim las bzhengs pa dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ chos skyong gi zhal thang bzhugs/ rje yab sras dang kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung 'bum spyan drangs/ khyad par du rje tsong kha ba'i dbu lo dang / 'khar rnga rang sgra grags pa slar 'byor/ 'chad nyan la — 581 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod dang smon lam lnga mchod/ chos skyong bskang gso sogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i smad rgyud ltar spel/ da lta dge 'dun pa bcu phrag gnyis bzhugs shing thog ma'i sku 'gyed de rje stag lung bas gtod pa'i srol tshugs te 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgya cher rgyun 'khyongs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig dgon pas srung ma dang / yul gnyan dar rgyal dang rma chen bcas la bla ma nyid nas mchod bkur che/bsang dang rlung rta chag med bgyis/ dgon pa'i mchod gzhis la zha'o kun zhang phal che ba dang / lin zha rdzong gi khongs bcas par mi khyim chig stong nyis brgya lhag yod do/ /yin khron dgon pa/yon khron dgon pa ni da lta'i lin zhwa khul gyi ci hrin hra rdzong gi yon khron 'ang(snyiṣ+ṭha)//༅ )du chags/dgon pa'i do dam pa lis yon phis sogs(༅tsho /khye ཿ༅ཿ cas skya)kyis phul pa'i dgon pa'i lo rgyus las/ dgon pa nyid ni ha lam rgya'i ze'u thang zung gi rgyal rabs(lo ṣ+ṭha)su tshugs pa la da bar lo ngo chig stong brgyad brgya lhag 'das/ bgres po rnams kyi ngag rgyun la ming rgyal rabs su dgon pa ches dar ba'i sgang yin te btsun pa nyis brgya lhag zhal 'dzoms shing li'u bla ma zhes pas bdag skyong mdzad/ bla ma nyid ni bshes bsnyen chen po yin gshes skabs de'i gong mas spyan drangs te lha lcam gyi na tsha bkrol/ gong mas khong la skyes su ba so'i 'gyog byams dang sla nga zhig bstsal skad/sung rgyal rabs rjes su dgon pa'i bla ma sku phreng dang bo da lta'i zhang nyid kyi nyo kya pho(༅zolo)nas sku 'khrungs pa la mi rnams kyi kha rgyun du nyo a lags su(༅8lta)'bod la/ da lta'i bar nyo zhabs drung bla ma(༅7sgotshoḥ)sku phreng bdun brgyud pa yin/ de snga dgon pa'i rgya khyon la sa mu'u sum cu lhag longs te/shar nub bar du 'du khang khang mig gsum dang / zur du khang logs khang mig nyi shu rtsa grangs phub/ dge 'dun pa zhal brgya lhag 'dus stabs/ dgon pa'i chos spyod rgya che zhing snyan grags rgyas/ spyi lo1928lo ste ming go srid lo bcu bdun par mi rigs nang 'khrug sogs rkyen las dgon pa yongs su bsnubs/ thengs 'gar bskyar bzheng byas par rdab sig ya nga ba myangs/ 1926lor dgon pa phal cher legs grub byung ba ma zad/ bla rabs da lta nyo a lags(༅lalha)bdun pa gdan sar 'khod thub/ 196ralor rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul chen po bslangs pa las gdon bgegs ma lus tshar gcod pa'i rnying bzhi gtor cing gsar bzhi 'dzugs sgang dgon pa'ang der bstun bsnubs nas yen khran zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung dgon gnas su btsugs so/ /1kha8〈lor rgya che'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rang lcag sgos nyo a lags kyi skul ngor rus lis can gsum gas 'go khrid nas dgon sa bdams pa dang dgon pa bskyar du bzhengs/ da lta sa khyon mu'u gsum lhag bzung nas 'du khang mig gsum rten brten pa bcas pa/ logs su mchod khang mig gsum/ grwa shag mig — 585 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ci hri hran rdzong gi khongs/bzhi/ rung khang mig gsum bcas phub/ rten gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas shāka thub sogs che chung brgyad/'khor tshogs rnam pa bdun sogs bzhengs grub/ zla re'i tshes gcig dang / bco lnga la mang tshogs kyis spos bdug cing lha bkur ba'i cho ga yod la/ lo rer chos spyod ches che ba thengs gnyis re spel to/ /rdo ldan byams pa gling /rdo ldan byams pa gling(bo1skor+sha)zhes pa 'di ni da lta'i lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ci hru hran rdzong gi phu khran zhang du chags/dgon pa 'di 'debs 'go snga la dgon pa'i rgyab ri gnas khyad can zhig yin par grags/ sngar sa skya ba dang bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa spel phyir gsang sngags lugs kyi rnal 'byor ba grub chen du ma phyogs 'di nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas red/ 'du khang lta bu'i gnas khang dang / rje btsun byams pa glo nyal/ lha sku brkos ma lta bu'i rang byung sku gzugs sna tshogs 'bur du thon pa mjal rgyu dang / snga dus gnas bstod sogs dam chos glegs bam mang bo bzhugs/ gdan sa'i mchog sprul ma ṇi ba zhes pa rim byon ni rtsa ba'i bla ma red de / sgo gsum dge bar gzhol ba'i ma ṇi ba sku gong ma yul 'di nas sku 'khrungs skad/ bla ma 'di bas ma ṇi dang smyung gnas kyi rgyun bzung ba dang ma ṇi bye chen mang bo bsgrubs pa dang / sgrub gnas kyi brag ngos su ma ṇi rang byon dang ril bu bab pa'i rnam pa byung stabs skyes bu dad ldan dag gi yid dbang bkugs shing gtsug tu bkur zer/ bla ma ma ṇi ba zhes pa'i mtshan yang sku thog der thogs/ de'i phyi ma yul 'di'i khang kya'i rus su sku 'khrungs/ byis pa khyad par can zhig yin par gleng / de dus gnas 'dir grub pa'i skyes mchog cig phebs bzhugs snang bar zhus pas/ bla ma mchog gis kha gya'i byis pa de nyid bstan 'gro'i don du sman pas bla ma ma ṇi ba'i yang srid yin zhes gsungs pa ltar gdan sar 'khod/ rab tu byung phyin bla ma mang bo'i zhabs la gtugs/ gdan sa rang dang byams pa 'bum gling sogs nas sgrub pa snying bo mdzad/ chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang gshis sa skyong 'ga'i mchod gnas su bkur ba la khang h+pha the(ochor+sha)zhes pa'i mtshan snyan btags pa da lta'i bar ngag rgyun du ma nyams/ de nas rdo ldan byams pa gling dang / cha 'brug dgon(༅༅ r+sha)nas gzim khang re brgyab/ gzhan tā grong sgar dang / khang kya sgar/ yang kya sgar/ yang hran sgar/spin bang kya sgar/ zhi grong sgar/ len kya sgar/ gtsos kya sgar(khrizlor+sha)bcas nyin khran lung ba'i yar nang sgar lnga dang mar nang sgar lnga zhes 'bod cing khong gis bdag gir mdzad/ dgon pa de dag tu bod rgya zung 'brel gyi 'du khang bzhengs shing sku gsung thugs rten lham mer bzhugs/ sku 'bum dgon pa'i phyag len ltar sgrub grwa btsugs te 'chad nyan bla lhag tu bskyangs par gzhan phan rgya cher mngon/ sku phreng gsum pa dang bcas pa'i rnam thar sa bon ni dgon pa nyams chag mang ba'i dbang gis brlags song / sku phreng bcu gcig pa ni kun lho'i hor gtsang shing sgo'i dpon skor zhang 'khor zhes par sku 'khrungs/ gdan sar bkod de rang — 586 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/dgon dang hor gtsang rdzong thog sgom grwa nas ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i thugs dam zab bzhes gtso bo mdzad/yul phyogs gang sar ma ṇi dang smyung gnas kyi rgyun spel bas bstan 'gro'i dge sems la phan pa byung / 'di ba la hor gtsang phyogs nas zhang 'khor a lags zer/ ma ṇi bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa hor gtsang dpon g.yog phug sde ru 'khrungs/ mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gnang ste gdan sar bkod/ hor gtsang yi ge thang dgon pa'i chos sgor zhugs skabs dgon 'di phyag 'debs thog mar mdzad dus yin stabs/ rten 'brel du dgongs nas dang bo sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchog bla brang dus 'khor rgyud pa'i phyag len sgrub sde dag btsugs nas legs par bskyangs/ 1929lor he dmag dang rgya'i yul 'khrug bar du dgon pa phal cher 'phrog bcom thebs kyang slar khong gis zhig gsos mdzad phyin sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/bla ma ma ṇi ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa blo bzang 'phrin las mchog ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags lug spyi lo1921lor slar hor gtsang shing sgo'i dpon skor grong du yang sangs rgyas mkhar dang yum snying kho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad par kun gzigs paṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang stabs gdan khrir 'phral 'khod/ blu yon dang dngul sgor lnga brgya phul cing yi ge thang dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs/dge rgan blo bzang bkra shis bsten nas 'bri klog chos spyod sogs bslabs/ hor gtsang tshogs 'du 'jigs med don yod kyi drung nas rang byung dge tshul bsgrubs shing rgyugs phul nas gral mtshams blangs/ gzim 7bang gsar du bskrun/ de rjes bsang chu rdzong gi skabs dang bo'i mi dmangs 'thus mir bdams/ dgon 'di'i rdo rje 'dzin par bzhugs te 'chad nyan skyong khur mdzad/ 1958lor yi ge thang dgon par bzhugs shing grong 'go bzung nas hor gtsang chu sngon yul du zing 'khrug ma bslangs pa ni bla ma 'di'i drin du brjod/ yang lo 'dir nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i nang zhugs pa dang phyis su slob mthar phyin rjes zhing chen spyi bde las khungs su lo tsā ba dang / zhin cang dang kun lho bcas nas dge rgan gyi phyag las mdzad par byas rjes che zer la/ da lta khong nyid zhabs pad lhun chags su brtan cing gzhan phan gyi dgongs pa rgya chen po ldan pas dam chos la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gzhol mus/ /dgon pa la rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i yar sngon du sgrub sde gong 'og bcas su 'du khang dang / dam can btsan khang / grwa shag sa zhing / rta drel yod cing yul 'di ga'i chos grwa rer btsun pa bcu phrag tsam re bzhugs pa'i chos spyod yar ldan du mchis kyang / rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i 'ur zing nang dgon pa bsnubs/da snga chos sgo slar phye ba las rdo ldan dgon pa rang dang / srin bang kya sgar/ tā grong bcas bod lugs sgrub sde lnga bskyar du phyag 'debs gnang zhing srung ma tha 'og dang chos rgyal bkur/ bla ma ma ṇi ba'i gsol dkar rnying ba 'gangs chen gcig lus/ lha sde'am mchod gzhis la phu khron dang yin khron ces pa zhang(༅ )gnyis kyi mang tshogs 'dus so/ /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ci hri hran rdzong gi khongs/cha 'brug dgon dge ldan g.yas 'khyil gling /cha 'brug dgon dge ldan g.yas 'khyil gling ni/ da lta'i len zhwa khul gyi cis hri hran rdzong phu khron 'ang du chags/ a mdo chos 'byung du nyin khron lis pa'i stod smad du yar nang sgar lnga dang / mar nang sgar lnga zer ba'i dgon sgrub sde bcu zhes gsung yod pa la/ mar nang sgar lnga'i lte gnas yin pa dang / rdo ldan byams pa gling gi ma ṇi spru' sku sku phreng rim byon gyi bzhugs gnas gdan sa yang yin/ snga dus nyi ma lta bu mnyam med dwags po rin po che nas slob ma mkhas pa mi gsum las garma/ 'brug pa/ 'bri gung / stag lung / khro phu sogs bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mtha' dag phyogs 'dir phebs te dam pa'i chos dar 'ing rgyas par mdzad/ dgon 'di'i lo rgyus snga sor yig bzhag yod pa dus 'khrug rkyen sna tshogs dbang gis chud zos su so nga / sngon byon grub pa'i skyes mchog du mas sgom sgrub yun ring mdzad pa'i gnas shul dang / sngon dus bod kyi sa cha yin pa deb ther chos 'byung sogs su mthong myong yod/ deng sang bod kyi sde ming 'bod pa 'ga' re snang /dge ldan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling 'di'i dgon pa'i 'du khang gi rten gyi gtso bor sman 'dam las bzhengs pa dus gsum sangs rgyas/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo/ rgyal ba mi pham mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs/ rje dge legs ma bcas li sku khru tshad du ma dang / bla mchod tshogs zhing gtsos rgyal chen bzhi'i gyan thang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ mgon chos lnga/ bsten pa thā 'og chos skyong sogs kyi thang sku du ma/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / bskal 'phags ting gsum/ rgyud bzhi sogs gsung thor bu du ma/ rdo ldan ma ṇi ba'i gdung rten mchod rten bcas sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs/da dung ba so'i ca ne rtsa chen dang / dung chen gnyis/ chos dung g.yas 'khyil cha/ li'i maṇ+ḍal/ shing shing sbub/ tsen/ dngul tsi/ mchod theb brgya bcas lha cha mchod cha 'ga' mchis/ lo hril bo'i chos spyod gtso bo hor gtsang yi ge thang dgon pa'i cho ga'i phyag len 'ga' zhig tshugs shing / bla mchod smon lam dus rgyun tshogs 'don dang / zla gsum pa'i nang du dus 'khor bdag 'jug sogs dang / lnga mchod/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes brgyad la chos lugs kyi cho ga yul dus dang bstun par spel ba'i nyi ma yin/ srung ma'i bskang gso dang / sman ring gsung mkhan chos gos dmar bo dang / snam sbyar ser bo gyon pa'i grwa ba lnga sor bcu phrag 'ga' bzhugs/ 'du khang dang / rung khang / rdo ldan ma ṇi ba'i gzim khang dang bde yangs/grwa shag lnga dang / rgyun bzhugs grwa ba bco lnga bzhugs/ 1958lo'i rjes su dgon pa gtor/ rdo ldan ma ṇi sprul ba'i sku'i dbon po dkon mchog tshul khrims sogs btson du bzung/ dgon pa dang nang chen gyi rta drel dang / rgya 'jag gsum gyi zhing sa tshang ma thun mong gzhung du bsdus so/ /1991lo'i rjes su chos sgo slar phye ba'i dge mtshan ldan 'og rdo ldan ma ṇi ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa blo — 588 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzang 'phrin las mchog nas dbu bskul te 'du khang bzhengs/ sman 'dam las rje tsong kha ba'i snang brnyan dang / ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rigs gsum mgon po/ tshe lha rnam gsum mgon chos lnga bcas zhal thang byin can du ma bzhengs shing / thā 'og chos rgyal sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i khang bzang bcas grub/lam sngags gnyis dang / sher phyin brgyad stong bcas lha rten chos gsum mi nyung tsam bzhugs shing / sa mu'u gcig yod/ dpal ldan gtsos grwa ba 'ga' 'dus yod/ ma ṇi sprul ba'i sku blo bzang 'phrin las pa'i gzim spyil slar bzhengs shing phyogs 'di'i yar nang mar nang dgon bcu la thugs rjes bdag gir mdzad de nyams gso dang / dgon 'di'i mtshan bstsal/ lha sde zi rgya/ līn rgya gtsos mi khyim stong phrag tsam mchis so/ /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/yon cin rdzong gi khongs/bod dgon gyi dkar chagayon cin rdzong ni/ da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen lin zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs su chags/thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yul gru 'di bod dang ldong pho spyang gis bzung / yon dang ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sog po hor dang kha che he yi mi rigs kyang gzhes/ sa 'di'i yul dpon chen por grags pa ho bsod nams 'bum(yang na skyid bsod nams 'bum)gyis sog po gong ma'i srid blon gyi khur bzhes/ phyis su ming rgyal rabs kyi hong lbu srid lo gsum par(spyi lo1271)gong ma'i bka' las thu'u si zhes pa sa gnas kyi dpon du bskos/ skabs der khong gi tsha rgyud mang shos rgya ru 'gyur te deng sang gi ka ju'i mkhar gyi byang phyogs mchod rten dkar po'i ho kya phu sogs su mched cing rim gyis kha bral yul gyar gyi dbang gis sa cha mang du khyab/rdzong khongs 'di'i zho len zhing gi khrin hran dang tu'o phen(lko༅)sde grong gi han zhes pa'i rus su 'bod pa dag yon rgyal rabs kyi dus nas han kya zi ru spar/ da ltar zhing grong de'i lo grong dang tre khro/ han kya zi ste ru sde gsum du han gyi rus su gtogs pa'i dud kha brgyad cu lhag la mi grangs bzhi brgya lhag yod/ der gzhes kyi skye bo dag gis kho bo cag gi rigs rus rgya dang cho 'brang bod kyi ma rgyud yin par smra/ yul srol goms 'dris kyi cha nas kyang dper na mdud la dpung ras nag po mi bskon pa dang / a mchod chos klog dang gshen dge'i cho ga sogs bod srol ma nyams par yod pa sogs ni sa de gar bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' dar ba'i rmang du song bar snyam/thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sa cha 'di dag bod kyis bdag tu bzung ba las/ rma chu dang tsong chu/ klu chu/ 'ju lag chu'i rgyud du bod brgyud kyi nang ba'i bstan pa'i dbu brnyes shing rim gyis 'phel/ phyis su sung rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bod brgyud dang rgya brgyud zung sbrel lta bu'i bstan pa dang / yon rgyal rabs kyi mjug nas ming rgyal rabs tshugs kha mar/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa ste dge lugs pa'i bstan pa dar/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lo dang kren thung(1lko)gi skabs su/ rje rin po ches rang nyid kyi dngos slob shākya ye shes sku tshab tu rgya nag gong ma'i mdun sar lan gnyis mngags/ gong mas kyang 44byams chen chos rje zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ snga rting gnyis ka sa 'dir brgyud de phebs/ kren thung srid lo bzhi ba spyi lo1429lor rgya nag nas phyir dbus phebs kyi lam du sa 'dir slebs pa dang / da lta'i mtsho sngon dang kun su'u ste zhing chen gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams ho'u phen(ṣ+ṭhapo)bya bar gzugs sku reg pa'i bkod pa bsdus/— 590 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ta ming kren thung srid lo bdun pa spyi lo1442lor/ rgyal po'i bka' las rje de nyid la dran gso'i dgon pa zhig bzhengs/ mtshan la hong hwa zi(214shādzad)gsol/ tshul des rgyu las 'bras bu mched pa ltar/phu yen zi(r+sājor+sha he kya zi yang zer/ khozatso) kong twe zi lung kyo ni(༅mar+sha)chi hran zi(lhakhyar+sār+sha)sogs mang du 'phel/ ming gi gong ma ban lis kyi srid lo tha ma spyi lo1619ba la/ sog po pa yon gro'i dge bshes 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo 'dir phebs bzhugs mdzad pa len yan zi'i(7gruchodzod)bla ma sku phreng dang bor bshad/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong rol tu bka' brgyud dang sa skya'i grub mtha' yang dar skad/ ming rgyal rabs nas man ju'i rgyal rabs skabs su dge lugs gtsor gyur gyi bod brgyud nang bstan ches cher 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/ dgon pa che phra drug cu lhag tu son/ grwa rgyun yang stong la nye ba bzhugs par bshad/ bcing 'grol gong tsam du dgon pa nyi shu longs tsam dang dge 'dun pa sum brgyar nye ba zhig bgrang du mchis te/ de dag grangs 'dren tsam gyi tshul du spel na/byams pa 'bum gling dang(lozar+sha) mchod rten dkar po(zi1thor+sha) he kya zi( chazor+sha) lo'u kya tun bde mchog gling(༅mokhor+sha) sgang mgo dgon(7shā76) chos dbyangs dgon/ (rnyikhya༈rmor+sha) a 'gang skyid dgon(lko 7༅r+sha) han kya zi(ཿzor+sha) hri tse zi(thokhyazozlo) co kya zi(lkozor+sha) ko pe zi( lor+sha) hong khrin zi(tram̐1yor+sha) hong tse zi(ram̐1khyashār+sha) ta khron zi(7)//r+sha) pe khron zi(tsho)//r+sha)hong lo'u zi(phre171dzo'i)sogs yod pa de las ming du grags pa ni byams pa 'bum gling dang mchod rten dkar po/lo kya tun bde mchog gling / sgang mgo dgon sogs nas lo rgyus kyis sa bon tsam rnyed pa'am mig mthong du snang ba dag yi ge'i 'du byed du spel ba gsham gsal lo/ /mchod rten dkar po mthong ba kun 'dren gling /yongs grags su rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chad sngon bod btsan po'i mnga' khongs su bshad pa'i mchod rten dkar po ni/ deb ther rgya mtsho las bka' bcu ngag dbang dge 'dun gyis bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag tu/ tshe lo nyis khri'i dus rgyal po kri kris sbyin bdag byas/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las dus mtshan mo gcig la mchod rten bye ba phrag gcig bzhengs par sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rab gnas mdzad/ rim gyis lha klu mi gsum gyi yul so sor byon te bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan yin zhes thu'u bkun rin po ches 'bum gling khri rin po cher gsung tshul snang / lo rgyus 'gar ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis brgya lhag tsam na dgra bcom pa ma tidha bas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bum pa gang / theg pa che chung gi glegs bam mang bo/ sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan ras bris bcas bsnams te phebs par/ han ming bhi rgyal po 'khor bcas dad pa skyes te mchod yon rnams kyis ring bsrel gyi snying bo can gyi mchod rten mang po bzhengs pa'i nang tshan dang / 'di las 'od zer 'phros pa sogs kyi mthong snang las rgyal rabs rjes ma 'ga' zhig gis dad pa'i sgo — 591 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/nas zhig gsos phul par bshad ces pa'i mchod rten 'di'i cha nas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang de lta ra thogs /mchod rten de'i mtho tshad la smi bcu gnyis/ sa'i khyon la smi gru bzhi ma brgya/ mchod rten gyi zur ba'ir mda' yab can gyi khang mig lnga re yod/ nang du rtse po ta la'i ras thang / thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/sgrol ljang / sgrol sngon/ sgrol dkar/ rje stong sku bcas bzhugs/ skabs der grwa ba bcu lhag las ma yod/ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung ṭi'i skabs su bsreg za'i phung bor gyur/ kong zhis kyis srid dbang skyong ba na bod kyi bzo skrun gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i 'du khang khang mig lnga can/ mgon khang khang mig gsum can/ ma ṇi 'khor khang khang mig gsum can/ rung khang khang mig bcu drug can/ grwa shag khang mig bzhi bcu zhe grangs bzhengs/ grwa rgyun yang sum cu lhag tu son/ g.yung sku skye rim byon gyis 'dzin bdag mdzad pa gzhir byas dam pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis gzhi gsum gyi phyag len legs par 'phel/ rab byung bcu ba'i me yos1807lor 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me shar tsong kha'i yul du phebs lam mchod rten dkar bo nas zhag bzhugs gnang / dge 'dun lnga bcu skor la rdo rje gcod pa'i lung bstsal/ mchod rten 'di sangs rgyas 'od srung dus kyi mchod rten zhig yin zer ba dang / bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'phel gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yin zer ba'i lo rgyus ci rigs snang gsungs/ lcags yos1nga91lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen po bsu ba rgya cher zhus/'das pa la phyag dbang gis thar ba'i sa bon bskrun te shis brjod kyi me tog sogs kun mkhyen nyid kyi rang rnam du gsal/ khyad par du grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan ras pa/ kun mkhyen yab sras sku phreng snga phyir/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che/ rje gser khang ba/ rje bla kho rin po che/ rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros sogs byon te dga' gus bsngags brjod zhus/ phyis su1958lo'i dus zing gis bcom lhag dag spyi lo1967par lo'u kya btsan 'gag gi chu mdzod chen mo bskyil ched gzhig dgos kyis 'jig na'ang / spyi lo1981lor/ srid jus bzang po'i bka' drin las/ snga ma'i dgon tshab tu dad ldan skya ser mi nyung ba zhig gis sbyor 'jags kyi bdog pa mi dman pa'i stobs la brten te/ san yān zhang gi phu tsi tse(zalo༅༅cakhyashā) bya bar mchod rten dkar po bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa la smi bcu'i dpangs su mtho/ lha khang ngam 'du khang khang mig gsum/ grwa shag khang mig nyi shu rtsa bdun bcas bskyar bzhengs mdzad thog dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / rje sku sogs sku rten dang rje gsung 'bum sogs glegs bam mi nyung ba bcas kyi gsung rten yang bzhengs/ rgyun sdod kyi btsun pa mi bdun yod/ snga srol ltar rten pa lha mo bkur/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba ma dgon du brten/ bca' yig rang 'di'o zhes bstan du ma yod kyang / mdo rgyud gnyis las sngags phyogs gtsor gnyer/ mchod gzhis kyi cha nas san yān dang bcas pa'i zhang grong gsum ste/ dud kha bzhi brgya lhag gi skye bo drug stong gi grangs las brgal/ lhag lus kyi rten dang mchod rdzas la ching rgyal rabs kyi thang rnying 'ga' dang / rnga sbub/ dung dkar gsum/ tsi cha gcig bcas yod/ dad ldan mang bas re ba — 592 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'don bzhin lo sprul dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtshos mchod rten bzhengs gnas gsar du gzigs te sa 'dul mdzad/ khong gis rgyu rkyen gang dgos sbyar te shing byi1984lor mchod rten rten brten par bskyar gsar du bzhengs/ rten gtso ston pa thub dbang bzhugs/ rje tsong ba'i snang brnyan/ rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can gyi sku 'bum mang bo/ kun mkhyen drug pa'i sku 'gag sogs gzungs gzhug tu bzhugs/ dus bzang sogs la bla mchod sogs gsung la/ rgyun bzhugs pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ 'phrin las rgya mtsho/chos grags rgya mtsho/ thub bstan/ 'jam dbyangs lhun grub/ yon tan rgya mtsho sogs yin/ de las 'jam dbyangs lhun grub kyis dkor gnyer dang dbu mdzad gcig lcogs su 'khur mus su snang bas/ gang ci'i bya ba yar ldan du 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /byams pa 'bum gling gong ma/byams pa 'bum gling(lozo༅r+sha)zhes pa ni/ da ltar kun su'u zhing chen yun cin rdzong gi lho nub mtshams kyi rdzong mkhar las spyi le so lnga'i gnas(wang the zhang)su chags/rgyal phran bcu drug gi skabs su/ chin nub ma'i(yozo)mnga' khongs kyi nang bstan spel ba'i gnas khyad par can du bshad/ chin nub ma dang lbes byang ma'i skabs su thang hru'u ku'i(lom9)gling du bsnyad/su'e dang thang rgyal rabs skabs su lung zhin zi(ṣ+ṭha༅r+sha)ru 'bod/ sung dang yon ming ste rgyal rabs gsum gyi ring la lin yan zi(zotshor+sha)ru grags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi mjug tsam du 'bum gling zhes byams pa 'bum tshar gyi sku bzhugs pa'i cha nas de skad du thogs so/ /de'ang zhib tu zhus pa ji skad du deb ther rgya mtsho las/ 'bum gling phur rgya bza' gong jo yun ring du bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma las sgrol sku rang byon du phebs shing / lha khang gi phyi rol tu seng ldeng gi nags tshal gyis mdzes pa/ sngon yid dge lung par bla ma grub chen zhig bzhugs pa'i nye gnas kyi chu tshags gnyis rim par bor te the tshom pa'i mur yod thog nang gcig kha ba'i steng du ri bor te the tshom pa'i mur yod thog nang gcig kha ba'i steng du ri bong gi rjes bab pa ded pas brag phug 'dir slebs/ sgrol sku zhig gi drung du sngar gyi chu tshags gnyis kyang snang / bla ma la zhus pas/ khong phebs te sgrol sku rten sgam du bzhugs te bsnams/ tsha chu kha'i zhag sar nangs dus sgrol sku mi bzhugs pa btsal sa 'dir rnyed/ de ltar lan kha shas gdan 'dren zhus kyang phyir phebs pas 'dir bzhugs su gsol zhes dkar chag tu bshad/ yid dge lung ni g.yo dge lung ba dang / bla ma grub kun rin po ches/ grub dbang bskal ldan rgya mtshos yig drug gi / ril sgrub mdzad chen nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'i/ /sangs rgyas zhal gzigs bstod bsngags mdzad pa'i gnas/ /sgrol ma phug gi gnas brtan mjal lags sam/ /zhes gsungs la/ lha khang ri khrod bcas yang kyā zhabs drung rim byon gyis bskyangs/ 'di'i le lag sgang mgo'i dgon/ ko kyā zi zhes sum pas bshad/ phyi ma 'di chu'i — 593 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/phar kha na yod/ mi la'i sgrub phug zer ba'i dben gnas su mi la'i sku rang byon bzhugs/byams pa 'bum gling gi byams chen 'di ngag rgyun 'gar kong tses bzhengs zer zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis kong tse'i ming la yang bzo kong tse dang kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes grags/ 'ga' 'ig gis de bon po zhig yin pa gzhir bzhag nas dang po ston pa gshen rab kyi sku yin pa la phyis su gtsug tor sogs bsnan te byams sku'i rnam par bsgyur zer snang / de dang mthun par thu'u bkwan rin po ches / gna' dus gshen rab lo'u gyin rnam pa ste/ /da lta mchog gi sprul sku'i cha byad du/ / bsgyur la rgyal ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa yi/ /'bum gling byams chen sku bsnyan mjal lags sam/ /lha sku mchod rten spyi blugs rdor dril sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs brag la rang byon du/ /byung bas phyogs mtshams khor yug kun gang ba'i/ /gnas kyi ngo mtshar ltad mo gzigs lags sam/ /zhes dang / bskal ldan chos 'byung du/ kong tse 'phrul rgyal gyis byams sku chen mos thog drangs byams sku 'bum ther bzhengs/ /'di la rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ sprul sku bsod nams ye shes dbang bo/ stong 'khor yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ sde ba zhabs drung rnams ched gnyer gyis mjal bar phebs/ stag lung chos rje 'phrin las dpal bzang gis gnas 'dir mchod rten gsar bzhengs tshe/ mchod rten rtse'i nam mkha' dang / nang du mar me 'bar ba stag lung tshogs pas gzigs/ mchod rten la 'ja' 'od zug ces gsungs la gnas kyi che ba kirti bstan pa rab rgyas pas rta lor rnam rgyal gling du mdzad pa sogs dkar chag le tshan gsum mthong / zhes 'byung ba la brtags pas kyang byams pa 'bum gling la lo rgyus ring zhing gnas mchog gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin pa tshegs med du rtogs thub/da ltar mthong yul du lha khang rgyan lnga can gcig dang / byams khang sogs yod la/ lha khang gi gtso sku sgrol ma rang byon/ rdo las grub pa'i ston sku khru gsum can/ shing las grub pa'i ston sku/ mtho sgang can gyi rgya gar li ma'i dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rgya gar li ma'i sgrol dkar/ sgrol ljang / dzam+bha lha/ dbyangs can ma bcas li sku drug cu lhag dang / khru dgu can gyi byams sku 'bog bzhengs/ sgrol ma'i gser thang dang sangs rgyas sman bla/ rje bla ma'i tshogs zhing / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu bas gnang ba'i sgrol ma'i thang ga 'jigs byed thang ga lha mo dang chos rgyal thang ga mgon khang du gnyan chen dang tsan mir+sha'i thang ga ste thang ga mi nyung tsam bzhugs/ pe cin dpar ma'i bka' 'gyur pota re drug dang / gzungs 'dus/ gung thang sku phreng drug pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang pos spyi lo1990lor gnang ba'i sde dge bka' 'gyur tshar gcig bcas pota sum brgya longs pa bzhugs/ mchod cha la/ tsen gnyis/ tsi cha/ dung dkar cha/dung chen cha/ tsong chen gcig dgon pa'i grwa rgyun la sngon chad mi nyung tsam bzhugs par bshad mod kyang /nga brgyad gong la bod btsun bcu gcig las med/ da ltar lbang bsod nams dang / sgrol ma/ 'jigs byed/ bskal bzang bcas so/ /dgon pa'i dus chen ni hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad yin/ da ltar sbyin bdag la zhang khongs gsum gyi grangs bsdoms pas nyis stong bzhi brgyar yong/ da lta'i dgon sar mu'u cu — 594 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bdun longs so/ /spyi lo1952la rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rig gnas dngos rdzas bdag gnyer khang 'dzugs rgyu'i chog mchan bkod/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rgyal yongs thengs dang po'i rig gnas dngos rdzas gnad che'i srung skyob kyi gras su ba'ag cing bsgrags/1965lor rgyal gzhung gis sgor mo mang bo gnang ste srid du smi sum brgya lnga bcu dang dpangs su smi nyi shu longs pa'i chu rags brtsigs / chu mdzod chen mos nyen pa'i brag phug mi nyung bar bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra tshang ma gnas spos pa dang / ri gzar la skas dang zam pa sogs bskrun/ ngang gis 'jig pa'am gtor zhig thebs pa'i lha khang dang sku khang sogs bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ da lta rdo brkos kyi sku khang brgya dang sum cu la brag brkos kyi sku brgyad brgya lhag bzhugs/ rnam pa sna tshogs su bzhengs pa'i 'dra sku'am snang brnyan smi gnyis can dgu brgya lhag mchis/ mtho tshad la smi nyi shu rtsa bzhi can gyi 'bog sku zhig kyang bzhugs/ sngon chad gling der khang rnying khang mig brgya lhag dang / rgyun sdod kyi grwa btsun yang drug brgya lhag la son zhes dgon der bzhugs pa'i dkar chag tu gsal/ da ltar rgyal khab dang zhing chen/ len zhwa khul/ yun cin rdzong bcas kyis thugs khur 'og dgon de phyi nang mgron po'i mig gi dga' ston du gyur pas rjes su yi rang byed pa'i gnas so/ /byams pa 'bum gling zhol ma/byams pa 'bum gling zhol ma ni/ da lta'i yun cin rdzong wang the(rwar+ha)zhang du chags/ thog mar chags pa'i dus ni thang rgyal rabs su bshad/grub mtha' thog mar rgya dgon yin yang ming rgyal rabs nas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dge lugs su bsgyur/ bla brgyud kyang zhe h+pha the(༅ chor+sha)zhes pa ste sku phreng gsum pa bcing grol gong rol tu zhing bzhes/blo bzang yon tan zhes pa'i sku phreng bzhi ba de1952lor gshegs/ 1958lo'i sngon du grwa shag khang mig bzhi cu zhe bdun la/ sa khyon smi bzhi brgya bdun cu/ grub chu phug ces pa'i lha khang la smi lnga bcu dang /sangs rgyas stong sku'i sgrub phug la smi nyi shu lhag yod/ grwa ba'ang kha shas bzhugs skad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang rje tsong kha ba/ rje btsun byams mgon dang / thugs rje chen po/ sgrol ma bcas kyi 'dra sku mi nyung tsam bzhugs/ da ltar yang snga ma'i phyag len ltar srung ma lha mo dang rgyud kyi phyag len bstar/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che rten du bzhugs/ thang sku 'bog sku dang bcas pa brgya dang sum brgya lhag kyang yod/mchod cha la rnga gcig sbub gcig tsi cha gcig dung dkar bzhi snang / grwa rgyun la'ang ṭang rgyal mtshan dang /don grub/ thub bstan/ rta mgrin/ dpal 'byor bcas bzhugs shing rgyun ldan gyi chos spyod spel mus su yod/ klu tshang lha sde la khyim tshang brgya dang dus chen ni zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad yin/ dus kyi dbang — 595 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/gis chag 'jig lan du mar thebs kyang / 1980lor phyir slar gso mdzad zin/ da ltar gang ci'i bgyi ba yar ldan du 'gro mus su snang ngo / /kan
