go'u dgon/lo kya tun bde chen rab rgyas gling dang nye zhing / da lta len zha khul yung cing rdzong li'u kya 'gag grong rdal gyi mnga' khongs su chags/a mdo chos 'byung du brag rin po che spungs pa lta bu la a ka ru'i nags dang / dri zhim po'i me tog ngo mtshar ba'i chu mig sogs kyis brgyan pa'i sgrub phug tu/ thugs rje chen po rang byon bzhugs pa'i dkar chag lo rgyus gsal kha can snang la/ gzhan ya nga rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i zhabs lham/ thub pa myang 'das kyi sku chen po bcas bzhugs zhes gsungs/ me yos1807lor 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs 'dir phebs te thugs rje chen po rang byon gyi sku brnyan la gzigs te/ sku dngos de mchod rten dkar po sogs su gzengs kyi steng nas lo ltar gdan 'dren gyin yod pa la snga ma zhig klus spyan drangs te 'di sku tshab yin zer mkhan yang 'dug gsungs te dpyad gzhi can du snang / lcags yos1891lor rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog kun go'u dgon 'di la phebs te zhag gcig bzhugs gnang ste gnas 'brel byas/phebs zhor lo gya tun dgon nas bde mchog mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug re bton/ bde mchog chog rkyang las bdag 'jug mi mdzad pa la khron pa brgya thebs su sprad de phyin nas tshes bcu nam yod la bdag 'jugs gsung rgyun btsugs/ phyir phebs lam rgya mo bong zhon zhig gis rjes zin nas shing tog phul nas mi snang bar gyur pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus rje nyid kyi rang rnam du gsal/ rgyun bzhugs grwa ba 'ga'i mchod 'bul phyag mchod snga sor byed cing195rngalo'i rjes su dgon pa'i lha khang rten bcas bshig da lta slar gso cung byas te grwa ba gcig gnyis tsam yod ces lo sprul dkon mchog mkhyen rab kyis gsungs so/ /mkhar dmar dgon nam hong khrin zi/mkhar dmar dgon nam hong khrin zi(phre1lor+sha)ni/ da lta'i yun cin rdzong zhi hu zhang mkhar dmar sde khrod du chags/thog mar 'debs pa'i dus ni thang rgyal rabs kyi mjug tsam yin par bshad/ skabs der rgya nag byang dar gyi bstan par grags/ phyis su ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa bla nas bla ru 'phel ba dang mnyam du/ grub mtha' dge lugs su 'gyur/ mdo rgyud gnyis las sngags phyogs gtso gnyer byas/ dus rabs rim byung gi 'phel 'gros dang bstun dgon pa'i lha khang dang grwa shag sogs kyi rgya bskyed/ men ju gong ma khang zhi'i ring la/ dpangs la smi bcu gnyis dang / zlum khyon la smi200lhag ldan pa'i mchod rten chen po zhig bzhengs/ der nang rten gang yin rang ma 'tshal/ skabs — 596 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/der grwa btsun yang lnga bcur longs pa 'dus/ sa zhing mu'u lnga bcu lhag yod pa ni grwa ba'i 'tsho rten kha nar dmigs/ shar lho nub ste phyogs gsum du tshom sa chen lha khang re bzhengs pa la rgyan lnga bcu lhag tu son/brkos dang ri mo tshon rtsi sogs kyi khyad chos ngo mtshar can mang du yod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sogs kyi 'dra sku rgyu gang rung las grub pa mang du bzhugs shing / bod kyi skyes chen dam pa du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas khyad par du 'phags pas/phyogs bzhi'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyi dang ba kun nas 'dren pa'i chos sde ming du grags par bshad/ da ltar yang spyi'i dgon par smi950dang khang sa smi60lhag zin/ dad ldan mang tshogs sum stong lhag du brgal/1958lo dang1967lo'i rig gsar sogs chom pos meg med du bcom na'ang / mang tshogs kyi dad pa ni brtan cing 'gyur med yin pa gong rim gyis kyang mkhyen pas/ da ltar snga ma las rgya bskyed du bzhengs so/ /sgang mgo'i dgon/sgang mgo'i dgon(lo༈ spyir+sha)ni da lta'i yun cin rdzong mkhar las spyi le nyi shu'i lam bar du chags/mdo smad chos 'byung du/ brag rin po che spungs pa lta bu la a ka ru'i nags dang / dri zhim po'i me togango mtshar ba'i chu mig sogs kyis brgyan pa'i sgrub phug tu thugs rje chen po rang byon bzhugs/ dkar chag tu tā ming yung lo(1402lo'i tshun)rgyal po'i dus/ yul 'di'i mi gcig phyugs 'tsho la phyin pas brag kha byang bstan zhig na/ ri bong gnyis 'gro 'ong byed pa dang brag nang nas sgo phye'am zhes pa'i sgra thos pa zla bo la bshad pas phye zhig smras pa bzhin byas pas/ brag la sgo rang dod du song ba'i nang nas/ yu shel las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku byung ba rang yul du lan kha shas khyer kyang / 'phral du brag phug tu phyir phebs pa'i gnas der dgon chags/ phyis su sngar gyis snang brnyan rang byon nang bzhugs su phul te 'jig rten gsum lhag par dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku 'di bzhengs pa yin zhes gsungs la/ gzhan yang rgyal dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i zhabs lham/ thub pa myang 'das kyi sku chen po bcas bzhugs zhes gsungs/ rgya'i yig cha mig mthong lag son byung ba las/ yon rgyal gyi mjug dang ming rgyal rabs gsar tshugs tsa na/ khre go'u(༅hākhri) zho go'u(7/dahāspyi) zi than(r+sha7khri) zho ke(7/)7) lu'o zhan ban(༅lodzi) ste sde grong lngar dgon pa re btsugs/ phyis kyi tā ming khrin hwa(7'a4shā) srid lo gnyis par(spyi lo1466)dgon chung de lnga bo gong bu gcig tu bsdus shing rgya bskyed pa las gling 'di grub par bshad/ de phyis ma 'gyangs par sreg zar bstems te 'jig man chin gong ma kong zhi'i skabs su/ zheng du smi don gnyis/ phug tu smi so drugagyen du smi bco brgyad yod pa'i rang byung gi brag phug cig tu/ sgrol dkar lha khang / byams khang / byams pa glo nyal lha khang / mgon khang / 'du khang / bu 'dod lha khang(rgya'i lugs srol)ste khang mig drug cu re brgyad du 'dra sku brgya dang gya brgyad bzhengs shing grub chu'i khrus gsol gyi tshul du lhang nger lhan ner bzhugs — 597 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/snang / gong ma chan lung gi skabs su brag khung mdun ngos su lha khang zhig brkos pa la ring tshad la smi bco lnga/dpangs su smi gsum/ zheng du smi gsum yod/ de la da dung tshangs la smi gang longs pa'i rdo'i ka ba zhig yod pa da lta'i bar snang / rten pa lha mo/ mdo sngags gnyis las sngags phyogs gtso gnyer bya/ grwa ba lnga bcu lhag dang rje'i gsung 'bum sogs glegs bam yang mi nyung ba bzhugs skad/ 1958lor rmeg med du bcom yang / 197rngalor dad ldan hung chon sogs sde grong du ma'i skye bo nyis stong lhag gis sbyor 'jags gya nom phul te slar gso bgyis/ grwa ba'ang 'ga' re phyir dgon gling du log ste gang ci'i bgyi ba yar ldan du spel mus su yod do/ /ljo kya tun bde chen rab rgyas gling /ā+o kya tun bde mchog lha khang(mtshan dngos bde chen rab rgyas gling)ni/ da lta'i yun cin rdzong lo'u kya zha 'ang grong gi lu'o khron sde khrod du chags/ (mo/zar+sā༅༅)//khro) rdzong mkhar gyi mdun ngos spyi le gsum gyi sa ru snang /dgos dbang gis gna' gtam lta bu'i ngo mtshar che ba'i lo rgyus dum bu zhig smras pa la/ mdo smad chos 'byung 'a sa/ lbo kya tun bde mchog rang byon 'di la lo rgyus 'dra min 'dug kyang / ba so rje drung gis mdzad zer ba'i dkar chag dang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi gsung mthun par pham mthing ba chung ba la rgyab brten nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yab yum gnyis ga'i sku ma nyams par bzhugs pa la bde mchog rang byon du grags par gsungs pa rje gsung zur dang mthun pas 'khrul ba med la/ de yang bon rnams kyis bal bo pham mthing bar 'bod cing bal yul du a ya de ba chen por grags pa dang / de'i gcung bal bo mi tri ba'am dus 'khor ba/ de'i gcung thang chu ba'am thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen zer/ 'di gsum sku mched dang nā ro ba'i slob ma yin/ gcen pham mthing che ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo su ma ti garti ste blo gros bzang bo/yongs grags la bal bo bha dan+ta zer ba des thang chu bas ngag gi dbang phyug bsgrubs pa'i dngos grub kyi lhag ma bzhes pas thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur/ (dgon pa'i mtshan da lta ba ni1994lor bse blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gis bstsal tothang chu ba bod du bsod snyoms la phebs dus rong ngur smig tu brang ti la mngon pa gsan/ bsgrub pa'i sgo nas bskyed rim la brtan pa thob/ thun mong gi dngos grub ci rigs pa yang grub/phyis su mu stegs kyi pan+ḍi ta gcig dang rnal 'byor ma gcig rtsod pas pham par mdzad pas khyed phyi'i rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du bskrad kyin zer/ nga bde mchog gi rnal 'byor ba la gang yang mi lto gsungs te bsrung ba ma byas par btang snyoms su bzhugs/ khong gnyis kyis bskrad pa'i 'khor lo byas pas lan kyang zer/ gang ltar rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar dngos grub kyi rdzas 'ga' zhig 'tshol du 'gro gsungs pa sus kyang bshom ma thebs par bod nas tshur byon/ mi nyag tu rgyal bo la dbang bskur pa'i bla ma mdzad cing re zhig bzhugs/ ljongs rgyu bas rgya — 598 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nag gi yul mthar ri dkar po gnam la langs pa 'dra ba gzigs/ ci yin dris pas phyi'i rgya mtsho yin zhus/sngar gyi de dran nas ngas de dus bsrung ba zhig byas na bzlog pa la tshegs med de da bal bo rgan pos rang yul la mthong ba yin 'dug gsungs slar log thugs phab nas rgya nag gi phyogs gcig tu bha dan ta'i gtsug lag khang zhes pa'i bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs te/ der bzhugs nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa shri tsakra sam bha ra'i sgo nas smin cing grol bar mdzad/ deng sang gi bar du dpal bde mchog gi cho ga dar zhing rgyas par grags zhes bde mchog chos 'byung du gsungs pas pham mthing ba chung ba 'di la ngos 'dzin dgos pa 'dra la/pham mthing sa cha'i ming yin zhing dgon pa'i ming la bha dha zi zer bas kyang shes sam snyam/ yang chos 'byung de nyid las/ pham mthing ba sku mched bzhi'i che ba chos kyi blo gros la bla ma nā ro bas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar song na dngos grub 'thob par lung bstan pa bzhin der bzhud de/ phyis 'dir song cha med cig byung zhes kyang gsungs/ rgya'i yig rnying ngag rgyun dkar chag tu bkod par/ bal bo phal mthing ba chung ba la rje btsun rnal 'byor mas lung bstan te phyogs 'dir phebs/ zas 'tshong gi bu mo zhig phyag rgyar bsten/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du brag sgo bcad de sgrub pa mdzad pas zung 'jug sku brnyes/ tā ming khrin hwa'(lo4shā)rgyal po khrir bzhugs lo gnyis pa me khyi lo'i ston dus/ lo yun zer ba'i rgad po zhig gi g.yog po gnas der zhing rmod du phyin pa'i mdun du ri bong gnyis phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa dang brag sgo 'byed dam zhes pa'i sgra lan gsum grags/ zhib tu nyan par brag dmar gyi dkyil na sgra de byung bas skrags te khyim du log nas bshad/ lo yun gyis khyod gnyid logs pa'i rmi lam min na sang yang grags 'ong / de dus phye zhes lan thob byas/ de bzhin byas pas 'brug ldir ba lta bu'i 'ur sgra dang sa g.yos/ 'ja' tshon bcas brag sgo phye ba'i nang nas yab yum zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa'i sku ma nyams pa thon/ lo de nas da lta'i srid gsal khrir bzhugs bcu gcig pa lcags yos bar sum brgya re bdun song / zas 'tshong gi bu mo ni/ pham mthing ba yul 'dir phebs dus/bu mo lo bcu gnyis can zhig gi dpral bar bsgrub pa'i sidhā ra'i dga' 'khyil 'phos pas mtshan ldan du dgongs/ de'i ma rgan mo la sbyin bdag bcol te nye logs der sgrub pa mdzad/ nyin gcig bu mos 'tsho ba phul te sang nye ba rnams kyis mo rma phar kha'i grong zhig tu bag mar byin pas 'gro ba'i skar ma la slebs song /a ma rgas nas 'ong mi nus/ sbyin bdag gzhan zhig btsal dgos 'dra zhus/ khyed sang nyin 'dir slebs dus bzhon pa las bab nas nga la phyag gsum btsal na rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ phyi nyin skyel mi rnams kyis bu mo rta las 'bab ma bcug kyang / mos yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa dang gsol ba btab pas de 'phral rlung chen po g.yos te bu mo gar song cha med du gyur zer/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes/ lcang skya rin po che sku 'phreng snga phyi/ thu'u bkwan rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen bla ma sku 'phreng bcas kyis yab yum gyi sku la na bza' rus rgyan/ phyag mtshan sogs cha thams cad phun sum tshogs pa dang / brag phug sgo la lan kun yol ba lha khang gi zhig gsos gang dgos/ dgon par bde mchog sgrub mchod btsugs/ gung thang 'jam pa'i — 599 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/dbyangs kyis yab yum gyi sku la gser chab phyag gis byugs pas gsang rdzas shin tu bsil ba'i reg bya can zhal du gsol pas zad mi shes pa phyag tu bab tshul rnam thar du/ mkha' dbyings til gang ltar bzhugs rgyal rnams kyi/ /thugs rje'i drod kyi grong khyer mthon por 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dpag ngaka' la/ sde khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi mas kyang rmi lam la bsnyad bal bo kha shas dang gsung 'phros byung tshul zur tsam thos kyang smra ga la nus/ sngon gyi chos 'byung 'gar theg dman 'gog snyoms pa mang po ri la bzhugs pa sa brkos pas thos te sangs rgyas 'od srung gang na bzhugs/ rgyal po kri kri gang na bzhugs/ zhes gsung phebs tshul snang la/ de bzhin gzhan don du bskal ba'i bar du 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug pa'i byang 'phags kyang yod pa dang / de las kyang rgyud du/ bskal ba bskal ba stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes pa ste ye shes kyi tshogs ji tsam 'phel stobs che ba bzhin bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur ba sngags bla med kyi khyad chos yin zhing / dag ma dag gi sgyu lus thob nas rnam smin gyi lus rags pa dang rten brten pa'i 'brel ba chad ma chad kyi khyad par yod kyang rten de la gang 'dod du 'byung 'jug byed nus pa 'dra la/ brten pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshe rten gyi lus rags pa yang rnam smin gyi cha dag nas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs shing / slob mi slob gang ltar yang sku gdung du grags pa tsam las zung 'jug dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha'i sprul ba yin pas gsang sngags bla med kyi lam la brten nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rang rgya bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa bo rnams kyi mi rkyen du che zhing mthong thos dran reg don ldan du the tshom med pa ni/ gung thang rin po ches/ zung 'jug sar gshegs grub mchog pham mthing ba/ /rags pa'i za ma tog gi bkod pa'i lus/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar bcas skur bzhengs te/ /skyes dgu'i mgon por sgyu ma'i gar gyis brtson/ /zhes dang /rje chos kyi nyi mas/ ā+o kya tun du bal bo pham mthing bas/ /rdo rje phag mo rgya mo'i rnam pa can/ /phyag rgyar bzhes te zung 'jug brnyes pa yi/ /sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu mjal lags sam/ / de yi drung du phyi nang gsang mchod dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rdo rje glu gar gyis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mnyes byas te/ /mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i gsol ba btab lags sam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas kyi ngo bo yang / dang bo brag khung gi sgo gcod byed kyi brag ri rtsar lhung ba la yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa dang / sgrub khang gi mdun ngos g.yas g.yon na dbang phyug yab yum gyi rtags kyi rnam pa thad sor gnas shing dur khrod kyi mi ro'i gzugs sogs bde mchog gi gnas kyi khyad chos tshang ba dang / mdun gyi lung ba g.yas g.yon dang / rma chu yang thur du 'bab par gzhir bzhag kyang snang tshod la gyen du 'gro ba'i nyams 'char la/ ri klu dmar hang nge ba sogs kyis nang rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs mtshon zhing phyi nang gi rten 'brel las gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlobs nus su snang ngo / /zhes 'byung ba las bde mchog rang byon gyi lo rgyus gcig bu ma yin te/ gnas 'dir grub chen pham mthing ba'i thang ga'ang rten gtsor 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ngo bshus kyi tshul du bgyis pa'o/ /dgon der mgon khang dang / 'phags pa kun tu bzang bo'i lha khang / rung khang / grwa shag khang mig — 600 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bcu phrag lhag ā+o seng bla ma dang / ā+o 'bas drung gi nang chen nam gzim khang bcas yod/ rten gyi gtso rigs la'ang bde mchog yab yum dang / ston pa li sku mi tshad/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po/ klu sgrub/a ti sha rje tsong kha ba sogs byin can brgya phrag bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi 'al thang / snar thang bka' 'gyur/ gsang sngags rgyud sde'i skor sna tshogs pa/ sher phyin sogs mdo mang bcas pota su ma brgya lhag bzhugs/ ljo/ seng bla ma dang lbo 'bas drung gi sku gdung mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ rgyun bzhugs grwa btsun sum cu rtsa grangs 'al 'dus pa la/ dus rgyun gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smad rgyud ltar gyi 'chad nyan las dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub mchod dang / rgyud sde'i cho ga tshogs su rgyun 'don/ bla mchod smon lam bcas dar/ srung ma dpal 'khor 'o sa sdom pa'i lū nag dril gsum la rnal 'byor bya mkhan mgon po nag po gdong ba'i ba dang phyag bzhi ba bsten/ tshes brgyad la gdong bzhi ba'i dus gtor bskang gso chag med/ da dung mgon gur ram chos skyong bcas kyi gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol yod/ yul gyi gzhi bdag kā lo ye la bsang mchod dang rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i co dar bsgrengs pa sogs chos spyod rgya cher spel/ de sngon men ching gong ma'i thung ṭi'i khri skabs su rten ya nga me 'jigs thebs kyang phyis su kong zhi'i skabs slar bzhengs/1958lor dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad nyams rgud shul med du btang / 198 1lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes bcu gsu ma nyin chos sgo slar phye 'ing ljo zhabs drung gis bskul te lha khang dang rten gsum bskyar bzheng gi dbu tshugs/ da lta dgon pa'i rnam pa slar grub ste btsun pa bcu gnyis bzhugs shing chos spyod phal cher gna' srol ltar rgyun 'khyongs/ bde mchog gi zas/ mchod dang smon lam mdor bsdus/ dmigs brtse ma bcas kyi par shing kha gya chos 'dzin gyis brkos/ dgon pa'i spyi 'jog dang btsun pa'i 'tsho ba thams cad zhal 'debs dang grong chog la brten te/ mchod gzhis grong tsho dud kha bzhi brgya lhag la mi grangs nyis stong las brgal/swo 'bas drung sku phreng thog ma ni ā+o kyā tun rang sar sku 'khrungs/ shing sku na phra dus nas bde mchog gi gnas ngo mtshar can nyid du chos grwa 'grim sa / dgon pa skyong khur yun ring mdzad pas yu la mis gtsug tu bkur/sku tshe smad tsam la bod dbus su chibs bsgyur te chos sde dag nas sgrub pa ring du mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu lha ga bzhes mthar rang yul nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i gdung rten bzhengs pa dgon par bzhugs/de'i ya nga srid dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya tsho ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug ste spyi lo192nga'o ra slar lī kya tun gyi yab le'u cin lin dang yum ljo krin we'i sras su sku bltam/sa/ bla ma gong ma sku gsheg khar yang sprul 'byon pa'i gsung dang mdzad pa gang thad nas rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog la zhus pas/ lī 'bas drung gi yang sprul la rtags bab nas thugs thag bcad zer/ rjes ma'i 'di ba gdan sa ra 'khod phyin hor gtsang yi ge thang dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs shing hor gtsang tshogs 'du 'jigs med don yod rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom khrims bzhes pa dang / blo bzang 'jigs med dge rgan du — 601 —

len zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/bsten te klog bslabs/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa shing bya lo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar 'grims nas phar phyin dam bca' ba'ag bde thang mkhan po blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i spyan snga nas bsnyen par rdzogs/195〈lo'i rjes su gdan sa rang dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun tshogs grong gseb so nam pa'i las la zhugs pa dang khong nyid kyang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nye logs lha sde gong 'gab tu thon skyed du zhugs/ chos dad rang dbang thob phyin khong slar bkra shis 'khyi' du bzhugs shing / 1981lor gdan sa'i bde mchog yab yum gyi byin sku bskyar ba'eng gi sbyin bdag mdzad pa dang gung ru tshang gi bde mchog shog sku stong phrag dang pham mthing ba'i gdung rus sogs nang rten du bzhugs/ da dung rim par thub dbang dang / lung ston byams pa/rigs gsum mgon po/ rje tsong kha ba/ kun mkhyen bcas bzhengs grub/ nye ba'i lo du ma'i ring rje 'di ba bsgrub bya mang bo'i rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad pa dang / yi ge thang dgon/ a mchog dgon/ bde thang dgon/ sman lung dgon/ chas bu gshis dgon/ bla brang dgon pa/ shis tshang sgar sar/ rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon/ rnga ba'i khang sar dgon/ nyi ma'i dgon/ mtsho sngon thar shul dgon/ so ga po'i lbang dgon bcas nas gdan zhus la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang lung rjes gsum lan mang gnang / da dung bla brang rgyud stod pa'i khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad/ rgyud smad pa'i khri ba/kyai rdor khri ba/ sman pa'i khri ba/ a mchog dang sgyis tshang 'bo ra bcas dgon pa'i khri ba/ lam rim khrir bzhugs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gser khri dang mkhan po bcas kyi yang sprul dag gi dbang lung man ngag gi bla mar bkur bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /lī seng bla ma zhes pa ni yu/la ljo kya tun nas sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra mo nas rab tu byung te gdan sa rang gi chos sgor 'grims te chos spyod rab tu gsal ba'i 'don cha bslabs pa ma zad/ mdo sngags spyi dang sgos rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gsan rgya che ba dang / dgon par sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ sa zhing re yod pa chos grwar spyi 'jog gnang / 'di ba'i sku phreng phyi ma de kun lho'i bsang chu rdzong gi hor gtsang spang g.yag 'brug mo'i bur sku bltams/ chung kha tshig gsal tsam nas nga ā+o kya tun nas yin zhes sngon gnas rjes dran gyi rtags bstan/ bla ma ma ṇi bar zhus pas na ā+o kya tun du bskyal nas rab tu byung na bzang gsungs pa ltar/ dgon nyid kyi chos gral du zhugs bcug ste ngam chos mang bo bklags/ mtshan la blo bzang chos grags btags pa la rgya skad dutsho chor+sha zhes 'bod/ de phyis bkra shis 'khyil ba'i tshogs chos su phyag phebs nas mdo sngags kyi 'jings la zhugs/ khyad par du bla ma bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos ltar rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i snying bo rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi bshad sgrub las bde mchog sgrub mchod chag med dang /yid dam chos skyong zhal bzhi ba'i snyan mtshams bzhugs pas dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba dngos su spyan drung la 'khor zhes grags/ sku tshe smad la rgya nang pe cin sogs su chibs bsgyur cing dgon ma lag du ma'i khri mdzad pas bstan 'phrin rgyas/ dgon rang la sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad mang bo sbyor 'jags — 602 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mdzad mthar sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med grags pa rgya mtsho zhes pa ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi ste spyi lo1924lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ya rdzi rdzong rdo sbis yul nas sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad steng a lags bla kho rin po ches sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos bzung / ljo kya tun gyi gdan sar 'khod/ chos grwa bla brang du zhugs nas chos 'dzin yon tan zhes pa'i dge slong dge rgan du bsten/ 1958lo'i rjes su rang yul du phebs nas bzhugs/ 19nga6lor ā+o kya tun du phyag 'byor 'phral sku yi bkod pa bsdus/gdung rten mchod rten bzhengs nas dgon par bzhugs/ sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang 'jigs med ces pa ni/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos lor mtsho sngon khongs rdo sbis nas yab lha lung tshe ring dang yum klu mo rgyal gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ ā+o zhabs drung dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mchos kun mkhyen drug par zhus pa'i bka' bkod ltar/ khri chen rab brtan rgya mtsho'i mchog sprul bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtshos ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / 1994lo ste shing khyi la gdan sar bkod/ ljo zhabs drung mdun sar rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom khrims mnos shing / zhabs drung nyid kyi drung du chos bka' ci rigs thugs gsan gnang bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /de sngon bstan sde ma brlags gong gung ru mkha'i 'gro ma dkon mchog rig 'dzin dpal mo thengs 'gar phebs nas bde mchog gi bdag 'jug gnang ba dang / rje gser khang ba phebs te oṃ gsum ma'i sbyin sreg chig 'bum drug khri phul/ yang rab byung bco lnga'i nang bde mchog rang byon de gdul bya'i las ltos kyi dbang gis me 'jig byung ba la/ bla brang a khu rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i bka' bkod ltar yul mis bskyar du bzhings/1958lor dgon pa bsnubs kyang / da ltar slar lha khang dang grwa shag nyung tsam bskrun/ rten 'gangs byin can phal cher bzhengs/ rgyun bzhugs btsun pa bcu gnyis tsam 'dus nas phyag ma/chod sngon ltar tshugs/bde mchog gi zas mchod dang smon lam mdor bsdus/ dmigs brtse ma bcas kyi par shing 'ga'ang tshags so/ /chos 'khor dgon/chos 'khor dgon(ṭhazar+sha)ni/ yun cin rdzong yan ko 'gag grong brdal gyi ci gya sde grong du chags/thog mar 'debs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma khrin hwa(lo4shā)bya ba'i skabs su bshad/dgon sa spyi la smi lham po1980dang / khang sa la smi lhan po 280yod/ snga mar khang ba gyan bdun cu lhag yod la/ grwa btsun yang bzhi cu lhag tu son skad/ man ju rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung ṭi'i skabs su dus zing gi sreg zar bstums/ skabs der co slong chen(ṭhaṣ+ṭhasto'i)bya bas thog drangs/ grwa btsun dang yul mi rnams kyis slong mo las bsags pa'i rgyu sbyor la brten dgon pa gong zhol gnyis kyi tshul du bzhengs kyang /gong ma de spyi lo1942lor mer 'jig zhol ma ni1958lor rten dang brten pa rnams bcom/ ma 'jig — 603 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul yon cin rdzong gi khongs/gong du smi do can gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas dang rje tsong kha ba'i thang ga gcig re/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing /'jigs byeng lha bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig dpal ldan lha mo'i thang ga dang / rnga gcigasbub gcig tsi gnyis/ dung dkar gcig bcas mchod rdzas kyang snang / spyi lo1984lor slar gso mdzad tshun nye sras brgyad sogs 'bog sku dang ras thang mi nyung ba bzhengs par ma zad/ gsung gi rten yang glegs bam mi nyung ba gsar blu mdzad/ da ltar yon bdag la dud khyim sum brgya lhag la mi grangs nyis stong drug brgya lhag 'dus shing / lha khang grwa shag dang bcas pa bsdoms pas rgyan bcu dgur nye ba zhig bskrun yod pas/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong mus su yod do/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs/bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chagaka ju grong khyer ni len zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi mnga' 'bas su gtogs pa'i rdzong rim pa'i grong khyer zhig dang / rang skyong khul srid gzhung gi lte gnas kyang yin/ lo rgyus yig tshangs ltar na/ chin rgyal rabs sngon la sa 'di bod 'brog mi spyang gis bzung zhing gzhis chags/ thang r+pā yon gyi srid lo dang bo nas son zhis nyen srid lo drug pa'i bar grong khyer 'di lte bar gyur pa'i khor yug yu la gru bod kyis bzung ste mi lo sum brgya lhag song zhes 'byung ba dag gsal bor brjod pas na/ yul gru 'dir bod brgyud nang bstan dar ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal bor shes thub snyam pa dang bcas brjod par bya ba la/bod ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi gdod ma'i mi rigs shig yin te/ swe rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rim gyis ka ju'i sar gzhis yod/ thang ko tsung gi skabs su tsho ba'am shog pa mi nyung ba grub pa'i mthun rkyen gyis/ ka ju ni bod kyis phyogs yongs nas bzung ba'i yul gru zhig du gyur/ thang ṭi ti srid lo dang por(spyi lo756)an hri'i don rkyen gyi bab la bstun te/ bod mi 'bor chen ka jur lhags te gzhis/ gung ti srid lo dang po(spyi lo762)la/ lung g.yon(lo+o)sa cha thams cad bod kyis bzung / ce tu'u bya ba'i srid shag lnga btsugs/ka ju ni de las gcig yin/sung byang ma'i skabs su/ rma chu dang tsong chu'i rgyud sogs su bod kyi tsong dkar rgyal po'am jo sras kyi srid dbang btsugs/ ka ju'i bod pa hu snying byams bya ba ko khrang ngam da ltar thu lu h+phan du grags par phyin/bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud 'khrul med du bshad pa chi rnam gling ba bya ba ka jur spyan 'drongs/ ka ju'i bod mi mtshan snyan can srid skyong zon khrang bya ba dang bgros mthar/ chi rnam gling ba jo sras su bskos/ gnas yes gung ngam da lta'i gan lho'i bla brang du spar/ ka ju'i bod mi shog pa thams cad dbang du bsgyur/ bod chin thang shog pa'i mgo ba lis lis tsun dang / ma'o khran gyi 'go ba bon po che gnyis kyis rang nyid kyi stobs shugs drag po la brten nas jo sras rang kho ju dang tsong dkar du spor bcug lis lis tsun gyis rang nyid blon po zhig tu brdzus shing jo sras kyi mtshan bzung ste/ bod mi shog pa khag la jo sras ma'i khran du spo bcug rim gyis rma chu dang tsong chu'i rgyud sogs dbang bsgyur nus pa'i dmag mi hrag bsdus drug khri bdun stong longs pa'i bod kyi srid dbang btsugs/ byang du mi nyag la thug shar du sung byang ma la 'brel/ sung dang mnyam 'brel gyis mi nyag brgyab/ sung ṭi phen gyis srid dbang bzung skabs/ jo sras kyi bu che ba zha dran gyi bu mu drin bya ba ka ju'i tshi hrir bskos/ de phyis sog po han gyis spyi lo1227par ka ju bzung rjes/ bod mis ka — 605 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs/—ju'i dpon gnas bzung ba'ang mang / 1269lor bod kyi zhon nges si to yon hri h+phu btsugs/ ka ju bdag skyong mdzad/ bod pa skyid bsod nams 'bum bya ba ches tha ma'i zhon bes ser bshad/ bsod nams 'bum bya ba'i dpon rgyud kyis ka ju dang bcas pa'i yul gru mi nyung ba dbang bsgyur te mi lo lnga brgya drug bcu lhag song skad/ ming rgyal rabs nas bzung rim gyis bod rnams rgya ru 'dres par gyur/gong du zhus zin gyi yul gru 'di dag bod kyis bzung ba'i sa yin pas bod dgon dar bar ha las mi dgos te/ sog po gong ma'i ring 'gro dgon yab sras rgya phebs kyi lam bar du dgon pa mang bo btab pa dang /ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa phyogs su rgyas pa'i stobs kyis sa cha 'dir yang bstan pa'i nyi ma bar med du shar/ /de la 'dir dri gtug dngos kyi rgyu cha gzhi byas dgon khag ba'i'i lo rgyus shes tshad tsam bri ba la/po en zi'am drin gzo dgon/po en zi'am drin gzo dgon ni da lta'i len zhwa'am ka ju'i grong khyer du chags/ tung men ta zi'am shar sgo'i dgon chen yang zer/thog mar 'debs dus ni wes byang ma'i rgyal rabs su yin par bshad/ phyis su sog po gong ma'i dus te spyi lo1275par dpon phen ṭang dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis bod dgon du bsgyur cing rgya bskyed du bzhengs/rten pa lha mo dang dam can la bsten/ dgon lag la len zhwa rdzong khongs kyi dmangs gtso zha gi rdo ldan byams pa gling dang g.yon byang bla kha zhang gi mon gya dgon sogs yin/ dang thog bod dgon du bsgyur pas na dgon sar yang sa mu'u sum cu lhag la lha khang dang 'du khang / khyams ra/ grwa shag sgo chen che chung gnyis/ glo 'bur/ sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod rdzas yo byad sogs gya nom du sbyar/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hong bu srid lo nyer drug par sen gang ngam chos blon yang sde 'dir bskos/ man ju gong ma dwa gung gi skabs su/bod btsun mang pos tshogs chen 'du khang bzhengs shing / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas a lags han tshang la skyong khur mdzad du bcug man ju thung ṭi srid lo dang po spyi lo1〈62lor dgon pa 'jig de phyis ka ju'i dpon po ho bsod nams 'bum gyi bu rgyud kyis sbyin bdag mdzad/ dad ldan byings kyis zhal 'debs phul ba sogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten/ slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ skabs der sgo chen gcigalha khang gyan lnga can gcig nang bzhugs su dus gsum sangs rgyas/ glo 'bur nub mar tshogs khang gyan drug bod btsun bzhugs khang rgyan bdun/ shar nub tu ra gong ma bar ma zhol ma gsum bzhengs/ ra gong gi lha khang nub mar thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang / rje sku/ byang du grwa shag ra ba bar ma me tog ldum ra/ ra ba zhal ma phyogs gnyis su phyes pa'i gcig ni bla brang grwa shag dang rta ra/ shing rta 'jog sa byed yod/ gcig ni bud shing sogs 'jog sa byed/ skabs der grwa ba lnga brgya lhag la son cing / 'brog — 606 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i 'bru nyo ba dag gi sna rta sde 'di'i rta rar bsdu'o/ /bod btsun gshegs tshe dur du sba/ ka ju'i mkhar nub tu bla ma h+phun than zhes grwa ba'i dur thang zer ba zhes yod la/ bcing grol rjes su1952lor dmag sgar rgyag dgos pa'i dbang gis gong gi bka' ltar g.yon byang bla kha'i spos kro'u phan sde khrod du/ de dus ngos zin gyi grangs ltar na mi rus cha tshang brgya lhag yod ces deng bzhugs kyi grwa rgan yen go men dang zhing ba bgres song re'i ngag las thos/ ma ju gong ma'i srid dbang nyams dmas su 'gro ba na/ dgon pa'i bya ba yod do cog thang bla ma zhes pas skyong khur mdzad/ ming rgyal rabs skabs su we bla ma zhes pas 'dzin bdag mdzad/ dge slong 'di gnyis gshegs rjes sku gdung mkhar nub bla ma'i dur thang du sbas/ dgon nang du gdung rten re bzhengs/ bcing grol gong rol tu/ sde 'dir chos spyod bya ba rgya chen yod skabs/ sku 'bum dang / kirti/ bla brang / byams pa 'bum gling / mchod rten dkar po/ ma ha ka la dgon/ gang kro'u dgon/ ā+o gya tun/ han gya zi dga' ldan byin chags gling / mchod rten dmar po dgon sogs kyi khri ba'am/ bla ma dbu mdzad/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bcas 'dir phebs pa'i srol phyes/ spyi lo1958par dgon pa gtor/ grwa ba rnams zhing grong du spyugs/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u lhan 'dzoms gros tshogs kyi rjes su19〈5lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad tshun nas/ lha khang ngam 'du khang thog so can gyan lnga bzhengs yod/ thog khang gi sgo 'phyor 'gram gnyis su rgyal chen bzhi/ 'bar ma nas spyan 'drongs pa'i g.yang ṭi dkar po las grub pa'i ston sku khru gsum dang phyed longs tsam/ 'bog bzhengs la/ 'jigs byed/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos rgyal gnyis/ thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ gsang bdagaspyan ras gzigs gnyis/ sgrol ljang gnyis/ 'di dag gi mtho tshad la khru gang lhag re/ ras thang la/ston pa'i thang ga bla ma'i tshogs zhing / sme ba lha dgu gsan bcu/ stong phyag mgon chos lnga/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sman lha bde gshegs brgyad gnyis/ lha mo gnyis/ gdugs dkar/ rigs gsum mgon po gsum/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ gnyan thang / g.yang ṭi'i ston sku'i mdun du/ kun mkhyen drug pa/ bse drug pa/ hor tshang 'di ba'i shog thang re bzhugs/ mchod cha la/ dung chen bzhi/ dung dkar rnying ba bzhi/ sbub cha bzhi/ tsen gcig chos 'khor ri dwags pho mo/ gser tog rgyal mtshan bcas/ 'og zhol du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'bog bzos khru brgyad re/ kun tu bzang po/ rje sku/'di gnyis 'bog bzos khru gsum re/ ras thang la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ sgrol ma nyer gcigadam can/ khyams ra'i g.yas g.yon du ma ṇi 'khor chen gnyis re bzhugs/ gsung rten la/ bskal 'phags ting gsum/ yum dum pa bcu gnyis/ lam sngags gnyis/ mgon chos lnga sogs so/ /'don pa la/ bla ma mchod pa/ gnas bcu/ sman bla/ mgon chos lnga/ thar mdo/ kun rigasde 'di bskyar bzhengs tshun nas bzung 'dzin bdag yen go men nam sbyin pa rgya mtsho bya ba195〈sngon la bla — ྾—sde

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs/brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dus 'khor du zhugs pa yin gshis/ snga ma'i phyag len la ma ltos par/ dus 'khor ltar dus rtag tu 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ kun rig sogs gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis199〈lo nas bzung / bla brang dus 'khor nas grwa ba bzhi gdan 'dren zhus te/ 'jigs byed dang kun rig bdag 'jug gsungs/ dus bzang ngam dus chen/ gcig pa'i smon lam/ gsum pa'i dus 'khor bdag 'jugaba'i bar smyung gnas nyin gsum ste/ tshes bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga/ drug pa'i tshes drug la chos 'khor/'don pa bskal 'phags ting gsum gsungs/ bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga la smon lam sna lnga/ rnam dag bsang gsungs/ brgyad pa'i nang maṇ+ḍal ba'i ba/ sgrol ma'i rlung rta/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la kun rig bdag 'jug bcu ba'i lnga mchod nyin bdun gling me dang bcas / bcu gnyis pa'i bco lngarabla brang rgyud pa ltar dam can la ra ma tshe thar gtong ngo / /dgon 'di'i da lta'i 'dzin bdag pa yen go men nam sbyin pa rgya mtshor zhu ba/ 1kha99lor dgung lo drug cu re gnyis su son/ dgung lo bdun par sde 'dir zhugs shing dge tshul slong gi sdom pa ma nos/ bcu gnyis thog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dus 'khor grwa tshang e waṃ chos 'khor gling du zhugs shing 'chad nyan la 'grus ( 1kha52—195〈'o /) skabs der dus dbang gis phyir rang yu la du so nam gyi las gnyer/1962lor slar yar bla brang du phebs kyang / tho yig der mi gtogs pas sdod ma tshigs par phyir ka jur log de nas rig gsar sogs dus rkyen gyi dbang gis chos lugs kyi bya ba dang bral te so nam gyi las bgyid/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs 'tshogs tshun nas/ srid jus bzang bo'i nyi 'od la brten chos sgo bskyar 'byed kyi go skabs rnyed/ khul dang grong khyer gyi srid gros u yon dang nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs mi'i gras su'ang zhugs/ khong gis 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i bka' drin gyis dgon sde'i rten dang brten pa bskyar ba'ings la 'gro gron dmangs sgor sum 'bum lhag gi 'al 'debs reg da lta gang ci'i bya ba rnams legs/ lam du 'gro mus dang / grwa ba rgyun bzhugs brgyad kyis zhogs pa'i tshogs 'don ma chag par skyong bzhin lags pas chos dad mang tshogs dga' 'os pa'i gnas so/ /lo'u ca zi bsam grub dgon/lo'u ca zi(lca kya zi)bsam grub dgon zhes pa ni/ da lta'i lin zhwa(ka chu)ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lin zhwa grong khyer gyi mkhar gtogs zhang wa yo grong(//yi7lolo༅༅khrotshiyo)du chags/bod brgyud nang bstan chos sde 'di'i lo rgyus deb ther rgya mtsho'i nang du 'di ltar gsungs te/ lū kya zi/gshin rje lha khang / mkhar gyi phyi rol tu thā ri zi ste mchod rten ring mo ni/ gna' gtam ngag rgyun du/ kong tse 'phrul rgyal gyi bus nub gcig la bzhengs zer/ rgyu so phag lta bus khang ba brtsegs pa'i bzo dbyibs ngo mtshar ba snang / spyi rgya khyon mu'u drug cu longs pa dang nags tshal sogs yod/ lha khang khog po de phyis su bar — 608 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/du bya tshang chud pa'i ser kha byung bar/ nyin gcig rta'u 'in 'ig 'ong / lha khang khyams nas bsdad/ de nub rlung dmar drag po nam lang bar du g.yo ba byung ba'i phyi nyin gas srub mi mngon par bya tshang thang la brul/rtse mo na rtse gsum 'ga' re yod pa'i gcig dang ha shang yang mi snang / zhes lo'u kya zi dang mchod rten dgon zur tsam gleng / da lta rjes ma shul tsam yang mi mngon par ha'e rigs bsdod gnas su gyur/ lo'u kya dgon(zi)de grong bar du mi ser dad ldan tshogs kyis slar bzhengs pa ma zad/ kun lho'i gtsos dgon pa'i btsun pa dkon ma chog bsam grub ces pas legs por skyong bzhin mchis/dgon pa 'di'i lo rgyus rna son ltar na/ da nas phyir lugs ldog tu lo brgya dang lnga bcu'i sngon te man ju chan 'u nga gong ma 'i dus yas mas su btab zer la/ grub mtha' sa skya nas dge lugs par 'gyur/ rgya khyon sa nu 'u bzhi bcu lhag longs la/ rjes su dgon 'di dge 'dun pa mang bo na tsha'am 'khrug rkyen las bkrongs pa dag dgon pa'i ltag thang du sbas par da lta'ang bla ma'i thang(lko//ཿkhriltayo7lokhrikhri)zhes mi ser tshos 'bod/da dung skabs der dgon du bod btsun mi nyung ba 'dus pa dang bod mi 'brog pa rnams tshong dang gnas mjal du 'gro ba'i sgar kha dus rgyun dgon pa'i mdun thang du brgyab myong / chos sde'i lo rgyus dpang rtags su da skabs dgon nga 'i ra nang du rgan da'am lcags da(༈khri/ )zhes pa'i sdong rgan gnyis dang lcags ri'i phyi mdun rtse nga sdong mi chen gsum gyi dpung mi 'khyig pa zhig drang nger skyes 'dug de ni dgon pa'i thog ma'i sgo 'gram ngos red ces gleng / skabs der dgon du btsun pa rgya rigs rus pe can dang mā can gnyis/ bod pa 'phags pa dang brtson 'grus/ rus ha'o(༈lko)can/ ga'an skya min ser min bcu phrag bcas zhal 'dzoms/ston pa gtsos bzhugs pa'i lha khang nyis thog can dang grwa shag rung khang / sgo chen sogs du ma bzhengs kyang mi na rgyal rabs skabs su ha'e jag mā krong dbyin(pho1khye༅)gyis mer btang / shul du slar cung bzhengs pa dag1kha5〈lor rten dang brten pa yongs su bsnubs/ 1kha87lor slar mang tshogs kyi dad 'dun ltar chos sgo phye shing rgya nag lha khang gnyis lhas gcig tu mang tshogs la mchod gnas byed du bcug 1989lor kun lho'i gtsos dgon pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog bsam grub ces yul de'i mi ser gyis gdan zhus bzhin skyong gnyer du phyag phebs/ lo mang bo'i ring khong gis 'bad pa bgyis te/ da lta lha khang zhig gso dang rten ba'engs yo ngas su grub/ lha khang gi gtso sku ni snga ba'in ston pa dang / sman bla bde bshegs brgyad/ sme ba lha dgu sogs kun dga' ra ba tshon brgyan du bzhengs pa dang / gsung rten la ting 'phags bskal gsum/ ru ma dum pa bcu gnyis/ mgon chos lnga/ ga'an ka 'phan/ gdugs/ kong bu sogs bsgrugs/zangs sgrom ma ṇi drug rje 'dra sku/ paṇa chen bcu ba'i 'dra sku/ srung ma lha mo dang mgon po gur(da lta ched du bkur ba) 'don chos sogs sna thung mang bo bzhugs/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes bdun dang brgyad la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug dang zla lnga ba'i tshes lngar mang tshogs kyis lab rtse bstod pa'i byed sgo spel/dgon sa mu'u gnyis dang phyed/ zur du yul gyi ga'i bdag a myes dbri lang(༅longakhrikhyornyesko)dang spyan ras — 609 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs/gzigs/ sa'i snying bo bcas bzhugs su gsol pa'i rgya'i lha khang lhas ra bcas gsum mu'u gcig bzhengs/bsdoms pas khang mig nyer gcig longs/ mchod rten zhig kyang bzheng grabs yod/ da lta dgon de la khongs gtogs le lag gam lha khang(lo)gsum yod de/ tshang mar dad ldan mi ser dud khyim nyis brgya lhag ste grong tsho bcu/ mi grangs chig stong lhag 'dus pa'i yul de ga'i mtshan grags che zhing rten dang brten pa bod srol ji bzhin grub cing bu slob blo bzang bsam gtan bya ba 'don dag la bstan pa skyong ba'i rgyud 'dzin par gyur to/ /han gya zi'am dga' ldan byin chags gling /han gya zi'am dga' ldan byin chags gling ni ka ju grong khyer h+phu han zhang gi khongs mgar sder chags/dang thog han tho si'i mnga' khongs yin pa'i cha nas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang de skad du thogs/ dgon sar mu'u lnga tsam/ grub mtha' dge lugs su gtogs/ thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni sog po han gyis rgyal khams skyong skabs su bshad/ grwa rgyun 'phel ba'i skabs su grwa ba lnga brgya lhag tu son/ man ju gong ma thung ṭi'i mkhar nub tu gzhes pa'i mi ser mang pos dad pa'i stobs la brten te zhal 'debs kyis deng gi dgon sa 'dir lha khang chen po gcig shar nub gnyis su glo 'bur gyan gnyis re can bzhengs/ lha khang du ston sku dang / rje btsun byams mgon/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i sku re bzhugs/ man chin kong zhis srid lo nyer gcig par(spyi lo18kha5)man chin la rgol ba'i 'khrug long las yang bskyar 'jig de nas dad ldan mang tshogs kyis bskyar bzhengs mdzad na'ang / ming go srid lo bcu bdun par thengs gsum par 'jig de nas yang sgo chen gcig dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang gcig shar nub gnyis su glo 'bur rgyan gsum re/ thog so can gyan bcu/ cong khang gyan gnyis/ grwa shag gyan bcu gnyis/ mchod rten tshigs bcu gsum can gcig bzhengs pa dang mnyam du sku gsung thugs rten yang mang du bzhengs par grags mod/1958lo'i dus zing gi chom pos bcom/ lha khang dag ni zhing las slob 'bring dang / 'bru mdzod du byas pas re zhig lus/ de nas ma 'gyangs par rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi chon pos meg med du bcom/ 19〈5lor gong rim gyi chog mchan ltar/ mang tshogs kyi 'dod mos kyis dmangs sgor bzhi khri lhag gi zhal 'debs phul te/ lha khang gyan gsum can zhig bzhengs pa la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi 'bog sku dang / gnas brtan bcu drug g.yas g.yon gyi gyang ngos su sangs rgyas stong sku sogs bzhengs yod/shar nub gnyis su glo 'bur gyan gsum re/ nub khang du dam can seng zhon ma bzhengs/ shar khang du rgya lha bkwan kon dang bkwan phen sogs bzhengs 'dug da dung rung khang gyan gsum/ grwa shag gyan dgu yod/lha khang gong gi byang shar mtshams su dus 'khor mchod rten mtho shos shig bzhengs 'dug pa mjal du snang /lha khang khyams ra'i dbus su yun cin rdzong gi sde ba ga ge mos phul ba'i cong chen zhig yod pa la rgya yig bod yig — 610 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gnyis blugs 'dug ste/ zhing zur gcig tu dmigs brtse ma dang / gcig tu 'di ltar/ mchog gsum zhing la snyan sgra phul pa yis/ /sems can thams cad tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dam pa mchog reg shog/chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor gyur cig/bskal ba bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs par shog/'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig/ nyon mongs 'joms 'gyur sdug bsngal sel bar shog/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi gyur cig/ces dang / yang zhing zur cig tu/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog/yan lag drug cu'i gsung gi bkra shis shog/ mtha' bral dri med thugs kyi bkra shis shog/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog/ bsod nams dar rgyas ri rab lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog ces 'khod 'dug pa'i tshig 'bru gsal ba/ gzugs legs pa/ don zab pa bcas kyi khyad chos dang ldan pas/ rgya'i yul du'ang bod kyi rig gnas 'di ltar mthong chen du gzigs pa la bka' drin mchog tu che bas/ dus nam rtag tu rjes su yi rang bya ba'i gnas so/ /de la sde 'di'i dgon bdag gi mtshan la don grub zer/ kho rang ni199khalo'i zla8pa'i tshes17la song skabs a khu don grub ni lho phyogs su phebs shul du khel/ dgon srung ni rgan bya'i brag dkar gyi a khu dge 'dun zer ba'i lo na sum cu ma son pa zhig gis sne len mdzad pas khong la thugs rje che zhu'o/ /h+phu len dgon/h+phu len dgon nam zi ko'u ste dgon zhes pa ni/ lung dgon da lta'i ka ju'i grong khyer nan lung zhang phen gya ban zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni lbes byang ma'i skabs su yin par grags/ phyis su grub mtha' dge lugs su 'gyur/ rten srung lha mo bkur/ byams pa 'bum gling gi le lag tu bshad/ lha khang / glo 'bur/ grwa shag lha rten chos gsum mi nyung ba dang / grwa btsun yang brgya kha longs tsam yod na'ang / man ju gong ma'i skabs kyi 'khrug long dang / rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i dmangs gtso bcos sgyur/ de phyis kyi rig gnas gsar brje sogs chab srid las 'gul lan du mar byung bas shul med du 'jig spyi lo1979lor rgya'i lha khang gyan bzhi bzhengs/ 1980lor lha khang gcig bzhengs pa la ston sku dang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i 'dra sku re bzhengs yod/ 1988lor mgon khang zhig phub pa la mgon po'i 'bog sku bzhengs/1994lor sgo chen dang grwa shag gyan 'ga' phub/ dgon sa spyi la mo'u do longs tsam/ snga mar sa zhing dang sil nags kyang rgya mi chung ba yod/ da ltar rdo sbis rgo ris nas 'ongs pa'i bod btsun zhig dang rgya'i grwa ba gnyis bcas skya ser drug las grub pa'i dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang btsugs te/ gong gi 'grig lam dang srid jus ltar tshul mthun gyi chos spyod spel mus dang / kho tsho'i 'tsho ba grong chog la brten bzhin 'dug go/— 611 —

lin 'a ha'e rigs rang skyong khul ka ju grong khyer gyi khongs/grwa tsha'i thub dbang lha khang /grwa tsha'i thub dbang lha khang ni/ da lta'i len zhwa khul ka ju'i shar lho'i srang lam gyi phyogs mtshams su bzhengs yod/'di bzhengs mkhan ni/ gangs can shar phyogs rgya bod so mtshams su/ /bshad sgrub gser gyi rgyal mtshan cher bsgrengs pas/ /bshad sgrub phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen zhing / /grags pa don dang ldan pas 'dzam gling khyab/ /ces rong chen kirti tshang gis gsungs pa'i kha gya stod dge ldan bstan 'phel gling gi skyes mchog bla ma grwa tsha tshang yin te/ bla ma grwa tshang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes pa 'di/ lcags 'brug1940lor grong khyer ka ju'i 'khrungs gzhis su/ rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje'i dpal bzang bo la zhus te gsung lan ltar/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me byi1996lor thub dbang lha khang bla ma grwa tsha nyid nas rgyu sbyar gyis bzhengs/ nang rten gtso bo ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po/ rgyal ba tsong kha ba/ gnas brtan bcu drug bde bshegs so lnga/ rje btsun sgrol ma bcas kyi sku brnyan/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dag gi zhal thang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ sher phyin 'bum pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs/ da dung lha khang gi ra nang du bse bla ma'i gzim khang / mgon khang / grwa tsha tshang nyid kyi gzim shag spyi khang bcas grub/bse bla mas lha babs dus chen la lha khang rten dang brten par rab gnas mdzad/ /bod rgya'i dad ldan mang tshogs la skyabs 'gro dang / ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma bcas kyi chos sbyin mi nyung ba bstsal/ lha khang grub pa'i dga' ston skabs snga phyir kha gya stod mas gang ci'i mthun rkyen sbyar to/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/tung zhang rdzong gi khongs/bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chagatung zhang rigs rang skyong rdzong ni da lta'i len zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs su gtogs la/shar du chu klong chen po klu chu bar du blangs pa'i ten zhi sa khul gyi khongs gtogs shing kun rdzong ngam len tho'u rdzong dang thug lho ru kung ho dang skya ga mkhar te rdzong khag gnyis dang 'brel/ nub tu bsang chus bcad pa'i len zhwa rdzong dang ka ju'i mkhar grong dang 'brel/ byang du gaṅgā'i sring mo rma klong chen pos bcad pa'i yun cin rdzong dang thug yul gru der mā gya ā+o zhes pa'i sa dung dang chis gya/ zhin ten sogs nas byung ba'i rig gnas gna' rdzas kyis mtshan pa'i len gya dang thang bang gnyis nas shul bzhag rig gnas kyi dngos rdzas kyang mi nyung ba rnyed/ tshul de las lo ngo chi khri lnga stong yan gyi rdo chas rnying ba'i skabs nas bzung 'gro ba mi gzhes shing 'tsho myung ba'i lo rgyus kyang rtogs thub/byung ba lo rgyus kyi phreng rim du/ rdzong zhes pa'i las shag rang 'di'o zhes btsugs ma myong yang / snga sa nas bzung ste bod mi rdzi bu ste spyang gis bzung ba'i sa ru bshad/ chen rgyal rabs kyi skabs su lung lis cun nam chu ma mkhar dpon po'i mnga' khongs h+phun han rdzong du gtogs par bshad/ rgyal khab bcu drug gi skabs su/ srid dbang dum bu bcad bzung du gyur/ mi lo brgya tsam gyi ring la ṭo snga ma dang l+yang snga ma ṭo phyi ma/chen snga phyi gnyis/ chin nub ma sogs kyi mnga' zhabs su tshud par bshad mod kyang / bod gtso gyur gyis 'a zha dang phyis sog pos kyang bzung / yon rgyal rabs skabs nas bzung ka ju'i dpon po bsod nams 'bum gyis bskyangs pa sogs lo rgyus yig cha mi nyung ba las 'byung ngo / /de yang sa cha 'dir nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i tshul dang sgos su bod brgyud nang bstan dus nam zhig la dar dang rkyen gang la brten zhe na/ yul gru 'dir byang dar ram rgya brgyud kyi nang bstan ni we cin lho byang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su thog mar dar skad/ de nas yon dang ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su/ sa skya 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpon g.yog gis yul mdo smad du phebs lam klu chu'i rgyud du dgon sde mang po btab pa dang / de phyis rgyal ba gnyis pa rje blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa yar zla bzhin 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/ mchod rten dmar po dgon/ ma hā ka la dgon/ tes than dgon/ mye phen dgon sogs dgon sde mi nyung chags pa ma zad/ rgya dgon mi nyung ba bod dgon du gyur/ de las 'dir drangs pa'i dgon sde bzhi ga ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag las rgya'i sa cha'i dgon las nyer brgyad kyi gras su 'dren/ rdzong 'dir ho than nam chu kha zhing gi khor yug tu snga mar dgon sde mang ba dang btsun — 613 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul tung zhang rdzong gi khongs/pa mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bla ma khran nam dge slong thang du da lta'i bar grags/ rgyas bod kyi btsun pa la bla ma zhes yongs khyab tu 'bod pas/ kho tsho'i bla ma zhes pa deng dus yongs grags su bsnyen bkur byed yul sprul sku'am dge rgan la go ba ma yin par btsun pa yongs la zer/ /bcings 'grol sngon tsam du/ rdzong yongs la rgya dgon gnyis dang bod dgon drug las med/ rgyun bzhugs grwa ba bcu bdun tsam/ 1958lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa'i khyad dbang la 'thab rtsod byas pa na rgyun bzhugs kyi grwa ba rnams 'ing grong du spyugs/ dgon lha khang thams cad shul med du btang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs tshun chod du srid jus dngos 'bebs bgyis pa las/snga ma'i dgon pa dag las yun cin chu mdzod kyi dbang gis slar gso bgyid mi btub pa ma gtogs/ chos dad mang tshogs kyi 'dod mos ltar slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ 19rnga7lor rgyal gzhung nas dgon pa khag la dus zing gis rkyen pa'i dod du dmangs sgor lnga 'bum brgyad khri lnga stong sum brgya bstsal/chos lugs bdag gnyer las khungs kyis chog mchan gnang ba ltar/ mye phen dgon dang mchod rten dmar po dgon/ ma hā ka la dgon te dgon pa gsum slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs byas pa'i tshul sogs gsham du brjod par bya'o/ /mchod rten dmar po dgon/mchod rten dmar po dgon ni/ da lta'i len zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul tung zhang rigs rang skyong rdzong khongs kyi thang bang zhang du chags/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon lag yin par bshad/ sa de ga'i ri rgyud thams cad mchod rten gyi dbyibs su grub pa las/ mchod rten dmar po zhes pa de dag thams cad las gzengs su mtho ba/ dbyibs mdzes pa/ klu chu ring mo'i 'gram du lhang nger 'gying ba'i rang byon gyi gzugs su grub pas sa de ga'i dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang mchod rten dmar po dgon zhes thogs/ de thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni sung lho ma'i mjug tsam yin par bshad/ dang thog rgya dgon dang / phyis su yon rgyal rabs skabs sa skya ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang / de phyis ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rje ring lugs pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i stobs kyis bod dgon du 'gyur/ de nas bzung ming rgyal gong ma hung bu'i srid lo dang bo nas man ju gong ma dang / ming go srid lo nyer gsum pa sogs snga phyi lan du mar zhig gso dang rgya bskyed sogs mthun rkyen ci rigs spel ba la brten/ dgon sa mu'u bcu gnyis kyi steng du lha khang tshigs gsum can zhig bzhengs/ steng sor gyan lnga/bar zhol gnyis gar yang gyan lnga re/ gzhan lha khang gyan lnga can zhig g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyan bzhi re byas pa'i gyan brgyad/ rung khang rgyan drug sgo chen rgyan gsum/ grwa shag ra skor gnyis/ ra skor re la gyan brgyad re/ bsdoms pas rgyan bdun cu don gnyis bzhengs myong skad/ de la dus gsum sangs rgyas — 611 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang / thugs rje chen po/ rje sku sogs 'bog bzos dang gyan thang / bskal 'phags ting gsum/ rje'i lam sngags sogs rten dang brten pa mang du bzhugs par bshad/ de phyis chin rgyal thung ṭi skabs dang /ming rgyal skabs su de dag tshang ma 'jig par bshad na'ang / bcings grol tsam na grwa ba dgu dang / zhing chu ma mu'u nyer brgyad/ bye zhing mu'u ba'i/ sbyar sdong dang g.yer sdong bcas chig stong nyis brgya lhag kham sdong bzhi cur nye ba/ lha khang gyan gsum/ logs khang gyan drug sogs gyan grangs nyi shu longs tsam dang /drel gnyis/ ra lug bcu drug sku gsung thugs rten yang mi nyung ba bcas bsdoms pas dmangs sgor sum 'bum brgyad khri lhag gi nom pa1968lo dang rig gsar skabs su 'jig pa dgon pa de ga'i do dam pa thang ston ces bya ba'i pho lo sum cu son tsam pa des smra'o/ /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u lhan 'dzoms gros tshogs tshun tshod de/ 1kha7〈lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi chog mchan ltar/ snga ma'i shul du lha khang gyan gsum/ grwa shag gyan gnyis bzhengs/rten rnying la man ju gong ma/ khang zhi srid lo bcu drug par(spyi lo1678) mchod rten dmar po dgon la 'al 'debs dkar thigs phul pa'i dkar chag rdo ring zhig bzhengs pa lus shing da ltar yang mthong yul du smin/de min gsar bzhengs la dus gsum sangs rgyas 'bog sku dang / thugs rje chen po/ rje sku/ kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba'i 'dra thang sogs dang mchod cha nyung tsam yang bsgrugs/ der rgyun bzhugs kyi grwa ba zhig yod pa'i mtshan la 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims zer/ khong yun cin rdzong tis than dgon gyi dge slong zhig yin par bshad/ tis than zi chu mdzod kyi dbang gis gnas spo 'ang ma nus pas 'dir phebs te lo bzhi song zer/da lo dgung lo re drug son/ da ltar yang btsun gzugs su snang / dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang la mi sna gsum las grub/ kru'u rin gyi ming la thang krung cis zer/ len zhwa khul srid gros kyi u yon dang / nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin/ na gzhon mthun tshogs kyi u yon/ tung zhang rdzong srid gros kyi u yon bcas kyi 'gan 'khri lhur ba'es/ lo re'i hor zla bdun pa'i bcu gsum/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga la chos thog lta bu zhig yod/ mi grangs mang skabs la mchod 'bul ba sum stong lhag la son/ 'don pa skyabs 'gro/yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ 'jigs byed/ bla ma mchod pa/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs/ lha sder sde grong bdun/ dud kha bdun brgya yas mas la/ mi grangs bdun stong lhag mnga' zhes yig cha re zung rnyed pa dang rgan pa bgres song gi ngag las thos pa dag yig lam du spel ba'o/ /ma'e phen dgon/ma'e phen dgon ni da lta'i tung zhang rigs rang skyong rdzong thang bang 'ing gi khongs su chags/ bshad tshul la mchod rten dmar po dgon las snga zer/ snga mar rten dang brten pa mang du bzhugs par bshad mod/dus zing lan du mar byung ba'i dbang gis thams cad 'jig198 2lor gong rim gyi chog mchan thob pa ltar slar gso byas/ lha khang rgyan gsum/ logs khang — 615 —

lin 'a ha'e rigs rang skyong khul tung 'ang rdzong gi khongs/gyan gsum bcas bzhengs shing / ston pa'i shog thang dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba'i 'a dra thang bcas bzhugs/ bskyar bzhengs la 'gro song dmangs sgor bdun stong tsam song / lo re'i ba'i ba'i tshes brgyad/ bcu gnyis pa'i chos brgyad la mang tshogs rang 'dus kyis mchod 'bul bstar/ 195〈lo'i sngon du grwa ba rgyun bzhugs pa brgyad re yod la/ ma dgon yang skya ga mkhar gyi zhan chin dgon la brten/ zla re'i tshes brgyad la lha khang sgo phyes ma chod 'bu' byed/ do dam khang gi 'go ba'i ming la ṭang go yin zer/ dgon nang du bya ba med skabs phal cher grong chog tu phyin/ rgyun 'don la skyabs 'gro/ bla mchod/ yo/na tan ga'i gyur ma/ dga' lhan lha brgya ma/ rgya'/ ba ma 'u sa ma bcas so/ / gang ltar srid jus bzang bo la brten/gang ci'i bya ba rnams tshul ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ /ma hā ka la'i dgon/ma hā ka la'i dgon ni lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi grong khyer ka ju'i byang shar phyogs ton 'ang rdzong gi ho than 'ang tun gan sde dbus su chags/dgon pa'i lo rgyus gsal kha can zhig ma rnyed kyang / cha rgyus cung yod pa sde 'di'i lha bzo g.ya nga hri khrin gyis bshad pa ltar na/ a mdo chos 'byung du gsungs pa'i mgon po byin can bzhugs pa ma hwa ka 'a 'i lha khang zhes pa de nyid gnas spar cing / yun cin byams pa 'bum gling gi bla ma hor gtsang nas 'khrungs/ pa'i g.yas kya sprul ba'i sku byams pa rgya mtshos rgyu sbyar te ma hā ka la'i(rten gtso la mgon po bzhugs)dgon 'di btab zer/phyis su kha gya'i ta re ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i sku skyes bzhi bas skyong khur re gnang bar grags/ 'du khang bzhengs shing / thugs rje chen po/ 'jigs byed/ mgon chos lnga/ rje yab sras gsum bcas lha rten chos gsum mi nyung tsam bzhugs/ bla brang dgon pa la sogs nas phebs pa'i btsun pa bcu kha rgyun bzhugs pa dang bla mchod chos spyod kyi nyams len skor tshugs yod/ 195ralo'i zing 'khrug rkyen byas te dgon pa bshig sngon chad sa zhing mu'u brgya lha ga tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes nas bzung / zing bcos yo bsring dang tang gi chos lugs srid jus dngos 'bebs byas par brten nas/ deng skabs 'du khang chung ba zhig bzhengs shing / ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ rje yab sras/ srung ma/ mgon po bcas kyi sku brnyan 'ga' cig bzhengs/ ba'i ba'i bco lnga/bdun pa'i bco lnga/ bcu ba'i nyer lnga bcas la mang tshogs rang 'dus kyi mchod 'bul yod/ 'don pa la/skyabs 'gro/ lam mchod/ smon lam rnam lnga/ mgon chos lnga/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ rgya' ba ma lus ma so gas so/ /gna' rdzas shul lus la cong chen zhig las med pa dang / grwa rgan 'jam ngabyangs rgya mtsho gtsos dge 'dun pa bzhi deng skabs bzhugs shing / dam pa kun mkhyen dang / dren mchog ngase bla ma'i gsung gnang bzhin phyag mchod lhun len pa'i sgang lags so/ /— 616 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/skya ga (ho krin) rdzong gi khongs/bod dgon gyi dkar chagade yang skya ka ma/khar rdzong (rnyeshāyo)ni da lta'i gan su'u 'ing chen len zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi lho phyogs su chags/ shar gnam rdzong ngam kung hu dang khang lo la 'brel/ lhor gan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul bas nga chu rdzong dang gtsos grong byer kha gya'i yul gru/ co ne rdzong dang mtshes/ nub len zhwa rdzong dang 'dres/byang yang len zhwa rdzong dang tung 'ang rigs rang skyong rdzong la nye/ /yul gru 'di han rgyal rabs kyi gong rol tu/ spyang nub ma'i pha sa yin par bshad/ thang rgyal rabs kyi r+pā ye na srid 'o/ dang bo ste spyi 'o 762par bod kyi mnga' khongs su gtogs zhes rgya'i yig tshangs las byung / de la 'dir spyang zhes pa ste mi pho spyang gi rgyud pa zhes 'byung ba'i tshe spyang ni bod kyi rus 'brog mir bshad pas/thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bod kyi khongs su gtogs zhes bshad tshul gyi rnam pa thad dad du song ba tsam la sa don gyis gcig tu nges so/ /skya ga ma khar dngos dang de'i mtha' 'khor gyi yul gru thams cad du chin rgyal rabs kyi gong rol tsa na spyang rong(nub grom༅ma)ste rong 'brog zung du gnyer ba'i bod kyi sdod gzhis su grags/ rgyal khab bcu drug dang lho byang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su / 'a 'as kyang sa 'di bzung mod/ spyang ba'am 'brog mi bod pa rnams ni sa 'di'i ga'i 'dzin gyi thog ma'o/ / thang rgyal r+pā len gyi skabs su bod rnam sa ka ju'i phyogs su gtan du ga'is chags/ de'ang gang byas pas gsal zhe na/ deng sang bar ma nyams pa sa ming gi steng nas kyang rtogs sla ste/dper na/ gnyan chen phyogs bcu'i a myes kyi sras su bshad pa sras mchog don yod rdo rje zhes pa'i rdza rgyab dang bkra shis lha brag dkar po'i rdza rgyab kyi 'dabs su chags pa'i ya steng / (pomo〉) dmar gtsang / (sgornyo ma)dme skor(zos) mi rtag(oṃ༅) chas pa(༅༅)sogs dang / phyis su bod ming don bsgyur gyi tshul du rgya yig bris pa/ dper na shug skya'i lung mda' yas mas dang phar tshur gyi sa ming ste/ lcags khang la the ko'u(ṣ+ṭha༈snyi) sgog tog klad 'a tshung hwa len(loloḥ) spen thang la sung zhang than(7oṃkhrikhri) be'u gdang la nyo'u tu'u hran(༈'khu/ ) khyom(khrom)gsar la 'in yon/ (lotsho) zer ba sogs dpe mang du 'dren rgyu yod pa las kyang rgya'i deb ther khungs btsun ltar skya ga mkhar dang bcas pa'i mtha' 'khor yul gru dag bod kyi sdod gnas yin pa tshegs med du rtogs thub/ des na dus da ltar sa cha de ga'i bod rnams gang du phyin zhe na/skabs su ma babs kyang zhar byung du zur tsam spro ba la/ deng gi khrom(khyom)gsar la snga mar 'is h+phan nam bod sde ru 'bod/ de ni rgya bod 'dres sdod byas tshun gyi ming du chags par nges/ sung rgyal rabs skabs su — 617 —

lin 'a ha'e rigs rang skyong khul skya ga(ho krin)rdzong gi khongs/'dir lhags kyi bod pa ma nga shos ni tsong kha rgyal bo ste jo sras kyi 'khor 'bangs su bshad/ ming rgyal rabs kyi rjes su/ bod pa rnams rim gyis lho phyogs su gyes/ shul du lus pa dag las kyang nyung shas rgya'i rigs su 'dres/ da lta'i ya steng gi rgya mi nyung ba zhig gis kho bo cag gi mes po ni bod pa yin zhes smra la/ ming rgyal hong wu srid lo gsum pa spyi lo1 270bar/ dmag dpon ldang ba chen po tin yu'u(smokhyam)bya bas ka jur g.yul bkye bas rkyen pas skya ga yul gru'i bod pa'ang mngon gsal du nyung ngur gyur/ mdor na gong zhus kyi tshul 'di dag las kyang yu la gru 'dir bod pa'i pha gzhis yin pa sogs gsal bas bod brgyud nang dgon gyi grub mtha' ci rigs dar khyab che ba'ang rtogs sla ba'i gnas so/ /des na yul gru 'dir bod dgon gang yod dang grangs ka ci zin zhe na/ mdo smad dgon sde'i dkar chag gi thog ma/ brag sgom pa'i deb ther rgya mtsho dang rgya'i yig tshags su nyar ba/ rgan pa bgres song gi ngag rgyun/ mig mthong lag zin gyi dgon shul sogs phan tshun go bsdur gyi tshul du/ ming go'i skabs su bsgrigs pa'i skya ga rdzong gi lo rgyus kyi them byang du bkod pa gzhi bcol te zhus na 'di lta ste/spen le dgon/ des ṭu dgon/ dgon lung phu tho hran nam ri bo ta la dgon/ mar yag dgon/the hwa hran dgon/ zhwa ye na dgon/ hri tses dgon/ phan sna dgon/ yen wa dgon/ gyang gya dgon/dmar gtsang dgon/ san ku dgon/ ṭo'u gya dgon/ ṭang gya zhung lung yan dgon/ an yan dgon/khro'u ho'u dgon/ ho gya ṭu dgon/ twe ṭāng dgon/ nan zi dgon/ srib pa dgon/ tshi ba ho dgon/bo lon dgon/ ri rgan dgon/ ā+o gya dgon/ gyang gya dgon te nyer lnga bgrang du yod pa las/ lo rgyus kyi sa bon tsam dri gtugs dngos kyi la ma nas rnyed pa dag yi ge'i ri mo la spel ba gsham gsal lo/ /spen le dgon dga' ldan chos gling /thugs rje chen po'i gnas ri spen len dgon dga' ldan chos gling da ltar len zhwa khul skya ka rdzong(ho krin)to than zhang khongs su chags/sngon gong ma hung wu khri lo gnyis pa'i dus nas thugs rje chen po rang byon bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus a mdo chos 'byung ltar dang / han stag lung gi mkhan pos gdan drangs/ khong gi bkas brag la lam brkos nas sku brnyan steng du gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ gnas mdun du ri khrod btab/ co ne'i sa skyong gi lcam yang gdan 'dren zhus/ srid bsrung mdzad pas phan thogs/ tshe 'bar gyi thebs su 'brog sde kha shas phul/ kong bu chen po steng du rgyu mtshan gyi yi ge yod pa ba'ag dkar phud 'bul ba dus phyis par yod/ ri khrod 'dir rgyun ring bzhugs mthar sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku tsang kyin ā+o ye zer ba 'khrungs/ dbus su rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags dang smad nas tho'u zi'i cho lo bka' shog dang bcas thob/ dngul srang khri phrag gi bka' 'gyur gdan drangs/ spen le khams kyi bdag po byas/ gnas mdun gyi ri khrod spos te spen le dgon dga' — 618 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ldan chos gling btab/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs las(sku phreng lnga ba)bsnyen par rdzogs/ drug cu ba la gshegs/ de'i sprul sku hor gtsang du 'khrungs/ de'i rjes ma yar thang 'khrungs pa bkra shis nyi ma/ ka ju'i g.yon byang la kha ru 'khrungs pa dkon mchog legs bshad rgya mtsho/de'i sprul sku sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen men ho rdzong du 'khrungs/ gung khran tang yon du gyur/gsar brje'i gnas gzhi yan an du phebs lam ste/ spyi lo1947par sku gshegs/ dkon mchog legs bshad rgya mtsho dang blo bzang tshul khrims rab 'byams pa'i sprul sku rnam gnyis kyis dgon gnas ri dang bcas pa skyong tshul snang / lar spen le dgon pa dang thog ri khrod chags pa nas bgrangs na lo yun ring bo 'das pas/spen le bla ma'i skye 'phreng yang bco brgyad byon zhes rgya yig gi lo rgyus shig tu mthong na'ang / re re bzhin bgrang du ni ma mchis/ gal srid sku rabs bco brgyad byas na sbyin pa rgya mtsho'ang de yin dgos snyam/ da dung lo rgyus zhib par rgyal mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du gsal zhing / yi ge rdo ring la bkod pa ltar yod ces gsungs/ gzhan yang brag dang thang shing sogs shing snas brgyan pa'i khrod du 'od dpag med kyi lha khang /sgrol ma'i lha khang / dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang / pha dam pa'i lha khang / mar me mdzad kyi lha khang sogs dang / brgya byin lha khang / rdzong thog lha khang sogs bzhengs pa'i rten brten pa'ang mang / de rjes kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen po spen le phyogs su phebs te rgya bod dad ldan mang bos mchod sprin bstar/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor sogs mdzad/ thog mtha' ba dang /gsang 'dus smon lam/ bstan 'bar ma bcas gsung skabs 'ja' gor mo nam mkha'i thad du shar/ kun mkhyen mchog la yul 'di nas dngul dang rta nor lnga'i 'bul ba bstar/ chu bya1872khyab bdag bse blo bzang bkra shis rab rgyas mchog man ju'i mkhar men 'an du phebs skabs spen le lbo ye tshang nas spen le yul du gdan 'dren zhus pa la phebs glags ma byung bas/ spen le yul khams bdag gir mdzad rgyu zhus pa zhal bzhes bzang bo gnang tshul bshad/ spen le yul gyi dgon grong nas bse tshang la gzim khang bskrun/ de rjes bse sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho spen ler lan 'ga' phebs nas bdag skyong mdzad pa ma zad kha gya'i sgar gsar gyi cho ga phyag len 'ga' 'ig kyang btsugs/ de rjes su rje nyid kyi gsung gnang ltar gnam lha nas 'khrungs pa'i ko gya sprul sku'i dpon po bstan 'dzin nas las khur bzhes te ko gya gzim spyil bskrun te ko kya sprul sku yul 'di nas bzhugs shing 'jam mgon bla ma'i 'phrin las spel/ gnas 'di nas smyung gnas mdzad cing smon lam gnang / gzhan yang bod rgya du ma'i skyes chen dam pa mang bo byon nas ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad mkhan byon tshul gleng / de yang spyi lo1828pa'i gong rol tsam la 'khrug long gis rkyen pas dgon pa bsnubs pa de 'phral du bskyar gso mdzad/ de dus cong dril zhig lugs pa da lta'ang mjal du snang / de nas spyi lo1846lor rdo gcal dang sgo chen/ zam pa sogs bskrun pa spyi lo1862lor brlags/ 1875lor rten dang brten pa slar bzhengs pa1895lor 'jig phyis su — 619 —

lim 'a ha'e rigs rang skyong khul skya ga(ho krin)rdzong gi khongs/bskyar gso ma/dzad pa195 2lor gam su'u zhing chen lus gso khang dang po btsugs/ 1958lo dang1967'o snga rting lan gnyis kyi chom pos dgon pa shul med du bcom/ spyi lo1kha8 4lor tang gi srid jus nyi zer 'phros pa dang ma nyam/ du/ ston pa nye sras dang bcas pa'i lha khang bskyar du bzhengs/ shul lus kyi gna' dril ya/nga cong khang
