jus bzang po'i bka' drin gyis chos dad rang mos dgon pa bskyar gso'i bskal ba la reg tshogs gsog zhal 'debs dang rdzong srid gzhung gis dgon bskyar gso'i thebs su bstsal pa dmangs sgor bzhi stong drug brgya lhag 'dus pa bsdoms pas sgor lnga khri lhag gi 'gro song sogs ched du btang ba la brten/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang bcas rten dang brten pa bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa dag snga ma'i so las ngo mtshar bar gyur pas/ nyams su dga' ba'i gnas so/ /de yang da ltar dad khyim dud kha bzhi brgya lnga bcu la dad mi nyis stong drug brgya nga gnyis su son/ rgyun ldan chos spyod kyi phyogs nas/ mchi zla'i tshes gcig bco lnga/ sa zla'i nya tshes brgyad gnyis/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs dus bzang la smon lam bla mchod bskang ba sogs gsung / da ltar rgyun bzhugs grwa btsun gsum/ skya min ser min zhig grong na yod pa bgrangs pas bzhi/ dgon pa do dam pa skya ser bdun las grub/ lo ngo du ma'i sngon la kun lho khul nas bod btsun gnyis phebs te lo du mar bzhugs na'ang phyis su phyir phebs/ sde 'di bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi le lag yin par yang smra/ da lan nags sa mu'u bdun tsam gyi g.yu lo'i bkod pa'ang yod do/ /lang thu'u chan ma ṇi dgon/lang thu'u chan ma ṇi dgon ni skya ka mkhar rdzong byo than zhang lang thu'u chan bya ba'i sde khrod du chags/'di bod dgon zhig yin yang / nam chags dang sus btab sogs mi gsal/ da lta'i skyong khur mdzad mkhan hu hrin zhon/ dgon sar sme lham po 2 14yod rgyun bzhugs grwa ba gnyis yod pas lo'u skal — 626 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzang dang ho'u te te zer/ gnyi gas btsun gzugs kyi tshul mdzad/ gangs can pa'i rus su gtogs/lha khang gyan gsum can zhig dang / rung khang ngam grwa shag gyan gnyis bskrun yod/ kun gzigs bcu ba'i sku thang sogs rten thang dang glegs bam re gnyis bzhugs/ dgon par mchod thebs su phul pa lo rer sgor drug brgya longs tsam/ de bsags te lha khang tshon rtsi'i thebs su sgor chig stong drug brgya song / dgon pa'i do dam pa skya ser brgyad las grub/ bya ba phra rags thams cad thun mong gis 'gro la/ do dam pa las lo'u skal bzang bya bas rdzong srid gros rgyun las pa'i 'khri ba'ang bzhes yod ces dri gtug dngos las byung ba'i sa bon tsam mo/ /nan lon dgon/nan lon dgon ni skya ka mkhar rdzong bkwan than ko'u zhing twe grong sde khrod du chags/thog mar 'debs pa'i dus ni spyi lo dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus te man ju gong ma khang zhi'i skabs su yin par bshad/ ming go srid lo bcu bdun par(192〈lo)'jig de'i skabs grwa ba'ang bzhi bcu lhag 'dus skad grags kyang nges cha mi 'dug gang ltar rnam thar gyi 'cham chen zhig yo da par bshad/1khakha4lor bskyar gso mdzad/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang zhig dang sgo chen lcags ri bcas brgyab/dgon pa do dam pa skya ser bcu las grub/ 'dzin bdag gi khur ho ṭan hran bya bas bzhes/ nya tshes brgyad la mchod 'bul bya ba'i srol yod do/ /pu zhang then gya dgon/pu zhang then gya dgon ni da lta'i skya ga mkhar rdzong mā gya phu sde grong du chags/ thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni spyi lo1921pa yin zer/ bzhengs grub rjes su mi lo brgyad las ma 'das par1929bar 'jig dus yun thung stabs rten brten pa bzheng long cher mi 'dug pa mngon gsal/ de nas da thug bar mi lo brgya dang lnga bcu'i bar bskyar bzhengs kyi skal ba rang ma rnyed/ spyi lo1979lor srid jus bzang bo'i nyi 'od 'phros pa dang dad ldan mang po'i 'dod mos ltar bskyar gso'i tshul du lha khang gcig dang rung khang ngam grwa shag gcig bskrun/ mchod rdzas kyang bod dgon dge lugs ltar gyi 'os mtshams re sbyor 'jags mdzad 'dug dad can dud khyim brgya dang so drug la dad mi drug brgya so gnyis yod/ de la'ang do dam mkhan mi gnyis las grub/gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams srid jus dang gang 'tshams spel mus su snang ngo / /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/khang lo rdzong gi khongs/bod dgon dkar chagakhang lo rdzong zhes pa da ltar len zhwa ha'e rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs su chags / han nub ma/'i skabs su da lta'i rdzong 'di'i mnga' khongs ni 'u nga nub jun gyi mnga' 'bas su gtogs / ṭo'u byang ma'i skabs su hru'e khri rdzong zhes pa ka ju'i h+phu han jun gyi mnga' zhabs su gtogs/ chan yan zhes pa'i srid lo gnyis par(spyi lo742pa)khrang li rdzong du bsgyur/ shing kun jun gyi mnga' zhabs su gtogs / pyo ye na srid 'o dang por(spyi lo762pa)bod kyi dpa' bo rnam rgyal gyi dmag sar gtogs/ da ltar rdzong 'dir mi grangs chig 'bum brgyad khri lha ga la son/ ha'e ha'e ma yin pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs ni bod dang sa lar/ hor sogs du ma 'dus la/ mi grangs kyang spyi grangs kyi brgya cha'i gsum zin/ yig cha gcig bu ma yin par rman nga bgres song dag dang der bzhugs kyi grwa rgan re gnyis la dris pas / snga mar sa 'di bod kyis bzung ba'i rgyu ma tshan gcig bu ma/ yin par/ co ne so gas la bar thag ha cang nye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang red zer/de yang man ju thung ṭi srid lo bzhi bar brag sgom pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyis ma dzad pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung du/ ‘ sho ba'i dgon pa'i byang shar ngos su sho ba'i a ma 'brug ma tshor grags pa'i ma tsho gnyan/ 'di la snga mo mtsho mjal gyi mthong snang mang zhing / stong 'khor yon tan rgya ma tshos dam/ga zor ma'i bla mtshor ngos bzung / de'i 'gram thog na sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis gru gu'i lu'/ du dam/ga drangs par bshad pa'i byang gru gu'i rgyal khab’〉ces pa'i gru gu la da ltar yangathaṣ+ṭha)// zhes gru gu thang du 'bod/ yang de nyid las/ ‘4der ser ra'i thob khungs su gtogs pa'i dgon dgu dang / 'bras spungs thob khungs su gtogs pa'i dgon bco brgyad du grags pa yod/ de yang lan hwa' shan nas rim par dus ser sdeb tshang gi dgon/ ho ba dgon bkra shis mkhas grub gling / 'di la le lag bang tshang dgon zer ba zhig kyang yod/bā jo'i dgon/ yang bla ma sku 'phreng gi gdan sa sab ri dgon/ na tsa zi(da ltar 'an gya ban du yodarnyatram̐sbramo 9) lcang lung paṇ+ḍi ta'i gdan sa khe gya zi'am lcang lung dgon thub bstan dar rgyas gling(da ltar bun ban du yodamalo) khyin kya zi'am bang kyang zi/ khyo'u kyā zi'am khang kya zi(da ltar khyo kya zir+sāmor+sha) rgya nag thang gi dus kyi dgon rnying / de dus lugs pa'i cong steng du lo rgyus kyi yi ge can yod/ mdzod nas phog dngu' thon pas dgon pa'i mchod thebs kyi sa zhing chu 'khor bkag nags sogs rgya che/ gser ba zi bsam gtan gling /mā kyā zi/ da lta cin go'i mā kyā zi/ ting kyā zi'am tre tshang dgon/ da lta'i tis zi phen4rmir+sha1༈) so 'u kyang zi'am mar so dgon/ hu'u kya zi'am nor bu dgon ma 'a ga gsum/ 'di co ne dang yer ba'i ma/ dgon yin da 628 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yang zer(da lta'e gru gu'i sa nga/r+ṇa dgonazlo+olo༅r+sha)bā to'i dgon nam ur nywa zir khang zhi'i dus kyi bka' bstan bzhugs / tsho'u kya zi/ tho'u kya zi/ 'dir bsod nams nor bu zer ba'i 'bras spungs 'bul sdud pa 'ig byung / des rgyal ba rin po cher chibs rta nor bu g.yang 'dzin phul/ shan de zi/ ko kya tā zi'am byang chub dgon/ cang kya zi'am chos gtsang thar ba gling / sho ba chos rjes btab pa shang kya zi'am sho ba dgon/ stag mo dgon/ kyi nā zi(da lta ra skyin nang sde brdzongajasmokhyaṇi/)sde rog dgon/ mā zan dgon a tsar ya ra dgon ma ra dgon du grags pa gnyis/ (yar dgon ni da lta'i 'phags pa sde ba'i zhol gyi ri rtser chags / ma ra dgon ni da lta'i su 'u holo༈me1 sde ba'i mā kya ri sked du chags/ der rdo ring zhig du kya ching srid lo bcu bar btab/ tī kung srid lo bco lnga bar lu'u har ba dang mi gsum gyis rgya bskyed) 'di tho ba chos sde sku 'phreng gis bskyangs 'a / lnga nga kya zi/ bun kya ho'i lwang kya zi) dgon lung zi(da lta 'i gru gu'i gu lo'u zi zhes par ngos 'dzin la / snga mar dgon sar mu'u stong lhag yod par bshad/ tā khyang zi rnams kyi go ri kha'i rtags can rnams 'bras spungs grwa rgyun bzhi ba'i smon 'a ma mnyam 'tshogs/ de dus grwa grangs lnga brgyar nye 'ing / chos spyod tshang ma / mgon chos gdangs dbyangs rgyud stod lugs ltar gtong / thig le'i rtags can rnam sa se ra'i grwa rgyun du gtogs shing / dgon phran ga'an yang yod snang ste zhib par ma nges so zhes dang /rgyab ngos ma ga' phyogs su shing ku na dgon pa'i le lag sgo mo che dga' ldan chos 'khor gling da ltar rgya skad du nub sbrang tshang dgon nam 'i h+phun wu zi zhes pa yod la/ de'i dgon lag ma ṇi zi gong 'og gnyis(da ltar pad tsha' 'u nga tin zis/ོ༈spyi/1r+sha ) kyin kya zi (da lta cin kya rir yodabhe༅zo la ) ko'u yan zi (byu khrin grong rda' go yo na sde ba'i phu bang zi dang 'khrul yo da tshod) hos mo'u zi/ 'dir rdo rje phag mo'i sku brnyan byin can bzhugs pa phag mo rang byon mched gsu ma gyi nang tshan yin zhes mkhan chen sidha'i zhal snga nas gsungs/ za 'o 'i zi(da lta 'i tin ka phen du yod)po tso zi (da lta'i su bā tso phen du yod) ā+o khyan zi (da ltar chi kya hranarnyikhyapho'o/khri ) phrin phri zi(ku po'u ko'u chon zi)sde the zi(da lta'i brag dmar them ziwaṃX6buṭha༅r+sha) smra bā zi(da lta'i dang la gsum gtso skyong dgonabhe157༅oṃdzartse) bī kyā zi (da lta'i phas kya thanabhe༅mokhrikhri) mā kyā ngan (da lta'i then kya phen〉〉 ༅ mo1༈) za kwar zi (da lta'i gang yin mi gsal) kro ming zi(da lta'i kro ā+o'u tsiphunazlo8khriX ta thā kon zi(da lta'i thā kon sde bar) then kyā ngan(da lta'i then kyā phen du yod〉〉 ༅ photsushākho) po lūn zi (da lta 'i tshun than r+pā lin zirnyaslo khrik+ṣi ༅ r+sār+sha) spen le stod (da ltar spen le dgon gi7khyasnyizlo/ r+sha ) kyi dgon 'a ga 'a4 / 'in grong zi(da lta pe wa nga 'ing gi zhin grong sde bar yod) nag po gru zi(pe wang zhang gi nag po grutsho—na ༅ 3she smo/rtalo༅ ) ho zhu zi(dpal gsu ma 'ang ho hri157༅ lkotho) dpal gsum zhang dpal grags dgon 15ṇi/ phro nya(༈6) sogs so/ /mdor na khang lo rdzong ni ho krin rdzong dang lin tho(shing kun) rdzong / co ne rdzong / bā tse(spra tshal) rdzong ste rdzong khag bzhi'i bar du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ srid 'dzin sa khongs khag ba'i'i bar du gnas pa'i rgyu — 629 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/mtshan gyis/ srid 'dzin sa khongs lan grangs du mar bgos kyang / dgon pa ni tshul de bzhin yin pas/'dir bshad mang shas sngon chad lin tho'i shing kun dgon chen gyi le lag lta bur zad/ 'dir bkod pa dag las kha shas da lta'i dgon ming dang mthun la/ mang shas mi mthun pas u tshugs rang ma byas/ ming go srid lo sum cu ba spyi lo1941lor sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ rdzong 'dir dgon pa che phra lnga bcu nga dgu yod par bshad/ phyis1958lor 'jig 1985lor slar gso byas pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis la son/ gsham du da lta'i gnas bab lag lon byung tshul dag yi ge'i lam du spel ba la/ /thā bkun dgon/thā bkwan dgon ni khang lo rdzong su'u ci zhang gi thā bkan sde khrod du chags nas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang de skad du thogs/thog mar chags pa'i dus ni spyi lo7rnga0yas mas su bshad/ lo rgyus snga ba'i dbang gis rten dang brten pa mang du bzhengs par grags mod kyang / chag 'jig lan du mar byung ba'i rkyen gyis shul med du gyur/ da ltar bskyar bzhengs mdzad tshun chod du lha khang gyan gsum/ sgo chen gyan gsum/ byang khang gyan dgu/shar khang gyan gnyis bcas bzhengs pa la shing cha smi lham po90 0lhag song / dgon sar smi lham po728dang /khang sar smi lham po200lhag yod/ hor gyi rigs gyur btsun pa wang then zhang zhes pas 'dzin bdag gnang mus/ 1996lo'i zla brgyad par chos sgo dngos su phye ba'i mdzad sgo spel/ lo re'i dgu ba'i bco lnga/ nyer gnyis dang / gcig pa'i smon lam sogs dus ltar spel/ dgon pa'i 'gro song thams cad mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs dang mchod thebs la brten/ dgon pa do dam pa dag gi 'tsho ba rang khyim nas sbyor la/ grong chog skabs su yon bdag rang gi 'dzoms tshod tsam las thag bcad rang mi 'dug/he mo zi'am phag mo dgon/he mo zi'am phag mo dgon ni khang lo rdzong hu'u bkwan zhang wu phen zhes pa'i sde ru chags/ lo rgyus kyi grags tshod la/ sung rgyal rabs skabs su thog mar chags/ yon rgyal rabs dang ming rgyal rabs/ man ju rgyal rabs skabs su dar zhing rgyas par bshad/ bod dgon du nam 'gyur zhe na/ yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin la/ grub mtha' yang sa skyar bshad/ ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rje ring lugs pa'i bstan pa 'phel stobs che ba'i dbang gis dge lugs su 'gyur/ mdo rgyud gnyis las rgyud pa'i phyag len che/ rdo rje phag mo'i 'dra sku yod pa'i cha nas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang de skad du thogs/ ston sku dang / thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs sku rten bzhugs shing / gsung rten yang dgon rnying yin stabs mang du bzhugs/ snga mar nags sa dang zhing sa sogs kyang mi nyung ba yod/ rig gsar skabs 'jig da lta slar gso byas/ dgon par rgyun bzhugs grwa ba gsum yod/ zla re'i nya tshes brgyad dang dgu — 630 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ba'i bcu dgu sogs la smon lam lam mchod sogs gsungs/ da ltar gang ci'i bya ba legs lam du 'gro mus su snang ngo / /yāng kya hu khron zhin dgon/yāng kya hu khron zhin dgon ni khang lo rdzong cin gu zhang cin go sde grong du chags/thog mar btab pa'i dus ni han rgyal rabs su yin par bshad/ skabs der cin gu mkhar rnying du chags/ hre'i khri rdzong gi dgon yang byas/ dus zing gis mkhar de 'jig pa dang gu'u lo'u zi zhes mtshan bsgyur/ phyis mang rgyal rabs skabs su bod brgyud nang bstan du 'gyur/ lha khang sogs rgya bskyed de bzhengs/ man ju khang 'i rgyal po'i skabs su lha khang chen mo zhig bzhengs la1958lo dang rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing du 'jig 1988lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad de thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang / byams khang / klu dbang khang sogs khang mig bco lnga bzhengs/ 'gro song bsdoms pas dmangs sgor sum 'bum lhag btang / dad ldan mi grangs sum khri lnga stong 'dus/ btsugs nags smi lham po2960yod/ lo re'i hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu nas bco brgyad bar chos spyod kyi bya ba rgya chen zhig yod/dad ldan mang tshogs phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ma bos ngang gis 'du/ da lta dgon pa do dam pa skya ser mi lnga las grub/ 'go 'dzin la na khron pu'i zer/ lo bdun cur nye ba zhig gang ci'i bgyi ba yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod/ /men lung dgon/men lung dgon ni da lta'i khang lo rdzong dpal bzang 'ang nag mgo sde khrod du chags/ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ca chin gyis srid dbang skyong ba na bzhengs/ skabs der rje ring lugs pa'i bstan pa yar ldan du spel mus yin stabs sde 'di'ang dar zhing rten dang brten pa mi nyung ba bzhengs skad/phyis su1958lo dang rig gnas gsar brje sogs dus zing du 'jig 1995lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang rgyan gsum/ rung khang ngam grwa shag gyan brgyad/ sgo chen khang mig gsum bzhengs pa la/ sa khyon smi lham po990lhag zin/ zhing sa'i yong sgo lo rer gro rgya ma drug brgya yas mas tsam/tshang ma mchod thebs su gtong / da lta'i rten dang brten pa yod tshad bsdoms pas dmangs sgor lnga khri lhag la son/ dad ldan dud khyim nyis brgya zhe lnga la mi grangs brgyad brgya nyi shu lhag dgon bdag gi mtshan la gu'o zhu'o kri zer/ lo drug cu lhag bzhes/ dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi mi sna skya ser gsum las grub/tang dang rgyal khab kyi srid jus ltar mang tshogs la chos spyod kyi re ba skong mus kyi skabs so/ /phu ṭo dgon/— 631 —

pa'i dus ni man ju gong ma zhan h+phun bya bas srid dbang skyong ba'i skabs su yin par grags/ skabs der rten dang brten pa 'os mtsham sa thig bzhengs shing / grwa rgyun yang mi nyung tsam/ yod zer/sde 'di thog mar chags dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par bshad/ phyis rig gas ra las 'gul skabs su 'jig 19rnga 0lo nas slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/rung khang khang mig gsum/ sgo chen gcig dgon sa spyi la smi lham po2 2 5lhag yod do/ /pe wang che kya ṭi dgon/pe wang tshe kya ṭi dgon ni khang lo rdzong pe wang zhang tshe kya ṭi zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags pas mtshan yang de ltar thogs/ thog mar bzhengs dus ni ming rgyal rabs su yin par bshang/ rig gsar du 'jig197khalor slar gso mdzad/ da lta lha khang khang mig gsum/ rung khang khang mig gsum/ sgo chen gcigadagon sa'i khyon la smi lham po2 2 0las sne mi gnyis/ mchod 'bul sogs mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs la rag las so/ /sde gsar gong klu dbang dgon/sde gsar gong klu dbang dgon ni khang lo rdzong su'i h+phun sde grong du chags/thog mar chags dus ni ming rgyal rabs su bshad/ rig gsar skabs shul med du gyur/ da lta lha khang khang mig lnga/ grwa shag rung khang khang mig gsum/ do dam las sne mi gsum/ 'go ba'i mtshan la lis khrin ye zer/ dad can khyim tshang bdun cu lhag la mi grangs sum brgya lhag 'dus so/ /ri bo pad ma can gyi dgon pa/ri bo pad ma can gyi dgon pa ni khang lo rdzong ri bo pad ma can gyi gnas su chags/ thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ban lis skabs su yin par grags/bar skabs shig la khang lo'i yul gru ma yin pa'i gan lho'i co ne rdzong gi sho ba dang chags kha gya/ khang thog sogs nye 'khor gyi grwa rgyun mi nyung ba 'dir ma bos ngang gis 'dus/ ston sku/ rje btsun byams mgon/thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ rje yab sras gsum sogs sku rten dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che sogs gsung gi rten yang mang du bzhugs pas phyogs bzhi'i dad ldan gyi dang ba kun nas 'dren — 633 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/pa'i mur/ 195〈lo'i chom pos rmeg med du bcom/ 1982lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/lha khang khang mig chen gsum bzhengs/ bzhengs grub kyi ston mo la zhing chen dang len zhwa khul/ khang lo rdzong /co ne/ bā tse sogs nye 'khor gyi 'brel yod las khungs kyi mgron po phebs/ nang sgos gung thang sku phreng drug pa rje btsun bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ sbyor 'jags kyang mang du gnang ste dgon pa'i rten bzhengs so gas legs grub byung / da ltar lha khang ngam 'du khang ma yin pa'i grwa shag khang mig gsum/ sne len khang khang mig gsum/ rung khang dang bcas pa bzhengs grub/ bsdoms pas 'gro song dmangs sgor drug 'bum lhag btang / dgon sa'i khyon la smi lham po268yod/ dad ldan gyi dud khyim lnga stong lhag la mi grangs nyis khri drug stong nyis brgya lhag yod par bshad/de dag ni rang rdzong ma yin pa'i gan lho dang rnga ba khul sogs nas 'ongs pa'am ha cang mang / lo re'i drug pa'i tshes gcig nas tshes drug gi bar la dgon nang du chos spyod kyi bya ba gzab cing rgyas/ da lta dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne skya ser 'ga' las grub/ gtso 'dzin gyi mtshan la chis bun po zer/ dgung lo bdun cur nye ba zhig gang ci'i bya ba rnams legs lam du 'gro mus su snang ngo / /zhe co rtswa dgon pa/zhe co rtswa dgon pa ni khang lo rdzong len lu zhang zhe co thang du chags/thog mar bzhengs dus ni ming rgyal rabs skabs su yin par bshad/ bar du ji ltar dar ba'i lo rgyus rang ma nges/ 195〈lo dang rig gsar skabs rtsa med du brlags/ 1995lor bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung / lha khang ngam rung khang gcig chog gi tshul du gyan brgyad bzhengs/ spyir dgon sa'i khyon la smi lham po666yod/ rten brten pa bsdoms pas dmangs sgor sum khri lhag tu son/ dad ldan dud khyim chig stong brgyad brgya la mi grangs dgu stong brgya lhag lo re'i zla lnga ba dang bdun pa/ dgu bar chos spyod kyi bya ba re yod/ skya ser 'gas smon lam bla mchod sogs gsungs la/ snga ma'i dgon sa der len lu slob grwa btsugs pas kha btags chu 'go zhes pa'i ri sked du spar/ dkyil khang la gyan bdun/ ltag rgyab tu lha khang bzhengs/da lta dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang la las sne mi bdun las grub/ hrang po zhe zhes pa'i bgres song zhig gis 'gan khur zhing do dam bgyid bzhin yod/ dgon pa'i 'gro song tshang ma mang tshogs kyi 'al 'debs dang mchod 'bul la brten pa yin no/ /khrang an dgon/khang an dgon ni khang lo rdzong yin ṭi zhang gi mā ci sde khrod du chags/sde 'di thog mar chags pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ban lis skabs yin par grags/ snga mar ston pa shākya thub pa dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang bo/ thugs rje chen po/— 631 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sa'i snying bo sogs kyi rten bzhugs/ man ju rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung ṭi'i skabs su bzhengs pa'i 'du khang chen mo dang / ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ban lis skabs su bzhengs pa'i rin po che'i mchod rten zhig bzhugs pa sogs rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su shul med du 'jig shing cha thams cad thon skyed ru khag bzhi ba/ lnga ba/ drug pa bcas la bgos/ 1996lor bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung thog slar gso'i mdzad sgo dngos su spel/ da ltar lhag lus su bzhugs pa ni ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma gya chen skabs su ho hri lon sogs kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te bzhengs pa'i rdo ring zhig bzhugs/ gsar bzhengs la lha khang gyan gsum/ lho byang gnyis su grwa shag gyan drug de'i sa khyon la smi lham po670 dgon pa'i do dam pa la skya ser mi lnga las grub/ hu l+yang yu bya bas 'go 'dzin gyi khur bzhes/ rten dang mchod byad sogs gang 'tshams shig bsgrugs yod pas/ chos spyod kyi bya ba rnams sa tshod dang dpags pas tshal bzhin du spel mas sa lags ///tho riri bye niri bye rigi sbyici son hran dgon/tsi son hran dgon ni/ khang lo rdzong wu ho zhang bu ho sde khrod du chags/thog mar chags dus ni ming rgyal rabs su yin par bshad/ 195ralo dang rig gnas gsar brje skabs su rmeg med du bcom/ 1989lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ da lta lha khang khang mig gsum/ grwa shag khang mig gsum/ bsdoms pas dgon sa'i khyon la smi lham po950yod/ dad ldan mang tshogs khang lo rang rdzong ma yin pa'i len tho (shing kun) rdzong khongs su'ang yod/ khang lo rdzong khongs su dad can dud khyim chig stong nyis brgya lhag yod/ rten brten pa bsdoms pas dmangs sgor chig khri lhag yod tshod/ da ltar gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams legs tsam du gnas so/ /kong len dgon/kong len dgon ni khang lo rdzong wu hu zhang ten kya go'u ru chags/ming rgyal rabs su bzhengs/ 195ralor 'jig 1989lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang gyan gsum/ grwa shag rgyan bzhi/ dad ldan dud khyim drug brgya sum cu la mi grangs sum stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu lhag 'dus so/ /gu'o yon phu ṭo dgon/gu'o yon phu ṭo dgon ni khang lo rdzong srid gzhung gi chags gnas gu'o yon grong brdal du chags/sde 'di thog mar chags pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par bshad/ nga brgyad lo dang rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jig 19ri2lor bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/— 635 —

lin 'a ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/rung khang khang mig ba'i/ bsdoms pas sa khyon smi lham po5 0dang / nags sa la mu'u gang dang phyed zin/dad ldan ma nga tshogs dud khyim brgya la/ mi grangs lnga brgya lhag dgon pa'i do dam pa mi gsum las grub po/ /gsar ba dgon/gas ra ba dgon ni khang 'o rdzong cin go'u(gru gu)zhang wang kya ko'u sde khrod du chags/thog ma ra bachengs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi dus 'go tsam yin par bshad/ ming go srid lo bco brgyad par dus zing gi dbang du gyur na'ang / ming go srid lo so gsum par bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa spyi lo195〈lor 'jig 1kha87lor li ra gso mdzad/ da lta lha khang chen mo smi lham po〈8can zhig dang /grwa shag khang mig gsu ma/ de la de ma tshungs kyi rten thang yang 'ga' re bzhugs/ dgon sa spyi la smi lham po1 2 2 0yod/ dad ldan ma nga tshogs dud khyim sum brgya dang bcu/ mi grangs chig stong lnga brgya bdun cu lhag dgon pa'i 'gro song thams cad mang tshogs kyi mchod 'bul dang 'al 'debs so gas la brten/de'ang bcing grol sngon gyi grwa ba re gnyis bzhugs na'ang da lta phyir log ste 'ing la sa gnyer gyin yod/ dgon pa'i do dam pa skya ser mi gsum/ las grub/ dus rgyun du mchod 'bul zhu mkhan ni dgon pa'i 'gan khur ba hrang tin jun zhes pa'i dgung lo bdun cu lhag son pa'i bgres so nga zhig yin/ da lta gang ci'i bya ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ /wang gya dgon/wa nga gya dgon ni khang lo rdzong se wang 'ang su'u h+phun sde grong du chags/thogs mar 'debs dus mi ming rgyal rabs su yin par grags/ rig gsar skabs 'jig dad ldan khyim tshang bdun cu lhag mi grangs sum brgya lhag lha khang khang mig lnga/ rung khang khang mig gsum phub yod/ dgon pa'i las sne mi gsum mo/ /yāng ba dgon/ lwang ba dgon ni khang lo rdzong dpal bzang zhang we kyā tre+e zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/thog ma/ra chags pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs su yin par bshad/ 1kha5rngalo dang rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jig 19〈7lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/ rung khang khang mig gsum/ sgo chen khang mig gsum/ bsdoms pas dmangs sgor lnga khri lhag btang / dad ldan dud khyim ba'i brgya lnga bcu la mi/ grangs nyis stong brgya lhag dgon pa'i 'gro song yongs rdzogs mang tshogs kyi ma chod 'bul dang zhal 'debs la brten/ da lta bya ba gang ci yar ldan du 'gro mus su snang ngo / /— 636 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/yun spun dgon/yān h+phun dgon ni khang lo rdzong dpal bzang 'ang kung kya grong gi khongs gtogs phes kya sde khrod du chags/thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par grags / sngon chad rten brten pa mang du bzhugs shing rgyun 'dug gi grwa ba'ang mi nyung ba yod zer/ 195rngalo'i dus zing gi skabs su 'jig na'ang / srid jus bzang bo'i bka' drin gyis/ 1kha86lo bskyar bzhengs kyi go skabs byung / lha khang gyan gsum smi lham po60yod/ grwa shag dang rung khang gyan lnga la smi lham po60/ sgo chen gyan gsum la smi lham po54 bsdoms pas rten dang brten pa thams cad la phal cher dmangs sgor drug khri lnga stong lhag gi 'gro song btang / de dag thams cad dad ldan skye bo'i mchod 'bul dang zhal 'debs sogs las byung / sde 'dir gtogs pa'i dad ldan dud khyim dgu brgya lhag la/ mi grangs bzhi stong drug brgya lhag lo re'i dus bzang ste dper na gcig pa'i smon lam/ bzhi ba'i smyung gnas/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis sogs la ma nga tshogs rang 'dus kyis mchod 'bul dang 'a/ba rtse bsto da par bgyid/ da lta dgon pa'i do dam/ pa ni yen wan lis gtsos pa'i skya ser mi lnga las grub po/ /dpal bzang dbyangs can dgon/dpal bzang dbyangs can dgon ni khang 'o rdzong dpal bzang zhang dpal bzang sde grong gi brag dmar sgang du chags/thog mar 'debs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par bshad/ skabs der rje ring lugs pa'i bstan pa rgya bod sog gsum du dar ba'i sgang yin stabs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dpag med dang grwa rgyun yang mang du 'phe'// rten brten pa rgya cher bzhengs pas sa cha yul gru de ga'i skye bo dad can dag gi yid kyi dad pa kun nas drangs par bshad/ 195〈lo dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su ma rung chom pos nyes pas bsnubs/ 1984lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ dgon sa spyi'i khyon la smi lham po660yod de/ lha khang chen mo gyan gsum la smi lha po26dang / grwa shag khang mig gnyis la smi lham po2 4/sgo chen khang mig gsum la smi lham po45/ bsdoms pas dmangs sgor sum khri lhag gi ma rtsa/ dad ldan mang tshogs khyim tshang nyis brgya nyi shu lhag la mi grangs drug brgya tsam/ sa zhing smi lham po1 2 2la lo re'i 'bru rigs yong sgo rgya ma brgyad brgya tsam/ de dag tshang ma mang tshogs kyi mchod 'bul dang 'al 'debs kyi kha snon byas te mchod thebs su btang / dgon pa'i las sne skya ser mi gsum las grub/ lu'o hrun ṭi bya ba'i lo drug cu can zhig gis spyi 'gan bzhes so/ /me'o yen dgon/

len zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/me'o yen dgon ni/ khang lo rdzong dpal bzang zhang dpal bzang grong brag dmar sde khrod du chags/thog mar gsar 'debs kyi dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs yin par bshad/ sde 'di tshugs snga ba'i stabs kyis de mtshungs kyi rten dang brten pa mi nyung ba bzhugs/ phyis195〈lo dang rig gnas gsar brje sogs chab srid las 'gul gyi skabs su 'jig 1984lor slar gso byas/ lha khang khang mig gsum/rung khang khang mig gsum/ grwa shag khang mig gnyis/ sgo chen khang mig gsum/ bsdoms pas dgon sa'i khyon smi lham po660lhag yod/ rten dang brten pa thams cad dmangs sgor sum khri lhag tu son/ dad can dud khyim nyis brgya nyi shu/ mi grangs chig stong lhag la son/ sa zhing smi lham po12 2yod/ der lo rer yong sgo gro rgya ma brgyad brgya lhag de'ang mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs dang mchod 'bul gyi kha gsab byas te/dgon pa'i mchod 'bul dang 'gro song gzhan gyi thebs su gtong gin yod/ da lta gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su mchis pa'i skabs so/ /h+phu lhun dgon/h+phu hrin dgon ni khang lo rdzong dpal bzang zhang khongs kyi mar pa sde khrod du chags/ thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su yin par bshad/ 1952 lor 'jig 1981lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/ rung khang dang grwa shag khang mig lnga/ sgo chen khang mig gsum/ cong khang gcig dgon sa'i khyon la bsdoms pas smi lham po660lhag mnga'/ dmangs sgor bzhi khri lnga stong gi 'gro song btang / dad ldan khyim tshang chig stong brgyad brgya lhag la mi grangs chig khri lnga stong lhag son/ chos spyod kyi bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ /wang kya an dgon/wang kya an dgon ni khang lo rdzong srid gzhung gi chags gnas h+phu ṭin grong brdal gyi hri wang sde khrod du chags/sde 'di thog mar chags pa'i dus ni man ju gong ma'i thung ṭi rgyal po'i skabs su yin par bshad/ rten dang brten pa 'os 'tshams shig bzhengs par bshad mod/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su shul med du bcom/ 1980lor chos sgo slar 'byed mdzad pa dang bstun bskyar bzhengs bgyis/ da ltar lha khang gyan gsum smi lham po50yod/ logs khang la gyan lnga/ dgon nang du rgyun bzhugs mdzad par hor rigs su gtogs pa'i grwa ba gcig yod/ dgon pa'i do dam pa mi gnyis las grub/ chos spyod kyi bya ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ / stod lo dgon pa/— 638 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/stod lo dgon pa ni da lta'i khang lo rdzong rtswa thang zhang gi stod lo zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/man ju rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung ṭi'i skabs su thog mar bzhengs skad/ sku gsung thugs rten dang 'du khang lha khang sogs mi nyung zhing rgya khyon yang mi dman par bshad la/ btsun pa'ang mi nyung tsam bzhugs pas chos spyod kyi bya ba gong 'phel du song bar grags/ rig gnas gsar brje sogs dus zing du ma'i bar rkyen gyis 'jig na'ang / srid jus bzang po'i bka' drin gyis spyi lo chig dgu gya bzhi lor slar gso dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/ logs khang khang mig ba'i phub/ 1996lo'i zla8pa'i tshes bdun la legs grub dang chos sgo phye ba'i rten 'brel spel/ dgon sar smi lham po42 2yod/ de las khang sar smi lham po128yod/ dad ldan khyim tshang150lhag mchis/ 'gro gron tshang ma mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs sogs la brten/ dgon pa'i do dam pa ni skya ser mi lnga las grub/ gang ci'i bya ba rnams rgyal gzhung gi srid jus dang mang tshogs kyi re 'dod ltar spel mus su snang bas rjes su yi rang byed pa'i gnas so/ /yān thung hran r+pā len dgon/yān thung hran r+pā len dgon ni khang lo rdzong le ba sde grong du chags/thog mar bzhengs dus ni man ju rgyal rabs kyi skabs yin la/ 1kha58lor 'jig 198 2lor slar gso mdzad/ lha khang khang mig gsum/ rung khang khang mig lnga/ sgo chen khang mig gsum/ khang sa'i khyon la smi lham po170/ dgon sa spyi'i khyon la smi lham po660dad ldan dud khyim brgya dang nyer gsum la mi grangs drug brgya sum cu lhag yod/ sgar zhing la smi lham po1980yod/ lo rer 'bru rigs rgya ma stong gi yong sgo yod pa'ang dgon pa'i mchod 'bul gyi thebs su gtong / da lta'i dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi 'go ba ṭo yan yon zer ba lo drug cu re grangs su son no/ /stag nyal ri shis sprin dgon/stag nyag ri shis sprin dgon ni khang lo rdzong hrang ban zhang san the'o sde ru chags/ngag rgyun ltar na dgon pa 'di thog mar hran zhi zhing chen gyi yu'u len rdzong nas thung nges rdzong lcags sdong rir spar/ de phyis san the'o sde grong du brgyud zer/ der dpyad pas thog mar chags pa'i dus su byang brgyud dam rgya brgyud nang bstan las bod brgyud rang ma yin/ sa 'dir spar ba nas bzung ste bod brgyud du 'gyur tshod red/ gang ltar lo lnga brgya lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i dgon rnying zhig go/ snga ma'i rten dang brten pa thams cad dus zing gis 'jig chos lugs slar gso btang tshun chod du bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa la/ lha khang chen mor smi lham po120/ grwa shag gyan bcu bdun la smi lham po72 5/ rung khang khang mig gsum la smi lham po115/ gzhan khang mig gyan gsum la smi lham po10 5yod/ da lta dgon nang du rgyun sdod pa mi bcu gnyis yod/ de las btsun pa 'gas dus bzang sogs la bla mchod smon lam sogs gsum/ rten bzhengs — 639 —

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul khang lo rdzong gi khongs/kyang ston sku gtsos pa'i thang ga mi nyung ba bzhugs/ dgon pa'i las sne su'u khi gyan bya bas sne khrid byed pas gang ci'i bgyi ba legs lam du 'gro mus su yod do/ /su'u hu hwa len dgon/su'u hu hwa len dgon ni khang lo rdzong su'u hu sde khrod du chags/ da lta'i dgon bdag la su'u hrang zhan zer/thog mar chags dus nam yin mi nges/ 1kha5〈lo dang rig gsar skabs 'jig chos lugs slar gso tshun chod du bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lha khang gi khyon la smi lham po11 2yod/ dgon sa'i khyon la smi lham po726yod do/ /yun gya dgon/yun gya dgon ni lo rgyus ring bar bshad kyang nam yitsha gsal bo rang ma nges/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jig 1kha80lor bskyar bzhengs byas/ dad ‘sdan dud khyim nyis brgya bcu drug lha khang la smi lham pa15dang / shar khang smi lham po2 4dgon sa spyi la smi lham po52 0yod/ dgon pa do dam las sne skya ser mi lnga las grub po/ /pe yun nam sprin dkar dgon/pe yun nam sprin dkar dgon ni khang lo rdzong mkhar gyi ri de'u zhig gi steng du chags/ ming go srid lo so gnyis par(spyi lo1942lo/) gsar 'debs mdzad/ skabs der lha khang gnyis dang / thugs rje chen po/rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po bcas rten dang brten pa du ma las grub/ grwa rgyun yang du ma yod/ 1958lor 'jig 198 2lor slar gso mdzad pa nas bzung lo bstud mar bskyar bzhengs dang rgya bskyed mdzad/ lha khang gyo thog can gyan lnga bzhengs pa la dus gsum sangs rgyas dang /thugs rje chen po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang bo sogs lha rten mi nyung tsam bzhugs/ g.yon gyi lha khang du1995lo'i zla bzhi bar 'brug yul nas gdan drangs pa'i g.yang ṭi las bzhengs pa'i 'phags pa sa'i snying po mtho tshad la khru lnga las brgal ba zhig bzhugs/ g.yas kyi lha khang du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje btsun byams pa mgon po/ bai ro tsa na sogs kyi 'dra sku bzhengs/gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku phreng drug pa rin po che rje btsun bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo sde 'dir lan gnyis phebs shing / dbang lung dang rab gnas bstsal/ rten bzhengs kyi thebs kyang sgor mo mi nyung ba gnang / dgon nang du grwa ba lnga 'dus/ tshang ma mtsho sngon men ho nas 'ongs/ dus rgyun grong lwa bkyon/ dus bzang sogs la gzan mnabs/ gcig pa'i smon lam dang bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs 'tshogs — 640 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/la/ bla ma mchod pa dang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ stong bshags/ skyabs 'gro/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/bsang rnam dag mgon chos lnga/ kun rig tshe dbang / sman bla sogs gsung / rten dang brten pa snga rting du bzhengs pa bsdoms pas dmangs sgor lnga 'bum lhag la son/ gang ltar dgon pa 'dir srid jus bzang bo dang mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor la brten gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod pas/kun gyis rjes su yi rang byed pa'i gnas so/ /'brug sngon dgon/'brug sngon nam chen lon dgon ni khang lo rdzong hu bkan zhang ko cis sde khrod du chags/thog mar chags pa'i dus ni bcing grol sngon du ste spyi lo1994lo yin par bshad/ skabs der rten dang brten mi nyung ba bzhengs shing / rgya bod gnyis kyi btsun pa'ang mi nyung ba 'phel bas bstan pa legs par spel/ ma 'gyangs par195rngalo dang rig gnas gsar brje'i chom pos sku gsung thugs rten thams cad med med du bcom/1992lor slar gso mdzad pa dang ston pa'i lha khang smi lham po12 0can zhig bzhengs/ shar khang khang mig bcu la smi lham po12 0/ lho khang khang mig drug la smi lham po72nub khang khang mig bdun la smi lham po84/ so so'i nang du 'phags pa sa'i snying bo sogs 'dra sku mi nyung ba bzhugs/ da lta dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang skya ser lnga las grub/ dus bzang sogs la bla mchod dang smon lam sogs/ las sne 'go ba mu'u don grub ces pa'i bod btsun zhig ste dgung lo drug cu lhag la son/ mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs sogs la brten pas gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su snang bas rjes su yi rang byed pa'i gnas so/ /

lin zha ha'e rigs rang skyong khul kong ho rdzong gi khongs/kong ho rdzong gi khongs/the ci dgon/thi tsi zi(dgon)zhes pa ni da lta'i len zhwa he rigs rang skyong khul shar gnam rdzong ngam kong ho rdzong mkhar gyi lho sgor chags/sngon dus shar tsong kha'i rgyal bo dang sa skya bas dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs su gsang sngags kyi bstan pa phyogs 'dir ches cher dar zhing / bse drug pa rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje mchog gis snga sor yul phyogs 'dir yongs khyab tu kun bzang bde gsar zhes gsungs/ rgyas the tsi zi zer ba'i ming chags tshul ni/ gnam bskos gong ma chen po ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs tsam ri bo mtho la lhun chags pa'i kha gya'i phyogs bcu'i gnyan chen gyi brag gzar zhig tu stag ma gcig gis byis pa khyad 'phags can gcig gso skyong mdzad/tsha ba rngon pas mthong bas rgyu mtshan gong ma chen por zhus par/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po thugs mnyes te gong ma'i mdun du khyer shog zhes bka' 'byor / khyer lam du byis pa khyad par can de yul 'di nas tshe las 'das/ gong ma'i gnang sbyin dang yul 'di ga'i dad ldan mang bo'i mthun rkyen la brten nas gtsug lag khang phan tshun gnyis rjes dran du bzhengs shing / nang rten bod rgya'i lha sku 'ga' dang mdo smad gnyan rje sngo la g.yu rtse'i snang brnyan bzhengs/ mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa mang bo stod smad phyogs gang du phebs lam yul skyong lha gnyan 'dir lam bgrod bde bar 'ong ba'i 'phrin bcol btang ba la rgya mi the tsi zi'am rgyal sras dgon zhes bos pa'i ming thogs/ sa khyi1889lor kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen po dwangs bsil ri bo rtse lngar phebs lam ka ju skya ga'i phyogs nas bla ma gung thang tshang gtsos mdzod dge shog lnga'i phebs bsu dang rdzong 'bul bstar ba dang yul 'di'i yul lha gzhi bdag 'dir lha bsang btang / rgya 'khrug skabs su gtor mod kyang / lha khang bskyar bzhengs skabs dngul srang brgya zhal 'debs gnang / yang sgos su the tsi zi'i mi dpon gyis khong rnam pa gdan drangs shing zhag bzhugs gnang bar bkur bsti gzab/ dgon 'dir lo re nang du dus mchod gtso bo gnyis 'dzin te hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du spen le dgon dga' ldan chos gling dang / skya ga'i dmar gtsang dgon dge ldan chos dar gling dag gi grwa ba rnams dgon 'dir phebs te smon lam chos spyod kyi cho ga spel la rgya bod dad ldan mang bo 'dus te mchod bkur che/ 195rngalor dgon pa chag 'jig byung / da skabs rdzong gi le logs su lha khang chung ba zhig slar gsos pa'i nang du sngar gyi dgon pa'i rten rnying 'ga' zhig bzhugs shing rgya'i dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis mchog sbyin byas/ dgon 'di'i mchod gzhis gtso bo lho sgo sde ba'i mi khyim brgyad cu yod do/ /— 642 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/༄/ /tin zhi sa khul/shing kun rdzong gi khongs/sgo mo che dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /nub sbrang tshang dgon nam sgo mo che dga' ldan chos 'khor gling ni snga sor shing kun dgon pa'i le lag yin stabs len tho rdzong khongs su gtogs/ da ltar khang lo rdzong gi lho nub mtshams kyi spyi le nyi shu'i sa ste men lu'u zhang khongs su chags/thog mar chags pa'i dus ni han shar ma'i kong wu'i(༅ca)skabs su bod btsun zhig gis bzhengs shing /'debs snga ba'i cha nas mtshan la sgar rnying dgon zer/ de nas thang rgyal shin bkan skabs su dgon pa'i mtshan yang tā hrin hro'u r+pā cis zi'am tshe dpag med nor bu spungs pa'i gling du bsgyur/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lo srid lo bcu ba'am spyi lo1412lor rgyal po khrun tsu bya bas shin co zi'am rtogs ldan dgon zhes mtshan brjes/ chin rgyal rabs kyi chan lung srid lo bcu ba ste spyi lo1745lo yas mas su/ len tho khongs su gtogs pa'i dgon pa bzhi'i mtshan sa phyogs bzhi'i sgo nas te shar lho nub byang du phyes te h+phun bu'u zi'am bung tshang dgon du zer te/ rtogs ldan dgon pa la bung tshang nub dgon dang / ā+o ten gyi chi kya dgon la bung tshang shar dgon zer/ rin kya ko'u yi h+phu ko'u zi'am dgon lung sgar la bung tshang lho dgon zer/ 'brug tshang nyal dgon la bung tshang byang dgon zer/ de yang skabs 'dir 'chad pa'i bung tshang nub dgon nam sgo mo che dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi lo rgyus ring thung la/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lo srid lo bcu ba nas bgrangs na lo ngo lnga brgya bdun cu don grangs kyi lo rgyus yod/ man ju chan lung srid lo bcu ba yas mas te dgon ming brjes pa nas bgrangs na'ang lo ngo nyis brgya zhe grangs kyi lo rgyus yod/ dgon 'di'i bdag po'i cha nas spros na/ ming rgyal rabs yar sngon du bod btsun gyis bskyangs skad/ de phyis man ju dpal ldan bkra shis sku na rim gyis bskyangs shing 'dzin bdag mdzad/ de la yang mdo smad chos 'byung du/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos slob shar ba brtson 'grus rin chen gyi gdan sa yin la/ dga' ldan chos 'byung du chos rje brtson 'grus rin chen pas shar yul du bstan pa bskyangs/ sgrub pa mdzad pas 'gyod med kyi gdengs brnyes zhes gsungs/ rje de nyid yab de gu hor 'phan dang / yum 'bro bza' bsod nams 'tsho'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad nas yi ge bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ shes rab kyi klong rdol ba'i snyan — 643—

tin 'i sa khul shing kun rdzong gi khongs/pas lha bla ma zhes bya ba'i thugs 'phrog lha bla ma nyid kyang dbus su lo bco brgyad bzhugs te mdo sngags la sbyangs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhig ste/ de nyid kyis rje 'di yab yu ma las bslangs te bcu gcig nas bzung gces par bskyangs/ rab byung yang bsgrubs/ phar phyin gyi gzhung blo 'dzin gyi steng nas sbyor ba brtsi ba dang / sgrub dkyil du ma 'dzin bcug khong gi bdag rkyen gyis nyer drug pa la dbus su byon/ dga' lda na du chos rje rgyal tshab pas mkhan po/ 'dul ba 'dzin pas las slob mdzad de dge 'dun bcur longs pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ bslab bya'i gnas rnams tshul bzhin du bsrungs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa du ma'i spyan sngar dbang rjes gnang mang du zhus/ mkhas pa mang bo bsten nas lo bco lnga'i bar mdo sngags kyi gzhung rab 'byams dang / khyad par phar tshad/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa gong 'og rgyud bla ma/ spyod 'jug rnams la zhib tu sbyangs/ tshad ma sde bdun mdo bcas/ rigs tshogs drug byams chos lnga bslab btus sogs bstan 'gyur phal mo che'i 'u nga gsan/ brtag gnyis/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/gsang 'dus dang / bde mchog lū dril gyi rdzogs rim/ nā ro'i chos drug sogs bskyed rdzogs man ngag gi gnad la thos bas ma gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ 'dus pa/ dus 'khor/ rdor dbyings sogs cho ga du ma'i lag len go don bri thig dbyangs dang bcas pa blangs pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mkhas pa'i grags snyan thob/ dgung lo bzhi bcu ba la rang yul du byon/ bsgrub bya du ma rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la bkod/bstan pa'i ga'i rtsa tshugs phyir 'dul ba'i gzhung bshad la rtsal 'don dang / lam rim sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mo'i bshad pa/ dbang rjes gnang / khrid lag len gyi rim pa rgya cher bstsal/ khyim pa rnams la bsnyen gsan 'bog pa sogs dge ba la sbyor gang thub dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten brtsigs pa/sku gzugs bzhengs pa/ gsung rab 'bri ba/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ phyag skor/ zhal 'don/ lta ba dang snying rje sgom pa sogs 'khor lo gsum dang 'brel ba'i legs mdzad bzang bos dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /bka' rtsom thor bu kha shas dang / nyid kyi rang rnam tshigs bcad nyung ngu zhig mthong ba las bshus pa yin la/de nyid las/ da dung tshe yi lhag ma gang yod de/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis/ /nyin mtshan 'das par byas nas 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'gyod pa med par dga' bzhin tshe 'phos te/ /rgyal ba'i 'ing khams mchog tu skyes gyur nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed par smon/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /gdan sa nyid kyi dpon rgyud mkhas btsun bzang bo/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos bzang / don grub rgyal po/ chos dbang grub pa/ dpal 'byor seng ge rnams byon pa'i phyi ma 'di nyid chos rje nas brtsis pa'i mi rabs bdun pa yin phyir/ ngam ring / gangs can chos 'phel/ dpal 'khor bde chen rnams su grwa skor mdzad de rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ rgyud stod smad rnams su sngags la sbyangs/ rang yul du byon nas sde dpon co'u spe chan pe'i gdung rgyud brgyad pa gan cu yo gi co tung phung gis gtsos ma gal dpon yab sras sogs mchog dman thams cad kyis bla mar bkur/ zab rgyas gdams pas smin grol la bkod/ rtse lngar gnas — 644 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mjal dang gong ma wan li'i ti shri mdzad/ rgyal po la dbang lung du ma phul/ gdan sa'i sde phan tshun gyi gtsug lag khang 'ig gsos dang / gnyis kur smon lam chen mo'i srol btsugs/ bka' 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ dbus su rgyal ba yab sras la 'bul nod/ gdan sa khag la mang 'gyed mi sna btang ste lan du mar bsgrubs/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyis thub bstan spel ba'i mod re lnga ba la gshegs/thugs ljags spyan gsum dang / ring bsrel lnga byon pa nang bzhugs kyi gser zangs mchod rten sde gnyis lar(gcig ni shing kun dgon par bshad)bzhengs/ 'da' khar/ bdag dpal 'byor seng ge 'jig rten gdul bya'i snang ba da lta rdzogs pa yin/ da 'di nas tshe'i 'du byed btang la/ dga' ldan du rgyal ba byams pa'i drung / gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du stong ldan gyi steng du lha'i bu rnam dpyod mchog tu gyur pa zhig tu skye ba blangs nas rje btsun gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par longs spyod/ a la la ho 'es pa'i zhal chems phyag bris su mdzad snang / rnam rgyal rgyal ma tshan/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang thos mang / blo bzang tshul khrims/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ blo bzang mgon po/ blo bzang chos 'phel/ ngag dbang don grub pa'i bar byon nas bskyangs/ 'di'i dgon lag ma ṇi zi gong 'og gnyis/ dur zi/ kyin kyā zi/ ko'u yan zi/ hes mo'u zi('dir rdo rje phag mo'i sku brnyan byin can bzhugs pa phag mo rang byon mched gsum/ gyi nang tshan yin zhes mkhan chen sidha'i zhal snga nas gsungs/) za lo'i zi/ po tso zi/ yī khyan zi/ līn khrin zi/ yī thes zi/ smra bā zi/ bī kyā zi/ mā kyā zi/ mā kyā ngan/ za gar zi/ kyo ming zi/ thā kon zi/then kyā ngan/ po ldan zi rnams yod ces lo rgyus rgyas tsam spros so/ / de la yang / rgya'i lo rgyus dag tu/len tho'am shing kun gyi khongs su sde 'di la le lag che phra bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod de/ de dag thams cad man ju dpal lda na bkra shis kyi skyong khur la brten cing / so so'i khri ba'am ma/khan po sogs las sna thams cad kyang dpal ldan bkra shis pas bsko mngags mdzad/ ming rgyal rabs kyi yung lo'i skabs su grwa ba'ang sum brgya lhag zin/ zhing sa mu'u sum brgya/ chu 'thag gcig snum btsur khang gcig bcas yod/ man ju gong ma hrung ṭi'i skabs su ste spyi lo1644yas mas su/ dpal ldan bkra shis la byams sku li ma 'ig gnang / gong ma chan lung skabs su'ang gong mas bdag skyong bla lhag tu gnang / thung ṭi dus dmag 'khrug gis 'jigaming go srid lo bcu bzhi ba spyi lo1kha2 5lor bskyar bzhengs ma/dzad/ dpal ldan bkra shis skye phreng nyer gcig pa sun ho'u nang bsod bla mas skyong 'ing / grwa rgyun yang nyi shu lhag bzhugs/ de nas 'o gsum song ba ming go srid lo bcu bdun/ spyi lo192〈lor ka ju'i jag gte ka si len nam mā krung yon gyis bcom/ spyi lo1kha5 2lor 'ang gi mgo ba su'u men zhan dang / lis tin zhan sogs dad ldan skye bo'i re bskul dang mthun rkyen bskrun pa la brten/ lha khang gyan gsum/ shar khang gyan gsum/ rung khang gyan lnga bcas bzhengs shing dpal ldan bkra shis skye phreng nyer gnyis pa bsod nams rgya mtshos bskyangs/ 195〈lor shul med du 'jig grwa btsun thams cad log ste so nam gnyer/ nags tshal tshang ma bcad zin/ gong mas — 645 —

tin zhi sa khul shing kun rdzong gi khongs/gnang ba'i byams sku tshong khang du sprad/ 1981lo'i zla gsum par srid jus bzang po'i bka' drin la brten te/ spen le'i dad ldan lu'o khe ṭo dang pen khon bcas kyis zhal 'debs dang slong mo bgyis te khang ba gyan bcu bskrun/ sku rim nyin gsum la bsgrubs/ snga mar tshong khang du sprad pa'i byams sku de phyir dgon nang du gdan 'dren zhus/ mtsho sngon phyogs nas grwa ba zhig gdan drangs te rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ dgon bdag snga ma bzhin ho'u dpal ldan bkra shis pa'i sku rgyud kyis mdzad/19ra2lo'i zla lnga bar krung go khang lo rdzong u dang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis sde 'di slar gso byed chog pa'i thag bcad mdzad/ 19rnga2lo'i zla dang por/ zhing chen srid gros kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas shing zhing chen srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog gis sne khrid mdzad pa'i chos lugs mi sna'i lta rtog tshogs pa sde 'dir 'byor/ kun mkhyen rin po ches byams sku la snyan shal 'then cing 'phags pa brgyad stong ba tshar gcig gnang / 1982lo'i zla gsum par/ sde 'di'i do dam u yon lha khang dngos su btsugs/ lha khang dang mgon khang / rung khang sogs bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa sogs kyi bka' drin las khang lo dang shing kun nam len tho sogs yul gru mang bo'i mchod mjal ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'ongs shing gang ci'i bgyi ba rnams yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ /shing kun dgon dga' ldan chos 'phel gling /shing kun dgon dga' ldan chos 'phel gling(r+pā thā zitsho1thor+sha)zhes pa ni/ da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen tin 'i sa khul len tho'u rdzong mkhar gyi dkyil du chags/ sa 'di'i ming la yongs grags su shing kun zhes 'bod kyang don gyis shing sku yin pa gshan du 'byung /bod brgyud nang bstan gyi chos sde 'di da skabs dngos gnas rtsad bcad pa dang mdo smad chos 'byung du bkod pa sbrel nas lo rgyus cung gleng bar bya ste/ mdo smad chos 'byung du/ lin tho'u con(/khyasnyakhrim)nam shing kun mkhar/ der 'gro mgon 'phags pa (1255— 12nga0) mchod yon gyi bkas tā dbon pas dgon pa btab/ dge7'dun stong mang bo tshogs/ gong ma mchod yon gzigs par byon/ rgyal bo bla ma la dad gus che bas sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa 'bral med dgos zhus par/ khong nas nga rang 'dra ba zhig gyis gsungs/ spos shing bzang bo las 'dra sku bzhengs/ de bla ma dngos su gyur nas re zhig bar chos ston pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa zhes tā dbon lo rgyus las bshad/ sku de 'phags pa shing skur grags shing r+pā kye(bānazi'i rten gtsor bzhugs/ phyis su shi hwa'i khang zer ba dbus nas byon pa'i bla ma grags chen zhig byung /des dge lugs su bsgyur/ chos rgyal nang sgrub chos skyong du bsten/ mchod rten chen po gsum bzhengs pas r+pā thā zir(rin chen mchod rten dgon)grags/ rgya rams pa tshul khrims bstan pas zhus pa'i le'u dga' ldan chos 'phel gling( sngon rgya ming tsam las ma mthong bas/ da lta dgon ming dngos 'di yin par 'dod de kha da 646 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/byang du bkod pa yin/)gi bca' yig kun mkhyen bar ma'i gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa dgon 'di nyid kyi yin nam snyam/ da dung shing kun lo rgyus(7zonya/ /lo)deb bcu ba'i nang du/ min rgyal dus su don grub rin chen (oṃyo.otsha)zer ba rus rdo(thom)yin/ sku na phra dus nas r+pā thā dgon du rab tu byung / yung lo(lkolo)bzhi bar bla dpon du bskos(/4athalom)/ zhon te(zoḥ)lo gnyis par dbus su phebs par bod gtsang yul nas ting 'dzin nyams sad dge ba skyong mdzad ces pa'i cho lo thob/ de'i rjes su nor bu rin chen(smokhya kha.otsho)zer ba rus leng( ༅ wa)yin te/ chung dus nas rab tu byung zhing sgom du yun ring bzhugs shing kren te(kye 2r+sā 1506lo)chos kyi rgyal bo dang gong ma'i dbu bla chen po(14༅(/ ta)thob/ yang de nas yon dkon mchog bzang bo(mkhye7shā31tshakro kha )zhes pa bzhugs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung ste dam chos bklags/ skabs shig shar rgya mtsho brug pa(moralo'irnaji༈ lko)la gong mas khong gdan drangs/ khong gis bstan pa'i mthu rtsal mdzad de chu 'jigs bsal/ drin gzo la g.yu yi glang chen dang bka' shog gnang / de rjes ting 'dzin chos rgyal dbu bla zhes tham ga sogs bstsal/ da dung ho'i rin chen bka' bcu(lo1/yotsha7)6'a)zhes bya bas kyang yun ring sgom sgrub mdzad/ ces rmam thar dum bu re bkod do/ /bla ma don grub rin chen zer ba'i 'dra sku dang / de la gong ma yung los(74yar)gnang ba'i tham ga bka' shog bcas bzhugs pa'i chos rje don rin pa yin nam brtag ces gsungs so/ /dbon bdag shul lus da lta ba dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i dge slong hri pin cin(r+ṣadzangalha'i tsho—kho rdzong srid gros rgyun u/ zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs mi)gyis/ nga rang lo bcu drug nas chos sde 'dir yong nas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi 'don pa thams bcad klog mgo brtsams/ dus de nas bzung da lta bar nga dgon sa 'di nas gom pa gang byol ma myong /bod rgya'i yig rigs mang bo bltas pa dang dgon bdag bla ma'am dge slong rnam pa'i zhal nas dgon pa'i lo rgyus mang bo thos/ nged kyi dgon pa 'di dang thog thang rgyal rabs kyi dus su chags shing rgya khyon mu'u brgyad cu longs/ lha khang dang grwa shag dgon bdag zon bla ma'i nang chen bcas le lag lngas rtsig bkod grub pa ni ched du dkyil 'khor lta bu'i sa stegs khang tshad tsam spungs pa'i steng du bzhengs pa la/ bod rgya mi rigs gnyi ga'i khyad chos ldan pa la shin tu ngo mtshar zhing brjid chags pa yin/ chos rgyal 'gro mgon 'phags pa(/khrikhu1lta)gnas 'dir phebs nas shing kun yul du nang ba'i sa skya'i chos sde bzhi(lkoloḥmor+sha(ཿr+sha)4khulo/lkothor+sha yosgozamar+sha(3lolotshozla) tshelotsho༅r+sha)phyag 'debs mdzad/ chin rgyal thung kru'i lo bcu gsum pa ste spyi lo1869lor yul 'khrug gi drag 'thab nang dgon pa bsnubs kyang kong zhu(76rmisgo)khri lo nyer lnga ba spyi lo190 0lor dgon pa bskyar bzhengs yongs su grub/ co ne'i tsha rdor dang yer ba sogs la 'brel ba zab/ dge slong mang bo dus rgyun dgon de dag rnams nas phyag phebs pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang /gong ma chan lung skabs kyi〈shing kun lo rgyus(1khu tshoni tin zhi sa khul shing kun rdzong gi khongs/zhes 'bod/ mkhar lho'i le dbar gcig tsam ste shar/ nub/ byang phyogs gsum po srid skyong mkhar rdzong dang 'brel 'dug pa ni shing kun mkhar zer ba nges so/ zhes bkod 'dugabod brgyud nang bstan yul der spel 'go 'dzugs pa'i sbyin bdag ni skabs der shing kun yul gru'i bdag gyur kra'o sa skyong(da dung sa skyong gi rgyud pa 'ig slob grwa'i dge rgan byas pa dang / gna' snga mo'i sa skyong khyim gzhis ni shing kun grong khyer gyi nub 'gram klu chu'i ngogs su yod la da lta rgyal khab kyi las khungs shul du gyur/ lin tho'u'i lo rgyus ltar na yon rgyal rabs kyi dus su/ a mgon dpal(amoṣ+ṭha)zhes pa yul der sku 'khrungs shing khyim rgyud rang sa'i mi yin/ zon rgyal dus su gong mas rus kra'o(lo)zhes pa bstsal cing yul de'i bod rgya bdag skyong mdzad bcug spyi lo1212—1217lo'i bar kye ta'o hri'i(ltoṭhaṣ+ṭha)'gan bzhes / 1224lor ri bo pad+ma can sogs kyi gnas ri bsrungs/ de'i bu kra'o khrun zhi(lod+nghazlo)la1260lor yon hre tru(lo)/nyalo)gnang rjes shing kun yul gyi stag lung dpa' khrir gyur to gsungs/ sngon chad gzhis mdun srang lam du bod gnyer tshong khang(gtso bo ja tshong dang rta tshong / gos cha ras cha/ lcags rigs zangs rigs tshong ba)khrom skor ring tsam yod/ da dung dgon par lho ri'i rdza rgyud du nags tshal mang bo dang dgon mthar sa zhing mu'u stong phrag yod do/ /grong mis bdag gnyer byas pa'i yong sgo la 'bru rigs dang shing tog sngo tsho mod po 'dzoms pas dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho rten la dka' khag med pa ma zad chos sde zhig gso sogs las don la phan pa che/ yang dge slong hrin pin cin gyi zhal snga nas kyis nged kyis shes tshod ltar na da lta'i bar dgon pa'i rten gtso ni rje 'phags pa'am 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che dang ston pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ rje tsong kha ba/ 'jigs byed sogs yin/ dgon pa ches dar skabs su grwa tshogs chig stong lnga brgya'i yan zhal 'dzoms shing bod brgyud pas bod yig tu dam chos bklags pa dang / rgya brgyud pas rgya yig tu dam chos bklag par bya ste/ chos gling gcig tu 'don rta dbyangs kha kha so so yin/ bcings 'grol snga phyi bar grwa ba brgya tsam las med/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la chos spyod chen po yod de 'phags pa bla ma'i gdung mchod dang mi ser spyi'i phan bde legs tshogs kyi rim gro spel/ byams pa gling skor phebs/ sa zhing bcos bsgyur 'go tshugs tshun lha khang dang grwa ba bdun brgyad las ma lus/ dgon bdag zon bla ma rin po che'i sku gong mar gong ma'i dbu bla zhes pa'i mtshan mchis te dgung lo bdun bcu lhag 'tsho bzhugs gnang mthar sku lus kyi bkod pa bsdus/ sku 'das rjes li sku ngo mtshar ba bzhengs/ 'on kyang yun ma ring bar dgon pa gzhung bzhes kyang byas te sdod dmag gi mdzod khang dang slob grwa btsugs shing rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul nang dgon pa rtsa ba nas bsnubs te thon skyed ru khag cig tu btang / zhes gsungs so/ /1984lor rdzong chos lugs cus kyis slar gso'i chog mchan bkod de lha khang khang mig gsum bzhengs nas dge slong r+pā lags khong nyid kyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang ston pa la sogs sku gsung gi rten 'ga' dang gdugs rgyal mtshan bcas kyis krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su 'u glegs bam/pa zhig tu khor rkyang du 'tsho bzhugs gnang 'dug grwa shag bya rung ba'i khang ba ga'an mig bcu phub/ dus rgyun dad mos bya mkhan chad rgya lugs dang bod lugs kyi mchod rten gsum bzhengs pa 'jig stabs da lta mchod rten gcig bzhengs pa'i mdun ngos su dgon pa'i chag 'jig gi lo rgyus phran bu bkod do/ /'brug tshang nyal dgon/'brug shu'i klu chu'i nyin ngos wo 'u nga zhang lu'u li kyā sde ba'i(smo//stsamokhro)nang du chags/chos sde chags yul ni rgyab ri g.yu 'brug 'khyil 'dra dang yul ljongs rnam par mdzes pa'i snga mo'i dben gnas khyad par ba 'ig yin/ ri sdebs su sgom khang gnas khang mang bo yod/ sngon chad li na tho'u'i nyin ngos(klu chu'i nyin)kyi mdzes ljongs brgyad kyi gas su brtsi/ dgon pa 'debs 'go ha cang snga bar gleng / zon yo na min dang chen rgyal rabs kyi dus dag tu chos sde dar drags pas dad ldan mchod gzhis dung khyim stong phrag yan zin/ lo re'i zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga dang bcu ba'i bco lnga'i nyin 'a chos spyod rgya chen po spe' te mi ser rnams kyi lo gegs dang dge don rim gro bsgrub par rem/ 'don rta dbyangs bcas bod lugs nang bstan dngos satsang yin/ dgon pa'i lha khang dag tu sku'i rten la g.yang ṭi dkar po'i rje btsun byams mgon dang 'jam dbyangs sogs 'jim sku che mtshar bdun dang / rdo brkos 'dra sku gcig(spyi rgya sum brgya can)sogs bzhugs su gsol/da skabs sngar gnas su slar ston pa shākya'i lha khang khang mig gsum can spus legs shig bzhengs shing /sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba bzhugs pa dang phyogs ba'i'i khyams su tshon gyis brgyan lha sa ra'i g.yas g.yon yig rtsal 'grem sto na khang dang klu dbang rgyal bo'i lha khang / grwa shag phub pa bcas khang mig lnga bcu lhag mchis /rtsig khyon smi drug brgya drug cu zin/ ra dkyil du lha khang bskyar bzhengs kyi rdo ring btsugs/ bskyar bzheng 'gro gron shog sgor chig 'bum drug khri btang / bdag skyong da lta ba'i mtshan la dge bsnyen kra'o rus (lolo)zhes pa dang dge slong na gzhon gnyis bzhugs te/ rang gso'i sa 'ing mu'u gcis dang skyed tshal smi chig stong lhag gi khyo/ na yo da/ lo rer mang tshogs kyis ma jal rten 'phrin mchod phul pa shog sgor bkugs na khri phrag 'o ngas pas sku rten mchod bkur la phan chen po thogs so / /lin hri dgon/lin hri zi(zapor+sha)zhes pa ni da lta'i tin zhi sa khul lin tho'u(shin kun)rdzong dar dmar(ṇ+ḍa1lo)zhang — 649 —

ba bzhengs par rten gsum 'gangs chen bye mar bltams skad/ bcings 'grol skabs su lha khang chen po dang mchod rten thal skya gnyis las med par gna' bo'i gtsug lag thams cad 'jig1966lo rig gnas gsar krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/slar bzhengs/ grwa shag sogs khang mig brgyad phub par dge bsnyen ma hri phin pho(r+ṣar+ṣa ṭha olha༅)dang bcas rnam gnyis kyis bdag krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'a sa kun su 'u glegs bam/shākya'i dgon/shākya'i dgon pa(ཿ༅r+sha)tshes pa da lta tin 'i sa khul lin tho'u(shing kun)rdzong zhin then grong rdal(snror+sha ni tshul de la brtags pas thang gi rgyal rabs skabs sam yang na de las snga shos shig yin pa rtogs nus/ su'u tsung r+pā yen srid lo gnyisapa'i dus su men ju'i yul phal mo che bod kyis bzung bod brgyud kyi nang ba'i bstan pa spel/ chos lugs gzhan las ches cher dar zhing rtse ru son gshis skye 'gro yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur/sung byang ma'i srin tsung yon h+phun gyi skabs su/ byams chen ting 'dzin(ḍa/ngatshor+sha)gling zhes pa ni/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag kro khron krong(mayizlo4tso)dang po khrin(྅1nyayo)r+pā hron(྅1//khu)gyis gong ma'i lung las sbyin bdag mdzad de bzhengs/ sa skyong chen po'i bsngags pa mnga' brnyes/ yon rgyal rabs thog ma'i dus su/ gong ma'i bka' blon lde rgyal(blangakhekhritshokhu)sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la yi rang zhing dad mos mchog tu bskyed/ tsha bo bkra shis dpal ba dang bcas mes tsha gsum gyi mi ring la/ dgon sde brgya lhag bzhengs par bshad pa dang / tā ming rgyal bo zhan tsung dang zhon te'i srid lo(spyi lo1429pa)la/ gong ma/'i bka' las lhun grub sde chen gling gi gtsug lag khang(14lkortsoyor+sha)gsar du bzhengs/ dpal ldan bkra shis la/ gong ma zhon tes tshul khrims dag pa'i ye shes kyi(nyi ma chen po)'gro phan mdzad pa rgyal khams skyong zhing rgyal bstan spel mkhas kyi lung rtogs mnga' brnyes pa 'phags yul gyi rgyal sras gong ma'i dbu bla chen po/ (11yo1nyanya༅stsozakhyacho chotshoṭhatsho ཿyo༈rnyamazo༅o+oṃ(༅)/khro)zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/ de'i mi rabs phyi ma chos rje bstan 'dzin('aṣ+ṭhak+ṣabacha)bya bas men ju'i srid skyong las shag tu dge 'dun pa'i don gnyer gyi las sne khur/ de'i spun tsha dar rgyas bya bas khang zhi srid lo so gnyis par(spyi lo1692lo)srid dbang bzung ste khra h+phu yu'u(lkopo༅)dang yul logs dag gi dgon sde so lnga bdag skyong mdzad/ de nas men ju kong zhi rgyal po'i bar du yul 'dir nang ba'i dgon sde rgya phrag gcig lhag yod ces sa de ga'i chos lugs pa rgan pa bgres song gi ngag rgyun du gsungs pa dang gsham gyi rnam thar sogs su byung ba mtshungs so/ /dgon pa de dag thams cad nang ba sangs rgyas kyi grub mthar gtogs kyang / bod brgyud nang bstan 'ba' zhig yin pa'i khyab pa rang ma mchis na'ang(chos dgon lhun grub sde chen gling ngam ta'u thung kya'o sde dang chos rdzong dgon pa ste sde 4 — 655 —

tithoskogi saganasamen ju rdzong gi khongs/ chen po 'di5nanyis shāsadagon lhag zlasan cu lhagashayod ces deb ther rgya mtshor yangasag sal)/ de'i rgyu mtshanasko / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byang nas byang du dar zhes pa ste bstan pa'i me ro mdo smad yul nas slar gsos shing des mtshon pa'i rje tsong kha ba chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa de dar ba nas bzung ste/ sog po'i yul gru thams cad du dge lugs pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / bod dang mtha' mtshams 'dres pa'i rgya nag gi sa cha phal mo cher byang brgyud dam rgya brgyud kyi nang bstan de tā ming rgyal bo'i dus su cung nyams rgud kyi tshul gyur cing / rje tsong kha ba'i ring lugs kyi bstan pargya cher 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/ rgya'i yul gru la yang shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgos su men ju sa cha 'di snga mar 'jang gi mi rgyud kyis bzung / bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang gcig tu byas shing rim gyis phyogs bzhir dbang bsgyur/ su'u tsung r+pā yen(loza༅༅)srid lo gnyis pa(spyi lo762)la/ bod shar bskyod dmag gis men ju bzung / sung rgyal rabs byang ma ste hrin tsung 'i nyin(༈lhozo༅ོ)srid lo drug pa(spyi lo1072pa)bar du bka' ma log par bsdad pa lo sum brgya lhag 'das pas mi lo bzhi yi tshe la de ru gzhis pa'i ring la/ 'jang dang mnyam 'dres kyis mi rgyud kyang 'phel 'o /de ya nga men ju yul gru'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag shes tshod tsam ste da lta shul lus bshad du snang ba dag drangs na/ tun zi'am chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling ngam ta'i thung kya'u zi'i gtsug 'a ga khang gi dkar chag/ ji skad du tho'u ju dang men ju'i rgyun du bod mi shar gyi sde la dad/ yid sems ring nas gcig tu mthun/ /zhes pa'i ngag rgyun 'a sa shar gyi sde'ang rgya skad du tung zi zhes pa ni yongs grags kyi ta'i thung kya'u sde'i gtsug lag khang ngo / /de'ang men ju'i mkhar gyi shar phyogs su chags pa'i cha nas shar gyi sde'am shar dgon du 'byams par grags/ sde chen po 'di nyid da lta'i tin zhi sa khul gyi khongs gtogs te/men ju'i rdzong mkhar gyi byang shar mtshams su spyi le nyi shu tsam gyi sar chags/ de la 'dir dpyad ga'i'i yig cha 'ga' dang kho bo'i mig mthong ltar dgon pa de'i bdag po dang / rten bzhengs/ 'gyur ldog phyogs kyi cha nas spros na/dgon pa 'dir mtshan du ma byung myong yang tā ming zhon te srid lo shing lug ste spyi lo1420pa'i zla7par ta'u thung kya'o zi zhes pa'i mtshan du brjes/ dgon pa nam btab kyi cha la bshad tshul mi 'dra ste/ kha cig gis we byang ma'i(shākhuskru'i)skabs su dang / kha cig gis thang rgyal rabs su 'dod/ brag sgom pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung du men ju dpal ldan bkra shis sam de tshang chos rjes btab ces dang / rgya yig las byung ba'i hor rgyal thog ma 'i dus su(spyi lo1271da 1268bar)zhon we hri(zoblo/skyong)zhes pas btab par bshad pa gcig tu nges/ der dpags pas dgon pa btab ste da lta'i bar lo grangs bdun brgyar nye ba'i lo rgyus yod/dgon mtha' yongs su lcags ris bskor/ dgon sa'i khyon la sa mu'u lnga brgya lhag yod/ lcags ri'i phyi nang kun tu g.yu lo'i bkod pa tshar du dngar ro/ /— 656 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su 'u glegs bam/de la'ang rten dang brten pa'i phyogs la/ rgyal chen lha khang gcig rdo ring lha khang gnyis/ jo khang gnyis/ 'du khang gtsang khang gsum glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ rgyud pa'i lha khang / gzim khang dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gnas bcas khang mig lnga brgya lha ga bzhengs shing / rgyal chen lha khang du rgyal chen bzhi'i 'dra sku dang / 'du khang chen mor dus gsum sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug dri gtsang khang dbus mar ston pa dang / rje btsun byams mgon/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad sogs bzhugs/ gtsang khang g.yon par mgon po phyag drug pa dang / g.yas par dpal rdo rje 'jig byed sogs kyi 'dra sku bzhugs so/ /de'ang zhib rgyas su 'chad ba la gsham gsal ltar ro/ /chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling /tin zi'am chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling(nga༅mar+sha)ni/ men ju dpal ldan bkra shis sam de tshang chos rje bya bas btab/de yang khri ral ba can gyis tsong khar dmag gi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dar bo che 'phyar/ dam ga rtsis dang go bsher mdzad dus gcen dar ba zer bas g.yag sde thams cad las de bud pas de bud du thogs/ 'di ba bod rgya'i mtshams sa mtha' gnon pa'i dpon du bskos/ theb ju(༅nya//lo)brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang la btsan mkhar brtsigs te mdo smad kyi mi dpon mdzad/ de nas mi rabs du ma 'das rjes bkra shis dpal zhes bya ba la ma mgo bdun gyi sras bco brgyad byung / gsum rab tu byung ba ste bla ma gu ru bya bas khrag 'o mar bsgyur nus shing hor gyi ti shri mdzad/ bla ma saṃ ghas rtse lnga'i chos sde dang / mkhan po rtarma pha las shing kun(rnya//yisnyokhri)dpal gyi sde chen gyi gdan sa mdzad/ ga'an mi dpon gyi las ka 'dzin pa bzhi dang / yul dpon sha stag byung ba'i snga ma bzhi'i nang tshan dben phon chen po'am mar steng dpon po bzang bo dpal gyi sras su/ rab byung drug pa'i me mo sbrul la(spyi lo1277pa)rje 'di nyid 'khrungs so/ /dam pa de nyid chung dus nas snying rje che zhing mchog gsum la dad cing rgan rabs la gus pa sogs dam pa'i kun spyod ldan pa zhig ste rab tu byung bar bzhed kyang pha mas ma gnang ngo / /bcu ba la nyid dang gdung rus gcig pa'i bla ma 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya bas yab yum la gsung gnang ste nyid kyi rtsar blangs/ slob dpon bsod nams rgya mtsho la gtad nas yi ge dang chos sna mang du slob bcug bla ma sbyin pa/ bla ma mgon po dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas grags rnams las lung dang chos bka' du ma gsan/ bcu gsum pa la kho bos drung chen dpal ldan rgya mtsho ba'i drung du rje 'de nyid kyis gtsos grwa ba nyi shu phul/ bco lnga ba la rje 'di nyid kyis rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ bcu bdun pa la bla ma'i phyag phyir zhwan zir(lor+sha)phebs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs/ rdor phreng gi dbang gsan/ sa ris cha tshang bslabs/ sbyor drug gi khrid gsan nas mun khang du bsgoms pas nyams rtogs 'khrungs/ nyer gnyis pa la bla ma drung chen pas mkhan po/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal — 657 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/mtshan gyis slob dpon/ bla ma yon tan bzang pos gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ bla ma'i drung nas lam 'bras la sogs pa'i khrid dang / dbang lung man ngag rdzogs par gsan/ rnam 'joms kyi rdor/ sgrol ma sogs la bsnyen pa mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can byung / nyer brgyad pa la drung chen pa'i phyag phyir nam thas su gong ma tha'i dzung(8zo)dang mjal/ phyi lor chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa bsu bar mdo smad bra bo rtse sgang bar du byon/ garma'i lo tsā ba yang gnang / gong du slebs dus bla ma drung chen pa gshegs 'dug pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ rtse lngar 'bum pa bzhengs/ gong gis rje 'di nyid gtsos ban+de'i kun spyod gtsang ba so dgu chos rje kurma ba'i 'bas phyir phul/ so gsum pa la kurma'i phyag phyir khams gar dgon du phebs/ phyi lor mtshur phur bzhugs skabs dbus kyi dbang grags rgyan pas gong gi bka' dang len ma mdzad pas dmag rgyag pa'i gtam la brten/ rje 'dis phag mo gru ba'i zhal ngo grags rgyal sogs zhabs phyir khrid de lcags yos(spyi lo1411)la ngo chen du byon/ 'bri chu brub pa grub rtags kyis brgal/gser yig pa brdzangs te lung bzang bo phebs/ dbang grags rgyan la'ang thugs khrel sangs pa'i gnang sbyin bstsal/ so bdun pa la gong gi bkas dbus su byon/ bla ma rnams mjal bas thugs mnyes/ dbang gis thog drangs pa'i mi dpon rnams kyis nged sde ba zho chags su bcug pa bka' drin che zhus/ rje rin po che/rgyal tshab/ 'dul 'dzin/ kurma de bzhin gshegs pa sku phreng / rin po che bsod nams bzang bo sa skya ba kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen rgyal mchog pa/ spyan snga chos rje bsod nams rgyal pa/ stag lung mañju shrī/ bla ma shākya dpal/ sa skya ba kun dga' bzang bo/ chos rje se ra ba/ 'bras spungs chos rje sog po dka' bzhi ba/ bla ma sangs mgon pa sogs las zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ bla ma u rgyan pa la tshe dbang zhus par bum nang nas yal ga skam po la me tog thon/ 'ga' zhig phrag dog gi dbang gis gong mar snyan zhu zhus pas bka' bkyon 'phog pa'i gtam gsan 'phral shing lug (spyi lo1415)la pho brang du byon/gong ma mjal ba tsam gyis thugs khrel zhi ste bdag rkyen bstsal/ phyi lor ta'i tur ha'i yon zi ru(ngasalo oṃr+sha)bzhugs dus/ ta'i tshing / bya'u tshang zer ba'i sbrul gnyis bzung ste char phab/ zhe gsum pa(spyi lo1419)la zing mu zi'i rgyal khams kyi ban dpon chen po g.yi'u tshan kya'u ke'i las ka sogs gnang / men ju'i gzhi bdag dbri lang(ngakhrikhya sko)sogs kyis dngos su bsus/ yung lo nyer gcig pa chu yos la kurma'i sprul sku brtag dpyad kyi ched dbus su brdzangs pa phyi lor phyag btegs/ chos rje sprul sku gong bo tsa rir bzhugs pa shing sbrul la mjal bar byon/ lam ma rnyed pa la gangs ri nyil nas lam phye/ slar ta'i tu'i pho brang du phyag phebs te zhon jung(zoza)dang wu yang ten(loskrulo)du mjal/ zhon te(zoḥ)dang bo me rta der tsing gyo tshe'u tse ta'i kau shri'i(༈rnyam༅ tsho/ nga༅lo/ )las ku gser srang nyis brgya'i tham ga gser gar blugs kyi prog zhu sogs phul/ khrun hwa'i sde chen(ṣ+ṭha༅r+sha)du bzhugs/ rgyal po'i bkas kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ 'khor chen/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ kun rig tshe dpag med — 658 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lha dgu rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnam sras sgrub thabs/ bar do'i 'phreng grol sogs mdzad nas de rnams dang / rgyud rtags gnyis 'grel ba dang bcas pa rgya yig tu bsgyur/ me lug la gong nas nyid la mtshan gyi gzengs bstod dang / bzhugs gnas khrun hwa'i sde la ta'i lung bshen zir bsngags/ gtsug lag khang rnying ba zhig gsos dang / gsar du lha khang dbu rtse glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ gzim khang / dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gnas bcas khang mig lnga brgya lhag mdzod nas bzhengs/ nyin re bzhin dkyil 'khor lnga las mi nyung ba rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod/ phyi dro grwa mang dang mnyam du sku rim chag med/ nyid nas nam gung yol ma thag sgrol dkar gyi rnal 'byor sgos bsnyen pa khri phrag bskyed rim bsdus pa re dang sbrel ba'i srog rtsol rdor bzlas la rtsal 'don/ lam 'bras nas gsungs pa'i 'khrul 'khor tshang ma re/ yan lag bdun pa dang rgyun gtor gyi rim pa/ nyin sgo theg pa nas bzung tha ma'i srod la thug gi bar rdor sems sgom bzlas/ 'khor chen gyi cho ga bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ chos skyong rnam sras/ gur zhal/ phyag drug pa/gdong bzhi ba/ trak+tad/ tshogs bdag las gshin sogs kyi gtor ma/ dgung mo gtor ma brgya rtsa/drug cu ba/ mi g.yo ba dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi gtor ma/ chos skyong gtor ma brgya rtsa/ lan chags gtor ma brgya rtsa cha gsum dang bcas pa/ srod la byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba dang / 'khor lo chen po'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnams thugs nyams su bzhes par mdzad do/ /'di dag thugs brel gyi g.yeng ba lta bu zhig byung yang chag med kyi rim pa yin la/ gzhan dpon g.yog du ma dang bcas pas lo star tshes grangs nges can gyis bsgrub pa'i skor shin tu mang ngo / /slob ma dge bshes rin chen grub sogs dbus su mngags nas jo bo'i mdun du nyer spyod kyi mchod sdong khyad mtshar/ tā hung gser ma'i rnam sbyar gsum/ dga' ldan gser gdung la na bza'/ dngul kong dang dngul maṇa chen po/ rgyal tshab rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs la dngos 'bul/ dgon sde nyi shu lhag la mang 'gyed phul/ sa sprel lor(spyi lo1428)byung hūng ten du(༅zolo)gong mar 'khor chen dang phen ten(4lo)du tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gnang / dngos dang rmi lam du bar chad kyi rnam pa mang du byung ba 'khor lo chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi sgos meg med du bcom/ nga drug pa la sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa mdzad skabs mnal lam du rje btsun mas dgung lo brgyad cu lhag thub par lung bstan/ rmi lam du ku ru kul+le'i zhal gzigs/ yang / chos rnams thams cad gdod nas rang bzhin med/ /'dus byas mi rtag bde sdug nges pa med/ /snang tshul 'di rnams rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /'di ltar shes na ji ltar byung yang blo bde'o ang / /'di ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor ba rang blo bde'o ang / /zhes gsung bzhin bro brdungs pa sogs rmis/ shing stag lor(spyi lo1424)rgya'i sde dpon grwa ha'i(ཿco)dang / yon bzhad(zapho)rgya gar lho phyogs pa'i ban+de bla ma yo gi shwa ra sogs dge slong gi sdom pa la bkod/ bla ma lnga bcu ba dang 'dul ba'i bslab bya rgya skad du gsungs/ zhon te bcu ba shing yos(zaṣ+ṭha/༅)zla ba dang po la cing thung rgyal bo gdan sar bzhugs/ zon jung(zoza)gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su rje 'di la mtshan gyi gzengs — 659 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/bstod spar nas shel tham ga'u dmigs dang bcas pa phul/ gong gi zhabs brtan du tsha 'bum gyi mchod rten bzhengs/ lcags bya lor7gong nas gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa la dkar chag mdzad/ chu khyi lor(1442)gong mar rgyal khams kyi ban+de rnams la tu'u thes(ṣ+ṭhaḥ)zhus pas ban+de sum khri bdun stong la tu'u thes gnang / sngar zhe gcig pa me bya la lhun grub bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang bzo ba'i 'ja' sa gnang /gzhan mi dpon che chung brgya phrag lhag sde dpon che chung brgya phrag gnyis/ bzo rig pa sna tshogs brgya phrag bcu gcig dmag mi'u lag stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas 7gong gi bkas mngags/ mdzod kyi steng nas lha khang chen mo dbu rtse can/ rnga khang / cong khang / glo 'bur drug rgyal chen khang / rdo ring khang sogs thams cad g.yu gyo brtsegs ma'i thog can/ khyams ra bcas khang mig drug cu'i lha khang chen mor dus gsum sangs rgyas/ gnas brtan brag ri ma/ rgya yig gi bka' 'gyur/ dbu rtser thub pa/ 'od dpag med/sman bla/ nye sras brgyad/ bka' 'gyur/ g.yas kyi glo 'bur byang mar 'jigs byed/ bka' sdod las gshin yab yum/ g.yon gyi glo 'bur byang mar mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ mgon po gur/ mgon po phyag drug pa bcas rang rang gi 'khor can/ shar gyi glo 'bur dang bor gser gyi bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ thams cad la gos thum lung thag ba so'i gzer mgo can/ glegs shing gser ma/ glegs thag gser gyi chab mgo yod pa/ nub kyi glo 'bur dang por bon gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa rgyal rong ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis 7gong mar phul pa'i bstan 'gyur la phyi mo byas te bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur skya pota thum sogs gong mtshungs/gzim khang gi skor la lha khang bdun/ gzim khang tshoms chen bcas pa'i gsang sngags pho brang du lha sa'i jo bo dang byin rlabs mnyam pa chos sde'i jo bor grags pa gdan la ma reg par bzhugs shing / zangs gling nas spyan drangs par bshad/ spos shing gi rdo rje 'chang sogs dang / chos rje garma ba'i 'dra sku/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam rten du bzhengs pa'i 'khor chen/ mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ rnam sras/ sgrol dkar gyi sku brnyan klus btegs pa'i gser gyi pad sdong steng du bzhugs pa/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga mar gad/ mu tig rnams kyi phra bkod phun sum tshogs pa can/ mdun du ma na ho'i bum pa nas thon pa'i gser ljang brdungs kyi ljon shing rtse mor rin po che sna lnga'i me tog yod pa/ thugs dam gser 'bum bkra shis sgo mang sum gser dang zangs la gser srang nyis brgya lnga bcu'i tsha gser gsol pa dpangs khru bco lnga/ rdo shel dkar po'i stegs bcas/ sman bla'i pho brang mtho khyad 'dom gsum yod pa/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur/ phal bo che rgya nag dang bod kyi yi ger gser gyis bzhengs pa thum sogs sngar smos ltar khyad du thon pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi lha khang gnyis su 'khor chen/ bde mchog lha re gnyis/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ tshe dpag lha dgu rnams kyi blos bslangs/ dkyil 'khor bzhi ga'i lha dkar po rnams ba so/ ljang khu dang dmar po rnams ba so la tshos byas pa/ ser po tsan dan dkar po'i snying po/ nag po dang sngon shel shing las byas pa/ shar gyi lha khang rgyab mar spos shing gi 'od dpag med/ byams pa/ sgrol ma/ lha khang gzhan gsum du rigs lnga'i sku brnyan/da 660 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gzim khang du nyid kyi 'dra sku/ gser gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten gnyis/ ga'an yang gser sku/ dngul sku/bum sku/ li sku/ tsan dan dang shel shing gi sku/ thang sku btags grub/ bzo grub/ bris grub sogs bgrang ba las 'das so/ /ljang gser la gser gsol ba'i maṇ+ḍal zhing bkod kyi rnam pa 'bur du btod pa'i mtha' 'dom gsum pa/ ljang gser gyi kong bu de mtshungs/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed can /'bru bre bo che gsum re shong ba'i bdun tshar sbub gsum/ bum/ pa dpangs khri do lar gse ra gyi me tog 'dom re yod pa sum cu res brgyan pa mang bo/ sbub cha ya re mi res res 'degs dgos pa gcig dngul bre chen bdun las grub pa'i kong bu/ dngul gyi man+dal lnga tshar/ gu gu sha'i maṇ+ḍal/ rin po che'i phra yod pa'i maṇ+ḍal lnga tshar/ dngul gyi bdun tshar/ shel dang ma na ho'i me dam/ gā thung gi spos phor mang bo/ bzang gos du ma'i 'phan gdugs bla bres sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gtsug lag khang de dag gi phyi rol tu grwa khang khang mig nyis brgya/ lcags ri chen mo dang bcas pa'i nang thams cad rdo dang so phag gis bkrams pa sogs cha mtha' dag nas blo yul las 'das pa lta bu 'ig yod kyang rgyas pa rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /gong ma mchod yon gyis rje'i bka' ba'in rnam rgyal gling bya ba'i sde zur du btsugs/ 'du khang dang grwa khang phub pas/ sde snod 'dzin pa dka' bzhi ba kau shri bsod nams bzang bo dang / dpon po kau shri bso da nam sa bzang bo gnyis chos dpon du bskos/ dka' bzhi ba grags pa bsod nams/ dka' bzhi ba smon 'a/ma brtson 'grus/ dka' bzhi ba grags pa rdo rje rnams zur chen pa byas / dbon po shes rab ye shes sogs grwa ba brgya phrag la dbu phar gi 'chad nyan dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa btsugs/ dus ba'i'i chos thog gzhan zla ba byung ngo cog gi lnga gsum la yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshar phyin/ sde chen du yang kon ting ta'i kau shri(ཿmngaṭha1/khro) shākya shri dang / dbon po ta'i kau shri chos grub bzang bo sogs kyis 'chad nyan mdzad/ tshes brgyad nyer dgu rnam sa su maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba/ rnam rgyal stong mchod/ 'jigs byed sgrub mchod drug cu ba dang bcas pa/ kha 'bar ma sogs gtor chen bzhi/ cho 'phrul smon lam la gsang 'dus / 'khor chen 'jigs byed/ rdor dbyings rnams kyi sgrub mchod rdul tshon la brten pa/ mgon khang du nyin re bzhin yi dam sgrub mchod dang chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi gtor chog zhogs pa rgyun ja dang dgung mo sku rim chag med kyis 'al 'don gang rgyas/ dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen thams cad kyi phog thon/ gong du zhus te 'di dang dus mtshungs su ta'i 'u nga bshen(ngakhotshosh+lau zal4khujoyomaṣ+ṭhatsho)du hwa shang brgya phrag brgal pa 'tshogs pa'i sde btsugs/ rgya'i mkhan po zi lu'u zi'i(/myur+ṣatha)jo' chen(maṣ+ṭha)kya'u ho'u tsin(mar+sālnga)dang / zur chen pa hur kya'u sde'i(loyor+sha)dzang la la'u gu yon gnyis la rgya'i lugs kyi 'chad nyan byed bcug go/der ser mo ba rnams kyis 'khor chen lha bco brgyad/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ kyai rdor lha dgu/bde mchog lha re gnyis/ thugs rje chen po gsang sgrub lha bcu gsum/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ gdugs dkar da 661 da

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/rnams kyi sgrub mchod/ rnam sras gtor sgrub bcas lo re sgron me sbar bar mdzad do/ /rje 'di nyid dgung lo re dgu ba yan gyi rnam par thar ba dad pa'i rgyan rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i dpar zhig kyang mthong ste dpar gang yod ma nges shing dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pas cung zad rgyas tsam bkod pa 'di yin no/ /rab byung bdun pa'i me bya la btab nas lo bcu gcig song ba'i sa sprel zhon te(za2stso)dgung lo gsum pa'i steng zhig gsos mdzad de 'chad nyan btsugs/ 7gong nas ta'i thung kya'o zi ste bstan pa mtho ba'i sde zhes bsngags pa'i yi ge rdo ring la bkod/ de nas brtsis pa'i shing glang yan la lo bzhi brgya dang so bdun 'das so/ /zhes brag sgom pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung du gsungs so/ /sde 'di man chin gyi gong ma thung kri'i skabs su 'khrugs zing gi gzhan dbang du gyur na'ang / dgon pa bskyar bzhengs legs grub dang gong ma zon te(ṣ+ṭhaḥ)mchog gis bstsal pa'i dgon ming ste ta'i thung kya'o sde'am bod skad du bstan pa mtho ba'i sde zhes pa sogs mtshon byed kyi rdo ring bod yig dang rgya yig gnyis las bzhengs pa de da ltar yang mig gi dga' ston du shar ba ma zad/ kho bos kyang snag lam du btab ste kha tshang zhig dpar yod/ sde 'dir dgon lag gi cha nas spros na/ gong smras zhin zi dang du gu gang dgon/ ri rtse ja sag cig gis btab pa lang zi/ 'bru khung dgon dar rgyas lhun po/ dog su zi/ khra la phu zi/ khre rgyag zi/tā kun zi/ spyin zi/ be thal re zi/ yan 'ji zi/ yang kyan zi/ zhe har zi/ tsā ti sa zi/ nyi 'bag zi/ phang kyang zi/ an 'bag zi/ ku khre zi/ tum nyin zi/ bla ma zi/ kram rgyag zi/ yan rgya zi/blo deb zi/ ding bying zi/ thel tse zi/ hi cag zi/ wag spo zi/ spyos cag zi rnams so/ /spyi lo1982lor chos sgo bskyar phye tshun te1982lor/ kun su'u zhing chen rig gnas las khungs kyis ma dngul bzhi stong lnga brgya gnangs te rdo ring rnam gnyis bdag gnyer byed du bcug 1984lor rdo ring de gnyis ka rdzong rim pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob gal chen gyi gras su thag bcad/ 1987lor/ rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dus mnyam gcig
