tu dmangs sgor lnga stong tham pa gnangs te/ lha khang khang mig bdun(spyi khru gru ba'i98yod)dang grwa shag khang mig gsum(spyi khru gru bzhi29yod)bcas zhig gso byas/ da ltar shul lus rten 'gangs la rdo ring rnam gnyis dang ba so'i tham ga las med/ snga mar yon sbyin gyi gdul bya rgyas na'ang da ltar dad mos can sum stong gi grangs tsam las mi 'dug go/bsod nams chen po'i sde/kun h+phu zi'am bsod nams chen po'i sde zhes pa ni/ de kun su'u zhing chen men ju mkhar grong(khrimi༅/yi)gi nub tu chags/ yongs grags su nub dgon zer/thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni sung byang ma'i rgyal rabs thog mchan ti srid lo gsum pa(spyi lo1065)yin par bshad/ hrin tson(lhaskolko)gyi skabs(spyi lo1068)su rgyud sder bsgyur bar grags mod/ ming da 662 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rgyal rabs kyi zon te(zaḥ)srid lo gnyis pa(spyi lo1427)la han zhan wang sung(ཿ༅zo7)bya bas dgon pa rgya bskyed pa'i khar/ lha khang phyi ma gsar du bzhengs/ skabs der bod dgon du 'gyur ba ma zad/zhwa ser gyi bstan pa spel/ phyis su 'khrug zing gi dbang gis ming go'i srid lo drug pa ste spyi lo1947pa la 'jig dgon shul da lta slob 'bring dang bos bzung ba'i sa de'o/ 'di la'ang lo rgyus kyi yig cha sogs mjal du mi snang ba'i khar sa de gar song yang dri gtug tsam yang chud dka' ba'i gnas su snang bas/ dgon pa'i gtsug lag lha khang sogs rten brten pa/ skyes chen dam pa byung yod med thogs 'bri ma nus so/ /chi yin dgon pa/tshi yon zi'am kun skyob gling ni/ da snga gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i mkhar grong(tshemismolo)gi dbus su chags/ sung rgyal rabs(spyi lo1279sngon)kyi skabs su bzhengs par bshad/thog mar rgya brgyud dam byang brgyud kyi nang bstan dgon pa zhig yin mod/ phyis su yon rgyal rabs skabs su bod brgyud nang bstan las sa skya dang / de phyis ming rgyal rabs skabs su zhwa ser du 'gyur ba yin tshod de/ gang yin zhe na/ man ju dpal ldan bkra shis kyi bu ring tsha rgyud kyis man ju'i phyogs su dgon pa brgya lhag btab ces pa'i gtam gyis kyang yid ches su 'gyur/ de'ang lo rgyus sa bon tsam yang mdo smad chos 'byung sogs su mjal du mi snang bas ha cang gis kyang phang ba'i gnas so/ /gang ltar dgon sde de lo rgyus thog tu byung myong ba ma zad/ de'i chags shul yang snga mar su'u kring srang lam(ṭhaloyolo)red ces da ltar bstan du snang / bcings 'grol sngon tsam la wang bes krin(chaḥr+sā)sogs kyis bdag skyong mdzad ces kyang grags mod/ lo rgyus gsal zhing rgyas tsam bri ba la rgyu chas stongs pas ma grub po/ /pra ti dgon/pra ti dgon ni/ dgon lung zhang ste da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong / (7khri༅)gi pra ti sde grong du chags pa'i cha nas de skad du thogs/thang rgyal rabs kyi dus su gsar 'debs mdzad ces grags/ phyis su dar rgud ci tsam byung ba mi shes/da ltar grwa ba gnyis las mi 'dug mod/ chos spyod kyi rgyun tsam ma nyams pa byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /bkra shis dgon nam phang kyā zi/bkra shis dgon nam phang kyā zi ni da lta'i tin zhi sa khul men ju'i rdzong khongs kyi lho nub mtshams su/ ste/rdzong mkhar dang le dbar nyer lnga'i bar thag las med pa'i nyi sde dang bum mchod ces pa'i gro tsho gnyis kyi bar du chags/yongs grags su shar dgon nam chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling yod pas na bkra shis dgon yod da 663 da

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/nges red ces pa ltar/ sde 'di la'ang shar dgon btab pa'i snga rting gang rung du btab pa yin tshod de/hor gyi gong ma rgyal thog dang bo se chen han gyi blon po lde rgyal gyi tsha rgyud bkra shis dpal ba la bu brgyad byung /de las bu gsum rab tu byung / bla ma gu ru ma bya bas khrag 'o mar bsgyur nus shing hor gyi ti shri mdzad/ bla ma saṃ ghas rtse lnga'i chos sde dang / mkhan po rtarma pha las zhis pa shing kun dpal gyi sde chen gyi gdan sa mdzad pa des sde 'di btab pa ma zad gdan sa'ang mdzad/ de'ang dus kyi cha nas spros na hor se chen gyi skabs te/spyi lo'i dbang du btang na1260nas1295bar yin tshod de/ da thug bar lo ngo bdun brgya tsam gyi lo rgyus yod/sde 'di hor rgyal thog ma'i dus su btab pa tshun chod du/ hor gyi rgyal rabs bgrangs pas rgyal rabs gsu ma pa ste/ tā ming rgyal rabs dang / man ju rgyal rabs brgyud/ man ju'i gong ma khang 'i'i ring la /'khrigs zing gi dbang gis lha khang dang gtsug lag khang grwa shag mi nyung ba sreg za'i phung bor bstums/dkar thigs 'al 'debs kyi sbyin bdag ni nyams/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyang sran ma'i phung bo la dbyig pa phog pa bzhin du gyur/ man ju'i rgyal rabs bdun pa yung ṭing(spyi lo172 2—1725bar srid skyong )gi skabs tsa na/ dge slong sgal sgur zhes pas dgon pa bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ skabs der men ju'i mkhar du rus phang(༅)du 'bod pa'i stobs 'byor ha cang che ba'i khyim tshang zhig yod/ rgan gnyi gar bu phrug ni med/dus nam rtag tu smyung gnas sogs dge phyogs la ngang gis gzhol pas/ phang dge ldan zhes 'bod/ ma 'gyangs par rang ga'is khor yug gi sa zhing rgya chen po dgon pa'i grwa bar 'tsho rten du phul pa dang bstun/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tu gyur pas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang phang kya zi zhes thogs so/ /dgon pa'i chos sde'am yon bdag nga phang kyā tshang ma yin pa'i nye 'khor gyi nyi sde dang / 'i rgya/ nyin pa/drang dpal/ r+pā kya/ sbra nag ta tso ste grong tsho bdun yod/ phang kyā tshang gi bgres song rgan rgon gnyis ka 'das rjes/ khyim ga'is skyong ba'i tsha rgyud phang dpal mgon zhes pa zhig skyes pa des dgon pa'i sa 'ing de phyis len rtsis kyis gyod brgyab kyang / dgon pa dang lha sde tsho bdun gyi do zlar ma pher/ rkyen de'i dbang gis dgon pa'i mtshan yang snga ba ltar bkra shis dgon du bskyar gso mdzad/ phang kyang zi zhes pa ni yongs grags 'byams klas kyi dbang du gyur pa ma gtogs dngos mtshan rang ma yin no/ /dgon sde 'di skyong khur mdzad po'i cha nas zhus na/ dgon pa tshugs mgor grub ma/tha' sa skyar gtogs tshod dang / gdan sa na rim gang yin rang yig cha dang rna thos sogs dben pas bri ru mi snang / de'ang gong zhus dge slong sgal sgur gyis dgon pa bskyar bzhengs tshun ma na ju'i sa skyong bdun pa chan lung (spyi lo1640yas mas tsam)gis srid kyi kha lo bsgyur pa na/ r+pā zhes pa'i rus su 'bod pa'i dge slong ste r+pā lu'u han zhes pas gdan sa mdzad/ de ni r+pā kyā grong tsho ru rus kyang r+pā can gyi mi rgyud du 'khrungs/ dgon pa'i 'du khang sogs kyi bkod pa rgya bskyed du bzhengs/ gsung rab gtsug lag mang bo spyan drangs/ khru gsum — 664 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/can gyi rje sku gser las grub pa zhig bzhengs pa rig gsar las 'gul skabs rdzong rig gnas cus kyis bskungs pas da lan mjal rgyu snang / khong rang 'chad nyan la mkhas shing bslab khrims dag dgung grangs bdun cu lhag la bzhugs/ de la sprul sku btsal pa yang chan lung srid lo sum cu ba r+pā kyā grong tsho'i rus ho'u(/lko)can gyi khyim zhig tu 'khrungs/ chung dus nas gsan sar bzhugs/ rig pa'i klong brdol/ 'chad nyan sogs ma gzhol ngang gis 'phel/ dgung lo nyi shu lhag bzhes pa dang shar dgon nam chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling gi gdan sa'ang bskyangs/ dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis la gshegs/ de'i sprul sku ste sku phreng gsum pa rnal ma(deng sang dgon lung zhangar+shahākhri༅ khongs kyi bod dmag lung3thulo༈khri)grong tsho'i rus lis can gyi khyim tshang zhig tu two gung srid lo bcu dgu ba la(spyi lo1840yas mas 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu drug thog chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs chos grwar 'grims nas lo du mar bzhugs/ 'chad nyan rtse ru phyin pas rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags byung / de nas bzung mtshan la'ang les dge bshes su 'bod/ phyir rang dgon du phyogs pa dang shar dgon nam chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling gi khri ba mdzad pas sde de'i khri thog dang bor rtsi ba'ang yod/(nges min dpyad dgos) g.yang ṭi'i phreng ba'i 'bul ba zhig btegs pa skabs der rang dgon du bzhugs/ gsung rten yang mang du bzhengs/ ming go srid lo bdun pa(spyi lo1918)ste/ dgung lo don brgyad pa dag zhing gzhan du gshegs/ de'i sprul sku'am sku phreng bzhi ba da lta'i zi khron 'ing chen gyi khongs gtogs rnam 'phel rdzong gi wu phen zhes pa'i bod grong du rus mā can gyi khyim la 'khrungs pas/ a lags mā tshang yang zer/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng du gdan sar bkod/ dgu'i steng bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te 'chad nyan la gzhol/ khrir bzhugs shing phar phyin ston mo'ang mdzad/ nyi shu'i thog phyir rang dgon du phebs te gdan sa bskyangs/ ming go srid lo nyer dgu ba(spyi lo19'u0) ste dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la gshegs/ de'i sprul sku sku phreng lnga ba ni a lags bla kho rin po ches thugs thag bcad cing de'i phyi lor(1941)da lta'i co ne rdzong khongs kyi bya dge tshal zhes pa'i sde grong du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng gdan sar bkod/ mtshan la blo bzang dge legs rgya mtshor gsol/ bcings 'grol rjes su co ne dgon chen ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas snga rting du slob gnyer gnang / bla brang tshogs chen du bla ma khyom dge tshang dang 'dzin grwa gong 'og byas te lo du mar bzhugs/ phyir rang yul du log nas skya sar babs te zhing las gnyer/ spyi lo1khar9pa la tang gi srid dus bzang bo'i nyi zer spros pa'i bka' drin gyis chos sgo bskyar phye mdzad/ bya dge sprul sku(bya dge ru 'khrungs pa'i cha nas de skad du 'bod pa las/ sku phreng na rim la mtshan gcig pa zhig ni mi 'dug) nyid kyang phyir men ju'i sa khongs su phebs te dgon pa skyong khur dang rdzong srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon 'khur mus su bzhugs lags pa'i skabs so/ /sde 'dir srung ma lha mo bkur la/ rten dang brten pa'i cha nas chag 'jig lan du mar byung na'ang /sde 'di'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa dge bshes kyi bka' drin gyis slar gso myur bas/ nga brgyad gong rol tu da 665 da

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/tshogs chen 'du khang stabs bde zhig dang / dus 'khor 'du khang / 'jigs byed lha khang / rung khang/grwa shag sogs yod la/ 'du khang gi sgo 'phyor la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ 'du khang dkyil gyang ngos su dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gyan thang ste/ dbus su ston pa shāka thub kyi 'dra sku/ de'i rtse thog tu gong zhus kyi rje rin po che'i gser sku khru gsum can de bzhugs/ 'og so'i g.yas gyang nges su rje yab sras gsum/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ 'jigs byed/ cho sa rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug bcas kyi 'dra thang bzhengs/ g.yon gyang ngos su nye sras brgyad/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing sogs kyi 'dra thang /dus 'khor 'du khang du kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs bzhugs so/ /1958lo'i gong rol tu/ grwa ba bcu phrag grangs su 'dus/ grwa rgan khrims gtsang can bzhi bzhugs/res mes kyis khri ba lo gsum rer 'khor te mdzad/ bla ma'i nang chen du phyag mdzod gcig 'al ngo gcig dge bskos gcig dbu mdzad gcig a ne gnyis bzhugs pa la nang dgong gi mchod 'bul gyi khur len dgos/ grwa ba mang shos rang sa'i yin/ rgya'i grwa bas kyang bod chos bklags shing bod skad smra shes so/ /dgon pa'i gzhung la sa zhing dang rgyu nom ni yod de/ grwa ba rer bre bzhi'i sa zhing(bre gang sa mo'u gcig dang grangs chung gnyis re thon thub)/ grwa ba'i lo hril bo'i 'tsho rten yin/ grwa ba gshegs rjes dgon pa rang la dbang bas grwa rgyun gsar ba la gnang bar bya/ 'jag lnga dang bre drug gis zhing grong ba la glas/ de'i yongs sgo thams cad lo hril bo'i chos thog tu bkol/ lung ba'i phu na rtswa sa mu'u drug brgya lhag yod/ rgod ma sum cu lhag dang bzhon ma'ang mi nyung tsam skyong yod/ rgyab ri'i nags tshal mu'u sum brgya tsam dang / mdun thang gi btsugs nags la mu'u nyis brgya lhag yod/ dgon pa'i gling mthar grwa shag bcu bdun la bsdoms pas khang mig brgya dang so drug yod/ 1kha52lor grwa ba'i thon skyed ru khag ces pa zhig kyang tshugs myong / chos thog gam dus mchod la dgong mo smon lam/ bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad dang bco lnga smon lam/ drug pa'i tshe drug la sku rim rnam gsum/ bco lnga bcu drug bcu bdun la smon lam bla mchod/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la smon lam bla mchod sogs gsungs/ bcu ba'i bco lnga la sku rim bdag 'jug bcu drug bcu bdun la bskang ba/bco brgyad la 'cham chen(bkra shis 'khyil ba ltar)nyer lnga la lnga mchod chen mo ste lo hril bo'i chos thog yin/dus rgyun du grwa ba phal cher grong chog tu phebs/ ban chung las dang bo ba dag dgon nang du 'bri klog dang 'don pa la 'grus so/ /198 2lor chos sgo bskyar phye tshun chod du/ mang tshogs kyi zhal 'debs dang rdzong srid gzhung chos lugs las khungs kyis dmangs sgor bdun stong gnangs pa dang bya dge sprul sku'i bdag skyong la brten/ bya dge tshang gi nang chen khang mig ba'i can gcig 'du khang sgo chen/ gru shag khang chung gsum sogs bzhengs/dad ldan mang tshogs nyis stong gi grangs las brgal/ da ltar dge slong bzhi bzhugs/ dge tshul bsgrubs pa dang ma bsgrubs pa bzhi 'dus/ dus rgyun dgon nang du dus mchod re tshogs tshe grwa log drug yod pa de dag — 666 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kyang gsung rogs su phebs/ de'i khrod du lo drug cu re gnyis can gnyis dang re drug can gcig nyi shu son tsam gcig yod/ grwa log tshang ma'i 'tsho ba rang khyim la brten/ grong chog gi yong sgo ni bdag bzhes chogagrong chog yod tshe nyin rer sgor nyi shu tsam dang go re mi nyung ba 'bul/ mi gcig re phebs na sgor sum cu re 'bul ba'ang snang / lnga re song tshe sgor nyi shu'i lhag 'bul ba nyung / da lta grwa gsar gnyis ni co ne'i chas pa'i gshis dgon pa dang gcig co ne dgon chen du slob gnyer gnang mkhan du ma mngags yod/ de gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i thebs ni bya dge tshang gis sbyar mus su yod/ de lugs de gar dpe lta bur song yod pa ni kho bo'i mig mthong dang rna thos dngos te bya dge tshang zhal snga nas kyis gsungs pa bzhin sug bris su btab pa'o/ /bsod nams zhing gi sde/twe h+phu zi'am bsod nams zhing gi sde ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i(tshekhrozo)shar phyogs su le dbar brgya'i sa ru chags/yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bun tsung kri hon gyi skabs su ste spyi lo1221pa la gsar du bzhengs/ da ltar shul tsam yang mi shes par grong ba'i zhing sar gyur to/ /gong te dgon/gong te dgon nam che kyā zi ni/ da lta'i gan su'u 'ing chen gyi men ju rdzong(tshemizo)chi kyā zhes pa'i ri 'gor chags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi hung wu'i skabs(spyi lo126〈yas mas tsam)su bzhengs/ dgon pa'i bkod pa cung chung / da ltar grwa ba gsum las med/ gcig gis chos spyod kyi don dag bdag skyong byed bzhin dgon nang du bsdad/ gzhan pa gnyis zhing las gnyer/ dus mchod kyi skabs su grwa lwa gyon te lha khang du 'du/de la khor yug tu dad ldan mang tshogs mi nyung tsam 'dug go/mkhar nang bla ma sgar/mkhar nang bla ma sgar zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju mkhar(khrimizolo)nang gi dbri lang zhes pa'i rgya'i bla ri de'i 'dabs su chags/sung rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yon h+phun(ṭhaṭharo spyi lo107rngayas mas su)gyi skabs su bzhengs par bshad/ ming rgyal rabs skabs su dge lugs su 'gyur/ bcings 'grol skabs su dgon pa'i lha khang sogs bzheng bkod kyi rgya che zhing lhun chags su snang / dgon sa'i khyon la mu'u bzhi brgya lhag yod/ lha khang dang glo 'bur/ thog so bcas khang mig lnga bcu'i grangs las brgal/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su 'jig spyi lo1991lor slar gso byas/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rang mos sgos lha khang khang mig gsum — 667 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/smi gru bzhi brgyad can zhig ba'engs/ dgon sa spyi la smi sum brgya nyi shu lhag zin/ chos dad mang tshogs chig stong sum brgya re lnga yo da/ dgon pa do dam las sne mi bdun 'a sa grub/ chos spyod kyi 'gan tshang ma bkra shis dgon gyi bya dge tshang gis gceg lcogs su gnang mus kyi skabs so/ /phar phyin dgom/pan ru'u zi'am phar phyin dgon ni/ gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i ma khar grong (tshekhuzolo) gi lho ma/tha'i sa le dbar lnga tsam du chasas /ming rgyal gyi gong ma/ hong wu srid 'o bcu ba ste spyi lo1 277par gsar rgyag mdzad skad tsam las / da lta ra shul tsam yang mthong rgyu rang ma/ yod kyang ngag rgyun tsam gyi sa bon ya nga mi rnyed pa'i 4nas su lus pas shin tu nas kyang phangs dgos pa'i gnas so/ /lo paṇa dgon/'o paṇa dgon ni/ gan su 'u 'ing chen gyi men ju rdzong mkhar(tshekhu༅yishā)gyi shar mtha'i ri ngos te mchod rten dkar po'i dgon pa'i sde khrod du chags /ming rgya' rabs kyi hong wu srid 'o/ bcu bar(spyi lo1 277)bzungs/ nga brgyad lo'i shul lus kyi mkhar chag tsam/ yo da pa'ang phyi lo1kha5khalor bshig tshar/ da ltar shul tsam yang med par btang ngo / /chos rdzong dpal sde dgon choru/ rdzong dpa' sde dgon nam dpal tsang zi(rgya skad dutsholor+sha)zhes pa ni/ da ltar men ju rdzong zhi cang zhang dpal grub(༅༅ṣ+ṭha ཿ/tshokho)sde khrod du chags/sde 'di ni rje dpa la ldan bkra shis pa'i yo ngas 'dzin drung chen dpal bzang pos phyag 'debs mdzad/dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo ba'i nas yi ge bslabs/ brgyad pa la brtag gnyis bzung ste skyor sbyangs mdzad skabs tho rangs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs/ 'dzin skyen cing mi rjed pa'i gzungs spobs brnyes/ bcu gsum steng spyod 'jug la thugs sbyong mdzad pas rje btsun gyi gzigs snang sngar ltar byung /bcu bdun pa la bla ma dpal mchog pa'i drung nas dge tshul bsgrubs/ nyi shu ba la bla ma kun dga' blo gros la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ de nyid las brtag gnyis/ spyod 'jug mngon pa kun btus rnams kyi bshad pa/dus 'khor rtsis bcas dang sbyo ra drug gi khrid gsan/ nyer lnga ba la dbus su bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs slob dpon nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zhabs la gtugs/ dus 'khor sogs dang / khyad par rnam 'grel rtogs rgyan gnyis la sbyangs te gtsang dbus su grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags snyan 'phel/ rgya gar gyi skad rigs bzhi'i yi ge bri klog dang / snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ mdo smad du shing kun/ chu ma — 668 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/zer gyis dbus su dam pa du ma bsten nas mdo sngags la sbyangs/ 'di ga'i gdan sa dang byang stag lung gi chos rje mdzad/ dbus gtsang du rgyu dngos phangs med brdzangs/ bkra shis lhun por lnga mchod la gling me'i srol btsugs/ chos rje bkra shis dpal bzang dbus su thugs gnyer dang / 'dir gdan sa ba mdzad/sku gsung thugs rten du ma dang / gong ma grags rgyan gyis bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur la bzhugs khang bskrun/kau shri chos grub snying pos dbu rtse'i lha khang / chos rje'i gzim khang gnyis zhig gso bgyis/ thugs rje chen po dge 'dun dpal 'bar dbus su gsan sbyong sgro 'dogs chod pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa byung /gdan sar 'chad nyan dang byams pa'i gser sku chen po tshad bzhugs pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ chos gzhis su mi ser mang bo bzhag dbus su gtong thebs phon che ba phul/ chos rje bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / chos rje 'jam dbyangs don grub rnam gnyis gong ma dge 'dun dpal 'bar gyis chung dus nas bskyangs/ dbus su brdzangs/ mdo sngags la gsan bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i skye bar grags pa paṇa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dbus su 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul gong bo zhal snga nas dpal ldan grags pa/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bzang bo rnams la gtugs nas lung khrid man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ rnam gnyis lhan du gdan sa 'dir byon/ byams pa'i gser sku khyad 'phags dang 'du khang gsar du bskrun/ dge 'dun stong phrag lhag gi mang ja shong ba'i tshogs slang bkra shis g.yang 'khyil bzhengs/ lha chen dpal 'bar dang bka' 'gyur khang zhig gso mdzad/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsugs te 'chad nyan bskyangs/ chos rje bsod nams rgya mtsho nyid ri bo rtse lngar mjal te mtshams bsdams/ der gong ma ban lis(1572lo'i rjes)gdan 'dren btang ste ti shri du bkur/ tong wang gi mtshan gsol/ mu tig gi snam sbyar/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra btab pa'i las zhwa phul/ rang dgon du bka' 'gyur/ rje rin po che'i sku brnyan li ma che legs gdan drangs/ mgon po gtso 'khor gyi 'cham lwa bcu gnyis phul/ re gsum pa sa byi lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i(spyi lo1588)nyi shu brgyad la gshegs/ dbon po chos rje 'jam dbyangs kyis snga ma'i 'cham gos kyi cha lag 'cham zhwa dmar bo bcu gnyis/ mgon po gtso 'khor gyi zhal 'bag bzhengs/ chos grwa rnams slar gsos/ kau shri bsod nams rab brtan dang blo bzang bstan 'dzin te dbon po che chung gnyis yod pa'i phyi mas rje dpal ldan rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur khang zhig gso dang /gzim khang chen mo bzhi skor bskrun te 'dzin skyong mdzad/ kau shri grags rgyan pa'i dbon po 'jam dpal snying bo gzhung lugs smra ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa brnyes/ tā kau shri'i (rgyal bo'i dbu bla chen po)thob byung / rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ gong ma la zhus te dgon pa'i mchod thebs/ sa phyogs kyi nags mchod gzhis bcas la mis mi gnod 'gal mi byed pa'i 'jags yig blangs/ dbus gtsang nas 'bul dpon pa tshul khrims rin chen byung dus thams cad mkhyen pas rgyal me tog thang gi gos sku'i sbyin bdag mdzad dgos kyi bka' phab/ 'di la sku mched lnga yod pa'i tha chung 'jam dbyangs blo gros ni/ chung dus nas dam — 670 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa'i bag chags sad/ chos sgor zhugs te zhal snga nas byang chub rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas gsan sbyong mdzad/dbus su byon te bka' pota lnga rigs pa'i lam nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ gtsang dbus gnyis su mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ gtsang du legs grub grwa tshang gi bla ma mdzad/ bkras lhun thos bsam gling gi 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i ngang 'bras blo gling mkhan por phebs/ phar phyin spyi don skabs bzhi ba yan brtsams/ sku tshe mthar ma phyin/ zhag zhe dgu'i ring thugs dam la bzhugs/ gdung rus la thub pa/ jo bo rje/ yi ge du ma/thugs ljags spyan gsum sogs byon pa nang bzhugs kyi byams sku blo gsal gling du bzhugs/ 'al bzhugs dus kyang byams mgon gyi sprul bar grags so/ /chan shrī blo bzang rab brtan gyis 'di ga'i gtsug lag khang rnams zhig gso dang / byams pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa lha chen dpal 'bar khang du bzhugs/ gong ma khang ni nyer bzhi ba la smon lam dgon gyi gtsug lag khang gsar rgyag mdzad/ dbon po rab brtan phun tshogs kyis khang zhi nga lnga'i steng gzim khang shar ma dang / lho ngos kyi sgo khang phub pa sogs 'dzin skyong mdzad/dgon 'dir sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i tshems dang / li'i dkyil 'khor rang byon du grags pa mjal rgyu'ang snang ngo / /sde 'di'i dgon lag la sngar smras kyi bya nag dang gzhi/ ngo lo zi/ hu ngos zi/ tum rgyag zi/ se rgya zi/ spyag dmag zi/ ju gag zi/ zi/ lang zi/ hag tsag zi/ tsag bug chi zi/ spru bla ma zi/ lug rgyag zi sogs yod do/ /mdor na sde 'dir snga mar gtsug khang lnga ste khang mig bco lnga/ grwa shag khang mig bcu lhag yod/ sgo chen khang mig bzhi yod/ sa zhing dang rta drel la sogs dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho rten mi nyung yod mod/ nga brgyad lo sogs dus rkyen du ma'i dbang gis re zhig bar rmeg med du btang na'ang / spyi lo1989lor slar gso mdzad/ rdzong srid gzhung gi 'brel yod las khungs kyis zhal 'debs dmangs sgor stong phrag gcig gnangs/ da ltar 'du khang gyan gsum can zhig zhig gsos grub la smi brgya dang so drug grwa shag khang mig drug ste smi gru bzhi go drug dgon sa la smi gru bzhi sum brgya lhag dang / zhing sa la mu'u brgyad lhag dgon sa'i khyon la smi gru bzhi sum brgya tsam/ chos dad can chig stong nyis brgya lhag bcas yod/ da lan grwa ba skya ma ser can bzhi dang / dgon pa do dam pa lnga yod la skya ser gnyis las grub po/ /gtsug lag dgon/gtsug lag dgon nam khrang kyā zi yang na tshang cin zi zhes pa'i sde kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i rdzong(khrikhyazo)khongs lpe cin mkhar rnying du chags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi zon te(zostor+sā)srid lo bzhi ba(spyi lo1429)la gsar du bzhengs/ man chen chan lung srid lo lnga bar(spyi lo1540)bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ 1958lo la 'jig dgon shul der men hran thug phyugs ra ba'i spyi khang tshugs par gyur to/ /khri mi dgon/

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/khri mi dgon nam zhe kyā zi ni/ men ju rdzong(/rmiṣ+ṭha)chin hru'e zhing ko'u lis phu( tsho7khri༅༈spyi༅༅)zhes ba'i byang ri'i ngos su gnas dben pa la brten te chags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi yon tson krong thung srid lo gnyis pa(spyi lo1427)la bzhengs/ man ju thung ṭi'i skabs su dpa' bo mgo nag(rgya skad duṭha༅smra)ces pas sreg zar bstims/ ming go'i srid lo dang bor(spyi lo1912pa)bskyar bzhengs mdzad kyang 'jig go/khro kyan dgon/khro kyan dgon nam khro then zi zhes pa de mi ser gyis brlags par smra/ da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen men ju'i rdzong(khrikhrizo)khongs kyi bun tu'i zhang gi lu'u lu'u zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/ming rgyal rabs kyi yen tsung then hron srid lo brgyad par(spyi lo1464)gsar du bzhengs/ gong zhu srid lo bco lnga bar(spyi lo1889)bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ bcings 'grol skabs su grwa btsun nyi shu bzhugs pa las/ bcu bzhi log nga brgyad lor 'jig kyang / chos rgyal gyi rwa yin par grags pa'i rwa gcig da lta'ang bzhugs so/ /bkra shis sgar/bla ma dgon nam bkra shis sgar ni da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(/mi11)lpe cin zhang bla ma zhes pa'i sde grong du chags/ming rgyal rabs kyi khrin hwa'i skabs su gsar du bzhengs/ ming go srid lo drug pa(spyi lo1915)dang ming go srid lo so bdun pa(spyi lo1948)ste snga rting gnyis la zhig gso mdzad/ da lta co ne nas phebs 'ongs pa'i grwa ba gcig dang bcas skya ser 'dres ma re gnyis kyis chos spyod kyi rgyun tsam spel mus su lags so/ /sgar gsar/ sgar gsar dgon pa ni da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen gyi men rdzong lpe cin zhang dgu lung sde bar chags/ming rgyal rabs kyi khrin hwa'i skabs su gsar du bzhengs/ man chin gong zhu'i skabs su bskyar bzhengs mdzad/bcings dgrol skabs su'ang grwa ba ni med skad/ da ltar co ne nas grwa ba gcig phebs pa des rgyun tsam spel mus kyi skabs so/ /nyi er dgon/nyi er dgon gyi ming la snga mar kri tshi zi(tshoskyur+sha)yang zer/ de snga gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrimi21)bun tu zhang khongs kyi nyi er dgon zhes pa'i sde khrod kyi ri mgor chags/— 672 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/ming rgyal rabs kyi zhan tson khrin hwa srid lo sanyis pa ste spyi lo1466par gsar du bzhengs/ man chin kung zhu srid lo bco lnga ba(spyi lo1rnga89)la bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ bcings 'grol skabs su dgon nang du grwa btsun bzhi las ma yod/ sa zhing bcos sgyur skabs su grwa ba gsum skya sar log sde 'di nga brgyad lor 'jig pas shul tsam yang ma lus pas da ltar yang chos sgo ma phyes par lus so/ /drin gzo dgon/r+pā yin zi'am drin gzo dgon ni gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju mkhar grong(khrimozo/yi)gi lho phyogs su chags shing yongs grags su lho dgon yang zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni men ju'i mkhar grong gi lho ru chags pa'i cha nas de skad du thogs/ men ju'i mdzes ljongs rnam brgyad kyi gras te mkhar lho'i sgar rlung zhes kyang 'bod/sung rgyal rabs byang ma'i hrin tson yon h+phun gyi skabs(spyi lo1572yas mas)su thog mar bzhengs skad/man chin rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thung ṭi'i skabs(spyi lo1rnga62yas mas)su 'khrugs zing gi gzhan dbang du gyur/ ming go'i srid lo tshugs skabs su bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ lo re'i dus mchod sogs la smon lam lam mchod re gsungs pa'i phyag len yod/ ming go srid lo nyer lnga ba(spyi lo1926)chom gte lu'u ta khrang(rmyu〉sbra)gi dmag gis sreg za'i phung por bstims pas shul tsam yang ma lus par 'jis go/dpal tsha dgon/dpal khri dgon ni da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen men ju rdzong(khrikhuzo)zhi car 'ang dpal tsha sde khrod du chags/dgon pa'i mtshan yang grong sde'i ming gi sgo nas bsnyad/thog mar yon rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs par bshad la/ bar du ming rgyal rabs skabs su rgya bskyed de dge lugs su 'gyur bar grags/ ming go srid lo so drug par(spyi lo1947)dus 'khrug gis 'jig kyang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ da ltar shul med du lus so/ /yon nyin dgon/yon nyin dgon la dang thog sgar gsar du 'bod/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(tshemizo)mes khran zhang ta kru'u zhes pa'i sde ba'i rgyab ri'i sked du chags myangs/ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bzhengs skad bshad kyang / lo rgyus dngos ma chud/ chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling gi dgon lag tu gtogs shag man chin thung ṭis dbang bsgyur skabs tsam la dmag zing gi dbang du song / ming go'i srid lo nyi shu ba ste spyi lo1921pa la bskyar bzhengs mdzad kyang / phyis ma 'gyangs par nga brgyad lo'i dus zing gi chom pos brlags/ da ltar grwa ba chos 'don tsam yang mi 'dug pas/lo rgyus thog yod myangs pa'i ming tsam du zad do/ /— 673 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/tā kran dgon/tā kun dgon gyi mtshan gzhan la hor co zi'am bstan 'phel gling du 'bod/ de snga kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhyazo)me kun zhang ta lu'u pho zhes pa'i nye logs su chags/ming rgyal rabs spyi lo9744sngon la gsar du bzhengs/ chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling gi dgon lag tu bshad/ bcing dgrol skabs su grwa ba gsum las med/ de gsum yang log ste so nam gyi las gnyer/ nga brgyad lor 'jig sngar gyi sku gsung thugs rten gang yod mjal du dang rna lam du mi reg da lan sa der phyin yang rgyu mtshan shod shes mkhan gcig kyang ming 'dug go/thang gu dgon/thang dgon zhes pa ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhuzo)zhi cang zhang gi thab gya khwan zhes pa'i grong sde'i nub tu chags/ming rgyal rabs skabs su gsar du bzhengs skad las/ gong 'phel song min sogs gsal bo rang ma nges/ da lta shul tsam yang med do/ /hong h+phu dgon/hor h+phu dgon nam wa pu zi ni/ da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(/mibyu)phu tsi zhang wa pu sde ru chags/ming rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs par bshad/ nga brgyad lor 'jig mod/ 1989lor gong gi chog mchan ltar chos sgo phyes shing mchod 'bul byed sa tsam snang / da ltar lha khang rgyan gsum la smi gru bzhi zhe gnyis yod pa zhig bzhengs/ sgo chen la gyan gcig smi gru bzhi nyi shu tsam/ grwa shag gyan gsum smi so dgu/bsdoms pas dgon sar smi sum stong dgu brgya go drug longs/ chos dad mang tshogs nyis brgya lhag dang / grwa ba bzhi/ skya ser gnyis las grub pa'i do dam pa brgyad bskos so/ /lug ra dgon/lug ra dgon nam dbyang kya zi zhes pa ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrimizo)dgon lung zhang l+yang zhing cin the zhes pa'i ltag rgyab tu chags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bzhengs/ bcing dgrol rjes su grwa ba rnams thor/ grwa sar rtswa ldum gyis khengs so/ /kyin kyā dgon/kyin kyā dgon nam brag dgon pa ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i smin hran zhang hrang ya zi zhes pa'i — 674 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sde ba'i byang ri'i sked du chags/ ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bzhengs/ man chin thung ṭi'i skabs su 'khrug zing gi me klong du tshud/ phyis gong zhu srid lo brgyad par(spyi lo1882)bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung mod/bcing dgrol skabs su grwa ba bzhi yod/ da ltar gnyis las med/ dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa spyi nga brgyad lor chom pos khyer par gyur to/ /yon co dgon/yon co dgon ni da lta kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhu༅)tsha yul lung du chags/ ming rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs/ nga brgyad lor spyi gzhung gi 'bru mdzod byas pas lha khang tsam lus/ da ltar skya min ser min re 'gas mchod 'bul tsam zhu ba las chos spyod kyi cho ga sna mang mi 'dug go/hong ya dgon/hong ya dgon ni kun su'u zhing chen men ju rdzong(khrikhyazo)zhi cang zhang kun nyi sde ru chags/ming rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs/ man chin gong zhi srid lo bcu bdun par(spyi lo1rnga91)bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ da ltar shul tsam yang ma mchis so/ /bsam grub dgon/bsam grub dgon nam sngags ru dgon ni kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhrizo)zhi cang zhang sngags ru sde khrod du chags/ming rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs/ da ltar lha khang zhig lus/ nang rten rang mi 'dug grwa ba'am skya min ser min gyi chos lugs pa gnyis bzhugs shing / dus mchod sogs la skar 'dzin tsam gyi cho ga zhig yod de/ bla ma mchod pa dang smon lam sogs gsung bzhin bzhugs so/ /gling dgon pa/gling dgon pa'am khrung lung zi ni da lta kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhrizo)krung kre zhang gi ta wa zhes pa'i sde khrod du chags/man chin thung kri'i skabs su gsar bzhengs mdzad/ skabs der gtsug lag khang sogs bkod pa rgya che ste/ lha khang lnga yod pa la khang mig bco lnga/ grwa shag khang mig bcu/ sgo chen khang mig gsum phub/ rig gnas gsar brje skabs su bsnubs/ spyi lo1989lor slar gso byas pa ma zad/ rdzong srid gzhung gi 'brel yod las khungs kyis lha khang bskyar bzhengs kyi zhal 'debs sgor stong phrag gcig gnang bas thog drangs mang tshogs kyis phul pas zur brgyan te/ 'du khang khang mig gsum smi gru bzhi dgu bcu can zhig dang grwa shag — 675 —

tin zhi sa khul men ju rdzong gi khongs/khang mig gsum la smi gru bzhi nga drug longs pa zhig gsar du bzhengs/ dgon sa'i khyon la smi gru ba'i ma10 28zin/ sgo chen gcig smi gru bzhi nyer brgyad longs/ chos dad mang tshogs chig stong sum cu yod/grwa ba gnyis/ do dam pa skya ser gnyis kyis grub pa mi bdun yod do/ /bcings 'grol gong rol tu/ men ju rdzong khongs kyi dgon sde so so'i cha rkyen mi mtshungs kyang / gang yin pa rang babs dang mthun pa'i chos spyod phra rags sna tshogs yod/ de las chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling dang / bkra dgon/ chos rdzong dgon la grags pa che bas gzhan las khyad du 'phags/ 'dis men ju rdzong khongs kyi bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag 'chad skabs de gsum la lag zin dang mig mthong re yod stabs cung rgyas tsam bri thub byung / spyir chos lugs bcos bsgyur dang‘4rig gnas gsar brje 〉sogs g.yon thal gyi rlung nag gis chos spyod kyi bya ba re zhig bar du 'jig na'ang / krung gung thengs bcu gcig pa'i lhan 'dzoms gros 'tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun chos lugs srid jus rim gyis dngos 'bab byas pa la brten/ chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling (ta'i thung kyā'u zi) bkra shis dgon/ chos rdzong dgon/hong h+phu dgon/ khrung lung dgon te 'di lnga rdzong chos lugs las khungs kyis chog mchan bkod de slar gso byas zin/ dgon pa lnga bo gya bdun lo'i bar bsdoms pas bla grwa sum cu las med mod/ da lta de las 'phel yang brgya khar mi long / so so'ang chos dad rang mos dang rgyal gces chos gces kyi phyogs su tshul bzhin du 'gro mus kyi skabs so/ /yon an dgon/yon an dgon nam gtan bde gling gi mtshan gzhan la yang kyā zi ru 'bod/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrikhuṣ+ṭha) hri lis zhang bon po lung du chags/nam btab kyi lo tshigs rang mi gsal/ bar skabs shig la 'jig man ju gong zhu srid lo bcu gsum pa spyi lo1887lo la bskyar bzhengs mdzad pa ni gsal bar grags/ nga brgyad lor shul tsam yang ma lus par brlags so/ /chan khran zi/chan khran zi'am rje dgon zhes pa ni/ da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju'i(khrimizo)krung kre zhang gi chan khran sde ba'i nub rir chags/man chin gong mas srid dbang skyong kha mar tshugs/ gung zhu dang ming go srid lo gsum pa spyi lo1914 ste snga rting gnyis la bskyar bzhengs bgyis/ bcings 'grol rjes su grwa ba bzhi las med/ da ltar grwa ba gcig las mi bzhugs pa'i skabs su gyur to/ /— 676 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/yu'u lon dgon/yu'u lon dgon ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men rdzong chen hru'e zhang gi chen hru'e sde ba'i rgyab ri'i ngos la chags/ chos sde 'di man chin rgyal rabs tshugs kha mar chags skad/ bcings 'grol skabs su dgon nang du grwa ba gsum las med/ nga brgyad lor 'jig da lta shul tsam shes kyang grwa ba gcig kyang mi 'dug lo rgyus kyi yig cha mthong rgyu phar zad/ 'dri bas mas kyang ngag rgyun tsam yang dben pa'i gnas su song bas so /btsan po'i dgon/btsan po'i dgon nam dar len dgon ni/ de snga gan su'u 'ing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrimizo)hrin to zhang gi dar len grong tsho ru chags/dgon nam btab kyi lo tshigs sogs mi gsal/ sa de ga'i bgres song dag la'ang bshad rgyun mi snang /da ltar yang shul tsam las mi shes so/ /thu su men dgon pa/thu su men dgon pa ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong zha kre 'ang zho kre sde grong du chags mod/ nam btab kyi lo tshigs sogs mi nges/ dri gtug byas kyang sa bon tsam ma brnyed/ da ltar shul tsam las mi 'dug par gyur to/ /lbang lcags mchu'i dgon/lbang lcags mchu'i dgon ni/ gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong (khrimozo)lbang lcags mchu'i sde bar chags pas/ dgon ming yang de skad du grags/ ming rgyal rabs skabs su ba'engs/ da ltar 'jig pas shul tsam yang mi shes so/ /dge 'phel pad+ma'isde/dge 'phel pad+ma'i sde'am kung hran zi zhes pa ni/ gan su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(tshemizo)chin zhu'u zhang nyin pa sde khrod kyi byang rir chags/ nam btab kyi lo tshigs sogs mi nges/ da ltar 'jig pas shul tsam yang mi shes pa'i gnas su mchis so/ /r+pā ten dgon/po ten dgon nam r+pā ten dgon ni/ da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen gyi men ju rdzong(khrimizo)chen zhu'u zhang gi lor pā grong du chags/— 677 —
da lta yang chos spyod kyi bya ba ha cang nyag phra ba'i skabs su

lung nan sa khul bu dod rdzong gi khongs/deng sang rgo lung shur ram ru sde dang po de rdzong mkhar dang thag nye rkyen bod skad smra shes pa'i mi phal cher med la/ sngar dgon pa zhig yo da kyang da ltar slar gso byas med/ lhag lus su yod pa'i dgon pa gzhan dag gam yang na bskyar bzhengs byas yod pa dag gi phyi'i rnam pa'i cha nas bltas na/ la la ni bla brang phyogs kyi sde ba'i ma ṇi khang nang ba'in du chags mod/ don gyis dgon pa dngos kyi phyag len yin/ grwa rgan re gnyis bzhugs pa dag gi zhal 'a sa thos pas/ 'dir yang dgon sde'i dkar chag gi gras su brtsis te lag son dang rna thos tsam/ bris pa'o/ /mnyan pa dgon bkra shis phun tshogs gling /mnyan pa dgon nam bkra shis phun tshogs gling ni/ ma nyan pa sde khrod du chags pa'i cha nas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang mnyan pa dgon zhes yo ngas grags su khyab/thog mar btab pa'i dus ni co ne dgon chen gyi rjes tsam yin tshod du bshad la/ dgon mtha'i shug sdong re gnyis yod pa la dpags pas kyang skabs de tsam yin pa rtogs thub/ 'don pa phyag len thams cad co ne dgon chen ltar/ rang sde'i btsun pa re gnyis bla brang sogs nas phebs byung ba'i rdo ram sa pa dag gis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i las sna'i khur bzhes/ rten pa lha mo/ rten gtso shākya thub pa/ sngar gyi rten brten pa grwa shag dang bcas yongs rdzogs 1958lo dang rig gas ra skabs 'jig spyi lo198〈lo nas bzung ste srid jus bzang bo'i bka' drin las/ 'du khang ka ring nyi shu can zhig bzhengs/ 1kha94lo nas1kha96bar te lo ngo gsum ring la bla brang rdo rams pa a khu sbyin pa dgung 'o brgyad cu ba dang khong gi slob ma a khu zla ba dgung lo re dgu ba/ grong ba pad+ma sogs kyis sbyor 'jags phul te byams sku bzhengs pa sogs kyis sne drangs/ dad ldan ma/nga tshogs kyi dngos 'bu' la brten/ rten bzhengs 'du khang tshon rtsi gtong ba sogs lha bzo gcig bu'i gla phog la'ang dmangs sgor bdun khri'i 'gro gron btang / nga brgyad sngon la grwa ba lnga bcu lhag bzhugs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs rin po che las grub pa'i sku brnyan mi nyung tsam bzhugs / mchod cha tsi cha gcig ngo 'bog nyer bzhi/ lo rer 'cham lan gsum ste/ gcig pa'i smon lam/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod/ dgun nyin ldo ga la 'cham yod/ ba'i ba'i smyung gnas la tshogs nyi ma gsum/ smon 'a ma nang bla mchod/ kun rigabacu ba'i lnga mchod la bla mchod smon lam/ kun rig sman bla/ mgon chos bcas nyin gsum / bzhi ba'i bco lnga la byams pa gling bskor/ zla re'i dus bzang snyel zla rer nyin gsum ste/ tshes brgyad/ bco lnga/nyer dgu/ de'i 'don pa bla mchod/ nyer dgur gnas bcu 'don/ bsang mchod bya/ gnyis pa'i tshogs mchod la smon lam dang gso la 'debs so gas gsungs/ 'du khang gi gnam yol la bla brang gi ma dpe ltar kun rig gi dkyil 'khor sogs bzhengs 'dug sngon chad sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig yod la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi 'dra sku'ang bzhugs mod 'jig da ltar grwa ba sum cu so ba'i las mi 'dug der tshul khrims ldan — 680 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/pa grwa rgan gsum bzhugs/ grong tsho 'di la dud kha brgya lhag la mi grangs bdun brgya bzhi bcu lhag yod/ de dag tu bod rkyang las mi rigs gzhan pa ni med/ dgon pa bskyar bzhengs skabs su bu dod sa khul mi rigs chos lugs las khungs kyis snga rting du dmangs sgor dgu stong tham pa'i 'al 'debs kyang gnang ba sogs/bsdoms pas dmangs sgor sum 'bul gyi 'gro song btang zhes dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi las snes smra'o/ /gyod byed dgon/gyod byed dgon pa ni 'phen ya zhing grong gi gyod byed sde khrod du chags shing dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang de skad du thogs/ nam btab kyi lo tshigs mi gsal yang phal cher ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bzhag chog ces sde de'i grwa log 'ga'i ngag las thos/ bcing 'grol sngon du grwa ba bcu lhag yod skad/ 'du khang ngam lha khang gcig cog tu byas pa khang mig gsum can zhig yod myangs/ dus 'khor gyi phyag len spel/ bzhi ba'i smyung gnas dang / bcu ba'i lnga mchod/ gcig pa'i smon lam sogs yod/ 'don pa la kun rig dang bla mchod/mgon chos bcas so/ gcig dgu nga brgyad lo'i dus zing dang phyis kyi rig gnas gsar brje'i bar rkyen gyis rten dang brten pa gcig kyang ma lus par 'jig/spyi lo1994ba nas bzung / dad ldan mang tshogs rang bsam gyis sbyor 'jags kyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs te 'du khang ngam mchod khang khang mig gsum can zhig slar gso'i tshul du bzhengs/ log pa 'ga' bzhugs pa dag gis nya tshes bcu dang snga ma'i phyag srol rnams slar spel byed bzhin pa'i skabs red/ der bla brang phyogs kyi phyag srol bzhin grwa ba 'dul khrims dang ldan pa ni dkon pas/ chos lugs mi nyams pa'i ched du log pa 'ga' re bzhugs pa dag gis 'tsho ba sogs rang gi khyim la brten thog dgon pa'i bya ba'ang sgrub bzhin yod/ dgon 'di da dung slar gso byed chog gi mchan yig re zhig bar reg mi 'dug/klu sde dgon pa/klu sde dgon pa ni/ klu sde zhes pa'i grong tsho'i ming gis thogs pa yin/dgon mtha'i grong tsho 'di la dud kha brgya dang zhe drug mi grangs bdun brgya re lnga yod/ mi re'i lo re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor sum brgya yas mas/ mi rer sa 'ing mu'u do re mi 'dang tsam/ nags tshal mu'u bdun brgya longs tsam/ sde der grwa rgan dgung lo brgyad cu son pa 'ig bzhugs pa de snga sor blang brang dgon pa'i thos bsam gling du slob gnyer byas zer/ sngar gyi dgon pa de bzhengs nas phal cher lo sum brgya lhag 'das tshod la me 'jig gam yang na rkyen gzhan pa'i dbang gis ma lhag zer/ da lta'i 'du khang 'di grong dbus su spos te lo ngo drug cu tsam las ma song / de'i rgyu mtshan ni grong der lo brgyad cu can gyi bgres po zhig yod pa des 'du khang grong dbus su spo skabs kho bo lo nyi shu tsam ste/ spyi lo1925nas26bar yin tshod zer bas — 681 —

lung nan sa khul bu dod rdzong gi khongs/rtogs nus/ 'du khang thog so khang mig lnga can 'ig dus zing skabs ma 'jig par lus pa ni nga brgyad(sa khyi lo)lo nas bzung sde gzhung gi 'bru mdzod byas pa dge grogs su song rkyen 'dra/ lha rten mchod gsum mang du yod kyang dus zing gi rkyen dbang du gyur/ dgon 'di'i rten pa dam can chos rgyal/ 'don pa kun rig sngon mar 'cham chen lo gcig la lan gsum ste/ gcig pa'i smon lam dang / bzhi ba'i bco lnga/ dgun nyin ldo ga bcas dang / / mgon chos lnga/ bla mchod/ smon lam/ kun rig sogs 'don/ sku rten la/mgon chos lnga/ rje yab sras gsum/ kun rig gdugs dkar/ sgrol ma/ thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas 'bog sku bzhengs so/ /da dung gnas brtan bcu drug thugs rje chen po/ 'od dpag med/ tshe dpag med/ bla ma mchog gsum(rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gras) rje bla ma'i tshogs zhing sogs gyan thang du bzhengs par bshad/ gsung gi rten 'a / rje'i gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/yum bcu drug ting 'phags bskal gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ lam sngags gnyis sogs mang du bzhugs/byang chub mchod rten zhig yod myangs/ nga brgyad gong la grwa ba drug cu longs tsam bzhugs/ da ltar sum cu tsam bzhugs kyang / mang che ba btsun pa rang ma yin par khyim pa'i tshul du mchis/ sde grong der wang phyag rdor zhes pa de'i mes pos sngon chad rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas dung chen zhig khur 'ongs pa de dang tsi sogs zangs gser gyi rigs thams cad rno lcags btso sbyong chen po'i las 'gul du 'jig pas shin tu phangs pa'i gnas so/ /don mthun dgon/kho bo cag don mthun sde grong du song ste bgres po mtshan la tshul khrims zer ba'i dgung lo don dgu ba zhig dang mjal/ khong rang lo bcu bdun steng bla brang du song ste tshogs chen la zhugs/ zhar du chas pa rgya mkhar(da lta sku tshe 'di ba)tshang gi zhabs phyi byas/ spyi lo194khalor phyir pha yul du log zur chag gi skad 'di bshad de lo ngo bzhi bcu phyin zhes bshums pa dang mnyam du 'di skad/dgon pa 'di'i mtshan la khyim bcu'i dgon yang zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dgon 'di 'debs kha mar grong tsho 'di la dud khyim bcu las med pas de ltar grags/ man ju gong ma khang zhi dgung lo bzhi ba sa mo lug(1679)la btab/ 'debs pa bo sngon mar rgya nag glang chen 'gying rir phebs te dgon pa zhig bzheng rgyu khas blangs kyis phyir rang sar log pa dang thog mar btab ces grags pa las/ khong nyid kyi mtshan la ci zer mi shes/ dgon 'di'i rten pa lha mo/ grub mtha' dge lugs/ phyag len dus 'khor/ sa cha 'di'i dgon pa gang yin la kun rig bdag 'jug yod pa gcig mthun bzhin/ de'i khar mgon chos lnga/ smon lam bla mchod sogs/ rje bdag nyid chen po dang / kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gdung mchod/ gcig pa'i smon lam/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis sogs la chos thog sngon mar lha mo gser khri dgon gyi phyag len ltar yin la/— 682 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/kun mkhyen thar 'dod rgya mtsho tshang 'dir phyag phebs gnang ba nas bzung bla brang ltar bgyi'o/ /dge tshul slong gi 'dul khrims can re gnyis bzhugs pa ni bkra shis lhun po/ se 'bras gnyis/ bla brang sogs chos sde chen po dag las phyir phebs byung ba'i bka' drin gyis red/ dper na a khu skal bzang bde gshegs lta bu/ spyi lo1958lo'i gong du/ grwa ba sum cu lhag bzhugs/ der yang ya mtshan che ba zhig ni/ der lha mo'i sgrub phug ces pa'i khung zhig yod/ sngon bla brang sogs nas phebs pa'i khong rnam pa dag der mtshams bzhugs mdzad/ stag tshang nyal gyi brag phug der rdo pha bong zhig yod pa la zhabs rjes rang byon zhig yod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhabs rjes yin par grags/ gang ltar de ni bla brang gi ho'u gya ri khrod kyi dri ba dong sna ba lta bu zhig red/ deng sang de la shar phyogs sgrub phug(shar la phyogs pa'am bstan pa'i cha nas/ de skad du thogs shing / da ltar lta skor byed sa'i yul du brtsis yodamawa ༅)sngon khyim bcu'i dgon zer ba'i sde 'di'i dge slong zhig bsod snyoms kyi tshul du der bzhugs shing / phyis su der gshegs pa'ang dri ba dong sna ba nang bzhin/ gzim thul bkyon bzhin dmar gdung du bzhugs pa la/ yul mi mjal ba dag gis zhal gser sogs spras/ rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs su 'brug chu'i klong du bstims pas phangs pa'i gnas so/ /spyir sde 'dir sprul sku zhig blu rgyu'i dbang du btang na/ sde 'di 'debs pa bo'am glang chen 'gying rir phebs pa bo der blu dgos mod/ blus pa ni ma grags/ sde 'di'i cho ga phyag len ni dus 'khor ltar yin pas/rdo rje 'dzin pa dbu mdzad/ gnyer ba sogs las sne yod/ da ltar lhag lus su yod pa'i 'du khang de sde gzhung gi slob grwa byas/ grwa ba nyi shu tsam yod kyang gza' spen pa dang gza' nyi ma ste slob ma 'tshogs med nyin la dmigs te smon lam sogs 'tshogs/rten gyi skor la/ ston pa'i tshogs 'khor('bog sku)/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug('bog sku)/rgyal chen bzhi/ tshe dpag med/ thugs rje chen po sogs yod myangs/ de dag thams cad bla brang nas phebs pa'i lha bzos bskrun/ gsung gi rten la/ bskal 'phags ting gsum/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum sogs so/ /grwa ba'i 'tsho rten gtso bo ni rang rang so so'i khyim la brten pa las/ gshin dge sogs kyi 'bul ba ni de tsam mo/ /zhar byung du/ sngon chad sa cha 'dir bya de sogs kyi srog bcad de dmar bsang gtong srid/ phyis su co ne phyogs kyi bla ma zhig phebs pa nas bzung / gzhi bdag sogs la dmar bsang gtong ba'i srol ni bcad do/ /e shar dgon/e shar dgon ni/ e shar sde grong du yod pa'i cha nas de skad du thogs/ klu sde'i dgon dang 'dra bar — 683 —

lung nan sa khul bu dod rdzong gi khongs /ma zad rten dang brten pa mang du bzhugs kyang dus zing du 'jig da ltar lhag lus kyi 'du khang cig yod pa dang grwa ba sum cu tsam/ las/ med/ 'don pa phyag len thams cad gong mtshungs so/ /ka bo dgon/ka bo sde ba'i dgon pa yi na pa'i cha nas dgon ming 'a 'ang de ltar thogs/ sde de'i grwa ba bgres po shes rab ces pa'i dgung 'o re bzhir son pa zhig bzhugs pa de'i 'al snga las thos pa ltar bris pa ste/dgon pa 'di gsar 'debs mdzad pa nas da thug bar 'o ngo nyis brgya lha ga song / thog mar 'du khang khang mig lnga can 'ig bzhengs / phyis su rgya bskyed de nyis thog ka ring bcu gnyis can bzhengs/ rten pa lha mo / nga brgyad gong la grwa ba bzhi bcur longs / 'don rta dbyangs sogs lha mo gser khri ltar/ sku gsung thugs rten ni rig gnas gas ra brje skabs dang nga brgyad lo'i dus zing du 'jig kyang / 'du khang ma 'jig tsam du lus/ da ltar blus pa'i rten la / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan('cham chen du bkol)/ yum dum pa bcu gnyis/ gzungs 'dus / thar 'dod/ sa bcu/ bskal 'phags ting gsum/ nye sras brgyad/jo sku/ sha ris bu dang mos 'gal gyi bu/ sangs rgyas ma ra me ma dzad/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/sman sku/ byams sku bcas bzhugs/ 'du khang gral 'go'i khri ni kun mkhyen thar 'dod rgya mtsho tshang bzhugs pa nas bzung / bde thang tshang / hor tshang so gas skyes chen du ma phebs bzhugs mdzad/ sgos su hor gtsang (da ltar rnga ba khul du bzhugs )yu na ring bzhugs pa'i bka' drin gyis 'chad nyan sogs yar rgyas su 'phel/ sngar bca' yig cig yo da skad kyang da ltar mi snang / gang ltar dus 'khor gyi phyag len yin stabs/rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs las sne kha tshang yo da/ lo gcig gi chos thog la/ hor zla dang por smon lam nyin gsum/khyim tshang 'ga' res bsko' / bzhes pa ko re tsam las 'bul nor ni med/ de'i tshes bzhi la kun rigabaco lnga la gsang bdag bcu drug la mgon chos lnga/ de'i 'phror 'cham/ 'cham pa ba bcu gsum/gnyis pa'i tshogs ma chod nyi ma bdun la kun rig bdag 'jug bzhi ba'i smyung gnas/ —bdun pa'i bco lnga 'cham chen/ de'i zhar du mgon chos lnga gsung ba dang mnyam du bsang mchod rgyas pa bya/ 'cham rgyun yang lha mo gser khri ltar/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la kun rig bdag 'jug bcu ba'i lnga mchod nyin gsum ste/ nyi shu gsum la yar tshogs/ nyi shu bzhi la kun rig nyer lnga la rnam dag bsang / nyer drug la mgon chos lnga/'cham bcas te rdzogs/ dgon sa'i khyon la mu'u gsum tsam/ sngon chad zhing sa mu'u gsum nags tshal mu'u bcu gnyis yod/ 'du khang mdun khyams su ma ṇi 'khor lo yod/ khang mig rer ma ṇi gnyis re ste bcu gnyis bzhugs/ sgo chen nang gnyis su rgyal chen bzhi bzhengs so/ /spyi lo gcig dgu gya ba'i lor gong rim gyi chog mchan ltar/ chos sgo slar yang phyes shing / grwa ba'ang sum cur longs tsam bzhugs/ de las sngon chad bla brang du 'chad nyan mdzad myong ba'i rgan pa re gnyis ma — 681 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gtogs/ dge tshul slong gi sdom khrims bsrungs med/ chos thog re yod na ma gtogs dus rgyun du rang khyim du zhing las gnyer bzhin mchis so/ /ha ho pa dgon/sde 'di la sngon chad dgon pa zhig yod pa la 'du khang ngam mchod khang gyan gsum can/ de la sku gsung thugs rten dgon pa chung ba'i tshod kyis ha cang bzang la/ grwa rgyun yang nyi shu longs tsam bzhugs/ 'don chog la bla mchod dang mgon chos/ kun rig bdag 'jug sogs yod/ gcig pa'i smon lam dang ba'i ba'i smyung gnas/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs la chos thog lta bu re yod/ nga brgyad lo dang rig gsar te zang zing snga rting gnyis kyis rmeg med du bcom/ da ltar yang slar gso byed ma nus par re zhig lus so/ /rgya he mo dgon/rgya he mo dgon pa ni/ rgya he mo/ 'es pa'i sde grong du(da ltar ru sde ba'i ba zer) chags pa'i cha nas mtshan yang de ltar thogs/1958lor sku gsung thugs rten mang du 'jig kyang / lha khang ngam 'du khang rnying ba ka ring bcu gnyis can zhig yod pa rig gsar skabs slob grwa byed pa'i bka' drin gyis ma 'jig par mjal du snang / snga mar grwa ba sum cu lhag grwa shag bdun brgyad tsam yod/ kun rig gi bdag 'jug yod la/ 'don rta dbyangs sogs phyag len thams cad bla brang ltar/ de ga'i grwa ba bla brang sogs grwa sa che khag gam tshul ldan las slob gnyer mdzad de phyir phebs pa re gnyis ma gtogs/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa yod med la bltos pa rang med/'don chog shes pa tsam yin phyin chos thog skabs su grwa chas bkyon te tshogs su zhugs chog pa'i srol yod/dgon pa'i do dam gyi sgrig bkod cha tshang ba yod de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dbu mdzad/ dge bskos/ gnyer ba/ dkor gnyer sogs las sne rnams lo ltar res mos su bsko/ da ltar yang snga ma'i phyag srol ma nyam sa tsam du slar gso byas yod/ dpal ldan lha mo srung mar bkur/ 'don pa la kun rig mgon chos/ bla ma mchod pa sogs/ gcig pa'i smon lam nyi ma lnga drug la 'tshogs/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod skabs chos thog yod/ chos thog skabs kyi tshogs bskol ni khyim tshang bzhi'am lnga res nyin rer res mos kyis bskol/ khyim tshang 'byor ba can re gnyis kyis bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs khas len gyis 'dzin/ dus de ma gtogs grwab phal cher khyim pa yin pas 'tsho ba rang khyim la brten/ grong nang du mi shi sogs rkyen ngan byung tshe/ grwa tshang gang bo gshin po tshang gis gdan 'dren zhu ba las/ 'du khang du mi 'tshogs/ rten gsar bzhengs la/ rje yab sras gsum/ gdugs dkar/ jo sku/ byams pa/ gzhan shog thang 'ga' re dang /rje'i gsung 'bum sogs gsung rten yang mi nyung ba snang / dgon pa de nam btab kyi lo tshigs gsal bo rang — 685 —

lung nan sa khul bu dod rdzong gi khongs/ma nges kyang / sgo 'gram gyi shug sdong chen po de la dpags pas nyung mtha' lo sum brgya tsam 'das yod pa rtogs thub/ a lags bde thang tshang dang / yongs 'dzin tshang / hor gtsang sku tshe da lta ba bcas snga rting du sde 'dir zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ da ltar srid jus bzang po'i bka' drin las chos spyod kyi bgyi ba thams cad yar ldan du 'gro mus su yod do/ /sbyi dgon dpal ldan bkra shis gling /spyi dgon zhes pa rgya he mo sde ba/ don mthun sde ba/ ka bo sde ba/ mnyan pa'i sde ba/ klu sde/ yas shar sde ba ste ru sde drug gi spyi gzhung du bzhengs pa'i cha nas de skad du thogs/ dgon pa de bcings 'grol sngon te spyi lo1946la mnyan pa sde ba'i ri rtser bzhengs/ 'du khang ngam lha khang gcig lcogs su nyis thog gi tshul du khang mig lnga yod/ de'i sbyin bdag ni gong zhus kyi ru sde drug po de yin yang / dus yun thung ba'i dbang gis grwa rgyun dang sku gsung thugs rten rang 'jog glags bral/ a lags hor gtsang gis dgon bdag mdzad/1958lor 'jig hor gtsang sngon mar zi khron rnga khul srid gros su bya ba byas myangs/ da ltar rgan gso reg ste rang shag tu bzhugs skad do/ /

lung nan sa khul than khrang rdzong gi khongs/tshang bdun brgya go drug yod la/ mi grangs bzhi stong tsam yod/ da lta shul tsam bstan du yod pa'am bsnyad du yod pa'i dgon pa la/lis khran dgond ༅)//r+sha nyen yon g.yag mgo dgond ཿtsho༅༅r+sha ya bu gser sgo sgard a3phopokhrar+sha stu phebs dgon—cizor+sha 'i ba'i dgon yo1shrīr+sha to ca sde'i lung dmar dgon—/yozo༅phre1hākhrir+sha gshed ma lung che ba'i dgon—ngañcaloṣ+ṭhasno ma ce thang dgon lotshokhrikhrir+sha dpal legs lung 'gyed dgon—157lhamor+sha thung ban dgon ༅༅'a༅r+sha spos ri dgon—r+sālar+sha(chor+sha)byams chen dgon ོsbrama.oṃr+sha bye ma lung bde chen dgon—༅/ chotsho.or+sha ko chan dgon/ —lozor+sha(tsho༅r+sha)gad ngo'i lung rigs dgon—dzitsho༅1ngar+sha sogs yod do/ /dgon pa 'di dag thams cad las mang shos shig da ltar bltas na rgya'i sa char chags mod/ gna' snga mor sa cha 'di dag bod kyis bzung ba'i stabs kyis skabs der chags pa rgya'i bgres po dag gi ngag las thos thub pa ma zad/ dgon pa de dag gi sku gsung thugs rten thams cad bod kyi sgyu rtsal dang / 'don chog phyag len sogs bod ltar yin pa dper na/ rgya'i sa cha dgon pa pe cin gyi bde ldan byin chags gling dang / men ju'i khongs gtogs kyi chos sde dgon lhun grub bde chen gling / bkra shis dgon/ chos rdzong sgar lta bu sogs so/ /lo rgyus 'gyur ldo ga gi dbang gis sa cha de ga'i bod phal cher rgyar 'gyur ba dang nyung shas shig sa gzhan du spar pas/ chos dad mang tshogs phal cher rgya rigs su zad/ bcings 'grol rjes su/ gong gsal dgon sde 'di dag snga rting du 'jig na'ang / han yon g.yag mgo dgon(rtsi'itsho༅lharadza1)dang / bye ma lung bde chen dgon(༅/ /lhotsho ar+sha)gnyis ga'i phyi'i brten pa tsam la chag 'jig de 'dra rang ma phog lung rigs dgon ni nye lam bzhengs pa yin no/ /lo rgyus shes tshod dag gsham du spro bar bya'o/ /lung rigs dgon pa/lung rigs dgon ni/ da lta'i than khrang rdzong gad ngogs bod rigs zhing grong gi khongs su chags/thog mar ming rgyal rabs skabs su lung rigs stod de da lta'i dgon sa'i mdun ri'i sked du bzhengs shing mtshan la smon lam dgon du grags/ der ma 'gyangs par lung rigs sde khrod du spar/ dgon ming yang sde ming gi rjes 'brang du 'bod/ spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya nga brgyad gong rol tu btsun pa nyi shu tsam yod myongs/sa zhing mu'u bcu lhag 'debs/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su 'jig 1981lor chos sgo bskyar phye mdzad/ dgon sa'i khyon la smi lham po brgyad dang bdun cu tsam las med/ lha khang khang mig gcig smi lham po nyer bzhi brgya dang bdun cu tsam las med/ lha khang khang mig gcig smis lham po nyer bzhi tsam zhig de la sgo chen gcig sgo'i g.yas logs su rung khang khang mig gsum/ g.yon logs su grwa shag gnyis la bsdoms pas smis lham po drug cu longs tsam las med/ chos lugs do dam u yon mi lnga las grub/ de'i gas su — 688 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/btsun pa'i cha lugs tsam snang ba gcig 'tsho bzhugs snang / gzhan tshang ma sde ba'i mgo ba ste grong ba skya bo dag yin/ rten pa gang yin sogs dris lan mi 'dug chos spyod kyi bya ba la/ zla re'i tshes gcig nya gang la smon lam bla mchod re gsungs/ grong mi dag ma bskul rang 'dus kyis mchod 'bul tsam byed/ dgu ba'i bcu bzhi bco lnga la chos spyod kyi bya ba rgyas tsam spel/ klog 'don la nye logs 'brug chu nas grwa ba gnyis gdan drangs/ da lta'i do dam pa ni/ ma'o cin pa'o/lo62slob chung gi yon tshad/ ma'o sgom te/lo 62dbyang blo bzang / lo55 to phe zhin/ lo4〈blo bzang 'bum te/ lo70bcas/ dpal 'byor phyogs su chos dad mang tshogs kyis zhal 'debs dang dkar thigs la brten pa'i khar rdzong chos lugs las khungs kyis dmangs sgor chig khri gnang ba sogs la brten nas da lta'i sgo chen gsar bzhengs mdzad/ lha sde'am chos sde la zhing grong de'i khongs gtogs kyi bod kyi grong sde drug yod de/ bsdoms pas mi grangs chig stong nyis brgya lhag da ltar lha khang du gnas brtan bcu drug gi ldebs ris/ jo sku dang rje sku li ma chung ngu re bzhugs so/ /

then hrus sa khul chin khris chus kyi khongs/༄7/ / then hrus sa khul/chin khris chus kyi khongs/pin lin dgon pa/bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sar pin lin dgon pa('bum gling)zhes pa ni/ kun su'u then hrus chen khrin chus(nga7tshezolo༅nas gnas su chags pa'i dgon pa zhigasnga sor dgon pa zhig yod myong ba'i gnas shul du/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyugs dpa' bzang bo mchog dang / 'jam mgon bse blo bzang dpal lda na chos kyi rdo rje rnam gnyis kyi rgya btsun slob ma 'ga' yis bla ma dag gi bka' gsung bzhin/ 'jam dbyangs stong sku bzhugs pa'i lha khang dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang / tshe lha rnam gsum gyi lha khang bcas rten dang brten pa mang bo bzhengs/da dung byams pa lo nyal/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan 'gyur/ tsong kha yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum sogs bzhugs/sa yos1999lor kun su'u nang bstan slob gling gi dge rgan chen mo klu chu'i thub bstan gtsos pa'i dge slong bzhi ldan gdan drangs phyag phebs nas ri bo dge ldan pa'i phyag len bzhin rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par mdzad pa dang / rgya rigs btsun pa rnams kyis bod brgyud nang bstan ji bzhin spel bzhin yod do/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/༄/ / co'u chon sa khul/su'u pe (su'u byang)sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/gser thang dgon pa/gser thang dgon pa(sog skad du ser thin zhes pa'i sgra thonathulaḥr+sha)) zhes pa'i dgon pa 'di nyid ni kun su'u zhing chen gyi su'u pe zhes pa'i rdzong du mchis/dang thog dgon pa 'di su'u pe sa cha'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi dgon pa dang bo yin zhes grags/tshugs nas lo mang du ma song ba dang dge lugs pa'i 'phelargyas kyis dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mjug tu a khu mkhan po(spro'o.oṃ)zhes pa'i sde dpon gyis dgon 'di nas spyi le nyi shu tsam gyi sa mtshams su yang dgon pa zhig btab/ de nas ser thin nam gser thang dgon rnying la ser thim byang dgon dang gsar du bzhengs pa la ser thin lho dgon zhes 'bod/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags phag(spyi lo1rnga51) gi lo nas rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags bya lo'i (spyi lo1861) bar mtshams su he dmag gis rtsa med du bsnubs/ de rjes ching rgyal rabs kong zhu'i skabs su ser thin lho dgon gsar 'debs byas/ 1940lo'i dpyid kur go min tang gi dmag shed can mā pu h+phang gis dgon pa 'di yang mer bsregs te med par btang ngo / /1951lor chos dad mang tshogs kyis lha khang zhig bzhengs/ de nas sa khyi lor rgya bskyed kyang mchong skyod chen mo dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin 'thab rtsod byas pa'i dus su dgon pa de shul med du brlags/198〈lor zhing chen chos lugs cus kyis sgor chig 'bum nyis khri lnga stong gnang ba dang de'i khar zhang gis sgor khri lnga byin/ de nas dad ldan mang tshogs kyis sgor stong phrag bzhi zhal 'debs byas nas1987lor rdzong shar nub mtshams kyi spyi le gcig tsam gyi tang khrin lung bar dgon pa 'di slar gsos/ 'debs gnas spar pas da lta tang khrin lung ba'i dgon pa(7lo༈ stor+sha) zhes gsar du ming thogs/ 'du khang chen por shākya thub pa'i sman 'jim 'dra sku dang g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs/ rje rin po che'i sman 'jim 'dra sku bzhengs nas rten du bzhugs so/ /dgon pa 'di'i nang dgon gsar ma gzhan dang mi mthun pa ni btsun pa rnams kyis khyim thab brten chog par snang / smon lam chen mo'am tshogs chen gyi skabs su grwa chas bkyon nas dge 'dun pa'i tshul 'chang ba las/ dus gzhan par skya mi rnams dang mtshungs so/ /— 691 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/༄7/ / krang dbye sa khul/su'u nan (su'u sbo) yu gur rigs rang spyong rdzong gi khongs/ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling /ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes pa(brashāskor+sha)ni/ da lta'i krang dbye sa khul gyi su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong gi khongs su chags/ krang dbye grong khyer bar spyi le re lnga yod/dga' ldan dam chos gling ni rnam rgyal mari phug pa dang / 'od zer can ma'i phug pa/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi phug pa gong 'og bar gsum/ gser bzhengs mchod rten phug pa/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i phug pa bcas brag phug brkos ma bdun las grub pa dang bye brag phug pa bdun cu lhag yod/ rgyal khab rim pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob sde khag red/khyung tsha dge bshes rab brtan zhes pas de snga'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgya bskyed de lhag tu je rgyas su btab cing bod rigs btsun pa lnga brgya lhag 'dus par grags/ phug pa kun las gser bzhengs mchod rten dang sangs rgyas stong sku'i ldeb ris bzhengs pa zhib tshegs che zhing sku nyams gson por mngon byung / de las lhag tu ngo mtshar ltad mo'am mjal phyag bya yul lha gnas sum cu so gsum zhes pa las grub pa'i bod dar nang bstan lha khang ngam phug pa che shos kyi bzhengs sku thams cad brkos ma yin pa dang / rang byung mchod rten mang bos dad ldan pa'i mig la mchu ma bsnyil pa dang dad med pa'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog par 'gyur/ da dung phyi'i yul ljongs las pad ri'i lha rtse zhes pa dang / 'brug nyal ltag 'gyed/ gling rta'i rmig rjes/ gsom gsang rbab chu zhes pa la sogs pa'i ljongs rgyu ba'i ltad mo tshar du dngar ba yod/ bod dar nang bstan lha khang zhes pa'i phug pa de zab la smi so gsum phyed dang zheng la smi nyer drug phyed tsam mchis te sgo khyams dang / mchod gnas/bzhugs klog nang gral phyi gral bcas tshan pa du mas grub pa/ kun dga' ra ba chen po zhe drug gi nang du yon rgyal rabs su sa skya'i bdag chen dam pa rnams dang bcas kyis bzhengs pa'i rdo sku mi tshad can sha stag bzhugs su gsol/ ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ni krung go'i lo rgyus su gzhan zhig mthong thos su gyur ma myong / phug pa 'dir lha'i dngos grub tu bstsal pa'i chu mig cig byon par dbyar dus brug rgyu dang dgun khar skem rgyu med cing yan lag brgyad ldan gyi ngo bos mi rnams ched dmigs gsol chu len par 'ongs/ phug pa brgyad pa'i shar byang gi brag zur du rta mchog chen po'i mig rjes gsal lhang lhang zhig dngos su rang byung du mchis pa la/— 692 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/la la na re rgya nag gi zhi han gong mi'i lha rta'i rjes red dang / la la na re bod kyi gling ge ser rgyal pos hor gling g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi rta mchog rkyang rgod yer ba'i rmig rjes su ngos 'dzin byed/ gang ltar rmig shul 'di las rgya skad du rta rmig dgon zhes btags/ da dung phug pa'i nang du gnas brtan bco brgyad(rgya lugs)dang rgyal chen rigs bzhi lhang nger lham mer bzhugs/ thu'u bkun hu thog thu rin po ches thad kur bdag skyong mdzad/dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes pa'i dgon rnying 'di'i dang thog gi phug pa ni ha lam rgya nag rgyal rabs las cin(dzo)shar ma'i dus nas mgo tshugs par gleng / de nas krung hwa mi ser rgyal rabs bar lo ngo chig stong sum brgya ring brgyud cing chags 'jig dar rgud yang yang thebs/ yon rgyal rabs sam de las snga mo'i dus nas bzung bod rgya zung dang bod shugs de bas che ba'i ngang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che mu mthud srung skyob dang bskyar du bzhengs/ rgya bskyed pa'i 'phel rim las/ phug pa'i brkos sku gson nyams ldan pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lha tshogs/ ma kha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku 'khor bcas gsar btod che zhing brjid du chags pas kun su'u'i phug rnying legs gras su gyur pa dang / ming rgyal khri lo bcu bzhi ba1416lor rgya nag gong ma kru'o lin gyis dgon mtshan gnang ba dang chan lung lha skyong rgyal bos rta sga dang lwa ba 'brug ris ma bcas bstsal pa da lta'ang tshags su gnyer yod/ 1958lo'i snga rol dgon du bod rigs dang rgya rigs/ sog rigs/ yu gur rigs kyi dge 'dun pa sum cu lhag 'dus nas lo hril bo'i nang bstan gyi dus chen dag tu chos spyod gzab rgyas spel ba dang / sa zhing nags tshal sgo phyugs sogs mi nyung ba yod pa a khyung mkhan pos gnyer/ deng dus su yul srol bstun pa'i khrom tshogs rgya cher 'tshogs te dam chos slob zhor dpal 'byor gnyer zhor bgyis la/ rig rdzas srung skyob byed pa'i gnas mchog yin gshis rgyal khab phyi nang gi ljongs rgyu ba stong phrag du ma chas te bod rgya'i rig gnas lo rgyus la 'ib 'jug dang phyag mchod/ lta skor byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon dga' ldan tshogs gsog gling /mdung nab 'jam dbyangs dgon dga' ldan tshogs gsog gling(dus rgyun 'jam dbyangs dgon zhes 'bod)ni sngon chad shu'u gru we la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/ mtsho tshad mi2 2〈0yas mas/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul lung ser dgon dang rgyang thag spyi le brgya go dgu longs/mdung nag 'jam dbyangs brag phug 'di dus rabs bzhi bar brko mgo brtsams te da lta'i bar du brag khung lo chig stong lnga brgya lhag 'das/ de yang rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug(spyi lo12 44)lor hor rgyal go dan gyis gdan drangs pa ba'in sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'khor bcas lang jur byon cing / rgyal bo — 693 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/mdung nag kha gsum sde drug gi gnas su lha khang gsar ba bzhengs nas rten du dus gsum sangs rgyas gnas rgya chen po mdzad mthar dgon chung zhig tu gyur/ de nas bod brgyud nang ba sa skya'i grub mtha' mdung nag sa cha dar/ rab byung lnga ba'i me stag(spyi lo1226)lor hor tsha he tha'i rgyal bu nan ta hris zhig gsos byas/mtshams shig ka ju'i zi kyā dge slong dpal ldan bsod nams zhes pa zhig gis gnas 'dzin byas/ rab byung bcu ba'i chu lug spyi lo15rnga2lor rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog(1542—1588)mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon par phebs shing sku nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs seng chibs 'ja' tshon gyi gur bzhengs byon pa gzigs pa la/ zhabs phyi tshos mi dkar khyi dkar khrid pa mthong / gnas 'dir zla ba gsum bzhugs/ brag phug gsar du brkos pa'i nang du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhengs te sngar gyi 'jam dbyangs rang byon nang bzhugs su phub/ rgyal dbang rang gi phyag phreng / sa paṇa gyi dbu rgyan sogs rten du bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcas bzhengs shing rje nyid dang dge slong sum brgyas rab gnas mdzad/ rab byung bcu ba'i shing yos spyi lo1615lor shu'u gru mkhar gyi rgya dpon jo bo tā ya gzugs 'das rig pa ba nang bstan la dad pas mjal du 'ongs tshe thugs mnyes shing gus pa 'phel/ dge bskul du lha khang bzhengs ste smon lam btab/ kong zhi'i dus kyi zi kyā dge slong sbyin pa rgya mtshos slar yang zhig gsos bgyis/ de skabs ra ljags e khe nang so dang a myes dge slong gi(/lhoza༅lta)gzhis kyis 'jam dbyangs kyi mdun ngos su lha khang che ba zhig logs su phub cing der byams pa bzhengs bsams kyang / stong skor mdo rgyud rgya mtshos rab gnas mdzad skabs lha khang 'dis 'du khang yong 'dug gsungs/ de nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag spyi lo1674lor 'gu chos rje mchog gis 'jam dbyangs dgon che ba phyag 'debs gnang / rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtshos dga' ldan tshogs gsog gling zhes gsol/ bka' shog phyag tham dang bcas pa bstsal/rgyal sras rin po ches bca' yig gnang / dpon 'bangs dad ldan so sos dbyar gnas dang chos thog gtong mkhan pa byung ba'i thog se chen chos rjes bshad grwa btsugs/ de nas 'gu chos rje'i tsha bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis hal ha phyogs su 'bul bsdud phebs nas slar 'jam dbyangs lha khang gsum thog bzhengs/ chin rgyal rabs gong ma chan lung gi skabs su dgon der ban ser mo ba sum brgya lhag bzhugs/ thu'u bkwan rin po che sku phreng rim byon dgon 'dir phebs te khri mdzad pas dgon lung byams pa gling gi bu dgon du cir zhing /dgon lag tu chos 'khor dang smos pa/ dgon zhol ma rtsa'i g.yang dgon bcas mchis/ lcang skya rin po che dang thu'u bkun rin po che rnam pa zung gis dngul srang chig khri lnga stong btang nas tshogs chen 'du khang bzhengs/dgon pas chos skyong mgon chos lha rnam gsum bsten/ yang yig tshangs kha shas su 'jam dbyangs dgon pa ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su lha khang brgya dang brgyad/ bla sprul bcu gsum/ grwa grangs lnga brgya lhag 'dzoms par bshad/ chin rgyal rabs kyi mjug tsam la jag pas 'jam dbyangs dgon par btsan 'phrog bsreg bcom byas nas lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten sogs bsnubs par gyur/ slar yang rab byung bcu drug pa'i me bya — 694 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/spyi lo1926lor 'gu kya mkhan po sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog gi nyams gso rgya chen bgyis te rten dang brten pa thams cad snga ma bzhin bzhengs grub/ 'on kyang rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor rtsa gtor btang / 'jig skabs der dgon pa'i yar ngos su rgya'i nang bstan chos sde la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang / byams khang / sa'i snying po'i lha khang / rgyal ba rigs lnga lha khang / jo khang /sgrol ma lha khang dang brag phug mang bo bcas btab pa'i nang rten rgya cher bzhengs la sangs rgyas stong sku dang bcas pa grangs las 'das so/ /dgon par bla sprul gsum bzhugs te/ 'gu kya mkhan po dang / ko mkhan po/ hor mkhan po bcas lags/ bla ma re rer sgar ba(nang chen)tshugs shing / khong rnam pa gsum gyis 'jam dbyangs dgon dang /dgon lag rnams/ mdung nag kha gsum so drug gi lha sde mchod gzhis kun la chos srid zung du bdag skyong mdzad pas chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs gna' snga mo nas btsugs shing cha tshang ba zhig go/bla sprul sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus gleng na/ 'gu kya mkhan po sku phreng dang po chos rje rgyal mtshan/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo1484lor 'gu zhes pa'i bod kyi tsho ba zhig tu 'khrungs/dpa' ris nags yangs dge 'phel gling nas rab tu byung / dgung lo dgu ba gdan sar phebs shing bcu gnyis pa la khrir bzhugs/ bco lnga ba la dgongs gnang zhus te bod du phebs par dgongs kyang dwags po zhabs drung gi lung bstan ltar yun ring du slob gnyer dang mtshan btags mdzad/ rjes sor mdung nag gi 'jam dbyangs kyi ri lung zhig tu sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa dkar 'jam grags pa rgya mtsho ni mdung nag tsho drug gi sa char rab byung bcu ba'i sa stag spyi lo1578lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco lnga bar mchog nyid dbus gtsang du phebs nas slob gnyer mdzad/ dga' ldan dgon nas mthar phyin cing phyir log nas chu log dgon pa'i khri mdzad/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprel lor mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon pa nas mu mthud du slob gnyer mdzad cing dgung lo don dgu 'tsho bzhugs bzhes/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing lug spyi lo1655lor sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang dar rgyas ni mdung nag tsho drug gi sa char rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags byi spyi lo1660lor bsam bzhin mdzes sku mngon par bltams/ sku na phra skabs sku 'bum byams pa gling du slob gnyer mdzad/ phyir log nas gsar du pad ma sgar zhes pa btab/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1718lor sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas ni mdung nag g.yas ru'i char rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo172 2lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nga brgyad bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi lor sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho ni bhan da hor gyi yul gnas gyur nag khyim tshang zhig tu rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa lug spyi lo1799lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco lnga bar mchog nyid sku 'bum du klog 'don chos gang mkho thugs 'dzin gnang / phyis bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer mdzad/ dbus gtsang du — 695 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/phebs te chos sde chen po rnam pa bzhir mjal skor de'i bar du rgyal dbang dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyis phyag dbang zhus/ de nas gsung gi rten mang bo 'jam dbyangs dgon par drangs shing dgon de'i khri bzhugs nas lha ldan phyag len ltar smon lam chen mo btsugs/ sog yul gor kha ru bzhi dang or to si mtho sgang rnams la gzigs skor mdzang mthar dgung lo nga dgu bzhes pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa rta spyi lo1858lor sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /sku phreng drug pa 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin nyi ma ni mdung nag kha gsum sde drug gi ya gyal g.yas ru'i khyung tsha nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags rta spyi lo1rnga70lor sku 'khrungs/ skabs shig la bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te kun mkhyen mchog dge rgan du bsten nas bka' chos mang bo gsan sbyang mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu'i thog dgon 'di'i khrir 'khod pa ma thag tu lcags stag lor sku 'das so/ /sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang 'phrin la sa rgya mtsho ni mdo la ring mo'i chu lung gur nag gi sa'i char yab bsod nams phun tshogs dang yum stong skor skyid kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu 'brug spyi lo1892lor sku bltams/ dgung lo bzhi'i thog sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de gdan sar bkod/ dgung lo dgu bar rta rmig dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling dang dgung lo bcu bdun par dgon lung byams pa gling du byon nas slob gnyer mdzad/ thu'u bkwan rin po ches rtsis gtsigs dgongs dgyes gnang ste mthar chu lung dgon pa dang pad ma chos grwa lnga'i khri tshab mngags nas khrir bzhugs mkhan po zhes su grags/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing glang spyi lo192 5lor mkhan po mchog nyid kyis mdo la ring mo shar nas nub bar 'bul bsdud bzhes te 'jam dbyangs lha khang rgya skyed mdzad/ me stag lor dgon 'di'i 'gug kya mkhan po sgar bsam gtan gling gsar du btsugs/ 'jam dbyangs dgon pa'i rgya mtsho gling dang dpe mdzod khang gsar du bzhengs te rab gnas mdzad/ khong sku bzhugs skabs su gdung nag phyogs su slob grwa mang bo btsugs te bod kyi rig gnas slob gso dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ dgung lo zhe drug bzhes/ rab rgyal chu lug spyi lo1942lor 'das so/ /sku phreng brgyad pa lung dar rgya mtsho ni chu lung dgon pa'i nye 'dabs gur nag tsho ba zhig la sku 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing lug spyi lo1kha55lor rab tu byung zhing lo gsum bzhugs/ sa khyi lor dus dbang gis grong du phebs/ da lta 'brog las mdzad bzhin 'dug pa dang su'u nan rdzong srid gros kyi u yon du bdams so/ /ko gyu mkhan po sku phreng dang po chos rje ngag dbang rab brtan ni dgon lung byams pa gling gi lcang skya ho thog thu'i zhabs phyir byon te lcang skya'i thugs dgyes pa'i slob bu zhig yin te dgon lung du slob gnyer mdzad/phyis su mthil phyin pa dang sbugs gling bsre thob cing / lcang skya dang mnyam du dbus gtsang du lan gnyis phebs/ phyir log ste mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon pa'i khrir phebs te dbang rjes gnang sogs mang bo gnang / 'jam dbyangs kyi mdun du bzhugs nas thos bsam sgom pa mdzad/ chu yos dus 'khrug gi mjug tu dgon lung ri khrod du bzhugs te chos bka' rgya chen po gnang ngo / /sku phreng gnyis pa ko gyu zhabs drung ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtsho ni thu'u bkwan rin po che'i dngos slob thugs shin tu nye/— 696 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gsum pa sgom zhib dge 'dun bzang bo/ bzhi ba mchog grub rgyal mtshan/ lnga ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin bcas so/ /hor mkhan po blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar mi gsal/ 'di ba dgung lo bzhi'i steng dgon 'dir bzhugs / de nas chos 'khor gling du phebs te mā blo bzang dge rgan du bsten te bod yig slob/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi spyi lo1946lor dgon lung du bstan gzhung gsan/ sa byi194〈lor 'jam dbyangs dgon par phyir phebs te dgon 'di'i las sne mdzad/ bcings 'grol rjes su gsar brje'i bya bar bzhugs shing chu 'brug lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor slob sbyong byas pa dang shing rta lor mthar phyin rjes gan su'u zhing chen mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang dang co'u chon sa khul mi rigs las don u yon lha khang du phyag las gnang / me sprel lor krang dbye sa khul gyi mi rigs u yon lhan khang du ched las u yon gyi 'gan 'khur bzhes/ shing 'brug spyi lo1964lor sku 'das so/ /dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur sngon la 'jam dbyangs dgon pa de'i lha sde dang mchod gzhis ni mdung nag gis gnang the'u le nas bzung mdung nag kha gsum sde drug phur tsha dpon po/ khyung tsha dpon po/ mā tsha dpon po/ gling dpon po sogs kyi mnga' 'bangs tsho ba drug dang g.yas ru dang / sa dmar lung / ma ṇi chos 'khor lung / khwa ta chu lung / sngon lung shar khug dang nub khug brag lung / thang dkar ma sogs mchis so /dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ rten gtso 'jam dbyangs rang byon yin la/ gna' dus dgon 'dir gser zangs las grub pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku dang / thub dbang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ sgrol dkar ljang / rigs gsum mgon po/ rje yab sras rnam gsum/ rgyal ba yab sras sogs grangs las 'das/ rje yab sras rnam gsum gyi gsung 'bum sku 'bum par ma tshar gsum/ la sogs bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la dus 'khor dang / sgo mang / byang chub sogs mchod rten bzhengs/ da skabs de dag gsar du ba'engs pa'i sku rten ni mgon khang du spyan ras gzigs dang / btsan khang nang du chos skyong srung ma chos rgyal rnam sras dang / 'gu kyā mkhan po dang hor po sku 'phreng rim byon gyi sku gdung mchod rten bcas bzhugs so/ /srid na rnyed par dka' ba'i 'jam dbyangs rang byon gyi sku/ gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ kun mkhyen kyis gnang ba'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs li ma/ gnas rten bcu drugarigs gsum mgon po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rje yab sras gsum/ 'jim sku shākya thub pa / sgrol dkar/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa chen rin po che sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rten khyad par can mang bo bzhugs/gsung rab kyi skor la lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur dngul bris ma tshar gcig re/ sku 'bum dpar ma brgyad stong ba/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ 'jam dbyangs dgon pa'i dkar chag phyag bris/ ma bla brang dgon pa nas gdan drangs pa'i gzungs 'dus bcas bzhugs so/ /— 697 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me pho stag spyi lo1976lo'i zla ba11par zhing chen mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis mdung nag 'jam dbyangs mgon pa'i chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan gnang / sa khyi lor dgon pa'i lha khang rnams dang grwa shag so so/ nang rten sku gsung thugs rten sogs rtsa gtor thebs pa la/ rgyal khab kyis snga rjes su ma rtsa bsdoms pas sgor khri dgu lhag gnang ba dang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyis phul pa'i zhal 'debs rnams bsdus nas ngag dbang blo bzang dang rgya mtsho lags kyis gtso 'gan bzhes te sngon gyi dgon shul du mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon pa gsar du bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo btsugs te nyams pa sor chud kyi mchod khang bzhengs pa'i sa phyogs su bkra shis gso sbyong 'tshogs/ da lta dgon 'dir grwa ba 'ga' re bzhugs/ dgon pa nyid dang bcas pa'i rgya dang bod kyi dgon pa dang mchod khang/ lha khang / brag phug ci yod rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya spyi lo19ra1lor gan su'u 'ing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung nas zhing chen rim pa'i rig dngos srung skyob sde khag tu bcugadagon pa'i mdzad sgo'i skor la/ lo ngo gcig gi nang dus mchod dang sgrub mchod de zla dang bo'i rgya lo'i smon lam/ gsum pa'i nang kun rig sgrub mchod/ ba'i ba'i tshes gcig nas tshes brgyad bar smyung gnas/tshes brgyad nas sangs rgyas sku bltams pa'i nyin mor ra lug sogs sems can tshe thar gtong / tshes bco lnga ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i nyin mor byams pa gling skor/ zla 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lhums su zhugs pa dang sku 'khrungs pa/ sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen gsum 'khel bas chos dad mang tshogs kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod 'bul byed pa/ bod kyi 'cham dang rgya lugs kyi zlos gar bcas 'khrab pa lta bu sogs chos spyod kyi bya ba ha cang rgya che/ thag ring rta rmig gam ma thel dgon pa dang gser thang dgon pa/ chos lung dgon pa/ ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling / rgya rdog dgon pa/ bshes gnyen lha khang / chos 'khor gling dang bcas pa'i ser mo ba rnams phebs te bstan 'gro'i don du 'phrin las gang mang mdzad/ de nas bcu ba'i lnga mchod bcas yin no/ /dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi yong khungs skor la/ sngon spyi tshogs rnying bar/ 'jam dbyangs dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi yong khungs lo ngo gcig rer tshogs mchod ci yod de dag gi dus su nyin gyi zhal zas dgon pa gzhung nas sprod dpe/ dgon du sa zhing mu'u sum brgya nyer lnga mchis pa sos gar mchod gzhis dang lha sde'i zhing ba sger la bogs gtong/ ston khar dgon gzhung nas gnyer ba mngags te sa bogs sdud/ da lta dgon pa lo re'i yong sgo gtso bo dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'bul ba dang mang ja sogs la brten pa kho na yin no/ /g.yang khyung dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling /g.yang khyung ngam gyang ring dgon pa 'di ni/ sngon chad dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong la gtogs/rab byung bcu drug pas mo phag gi lo'i(1959)zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin nas bzung krang dbye sa khul gyi da 698 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mnga' zhabs su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su gtogs par gyur/ spyi lo1971lo'i zla bcu bar yon khrang rdzong la bkar mod kyang / phyi lor slar su'u nan rdzong gi khongs su 'du bar byas/ mtsho tshad smi sum stong lhag rdzong srid gzhung gi yul grwa ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling las bar thag spyi le22 5yod do/ /g.yang
