khyung dgon pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs don ni/ kun su'u zhing chen gyi su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi sa'i ming dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs phyogs bsgrigs zhes bya ba las bkra shis khyung chen dgon zhes dang g.yang khyung zhes bris/ rgya yig gi 'grel ba la g.yang zhes pa'i don ni bkra shis lta bu dang khyung zhes pa'i don ni bya 'dab chags kyi ming / mdo smad chos 'byung du yong chang zhes bris yod/ dgon mtshan la thang ring dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du grags/ deng sang rgya mis thang ring rgyal ba'i bu dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling zhes kyang zer/ 'debs pa bo rgyal ba bla ma bsam blo dge 'dun rin chen yin te/ khong nyid ni thang ring rgyal ba sku phreng dang bo'ang yin/ slob dpon chen mo tshe tan zhabs drung mchog gis mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun las btus par rab byung bcu ba'i lcags lug lo ste spyi lo1571lor sku 'khrungs/ mdo smad chos 'byung las nyi shu ba la dbus su phebs te thugs gnyer dang gling bsres dka' bcu gnang / nyer dgu la 'bras spungs rgyal ba bla mar bzhugs/ so bzhi ba la mdo smad du byon/ sngar rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mchos zhabs bcags te dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis dka' bcu don grub rgya mtsho la bka' lung dang dgon pa'i mtshan gnang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang grwa tshang btsugs/ gong ba chos rje grags pa rin chen slob dpon chung bar bskos/ shing khyi'i dbyar khar rje nyid dang rtogs ldan chos mdzad dga' ba dpal bzang / g.yi dge'i dpon po sogs mchod yon thams cad kyis sde ba chos rjes drug pa'i smon lam gyi mgor spyan drangs/ dbang lung rjes gsum gyi bka' chos mang du zhus pa gnang / bdun cu ba la sku gshegs/ de'i sprul sku blo bzang dge 'dun rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta lor(spyi lo1642)'khrungs/ dbus su thugs gnyer dang paṇa chen chos rgyal las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan mthu stobs rgya mtsho gsol/ lnga ba chen po'i bka' ltar byams sku dang jo sku bzhengs pa lha ldan jo khang du zhag bdun bzhugs te byin gyis rlob par gsol ba btab/ lcags phag lor(1671)mdo smad du gdan drangs te dgon pa'i rten gtsor bzhugs/ lang kru'u gyang ring dgon dang kun kru'u rta mig gong ma grags pa 'od zer khrir bzhugs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me yos (spyi lo1627) dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang /byams khang / mgon khang bcas bzhengs/ dbu phar dang mdzod 'dul zhib khrid byas par nyan dmar ba byung / g.yung bsod nams dar rgyas chos sde 'di nas byams pa 'bum gling sogs dgon sde du ma'i khrir bzhugs/ sku phreng gsum pa chu kha phun tshogs bzang po'i 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs dang / sku phreng bzhi ba chu kha blo bzang brtson 'grus kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs mi gsal/ rjes ma 'di ba gtsang du phebs te slob gnyer mdzad/ skabs der khong nyid kyis rgyal dbang gi tshab tu khri ba'ang mdzad myong / har gya blo bzang seng — 699 —

krang dbye sa/ khul su 'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/ge dbus su byon nas bka' pota la gas na sbyong mdzad/ rgyal dbang gis khong la chos rje zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/lnga ba chen po rgya phebs dus khri ba yin pas grwa tshang bcas sku 'bum du mjal bar byon/ dgon par dka' bcu'i ming btags 'dzugs rgyu'i bka' gnang / mkhar sngon du phebs nas ja sag bla ma'i go sar bzhugs/rang dgon du dngul srang su ma brgya lhag gis 'bum pa sogs shing par bskrun nas skyong khur mdzad/ zan gya blo bzang ngage legs 'bras sbo ma/nga du thugs gnyer dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes las bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ ser smad rgyud du phebs nas sngags la sbya ngas pa phul phyin pa dang/ kun mkhyen gong ma dge 'phel du bzhusas pa'i 'bas gtugs/ larma/ rim chen ro/'i bshad lung lan kha shas dang dbang rjes gnang sogs mdo sngags kyi zab khrid du ma gsan te thugs nyams su bzhes pas dbu ma'i lta ba brnyes shing 'jigs byed kyi 'al gzigs par grags/ phrir lo lnga bzhugs nas 'chad nyan dang dbu ma'i yig cha brtsams/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu byi(spyi lo172 2 )lor smad rgyud dang sgo bstun pa'i rgyud grwa btsugs te gong ba ngag dbang ye shes khrir bskos/ g.yung rgyal mtshan nor bu/ paṇa chen rin po che la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ mdo smad lo dkar dgon theg chen chos gling bskyangs nas khrir bzhugs pa dang gro tshang gi khrir phebs/ phun tshogs sgang du bzhugs skabs rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs pa dang thugs 'dris byung bas rang dgon du gdan drangs te chos zhus/chag ga blo bzang dar rgyas/ skya ti bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bcas mnyam por rgya nag tu phebs/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje dang 'brel zab che bas chen 'u nga gis hu thos thu'i cho lo bstsal/ a phag she ra tha lar dgon pa btab/sku phreng lnga ba ngag dbang don grub kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs mi gsa'// sku phreng drug pa chu kha blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing phag(spyi lo1755)lor 'khrungs/ 'bras sgo mang du thugs gnyer dang gas nga phu'i dka' bcu gnang / rwa sgreng khri chen las bsnyen par rdzogs/ smad du o thog pe li'i bla mar byon/ 'di ga'i khri'i skabs paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes sku 'bum du phebs pa mjal bar sne ring sogs rten chas bstsal / lang kru'u gyang ring dang yong ching sogs kyi khri mdzad/ na sa cun bka' gnang bzhin sbra nag phyogs kyis gong ma'i sku don snga phyir bsgrubs pas then chin tā bla ma'i cho lo dang mkhan chas bstsal/'du khang dang jo khang gnyis zhig gsos gnang ste snga mar gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rab gnas mdzad/phyi mar chu bzang rin po ches rab gnas dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / re bzhi ba sa stag (spyi lo18 27)lor lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa gdan drangs par chos 'brel btsugs/ dgung lo gya lnga bzhugs/de 'phros g.yung 'jam dbyangs blo gros dpal 'byor/ nyin zha blo bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho/ gong ba bstan pa rgya mtsho/ 'gu blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gnas bcu rab 'phel gling gi li kya ngag dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i bar phebs te sgo mang yig cha'i steng nas 'chad nyan gyis rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ grwa grangs lnga brgya lhag la rgyab ri'i ngos su rgyal ba gong mas btab pa lha lung ri khrod thar ba gling / gzhan bkra shis chos 'khor gling / dga' ldan lhun grub gling / 'bum khang thang sogs tsong kha'i g.yon phyogs kyi rgyud du dgon che da 700 da

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/chung bco brgyad/ 'gag rtsa ba yan phyogs su dgon sgrub sde drug bcas dgon pa nyer ba'i mchod gzhis lung ba gsum(de skabs kyi rgya mo dur lung ba/ 'dre mtsho lung ba/ spyang tshang lung ba/ nag lung chung ba/ nag lung chen po/ tsher ma lung gong ma/ phyugs lung sto da ma dang smad ma/ brag lung gong ma dang smad ma/ sa dmar nyin kha/ ma ṇi lung ba/ dgon pa lung ba bcas)yod ces bshad/ 'di dang gro tshang dgon bkra shis lding kha gling gnyis dus mnyam du byung / sku phreng bdun pa 'khrungs yul gyang ring sa khul yin zhing /chung dus nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyi' dang sku 'bum byams pa gling du slob gnyer mdzad/ lhag par du sku 'bum du thun mong gi rig gnas la gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i dus su he dmag gis sku bkrongs so / /sku phreng brgyad pa ye shes bstan pa rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul ni mtsho sngon zhing chen ba yan rdzong yin/ snga phyir bya khyung dang sku 'bum nas slob gnyer mdzad/ sku phreng dgu ba skal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i rab myos lcags rta'i(spyi lo1920)lor mdo smad chu kha ru sku mngon par bltams/ shing phag(spyi lo1925)lor thang ring bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin byas te/ me glang lor dgon par khri 'don mdzad/ de nas cho ga dang dus rgyun slob gnyer gtsigs su mdzad/ rab byung drug pa'i sa khyi(spyi lo1758)lor khong la ma nyes kha g.yog thebs te khrims la sbyar/ phyis su min chen(7pho)rdzong gi chu rags las gnas su ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed skabs gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ sku phreng bcu ba ngag dbang dpal ldan ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa mo lug(spyi lo1979)lor mtsho sngon 'ing chen gyi hwa lung(ba yan)rdzong mchog khyu sa cha yab chos 'bum dang yum rta mgrin 'tsho'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ de nas sku 'bum byams pa gling gi skyabs rje zi na chos rje mchog nyid kyis phywa btab ste dgu ba'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ chu bya lo'i zla10pa'i tshes20nyin la rang dgon du khri 'don mdzad/ nye char dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te sku 'bum byams pa gling du dpe gzugs gnang bzhin mchis so/ /dgon pa 'di dang thog btab nas bzung dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur sngon la/ dgon 'dir lha sde dang mchod gzhis ni mdzub lung dong chu dang / g.yang mtsho stegs srib chen po/ rdo 'bum sked/ dkar chu lung ba/ rdo thang / yang skyed dar gong ma dang bcas pa'i yul gru sogs kyi khyung tsha/ rgyal sras/ thogs pa/ am tho/ shar ma tsho ba lnga yod par chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs lag bstar mdzad do/ /dgon pa 'di ni rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing phag(spyi lo1995)gi lor gsar du zhig gso legs grub byas/ dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten yongs rdzogs kyang gsar du legs bzhengs mdzad pa la/ 'du khang gi rten gtso la ston pa bākya thub pa'i sman 'dam 'bag sku dang thang ring rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa'i gdung rus dngul sku grub mchod rten/ sku phyogs kyi zangs grub gdung rten dang ltungs bshags sum cu so lnga/ bla mchod tshogs zhing gi thang ga skyabs 'gro'i tshogs shing / tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang ga mgon po dang lha mo gnyis — 701 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/kyi thang ga sman 'dam 'bag sku la sman gyi bla ma bde gshegs brgyad/ rje yab sras gsum/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ gnas rten bcu drug mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal chen bzhi/ rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol dkar/sgrol ljang / sgrol ma nyer gcig jo sku mtho tshad khri bzhi/ mgon po 'od dpag med/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mgon po phyag drug pa dang bcas/ kun rig dang 'jigs byed gnyis ku'i dkyil 'khor sogs bzhugs/ ldebs ris la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'khrungs rabs/ ltung bshags/ rgyal ba byams pa/ gdugs dkar/ 'od dpag med / gsang 'dus/bde mchog spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / gnas rten bcu drug sogs rten dang brten pa tshogs chen 'du khang dang / sā ts+tsha sku par/ 'bum khang gsum/ nang chen gcig grwa shag bcu phrag 'du khang mtha' ru ma ṇi dung phyur bco brgyad kyi 'khor lo bcas yod do/ /dgon pa'i chos spyod/ dgon pa 'dir lo ngo gcig gi nang chos spyod ni zla dang bor smon lam chen mo/bco lnga'i nyin lha mo bshegs gtor 'bul ba/ mar gyi me tog mchod bshams/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du smyung gnas/ zla lnga ba'i nang gdung mchod/ zla drug pa'i bco lngar gnas bdag bstod pa/ zla dgu ba'i nyer gnyis tshogs chen/ zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga nas nyer dgu'i bar bgeg gtor bcas so/ /dgon pa'i deng dus kyi gnas tshul/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi(spyi lo1958)lor grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i chab srid las 'gul khrod du dgon 'di gtor bshig tshabs chen thebs/ skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes kyi tang gi chos lugs srid jus yang dag par lag bstar byas/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i rnga chen chu pho khyi(spyi lo1982)lor dang thog dgon pa'i ma ni khang zhig nyams pa gsos/ de nas shing glang lor su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis g.yang khyung dgon pa chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan gnang / rgyal khab kyis snga phyir slar gso'i ma nom sgor khri gsum lhag gnang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyis kyang skor khri dgu bcu go bdun lhag zhal 'debs phul pa bcas pas 'du khang khang mig brgyad cu can dang sku par tsha tsha 'bum khang gsum/ nang chen gcig grwa shag bcu phrag bcas yongs su grub/ chu sprel lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyes drug nyin la krung gung su'u nan rdzong u rgyun las u yon tshogs pa thengs drug pa'i gros tshogs thog tu dgon 'dir ser mo ba nyi shu bzhugs chog pa gtan la phab/ da lta dgon par dngos su ser mo ba sum cu so drug 'dus te bzhugs yod/ dgon pa'i las sne ste dge bskos bla ma ni 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad skal bzang dbyig gnyen/ gzhung gnyer skal bzang rgyal mtshan dang skal bzang snyan grags/ nang chen gnyer ba dam chos zla grags bcas yin/ dgon 'di'i chos spyod phyogs dang bya ba gzhan dag thams cad bdag gnyer tshan khag gi mi sna 'tshogs nas thag gcod par bya'o/ /— 702 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dgon pa'i dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs snying bar dgon 'di'i dpal 'byor gyi yong 'bab la/ dgon pa nyid kyis sa zhing mu'u drug cu re bdun dang shing tog ra ba mu'u bcu tsam/ phyugs zog lnga brgya lhag gnyer/dgon pa'i lo hril ba'i zla chos thams cad 'tshogs ring dgon gzhung nas zhal zas sprod lugs dar/ da lta mang tshogs la lag mi bsrings ched rang kha rang gso'i khang mig che chung drug cu re dgu dang sa zhing sum cu so gnyis/ phyugs zog nyi shu lhag yod la/ ser mo ba rnams mi ser grong khyim du rim gror phebs pa'i yon gang 'byor dgon gzhung la 'bul dgos pa dang / yon bdag cung zhan pa'am 'byor ldan rung ser mo sger la zur nas 'bul ba ster mi dgos pa la sogs sngon med srol bzang tshugs te lag bstar byed bzhin yod/gzhan yang sa zhing dang phyugs zog gi yong sgo dgon gzhung la dbang bas spyi nom 'di dag la brten nas dgon pa legs po bskyangs pa dang ser mo 'tsho ba'i kha gsab byed bzhin mchis so/ /rgyud pa sgar chos 'khor gling /chos 'khor dgon nam rgyud pa sgar chos 'khor gling ni(po r+shangaloyolko khrir+sha)/ sngon chad shu'u gru la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/dgon pa 'di ming rgyal rabs mjug(1744lo'i sngon)tsam la ting kyā rab 'byams snyan grags rgya mtshos phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dang thog gling 'di ni dbus kyi rgyud pas btang ba'i 'bul sdud pa zhig bsdud pa'i sgar la brten nas chags shing / rgyal dbang gis gnang ba'i bka' shog ngo mtshar ba yod/ mdung nag 'jams dbyangs dgon pa'i bu dgon yin/ chos skyong gnas chung la bsten/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas thu'u bkwan rin po che la gsar 'dzin gyi bkod khyab gnang bar brten lung bstan zhus pas/ bkra shis chos gling 'brog sde'i khrod sa dpyad legs shing gnas bkra bzang ba tsā tshe zer bar dgon gsar thar ba gling gsar 'debs mdzad de gnas gcig tu bsgril/ lcags glang lor rdo rje 'chang nyid der phebs te sa bcos dang lto 'phye brtag pa sogs mdzad de bum gter bcug a nam tsho ba la bka' gnang ste g.yas g.yon gyi mchod rten lung ba dang / bkra shis lung ba/ lha lung sogs sa mtshams bcad/ 'du khang gi phug dbus su nyid kyi khri dang g.yas g.yon du lam rim bla rgyud kyi sku brnyan byis pa lo brgyad can gyi bongs tshad tsam nga dgu dang / 'og shod logs bris la mdzad bcu/ rje'i rnam thar rgyas pa/rgya mthong du bla rgyud sogs kyi ldebs bris/ steng du gser zangs kyi gañji ra/ steng shod g.yas kyi mchod khang du jo bo'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan gtsos pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku du ma/ g.yon gyi mgon khang du rgyal gyi lha mo bla mtsho'i chu dang / bye ma rde'u sogs rgya bod kyi gnas chen rnams dang mgon khang dur khrod mang bo'i sa rdo/dam pa mang po'i dgung lo nas bza' phyogs bsdebs pa'i sku rgyu byas shing thugs gar srog 'khor bris sgrub — 703 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/sog4gzungs gzhug tshad ldan gyi dmag zor lha mo'i sku brnyan tho bcu tsam pa/ sku thang byin can/ rgyal sras rin po ches gnang ba'i dan gyi be con sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs/ dge slong ngag dbang dga' blos bzhengs pa'i lha khang rgya phibs gyo thog can du bka' 'gyur ro cog gi chos 'khor chen mo/ btsan khang pho brang nang mar gsang sgrub/ nor sgrub/ mgar nag gsum gyi sku brnyan mtho bdun re tsam pa/ pho brang phyi mar gos bzang kyi dra ba dra phyed sogs spyan gzigs spus gtsang / mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku srid du 'dom brgyad can sogs bzhugs/ mtshod rdzas dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gyi yo byad grangs mang / bla brang gi dbus kyi lha khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas gser sku yong lo'i thugs dam du grags pa byin can khri rgyab yol bcas pa bzhugs/ tsan+dan las grub paṇa chen rin po che'i 'dra sku khru gang ba bkris lhun nang brten byung ba/ tsan dmar gyi bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku brnyan dang / lha bab mchod rten che ba/ rje gling 'phur ma sogs tsan tan dang gser zangs kyi sku brnyan du ma/ jo sku/ rje rin po che/ rgyal dbang bcas kyi rnam thar/ lam rim tshogs zhing sogs sku thang mang bo/ steng shod du bka' 'gyur dbus dpar dang phyag dpe po ti brgya phrag brgal pa/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sku brnyan che ba sogs bris 'bur gyi sku du ma/ mgon khang du dpal mgon zhal gyi rten thang bskang rdzas spyan gzigs/ gzim khang rnams su byams pa rin po che sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs thugs dam gyi sku brnyan bris 'bur can/ mchod rdzas dang mchod pa'i yo byad/ khang rgyan gyi snod spyad mtha' yas la tshar du dngar ba/ mdun ngos klu sdings su rigs mi 'dra ba'i sa bon du mas bskyed pa'i rtsi shing me tog pad+ma sna tshogs kyis phyug pa'i skyed tshal gda'o/ /chos kyi chog gzhi gsum gyi phyag len la/ tshogs pa'i zhal 'don du mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga gtan chags/sgrub mchod/ cho 'phrul smon lam/ beg tse gtso 'khor gsum/ gri thog bshan pa brgyad/ dam can/keng rus gnyis/ a tsa ra gnyis dang bcas pa'i bkra shis lhun po'i phyag len gyi lha 'cham/ bzhi ba dang dgu bar smyung gnas/ drug pa'i smon lam/ lo sar lha mo'i tshe gtor sogs kyi sgrig khrims ngos gtsang /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa gtsos skyes chen du ma gdan drangs te rab gnas/ zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor pas snod bcud la ye shes kyi byin chen bstsal pa/ bla ma hor dgon pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyis snga phyir lam khrid dang / dbang lung rjes gnang mang du gnang zhing / dgon 'dabs su mchod rten thog tshad gsum longs pa zhig bzhengs/ 'di ba 'bras spungs dge bshes dang dge 'phel du bzhugs la rlung gi rnal 'byor ba'i tshad phyin/ khri bsod nams grags pa dang grwa thog mnyam/ bka' bcu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan chos khrims pa dang / mar tshang chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin slob dpon du bskos/ yang lo dkar bka' bcu ngag dbang bstan pa dang / de'i rjes phur tsha chos rje sogs rim bskos kyis bskyangs/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa gling lor spyi lo1709lo nas rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i sngon la/ dgon sde'i 'du khang chen mo — 701 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nyis thog ka ba nyer bzhi can bzhengs pa'i nang na nang chen dang bla ma'i gzim khang / dpe mdzod 'dzoms te/der gser bris bka' bstan 'gyur dang kun rig rnam bshad/ kyai rdor rnam bshad/ bde mchog rjes dran/brgyad stong / sangs rgyas spyi bstan la sogs pa bzhugs/ phur tsha dpon po dang mā tsha dpon po/ sgos su ko ca no min han dang bcas pa gtso bdag mdzad/ khyad par du bcu phrag gnas la sbyangs pa mthil phyin cing /rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dang paṇa chen drug pa snga rting du mkhas pa chen po zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog la erte ni no mon han gyi cho lo bstsal pa dang/ rtse pho brang po ta la nas bla ma blo bzang lhun grub ces mtshan btags gsol/ lcang skya rin po che mchog gis khong la pi li thu dar han dang be lag thu ye shin thu si zhes cho lo gnyis gnang ste mkhas dbang chen mo'i mtshan snyan grags pas bod gangs can ljongs su mtshan khyab par gyur to/ /bla sprul ko a+yo no mon han sku phreng du byon pa mi gsal/ sku phreng las ngag dbang 'jigs med ces pa 'di rab rgyal lcags lug spyi lo1921lor mdung nag sa khul gyi tsho drug sde bar sku mngon par bltams/ sa stag spyi lo1928rab tu byung ste 'di ga'i chos sgor zhugs nas slob gnyer mdzad pa dang khri la bkod/bcings 'grol rjes su gsar brje la zhugs nas rdzong srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa mdzad myong / mig sngar las 'khyur ngal gso bzhes 'dug go/ snyan grags che ba'i skyes chen dam pa mā blo bzang ni mdo la ring mo'i mdung nag sa char gtogs pa'i tsho drug ces par rab byung bco lnga ba'i me sprel spyi lo1896la sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas mtsho sngon gyi ser mo ba zhig dge rgan du bsten nas bod yig 'bri klog mdzad pa dang / dgon lung dang sku 'bum byams pa gling du thu'u bkwan rin po che la bsten nas chos gzhung mang bo gsan sbyong mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag spyi lo1924lor khong dang 'gu kya mkhan po sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog dang lhan cig tu spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi slob grwa btsugs shing / chos 'khor gling slob grwa'i zho krang gi 'gan bzhes/ sa yos lor 'gu mkhan po dang rang nyid kyis mnyam du mdo la ring mo'i bod dmangs ri 'gog rgyal skyob dril sgrog ru lag ces pa zhig btsugs nas krung go gsar ba 'dzugs pa'i dmigs chen khur du bzhes/ bcings 'grol byed khar mā blo bzang mchog nyid kyis snying thag pa nas gung khran tang la brtsi bkur byas te/ mdung nag kha(khag)gsum sde drug gi rta nor lug gsum bsdus nas shu'u gru mkhar du phebs pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la 'tshams 'dri zhus/ rab rgyal chu sbrul spyi lo1952lor nyid kyis shu'u gru mkhar su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong 'dzugs rgyu'i sta gon byed pa'i skabs su khong rang kru'u rin gzhon pa'i srid gnas bskos pa dang / shing rta lor su'u nan rdzong mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen skabs dang bo'i steng du rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams/ de rjes rdzong dpon gzhon par bdams/rab rgyal sa khyi lor spyi lo1958lor sku 'das so/ /mdung nag bshes gnyen lha khang /

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/mdung nag khul gyi bshes gnyen lha khang ni rgya yig lazlo༅chu bshes gnyen gser thang shākya'i lha khang zer ba zhig kyang mthong / sngon chad shu'u gru zer ba'i rgya nag gi grong khyer la gtogs pa dang / deng sang kun su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/lha khang 'di phyag 'debs mkhan ni sa der bsdad pa ste da skabs skam pa chu lung sde ba'i nang du bshes gnyen zhes tsho ba'i mgo bar dbang ba zhig yin/ dmangs khrod la grags pa'i ngag rgyun du gna' snga mo zhig la bshes gnyen tsho bar mgo ba zhig yod pa'i ming khyi gu thar zhes zer zhing / phyis su ming la gtsang dga' zhes su gsol/ der dbang ba'i khyim tshang zhe bdun de bzhin mi grangs nyis brgya sum bcu rtsa dgur 'phel/ 'di la kun gyis bshes gnyen rigs gsum can nam skam pa phun tshogs kyang zer/ de la lo rgyus su gur nag mgo ba bshes gnyen bon po'i skyes rgyud rim par byon myong / mched khungs ni lho phyogs su mdo la ring mo'i gangs ri dang 'brel zhing nub tu kyo'u chun sa khul la gtogs pa'i ching dwangs chu sgar bcas la 'brel ba sogs gsar ma zhes bya ba'i deb tu bkod byung / gzhan yang lha khang 'di ha lam tā ming rgyal rabs wan li'i khri rabs spyi lo1572lo'am162 0lo'i bar la btab pa'i dge lugs pa'i lha khang red zer ba'ang byung / spyi lo1949lo'i rjes su lha khang de la mchod khang gcig las med par btang nas thon skyed ru khag gi mdzod khang zhig tu bcos/ gyang ngos su ldebs ris gsal mi gsal lus pa ste/ skyabs rje 'gro bzang mas 'brug zhon pa'i tshul dang / bkra shis tshe ring mas g.yu ral seng ge chibs pa'i tshul dang / dam can rdo rje legs pas seng chen bskyon pa'i tshul sogs bkod 'dug bgres po tsho'i kha rgyun la/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur sngon la lha khang 'dir khang mig ha cang mang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1958lor gtor rlag thebs te 'jig nye char mchod khang gyan gsum gsar du bzhengs shing / grwa ba gcig kyang bzhugs pa med rung /gnam lo gsar ba'i tshe bshes gnyen zer ba'i dad ldan mi ser 'dir 'ongs te lug bshas nas spro bsang skyid po byed pa las chos lugs la 'brel pa'i cho ga ci yang sgrub pa med do/ /ho yor e khe'i ri khrod chos 'khor gling /ho yor e khe'i ri khrod chos 'khor gling ngam g.yu 'brug dgon pa ni/ sngon chad gan gru(ju)la gtogs pa dang / da lta krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi nye 'dabs su shul yod/ mtsho tshad smi2 2 0 0yas mas longs/ rgya skad dukhro7khriḥtsho67oṃtsholozor+sār+sāṣ+ṭhar+sā sogs 'bod/dgon 'di'i mchod gzhis dang lha sde ni yu gur rigs kyi tsho ba gar rge'am(༈r+shasoza)don la yum gnyis po yin/ 'debs lo dang phyag 'debs gnang mkhan mi gsal/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me bya spyi lo1926lor nub lam du bskyod pa'i krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag dgon 'dir brgyud skabs/ dgra jag mā pu'u h+phang gi ha'e dmag gis dgon pa mer bsregs te brlags/ phyis su mchod khang rgyan bcu dang — 706 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mgon khang / grwa shag sogs khang mig bzhi bcu slar gsar bzhengs grub mod kyang rab rgyal shing lug spyi lo1955lor dgon du ban ser mo ba bcu gnyis bzhugs tsam las ma 'phel ba dang sa khyi lor dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad brlags nas 'jig stabs de rjes slar gso bya ma thub par gyur to/ /ting 'dzin dgon chos rgyal gling /ting 'dzin dgon chos rgyal gling zhes pa sngon chad gan gru(ju)la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong srid gzhung gi lte gatshas su btab pa'i shul yod/mtsho tshad smi2 200longs la/ rgya skad du lhotsho ṣ+ṭhakhri1r+sha phre1lor+sha zhes 'bod/ dge lugs pa'i dgon 'di btab nas bzung nub bar lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam 'das/ dgon bdag bla ma 'gu mkhan po(15phoza)sa skyong khur mdzad do/ /ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling thog mar btab gnas ni zhi lo'i ku'u ste bod skad du lcang ma nub lung zer ba der chags kyang mthar mer bsregs te thal bar brlags/ shul du re zhig sdod mkhan ma byung / phyis su bla ma zhig mtsho sngon nas gdan drangs te da lta'i gnas 'dir bskyar 'debs mdzad/ mtsho sngon ta thung gi sgo mang dgon pa'i dgon lag yin/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi sngon dgon pa dar ba'i dus su ban ser mo nyer brgyad 'dus te chos spyod ci 'khyong spel/ dgon du 'du khang nyis thog khang mig so drug ste ka chen bzhi ldan pa dang / rung khang mig bcu drug spyi khang mig bcu drug bzhengs/ grwa shag nyer bzhir khang mig brgyad cu rtsa gnyis phub/ de bzhin dgon pa btsan po dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi chu bzang rin po che sku nyid kyis skyong gnyer bzhes/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i sngon la ta khra sa cha'i phyugs ra de bla ma a yon tshang gis bdag gnyer byas/ dgon pa'i lha sde la pa ka ste deng sang lcang ma nub lung / ta khra phyugs ra/ dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor du sdod pa'i tsho ba so so'i khyim pa bcas yin te/ kho tshos dus rgyun mang 'gyed dang bsnyen bkur bgyis pa la/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1958lor bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin la ngo rgol byas pa'i chab srid las 'gul nang dgon pa gtor bshig btang nas rmeg med du 'jig pas nyams gso ci yang ma byung ngo / /lo ngo gcig gi ring la dus mchod dang sgrub mchod gtso rigs la/ lo mjug gi tshes nyer dgu dang sum bcu'i nyin la chos thog dang mar rgyan me tog bca'/ gnam lo gsar ba'i tshe drug nas bco lnga'i bar mang ja bskol/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes drug nas bco lnga'i bar chos thog zla bzhi ba'i tshes bzhi nyin la smyung gnas/bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs tshugs so/ /lung ser dgon pa/lung ser dgon pa'am lung ser ri khrod ces pa ni/ gna' dus yu gur ba rnams dus rabs bcu drug — 707 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/pa nub phyogs su gnas spor du mdo la ring mo ri khul du thon nas ches snga mor gsar du bzhengs pa'i yu gur rigs kyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa ang dang bo yin/ rgya skad duzo+or+sha zo༅r+sha ༅cho/ zo7ṣ+ṭha.oṃr+shazhes kyang bya/ deng skabs mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi chi len te mdo la rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi lte gnas kyi byang shar chu nag stod rgyud 'bab yul brag ri zhes zer bar gnas spor te chags/dang thog dgon 'di'i thag nye sar mkhar shul mchis pas yu gur skad du mdo lung ho thang lam bod skad du mdo lung mkhar zhes pa la dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs sum cu'i skabs su'ang ring tshad smi lnga brgya yas mas kyi mkhar shul yod pa mthong / thu'u bkwan rin po ches gzigs skyong gnang ba'i dgon pa zhig kyang lags/mchod gzhis ni tsho ba chen po dang gur ser tsho ba/ smug thig tsho ba/ ser rta tsho ba/ stod ra tsha tsho lnga dang smad khyung tsha tsho dgu sogs gda'/ dgon pa ha cang dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun pa bdun brgya'am brgyad brgya lhag bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i mdzad sgo gtso bo lo ngo gcig la hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar smyung gnas dang / dbyar zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas bcu drug pa'i nang chos thog nyin drug bcu ba'i lnga mchod chos thog nyin drug tor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu nas sang lo'i gnam lo gsar ba'i tshes bco lnga'i bar rgya lo'i smon lam bcas so/ /chu yos1902dus 'khrug las dgon pa bcom tshar/ phyis su rgya rdog tu gnas spor te slar gso mdzad/ de'i phyir rgya rdor dgon yang zer/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lo'i yar sngon la dgon 'dir ser mo ba zhal sum cu tsam bzhugs/ rgyun du gnyer ba gcig dang dbu mdzad gcig bskos te bskyangs/ lung ser dgon dang rta mgo dgon ni gcig 'dra yin pa ste dge 'dun rnam pa tshos chos thog tu dgon par chos spyod spel ba las dus gzhan la rang khyim du zhing phyugs las gang rung gnyer chog ste dge bsnyen pa shag stag yin/ sngar spyi tshogs rnying bar dpal 'byor gyi yong khungs gtso bo ni dgon pa rang la sa zhing mu'u brgyad cu lhag yod pas bod mi dang ha'e mi rnams la sa bogs btang nas ston dus dgon gzhung gis gnyer ba du ma mngags te sa bogs 'bru rigs rgya ma nyis stong lhag bsdus nas ma dngul re blangs pa chos thog mang ja'i ma rtsa bgyis/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1kha58lo nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol rgya cher byas pa'i skabs su dgon pam lus par bshigs pas nang rten dang bcas pa 'jig go/lo rgyus su dgon 'dir bzhugs myong ba'i gtso gnyer bzhes pa'am lnga rig smra ba'i dbang bo rje grags pa rgya mtsho'am grags pa dar rgyas ni smug thig tsho bar 'khrungs pa'i mkhas chen zhig yin/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa 'brug(1877)lor sku bltams/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste lha sar gnas mjal du phebs/ dgung lo nyer gsum steng rdo ba tshang gis zhu sna byas te rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad du 'byor ma thag lam rim thung ngu'i zhal lung gi gnang mtshams su bshes gnyen dul ba nyer zhi ba/ zhes pa nas gsan pas rten 'brel khyad par 'grig bla ma rin po ches thugs ha cang dgyes pa'i ngang phyag gnyis thal mo — 708 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/sbyor ba gnang nas 'di bas chos kyi 'khor lo ci 'dra mang po zhig bskor bar 'gyur ang zhes gsungs par grags/ de nas lo nyer gsum gyi ring mnyam med bu rim shing ba'i gdung 'tshob snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rje zhwa dmar rin po che bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten te chos bka' gang gnang ma gsan med pas dbang lung man ngag gi gter mdzod gcig bur gyur cing / lo bdun tsam la drung yig kyang gnang /rdo rje 'chang dang dar grong dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngag dbang blo gsal rnam gnyis las lam rim/ chen mo'i zhal lung thengs ba'i gsan cing lam rim yo ngas rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu gzho' / phyis su bstan 'dzin dam pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las kyang dbang lung man ngag mang du gsan/ rje de snga phyi nyid paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs shing 'phrin las mkha' mnyam du grags pa thugs 'dris ha cang che na'ang dam pa 'di kho nar mu tra'i dbang skor bstsal pas thugs kyi sras gcig pur rjes su bzung ba'i rnam thar ya mtshan can mang / gzhan dran dbang las sum cu ba dang rtags 'jug gi khrid rgyun mi 'dra ba du ma dang / sgra ka lā ba dang dbyangs can ma/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/rtsis dkar nag sogs rig gnas che chung kun sbyangs pa mthil phyin gnang ste lnga rig smra ba'i dbang bor gyur/sa bya spyi lo1909lo nas dbu btsugs te/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' bzhin gdan sa bkra shis chos sdings dang / ba yan/ dpa' ris/ a rig rkang tsha bcas kyi phyogs dang / yu gur phyogs kyi dgon sde du mar phebs/ da dung rma byang rgyud kyi dgon sde mang bo dang / lha ri dgon sogs rma lho sogs kyi dgo na sde du mar snga phyir mu tra rdor phreng gi dbang lan 'ga'/ dus 'khor dbang tshad gnyis/ zhar du bka' dbang gzhan du ma/ brgya rtsa gsum/ rim 'byung / gser chos bcu gsum/ rnam sras bka' bco lnga/ zur bka' thor bu rnams kyi rjes gnang dang byin rlabs/ lam rim dang bskyed rdzogs phyogs kyi khrid/ chos mkhan chen rin po che/ rje lha ri ba blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ sku zhabs mi nyag rin po che sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang du byon/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung 'bum par du bskrun pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i lha khang rten dang brten pa gsar du bzhengs/ gsung rtsom ngo ta lnga mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig tu son pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa byi spyi lo194〈'o ra dpal ldan bkra shis chos sdings su sku gshegs so/ /chu lung bkra shis dgon/chu lung bkra shis dgon pa ni sngon chad gan gru(7〉/ /)la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags te/ mtsho'i mtho tshad smi2700yin la/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling dang bar thag spyi le sum cu lhag yod/ rgya'i skad du༅ char+sha 7oṃ7khri༅r+sha zhes 'bod/ dgon gzhis da lta rdzong srid gzhung gi gong du tshugs pa'i chu lung zhang la gtogs/— 709 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa 'di ni ching rgyal rabs gong ma 'od gsal rgyal bo'i sku ring ste spyi lo1875—1909lor 'gu mkhan pos phyag 'debs mdzad cing bskyangs pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa yin/ lha sde dang mchod gzhis ni hor tshang dang gling tshang(lkoyo1khri)sogs deng skabs thal lung bdag po dang thal lung shar phyogs/ spel klung dang bcas pa'i yul gru sogs snang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1958lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol rgya cher byas skabs su chu lung dgon pa ma lus par gshigs nas gsung rten thams cad mer bsregs pa dang mchod rdzas dang gna' rdzas tshang ma gang khyer rgyus med ngang yal bar gyur to/ /rgyus yod mi sna'i bshad tshul la dgon pa'i btsan khang du lha mo rten gtso bzhugs pa dang mgon po chos skyong srung mar bkur bzhin pa gleng / dgon pa'i mdzad sgo ni lung ser ri khrod kyi cho ga phyag len dang gnyis su med pa yin na'ang da lta shul tsam las slar gso ba'i sta gon byas med do/ /gser dong dgon pa/gser dong dgon pa ni/ sngon chad gan su'u'i ga'o the(zlor+ha)rdzong la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/mtsho tshad smi2100yin zhing / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling dang bar thag spyi le so lnga yod/ rgya'i skad du(za0r+sha)zhes 'bod/ dgon gzhis ni deng sang rdzong srid gzhung gi gong du chags pa'i chu lung sa khul yo 'bog ri bor brgyud pa'i gser dngo chu bo'i shar 'gram yin/dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprel spyi lo1644nas lcags glang spyi lo1661lo'i bar du bla ma 'ja' mo(za༅lko// lo)sogs du ma brgyud de phyag btab gnang ba'i rnying ma ba'i dgon pa yin/ sa khongs yu gur rigs sdod gnas gtogs kyang yu gur pa rnams gna' snga mo nas nang bstan la dad pas bod brgyud nang ba'i chos sde gal chen du gyur/ dang thog dgon pa'i rnam pa ma grub gong gnas de'i brag phug tu sku gsung thugs rten shin tu mang bo bzhugs shing / dad ldan skye bos mchod bkur srung skyob bgyis stabs nang rten gang mang bzhugs sa yod pa dang gsung rab mang bo bzhugs yod/ phyis kyi dgon mtshan la gser dong dgon zhes thogs par grags/ rgan rabs tsho'i ngag rgyun du/ gna' snga mo zhig la/ rnying ma ba'i bla ma zhig sa 'dir phebs te brag tu phug pa brkos nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bla ma khong gis dus rtag tu zhal 'don dge sbyong gi brtson 'grus ma btang bas dbu skra dang smra ra zang zing du skyes 'dug pa la mi rnams kyis khong la bla ma skra spu ring bo can zhes bos par grags/ skyes chen dam pa 'di nyid bstan gzhung la mkhas pas mtshan snyan grags che zhing bu slob mang du 'dus te chos grwa rgya cher bskyed/ phyis su dge lugs pa yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel pas rnying ma'i lugs rim gyis nyams mod kyang / lo rgyus 'phel 'gros dang bstun ched gser dong dgon pa skabs der dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ dgon pa ha cang dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun pa — 710 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhal bzhi bcu lhag bzhugs myong / mkhan po dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad bcas bskos/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me yos spyi lo1867lor hos hos kyis dus 'khrug bslangs stabs/ khri ka smad kyi dgon pa thams cad mer bsregs/ gser dong dgon pa'ang gnod skyon las thar ga la thub ste ma lus par thal ba'i rdul du brlags/ slar yang rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing byi spyi lo1924lor sa gnas 'di'i ser skya rnams te lhag par du stod ra tsha tsho lnga dang smad khyung tsha tsho dgu bcas kyis dkar thigs bslangs nas lha khang nyams gso bgyis/dgon pa'i rten bdag bla ma 'ja' mo sku phreng brgyad rim par byon pa'i mtha' ma ni sa khyi spyi lo1952lor sku bshegs pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa thams cad bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol gtong ba'i chab srid kyi las 'gul khrod du rtsa rdzogs su bsnubs/ da lta gzhug la lus pa'i dgon yul der brag phug dang sa dong ches mang bo brdibs pa mngon la/ gyang khog brag phug bcu lhag lus pa'i nang du ldebs ris cha mi tshang ba phra zhing zhib pa dang tshon mdangs ma nyams pas mi rnams kyis yid smengs par bya'o/ /rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags rta spyi lo1990lor su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rdzong rim rig dngos srung skyob sde khag tu chog mchan gnang nas srung skyob bya mgo tshugs/ lo gcig ring dgon pa'i dus mchod dang sgrub mchod la hor zla dang bo tshes dgu nyin 'cham dang bco lnga la chos thog zla re'i bco lnga la chos thog nyin gcig sogs dar/ bcings 'grol yar sngon du dgon gzhung la ra lug nyis brgya lhag dang / nor dang rnga mong nyi shu lhag skyong ba'i rtswa sa'ang rgya che ba mchis so/ /lung skya dgon pa/lung skya dgon pa zhes pa ni/ sngon chad kun gru(ju)la gtogs pa dang da lta gan su'u zhing chen krang dbye sa’khul su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags te/ mtsho tshad smi sum stong yas mas dang rdzong srid gzhung gi lte gnas ting 'dzin chos rgyal gling bar rgyang thag spyi le so gnyis yod/ rgya skad du(ṣ+ṭhashā spyir+sha)zer/gser lung dgon pa dang lung skya dgon pa gnyis ni lhun du 'dres kyang phyis su bkar te yu gur bla dpon gyis(༅4mo)bdag skyong mdzad/ mchod gzhis ni gur ser nag po(༅zo+o)tsho ba zer ba de yin/dgon 'di'i gtso bdag pa ni bla ma 'ja' mo tshang lags te btab po mi gsal/ dgon pa dar ba'i dus su ban ser mo nyer brgyad 'dus zer/dgon 'di'i chos spyod mdzad sgo'i skor la/ lo gcig nang zla ba dang bo'i tshes brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar chos thog tu me tog mchod 'bul/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas bco lnga'i bar chos thog dang / zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad la smyung gnas/ zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nang bco lnga bar 'cham/ zla dgu ba'i mchod pa chos thog nyin bdun/ zla bcu ba'i lnga mchod chos thog nyin bdun bcas so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi spyi — 711 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/lo1958lor bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i chab srid las 'gul khrod du ma lus par bshigs nas rtsa med du yal lo/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i me stag spyi lo1986lor slar yang dgon pa gsar du bzhengs shing / lo 'dir rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis nang bstan chos spyod spel sa bya rung ba'i chog mchan gnang / da lta lha khang gyan brgyad bzhengs kyang btsun pa bzhugs mi ha cang nyung ngo / /khung lham dgon pa/khung lham dgon pa zhes pa ni/ da lta 'i su'u nan rdzong gi khang lus khul gyi hung hri wo(phre1tho tshi)'ang du 65gas/dgon chung 'di spyi lo172 2lo'i sngon yul gyi gtso bo dang shar 'gug mkhan pa'i shog pa'i mchod gzhis bgyis te btab cing / ches dar ba'i dus su grwa tshogs zhal sum brgya 'dus te chos spyod rgya cher spel/ go thos ltar na khung zhi gong ma yul der zhabs bcags shing zhabs cag gnang bas dgon mtshan la khung lham zhes thogs par grags/ yul gyi chos sde che shos yin pas/ der dgon lag tu gser dong dgon(zlotsho'ir+sha)dang / chos 'khor dgon(blo rgyal dgon) ting 'dzinadagon chos rgyal gling(lung dmar dgon) pad+ma'i sde/'bum tshogs dgon(tsho ཿr+sha) lung ring dgon/ chu lung bkra shis dgon(7khri༅r+shayo+ozor+sha)bcas bdun yod/ snga phyir mkhan po lngas bdag skyong mdzad pa la rjes ma'i mtshan la blo bzang bsam gtan nyi ma zer te/ 195 2'o ra sku gshegs so/ /bar skabs shig la sku 'bum byams pa gling gi dgon lag byas kyang nang ma 'cham par phyir bkar/ mchod gzhis la mgo ba che bo tsho ba dang / shar tsho 'gu mkhan po/ modze15nga/ za ༅nga/ braza gar rge/ ༈rmophoza ༅16zo la sogs yod/ 1926lor dmar dmag rgyang du skyod par dgon du gnas tshang g.ya ra nas cung bsdad pa la he jag lte bo mā pu h+phang gis phung dkrugs nas dgon pa mer btang / phyis su yu gur ba rnams kyis tshogs gsog dge sbyong gi dgos mkho zhal 'debs 'bul nom bsdus nas thub pa'i lha khang chung ba zhig bzhengs// 1955lor dgon du grwa mang 'al gya bzhi bzhugs pa la sprul sku gnyis dang / dge slong so brgyad/ ban de zhe bzhi 'dus/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor spyi tshogs gsar brje'i nang dgon pa bsnubs/ 19rnga6lo'i zla11pa'i nang su'u nan rdzong srid gzhung gis slar gso'i chog mchan gnang nas dgon shul du lha khang khang mig gsum/ tsam dang le lag khang chung mig gsum phub ste lo re'i chos spyod sna tshogs ci thub byed bzhin mchis so/ /chos 'khor dgon/chos 'khor dgon pa(7yo6lo༅lomochazlo༅r+sha)ni/ su'u nan rdzong gi khāng lham sa khul gyi chen lung zhang du chags/ khāng lham dgon pa'i dgon lag yin/— 712 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dang thog blo rgya'i 'brog sar btab cing zi ko tsho bas mchod bkur bgyis/ 'khon sgam yang zer te btsun pa ba'i brgya lhag 'dus myong la gar rge tsho ba dang mnyam du bskyangs mod/ phyis tsho khag nang ma 'cham par dgon pa 'di kha bkar nas chos 'khor dgon pa btab skad/ 1926lor dgon pa bsnubs/ phyis su rnam pa chung ngu 'ig slar gsos/ 1955lor dgon du btsun pa bcu gnyis 'al bzhugs/ sa khyi 'o ra dgon pa yang gsar brje'i las 'gul nang rtsa ba nas bsnubs gshis da snga slar gsos med do/ /pad+ma'i sde/pad+ma'i sde'am pad+ma'i dgon ( ༅lor+sha) zhes pa ni/ su'u nan rdzong gi men hwa sa khul pad ma 'ang du chags/ ho gling dkar tshang du gtogs/ ching rgyal rabs kyi dus phyag 'debs mdzad/ sngon chad ho gling dkar zhes pa'i tsho mgo gzhon pa'i khong gtogs skya ser dang g.yang gling dkar zer ba'i tsho mgo'i mi ser thun mong gis mchod gnas byed/ rgya nag dpon chen tso tsung thang nub tu bskyod dus dgon pa bsnubs/ rjes su dad ldan yu gur ba'i mi ser gyis bskyar du bzhengs shing bcings 'grol yar sngon du btsun pa sum cu rtsa grangs zhal 'dus pa dang / dgon bdag dngos ni ko kyāmakhan po bzhugs/ lo re'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes lngar grwa mang tse yon dgon du phyag phebs nas smon lam gsungs/ khri ba dang bo'i mtshan la ko yen tru(molo7) zer/ khri rabs gnyis pa ni ko kyā blo bzang zer ba bzhugs/ da snga slar gsos med do/ /'bum tshogs dgon/'bum tshogs dgon pa(walor+sha)zhes pa ni/ su 'u nan rdzong gi min hwa khul min he zhang du chags/g.yang gling dkar gyi khongs su gtogs/thog ma/ra dgon pa ni g.yang gling dkar(༅4༈spo)zhes pa'i bla dpon gzhon pa'i khongs gtogs su btab cing kho tshos mchod bkur bdag dam bgyis/ ching rgyal dus su btab pa'i nang dgon gsar ma'i grub mtha' can te spyi lo1kha42lor dgon du grwa ba bco brgyad tsam bzhugs/ dgon pa re zhig bla ma 'jam mo bla ma mnga' ru gtad cing / dus rgyun du ko kyā ho pe li ke(ཿtso7 lko//tho)zhes pas skyong khur bzhes/ rab rgyal sa khyi lor dgon pa bsnubs/ 1kha86lor lu gur ba'i ma nga tshogs kyi re 'dod ltar rdzong gi sla/ra gso'i chog mchan thob ste lha khang mig drug bzhengs/ chos spyod spel mi gsu ma rgyun bzhugs gnang nas lo re'i zla dang bo'i nang byed sgo chung gras re yod do/ /shes rab dgon/shes rab dgon(poḥr+sha) zhes pa ni/ kun ju dang su'u ju'i lho mtshams su btab/— 713 —

krang dbye sa khul su'u nan(su'u lho)yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa ni sngon chad krang ye mkhar gyi lho nub phyogs su chags/ spyi lo1644lo'i sngon du gong ma 'i dbu bla sngags drang srong(dbus pa)zhes pas phyag 'debs mdzad/ khāng zhi gong ma sa khong la bka' 'gyur mtshal dpar ma pota brgya dang brgyad can bstsal / khong gi pho brang dgon par bcos/ gtsug lag khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ 'di bas dgon pa legs por skyong khur mdzad 'phror dge slong li'u blo bzang lta bu dang kra'o bstan pa rgyal mtshan zhes pas mu mthud rgya bskyed du bzhengs/ chin rgyal skabs nas ma thel lam rta rmig dgon pa'i dgon lag tu bgyis shing bod dang yu gur thun mong gis mchod gzhis sam gan ju'i las shag der tshugs/snga mar dgon du gsung 'bum lha khang dang / srung ma khang / 'jigs byed lha khang / 'du khang sogs khang mig nyis brgya lhag bzhengs/ da lta ni dgon shul mi nyams tsam du slar gsos pa ma zad/ 1962lor zhing chen srid gzhung gis zhing chen rim pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob sde khag tu bkod do/ /su'u nan rdzong gi chos sde chung gras 'ga'/su'u nan rdzong gi bod rigs dang yu gur rigs dang rgya rigs thun mong du bkur ba'am sngon chad bod mis skyong khur byas pa'i chos sde 'ga' re yod de/ ha lam spyi lo1864lor 'jam dbyangs dgon pa 'jig pa'i rjes su hor mkhan po lags kyis bod mi rnams mchod gzhis yon bdag tu brten nas yu'o lin bā(7oṃm)zhes par dgon gong 'og gnyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ bar skabs shig la he dmag gis bsnubs/ de rjes hor mkhan po'i pho brang(yā min zer)der brtsigs so/ /tshe dpag dgon(zozor+sha)zhes pa ni hong khrin gyi dpa' rgyan zhang du yod de/ bla ma blo bzang zhes bya bas btab pa dang grwa tshogs rgyas pa'i dus su zhal bdun brgya 'dzoms myong bar grags la/ kha shas dge chos dgon yang zer ro/ /bkra shis dgon(ོཿr+sha)ni chu 'u nga bkra shis dgon pa'i le lag yin/ sngon chad 'du khang ngam lha khang rten dang brten pa/ grwa shag khang mig bco lnga la dge 'dun pa zhal grangs bcu phrag 'dus/ da lta shul tsam las lus med do/ /sems can skyob pa'i sde(:(༅r+sha)te cong chen dgon pa ni rdzong gi nub byang du chags/ 'jam dbyangs dgon pa'i le lag tu gtogs/ ko kyā mkhan pos skyong khur mdzad/ dgon 'di nas spyi lo1944lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la chi lan khul gyi slob grwa'i dge rgan gyi mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa dang / 1972lor dgon 'di su'u ju'u rdzong bdun gyi nang bstan mthun tshogs btsugs(rdzong bdun po ni/ co'u chon dang /go the/ an zhi/ tun hong / yu men/ cin tha/ tin zhin bcas)shing rgyal srid spyi khyab khang du snyan bsgron te gnas gal chen shig tu gyur to/ /

wu'u we sa khul wu'u we grong khyer gyi khongs/gcis tshogs gnyis kyi spa ngas rtogs mang bo mtho bar ba༅da pa yin༈ de lta bu rnams kyang mang du thos pa dang /mthong ba la brtso na pa chen po bskyed dgos par bshad/ lpa gas pa 'di 'a yon tan mang du yod/ khyod rang gi tshogs gnyis cung zad bas gas pa dang / kho bo'i smon lam gyi stobs kyis 'dir bslebs pa yin/ 'di la blta lugs ma nga du yod pas / sto na shes kyis bstan nas// blta shes kyis blta sa na sa ngas rgyas stong gi sku tshang ba dang / nye ba'i sra sa brgyad kyang bzhugs nga/ yin gsungs / phyogs 'di nas bzung ste 'di ba'in ston cig ces zhal b.lod ma dzad pas / sa ngas rgyas stong gi sku dang nye sras brgyad sku gas la por mthong ba la der tshogs pa'i skye bo kun gyis ya ma tshan cher skyes kyang / gong ma cung zad 'al mnong ba'i ngang nas/ khyod sa mtha'i ban de kha bdar byed ba'in byung / nga blon po'i tshogs dud 'gro'i dkyil du brgyab gsu ngas sa paṇa gyi 'al nas / skye bo ma nga tsam nas kha bdar bya dgos ci byung / sems can kun gyi skyes gzugs dang nang sems kyi rgyu ba ri/ gcig pa kun chos nyid yin gsu ngas kyang cung zad ma ma/nyes/ de nas 'ag mi mang ba na blon po'i tshosas la / rgyal ngo/'i 'al nas / nga'i ma chod gnas mkhas pa yin pa'i dbyibs su 'dug 'on kyang rang cag rnams dud 'gro'i dkyil du brgyab pa la / kho bo cung zad spro ba dman par 'dug kho la lan cung zad byed pa yin gsungs / sgyu ma khan rnams/ bsdus nas sngags rdzas bsgrub tu bcug ste yul kham sa yid du 'ong 'ing gtsug 'a ga khang so gas dgon nga 'i rnam pa shin tu legs par sprul nas yo na mchod rnam gnyis phan tshun 'khor mang bo dang bcas phebs / sde 'di ni spyi lo1 2 5 1lo'i rjes tsam btab/ bca chen gyis mkhyen nas khyed thams cad sngon la rgyugs / nga ma jug nas yo/nga gsungs nas/ sgo srung gis khro bo spru la 'dug pa la bka' bsgos shing sgyu ma/ bshig ma/ thub par byin gyis brlabs pas sprul5 ba'i sde zhes grags so / /de nas rgyal bor dad pa thob pas zab chos ma/nga bo zhus / bsnyen bkur bsam gyis ri khyab nga/ ma dzad/ de ltar lo lnga tsam ring bzhugs/ sde bzhi sogs gnas rnams 'a 'bas kyis bcags zhing byin gyis brlabs nas bstan 'gro'i sman yon dam par 'gyur nges dang / khyad par du hor go dan rgyal pos thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gang mang gnang ba'i 'og tu sprul ba'i sde rgya skyed ma dzad/ sa paṇa dgung 'o bdun cu'i thog spru la pa'i sde nas 'das pas rgyal pos sku gdung la mchod pa rgya chen po bgyis/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung mchod rten chen po stod cha bka' gdam sa gdung rten gyi dbyibs can/ mtho tshad lag 'dom bcu drug yod pa legs par bzhengs/ chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs ma khas grub du mas rab gnas mdzad cing byin rlabs kyi gter chen por bsgrubs/ ma/chod rten brgya rtsa brgyad du grags pa'i mchod rten che chung du ma mchis pa mis grangs mi lon pa mkha' 'gro'i sprul ba'i mchod rten yin pas sprul pa'i sde zhes pa thogs kyang zer/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus su sa skya'i dgon sde 'dir dge 'dun stong tsam yod pa zhig chags / lha khang che ba'i rgyab kyi mchod rten nang bzhugs tsha 'bum 'gangs chen/ sa par+ṇa yab sra sa kyi sku ring la lha khang dang grwa shag sogs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i ngo mtshar ba du ma yod pa me 'jig sogs rkyen dbang gis rim par nyams/ rab byung bdun pa'i — 716 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/lcags pho khyi spyi lo14 20lor ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma zhon nyes bod kyi ban de bsod nams rgyal mtshan la skye'o zhen thung hu'i ku shri zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/ ku shri dbu bla des sprul pa'i sde dang mchod rten dkar po bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ de nas dus 'khrug la sogs pa byung bas bod brgyud nang ba'i chos sde 'di slar yang nyams/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing pho stag spyi lo1674lor lang jus kyi srid skyong mdzad pa'i dmag dpon chen mo the tu zung h+phu kra'o dang pad+ma sgang byam/sa pa lha khang gi bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyis gron dngul mang bo bsdus nas lha khang dang bcas nyams gso bgyis/ gsar bzhengs lha khang che bar dbus su rdo rje 'chang /g.yas g.yon du phyag rdor sgrol ma/ g.yas su thub dbang / g.yon du mchog bzung / de'i g.yas su sa ngas rgyas mthong ba don yod/ g.yas g.yon du rab 'byor dang 'od srung / gtso bo'i g.yon du 'od dpag med/g.yas g.yon du dpa' bo ser po dang mdzes dga' sngon po/ de'i g.yon du sman gyi bla ma/ g.yas g.yon du thul dang ming chen/ shar nub kyi gral la nye sras bzhi re/ g.yas gral mthar rta mgrin dbyug to can/'dis sngon lha khang me 'jig byung bar zhabs ya gcig chu 'gram du ba'ag phyag gis chu gtor bas me zhi ba'i ngag rgyun snang / g.yon gyi gral mthar mi g.yo ba sngon po/ gnam rgyan ling tshe che ba drug gi dbus ma la thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug g.yas su gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur 'a khro bcu g.yon du thub dbang nye sras kyis bskor ba/ mdun dbus mar kun rig dang g.yas g.yo na du mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag med gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ ling tshe chung ba nyis brgya drug cu'i ngos su sgo steng du khro bo bzhi/ gzhan rnams la bshags lha so lnga/rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang bcas lha sku nyis stong drug brgya yod par yi ga rnying du bshad/ g.yas g.yon gyi logs bris phreng drug re yod pa'i g.yas kyi dang bos 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bla rabs dang / rdo rje 'chang / te lo/ nā ro/ mar ba/ mi la/ sgam po ba/ phag gru sogs/ gnyis par thams cad mkhyen pa rje blo bzang grags pa/ 'jam dkar ba/ grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs/ gsum par dus 'khor gyi lha sku kha shas/ bzhi bar sna tshogs grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rigs kyi yum lnga/gshin rje gdong drug gi yum lnga/ 'khor chen yum lnga'i lha tshogs/ 'jigs byed sogs/ lnga bar sgrol ma/rnam 'byor rgyud lase byung ba'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can ma/ spyan ras gzigs dkar dmar gnyis/ rnam rgyal ma/ lo gyon ma rigs kha shas/ las gshin bcas/ drug par 'od zer can ma/ rnam sras/ rdza nag dzi ser/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis/ las gshin dmar bo/ g.yon ngos dang por sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birlu ba sogs sa skya'i lam 'bras brgyud pa/ gnyis par sa bzang paṇa chen/ 'khor chen bla brgyud/ bu ston rin po che/ lo chen shākya bzang po sogs/ sna tshogs yum/ gsum par dus 'khor gsungs pa'i yum drugaphreng ba bzhi bar gshin rje gdong drug rigs lnga/ 'jigs byed zhal gsum sogs rigs lnga/ gshed dmar rigs lnga/ 'khor chen rigs lnga/ lnga bar sbas lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig drug par phyag rdor gtum po/— 717 —

sa na gas tsho'alha ra gyikhongs mi g.yo ba rigs gnyis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs gsum/ rig ma bcu drug sgo'i steng ngos dus 'khor/thub dbang / chos rgyal bdun/ rigs ldan nyer lnga/ sras tshangs dbang dang lha dbang / tshangs dbang sras 'od srung / dus zhabs pa che chung / kha che zla mgon/ 'brom lo tsā ba sogs dus 'khor bla brgyud/sgo chen g.yas logs su 'khor lo sdom pa rigs lnga/ mgon po phyag bzhi ba dang de'i brgyud pa/ sgo'i g.yon phyogs su kyai rdor rigs lnga/ bdag med ma/ kun runye/ yang kyai rdor rigs kha shas/ gur mgon lha mgon bcu gnyis/ khyung chen sngon po sogs yab kyi pho nya/ ru 'dren sde bzhi sogs yum gyi sprul pa'i pho nya/de nyid kyi bla rgyud/ phyi'i shar gyi bya 'dab gong mar 'od dpag med kyi sku bcu gnyis/ phyogs gzhan gsum la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zhe dgu/ de bzhin lha khang la rnying skyon che zhing sngon nas yod par bshad kyang chos rje yab sras kyi sku dus byon pa logs bris bla sku 'ga' nas shes nus so/ yi dam bstan srung du ma'i sman sku sna tshogs bzhugs pa'i lha khang gsar ba 'ga' zhig snang / lo rgyus kyi yig cha sogs dkon pas bla sprul dang ser mo ba'i grangs ga gdan rabs rim byon/ chos 'chad nyan/ dpal 'byor yong sgo la sogs rtsad ma chod par lus/ rab rgyal me mo yos spyi lo1927lor lang jus phyogs su sa g.yos chen po byung bas lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten thams cad rtsa gtor thebs so/ /da lta mchod rten dkar po'i shul tsam mthong thub pa dang gna' rdzas la bod rab byung bdun pa'i lcags pho khyi spyi lo1420lor btsugs pa'i rdo ring zhig lus so/ /lang ju sde bzhi las nub pad+mo'i sde/nub pad+mo'i sde(tshokhyilor+sha)zhes pa ni/ lang ju mkhar nas nub ngos spyi le bco lnga tsam gyi sar bzhengs yod/ ga tshod bzhengs pa dang bzhengs mkhan su yin pa ni mi gsal/gnas 'dir sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdo phyogs kyi bka' chos mang bo gnang zhes gong sa lnga ba'i deb ther nas gsungs/ zam sna'i lha khang na rje btsun byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs sogs dang / de'i g.yas phyogs kyi lha khang na kun rig gi lha tshogs bzhugs/ de nas yar la rim par lha khang rnams su lha mo 'od zer can ma/ spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso/ kun rig byams pa/ sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba/ thub dbang / mchog zung / sangs rgyas spyan ma sogs dang / yang lha khang zhig tu bla ma stong 'khor rin po che mdo rgyud rgya mtshos bton pa'i sman chu snang / gzhan lha khang mang bo yod/ nyin gyi lha khang chen mo de'i dbus kyi shing gi gdong ma ha cang mi sbom pa zhig yod pa de rang byon yin par grags/ rten gyi gtso bo chos rje sa paṇa gyi sring mo zhes pa bzod pa ring mo 'gying stabs su bzhugs pa khro nag gi lugs sku mi tshad tsam/ thub dbang grong gshegs pa'i rnam pa can de nyid kyi nang gzhug tu bzod pa ring mo'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel gdung rus sam tshems gnyis yod par gsungs/ sku'i thugs ka yan chad la nang rten dang khams sa'i — 718 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/—'dag sbyar byas pa mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren cing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang dus gsum sangs rgyas dang nye sras brgyad khro bo gnyis dang / g.yas kyi lha khang na tshe dpag med sogs lha sku mang bo dang / cung che ba de sngar sa 'og nas rnyed zer/ g.yon gyi lha khang na 'jigs byed sogs yi dam dang chos skyong zhabs tshang bzhugs/ gzhan lha khang zhig na o rgyan rang byon zhes grags pa zhig dang /ri rtse na 'jam dbyangs dmar ser dang mchod rten gcig bzhengs pa'i gnas ni sa paṇa gyi sku sring bzod pa ring mo zhes pa pad+mo'i sde 'dir sgom sgrub la bzhugs pa dang / de nyid sku 'das pa'i sa dang / sa paṇa gyis dbang gnang ba'i bum chu dang rdul tshon gshegs sa yin par grags/ mchod rten de'i bzo dbyibs ni rgya gar nas byung ba khang thog mang du brtsegs pa rnams kyang mchod rten yin tshul du bshad/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ lhung bzed kha spub pa lta bu'i mchod rten/ khang bu brtsegs pa lta bu'i mchod rten/ rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa lta bu'i mchod rten dang gsum gsungs pa'i gras yin gsungs so/ /mchod rten gyi nang du sangs rgyas sman bla sogs sku gzigs bzhengs legs shing mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'gug par 'gyur/ mchod rten byin can 'di la bskor ba lnga brgyas grub ces gsungs rgyun snang / g.yon phyogs kyi lung ba'i chu mig cig gi 'gram du bzod pa ring mos rdo chen po g.yag nyal tshod tsam zhig la zhabs g.yon pa gtad nas phyir bsnur pas sngar med pa'i chu byung zer ba'i grub chu dang zhabs rjes 'dra ba mchis/ ri gdong gi lha khang du rgyal ba byams pa dang rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol ma/ de'i rgyab kyi lha khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas/ g.yon phyogs kyi lha khang na thub dbang mchog zung dang bcas pa mang bo bzhugs/ yon rgyal rabs kyi mjug mthar dus 'khrugs bslangs pa dang spyi lo1927lor lang jus su sa g.yos chen po byung nas pad+mo'i sde 'di rtsa gtor du 'jig par gleng ngo / /lang jus sde bzhi las lho dbang sde/lho dbang sde(༅༅r+sha)zhes pa ni/ mkhar grong gi lho phyogs su chags pa de mkhar las rgyang thag spyi le bco lnga yod/de yang sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog hor go dan rgyal pos gdan drangs pa bzhin lang jus sogs su byon nas shar sprul pa'i sder rgyal bo 'khor bcas la zab chos mang bo gnang ba dang / lho dbang sde nas rgyal bo 'khor bcas la dbang chen mang bo gnang / 'gro mgon 'phags pas rgyal po gser gyi ska rags can la dbang chen gnang ba'i gnas yin pas mtshan la dbang sde zhes btags/ sa paṇa yab sras mchog gis chos sde 'di la rgya skyed mdzad/ 'du khang gi nang du bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo dang 'khor nyan thos sogs sde 'di'i mchod rten lha sku rnams skyabs rje sa skya paṇa chen gyi dus su bzhengs skabs na nang rdzong la byin rten sna tshogs dang / sku rgyu 'jim pa la sme brtsegs dang rnam 'joms ma'i bum chus sbags — 719 —

wu'u we sa khul wu'u we grong khyer gyi khongs/skabs su lha de gnyis dngos su thim pa'i snang ba byung zhing / khyad par thub dbang 'di nyid 'bad rtsol cung tsam gyis rang grub ltar byung zhing / rab gnas skabs 'ja' tshon shar ba bcas ye shes pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas hor rgyal po 'khor la dbang chen mang bo gnang skabs kyi rdul tshon gyi stegs kyi rdo rngams su sor lnga/ ngos re la mtho lnga re yod pa de dang / de'i rgyab tu dus gsum sangs rgyas dang nyan thos byang sems sogs bzhugs/ paṇa chen yab sras kyi dus su lab bzhi'i sbyin sreg byas pas drag po'i skabs su khro ba'i tshogs kyis bstan 'gro'i gdon gegs rnams bkug nas thab tu bcug pa'i gnas der bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten chen po zhes pa bzhengs pa byin can du grags/ 'di'i nang du o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel bya sgong tsam dang / slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten mang bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma mang bo'i rten sna rdzas sna mang bo dang / bla ma dri ma med pa'i phyag phreng so/gas kyis gang ba'i tsan dan go sha'i mchod rten gser shun mas g.yogs pa khru gang ba bla ma dri ma med pas rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs la gnang ba yin zer ba de rnams bzhugs/ sngar nas bzung dus chen la 'ja' dang 'od 'char zhing / dri bzang 'thul ba/ me tog gi char 'bab pa/ rol mo'i sgra sgrog pa sogs byung / rang byung bcu ba'i ba'i chu pho sprel spyi lo1892lo'i dbyar dus ser ba drag po zhig byung dus mchod rten gyi rtse nas 'ja' 'od lta bu zhig byung nas/ rdo char zhu ba la rgya mi mang bos mthong nas dad pa skyes/ gnas 'di rgyal bo gser gyi ska rags can gyi dur sa yin par grags/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs sogs gsum gsum dang /sa skya paṇa chen dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa nye sras brgyad/ khro bo gnyis/ rgyab khang mun pa che ba zhig na khri mthon po'i khar sa skya paṇa chen gyi sku 'dra dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yod/ mdun gyi lha khang gi dbus mar tshe dpag med dang 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ g.yas na mgon po phyag ba'i ba gtso 'khor gsum sogs lha bcu gcig dang / g.yon du gur mgon dang lha mo sogs lha bcu gcig yod/ gur mgon nam mgon po bde dbyug can rnying ba sa skya paṇa chen gyi dus la bzhengs nas paṇa chen gyis bka' bsgos pa/nang du gcod pa bram ze nag po'i sgom thag dang dbu skra/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi phyag dpe sogs rten mang bo bzhugs/ 'dir lha khang rnams kyi rtsig ngos kun la sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi bris sku ni go mtshams med par gtams so/ /sa skya ba'i rjes su rkam pa'i bla ma mang bo gnas 'dir byon te nang ba'i chos dar bar mdzad/ da dung ri bo dge ldan pa'i bla ma mang bo gnas 'dir byon myong / 'on kyang sa cha 'dir rgya mang zhing bod ha cang nyung bas rim gyis rgya dgon du gyur/ spyi lo1927lor lang jus phyogs su sa 'gul chen po byung ba'i skabs su lho dbang sde la nyams nyes gang yang ma byung / spyi lo1956lo nas1958lo'i bar sde 'di lha khang dang bcas pa thams cad rtsa gtor btang ste steng du slob grwa zhig btsugs/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten de la gtor gshig thebs nas da lta shul tsam las ci yang med par gyur to/ /— 720 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lang ju sde bzhi las byang rgya mtsho'i sde/byang rgya mtsho'i sde( ༅༅r+sha)zhes pa ni/ deng sang wu'u we grong khyer gyi byang phyogs su chags shing mkhar las rgyang thag spyi le gnyis lhag yod/spyi lo1487lor btab/ gnas 'di sngon hor go dan rgyal po la klu nad gtong mkhan gyi klu gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa gzhi yin la/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gyi bum bzang las dam chos zab mo lhug par bstsal nas gdul bya rnams la thar ba'i sa bon thebs par mdzad pa'i gnas chen yin/ de dus kyi gnas sgo zhes grags pa'i khron chu byin rlabs can du brtsis pa yod/ rten gtso la mchod rten byin can/dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nye sras/ rdo rje 'chang / rnam snang / tshe dpag med/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs dang / rwa ba'i khyams logs su bris sku sna tshogs/ 'jigs byed/ chos skyong du ma bzhugs pa'i mgon khang / rgya'i bka' 'gyur dang / rgya ban smug chas can gyi sde yang yod/ sde 'di yon rgyal rabs dus mjug tu dmag 'khrug byung bas lha khang dang bcas pa gtor bshig byas/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu yos nas me lug spyi lo148 2lo nas1487lo'i bar lang jus phyogs kyi rgya'i dmag dpon krang pin gyis gtso 'gan khur te byang rgya mtsho'i sde de bskyar bzhengs rgya chen po byas pa nas rim gyis rgya dgon du gyur/ khang zhi rgyal po khrir bzhugs skabs slar yang nyams gso byas nas brjid sngar las che na'ang sa khyi'i lor bsnubs/rab rgyal chu yos spyi lo1986lor grong khyer srid gzhung gis byang rgya mtsho'i sde'i chos sgo phye chog pa'i chog mchan gnang / de nas rim gyis lha khang nyams gsos dang sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gsar bzhengs mdzad de lbu'u lbe phyogs kyi rgya brgyud nang bstan gyi dgon chen zhig tu gyur to/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo'i sde/dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo'i sde(zoyi ༅r+sha)zhes pa ni/ sngon chad lang ju'i bod lung tsho drug la gtogs pa dang / da lta'i gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul wu'u we grong khyer gyi khongs su chags/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos sde 'di nyid phal cher sa rta spyi lo705lor btab/ phyag 'debs gnang mkhan su yin pa mi gsal/chos sde'i rten gyi gtso bo rdo rje phag mo lo rgyus can ni/ sngar yul 'dir shan pa grang thu zer ba'i lag nas bu mo lo brgyad ma zhig gi glo snying yang yang nyos/ lan gcig shan pas glo snying gi rin phyir btsal nas song ba'i tshe/ gnas 'di'i bu mo lnga dang bcas pas tshogs rdzas bzhes kyin 'dug ces grags gang ltar yang mkha' 'gro ma kha shas dang bcas dpal mo'i dga' ston la longs spyod par mthong / shan pas rin ma thob pa'i lus dang bcas pa'i gtso mo de bzung bas gzhan rnams nam mkha' la 'phur/ gtso mo de nyid bar snang la cung zhig 'phags kyang sku khams 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du lus/ skal ldan gyi shan pa la yang dad pa thob/bod kyi man lung gu ru'i zhal nas/ sngar 'dom gang lhag tsam gyi nam mkhar zhugs zhes gsungs/ grub thob — 721 —

wu'u we sa khul wu'u we grong khyer gyi khongs/ma de nyid kyi dus su mtho gang tsam gyis zhabs sa la ma reg par bzhugs/ sku de la 'jim pa cung zad g.yogs pa yin zer/ sngar dus chen rnams la bdud rtsi babs pa sogs byin rlabs shin tu che/ de'i g.yas su ston pa'i 'jim sku'i nang du las dag shan pa'i gdung sbos par bshad/ gtso bo'i g.yon du rdo rje 'chang dang /de'i g.yon du sgrol ma'i sku/ de nas tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i brag khung nas cung zad bgrod dka' ba'i skor lam la rim pa bzhin myang 'das dang / rnam rgyal/ bkra shis sgo mang sogs kyi mchod rten/ yang na mchod rten nag po rtse gsum can zhig gi steng du sngar gyi glo snying gna' dus su bkal skad/ gzhan lha khang rnams su spyan ras gzigs sogs lha sku mang bo dang g.yas kyi gdong na mchod rten gcig dang g.yon na mchod rten gcig bzhugs/ rgya gar gyi grub chen nyer bdun dang / sa skya ba dang kurma ba'i bla ma mang bo sde 'dir byon/rab rgyal me mo yos spyi lo1927lor wu'u we phyogs 'dir sa g.yos chen po byung bas dpal ldan phag mo sde'i sku gsung thugs rten tshang ma brlags shing brag khung thams cad 'jig go/rab rgyan shing phag spyi lo1995lor skyabs mgon bla ma sangs rgyas dpal ldan mchog zi khron nas wu'u we sa char phebs te sde 'di'i rjes shul du rdo rje phag mo'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel rnyed de zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku gdung mchod rten slar bzhengs/ da lta wu'u we grong khyer rig rdzas do dam khang gis gong rim la snyan zhu phul te khyon yongs nas nyams gso byas so/ /

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling /mdo smad byang rgyud kyi chos sde chen po dpa' ris mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling(zangar+sha)zhes mtshan snyan gyi nga ro ring nas rgyal khab phyi nang du grags pa nyid ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs/ da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris khongs kyi lho nub mtshams/ mtsho sngon hu'u kru'u rdzong dang 'dabs 'brel/ 'ju lag chu chen gyi nyin ngos 'gram bcar du gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang sa pad ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs bkra shis rtags brgyad ldan pa'i sa dge bcu tshang bar chags shing / sa gzhi bde zhing khod snyoms mtsho tshad smi2 262'phags pa'i gnas su yod/dgon pa ni sngon spyi lo777lor gnas 'dir g.yung drung dgon zer ba'i bon dgon zhig tu chags/de nas lo lnga brgya dang gya gsum lon pa na rab byung drug pa'i lcags pho byi spyi lo1260lor kurma rol ba'i rdo rje lang ju phyogs su phebs skabs 'ju lag pa rnams kyis zhus pa ltar/ klu bdud shin tu gdug pa chu 'gram gyi mi phyugs mang po la gnod pa che ba btul te dam la btags shing dam rtags su bkra shis thang der mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ bon dgon de kurma pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ de nas bzung mchod rten thang dgon pa zhes yongs su grags/ garma'i grub mtha' lo nyis brgya brgyad cu gya bdun brgyud/ rjes su 'ju lag gi tsho sde/sngo kho/ rgya tig stobs tshang ba rnams kyis gros mthun gyis dge dgon 'debs par bla ma stong 'khor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho la zhus/ khong gis mchod rten thang gi gnas 'di sa bkra legs shing / phyogs 'dir 'chad nyan dang gdul bya rgyas par gzigs nas/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me phag(1647)lor dge ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bshad sgrub kyi chos sde chen po bkra shis dar rgyas gling zhes pa rgya bskyed du phyag 'debs mdzad/ chu 'brug(1652)lor rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po rgya nag tu chibs sgyur mdzad lam bar dpa' ris tsho ba so drugadagon sde bcu gsum gyis jag rung thang du thab bsu zhag bzhugs zhus/ khri 'bul brgyab/ jag rung zhes pa ming mi legs gsungs nas bkra shis phyug lung zhes bcos/ lnga ba chen po'i dngos slob pham mdor rab 'byams pa dam chos rgyal mtshan pas dor zhi dge ldan nor bu'i gling gsar 'debs kyi 'du khang bzhengs par rab gnas zhus pa na/ rta lam tsam yod pa'i dor zhi'i 'du khang du phyag 'bras gtor ba babs zhes grags/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung ltar dgon pa'i srung ma lha mo dang tshangs pa bsten/ bsam blo lha rams pas 'dan ma tshul khrims rgya mtsho mtshan nyid kyi bla mar zhus nas/ bsdus grwa blo rtags/ don bdun cu/dge 'dun nyi shu chis 'khor/ skabs brgyad pa/ dbu ma/ mdzod/ 'dul ba bcas kyi 'dzin grwa — 723 —

lu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/btsugs shing / gzhung bka' po ta lnga'i brtsi bzhag mdzad/ phar phyin dam bca' yar bud khrod nas lo rer dka' bcu ba gnyis re ming 'dogs gnang ba'i srol spel ba sogs kyis mtshan nyid dar/ bar skabs shig la bod dbus dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ dgon lung sogs su grwa mang slob gnyer du phebs pa dang /rang dgon du'ang dpe gzigs gnang ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du byung / grwa tshogs rgyas pa'i skabs su dge 'dun pa brgyad brgya lhag zhal 'dzoms/ mchod rten thang ban brgyad brgya zhes kha dpe yod/ stong 'khor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho nyid kyis tshogs 'don dang sgrig lam sogs zhal bkod gnang zhing / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsugs pa bcas kyis sde 'di'i 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba'i srol btod/ stong 'khor sku phreng lnga ba bsod nams rgya mtsho rgyun bzhugs gnang nas bdag gir mdzad cing / bca' yig chen po bzhag ste 'chad nyan gong 'phel gyi thabs la 'bad/ lam rim/ bskyed rdzogs/ lcags ma khar sogs mdo sngags zab chos mang po'i khrid dang / rdor phreng sogs spyi zur bka' chos mang bo'i dbang lung gnang ba dang / gtor sgrub rnying bar grags pa'i dben sa lugs kyi lcags mkhar zhwa nag pa'i 'cham sogs 'dzugs par mdzad/ stong 'khor sku phreng drug pa 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gtor sgrub gsar bar grags pa'i chos rgyal phyi sgrub kyi gtor chen shin tu gnyan cha can dang mdo sngags kyi chos thog mang bo btsugs pa dang phyag len dri ma med pas rim bzhin bskyangs/ 'du khang dang lha khang snga gzhug tu che chung bcu gsum bzhengs pa dang / stong (rakhor nang chen/ sngo kho sgar/ thur bzhes sgar/ ma zur sgar/ me phye sgar/ tshang nga sgar/ skya bo sgar/stobs tshang sgar/ rgya tig sgar sogs sgar khag bco brgyad dang grwa shag mang bo phub/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me phag lo(spyi lo1647)la btab nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi'i bar lo sum brgya dang bcu gcig 'das bar du sa 'gul dang me chu'i 'jig pa'am/ chu yos dus zing / thong ṭi dang kwang zhi'i dus su hos dmag gi gnod pa sogs thebs ma myangs pa'i dgon rnying khyad par can zhig yin stabs/ lha khang 'du khang gi bzo bkod dag gna' dus kyi khyad chos mngon par 'phags shing sku rnying dpe rnying lo rgyus rgyu mtshan mang du yod pa 'ig yin la chos srid zung gi sgo nas skyong khur gnang ba'i bla ma dang skyes chen dam pa'ang mang bo byung ngo / /da ni 'dir dgon bdag bla ma stong 'khor sku phreng rim byon gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/gsol 'debs rgyal kun ma ltar na/ sngon sangs rgyas log par dad sel gyi sku'i sprul ba zhig la bsod snyoms phul te dam chos 'dzin par gsol ba btab pa bram ze'i khye'u go 'phang / dga' ldan du byams mgon sras po zhi ba'i blo gros zhing 'dir ston pa'i nyan thos zhi ba'i sgra dbyangs/ sum cu rtsa gsum du lha'i bu sprin gyi phreng ba/kha ba can du srong btsan chos blon thon mi sam bho ṭa/ o rgyan thugs sras g.yu sgra snying bo/ 'brom ston pa'i sras mchog dge bshes po to ba(10 27—1104)dang / rje tsong kha ba'i dngos slob 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan(1224da 1424) gzhon nu grags pa 'jigs med ni rgya gar phyogs su 'khrungs te sngon — 724 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/gom sa yon tan gyis thugs brgyud bltams shing / lung rigs dri ma med pa'i sgo nas gzhan sde mu stegs tshokas rnams lhad med du bcom te rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas par byas pa dag ni stong 'khor zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi skyes phreng dgu zhes grags/ son rgyal rabs byang ma'i dus su rgya nag gi btsun pa sku tshe stod la dmag dpon dang sku tshe smad la ri bo rtse lngar rtsa sngags 'grims pa'i h+pha hri zhes pa'i chos kyi bla ma byas pa yāng lwa'u sang stong 'khor mañju shri'i skyes phreng zhig yin zhes gsungs rgyun yod/ yo ngas grags su stong 'khor ram stong skor mañju shri'i sku phreng zla ba rgyal mtshan zhes te 'bod/ stor 'khor byang sems zla ba rgya' mtshan ni bar khams stong 'khor du tsar ngos kyi sar dong bu lung ba zer bar sbrang bu khyo shug gi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel(9476)lo sku 'khrungs/ yab kyis bon po'i bla ma cig la brtags par des khyod kyi bus shākya'i bstan pa zla ba bzhin du gsal ba dang / nged cag bon gyi bstan pa mun nag bzhin du sel pa'i snga ltas byung 'dug zer/sku gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing sems dpa' bkra shis rgyal mtshan sogs yongs 'dzin bsten/ mi nyag rab sgang phyogs nas thugs gnyer mdzad/ nag 'jigs skor gsum dang / dmag zor ma gtso bor bsten/dbus su thog mar ser byes kri bar phebs kyang thugs gnyer ma byung bas ser smad rong bo khams tshan du phebs /rong bo kirti chos rje mjal cing bsdus grwa nas phar phyin/ dbu tshad/ 'dul mdzod sogs zhib par sbyangs/rang yul du phebs nas sngon bon po'i dgon gnas bon khang sgang ba zhes pa'i sa cha bslangs te stong skor dgon gsang chen rdo rje gling btab/ gnas gzhi'i gtsug lag le lag byams sku thog tshad lnga ba sogs rten brten pa yongs rdzogs gsar du bskrun/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan btsugs/lcam sring chos skyong du bskos/ bka' 'gyur blus/ hor dpon zhig gis dmag khrid nas dgon pa gzhom du 'ongs pa la/ grwa tshogs kyi mthong sar chos skyong gis dpon de'i snying blangs te 'du khang du 'phangs pa kho rang 'phral du shi chos rje gzhon nu zer bas gza' rbad pa gzim chung gi ka steng du babs kyang gnod pa lta zhog 'gro ma nus pa snying rje mdzad/ chos rje de yang rag khrom zer ba'i g.yang du chas pa sogs nus mthu che ba'i snyan grags che/ dgung lo gya gcig pa rab byung dgu ba'i me 'brug(1556)lor sku gshegs so/ /stor 'khor sku phreng gnyis pa yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ bar khams wa to bho zhes pa rab byung dgu ba'i me sbrul(6557)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad par bsam grub rtser mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas rab tu byung / mkhan po dang / dka' bcu bsod nam/sa don grub sogs las dbang lung rjes gnang sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ 'jigs byed dang mgon dkar sogs lha du ma'i zha' gzigs shing skye ba mang bo dran/ rdza bkra shis bsam grub gling / rte shod/ spo mda' sogs 'bas kyis bcags/bstan 'gro'i don du dar rtse mdo dang / 'bum/ gling phyogs gnyis gang la phebs na legs pa'i rtags mang mdzad par phyi ma bzang bar babs te rong bo kirti dgon/ dwa tshang dgon/ dmu dge dgon/ zung chu dgon rnams su'ang phebs/ rnga ba'i mdzod dge phyogs su ra rong dpon slob chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i — 725 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/thub dbang dang / rje'i rtogs brjod gzigs pas thugs dad 'khrungs shing / phan tshun bla slob tu 'brel ba'i mnal ltas ngo mtshar ba rnam gnyis byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad/ dam pa de nyid kyi drung nas chos bka' gsan par ltas khyad par can du ma thon/ mdzod dge dpon po grags pa bsod nams kyis zhus te rnam thar ngo mtshar can mang bo bzhag sdom chu bzang rtse rgyal gyi sgar thog sogs su mdzad/ rta mgrin gyi rnal 'byor ba shes rab seṅge'i zhabs la gtugs/ klu sho ru chos bka' du ma gnang / chos rje dpal ldan bzang bo sogs dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang / co ne sa skyong khag gis bsus te yongs 'du'i rgyal khab(da lta'i co ne rdzong thog)tu phebs nas zla gcig tsam bzhugs/ tho ju'u brgyud gzhong ba kha gsum du chos bka' mang du gnang / slob dpon gyi zhal gzigs/ 'brug mtshor da lta'i co ne rdzong sho ba zhang gi khongs kyi gnas mtsho ngo mtshar 'khyil bar phebs dus mtsho smad kyi gzugs bstan/ dpon slob thams cad mtsho mjal ya mtshan pa byung bas dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho yin nam gsungs/ byams pa 'bum gling / han stag lung / kha gya/ rgan gya bcas dang /slar yang tho'u ju/ tsha rdor/ khu sha khra ba brgyud de co ne mdor phebs/ der rgyud sde spyi rnam rig 'dzin rol ba'i dga' ston brtsams/ bzhag sdom du lha srin gdug pa can du ma btul/ stag tshang lha mo'i gnas sgo phye/nyer gsum par mtsho kha nas rgyal ba bsod nams rgyal mtshor mjal bar chab cha theg chen gling du phebs/bsnyen rdzogs dang chos bka' mang bo zhus/ al than gyi mchod gnas su lo 'ga' bzhugs/ rgyal ba'i bka' ltar yang cha har du phebs te rdzu 'phrul gyis mtshun mchod pa'i rgyun bcad/ tā'i ming wan li rgyal bos gzengs bstod gnang / thu med kyis gdan 'dren byung yang ma phebs par chu rta la dbus su phebs/ 'bri chu'i khar las gshin gyi thod dbyug zam pa'i tshul du bzhag pa'i mtshan ma byung 'phral dar lam chags/ se 'bras dge gsum/ btsun mo tshal/ brag yer ba sogs dgon sde che phra du mar mang 'gyed dang / sde ba skyid shod pa dpon g.yog la rdor phreng gi dbang gnang / se ra'i mkhan khri lo shas bzhugs/ phyir lam 'bri gung brgyud rje drung shes rab dbang bor chos 'brel zhus/ chab mdo byams pa gling sogs la mchod mjal bgyis te rang dgon bkra shis lhun por phebs/ dgung lo so gcig pa rab byung bcu ba'i me phag(1587)lor sku gshegs so/ /hal ha mañju shri ur du su mañju shri rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas sprul sku gsum byung ba'i stong skor sku phreng gsum pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu ba'i sa byi(1588)lor bar khams stag bzang du sku 'khrungs/nang so bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gong ma'i sprul sku thag bcad de stong skor khri thog tu bkod/dwags po mkhas mchog chos rje'i sku skyes blo bzang bstan pa rgyal mtsho'i drung nas rab byung bsgrubs/ sngar zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis/ byang phyogs su 'brog sde chen po zhig 'byung / de nga'i gdul byar 'gyur zhes lung bstan dus thog tu babs te/ dgung lo bdun pa la mtsho khar kho lo che'i sde thog tu phebs pa la yol than gdung brgyud sku mched kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ ji gin sgam brag lha mo'i zhal gzigs/ stong che/ khri kha/ a rig — 726 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sogs su phebs/ phyir phebs kyis lo gsum bcad rgya la bzhugs pa grol mtshams/ phur tshe dbal shul sogs kyi dpon khag so so gdan drangs/ 'ji ska lha mo dar thang du phur tshe dpon po shes grags/ dbal shul dpon po 'bum skyabs yag mgo log dpon po a skyong / tshe 'bum thar rnams kyis chos mang du zhus/rma chu la gru brgyab ste dbal shul dpon rin chen khro rgyal byams sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ kirti/ dwa tshang / dmu dge zung chu'i sde dgon rnams dang mtsho khar phebs/ rgya sog gi chings mdzad/ skyid shod sde ba chos rje las bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs te rdor phreng gi dbang gsan/ o rod du gdan drangs shing dbus su phebs/ rgyal dbang bzhi ba yon tan rgya mtsho mchog (15ra9da 1616) mjal/ slar mtsho kha dang /dpa' ris yul gru/ lang kro'u(ju)sde bzhir phebs/ nga gnyis pa sa yos(1689)lor sku gshegs so/ /de'i phyir mngal du yang srid 'dzin ma dgos par grong 'jug gi lam nas stong 'khor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku gsum par ngos bzung ngo / /yang blu ba la dogs slong mdzad kyang / sngags bstan pa'i chos kyi bcud bzang bos/ /thugs brtse bas grong 'jug bde lam nas/ /dpal mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i skyes pa bzhes/ /zhes shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsungs las byung bas sgro btags sel/ mi ser bshad rgyun la/ stong 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyogs kyi nang du bzhugs nas kun kro'u sug chu'i 'gram du phebs par lam du wang kyā rgya phrug lo bcu dgu can zhig tsha brgyab ste shi ba'i ro dur du bskyal par 'phrad/ khong gis ro skyel mkhan rnams la/ khyod cag ro sgam kha phye dang / shi yod med lta zer bar rgya mi rnams kyis bod kyi bla ma 'di la shi bo gson por gtong ba'i thabs yod kyang srid snyam nas/ ro sgam sar bzhag ste kha phye ba dang / ro de gnyid las sad pa bzhin yar langs/rgya mi rnams shin tu dga' zhing / khyogs kyi mdun du pus mo btsugs nas sku drin zhus pa la/ bla mas kha mi gtam zhing / zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis bltas tshe/ khong khyogs kyi nang du gshegs nas gda'/ rgya mi tshos 'das log brgyab pa'i rgya phrug de la nga rang gi khyim du 'gro zer nas khrid/ rgya phrug gis kho la 'di na khyim med kho stong 'khor bla ma yin zer zhing / zhabs phyi ba dag gi ming la ci zer dang gang nas 'ongs/ gang la 'gro yi yod pa sogs gsal por gsungs pas kun gyi the tshom chod cing / stong 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprul sku yin par ngos 'dzin byas zer/ yi ge dang klog 'don gang yang slob ma dgos par sku tshe gong ma'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan thugs la mnga' ba'i tshul mdzad/ grong 'jug mdzad pa'i lo ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa yos(1629)lo yin/ de nas lo dgu song ba dgung lo nyer bdun me khyi(1646)lor dbus su byon/ paṇa chen bzhi ba blo bzang chos rgyan(1565 162 2)las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan mdo rgyud rgya mtsho bstsal/'bras spungs su rgyal dbang lnga ba chen por mjal ba dang / sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel dang / ku shri han gnyis kyis bkur gzo tshad med gnang / rgyal dbang la mdo mkhar du dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i gsol re zhus par bka' shog bstsal/ slar mtsho kha brgyud nas mdo mkhar du phebs shing / zi ling gi stong skor 'khor dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling btab/ 'du khang mgon khang sogs gsar du bskrun/ shing bya(1645)— 727 —

wu0wer0ladabalarisabod ra4skyothadzongogaspyalag lor dpa' ris mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling rgyas 'debs mdzad/ chu 'brug lor dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mo nas rgyal dbang lnga ba chen por mjal/ shing sprul(1665)lor rgya nag tu phebs nas men chin khang zhi rgyal bos chan zhi mañju shi'i lung phul/ ri bo rtse lnga brgyud bar khams stong skor du chibs bsgyur/dka' bcu shākya rgya mtsho sogs kyis dmu dger gdan drangs/ de dang mtsho khar lan mang bo phebs/ dpa' ris sa char sman chu dang bde mchog gi bla mtsho ngos bzung ste gnas sgo phye nas brag la phyag rjes dpar/ rong bo dgon chen
