dang gnya' gong brag dkar du phebs/ dmu dge dgon du byams khang / mgon khang / 'du khang /gzim chung bcas bzhengs nas sku gsung thugs rten du ma dang / bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur gnang /dgung lo re bzhi bzhes pa chu phag(1682)lor sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng lnga ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho ni/ shing byi ste spyi lo1684lor snang ra'i gram pa'i nang du/ ldong rigs gcan tsha'i dpon rgyud gtsug dor skyabs dang yum 'bum mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/sku mched brgyad byon pa'i che ba yin/ la mo zhabs drung blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan drung nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ tā la'i hu thog thu bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ rtse gdung zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dga' yongs 'dus dang / chos dpal 'byor/ ā+o kya don yod pa/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang nyi ma/slob dpon blo bzang bkra shis/ mtshungs med nam mkha' bsam grub/ rje dpal ldan chos skyong / sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ g.yer gshong sngags rams pa sogs las gsar rnying gi dbang rjes gnang 'u nga man ngag rgya cher gsan pas/ grub mtha' ris med la mkhas par grags/ khams stong skor dang co ne dgon chen sogs su phebs shing chu yos dus 'khrugs skabs g.yer gshong du bzhugs/ mdo mkhar dmag gis gtor ba slar yang rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug lor stong skor gyi da lta'i dgon thub bstan bshad sgrub gling 'di btab/ gcung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis srid don du rim mdzad pas kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i thugs sras su 'khrungs/ sku 'khrungs ma thag nas bsrungs pa dang gang ci'i do dam/dge tshul bsgrubs te rdor phreng sogs chos bka' mang du phul 'ing gdan sar bkod pa sogs kyi 'gan bzhes/rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho(1708da 1757)mjal/ zi ling stong skor dgon pa'i zla gsum pa'i bgeg gtor gyi 'cham ni nyid kyis dag snang du gzigs pa ltar btsugs/ dpa' ris mchod rten thang du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang rten brten pa bcas ngo mtshar can bzhengs/ bca' yig chen mo ba'ag nas 'chad nyan gong 'phel gyi thabs tshul lhur bzhes/ 'dzam dkar gter sgrub mdzad pas grwa rkyang rnams 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gyis mi phongs par gyur/ lam rim// bskyed rdzogs / lcags mkhar so gas kyi khrid rdor phreng sogs spyi zur bka'i dbang mang du gnang / chu stag(1722)lo'i zla dgu ba'i mar ngor rje nyid nas rdo rje slob dpon gnang ste dben sa lugs kyi lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa thang nag pa'i 'cham btsugs/ nyer dgu'i nyin thang nag pa 'du khang nang nas phyir 'bud skabs dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed du bskyed pa'i rwa rtse 'du — 728 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khang sgo'i ya them la thogs shing / dbu bkugs nas 'bud dgos pa byung bas phyis kyang phebs lugs de bskyangs/ 'du khang gi khyams rar rak+ta'i argam phul pa las gshin gyis gsol pa dang / mkhyen gsol shin tu gnyan par gsungs la gtor rgyag skabs 'brug sgra grag cing thog brgyab pa sogs kyi ltas 'dra min byung /rta mchog rna zhes pa'i ri rtser 'jigs byed kyi zhal phyag bcas zhal gzigs / phyag phur 'du khang gong ma'i ka ba zhig la btags/ phyis 'du khang la me 'jig thebs skabs phur bu dang ka ba ma tshig pas phur bu me thub ma zhes thogs shing rab rgyal sa khyi'i bar rten khrod du tshags/ dngos slob la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/g.yer gshong dge 'dun zla grags sogs byung / chu yos dus zing skabs mchod rten thang gi thag nyer rgya thang du dmag babs kyang dgon par skyon ma zhugs pa mgon 'di'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs yin par gleng / zi ling am bhan gyis btson du bcug par rdzu 'phrul gyis thar/ gsar rnying gnyi ga'i phyogs la gsan rgya che zhing grub mtha' ris med lta bu gnang yang mchod rten thang du rnying bon gyi cho ga byas mi chog pa bca' yig tu bkod cing chos skyong la gtad gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo re dgu bzhes mthar rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel(1752)lor ri bo rtse lngar phebs pa'i lam du sku gshegs so/sku phreng drug pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni shing khyi(1754)lor rong bo shing le khar sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng sku 'bum du chub bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi drung nas rab tu byung / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ 'jam dbyangs gzugs snang byung / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i drung nas rig gnas skor gyi dpe khrid dang dbang lung rjes gnang khrid man ngag chos bka' mang du gsan/ chan lung khri lo bzhi bcu ba shing lug la pe cin du gong mar 'tshams zhur phebs/slar dbus su phebs khar bkra shis 'khyil du byon nas kun mkhyen mchog gis thos bsam sgom pa mdzad tshul gyi bslab bya dang gsol ston thon dngul srang brgya sogs kyi phebs rdzong gnang / ser smad chos grwar bka' pota yongs rdzogs sbyangs/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ pha bong kha ba rgya mtsho mtha' yas/ se ra rtse'i dge bshes thogs med/ klong rdol bla ma sogs rtsod bral gyi mkhas grub du ma las chos bka' gsan/ 'bras spungs gtsang ba mkhan po/ mkhan po skal bzang dngos grub la yang chos 'brel bzhag dgung lo so gcig pa shing 'brug lo'i smon lam tshes bcu gsum nyin lha ldan du dam bca' ba'ag cing tsha rdor no min han gyis de 'phral ser smad mkhan khrir bskos pa'i bka' bsgyur 'byor/ 'grig lam gyi rting skul dang 'chad nyan phul tu phyin/ lcags po ri dang zhwa lu'i mkhan po mdzad/ de nas legs bshad snying bo'i yang 'grel/ kun gzhi'i 'grel ba/ seng gdong chos skor/ rta mgrin chos skor sogs ljags rtsom mang du mdzad/ slob ma 'bru la mkhan chen dung dkar sprul sku/ de mo yongs 'dzin/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ no mon han sprul sku/ byang rtse blo bzang dge legs/ ser smad kyi blo bzang thugs rje/ grags pa mkhas grub/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ stong skor dang mchod rten thang gnyi ga'i khri — 729 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/—ba tā dbon ngag dbang blo bzang / ri bo rtse lnga'i blo bzang shes rab/ mchod rten thang gi mkhan po don grub rgya mtsho/ rgyal rong phyogs ba'i dpon po byams pa phun tshogs sogs mang bo byon/ mchod rten thang gi mkhan khrir bzhugs/ se ra'i dgu sdong bcad pas bya dkar dmigs bsal gyis phyag len gnang ba'i chos rgyal phyi sgrub kyi gtor chen shin tu gnyan cha can/ rje nyid kyis slo ba dpon mdzad nas mchod rten thang du btsugs pa phyis su gtor sgrub gsar bar grags/ me lug(1787)lor rgya nag tu phebs/ chan lung khri lo gnyis pa la gong mas h+phu yen bla ma dang / nga bzhi ba la drung yon tham ga bla ma zhes pa'i 'ja' sa bstsal/ dgung lo zhe lnga sa rta(17kha8)lor sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ sa lug(1799)lor a rig dpon rgyud du 'khrungs/ shing sa dpon slob las rab byung bsgrubs te chos bka' mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa lcags lug la hang nge chu mig me long dang / hang nge la bya'i byang lam brgyud nas dbus su phebs/rgyal dbang dgu ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog mjal cing ser smad chos grwar zhugs mod kyang lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig par sems can gyi las zad pas kho'i dgongs pa gzhan don du gtad do/ /sku phreng brgyad pa thub bstan 'jigs med skal bzang ngam blo bzang mdo rgyud ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu sprel(1812)lor sku 'khrungs pa dgung lo brgyad kyi steng gshegs so/ /sku phreng dgu ba thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho rab byung bcu ba'i'i lcags 'brug(1820)lor rwa ke bar du sku bltams/ chu bzang rin po che'i mdun nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs rim par bzhes/ dgung lo bcu bdun steng sku 'bum du phebs nas chu dkar dge bshes dge rgan bsten nas klog 'don la sbyangs pa dang gser tog ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ chu dkar dge bshes dang mā yang paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma gnyis bcar bzhugs mtshan zhabs pa bgyis/ lo kha shas kyi bar bsdus tshad phar phyin gyi gzhung la thugs gnyer brdar sha chod/ gser tog no mon han dang rje gser khang rin po che'i mdun nas sgrub thabs rin 'byung gis mtshon pa'i dbang rjes gnang bshad khrid klog lung sogs chos bka' mang bo thob/ mchod rten thang gi mkhan khri bskyangs/ rje gser khang ba'i lung bstan dang rgyal dbang gi bka' lung bzhin rgya nag tu lan du mar phebs te to kong / zhen h+phun/ thon kri/ bkang zhu bcas rgyal po bzhi rim bzhin mjal 'phrad zhabs grogs gnang zhing gser khab h+phu yin bla ma'am mnga' gsol ba ltar pe cin du lo so drug bar bzhugs/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa gser khrir 'khod pa'i zhabs 'degs bsgrubs pa sogs chos srid zung gi 'phrin las rgya che/ dgung lo re bzhi ba rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu phag(1nga82)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su gzims so/ /sku phreng bcu ba blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ chu lug lor cong pe su'i ho shor sku 'khrungs/ shing bza' blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims phun tshogs drung nas rab tu byung — 730 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/zhing dus 'khor dbang chen gsan/ dgung lo brgyad steng sku gshegs te sku gdong la gzhon sha chags shing 'phel gdung skra sen skyes pa sogs ngo mtshar che ba zhon thun khri lo dang bo'i bar dad ldan rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong bar grags so/ /sku phreng bcu gcig pa blo bzang 'jigs med tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ lcags stag(1890)lor thir dge ja sag sde khrod du sku 'khrungs/ hor chen yongs 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho'i drung nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs la gsan sbyong dang sku 'bum chos grwar zhugs skabs rnam dpyod che ba'i mtshan snyan rgyas/ dgung lo bco lnga'i thog gtan tshigs rigs pa'i dka' gnad dogs dpyod mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba'i bstan bcos brtsams/rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum par mjal ba dang dus rkyen gyis spyi lo1959lor rgya gar du phebs shing spyi lo1984lor sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng bcu gnyis pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin byang chub rgya mtsho ni shing glang1985lor yab chos bzang dang yum bskal bzang skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ da skabs rgya gar du slob gnyer byed bzhin mchis so/ /gzhan sngo kho tshang sogs bla ma bcu lhag dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo byon/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma ni stong skor rin po che'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs pas sngo kho yongs 'dzin zer/ go la'i rnam bzhag bstan rtsis/ dan tig dkar chags/ bslab bya/ gnas bstod/ bsang bsngo 'don cho ga skor sogs gsung 'bum po ti gnyis yod/ rgya tig dkon mchog rgya mtsho zhes pa'i gsung rtsom la gsan yigalam khrid zin bris/ dbang bshad/ marjal bshad pa/ gsol 'debs/ gsan bstod/ gsungs mgur bslab bya/ chab shog lo rgyus/ 'don chog sogs pota bzhi longs tsam yod kyang dus rkyen gyi dbang du brlags so/ /lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la ni 'du khang chen mo khang mig brgya dang drug ka ring bcu gnyis can de stong skor drug pa'i sku ring la grwa tshogs rgyas te ma chub par thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma mkhan khrir bzhugs skabs rgya bskyed gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / rab rgyal me bya lor1957lor gsar gsos byas/rten gyi gtso bo tshe dpag med li sku/ dgon gsar 'debs skabs sa 'og nas thon pa'i kurma'i dus kyi rten gzungs gzhug byas pa'i sman sku khru lnga can gcig dang / rje'i li sku khru bzhi can/ shing sku khru brgyad can lnga/tsan dan dmar bo las grub pa'i byams sku khru bzhi can gcig dang khri gang can gcig tsan dan dmar po'i byams sku khru bzhi can/ thub pa tshul khrims ma'i gtso 'khor gsum gtsos pa'i ltung bshags kyi sku so lnga/ bde gshegs brgyad la sogs pa'i li sku brgya bdun du bzhugs/ gyang thang bzhi bcu zhe drug thang ga shin tu bzo legs pa'i rten rnying mdzad bcu/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / sku zhabs rin po che'i sku phreng rim byon/gnas bcu/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ stong skor bsod nams rgya mtsho'i man ngag ltar bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal phyi sgrub nang sgrub kyi rten thang byin can sogs brgya dang sum cu lhag gsung rten la brgyad stong ba gser — 731 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/bris tsan dan dmar bo'i glegs shing can/ bka' 'gyur sde dge'i mtshal dpar can tshar gsum/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig ga'an gsung 'bum/ mang / brgyad stong / ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ bskal bzang /gzungs 'dus/ gong ma'i dbu na ba/ rnam sras g.yang 'gug sogs dang de dag gi par shing gang mang dang /bde mchog rje gzigs pa lnga ldan sogs kyi sku par mang po tshags/ rje 'jam dpal ba'i sku gdung mchod rten dngul brdungs khru bache can/ li li'i sku gdung mchod rten khru lnga gcig dang shing gi mchod rten dgu bzhugs/ sman bla'i blos bslangs/ mchod chas dgra bgegs zil gnon/ tshangs dbyangs 'dod 'jo/dngos grub char 'bab/ stong skor sku drug pa'i skabs su mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gnang bar grags pa'i bdud 'dul sgra dbyangs spug rtsa chen dang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ me long gser ris can rigs lnga sogs rin thang gzhal du med pa'i mchod chos shin tu ma nga / dus 'khor 'du khang gyan brgya dang bdun can de stong skor sku phreng dgu ba thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtshos rje gser khang rin po che dang bla slob zung 'brel gyis dus 'khor grwa tshang thos bsam nor bu'i gling btsugs shing 'du khang bzhengs/ dus 'khor grwa tshang gi 'don rta dbyangs thig rdul tshon/ sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor bcas thams cad bya khyung gi sgrub mchod kyi phyag len ltar tshugs/rjes su chos bzang yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho mtshan can gyi thugs rje las sa gar dang mchod gar bdung 'bud bcas cha tshang spe' / dus der gser khang rdo rje 'chang gis dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba dang /rjes su lcags 'brug lor dngul chu rdo rje 'chang gdan 'dren zhus te dbang chen gnang / sa gar sogs la zhu dag gnang ste 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud phyag bzhes mdzad/ sku'i rten la sman 'jim gyi tshe dpag med kyi sku khru brgyad can dang / rje gser khang ba'i 'dra sku khru do sor brgyad can/ chos rgyal gong mtshungs dang / rje gser khang ba'i 'bas rjes can rdo khru gang lhag can/ dus 'khor gyi gyan thang gser bris/ dkyil thang /gzhan gyan thang nyer gnyis/ thang ga rten rnying shin tu bzo legs po don brgyad dang rin chen mang bo las bskrun pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil thang che ba bcas bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur dang mchod rdzas rtsa chen mang bo mchis/ stong sku'i lha khang gyan sum cu can stong 'khor lnga ba'am drug pa'i sku ring la bzhengs/ seng ge sgra'i sku khru gsum can dang gyan thang lnga bzhugs/ sngags khang gyan nyer gsum can de ni dgon pa gsar 'debs skabs kyi 'du khang yin par grags/ gser bris tshe dpag med kyi sku 'bum/ stong skor bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bka' bsgos ltar bzhengs shing chos rgyal nang sgrub kyi thang ga dang nag thang byin can bzhi bcas/ lho byang khra khra zer ba'i 'jigs byed bsnyen chen bcu gsum bsgrubs pa'i grub thob pa nyid kyi 'cham lwa me thub ma sogs rten rnying grangs mang bo mchis/ mgon khang gyan drug stong skor sku phreng lnga ba'am drug pa'i skabs su bzhengs/ rten gtso mgon po'i rten thang byin can de gna' dus su me shor ba ma tshig pas mgon po me thub mar grags pa dang chos skyong gi thang ga drug gtso sku 'jigs byed khru lnga dang mgon chos lha gsum po'i 'jim sku khru gsum can dang a tsā ra'i phur bu sogs byin can mang bo bzhugs/ byams khang gyan dgu can ni dgon — 732 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'di ma btab pa'i gong rol nas yod par gleng / sde dge dar rgyas rgya mtsho mkhan khrir bzhugs skabs su zhig gso byas/ gtso sku byams pa khru bdun dang nye sras brgyad/ rta mgrin phyag rdor bcas kyi sku khru lnga can gyi byams sku'i mdzod spu ni mun gsal mu tig gom pa bdun cu'i mtshams nas gsal bar mthong thub/ rje sku dang mdo rgyud tshang gi 'dra sku khru bzhi bcas bzhugs/ lha mo pho brang gyan gsum/ stong skor lnga ba'am drug pa'i skabs su bzhengs/ gzhan da dung 'jam dbyangs dmar ser lha khang gyan sum cu/ dkor gnyer khang rgyan bco lnga/ 'di ni dpa' ris dge bshes chen po blo bzang chos 'phel lam dpa' ris rkang rjen zhes grags pa nyid kyis rab byung bco lnga'i mjug tsam la bzhengs/ gtso sku 'jam dbyangs nyis thog can g.yas su thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / g.yon du phyag rdor 'khor chen khru dgu can/ mdun du rtag tu ngu dang gzhan rgyu nor bzang gi sku khru bcu can/ gnas brtan bcu drug khru do can bcu drug sku 'bas stong skor sku phreng rim byon gyi 'dra sku bcas dang gyan thang dang thang ga mang bo bzhugs/ seng gdong ma'i lha khang gyan gcig seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku bzhengs/ btsan khang gi thog khang gyan gsum/ dkor gnyer khang gyan bzhi/ stong 'khor sku phreng lnga ba'am drug pa'i skabs su bzhengs/ rten gyi gtso bo tshangs pa'i rten thang byin can dang thang ga bcu lhag dbyangs can ma'i sku bcas bzhugs/ gnas bdag khang rgyan gsum/ stong skor lnga ba'am drug pa'i sku ring la bzhengs/ gtso bo gnas bdag byams pa dbang phyug gi sku dang snyan dar nang du gser nag gi me long sogs mchod chas rtsa chen mang bos bltams/ jo'i khang rgyan bco lnga/ stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas lha khang steng lha khang sngun ma zer zhing / rje gser khang rin po ches gtso skur dbu rgyan phul rjes jo khang du gyur/ rten gtso rje gser khang rin po ches dbu rgyan phul pa'i jo sku thog gnyis can sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung a ru ra tsam nang rten du bzhugs pa gsung 'byon ma/ g.yon tu byams sku/ g.yas su 'od srung dang nye sras brgyad/ rta mgrin phyag rdor bcas khru dgu li ma'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser rje 'ja' khyim can li ma/ rwa stod thugs rje chen po/rwa stod jo bo/ rje gling 'phur ma bde mchog 'dang can/ mgon po bum lto ma bcas dang gzhan thang ga bzhi bcu lhag bka' 'gyur dang gsung 'bum gang mang bcas so /gzhan yang rab rgyal sa khyir dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi yar sngon du dgon par sa zhing mu'u42 50dang / nags tshal mu'u20 00lha ga rta drel12rnga nor gnag 827 bung bu21 ra lug2 25 rang 'thag la sogs gnyer te/ lha sde'am mchod gzhis ni stobs tshang dang rgya tig sngo kho bcas yin/ sngar chos thog mang bo spel rgyun dar na'ang spyi lo19〈1lor dgon pa'i chos sgo slar phye rjes sngar ltar 'khyongs dka' bas da skabs spel bzhin pa ni rgya lo'i smon lam nyin bcu drug zla gnyis pa'i tshogs mchod nyin bcu gnyis/ zla drug pa'i bde gsang dus 'khor bdag 'jug nyin bdun/ zla bdun pa'i sgrub mchod sa chog nyin bco lnga/ zla brgyad par dus mchod nyin gsum/ zla dgu ba'i smon lam nyin bcu drug— 733 —

—— 4༅ su ༅ dwa ba' nis godu rwad skyod dzodwa gi kho das /— — — — — —— ———— ——zla bcu bar dga' ldan lnga mchod nyin lnga/ paṇa chen dus mchod nyin gcig zla bcu gcig par bsnyen sgrub nyin lnga/ lha mo'i tshogs gtor/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i rten mchod bcas slar tshugs/ rgyal khab kyis dgon pa slar gso'i snga rjes su sgor khri bco lnga gnang ba dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyi tshogs gsog dge sbyong la brten nas spyi lo19〈 2lor thog mar jo'i khang bzhengs/ lcags lug lor dus 'khor 'du khang bzhengs shing /rje sku/ ston pa/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar/ thugs rje chen po/ jo bo rje/ kun rig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ byams pa/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ 'od dpag med sogs khru bdun can du ma/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang dus 'khor shing sku khru lnga can/ da dung gyan thang bcu/ thang ga brgya lhag gsung rten la bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig rje gsung 'bum sogs pota grangs lnga brgya tsam bzhugs/ byang chub mchod rten dang dbyen 'dum mchod rten chen po gnyis bzhengs/ dgon du dngos bzhugs grwa ba zhe bdun la grwa shag phub/ 1992lor kun su'u zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan bkod de mchod rten thang dgon pa bkra shis dar rgyas gling nyid zhing chen rim pa'i rig dngos srung skyob sde khag tu bkod do/ /slob gnyer gyi go rim ni/ nyin re snga mo'i chu tshod drug nas dgu'i bar dge rgan gyi mdun nas dpe cha klog pa dang phyi dro'i chu tshod drug nas brgyad bar dgon spyi nas blo 'dzin skyor sbyong thugs khur gzigs rtog bya/sum rtags dag gsum dang yig rtsal glags bstun du sbyong / zla re'i zla mjug tu rgyugs chung len pa dang lo mjug snyepa rgyugs chen blangs nas grub 'bras bzang ngan ltar dga' rtags dang chad pa gcod pa'i sgrig btsugs/grwa ba'i 'tsho rten gtso bo ni mang tshogs kyis bskol pa'i mang ja la brten dgos te/ lo hril bor dge 'dun rer ha lam shog sgor stong gcig lhag gi yong sgo 'bebs/ gzhan mchod me rin/ sgo yig bum pa/dar lcog sogs btsongs par sgor chig khri yan gyi yong sgo yod pa rten bzheng la bkol/ 1995lor dgon rang ga skyong ched dang sems can phan phyir bod sman khang btsugs/ gzhan sa zhing dang sa rgod mu'u brgyad cu yod pa las khungs la gnyer du bcug nas glas gla gan rgya ltar len te grwa mang gi 'tsho ba'i kha gsab tu dmigs pa kyipen ces/ /te thung dgon chen thos bsam dar rgyas gling /mdo smad dpa' ris phyogs kyi te thung dgon chen thos bsam dar rgyas gling(lkomar+sha)ni/ da lta'i dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi stong bon zhang gi khongs su chags/ dpa' ris 'ju lag chu la rgya nag skad du te thung(malo)zhes 'bod pas chu de'i nye logs kyi bod dgon 'ga'i ming la te thung zhes par btags/te thung dgon chen 'di ni rgyal sras rin po che'i lung bstan ltar/ rab byung bcu ba'i sa lug spyi lo1619lor lca kyā bla ma shes rab nyi mas phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/— 734 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gnas 'dir sa skya dang kurma'i skyes chen dam pa mang du byon/ de dag gis gnang ba'i rten gsum mang du bzhugs/ bde skyid rgyal po'i dus su rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khrir bzhugs/ khong gis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa yar lung du phebs skabs dgon 'di nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang sogs chos bka' rgya cher bstsal/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya dang so gcig rab byung dge tshul ches mang ba sgrub par gsungs pas grwa tshogs shin tu rgyas/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa glang spyi lo1829lor mkhan po'i nang chen gsar du bzhengs/ dgon pa ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su grwa ba10 2 0lhag bzhugs par grags/ de nas rim gyis tshogs chen 'du khang dang / ston pa'i lha khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang / mgon khang / btsan khang / par khang / spyi ba khang / dgon bdag lca kyā mkhan po'i nang chen/ grwa shag rgyan brgya phrag bcas bzhengs pa'i rgya khyon rgyas par mngon/ de dus dgon par rgyud stod pa dang rgyud smad pa/ mtshan nyid/gso rig bcas grwa tshang bzhi tshugs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1rnga66lor ha'e dmag gis bcom te bsnubs/ phyis su lca kyā mkhan po rjes mas gtso 'gan bzhes te dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi 'bul ba dkar thigs sogs dge rtsa gang mang bsdus nas dgon pa slar gso cung mdzad/ spyi lo1949lor dgon par bla sprul gcig dang dge 'dun pa zhal grangs so drug bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor dgon pa'i lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten thams cad gtor bshig byas nas brlags tshar ro/ /dgon chen 'debs pa bo lū kyā mkhan po sku phreng dgu byon myong la so so'i rnam thar ni lo rgyus kyi yig cha ci yang lag thob med pas lus/ sku phreng da lta ba ni spyi lo1980lor dpa' ris g.yang khyung nas sku 'khrungs/spyi lo1990lo'i zla9tshes9la kun mkhyen drug pa rin po ches ngos 'dzin mdzad de sku gong ma'i yang sprul du thugs thag bcad/ mtshan la blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ lha babs dus chen du khrir bkod/nye char bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du chos gzhung la slob gnyer mdzad bzhin mchis/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i spyi lo1980lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ba ltar te thung dgon chen gyi chos sgo slar phye/mkhan po nang chen rnying ba de 'du khang byas nas chos lugs bya 'gul spel bzhin yod/ da lta khang mig re drug phub par btsun pa zhal bcu gsum tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs so/ /te thung dgon chung dga' ldan dam chos gling /se ra lung du grags pa te thung dgon chung dga' ldan dam chos gling(spor+sha)ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags te mtsho tshad smi2690yas mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le drug cu yod/sngar gnas 'dir ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa la/ phyis su sa skya ba'i skyes chen dam pa mang po byon — 735 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/nas sa skya ba'i dgon pa chung ba zhig btab/ de nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags lug spyi lo162 2lor sum pa slob dpon dam chos rgyal mtshan gyis te thung dgon chen gyi bla ma mdzad skabs zhal bkod de sran chang blo bzang bkra shis la bka' gnang zhing / te thung rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis grogs byas nas 'chad nyan btsugs te dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor khrir bzhugs skabs sngar sa skya'i dus bzhengs pa'i hā zi me lha khang la zhig gsos mdzad/ rgyal sras rin po che dang sum pa mkhan chen rnam gnyis kyis bdag skyong mdzad pa'i dbang gis dgon lung gi bu dgon du gyur/ chos skyong lha mo la bsten/ chin rgyal rabs gong ma bde skyid rgyal po dang lha skyong rgyal po'i sku ring la dgon pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur te/ bla sprul dang ser mo ba brgyad brgya lhag bzhugs te rgyud pa dang mtshan nyid grwa tshang gnyis tshugs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa sprul spyi lo1869lor dus 'khrug bslangs nas ha'e dmag gis te thung dgon chung bcom tshar/ de nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa yos spyi lo1879lor slar gsos bgyis te rim gyis tshogs chen 'du khang dang btsan khang / dmar gdung lha khang / spyi ba khang / nang chen bdun/ grwa shag mang bo gsar bzhengs grub/spyi lo1949lor bla sprul dang ser mo ba lnga bcu lhag bzhugs so/ /lo rgyus kyi yig cha dkon pas bla sprul re re dang sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar 'god ma nus/ 'dir da lta dgon par bzhugs pa'i bla ma mang ra tshang gi rnam thar mdo bsdus tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ sprul ba'i sku mang ra sku phreng bcu gcig pa ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing yos spyi lo1915lor deng sang nang sog rang skyong ljongs hor lung per phrin gral le the che'i sog po'i khyim tshang zhig tu 'khrungs/ shing glang lor ci len zhing chen gral shar thil chi'i nang bstan dgon pa'i bla ma'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad de gdan sar 'khod/ snga rjes su pe cin bde ldan byin chags gling dang / rong bo dgon chen/ dgon lung sogs chos sde chen po nas thugs gnyer mdzad/ rab rgyal chu bya spyi lo192 2lor sku nyid dpa' ris te thung dgon chung du phyag phebs te bstan 'gro'i mdzad 'phrin gang mang bzhag lo bcu gcig ring du khri ba mdzad/ rab rgyal chu 'brug spyi lo1959lor gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs/ de nas bod yig dge rgan dang bod rgya skad yig smra ba'i lo tsā ba'i 'gan bzhes/ khong nyid ni dpa' ris rdzong srid gros rgyun las u yon dang kun su'u zhing chen srid gros u yon/ kun su'u zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi rgyun bzhugs las 'dzin pa/ da lta krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa bcas kyi 'gan bzhes so/ /dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor las sku'i rten la 'du khang du gser zangs kyi ston pa'i sku dang /rje yab sras gsum gyi sku/ sgrol ma'i sku/ khyad par du stong sku li ma la sogs bzhugs/ gsung rten gyi skor la gtso bo bka' bstan 'gyur sde dge dpar ma tshar gcig re/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum ste sku 'bum dpar ma tshar bdun/ gzhan bod kyi mkhas dbang rim byon gyi phyag bris sogs mang po mchis/skabs der dmangs gtso bcos sgyur ma byas gong / dgon sa zhing mu'u chig stong drug brgya dang / nags tshal — 736 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mu'u nyis stong lhag nor sum brgya/ lug lnga brgya drug cu/ rta drel brgyad cu bcas yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i dus 'khrug las thams cad brlags par gyur to/ /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshong 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su/ dpa' ris rdzong mi dmangs sred gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ba ltar spyi lo1981lo'e lha babs dus chen du chos sgo slar phye/ rgyal khab kyi rogs skyor ma dngul sgor khri gcig gnang ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi 'bul ba dang dkar thigs dge rtsa gang mang bsdus nas lha khang chung chung gyan gsum/ grwa shag gyan bcu gnyis bzhengs stabs grwa ba 'ga' re bzhugs/ da skabs dgon pa'i mdzad sgo ni hor zla dang bor lha mo bskang gso dang rgya lo'i smon lam chos thog nyin bdun/ bzhi ba'i mchod pa chos thog nyin bdun bcas tshugs/dgon pa'i do dam khang la khongs mi ser skya mi sna dgu ste mang ra tshang gis gtso 'gan bzhes/ dgon pa'i yong sgo gtso bo dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'bul ba dkar thigs dge rtsa yin no/ /sems nyid dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling /sems nyid dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling(1yitsor+sha) ni sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / dgon pa'i btab shul da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong khongs sems nyid sa cha yin/ mtsho tshad smi nyis stong yas mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le bzhi bcu yod/rab byung bcu ba'i shing sprel spyi lo1584lor rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho(1542—1588)gnas 'dir phyag phebs nas byin gyis brlabs pas mi ser la chos kyi snang ba rgyas shing dgon pa zhig 'debs par lung bstan pa dang dgon mtshan bstsal/ de'i rjes sems nyid dpa' ris sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs rnam rgyal ba byon/ rgyal ri'i rtse nas bud med gos dkar can zhig gis mda' dar lan gsum g.yugs pa na dge slong chos gos gyon pa bcu phrag gis gtsos dge 'dun mang bo 'dus pa'i mtshan lam byung /dgon pa tshugs pa'i ltos bzang dang / rgyal ri'i rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gnas par gsungs pa'i lung bstan dus su babs pas lha bus mes po shes rab rgya mtsho zhes bya ba lho kha brgyud de rkang 'gros dbus su byon/ bod srid skyong gis 'bul dpon du bskos/ bod pa 'byung gnas sogs dpon g.yog 'bul sdud la phyin/ rgyu dngos gang byung bcas dpon po kun dga' rgya mtsho yang dbus su mngags/ des rgyal ba yab sras la dngos 'bul dang sgo mang grwa tshang la mang 'gyed btang / paṇa chen chos rgyan las bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ gong sa nas sngar rgyun gtan chags dgos tshul dang / bka' shog gis gzengs bstod mdzad/ sgo mang mkhan po lhag ru byams pa lhun grub pas kyang grwa tshang gi sku don sngar bzhin bsgrubs na bla rabs rim brgyud du 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du ma byon pa sogs 'byung 'gyur 'ga' zhig rmi lam gyi tshul du lung bstan/ lha sa'i jo bo dang sku rgyu — 737 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/gcig pa'i thub sku sangs rgyas kyi rab gnas ma phyis su thor sa bzhes pa'i lo rgyus can/ tsan dan gyi rnam sras gser chen rje'i phyag nas ma 'jam dbyangs chos rje brgyud sgo mang dpon slob gung ru chos 'byung ba'i phyag nas 'ongs pa'i byin can bka' shog bcas gnang / dbus su gtong thengs lan grangs du ma khyer/ rjes ma'i skabs shig dpon po 'bul dpon pas dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i don du bla ma zhig dgos tshul gzhung la zhus par yer ba lha ri'i gdan sa ba mkhan chen tshe brtan don grub pa gnang bas dpon g.yog mnyam du phebs/dpon po grub bzang bo/ dpon po dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ sman zhi'i dpal ldan/ rgad po tshe rgyal 'bum/klu rtse lha rgyal skyabs sogs zhang tsha gtso bo rnams dang gros mthun gyis rab byung bcu ba'i chu phag162 2lor dgon pa'i rming btings/ 'du khang ka ba bcu drug can bzhengs/ sngar sgo mang dpon slob gung ru chos 'byung dang byams pa lhun grub rnam gnyis nas 'bul dpon pa khu dpon gyi bla rabs la chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo dgos gsungs pa bzhin bsten/ rab byung bcu ba'i me stag spyi lo1626lor gtsug lag khang bzhi thog brtsigs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pa mang du byung nas dge 'dun pa brgya lhag 'dzoms/ bsdus tshan gsum du phye nas mtshan nyid tshugs/ bsdus grwa dang rnam 'grel le'u dang bo gsum gyi rtsod grwa 'phel ba byung /dgon lung nas wang kyā dbu mdzad sogs blangs nas tshogs 'don skor gyi dbyangs rta sbyangs/ rol mo 'bud dkrol dang 'cham bcas bslabs/ chos srid phyogs bzung lo nyi shu'i bar bskyangs pa la dgon lung gi khrid bar phebs/ de nas bla ma btsan po tshang don grub rgya mtsho la zhus ngor/ nyid kyi bde gsang 'jigs gsum/kun rig gi cho ga phyag rgya/ mgon po'i gtor sgrub rnams btsugs/ de rjes 'dul ba slob dpon dge legs rnam rgyal ba mtsho khar phebs pa khrir zhus/ dgon pa'i byang du byang chub mchod rten brtsigs/ 'od dpag med kyi li sku dang mchod rdzas du ma bsgrugs/ dpon slob 'di lo bzhi'i ring mchod yon zung 'brel gyis bskyangs pas dgon pa 'phel rgyas byung / shing khyi lor gnas chung btsan khang brgyab/ me byi lor dpon klu skyabs la zhus nas bka' 'gyur gdan drangs/ lcags 'brug lor gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i bka' ltar 'du khang du byams sku dang / dgon pa'i byang ngos su dbyen blum mchod rten brtsigs/ chu bzang rin po cher zhus te rje'i gos sku bzhengs/ shing 'brug lor lha khang rgyan dgu/ rgyal ba'i gzim khang rgyan bco brgyad/ sngags khang rgyan bco lnga sum thog bcas bzhengs/ me phag nas dus mchod rnams lo re bzhin je rgyas su btang / de nas bla ma mang bo dgon 'dir byon te/ btsan po'i bsdus grwa gung ru'i skabs dang bo/ dam chos kyi rten 'brel sogs yig cha sna tshogs pa'i steng nas 'chad nyan mdzad/ dpyid chos zla ba gnyis/ dbyar ston dgun gsum la zla chos re/ sa zla'i dus bzang nyin bdun/ dbyar gnas ring chos thog dgu ba'i tshes brgyad nas smon lam/ dben sa lugs kyi lcags mkhar dang bcas pa/de'i bcu drug nas jo mchog smon lam nyin bdun/ lnga mchod nyin bdun/ mjig tu gtor rgyag rgyal zla'i nang mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub/ lor ser gtor sgrub bcas mi nyams gong 'phel du snang / sgrig lam dang — 738 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'dzin skyor sbyong gi rting bskul/ chos grwa'i rtsod pa/ cho ga chos spyod rab gnas sbyin sreg bskang gso skor gyi dbyangs rta 'dur/ gtor ma'i bca' bzo/ rol mo 'bud dkrol bcas dgon lung gi phyag len ltar rgyas pa spel to/ /rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos te spyi lo172 2lor dus 'khrug las chin dmag gis sems nyid dgon pa bsregs bcom btang tshar/ de nas mtsho sngon zhing chen sīn yon rdzong gi sems nyid zhang du gnas spor te slar gsos byas pa yin te/ phyi ma'i lo rgyus mtsho sngon gyi glegs bam du gsal lo/ /sngon chad dgon pa'i mchod gzhis ni gzungs pa dang / ha se 'bum rgyal/ phyug po/ ban skor te sems nyid tsho ba lnga yin no/ /ser chud dgon dga' ldan dar rgyas gling /ser rtsud dgon nam chu lung dgon la dga' ldan dar rgyas gling(ོlor+sha)yang zer/ 'di dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong ser rtsud zhang du chags/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las rgyang thag spyi le so bzhi yod/dgon 'di ni ching rgyal rabs skabs la rgya zha rab 'byams pa blo gros kyis gsar du btab pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig red/ sngon chad the'u tung dgon chen thos bzang dar rgyas gling dang dgon ma lag gcig yin/ ching gong ma chen lung rgyal pos srid dbang bzung ba'i skabs te rab byung bcu gnyis me mo sbrul gyi lor(1727)dgon pa'i nang tshogs su 'gal ba byung ba'i rkyen gyis/ dge 'dun pa cha shas 'brong lung gi ta yas zhang du song nas dgon pa btsugs/ de rjes slar ser tsud du gnas spar/ dgon bdag bla ma rgyal sras zhes pa yin/ dgon du tshogs chen 'du khang gnyis dang byams khang gcig gam btsan khang gcigaspyi ba khang gcig bcas bzhengs pa dang / nang chen lnga ste shākya nang / li'u kya nang / byams pa'i nang /'dan ma'i nang / tshe dor nang bcas so/ /rab rgyal sa glang spyi lo1949lor dge 'dun pa brgya yas mas bzhugs/ dgon par sa zhing / rtswa sa/nor lug nags tshal bcas rgyu nom cung mod po yod/ spyi lo1958lor chab srid kyi las 'gul nang dgon pa yongs su bsnubs shing rgyu nom gzhung bzhes byas so/ /spyi lo198 2lo'i zla11tshes7la tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'og slar chos spyod spel sa'i 'du khang gcig bzhengs/ da bar dge 'dun pa brgyad bzhugs so/ /yar lung dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling /yar lung dgon pa'am jag rung dgon chen thos bsam dar rgyas gling(tho/ kar+sha)ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul — 739 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags par/ mtsho tshad smi2 590yas mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon 'a sa bar thag spyi le bcu gcig yod/dgon pa 'di dang thog rta nag pa'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa chos kyi nyi mas ming rgyal rabs kyi mjug( 1644)tsam la phyag 'debs mdzad par grags/ skabs der dgon pa'i mtshan la dga' ldan byams pa gling btags/ dgon rnying chin dmag gis bcom pas phyis su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo1727lor rgyal dbang drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog gis dgon pa gsar du btsugs nas dgon pa'i mtshan la thos bsam dar rgyas gling zhes gsol/ a lag sha mkhan po sku phreng lnga ba ngo mtshar gzhan phan phul byung sangs rgyas rgya ma/tsho'i skabs su chin rgyal rabs kyi rgyal bos dga' ldan legs tshogs gling zhes pa'i mtshan bstsal/ sum pa'i chos 'byung du dga' ldan chos sding zhes pa'ang byung ngo / /chos sde 'di thog mar dgon lung dang gser khog dgon gnyis ka bdag skyong mdzad pas de gnyi ga ma dgon du ngos 'dzin/ phyis su rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos lo nyer lnga'i yun la skyor khur mdzad cing khong gi thugs sras a lag sha mkhan por sprad pa nas bzung dgon 'di a lag sha dang 'brel ba btsugs/ de ltar dgon pa'i mchod gzhis ni yar lung dang rgya tig byang sngo kho/ byang stobs tshang /mda' rwa pha sde/ pra sti/ mā tsho ba sogs dang / a lag sha'ang bcings 'grol bar dgon 'di'i sbyin bdag byas/ a lag sha dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling dang pra ste rab rgyas dgon gnyis ni 'di'i bu dgon yin/ rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos dgon 'di bdag gir mdzad pa'i skabs su grwa tshogs shin tu rgyas pas dge 'dun pa brgyad brgyar 'phar/ bla sprul mang du byung / rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni a lag sha rgyal sras tshang gi sku phreng dang bo yin te/ khong ni sham po gangs kyi lho nub nye 'dabs sbas yul mkhan gdeng la 'brel ba'i la 'og yul gsum gyi sngags rgyud rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin dang rgyal rigs tshe dbang lha mo'i sras su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag lo(168 2)la sku 'khrungs/ spyi tshogs don rkyen dbang gis mtshan brjes nas ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho dang dwags po bla ma zhes 'bod/ dgung lo bco lnga'i bar rang yul du bzhugs/ dgung lo bco lnga ba me glang spyi lo1697lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bcu bdun nyin paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes(1662—1727)drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes nas mtshan blo bzang rig 'dzin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gsol/ bcu ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin lha sa'i po ta lar gdan drangs te rgyal dbang gi gser khrir 'khod/ de nas paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten nas thugs gnyer lhod med gnang / skabs der lha bzang gis bod kyi srid dbang 'phrog phyir sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bkrongs/ rgyal dbang yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang chos srid kyi 'brel ba zab gshis lha bzang gis lkog tu man chin srid gzhung la nag yig brgyud pa sogs kyis rkyen las/ dgung lo nyer gsum spyi lo170 5lo'i ston gar man chin srid gzhung gi mi sna pad ma sbi chis chi sogs lha bzang gi khar — 740 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/brgyugs nas khong rgyal ba'i khri 'phang las phab ste rgya nag tu spyugs/ byang lam brgyud nas stong ru mtsho nag tu 'byor/ de nas kun dga' nor du 'ag bzhugs skabs gsol mgron dang rgya nag mi sna las gzhan dag la gsang ste/ grwa chas sogs brjes nas mtshan dus khong gcig bu bros nas phebs/ de nas sog po sogs yul gru mang bor brgyud nas spyi lo172 0lor dpa' ris gser khog tu 'byor/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo172 1lor jag rung dgon rnying gis gdan drangs pa ltar bdun pa'i tshes gsum la yar lung du phebs/ spyi lo172 4lor hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i mchod sdong ma/ja' phyir khu rer phebs/ spyi lo1727lor brag 'gag gi gzhis dngul srang brgya phrag 'gas nyos nas 'du khang bla brang grwa shag sogs gsar 'debs kyi dbu bcoms shing spyi lo1742lor yar lung dgon gser bzhengs dngos su grub/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag spyi lo1746lo'i lnga ba'i tshes brgyad nyin dgung grangs re bzhi bzhes te dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim (sku'i 'khrungs yul la rtags par 'tshal) dmar gdung a lag sha pā ring khe dgon par bzhugs su gsol/ khong la gsung rtsom gyi skor du te thung rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag pad dkar ljon bzang dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsol 'debs/ tshangs dbyangs pa'i mgur glu/ a lag sha'i bas nga ma chod sogs bzhugs so/ /rgyal sras sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu gsum me yos spyi lo1747lo'i bzhi ba'i ches brgyad la a lag sha wang gi khyim du sku 'khrungs / tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin thob/ dgung lo brgyad kyi thog gdan khrir 'khod/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog lha skyong rgyal bos kun grol ho thog thu'i cho lo gnang ba'i dbang gis blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho la kun grol gong ma rin po che zhes 'bod/ rab byung bcu gsum/ pa'i med dbang bo dgon 'dir gdan drangs par nyid kyis gtso bor mdzad/yar lung mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob dpon bkra shis don grub sogs ser skya nyis stong lhag gis rdor 'phreng dang kri ya sbrags pa'i yig kyang bzhag rgyud pa'i mkhan khri thog ma ba ri don grub bkra shis bskos/ blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho shing yos lor rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gso/la 'debs tshigs su bcad pa byin rlabs kun 'byung mdzad/ gsung rtsom 'di da lta a lag shar tshags/ spyi lo1779lor a lag sha spor gyi dgon rnying gi shul du dgon pa gsar ba bzhengs grub/ yang khong gis zhus ngor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos sa lam gyi rnam bzhag theg gsum mdzes rgyan mdzad/ kun grol rin po ches dar rgyas no mon han bla ma gtso bor bsten/ paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dang lcang skya wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/kyang gtugs par snang / spyi lo1ra07lo'i gnyis pa'i bcu bdun gyi nyin sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang chos dar rgya mtsho1808lo'i gnyis pa'i bcu bdun nyin yab 'jam dbyangs don grub dang yum sgrol ma'i sras su sku bltams/ chu bzang ho thog thu'i sku tsha yin/ yung ho gung dga' ldan byin chags gling du gser bum dkrugs nas ngos 'dzin byas/ dgung lo drug gi thog gdan sar zhabs kyi pad mo rnam par bkod/ spyi lo1820lo dang1825lor pe cin du thengs gnyis chibs bsgyu ra/ pe cin du bzhugs skabs 'od gsal rgyal bos khong la ho thog thu'i cho lo bstsal/ spyi lo1828lo'i drug pa'i tshes nyer brgyad la sku gshegs/ dgung lo nyer gcig bzhes/ sku gdung yar lung dgon du bzhugs su bcug go/sku phreng ba'i ba ye shes tshul khrims dar rgyas rgya mtsho/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa glang1829lo'i drug pa'i tshes nyer drug la a lag shar sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo1824lor dga' ldan byin chags gling du gser bum dkrugs te thugs thag stabs dgung lo nyer gnyis tsam las ma bzhugs so/ /sku phreng lnga ba kun gsal mchog rgyal zhes pa spyi lo1851lo'i bcu ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin a lag shar sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo1866lo'i gsum pa'i tshes pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho spyi lo1901lor a lag sha'i 'brog khyim zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ 1922lor phyi sog tu phebs pas da lta'i bar khong gi gnas tshul ci 'dra yin pa shes dka' bar steng rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khyim der phebs par gzigs pa tsam gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i yang srid red ces sngon na bzhes/ sku na phra mo'i dus nas rje tshangs dbyangs pa'i drung du thugs gnyer mdzad/ spyi lo1725lor tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhal bkod ltar lha sar phebs nas slob gnyer brtson/ thugs rigs shin tu skyen pas mdo sngags rigs gnas mang bor mkhas par gyur stabs lha btsun paṇ+ḍi ta zhes su grags/ 1746lor rgyal dbang drug pa zhing gzhan du gshegs rjes khongs yar lung gi mkhan po bdag gir mdzad/ phyi lor rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mchos i ri lug sin bzung khong gis a lag sha dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling 'debs mgo brtsams/ phyi lor 'du — 742 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/khang bzhengs grub cing rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar brtsams pa grub/ 1762lor lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje mchog gi yab gshegs par dge rtsa bsgrub ched sog po brgyud de phebs par lha btsun pas zhabs 'degs bgyis pa las thugs kyi sras por gyur/ sa glang lo'i dbyar khar lha btsun dang lcang skya rin po che/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo sogs dang mnyam du ri bo rtse lngar chos kyi mdzad sgo spel/ 1780lor gzugs sku chos dbyings su gzims/ gsung 'bum la rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dang /myur 'byon gsol 'debs/ blo gros kun bzang ma sogs dang / thu'u bkun chos kyi nyi mas lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar du/ lcags mkhar sbyin sreg skor gyi yig cha mang du rtsom pa bo ngag dbang rdo rje'am ngag dbang lhun grub dar rgyas zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ro/ /sku phreng gnyis pa lhun grub dar rgyas ni thu'u bkwan rin po che'i sku tshar 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig la sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa 'byung gnas dar rgyas1748lor a lag sha gung (rgyal sras) gi sras su 'khrungs/khong ni kun grol no min han thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku tshab yin/ dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling gi mtshan nyid grwa tshang khong gis btsugs pa la nang don rig par mdzad rjes che/ spyi lo1857lor sku gshegs pa dang /gsung rtsom 'ga' mchis par grags so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba dar rgyas rgya mtsho ni a lag sha the ju'i rigs su sku 'khrungs mod kyang 'khrungs 'das dang mdzad 'phrin rnam thar gsal cha ma nges/ /sku phreng lnga ba ngo mtshar gzhan phan phul byung sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'am mtshan gzhan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang bo ni1ra71lo'i bcu ba'i bco brgyad la a lag shar sku bltams/ chos srid zung gi 'phrin las bla na mtho zhing lnga zung rig pa'i gnas la'ang mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ dpa' ris blo bzang rab gsal yongs 'dzin du bsten nas sgra snyan dngags sdeb sbyor sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ khong gis pā ring khe dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling gi 'du khang rgya bskyed du bzhengs shing dus bzhi'i chos thog gi 'chad nyan legs po btsugs/ rgya lo'i sman lam dang /lnga ba'i smon lam/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod bcas kyi skabs su rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo dag la lam rim dang skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i dbang lung bstsal/ dus mtshungs su tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar zhib tu khrid/lo rer gsang 'dus dang bde mchog 'jigs byed/ dus 'khor sogs kyi cho ga spel bar mdzad/ nyid kyis zla gcig gnyis ring la sgom mtshams bzhugs/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba'i bar phan tshun chos 'brel zab mo byung ba ni nyid kyi phyag 'phrin du gsal rtogs thub/ rgyal pa paṇa chen gyi thugs dgongs ltar khong gis pe cin dang a lag sha nas gser zangs las grub pa'i ka 'phan rgyal mtshan sogs mang bo phul/ rgyal dbang gis khong la paṇ+ḍi ta'i thob thang gnang zhing / sku 'tsho bzhes skabs da 743 da

— 'dzowegosaladaphro— yar lung dgon du thengs mang bo phebs nas mang 'gyed dang dbang lung bstsal/ spyi lo1944lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la sku gshegs/ gsung 'bum po ti brgyad yod par grags pa'i po ti gsum shing par du brkos pa mchis te yar lung dgon pa'i bla ma'i khrid yig kyang brtsams so/ /sku phreng drug pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog ni1946lo'i bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la yab pad+ma tshe ring dang yum yum skyid kyi sras su dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi steng paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu bas sku 'bum dgon du a lag sha mkhan po'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de mtshan la ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bstsal/ yar lung dgon du mkhan khrir mnga' gsol/ dgung lo lnga ba la a lag sha dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling du gdan drangs nas byams pa bstan 'dzin dang lha rams pa skal bzang rab gsal yongs 'dzin du bsten nas tshad ma rig pa sbyangs/ 1955lor sku 'bum du phebs nas mi nyag tshang gi drung du rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes gnang / sku 'bum du lo phyed bzhugs skabs 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang bka' 'gyur gyi lung thob/ 1958lor a lag sha'i slob chung du zhugs/ chu yos lor mthar phyin pa dang chu glang lor nang sog slob grwa chen mor phebs nas slob gnyer gnang zhing de nas zhib 'jug slob ma'i 'dzin grwar slob gnyer mdzad/ spyi lo1982lor slob chen gyi dge rgan mdzad/ chu phag lor 'jar par rgyal khab tu phebs nas slob gnyer gnang rjes shing glang lo nang sog slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon du bskos la/ da lta dge rgan rab 'byams gzhon pa'i go gnas mchis/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos dang chu sprel/ me byi lo ste thengs gsum la dpa' ris yar lung dgon du phebs te chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad/ lcags rta lor a lag sha dga' ldan bstan rgyas gling gi tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzhengs grub/ dad ldan mang tshogs stong gsum lhag la phyag dbang bstsal/ chu bya lor phar phyin gyi darma bca' bzhag khong ni da lta krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa dang / nang sog slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon gzhon pa/ nang sog slob chen sog rigs zhib 'jug khang gi so'u krang gzhon pa/ nang sog chos lugs tshogs pa'i kru'u rin gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan yod pa ma zad/ dgon sde du ma'i dgon bdag kyang bzhes kyin bzhugs/ gsung rtsom gyi skor la rgya yig dang sog yig sogs kyi ljags rtsom nyi shu lhag mchis so /rjes drung mkhan po sku phreng dang bo blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po ni a lag sha'i wang ye'i sras lnga bar sku 'khrungs/ chung dus a lag sha nas bod yig sbyangs/ phyis su dbus la phebs nas phar phyin dang dbu ma'i gzhung gsan bsam mdzad/ a lag shar phyir log nas byang dgon gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang grwa ba'i 'dul khrims gtsigs su bzung bas snyan grags ha cang rgyas/ yar lung stobs tshang ho thog thu'i cho lo thob/spyi lo1814lor sku gathegs so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa ye shes bstan pa'i 'od zer mtsho sngon du sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo1〈81lor sku gshegs so/ /sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang don grub lung rigs 'jigs med rgya lo1921lor a lag shar sku 'khrungs/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba'i spyan snga nas sdom khrims bzhes/ da lta a lag shar 'tsho bzhin mchis so/ /dor zhi sku gong ma shes rab dar rgyas mā tsho bar sku 'khrungs/ dpa' ris dge bshes blo bzang rab gsal yongs 'dzin du bsten nas rig pa'i gnas mang thos bsam mdzad/ dge slong bstan 'dzin grags pa sogs la sdom khrims gnang / yar lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang bskyar bzhengs mdzad pas mkhan zur bzhugs mthar ha lam spyi lo1925lo tsam na sku gshegs so/ /dor zhi gnyis pa thub bstan blo bzang chos 'phel lam mtshan gzhan gdong drug snyems pa'i blo ldan mchog ni spyi lo1926lor dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus zhwa dmar dgon dang mchod rten thang nas slob gnyer mdzad/ phyis su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te thugs gnyer gnang / nang don rig pa sogs la gting tshugs pa rnyed/ spyi lo1942lor dor zhi dgon gyi gdan sar bkod/ spyi lo1942lo nas1964lor slob grwa du ma'i dge rgan du phebs/ chu phag lor dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong rig slob cus kyi cus krang gzhon pa dang rtsom sgyur khang gi kru'u rin gyi 'gan bzhes/ shing byi lor nub byang mi rigs slob gling gi dge rgan du gdan drangs pa dang slob gling de'i slob dpon chen mo dang bod yig tshan khag gi kru'u rin kyi 'khri ba bzhes/ gsung rtsom sna tshogs poṭa mang bo mdzad de bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum la mdzad rjes ha cang che bas mkhas grags kyi dbu 'phang je mthor 'dzeg bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan rgya tig tshang gi skye rgyud sa bon dkon pas 'bri mi spobs te/ sku phreng 'di ba ser tsud sa char sku 'khrungs te da lta 'tsho bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /yar lung dgon btab pa nas lo bzhi brgyar nye ba'i ring la mkhas pa mang du byung ba las gtso che ba 'ga' zhig dper na mkhas ba'i dbang bo rdo rams pa rje blo bzang rab gsal lam mtshan gzhan mtsho byung rol ba'i blo gros mchog ni spyi lo1840lor dpa' ris yar lung dgon gyi nye 'dabs mdzo bur gong ma zhes pa'i 'brog sder sku bltams/ sku na phra mo'i dus rlabs mkha' la 'phyo/ khams kyi mkhas pa 'ju mi pham dang chos kyi gsung gleng phan tshun mdzad nas lhag tu mkhas dbang stong gi yid dbang 'phrogs pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor bar mdzad/spyi lo1902lor a rig dgon chen gyis gdan drangs nas der dus 'khor dbang chen gnang / de'i phyi lor te thung rdo rje 'chang gi klu skyabs dpon po gtsos gdan drangs nas dus 'khor dbang mo che bstsal/ spyi wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/pa dang / mdo smad kyi bshad grwa phal cher grwa skor zhugs/ 1912lor phyi sog tu phebs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par spel bzang chos dar ni 'ju lag phyogs su sku 'khrungs(spyi lo1817lor snang ngo yar lung du tshogs zhugs gnang / rjes sor 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du gzhung pota lnga sbyangs nas lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs su grwa skor mdzad de lha rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ rgyal sras rin po che sogs mkhas chen du ma bsten/ bshad dang sgrub pa'i sbyor ba lhod med mdzad cing mtshan bzhugs kyang mang du gnang ba ma zad sngar bod srid gzhung gis phyi sog tu mngags nas bla ma mdzad/ phyis sku 'bum du phebs nas dus 'khor grwa tshang gi khri rabs gnyis pa'i 'gan bzhes so/ /dpa' ris 'jigs med dam chos ni sku na phra mo'i dus su yar lung dgon du tshogs zhugs mdzad cing / phyis su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad de rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me(1762—18 2 2)dang dus mnyam/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gser khri bzhi'i ya gyal sde khri rin po che'i yongs 'dzin du bzhugs/ dag yig shes bya rab gsal sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' mchis so/ /gzhan yar lung dgon 'dir dus thog gcig la dge bshes brgyad cu yod par grags shing / dgon 'di'i khrod na shel dkar dang 'bras spungs mkhan po/ ser byes mkhan po zla grags/ gro mkhan po lha rams pa chos dar/ gser khog grwa tshang gi bla ma lta bu lha rams pa byams pa/ mkhan chen no mon han gyi dgon pa'i bla ma gyang lha rams pa/ a lag sha dgon pa lho byang gnyis dang wang gi ya mun gyi dgon pa/ te thung dgon pa/ ser rtsud chu lung bcas kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i 'ja' mo dka' bcu ba sogs mdo dbus kyi khrir phebs pa du ma/ lha rams pa'i skor/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i rtsis kyi dngos slob dpa' ris a bstan zer ba'i rtsis pa grags can/ de'i tsha bo dpa' ris grags pa/dpa' zhar ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sangs rgyas 'phrin las/ phun tshogs yon tan/ dpa' thang ye shes bstan 'dzin/ mchod rten thang gi khrir blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs nas gzhung bka' pota lnga dang / lam rim chen mo/rgyan 'jug sogs khrid rgyun du bkod/ 'chad rtsod dag ni 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi phyag len ltar bgyis/ sngags phyogs la kun mkhyen 'jigs dbang bos rgyud pa grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa nas dge bshes don grub bkra shis rgyud grwa'i bla mar bsko bzhag gnang / lha sa'i rgyud smad bo'i mgon dkar sa skya'i sku rnying / rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sku thang dang gos ber/ stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me lha sa 'grim skabs kyi zhwa mo/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma'i thod mdar/ 'jigs byed rwa dpar thang ga dpa' ris dge bshes rab gsal gyi sku gdung mchod rten dang khong gi ras ber/ sku 'gag mchod khri sogs/ rten bshad phyag bris 'khrul med gnyis/ dung dkar rang grags/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag spyi lo1419lor brkos pa'i 'od zer can ma'i rdo sku/ khyad par du rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar yig nag bris ma dpe rnying gcig bca' yig chen mo tham can gcig bla ma khri'i bca' yig tham can sogs shin tu mod po brten du bzhugs su gsol/ de yang chin rgyal rabs kyi skabs su/ gong ma'i mdzod kyi bka' bstan gnyis dngul srang stong phrag lngas gdan drangs/ 'du khang la dngul srang stong phrag bdun/ gzhan gral gdan dang mchod rdzas sogs thams cad rje tshangs dbyangs pa'i phyag rdzas kyi steng nas bzhengs/ gong ma bde skyid rgyal bos mi nyis brgya lnga bcu'i ti'u thes(loṭha)dang / rje nyid kyis gtso bo'i mi drug cu re brgyad la zhwa tog dang / mi nyis brgya la dngul dang 'bru phogs bcas kyi lugs srol slar gso bgyis te gnang / (de yang rje 'di nyid la dngul srang gsum dang 'bru phog bre nas 'jag gsum/ gzim chas la dngul srang do zho lnga dang /bre nas 'jag gnyis re yin/) de skabs rje 'di ba'i mtshan la mi mang bos dwags po bla mar 'bod pa'i rkyen gyis/dgon pa'i ming yang rgya skad kyis dwags po zi(cakhyar+sha)zer zhes gong mas gnang ba'i ti'u thes su de ltar bkod do/ /dgon 'di sngar tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang bzhengs/ grwa shag brgya lhag phub/ rgyal sras nang chen/ mkhan po'i nang chen/ dor zhi'i nang chen/ rgya tig nang chen bcas bskrun/ zog lnga brgya dang / lug nyis brgya lhag chu 'thag gnyis/ sa zhing dang nags tshal rtswa sa bcas mu'u stong tsho 'ga' — 747 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/re bdag tu bzung / 1958lor dgon pa yongs rdzogs rtsa med du bsnubs so/ /spyi lo1981lor hor zla dang bo'i bco lnga nyin dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan bkod tshe gzod slar chos sgo phye na'ang da lta btsun pa bcu lhag las ma 'dus par 'du khang dang byams khang stabs bde bzhengs/ grwa shag khang mig nyi shu phub pa bcas kyi skabs so/ /pra sti rab rgyas dgon pa/pra ste rab rgyas dgon pa(4 r+sha)ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung ston dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags te mtsho tshad smi2 290longs/ dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong srid gzhung gi chags yul te gna' bor dgon pa btab gnas 'dir btsugs pas rang skyong rdzong gi srid 'byor rig gsum gyi lte gnas la rab rgyas dgon zer/dgon pa 'di dang thog dpa' rdzong nas phebs pa'i dge slong zhig gis tsho ba'i ser skya mang bo'i zhus ngor/gnas 'dir zhal gzigs mdzad de dgon pa chung chung zhig btab rjes yar lung dgon pas bdag skyong bgyis shing de'i dgon lag tu gyur/ nge nas rab byung bcu gcig(spyi lo1627yas mas)pa'i dus 'gor pra sti nang so dpal bzang gis rgya cher bskyed de sger tshugs bzung ba ma zad/ pra sgom chos kyi rdo rje'i sgar ba bcu gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur gshis dgon ming la pra sti rab rgyas dgon zhes gsol/ chos skyong mgon chos lha gsum la bsten/ dgon pa ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su ban ser mo lnga brgya lhag 'dus pa dang bla sprul gcig bzhugs/dgon bdag rab rgyas bla ma sku phreng dang bo pra sti nang so dpal bzang / sku phreng gnyis ba ngag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtsho/ sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang bshad sgrub nyi ma/ sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bshad sgrub chos kyi nyi ma bcas sku 'phreng bzhi tsam phebs shing lo rgyus kyi yig cha dkon pa'i dbang gis khong rnam pa'i rnam thar 'god ma nus/ rab rgyas dgon 'di chin rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bde skyid rgyal bo'i dus su gong ma chen po'i zhabs brtan dgon pa phog dngul can gyi gras yin zhing / rgyal pos tham ga dang bka' shog sogs gnang / rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1866lor ha'e dmag gis bsregs bcom byas/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags bya spyi lo1921lor rab rgyas bla mas gtso 'gan bzhes te lha sde dang mchod gzhis sogs kyi sbyor 'jags la brten nas 'du khang chen mo gsar bzhengs grub/ rab rgyas bla ma dang zhabs phyi ba yāng blo bzang 'khor bcas lha sar phebs te rgyal dbang bcu gsum par mjal/ rgyal dbang khong thugs shin tu dgyes te gser sku dang gser tham/ gser tog sog gur/ mchod rdzas la sogs pa gnang / de nas rim gyis rab rgyas sgar ba dang / a ban sgar ba nang chen gnyis dang / gnas bdag khang / rung khang / grwa shag sogs bsdoms pas khang ba mig gsum brgya drug cu lhag gi rgya khyon du gyur te spyi lo1949lor btsun grangs zhe drug — 748 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/bzhugs so/ /sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la/ rten gtso lnga ba chen pos gnang ba'i rje yab sras gsum gyi gser zangs sku mi tshad/ ston pa'i shing sku/ lha mo'i sku thang mang bo/ gsar bzhengs rtsa chen ni rje rin po che'i shing sku dang ston pa'i zangs sku/ sde dge'i shing dpar bka' 'gyur tshar gcig sku 'bum shing dpar rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gcig bcas pota grangs nyis brgya lhag 'du khang gsar ba'i nang du bzhugs/ dgon 'dir gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / 'jigs byed/ kun rig gnas brtan mchod chog sman bla/ bskang gso/ 'cham/ gtor rgyag smon lam gyi phyag len sogs ngos gtsang dar/da skabs kyi chos spyod mdzad sgo la/ hor zla dang bo'i smon lam dang / lha mo'i bshags gtor/ bzhi ba'i mchod pa/ drug pa'i dbyar gnas/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod bcas so /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su/ spyi lo198 2lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ste dgon pa'i chos sgo slar phye/ rgyal khab kyis slar gso'i ma dngul sgor khri brgyad gnang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyis 'bul ba dang dkar thigs so/gas bsdus pa bsags nas lha khang chung chung bzhengs pa dang grwa shag gyan nyer dgu phub/ 1kha8ralor ya nga rgyal khab kyis ma dngul sgor khri phrag bcu gnyis gnang ste 'du khang nyis thog can bskrun te sngon gyi rab rgyas bla ma'i sgar shul der rnam pa gsar ba byung / rgya khyon smi lham pa10 0 27longs te/ da lta btsun pa bcu tsam bzhugs pa dang do dam khang gi las sna'i gtso 'gan dge bsnyen grong ba zhig gis khur to/ /dgon pa'i dpal 'byor skor la/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi yar sngon du dgon pa la sa 'ing mu'u chig stong yan dang / rtswa sa mu'u chig khri lnga stong / lug sum stong lhag nor gnag drug brgya lhag rta drel brgya lhag btsugs shing rgya khyon smi lhan pa sum stong bdun brgya/ sngo tshal rwa ba gcig rgya khyon smi lhan pa drug cu/rang 'thag gcig sogs mang bo gnyer mod/ da skabs dgon par sa zhing mu'u drug dang 'grul khang gyan bdun tsam ste/ grwa mang gi lo re'i 'tsho ba'i yong 'bab gtso bo khang gla dang rong 'brog mang tshogs kyis zhal 'debs bso da snyoms phul ba'i dge rtsa bcas la brten to/ /stag lung dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling /dpa' ris stag lung dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su gnas chags par mtsho tshad smi2 450yas mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las rgyang thag spyi le bar bcu bzhi yod/chos sde 'di ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing pho sprel spyi lo1644lor gtsang rta nag pa blo bzang bstan — 749 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/pa chos kyi nyi ma go shis phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dgon pa btab pa'i tshul ni/ blo bzang bstan pa chos kyi nyi ma mchog gi sku gong ma paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi skye bar grags pa gtsang rta nag pa kun dga' rnam sras zhes bya ba/ bkra shis lhun po nas mkhas snyan grags par sbyangs shing paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob tu gyur/ paṇa chen rin po che'i lung bstan ltar mdo smad du byon/ byams pa 'bum gling gi byams sku chen mo 'di snga mo kong tse'i dus bzhengs pa'i bon gyi lha yin 'dug pa la/ bla ma 'dis gtsug tor sogs bsnan te byams pa'i sku'i rnam par bsgyur nas gser chab gsol/ han stag lung yul dpon rta mgrin gyis gdan drangs nas der dgon pa btab/de'i sprul pa'i sku go shri nyid mdo smad rma chu'i 'gram gyi mtsho sngon mdo ba zhes par sku 'khrungs/ sgo mang klu 'bum khang tshan du bzhugs te mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer dang / ngam ring du rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags gnang ste bkra shis lhun po'i sngags pa'i bla ma mdzad/ yang paṇa chen rin po che'i lung bstan ltar mdo smad du byon nas han stag lung gi dgon pa dang / mchod rten thang dang / te thung dgon chen gyi bla ma mdzad/ dpa' ris jag rung smad kyi yar lung dgon dang / stag lung dgon 'di nyid btab/ mtshan stag lung dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes gsol/ dgon pa 'di gnyis kyi mchod gzhi'i don ched du rgya nag pho brang pe cin du byon nas bde skyid rgyal pos thug 'phrad gnang / rgya nag sa cha mang bo'i than skyon chen po bsal ba dang /rgyal po'i yum chen tshe las 'das pas rnam shes dag pa'i zhing khams la yar 'dren mdzad pa'i gsol mchod gang legs yang yang btab pas rgyal po'i thugs shin tu dgyes/ sku nyid la ku shri'am hu thog thu zhes pa'i cho lo dang / gser sga gser srab cha tshang / srang zhe brgyad yod pa'i gser nag gi tham ga gcig g.yang ṭi'i tham ga gcig gser yig bka' shog dgon pa'i mtshan la pa'o yin zi ste drin gzo dgon pa zhes pa'i phyag bris sgo byang la sogs bstsal/ sku nyid kyis da dung pho brang nang gi cha kwan si'i bla ma mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba'i don du bde skyid rgyal pos dpa' ris phyogs kyi tsho sde bco brgyad dgon sde bcu lhag sku nyid kyis bdag gnyer do dam mdzad chog pa'i bka' bsgos/ chen rgyal rabs kyi gong ma rim byon gyis thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang ba las dus yun mi ring bar dar zhing rgyas par phyin te gtsug lag khang dang / grwa tshang /bla brang / grwa shag gang mang bzhengs te/ gtso bor tshogs chen 'du khang / byams khang / jo khang / spyi ba khang / rung khang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang / rgyud pa grwa tshang / dus 'khor grwa tshang / sman pa grwa tshang la sogs pa yod/ ha cang dar ba'i dus su grwa shag lung ba gsum gyi nang la khengs shing dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong lnga brgya lhag bzhugs/ dgon pa nyid kyang gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i bu dgon yin zhing / dgon lag tu 'brong lung dbyang kyā zi dang yar lung dgon sogs mchis/ chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo bsten to/ /gzhan 'debs po ni sku zhabs blo gros bstan pa ( 1652—1727)yin zer ba'ang mchis so /stag lung dgon pa'i dgon bdag dpa' ris stag lung ba sku phreng dang po gtsang rta nag pa kun dga' — 750 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rnam sras dang / gnyis pa blo bzang bstan pa chos kyi nyi ma/ gsum pa blo bzang rnam rgyal/ bzhi ba blo bzang bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'am blo bzang dpal ldan thub bstan rgya mtsho/drug pa blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ bdun pa blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ brgyad pa blo bzang dge legs rgya mtsho/ dgu ba blo bzang dge legs nyi ma/ bcu ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho bcas yin/yang rta nag sprul skus dgon pa btab rjes su/ erti ni chos rje blo gros bstan dar bas bskyangs/ sprul sku 'di ba sog yul gyi bla ma chen po rje btsun dam pa mchog gi yongs 'dzin yin par grags/ stag lung du mkhan po tshang zhes 'bod/ sku phreng gsum tsam byon/ lo rgyus su dgon 'dir mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa kha shas byon kyang gtso bo stag lung sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'am dpal ldan thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog ni nang rig pa dang lo rgyus thad dpa' ris yul gru kun tu khong las ma byung skad〈lang ju sde bzhi'i dkar chag〉rgyas pa khong gis phyag bris bstar ba mda' tshad ma pota rgan gcig bzhugs pa rab rgyal sa khyi lor brlags/ de min sprul sku gang mang gi gsol 'debs dang lung bstan sogs kha shas da lta'ang 'dren byed kyi dpal du bzhugs so/ /dgon pa 'di btab nas da bar nyams nyes thengs gnyis byung / rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me pho stag spyi lo1866lor ka ju'i ha'e dmag mā kun o zer bas chin rgyal rabs kyi krung dbyang srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed skabs ha'e jag mang bo khrid de dgon 'di'i rten brten pa grwa mang bzhugs tshad gcig kyang ma lhag par bsregs bcom dang dmar gsod byas/ de nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1928lor slar yang nyams gso byas te byams khang dang / jo khang / tshogs chen 'du khang / rung khang / spyi khang sogs bzhengs te ser mo brgyad cu lhag bzhugs/ nyams gso'i 'gan 'khur ba ni stag lung sku phreng brgyad pa rje blo bzang dge legs rgya mtshos mdzad/ sbyin bdag gtso gras mchod gzhi'i tsho brgyad kyi dad dmangs rnams red/yang rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo195ngalor dgon pa rtsa med du brlags/ ser mo ba don lnga las mi nyung ba btson 'jug thebs pa phyis su dkar 'don thob/ rab rgyal chu khyi spyi lo1982lor tang gi mi rigs chos lugs srid jus bslar gtan la phab ste dgon pa'i chos sgo bskyar du phye/ stag lung sku phreng dgu ba rje blo bzang dge legs nyi mas nyams gso'i 'gan bzhes/ sbyin bdag gtso gras deng sang stag lung zhang dang / ched po zhang /bde yangs zhang kha shas bcas kyi dad ldan mang tshogs rnams yin/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur yar sngon la dgon par lha sde dang mchod gzhis tsho ba brgyad yod de wa bse dang / ma khye/ rgya tig a dge gser gzhis/ bya rgyud/ ched po/ a lo bcas yin no/ /dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas gna' rdzas kyi skor la/ sku'i rten la ston pa 'khor rnam gsum gyi 'jim sku chen mo/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bris thang dang bla mchod tshogs zhing / sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi bris thang / sme ba lha dgu dang rje yab sras gsum gyi bris thang / 'od dpag med kyi — 751 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/'ing bkod/ ga'i bdag dge bsnyen gyi bris thang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bris thang / sman sku gang mang / spyi'i lha grangs sum cu lhag bzhugs so/ /gsung rten 'a bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur sde dge'i par ma re re dag tshar gcig sku 'bum/ par ma/ rje'i gsung 'bum dag tshar gcig yum dum pa bcu gnyis dag tshar gcig ting 'dzin/ 'phags pa skal bzang bcas tshar gang mang / gzungs 'dus/ lam rim chen mo/ sngags rim chen mo / chos spyod che ba dag tshar gcig bcas khyon bsdoms pota grangs sum brgya bdun cu lhag bzhugs so / /thugs rten la sta ga lung sku phreng rim byon gyi mchod rten brgyad dang / byang chub mchod rten gcig bzhugs/ mchod rdzas rtsa chen la rigs lnga 'i dbu rgyan/ 'gu rtse/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ka 'phan/ bla bre bcas bsgrugs / shul 'u sa rten rnying rtsa chen lnga gong ma khang cos stag lung sku phreng gnyis pa ra gnang ba'i gser sga gser sra ba cha tshang / maṇ+ḍal cha tshang / gna' bltos sbal cha gcigamachod chas 'gu tse gcig zangs leb brdungs pa'i gna' bo'i dbus zwa chen po/ dung dkar gcig bcas so/ /sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rtsa chen 'a khru lnga can gyi sto na pa'i sman sku dang sde dge'i bka' bstan tshar gcig rje'i gsung 'bum/ yum/ dum pa bcu gnyis/ ting 'phags bska' gsum/ ston sku li ma/rje yab sras gsum li ma// 'jim grub sgro'/ ma/ ston sku byin can/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bris thang byin can gnyis/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bris thang byin cin dang sman bde gshegs brgyad kyi gyan thang byin can/bla mchog tshogs zhing bris thang byin can/ sme ba dgu'i bris thang byin can/ rje'i yab sras gsum gyi gyan thang byin can/ spyan ras sazigs phyag ba'i ba'i bris thang phyin rlabs kyi mtshan kha mngon par mtho ba/ kun rig gi dkyi' 'khor ngo ma tshar can bcas bzhugs/ khongs gtogs rigs so so'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis ma chod bkur sbyin bdag bgyis so /dgon pa'i bslab pa slob gnyer ram 'chad nyan gyi phyogs su/ dgon 'di dpal ldan sgrub grwa yin pas chos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub 'phar rim cher ma mchis kyang / mgon chos rnam lnga dang chos spyod brgyad cu/ rgyan 'jug pa/ khrus gso la / smon lam rnam lnga/ ma do gdugs sgrol gsu ma/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gcig pa/kun rig bde mchog gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor bcas kyi cho ga dgon 'di'i chos thog tshogs 'don chag pa med cing / stag lung sku phreng brgyad pa sku tshe hril bor bsgrub par gzhol ba'i gnas ngo mtshar can zhig da cha mjal rgyu yod/ dus chos gtso rigs ni bod zla dang po'i nang smon lam chos thog nyin gnyis/ bzhi ba'i mchod si nyin gnyis/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod chos thog nyin gnyis/ bod lo'i phyag gtor chos gnyis nyin gnyis/ gzhan rgya lo'i bco lnga'i nyin gos drub byams sku bshams pa/ byams pa gling skor bcas dus chen tshugs so/ /dgon pa 'di'i las sne la/ gtso bo tshogs chen khri ba dang dge bskos/ dbu mdzad/ chab ris/gnyer ba bcas go gnas mtho shas lnga las ma mchis/ bzhugs yun la tshogs chen khri ba lo gsum/ dge — 752 —

krung go'i bod brgyud chang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam//bskos lo gcig dbu mdzad lo gnyis/ chab ris lo gcig gnyer ba lo gcig bcas brje spor bya/ rgyal dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mchos mdzad pa'i dpa' ris yar lung dgon pa'i bca' yig 'a bsten/ da lta kun su'u zhing chen nang bstan mthun tshogs kyis spyi lo1987lor tshogs thog tu gtan la phab pa'i〈〈kan su'i nang bstan dgon sde'i do dam bya thabs〉zhes bya ba de dag lag len byed ba'in mchis/ dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'khur ba ni dgon bdag stag lu nga sku phreng bcu ba blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho yin te/bod rigs/ dgung lo dgu mdo smad bas nga chu'i 'gram gyi rgyo'u rgya grong du sku 'khrungs/ rab rgyan shing khyi spyi lo1994lor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa rin po ches thugs thag bcad de stag lung sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang dge legs nyi ma'i yang srid kyi mchog sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad de gdan sar bkod/ da lta bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang du slo ba sbyong mdzad ba'in yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis stag lung dgon pa'i chos sgo phye chog pa'i chog mchan gnang / snga rjes su rgyal khab kyi slar gso'i ma dngul sgor khri gsum dang / dad ldan rong 'brog mang tshogs kyis tshogs bsags zhal 'debs sgor khri bco lnga 'dus nas stag 'u nga sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang dge legs nyi ma mchog gis gtso 'gan bzhes te sngon gyi byams khang gi shul du jo khang bzhengs pa dang / nang chen bskyar du phub/ da lta'i gzhi rgya ni/tshogs chen 'du khang smi lha ma pa brgya can dang / nang chen dang grwa shag smi lham pa brgya go drug zin snang / bla sprul dang ser mo ba lnga tsam bzhugs so/ /dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi yong khungs skor ni sngon dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi skabs su stag lung dgon par rta chig stong sum brgya lhag dang / 'bri g.yag lnga brgya lhag lug chig khri chig stong lhag sa 'ing chu ma mu'u brgyad brgya lhag ha ma nu/'u nyis stong lhag rtswa sa nu 'u 'bum gcig lhag tshong khang gcigamagron khang kha shas bcas gnyer ba la/ dgon pas lha sde'i mi'am byes yong rgya mi rnam sa la bogs mar btang nas khral bogs len gyin yod/ da lta dgon par rta nor lug gsum dang / sa zhing rtswa sa ci yang med par grwa ba'i 'tsho ba'i yong 'bab gtso bo rgya che'i rong 'brog dmangs kyi 'al 'debs dang bsod snyoms phul pa'i dge rtsa dang rim gro bsgrubs pa/ rdzong mkhar rab rgyas su tshugs pa'i dpa' ris stag 'u nga dgon pa'i 'grul khang bcas las 'tsho rten nges can sbyo ra bzhin no/ /zhwa dmar pra sti dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /lung dkar gyi zhwa dmar pra sti dgon bkra shis chos gling ngam dga' ldan chos 'khor gling ni/ gna' dus kyi pho rod yul phyogs te lang ju la gtogs/ da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags par mtsho tshad smi2720yang mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le bzhi bcu yod/— 753 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa 'di dang thog hor go dan rgyal po lang jus su bzhugs skabs khong gi mnga' 'og na zhwa dmar wang zhes pa'i rgyal po zhig yod/ des pho rod phyogs su dbang bsgyur skabs su bod kyi nang ba'i grub mtha' bka' brgyud zhwa dmar bla ma mang bo gdan drangs nas zhwa dmar dgon zhig btab zer ba ni dgon 'di red/de nas ming rgyal rabs kyi mjug tsam la rgyal sras rin po che blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi lung bstan bzhin pra sti nang so grags pa lhun grub kyis gna' dus kyi bka' brgyud pa'i dgon rnying 'di gnas spar cing rgya bskyed mdzad de dge lugs gsar ma bar bcos/ stag lung go shri blo bzang bstan pa chos kyi nyi mas dar 'ing rgyas par mdzad/ thu'u bkun rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma khrir bzhugs/ khong nyid kyis bdag skyong gang mang mdzad cing klog slob tu chu rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dar rgyas bskos/ de'i phyir dgon lung byams pa gling gi bu dgon du bsgyur/ chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo bsten/ ching rgyal rabs thung kri lo lnga ba spyi lo1866lo dang / ching rgyal rabs kong zhu lo nyer gcig spyi lo1895lo dang / min go lo bcu bdun spyi lo1928lor dgon pa 'di snga phyi thengs gsum la dmag 'khrug nang brlags/rab rgyas sa glang spyi lo1949lo'i dus su/ dgon pa 'di na dge 'dun pa brgya dang bco lnga bzhugs/sa zhing mu'u stong gcig dang / nor gnag bzhi brgya/ lug chig stong lhag yod/ rta brgya lhag rtswa sa nags tshal cung rgya che/ g.yis khang gsum/ rang 'thag dgu bcas spyi rdzas mang / dgon du co ne dpar gyi bka' 'gyur dang lha sa dpar gyi bstan 'gyur bcas bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo195〈lor chab srid kyi las 'gul nang 'jig na'ang spyi lo19rnga 2lo'i zla10tshes1nyin la slar bzhengs nas chos sgo phye/ da lta dge 'dun pa drug 'dus shing tshogs khang gcig dang grwa shag khang mig bcu yod do/ /dor zhi dgon dge ldan chos gling /dor zhi dgon(༅4/r+sha)dge ldan chos gling ni/ sngon chad lang jus la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su shul yod/ mtsho tshad smi2 460yas mas dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon bar spyi le so brgyad yod/dgon 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag spyi lo1646lor rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i dngos slob dor zhi ngam ring rab 'byams pa dam chos rgyal mtshan gyis phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ chos skyong dmag zor ma bsten cing / dgon ha cang rgyas pa'i dus su bla sprul gcig ser mo ba sum brgya lhag 'dus/ dgon bdag bla ma dor zhi ba sku phreng drug phebs byon zer yang sku gong ma rim byon gyi rnam thar gyi yig rigs dkon pas 'god ma nus/ bla ma da lta ba dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo'i gnas tshul dpa' ris yar lung dgon pa'i lo rgyus su gsal/ dgon 'di rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1〈66lor ha'e dmag gis bcom tshar/ de'i sngon du dgon par gtsug lag khang dang lha khang / 'du khang / grwa tshang / grwa — 754 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/shag sogs ga tshod bzhengs pa dang sku gsung thugs rten sogs ci 'dra bzhugs yod byin can dkon po shin tu mang bar grags/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos spyi lo1927lor dgon bdag bla ma dor zhi shes rab dar rgyas kyis nyams gso mdzad de 'du khang khang mig sum cu can bzhengs/ da dung bla brang gcig dang grwa shag mi nyung ba phub/ skabs der btsun pa bcu lhag bzhugs/ spyi lo1949lor dgon par bla ma gcig dang ser mo brgyad tsam bzhugs/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi yar sngon la dgon pas nor lug brgya phrag dang sa zhing dang nags tshal nyung nyung gnyer/ mchod gzhis ni dor zhi tsho ba yin la dor zhi bla ma'ang 'tsho bzhugs skabs yin/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa rtsa gtor byas/ da lta slar gso byas par btsun pa brgyad tsam bzhugs so/ /'bri gung dgon dga' ldan legs bshad gling /dpa' ris 'bri gung dgon dga' ldan legs bshad gling ni/ sngon chad 'brong lung we'am 'brong lung stong dpon do dam khang la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/ mtsho tshad smi2960dang / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le brgya rtsam yod/dgon pa 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo1727lor dge slong bzang bo rin chen gyis phyag 'debs gnang ba'i bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ 'bri gung zhes mtshan thogs don ni sngar 'bri gung gi 'bul sdud pa zhig gi gzhis dgon de lung nub ngos rong bo zer ba'i sa char chags/ phyis su 'bri gung nang so bzang bo rgyal mtshan pa mdo smad du byon nas gzhis de bdag skyong mdzad/ rgyal dbang lnga ba(1617—162 2)chen po rgya nag tu phebs skabs bzang bo rgyal mtshan pas dpa' ris kyi tsho ba so drug dgon sde bcu gsum gyi gtso 'gan bzhes te lnga ba chen po gur chen du gdan drangs/ rjes su khong lha sar phebs te dga' ldan du slob gnyer mdzad pas dga' ldan gser khri brgyad bcu ba'i gsol dpon du bskos/ yang khong phyir mdo smad dgon lung du phebs nas chos srid zung gi thad mdzad 'phrin mang bo bzhag chu yos dus 'khrug gi dus su chen dmag gis bkrongs/ de'i gzhis chen dmag gis bcom pas na/ gzhis srung ba bzang bo rin chen bros nas jag rung smad du 'ongs te lung mdor mtshams khang zhig bzhengs/ me lug lor(spyi lo1667)dgon rnying zer ba'i lung bar dgon pa 'di nyid btab ste 'bri gung gi lugs 'dzin zhing chos skyong a phyi ma sog bsten/ gser khog dgon pa'i bu dgon yin zhing dgon lag tu nang sog ya mon gyi jung gur zhi jo dang tung jo sogs yod/ dgon pa dar ba'i dus su bla sprul gnyis dang ser mo ba stong lhag bzhugs zer/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang lha khang mang bo/ bla brang gsum/ grwa shag mang bo bcas bzhengs/ mchod gzhis su 'bri gung a lod stod smad yod/ dgon bdag bla ma 'bri gung nang so sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar yig rigs dkon — 755 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/na'ang / sku phreng 'di ba da lta nang sog ur tu su sa cha na dmag dpon gyi 'gan bzhes bzhin snang / sprul sku 'di kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu bas ngos 'dzin mdzad do/ /grub chen pa blo bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sku na phra dus sku 'bum du phebs nas rig gnas che chung kun la sbyangs/ phyis su sku 'bum sman pa grwa tshang gi khri ba mdzad/ spyi lo1979lor rang yul du phebs te dpa' ris rdzong bod sman khang du gso sman phyag las gnang zhing / srid gros kun su'u zhing chen u yon lhan khang gi u yon du bdams so/ /yang rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsang rnam las/grub chen sku phreng drug pa dkon mchog chos kyi nyi mas rgyal dbang drug par zhabs zhu byas nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs / rgyal dbang gis ur tu su gar jo la khyed kyis bdag po byed ces bka' bsgos gshis/ da lta'i bar du mu mthud bdag po byed bzhin mchis/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1866lor dpa' ris 'bri gung dgon la ha'e dmag gis bsregs bcom byas te bsnubs/ de rjes dgon bdag bla ma 'bri gung tshang dang grub chen tshang gnyi gas gtso 'gan bzhes nas slar gso cung mdzad kyang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing lug spyi 'o 1rnga95lor ha'e dmag gis thengs gnyis par 'bri gung dgon pa rtsa brlags btang / phyis su gnas spor te zhi khra mdor dgon pa btab nas dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ de nas rim gyis tshogs chen 'du ṇabang dang / jo khang / 'bri gung bla brang / grub chen bla brang / grwa shag mang bo bcas gsar du bzhengs / 'du khang gi rten gtso la/ dbus kyi khri'i thog tu dga' ldan gser khri brgyad cu ba'i mchod sdong /rgyab tu ston pa gtso 'khor gsum dang gnas brtan bcu drug gser zangs las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum gyi sku bcas dang / skyabs 'gro dang bla mchod sogs kyi gyan thang brgyad/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcigarje'i gsung 'bum sogs sangs rgyas kyi gzhung pota brgya lhag bzhugs/ jo'i khang du rje gtso 'khor gsum dang 'bri gung nang so sku phreng gnyis pa'i sku gdung / mchod rten/ grub chen sku phreng bcu ba'i sku gdung mchod rten/ rje'i stong sku dang gyan thang mang bo/ dam pa'i chos ni 'bum dang nyi khri sogs mang bo bzhugs/ spyi lo1949lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu rtsa
