'dus/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi yar sngon la dgon par sa 'ing mu'u bzhi stong dang / nor gnag sum brgya lhag lug stong lhag rta bdun cu/ rdo sol gter kha gnyis/ nags tshal dang rtswa sa mu'u sum stong bcas bdag gnyer byas/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1kha5rngalor 'bri gung dgon pa rtsa med du brlags te 'jig go/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya spyi lo1981lor dpa' ris rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 'bri gung dgon pa'i chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan gnang ste slar chos sgo phye/ rgyal khab kyis rogs skyor ma dngul sgor chig khri nyis stong dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyis 'bul ba dge rtsa sgor khri brgyad 'dus shing / grub chen blo bzang 'jigs med kyis dbu khrid gnang 'og 'du khang gnyis thog khang mig nyer bdun can bzhengs/ grwa shag khang mig bcu phub/ grub chen blo bzang 'jigs med kyis bskyangs/ 'du khang gzhi rgya ni smi lham pa nyi shu dang grwa — 756 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su/'u glegs bam/shag dang skor lam sogs smi lham pa〈10 5zin yod/ dgon par dge tshul 'ga' dang dge bsnyen bzhi bcu 'dus pa'i skabs so/ /tā ban rgya rdog dgon chos 'khor dar rgyas gling /tā ban rgya rdog dgon chos 'khor dar rgyas gling(rnyesmolor+sha)ni/ sngon chad lang jus la gtogs pa dang /da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su gnas yod/ dgon gnas mtsho tshad smi2650yas mas/ rdzong chags gnas rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le zhe bzhi yod/rab byung bzhi ba'i me rta spyi lo12 46lor sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan lang jur phyag phebs te hor go dan rgyal po dang thug 'phrad gnang zhing skabs der khong dpa' ris bod dkar po'i yul la gzigs skor du chibs sgyur mdzad/ or so'i rgya rdog gnas 'dir zhal gzigs mdzad de sa skya ba'i dgon pa 'di phyag 'debs gnang skad/ de nas skyabs mgon 'phags pas rgya bskyed de yon rgyal rabs gong ma chen po'i zhabs brtan gyi dgon par gyur/ de'i phyir dgon pa'i mtshan la tā ban zhes gsol/ tā ban ni tā yon gyi don yin pas sgra log nas de ltar thogs shing / yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal ming red/ de nas rab byung drug pa'i lcags bya spyi lo1 26khalor kurma bka' brgyud zhwa nag pa'i bla ma garma rol ba'i rdo rje rgya nag tu byon skabs gnas 'dir phebs te rgya cher bskyed de kurma bka' brgyud pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ chin rgyal rabs kyi dus mgor a 'o da rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa 'di rgya skyed mdzad de dge lugs pa'i dgon par bcos/ dgon lung byams pa gling gis bdag skyong mdzad pas de'i bu dgon du gtogs / phyis su chu bzang dgon pas kyang skyong khur mdzad/ dgon pa ha cang dar ba'i dus su dge 'dun pa zhal grangs lnga brgya 'dus te bzhugs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1ra66lor mā kun o zhes pa gtsos pa'i he dmag gis dpa' ris phyogs kyi nang ba'i dgon sde tshang ma sreg bcom byas skabs su tā ban rgya rdog dgon pa 'di'ang bcom tshar/ phyis su dgon lung dang chu bzang gis rogs ram mdzad 'og rim gyis slar gso byas te tshogs chen 'du khang dang btsan khang / byams khang / grwa shag mang bo gsar bzhengs grub/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi yar sngon la dgon par btsun pa zhal bco brgyad las med/ dpal 'byor thad du sa zhing mu'u brgyad brgya lhag dang sgo zog bcu phrag yod/ dgon pa'i mchod gzhis ni rgya rdog dang ldan ma bcas yo da/ spyi lo1966lo'i rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i dus su dgon pa'i rten brten pa thams cad gtor bshig byas nas brlags/ spyi lo1984lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ba ltar dgon pa'i chos sgo slar phye/ rgyal khab kyis slar gso'i ma dngul sgor chig khri bzhi stong dang dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi 'bul ba dkar thigs sgor stong phrag dgu bcas kyis lha khang dang grwa shag khang mig gsum gsar bzhengs grub bo/ /— 757 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/or so dgon bkra shis chos gling /or so'am 'brug sug dgon bkra shis chos gling ni/ sngon chad lang ju la gtogs/ da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we su khul gyi dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le nga lnga yod/dgon 'di rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya spyi lo1729lor or so dka' bcu bstan 'dzin bzang pos phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa yin/ dgon bdag or so mkhan po yin la sku phreng ci tsam brgyud pa ma nges/ chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo bsten/rab rgyal sa glang spyi lo1949lor dgon par 'du khang khang mig lnga dang / or so sgar ba/ tsha kho sgar ba zhes nang chen gnyis/ grwa shag khang mig drug phub/ dge 'dun pa gsum las med zer/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo195rngalor chab srid kyi las 'gul nang dgon pa brlags phyin da lta chos sgo slar phye ba'i bskal ba ma ldan no/ /rigs ldan dga' tshal dgon pa/rigs ldan dga' tshal dgon pa ni/ da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags zhing / rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le bar so lnga yod/ mtsho tshad smi2400longs/dgon pa 'di dpa' ris phyogs kyi rigs so so'i dad ldan mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu ba tshang zhal bzhugs skabs su dpa' ris bod dkar po'i yul du phyag phebs pa'i dran rten du/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang spyi lo1985lo'i bod zla6pa'i tshes 6nyin gsar du btab pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ rigs ldan dga' tshal zhes thogs don ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing byi spyi lo1984lor zla 9bar krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal yongs dmangs chen rgyun u khang gi bkod sgrig ltar/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu ba tshang zhin cang sa char gzigs zhib gnang nas phyir lam rgyal sa pe cin du phebs lam du/ zla9ba'i tshes14nas17nyin gyi bar du dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong la gzigs skor dang mtshams 'dri gnang zhing / tshes15nyin rin po che 'khor dang bcas pa bkra shis phyug lung du phebs/ zhing chen dang sa khul dang rang skyong rdzong bcas kyi rim pa so so'i 'go 'dren rnams dang / dpa' ris dang bcas pa'i phyogs mang bo'i dad ldan mi dmangs mang tshogs bsdoms pas mi grangs khri tsho bzhi lhag gis rin po che la chibs bsu rgya chen po zhus shing phyag dbang zhus la zhal 'don gyi lung mang thob/rin po ches las rigs so so'i mi sna dang mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams la zhal gsung dang bka' chos mang bo gsungs/ rta rgyug dang glu gar 'khrab ston la gzigs/ rin po ches dpa' ris — 758 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mchod rten thang dang yar lung dgon/ te thung rdo rje 'chang bcas la zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ tshes17nyin gyi phyi dro rin po che 'khor bcas yul dpa' ris dang zhal gyes te pe cin du phebs/dpa' ris bkra shis phyug lung dang bcas pa'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rin po che sku bzhugs gnang ba'i gur chen phub sar dran gso'i dgon pa zhig bzhengs rgyu'i re ba de dpa' ris rdzong srid gzhung la zhus pa/ mang tshogs kyi re 'dun bskong phyir dgon 'debs chog pa'i gros mthun chog mchan gnang / de dpa' ris rdzong mi rigs chos lugs las don khang dang rdzong nang bstan mthun tshogs kyis mdzub ston gnang zhing / khyad par du a khu chos 'phel zhes pas gtso 'gan bzhes te dad ldan mang tshogs kyi 'bul ba dang dkar thigs la sogs pa'i zhal 'debs rogs dngul sgo khri drug bsdus nas lha khang khang mig gsum bzhengs pa dang grwa shag khang mig drug phub/ rab rgyal shing glang lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin du dpa' ris rdzong nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso zur zhi ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nyi ma mchog gis rab gnas mdzad de chos kyi sgo mo phye/ mtshan la paṇa chen ma ṇi khang zhes gsol/ rab rgyal me yos spyi lo1987lor zur zhi tshang dang mang ra tshang rnam gnyis kyis pe cin du krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs skabs lnga ba'i 'thus mi tshogs 'dur zhugs skabs drung yig brgyud de paṇa chen rin po che la dgon pa chags tshul dang dgon par mtshan zhig gsol dgos pa'i re ba zhus pas rin po ches rigs ldan dga' tshal zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gnang zhing chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo bsten bzhin mchis so/ /rigs ldan dga' tshal dgon pa'i sku gsungs thugs rten dang mchod rdzas rtsa chen gyi skor la/ shing las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku/ rje rin po che'i sku/ 'od dpag med kyi sku bcas dang kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku gong mas dngos su gnang ba'i sku nyid kyi sku par tshon mdangs can gzungs gzhug bzhugs/ paṇa chen rin po ches phyag gnang mdzad pa'i ston sku chung ngu / paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza' sogs mchis pa ma zad/ gzhan gos drub thang ga 'ga' dang dpar thang 'ga' bcas bzhugs/ nang rten du da dung kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu ba dpa' ris su sku bzhugs skabs kyi gdugs dang bcas snang ngo / /da lta dgon par ban ser mo brgyad bzhugs shing / lo ngo gcig gi ring la bzhi ba'i mchod pa dang drug pa'i lha gsol/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod sogs mdzad sgo nyung tsam spel bzhin gda'/ lo re 'tsho ba'i yong 'bab gtso bo ni rgya che 'brog dmangs kyi zhal 'debs don snyoms phul pa'i dge rtsa yin zhing sbyin bdag 'brog khyim rnams kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin rim gro bsgrub pa bcas so/ /rgya yag dgon gong ma dge ldan rnam rgyas gling /rgya yag dgon gong ma dge ldan rnam rgyal gling(tram̐1hākhri༅r+sha)zhes pa ni/ rgya yag dgon 'og ma dang gcig par sngon chad lang ju khongs gtogs te/ da lta wu'u we sa khul gyi dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong du — 759 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/chags/rgya yag dgon gong ma dge ldan rnam rgyal gling zhes pa 'di'ang rgya yag dgon 'og ma'i lo rgyus nang bkod zin pa ltar thu'u bkun rdo rje 'chang chos kyi nyi mas gong ma gnas spo mdzad rjes slar shul der phebs nas bsang mchod cig mdzad rjes dge ldan bstan 'bar ma dang dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gsung skabs su/nye logs 'brog khyim zhig gis khong la zho ze'u gang dang mar cog gcig phul pas na/ khong nyid thugs ha cang dgyes tshul bstan nas zho phyogs bcur mchod cing zhal nas deng phyin khyed tshos sa 'dir dgon shul ma zer dgon rnying thogs dang / dgon pa rnying ba gsar sos pa'i rten 'brel yod ces gsungs/ dus de nas bzung deng sang bar yu la mis dgon rnying 'bod kyi yod/ phyis su rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1924lor rgya yag mkhan po tshang(sku nyid ni spyi lo1941lor thu'u bkwan rin po ches dgon pa 'bul skabs su/ khong mkhan po'i sprul sku ngos bzung zhing mkhan po'i cho lo'ang gnang )gis thugs khur 'og khong gi khu bo tsa mo bskal bzang dang / a lod tshang gtsos pa'i yul byes sbyin bdag rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te/ tham ga rdo rje 'chang gdan drangs nas 'du khang sogs 'bub pa'i gnas gzigs dang bkra shis gso sbyong dang sa 'dul byin rlabs sogs mdzad rjes/ 'du khang khang mig lnga logs mig bdun can dang / mgon khang ka bzhi ma chung chung bcas bzhengs / spyi khang rung khang sogs mang du phub/ de nas rim bzhin yang jo khang gyo tog can gyan lnga/gzhi bdag rnam rgyal khang / mkhan po bla brang thog khang khang mig lnga bcas grub pa ma zad/ thu'u bkwan bla brang / tsha kho bla brang / snang gong bla brang / grwa shag mang bo bcas gsar du grub/ 'du khang du sman 'dam las grub pa'i jo sku khri rgyab yol drug 'gyog can mchog zung gnyis gnas brtan bcu drug bcas dang / jo 'brom yab sras gsum khri rgyab yol can/ g.yon du rje yab sras gsum khri rgyab yol can bzhengs/ slar de dag gi g.yas g.yon du dpal mo'i lugs dang rgyal po'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rgyab yol re re/ gzhan bde smon gyi nang ltar shākya'i rgyal bo/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/gsang bdag sman bla/ tshe dpag med sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku khru gsum tsam re re/ 'jim dpar gyi rje nga 'dra ma'i stong sku/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gsung bkod ltar rab gnas mdzad/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku khru lnga lhag byin can dang / gser khri'i g.yon du byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis sku tshad gong mtshungs bzhugs pa dang / tai lo ba/ na ro ba/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi sku de rnams gser zangs las bzhengs pa sha stag yin/ byams pa gling skor du 'dren rgyu'i byams pa'i shing sku/ thang ga gsar rnying mang bo dang / gser zangs kyi 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sku/ mgon khang du sman 'dam gyi phyag drug pa'i sku khru do lhag mdun du k+ṣi tra pa la/ gser zangs kyi lha bcu gsum ca/'i sku chung chung / lha mo'i sku khru do lhag gdong can gnyis bcas 'bag bzo/ tsan dan gyi chos rgyal sku/ dam can rnam gsum gyi 'bag sku/ se ra gling nas drangs pa'i gser zangs kyi phyag drug pa'i sku/ mgon dkar gi 'bag sku/ sku — 760 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/'bum gzhung nas gnang ba'i rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag tu banams pa'i bla ma chod tshogs zhing gi thang ga byin can/ sku 'bum rgyud pa'i a myes kyi dbu zhwa/ sku 'bum gyis rten gnang don ni rgyud pa'i 'du khang gsar gso skabs kyi yon bdag gtso bo yin pas so/ /de dang sku tshad mnyam pa'i dam can ra bcibs kyi sku/mgon po'i nag thang gser bris/ rta mgrin g.yang gsang dang / mgon chos/ lha mo/ 'jam dbyangs/rnam sras/ gser chen rgyal bo sku lnga/ dam can sogs kyi thang ga mang / jo khang du gser zangs kyi jo bo sku khri rgyab yol bcas/ 'jim bzhengs dus 'khor gyi sku mi tshad/ rdo rje shugs/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan sogs sku mang bo dang / rnam rgyal khang du rnam rgyal gyi sku khru lnga tsam/ gzhan slob dpon sogs thang ga bcas/gdan ma grub chen gyi gnam lcags rdo rje tshe lnga ba sngon rwa gcig chad pas grub chen gyis dam can mgar nag gi mdun du bzhag nas tshwa la byas nas sbyar ba/ sum pa grub chen gyis bka' bsgos dam bca' mdzad pa'i dam can gyi sku rten hu'u ma mu'i rten ma dung gsol kha gtong dus mtshams mtshams su rten khrod nas dril chung gi sgra bcas snyan shal 'dar sig sig byed pa'i ya mtshan can/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i lo rgyus can te spyi lo1929lor bzhengs nas tham ga rdo rje 'chang gdan drangs shing hor grub chen tshang dang / rgya yag mkhan po sogs gtso bas rab gnas mdzad rjes/ 'bru gu dang / rgya yag dgon gong 'og hor dang nags yangs/ta ban sogs dgon sde'i ser skya mang tshogs la mu tra brgya rtsa dang / mgon po bka' bcu gsum/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ rnam/ sras/ bag tse/ dam can/ rgyal bo sku lnga sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang sogs chos bka' gsung skabs su sku'i zhal la nag shad dang nag thig gsal mi gsal ma nga bo babs/ mkhan po tshang gis dkor gnyer gyis lag pas brkos pa red ces bka' bkyon gnang nas gser skyems phul/ nyin gnyis gsum 'gor rjes nag shad sngar las mang du song mthar mgrin pa yan dang snyan man chad nag por gyur pa la/ rdo rje 'chang la zhus/ nyid kyis deng phyin nas zhal gser ma 'bul khyod kyi rten skal red gsu ngas/de rjes mtshams mtshams su zhal mdog 'gyur 'gro ba de dag nga tshos mngon sum du mthong ngo / /gsung rten skor 'a / sngo kho rin po che nas gnang ba'i snar thang par gyi bka' 'gyur kha tshang / co ne'i bstan 'gyur tshar gcig lan hwa the'i yum dum pa bcu gnyis/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ lang ju'i thu h+phu zi nas ya ra drangs pa'i brgyad stong pa dngul bris/ mdo sde brgyad brgya ba gser bris/ li bzos rnam rgyal mchod rten/ nyi khri sogs dang / kun mkhyen sku phreng dang lcang skya sku phreng / thu'u bkwan sku phreng rim byon/ klong rdo'/ bla ma/ zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta sogs skyes chen dam pa mang bo'i gsung 'bum/ be'u bum sman dpe/ na bza' dang sgyu ma'i be'u bum mtshon ldan dpe rgyun dkon po mang bo/ dgon pa'i g.yas phyogs su bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ lang jus phyogs kyi dgon pa bsnubs rjes lus pa'i tsan dan gyi sku gsum sogs mchod rten dang sbub cha sogs mchod cha'i skor sa paṇa gyis dbang gnang skabs kyi yin zer ba'i li las bzos pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa khru do tsam sogs khyad mtshar can gyi gna' rdzas mang bo bsgrugs so/ /— 761 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dgon pa'i ma dzad sgo'i skor la/ zla dang bo'i gnam lo gsar tshes lha mo'i tshe gtor dang / tshe drug nas bco lnga'i bar smon lam nyin bcu/ sa ris tshe sgrub(rnam rgyal stong mchod)nyin bdun/ bzhi ba'i tshe gcig nas rje gser khang ba'i phyag len bzhin mchod pa nyin bcu/ lnga ba'i tshe brgyad nas ras bris la brten pa'i kun rig sgrub mchod nyin bdun(rdo sbis se chang dgon pa'i phyag len)/ de nas dbyar gnas chen mo/ rje'i lnga mchod nyin drug la rje stong mchod/ yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong dang / gzhan zla gnyis pa dang lnga ba/brgyad pa gsum gyi tshe gnyis nas bzung mgon po zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi gtor sgrub nyin bdun re/ brgyad pa'i nyi shu nas yang gsang gtor bzlog las ba'i'i sbyin sreg bcas nyin bcu/ dgu ba'i tshe gcig nas rnam sras g.yang 'gug nyin brgyad/ bcu gcig par chos skyong zhabs tshang gi bskang gso gtor rgyag bcas nyin gsum/ nyin rer rgyun ja'i skabs la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang sku rim rnam gsum/ zla rer bzhin bgeg gtor dang tshe gnyis kyi rgyal gso dang / tshe brgyad kyi rnam rgyal bsngo ba sogs 'don rta dbyangs/phyag rgya gtor bzo/ mchod bshams 'bud rdung dkrol gsum sogs phyag len phra zhib thams cad 'bru gu dgon gyi phyag len rnam dag yin no/ /dgon chung nang nas mkhan po'i sku drin la brten nas 'dir sgrig lam gang ci'i thad nas gtsang zhing dam pas/ gling du grwa bas phu dung dang rgya lham gyon mi chog pa dang rang gi pha ma dang nad pa(phyag skor mkhan)las bud med mtshan sdod mi chog cing / grwa bas tshong dang lhag tu nor lug sogs dud 'gro'i tshong rgyag mi chogagling du cal col mi chog pa sogs dang / chos spyod du phebs dus zla gam zhwa mo nges par gyon dgos la/ rang 'dod du tshogs la ma song bar sdod mi chog pa la sogs dper na rgyun grwa dge bskos kyis tshogs gtam gsan 'ing rgan rnams kyis phyag dang bskor ba/ kha bton dge sbyong / gsar bu rnams rang rang gi thad nas yi ge dkar nag bslab ba slob gnyer sogs brtson 'grus lugs bzang yar ldan du mchis mod/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lo dang lo bcu'i nang zing gi skabs su sku gsung thugs rten yongs su rdzogs pa bsnub par gyur to/ /rgya yag dgon 'og ma chos 'khor dar rgyas gling /rgya yag dgon 'og ma(tram̐1hākhrirwar+sha)chos 'khor dar rgyas gling zhes pa ni/ (lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar du kun dga' bde chen gling gsungs/) sngon chad lang ju la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul gyi dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/ mtsho tshad rmis2890yas mas kyi rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon dang bar thag spyi le go drug longs/dgon 'di dang thog sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'khor bcas lang jus su byon nas hor go dan rgyal bor thug 'phrad mdzad pa'i skabs su/ khong sku nyid kyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i sa skya'i lugs kyi chos — 762 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/sde zhig yin/ dpa' ris kyi byams pa lha chen dang dus mnyam yin par grags/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo144〈lor tā ming go shri bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang shākya dge slong bla ma bzod pa dpal rnam gnyis kyis dmag dpon chen po le'u yung khrin gyi rogs ram las byams pa lha chen slar gso mdzad skabs rgya yag dgon pa'ang nyams gso bgyis/ dus kyi 'phel dbang las dgon 'di la chag 'jig thengs mang byung myong / chin rgyal rabs dus mgor rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dngos slob 'gag shing rab 'byams pa grags pa rgya mtshos slar gso gang legs mdzad de dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur/ phyis su dus 'khrug cig las khong nyid(sku phreng gang yin ma nges) mi khyim khag gcig dang bcas sku 'bum du phebs phyin phyir ma phebs/ rgya yag mkhan po zer ba'i bla ma zhig gis dgon pa'i bca' yig sogs brtsams nas bros pa sog yul nas thu'u bkwan tshang mjal rjes dgon pa der phul/ de nas 'di ba slar phebs nas zhig gso sogs grub/ dgon pa nags rdzong stug po'i dkyil du chags pa la gcan gzan sogs kyi gnod 'tshe rgyun ma chad par skrag nas skyabs rje thu'u bkwan rdo rje 'chang sku phreng gsum par zhus ngor/ sku nyid nas dgon spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad cing 'debs gnas la dar chen thang zer bar thugs dgyes tshor mdzad/ 'bubs thebs dang ljags bkod gnang bzhin bod dbus bzheng gi 'du khang phub/ spen pad gyo thog can/ chos ra sgo khang rung khang dang /bla brang gi khang bskor bcas grub cing / rim gyis 'du khang steng du gser zangs las grub pa'i gañjir mi tshad lhag pa/ rgya mthong la thub dbang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i bla rgyud rags rim/grub thob brgyad cu/ gnas brtan bcu drug shod du sne sna dka' bcus sbyin bdag byas nas rje rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ kun rig gi lha tshogs rab bris mthong ba don ldan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam thar mdo rgyud du ma las btus pa/ gsham du rnam thar gi yi ge dang / lha dang rnam thar so so'i thad du mtshan byang dang ka rtags kyang bkod/ dge 'dun gyi thugs dam rten du tshe dpag med kyi sman sku thog tshad ma/ thub pa'i sku khyad 'phags/ btsan khang gyo tog can gyi pho brang nang rgyal bo sku lnga'i 'bag sku mi tshad longs pa/ stod smad bar gsum gyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang bzhug man ngag bzhin tshad ldan/ smon lam gyis skabs su bkras pa'i byams pa'i gong sku/ gong mtshon snga srol bros 'bur sku brnyan mang du bzhengs/ sku gsung thugs rten thams cad bla ma khong gi zhal bkod gang gnang ltar blus pa las lha bzo rang gis gang 'dod bya mi chog pa dang / gzungs gzhug kyang sku dngos kyis gzigs rtog mdzad de tshad ldan du bsgrubs pa sha stag nges/ nyid kyi dbu zhwa gos bur bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dang / mchod rdzas su gser gos sna tshogs las bsgrubs pa'i ka 'phan ring brgyad dang phye 'phur rmog bcas 'dzoms/ dgon lung ltar gyi 'cham btsugs shing gos bzang gi 'cham lwa/ zhal 'bag stod khebs/ phyag mtshon/ bod kyi grwa lham la sogs nyid kyis gnang / mtshan nyid chos grwa'ang btsugs/ gong mar mkhyen bcug ste dge tshogs gling zhes pen bstsal/ dgon 'di dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su ban ser mo ba brgya mchis par grags/ dbus gtsang — 763 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/ser 'bras mdo smad dgon lung sogs nas 'chad nyan mthar phyin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang 'gag shing rab 'byam/sa pa sogs mang du byung / yin na'ang rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag spyi lo1866lor ka ju'i ha'e mi mā kun o zhes pas ha'e dmag khrid de bsreg bcom byas te yongs su brlags/yang chin rgyal rabs kyi mjug tsam la dmag 'khrug mang bo byung / sa 'di'i mi grangs phal cher tshar song bas/dus phyis dgon gzhis chung chung 'ig btab/ 'du khang 'ig bzhengs yod na'ang / mā pu'u khyin gyi dam/ga dang rgya mis mnar gcod 'og chos rwa'i nang dmag rta'i rtsa spungs gshis 'du khang bcas mer sreg tu bcugabatsun pa phal cher dgon lung du bros/ de nas lo 'ga' 'gor rjes/ da dung rab rgyal sa sta ga spyi lo1927lo'i rjes su tsho ba'i nang gi bgres po dang grwa rgan shul lus rnams kyis ha'e dmag dpon po mā h+phu bkwan la ma khas thabs ngo zhu bgyis mthar de'i rogs skyor la brten nas slar 'du khang dang rung khang bcas bzhengs/ rim gyis gnas bdag khang dang / thu'u bkun bla brang / spyi ba bla brang / btsan khang / grwa shag bcas chags so/ /nang rten skor la thu'u bkwan rdo rje 'chang gi thugs bkod ltar/ 'du khang du sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'od dpag med dang / rje yab sras/ rje btsun byams ma/gon bcas kyi sku mi tshad tsam/ sangs rgyas sto nga sku/thugs rje chen po'i shing sku/ gser zangs kyi ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa/ tsan dan las grub pa'i mi 'khrugs pa byin can/ smon lam 'grem rgyu'i byams pa'i gos sku/ thugs rje chen po phyag sto nga spyan stong /gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong / sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ sgrol ma'i zhing bkod sogs sman sku dang rgyan thang / dgon lung nas gnang ba'i bla mchod tshogs zhing dang / mgon po phyag drug pa/ lha mo ba/su ma gyi thang ga byin can/ thu'u bkwan gyis gnang ba'i gser zangs las grub pa'i sku gzungs gzhug tu phul pa'i 'phrin las rgyal po'i 'bag sku mi tshad can/ snar thang shing dpar bka' bstan 'gyur tshar gcig yum sogs dam chos pota mang bo dang / shing las bzos pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ ga'an thu'u bkwan bla brang / spyi ba bla brang / grwa shag sogs su'ang sku gsung thugs rten dang gna' rdzas mchod rdzas gang mang bris kyis mi long / 'don pa chos spyod skor/ phyag len 'don rta dbyangs gsum/ 'bud dkrol rdung thams cad dgon lung gi phyag len spel/ sa khyi lo'i sngon la grwa grangs drug cu lhag bzhugs/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor brlags gtor bshig gsum gyis shul tsam yang med par btang ngo / / dgon pa'i mchod gzhis la garma/ pra sti/ te mur/ nags shul/ tshal sgang bcas tsho ba lnga/ sa zhing rgya 'jag brgya lnga bcu/ nags lung 'ga' yod par gtsug lag khang thams cad bzheng ba'i nom rtsa yin/dus ltar dgon lung thu'u bkwan mchog nas mngag gtong gnang ba'i sku tshab/ de'i 'phror spyi ba dang / dge bskos/ grwa rgan tshogs 'du bcas bsko srol dar ro/ /da skabs dgon pa'i gnas babs ni/ spyi 'o 1996lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin la rdzong srid — 761 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gzhung gi thugs khur 'og chos sgo phye/ da skabs lha khang khang mig gsum nang gser zangs kyi ston pa'i sku khru gsum can dang / gzhan thang ga 'ga' dang lcags dpar gyi 'bum pa tshar gcig gzungs 'dus/gser 'od sogs chos tshan du ma/ gtso bo thu'u bkun rin po ches gnang ba'i 'phrin las rgyal po'i sku chung chung sogs bzhugs su gsol/ dge slong gsum bzhugs par grwa shag mig drug bcas phub pa ma zad/dka' spyad sdug rus ngang dgon pa'i 'du khang zhig bzheng rgyu'i gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /hor dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling /hor dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling(caḥr+sha)ni/ sngon chad lang ju la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi hor nags yangs shug cha'i shug bkra chu bo byang gi ri ngos su chags/ mtsho tshad smi sum stong yas mas dang / rdzong gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le brgya dang bzhi bcu yod/dgon 'di chin rgyal rabs gong ma chen po'i zhabs brtan gyi dgon pa phog dngul can gyi gras yin/sngon dpa' ris nags yangs sa 'di bhan ta hor gyis bzung ba'i sa cha yin pas hor lho ba zer/ rgya'i yig rnying du we rgyal rabs byang ma'i dus su phyogs 'di'i ming la thu khyod ces bkod/ phyis su bod dmag dpa' ris su phebs nas bod kyi mnga' 'og tu slar bkugs rjes da bar sgra cung 'gyur nas stod pa zer/ ngag rgyun du hor dgon 'di gna' snga mor btab zer/ bod rgyal srong btsan gyi rjes su gnas 'dir bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gyi shul de da dung yod/ dgon pa chags kyang chu'i 'jigs par skrag nas mchod rten ni chu 'gog pa'i ched du bzhengs par grags/ dus la dpags na thang rgyal thog ma'am thang rgyal sngon pa'i dus su(spyi lo907sngon tsam)yod pa 'dra/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprel spyi lo1244lor chos rje sa paṇa 'khor bcas hor go dan rgyal pos gdan drangs bzhin lang jus su byon/ me phag lor sa paṇa gyis dpa' ris hor nags yangs yul grur zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ hor dgon 'di'ang slar gsos mdzad de sa skya ba'i dgon par bsgyur/ ngag rgyun la/ sa 'di'i gzhi bdag rdza dmar maṇ+ḍal(ming la blo bzang kun dga' 'bod) ni sa paṇa gyi gsol thab pa yin zer ba'i lo rgyus snang / de nas chin rgyal rabs gong ma thabs skyong rgyal bo khrir bzhugs skabs lha sa'i dge bshes or so mkhan po zhes pas rgya cher bskyed de dge lugs pa'i dgon par bsgyur cing khong yang dgon bdag tu gyur/ dgon 'di dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su btsun grangs chig stong lnga brgya longs/ hor dgon chen ban dgu brgya zhes bshad srol da bar brgyud/ dus de tsam nas dgon 'di gser khog dgon pa'i dgon lag tu gyur/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu mo yos nas gser khog dgon gyi zha lu ba tshang 'dir skabs shig bzhugs/ de nas or so mkhan pos rgya bskyed mdzad de byams khang dang / byams khang du rgyal sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal chen khang / tshogs chen 'du khang / rgyud pa'i 'du — 765 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/khang / mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang / 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang / mgon khang /btsan khang / tsi dmar khang / gnas bdag khang bcas bzhengs pa las byams khang gi bzo bkod ni ches khyad du 'phags shing / deng skabs mes bzhes shul du g.yu cog ljang khu dang ser bo sogs da dung mig gis mngon sum du mthong snang yod/ rten gyi skor la/ byams khang gi byams sku thog tshad gzungs gzhug rje mi la ras pa'i sgom thag gi tshal bu ring thung khru gang tsam 'brong rtsid yin/ sa paṇa gyi thugs dam rten thub dbang gi sku me thar ma(gser zangs tshun lnga tsam)/ byams sku me thar ma (gser zangs tshun gsum tsam da skabs bzhugs) hor rgyal gyi dus su gser dngul mtshal dung las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcigamatshal las bzhengs pa'i 'bum tshad gcig shing dpar gyi bka' bstan tshar kha shas/ sngon sa 'dir lha 'brum byung dus lha 'brum bzhes pa yin zer ba'i lha mo'i rten sbub steng na nag thig yod pa'i sbub cha gcigagazhan sku gsung thugs rten mang du mchis kyang / mang che ba ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me pho stag spyi lo1866lor mā kun a'o gtsos ha'e dmag gis bcom tshar/ de dag gi nang nas rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sgom thag dang thub sku/ byams sku me thar gsum po'ang de dus me las thar ba yin zer/ yang de dus gser dngul las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur sogs dam chos pota grangs mang bo dang / gna' rdzas skor gcig rdza stong gi brag khung dang / 'gag mdo zer ba'i mchod rten yod sa'i ri'i ngos la dong brkos nas spar ba'ang skor gcig spyi lo1928lor mā pu'u chen gyi ha'e dmag sdong gcod du yong nas brlags tshar/ brag khung du lus pa thams cad rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i rjes su rim gyis 'jig go/dgon pa'i chos skyong gtso bo mgon po dang lha mo/ sgos su tsi dmar dang dam can ra bcibs bsten/dgon pa'i nub phyogs kyi brag rtser brag khung zhig yod pa der dam can mgar khang zer gyin yod de mtshams dgong mo dang nyin dkar smug pa 'thibs dus brag rtsar song na mgar ba'i tho sgra thos pa dang / me stag 'tshub pa sogs mig gis mthong mod/ las 'gul drag che ba'i lo du mar med song zer/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags lug rjes su yang tho sgra sngar ltar thos mi yod do/ /rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i sngon gyi dgon pa'i gnas bab mdor tsam gleng na/ rab rgyal chu bya spyi lo192 2lor tsha kho bla ma dang hor grub chen rnam gnyi gas gtso 'gan bzhes pa dang / rgya yag tsho ba'i sangs rgyas bkra shis dang / bla ma bkra shis/ shar mda' brgyad tsho ba'i rig 'dzin/ de min hor stobs dang zhwa dmar/ ldan ma bcas tsho ba sogs kyi dad ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis rogs ram byas pa la bsten nas snga gzhug tu tshogs chen 'du khang dang / mgon khang dang / rung khang / nang chen rwa phyi nang gnyis re(tsha kho sgar ba dang grub chen sgar ba)can sogs tshon bcas bzhengs grub/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi skor la 'du khang 'jim 'bag las grub pa'i ston pa gtso 'khor rnam gsum/ gnas brtan bcu drug g.yas su jo 'brom yab sras gsum/ g.yon du rje yab sras gsum/ rje stong sku dpar ma/ ston pa dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi thang ga — 766 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/gos drub ma/ snar thang dpar ma'i bka' bstan tshar gcig rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ 'bum tshar gnyis/ gzhan chos pota mang du mchis/ mi la ras pa'i sgom thag dang / thub sku/ byams sku me thar ma/ lha 'brum bzhes pa'i lha mo'i rten sbub dang ta ming rgyal rabs dus kyi sbub che chung cha lnga/ shing shing de'u yin zer ba'i ting shag cha gcig ar skya lha bzo ba'i mdun cog sogs gna' rdzas mang du mchis kyang spyi lo1958lor byams sku me thar ma chung chung dang nang chen gnyis kyi thog khang gyan lnga/ grwa shag gyan bzhi bcu zhe gnyis las gzhan thams cad brlags tshar ro/ /dgon pa'i mdzad sgo'i skor la lo ltar dbyar gnas dang zla yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong chag med/ sa ga zla ba'i nang rje gser khang ba'i phyag len ltar mchod pa nyin bdun/ dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo nyin bdun/rgya lo'i smon lam nyin bcu gnyis/ zla re'i nyer dgu'i nyin chos skyong zhabs sil ba'i bskang gso sogs tshogs 'don phyag len pa phal cher 'bru gu dgon pa'i phyag len ltar spel to/ /dgon pa'i dpal 'byor 'byung khungs sngon chad sog yul gyi cung gur la mchod yon gyi 'brel che bas phan rgya cher thogs pa bcings 'grol rjes su mtshams chad/ mchod gzhis la sngon chad lho ba dang / hor/g.yag thod bcas tsho ba gsum yod kyang / phyis su dus rkyen gyi 'gyur ltog che bas da skabs lho ba gcig tsam du gyur/ de'i nang du dgon par dbang ba'i rtswa sa phal cher mu'u lnga khri longs pa dang / mdun ri'i bkag nags mu'u bdun stong lhag sa zhing mu'u chig stong nyis brgya/ nor gnag lnga brgya/ lug nyis stong lhagarta drel drug cu bcas skyong gnyer byas so/ /tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes te spyi lo19ra 2lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga nyin slar yang chos sgo phye/ srid gzhung gis snga gzhug tu rogs skyor ma dngul sgor chig khri nyis stong gnang ba dang / 1958lo'i shul du lus pa'i khang rnying khang mig zhe bdun rmang gzhi'i steng 'du khang dang lha khang bzhengs/ grwa ba 'dug sa'i khang ba phub/ rten rnying sa 'og nas thon pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sku chung chung zhig nang rten du bzhugs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i 'jim sku bzhengs/ lcags dpar bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig rje yab sras gsung 'bum/ hor grub chen pa'i sku gdung mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa bcas bzhugs/ da skabs dgon du btsun pa nyung nyung 'dus pa dang 'tsho rten la nor gnag lnga bcu/ rtswa sa mu'u nyis stong lhag yod de do dam kru'u rin tsha kho tshul khrims rgya mtshos skyong khur gnang bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /sngon chad dgon pa dar dus su tham ga bla brang / mkhan bla brang / ldan ma/ grub chen bla brang / tsha kho bla brang bcas nang chen khag tshugs/ de dag las bla sprul sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdo tsam gleng na/tham ga sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dpa' ris nags yangs dgon pa'i lo rgyus su gsal/od so mkhan po sku phreng du byon pa mi gsal na'ang mkhan po zhes pa'i cho lo ni rgya nag gi rgyal pos gnang skad de/— 767 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/sngon chad khong gi rang rnam mdor bsdus dang gsung 'bum tha thor pota chung ngu gcig yod/ hor grub chen gyi sku thog dang bo sa 'di'i mtsho khol zer ba'i sa na mtsho chung chung zhig yod/ de'i nang nas glang sngon po bcibs nas byon zer(mtsho 'dir deng sang da dung grub chen bla mtsho zer) dus nam zhig mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas rje mi la ras pa'i sgom thag bsnams nas bar snang skyod pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis bkra shis lhun por bka' chos gnang skabs glo bur du khong nyid kyi phyag bar snang du bsrings shing spyan de'i phyogs su gzigs tsam la zhal 'dzum pa mdzad/ bka' chos grol rjes phyag phyi rnams kyis de ltar mdzad don gang yin zhus pa na/nyid kyis/ o/ khyod tshos ma mthong / a mdo'i phyogs kyi grub chen zhig gis mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sgom thag drangs nas mar 'gro bzhin mchis/ ngas nga la cung zhig byin byos pa na'ang /khos mig gis blta tsam yang mi byed par mar bud song / zhes grub chen gyi mtshan yang de ltar thogs zer /khong nags yangs zhwa dmar tsho bar 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus nas mtsho sngon 'bru gung dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo la bsten nas thos bsam mdzad de dge bshes thob/ spyi lo192 2lor phyir phebs/ bcings 'grol btang rjes nyid gcig pus bka' 'gyur tshar gsum bklags/'bru gung rgan po'i zhal chems ltar/ nga 'das rjes/ nga'i kha bton brgyad stong ba'i dpe cha 'di hor grub chen tshang la phul/ deng phyin khong las gzhan brgyad stong zhal 'don mdzad thub mkhan dkon gsungs shing /dus de nas ba thung nyin re bzhin brgyad stong zhal 'don 'chag med mdzad mthar spyi lo1958lor btson khang nas sku 'das so/ /tsha kho tshang ni rgan rabs tsho'i bshad srol la tsha kho kirti thogs med kyi sprul sku yin zer/ sku 'di nyid thog mar 'dir yongs su mjal skor du 'gro ba'i a skyo ba'i tshul bzung nas rgyab tu 'bog sgril khur/lag na sba g.yug gi mkhar gsil khog stong nang gser gang yod pa zhig bzung yod pas phyis su thams cad kyis a skyo ba gser khur zer/ dpa' ris ba dan dgon la thon tshe or so dgon gyi 'du khang gser bzhengs grub pa'i skabs dang 'phrad/ nub der or so mkhan po tshang gi mtshan lam ltar/ phyi nyin mkhan pos grwa ba gsum mngags te nyin gnyis la lam nas bsgug rjes kyi phyi drod mkhan po tshang la/ nged tshos nyin gnyis la bsgugs kyang a skyo ba gcig las bla ma 'dra gcig kyang ma phebs/ mkhan pos de yin gsungs nas/ mkhan po tshang dgung lo bgres stabs myur du grwa rgan gnyis zhu ru 'gror bcug khong rnams rgya yag dgon nas bla ma dang 'phrad/ 'du khang rab gnas la phebs dgos pa'i gdan 'dren zhus/ khong gis nga rang mjal skor du 'gro mkhan yin pas phyir 'gro rgyu khag po yin/ de las khyed tshos nyin 'di 'drar rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo ltar mchod bshoms yag po gyis la tshogs 'tshogs dang / ngas lam nas rab gnas byed gsungs/ phyir mkhan po tshang la zhus pas/ mkhan pos kyang de ltar mdzad pas nyin der 'tshogs skabs 'du khang steng du 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa dang nang du phyag nas babs pas thams cad ya mtshar du gyur/ de nyin a skyo ba khong nyid kurma ri khrod nas tshur rab gnas gnang ba yin/ deng sang kurma ri khrod du rab gnas gnang skabs bzhugs sa — 768 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang daso/na dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/yin zer ba'i rdo zhig gi steng na zhabs rjes dang lag rten btsugs shul khung bu dang pha bong zhig gi steng na phyag nas babs shul 'dam la zug pa ltar da dung gsal/ de nas lang jus sde bzhi mjal rjes hor dgon par phebs nas or so mkhan pos hor dgon dang or so dgon gnyis phul nas bzhugs shing khong nyid dgon bdag tu gyur/ phyis su 'khrungs rabs rnam thar zhig yod kyang dus rkyen gyi dbang du song / spyi 'o 1kha2 2'o ra grub chen tshang dang mnyam du hor dgon nyams gso mdzad pa bo ni/ dpa' ris nags yangs zhwa dmar tsho ba'i stag tshang zhes pa'i bod kyi 'brog khyim zhig nas sku 'khrungs/ lde'u tsha dgon nas dpe gzigs gnang / sku gang bor yi dam yang gsang dang 'jigs mdzad rdo rje rnal 'byor la 'bad pas lung bstan gsungs pa mang ba dang / mthu nus can du grags/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa grangs la bgrongs/ sku 'da' khar na bza' dang spyan shel/ g.yang ṭi'i sna dam sogs rgya yag tsa mo tshang la gnang nas khyod kyi 'di bdag byos dang phyi lor nged gnyis nges par 'phrad yong gsungs so/ /sku phreng gong ma rnams rgya yag dgon dang rgya ldo ga ta ban dgon/ 'bru gu/ khor so/ hor dgon rnams kyi khri/ ra bzhugs myong la/ sgar khag kyang yod do/ /sngo shul ri khrod/sngo shul ri khrod ni/ hor dgon pa'i mdun ri'i rgyab kyi ri rtser chags/ 'du khang gi shul dang grwa shag bcu lhag gi gna' shul da dung gsal ler mchis kyang / 'debs lo dang 'debs mkhan mi gsal/ tsha kho ri khrod pa dang / hor grub chen sogs bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug yo da/ chen rgyab rabs thun kru'i rjes su dar ma thub pas lo rgyus zhib tu gleng ma thub po/ /nags yangs dgon gong ma bkra shis tshogs rdzogs gling /hor nags yangs dgon bkra shis tshogs rdzogs gling(nga7khri༅r+sha)ni/ dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong ldan ma 'ang du chags/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las rgyang thag spyi le brgya dang bco brgyad yod/ dgon 'di ni dbus gtsang bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ ching thung kri skabs la dgon pa 'khrug long bar du bsnubs/ rjes su nye logs tsho bas bskyar du bzhengs/ dgon par tshogs chen 'du khang gcig grwa khang bcu bzhi/ mdzod khang gsum/ g.yis khang gcig rang 'thag khang gcig sa zhing mu'u sum brgya/ lug bdun brgya/ nor gnag bzhi brgya/ rta nyi shu lhag yod/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor chab srid kyi las 'gul nang rtsa med du brlags/ /spyi lo197ngalor tang gi mi rigs chos lugs kyi srid jus lag bstar byas nas dgon 'dir slar chos spyod spel ba'i 'du khang chung ngu zhig dang grwa khang rgyan gsum bzhengs/ spyi lo1984lo nas chos sgo slar 'byed pa'i skal ba bzang po ldan no/— 769 —

wu'u we sa khul dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs/dgon bdag bla ma tham ga tshang zhes pa yin/ sku phreng dang bo nas sku phreng bcu gnyis bar deb ther dang lo rgyus kyi yig cha'i nang khong rnam pa'i mdzad rjes dang lo rgyus sogs bkod pa shin tu dkon pas 'dir brjod thabs zad do/ /sku phreng bcu gsum pa khong nyid rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho stag lo'i dbyar zla bzang po'i dus dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong shug cha zhang 'brog khul nas yab lhun mgon srung / yum tshe ring skyid kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi steng sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bla chen rnams kyis tham ga sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i sprul sku yin pa thugs thag bcad/ mtshan la blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho zhes bstsal/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing mo lug gi nyin skar ma bzang bo'i nyin la hor nags yangs dgon pa'i khri la bkod/ lo de nas bzung sku 'bum byams pa gling / 'bru gung dgon sogs la phebs bzhud gnang nas slob dpon dang bla ma mang bor bsten te bstan gzhung klog sbyong dang rig gnas bslabs/ spyi lo1991lo nas1992lo'i bar krung go bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling du phyag phebs nas rig gnas spyi dang khyad par nang bstan rig pa sbyong bar 'bad 'bungs bgyis/ sku tshe gang bor mi rigs mthun sgril dang sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel la nus shugs gang yod phul mthar spyi lo1999lo zla2tshes15la re zhig dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim par gyur ro/ /nags yangs dgon zhol ma bkra shis chos 'khor gling /hor nags yangs dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling(77khrikor+sha)ni/ dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong 'dan ma 'ang du chags/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yu la rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le bco brgyad yod/ching rgyal rabs shun ju skabs spyi lo 1645lo/ rab byung bcu gcig pa shing mo bya lor sngags rams pa shes rab blo gros kyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ min go skabs nas dgon pa nyams rgud du song / dgon bdag bla ma tham ga tshang yin/ dgon 'di re zhig chi len dang / 'dan ma(ldan ma)/ shug cha bcas bod 'tsho sa khul gyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi srid dbang lte gnas zhig tu gyur myong /dgon 'di la tshogs chen 'du khang gnyis/ lha khang gnyis/ nang chen gsum ste tham ga nang chen/'bri gung nang chen/ 'dam ma nang chen bcas yod/ de'i khor yug nye logs su brag khung ri khrod/ 'dab chags ri khrod/ gro tshang ri khrod/ zha zur ri khrod/ bar ma ri khrod bcas gnas dben yod/ rab rgyal sa glang spyi lo1949lor dge 'dun pa bdun dang / sa zhing mu'u brgya dang nyi shu/ ra ma brgya lhag rta nor bsdoms pas bco lnga dang / g.yis khang dang rang 'thag so gas 'tsho rten gyi cha rkyen ldan/ rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor chab srid las 'gul nang gtor brlag thebs tshun da snga bar du slar bzheng ba'i bskal ba ma ldan par lus so/ /lho ba dgon chung /— 770 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las gan su'u glegs bam/da lho ba dgon chung ni/ hor lho ba'i them rgan(༅phyar+sha)zer ba'i sa char yod/'debs lo hor dgon par phal cher 'dra ba dang lho ba stong dpon gyi dgon pa zer ba las lo rgyus gsal bo mi nges/ brag khung chen po zhig na dam chos pota mang bo dang sku 'dra sogs yod na'ang mis gtor brlag byas te 'jig go/garma ri khrod/garma ri khrod(thozar+sha)ni/ sngon chad lang jus la gtogs pa dang / da lta gan su'u zhing chen wu'u we sa khul gyi dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong gi khongs mtsho tshad smi2800yod pa'i sar chags/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas yul rab rgyas dgon las bar thag spyi le145yod/ri khrod 'di ni sngon nas bzung btab pa'i sgrub gnas byin can zhig yin la/ phyis su kurma'i bla chen mang bos sgom sgrub mdzad cing mi rigs kha shas 'dus pas de ltar thogs/ gna' dus su rnal 'byor ba bzhis gnas 'di nas sgrub pa yun ring mdzad mthar thams cad nam mkhar 'phur/ gcig rgyang ring du 'phur ma nus par nye 'khor gyi brag la bab pa'i lo rgyus snang / dus chen rnams su sgra snyan sna tshogs mi ser gyi thos 'dzin du phyogs/ thang rgyal rabs(spyi lo༅07ston tsam)kyi gong ma the tsung gis bde chen lha khang du bsngags par gleng / tā ming gsum pa yung lo'i skabs zhig gso bgyis/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu pho khyi spyi lo1442lor lang ju phyogs kyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i dmag dpon tha'i rgyan li gus zer ba dang / bod kyi bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shākya'i dge slong bzod pa dpal/ dge tshul dharma shrī sogs kyis lha khang khang mig gsum skor lam bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon du khang ba khang mig nyi shu re/ rgyal chen khang / thub pa grong gshegs kyi lha khang / mchod rten gsum/ rung khang spyi khang bcas bzhengs/ mtshan du bsod nams lha khang zhes gsol ba'i lo rgyus rdo ring du yi ger bkod pa mchis te/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa bya spyi lo1844lor mer 'jig gshis da la shul tsam du gyur to/ /

lan gru grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs/༄/ /lan gru grong khyer/yung tin rdzong gi khongs/te thung rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang /te thung rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang ni(shā༅/༅r+sha)sngon chad 'brong lung we la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen lan gru grong khyer yung ting rdzong gi khongs su chags/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo1424lo ra 'brong lung yul dpon shākya klu byams kyis phyag 'debs gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'ig yin/ 19〈1lor zhing chen rim pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob sde tshan du bkod/18( 0lo'i zla5ba'i tshes17nyin tshugs pa'i rdo ring ltar na/ min rgyal dus kyi dmag srid don byed las shas/ gi mgo gtso mi rabs gsum pa'i mkhas chen gyis btab/ rdo ring 'dzugs bar lo lnga brgya lhag 'das zer te ha lam spyi lo1247lo'i zla2pa'i tshes22nyin dgon mtshan gnang zer/ 1442lor rgya ming te thung dge zhes pa btags/ rgyal dbang drug pa dang paṇa chen lnga ba phebs myangs/ yang thos rgyun du sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yu la na mkhas pa chen po te lo ba dz+nyān bh+ra tra zhes pa bzhugs pa lha khang gi rten skal du bzhugs/ rdo rje 'chang ni 'ja' lus chos sku grub/ te lo ba ni ga'an la rten pa med ces pa'i mkhas pa de nyid thun mong ba tsam min par mi'i zlos gar gyi tshul du rnam par rol te/ gang zag gzhan la brten pa med par gdams ngag gi rig pa klong rdol ba zhig tu nges/ nyin gcig rdzogs pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dbus na chos kyi sgra chen po zhig byung ba gzigs pas/ rdo rje'ang sku mdog mthing ga rin chen rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs 'chang ba/ phyag gnyis thugs kur bsnol cing rdo dril bsnams pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha lugs 'dzin pa'i spyan hrig ger gzigs nas/ rigs kyi bu/ /stong nyid chos sku don dam skye med kyi/ /'byung dang mi 'byung rang rig ngo bo nyid/ /chos sku stong bar rang shar rang grol 'di/ /skye 'phags thar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa che/ /zhes gsungs pas mo/sa gus lhag par btab/ bu nga 'dra ba zhig bzhes pas/ 'od la la ni yal/ la la rang la thim pas bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de 'dra ba zhig bzhengs dgos dgongs pa dang mnyam du/ nam mkha' nas sgra zhig las ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang dang / yangs pa can gnyis na sku grub pa'i rgyu yod de longs shig ces pa byung ma thag bya rkang gi pri ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du phebs pas dhi k+ṣim gyi sku gcig bzhugs pa des/— 772 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nga 'dra ba zhig bzhengs gsungs pas sku rgyu 'di 'dra ni mi rnyed par 'dug pas mi 'grub po zhes pa'i brda yin nam dgongs so/ /de nas nam zhig nam mkha' nas rdo rje 'chang gi sku rin po che dhe k+ṣim las grub pa mtho gang ba 'ig 'od lhang nge byon nas nga ni khyod kyi rten skal lo/ /mtha' ni gdong dmar yul du 'gro/ /nag po'i phyogs ni dkar bar byed/ /'brog gi klu la 'chang bar byed/ /zhing de chos kyis 'byed par 'ong / /srung ma ma hā kā la dang / /e ka tsa ti sde brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs nas rten skal du gyur pa la thugs shin tu dgyes nas gdan drangs/ zhes pa lta bur gsungs pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du snang / de nas phyis su dpa' nā ro ba la rten skal du gnang / nā ro bas bu la ha ri'i dgon par gdan drangs nas rten gyi gtso bor mdzad cing yod pa'i skabs shig kha che mu stegs pa rnams kyis rtsod pa'i 'jigs pa byung dus su yang nam mkhar 'phags nas bzhugs/de nas nā ro ba'i sku gdung rus rgyan rnams bod kyi mar ba lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros(1092—1091)kyis gdan 'dren skabs nga yang 'gro gsungs nas lho brag bro bo lung du phebs nas bzhugs/ de nas sa skyar phe bas na'ang slar bro bo lung du lhags skad/ phyogs 'dir 'phan nā len+d+ra gdung chos rje bco brgyad pas sa skya dang / bro bo lung sogs su gnas skor du phyin nas tshur phebs dus bro bo lung nas sku 'di gdan drangs nas na len+d+rar bzhugs/ de skabs sa skya dang 'bri gung gnyis phan tshun the zlog byed res kyi skabs su khel/ hor tsha har rgyal bo dbus gtsang la song nas bod thams cad mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ tshur yong skabs byin can gyi rten mang bo dang / nā ro ba'i sku gdung / rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'di dang bcas gdan drangs te mtsho khar slebs/rgyal bos sku gdung rten rnams dang chabs gcig stabs bde bas snga bar 'ju lag brgyud nas yong bas khu khur thu'i la rtsar slebs skabs/ sku gdung dang rten rnams sngon du song / rgyal bo rang nyid cung zad rjes la 'gyangs nas byon/ bod kyi lha 'dre rnams rten gyi rjes su 'brangs pa la 'phrul 'tshub byas/ de'i skabs 'od de gung rgyal la sogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams la'i phar brgal nas sku gdung dang rten rnams gangs nang du sbas/der btsal nas rten drangs pa'i dre'u min pa gzhan ma rnyed/ sku gdung de ni la'i phar phyogs gangs nang na da ltar yang bzhugs/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'di sngon gyi zhal bzhes bzhin mgon po gur dang / e ka tsa ti sde brgyad kyi tshogs bcas nam mkhar btegs nas gdong sna dmar bo'i steng shug sdong zhig gi khar zhag bdun dang / 'ju lag chur brgyud de phebs nas col la'i steng zhag gsum bzhugs/ de nas gdul bya 'dir smin par gzigs nas da lta'i grong gnas pa 'dir de dus tsan dan la sogs pa'i nags tshal chen po yod pa'i tsan dan gyi sdong po 'ig gis mthong nas dpon klu skyabs la zhus pa na khong tshur lta ru 'ongs tshe sdong bo'i steng 'dom phyed kyis 'phags nas bzhugs shing 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs du ma 'phro ba 'ja' tshon gyi 'khor lo zlum por phul bzhin pa mthong / kha sang nas phyogs 'dir 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang byung ba/ chu sgra byung ba sogs dang / rmi lam du'ang phun tshogs 'byung ba rnams brtags na 'di ni rang cag rnams kyi legs byas las phebs pa min pa'i nges pa med zer nas dad gus phyag mchod mtha' yas pa zhus/ rol mo'i sgra yang byung /— 773 —

lan gru grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs/dpon la sogs pa rnams kyis bgros nas/ ji ltar len zhes pas la las shing bcad nas dang / 'dzeg nas dang / pheb par gsol ba sbrags pa la sogs pas gdan 'dren par kha 'cham pa na/ gtso bos 'gos nas len zer nas 'gos pas nam mkhar ring du btegs song / shing de'i rtsad par ma hā ka la mi nag po'i tshul can du gnas nas smras pa/ khyed rang rnams kyis mchod yul du spyan 'dren na khri dang mchod pa legs par bshams pa gsol ba 'thob cig des na 'ong zer ba ltar/ rgyan khri gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/me tog dang spos/ rol mo'i bye brag dang / rten yol la sogs pa bzung du bcug dpon gnyis la sogs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba 'ur btab pas sku de khri'i steng du 'od kyi spro bsdu dang bcas te 'tsham par babs/de nas rang gi gnas khang du gdan byed bsams nas mi bzhi rgyan 'chor spras shing khri sku dang bcas 'degs rtsol byas pas ma khyogs/ gsol ba drag tu btab phyin gsung byon nas/ nga ni grong khyim du 'gro'o/ /'dug khang chung ba zhig 'dir gyis shig gsungs bkrol pas shin tu dga'/ mos gus pa thams cad kyis 'dun shugs gcig gis nyin gcig la khang ba chung ngu zhig bskrun pa grub ma thag tu rtsol ba med par gnas su phebs/sngon gyi legs byas dge ba'i stobs dang / smon lam rnam par dag cing lha'i byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor bzang bo las rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis dbyer med pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter du grub pa'i sku brnyan rin po che 'di/'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du/ sa'i dge mtshan du mas brgyan pa'i yul ljongs 'dir gtan 'jags su bzhugs pa'i bskal ba bzang po mngon du gyur/ phyogs 'di'i skye bo mtha' dag dge ba rnam par dkar pa'i chos kyi phung bo bcu la rol pa kho nas 'da' ba byung / de'i rjes bstan 'gro'i rgyun tsam ma chad par da lta'i bar du bzhugs so/ /sku 'di ni mi thog 'ga'i ring de ltar bzhugs pa phyis su bla ma lho sdings pa zer ba zhig gi dus/ sngar gyi tsan dan gyi sdong bo des gdung sogs byas te/ gtsug lag khang chen po bskrun nas rten gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'dra che ba'i nang gzhug tu rang byon rdo rje 'chang gi sku de nyid sbal tshul du bzhugs bcug de nas chu rgyun 'dzin pa 'od 'byung ba sogs pa ni 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ltas bzang rmad du byung ba ngo mtshar byung / sku rten de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor gnyis bzhugs pa sku'i bong gtso mtshungs su 'dom phyed tsam yod pa/ g.yas g.yon na gral rim ba'in thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal bo dang / dpa' mo'i lugs/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ mtha' rten khro bo rta mgrin lcags ral can/ chos rgyal gyi 'dra sku ye shes pa dngos su zhugs pa bcas bzhugs/ skor lam nang ma'i rtsig ngos la brag ri'i phug pa rnams su mi pham mgon pos gtsos pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas/ seng ge nga ro/ mi skyod pa/ g.yas ngos na gsang 'dus/ bde mchog 'phags byed gsum dang / rnam snang /'jam rdor/ dmar nag 'jigs gdong sogs thabs brgyud kyi lha tshogs/ g.yon ngos su/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ kyai rdor/ bdag med ma zog shes brgyud kyi lha tshogs/ bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma la sogs pa de dag rang rang gi brgyud khungs kyi bla ma rnams dang / steng phyogs bung bu rnams su rgyal dang rgyal sras 'i khro'i — 774 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/rten brten pa ji snyed bzhugs/ mdun du dus gsum sangs rgyas li ma gsum bzhugs pa 'di sngon gro tshang nas gdan 'dren pa'i skabs su rjes la phyugs zog 'brangs pa dang / gsung byon pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/gsung gi rten la gser dngul gyis bris pa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dang / mtshal bris bstan 'gyur sogs bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la lha khang gi rgyab byang mtshams su mchod rten chen po gnyis la sogs pa sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'phro ba bas ma gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs so/ /rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo1727lor kun grol rin po che ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtshos sbyin bdag gnang ste cho 'phrul smon lam gyi phyag len btsugs/ gsung chos gnang / gtor rgyag mdzad/dge 'dun stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya 'dus/ ston pa khang / rnam 'joms khang / mchod rten khang /gsol mchod khang / sgom sgrub khang / gtsug khag khang / 'du khang / rgod lung pho brang bcas brgyad yod/rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos zhwa nag gi 'cham bslabs/ yul dpon klu rgan gyis dkyil 'khor lha khang du gdan drangs/ lha khang du blos bslangs gsum yod pa'i nang du phar 'byon tshur 'byon ma dzad/ de dus lū kyā dpon slob dang dpon klu skyabs kyi rgyud pa mchod yon gyis te thung dgon chen dang zung 'brel du bskyangs/smon lam la dgon sgrub sde bzhi'i dge 'dun rnams mnyam du 'tshogs/ te thung dgon chen dang chu lung dgon pa'i slob gnyer ba re mos kyi smon lam grwa skor dang tshogs gling byed pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi yo lang che de nas rim gyis thu'u bkun rin po che/ sum pa mkhan chen/ dpa' ris rab gsal sogs skyes chen dam pa mi nyung ba phebs te slob khrid mdzad/ sa khyon smi lham po drug stong bzung / rab rgyal sa khyi lor sku gsung thugs rten thams cad rtsa gtor btang zin kyang / rten gtso rang byon rdo rje 'chang gi sku ni da dung lus yod/gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang dang bcas pa ni de dus dpa' ris kyi mi rigs khag gi mi brgya phrag lhag gtor bshig byed du song na'ang / sa de'i dad ldan mang tshogs tshos bkag pas brlag ma nus/ spyi lo1985lo nas bzung gong rim gyis chog mchan gnang ste chos sgo slar yang phye nas nang rten mang bo gsar bzhengs bgyis so/ /brag dgon mchog dga' gling /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga dang gnyis su med pa'i brag dgon mchog dga' gling ni sngon chad hor rgyal gyi ring la sog po'i yul dpon klu skyabs kyi mnga' 'og la gtogs pa dang / da lta kun su'u zhing chen lan kru'u grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs su chags/dgon pa 'di rab byung bzhi ba'i me rta spyi lo12 46lor sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis phyag 'debs gnang ba'i sa skya ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ mchog dga' gling zhes thogs don ni/ rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug spyi lo12 44lor sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan hor rgyal go dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin lang ju la — 775 —

lan gru grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs/phebs/ bstan don du mdzad 'phrin mang bo ba'ag dpa' ris phyogs kyi hor nags yangs dang / rgya rdogamadung nag 'jam dbyangs/ brag dgon la sogs pa'i gnas mchog gang mang la zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ de sngar rgyal po srong btsan gyi sku ring la rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya ri bo rtse lngar gdan drangs skabs thog mar gnas 'dir phebs te bkra shis gso sbyo nga mdzad cing dbyar bzhugs thugs bzhis gnang ste/ gnas byin gyis brlabs pa dang bstan pa'i dbu 'dzugs par mdzad/ phyis su sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rnam gnyis hor rgyal pos gdan drangs tshe gnas 'dir phebs nas gnas 'di 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams zhing du gyur pa ri bo rtse lnga'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bzhugs gnas dang mtshungs pa'i gnas khyad du 'phags pa yin gsungs shing / mchog dga' gling zhes pa'i sa skya'i sgrub sde phyag 'debs gnang / de'i rjes su rgya nag tā ming rgyal bo'i sku ring 'a / sa skya'i grub chen bla chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dge lugs pa rje klu 'bum bsam gtan gnyis 'dir byon/ du ru chen po dpon klu skyabs gtsos bod hor rgya gsum gyi sbyin bdag rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar/ bla chen rnam gnyis kyis zhal bkod mdzad nas dbus ri'i rtser sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i 'phel gdung ring bsrel/na bza' dang / rgya gar/ bod yul/ rgya nag sogs kyi gnas chen du ma'i rten sna byin can las grub pa'i rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan rang byon lnga ldan gtso 'khor gsum lha khang dang bcas pa/ lho ri'i rtser sangs rgyas 'od srung dang shākya thub pa'i ring bsrel/ gzhan sangs rgyas byang sems/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma'i 'phel gdung ring bsrel/ phyag tshwa/ na bza'/ sgrub gnas mang bo'i sa sna rdo sna las grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan mthong ba don 'khor mchog zung bcas/ logs bris la gnas brten bcu drug bzhugs pa'i lha khang / nub ngos su phyi nang gi sa dgra 'dul phyir du dmigs nas rten byin can du ma las grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang bo'i sku gtso 'khor gsum pa'i lha khang /byang ri'i rtser rgya nag ri bo gru 'dzin gyi rten sna dang / gzhan sangs rgyas byang sems mang bo'i 'phel gdung ring bsrel byin can du ma las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku ri bo gru 'dzin dang sku nyams mtshungs pa/ sku 'di bzheng skabs su ri bo gru 'dzin gyi phyogs nas 'phur 'ongs pa'i ne tso dkar po yid du 'ong ba 'ig mngon sum du rten de la thim pa kun gyis mthong ba'i rten byin can gtso 'khor lnga'i lha khang / shar ngos su ri bo rtse lnga'i sa sna rten sna gzhan 'phel gdung ring bsrel na bza' dbu skra sogs byin ldan du ma las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba gtso 'khor gsum pa/ logs bris su ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas kyi bkod pa'i lha khang bcas gsar du bzhengs so/ /de'i rjes su grub dbang klu 'bum bsam gtan seng ge rin po che de nyid gnas 'di'i bde mchog sgrub phug tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad skabs/ lha dang mkha' 'gro du ma'i zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa ltar/sngar gyi sa skya'i mchog dga' gling de nyid gnas spar te dge 'dun bcu phrag gsum lhag 'dus par ri de'i — 776 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/mdun ngos su lha khang 'du khang bla brang grwa shag sogs gsar du bzhengs nas/ dben gnas brag dgon ri khrod ces pa'i mtshan gsol/ 'du khang gi rten gyi gtso bor sangs rgyas 'od srung dang shākya thub pa'i ring bsrel gyis thig drangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i ring bsrel/ rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub chen du ma/sa chen kun dga' snying bo/ paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yab sras/mar gtsang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ mar lo tsā ba/ rje mi la ras pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/mnyam med jo bo chen po dang / 'brom ston pa/ rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs gtsang ba bdun brgyud rnams kyi phyag tshwa/ na bza'/ dbu lo/ ga'an rten sna byin can mang bo dang gnas chen mtha' dag gi sa sna bcas phyogs gcig tu bsgrubs nas gzungs gzhug dang sku rgyur bsres pa ci rigs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras gsum gyi sku byin rlabs can dang / steng du 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ g.yas su dpal mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku rten du dpal ldan shawa ri dbang phyug gi phyag tshwa mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku dang / mkhas grub khyung bo rnal 'byor gyi phyag tshwa mgon dkar gyi sku gnyis bzhugs/ yum lha mo phyag bzhi ma dang bcas pa/ g.yo na du dam can chos rgyal gyi sku de'i nang rten du rje rin po ches rab gnas mdzad pa'i chos rgyal gyi sku bzhugs shing yum tsamaṇ+ḍi dang bcas pa/gsung rten gser las grub pa'i yum 'bring bsdus gsum/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar bo/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs bzhugs/ rten de rnams rab gnas kyi skabs su nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang zhing me tog gi char babs pa dang / ye shes pa mngon sum du zhugs pas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur/gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyang gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang rgyun 'don du skyabs 'gro/ltung bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi sgrub thabs sogs btsugs te rgyal bstan rin po che yun ring du gnas par mdzad/ yang dam pa de nyid dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa'i tshe yul de'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi nad yams 'thab rtsod sad ser btsa' than sogs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i phyir du ri khrod kyi nub ngos kyi ri rtsar skul byed ma'i snying bo bye ba/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i snying bo bye ba re rten du bcug pa/ rten byin can du ma bsres pa'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i lha mo skul byed ma zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gtso 'khor lnga/ logs bris la yum chen mo/ rnam rgyal ma/ gdugs dkar/ sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis/'khor sgrol ma nyer gcig bcas bzhengs te 'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dag ste thar ba'i sa son thebs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba'i smon lam gyis kha bsgyur nan tan mdzad/ yig drug dung phyur gcig dang gzungs ring khri phrag mang bo gsungs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso'i snang brnyan/ nang rten du rten khyad par du 'phags pa du mas gtams pa mthong ba tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bkrol cing thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon can gtso 'khor lnga ba'i lha khang / g.yon du rigs brgyud spel ba'i spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor lnga'i lha khang bcas — 777 —

lan gru grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs/bzhengs pa sogs chos srid zung gi sgo nas ri khrod de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang / dgung lo don lnga bzhes pa hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod mdzad nas tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i cha la zhi bar mnal ba'i tshul bstan pa na dpon slob dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs pa dang sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs/ skyabs mgon de nyid kyi yang srid sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes pa gnas 'dir zhabs pa bkod de/ nyid nas lam rim gnyis kyi nyams bzhes mthar phyin mdzad mthar gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshe sku gdung mchod rten byin ldan bzhengs/ yang dam pa 'di nyid kyi sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa'i sku ring la/ gong ma khang zhi rgyal bos kun gzigs lnga ba chen po rgya nag pho brang du gdan drangs skabs/ du ru dpon po klu skyabs dang bcas pa ri khrod 'dir phebs/ rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ da dung gnas 'di 'khor lo bde mchog gi grub gnas dang / rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin te/ ma 'ongs pa na byams mgon rang byung 'byung / zhes lung bstan/ rgyal dbang rin po che nyid la klu'i rgyal bos phul pa'i rgya ja sdong bo gnyis ngo mtshar ba'i rten du gnang ba da lta'i bar du yod pa'i ja sdong 'di gnyis yin zhes grags so/ /yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rong bo'i skal ldan rgya mtsho der phebs nas bdag gnas 'brel 'jog phyir 'ongs pa yin gsungs nas sku mtshams la yun ring bzhugs/ 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi bzhugs gnas byin rlabs shin tu che ba 'ig red/ dpal mgon dngos su bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug yod gsungs nas dpal mgon sgrub phug ngos 'dzin par mdzad/ de'i rjes rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtsho phebs nas ri khrod kyi lha khang 'du khang sku gsung thugs rten bcas rab gnas rgyas par gnang / rten dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dngos su thim/ chos skyong rnams la dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pas bsrung bar bka' bsgos 'phrin bcol nan tan mdzad/ nyid nas lung bstan pa ltar/ bra sgom chos kyi rdo rje/ phur sgom nyi ma rang shar/ a khyung bla ma gling dkar ba/ sum pa slob dpon/ rje sgom zhes pa/ grub dbang 'dam ma sku zhabs rnams kyang rim par phebs/ sku mtshams la bzhugs/ yi dam du ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs thugs dam la rtag 'grus mdzad/ rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'am mtshan gzhan ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid/ dpon klu skyabs kyis mchod gnas zhus shing / te thung dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi khri ba mdzad skabs/ ri khrod 'dir phebs nas kun bzang lha khang gi g.yas su gzim gur phub nas re bzhin dgun ra ba nas sa ga zla ba'i bar bde mchog sogs yi dam mang bo'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad/lo dang bor bcad rgya grol skabs ri khrod kyi bla ma dge 'dun mang bor bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dbang dang bka' chos mang bo bstsal cing zhal nas/ byang sham bha lar dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa dar skabs byang ri'i rgyab kyi bde mchog sgrub phug der bde mchog rang byung lnga ldan yab yum dang bcas pa byung skad/yang ri khrod 'dir dge 'dun bcu phrag mang bo 'dus na 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstan pa dar bar 'gyur ces — 778 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lung bstan/ byams pa lha khang gi mdun gyi brag steng byams mgon gyi sku rang byon 'byung bar yang gsungs/gnas 'di rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin pa'i stabs nged kyang lo re ba'in 'di mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub re byed rtsis yin zhes yang yang gsungs/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ dam can/ gur mgon sogs kyi rten rnams sngon byon skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten khyad par can yin gsungs nas rgyun gtor dang bco lnga nyer dgu rnams la dus gtor chag pa med pa'i phyag len gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa sogs bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskyangs/ stong 'khor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho gnas 'dir phebs nas sku mtshams bzhugs pa dang lha khang 'du khang bcas la rab gnas mdzad/yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'jigs med dbang po 'dir byon te 'jam dbyangs lha khang gi g.yas su gzim shag brgyab nas 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub pa yun ring mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs 'di dang ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs pa'i 'jam dbyangs gnyis la byin rlabs mchog dman med/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi sems nyid ngal gso'i sku dang / 'dir bzhugs pa'i sems nyid ngal gso gnyis zhal mthong ba tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khengs pa dang thar ba'i sa bon bskrun pa'i rten khyad par du 'phags pa yin zhes bsngags brjod mdzad/bde mchog gi rten dang brten pa bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i bde mchog sgrub phugadapal mgon sgrub phug rjes sor rje btsun byams mgon rang byung 'byung ba'i brag rnams kyang ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gzhan yang brag dgon sprul sku bstan 'dzin rin chen dang / phren gya hu thog thu ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi gsung bkod ltar dad ldan mang bos dwags po mthu stobs rgya mtsho ri khrod du gdan drangs/tshogs dbus su bzhugs nas bla ma dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa la zab chos mang bo gsungs/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ de rjes pra sti'i mkhan po/ stag lung mkhan po/ a khyung blo bzang mchog grub nyi ma/ ba za grub chen dam pa du ma yang gnas mjal du phebs nas rab gnas mdzad/ mkhas dang grub pa'i rje gser kha rin po che phebs nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub dang / dge 'dun rnams la bka' chos/ lha khang dang 'du khang bcas la rab gnas mdzad/ da dung rje hor grub chen dang /gser tog no mon han/ mtshan sgrogs rin po che sogs kyang gnas mjal du phebs/ sems nyid mkhan po sku mtshams la bzhugs shing dad ldan rnams la bka' chos dang / sku gsung thugs rten thams cad la rab gnas mdzad/ mdor na gnas mchog 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten rnams byin rten khyad par can du mas dkrigs pa dang / rim gnyis kyi lam la nang byan chud pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug du mas ye shes pa dngos su bstims pa'i rab gnas ldan pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa grags snyan gyi ba dan g.yo ba dang /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor ba sa lam gyi rtogs pa brnyes pa du ma snga phyir byon nas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bsngags 'os kyi yon tan dpag par dka' 'o/ /rab rgyal sa khyi spyi lo1958lor dpa' ris phyogs kyi mi rigs khag gi mi brgya phrag yung tin du song nas — 779 —

lan gru grong khyer yung tin rdzong gi khongs/brag dgon mchog dga' gling gi lha khang 'du khang dang sku gsung thugs rten brten pa bcas gtor shig btang tshar mod/ spyi lo1985lo nas brag dgon nye 'debs kyi dad ldan mang tshogs kyis dad gus kyi gdung ba drag pos bskul te 'bul ba gang mang phul nas ri rtse brgyad kyi lha khang dang bcas pa gsar du bzhengs grub cing btsun pa zhal zhe brgyad 'dus pa dang bla ma gnyis bzhugs/ da lta yung tin rdzong gi ljongs rgyu spro gseng gi gnas mchog cig tu gyur to/ /los than dgon pa/los than dgon pa(tsho1rker+sha)zhes pa ni/ yung tin rdzong gi mnga' 'og tu chags/'di yang bod brgyud dge 'u gas pa'i dgon pa 'ig yin te/ min rgyal rabs kyā chin khri lo so bzhi(spyi la1555)lor li kyā mkhan po sku phreng drug pas phyag 'debs mdzad/ da lta lha khang gcig dang grwa shag gsum las med do/ /drin rtogs dgon pa/drin rtogs dgon pa(ṭha wur+sha)zhes pa ni/ yun tin rdzong rdzong mkhar gyi lho phyogs spyi le sum cu tsam gyi sde ba zhig tu chags/ bod brgyud dge lugs pa'i dgon pa yin/lo rgyus kyi dpyad yig tu dgon pa 'di ni ming rgyal rabs hon kri khri lo lnga ba ste(spyi lo1492)lor tshugs/rnam pa tsam slar gsos nas/ 196 2lor zhing chen gyis zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rdzas srung skyob sde khag tu bkod do/ /hor sde dgon pa/hor sde dgon pa(ོ2stsor+sha)zhes pa ni/ yung tin rdzong rdzong mkhar gyi shar byang du chags/min rgyal rabs yun lo'u khri lo bcu drug ste spyi lo1418lor tshugs/ 1969lor dgon pa rtsa med du brlags nas lha khang gsum las med/ 1958lor krung dbyang dang zhing chen gyis zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rdzas srung skyob sde khag tu bkod do/ /zhan gyo dgon pa/zhan gyo dgon pa(༅mar+sha)zhes pa ni/ dge lugs pa'i dgon pa ste da lta yung tin rdzong gi mnga' khongs the tung sde ba'i 'dabs su chags/dgon pa'i lo rgyus dpyad yig med pas bod ming ma rnyed/ yin na'ang 'di bod brgyud dge lugs pa'i dgon pa dngos pa ni yun tin rdzong gi dpyad yig tu bkod byung / ming rgyal rabs kyi yun lo'u skabs spyi — 780 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/lo1411btab/ spyi lo195rngalor brlags pa nas lha khang gsum dang grwa shag lnga las med par byas/1985lor rdzong gis gna' rdzas su srung skyob byed sa'i sde khag tu bkod do/ /zhin yon dgon pa/'in yon dgon pa ches pa ni/ da lta'i lan gru grong khyer gyi chi le ho( 45sprigrahāgo) khul gyi zon kyā the'i ang121pa red/min rgyal rabs su tshugs pa'i(r+sā.o/ro715shra ) rdo ring ltar na/ dgon bdag bla ma'i mtshan la tshe'u bsam gtan(ṣ+ṭhaspyo(༅) zer/ de'i tsha bu dge slong dbyang shāka bla( ṣālko// ) sogs drug po'i gsung du‘8min rgyal dus kyi bod rgyal ( tshuk+ṣica ) gyis min wan li ( 1572lo'i rjes) skabs su dgon pa btab pa ste/bod phyogs kyi phyogs bcu dgon sde gras yin no byung / phyis su nyams chag thebs te dar shul tsam lus/min kya chin gyi skabs ni nyams pa thams cad gso ba'i dus khel pas/ yul mi grags can rnams kyis gna' dgon nub pa mi bzod par dgon pa slar gsos shing dgon pa'i mtshan la gtan dar gling ( ༅lor+sha) zhes gsol/ dgon pa skyong mkhan wang chos 'phel (rwa༅ṣ+ṭha ) dang wang bstan 'dzin ( 4༅khyaspo) zhes pa gnyi ga spucha yin te rab tu byung nas dgon par bzhugs/ chan lung khri lo zhe drug pa'i sos kur bod dang ha'e rnams 'khrugs pas dgon pa me bsgron/ yang stabs legs pa ni rje bstan 'dzin zhes sku bzhugs pas chan lung khri rabs drug cu'i dus (spyi lo1795shing yos) su dbyi lu dgon pa'i ( ṣā7zor+sha) mkhan chen du bskos/ de nas ca chin khri lo lnga bar yul de'i las grub nas slar rgo lam(d+ngha༅) brgyud de rang sar dngul srang lnga brgya gnang zhing dbyang shāka blar nges par du dgon pa slar gsos nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don du drin gzo pa dang bla ma'i drin lan 'jal dgos/ bdag gi phu bo 'das kyang las 'di 'grub pa'i bsod nams khyod la yod ces gsungs/ shāka blas bka' bsgos dang du blangs nas lo der sa las kyi mgo tshugs/de bzhin dmangs khrod du bsod bsnyom slong ba bcas brten nas dgon pa lo bzhi'i nang slar grub/ gser srang stong phrag btang ba'i rtsig bkod ngo mtshar can bskrun no/ /da skabs par du btab pa'i 〈〈lan ju'i gna' deng rdo ring〉〉zhes pa'i nang bklags na/ min wan li'i skabs su btang zhing chin rgyal rabs dang min go bar dar myong ba'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon pa zhig red/nub zur du shing khang nyis thog can zhig yod de/ der sangs rgyas byang sems brgya tshar bzhugs pa dang /khang ba'i 'og rim du sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal bo mu ni'i sku bzhugs/ mdun phyogs thog khang du khru bcu drug mtho ba can gyi tsan dan las bzhengs pa'i rnam 'dren bzhi ba zhig bzhugs so/ / 1992lo'i zla10ba'i nang dgon pa'i stor skyor ni bkra shis 'khyil bar gtad/ dgon pa'i rdo ring las lo rgyus cung gsal lo/— 781 —

ma jug byang /mjug byang /deb 'di dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs dgu bcu ba nas 'go bzung / de la thog mar gdan rabs dkar chag sogs mig mthong lag son dang rna lam du thos pa dag phyogs su bsdus pa ga'i byas/ bar du rang 'ing gi yul gru phal mo cher phyin te skya ser dbyer med kyi rgan pa bgres song dag la dri gtug dngos kyi sgo nas lag son byung ba dang / tha na ming tsam las ma lhag pa dag kyang rtsad gang chod kyis yig zin du phab pa rnams sa bon du bsags te da reb mig mthong gi glegs bam 'di grub/ /de'ang bcing grol gong rol du dang rab rgyal sa khyi nas rig gsar sogs rkyen ngan lan du mar brgyud pa'i dbang gis dgon sde'am ri khrod la la ni lhag lus su yod pa dag slar gso'am zhig gso tsam byas yo da la/ la la ni shul yang mi shes la/ sa de ga'i rgan pa dag la dris kyang mig cer ba nyid las a/ lan yod pa ha cang gis kyang dkon pa'i gnas su song bas/ 'ib cha 'ig 'bri 'dun bskyed kyang thabs ma ma chis pas re zhig bar phangs pa'i bag la 'jog rgyu las 'os ma yod/spyir lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin lda na pa'i rtsom gang yang rung ste de la sgro 'dogs zol bstod sogs kyi dri tsam yang ma yod par don ji lta ba bzhin du brjod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dir dngos yod kyi rgyu cha 'ba' zhig la brten te bris pa'o/ /de'ang kho bo cag la skyes stobs kyi shes rab dang sbyong thob kyi yon tan dam na pa/ rtsom 'bri'i nyam sa myong de bas kyang zhan pa'i dbang gis rgya che'i klog pa bo rnams kyi yid tshim pa zhig yong dka' bas bzod gsol yang yang zhu ba dang ma nyam du rnam dpyod kyi kho lag ma/chog tu rdzogs pa rnams kyis mig mthong 'di la nor bcos dang lhag lus kyi bag la nyal ba dag kha skong mdzad rgyu'i re ba de bas kyang che'o/ /de yang glegs bam 'di thog mar 'char gzhi'i sbyor ba brtsams pa nas bzung skabs der krung go bod rig pa'i 'ib 'jug lte gnas kyi 'gan spyi gzhon pa/ deng skabs gan su'u zhing chen mi dmangs 'thus tshogs rgyun u lha na khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa/ bod rig pa dang dpal 'byor rig pa'i 'ib 'jug gi cha la phyag rjes chen po'i gdeng brnyes pa blo bzang lhun grub rdo rje mchog gi mdzub ston dang thog ma'i gleng mchid gsungs pa/ sgos su snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam mgon khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i mchog sprul bse sku phreng drug pa rin po che7blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga — 782 —

krung go'i bod brgyud nang dgon dkar chag las kun su'u glegs bam/nas kyis 'khrul se la dog gcod gnang ba'i bka' drin dang / yang sgos rje gang nyid kyi phyag sor dngos nas shis tshig gnang ba la 'ang bka' drin bskal brgya'i bar du zhu zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi cha la deng dus bla sprul gzhon skyes kyi gras su tog lta ra mdzes pa7'jam bho sprul pa'i sku gtsos pa'i krung go bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling 'ib 'jug khang dang / gan su'u 'ing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u dang / gan su'u 'ing chen slob gso then bcas kyis mthun rkyen sbyar ba la bka' drin yang yang zhu zhing / glegs bam gyi mtshan byang phyag bris pa khyung po g.yu khri'i phyag rgyun spel ma dzad kyi ma/khan po smon lam rgya mtsho gang de'i bu slob kyi mchog gyur dge rgan sangs rgyas bkra shis la'ang bka' drin che zhu/ rtsom 'bri'i skabs su su 'u nan rdzong slob 'bring gi dge rgan mkhas grub byams dang / dpa' ris mchod rten thang gi a khu legs bshad/ krung go bod rig pa 'ib 'jug lte gnas kyi sku 'bas gdugs dkar tshe ring dang / blo gros/ 'jigs med bsam 'grub bcas kyis dgon 'ga' re'i rgyu cha dang mdzub ston gnang ba/ kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi 'gan khur ba sku 'bas 'brug rgyal mkhar gyis zhu dag lan du mar gnang ba dang par sgrig pa h+phang yon zha lags kyis par yig nan tan tu bsgrigs pa la'ang snying thag pa nas bka' drin mchog tu che zhu'o/ /zhes spyi lo2 0 09ba'i zla9ches8la klu tshang rdo rje rin chen nam rdor phrug gis sbyar ba'o/ /
